title: CoVLM-Bench: A Real-World Benchmark for Cooperative Driving Question Answering and Planning
comment: 32 pages, 11 figures, 13 tables. Main text 9 pages; appendices from page 17
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have made substantial progress in autonomous driving, but their success has primarily been studied in ego-centric scenes. Infrastructure-side observations provide views beyond the ego vehicle's field of view, yet conventional cooperative-driving systems typically transform them into geometric representations for downstream perception and planning. Directly incorporating these views into VLMs offers an opportunity to improve cooperative scene understanding and trajectory planning. However, question answering and trajectory planning have not been jointly evaluated on the same real-world vehicle-infrastructure scenes. We present CoVLM-Bench, a benchmark for cooperative driving question answering (CDQA) and cooperative planning (CP) on vehicle-infrastructure paired scenes. CoVLM-Bench provides scene-grounded CDQA annotations, three-part rationales as auxiliary supervision, and future trajectory targets derived from recorded ego motion. It contains 2,196 paired frames with 35,136 CDQA annotations, while CP predicts six waypoints over a three-second horizon. The annotations combine model-assisted drafting, record-based computation, and human verification. Built upon CoVLM-Bench, we introduce CoVLM-Drive, a unified VLM baseline that directly uses paired views for both CDQA and CP. Experiments show that CDQA adaptation improves answer accuracy and that CoVLM-Drive reaches a lower FDE than the compared V2X planners; QA initialization and rationale supervision each reduce planning error. Together, CoVLM-Bench and CoVLM-Drive support the training and comparison of VLMs for cooperative scene understanding and planning.

AI.tldr: 提出 CoVLM-Bench（车-路配对场景的协同驾驶问答与规划基准）及统一 VLM 基线 CoVLM-Drive，实现协同场景理解与轨迹规划。
AI.motivation: VLM 在自动驾驶中多以自车视角为主，路侧视角虽有价值但通常被转为几何表示再下游处理。直接在 VLM 中引入路侧视图有望提升协同场景理解与规划，但现有工作未在同一真实车-路场景上联合评估问答与轨迹规划。
AI.method: 构建 CoVLM-Bench：提供场景锚定的协同驾驶问答（CDQA）标注、三部分理由作为辅助监督，以及由实车运动记录导出的未来轨迹目标；含 2,196 对帧、35,136 条 CDQA 标注，协同规划（CP）预测 3 秒 6 个路点。标注采用模型辅助起草、基于记录计算与人工校验相结合。基于该基准提出统一 VLM 基线 CoVLM-Drive，直接用配对视角同时完成 CDQA 与 CP。
AI.result: CDQA 适配提升答案准确率；CoVLM-Drive 的 FDE 低于对比的 V2X 规划器；QA 初始化与理由监督均能降低规划误差。
AI.conclusion: CoVLM-Bench 与 CoVLM-Drive 共同支持面向协同场景理解与规划的 VLM 训练与比较。

title: HERO: Histology Encoder for Robust Representation in Oncology
summary: Foundation models trained on large pathology image corpora now provide strong, transferable representations for computational pathology. Over the past few years a series of such models has been released, each trained on more slides than the last; on standard classification and segmentation benchmarks, the leading models are now separated by small margins. In clinical use, however, the foundation model is applied to images from hospitals, scanners, and staining protocols outside its training data. Encoders generally embed these acquisition factors alongside biological information, which may introduce downstream errors and hinder safe clinical adoption. A pathology foundation model should therefore be robust to acquisition shift without giving up representation quality, yet robustness is seldom the axis along which models are compared. In this report, we introduce HERO (Histology Encoder for Robust Representation in Oncology), a ViT-G/14 pathology foundation model trained with the DINO and iBOT objectives and refined with high-resolution Gram anchoring on a morphology-balanced corpus of 500 million tiles from approximately 575,000 clinical whole-slide images. Across the evaluated public benchmarks, HERO shows the strongest robustness to center, scanner, and stain variation among the compared state-of-the-art foundation models, performs comparably on tile-level classification, segmentation, and gene-expression prediction, ranks first on average across 39 evaluated slide-level clinical tasks, and, under an equal-weighted framework-level analysis, has the best average rank across the six benchmark frameworks.

AI.tldr: HERO是一个ViT-G/14病理基础模型，采用DINO+iBOT训练并在5亿tile上以高分辨率Gram anchoring精调，在中心、扫描仪和染色变化下鲁棒性最优，同时保持或领先下游任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有病理基础模型主要比拼标准分类/分割基准且差距微小，但临床中模型面对训练数据外的医院、扫描仪和染色方案，编码器会把采集因素与生物信息混入表征，导致下游错误，阻碍临床应用。因此需要模型在采集偏移下保持鲁棒且不牺牲表征质量，而鲁棒性此前很少成为比较维度。
AI.method: 提出HERO（Histology Encoder for Robust Representation in Oncology），一个ViT-G/14病理基础模型；使用DINO和iBOT目标训练，并在形态学均衡的语料（约575,000张临床全切片图像、5亿个tile）上进行高分辨率Gram anchoring精调。
AI.result: 在所评估的公开基准上，HERO对中心、扫描仪和染色变化的鲁棒性优于所比较的最先进基础模型；在tile级分类、分割和基因表达预测上表现相当；在39个slide级临床任务上平均排名第一；在等权框架级分析下，于六个基准框架中取得最佳平均排名。
AI.conclusion: 病理基础模型应把对采集偏移的鲁棒性作为核心评价维度；HERO表明可在不牺牲表征质量的前提下实现这一目标，并在鲁棒性和多任务综合表现上达到领先水平。

title: HEIR: Learning Human-Entity Interactions with Functional Roles
comment: 24 pages, 4 figures. Code and dataset: https://github.com/Kratos-Wen/HEIR
summary: Understanding human-entity interactions requires recovering each person-action event's participants, roles, and shared identities. This structure can support embodied agents by clarifying who acts on which entities and how, informing anticipation and coordination in shared environments. Standard HOI metrics score individual links, leaving complete event composition undermeasured. We introduce HEIR (Human-Entity Interactions with Functional Roles), an image benchmark for complete grounded participant-role sets across object, interpersonal, and self-directed interactions. It contains 18,730 images, six roles, 105 actions, and 437 nouns, with shared entities, role changes, and repeated fillers; 51.6% of images contain multiple actors and 62.1% contain multiple actions. HEIR pairs relation AP with complete-set AP and structural evaluation. We also introduce CoRISP (Compositional Role-aware Interaction Set Prediction), which uses shared entity identities to combine role-conditioned evidence and predict normalized participant-role sets. Cardinality and role-multiplicity potentials couple assignments through event size and role composition, with exact per-event normalization. Across 16 baselines, relation and complete-event rankings diverge even after aligning action weights. CoRISP leads the evaluated systems on repeated-role events and shared-participant images in HEIR by 2.87 and 3.82 Set mAP points, respectively. On V-COCO, CoRISP achieves 73.72/76.23 role AP and 61.06/68.59 complete-set AP on two-slot actions under Scenarios 1/2. These results show the value of learning and evaluating event composition alongside individual relations. The code and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/Kratos-Wen/HEIR.

AI.tldr: 论文提出HEIR基准与CoRISP模型，用于完整建模和评估人-实体交互事件中的参与者-角色集合，弥补传统HOI指标只评估单链接的不足。
AI.motivation: 理解人-实体交互需要恢复每个动作事件的参与者、角色及共享身份，以明确谁对哪些实体施加何种作用，从而支持具身智能体的预判与协调。但标准HOI指标仅评估个体链接，导致完整事件组合被低估，缺乏对事件组成的评测。
AI.method: 构建HEIR图像基准，涵盖物体、人际与自我导向交互，含18,730张图像、6种角色、105种动作、437个名词，并包含共享实体、角色变化与重复填充。HEIR将关系AP与完整集合AP及结构评估配对。提出CoRISP模型，利用共享实体身份融合角色条件证据，预测规范化参与者-角色集合，并通过基数与角色多重性势函数以事件规模与角色组成耦合分配，实现逐事件精确归一化。
AI.result: 在16个基线中，即使对齐动作权重后，关系排名与完整事件排名仍存在分歧。CoRISP在HEIR的重复角色事件和共享参与者图像上分别领先2.87和3.82 Set mAP。在V-COCO上，CoRISP在Scenario 1/2下双臂动作取得73.72/76.23角色AP和61.06/68.59完整集合AP。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在评估单个关系的同时，学习并评估事件组成具有重要价值。代码与数据集已公开。

title: Systematic Multi-Agent Vision-and-Language Navigation: Formulation, Benchmark, and Method
summary: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) has largely focused on a single agent following a single instruction, yet many real-world applications require teams of robots to tackle tasks beyond the capabilities of any individual agent. We present Systematic Multi-Agent Vision-and-Language Navigation, providing, to our knowledge, the first systematic formalization of multi-agent VLN as a constrained coordination problem: each mission consists of subtasks carrying dependency and resource constraints (presence locks and holding chains). A verified four-stage crafting pipeline instantiates the task as MAVLN, comprising 11,724 episodes across 145 scenes with teams of up to four agents under three instruction regimes, accompanied by tailored constraint-aware metrics. We further present TRISS, a coordination-ready navigation system coupling an LLM-based subtask scheduler, a shared topological memory that turns each agent's exploration into team knowledge, and a conflict-aware execution mechanism that realizes simultaneous intentions as collision-free routes. Extensive experiments establish TRISS as a comprehensive baseline and reveal substantial room for improvement across scheduling, planning, and execution, highlighting the challenges of coordinating under MAVLN task constraints. Project page: https://xyz9911.github.io/mavln.

AI.tldr: 本文将多智能体视觉语言导航（VLN）形式化为带约束的协同问题，构建了MAVLN数据集并提出TRISS协同导航系统作为基线。
AI.motivation: 现有VLN研究集中于单智能体执行单条指令，而现实应用中常需多机器人团队完成单个智能体无法胜任的任务，缺乏对多智能体VLN的系统化形式化与基准。
AI.method: 将多智能体VLN形式化为带依赖与资源约束（presence locks、holding chains）的约束协同问题；通过四阶段可验证构建流水线生成MAVLN数据集（11,724个episode、145个场景、最多4个智能体、三种指令模式）及约束感知评价指标；提出TRISS系统，包含基于LLM的子任务调度器、将各智能体探索转化为团队知识的共享拓扑记忆、以及将并发意图转化为无碰撞路径的冲突感知执行机制。
AI.result: TRISS作为一个综合性基线被建立，实验显示在调度、规划与执行各环节均有较大提升空间，揭示了MAVLN任务约束下协同的挑战。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次系统形式化多智能体VLN，提供数据集与度量工具，并通过TRISS基线指明未来研究方向。

title: Persistence Forcing: Exploiting Feature Specialization in Pixel-Space Diffusion
summary: Pixel-space diffusion Transformers (DiTs) directly operate on high-dimensional visual data, yet their hidden representations typically undergo uniform refinement across depth. Natural images, however, are inherently organized at different levels of granularity. Global structure can often be represented compactly, whereas local textures and fine details require richer representations. Motivated by this, we introduce heterogeneous refinement in pixel-space DiTs, assigning different feature groups distinct refinement budgets across depth. Consequently, an ordered feature specialization emerges: sparsely refined features predominantly encode global visual structure, whereas more frequently refined features increasingly specialize toward localized, high-frequency details. We refer to these two groups as persistent and active features, respectively. Building on this emergent specialization, we introduce Persistence Forcing (PerF), which explicitly exploits this persistent--active feature organization for pixel-space image generation. This enables persistent features to continuously condition actively refined features, allowing stable global information to guide the ongoing refinement of finer visual details. During generative sampling, this interaction further induces a meaningful guidance direction that promotes coherent global structure and naturally complements classifier-free guidance. On ImageNet $256\times256$, PerF-L achieves FID of $1.91$, approaching $1.86$ of JiT-H with only half the parameters, while PerF-H further achieves FID of $1.63$ and $1.76$ on ImageNet $256\times256$ and $512\times512$, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出像素空间DiT的异质细化机制，将特征分为持续特征与活跃特征，并据此设计Persistence Forcing（PerF），在ImageNet上取得有竞争力的FID。
AI.motivation: 像素空间DiT在高维视觉数据上操作，但其隐表示在深度方向通常进行均匀细化；而自然图像本身具有多粒度组织结构——全局结构可紧凑表示，局部纹理与细节需要更丰富表示。因此需要异质化的细化策略。
AI.method: 在像素空间DiT中引入异质细化，为不同特征组分配不同的深度细化预算，形成有序的特征专门化：稀疏细化的特征编码全局视觉结构（persistent features），高频细化的特征专门化于局部高频细节（active features）。基于此提出Persistence Forcing（PerF），让持续特征持续条件化活跃特征，使稳定的全局信息引导细节细化；采样时该交互产生有意义的引导方向，增强全局结构一致性并与classifier-free guidance互补。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256×256上，PerF-L达到FID 1.91，接近JiT-H的1.86且仅用一半参数量；PerF-H在ImageNet 256×256与512×512上分别达到FID 1.63与1.76。
AI.conclusion: 异质细化可诱导像素空间DiT中持续特征与活跃特征的自发专门化，PerF利用该结构实现全局引导局部的生成，兼顾参数效率与生成质量。

title: CoDimRecon: Agentic Reconstruction of Sim-Ready 3D Scenes with Deformable Curves, Surfaces, and Volumes
summary: Reconstructing simulation-ready 3D scenes from real-world observations enables robotics, gaming, and immersive applications, yet existing methods largely assume rigid objects. This leaves an important gap for deformables, whose simulation-ready geometry depends on dimensionality (curves, surfaces, or volumes) and whose behavior may require models beyond elasticity. We present CoDimRecon, an agentic framework that reconstructs editable scenes containing rigid, articulated, and deformable objects from multi-view RGB observations. Scene-level geometric priors ground scale and layout, while object-level generated meshes guide the agent toward detailed, compact geometry; articulated rigid objects are decomposed into movable parts with explicit joints. For deformables, category-wise agent sessions reconstruct curves as centerlines with radii, surfaces as manifold shells with thickness, and volumes as watertight solids for volumetric meshing. Reusable simulator skills initialize compatible physical models and parameters, while agent-guided behavioral tests expose mismatches and trigger targeted revisions of motion, geometry, numerics, or material modeling. On evaluated Replica and ScanNet++ scenes, CoDimRecon achieves competitive compositional reconstruction accuracy while additionally producing deformable assets for rod, shell, and solid simulation. We further demonstrate robot interactions across all three representations, including a controlled paper-folding case in which behavioral testing motivates plastic bending.

AI.tldr: CoDimRecon 是一个智能体框架，可从多视角 RGB 观测重建含刚体、铰接体与可变形体的可编辑、可仿真 3D 场景，并按曲线/曲面/体三类维度生成对应可变形资产，配合仿真器技能与行为测试迭代修正，在 Replica 与 ScanNet++ 上取得有竞争力的重建精度。
AI.motivation: 现有仿真就绪的 3D 场景重建方法大多假设物体为刚体，对可变形物体存在明显空白：可变形体的可仿真几何取决于维度（曲线、曲面或体），其行为也可能超出弹性模型范围。
AI.method: 提出智能体框架 CoDimRecon：以场景级几何先验提供尺度与布局，物体级生成网格引导智能体获得精细紧凑几何；铰接刚体被分解为带显式关节的可动部件。对可变形体，按类别划分智能体会话，将曲线重建为中心线加半径、曲面重建为带厚度的流形壳、体重建为水密实体以进行体网格划分。通过可复用仿真器技能初始化兼容的物理模型与参数，并由智能体引导的行为测试暴露不匹配，触发对运动、几何、数值或材质建模的针对性修正。
AI.result: 在 Replica 与 ScanNet++ 场景上，CoDimRecon 取得有竞争力的组合式重建精度，并额外产出可用于杆、壳、实体仿真的可变形资产；进一步展示了三类表示下的机器人交互，包括一个受控折纸案例，其中行为测试促使引入塑性弯曲。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将仿真就绪场景重建扩展到刚体、铰接体与多维度可变形体，并通过行为测试驱动的迭代修正弥合几何与物理建模间的差距，为机器人与沉浸式应用提供可编辑、可仿真的场景资产。

title: AerialDojo-200K: A Large-Scale Benchmark Suite for Open-World Aerial Object-Goal Search
summary: Open-world aerial object-goal search is a foundational yet challenging task, requiring aerial agents to autonomously explore large-scale, unstructured three-dimensional environments and reach target objects specified by semantic descriptions or reference images, rather than following route-specific instructions. However, research in this task remains at a nascent stage and relies on small, environment-specific benchmarks with heterogeneous action spaces and data formats. These limitations hinder large-scale training and cross-benchmark evaluation, constraining the scalability and generalizability of aerial agents. To address this problem, we propose AerialDojo-200K, a large-scale benchmark suite for open-world aerial object-goal search, with 3 times as many scenes and 18.7 times as many task instances as the largest existing benchmark for this task. Specifically, we construct 42 simulation scenes spanning four scene families and 21 scene types, including 18 urban, 12 natural, six infrastructure, and six disaster scenes. To ensure data quality, 12 annotators spent two months manually annotating 109 landmarks, 2099 target objects, and 2099 object anchors across these scenes. We further construct 205,732 task instances, comprising over 100K semantic-goal and over 100K image-goal instances across Base, Standard, and Long-Horizon settings. Each task instance includes a collision-free reference trajectory and corresponding multi-view video recordings. We also develop a unified evaluation framework with a scene partition comprising 21 in-distribution scenes and 21 out-of-distribution scenes. Finally, our evaluation of five open-source and four closed-source multimodal large language models reveals that there is still a long way to go toward achieving general-purpose aerial agents. All can be found at https://fengtt42.github.io/AerialDojo/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AerialDojo-200K，一个面向开放世界空中目标搜索的大规模基准套件，规模远超现有基准，并配套统一评测框架，用以推动通用空中智能体的研究。
AI.motivation: 开放世界空中目标搜索要求空中智能体自主探索大规模非结构化三维环境，并依据语义描述或参考图像到达目标物体。然而该任务研究尚处初期，依赖规模小、环境特定、动作空间与数据格式异构的基准，难以支撑大规模训练与跨基准评测，限制了可扩展性与泛化能力。
AI.method: 构建 AerialDojo-200K 基准套件：涵盖42个仿真场景，分属4个场景族、21种场景类型（18个城市场景、12个自然场景、6个基础设施场景、6个灾害场景）；由12名标注人员历时两个月手工标注109个地标、2099个目标物体及2099个物体锚点；构建205,732个任务实例，包含超100K语义目标与超100K图像目标实例，覆盖 Base、Standard、Long-Horizon 三种设置；每个实例配有避碰参考轨迹与多视角视频记录；并开发统一评测框架，场景划分为21个分布内与21个分布外场景。
AI.result: 相比该任务最大的现有基准，场景数为其3倍，任务实例数为其18.7倍。对五个开源和四个闭源多模态大模型的评测显示，距离实现通用空中智能体仍有很大差距。
AI.conclusion: AerialDojo-200K 通过大规模场景、丰富任务实例与统一评测框架，为该任务提供了可扩展、可跨基准比较的研究平台，并揭示当前多模态大模型在开放世界空中目标搜索上仍存在显著不足。

title: One Geometry, Different Outcomes: Readout-Dependent Effects of the Modality Gap in Vision-Language Models
summary: Contrastive vision-language models learn shared embedding spaces by aligning matched image-text pairs, yet their representations remain separated by a modality gap. Prior work reports divergent effects of modifying this gap: reducing it can improve zero-shot classification and cross-modal alignment, whereas removing gap-related structure can degrade image-text retrieval. In this paper, we provide a unified geometric explanation for these task-dependent effects. Across CLIP and SigLIP encoders, we find that a single dominant direction captures 94.4-99.9% of the squared norm of the image-text mean separation, revealing that the mean-separation component is approximately rank-one. A decomposition of the similarity score then identifies three task-specific roles. In zero-shot classification, query-side fixed gap-offset subtraction is exactly equivalent to an additive class bias. In standard cross-modal retrieval, projecting out the gap direction and renormalising residuals discards candidate-specific norm information, inducing a multiplicative ranking distortion; a geometry-derived exponent tracks the grid-search optimum (Spearman rho = 0.93) and restores performance in some settings, although the gains transfer unevenly. In mixed-modal retrieval, the gap direction sorts candidates by modality; its removal can improve cross-modal ranking, unlike random or non-gap controls. Residual semantic structure after removal defines the limits of the rank-one account. Together, these results explain why gap modification can improve, degrade, or restore performance across downstream settings. By clarifying when and why gap modification changes model behavior, this account provides a principled basis for selecting gap interventions in similarity-based vision-language systems across evaluated downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一几何解释，说明视觉语言模型中模态间隙修改对下游任务产生改善、退化或恢复等不同效果的原因。
AI.motivation: 已有工作报告修改模态间隙的效果存在分歧：缩小间隙可改善零样本分类与跨模态对齐，而移除间隙相关结构会降低图文检索性能，缺乏统一解释。
AI.method: 在CLIP与SigLIP编码器上分析图文均值分离的几何结构，发现单一主方向占其平方范数的94.4-99.9%，即均值分离近似秩一；随后对相似度分数进行分解，分别刻画零样本分类、标准跨模态检索与混合模态检索中间隙方向的作用。
AI.result: 零样本分类中查询侧固定间隙偏移减法等价于加性类别偏置；标准检索中投影消除间隙方向并重归一化会丢弃候选特定范数信息，造成乘性排序失真，几何推导的指数与网格搜索最优值吻合（Spearman rho=0.93）并可部分恢复性能；混合模态检索中间隙方向按模态排序候选，移除可改善跨模态排序，且优于随机或非间隙对照。
AI.conclusion: 秩一解释界定了间隙修改的作用边界，残余语义结构决定其适用限度，为相似度视觉语言系统中间隙干预策略的选择提供有原则的依据。

title: Hardware-Aware Functional Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Efficient Medical Image Enhancement and Segmentation
summary: Functional Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (FunKAN) achieve state-of-the-art accuracy on MRI Gibbs artifact removal and anatomical segmentation, but their 11.6 M parameters and 8.7 GFLOPs are too large for edge medical devices. We present FunKANLite, a two-stage, hardware-aware compression of FunKAN for point-of-care use. FunKANLite-TR reduces the spatial prior and replaces the ResBlock offset predictor with a depthwise-separable block. It has 1.9x fewer parameters than FunKAN and no loss in accuracy. We then distill FunKANLite-TR into FunKANLite-ST, which lowers the Hermite basis rank, factorizes the spatial prior into a low-rank form, and halves the filter widths. FunKANLite-ST has 5.6x fewer parameters and 3.7x fewer GFLOPs than FunKAN. It stays within 1.4 percentage points IoU of FunKAN on BUSI, GlaS, and CVC-ClinicDB, and reaches 33.95 dB PSNR on IXI. On an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano and a Raspberry Pi 5, FunKANLite-ST reduces energy per inference by up to 68% and raises throughput by 2.9x.

AI.tldr: FunKANLite：两阶段硬件感知压缩，将FunKAN压缩5.6倍参数、3.7倍GFLOPs，边缘设备上精度损失≤1.4个百分点IoU，能耗降低68%、吞吐提升2.9倍。
AI.motivation: FunKAN在MRI Gibbs伪影去除和解剖分割上达到SOTA精度，但其11.6M参数和8.7 GFLOPs对边缘医疗设备而言过大，难以用于即时诊断（point-of-care）场景。
AI.method: 提出两阶段硬件感知压缩框架。第一阶段FunKANLite-TR：缩减空间先验，并用深度可分离卷积块替换ResBlock偏移预测器。第二阶段将FunKANLite-TR蒸馏为FunKANLite-ST：降低Hermite基秩、将空间先验分解为低秩形式、并将滤波器宽度减半。
AI.result: FunKANLite-TR参数量比FunKAN少1.9倍且精度无损。FunKANLite-ST参数量少5.6倍、GFLOPs少3.7倍，在BUSI、GlaS、CVC-ClinicDB上IoU与FunKAN差距在1.4个百分点以内，在IXI上达到33.95 dB PSNR。在NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano和Raspberry Pi 5上，单次推理能耗最多降低68%，吞吐提升2.9倍。
AI.conclusion: FunKANLite通过两阶段硬件感知压缩，在几乎不损失精度的前提下大幅降低计算与存储开销，验证了FunKAN类模型在边缘医疗设备上实现即时诊断的可行性。

title: Xiaomi-OCR-0 Technical Report
summary:
Compact OCR-specific vision-language models achieve strong document parsing performance, but often rely on costly supervision and focus primarily on visual-text reconstruction. We introduce Xiaomi-OCR-0, a unified 0.8B model for document parsing and OCR-centric understanding. We build an approximately 170M-sample OCR-centric corpus using an automated data engine that combines expert consensus, render-based verification, and targeted synthesis. Starting from Qwen3.5-0.8B, our progressive training recipe combines Q-Mask-based text anchoring, continued pretraining, and mixed-task reinforcement learning (Mix-RL). Xiaomi-OCR-0 achieves 95.24 on Real5-OmniDocBench, 96.83 on OmniDocBench v1.6, and 87.94 on Wild-OmniDocBench, while reaching an average score of 83.2 across five OCR-oriented VQA benchmarks. Ablations further show that, with sufficient parsing training, OCR-centric understanding supervision provides additional gains for document parsing.
  Homepage: https://huggingface.co/spaces/SeerRay-Lab/Xiaomi-OCR-0.

AI.tldr: Xiaomi-OCR-0 是一个统一的 0.8B 文档解析与 OCR 理解模型，通过自动化数据引擎构建约 1.7 亿样本语料，并采用渐进式训练策略，在多个文档解析与 OCR 理解基准上取得领先结果。
AI.motivation: 现有紧凑型 OCR 专用视觉语言模型虽在文档解析上表现良好，但依赖昂贵监督信号，且主要聚焦于视觉-文本重建，忽视了 OCR 相关的理解能力。论文希望以更低成本、统一的方式同时提升文档解析与 OCR 中心理解能力。
AI.method: 以 Qwen3.5-0.8B 为基座，构建约 1.7 亿样本的 OCR 中心语料，数据引擎融合专家共识、基于渲染的验证与定向合成；训练采用渐进式配方，包含基于 Q-Mask 的文本锚定、继续预训练以及混合任务强化学习（Mix-RL）。
AI.result: 在 Real5-OmniDocBench 上得 95.24，OmniDocBench v1.6 上得 96.83，Wild-OmniDocBench 上得 87.94；在五个 OCR 导向 VQA 基准上平均分达 83.2。消融实验表明，在充分解析训练基础上，增加 OCR 中心理解监督可进一步提升文档解析性能。
AI.conclusion: Xiaomi-OCR-0 证明小规模统一模型在文档解析与 OCR 理解上均可达到强性能，且解析与理解任务可相互促进，为 OCR 中心的多任务统一建模提供了有效范式。

title: From Sharp Eyes to Expert Mind: Internalizing Expert Knowledge in MLLMs for Tampered Text Detection
summary: Tampered Text Detection (TTD) is essential for safeguarding document authenticity in security-critical workflows. Existing expert models are effective at capturing subtle manipulation traces but often generalize poorly across diverse document domains, while Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) offer stronger semantic understanding and transferability yet remain insensitive to fine-grained forensic artifacts. This complementarity motivates us to investigate how expert forensic perception can be internalized into an MLLM rather than merely accessed through an external module. We identify a fundamental Double Mismatch that hinders this goal: a Spatial Precision Mismatch between coarse visual tokens and tiny tampered regions, and a Perceptual Granularity Mismatch between semantics-oriented pre-training and low-level forensic perception. To address these challenges, we propose Expert Knowledge Internalization (EKI), a progressive two-stage framework that transfers forensic expertise into the MLLM itself. In Stage 1, Text-Focused and Image-Focused strategies establish precise spatial focus on small text regions. In Stage 2, the proposed Forensic-General Representation Alignment (FGRA) loss aligns shallow LLM representations with those of a pre-trained forensic expert, enabling the model to acquire fine-grained artifact perception before such cues are diluted by deeper semantic abstraction. Extensive experiments on multiple in-domain and cross-domain benchmarks demonstrate that EKI achieves state-of-the-art performance and stronger generalization than existing expert-model-based and MLLM-based methods. Moreover, the expert is required only during training, allowing the resulting MLLM to maintain inference efficiency nearly identical to the vanilla model without relying on any external expert at inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出专家知识内化(EKI)框架，通过两阶段渐进式训练将取证专家的细粒度感知能力注入多模态大语言模型，以解决篡改文本检测中的双重错配问题，实现跨域泛化的SOTA性能且推理时无需外部专家。
AI.motivation: 篡改文本检测对文档真实性至关重要。现有专家模型能捕捉细微篡改痕迹但跨文档域泛化差；MLLM具备更强语义理解与迁移能力却对细粒度取证痕迹不敏感。二者互补，但核心动机在于探索如何将专家取证感知"内化"进MLLM，而非仅通过外部模块调用。作者识别出阻碍该目标的双重错配：视觉token粗粒度与微小篡改区域之间的空间精度错配，以及语义导向预训练与低层取证感知之间的感知粒度错配。
AI.method: 提出专家知识内化(EKI)，一个渐进式两阶段框架。阶段一通过文本聚焦与图像聚焦策略，建立对小文本区域的精确空间聚焦。阶段二提出取证-通用表示对齐(FGRA)损失，将LLM浅层表示与预训练取证专家的表示对齐，使模型在细粒度线索被深层语义抽象稀释之前获得伪影感知能力。
AI.result: 在多个域内和跨域基准上，EKI取得SOTA性能，泛化能力强于现有基于专家模型和基于MLLM的方法。专家仅在训练阶段需要，推理时所得MLLM的推理效率与原始模型几乎相同，无需依赖任何外部专家。
AI.conclusion: 将取证专家知识内化进MLLM是可行且有效的，能同时兼顾细粒度取证感知与语义泛化，并保持推理效率。

title: Boosting Metric Depth Completion via Training-Free Adaptive Response Geometry
summary: Depth completion aims to recover dense metric depth from sparse sensor measurements, increasingly leveraging visual foundation models as geometric priors. However, aligning these priors to true metric scale typically relies on rigid affine assumptions in predefined coordinate systems, leaving systematic calibration errors. Linearity in depth calibration depends on the response coordinate. We introduce adaptive response geometry, which makes the fixed choice of depth, log depth, or disparity an image-level unknown. A continuous response family unifies these coordinates and defines an explicit depth-dependent gain. We derive the response-gradient relation and estimate the response parameters in metric space. Hard-Dirichlet residual reconstruction completes the calibrated prior. Under deliberately incomplete metric observations, the training-free pipeline achieves macro AbsRel 0.0301 and macro NMed 14.04°, improving both aggregate measures over PriorDA, LDCM, and Any2Full. Linearity diagnostics examine how the selected response changes the depth relation and its metric error.

AI.tldr: 提出自适应响应几何，将深度校准中固定的深度/对数深度/视差坐标选择变为图像级未知量，实现无需训练的深度补全。
AI.motivation: 深度补全借助视觉基础模型作为几何先验，但将这些先验对齐到真实度量尺度通常依赖预定义坐标系中的刚性仿射假设，导致系统性的校准误差。作者观察到深度校准的线性性取决于响应坐标的选择，因此固定坐标系会带来误差。
AI.method: 引入自适应响应几何，将深度、对数深度或视差的固定选择变为图像级未知量；用一个连续响应族统一这些坐标并定义显式的深度相关增益；推导响应-梯度关系并在度量空间中估计响应参数；再用Hard-Dirichlet残差重建完成对先验的校准。整体为免训练流程。
AI.result: 在刻意不完整的度量观测下，该免训练流程取得macro AbsRel 0.0301与macro NMed 14.04°，两项聚合指标均优于PriorDA、LDCM和Any2Full。线性诊断分析了所选响应如何改变深度关系及其度量误差。
AI.conclusion: 自适应选择响应坐标可有效缓解刚性仿射假设带来的系统性校准误差，在免训练条件下提升深度补全的度量精度，并揭示了响应几何与深度度量误差之间的关系。

title: Exploring Learning Models for Topological Relationship Recognition from Image Data
summary: Figuring out how objects relate to each other, like whether they touch, overlap, stay completely separate or one sits inside another, matters a lot in fields like GIS, biomedical imaging, and robotics. Even though machine learning has come a long way, people haven't really focused on spotting these topological relationships in images. The main roadblocks? Not enough good datasets and no clear way to measure results. So, we rolled up our sleeves and built a new dataset. It's pretty sizable: over 11,000 labelled images showing all those essential relationships. We ran tests with some classic machine learning models, Naive Bayes, KNN, Random Forest, SVM, and Artificial Neural Networks, and threw in some deep learning stars like VGG16 and InceptionResNetV2. For the dataset itself, we used segmentation, contour detection, and grayscale normalization to tease out solid feature vectors. The results? Deep learning methods, especially VGG16, pulled ahead, with validation accuracy hitting 89.55%. That's a big jump compared to the traditional models. This shows how powerful transfer learning is for analyzing topological relationships in images, and it gives researchers a new standard to aim for in future work on spatial reasoning and topological classification.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个包含超过11000张标注图像的拓扑关系数据集，并比较传统机器学习与深度学习模型在拓扑关系识别任务上的表现，其中VGG16取得89.55%的最高验证准确率。
AI.motivation: 图像中物体间的拓扑关系（接触、重叠、分离、包含等）在GIS、生物医学成像和机器人等领域具有重要意义，但机器学习领域对该任务的关注不足，主要瓶颈在于缺乏高质量数据集和明确的评价标准。
AI.method: 构建包含11000余张标注图像的拓扑关系数据集；采用分割、轮廓检测和灰度归一化提取稳健特征向量；在传统模型（Naive Bayes、KNN、Random Forest、SVM、ANN）与深度学习模型（VGG16、InceptionResNetV2）上进行对比实验。
AI.result: 深度学习方法整体优于传统模型，其中VGG16表现最佳，验证准确率达到89.55%，相较传统模型有明显提升。
AI.conclusion: 迁移学习在图像拓扑关系分析中具有显著优势，该工作为空间推理与拓扑分类的后续研究提供了新的数据集基准和性能参考。

title: FD-AA: A Lightweight Focal-Diffuse And Attenuation-Aware Head for Incidental Abdominal Abnormality Detection in Chest CT
summary: Routine chest CT captures upper-abdominal structures that may contain clinically relevant incidental abnormalities. Detecting these findings requires feature extraction from organs with different spatial extents and attenuation patterns. We propose FD-AA, a lightweight organ-aware classification head adaptable for frozen 3-D CT encoders. Within each organ, an attenuation-aware module preserves sparse focal evidence, while masked generalized-mean pooling captures diffuse anomaly patterns. In seven abdominal organs, FD-AA with Pillar-0 achieved state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in both the CT-RATE test set (AUC = 0.798) and the external RAD-ChestCT dataset (AUC = 0.713). More specifically, FD-AA improved macro AUC/AP from 0.763/0.346 to 0.798/0.405 over direct classification using frozen Pillar-0 only (p = 0.034/0.016). Such performance gain generalizes across multiple frozen encoders (AUC improvement on MedicalNet +9.8%, CT-CLIP +14.7%, ResNet +3.7%), demonstrating the effectiveness of FD-AA across different feature representations. These results support the effectiveness of integrating focal-diffuse aggregation with explicit HU evidence for incidental abdominal abnormality detection.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级器官感知分类头FD-AA，可从冻结3-D CT编码器中检测上腹部偶发异常，性能达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 常规胸部CT会捕获上腹部结构，其中可能含临床相关的偶发异常。检测这些异常需从空间范围和衰减模式各异的器官中提取特征，存在挑战。
AI.method: 提出FD-AA，一种可适配冻结3-D CT编码器的轻量级器官感知分类头。其内包含衰减感知模块（保留稀疏局灶性证据）与掩码广义均值池化（捕获弥漫性异常模式）。
AI.result: 在七个腹部器官上，FD-AA结合Pillar-0在CT-RATE测试集（AUC=0.798）和外部RAD-ChestCT数据集（AUC=0.713）均达SOTA。较直接用冻结Pillar-0分类，宏AUC/AP由0.763/0.346提升至0.798/0.405（p=0.034/0.016）。该增益在多种冻结编码器上通用（MedicalNet +9.8%、CT-CLIP +14.7%、ResNet +3.7%）。
AI.conclusion: 将局灶-弥漫聚合与显式HU证据相结合，可有效提升偶发腹部异常检测性能，且对不同特征表示具有泛化性。

title: PreviewDiff: Multimodal Critic-Guided Search over Diffusion Latents
summary: Diffusion models can produce striking images and videos, but they still struggle with the compositional details that make a generation faithful to a prompt, such as object counts, attribute binding, spatial relations, and temporally grounded actions. A common way to improve prompt satisfaction is to spend more compute at test time through Best-of-N sampling, but final-sample selection is fixed. Best-of-N can only choose among completed outputs and cannot repair a promising trajectory before it fails. We introduce PreviewDiff, a training-free test-time search method that turns diffusion sampling from scalar search into a multimodal critic-guided search over intermediate latents. At selected denoising checkpoints, PreviewDiff decodes a partial preview, asks a multimodal judge to score and critique it, and uses the resulting natural-language feedback to branch over semantic prompt edits and locally re-noised latent continuations. These branches are then scored and selectively rolled forward, allowing verifier compute to guide generation while the sample is still editable. Across image and video generation benchmarks, PreviewDiff consistently improves over budget-matched Best-of-N selection and strong scalar-search baselines. Ablations show that earlier interventions and increased search width provide the largest gains, while deeper search and additional semantic variants offer complementary improvements. PreviewDiff demonstrates that multimodal feedback is most useful not only as a final verifier, but as an active controller inside the denoising process.

AI.tldr: PreviewDiff是一种免训练的多模态评判器引导的测试时搜索方法，将扩散采样从标量搜索转变为对中间潜变量的多模态搜索，在图像与视频生成基准上优于同等预算的Best-of-N和标量搜索基线。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在提示词忠实度上仍存在不足，如物体计数、属性绑定、空间关系和时间接地动作等组合细节。常规做法是用Best-of-N采样增加测试时计算量，但最终样本选择是固定的：只能在已完成输出中选择，无法在一条有潜力的轨迹失败前对其进行修复。
AI.method: PreviewDiff在选定的去噪检查点解码部分预览，由多模态评判器对预览打分并给出自然语言批评；利用该反馈在语义提示词编辑和局部重加噪的潜变量延续上进行分支；随后对这些分支打分并选择性向前推进，从而在样本仍可编辑时以验证器算力引导生成。整个方法免训练。
AI.result: 在图像和视频生成基准上，PreviewDiff持续优于同等预算的Best-of-N选择与强标量搜索基线。消融实验显示，更早的干预和更大的搜索宽度带来最大增益，更深的搜索与更多语义变体提供互补提升。
AI.conclusion: 多模态反馈不仅可用作最终验证器，更可作为去噪过程内部的主动控制器；在采样过程中进行可编辑的分支搜索能有效提升提示词忠实度。

title: Sparse-View Interpretable 3D Animal Behavior Representations for Neural Encoding and Decoding
summary: A deeper understanding of brain function requires a precise, structured characterization of behavior.Yet, extracting behavioral representations from video in a form suitable for scientific analysis remains a fundamental challenge. Many prior studies represent behavior via pose estimation or nonlinear video embeddings. However, pose tracking discards rich information beyond predefined keypoints, while nonlinear video embeddings lack interpretability. We address this limitation with SABLE (Sparse-view Animal Behavior Latent Embeddings), a self-supervised framework that leverages a geometric inductive bias to learn behavior representations.By augmenting a multi-view transformer with priors from monocular depth and pose estimation, SABLE reconstructs 3D animal behavior from extremely sparse views while learning explicit 3D latent structure. Without ground-truth 3D labels, it reliably recovers 3D behavior from two-view videos, whereas state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods fail or yield degenerate solutions. Across the International Brain Lab and Cheese3D datasets, we demonstrate that SABLE learns 3D representations that match or exceed prior SOTA performance in neural encoding and decoding. Once pretrained across animals, SABLE serves as an off-the-shelf model that generalizes zero-shot to unseen animals without animal-specific calibration or retraining. Our method establishes 3D-aware video embeddings that capture complex behavior, opening new avenues for studying brain-behavior relationships.

AI.tldr: SABLE 是一个自监督框架，通过几何归纳偏置从极稀疏视角视频中学习可解释的三维行为表征。
AI.motivation: 精确且结构化地刻画行为是理解脑功能的前提，但从视频中提取适合科学分析的行为表征仍是难题。现有方法中，姿态追踪会丢失预定义关键点之外的信息，而非线性视频嵌入缺乏可解释性。
AI.method: SABLE（Sparse-view Animal Behavior Latent Embeddings）在多视角 Transformer 中引入单目深度估计与姿态估计先验作为几何归纳偏置，从而在极稀疏视角下重建三维动物行为，并学习显式的三维隐结构；整个过程无需真值三维标签。
AI.result: 仅用双视角视频，SABLE 即可稳定恢复三维行为，而现有 SOTA 方法失效或产生退化解。在 International Brain Lab 与 Cheese3D 数据集上，其学习到的三维表征在神经编码与解码任务上达到或超过此前 SOTA；跨动物预训练后可作为即用模型，零样本泛化到未见动物，无需个体校准或重训练。
AI.conclusion: 该方法建立了捕捉复杂行为的、具有三维感知能力的视频嵌入，为研究脑—行为关系开辟了新途径。

title: LeRF: Learning Reference Coordinate Frames for Perspective Taking Reasoning
summary: Perspective taking is a fundamental component of spatial intelligence, requiring models interpret spatial relations from a specified viewpoint, such as that of another entity or an imagined observer. Despite the increasing spatial reasoning capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs), they still struggle with perspective taking, often defaulting to the camera viewpoint when a query requires reasoning from a different perspective. We introduce Learning Reference Coordinate Frames for Perspective Taking (LeRF), a framework that trains VLMs to construct and use explicit reference frames for viewpoint-dependent reasoning. Given an image and a query, LeRF decides whether a coordinate frame is necessary. If so, it grounds the reference entity and predicts the frame's origin and entity-centered reference frame. A lightweight renderer overlays the frame onto the image, enabling subsequent reasoning over these visual cues without external perception models or explicit 3D reconstruction. To learn this process, we first perform supervised fine-tuning to teach selective tool invocation and reference coordinate frame prediction, followed by reinforcement learning on spatial VQA pairs to improve frame-guided reasoning. Across diverse perspective-taking benchmarks, LeRF consistently improves over its backbone and achieves strong performance against existing open-source methods. Further evaluations also show improved reference-frame grounding and orientation estimation, supporting the effectiveness of learned reference frames for viewpoint-dependent reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出LeRF框架，训练VLM构建并使用显式参考坐标系进行视角采择推理，通过SFT学习选择性调用工具与坐标系预测，再用强化学习优化帧引导推理，在多个基准上超越基座模型和开源方法。
AI.motivation: 视角采择是空间智能的基本组成部分，要求模型从指定视角（如其他实体或想象观察者的视角）解释空间关系。尽管VLM空间推理能力不断增强，但在视角采择上仍有困难，当查询需要从不同视角推理时，模型常默认采用相机视角。
AI.method: LeRF框架：给定图像和查询，先判断是否需要坐标系；若需要，则定位参考实体并预测坐标系原点及以实体为中心的参考坐标系；轻量级渲染器将坐标系叠加到图像上，使后续推理可基于这些视觉线索进行，无需外部感知模型或显式3D重建。训练上先进行监督微调学习选择性工具调用与参考坐标系预测，再在空间VQA对上强化学习以提升帧引导推理。
AI.result: 在多样化的视角采择基准上，LeRF持续优于其基座模型，并对现有开源方法取得强劲表现；进一步评估显示参考坐标系定位和朝向估计均有改善。
AI.conclusion: 学习到的参考坐标系对视角依赖推理有效，为VLM视角采择提供了一种无需外部感知模型或3D重建的可行方案。

title: Mutually Adversarial Self-Training with Evolving Data for Unified Multimodal Models
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) combine image generation and visual understanding in a shared backbone. Since generation and understanding are inverse tasks, recent studies self-train UMMs by letting the two branches cooperatively supervise each other. We introduce MATE (Mutually Adversarial self-Training with Evolving data), a reinforcement-learning-based post-training framework in which the two branches instead challenge each other, and the challenges evolve as the model trains. MATE lets generation and understanding take turns to be challenger and solver. Given an image, the understanding branch proposes several candidate descriptions that the generation branch must turn back into similar images, and vice versa. The candidates are screened for consistency with the image or prompt they were proposed from, and the solver is trained on the candidate it handles worst. The adversary thus comes from the model's own outputs, and no separate adversary is trained. Moreover, the candidates that defeat one branch become the sources of the next challenges to the other in the next epoch, which keeps the challenges evolving with the model and turns the training into self-play in data space. On Janus-Pro-1B, MATE improves GenEval by 2.4 points, DPG-Bench by 1.7 points, and the average over nine understanding benchmarks by 0.7 points, while strengthening consistency across repeated image-text cycles.

AI.tldr: MATE是一个基于强化学习的后训练框架，让统一多模态模型的生成分支与理解分支互为对手、轮流充当挑战者与求解者，实现数据空间中的自博弈训练，在Janus-Pro-1B上提升生成与理解多项指标。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型将图像生成与视觉理解共享同一骨干网络，二者互为逆任务。现有自训练方法让两个分支协作互相监督，但协作式监督的挑战强度有限，难以持续提供有效训练信号。
AI.method: 提出MATE（Mutually Adversarial self-Training with Evolving data），让生成与理解分支互相挑战而非协作。给定图像，理解分支提出若干候选描述，生成分支须据此重建相似图像，反之亦然。候选需与来源图像或提示做一致性筛选，求解者在处理最差的候选上训练。对手来自模型自身输出，无需单独训练对手模型。上一轮击败某分支的候选将成为下一轮对另一分支的挑战源，挑战随模型演化，形成数据空间中的自博弈。
AI.result: 在Janus-Pro-1B上，MATE使GenEval提升2.4分，DPG-Bench提升1.7分，九项理解基准平均提升0.7分，同时增强了重复图文循环中的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 将协作式自训练改为互对抗式自训练，并让挑战者候选随训练迭代演化，可在无需额外对手模型的情况下同时提升统一多模态模型的生成与理解能力及跨轮一致性。

title: Think Before You Restore: Risk-Aware Manchu Manuscript Restoration with Stroke-Guided Attention
summary: Full-page blind restoration of historical Manchu manuscripts is challenging due to scarce annotations, unknown degradation regions, and fragile connected strokes. Generic restoration models may improve visual quality but often modify intact content, leading to over-restoration. We propose SAGE-Restore (Stroke-Aware Gated rEstoration), a selective restoration framework that first assesses where restoration is needed and then uses this assessment to guide restoration candidate generation and pixel-level selection. Its encoder predicts patch-level repair probabilities from complementary appearance and stroke-structural cues to condition restoration candidate generation, while the corresponding repair logits are refined into a pixel-level soft gate that selectively controls where the restoration candidate is applied. We further introduce a fidelity-aware evaluation protocol that jointly measures degraded-region recovery, intact-content preservation, and their balance. SAGE-Restore achieves the highest R-Recovery (0.463) and RFS (0.626), while maintaining high U-Fidelity (0.968), demonstrating an effective balance between restoration and content preservation.

AI.tldr: 提出 SAGE-Restore 选择性修复框架，先评估需修复区域，再以此指导候选生成与像素级选择，在满文古籍整页盲修复中兼顾退化区域恢复与完好内容保真。
AI.motivation: 满文历史手稿整页盲修复面临标注稀缺、退化区域未知、连笔笔画脆弱等困难；通用修复模型虽能提升视觉质量，却常修改完好内容，造成过度修复。
AI.method: SAGE-Restore（Stroke-Aware Gated rEstoration）包含：(1) 编码器基于外观与笔画结构互补线索预测块级修复概率，用于条件化修复候选生成；(2) 将对应修复 logits 细化为像素级软门控，选择性控制修复候选的应用位置。同时提出保真感知评估协议，联合度量退化区域恢复、完好内容保持及其平衡。
AI.result: SAGE-Restore 取得最高 R-Recovery（0.463）与 RFS（0.626），同时保持高 U-Fidelity（0.968），在修复与内容保持间实现有效平衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过“先定位、再生成、后门控”的选择性修复范式，可有效缓解过度修复问题，为标注稀缺、退化未知的古籍盲修复提供兼顾恢复与保真的解决方案。

title: Representation by Design in Generation: Cross-View Class-Token Alignment in Diffusion Transformers
summary: Generative and representation learning remain asymmetrically connected: semantic representations are used to improve diffusion generation, whereas the models' own representations are often treated as a by-product of synthesis. We ask whether diffusion models can instead be trained to learn substantially stronger semantic representations without sacrificing generation quality. SelfFlow takes a step in this direction by introducing self-supervised patch alignment into flow matching, but its main gains remain in faster convergence and improved generation. Inspired by DINO and iBOT, we extend this framework with cross-view class-token alignment to further strengthen semantic representations. Specifically, we form two independently noised, dual-timestep observations of each image and align each student class-token representation with the stop-gradient EMA-teacher target from the other observation. This objective is optimized jointly with the inherited flow-matching and local patch objectives. Notably, although the additional objective acts only on the class token, it strengthens both class-token and patch representations. Compared with a matched two-view baseline, ImageNet linear-probing accuracy improves by 9.4\% using the class token and 10.1\% using mean-pooled patch tokens, while frozen-backbone VOC2012 segmentation improves by 3.6 mIoU. These representation gains are achieved while maintaining comparable ImageNet generation FID. In text-to-image training, the same objective also improves generation FID, reducing it from 2.52 to 2.37 at matched checkpoints. Our results show that representation need not remain a by-product of generation or merely a tool for improving it: it can be directly optimized as a first-class capability of diffusion pretraining alongside generation.

AI.tldr: 本文在Flow Matching框架中引入跨视角类令牌对齐（借鉴DINO/iBOT），使扩散模型在不牺牲生成质量的前提下显著提升语义表征能力。
AI.motivation: 生成与表征学习长期处于不对称关系：语义表征常用于改进扩散生成，而扩散模型自身的表征多被视为合成的副产品。作者探究扩散模型能否在不损害生成质量的同时学习更强的语义表征。SelfFlow虽将自监督Patch对齐引入Flow Matching，但主要收益集中在收敛速度与生成质量。
AI.method: 在SelfFlow基础上扩展，加入跨视角类令牌对齐：对每张图像构造两个独立加噪、双时间步的观测，将学生类令牌表征与另一观测的stop-gradient EMA教师目标对齐；该目标与继承的Flow Matching目标及局部Patch目标联合优化。尽管该目标仅作用于类令牌，却同时增强了类令牌与Patch表征。
AI.result: 相比匹配的双视角基线，ImageNet线性探测准确率在使用类令牌时提升9.4%，使用平均池化Patch令牌时提升10.1%，冻结主干VOC2012分割提升3.6 mIoU，且ImageNet生成FID保持可比。在文生图训练中，相同目标在匹配检查点将FID从2.52降至2.37。
AI.conclusion: 表征无需作为生成的副产品或仅充当改进生成的工具，它可以作为扩散预训练与生成并列的一等能力被直接优化。

title: StructRL: Online Structured Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Tasks
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models perform well on shorter-horizon manipulation tasks but still struggle with long-horizon tasks that require multiple dependent manipulations from a single command. Online reinforcement learning (RL) can improve these policies through environment interaction, yet many existing methods provide reward only after the complete task succeeds. However, such terminal supervision is sparse and does not distinguish early failures from rollouts that make substantial partial progress. We propose StructRL, an online RL framework that constructs structured intermediate supervision from verifiable subtask completions. StructRL decomposes each task into verifiable subtasks, grants intermediate rewards only after the prerequisite subtasks have been completed, and scales each reward according to completion pace. Across RoboCasa365 and LIBERO-Long with GR00T-N1.5 and pi 0.5, StructRL consistently outperforms evaluated online RL baselines. These results show that verifiable, structured intermediate rewards improve long-horizon VLA post-training. Code is available at https://github.com/amazon-science/StructRL.

AI.tldr: 提出 StructRL，一种在线强化学习框架，通过可验证子任务完成构建结构化中间监督，缓解长时序 VLA 任务的稀疏奖励问题。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型在长时序、需多步依赖操作的任务上表现不佳；现有在线 RL 多在任务完全成功后给奖励，终局监督稀疏，无法区分早期失败与有实质进展的 rollout。
AI.method: 将任务分解为可验证子任务，仅在前置子任务完成后给予中间奖励，并按完成节奏对奖励进行缩放。
AI.result: 在 RoboCasa365 与 LIBERO-Long 上，结合 GR00T-N1.5 和 pi 0.5 模型，StructRL 一致优于所评估的在线 RL 基线。
AI.conclusion: 可验证的结构化中间奖励能有效提升长时序 VLA 后训练性能。代码已开源。

title: Compress to Remember: Learning Compact Memory via On-Policy Distillation for Long Video Generation
summary: Standard video generators do not natively compact historical context into reusable memory tokens. As generation continues, the growing history makes it increasingly difficult to retain information from earlier frames due to long-context degradation. Key-frame-based approaches address this challenge by retaining selected past frames, but can discard information needed for future generation. Rather than relying on frame selection alone, we study whether a frozen video generator can supply the supervision needed to learn a compact representation of the history. We propose Prediction-Aligned Context Compaction (PACC), which uses a learned compressor to aggregate information across past frames into compact memory tokens. We train the compressor through on-policy distillation, using the same frozen generator both as a student when conditioned on compressed memory and as a teacher when conditioned on the full history. The student generates continuations, while the teacher provides targets for the same noisy inputs at each denoising step. Only the compressor is updated to align the student's predictions with these targets. We evaluate PACC on MBench, which jointly measures memory-event coverage and consistency. PACC outperforms the strongest baseline by 6.63 points on Causal-rCM and 3.19 points on Causal Forcing. Evaluation on VBench-Long using MovieGen prompts further shows that PACC produces minute-long videos with generation quality competitive with baselines. Together, these results show that learning to compact historical context can improve long-video memory without modifying the underlying generator.

AI.tldr: 提出PACC（Prediction-Aligned Context Compaction），用可学习压缩器将历史帧聚合为紧凑记忆token，通过在线策略蒸馏训练（冻结生成器同时作学生与教师），在不修改底层生成器的前提下提升长视频记忆能力。
AI.motivation: 标准视频生成器无法将历史上下文原生压缩为可复用的记忆token，随生成推进，历史上下文增长导致长上下文退化，难以保留早期帧信息；基于关键帧的方法虽保留部分历史帧，却会丢弃未来生成所需的信息。
AI.method: 研究是否可由冻结的视频生成器提供监督以学习紧凑历史表示。PACC使用学习到的压缩器将过去多帧信息聚合为紧凑记忆token；通过在线策略蒸馏训练压缩器：同一冻结生成器在压缩记忆条件下作学生、在完整历史条件下作教师，学生在各去噪步生成续帧，教师对相同噪声输入提供目标，仅更新压缩器以对齐学生预测与教师目标。
AI.result: 在MBench上，PACC在Causal-rCM上超过最强基线6.63分，在Causal Forcing上超过3.19分；在VBench-Long上使用MovieGen提示词，可生成分钟级长视频，生成质量与基线相比具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 学习压缩历史上下文可在不修改底层生成器的情况下提升长视频记忆能力。

title: OTT3R: Multi-View 3D Reconstruction and Fast Dataset Generation at 1% Compute
summary: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models have achieved impressive performance by scaling model and dataset size, but their cost excludes most research groups and precludes edge deployment. Additionally, generating 3D supervision without sensors still relies on slow, unreliable Structure-from-Motion, as the community lacks a COLMAP-like system for neural 3D pseudo-label generation. We present OTT3R (RGB-Only Tiny Transformer for 3D Reconstruction), a knowledge distillation framework that addresses both problems on a single workstation equipped with 2 GPUs. Distilling $π^3$ (959M parameters) into a 102M-parameter student yields 9.4$\times$ compression and up to 7$\times$ faster inference, trained at 1.6% of VGGT's training compute. An integrated pseudo-label pipeline offers a reliable, high-throughput alternative to COLMAP, generating dense per-pixel point maps and SE(3) camera poses for a 667K-image corpus in 3.5 hours on two commodity GPUs and succeeding on every sequence we tested, including those where COLMAP fails. The general student tracks the teacher on in-distribution monocular depth and, zero-shot, outperforms COLMAP on 7-Scenes and on DTU completion, but it does not replace the teacher on out-of-distribution multi-view geometry. The deployable artifact is the domain-specialized student: after specialization at 0.2% compute, it is 4$\times$ more accurate than COLMAP on 7-Scenes at 980$\times$ throughput, with near-teacher completion. Code is available at https://github.com/TheFourthKaramazov/OTT3R

AI.tldr: OTT3R 是一种知识蒸馏框架，把 959M 参数的 π³ 教师模型蒸馏为 102M 参数的学生模型，仅用 2 张 GPU 完成训练，实现 9.4× 压缩与最多 7× 加速，并提供替代 COLMAP 的高吞吐伪标签流水线。
AI.motivation: 前馈 3D 重建模型靠扩大模型与数据规模取得优异性能，但高昂成本使多数研究组难以承受且无法边缘部署；同时，在无传感器情况下生成 3D 监督仍依赖缓慢且不可靠的 Structure-from-Motion，社区缺乏类似 COLMAP 的神经 3D 伪标签生成系统。本文旨在用单台双 GPU 工作站同时解决这两个问题。
AI.method: 提出 OTT3R（RGB-Only Tiny Transformer for 3D Reconstruction）知识蒸馏框架：将 959M 的 π³ 教师蒸馏进 102M 学生模型；并集成伪标签流水线，替代 COLMAP 生成稠密的逐像素点图与 SE(3) 相机位姿；此外还包含针对特定领域的专业化（specialization）步骤。
AI.result: 蒸馏实现 9.4× 压缩、推理最多快 7×，训练算力仅为 VGGT 的 1.6%；伪标签流水线在两张消费级 GPU 上用 3.5 小时为 667K 图像语料生成标签，所有测试序列均成功（包括 COLMAP 失败的序列）。通用学生在分布内单目深度上追平教师，零样本下在 7-Scenes 与 DTU 补全上超过 COLMAP，但在分布外多视图几何上无法取代教师。领域专业化学生（额外 0.2% 算力）在 7-Scenes 上比 COLMAP 准确 4×，吞吐量高 980×，补全性能接近教师。
AI.conclusion: OTT3R 以极低算力与硬件门槛实现了可部署的轻量 3D 重建学生模型，并提供可靠的 COLMAP 替代伪标签方案；其可部署产物是领域专业化学生模型，在精度与吞吐上显著优于 COLMAP，但通用学生尚不能完全取代教师处理分布外多视图几何。

title: LEGO-Anything: Coding Agents for 3D Scene Reconstruction
summary: A 3D scene reconstructed from a single image is most useful when represented not as a rendering or a fixed 3D output, but as an explicit scene program whose execution yields a scene that can be inspected, edited, and queried. We present LEGO-Anything, an Image-to-Code framework in which a coding agent iteratively writes and executes Blender code, inspects scenes and renderings, and revises the program. To evaluate end-to-end scene recovery, we introduce LEGO-Bench, a simulator-grounded benchmark with 208 images from 104 diverse indoor and outdoor scenes. LEGO-Bench separately scores artifact validity, visible-surface geometry, and rendered appearance. Its simulator-grounded design enables extensibility and precise automatic evaluation. Among evaluated agents, GPT-6-astra achieves the strongest overall results, with 53.4% indoor and 39.6% outdoor scores, yet substantial gaps remain between delivering valid scene artifacts and faithfully recovering scene geometry and appearance. Analysis of agent construction trajectories reveals three recurring issues: weak scene initialization, regressive edits during iteration, and unreliable self-evaluation. These findings motivate LEGO-Plugin, a training-free harness plugin for more controlled iterative scene construction, which improves all six evaluated models, with relative gains of up to 62.7% in overall score. Finally, we test whether reconstructed scenes can represent natural images and support vision tasks. In LEGO-World, we derive object detections, instance masks, and relative depth as deterministic queries on scenes reconstructed by GPT-6-astra. These readouts show non-trivial performance across all three tasks but fall well short of specialized vision models, suggesting that program-constructed scenes from current coding agents are a promising but not yet sufficiently precise representation of natural images.

AI.tldr: 提出 LEGO-Anything（Image-to-Code 框架）、LEGO-Bench（208 张图、104 个室内外场景的模拟器基准）与 LEGO-Plugin（免训练插件），将单图三维重建表示为可执行、可编辑的 Blender 场景程序，并评估其在视觉任务上的可用性。
AI.motivation: 单图重建的三维场景若只以渲染或固定三维输出呈现，价值有限；作者希望将其表示为显式"场景程序"，使场景可检查、可编辑、可查询，并据此系统评估端到端场景恢复能力。
AI.method: 1) LEGO-Anything：编码智能体迭代编写并执行 Blender 代码，检查场景与渲染结果并修订程序；2) LEGO-Bench：基于模拟器构建的基准，含 104 个室内外场景的 208 张图像，分别评分产物有效性、可见表面几何与渲染外观，支持精确自动评估与扩展；3) 分析智能体构建轨迹中的失败模式；4) LEGO-Plugin：免训练脚手架插件，实现更可控的迭代式场景构建；5) LEGO-World：以确定性查询从重建场景中导出目标检测、实例掩码与相对深度。
AI.result: GPT-6-astra 在评测智能体中总体最优，室内 53.4%、室外 39.6%，但"生成有效场景产物"与"忠实恢复几何与外观"之间仍有明显差距。轨迹分析揭示三类反复出现的问题：场景初始化薄弱、迭代中出现退化性编辑、自评估不可靠。LEGO-Plugin 在全部六个被测模型上均有提升，总体分数相对增益最高达 62.7%。LEGO-World 中三项视觉任务的读出性能均非平凡，但明显低于专用视觉模型。
AI.conclusion: 以程序形式表示单图重建场景是可行且有价值的：LEGO-Bench 提供了可扩展、可精确自动评估的方案，LEGO-Plugin 能稳定提升迭代构建质量。但当前编码智能体构造的场景程序对自然图像的表示仍不够精确，尚不能替代专用视觉模型，是"有前景但未成熟"的表征方式。

title: Stealth Is a Relation, Not a Property: How Event Representations Create Blind Spots for Timing Attacks in Event-Based Perception
summary: An event camera produces an asynchronous stream, but what is visible in that stream depends on how a downstream consumer, such as a model or detector, processes time. The same timestamp change may leave a coarse temporal representation unchanged while changing the response of a model that preserves finer timing. We characterize this dependence as observer-relative stealth. For recorded event streams, retiming an event within its protected accumulation window leaves the accumulated integer tensor exactly unchanged. We use this exact blind space to construct Null, a gradient-guided timestamp-retiming attack, and define SC-ASR_A(tau) to measure attack success while bounding the change visible to observer A. On DVS Gesture at a 10% event budget, Null reaches 81.56 +/- 5.81% ASR on ConvSNN and 98.67 +/- 0.45% on a GRU while preserving the protected tensor exactly. On DailyDVS-200, a protocol-scale Multi-View Fusion Network variant reaches 99.28 +/- 0.11% exact-null ASR, compared with 9.70 +/- 1.06% for its matched control. In a five-attack comparison, Null is the only method with nonzero attack success at exact observer equality, reaching 81.4% on DVS Gesture and 87.35% on DailyDVS-200. We also search the same exact blind space with an independently implemented constrained projected-gradient optimizer, C-PGD. At matched victim-gradient evaluations, C-PGD reaches 84.50 +/- 2.89% ASR on DVS Gesture and 89.55 +/- 4.39% on DailyDVS-200, again with exact protected equality. Perturbations that are exactly hidden from the protected observer become visible under shifted, finer, overlapping, and randomized temporal views. Adding observer constraints reduces the real-valued blind-space fraction from 87.5% to 75.0% to 62.5%, while DVS ConvSNN ASR falls from 74.9% to 61.9% to 37.2%. These results show that stealth is not a property of the perturbation alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"观察者相对隐蔽性"概念，利用事件流时间重标记中的精确盲空间构造了 Null 攻击，在保持受保护张量完全不变的前提下实现高攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 事件相机输出异步事件流，其可见内容取决于下游消费者（模型/检测器）如何解析时间。相同的时间戳变动可能对粗粒度时间表示无影响，却改变保留精细时序的模型响应，因此隐蔽性并非扰动本身的独立属性，而是相对于观察者而言。作者希望刻画并利用这种观察者相对依赖性。
AI.method: 将事件流中的时间重标记限制在受保护的累积窗口内，可使累积整数张量完全不变，从而定义"精确盲空间"。基于该盲空间，用梯度引导构造时间戳重标记攻击 Null，并定义 SC-ASR_A(tau) 指标以在限定观察者 A 可见变化的前提下度量攻击成功率。此外使用独立实现的约束投影梯度优化器 C-PGD 在同一盲空间中搜索。
AI.result: 在 DVS Gesture 上（10% 事件预算），Null 对 ConvSNN 达到 81.56±5.81% ASR，对 GRU 达到 98.67±0.45% ASR，且受保护张量精确不变。在 DailyDVS-200 上，协议规模的 Multi-View Fusion Network 变体达到 99.28±0.11% 精确零变化 ASR，对照仅 9.70±1.06%。五攻击对比中，Null 是唯一在观察者完全相等时仍有非零成功的方法（DVS Gesture 81.4%，DailyDVS-200 87.35%）。C-PGD 在匹配受害者梯度评估下分别达到 84.50±2.89% 与 89.55±4.39% ASR，同样保持精确受保护相等。对受保护观察者完全隐藏的扰动，在偏移、更精细、重叠及随机化时间视图下会变得可见；加入观察者约束使实值盲空间比例由 87.5% 降至 75.0% 再降至 62.5%，DVS ConvSNN ASR 相应由 74.9% 降至 61.9% 再降至 37.2%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明隐蔽性不是扰动单独的性质，而是相对于特定观察者时间处理的属性；精确盲空间可被有效利用构造在受保护观察者下完全不可见、却能欺骗更精细时序模型的时间戳重标记攻击。

title: What Makes High-Magnification Knowledge Transferable? A Study of Cross-Resolution Distillation in Whole-Slide Imaging
summary: Cross-resolution knowledge distillation aims to improve low-magnification whole- slide analysis by transferring high-magnification representations, yet the conditions for useful transfer remain unclear. We develop a decomposition-based analysis of teacher access, representation loss, and model excess, motivating three questions: whether (a) teacher targets help the task, (b) low-magnification students can predict them, and (c) slide models benefit from those predictions. We investigate them through controlled experiments across ten pathology cohorts spanning classifi- cation, grading, and survival prediction. In the main comparison, providing teacher regional means alongside native low-magnification features improves downstream performance in all ten cohorts. Direct prediction achieves lower reconstruction error than residual prediction, yet the predicted features underrepresent variation in the teacher targets. Moreover, better reconstruction does not consistently improve downstream scores, and retaining native features changes performance even when the predicted teacher features are held fixed. Together, these findings expose a gap between reconstructing teacher representations and realizing their downstream value. They challenge the sufficiency of reconstruction error as a measure of cross-resolution transfer and provide a diagnostic framework for examining where that transfer breaks down. Future distillation designs must account for both what students can predict and how slide models use those predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分解式分析（教师可及性、表征损失、模型冗余）考察跨分辨率知识蒸馏的三个问题，并在十个病理队列上开展受控实验，发现重建误差与下游收益之间存在鸿沟，重建误差不足以衡量跨分辨率迁移效果。
AI.motivation: 跨分辨率知识蒸馏被用于提升低倍镜全切片分析，通过迁移高倍镜表征来改进性能，但何种条件下迁移才有用尚不明确，缺乏对迁移有效性的系统诊断。
AI.method: 提出基于分解的分析框架，将问题拆解为教师可及性、表征损失与模型冗余；据此提出三个问题：(a)教师目标是否对任务有帮助，(b)低倍镜学生能否预测这些目标，(c)切片模型能否从这些预测中受益。在覆盖分类、分级和生存预测的十个病理队列上开展受控实验，比较直接预测与残差预测，并在固定预测特征时考察原生特征保留的影响。
AI.result: 主要对比中，在全部十个队列里将教师区域均值与原生低倍镜特征同时提供均改善了下游性能。直接预测的重建误差低于残差预测，但预测特征对教师目标变异的表征不足；更好的重建并未一致地提升下游分数；即使固定预测的教师特征，保留原生特征仍会改变性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了"重建教师表征"与"实现其下游价值"之间的鸿沟，说明重建误差不足以作为跨分辨率迁移的充分度量，并提供了一个诊断框架以定位迁移失效环节；未来蒸馏设计需同时考虑学生能预测什么以及切片模型如何使用这些预测。

title: Towards Scalable Context-Aware Single-Cell Spatial Transcriptomics Prediction from Histology Images
summary: Predicting gene expression from H&E-stained histology images offers a scalable alternative to costly spatial transcriptomics, yet most existing methods operate at the spot level, where signals from multiple cells are aggregated and critical cellular heterogeneity is obscured. Extending this paradigm to single-cell resolution is non-trivial. Naively applying pathology foundation models faces a scale mismatch: their patch-level representations mix multiple cells, whereas per-cell cropping or resizing distorts morphology and removes local context. Conversely, segmentation-based models without strong pretrained visual encoders often lack the morphological representation capacity needed for accurate molecular prediction and inherit errors from imperfect cell boundary masks. Here, we present CELLO, an efficient end-to-end framework that performs a single pathology foundation model forward pass per image and uses grid sampling to extract location-specific features for all cells simultaneously. We further introduce a distance-decay cross-attention module that refines each cell representation using spatially biased local morphological context. Using 52 public Xenium-H&E pairs from HEST-1k that span 12 organs and approximately 10 million cells, CELLO improves the average predictive accuracy over the evaluated baselines while reducing the mean whole-slide inference time compared to DeepSpot2Cell, a 14.0x speed-up on average that excludes upstream cell segmentation. Our work establishes a scalable foundation for single-cell gene expression prediction from H&E images.

AI.tldr: CELLO：通过单次病理基础模型前向传播与网格采样提取全细胞特征，结合距离衰减交叉注意力，实现H&E图像的单细胞基因表达预测，平均精度优于基线，推理速度较DeepSpot2Cell平均提升14.0倍。
AI.motivation: 从H&E组织学图像预测基因表达可替代昂贵的空间转录组学，但现有方法多停留在spot级别，多细胞信号被聚合，掩盖了关键的细胞异质性。扩展到单细胞分辨率存在挑战：病理基础模型的patch级表示混合多个细胞，存在尺度不匹配；逐细胞裁剪或缩放会扭曲形态并丢失局部上下文；而缺乏强预训练视觉编码器的分割模型表示能力不足，并继承不完美细胞边界掩码的误差。
AI.method: CELLO是一个高效的端到端框架：每张图像仅对病理基础模型做一次前向传播，使用网格采样同时提取所有细胞的位置特异特征；并引入距离衰减交叉注意力模块，利用空间偏置的局部形态上下文细化每个细胞的表示。
AI.result: 在HEST-1k中52个公开Xenium-H&E配对样本（覆盖12个器官、约1000万个细胞）上，CELLO相比所评估的基线提高了平均预测精度，同时降低全切片平均推理时间，相较DeepSpot2Cell平均实现14.0倍加速（不含上游细胞分割）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为从H&E图像进行单细胞基因表达预测建立了可扩展的基础。

title: Temporal-Aware Fusion for Robust Outdoor LiDAR Localization
summary: LiDAR relocalization aims to estimate the global 6-DoF pose of a sensor in the environment. However, existing regression-based approaches often encounter limitations in dynamic or ambiguous scenarios, as they typically prioritize single-frame inference, leaving the potential of spatio-temporal consistency across scans not fully explored. In this paper, we propose a Temporal-aware Localization framework (TempLoc) designed to enhance the robustness of outdoor localization by effectively modeling sequential consistency. Specifically, a Global Coordinate Estimation module is first introduced to predict point-wise global coordinates and associated uncertainties for each LiDAR scan. A Prior Coordinate Generation module is then presented to estimate inter-frame point correspondences by the attention mechanism. Lastly, an Uncertainty-Guided Coordinate Fusion module is deployed to integrate both predictions of point correspondence in an end-to-end fashion, yielding a more temporally consistent and accurate global 6-DoF pose. Experimental results on the NCLT and Oxford RobotCar benchmarks show that our TempLoc outperforms state-of-the-art methods by a large margin, demonstrating the effectiveness of temporal-aware correspondence modeling in LiDAR relocalization.

AI.tldr: 提出TempLoc时序感知定位框架，通过全局坐标估计、注意力帧间对应和不确定性引导融合，提升LiDAR重定位的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于回归的LiDAR重定位方法多聚焦单帧推理，未充分利用跨扫描的时空一致性，在动态或模糊场景中鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: TempLoc包含三个模块：1）全局坐标估计模块预测每个LiDAR扫描的逐点全局坐标及其不确定性；2）先验坐标生成模块借助注意力机制估计帧间点对应关系；3）不确定性引导坐标融合模块以端到端方式整合点对应预测，输出时序一致且精确的全局6-DoF位姿。
AI.result: 在NCLT和Oxford RobotCar基准上，TempLoc大幅优于现有最先进方法，验证了时序感知对应建模在LiDAR重定位中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 时序感知的帧间对应建模能显著提升室外LiDAR重定位的鲁棒性与精度。

title: RA-CFGCache: From Branch-Level Criteria to Guided-Risk Control under Classifier-Free Guidance
summary: Diffusion models enable high-quality visual generation, but iterative denoising remains computationally expensive, especially under classifier-free guidance (CFG), which requires both conditional and unconditional evaluations. Training-free caching reduces this cost by reuse of previously computed features or predictions. However, existing branch-local reuse criteria do not explicitly account for how cache errors combine under CFG or how local perturbations affect the final output. We identify two misalignments in cache control: a branch-guided mismatch, where guided error depends on both the magnitudes and alignment of branch errors, and a local-final mismatch, where the downstream impact of a local error varies across timesteps. We propose RA-CFGCache, a Risk-Aligned Caching framework under CFG that incorporates both factors while keeping the sampling schedule and guidance rule fixed. CFG-aware Guided-Risk Composition combines existing branch-wise proxies using CFG coefficients and offline-calibrated cross-branch alignment. Propagation-Aware Rescaling further weights the resulting guided-risk estimate with a timestep-dependent propagation prior calibrated from isolated reuse perturbations. An online threshold controller then determines when to jointly refresh or reuse both branches. Experiments on FLUX.1-dev, Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, and CogVideoX-2B demonstrate improved efficiency--fidelity trade-offs over evaluated training-free caching baselines. Moreover, RA-CFGCache is compatible with diverse base proxy families, including TeaCache-, DiCache-, and MagCache-style estimators, and consistently improves fidelity at nearly unchanged latency. Code is available at https://github.com/yiming-l21/RA-CFGCache.git.

AI.tldr: 提出 RA-CFGCache，一种风险对齐的无训练缓存框架，在 CFG 下显式建模分支误差组合与局部误差传播，改善扩散模型采样的效率-保真度权衡。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型迭代去噪计算昂贵，CFG 下每步需条件与无条件两次评估，成本翻倍。现有无训练缓存采用分支局部复用准则，未显式考虑 CFG 下缓存误差如何组合，以及局部扰动如何影响最终输出。
AI.method: 识别两类错配：分支引导错配（引导误差取决于两分支误差的幅值与对齐性）和局部-最终错配（局部误差的下游影响随 timestep 变化）。据此提出 RA-CFGCache：1）CFG 感知的引导风险组合，用 CFG 系数与离线校准的跨分支对齐度组合分支级代理；2）传播感知重缩放，用由孤立复用扰动校准的 timestep 相关传播先验加权引导风险估计；3）在线阈值控制器决定两分支联合刷新或复用；采样调度与引导规则保持不变。
AI.result: 在 FLUX.1-dev、Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B、CogVideoX-2B 上，相比评估的无训练缓存基线取得更好的效率-保真度权衡；与 TeaCache、DiCache、MagCache 等代理家族兼容，在延迟几乎不变时一致提升保真度。
AI.conclusion: 通过风险对齐显式建模 CFG 分支误差组合与误差传播，可在不改变采样流程的前提下提升缓存复用质量，且具备良好的代理家族通用性。

title: Merlin Plus: A Large-Scale, Multi-Cancer, Image-Mask-Report Dataset
summary: Multi-cancer segmentation in computed tomography (CT) is fundamentally limited by the scarcity of tumor masks across different organs. We present Merlin Plus, the first large-scale CT dataset with radiologist-created tumor masks across 9 organs. Merlin Plus extends the Merlin dataset by adding 1,153 per-voxel tumor masks and longitudinal metadata. To create these tumor masks, we developed a report-based active-learning framework in which radiology reports identify tumor cases for annotation and support training of a tumor segmentation model. The model generates initial masks, which radiologists review and correct to produce the final masks, reducing annotation burden while maintaining high-quality annotations. Besides tumor masks, the longitudinal metadata in Merlin Plus enables temporal modeling of cancer progression. By directly addressing the major bottleneck of limited multi-cancer segmentation masks, Merlin Plus supports scalable multi-organ cancer detection, segmentation, and longitudinal analysis in CT. Dataset is available at: https://github.com/MrGiovanni/MerlinPlus

AI.tldr: Merlin Plus 是首个覆盖9个器官、由放射科医生逐体素标注肿瘤掩膜的大规模CT数据集，通过报告驱动的主动学习框架降低标注成本，并附纵向元数据以支持时序建模。
AI.motivation: CT多癌种分割的核心瓶颈在于不同器官的肿瘤掩膜稀缺，现有数据集难以支撑跨器官的规模化研究。
AI.method: 在 Merlin 数据集基础上新增 1,153 例逐体素肿瘤掩膜与纵向元数据；采用基于报告的主动学习框架：利用放射报告筛选肿瘤病例用于标注，并训练肿瘤分割模型；模型生成初始掩膜，由放射科医生复核修正得到最终掩膜。整个过程在降低标注负担的同时保持高质量标注。
AI.result: 构建了覆盖 9 个器官、含 1,153 例医生标注肿瘤掩膜的大规模CT数据集，并附带纵向元数据，可实现癌症进展的时序建模。
AI.conclusion: Merlin Plus 直接缓解了多癌种分割掩膜不足的瓶颈，支持可扩展的多器官癌症检测、分割与纵向分析；数据集已开源。

title: DARE to Mitigate Hallucination: Dual-path Auto-Regressive-aware Editing
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have recently achieved remarkable progress across multimodal tasks, yet object hallucination remains a persistent challenge where models generate descriptions inconsistent with the visual input. Recent work mitigates hallucinations through training-free representation editing, typically by constructing hallucination-related directions from teacher-forcing (TF) contrasts between hallucinated and truthful responses. However, LVLMs operate through autoregressive (AR) decoding during generation, raising the question of whether TF-based analysis fully reflects the generation dynamics that lead to hallucinated outputs. In this paper, we analyze the relationship between TF-based editing and AR generation behavior and find that TF-based editing alone may be insufficient to capture both decoding dynamics and multimodal interactions associated with hallucinations. To address this limitation, we propose DARE (Dual-path Auto-Regressive-aware Editing), a hybrid hallucination editing framework that integrates two complementary contrast pathways: textual contrasts and image contrasts, together with autoregressive-aware representation signals. Specifically, DARE constructs hallucination editing directions from (1) TF-based textual contrasts, (2) AR-aware representation transitions during decoding, and (3) controlled visual differences between paired images. Extensive experiments on multiple LVLM hallucination benchmarks demonstrate that DARE consistently reduces object hallucinations while preserving multimodal perception capability and inference efficiency. Our implementation code is available at https://github.com/KU-VGI/DARE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DARE，一种融合文本对比、自回归感知表示信号和图像对比的混合式幻觉编辑框架，用于无训练地缓解 LVLM 的物体幻觉。
AI.motivation: 现有基于教师强制（TF）对比的无训练表示编辑方法可能无法完全反映自回归解码的动态过程，以及幻觉相关的多模态交互，因此需要更贴合生成行为的幻觉编辑方式。
AI.method: DARE（Dual-path Auto-Regressive-aware Editing）构建两条互补对比路径并引入自回归感知表示信号：其一为基于 TF 的文本对比，其二为解码过程中的 AR 感知表示转移，其三为成对图像之间受控的视觉差异，从而构造幻觉编辑方向。
AI.result: 在多个 LVLM 幻觉基准上，DARE 持续减少物体幻觉，同时保持多模态感知能力与推理效率。
AI.conclusion: 仅依赖 TF 对比的编辑不足以捕捉幻觉相关的解码动态与多模态交互；引入自回归感知与图像对比的混合编辑框架可更有效缓解 LVLM 物体幻觉。代码已开源。

title: Online Versatile Incremental Learning: Towards Class and Domain-Agnostic Adaptation at Any Time
summary: Continual learning enables vision systems to adapt to ever-changing data distributions. Despite significant advances, existing approaches fail to capture continuous and concurrent shifts in classes and domains, a critical capability for real-world deployment. This work introduces Online VIL (Online Versatile Incremental Learning), a novel scenario where class concepts and visual domains evolve simultaneously online without explicit boundaries. To better adapt to the challenges of such dynamic environments that more closely resemble real-world conditions, we propose a novel framework TopFlow, Topology preservation with Flow matching representation that contains two complementary mechanisms: Domain-agnostic Flow Matching (DFM) and Global Topology Preservation (GTP). DFM guides the model to have domain-agnostic representations by integrating the geodesic flow kernel into contrastive learning. In contrast, GTP maintains the global structure of the feature space without explicitly storing past examples. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that TopFlow effectively addresses the limitations of existing methods within the Online VIL scenario, achieving state-of-the-art performance in challenging Online VIL. The proposed methods suggest potential directions for building continual learning systems in realistic dynamic environments. Our implementation code is available at https://github.com/KU-VGI/Online-VIL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Online VIL 场景及 TopFlow 框架，通过域无关流匹配（DFM）与全局拓扑保持（GTP）实现类别与域的在线同步增量学习，取得 SOTA 性能。
AI.motivation: 现有持续学习方法无法处理类别与域同时、连续且无显式边界的在线漂移，而这正是真实部署中的关键需求。
AI.method: 提出 TopFlow 框架，包含两个互补机制：DFM 将测地流核（geodesic flow kernel）融入对比学习，引导模型学习域无关表示；GTP 在不显式存储历史样本的前提下维持特征空间的全局结构。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，TopFlow 在 Online VIL 场景下有效克服现有方法的局限，在具有挑战性的设定中取得最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为在真实动态环境中构建持续学习系统提供了潜在方向，代码已开源。

title: DynamicHOI: Coupled Dynamics for Physics-aware HOI Reconstruction
summary: We study hand-object interaction (HOI) reconstruction from monocular RGB videos, where partial observations can produce visually plausible yet mechanically inconsistent trajectories. Existing methods mainly enforce visual and geometric agreement, leaving the underlying interaction dynamics insufficiently constrained. We propose DynamicHOI, a physics-aware HOI reconstruction framework combining geometry-grounded diffusion refinement with coupled hand-object dynamics. Geometry spatially grounds visual evidence for trajectory refinement, while articulated inverse dynamics and Newton-Euler dynamics derive hand generalized forces and object wrenches for dynamics-level supervision. We further couple hand and object dynamics through contact-force transfer and recover active hand actuation as an interaction-level physical quantity. We formulate its empirical magnitude distribution into a probabilistic prior that penalizes unlikely actuation and suppresses mechanically implausible reconstructed motion. Experiments on three HOI datasets show consistent improvements in both hand and object reconstruction. The reconstructed trajectories further benefit downstream applications including hand world-model generation and robotic manipulation learning, demonstrating the value of physics-aware HOI modeling beyond reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出DynamicHOI，一个物理感知的手-物交互重建框架，结合几何引导扩散细化与手-物耦合动力学，实现更符合机械一致性的轨迹重建。
AI.motivation: 单目RGB视频的手-物交互（HOI）重建中，部分观测易产生视觉合理但机械不一致的轨迹。现有方法主要约束视觉与几何一致性，对底层交互动力学约束不足。
AI.method: 框架包含两部分：1）几何引导的扩散细化，用几何为视觉证据提供空间基础以细化轨迹；2）耦合手-物动力学，通过关节逆动力学与牛顿-欧拉动力学推导手部广义力与物体力旋量，实现动力学级监督。进一步通过接触力传递耦合手与物体动力学，并将主动手部驱动恢复为交互级物理量，将其经验幅值分布建模为概率先验，惩罚不合理驱动、抑制机械不可行运动。
AI.result: 在三个HOI数据集上，手部与物体重建均取得一致性提升；重建轨迹还利于下游任务，包括手部世界模型生成与机器人操作学习。
AI.conclusion: 物理感知的HOI建模具有超越重建本身的价值，能提升机械一致性并赋能下游应用。

title: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models on Synapse Detection and Proofreading in Connectomics
summary: We benchmarked vision-language models (VLMs) on the decisions annotators take when inspecting electron microscopy images in connectomics: synapse detection (presence and polarity) and proofreading (split errors and merge errors). For synapse detection, we evaluated 19 open and 2 closed models across various architectures and sizes under zero-shot, four-shot in-context learning and LoRA settings, against specialist models, on datasets constructed by us using public resources. For proofreading, we evaluated 3 open and 2 closed models on the ConnectomeBench2 dataset, with cross-species transfer from fly and mouse to human and zebrafish. Most models were at chance zero-shot; a few examples helped mainly the closed and largest open ones. LoRA on a few thousand labels brought open models level with specialist models. When evaluated on unseen species, the best adapted VLMs outperformed specialist models trained on the same data in identifying merge errors. The project will be publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评测了视觉语言模型在连接组学电镜图像判读任务上的表现，涵盖突触检测与校对任务，并与专用模型对比。
AI.motivation: 连接组学中，标注者在电镜图像上需完成突触检测（有无及极性）与校对（分裂错误和合并错误）等判读决策，但视觉语言模型在此类任务上的能力尚缺乏系统评估，因此需要建立基准进行比较。
AI.method: 针对突触检测，采用自建数据集（基于公开资源），在零样本、四样本上下文学习及LoRA微调三种设置下，评测19个开源与2个闭源模型，覆盖不同架构与规模，并与专用模型对比；针对校对任务，在ConnectomeBench2数据集上评测3个开源与2个闭源模型，并进行从果蝇、小鼠到人类、斑马鱼的跨物种迁移。
AI.result: 多数模型零样本表现接近随机水平；少量示例主要提升了闭源模型和最大的开源模型；在数千个标注上做LoRA微调后，开源模型达到专用模型水平；在未见物种上，最佳适配VLM在识别合并错误方面优于用相同数据训练的专用模型。
AI.conclusion: 视觉语言模型在连接组学判读任务中经少量标注微调即可媲美专用模型，并在跨物种合并错误识别上展现优势，项目将在论文接收后公开。

title: Reimagine Video Dynamics
summary: Most video editing methods focus on changing the appearance of the source video, while offering limited control over its dynamics. We introduce Reimagine Video Dynamics (RVD), a framework that disentangles a compact, editable dynamics token from visual context. We learn this token through self-supervised reconstruction: given the first frame as visual context, a renderer must recover the original video from the dynamics token, encouraging it to capture how the scene evolves rather than how it looks. This disentanglement allows video dynamics to be edited directly while preserving visual context. We develop a language-guided dynamics-token editor that transforms source dynamics into target dynamics, and train it with a scalable counterfactual video-pair pipeline and a two-stage training strategy. Extensive experiments show that RVD enables effective video dynamics editing, training-free retiming, and appearance-controlled re-rendering.

AI.tldr: 提出 Reimagine Video Dynamics (RVD) 框架，通过自监督方式从视觉上下文中解耦出紧凑可编辑的动力学 token，实现视频动力学编辑、免训练重定时与外观可控重渲染。
AI.motivation: 现有视频编辑方法主要聚焦于改变源视频的外观，对视频动力学（dynamics）的控制能力有限，因此需要一种能将动力学与视觉外观解耦并实现直接编辑的框架。
AI.method: 1）用自监督重建学习动力学 token：以首帧作为视觉上下文，渲染器需从动力学 token 恢复原视频，促使 token 编码场景演化方式而非外观；2）基于该解耦设计开发语言引导的动力学 token 编辑器，将源动力学转换为目标动力学；3）构建可扩展的反事实视频对（counterfactual video-pair）数据流水线与两阶段训练策略进行训练。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，RVD 能有效实现视频动力学编辑、免训练重定时（training-free retiming）以及外观可控的重渲染（appearance-controlled re-rendering）。
AI.conclusion: RVD 通过将紧凑的动力学 token 从视觉上下文中解耦，为视频动力学提供了直接、可控的编辑能力，同时保持原有视觉上下文，拓展了视频编辑的可控维度。

title: Foresight at the Event Boundary: Evaluating Physical Prediction in Video World Models
summary: Video world models are largely regarded as predictive models of the physical world and are therefore expected to anticipate the consequences of observed events. However, evaluation has mainly focused on reference similarity, physical-law consistency, or judgment plausibility, estimating anticipation only indirectly. We address this directly: when a release or impact has just occurred but its consequence is withheld, can a world model anticipate what should happen next? We introduce an event-anchored evaluation based on 62 controlled real-world free-fall recordings and 124 clips spanning three object types, with fine-grained release and impact annotations and ground-truth trajectories. The protocol separates consequence production, temporal placement, and physical realization. Across six contemporary video generation and world models, Runway and Veo produce release and subsequent impact events at rates above 93% but often initiate them substantially late, whereas Cosmos-Predict-2.5 and MAGI-1 frequently preserve the pre-event state and produce little or no measurable consequence. Among measurable falls, plausible timing does not necessarily imply physically consistent motion. We further conduct a 15-participant, 20-condition human study in which participants describe the expected consequence from a single event-anchored frame and draw its trajectory. Human predictions favor the recorded future in aggregate while revealing genuine ambiguity among plausible continuations. Overall, physical foresight emerges as a sequence of distinct challenges: initiating a consequence, anchoring it in time, and realizing its motion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以事件锚定的评测方法，直接检验视频世界模型在"释放/撞击已发生但后果被隐藏"时能否预测后续结果，覆盖62段自由落体录像、124个片段和6个模型，并辅以15人人类研究。
AI.motivation: 世界模型被期望预测物理世界的后果，但现有评测多依赖参考相似度、物理规律一致性或判断合理性，只能间接估计"预见"能力，缺乏对后果预测的直接测量。
AI.method: 构建事件锚定评测：62段受控真实自由落体录像、124个片段、三类物体，含细粒度释放与撞击标注及真实轨迹；协议将任务分解为后果生成、时间定位与物理实现三部分；评测6个当代视频生成与世界模型；并开展15名被试、20种条件的人类研究，要求被试依据单一事件锚定帧描述预期后果并绘制轨迹。
AI.result: Runway与Veo在93%以上样本中能产生释放及后续撞击事件，但常显著延迟触发；Cosmos-Predict-2.5与MAGI-1常保持事件前状态，几乎无可测后果。在可测下落中，时间合理并不代表运动物理一致。人类预测总体上倾向真实未来，但揭示出多种合理延续之间存在真实歧义。
AI.conclusion: 物理预见可分解为一系列不同挑战：启动后果、在时间上锚定后果、以及实现其运动，三者需分别评测。

title: SCCM: Spherically Consistent Coarse Matching for ERP Dense Feature Correspondence
comment: Accepted to ACCV 2026. 35 pages: 16-page main paper (including references) and 19-page supplementary material. Project page: https://gandanlee.github.io/sccm/ Code: https://github.com/gandanlee/sccm
summary: Equirectangular projection (ERP) is the standard representation for 360$^\circ$ imagery, and robust dense feature matching on ERP underpins panoramic stereo, view synthesis, and omnidirectional SLAM. Dense matchers trained on flat images degrade systematically on ERP because the chart introduces three coupled distortions -- topological, metric, and area -- that standard coarse matching and visibility estimation do not explicitly model. We show that correcting the three distortions at the coarse-stage interfaces where they arise -- pairwise distortions in attention, per-pixel distortion in covisibility gating -- improves PCK@$1^\circ$ from 0.229 to 0.275 on Matterport3D under a fixed coarse scaffold, with the refiner architecture unchanged -- our central result. Concretely, SCCM (Spherically Consistent Coarse Matching) augments a chart-naive cross-attention/dual-softmax coarse matcher with two sphere-derived priors: Spherical Positional Attention (SPA) pairs a yaw-periodic RoPE (topology) with a tangent-plane bias (metric), and Area-Aware Covisibility (AAC) applies a pre-sigmoid log-area correction (area). The chart-naive scaffold serves as a controlled reference, separating the scaffold-replacement effect from the spherical-prior effect. Instantiated in the RoMa V1 framework with the same frozen encoder, refiner architecture, and loss, SCCM also outperforms the ERP-native EDM (0.163) and an ERP-retrained RoMa V1 (0.198) under a unified ERP dense matching protocol, while perspective-trained matchers largely fail on ERP. It further transfers zero-shot to Stanford2D3D and, when trained on outdoor Holo360D, leads there as well.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SCCM 方法，通过在粗匹配阶段显式校正 ERP 投影带来的拓扑、度量和面积三种耦合畸变，显著提升全景图像稠密特征匹配性能。
