AI.motivation: 360° 图像普遍采用等距柱状投影（ERP）表示，其稠密特征匹配是全景立体、视图合成和全向 SLAM 的基础。然而在平面图像上训练的稠密匹配器在 ERP 上系统性地退化，原因是 ERP 引入了拓扑、度量和面积三种耦合畸变，而标准的粗匹配与可见性估计并未显式建模这些畸变。
AI.method: SCCM（球面一致粗匹配）在图表朴素（chart-naive）的交叉注意力/对偶 softmax 粗匹配器基础上，于畸变产生的粗阶段接口处引入两个球面先验进行校正：1）球面位置注意力（SPA），将偏航周期性的 RoPE（对应拓扑）与切平面偏置（对应度量）配对；2）面积感知共视性（AAC），施加 sigmoid 前的对数面积校正（对应面积）。图表朴素支架作为受控参照，以分离"支架替换效应"与"球面先验效应"。方法在 RoMa V1 框架中实例化，保持编码器、细化器架构和损失函数不变。
AI.result: 在固定粗支架下，PCK@1° 在 Matterport3D 上从 0.229 提升至 0.275（细化器架构不变，为核心结果）。在统一的 ERP 稠密匹配协议下，SCCM 也优于 ERP 原生的 EDM（0.163）和在 ERP 上重训练的 RoMa V1（0.198）；而透视训练匹配器在 ERP 上基本失效。方法还能零样本迁移到 Stanford2D3D，并在户外 Holo360D 数据集上训练后同样取得领先。
AI.conclusion: 在粗匹配阶段显式建模并校正 ERP 的拓扑、度量、面积三种畸变，是提升全景稠密特征匹配的有效途径；SCCM 在多个数据集上超越 ERP 原生及重训练基线，并具备良好的零样本迁移能力。

title: How Medical VLMs Underutilize Their Vision Encoders: A Dermatology Perspective
summary: Medical Vision-Language Models (VLMs) show significant promise for clinical image understanding, offering accurate diagnosis with interpretable reasoning. However, a critical performance gap exists between their strong vision encoders and the full multimodal model: in dermatology, the MedSigLIP encoder outperforms MedGemma by an average of 10.26 percentage points even when both use zero target-task labels; few-shot linear probing provides further evidence of strong visual representations. This gap motivates an investigation of how visual information is used in end-to-end diagnosis and why plausible-sounding predictions can lack grounding in image evidence. Using dermatology as our primary testbed, we systematically investigate three hypotheses for this phenomenon. We further provide a mechanistic analysis of the model's internal attention patterns, showing that a simple describe-then-decide prompting strategy increases vision attention by 30-40% during generation. Task-specific fine-tuning improves dermatology classification but reduces cross-domain medical question-answering performance in our evaluation. To address these challenges, we combine label-free prompting with low-label encoder-assisted reranking while keeping the VLM frozen. We validate the interventions across five VLM backbones in dermatology and provide supporting representation and attention analyses across additional medical modalities.

AI.tldr: 医学视觉语言模型（VLM）的视觉编码器（如MedSigLIP）显著强于完整多模态模型（如MedGemma，差10.26个百分点），论文以皮肤科为测试床系统探究该性能鸿沟的成因，并通过机制分析提出无标签提示与低标签编码器辅助重排序的干预方案。
AI.motivation: 医学VLM虽在临床图像理解与可解释诊断上表现突出，但其强视觉编码器与完整多模态模型之间存在明显性能鸿沟（皮肤科中MedSigLIP在零目标任务标签下平均领先MedGemma 10.26个百分点，少样本线性探测也证实视觉表征较强）。这一差距促使作者探究端到端诊断中视觉信息究竟如何被使用，以及为何看似合理的预测可能缺乏图像证据支撑。
AI.method: 以皮肤科为主要测试床，系统检验关于该现象的三种假设；对模型内部注意力模式进行机制分析，比较"先描述再决策"（describe-then-decide）提示策略对视觉注意力的影响；并结合无标签提示与低标签、编码器辅助的重排序，同时保持VLM冻结，在五个VLM骨干上验证干预效果。
AI.result: describe-then-decide提示策略在生成过程中使视觉注意力提升30–40%；任务特定微调改善了皮肤科分类，但在评测中降低了跨域医学问答性能；无标签提示结合低标签编码器辅助重排序的干预在五个VLM骨干上得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 完整医学VLM未能充分利用其视觉编码器的表征能力，注意力模式揭示了视觉接地不足的问题；通过提示策略与编码器辅助重排序可在不微调VLM的前提下改善性能，且相关表征与注意力分析可推广至其他医学模态。

title: FM-ReID: Selective Competitive Token Routing for Object Re-Identification
summary: Object re-identification (ReID) faces a recurring challenge: different identities can share highly similar global appearances, while the cues that distinguish them are localized, heterogeneous, and visible only under particular viewpoints. This challenge arises in animal ReID through markings, contours, and scars, in person ReID through subtle clothing and accessory cues, and in vehicle ReID through localized appearance details. Although visual foundation models encode such information in dense tokens, a single holistic descriptor can obscure discriminative local signals. We propose FM-ReID, an end-to-end framework that formulates local representation learning as selective competitive token routing. Its Competitive Fine-grained Mining module uses multiple mining queries and a residual query to compete for dense DINOv3 tokens. Above-prior selection retains tokens preferentially allocated to each mining query, while the residual slot receives tokens excluded from the retrieval descriptors. The resulting multi-query descriptors are jointly trained with a holistic representation for retrieval, without fixed spatial partitions or equal-area constraints. FM-ReID achieves strong results on animal, person, and vehicle ReID benchmarks, supporting competitive token routing as an effective way to augment holistic foundation-model representations.

AI.tldr: 提出FM-ReID框架，将局部表征学习建模为竞争性token路由，通过多挖掘查询与残差查询竞争DINOv3密集token，在动物、行人、车辆ReID基准上取得强结果。
AI.motivation: 目标重识别（ReID）存在一个反复出现的难题：不同身份可能具有高度相似的全局外观，而区分它们的线索是局部的、异质的，且仅在特定视角下可见——动物ReID中体现为斑纹、轮廓和疤痕，行人ReID中体现为细微的服饰与配饰线索，车辆ReID中体现为局部外观细节。尽管视觉基础模型以密集token形式编码了这些信息，但单一的整体描述符会掩盖具有判别力的局部信号。
AI.method: 提出端到端框架FM-ReID，将局部表征学习表述为选择性竞争性token路由。其竞争性细粒度挖掘（Competitive Fine-grained Mining）模块使用多个挖掘查询和一个残差查询来竞争密集的DINOv3 token；采用上先验（above-prior）选择机制保留优先分配给各挖掘查询的token，残差槽则接收被检索描述符排除的token；所得多查询描述符与整体表征联合训练用于检索，无需固定空间划分或等面积约束。
AI.result: FM-ReID在动物、行人和车辆ReID基准上均取得强性能表现。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果支持将竞争性token路由作为增强整体式基础模型表征的一种有效方式。

title: ThinkingGuard: Decoding Implicit Hazards via Step-by-Step Risk Attribution in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in safety-critical domains, their reliability is threatened by multimodal implicit risks. Unlike explicit threats, these hazards emerge when individually benign text and neutral visual entities logically converge to induce unsafe outputs. Current detection methods fail to address this because they overlook the underlying risk activation mechanisms that govern cross-modal risk activation, leading to single-modality shortcut learning and hallucinated rationalizations. To bridge this gap, we first construct TriggerBench, the first dataset explicitly modeling risk compositionality (5,600 instances). By formally isolating Key Elements and Trigger Elements to build counterfactual contrastive pairs, TriggerBench eliminates risk residues and forces models to perform genuine logical deduction rather than superficial pattern matching, which provides a rigorous foundation for both large-scale training and fine-grained evaluation. Building on this, we propose a Step-Supervised Structured Reasoning training framework and employ it to train ThinkingGuard, a specialized guard model. Inspired by Situation Awareness theory, we decouple implicit risk identification into progressive cognitive stages, and utilize a step-reward Monte Carlo Tree Search algorithm to explore optimal reasoning trajectories, which are then distilled into the model through Dual-Constraint Preference Alignment. Extensive experiments across both standard and implicit safety benchmarks demonstrate that ThinkingGuard achieves strong performance. Project resources are available at https://github.com/FroggyChen/ThinkingGuard.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对多模态大模型（MLLMs）的隐式风险问题，构建了首个建模风险组合性的数据集TriggerBench，并提出Step-Supervised Structured Reasoning训练框架，训练出专用防护模型ThinkingGuard，在标准与隐式安全基准上取得优异性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型日益部署于安全关键领域，但面临"多模态隐式风险"威胁：单独看似无害的文本与中性视觉实体在逻辑上组合后，会诱发不安全输出。现有检测方法忽视了支配跨模态风险激活的底层机制，导致单模态捷径学习和幻觉式推理，无法应对该问题。
AI.method: 1. 构建TriggerBench数据集（5,600实例），首次显式建模风险组合性，通过形式化分离Key Elements与Trigger Elements构造反事实对比样本，消除风险残留，迫使模型进行真实逻辑推理而非表层模式匹配。2. 提出Step-Supervised Structured Reasoning训练框架，并据此训练专用防护模型ThinkingGuard：受Situation Awareness理论启发，将隐式风险识别解耦为渐进认知阶段，利用步级奖励的蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）探索最优推理轨迹，再通过Dual-Constraint Preference Alignment蒸馏进模型。
AI.result: 在标准安全基准与隐式安全基准上的大量实验表明，ThinkingGuard取得了强劲的性能表现。项目资源已开源于 https://github.com/FroggyChen/ThinkingGuard。
AI.conclusion: 通过构建建模风险组合性的数据集与步级监督结构化推理框架，该工作有效缓解了单模态捷径学习与幻觉推理问题，为多模态隐式风险检测提供了严谨的数据基础与训练范式。

title: AffectReveal: Event-Grounded Emotion Recognition Beyond Visual Appearances
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Submitted to ICLR 2027
summary: Visual emotion recognition commonly assumes that all evidence required for prediction is contained in the observed image or video. Yet the same visible reaction can convey different emotions depending on events beyond the input: tears, for example, may indicate grief or joy. We formulate Event-Grounded Emotion Recognition (EGER), where emotion recognition requires recovering the affect-determining event. We construct EGER-Bench, comprising 10,052 videos and 10,734 images across 11 emotions, two source domains, and four visual settings. A study with six annotators shows that event context raises human recognition accuracy from 33.96% to 72.08%, confirming that visual evidence alone is often insufficient. Semantic relevance alone does not solve EGER: a plausible event may imply the wrong emotion if its identity, focal-person role, relationship, or outcome is misinterpreted. We therefore propose AffectReveal, a tuning-free framework that first constructs and independently verifies evidence-grounded alternatives over these affect-critical factors. It then cross-checks the recovered event against face-masked in-media facts through bidirectional atomic evidence support, while retaining the original unmasked input for final prediction. Across three downstream models and four input settings, AffectReveal yields average UAR gains of 5.26--10.53 points. For three fine-tunable models, it also enables untuned models to outperform their fine-tuned visual-only counterparts in all 12 accuracy comparisons, without updating downstream parameters.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"事件接地情绪识别"(EGER)新任务，构建EGER-Bench基准，并提出免调优框架AffectReveal，通过构建并验证影响情绪的关键事件因素、与遮脸媒体事实做双向原子证据校验，显著提升情绪识别性能。
AI.motivation: 传统视觉情绪识别假设输入图像或视频已包含全部所需证据，但同一可见反应（如流泪）可因画面之外的事件而对应不同情绪（悲伤或喜悦）。人类标注实验也显示仅凭视觉证据准确率仅33.96%，加入事件语境后升至72.08%，说明仅靠视觉证据往往不足。
AI.method: 提出AffectReveal免调优框架：首先围绕影响情绪的关键因素（事件身份、焦点人物角色、关系、结果）构建并独立验证"接地证据的候选事件"；再通过双向原子证据支持，将恢复出的事件与遮脸后的媒体内事实进行交叉校验，同时保留原始未遮脸输入用于最终预测。
AI.result: 在三种下游模型与四种输入设置下，AffectReveal平均UAR提升5.26–10.53个百分点；对三个可微调模型，在全部12项准确率比较中，未调优模型在不更新下游参数的情况下均超过仅视觉微调版本。
AI.conclusion: 情绪识别需恢复决定情感的事件，仅靠语义相关性不足（事件身份、角色、关系或结果误解均会导致错误）。EGER-Bench与AffectReveal验证了事件接地范式的必要性及免调优框架的有效性。

title: Beyond Legibility: Benchmarking Visual Text Rendering and In-Place Editing in Unified Video Generation
summary: A video can exhibit convincing motion and photorealism yet fail immediately when visual text collapses. Unlike generic scene content, visual text is unforgiving in video generation: minor stroke corruption, temporal instability, or editing errors instantly break legibility and realism. Existing benchmarks overlook this challenge by treating text as incidental or using static OCR metrics that ignore temporal dynamics. We introduce VidScribe, a unified diagnostic benchmark spanning four generation regimes: writing from language (T2V), transferring text identity from a reference (R2V), sustaining text under dynamics (I2V), and localized text editing (V2V). VidScribe contains 803 human-verified samples across a 12-axis conditionally orthogonal factor space covering Intrinsic Text Properties, Physical Imaging Conditions, and Temporal Behavior. For reliable evaluation, we build a track-grounded, gated suite with 11 shared metrics and 2 task-specific probes under strict measurability conditions. Benchmarking 11 commercial and open-source systems shows that video text capability is non-monolithic, with content recognition decoupled from stroke-level glyph correctness. Performance is highly task-asymmetric: I2V sustains text most reliably, whereas V2V editing is the primary bottleneck. Counter-intuitively, degradation concentrates on a small subset of text-centric structural and temporal factors rather than adverse imaging conditions. Further probes show that visual references improve glyph and typographic fidelity rather than content accuracy, while localized editing fails to isolate target text without corrupting undeclared source text. Beyond evaluation, VidScribe also provides an actionable training signal, where benchmark-aligned preference optimization measurably improves visual text generation. https://huggingface.co/datasets/Vicky0720/VidScribe.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 VidScribe，一个面向视频生成中"视觉文本"的诊断基准，覆盖T2V/R2V/I2V/V2V四种生成范式，包含803个人工验证样本、12轴条件正交因子空间与基于轨迹门控的评测套件；对11个系统的评测揭示视频文本能力非单一化、任务高度不对称（V2V编辑为主要瓶颈），并可作为偏好优化训练信号。
AI.motivation: 视觉文本在视频生成中极为"苛刻"：笔画轻微损坏、时序不稳定或编辑误差都会立刻破坏可读性与真实感，而现有基准将文本视为附带内容，或采用忽略时序动态的静态OCR指标，无法评估这一挑战。
AI.method: 构建VidScribe统一诊断基准，覆盖四种生成范式：由语言书写文本(T2V)、从参考迁移文本身份(R2V)、在动态中维持文本(I2V)、局部文本编辑(V2V)。数据集含803个经人工验证的样本，分布在12轴条件正交因子空间，覆盖内在文本属性、物理成像条件与时序行为；评测方面构建轨迹锚定、门控式的指标套件，含11项共享指标与2项任务专用探针，并设严格可测性条件。
AI.result: 对11个商业与开源系统评测显示：视频文本能力并非单一整体，内容识别与笔画级字形正确性相互解耦；性能呈显著任务不对称，I2V最能稳定维持文本，V2V编辑是主要瓶颈；退化反常地集中于少数以文本为中心的结构与时序因子，而非不利成像条件。进一步探针表明：视觉参考提升字形与排版保真度而非内容准确度；局部编辑难以在不破坏未声明源文本的情况下隔离目标文本。
AI.conclusion: VidScribe不仅是评测基准，还能提供可操作的训练信号：与基准对齐的偏好优化可显著改善视觉文本生成。数据与资源已开源发布。

title: Scaling Video Generation for Reasoning: At What Cost?
summary: We study whether scaling video generation enables models to reason about hidden information from the past frames, and at what computational cost. Our controlled benchmark requires predicting nine prescribed moves of an initially solved 2x2x2 Rubik's Cube from a fixed view of three faces. Correct predictions require inferring how actions change hidden states, and the simulator provides exact ground truth for evaluation. Models learn plausible cube geometry early, while correct sticker configurations require substantially more training. Although validation MSE follows approximate power-law scaling, lower MSE loss does not reliably indicate downstream reasoning capabilities. Smaller autoregressive models achieve higher state accuracy with limited compute, while larger models reach higher accuracy after more training. At roughly 0.1 PF-days, the 70M-parameter model correctly predicts the visible sticker configuration in 44.6% of post-action frames, compared with 0.3% for the 1B model, which reaches 83.7% at 3.14 PF-days. Symbolic state supervision raises the 20M model's frame accuracy from 31.1% to 67.3% at the same training-data budget, suggesting that learning representations of state changes can complement scaling.

AI.tldr: 论文研究扩大视频生成模型是否能让其从历史帧中推理被遮挡信息，以及所需计算代价。以2×2×2魔方为受控基准，发现验证MSE虽呈幂律缩放，但低MSE并不代表下游推理能力强；小模型在有限算力下状态准确率更高，大模型需更多训练才反超；符号状态监督可显著提升小模型的帧准确率。
AI.motivation: 探究视频生成模型能否通过规模扩展获得对历史帧中隐藏信息的推理能力，并量化其计算成本，同时检验传统损失指标能否可靠反映下游推理性能。
AI.method: 构建受控基准：从三个面的固定视角，预测一个初始已还原的2×2×2魔方的九个指定动作序列，需推断动作对隐藏状态的影响；使用模拟器提供精确真值进行评测；对比不同参数量（20M、70M、1B）的自回归模型在不同训练算力下的表现，并引入符号状态监督作为对照。
AI.result: 模型早期即学得合理的立方体几何，但正确贴纸配置需更多训练；验证MSE呈近似幂律缩放，但更低MSE并不稳定指示下游推理能力；约0.1 PF-days时，70M模型在44.6%的动作后帧中正确预测可见贴纸配置，而1B模型仅0.3%，后者在3.14 PF-days时达到83.7%；同等训练数据预算下，符号状态监督将20M模型的帧准确率从31.1%提升至67.3%。
AI.conclusion: 视频生成模型的规模扩展与推理能力并非简单正相关，损失缩放不能可靠预测下游推理表现；较小模型在有限算力下更具效率，而符号状态监督可补充甚至部分替代单纯依赖缩放带来的收益。

title: Pixel-wise Exposure for Highly Robust In-Vehicle Remote-PPG
summary: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) offers a promising non-contact solution for heart rate monitoring, yet its real-world robustness is fundamentally limited by an inherent hardware limitation: existing camera exposure control paradigms, whether fixed or auto-exposure, impose a uniform exposure time across all pixels within a frame. In high-dynamic-range scenes such as automotive cabins with strong directional sunlight, this spatially invariant exposure constraint inevitably leads to localized facial overexposure or underexposure, irreversibly corrupting the subtle pulsatile signals essential for rPPG at the point of capture, a physical degradation that no downstream algorithm can recover. To overcome this bottleneck, we propose PixExpo (Pixel-wise Exposure), a "temporal-for-spatial" framework that sequentially captures frames under a predefined cyclic exposure schedule and performs non-iterative pixel-wise fusion. At each pixel location, PixExpo selects the observation closest to an rPPG-motivated target intensity. This criterion seeks to reduce local saturation and severe underexposure rather than optimize perceptual appearance. PixExpo requires no sensor modification but assumes programmable frame-level exposure control. We validate the proposed PixExpo framework using our newly introduced MEX-Drive dataset, comprising 48 participants under real-world driving conditions. Experimental results demonstrate that PixExpo outperforms manufacture-default auto-exposure methods, reducing the mean absolute error (MAE) by 7.21 bpm (from 13.94 to 6.73 bpm) and increasing the success rate by 37.29 percentage points (from 25.95% to 63.24%) across challenging driving scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PixExpo，一种"以时间换空间"的像素级曝光框架，通过循环曝光序列采集并用非迭代像素级融合选取最接近rPPG目标强度的观测值，缓解高动态范围场景下的局部过曝/欠曝问题，在MEX-Drive数据集上将MAE从13.94降至6.73 bpm，成功率提升37.29个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有相机的曝光控制范式（固定或自动曝光）对一帧内所有像素施加统一曝光时间，属于空间不变的硬件限制。在车载座舱等存在强方向性阳光的高动态范围场景中，这种约束必然导致面部局部过曝或欠曝，在采集端即不可逆地破坏rPPG所需的微弱脉动信号，任何下游算法都无法恢复。因此需要从采集层面突破该瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出PixExpo（Pixel-wise Exposure），一种"temporal-for-spatial"（以时间换空间）框架：在预设的循环曝光时间表下顺序采集多帧，随后进行非迭代的像素级融合。在每个像素位置，选取最接近rPPG动机目标强度的观测值，该准则旨在减少局部饱和与严重欠曝，而非优化视觉观感。方法无需修改传感器，但假设具备可编程的帧级曝光控制。同时构建MEX-Drive数据集用于验证，包含48名参与者在真实驾驶条件下的数据。
AI.result: 在真实驾驶场景的MEX-Drive数据集上，PixExpo优于厂商默认自动曝光方法：平均绝对误差（MAE）降低7.21 bpm（由13.94降至6.73 bpm），成功率提升37.29个百分点（由25.95%升至63.24%）。
AI.conclusion: 通过将空间上统一曝光的硬件约束转化为时间维度上的多曝光采集与像素级选择，PixExpo在不改动传感器的前提下显著提升了高动态范围场景下rPPG心率监测的鲁棒性与精度，为从采集端解决rPPG信号退化问题提供了可行路径。

title: CrossTimeEdit: A Decade-Spanning Cross-View Dataset and Reward-Guided Editing for Historical Street-View Generation
summary: Historical street-view imagery records urban evolution, but uneven coverage leaves substantial gaps in historical records. Generating plausible past appearances requires restoring changed structures while preserving persistent scene content. We construct VIGOR-his, a decade-spanning cross-view dataset containing 43,653 location-level quadruplets across 11 cities on three continents. Its automated pipeline performs spatial pairing, consistency screening, change classification, and the generation and validation of satellite-based change descriptions and local editing instructions. Based on VIGOR-his, we propose CrossTimeEdit, a model that reformulates historical street-view generation as editing, using recent street views to constrain viewpoint and unchanged appearance and temporal satellite differences as change evidence. Starting from FLUX.2 [Klein] 4B, we train CrossTimeEdit through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by online reinforcement learning (RL). We design three street-view editing criteria, namely Instruction Alignment (IA), Background Preservation (BP), and Quality and Physical Plausibility (QP), as both RL reward dimensions and evaluation metrics. We optimize this multi-reward objective using Within Group Relative Policy Optimization for flow-matching models (Flow-GRPO) with Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (GDPO), which normalizes each reward dimension before aggregation. CrossTimeEdit improves overall performance across the three editing criteria by 17.12\% over the pretrained baseline and outperforms cross-view generation models in scene consistency, visual realism, and perceptual quality. The implementation code, dataset, and model weights are available at https://luhanwen67.github.io/CrossTimeEdit-release/.

AI.tldr: 提出VIGOR-his跨视角数据集与CrossTimeEdit模型，将历史街景生成重构为编辑任务，结合SFT与Flow-GRPO/GDPO在线强化学习优化，在三项编辑准则上较基线提升17.12%。
AI.motivation: 历史街景影像可记录城市演变，但覆盖不均导致历史记录存在大量空白。生成合理的过去街景外观需在恢复已变化结构的同时保留未变化的场景内容，现有方法难以兼顾。
AI.method: 构建VIGOR-his数据集（11座城市、43,653个地点级四元组），自动化流程包含空间配对、一致性筛选、变化分类及基于卫星的变化描述与局部编辑指令的生成验证。提出CrossTimeEdit，将历史街景生成建模为编辑，用近期街景约束视角与不变外观、以时序卫星差异作为变化证据；基于FLUX.2 [Klein] 4B先SFT后在线RL训练。定义IA、BP、QP三项编辑准则作为奖励维度与评价指标，采用Flow-GRPO结合GDPO（先对各奖励维度归一化再聚合）优化多奖励目标。
AI.result: CrossTimeEdit在三项编辑准则上的整体性能较预训练基线提升17.12%，并在场景一致性、视觉真实感与感知质量上优于跨视角生成模型。
AI.conclusion: 将跨时序街景生成转化为以卫星差异为证据的编辑任务，并借助多奖励在线强化学习，可有效缓解历史街景覆盖空缺问题；代码、数据集与模型权重已开源。

title: Beyond Binary Preferences: Graded Preference Optimization for Limb-Motion Captioning
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can generate rich video captions, yet often misidentify which person performs an action or which limb is involved, particularly across camera cuts. Improving these details requires evaluation and training that distinguish missing information from incorrect assertions. We introduce FlexBench, a benchmark spanning 3,105 shots and 18,161 evaluation queries, with human-verified identities and systematic per-person coverage of fine-grained limb actions and states. Its reference-derived checklists support automated assessment of complete captions in their person and shot contexts. Our Graded Physical Alignment score (GPA) awards credit for correct content and deducts points for incorrect or fabricated actions, making these errors explicit in the aggregate score. Building on this rubric, we propose Graded Margin Direct Preference Optimization (GM-DPO), which assigns stronger preference margins and greater training weight to more severe action errors. Across three VLM backbones, GM-DPO achieves the highest substantive-action and GPA scores among the evaluated preference objectives, improving GPA over DPO by 2.02-3.40 points. On Qwen3-8B, it reduces the weighted hallucination rate by 21.3% relative to DPO. These gains accompany sustained long-form output, improved shot structure, and competitive performance on three additional multimodal benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出FlexBench基准与GPA评分法，并设计GM-DPO偏好优化方法，用于区分视频字幕中“信息缺失”与“错误断言”，显著提升人物—肢体动作描述的准确性并降低幻觉率。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在生成视频字幕时，常错误识别人物身份、动作主体或涉事肢体，尤其在镜头切换处更明显。改进此类细节需要同时评估训练环节能够区分“信息缺失”与“错误断言”，而现有基准与偏好优化目标往往无法显式体现这类错误。
AI.method: 构建FlexBench基准，包含3,105个镜头与18,161条评估查询，具有人工核验的人物身份与逐人物细粒度肢体动作、状态覆盖；基于参考答案生成检查清单，支持在人物与镜头语境下自动评估完整字幕。提出分级物理对齐分数（GPA），对正确内容加分、对错误或虚构动作扣分。在此评分标准上提出分级边际直接偏好优化（GM-DPO），对更严重的动作错误赋予更大的偏好边际与训练权重。
AI.result: 在三个VLM骨干模型上，GM-DPO在实质性动作与GPA分数上优于所评估的偏好目标，GPA较DPO提升2.02–3.40分。在Qwen3-8B上，加权幻觉率较DPO降低21.3%，同时保持长文本输出、改善镜头结构，并在另外三个多模态基准上具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过FlexBench与GPA显式区分缺失与错误，并以GM-DPO按错误严重程度加权优化，可有效提升视频字幕中人物—肢体动作描述的准确性、降低幻觉，且不损害长文本生成与通用多模态性能。

title: OCA: ODE-Driven Cross-Attention for Image-to-Point-Cloud Registration
summary: Cross-attention is a crucial component in learning-based image-to-point-cloud (I2P) registration. Although existing cross-attention mechanisms have achieved promising progress, attention ambiguity remains a fundamental challenge that hinders the learning of discriminative 2D-3D correspondences. To address this problem, we revisit cross-attention and establish ordinary differential equations (ODEs) to model the ideal I2P feature interaction. Based on this formulation, we develop an ODE-driven cross-attention (OCA) module that refines feature representations and attention matrices through ODEs. In practice, OCA can be seamlessly integrated into existing I2P registration frameworks. To validate its effectiveness, we incorporate OCA into five state-of-the-art baselines and evaluate on four public benchmark datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that OCA improves registration recall by up to 5\%, 9\%, and 15\% under the standard, fine-tuning, and zero-shot settings, respectively.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对图像到点云配准中交叉注意力存在的注意力模糊问题，提出用常微分方程建模理想I2P特征交互，并设计ODE驱动的交叉注意力（OCA）模块，可无缝嵌入现有框架，在多个基准上显著提升配准召回率。
AI.motivation: 交叉注意力是学习式图像到点云（I2P）配准的关键组件，现有机制虽有进展，但注意力模糊仍是阻碍学习判别性2D-3D对应关系的根本挑战。作者希望从新的建模视角解决该问题。
AI.method: 作者重新审视交叉注意力，建立常微分方程（ODEs）来建模理想的I2P特征交互。基于该形式化，提出ODE驱动的交叉注意力（OCA）模块，通过ODEs细化特征表示和注意力矩阵，且OCA可无缝集成到现有I2P配准框架中。
AI.result: 将OCA嵌入五个最先进基线，并在四个公开基准数据集上评估。实验表明，OCA在标准、微调和零样本设置下分别将配准召回率提升最多5%、9%和15%。
AI.conclusion: OCA有效缓解了注意力模糊问题，提升了2D-3D对应关系的判别性，具有良好的通用性和显著的性能增益，为I2P配准提供了新的ODE建模范式。

title: VLM4Cluster: Benchmarking Deep Clustering In the Era of Vision-Language Pre-training
summary: Vision-language pre-training has reshaped image clustering, giving rise to language-assisted image clustering (LaIC), which leverages textual semantics to complement visual representations. Despite the rapid proliferation of LaIC methods, it remains unclear how much LaIC has actually advanced image clustering, as existing studies generally suffer from major limitations, including inconsistent experimental settings, inadequate dataset selection, and limited evaluation dimensions. To address this gap, we introduce VLM4Cluster, a comprehensive benchmark for image clustering in the era of pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs). VLM4Cluster implements 17 representative methods spanning classical, deep, and language-assisted image clustering, and evaluates them on 20 datasets covering classical, challenging, fine-grained, large-scale, and out-of-distribution settings. Beyond effectiveness, VLM4Cluster systematically investigates image clustering along three complementary dimensions: robustness to adversarial perturbations, generalization under distribution shifts, and computational efficiency. Our study shows that LaIC substantially advances the clustering performance frontier on many semantically demanding benchmarks, generally exhibits stronger generalization under distribution shifts, and achieves a more favorable effectiveness-efficiency trade-off. However, its gains become less consistent on large-scale and fine-grained datasets, while language assistance does not systematically reduce sensitivity to adversarial perturbations. VLM4Cluster is released at https://github.com/YuanweiHuu/VLM4Cluster.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VLM4Cluster，一个面向预训练视觉-语言模型时代图像聚类的综合基准，涵盖17种代表性方法与20个数据集，并在有效性、鲁棒性、泛化性和效率四个维度进行系统评测。
AI.motivation: 语言辅助图像聚类（LaIC）方法快速涌现，但由于实验设置不一致、数据集选择不足、评估维度有限，无法判断LaIC究竟在多大程度上推进了图像聚类研究，缺乏统一、全面的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建VLM4Cluster基准，实现17种代表性方法，覆盖经典、深度和语言辅助图像聚类；在20个数据集上评测，涵盖经典、挑战性、细粒度、大规模及分布外（OOD）场景；并从有效性、对抗扰动鲁棒性、分布偏移泛化性和计算效率四个维度进行系统分析。
AI.result: LaIC在多个语义要求高的基准上显著推进了聚类性能前沿，通常在分布偏移下具有更强泛化能力，并取得更优的有效性-效率权衡；但在大规模和细粒度数据集上增益不稳定，语言辅助并未系统性降低对对抗扰动的敏感性。
AI.conclusion: VLM4Cluster为VLM时代的图像聚类提供了统一评测平台，揭示了LaIC的优势与局限，指出其在大规模、细粒度及对抗鲁棒性方面仍有改进空间，基准已开源。

title: FocusVTC: Efficient and High-Performance Visual Text Compression with Adaptive Resolution
summary: Long-context reasoning in large language models incurs substantial computation and memory costs. Visual text compression (VTC) reduces input length by rendering text as images, but fixed-resolution rendering creates a compression-performance trade-off: low DPI saves tokens at the expense of legibility, whereas high DPI spends tokens on irrelevant content. We introduce FocusVTC, which breaks this trade-off through adaptive resolution while preserving general multimodal capabilities. It combines compressed low-DPI global views with selective region enhancement, integrating enhanced views into ongoing reasoning. We construct 29.4K high-quality Reasoning-Evidence Localization (REL) chain-of-thought examples (REL-CoT) that link reasoning traces to page indices and bounding boxes. Multi-resolution REL supervised fine-tuning (REL-SFT) teaches the model to localize relevant regions, and Group Relative Policy Optimization learns when to enhance resolution and how to use the resulting observations, without a separate continual-pretraining stage. At 72 DPI on RULER v1, FocusVTC scores 87.4 at $2.9\times$ input compression, including tool observations, versus 57.5 for Glyph at $3.0\times$ input compression. It surpasses its text-input backbone on LongBench (56.40 versus 55.86), improves the MRCR macro-average by 13.91 points, and achieves a 51.19 macro-average on VTCBench. The MRCR latency evaluation also shows a $2.79\times$ online end-to-end speedup over Text. General multimodal capabilities are preserved, with MMMU increasing from 65.12 to 66.73 and MME from 2424.02 to 2457.62.

AI.tldr: FocusVTC 通过自适应分辨率打破视觉文本压缩的固定分辨率权衡：以压缩低 DPI 全局视图结合选择性区域增强，并借助 REL-CoT 数据、REL-SFT 与 GRPO 训练模型定位并增强相关区域，在长上下文任务上取得显著性能与效率提升，同时保持通用多模态能力。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理在大型语言模型中带来高昂的计算与内存开销。视觉文本压缩（VTC）通过将文本渲染为图像来缩短输入长度，但固定分辨率渲染造成压缩—性能权衡：低 DPI 节省 token 却牺牲可读性，高 DPI 则将 token 花费在无关内容上。因此需要一种既能高压缩又不损失性能的方法。
AI.method: 提出 FocusVTC，通过自适应分辨率打破上述权衡，同时保留通用多模态能力。方法将压缩的低 DPI 全局视图与选择性区域增强相结合，并把增强视图整合到持续推理中。构建 29.4K 高质量 Reasoning-Evidence Localization（REL）思维链示例（REL-CoT），将推理轨迹与页码索引和边界框关联。多分辨率 REL 监督微调（REL-SFT）教会模型定位相关区域，随后用 Group Relative Policy Optimization 学习何时增强分辨率以及如何使用由此得到的观测，且无需单独的持续预训练阶段。
AI.result: 在 RULER v1 上以 72 DPI 运行时，FocusVTC 在 2.9× 输入压缩（含工具观测）下得分为 87.4，而 Glyph 在 3.0× 输入压缩下为 57.5。在 LongBench 上超过其纯文本输入骨干（56.40 对 55.86），将 MRCR 宏平均提升 13.91 分，在 VTCBench 上达到 51.19 宏平均。MRCR 延迟评测显示相对 Text 有 2.79× 的在线端到端加速。通用多模态能力得以保留，MMMU 从 65.12 提升到 66.73，MME 从 2424.02 提升到 2457.62。
AI.conclusion: FocusVTC 证明自适应分辨率可以有效解决视觉文本压缩中压缩率与性能之间的固有权衡：通过压缩全局视图加选择性区域增强，并配合 REL-CoT 数据与 SFT+GRPO 训练，在保持甚至提升长上下文性能的同时实现显著输入压缩与端到端加速，且不损害通用多模态能力。

title: Not Every Correction Helps: Gain-Guided Continual Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Continual test-time adaptation (CTTA) adapts a source model to an unlabeled test stream whose distribution may change over time. Existing TTA methods often assess prediction reliability using confidence or entropy, which primarily reflect the model's self-certainty for the current sample. In CTTA, accumulated target observations can provide complementary evidence for correcting the source prediction, but this history may become misaligned as the target distribution changes. The key question is therefore not how much the correction differs from the source prediction, but whether and how strongly it should be applied. This paper proposes Gain-Aware INtervention (GAIN), a backpropagation-free CTTA framework guided by a simple principle: history proposes, gain decides. GAIN maintains compact target statistics to form a correction proposal and a posterior-predictive evaluator that accounts for estimation uncertainty. The resulting source-relative gain estimates the proposal's benefit and determines a sample-specific intervention strength along a continuous path through efficient one-dimensional optimization. Gain-controlled predictions then update the target statistics online, limiting the propagation of unreliable corrections, all without backpropagation, sample storage, or replay. Across five benchmarks, our method achieves strong predictive performance, with favorable accuracy--calibration--efficiency trade-offs in continual adaptation. On ImageNet-C, for example, GAIN achieves 61.9% accuracy with near-source calibration. It remains stable under diverse and challenging continual shifts while running 15.9x faster than a representative optimization-based CTTA baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出GAIN，一种免反向传播的持续测试时自适应框架，以"历史提议、增益决定"为原则，通过源相对增益估计决定样本级干预强度，在五个基准上取得良好性能与效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有持续测试时自适应（CTTA）方法多用置信度或熵评估预测可靠性，但这主要反映模型对当前样本的自确定性。在CTTA中，累积的目标观测可为修正源预测提供互补证据，然而随着目标分布变化，历史信息可能失准。因此关键问题不是修正与源预测差异多大，而是是否应施加修正以及强度如何。
AI.method: GAIN是一种免反向传播的CTTA框架。它维护紧凑的目标统计量以形成修正提议，并构建考虑估计不确定性的后验预测评估器；由此得到源相对增益估计，用于衡量提议收益，并通过高效的一维优化在连续路径上确定样本级干预强度。受增益控制的预测随后在线更新目标统计量，从而抑制不可靠修正的传播。整个过程无需反向传播、样本存储或回放。
AI.result: 在五个基准上方法取得强预测性能，并在持续自适应中呈现良好的准确率—校准—效率权衡。例如在ImageNet-C上，GAIN达到61.9%准确率且校准接近源模型；在多样且具有挑战性的持续漂移下保持稳定，同时比代表性基于优化的CTTA基线快15.9倍。
AI.conclusion: GAIN通过将历史提议与增益决策解耦，用源相对增益引导样本级干预强度，为CTTA提供了一种高效、稳定的免反向传播方案，兼顾精度、校准与效率。

title: You Only Reprogram Once: Rethinking Prolonged Training for Visual Reprogramming
summary: Visual reprogramming is a parameter-efficient method for adapting pretrained models, yet its training can remain computationally expensive: even with a frozen backbone, visual prompts are often optimized through the full model for hundreds of epochs. Before changing what the pretrained model sees, we ask whether we are fully using what it already tells us. We find that modeling the full source response can already yield strong downstream predictions without prompt optimization. Motivated by this observation, we introduce You Only Reprogram Once (YORO), which constructs a downstream predictor from the frozen response space in a single forward-only traversal. Its Bayesian Discriminant Mapping (BDM) derives a covariance-aware affine mapping from streaming class statistics, requiring no backpropagation, optimizer updates, or repeated visits to the training set. When further input adaptation helps, YORO-FP optionally refines the visual prompt for 20 epochs. BDM also extends naturally to CLIP by treating attribute-prompt similarities as source responses. Across three full-data settings, YORO improves average accuracy over the strongest prior gradient-free mapping by 18.4--24.4\%. On 16-shot CLIP, it raises the four-backbone average from 71.4\% to 77.2\%. YORO-FP provides further gains on selected tasks, while validation often retains the one-pass predictor. These results suggest a different default for visual reprogramming: read out the frozen response first, and optimize the input only when needed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出YORO，一种无需提示优化、单次前向遍历即可构建下游预测器的视觉重编程方法，核心为基于流式类统计的贝叶斯判别映射（BDM）；在全文数据与少样本CLIP设定下均显著优于现有无梯度映射方法。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉重编程虽参数高效，但即使在骨干网络冻结的情况下，仍需通过完整模型对视觉提示进行数百个epoch的优化，训练计算代价高昂。作者质疑：在改变预训练模型的输入之前，是否已充分利用模型本身已有的信息。
AI.method: 作者发现直接对完整源响应建模即可获得较强的下游预测，无需提示优化。据此提出YORO：在冻结的响应空间中进行单次前向遍历构建下游预测器。其贝叶斯判别映射（BDM）从流式类统计中推导出协方差感知的仿射映射，无需反向传播、优化器更新或重复访问训练集。当输入适应确有帮助时，YORO-FP可选地对视觉提示进行20个epoch的微调。BDM亦可自然扩展至CLIP，将属性-提示相似度视为源响应。
AI.result: 在三个全文数据设定中，YORO相较最强的无梯度映射方法平均准确率提升18.4%–24.4%；在16-shot CLIP上，将四个骨干网络的平均准确率从71.4%提升至77.2%。YORO-FP在部分任务上带来进一步增益，而验证集上通常仍保留单次遍历预测器。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明视觉重编程应采用不同的默认范式：先读出冻结响应，仅在需要时再优化输入。这为参数高效适配提供了更高效的新方向。

title: ReWorld-Track: A Recursive Event World Model for Language-Guided Multi-Camera Tracking
summary: Language-guided multi-camera tracking must preserve a target identity across unobserved gaps, where similar candidates and uncertain returns can make early associations unreliable. A wrong match can corrupt the history used to predict later observations and propagate identity errors across subsequent camera handoffs. We propose ReWorld-Track, a recursive event world model that carries association uncertainty into future predictions. Candidate matches and continued waiting define alternative target states, whose posterior probabilities are used to update a persistent recurrent belief. This representation preserves uncertainty about alternative trajectories through successive observations. This belief predicts the next camera, arrival time, and entry region, while appearance and language evidence guide association. By training across successive handoffs, the model learns to retain uncertainty that remains useful for later predictions and identity decisions. ReWorld-Track achieves HOTA scores of 65.19 on CityFlowV2 and 45.36 on MTMMC, with improved identity continuity across repeated handoffs. On MTMMC, its structured posterior update gains 0.50 HOTA points over a similarly sized generic updater and 0.94 points over fixed-moment soft association, raising next-camera accuracy from 86.03% to 87.41% and reducing median arrival-time error from 0.78 s to 0.71 s for subsequent target returns.

AI.tldr: 提出ReWorld-Track，一种递归事件世界模型，将关联不确定性纳入未来预测，在跨摄像头跟踪中保持目标身份连续性。在CityFlowV2上HOTA达65.19，MTMMC上达45.36。
AI.motivation: 语言引导的多摄像头跟踪需在目标未被观测的间隙中保持身份一致，但相似候选与不确定回归使早期关联不可靠。一次错误匹配会污染用于预测后续观测的历史，并将身份错误传播至后续摄像头交接。
AI.method: 将候选匹配与继续等待定义为目标的备选状态，用其后验概率更新持久递归信念，从而在连续观测中保留对备选轨迹的不确定性。该信念预测下一摄像头、到达时间与进入区域，外观与语言证据用于引导关联；在多次连续交接上训练，使模型学会保留对后续预测与身份决策有用的不确定性。
AI.result: CityFlowV2 HOTA 65.19，MTMMC HOTA 45.36，重复交接下身份连续性提升。MTMMC上结构化后验更新比同规模通用更新器高0.50 HOTA，比固定时刻软关联高0.94 HOTA；下一摄像头准确率由86.03%升至87.41%，后续目标回归的中位到达时间误差由0.78 s降至0.71 s。
AI.conclusion: 将关联不确定性显式建模并递归传递到未来预测，可有效缓解跨摄像头交接中的身份误差传播，提升跟踪精度与身份连续性。

title: Reprogramming Vision-Language Models via Structured Prompt Reparameterization
summary: Visual reprogramming adapts pretrained models to downstream tasks by modifying their input and output interfaces while keeping the backbone fixed. In vision-language models, existing methods mainly rely on intra-class prompt aggregation and do not explicitly model relationships among classes. However, fine-grained categories often exhibit highly overlapping attribute descriptions and strong inter-class correlation in the text embedding space, where discriminative cues lie in subtle low-variance components. We propose Reparameterized Inter-Class Visual Reprogramming (RVP), a structured framework that aggregates multiple text prompts within each class and applies residual correction across classes. We also show that CLIP-based visual reprogramming with input-independent linear output aggregation can be expressed as a linear mapping from frozen image embeddings to downstream logits, and use this view to design a structured reparameterization that models shared semantic components and class-specific differences. RVP uses only a single visual prompt and can be reparameterized at inference into a frozen backbone followed by a linear classifier, incurring nearly zero computational overhead. Across 11 few-shot classification benchmarks and four CLIP backbones, RVP consistently improves over prior visual reprogramming methods with comparable or better inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出RVP（重参数化类间视觉重编程）框架，通过类内多提示聚合与类间残差校正，将CLIP视觉重编程建模为从冻结图像嵌入到下游logits的线性映射，推理时可重参数化为冻结骨干加线性分类器，几乎零额外开销。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型的重编程方法主要依赖类内提示聚合，未显式建模类间关系。而细粒度类别在文本嵌入空间中属性描述高度重叠、类间相关性强，判别线索存在于低方差细微成分中，因此需要显式建模类间关系。
AI.method: RVP在一个结构化框架中，对每个类内聚合多个文本提示，并在类间施加残差校正；理论证明基于CLIP的、输入无关线性输出聚合的视觉重编程可表示为从冻结图像嵌入到下游logits的线性映射；基于该视角设计结构化重参数化，建模共享语义成分与类特有差异；仅使用单个视觉提示，推理时可重参数化为冻结骨干加线性分类器。
AI.result: 在11个少样本分类基准和4个CLIP骨干网络上，RVP一致优于先前的视觉重编程方法，且推理效率相当或更优，额外计算开销几乎为零。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模类间关系并结合结构化重参数化，可在保持冻结骨干与高推理效率的同时显著提升少样本分类性能，为视觉重编程提供了新的理论视角与实用设计。

title: When Semantics Matter: Reliability-Aware Semantic-Rhythm Control for Co-Speech Gesture Generation
summary: Co-speech gesture generation aims to synthesize natural gestures that are both temporally synchronized with speech and semantically consistent with the spoken content. Although recent methods can generate rhythmically plausible motions, they often rely heavily on acoustic prosody while underutilizing textual semantics, especially when semantic annotations are incomplete, noisy, or unavailable. Consequently, the generated gestures may follow speech rhythm while failing to express the intended semantics. To address this problem, we propose a reliability-aware semantic-rhythm control framework for co-speech gesture generation. We first learn a discrete motion prior that represents continuous gestures in a compact and structured motion-code space. We then introduce a dual-branch semantic contribution estimation mechanism consisting of a full multimodal branch and an audio-only branch. Their distributional discrepancy is formulated as conditional information gain to quantify how much textual semantics changes the predicted motion. Based on this estimate, a controllable semantic-rhythm objective selectively strengthens semantic guidance in content-relevant segments while limiting unnecessary semantic intervention in rhythm-dominant segments. Furthermore, we treat background noise as an acoustic reliability condition and introduce noise-conditioned feature modulation together with beneficial latent perturbation to improve generation robustness under realistic acoustic environments. Experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves a favorable balance among semantic expressiveness, rhythmic synchronization, motion diversity, and robustness, enabling reliable and controllable co-speech gesture generation.

AI.tldr: 提出可靠性感知的语义-韵律控制框架，通过离散动作先验与语义贡献估计实现语义引导与韵律主导的自适应切换，并增强噪声鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有共语手势生成方法过度依赖声学韵律而低估文本语义，尤其在语义标注不完整、噪声大或缺失时，生成动作虽韵律合理却无法表达预期语义。
AI.method: 1) 学习离散动作先验，将连续手势映射到紧凑结构化的动作码空间；2) 构建双分支语义贡献估计机制（全多模态分支与仅音频分支），以分布差异作为条件信息增益量化文本语义对动作预测的影响；3) 基于该估计设计可控语义-韵律目标，在内容相关片段强化语义引导、在韵律主导片段抑制多余语义干预；4) 将背景噪声视为声学可靠性条件，引入噪声条件特征调制与有益潜变量扰动。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上实现了语义表达力、韵律同步、动作多样性与鲁棒性之间的良好平衡。
AI.conclusion: 该框架实现了可靠且可控的共语手势生成。

title: AESplat: Advancing Pose-Free Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting via Decoupled Appearance Modeling
summary: Pose-free feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has demonstrated remarkable potential for generalized novel view synthesis. However, existing methods typically predict Gaussian appearance attributes represented by spherical harmonics (SH) in the same manner, overlooking the fundamental distinction between view-independent and view-dependent appearance, which results in suboptimal rendering quality. In this paper, we present AESplat, a novel and general framework for pose-free feed-forward 3DGS that introduces an effective decoupled appearance modeling strategy based on an analysis of SH, enabling higher-quality rendering. Specifically, AESplat directly derives the zeroth-order SH coefficient, which represents the base view-independent appearance component, from the input images without training. The higher-order SH coefficients are subsequently predicted by a shallow multilayer perceptron equipped with two efficient 3D-aware inductive biases to model view-dependent appearance variations. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, achieving a $0.8$ dB improvement in PSNR over the pose-free method NAS3R and a $1.1$ dB improvement over the pose-required method DepthSplat on the RealEstate10K dataset. Project page: https://aesplat.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AESplat，一种无位姿前馈 3DGS 框架，通过解耦外观建模（0 阶 SH 免训练直接从输入图像获得，高阶 SH 用带 3D 感知归纳偏置的浅层 MLP 预测）提升渲染质量，在 RealEstate10K 上 PSNR 较 NAS3R 提升 0.8 dB、较 DepthSplat 提升 1.1 dB。
AI.motivation: 现有无位姿前馈 3DGS 方法对所有高斯外观属性统一用球谐函数（SH）预测，忽视了视角无关与视角相关外观的本质区别，导致渲染质量次优。
AI.method: 分析 SH 后提出解耦外观建模策略：0 阶 SH 系数（视角无关基础外观）无需训练直接从输入图像导出；高阶 SH 系数由带两种高效 3D 感知归纳偏置的浅层 MLP 预测，用于建模视角相关外观变化。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上大幅超越 SOTA；RealEstate10K 上 PSNR 较无位姿方法 NAS3R 提升 0.8 dB，较需位姿方法 DepthSplat 提升 1.1 dB。
AI.conclusion: 解耦视角无关与视角相关外观的建模策略对无位姿前馈 3DGS 有效，AESplat 作为通用框架可实现更高质量的新视角合成。

title: Drag as Evidence: Motion-Grounded Latent Recomposition for Drag-Based Editing
summary: Modern image editors excel at semantic manipulation and visual synthesis, yet remain limited in precise spatial control, motivating the development of drag-based editing. However, existing drag-based methods often struggle to balance drag accuracy with natural, plausible, and intent-aligned generation. We propose MoRe-Drag, a motion-grounded drag-based editing method. Our key insight is to treat pixel-space warping as coarse motion evidence, and to inject this evidence into the generative sampling trajectory. Specifically, MoRe-Drag performs region-aware latent recomposition over refinement, inpainting, and anchor regions, coupled with stage-adaptive conditioning that progressively shifts from motion-grounded structure formation to semantic refinement. We further support an instruction-free interface by adapting the MLLM-based text encoder for drag-aware instruction inference. Experiments on DragBench-SR and DragBench-DR show that MoRe-Drag substantially improves drag precision over strong base editors and achieves superior drag accuracy among SOTA drag-based methods, while delivering strong semantic consistency and visually realistic results. Code and dataset will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: MoRe-Drag 将像素空间的 warping 视为粗运动证据并注入生成采样轨迹，通过区域感知 latent 重组与阶段自适应条件实现高精度、自然的拖拽式图像编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有图像编辑器擅长语义操控与视觉合成，但精确空间控制能力受限，因此出现拖拽式编辑。然而现有拖拽方法难以在拖拽精度与自然、合理、符合意图的生成之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 将像素空间 warping 作为粗运动证据注入生成采样轨迹；对 refinement、inpainting、anchor 三类区域执行区域感知的 latent 重组；采用阶段自适应条件，从运动驱动的结构形成逐步过渡到语义精修；并通过适配基于 MLLM 的文本编码器实现拖拽感知的指令推断，支持无指令接口。
AI.result: 在 DragBench-SR 与 DragBench-DR 上，MoRe-Drag 相较强基线编辑器显著提升拖拽精度，在 SOTA 拖拽方法中达到领先的拖拽准确率，同时具备较强的语义一致性与视觉真实感。
AI.conclusion: MoRe-Drag 通过运动驱动的拖拽编辑框架有效平衡了精度与生成质量，为精确空间控制提供了新思路，代码与数据集将公开。

title: NesTok: Nested Self-Aligned 1D Tokenizer for Autoregressive Image Generation
summary: One-dimensional (1D) variable-length visual tokenizers enable adaptive compression by varying the number of tokens, allowing downstream autoregressive (AR) models to flexibly trade off generation quality against computational cost using a single tokenizer. However, existing approaches based on nested dropout often fail to fully exploit the representational capacity of the tokenizer, resulting in suboptimal performance in both image reconstruction and generation. In this work, we introduce NesTok, a nested self-alignment framework tailored to dynamic visual tokenizers. NesTok introduces cross-length training, which jointly optimizes reconstruction across token lengths while using the full-length sequence to guide shorter counterparts, enabling shorter token sequences to approach the reconstruction quality of full-length sequences. On ImageNet, NesTok improves substantially over standard training and achieves an rFID score of 0.98. On downstream image generation, it achieves the state-of-the-art gFID score of 1.46 on ImageNet 256$\times$256 among existing variable-length autoregressive image generation methods. Code will be available at https://github.com/jaiwei804/NesTok.

AI.tldr: NesTok：面向一维变长视觉分词器的嵌套自对齐框架，通过跨长度训练提升重建与生成性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于嵌套dropout的变长视觉分词器未能充分发挥分词器的表征能力，导致图像重建与生成性能次优。
AI.method: 提出NesTok嵌套自对齐框架，引入跨长度训练：联合优化不同token长度下的重建，并用全长序列指导短序列，使短token序列逼近全长序列的重建质量。
AI.result: 在ImageNet上显著优于标准训练，重建rFID达0.98；下游ImageNet 256×256生成任务中，gFID达1.46，在现有变长自回归图像生成方法中取得最优。
AI.conclusion: NesTok有效提升变长视觉分词器的重建与生成性能，验证了嵌套自对齐与跨长度训练的有效性，代码将开源。

title: FastVR: Efficient Streaming Video Restoration with One-Step Diffusion
summary: Diffusion-based video restoration recovers realistic details, but its practical deployment is limited by two efficiency bottlenecks: costly VAE encoding and decoding, and the quadratic cost of full self-attention in diffusion transformers (DiTs). This paper presents FastVR, a streaming video restoration framework built on a one-step diffusion model, which delivers strong restoration quality and temporal consistency while processing 1080p video at 11 FPS on a single H20 GPU. To improve inference efficiency, FastVR combines a lightweight VAE with chunk-wise causal attention, which substantially reduces the computational cost. During training, it further adopts velocity consistency regularization and continuous trajectory learning, which improve restoration quality. Extensive experiments show that FastVR is more efficient than the evaluated diffusion baselines while achieving state-of-the-art performance on synthetic and real-world benchmarks. We hope that this work supports further progress in the community.

AI.tldr: 提出FastVR，基于一步扩散模型的流式视频修复框架，结合轻量VAE与分块因果注意力，在单张H20 GPU上以11 FPS处理1080p视频并达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 扩散式视频修复虽能恢复真实细节，但实际部署受制于两个效率瓶颈：VAE编解码开销高，以及扩散Transformer（DiT）中全局自注意力的二次复杂度。
AI.method: 构建于一步扩散模型之上的流式视频修复框架；推理阶段采用轻量VAE与分块因果注意力（chunk-wise causal attention）以降低计算成本；训练阶段引入速度一致性正则化与连续轨迹学习以提升修复质量。
AI.result: 在单张H20 GPU上以11 FPS处理1080p视频；在合成与真实世界基准上达到SOTA性能，且效率优于所评测的扩散基线方法。
AI.conclusion: FastVR在效率与修复质量间取得良好平衡，兼顾强恢复质量与时序一致性，为视频修复的实际部署与后续社区研究提供支持。

title: Dual-Mode Low-Rank Learner with Bridge-Prototype Ensemble for Vision-Language Class-Incremental Learning
comment: 21 pages, 11 figures, and 12 tables, including the appendix
summary: Benefiting from transferable visual-textual alignment, CLIP has been widely adopted for class-incremental learning (CIL). However, existing learners either repeatedly update components shared across tasks, leading to knowledge overwriting, or overly isolate new-task updates, hindering the reuse of CLIP's transferable knowledge and limiting plasticity. Moreover, the text-based or bimodal classifier designs still fail to effectively integrate complementary information from the visual and textual modalities. To address these challenges, we introduce DuLBE, which couples dual-mode low-rank learning with a bridge-prototype ensemble classifier for exemplar-free CIL. DuLBE allocates two visual low-rank update modes according to the gradient demand and uses gradient routing to coordinate them: a compact and rewritable shared mode is selected from historically occupied visual directions to reuse transferable knowledge, while residual modes provide low-interference channels for task-specific variations. Building on the resulting stable inter-modal structure, we further construct geodesic bridges between visual prototypes and text embeddings on the unit hypersphere, and ensemble reliable bridge prototypes to compensate for the modality-gap limitations of textual decision boundaries. Extensive experiments under multiple settings show that DuLBE achieves state-of-the-art CIL performance while retaining the high parameter efficiency of low-rank tuning.

AI.tldr: DuLBE：面向无样本类增量学习，结合双模式低秩学习与桥原型集成分类器，兼顾可塑性、稳定性与参数效率。
AI.motivation: 基于CLIP的类增量学习（CIL）存在两类问题：一是重复更新跨任务共享组件导致知识覆盖，或过度隔离新任务更新，阻碍CLIP可迁移知识复用并限制可塑性；二是纯文本或双模态分类器设计无法有效整合视觉与文本的互补信息。
AI.method: 提出DuLBE，将双模式低秩学习与桥原型集成分类器耦合用于无样本CIL。按梯度需求分配两种视觉低秩更新模式，并用梯度路由协调：从历史占用的视觉方向中选择紧凑可重写的共享模式以复用可迁移知识，残差模式提供低干扰通道承载任务特定变化。在由此形成的稳定跨模态结构上，于单位超球面构建视觉原型与文本嵌入之间的测地桥，并集成可靠桥原型以补偿文本决策边界的模态鸿沟局限。
AI.result: 在多种设置下的广泛实验表明，DuLBE取得state-of-the-art的CIL性能，同时保持低秩调参的高参数效率。
AI.conclusion: DuLBE通过双模式低秩更新与梯度路由缓解稳定性-可塑性冲突，并通过测地桥原型集成弥补模态鸿沟，是兼顾性能与参数效率的无样本CIL方案。

title: DSPO: Diversity-aware Subjective Policy Optimization for Robust Emotional Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement Learning has significantly advanced the complex reasoning capabilities of MLLMs. However, prevailing RL algorithms suffer a severe failure in emotion reasoning tasks. These methods heavily rely on deterministic hard-label supervision and point-wise isolated evaluation, creating a fundamental gap with the inherently subjective and continuously distributed nature of human emotions. Furthermore, unlike explicit physical objects, emotional states are deeply implicit within visual cues. This abstract nature exacerbates visual hallucinations in MLLMs, leading to plausible yet ungrounded emotional evidence. To address these limitations, we propose Diversity-Aware Subjective Policy Optimization (DSPO), a reinforcement learning framework that jointly promotes subjective affective coverage and visual grounding. First, we construct a context-grounded emotional distribution prior in the VAD space by combining the lexical prior of the annotated emotion with image-specific contextual information. Based on this prior, we introduce a Distribution-Aligned Emotional Diversity Reward (DEDR), which measures the leave-one-out marginal contribution of each candidate emotion within a rollout. DEDR rewards candidates whose inclusion brings the predicted affective set closer to the context-grounded prior, thereby preserving plausible subjective interpretations without encouraging unconstrained dispersion. We further develop Counterfactual Visual Intervention Gating (CVIG), which masks the visual region highlighted in the reasoning process and uses the resulting candidate-wise probability changes to reduce the weights of interpretations unsupported by visual evidence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DSPO achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple public benchmarks, especially on the cross-domain performance, i.e., improving +10.8\% on average cross-domain accuracy than EMO-R3.

AI.tldr: 提出DSPO强化学习框架，通过分布对齐的情感多样性奖励与反事实视觉干预门控，解决MLLM情感推理中硬标签监督与视觉幻觉问题，在多基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有RL算法在情感推理任务上存在严重失效：依赖确定性硬标签监督与逐点孤立评估，与人类情感主观、连续分布的本质存在根本性差距；同时情感状态隐含于视觉线索中，抽象性强，加剧了MLLM的视觉幻觉，导致看似合理却缺乏依据的情感证据。
AI.method: 提出Diversity-Aware Subjective Policy Optimization（DSPO）框架，联合促进主观情感覆盖与视觉接地。1）在VAD空间中，结合标注情感的词汇先验与图像特定上下文信息，构建上下文接地的情感分布先验；2）基于该先验提出Distribution-Aligned Emotional Diversity Reward（DEDR），以留一法衡量每个候选情感在rollout中的边际贡献，奖励使预测情感集合更接近先验的候选，从而保留合理的主观解释而不鼓励无约束发散；3）提出Counterfactual Visual Intervention Gating（CVIG），遮蔽推理过程中高亮的视觉区域，利用候选概率变化降低缺乏视觉证据支持的解读权重。
AI.result: 大量实验表明DSPO在多个公开基准上取得SOTA性能，尤其在跨域表现上，相比EMO-R3平均跨域准确率提升+10.8%。
AI.conclusion: DSPO通过将情感推理的监督从硬标签转向分布先验对齐，并结合反事实视觉干预，有效缓解视觉幻觉，兼顾情感主观多样性与视觉接地，显著提升情感推理及跨域泛化能力。

title: Causal-EVC: Breaking Emotional Spurious Causality via Spatiotemporal Grounding and Counterfactual Intervention
summary: Emotional Video Captioning aims to generate factually accurate and emotionally empathetic descriptions. While recent methods have recognized the importance of visual causes to guide emotion perception and caption generation, they fundamentally rely on simple attention matching, which inevitably suffers from {causal redundancy and spurious correlations} in co-occurrence bias (e.g., misclassifying ``sadness'' as ``joy'' on a sunny beach), leading to severe shortcut learning from confusing backgrounds. Furthermore, existing evaluations fail to verify whether models have genuinely mastered causal reasoning or merely exploited background confounders. To address these limitations, we first construct {EVC-CauseGround}, a comprehensive benchmark with dense spatio-temporal causal annotations. Crucially, it introduces a carefully selected {Causal-Faithfulness Subset} to explicitly quantify genuine emotion-cause attribution. Second, we propose {Causal-EVC}, an emotion-grounding captioning framework, which introduces a Motion-guided Causal Spatiotemporal Localization module to precisely decouple causal triggers from background confounders. Besides, we introduce an Interpretable Sparse Emotion Routing module. By synthesizing counterfactual representations and formulating a novel counterfactual contrastive objective, we enforce the model to anchor its emotion predictions strictly on authentic causal triggers instead of confusing background. Extensive experiments show that Causal-EVC not only achieves the best performance on semantic metrics but also exhibits significant advantages in the causal-faithfulness subset, which demonstrates that our model could mine emotional cues from genuine visual causes and mitigate co-occurrence bias for interpretable multimodal emotion understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文针对情感视频描述中的因果冗余与虚假相关问题，构建了带稠密时空因果标注的 EVC-CauseGround 基准与因果忠实性子集，并提出 Causal-EVC 框架，通过运动引导因果时空定位、可解释稀疏情感路由与反事实对比目标，显著提升语义指标与因果忠实性。
AI.motivation: 现有情感视频描述方法虽已关注视觉原因对情感感知与描述生成的引导作用，但依赖简单注意力匹配，易受共现偏差导致的因果冗余与虚假相关影响（例如晴天海滩场景中将“悲伤”误判为“喜悦”），产生严重捷径学习；同时现有评测无法验证模型是否真正掌握因果推理，抑或仅利用背景混杂因子。
AI.method: 1) 构建 EVC-CauseGround 基准，提供稠密时空因果标注，并设置经精心筛选的 Causal-Faithfulness Subset 以量化真实情感—原因归因；2) 提出 Causal-EVC 情感定位描述框架，包含 Motion-guided Causal Spatiotemporal Localization 模块，从背景混杂因子中精确解耦因果触发因素；3) 引入 Interpretable Sparse Emotion Routing 模块，结合合成的反事实表征与新颖的反事实对比目标，约束情感预测锚定于真实因果触发因素而非混淆背景。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，Causal-EVC 不仅在语义指标上取得最佳性能，还在因果忠实性子集上展现出显著优势。
AI.conclusion: 该模型能够从真实视觉原因中挖掘情感线索，缓解共现偏差，实现可解释的多模态情感理解。

title: Decoding Affective Nuances: Enhancing MLLMs via Hierarchical Emotion Reasoning and Contrastive Discriminative Pruning
summary: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated exceptional capabilities in objective understanding tasks, their performance in affective reasoning still falls significantly short of human standards. We attribute it to a central capability gap: MLLMs are difficult to reliably distinguish semantically proximal emotions based on fine-grained visual evidence, which could be decoupled as two limitations: 1) Insufficient Attribution. The global reasoning paradigm of conventional MLLMs severely dilutes fine-grained emotion cues, where subtle emotional states are usually implicitly encoded, thereby generating emotional misjudgments in complex scenarios. 2) Insufficient Discrimination. Existing methods could only identify regions generally associated with emotions, which fails to distinguish discriminative regions between semantically similar emotions, leading to ambiguous emotion judgements. To overcome these limitations, we present a training-free inference-time optimization framework, named Decoding Affective Nuances (DAN). Specifically, we propose a Hierarchical Emotional Reasoning Chain (HERC) that enhances the insufficient attribution by harmonizing fine-grained scene/object-level cues and performing a soft-gated reasoning. Furthermore, to discriminate between semantically proximal emotions, we design a Contrastive Discriminative Visual Pruning (CDVP), which isolates discriminative visual tokens to reason the final emotion category by computing the absolute discrepancy between the attention distributions of similar emotions. Performances on several benchmarks demonstrate that DAN significantly improves discrimination for affective nuances without consuming additional training resources, especially achieving +10.47% improvements with Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct on WebEmo25 dataset that contains 25 fine-grained emotion categories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出免训练的推理时优化框架 DAN，通过分层情感推理链（HERC）与对比判别视觉剪枝（CDVP），缓解 MLLM 在细粒度情感归因与相似情感判别上的不足，在 WebEmo25 上提升 10.47%。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在客观理解任务上表现优异，但情感推理远不及人类水平。作者将其归因于一个核心能力缺口：MLLM 难以依据细粒度视觉证据可靠区分语义相近的情感，并解耦为两点局限：1）归因不足——全局推理范式严重稀释细粒度情感线索，细微情绪状态通常被隐式编码，导致复杂场景下误判；2）判别不足——现有方法只能定位与情感大致相关的区域，无法区分语义相似情感之间的判别性区域，造成情感判断模糊。
AI.method: 提出免训练的推理时优化框架 Decoding Affective Nuances（DAN）。其一为分层情感推理链（HERC），通过协调细粒度场景/物体级线索并进行软门控推理来增强归因能力；其二为对比判别视觉剪枝（CDVP），通过计算相似情感注意力分布之间的绝对差异，隔离判别性视觉 token，从而推理最终情感类别。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，DAN 在不消耗额外训练资源的前提下显著提升了对情感细微差别的判别能力，尤其在包含 25 类细粒度情感的 WebEmo25 数据集上，使用 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 取得 +10.47% 的提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过推理阶段的细粒度线索协调与相似情感间的对比视觉剪枝，可在免训练条件下有效弥补 MLLM 的情感归因与判别短板，提升细粒度情感推理性能。

title: Seeing What Should Be Heard: Diagnosing and Repairing Cross-Modal Shortcuts in Omni-Modal LLMs
summary: Omni-modal large language models (LLMs) are expected to answer a question using the modality it explicitly refers to. However, existing training paradigms rarely verify whether models actually follow this modality, because multimodal inputs from the same sample often provide redundant evidence for the same answer. In this work, we uncover a pervasive cross-modal shortcut in omni-modal LLMs: when asked an audio-related question, models rely on the image as much as on the audio, and sometimes even more. To systematically diagnose this behavior, we introduce the Factorized Modality Diagnostic, which independently swaps audio and images between samples to isolate each modality's causal contribution. Across two model families in different settings, we find that this shortcut persists throughout supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning post-training, while judge-based RL may further amplify such reliance on irrelevant visual information. Based on this finding, we propose DMC-Repair, which trains models on the same kind of cross-modal swapped samples while assigning supervision according to the modality specified by the question. This prevents models from exploiting the spurious correspondence between modalities within the same clip. Experiments demonstrate that DMC-Repair reduces the image-induced share of the answer effect by 59.9%, effectively suppressing the cross-modal shortcut without compromising audio-question answering performance. The reduction in shortcut reliance generalizes across two model families and zero-shot to an unseen dataset and an unseen benchmark, and persists through subsequent post-training. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DMC-Repair.

AI.tldr: 本文发现全模态大语言模型存在普遍的跨模态捷径：回答音频相关问题时，模型对图像的依赖与音频相当甚至更强，且该捷径贯穿SFT与RL后训练；提出DMC-Repair修复方法，通过跨模态交换样本并按问题指定模态施加监督，将图像诱导的答案效应占比降低59.9%且不损失音频问答性能。
AI.motivation: 现有全模态LLM训练范式很少验证模型是否真正遵循问题所指明的模态，因为同一样本的多模态输入常对同一答案提供冗余证据，导致模型可借助另一模态走捷径而无需真正使用目标模态。
AI.method: 提出Factorized Modality Diagnostic（分解模态诊断），通过在同一样本间独立交换音频与图像来隔离各模态的因果贡献；基于诊断发现，提出DMC-Repair，使用同类跨模态交换样本训练，并依据问题所指定的模态分配监督信号，打破同片段内模态间的虚假对应关系。
AI.result: 在两个不同设置下的两个模型家族中，跨模态捷径在SFT和RL后训练中持续存在，且基于评判的RL可能进一步放大对无关视觉信息的依赖；DMC-Repair将图像诱导的答案效应占比降低59.9%，在保持音频问答性能的同时有效抑制捷径，且该效果可跨模型家族泛化、零样本迁移到未见数据集与基准，并在后续后训练中持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 全模态LLM普遍存在跨模态捷径，仅凭标准训练范式难以消除；通过跨模态交换并按问题指定模态施加监督的DMC-Repair可有效抑制该捷径，同时不损害目标模态问答能力，具有良好的泛化性与后训练稳定性。

title: Scene Retargeting: Learning Object Placement with Analogical Transfer
summary: Interactive simulations of embodied AI or spatial computing applications build on realistic 3D scenes that support daily activities. However, sparse, irregular layout structures impose scene-specific physical constraints, making it hard to define a generalizable framework for generating similar functional context. We formalize Scene Retargeting as stably transferring the semantically coherent spatial organization across layouts, rather than relying on textual descriptions or pairwise relationships. Our cluster-wise transfer flexibly handles mismatched object instances and adapts to distinctive floor plans. We optimize to preserve the rich semantic context of individual clusters by respecting the spatial distribution of foundation features. We can then impose physical constraints to refine wall contacts, pairwise alignment, or clear passageways and openings. Our framework outperforms state-of-the-art methods on layout generation on the 3D-FRONT dataset, and demonstrates downstream applications including real-to-sim transfer, analogical trajectory transfer, and multi-reference composition.

AI.tldr: 论文将"场景重定向"形式化为跨布局稳定迁移语义连贯的空间组织，提出基于簇的迁移与优化框架，在3D-FRONT上超越SOTA并支持多种下游应用。
AI.motivation: 交互式具身智能与空间计算应用依赖支持日常活动的真实3D场景，但稀疏、不规则的布局结构带来场景特定的物理约束，难以构建可泛化的功能性场景生成框架；且现有方法多依赖文本描述或成对关系，不足以稳定迁移场景语义组织。
AI.method: 将Scene Retargeting形式化为跨布局稳定迁移语义连贯的空间组织；采用簇级（cluster-wise）迁移以灵活处理对象实例不匹配并适配不同户型；通过尊重基础特征空间分布的优化来保留各簇的丰富语义上下文；随后施加物理约束以优化墙接触、成对对齐以及通道与开口的通畅。
AI.result: 在3D-FRONT数据集的布局生成任务上，该框架性能优于现有最先进方法，并演示了真实到仿真迁移、类比轨迹迁移和多参考组合等下游应用。
AI.conclusion: 以簇为单位的空间组织迁移与物理约束精修相结合，可提供可泛化的场景重定向框架，在布局生成上取得领先效果，并支撑真实到仿真迁移、轨迹类比迁移与多参考组合等实际应用。

title: EGSD: Event-Grounded Self-Distillation for Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Real-time video understanding requires incrementally maintaining a memory of streaming content, and optimizing this requires dense process signals. On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), which lets one model serve as both teacher and student with the teacher receiving additional privileged information such as the question and ground-truth (GT) answer, can supply such token-level signals. However, applying it directly to streaming video raises two problems. (1) The student cannot be optimized end-to-end, where memory is written before the question arrives, yet the teacher scores it with the question-and-GT privilege, misaligning their preferences. (2) Effective-entity memory collapses, where the question-and-GT privilege makes the teacher favor only question-relevant entities, and token-mean averaging over a memory renders its signal invariant to how many entities that memory covers, both driving memory against the streaming need for diversity. To address these issues, we propose Event-Grounded Self-Distillation (EGSD), which characterizes streaming memory as an incremental update over verifiable Events (key visual entities, actions, and details) and targets the two problems on this basis. For problem (1), we adapt the OPSD signal into a multiplicative weight combined with the outcome reward; for problem (2), we re-weight the teacher with Events as privileged information to counter its question-relevance bias, and add an entity-coverage reward to supply the coverage preference the token-mean teacher lacks. Extensive experiments on mainstream online and offline benchmarks show EGSD achieves strong performance, reaching 79.8% on StreamingBench and 73.4% on the OVO-Bench Real-Time track, while memory analysis shows effective-entity recall rises 17.4% at only 6.8% more memory length.

AI.tldr: 提出事件锚定的自蒸馏方法 EGSD，缓解流式视频记忆中 OPSD 的端到端不可优化与有效实体坍缩问题，在多个在线/离线基准上取得优异表现。
AI.motivation: 实时视频理解需增量维护流式内容记忆，并依赖稠密的过程信号来优化。On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) 可提供 token 级信号（教师模型接收问题与答案等特权信息），但直接用于流式视频会产生两个问题：(1) 学生模型无法端到端优化——记忆在问题到达前写入，教师却用问题与 GT 特权对其打分，导致二者偏好不一致；(2) 有效实体记忆坍缩——问题与 GT 特权使教师只偏好与问题相关的实体，且对记忆做 token 均值平均会使其信号对实体覆盖数量不敏感，二者共同使记忆偏离流式场景所需的多样性。
AI.method: 提出 Event-Grounded Self-Distillation (EGSD)，将流式记忆刻画为对可验证事件（关键视觉实体、动作与细节）的增量更新，并据此解决上述两个问题。针对问题 (1)，将 OPSD 信号改造为与结果奖励相乘的乘性权重；针对问题 (2)，以事件作为特权信息对教师重新加权，以抵消其问题相关性偏好，并加入实体覆盖奖励，提供 token 均值教师所缺失的覆盖偏好。
AI.result: 在主流在线与离线基准上取得强劲表现：StreamingBench 达 79.8%，OVO-Bench Real-Time 赛道达 73.4%；记忆分析显示有效实体召回率提升 17.4%，而记忆长度仅增加 6.8%。
AI.conclusion: EGSD 通过事件锚定的自蒸馏框架，有效解决了 OPSD 在流式视频记忆中的偏好错位与有效实体坍缩问题，在保持记忆开销基本不变的前提下显著提升实体覆盖与下游任务性能，验证了以可验证事件作为记忆单元与特权信息的有效性。

title: MeteoVerse: Unified Weather-Controllable Video World Model
summary: Video world models aim to predict future content from an observed scene while following prescribed camera motion. Real-world scene evolution is determined not only by changes in viewpoint and object dynamics, but also by environmental conditions such as weather, which can substantially alter scene appearance and visibility. Modeling such realistic weather evolution is challenging because the required weather modification depends jointly on the observed and desired weather states. Depending on their relation, the model may need to preserve, introduce, or remove a weather effect. Existing video world models typically leave this weather transition implicit, forcing the generation backbone to infer weather evolution together with scene dynamics and camera motion, which leads to imprecise weather control. To address this limitation, we propose MeteoVerse, a unified weather-controllable video world model that generates future videos from a single sunny or adverse-weather image, conditioned on a weather-free scene description, a target-weather instruction, and a camera trajectory. Rather than conditioning only on the desired weather, MeteoVerse explicitly estimates the observed and target weather states and represents the required weather transition. A transition-aware mixture of weather experts then translates this transition into category-specific residual weather features, unifying weather preservation, introduction, and removal while enabling fine-grained control over introduced weather intensity. We further construct the MeteoVerse dataset with over 50K real-world weather video clips, generated sunny counterparts, disentangled scene and weather descriptions, weather-intensity annotations, and camera trajectories. Extensive experiments demonstrate substantially improved weather controllability while retaining competitive scene consistency and camera-control performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 MeteoVerse，一个统一的天气可控视频世界模型，通过显式建模观测与目标天气状态之间的"天气转移"，实现天气的保持、引入与移除及强度细粒度控制，并构建了 50K+ 真实天气视频数据集。
AI.motivation: 现实场景演化不仅由视角变化和物体动态决定，还受天气等环境条件影响，天气会显著改变场景外观与可见度。天气修改取决于观测天气与目标天气的共同关系（需保持、引入或移除天气效应）。现有视频世界模型将天气转移隐含处理，让生成主干同时推断天气、场景动态与相机运动，导致天气控制不精确。
AI.method: MeteoVerse 以单张晴天或恶劣天气图像、无天气场景描述、目标天气指令和相机轨迹为条件生成未来视频。它不只用目标天气作为条件，而是显式估计观测天气状态与目标天气状态并表征所需的天气转移；再用转移感知的天气专家混合（transition-aware mixture of weather experts）将该转移转换为类别特定的残差天气特征，统一天气保持、引入与移除并支持引入天气强度的细粒度控制。同时构建 MeteoVerse 数据集，含 50K+ 真实天气视频片段、生成的晴天对应版本、解耦的场景与天气描述、天气强度标注和相机轨迹。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，MeteoVerse 在显著提升天气可控性的同时，保持了具有竞争力的场景一致性和相机控制性能。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模天气转移并结合天气专家混合，是解决视频世界模型中天气演化控制不精确问题的有效途径，为可控且逼真的天气演化视频生成提供了统一框架与配套数据资源。

title: CurvSpec: Adaptive Multi-Curvature Learning for Partial Relevant Video Retrieval
summary: Partially Relevant Video Retrieval (PRVR) seeks to retrieve untrim-med videos containing a moment that matches a text query, without temporal annotations. The relevant moment may last only seconds within a video spanning several minutes, creating an extremely low signal-to-noise ratio that makes PRVR more challenging than standard full-video retrieval. This task presents two intertwined challenges: (1) signal dilution, where coarse global representations blur the brief relevant signal into the dominant irrelevant surroundings;(2) curvature rigidity, where embedding all videos in the same fixed-geometry space distorts representations for videos that range from flat atomic events to deep compositional hierarchies. Existing PRVR methods have improved moment selection and cross-modal matching, but they still typically encode all videos in a single fixed-curvature retrieval space, limiting their ability to model diverse video structures. To address both challenges, we propose CurvSpec, a framework that learns content-adaptive curvature for video retrieval representations rather than imposing a fixed geometric prior. CurvSpec processes features through parallel Euclidean and hyperbolic attention layers, with independently learned curvatures assigned to the hyperbolic layers, and a content-aware fusion mechanism routes each input to its most suitable geometric regime. To further suppress signal dilution, CurvSpec represents each video with semantic centroids whose number is determined by the video's content complexity, projects them onto the learned manifold, and matches each query against its nearest centroid by geodesic distance. Experiments on ActivityNet Captions, TVR, and Charades-STA demonstrate state-of-the-art retrieval performance.

AI.tldr: 提出CurvSpec框架，通过内容自适应曲率学习与语义质心匹配解决PRVR中的信号稀释和曲率刚性问题，在多个数据集上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 部分相关视频检索（PRVR）中，相关片段可能仅持续数秒而视频长达数分钟，信噪比极低，比标准全视频检索更具挑战。该任务面临两个交织的难题：(1)信号稀释，粗粒度全局表示将短暂的相关信号淹没在占主导的无关背景中；(2)曲率刚性，将所有视频嵌入同一固定几何空间，会扭曲从平面原子事件到深层组合层次等结构各异的视频表示。现有PRVR方法虽改进了片段选择和跨模态匹配，但仍将全部视频编码在单一固定曲率的检索空间中，难以建模多样的视频结构。
AI.method: 提出CurvSpec框架，学习内容自适应的曲率而非强加固定几何先验。具体地：并行处理特征通过欧几里得与双曲注意力层，双曲层分配可独立学习的曲率；采用内容感知融合机制，将每个输入路由到最合适的几何体系。为进一步抑制信号稀释，CurvSpec用语义质心表示每个视频，质心数量由视频内容复杂度决定，将其投影到所学流形上，并通过测地距离将查询与最近质心匹配。
AI.result: 在ActivityNet Captions、TVR和Charades-STA三个数据集上的实验表明，CurvSpec取得了最先进的检索性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过内容自适应曲率学习与语义质心匹配，CurvSpec同时缓解了信号稀释与曲率刚性问题，验证了学习式几何表示在部分相关视频检索中的有效性。

title: RED: Reconstruction Evolution Dynamics for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: The rapid evolution of image generators calls for forensic cues that generalize beyond known generation mechanisms. Existing detectors often rely on static image representations or endpoint reconstruction discrepancies, leaving the evolution of intermediate reconstruction stages underexplored. We observe that the relative token predictability of real and generated images can reverse across reconstruction scales, suggesting that intermediate stages may expose forensic evidence overlooked by endpoint comparisons. Motivated by this observation, we propose RED (Reconstruction Evolution Dynamics), a framework that captures transferable forensic cues from coarse-to-fine reconstruction evolution. To our knowledge, RED is the first framework to use scale-wise token predictability to guide forensic evidence aggregation across intermediate reconstruction states. It represents the reconstruction trajectory produced by a frozen multiscale VQ-VAE in the shared feature space of a frozen CLIP encoder. To connect the observed predictability variations with visual evidence, RED learns image-adaptive stage weights from scale-wise token negative log-likelihoods provided by a frozen VAR model. A cross-stage evidence aggregation module then jointly models the original-image representation and the weighted reconstruction features, capturing complementary forensic cues through interactions along the reconstruction trajectory. Experiments on six diverse benchmarks demonstrate that RED achieves the highest average accuracy of 92.5\% and average precision of 97.5\% among the evaluated methods. Further evaluations show strong robustness to common image degradations, supporting the value of reconstruction evolution for generalizable AI-generated image detection. The code will be made publicly available upon acceptance of this paper.

AI.tldr: 提出RED框架，利用多尺度VQ-VAE重建轨迹中逐尺度token可预测性变化，聚合中间重建阶段的取证证据，实现可泛化的AI生成图像检测。
AI.motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测器多依赖静态图像表征或终点重建差异，忽视了中间重建阶段的演化过程。作者观察到真实与生成图像的相对token可预测性会随重建尺度发生反转，提示中间阶段蕴含被终点比较所忽略的取证证据。
AI.method: RED将冻结的多尺度VQ-VAE生成的重建轨迹映射到冻结CLIP编码器的共享特征空间，利用冻结VAR模型给出的逐尺度token负对数似然学习图像自适应的阶段权重，再通过跨阶段证据聚合模块联合建模原图表征与加权重建特征，捕捉重建轨迹上的互补取证线索。
AI.result: 在六个多样化基准上，RED取得评估方法中最高的平均准确率92.5%与平均精度97.5%，并对常见图像退化表现出较强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: RED是首个利用逐尺度token可预测性引导中间重建状态取证证据聚合的框架，验证了重建演化对可泛化AI生成图像检测的价值。

title: Learning via Self-Consistency for Diffusion-based Video Reasoning
comment: 23 pages, including 10 pages for the main body
summary: Video generation models have demonstrated emerging zero-shot capabilities for visual reasoning, perception, and other vision tasks. However, diffusion-based video generation is inherently stochastic, while many downstream vision tasks are deterministic. Motivated by the effectiveness of self-consistency in chain-of-thought reasoning for large language models, we investigate whether self-consistency can similarly improve diffusion-based video reasoning. We first introduce a training-free test-time scaling method that samples multiple video generations and aggregates their predictions through self-consistency. Specifically, we aggregate extracted paths, locations, or masks from multiple rollouts into a consensus prediction. To reduce the inference overhead of multi-rollout generation, we read out predictions early in the denoising trajectory, which preserves consensus quality while reducing denoising steps by more than half. We further propose Rejection Fine-Tuning (RFT) to distill consensus predictions into the video generation model. The resulting model internalizes the benefit of multi-sample consensus and requires only a single generation at inference time, while substantially outperforming the original model. Experiments on three tasks, including maze solving, visual search, and referring segmentation, show that both our self-consistency inference and consensus distillation dramatically improve video-based perception and reasoning, without requiring ground-truth videos or task-specific verification. For visual search, self-consistency raises task accuracy from 48.4% for a single generation to 99.0%. The distilled model retains much of the consensus benefit with a single rollout. For 4-by-4 maze solving, consensus-based training improves the single-generation strict success rate from 72.0% to 84.0% with the same inference latency.

AI.tldr: 本文将大语言模型中的自一致性思想引入扩散视频生成，提出免训练的多rollout共识聚合与Rejection Fine-Tuning蒸馏方法，在迷宫求解、视觉搜索和指代分割任务上大幅提升视频推理精度。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型已展现零样本视觉推理能力，但基于扩散的视频生成本质上是随机的，而许多下游视觉任务需要确定性输出。受大语言模型思维链中自一致性方法有效性的启发，作者探索能否用自一致性提升基于扩散的视频推理能力。
AI.method: 1) 免训练测试时扩展：多次采样视频生成，将多条rollout中抽取的路径、位置或掩码聚合成共识预测；2) 为降低多rollout开销，在去噪轨迹早期读出预测，在保持共识质量的同时减少一半以上去噪步数；3) 提出Rejection Fine-Tuning (RFT)，将共识预测蒸馏进视频生成模型，使模型内化多样本共识收益，推理时仅需单次生成。
AI.result: 在迷宫求解、视觉搜索、指代分割三个任务上，自一致性推理与共识蒸馏均显著提升视频感知与推理表现，且无需真值视频或任务特定验证器。视觉搜索准确率从单次生成的48.4%提升至99.0%；蒸馏模型以单次rollout即保留大部分共识收益。4×4迷宫求解中，基于共识的训练将单次生成严格成功率从72.0%提升至84.0%，推理延迟不变。
AI.conclusion: 自一致性可有效迁移至扩散视频推理，测试时多rollout共识与拒绝微调蒸馏均能显著提升性能，且蒸馏后的模型在单次生成下即可获得接近共识的效果，验证了该范式在视频视觉推理任务中的通用性和实用性。

title: Motion Concept Unlearning in Video Diffusion Models
comment: Accepted to ACM MM 2026. Dr. Chi Zhang is the corresponding author
summary: Text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models can generate realistic depictions of actions such as kicking, stabbing, and shooting, raising safety concerns that motivate targeted concept erasure. Although concept erasure has been extensively studied for static concepts in text-to-image and T2V models, erasing motion concepts remains largely unexplored. We present a systematic study of motion concept erasure in video Diffusion Transformers (DiTs). Through causal interventions, we show that text-conditioning attention carries concept-specific motion information and supports selective intervention, whereas perturbing temporal positional encoding suppresses both target and non-target dynamics. We further find that directly adapting ESD, a representative weight-level image erasure method, to a video DiT yields modest and uneven motion suppression: reducing its erasure training loss does not by itself remove the concept signal from the difference between the conditional and unconditional predictions, which classifier-free guidance (CFG) then scales at every denoising step. From these findings, we derive three requirements for motion concept erasure: concept specificity, spatial selectivity, and temporal naturalness. Each determines one component of MUTE (Motion concept Unlearning in Text-to-video gEneration): at each denoising step, MUTE extracts a concept direction through token neutralization, derives a spatial gate from the direction's intrinsic structure, and subtracts the resulting correction from the velocity output before CFG is applied. MUTE is training-free and requires no weight modification. Experiments on 20 motion concepts show that MUTE outperforms representative prompt-level, weight-level, and inference-time baselines on Wan2.1-T2V, and the same formulation transfers to CogVideoX, supporting its applicability across distinct T2V attention architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究视频扩散Transformer中的运动概念擦除，提出免训练方法MUTE，通过令牌中和提取概念方向、构建空间门控并在CFG前减去校正量，在20个运动概念上优于现有基线并可迁移至不同T2V架构。
AI.motivation: T2V扩散模型可生成踢打、刺击、射击等真实动作，引发安全担忧，需针对性概念擦除。静态概念擦除已在T2I和T2V中广泛研究，但运动概念的擦除仍基本未被探索。
AI.method: 通过因果干预发现：文本条件注意力携带概念特定的运动信息并支持选择性干预，而扰动时间位置编码会同时抑制目标与非目标动态。指出直接将ESD（权重级图像擦除方法）迁移到视频DiT效果有限且不均衡，因为降低擦除训练损失并不能消除条件与无条件预测差值中的概念信号，而CFG会在每步去噪中放大该信号。据此提出运动概念擦除的三项要求：概念特异性、空间选择性、时间自然性。MUTE在每个去噪步通过令牌中和提取概念方向，从该方向的内在结构导出空间门控，并在应用CFG前从速度输出中减去所得校正。MUTE免训练、无需修改权重。
AI.result: 在20个运动概念上的实验表明，MUTE在Wan2.1-T2V上优于代表性的提示级、权重级与推理时基线；相同形式可迁移至CogVideoX，证明其适用于不同的T2V注意力架构。
AI.conclusion: 运动概念擦除需满足概念特异性、空间选择性与时间自然性；基于令牌中和、方向结构门控及CFG前校正的免训练框架MUTE能有效擦除运动概念，并具备跨架构的可迁移性。

title: You Cannot Recover What Was Never Measured: Quantifying the Information Ceiling of Ultra-Low-Field MRI Super-Resolution
summary: Generative super-resolution models can turn portable 64 mT MRI into images that look like 3T scans, and the field evaluates them with PSNR, SSIM, and pixelwise uncertainty, most often on pairs built by synthetically degrading high-field images. Prior work acknowledges that these models hallucinate and that the problem is ill posed, but to our knowledge no study measures how much information about the individual subject the real low-field scan actually contains. We measure it. Using paired 64 mT and 3T scans of the same subjects from three public datasets, and a measurement protocol validated on tests whose correct answer is known in advance, we find that, judged over the whole brain, real 64 mT scans carry structure specific to the individual only down to approximately 3 to 4 mm half-pitch in plane, and coarser still through plane. Standard synthetic degradations preserve subject information roughly 1 mm beyond this ceiling, so models trained and benchmarked on synthetic pairs are evaluated on information that real scanners never record. We then test trained diffusion models and a publicly released external model on real paired acquisitions; 24 trained runs of five architectures (GAN, diffusion, and transformer families) give the coverage of the audit. On every subject where faithfulness can be measured, fine output detail is no more correlated with the subject's own 3T scan than with a stranger's, while sample-variance uncertainty does not distinguish fabricated structure from reconstruction difficulty. Because PSNR and SSIM score resemblance to a reference rather than whether detail belongs to the subject, a benchmark scored by them cannot tell recovery from fabrication. Code for the measurement protocol will be released so that recoverability claims can be tested for newer models.

AI.tldr: 该研究量化了真实64 mT低场MRI中所含的个体主体信息上限（约3–4 mm平面半间距），指出常见合成退化对保留主体信息约多1 mm，因此基于合成配对的评测超出真实扫描可记录的信息；对24个训练模型与一个外部模型的审计显示，细粒度输出细节与主体自身3T扫描的相关性并不高于陌生人扫描，且样本方差不确定性无法区分伪造结构与重建困难，故PSNR/SSIM无法区分恢复与伪造。
AI.motivation: 生成式超分辨率模型可让便携式64 mT MRI看起来像3T扫描，但领域内多以PSNR、SSIM及逐像素不确定性评测，且配对数据常由高场图像合成退化得到。已有工作承认此类模型会幻觉、问题病态，但尚无研究测量真实低场扫描实际包含多少个体主体信息，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 使用三个公开数据集中同一受试者的64 mT与3T配对扫描，并采用在答案已知先验的测试上验证过的测量协议；据此测定真实64 mT扫描所含个体特异结构的信息上限；再在真实配对采集上测试训练过的扩散模型与一个公开外部模型，覆盖5种架构（GAN、扩散、Transformer族）共24个训练运行，评估细粒度输出细节与主体自身3T扫描的相关性，以及样本方差不确定性对伪造结构与重建困难的区分能力。
AI.result: 按全脑判断，真实64 mT扫描携带个体特异结构仅至平面内约3–4 mm半间距，穿平面方向更粗；标准合成退化保留主体信息约超出该上限1 mm，说明模型在合成配对上训练与基准测试时所用信息是真实扫描器从未记录的。在可测量保真度的每个受试者上，细粒度输出细节与主体自身3T扫描的相关性不高于与陌生人扫描的相关性，样本方差不确定性无法区分伪造结构与重建困难。
AI.conclusion: 由于PSNR与SSIM衡量的是与参考图像的相似度，而非细节是否属于该主体，以二者评分的基准无法区分恢复与伪造。测量协议代码将公开，以便对新模型的可恢复性主张进行检验。

title: On-Policy Visual Evidence Distillation
comment: 44 pages, including appendices. Project page: https://sylvain-wei.github.io/ReVuE/ . Code: https://github.com/sylvain-wei/ReVuE
summary: Visual agents solve problems by interleaving reasoning with image operations, and on-policy distillation (OPD) provides guidance from a strong teacher on student-generated interaction trajectories.
