However, image operations change the evidence available for subsequent reasoning, so local errors in evidence acquisition (Acquire), reading (Read), or answer grounding (Ground) can propagate through the trajectory and lead to incorrect answers. Existing multimodal OPD methods primarily construct or contrast auxiliary views of the original image to strengthen supervision, without explicitly modeling the connections between student actions, resulting observations, and subsequent reasoning. This limits their ability to provide corrections tailored to different failure stages. We introduce Reflection on Visual Evidence (ReVuE), an on-policy distillation method for visual agents. ReVuE compares multiple student-generated trajectories for the same query, summarizes the observed visual evidence, and diagnoses the first failure across the Acquire, Read, and Ground stages. The resulting reflections provide training-time context for the teacher. We group and reweight token-level distillation losses according to how strongly these reflections affect the teacher's predictions. This design translates trajectory-level evidence diagnosis into targeted token-level supervision, guiding students to improve their visual evidence acquisition and reasoning. Across 11 benchmarks spanning the Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL3.5 model families, ReVuE outperforms all evaluated OPD baselines in weighted-average scores for perception, mathematical reasoning, and general tasks. ReVuE also reduces redundancy in reasoning and tool calls while improving tool-call accuracy and task accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/sylvain-wei/ReVuE

AI.tldr: ReVuE 是一种面向视觉智能体的在线策略蒸馏方法，通过对比多条学生轨迹、诊断首个视觉证据失败阶段并生成反思，将轨迹级证据诊断转化为加权的 token 级监督信号，在 11 个基准上超越现有 OPD 基线。
AI.motivation: 视觉智能体通过推理与图像操作交替求解问题，图像操作会改变后续推理所依赖的证据，因此证据获取（Acquire）、读取（Read）或答案锚定（Ground）阶段的局部错误会在轨迹中传播并导致错误答案。现有方法多通过构建或对比原图辅助视图来强化监督，未显式建模学生动作、观测结果与后续推理之间的联系，难以针对不同失败阶段提供定制化纠正。
AI.method: ReVuE 针对同一查询对比多条学生生成的轨迹，总结所观测到的视觉证据，并诊断 Acquire、Read、Ground 三个阶段中的首个失败。所得反思作为训练时上下文提供给教师模型，再依据反思对教师预测的影响程度对 token 级蒸馏损失进行分组与重加权，从而将轨迹级证据诊断转化为有针对性的 token 级监督。
AI.result: 在覆盖 Qwen2.5-VL 与 InternVL3.5 模型家族的 11 个基准上，ReVuE 在感知、数学推理与通用任务的加权平均得分上均优于所有被评估的 OPD 基线；同时减少了推理与工具调用的冗余，提升了工具调用准确率与任务准确率。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式诊断视觉证据失败阶段并据此重加权蒸馏损失，ReVuE 能引导学生改进视觉证据获取与推理，在多个模型家族与任务上验证了有效性，为多模态在线策略蒸馏提供了更细粒度的监督范式。

title: Does the VGGT Family Need All Its Layers?
summary: Which layers of a feed-forward geometry model are needed to preserve both camera poses and dense 3D structure? We study layer redundancy in VGGT, $π^3$, and VGGT-$Ω$: 3,018 pruned configurations, scored on seven camera-pose and dense-geometry metrics across four indoor and outdoor datasets. Four findings follow: (i) Removable layers cluster in two redundancy regions: a dominant early region and a narrower late one, while deletions spanning the intervening layers are consistently more disruptive. This recurring pattern holds across models, datasets, and metrics, and contrasts with the middle-to-late redundancy commonly reported in the literature. (ii) Within these regions, we observe that the joint degradation from deleting two intervals is approximately the sum of their individual degradations, reducing the number of model evaluations for pruning search from $O(L^4)$ to $O(L^2)$, where $L$ is the aggregator depth. (iii) We find that CKA provides a cheaper representation-based proxy for interval degradation, offering a practical trade-off between pruning quality and calibration cost. (iv) Closed-form linear calibration recovers accuracy after pruning without end-to-end retraining. A least-squares analysis shows that using a shared map for special and patch tokens generally incurs excess reconstruction loss, motivating token-aware recovery. Recovery maps fitted on just 100 calibration scenes generalize to held-out scenes and unseen datasets. The resulting models reduce aggregator parameters by up to 44% while maintaining accuracy comparable to their intact counterparts. Code and experimental results will be available at our project page: https://xian-bei.github.io/vggt-family-layer-redundancy/

AI.tldr: 研究VGGT、π³、VGGT-Ω的层冗余，发现早期与晚期两个可移除区域，提出O(L²)剪枝搜索、CKA代理与闭式校准，参数减44%且精度相当。
AI.motivation: 针对前馈几何模型（如VGGT系列）中聚合器层冗余不明的问题，探究哪些层对保持相机位姿与稠密3D结构不可或缺，以指导剪枝压缩。
AI.method: 在VGGT、π³、VGGT-Ω上进行3018种剪枝配置，用7个相机位姿与稠密几何指标在4个室内外数据集上评估；分析区间删除的可加性、CKA代理指标及闭式线性校准。
AI.result: 可移除层集中于早期主导区和晚期狭窄区；双区间联合退化近似等于各自退化之和，将搜索从O(L⁴)降至O(L²)；CKA可作为低成本代理；共享映射会造成额外重建损失，token-aware校准在100个场景拟合后可泛化至未见数据集；聚合器参数减少至44%仍保持精度。
AI.conclusion: VGGT类模型存在一致的层冗余结构，结合可加性剪枝搜索与闭式token-aware校准，可在无需端到端重训的情况下大幅压缩模型并保持精度。

title: GlassFormer: Learning Real-time Glass Segmentation using Radar-Depth Fusion
comment: Accepted for presentation at IEEE IROS 2026. Code available at https://github.com/Suhani92/GlassFormer
summary: Transparent surfaces are ubiquitous in built environments, yet they remain a persistent failure case for robotic perception. RGB cameras perceive the background behind glass rather than the surface itself, while depth sensors such as LiDAR, time-of-flight, and RGB-D often return invalid or background measurements in transparent regions. As a result, systems that rely solely on optical sensing may misinterpret glass walls, doors, or mirrors as free space, compromising safe and reliable navigation. Existing glass segmentation approaches address this by learning visual cues such as reflections, boundaries, and semantic context from RGB images. While effective under favourable lighting and viewing conditions, these cues degrade in low-light environments, under glare, or when glass surfaces are featureless or partially occluded. In this work, we propose a multimodal framework that fuses millimetre-wave radar with RGB-D sensing for real-time transparent surface segmentation. Radar reflects strongly off glass surfaces, providing a geometric cue that remains reliable precisely where vision and depth fail. We exploit this cross-modal inconsistency to generate a radar-guided spatial prior, which is integrated into a lightweight transformer-based segmentation network, GlassFormer, via cross-modal attention. We report results on a mixed-condition test split covering all scene types and a dedicated low-light split designed to stress vision-only methods. GlassFormer achieves 0.88 mIoU on the mixed split, and 0.59 mIoU on the low light split, demonstrating substantial robustness gains over vision-only baselines while maintaining real-time performance on resource-constrained platforms.

AI.tldr: 提出融合毫米波雷达与RGB-D的多模态透明表面分割框架GlassFormer，用雷达引导空间先验并通过跨模态注意力注入轻量Transformer分割网络，在混合条件与低光条件下均显著优于纯视觉基线且保持实时性。
AI.motivation: 透明表面（玻璃墙、门、镜子）是机器人感知的持续失败场景：RGB相机只能看到玻璃背后的背景，LiDAR、ToF、RGB-D等深度传感器在透明区域返回无效或背景测量，使系统误将玻璃判为自由空间，危及导航安全。现有基于RGB的玻璃分割方法依赖反射、边界、语义上下文等视觉线索，在低光、眩光、无纹理或部分遮挡条件下会退化，因此需要一种在视觉与深度均失效处仍可靠的感知模态。
AI.method: 提出多模态融合框架，将毫米波雷达与RGB-D传感结合用于实时透明表面分割。利用雷达对玻璃表面的强反射特性提供几何线索，并利用雷达与视觉/深度之间的跨模态不一致性生成雷达引导的空间先验；该先验通过跨模态注意力机制集成到轻量级Transformer分割网络GlassFormer中。
AI.result: 在覆盖全部场景类型的混合条件测试划分上，GlassFormer达到0.88 mIoU；在专门用于压力测试纯视觉方法的低光划分上达到0.59 mIoU；相较纯视觉基线具有显著的鲁棒性提升，同时在资源受限平台上保持实时性能。
AI.conclusion: 毫米波雷达对玻璃的可靠几何响应可有效弥补视觉与深度传感在透明区域的失效，通过雷达引导先验与跨模态注意力的融合，能够在多样及低光条件下实现鲁棒且实时的透明表面分割，为机器人安全导航提供可行方案。

title: RoXDrive: Closed-Loop Reinforcement Learning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving via Action-Faithful Rollouts
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving policies are commonly trained via imitation learning on logged demonstrations without observing the consequences of their own actions, leading to causal confusion in closed-loop real-world deployment. To address this issue, reinforcement learning (RL) post-training offers a promising alternative by leveraging world models as interactive training environments to enable future scene generation for policy improvement. Nevertheless, existing approaches either rely on reconstruction-based simulators, offering limited counterfactual interaction, or adopt synthetic simulators to enable long-horizon closed-loop interaction at the cost of a substantial sim-to-real gap. Recently, video world models have exhibited the ability to generate realistic multi-step future rollouts but may not faithfully reflect action conditions, resulting in action-vision mismatch. In this paper, we introduce RoXDrive, a plug-and-play closed-loop RL framework that enables reliable policy optimization by identifying action-faithful world-model rollouts, consisting of two stages: 1) Model pre-training: In addition to imitation-based policy pre-training, we devise an Action-Vision Faithfulness Evaluator for inverse dynamics estimation with our geometry-aware auxiliary trajectory supervision, enabling long-horizon assessment of whether visual dynamics faithfully reflect the conditioning ego actions. 2) Action-faithful RL post-training: Agents iteratively interact with world models to form long-horizon scene rollouts, retaining only action-faithful ones for dense safety-aware scoring and scene-level closed-loop RL post-training. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and an in-house dataset with over 130K training scenarios demonstrate consistent gains across planners, reducing safety violations by 27.6% with DiffusionDrive on nuScenes and 33.7% with Qwen3-VL on the internal data.

AI.tldr: 提出RoXDrive，一种即插即用的闭环强化学习框架，通过识别"动作忠实"的世界模型推演实现可靠的自动驾驶策略优化，显著降低安全违规率。
AI.motivation: 端到端自动驾驶策略通常通过模仿学习在日志演示上训练，无法观察自身动作的后果，导致闭环部署时出现因果混淆。强化学习后训练是潜在替代方案，但现有方法或依赖重建式模拟器（反事实交互有限），或采用合成模拟器（长时域闭环但存在显著sim-to-real gap），而视频世界模型虽能生成真实的多步未来推演，却可能无法忠实反映动作条件，造成动作-视觉不匹配。
AI.method: RoXDrive包含两个阶段：1）模型预训练：在基于模仿的策略预训练之外，设计动作-视觉忠实度评估器（Action-Vision Faithfulness Evaluator），结合几何感知的辅助轨迹监督进行逆动力学估计，实现对视觉动态是否忠实反映条件化自车动作的长时域评估；2）动作忠实强化学习后训练：智能体迭代与世界模型交互形成长时域场景推演，仅保留动作忠实的推演用于密集安全感知评分和场景级闭环强化学习后训练。
AI.result: 在nuScenes和超过130K训练场景的内部数据集上进行大量实验，跨规划器取得一致性增益：在nuScenes上使用DiffusionDrive降低安全违规27.6%，在内部数据上使用Qwen3-VL降低安全违规33.7%。
AI.conclusion: RoXDrive作为即插即用的闭环强化学习框架，通过识别动作忠实的视频世界模型推演，有效缓解动作-视觉不匹配问题，实现可靠的策略优化，并在多个数据集与规划器上验证了其通用性与有效性。

title: Socialality Anchors: Towards Group-bounded Trajectory Prediction
summary: Trajectory prediction is a key component for understanding human behavior patterns in dynamic scenes. Researchers have devoted substantial efforts to modeling social interactions, especially group-wise interactions, since group membership often reflects shared intention, coordinated motion, and stable mutual adaptation, thus providing a persistent and semantically meaningful social prior for forecasting. However, existing group modeling methods may rely on a fixed threshold and infer groups mainly from agents' relative positions within the observation window, overlooking the fact that grouping rules should be agent-specific, temporally coherent, and context-adaptive across diverse personalities, culturalities, and evolving interaction contexts. Inspired by human social perception that alternates between interpersonal distance in boundary-sensitive situations and relative speed consistency in dynamic interactions, we propose Socialality, a human-inspired trajectory prediction framework with interpretable Socialality anchors and an extended grouping window for stable, context-aware grouping inference. Concretely, Socialality introduces a duo-scalar-controlled grouping kernel Socialality that jointly leverages historical observations and short-term future trajectory previews to learn agent-specific grouping rules, and employs a group-wise perception mechanism to model in-group and out-of-group interactions in an intuitive and explainable manner. Furthermore, we conduct extensive experiments on standard benchmarks to demonstrate the performance gains of Socialality, and provide qualitative analyses and statistical studies of anchor distributions to verify the interpretability and stability of the proposed Socialality anchors.

AI.tldr: 该文提出Socialality，一种受人类社会感知启发的轨迹预测框架，通过可解释的Socialality锚点与扩展分组窗口实现稳定、上下文自适应的分组推断，并联合历史观测与短期未来预览学习智能体特异性分组规则。
AI.motivation: 群体成员关系常反映共享意图、协调运动与稳定相互适应，可作为持续且具语义的社会先验用于预测。但现有群体建模方法多依赖固定阈值、主要从观测窗口内智能体相对位置推断群体，忽略了分组规则应具备智能体特异性、时间连贯性与上下文自适应性。
AI.method: 受人类在边界敏感情形下依赖人际距离、在动态交互中依赖相对速度一致性的社会感知机制启发，提出Socialality框架：引入双标量控制的分组核Socialality，联合历史观测与短期未来轨迹预览，学习智能体特异性分组规则；并采用群体感知机制，以直观可解释的方式建模组内与组外交互；同时使用扩展分组窗口进行稳定、上下文感知的分组推断。
AI.result: 在标准基准上进行大量实验，验证了Socialality的性能提升；并通过定性分析与锚点分布的统计研究，验证了所提Socialality锚点的可解释性与稳定性。
AI.conclusion: Socialality通过智能体特异性、时间连贯且上下文自适应的分组推断，提升了轨迹预测性能，并提供了可解释且稳定的分组锚点，为群体交互建模提供了新思路。

title: S2T-Unet: A Structure-to-Style Framework for Inter-Modality MRI Translation
summary: Inter-modality MRI translation aims to synthesize missing MRI modalities from available acquisitions, reducing the need for additional scanning while preserving clinically relevant anatomical information. However, existing image translation methods often learn intensity mappings without explicitly separating modality-invariant structural information from modality-specific appearance, which may lead to structural information loss or unrealistic image details. In this work, we propose S2T-Unet, a structure-to-style framework that explicitly models these two aspects. Specifically, vector quantization is introduced at the lower-level bottleneck to encode modality-invariant structural information using a learned discrete codebook. At higher levels, a modality transformation module uses decoder features to condition and transform encoder representations toward the target modality, thereby recovering modality-specific intensity and contrast information. Experiments on the IXI multi-contrast MRI dataset across four translation tasks demonstrate that S2T-Unet is comparable or outperform with state-of-art method.

AI.tldr: 提出S2T-Unet结构-风格分离框架，通过向量量化编码模态不变结构、用模态转换模块注入目标模态风格，实现MRI跨模态合成。
AI.motivation: 现有MRI跨模态翻译方法通常只学习强度映射，未显式分离模态不变的结构信息与模态特有的外观信息，易导致结构丢失或生成不真实的图像细节。
AI.method: S2T-Unet框架：(1) 在低层瓶颈处引入向量量化，利用学习到的离散码本编码模态不变的结构信息；(2) 在高层设置模态转换模块，以解码器特征为条件，将编码器表征向目标模态转换，从而恢复模态特有的强度与对比度信息。
AI.result: 在IXI多对比度MRI数据集的四组翻译任务上，S2T-Unet性能与最先进方法相当或更优。
AI.conclusion: 显式解耦结构信息与风格信息有助于在减少额外扫描的同时保留临床相关解剖结构，是MRI跨模态合成的有效思路。

title: S4VY: Segment Anything in Feed-Forward 4D Visual Geometry
summary: Accurate instance segmentation in dynamic scenes is important for downstream applications such as robotics and autonomous driving. Existing Segment Anything models operate primarily on 2D image or video masks and preserve identity through sequential memory, while promptable 4D instance segmentation built upon feed-forward visual geometry remains underexplored. We introduce S4VY, a Segment Anything model built on feed-forward 4D visual geometry. From a set of RGB observations, S4VY transforms shared visual-geometric features into an exhaustive set of class-agnostic 4D instance masks through a space-time query decoder, with each persistent object query binding one entity across all observations. This representation supports prompt-independent segmentation as well as point- and box- conditioned selection, without requiring a seed mask or temporal ordering. We further develop an agentic harness for natural-language grounding in the large observation space of a 4D scene. Active tree search identifies relevant frames without scanning every fixed window; a dual-stream grounder combines fine-grained VLM visual priors with geometry-consistent instance features through complementary bounding-box prediction and object-query matching; and an independent critic selects the final 4D instance mask from their predictions. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art 4D instance segmentation and strong language-guided grounding performance under a unified evaluation spanning static and dynamic scenes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 S4VY，一个基于前馈 4D 视觉几何的 Segment Anything 模型，通过时空查询解码器将共享视觉-几何特征转换为类别无关的 4D 实例掩码，并配合智能体框架实现自然语言引导的 4D 实例分割。
AI.motivation: 动态场景中的精确实例分割对机器人与自动驾驶等下游任务至关重要，但现有 Segment Anything 模型主要处理 2D 图像或视频掩码，通过序列记忆保持身份，基于前馈视觉几何的可提示 4D 实例分割仍研究不足。
AI.method: S4VY 从一组 RGB 观测中，通过时空查询解码器将共享视觉-几何特征转换为穷尽的类别无关 4D 实例掩码，每个持久对象查询在所有观测中绑定同一实体；该表示支持无提示分割及点/框条件选择，无需种子掩码或时间顺序。此外构建智能体框架用于 4D 场景大观测空间中的自然语言定位：主动树搜索定位相关帧、双流定位器融合 VLM 视觉先验与几何一致的实例特征、独立评论器选择最终 4D 实例掩码。
AI.result: 在涵盖静态与动态场景的统一评估中，S4VY 取得了最先进的 4D 实例分割性能和较强的语言引导定位性能。
AI.conclusion: S4VY 将 Segment Anything 扩展到前馈 4D 视觉几何，实现了持久的 4D 实例表示与语言引导定位，为动态场景中的实例分割提供了统一且有效的方案。

title: Less Supervision, Better Generalization: Weakly Supervised Fake Region Localization in Diffusion-Edited Images
summary: Localizing AI-edited regions is essential for interpretable forensic analysis, but remains challenging due to subtle and spatially distributed artifacts that are misaligned with semantic or object boundaries. Existing approaches rely on pixel-level supervision from controlled editing pipelines, which is difficult to scale and can introduce misleading signals: artifacts frequently extend beyond annotated regions, while out-of-mask pixels are treated as authentic. This limits models' ability to capture transferable evidence and generalize across generators and datasets. To address these issues, we propose ReGFLoW, a Reconstruction-Guided Fake Localization framework under Weak supervision, which is the first weakly supervised approach for diffusion-edited fake region localization. ReGFLoW requires only real/fake labels at the image-level and uses diffusion reconstruction errors as dense spatial guidance to inject them into both feature and score spaces. Furthermore, by artifact-centric multiple instance learning, ReGFLoW utilizes localized diffusion evidence without relying on semantic-affinity or boundary-based pseudo-mask priors. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ReGFLoW achieves stronger out-of-domain generalization than fully supervised learning baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReGFLoW，首个弱监督扩散编辑伪造区域定位框架，仅用图像级真伪标签，以扩散重建误差作为密集空间引导注入特征与分数空间，实现优于全监督基线的跨域泛化。
AI.motivation: AI编辑区域定位对可解释取证至关重要，但伪影细微且空间分散，与语义或物体边界不对齐。现有方法依赖受控编辑流程产生的像素级监督，难以规模化且引入误导信号：伪影常超出标注区域，而掩码外像素被当作真实，限制了模型捕获可迁移证据及跨生成器、跨数据集泛化的能力。
AI.method: 提出ReGFLoW（Reconstruction-Guided Fake Localization under Weak supervision）弱监督框架，仅需图像级真/伪标签；利用扩散重建误差作为密集空间引导，注入特征空间与分数空间；通过以伪影为中心的多示例学习（MIL）利用局部扩散证据，不依赖语义亲和或边界先验生成伪掩码。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，ReGFLoW的域外泛化能力强于全监督学习基线。
AI.conclusion: 弱监督+扩散重建引导可替代像素级标注，既避免标注依赖与误导信号，又提升跨生成器/跨数据集的伪造区域定位泛化性能。

title: ProGuT: Label-Efficient Panoptic Segmentation for Forest Scenes
summary: Panoptic segmentation in forest environments is bottlenecked not by semantic quality but by instance separation; existing unsupervised panoptic approaches produce usable stuff maps but near-zero thing quality. Depth or flow-based instance discovery methods needs sensors that are not always available. We present ProGuT (Prototype Guided Training), which produces panoptic pseudo-labels without per-image training masks, needing only unlabeled images and one-time cluster-to-class mapping. ProGuT clusters CLIP patch features, then recovers trunk instances through multiscale geometric prior that falsifies non-trunk structures via structure-tensor. This is cheap compared to depth, flow or class-supervision methods to create pseudo labels. These are then used for downstream tasks which we evaluate against other unsupervised baselines. ProGuT achieves a Panoptic Quality (PQ) of 65.2 on Our-forest dataset (2.6x improvement over the initial pseudo-label quality) and reaches 65.9 mIoU on Freiburg Forest, outperforming unsupervised baselines like PiCIE (45.3 IoU) and STEGO(57.6IoU). Additionally, ProGuT outperforms existing unsupervised methods for class-agnostic trunk instance benchmark.

AI.tldr: ProGuT利用CLIP原型聚类与结构张量几何先验，无需逐图掩码或额外传感器，生成全景伪标签，在森林场景实现高质量实例分离。
AI.motivation: 森林环境全景分割的瓶颈在于实例分离而非语义质量：现有无监督方法能生成可用的stuff图，但thing质量接近零；基于深度或光流的实例发现依赖不总可得的传感器。因此需要仅用无标注图像即可生成全景伪标签的方法。
AI.method: ProGuT先对CLIP patch特征进行聚类，并利用一次性cluster-to-class映射确定类别；再通过多尺度几何先验，用结构张量证伪非树干结构，从而恢复树干实例。相比深度、光流或类别监督方法，该伪标签生成成本更低，生成结果用于下游任务。
AI.result: 在Our-forest数据集上PQ达65.2，较初始伪标签质量提升2.6倍；在Freiburg Forest上mIoU达65.9，优于无监督基线PiCIE（45.3 IoU）与STEGO（57.6 IoU）；并在类无关树干实例基准上超过现有无监督方法。
AI.conclusion: ProGuT表明仅凭无标注图像与轻量几何先验即可生成高质量全景伪标签，有效解决森林场景的实例分离瓶颈，并在语义与实例指标上超越现有无监督基线。

title: DiffReID: Discriminative Diffusion Model for Object Re-Identification
comment: Accepted by TIP2026. More modifications can be performed
summary: As a fundamental image processing task, object Re-Identification (ReID) aims to retrieve objects across non-overlapping cameras. Recently, with the development of deep learning, significant advancements have been made in object ReID. However, most existing methods suffer from generalization due to the limited size and diversity of ReID datasets. Meanwhile, current models tend to focus on extracting semantic patterns rather than learning identity-aware feature distributions. To address these issues, we propose a novel feature learning framework named \textbf{DiffReID} for object ReID. It leverages a discriminative diffusion model to gradually learn identity-aware distributions and generate identity-invariant features. More specifically, with the Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) model, we first obtain identity-aware text features by prompt tuning. Then, we propose a Vision-guided Noise Generator (VNG) to initialize probabilistic noises and gradually corrupt identity-aware text features. Afterwards, we take visual features as conditions and propose a Light Weight Denoiser (LWD) to denoise the corrupted text features step-by-step for identity-aware distribution learning. To obtain discriminative features, we further generate identity-invariant guided features from randomly sampling visual-guided noises. Finally, we propose a Mutual Enhancement Constraint (MEC) to facilitate mutual learning between visual features and guided features to enhance the representation robustness and discrimination. Extensive experiments on five object ReID benchmarks demonstrate that our method shows better results than most state-of-the-art methods. The source code is available at https://github.com/AWangYQ/DiffReID.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DiffReID，一种利用判别式扩散模型学习身份感知分布并生成身份不变特征的目标重识别框架，在五个基准上超越多数SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 现有目标ReID方法受限于数据集规模和多样性，泛化能力不足；且模型倾向提取语义模式，而非学习身份感知的特征分布。作者希望借助扩散模型建模身份感知分布，解决泛化与判别性问题。
AI.method: 1) 基于CLIP通过prompt tuning获得身份感知文本特征；2) 提出视觉引导噪声生成器（VNG）初始化概率噪声并逐步破坏身份感知文本特征；3) 以视觉特征为条件，提出轻量去噪器（LWD）逐步去噪受损文本特征，实现身份感知分布学习；4) 从随机采样的视觉引导噪声中生成身份不变的引导特征；5) 提出互增强约束（MEC）促进视觉特征与引导特征的互相学习，增强表示的鲁棒性与判别性。
AI.result: 在五个目标ReID基准上进行了大量实验，结果表明该方法优于大多数现有最先进方法。源代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: DiffReID通过判别式扩散建模身份感知特征分布，并结合视觉-文本互增强约束，有效提升了ReID的泛化能力与判别性，验证了扩散模型在目标ReID任务中的有效性。

title: SafeVantage: Vantage-Aware Memory for Reliable Embodied Decisions
summary: Reliable embodied decisions under partial observability require informative observations and sufficient supporting evidence. However, semantic scores alone do not reveal which viewpoints justify a claim or where additional evidence should be acquired. We introduce SafeVantage, a vantage-aware semantic memory and active acquisition framework that retains each claim's supporting views, camera poses, and estimated target location, keeping positive support distinct from search coverage. A learned candidate-observability model uses claim-grounded geometry to predict target visibility at reachable viewpoints. These predictions guide view selection through expected reduction in terminal decision loss, accounting for travel cost and geometrically distinct corroboration. A calibrated head then combines support, spatial consistency, and coverage to produce Yes, No, or Abstain decisions. We evaluate SafeVantage on a category-presence benchmark spanning 232 unseen ProcTHOR houses and 7,424 paired episodes per method and action budget. Compared with validation-selected equal-budget baselines, SafeVantage achieves macro-F1 gains of 24.7% and 12.0% at eight and twelve actions, respectively, with lower risk and higher answer rates at both budgets and 31.7% less travel at eight actions. Equal-input HM3D experiments show lower selective risk under fixed observations, while controlled ScanNet interventions show that restoring supporting views improves downstream VLM answers. Ablations further support the contribution of candidate observability to decision quality and acquisition efficiency. Results demonstrate the value of claim-level viewpoint evidence for connecting semantic memory, active acquisition, and reliable decision-making. Code is available at https://safevantage.github.io

AI.tldr: 提出 SafeVantage，一种"视角感知"的语义记忆与主动采集框架，保留每个论断的支持视角、相机位姿与目标位置估计，通过学习候选可观测性模型预测可达视角下的目标可见性，以终端决策损失的期望下降指导选视角，并用校准头输出 Yes/No/Abstain 决策。
AI.motivation: 在部分可观测条件下做出可靠的具身决策，需要信息量充足的观测和足够的支撑证据。但仅依赖语义分数无法说明"哪些视角支撑某一论断"以及"应在何处补充证据"，即缺乏对证据来源与采集方向的可解释刻画。
AI.method: 1) 构建视角感知语义记忆，为每条论断保留支持视角、相机位姿和估计目标位置，并将"正向支持"与"搜索覆盖"区分开；2) 训练候选可观测性模型，利用以论断为条件的几何信息预测可达视角处的目标可见性；3) 以终端决策损失的期望下降为准则进行视角选择，同时考虑移动代价与几何上互不相同的佐证；4) 校准头融合支持度、空间一致性与覆盖度，输出 Yes/No/Abstain 三类决策。
AI.result: 在涵盖 232 个未见 ProcTHOR 房屋、每种方法与动作预算 7,424 个配对回合的类别存在性基准上，相比验证集选出的等预算基线，在 8 动作和 12 动作下宏 F1 分别提升 24.7% 和 12.0%，两个预算下风险更低、回答率更高，8 动作时行程减少 31.7%；在等输入 HM3D 实验中固定观测下选择性风险更低；ScanNet 受控干预表明恢复支持视角可改善下游 VLM 回答；消融实验支持候选可观测性对决策质量与采集效率的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，论断级的视角证据在连接语义记忆、主动采集与可靠决策方面具有明确价值，能够以更低代价获得更可靠且回答率更高的具身决策。

title: Representation Dynamics Reveal Semantic Saliency and Similarity for Visual Token Pruning in MLLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) incur high inference latency from long visual token sequences. Existing pruning methods commonly use attention maps or output features to estimate token importance or redundancy. Several recent approaches also exploit representation changes, but when and how these changes reflect foreground saliency and semantic consistency remain insufficiently understood. We analyze visual token representation dynamics across encoder depth and uncover two findings. First, the relationship between token update magnitudes and foreground saliency is layer-dependent: large token updates concentrate on foreground regions in two depth intervals, separated by several sink-dominated layers at intermediate depths. Second, similarities between token update directions better distinguish same-class from different-class tokens than those between encoder output features. Building on these findings, we propose MSDG-Prune, a training-free method that uses update magnitudes and directions to preserve salient and diverse visual information. Specifically, we group tokens by update-direction similarity and use query-weighted saliency derived from update magnitudes across a chosen depth window for group-wise token pruning. Extensive experiments across four MLLMs demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of MSDG-Prune. On LLaVA-NeXT, it retains 91.9% of uncompressed performance on average with only 5.6% of visual tokens, while achieving a 7.8x prefilling speedup. Code is available at https://github.com/liweixuan-hitsz/MSDG-Prune.

AI.tldr: 本文分析视觉token表征动态，提出免训练的MSDG-Prune方法，按更新方向分组、按更新幅度剪枝，在保留极少token时维持高性能并显著加速。
AI.motivation: MLLM因长视觉token序列导致高推理延迟。现有剪枝方法多用注意力图或输出特征估计重要性，或利用表征变化，但对这些变化何时、如何反映前景显著性与语义一致性理解不足。
AI.method: 先分析跨编码器深度的token表征动态，得到两点发现：token更新幅度与前景显著性的关系依赖层级，大更新集中于两个深度区间的前景区域，中间隔着若干被sink主导的层；token更新方向相似性比输出特征相似性更能区分同类/异类token。基于此提出免训练方法MSDG-Prune：按更新方向相似性对token分组，用所选深度窗口内更新幅度导出的查询加权显著性进行组级token剪枝。
AI.result: 在四种MLLM上验证有效性与泛化性。在LLaVA-NeXT上，仅用5.6%视觉token即可平均保留91.9%的未压缩性能，并实现7.8倍预填充加速。
AI.conclusion: token更新的幅度与方向蕴含层级化的前景显著性和语义一致性信息，合理利用可实现高效免训练视觉token剪枝，兼顾性能与加速。

title: Seg3DParts: Segmentation-Grounded Controllable Part-Level 3D Generation
summary: Part-level 3D assets are essential for editing, reassembly, and interaction, yet recovering such structure from a single image remains challenging due to occlusion, ambiguous boundaries, and the need for coherent multi-part reasoning. Existing approaches struggle to achieve both controllable part-level generation and coherent multi-part structure, as part identity and spatial allocation are typically inferred implicitly. We present Seg3DParts, a segmentation-grounded framework for controllable part-level 3D generation from a single image. By treating segmentation as an explicit grounding signal, our method defines part identity during generation, enabling each component to be anchored to a corresponding image region. To ensure coherent assemblies, we introduce structured cross-part interaction that allows components to exchange global context throughout the generative process. As a result, Seg3DParts directly generates well-aligned part meshes in a shared canonical space without post-hoc alignment, supporting flexible and controllable decomposition. We further introduce PartObjectNet, a large-scale dataset with over 200K objects and 1M annotated parts. Experiments demonstrate that Seg3DParts achieves superior geometry quality, cross-part coherence, and part-level controllability over existing methods.

AI.tldr: Seg3DParts以分割作为显式引导信号，从单张图像可控地生成部件级3D资产，并构建了大规模PartObjectNet数据集。
AI.motivation: 部件级3D资产对编辑、重组和交互至关重要，但从单张图像中恢复这种结构面临遮挡、边界模糊以及多部件一致性推理等挑战。现有方法通常隐式推断部件身份与空间分配，难以同时实现可控的部件级生成与连贯的多部件结构，且生成后往往需要后处理对齐。
AI.method: 提出Seg3DParts框架：将分割作为显式grounding信号，在生成过程中定义部件身份，使每个部件锚定到对应图像区域；引入结构化跨部件交互（structured cross-part interaction），让各部件在生成全过程交换全局上下文，从而在共享规范空间中直接生成对齐良好的部件网格，无需事后对齐，支持灵活可控的分解。同时构建PartObjectNet大规模数据集，包含20万以上物体、100万以上标注部件。
AI.result: 实验表明，Seg3DParts在几何质量、跨部件一致性以及部件级可控性方面均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将分割作为显式部件身份引导并结合跨部件全局交互，Seg3DParts实现了无需后处理对齐的可控部件级3D生成，配合大规模PartObjectNet数据集，为该任务提供了有效方案与数据支撑。

title: SFE-VGGT: Source-Free VGGT Distillation for Event-Based Monocular Depth Estimation
summary: Recent event-based depth estimation methods successfully transfer geometric priors from vision foundation models via cross-modal distillation. However, their reliance on synchronized RGB-event pairs or depth annotations during training severely restricts practical deployment. To overcome this bottleneck, we propose SFE-VGGT, a novel source-free framework that distills the geometric priors of VGGT to the event domain without any paired RGB observations. Our core idea is to reconstruct surrogate frames directly from the target event stream to act as a frozen geometric teacher, entirely eliminating the need for genuine source RGB data. Crucially, as these surrogate frames inherently yield imperfect and spatially varying supervision, directly distilling from them propagates artifacts. To resolve this, we introduce a novel reliability-aware distillation strategy. This includes Density-Aware Feature Distillation to emphasize informative event regions, and Confidence-Weighted Depth Distillation to dynamically regulate supervision based on relative teacher-student prediction confidence. Meanwhile, we propose a Cross-Frame Relational Consistency loss that enforces temporal geometric stability using reliable inter-frame correspondences, bypassing the need for temporally consistent teacher's depth. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, despite source-free, our SFE-VGGT closely matches the accuracy of RGB-dependent baselines under standard conditions and significantly surpasses them in challenging nighttime scenarios. Across MVSEC nighttime sequences, SFE-VGGT reduces the average 10 m depth error by 15.3% compared with EventVGGT. Moreover, our method exhibits robust zero-shot generalization across real-world datasets, proving that highly effective geometric priors can be transferred to event cameras using strictly source-free supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出SFE-VGGT，一种无源域框架，无需配对RGB数据即可将VGGT几何先验蒸馏到事件域，并在夜间场景显著优于RGB依赖基线。
AI.motivation: 事件相机深度估计依赖视觉基础模型的几何先验，但现有跨模态蒸馏方法在训练时需要同步的RGB-事件对或深度标注，严重限制实际部署；目标是摆脱对真实源域RGB数据的依赖。
AI.method: 核心思想是从目标事件流直接重建代理帧，作为冻结的几何教师，完全消除真实源RGB需求。针对代理帧监督不完美且空间变化的问题，提出可靠性感知蒸馏策略：密度感知特征蒸馏（强调信息丰富的事件区域）与置信度加权深度蒸馏（依据师生相对预测置信度动态调节监督）；并提出跨帧关系一致性损失，利用可靠的帧间对应关系约束时序几何稳定性，无需教师深度在时间上一致。
AI.result: 尽管无源域，标准条件下精度接近RGB依赖基线；夜间场景显著超越。在MVSEC夜间序列上，相比EventVGGT将10 m平均深度误差降低15.3%；在真实数据集上展现稳健的零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 证明可仅用严格无源域监督将高效几何先验迁移至事件相机，为事件深度估计的实际部署提供可行方案。

title: WeLike2Party! In-Context Motion Transfer for Multi-Human Image Animation
summary: Human image animation aims to transfer motion from a driving video to subjects in a reference image. Despite remarkable progress in video generation, achieving high-fidelity animation of multiple interacting subjects remains a challenge. Many existing approaches rely on explicit motion representations such as 2D skeletons or parametric body meshes and struggle to preserve identity-motion binding under inter-person occlusion. To address this limitation, we propose WeLike2Party, a multi-human animation framework built on direct in-context video conditioning without explicit pose or mesh extraction at inference. We further introduce Reference Asymmetric RoPE Conditioning to preserve fine-grained appearance details, and Identity Binding Supervision to associate each reference identity with its intended motion trajectory. To support cross-identity training, we construct MotionTwin, a large-scale synthetic dataset comprising 14.4K cross-identity video pairs with shared subject and camera motions, totaling 84.3 hours of photorealistic video. We additionally present MotionTwin-Bench, a cross-identity benchmark specifically designed to evaluate subject-level visual fidelity and identity-motion binding. Extensive experiments on MotionTwin-Bench and real-world videos demonstrate that WeLike2Party outperforms recent state-of-the-art methods in subject-level visual fidelity, identity-motion binding, and overall perceptual quality, particularly in multi-person interactions with substantial occlusion.

AI.tldr: 提出 WeLike2Party 多人物动画框架，基于直接上下文视频条件，无需显式姿态或网格提取，并引入 RARC 与身份绑定监督，配合 MotionTwin 数据集，在多人物遮挡场景下优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 多人交互的高保真人体图像动画仍具挑战。现有方法依赖 2D 骨架或参数化人体网格等显式运动表示，在人物间遮挡时难以保持身份—运动绑定。
AI.method: 构建基于直接上下文视频条件（in-context video conditioning）的多人物动画框架，推理时不需显式姿态或网格提取；提出 Reference Asymmetric RoPE Conditioning（RARC）以保留细粒度外观细节，以及 Identity Binding Supervision 将每个参考身份与其目标运动轨迹关联；构建 MotionTwin 大规模合成数据集（14.4K 跨身份视频对、共 84.3 小时真实感视频）以支持跨身份训练，并提出跨身份评测基准 MotionTwin-Bench。
AI.result: 在 MotionTwin-Bench 和真实视频上的大量实验表明，WeLike2Party 在主体级视觉保真度、身份—运动绑定和整体感知质量上均优于近期最先进方法，尤其在存在严重遮挡的多人物交互场景中表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 无需显式运动表示的直接上下文条件框架可有效提升多人物动画的保真度与身份—运动绑定，MotionTwin 数据集与基准为该任务提供了训练与评测支撑。

title: DispFlow-GS: Displacement Flow Supervision with Motion Disentangling for Monocular Deformable 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Accurate dynamic scene reconstruction is important for robotic perception, where temporally consistent representations of dynamic environments are essential. Deformable 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) models dynamic scenes through deformation fields, and recent methods incorporate motion supervision by aligning rendered Gaussian flow with optical flow. However, we find that such Gaussian-flow-based supervision provides only limited improvements in motion modeling. We identify a fundamental limitation of this supervision paradigm, namely a domain gap between rendered Gaussian flow and optical flow. To address this limitation, we propose a motion supervision framework built on Displacement Flow, which splats per-Gaussian 3D displacements onto the image plane to provide direct and stable optimization signals. We further disentangle scene motion from camera motion via intermediate-view rendering, enabling more reliable motion priors and targeted constraints on deformation and geometry. We also observe a discrepancy between motion fidelity and image-based evaluation, where improved motion awareness does not necessarily translate into better rendered image quality or higher image-based metric scores. Motivated by this mismatch, we introduce Deformation-Rendering Consistency (DRC), a motion-aware metric that measures the alignment between predicted deformation and rendering improvement. Experiments on dynamic scene benchmarks show substantial improvements in motion localization and motion--rendering consistency, reaching up to 39% and 6%, respectively, while image-based metrics change by only about 0.1%. These results confirm the observed mismatch between motion fidelity and image-based evaluation, demonstrating the significance of DRC for motion-aware evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对可变形3DGS中"渲染高斯流-光流"监督存在的域差异问题，提出基于位移流（Displacement Flow）的运动监督框架，并通过中间视角渲染解耦场景运动与相机运动；同时提出运动感知指标DRC，实验显示运动定位与运动-渲染一致性分别提升达39%和6%，而图像指标仅变化约0.1%。
AI.motivation: 动态场景重建对机器人感知至关重要，需要时间一致的动态环境表示。现有可变形3DGS方法通过将渲染高斯流与光流对齐来引入运动监督，但本文发现这类监督对运动建模的提升有限，其根本原因在于渲染高斯流与光流之间存在域差异（domain gap），缺乏直接、稳定的优化信号。
AI.method: 1) 提出基于Displacement Flow的运动监督框架，将逐高斯3D位移splat到图像平面上，提供直接且稳定的优化信号；2) 通过中间视角渲染解耦场景运动与相机运动，获得更可靠的运动先验并对形变与几何施加针对性约束；3) 提出Deformation-Rendering Consistency (DRC)运动感知指标，衡量预测形变与渲染提升之间的一致性。
AI.result: 在动态场景基准上，运动定位与运动-渲染一致性分别提升最高达39%和6%，而基于图像的指标仅变化约0.1%，验证了运动保真度与图像评价之间的不匹配现象。
AI.conclusion: 实验确认了运动保真度与图像评价之间的失配，表明基于图像的指标难以反映运动建模的真实改进，凸显了DRC在运动感知评价中的重要性；所提位移流监督框架为动态3DGS提供了更有效的运动优化与评估范式。

title: Beyond Readability: Evaluating Task Information Recoverability
summary: Direct visual readability and task-information recoverability are different quantities. Failure to decode a target from a fixed observation need not eliminate access to that target through another recovery route. We develop an evaluation perspective that makes the observation, query, target, and available knowledge explicit and measures the overlap between routes' success sets. For information available on the original visible surface under suitable imaging conditions, direct optical recovery reads the target from the image, optionally after restoration; entity-linked recovery uses residual visual evidence to identify the depicted entity and accesses its target through an entity--attribute relation in a specified knowledge resource. Such access can draw on stored knowledge or an external source. A controlled book-cover study instantiates external access with a fixed title--author catalog, comparing optical author recovery with visual title resolution and deterministic lookup under resolution degradation. Entity-linked successes persist across the tested vision--language models, revealing information access beyond the tested direct visual frontier despite substantial differences in absolute performance. A substantial optical-only region remains. These complementary outcomes show why visual degradation should be evaluated through the task information accessible along specified routes and knowledge resources, alongside direct readability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种显式区分"直接视觉可读性"与"任务信息可恢复性"的评估视角，通过度量不同恢复路径成功集合的重叠程度，揭示视觉退化下信息仍可通过实体关联路径获取。
AI.motivation: 直接视觉可读性与任务信息可恢复性是两个不同量。无法从固定观测中解码目标，并不等于该目标不可通过其他恢复路径获得，因此需要一种新的评估框架来刻画这一点。
AI.method: 提出一个显式化观测、查询、目标与可用知识的评估视角，度量各路径成功集合的重叠。区分直接光学恢复（从图像读取，可含修复）与实体关联恢复（用残留视觉证据识别所描绘实体，再借指定知识资源中的实体-属性关系访问目标，可用存储知识或外部来源）。以受控书封研究实例化外部访问：固定"书名-作者"目录，在分辨率退化下比较光学作者恢复与视觉书名解析加确定性查找。
AI.result: 实体关联恢复的成功在测试的多个视觉-语言模型上持续出现，尽管各处绝对性能差异显著，仍揭示出超越所测直接视觉前沿的信息访问能力；同时仍存在相当比例的光学独有区域。
AI.conclusion: 视觉退化应通过沿指定路径与知识资源可访问的任务信息来评估，而非仅看直接可读性；两类互补结果说明需并列考察直接可读性与任务信息可恢复性。

title: Prior-Driven Enhancements in 3D Gaussian Splatting: Normals and Depths Regularization
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Oral presentation at ISPRS Geospatial Week 2025 (Dubai). Project page: https://gandanlee.github.io/pdigs/ Code: https://github.com/gandanlee/pdigs
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is a state-of-the-art technique for 3D scene rendering, offering high efficiency and excellent visual quality. However, because 3DGS relies on an initial sparse point set from Structure-from-Motion (SfM) and view-dependent properties, it can suffer from geometric inaccuracies and visual artifacts, particularly in complex scenes. To address these challenges, we propose an improved 3DGS approach that regularizes the optimization process by integrating geometric priors, including surface normals and dense depth information. Surface normal regularization improves geometric consistency by aligning Gaussian covariance with local surface structures, while dense depth priors combined with an initial points from SfM enhance per-pixel depth estimation, increasing accuracy and reducing ambiguities. These enhancements enable robust handling of diverse and complex real-world scenarios, minimizing visual distortions and improving reconstruction quality across various environments. To validate our method, we evaluate it on challenging datasets, including street-view scenes and highly reflective environments, while testing it across multiple SfM pipelines. Our results demonstrate compatibility across diverse environments and highlight the robustness of our approach. Experimental findings further show that our method enhances geometric accuracy and visual quality, establishing a reliable solution for real-time 3D scene rendering in complex environments.

AI.tldr: 提出一种改进的3D高斯泼溅方法，通过引入表面法线与稠密深度等几何先验对优化过程进行正则化，提升复杂场景下的几何精度与视觉质量。
AI.motivation: 3DGS虽高效且渲染质量高，但依赖SfM初始稀疏点集与视角相关属性，在复杂场景中易出现几何不准确与视觉伪影。
AI.method: 在3DGS优化中集成几何先验：利用表面法线正则化，使高斯协方差与局部表面结构对齐以增强几何一致性；结合稠密深度先验与SfM初始点，改善逐像素深度估计，提高精度并减少歧义。
AI.result: 在街景与高反射等挑战性数据集上评估，并测试多种SfM流程；结果显示方法具备跨环境兼容性与鲁棒性，提升了几何精度与视觉质量。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为复杂环境下的实时3D场景渲染提供了可靠解决方案。

title: Structured Visual Target Learning For Cross-Subject eeg-to-image retrieval
summary: Cross-subject EEG-to-image retrieval requires a neural represen- tation trained on source subjects to remain aligned with a visual embedding space for an unseen subject. Whereas existing methods primarily focus on the EEG side, we address this problem from the perspective of the visual target. Our approach preserves the spatial information of the Perception Encoder, converts its patch grid into a compact set of learned visual views, and aggregates them for each image with a block-structured, content-dependent router. The target is learned jointly with the EEG encoder through contrastive learning with MMD regularization across source subjects. For deployment, we propose a training-free representation refinement that aligns frozen embeddings without updating either encoder. Under leave- one-subject-out evaluation on THINGS-EEG2, the structured target achieves 35.3%/65.6% Top-1/Top-5 accuracy, the best among com- pared methods. Refinement raises this to 48.1%/77.1%, an 18.5% Top-1 gain over the strongest compared method, improving all ten held-out subjects.

AI.tldr: 本文从视觉目标端入手改进跨被试 EEG-to-image 检索：利用感知编码器的空间信息构建结构化视觉表示，并配合免训练的表征精炼，在 THINGS-EEG2 上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 跨被试 EEG-to-image 检索要求源被试训练的神经表征对未见被试仍与视觉嵌入空间对齐。现有方法多聚焦 EEG 端，视觉目标端的潜力尚未被充分挖掘。
AI.method: 保留 Perception Encoder 的空间信息，将其 patch 网格转换为紧凑的可学习视觉视图集合，并用块结构、内容依赖的路由器对每张图像聚合视图。该目标端与 EEG 编码器通过对比学习联合训练，并加入跨源被试的 MMD 正则。部署阶段提出免训练的表征精炼，在不更新两个编码器的前提下对齐冻结嵌入。
AI.result: 在 THINGS-EEG2 的留一被试评估下，结构化目标取得 35.3%/65.6% 的 Top-1/Top-5 准确率，优于所比较方法；精炼后提升至 48.1%/77.1%，Top-1 较最强对比方法提升 18.5%，且十个留出被试全部改善。
AI.conclusion: 从视觉目标端建模并结合免训练精炼，可有效缓解跨被试分布差异，显著提升 EEG-to-image 检索的跨被试泛化性能。

title: A Dual-Track Curation-and-Classification Framework for Resolving Ground-Truth Label Noise in Operational Sentinel-2 Wheat Area Estimation
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Preprint. Not yet peer-reviewed
summary: Operational estimation of wheat-cultivated area is persistently constrained by discordance between administrative record-keeping and remotely sensed classification products. We address this administrative reference discordance for the 2022 Rabi season in Patiala district, Punjab, India, using a thirteen-timestep Sentinel-2 NDVI time series. A curated 849-sample reference dataset, developed through an iterative rule-based bootstrapping procedure, underpins both a feature sensitivity analysis and an operational classifier. Feature sensitivity independently assessed via Cohen's d and gradient-boosted information gain converges on the February-to-March grain-fill window as most discriminative. Four classifiers (1D-CNN, LSTM, hybrid CNN-LSTM, and XGBoost) were benchmarked on an identical 679/170 sample split. XGBoost achieved the highest overall accuracy (78.82%) against deep-learning baselines (64-66%), consistent with tree-based ensembles' favourable parameter-to-sample ratio in low-sample regimes. At full-population deployment across 36.25 million valid district pixels, the operational classifier attained 86.31% precision and 71.05% recall. The predicted wheat extent deviated by only +2.99% from the official tabular target, whereas the government's spatial reference mask exhibited a +25.11% positive area bias against the identical target. This asymmetry indicates that a classifier trained on an auditor-curated reference set reconciles more closely with the official tabular area than the spatial product conventionally used to validate it. We present this dual-track curation-and-classification framework as a methodological reference for crop-area reconciliation in label-noisy administrative settings.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对行政记录与遥感分类产品之间的不一致问题，利用2022年印度旁遮普邦Patiala地区Rabi季的13期Sentinel-2 NDVI时间序列，构建了849样本参考数据集，比较了1D-CNN、LSTM、CNN-LSTM与XGBoost四种分类器。XGBoost在小样本条件下表现最优，全量部署时对官方统计面积的偏差仅为+2.99%，远优于政府空间参考掩膜的+25.11%。
AI.motivation: 小麦种植面积的业务化估算长期受制于行政记录与遥感分类产品之间的不一致（administrative reference discordance）。官方表格面积与用于验证的空间参考掩膜存在显著矛盾，亟需一套能在标签噪声严重的行政环境下实现面积对账的方法框架。
AI.method: 采用13期Sentinel-2 NDVI时间序列，通过迭代式规则引导自助采样（bootstrapping）构建849样本参考数据集；利用Cohen's d与梯度提升信息增益进行特征敏感性分析；在679/170固定划分下对1D-CNN、LSTM、混合CNN-LSTM与XGBoost进行基准比较，并将最优模型部署至全区3625万个有效像元。
AI.result: 特征敏感性分析一致指向2—3月灌浆期（grain-fill window）最具判别力。XGBoost总体精度最高（78.82%），优于深度学习基线（64—66%）。全量部署时业务化分类器达到86.31%精确率与71.05%召回率；预测小麦面积相对官方表格目标仅偏差+2.99%，而政府空间参考掩膜相对同一目标存在+25.11%的正向面积偏置。
AI.conclusion: 基于审计者筛选参考集训练的分类器，比传统用于验证的空间产品更能贴近官方表格面积，说明行政参考不一致可通过双轨制（curation-and-classification）框架加以协调。该框架可为标签噪声严重的行政场景下的作物面积对账提供方法学参考。

title: UltraMatch: Transport Path Routing for Ultra-Fast and Memory-Efficient Image Matching
summary: Despite recent advances in accuracy and efficiency, coarse matching remains an indispensable yet costly stage in existing semi-dense matchers due to dense token-level matching. We present UltraMatch, an ultra-efficient and scalable semi-dense matching framework that bypasses the quadratic computation and memory cost of dense token-level matching by routing only a small fraction of candidate matching paths. At its core, a lightweight Transport Path Router operates on coarse block representations to rank candidate target blocks for each source block and retain only a small set, restricting subsequent token-level matching to the selected paths and avoiding the construction of the full token-to-token matching matrix. We further design a sparse global Dual-Softmax that performs matching only over the routed block candidates while retaining global competition across the sparse matching space. Beyond matching acceleration, UltraMatch employs deployment-oriented structural reparameterization for feature extraction and a tiny fine matching head with shared parameters, further reducing inference cost and memory consumption. UltraMatch achieves competitive accuracy among semi-dense matchers, while running 1.67$\times$ faster than SuperPoint+LightGlue with only 0.44 GiB peak inference memory. Its scalability enables inference at up to 6K resolution on a single RTX 3090, whereas existing semi-dense matchers run out of memory before reaching 2K. Our routing strategy is also transferable, delivering about 2$\times$ end-to-end speedup in EDM and ELoFTR without accuracy loss. The project repository is available at https://github.com/JiajunLe/UltraMatch.

AI.tldr: UltraMatch通过稀疏化路径路由跳过密集token级匹配，实现超高效可扩展的半稠密匹配。
AI.motivation: 现有半稠密匹配器中，粗匹配阶段因密集token级匹配导致二次计算与内存开销，成为昂贵瓶颈，制约效率与高分辨率可扩展性。
AI.method: 提出轻量Transport Path Router，在粗块表示上为每个源块排序候选目标块，仅保留少量路径，避免构建完整token-to-token匹配矩阵；设计稀疏全局Dual-Softmax，仅在路由候选块上匹配并保持全局竞争；采用面向部署的结构重参数化特征提取与共享参数的轻量精细匹配头。
AI.result: 在半稠密匹配器中达到有竞争力的精度，比SuperPoint+LightGlue快1.67倍，峰值推理内存仅0.44 GiB；单张RTX 3090上支持最高6K分辨率推理，而现有方法在2K前即内存耗尽；路由策略迁移至EDM和ELoFTR可带来约2倍端到端加速且无精度损失。
AI.conclusion: UltraMatch以路径路由取代密集token匹配，兼具高效性、可扩展性与精度竞争力，且路由策略具备良好可迁移性，推动半稠密匹配在实际部署中的应用。

title: Salt++: Context-Aligned Post-Training for Few-Step Streaming Multimodal Generation
summary: Few-step streaming audio--video generation requires both causal modeling and step distillation, yet standard training recipes face two context-related challenges. Teacher forcing pairs clean history with a noisy target, but supervises predictive contextual representations only indirectly through velocity prediction. Meanwhile, directly reusing bidirectional score models in causal Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) creates a mismatch between generation and scoring contexts. We address these challenges with Salt++, a two-stage post-training framework comprising Causal Self-Flow (CSF) and context-aligned autoregressive DMD. CSF exploits contextual information asymmetry by varying the history while keeping the noisy target fixed: a noise-mixed-history student aligns its intermediate representations with those of a clean-history exponential-moving-average teacher. This self-supervised signal encourages the student to extract semantic information and improves cross-modal alignment. Context-aligned AR DMD shares the causal mask and prefix across generator sampling, fake-score training, and real-score evaluation to match generated and reference distributions under a block-conditional KL objective. With calibrated teacher guidance, it performs clean-prefix few-step distillation and then adapts to generated histories without switching objectives or requiring separate consistency distillation. At 480p, Salt++ improves visual and motion quality by 57% and 45% over OmniForcing on JavisBench under the same 4-step causal setting. A separate scale-wise post-training stage extends Salt++ to 4-step $1664\times960$ generation, outperforming bidirectional LTX-2 on six of seven reported metrics. Project page: https://xingtongge.github.io/Saltpp

AI.tldr: Salt++ 是一个两阶段后训练框架，用于少步流式音视频生成。它通过 Causal Self-Flow（CSF）与上下文对齐的自回归 DMD 来缓解因果建模和步蒸馏中的上下文错配问题，显著提升了生成质量。
AI.motivation: 少步流式音视频生成同时需要因果建模和步蒸馏，但标准训练配方面临两个与上下文相关的挑战：一是 teacher forcing 将干净历史与噪声目标配对，仅通过速度预测间接监督预测性上下文表示；二是在因果 DMD 中直接复用双向评分模型会造成生成上下文与评分上下文之间的错配。
AI.method: Salt++ 包含两个阶段。CSF 利用上下文信息不对称性，在固定噪声目标的同时变化历史：让噪声混合历史的学生模型将其中间表示与干净历史的 EMA 教师模型的表示对齐，从而提供自监督信号以提取语义信息并改善跨模态对齐。上下文对齐的 AR DMD 则在生成器采样、假分数训练和真分数评估中共享因果掩码与前缀，在块条件 KL 目标下匹配生成分布与参考分布；借助校准的教师引导，先进行干净前缀的少步蒸馏，再适应生成历史，无需切换目标或单独的 consistency distillation。
AI.result: 在 480p、相同 4 步因果设置下，Salt++ 在 JavisBench 上相比 OmniForcing 将视觉质量和运动质量分别提升 57% 和 45%。额外的尺度级后训练阶段将 Salt++ 扩展到 4 步 1664×960 生成，在报告中七项指标中的六项上超过双向 LTX-2。
AI.conclusion: Salt++ 通过 CSF 与上下文对齐 AR DMD 有效解决了流式音视频生成中的上下文相关挑战，实现了高质量少步因果生成，并可扩展到高分辨率场景。

title: Parameterized Stripe Attention for Efficient Video Generation
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) enable high-quality video generation but suffer from substantial inference latency, primarily attributable to the computationally expensive full spatio-temporal attention. While sparse attention methods offer potential solutions, existing approaches face an inherent flexibility--efficiency dilemma: predefined masks lack the flexibility to capture diverse attention patterns, while runtime-determined masks introduce overheads and sacrifice hardware efficiency. We identify the lack of a unified structural characterization of DiT attention as a key limitation of existing methods, and establish that video DiT attention exhibits \textbf{periodic diagonal stripe structures} along both temporal and spatial dimensions. To formally encode these structured patterns within a single efficient kernel, we present {\bf PSA}, a parameterized stripe attention that formalizes the observed stripe regularity, unifying diverse attention patterns for efficient mask generation. This unified representation enables a single hardware-efficient CUDA kernel to process all sparse patterns, achieving FlashAttention-3-level Model FLOPs Utilization. To determine optimal sparsity configurations, we propose a training-free offline search algorithm that automatically maximizes sparsity under a specified error tolerance for each attention head. Experiments on HunyuanVideo and Wan~2.1 demonstrate that PSA achieves 1.57$\times$ and 1.37$\times$ end-to-end speedups over FlashAttention-3 baselines, with acceptable visual quality degradation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出参数化条带注意力PSA，利用视频DiT注意力的周期性对角条带结构实现统一稀疏注意力，单核达FlashAttention-3级MFU，端到端提速最高1.57倍。
AI.motivation: 扩散Transformer（DiT）可实现高质量视频生成，但全时空注意力计算昂贵、推理延迟高。现有稀疏注意力方法存在"灵活性—效率"两难：预定义掩码缺乏捕获多样注意力模式的灵活性，运行时确定掩码则带来额外开销并损失硬件效率。作者认为现有方法的关键缺陷在于缺乏对DiT注意力结构的统一刻画。
AI.method: 1) 发现并确立视频DiT注意力在时间与空间维度上均呈现"周期性对角条带结构"；2) 提出参数化条带注意力（PSA），将该条带规律形式化编码，统一多种注意力模式并支持高效掩码生成，从而以单个硬件友好的CUDA内核处理所有稀疏模式；3) 提出无需训练的离线搜索算法，在每个注意力头上于给定误差容限下自动最大化稀疏度。
AI.result: 在HunyuanVideo与Wan 2.1上实验显示，PSA相比FlashAttention-3基线分别实现1.57倍与1.37倍的端到端加速，视觉质量退化在可接受范围内；单内核达到FlashAttention-3级别的模型FLOPs利用率（MFU）。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一刻画视频DiT注意力的周期性对角条带结构，PSA在保持硬件效率的同时兼顾稀疏模式灵活性，配合离线稀疏度搜索，实现了显著的端到端加速与可接受的画质损失。

title: Visual Parallel Search: Learning to Search High-Resolution Images with Parallel Tile Inspection and Adaptive Zoom
summary: High-resolution visual question answering often fails because a multimodal model does not acquire the small, spatially localized evidence needed to answer a question. Sequential zooming can recover detail, but it asks the main model to choose a region before obtaining a reliable overview. We introduce VPS, a visual parallel-search framework in which a main agent first invokes grid_search to inspect image tiles in parallel with question-conditioned sub-agents, and then adaptively invokes zoom_in PSisual Parallel Search improves mean accuracy over dedicated zoom-only search in 14 of 15 same-model comparisons, with gains up to 8.0 points and especially strong improvements for smaller main models. ZoomBench retains an approximately 3.2-point gain at every tested size. We further develop a supervision pipeline with hint-free verification and a paired role-specific GRPO surrogate for learning the controller and tile-reader roles. SFT improves observed accuracy on all five benchmark splits, including a 4.17-point gain on HR-Bench 4K. Role-specific RL further reshapes search behavior: main-only RL reduces mean tool use from 2.65 to 2.11 with similar pass@1 in an internal four-response evaluation, while external accuracy changes are mixed. Joint training reveals an asymmetry between local evidence reading and global search control. Together, these results support VPS as an effective inference-time scaffold and a trainable decomposition for visual evidence acquisition.

AI.tldr: 提出VPS视觉并行搜索框架：主智能体先用grid_search并行检查图像分块，再自适应调用zoom_in，在多个基准上提升高分辨率VQA准确率，并配套可训练的监督与角色专用RL流程。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率视觉问答常因多模态模型无法获取回答所需的小尺度、空间局部证据而失败；顺序式缩放虽可恢复细节，但要求主模型在获得可靠全局概览之前就选定区域。
AI.method: VPS框架：主智能体先调用grid_search，以问题为条件由子智能体并行检查图像分块，再自适应调用zoom_in。训练方面构建无提示验证的监督流程，以及面向控制器与分块读取器两种角色的配对角色专用GRPO代理目标；并比较SFT、仅主模型RL与联合训练。
AI.result: 在15组同模型对比中的14组优于纯缩放搜索，提升最高8.0分，小规模主模型增益尤为明显；ZoomBench各测试规模保持约3.2分增益。SFT在全部五个基准划分上提升观测准确率，HR-Bench 4K提升4.17分。仅主模型RL将内部四响应评估的平均工具调用从2.65降至2.11且pass@1相近，外部准确率变化不一；联合训练揭示局部证据读取与全局搜索控制之间的不对称性。
AI.conclusion: VPS既可作为有效的推理时脚手架，也提供了一种面向视觉证据获取的可训练分解方案。

title: VesselBench-800K: A Large-scale Perception Benchmark for Multimodal Vessel Detection, Counting, and Density Estimation
summary: Vessel perception from space is crucial for a wide range of maritime applications, from traffic monitoring to environmental protection. However, most existing datasets predominantly focus on general object detection tasks in optical remote sensing (RS) images. Relying solely on single-modality optical RS images proves inadequate for effectively perceiving vessel objects in complex maritime scenarios, where ever-changing weather conditions (e.g., clouds and rain), the need for day-and-night coverage, and the inherent limitations of a single imaging modality pose significant challenges. To fill this gap, we introduce VesselBench-800K, the largest-to-date benchmark dataset on a global scale for vessel perception in multimodal RS images. As its name suggests, VesselBench-800K comprises 800,000 images, each at a resolution of 512x512 pixels, specifically curated for vessel perception tasks such as detection, counting, and density estimation. These multimodal image pairs (i.e., optical, SAR) are collected from diverse platforms, sensors, scenes, shooting heights, and synthetic sources, spanning spatial resolutions from 4.5m to 0.1m. Furthermore, we evaluate numerous state-of-the-art detection, counting, and density estimation models on VesselBench-800K through both qualitative and quantitative comparisons. By revealing previously unrecognized cues, this dataset holds immense potential to significantly advance our understanding of marine traffic. Our VesselBench dataset will be publicly available at https://github.com/danfenghong/IEEE_TGRS_VesselBench to support and contribute to community development.

AI.tldr: 提出VesselBench-800K，全球最大规模多模态遥感船舶感知基准数据集，含80万张512×512图像，覆盖光学与SAR，支持检测、计数和密度估计任务。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集多聚焦于光学遥感图像的通用目标检测，单模态光学图像在复杂海上场景（云雨天气、昼夜覆盖需求等）下难以有效感知船舶目标，亟需多模态大规模基准数据集填补空白。
AI.method: 构建VesselBench-800K数据集：80万张512×512像素图像，包含光学与SAR多模态图像对，采集自多样平台、传感器、场景、拍摄高度和合成来源，空间分辨率覆盖4.5m至0.1m；并在该数据集上对多种先进检测、计数与密度估计模型进行定性与定量评估。
AI.result: 数据集规模达80万张，为当前全球最大；多模态图像对覆盖广泛分辨率（4.5m–0.1m）；多种SOTA模型评估揭示此前未被发现的线索与挑战。
AI.conclusion: VesselBench-800K为多模态遥感船舶感知提供大规模基准，有望显著推动海上交通理解，数据集将公开以支持社区发展。

title: World2Motion: Turning Video World Models into 3D Human Motion Generators
summary: We present World2Motion, a framework that generates scene-aware 3D human motion and corresponding video from a single image and a text prompt. While existing 3D motion generators learn from motion datasets, their generalization is constrained by limited coverage of environments. In contrast, video world models such as Cosmos 3 offer broader environmental priors but are not designed for full-body motion generation; recovering motion from their generated videos requires costly two-stage inference. To address these, we turn Cosmos 3 into a single-stage 3D motion generator. This adaptation has two challenges: the scarcity of paired video--motion data and temporal instability in the generated motion. First, we construct a training dataset combining synthetic video--motion pairs with real videos paired with estimated 3D motion. Second, we propose a shift-decoupled noise schedule that assigns different noise levels to video and motion through shared denoising progress. This design accommodates the different denoising requirements of the two modalities, reducing motion jitter. Experiments on a multi-source interaction benchmark show that World2Motion has better motion--text alignment and scene interaction compared with the evaluated 3D motion generators. It also matches the interaction success rate of the two-stage baseline while achieving approximately 3.3$\times$ faster inference.

AI.tldr: World2Motion 将 Cosmos 3 视频世界模型改造为单阶段场景感知 3D 人体运动生成器，通过混合数据构建与移位解耦噪声调度，在提升运动—文本对齐与场景交互的同时实现约 3.3 倍推理加速。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 运动生成器受限于运动数据集对环境的覆盖不足，泛化能力受限；而 Cosmos 3 等视频世界模型虽具备更广的环境先验，却不擅长全身运动生成，从其生成视频中恢复运动需要昂贵的两阶段推理。
AI.method: 将 Cosmos 3 改造为单阶段 3D 运动生成器：一是构建混合训练数据集，结合合成视频—运动配对与真实视频配估计 3D 运动；二是提出移位解耦噪声调度，在共享去噪进度下为视频与运动分配不同噪声水平，以适配两种模态不同的去噪需求并抑制运动抖动。
AI.result: 在多源交互基准上，World2Motion 相较所评估的 3D 运动生成器具有更好的运动—文本对齐与场景交互效果；交互成功率与两阶段基线相当，同时推理速度约提升 3.3 倍。
AI.conclusion: 以视频世界模型为骨干的单阶段框架可有效统一环境先验与全身运动生成，兼顾质量与效率，为场景感知人体运动生成提供了新思路。

title: Embedded Bi-Temporal Building Damage Assessment for On-Board Data Reduction
comment: 8 pages. Accepted at OBPDC 2026 (International Workshop on On-Board Payload Data Compression), Barcelona, October 2026
summary:
Rapid assessment of building damage after natural disasters is essential to support emergency response. Earth Observation satellites can acquire relevant imagery shortly after an event, but exploitation is limited by uplink and downlink capacity and by ground-processing latency. We address this with a bi-temporal building damage assessment pipeline built on a siamese detector derived from YOLOX, designed to compress information at both ends of the ground/space link. On the ground, pre-disaster reference images are encoded into a compact latent space -- compressed by up to a factor of 64 -- and uplinked to the satellite. On board, this reference is compared with a fresh post-disaster acquisition so that the downlink carries only actionable object-level products, bounding boxes and damage classes, instead of full scenes. This cuts the data exchanged in both directions, while on xBD the strongly compressed reference still preserves most of the detection performance.
  Because on-board acquisitions suffer from residual pre/post co-registration errors, we introduce a latent-space shift estimation and correction module that regresses the global offset from the coarse feature level and realigns the post-disaster features before fusion. It substantially improves robustness to de-registration -- especially under large shifts, where fusion-only variants collapse -- while also raising nominal accuracy and remaining compatible with the strongest compression. We finally port the pipeline to two embedded targets, a Xilinx Versal VCK190 and an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, and report hardware performance (latency, throughput, power efficiency). The core detector and its compression port cleanly to both, but the operators needed for long-range robustness survive only on the Jetson GPU, whereas the Versal DPU does not.

AI.tldr: 提出基于YOLOX孪生检测器的双时相建筑损毁评估流程，在地面压缩灾前参考影像（最高64倍）上行、在星上比对下传目标级产品（框与损毁类别），并引入潜空间位移估计与校正模块抗配准误差，最后在VCK190与Jetson AGX Orin上完成嵌入式部署与性能评估。
AI.motivation: 自然灾害后需快速评估建筑损毁以支撑应急响应。对地观测卫星虽能及时获取影像，但受上行/下行链路容量与地面处理时延限制，传统全场景回传与地面处理模式效率低。
AI.method: 构建基于YOLOX孪生检测器的双时相损毁评估流程：地面端将灾前参考影像编码为紧凑潜空间（压缩比最高64倍）并上传；星上端将参考与灾后新采集影像比对，仅下传目标级产品（边界框与损毁类别）。针对星上成像残留的前后配准误差，引入潜空间位移估计与校正模块，在粗特征层回归全局偏移并重对齐灾后特征后再融合。
AI.result: 双向交换数据量显著降低，在xBD数据集上强压缩参考仍保留大部分检测性能；位移校正模块大幅提升去配准鲁棒性（大位移下仅融合变体失效），同时提升标称精度且兼容最强压缩；移植至Xilinx Versal VCK190与NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin，报告时延、吞吐与能效。核心检测器及压缩模块均可干净移植，但长程鲁棒性所需算子仅在Jetson GPU存活，Versal DPU不支持。
AI.conclusion: 将信息压缩置于地空链路两端并结合潜空间配准校正，可实现高效、鲁棒的星上建筑损毁评估；但嵌入式平台的算子支持能力决定长程鲁棒性模块的可部署性，GPU平台优于DPU平台。

title: RBF-GNN: Rational Basis Functions for Pseudo-Coordinate based Graph Convolutions
summary: We propose RBF-GNN, a new pseudo-coordinate based graph neural network architecture that takes into account Euclidean, spherical or angular coordinates and uses them to induce a powerful spatial inductive bias. Similar in architecture to SplineCNN, we improve upon the latter by replacing the less efficient sparse-activation based B-splines whose number grows exponentially with dimension by rational Padé basis functions. For effective training we propose a spline-subspace initialization and a variance-preserving weight rescaling. Experimentally, we evaluate on a number of popular neural network architectures that use SplineCNNs. We replace only the SplineCNNs with RBF-GNN. We achieve improved results, including on semantic keypoint matching, shape matching, event based camera computer vision tasks. We will make our implementation publicly available upon acceptance of the paper.

AI.tldr: 提出RBF-GNN，一种基于伪坐标的图神经网络架构，用有理Padé基函数替代SplineCNN的B样条，并引入样条子空间初始化与保持方差的权重重缩放，提升空间归纳偏置效率与精度。
AI.motivation: SplineCNN等基于稀疏激活B样条的方法，其基函数数量随维度呈指数增长，效率受限，因此需要更高效的伪坐标基函数来诱导强空间归纳偏置。
AI.method: RBF-GNN采用欧氏、球面或角度坐标作为伪坐标；架构类似SplineCNN，但将B样条替换为有理Padé基函数；训练时使用样条子空间初始化与保持方差的权重重缩放。
AI.result: 在多个使用SplineCNN的流行网络架构上仅替换为RBF-GNN，在语义关键点匹配、形状匹配、事件相机视觉任务上均取得改进结果。
AI.conclusion: RBF-GNN通过更高效的基函数和训练策略，在保持架构兼容性的同时提升了空间归纳偏置效果，代码将在论文录用后公开。

title: Back2Struct: Making Structured Images Editable Again
summary: Structured images, such as diagrams, charts, and flowcharts, are inherently symbolic and can be compactly represented in an editable format, yet in practice, they are often rendered as images, and therefore not graphically editable. This mismatch presents a significant challenge for researchers, engineers, and designers who wish to incorporate modified versions of existing graphic content into new materials without manually reconstructing it. In this study, we presentBack2Struct, which "makes structured images editable again" by directly recovering vector graphics code (SVG / XML) from image representations. Given an image of a structured graphic, Back2Struct predicts semantically object-level SVG / XML code that explicitly encodes text, shapes, topology, and layout, rather than performing low-level pixel vectorization. The generated code can be seamlessly imported into tools such as PowerPoint, allowing users to edit, refine, restyle, and reuse graphic content while preserving structural fidelity. Beyond supervised fine-tuning on ground-truth SVG token sequences, we further optimize Back2Struct with reward-based learning to better match deployment-time requirements: the output should be syntactically valid, properly concise, and visually faithful to the input diagram. Specifically, we design a composite reward that jointly encourages SVG / XML compilability, length consistency with the reference code, and structural or semantic similarity between the generated and ground-truth graphics. These complementary signals guide the model to produce SVGs that are not only closer to the training distribution, but also more complete, editable, and renderable in practice. Experiments show that Back2Struct improves accuracy, editability, validity, and user alignment over baselines. Dataset and code are available at: pengyu965.github.io/Back2Struct.github.io

AI.tldr: Back2Struct 通过从图像直接恢复语义化、对象级的 SVG/XML 代码，实现结构化图像的再可编辑，并结合复合奖励的强化学习提升可编译性、简洁性与视觉保真度。
AI.motivation: 结构化图像（如图表、流程图）本质上是符号化的，可紧凑地以可编辑格式表示，但实际常以位图形式存在而无法图形化编辑。研究人员、工程师和设计师希望将现有图形内容修改后复用到新材料中，却不得不手动重建，这一不匹配构成现实痛点。
AI.method: 提出 Back2Struct，从图像表示中直接恢复矢量图形代码（SVG/XML），预测兼具语义性、对象级的代码，显式编码文本、形状、拓扑与布局，而非低层像素矢量化。除对真实 SVG token 序列做监督微调外，进一步采用基于奖励的学习进行优化，设计复合奖励联合鼓励：SVG/XML 的可编译性、与参考代码的长度一致性、以及生成图形与真值图形之间的结构或语义相似度。
AI.result: 实验表明，Back2Struct 在准确率、可编辑性、有效性和用户对齐方面均优于基线方法。生成代码可无缝导入 PowerPoint 等工具，在保持结构保真度的同时支持编辑、精修、重设样式与复用。
AI.conclusion: 语义化、对象级的矢量代码恢复为结构化图像的再编辑提供了有效路径；通过复合奖励的强化学习对齐部署需求（可编译、简洁、视觉忠实），可产出更接近训练分布且更完整、可编辑、可渲染的 SVG。数据集与代码已公开。

title: MotionInsight: Diagnosing Object Motion Deficiencies in Generated Videos
summary: Despite rapid progress in video generation models, they still exhibit obvious motion deficiencies, often manifested as incorrect object motion. However, most existing video quality evaluations focus on aesthetic quality or text-video alignment. To address this gap, we study object-centric motion fidelity assessment, evaluating target objects along object consistency, motion continuity, and physical plausibility. To achieve this, we first introduce VidMotion, a diagnostic dataset of 6,879 videos with designated moving objects and fine-grained annotations including dimension-wise scores and failure causes. We further propose MotionInsight, a diagnostic evaluator that shifts assessment from implicit RGB-frame observation to explicit motion-space diagnosis. By constructing motion-aware representations, MotionInsight makes subtle motion deficiencies more observable. We also introduce motion-specific rewards during GRPO to transform observed motion into a diagnostic assessment. Experiments demonstrate that MotionInsight provides an effective basis for diagnosing object motion deficiencies, producing human-aligned scores along three dimensions and grounded explanations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以对象为中心的运动保真度评估任务，构建了VidMotion诊断数据集与MotionInsight评估器，实现三维度分数与可解释的失效分析。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型仍存在明显运动缺陷（如物体运动错误），但主流视频质量评估多聚焦美学质量或文本-视频对齐，缺乏对物体运动保真度的针对性评估。
AI.method: 1）构建VidMotion诊断数据集，含6,879个视频、指定运动对象，标注维度分数与失效原因；2）提出MotionInsight评估器，从隐式RGB帧观测转向显式运动空间诊断，通过构建运动感知表征放大细微运动缺陷；3）在GRPO中引入运动专用奖励，将观测到的运动转化为诊断性评估。
AI.result: 实验表明MotionInsight能有效诊断物体运动缺陷，在对象一致性、运动连续性、物理合理性三个维度上给出与人类对齐的分数，并提供有依据的解释。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了运动保真度评估的空白，提供了可解释的物体运动缺陷诊断基础。

title: UniBuild: Unified Building Mapping From Multi-Source Optical Remote Sensing Imagery With Detail Decoding and Geometry Regularization
summary: Building extraction from optical remote sensing (RS) imagery is fundamental to urban mapping, yet existing methods are often dataset-specific and generalize poorly to unseen domains. Their practical use is also limited by insufficient detail recovery and weak geometric regularization, leading to blurred boundaries, irregular shapes, and merged adjacent buildings. To address these issues, we propose UniBuild, a unified building extraction framework for multi-source RGB optical RS imagery. First, a unified multi-dataset training scheme is constructed over heterogeneous RGB optical datasets to learn transferable building representations across sensors and resolutions. Second, a novel detail-preserving HR-DPT decoder is designed to integrate high-level semantic features with high-resolution spatial features, enhancing building detail recovery. Third, geometry-aware regularization is introduced through a structure-tensor-based direction-aware loss for boundary direction consistency and a saddle-aware loss for suppressing false activations in narrow inter-building gaps under low-resolution conditions. We train and evaluate UniBuild on multi-source RGB optical datasets, including 10 public high-resolution datasets and two self-collected low-resolution datasets. Experiments show that UniBuild consistently improves building-region accuracy, boundary sharpness, and adjacent-building separation across diverse datasets. It also generalizes well to unseen domains and supports practical building extraction from RGB optical RS imagery up to 10\,m resolution. The predicted masks can be further converted into GIS-compatible building footprints through simple polygonization. The trained model and inference code are released at https://github.com/zhu-xlab/UniBuild.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 UniBuild，一个面向多源 RGB 光学遥感影像的统一建筑物提取框架，通过多数据集统一训练、细节保留解码器与几何感知正则化，提升跨域泛化、边界锐度与相邻建筑分离能力。
AI.motivation: 现有建筑物提取方法往往针对特定数据集设计，跨域泛化能力差；同时细节恢复不足和几何约束薄弱，导致边界模糊、形状不规则以及相邻建筑物粘连，限制了实际应用。
AI.method: 1）构建异构 RGB 光学数据集上的统一多数据集训练方案，学习跨传感器、跨分辨率的可迁移建筑物表征；2）设计细节保留的 HR-DPT 解码器，融合高层语义特征与高分辨率空间特征；3）引入几何感知正则化，包括基于结构张量的方向感知损失（保证边界方向一致性）和鞍点感知损失（抑制低分辨率下建筑间窄间隙中的虚假激活）。
AI.result: 在 10 个公开高分辨率数据集与 2 个自采低分辨率数据集上训练与评估，UniBuild 在建筑区域精度、边界锐度和相邻建筑分离方面均持续优于对比方法，对未见域具有良好泛化性，支持最高 10 m 分辨率的 RGB 光学遥感建筑物提取，预测掩膜可经简单多边形化转换为 GIS 兼容的建筑轮廓。
AI.conclusion: UniBuild 通过统一训练、细节保留解码与几何正则化，有效缓解跨域泛化差与几何质量不足问题，为多源 RGB 光学遥感影像提供实用的统一建筑物提取方案，模型与推理代码已开源。

title: GleanVID: Complementary Token Selection for Efficient Video Large Language Models
summary: Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) have achieved strong video understanding capabilities but incur substantial inference overhead due to the large number of visual tokens. Existing VideoLLM token compression methods largely rely on selection-independent scoring, overlooking cross-frame complementarity and consequently retaining redundant evidence across frames. Instead, we view video token selection as a progressive evidence accumulation process. It aims to retain visual evidence that is individually informative and collectively complementary under a limited token budget. Building on this insight, we introduce GleanVID, a training-free inference acceleration framework for VideoLLMs. Specifically, GleanVID first allocates the global token budget across frames according to temporal novelty and then selects tokens by jointly considering local representativeness and subspace complementarity, thereby preserving richer and less redundant visual evidence. Extensive experiments across diverse VideoLLMs and benchmarks demonstrate that GleanVID consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance. Notably, with only 25% of visual tokens, GleanVID preserves 98.6% of Qwen3-VL's original performance while reducing its prefill latency by 44.7%. On LLaVA-OV-7B, GleanVID at a 25% retention ratio even slightly surpasses the original model.

AI.tldr: GleanVID：一种免训练的视频大语言模型推理加速框架，将视频token选择视为渐进式证据积累过程，按时间新颖度分配预算并联合考虑局部代表性与子空间互补性选token，25%预算下保持98.6%性能并降低44.7% prefill延迟。
AI.motivation: VideoLLM因大量视觉token导致推理开销巨大；现有token压缩方法多采用与选择无关的打分，忽略跨帧互补性，导致保留跨帧冗余证据。
AI.method: 将视频token选择重构为渐进式证据积累过程，目标是在有限预算下保留个体信息量高且整体互补的视觉证据。GleanVID为免训练推理加速框架：先依据时间新颖度为各帧分配全局token预算，再联合局部代表性（representativeness）与子空间互补性（subspace complementarity）选择token。
AI.result: 在多种VideoLLM与基准上取得一致的SOTA表现；仅用25%视觉token时保留Qwen3-VL原始性能的98.6%，prefill延迟降低44.7%；在LLaVA-OV-7B上25%保留率甚至略超原模型。
AI.conclusion: 跨帧互补感知的渐进式token选择可在免训练条件下有效压缩视频token，实现高保真加速，优于现有选择独立打分方法。

title: Speed in the Blind Spot: An Interpretability Analysis of Dynamic Perception in VLMs for Autonomous Driving
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Vision-Language Models are increasingly used in autonomous-driving systems, yet their ability to recover dynamic physical state from visual input remains insufficiently characterized. We study velocity understanding as a controlled diagnostic across three tasks: surrounding-agent speed, current ego speed, and short-horizon future ego-speed proposal. On nuScenes, we evaluate open-weight general-purpose and PhysicalAI VLMs, together with the driving-oriented Alpamayo-1.5 Vision-Language-Action model, using multiple input and output formulations. We combine verbal evaluation with temporal perturbations, counterfactual ego-speed hints and linear probes of hidden representations. The tasks exhibit distinct failure modes. Surrounding-agent speed is weakly encoded in an agent-specific form, whereas current ego speed is often internally accessible but poorly verbalized: continuous probes achieve 4.7-5.8 km/h MAE compared with 10.2-16.8 km/h MAE for verbal outputs. Multiple frames provide inconsistent verbal gains to single frame inputs, and frame order is rarely exploited. Under non-optimized QLoRA, task-specific adaptation improves both task-relevant latent speed representations and verbal readout, but continuous surrounding-agent speed estimation remains weak, while most future-speed gains survive frame shuffling, indicating limited temporal grounding. Driving specialized Alpamayo-1.5 shows stronger latent representations for surrounding-agent and future ego speed, while current ego-speed decodability is comparable and substantial probe-verbal gaps remain. Thus, driving specialization can strengthen motion representations but does not guarantee stronger encoding across both scene and ego states or reliable readout. The results show that plausible planning outputs do not necessarily imply reliable recovery or temporal grounding of the underlying dynamic state.

AI.tldr: 该研究以速度理解为诊断任务，在nuScenes上评估通用、具身与驾驶专用VLM，发现速度信息在隐表示与言语输出间存在显著鸿沟，驾驶专精可增强运动表示但不保证可靠读出与时序接地。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型越来越多地用于自动驾驶系统，但其从视觉输入中恢复动态物理状态的能力尚未被充分刻画。作者希望以速度理解为受控诊断，检验这类模型是否真正编码并读出运动状态。
AI.method: 在nuScenes上评测开放权重通用VLM、PhysicalAI VLM，以及驾驶导向的Alpamayo-1.5 VLA模型，覆盖三个任务：周围智能体速度、当前自车速度、短时域未来自车速度建议；采用多种输入与输出形式，结合言语评估、时间扰动、反事实自车速度提示与隐表示线性探针，并施加非最优QLoRA任务特定微调进行对比。
AI.result: 任务呈现不同失效模式：周围智能体速度仅以弱智能体特定形式被编码；当前自车速度常内部可及但难以言语化，连续探针MAE为4.7–5.8 km/h，而言语输出为10.2–16.8 km/h；多帧对单帧无一致言语增益，帧序很少被利用。QLoRA适配改善任务相关潜在速度表示与言语读出，但连续周围智能体速度估计仍弱，多数未来速度增益在帧打乱后仍存在，表明时序接地有限。Alpamayo-1.5在周围智能体与未来自车速度上潜在表示更强，当前自车速度可解码性相当，探针—言语鸿沟依然显著。
AI.conclusion: 驾驶专精可强化运动表示，但不能保证对场景状态与自车状态均有更强编码，也不能保证可靠读出。看似合理的规划输出并不意味底层的动态状态能被可靠恢复或具备时序接地。

title: NHO: A Neural Hamiltonian Operator for Anchor-based Region Localization and Dense Correspondance
summary: Non-rigid partial-to-full shape correspondence from sparse anchors requires identifying the corresponding region on the full surface and recovering dense correspondences between the partial shape and that region. We present NHO, which combines sparse anchors with the intrinsic geometry of the partial shape to learn a neural Hamiltonian operator whose localized eigenspace encodes both the region support and intrinsic coordinates for dense correspondence. NHO parameterizes the Hamiltonian potential as an intrinsic neural field and optimizes it using anchor evidence together with spectral and geometric constraints. To resolve the spatial ambiguity left by sparse anchors, we introduce reciprocal refinement between operator estimation and correspondence recovery. At each round, the current eigenspace provides spectral coordinates and restricts matching to its induced support, while geometrically reliable correspondences provide additional evidence for updating the potential. After refinement, aggregated eigenfunction energy yields the final localization, and the recovered map initializes dense correspondence refinement. Experiments demonstrate competitive accuracy on both tasks and robustness to uniform scaling and rotation.

AI.tldr: 提出NHO方法，用稀疏锚点结合部分形状的内蕴几何学习神经哈密顿算子，其局部化特征空间同时编码区域支撑与内蕴坐标，通过算子估计与对应恢复的相互迭代精化，实现非刚性部分到完整形状的稠密对应。
AI.motivation: 非刚性部分到完整（partial-to-full）形状对应需要两步：在全表面上定位对应区域，并恢复部分形状与该区域间的稠密对应。仅凭稀疏锚点存在空间歧义，难以直接确定区域支撑并建立稠密映射，因此需要一种能同时编码区域支撑与内蕴坐标的统一表示。
AI.method: 提出NHO，将稀疏锚点与部分形状的内蕴几何结合，学习一个神经哈密顿算子，使其局部化特征空间（localized eigenspace）同时编码区域支撑与用于稠密对应的内蕴坐标。将哈密顿势能参数化为内蕴神经场，利用锚点证据以及谱约束和几何约束进行优化。为解决稀疏锚点带来的空间歧义，引入算子估计与对应恢复之间的相互精化（reciprocal refinement）：每轮中当前特征空间提供谱坐标并将匹配限制在其诱导的支撑内，而几何上可靠的对应则为更新势能提供额外证据。精化后，聚合特征函数能量得到最终定位，恢复的映射用于初始化稠密对应精化。
AI.result: 在区域定位与稠密对应两个任务上均取得有竞争力的精度，并对均匀缩放和旋转具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: NHO通过神经哈密顿算子的局部化特征空间统一建模区域支撑与内蕴坐标，并以相互精化机制缓解稀疏锚点的空间歧义，为部分到完整非刚性形状对应提供了有效且几何鲁棒的方案。

title: OmniRoute: Mapping Temporal Semantic Evidence to Audio-Visual Token Budgets for Efficient Omnimodal Large Language Models
summary: Omnimodal large language models (Omni-LLMs) encode audio and visual streams into temporally interleaved token sequences for multimodal reasoning. However, processing long audio-visual token sequences incurs substantial prefill costs. Existing compression methods have made progress, but often overlook temporal changes in audio-visual semantic relevance. Motivated by temporal variation and local continuity, we propose OmniRoute, a training-free, two-stage compression framework. First, Temporal Evidence-Guided Budgeting (TEGB) derives chunk-wise modality preferences and initial leading-modality budgets from semantic relevance and local content variation. Second, Budget-Constrained Semantic Compression (BCSC) compresses the leading modality and then calibrates the follower's retention target using the actual retained fraction. For video, it combines spatiotemporal grouping with query-guided selection; for audio, it selects tokens based on encoder attention and query relevance, then merges residual tokens into context anchors under visual guidance. Experiments on four representative benchmarks demonstrate a better trade-off between inference efficiency and performance than competitive baselines. The code and interface will be released to facilitate further research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OmniRoute，一种免训练的两阶段音视频 token 压缩框架，通过时序证据引导预算分配与预算约束语义压缩，在四个基准上实现推理效率与性能的更优权衡。
AI.motivation: Omni-LLM 将音频和视觉流编码为时序交错 token 序列进行多模态推理，但长音视频 token 序列带来高昂的预填充（prefill）成本。现有压缩方法虽有进展，却常忽视音视频语义相关性的时序变化。
AI.method: 受时序变化与局部连续性启发，提出免训练两阶段框架 OmniRoute。第一阶段 TEGB（Temporal Evidence-Guided Budgeting）基于语义相关性和局部内容变化，推导分块（chunk-wise）模态偏好与初始主导模态预算；第二阶段 BCSC（Budget-Constrained Semantic Compression）先压缩主导模态，再用实际保留比例校准跟随模态的保留目标。视频侧结合时空分组与查询引导选择；音频侧基于编码器注意力和查询相关性选择 token，并在视觉引导下将残余 token 合并为上下文锚点。
AI.result: 在四个代表性基准上的实验表明，相比竞争基线，OmniRoute 在推理效率与性能之间取得了更好的权衡。
AI.conclusion: OmniRoute 通过时序自适应的分块预算分配与预算约束的语义压缩，有效缓解长音视频序列的预填充开销。代码与接口将开源以促进后续研究。

title: Spatial-OPSD: Self-Improving Spatial Reasoning via Label-Free Self-Distillation
summary:
Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly operate in embodied and spatially grounded settings, where accurate understanding of depth, viewpoint, and three-dimensional relations is essential. However, improving spatial reasoning typically relies on ground-truth answers, answer-derived rewards, or other forms of task-specific supervision. We introduce Spatial-OPSD, a label-free self-improvement framework that instead exploits spatial structure naturally available from perception and reconstruction tools. During training, a privileged teacher receives automatically obtainable spatial priors, such as depth, reconstructed 3D relations, and camera geometry, while the student observes only the original visual-language input.
