On trajectories sampled by the student itself, the teacher provides dense token-level supervision, allowing the student to internalize spatial knowledge without ground-truth answer labels or privileged information at inference time.
  To extend this supervision beyond a single round, we adopt a round-wise recursive training scheme: the teacher remains frozen within each round to provide a stable learning target, and the improved student initializes both teacher and student in the next round, where privileged spatial priors re-establish an informative teacher--student asymmetry. This enables repeated self-improvement while avoiding a rapidly moving teacher during optimization. Across four VLM families, a single round of Spatial-OPSD consistently improves the five-benchmark average, while three rounds further push a strong spatially specialized model to the open-source frontier, achieving the highest average among the open models and the best results on three of five spatial reasoning benchmarks. Our code is available at https://github.com/vermouth599/Spatial-OPSD.

AI.tldr: Spatial-OPSD：无需标签的自提升框架，利用深度、重建3D关系与相机几何等空间先验构建特权教师，对学生自采样轨迹提供稠密token级监督，并以逐轮递归训练实现多轮自提升。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型越来越多应用于具身与空间落地场景，需要准确理解深度、视角和三维关系，但现有空间推理改进方法依赖真值答案、答案派生奖励或任务特定监督，成本高且受限。
AI.method: 提出Spatial-OPSD标签无关自提升框架：训练时特权教师接收自动可得的空间先验（深度、重建3D关系、相机几何），学生仅见原始视觉-语言输入；在学自采样轨迹上教师提供稠密token级监督，推理时无需真值与特权信息。采用逐轮递归训练：轮内教师冻结以稳定目标，改进后的学生初始化下一轮的教师与学生，重新建立教师-学生不对称性。
AI.result: 在四个VLM家族上，单轮Spatial-OPSD即稳定提升五基准平均；三轮训练将强空间专用模型推至开源前沿，取得开源模型最高平均，并在五个空间推理基准中的三个上取得最佳结果。
AI.conclusion: 空间结构先验可作为免标签监督信号，通过特权教师-学生不对称与逐轮递归蒸馏，实现可重复的空间推理自提升，且不依赖真值标签或推理期特权输入。

title: Context without Commitment: Robust Dense Correspondence under Non-Rigid Deformation
summary: Non-rigid point-cloud registration aims to find the corresponding target point for each point on a deforming source surface. Point-level matching keeps the full target cloud available, but correspondence becomes ambiguous when different regions have similar local geometry. Regional or coarse-to-fine methods provide broader spatial context, but an incorrect regional match can exclude the correct correspondence before dense matching. We propose CoCo-Reg, which uses regional patches to enrich dense point features without allowing patch predictions to restrict the final point-level search. CoCo-Reg constructs farthest-point-sampled patches, exchanges geometric information within and between source and target, supervises patch similarity using identity-corrected point overlap, and projects the resulting regional information back to dense point features. The final registration stage still scores the full target cloud before global point-level candidate selection. On 726 held-out ModelNet10 objects across nine deformation levels, two established learning-based baselines obtain mean correspondence errors of 0.1993 and 0.1921, whereas CoCo-Reg obtains 0.0547. Relative to its point-level baseline, this is a 72.6\% reduction. CoCo-Reg achieves lower correspondence error on 92.3\% of paired test objects and reduces the mean fraction of points with error above 0.1 from 47.3\% to 17.3\%. Chamfer distance and HD95 decrease in the same direction, and CoCo-Reg remains lower across all tested deformation levels. These results support using regional context for dense non-rigid correspondence without imposing a hard patch-level restriction on the final search. Because evaluation uses one checkpoint per method, the reported gains characterize the complete systems rather than the isolated causal contribution of an individual component. Code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出CoCo-Reg，用区域patch信息增强稠密点特征，但不让patch预测限制最终的点级搜索，在非刚性点云配准上大幅降低对应误差。
AI.motivation: 非刚性点云配准中，点级匹配保留完整目标点云但局部几何相似时对应关系易歧义；区域或由粗到细方法虽提供更大空间上下文，但错误的区域匹配会在稠密匹配前排除正确对应。因此需在利用区域上下文的同时避免patch级硬性限制。
AI.method: CoCo-Reg构建最远点采样patch，在源与目标内部及之间交换几何信息，用身份校正的点重叠监督patch相似度，并将区域信息投影回稠密点特征；最终配准阶段仍对完整目标点云打分后进行全局点级候选选择。
AI.result: 在726个ModelNet10留出对象、九种变形水平上，两个学习基线平均对应误差为0.1993和0.1921，CoCo-Reg为0.0547，相对点级基线降低72.6%；在92.3%配对测试对象上误差更低，误差大于0.1的点比例均值从47.3%降至17.3%；Chamfer距离和HD95同向下降，且在全部测试变形水平上保持更低。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明可利用区域上下文进行稠密非刚性对应，而无需对最终搜索施加硬性patch级限制；因评估每种方法仅用一个checkpoint，报告增益刻画的是完整系统性能而非单个组件的孤立因果贡献。

title: LDM-is-AE: Latent Diffusion Model is an Auto-Encoder for End-to-End Image Generation
comment: Accepted by NIPS 2026. More info can be found in https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/LDMisAE
summary: Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) typically adopt a two-stage pipeline: an auto-encoder (AE) is first pre-trained to define a latent space, then a diffusion model is trained to perform denoising within it. Such a two-stage design introduces a representation mismatch, as the latent space is optimized for reconstruction rather than adapting the denoising dynamics. We reveal that the LDM itself is an AE, and consequently present LDM-is-AE, an end-to-end one-stage LDM training framework that eliminates the need for a separately trained tokenizer. Our key observation is that the LDM backbone actually performs a latent-to-feature-to-latent transformation at each denoising step, which can be interpreted as an internal decoding--encoding process. Leveraging this structure, we split the DiT backbone into two reciprocal components, DiT-E (i.e., DiT Encoding) and DiT-D (i.e., DiT Decoding), and impose image-space supervision on the intermediate features across all timesteps. Our model encourages the internal representation to align with the image domain throughout denoising, thereby establishing an explicit latent-to-image-to-latent path. At the zero-noise timestep, our model further performs an image-to-latent-to-image mapping, corresponding to an auto-encoding process. As a result, LDM-is-AE jointly learns latent representations and denoising dynamics in an end-to-end manner, yielding a diffusion-native latent space tailored to the generation process. Experiments demonstrate that LDM-is-AE exhibits highly competitive generation performance, achieving an FID of 1.80 and 1.90 on 256x256 and 512x512 class-conditional image generation, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LDM-is-AE，一种端到端单阶段LDM训练框架，无需单独预训练tokenizer，将DiT骨干拆分为DiT-E和DiT-D并施加图像空间监督，实现扩散原生潜在空间。
AI.motivation: 传统LDM采用两阶段流水线（先预训练自编码器定义潜在空间，再训练扩散模型），导致表示不匹配问题：潜在空间为重建优化，而非适配去噪动态。
AI.method: 核心观察是LDM骨干在每个去噪步实际执行latent-to-feature-to-latent变换，可视为内部解码-编码过程。据此将DiT骨干拆分为互逆的DiT-E（编码）和DiT-D（解码），在所有时间步对中间特征施加图像空间监督，构建显式的latent-to-image-to-latent路径；在零噪声时间步进一步执行image-to-latent-to-image映射，对应自编码过程。
AI.result: 在256×256和512×512类别条件图像生成任务上，LDM-is-AE的FID分别达到1.80和1.90，生成性能极具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: LDM-is-AE以端到端方式联合学习潜在表示与去噪动态，得到适配生成过程的扩散原生潜在空间，验证了"LDM本身即AE"这一洞察的有效性。

title: Real2Gym: Building Gyms from Videos, Bringing Skills to Robots
summary: Real-world videos provide rich demonstrations of manipulation, but turning them into reusable robot skills requires visually aligned environments, executable physical interactions, and mechanisms for learning from experience. We introduce Real2Gym, an agentic Real2Sim2Real framework that turns human and robot demonstrations into interactive simulation gyms and brings skills acquired in simulation to physical robots. The Real2Sim module reconstructs editable scenes, aligns objects and cameras with the input, validates demonstrated or retargeted actions through native physics execution, and generates task-conditioned variations with action-feasibility checks. Within these environments, the agent generates executable code for manipulation stages, observes their outcomes, and distills successful attempts and failures into reusable task procedures, object-relative motions, and recovery strategies. Through a shared perception-and-control interface, these skills guide subsequent execution in simulation and on real robots, with motions adapted to current observations and no updates to the underlying model weights. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that Real2Gym enables high-fidelity simulation environment reconstruction, outperforming GPT-6 Astra Direct Mode by 16.7% in success rate with approximately 74.9% fewer policy-execution tokens across these environments, while exceeding it by 33.3% in physical robot execution success rate across four tasks on a real Franka robot.

AI.tldr: Real2Gym：将人类/机器人演示转为可交互仿真gym，并将仿真技能迁移到真实机器人的Agentic Real2Sim2Real框架。
AI.motivation: 真实视频蕴含丰富操作演示，但要转化为可复用机器人技能，需视觉对齐的环境、可执行的物理交互，以及从经验中学习的机制。
AI.method: Real2Sim模块重建可编辑场景，对齐物体与相机，用原生物理执行验证演示/重定向动作，并生成带动作可行性校验的任务条件变体；智能体在环境中为操作阶段生成可执行代码，观察结果，将成功与失败蒸馏为可复用任务流程、物体相对运动与恢复策略；通过共享感知-控制接口，这些技能在仿真与真机上引导执行，动作随当前观测自适应且不更新底层模型权重。
AI.result: 实现高保真仿真环境重建；成功率较GPT-6 Astra Direct Mode高16.7%，策略执行token减少约74.9%；在真实Franka机器人四任务上物理执行成功率高出33.3%。
AI.conclusion: 该agentic Real2Sim2Real框架能有效桥接真实演示与机器人技能复用，在仿真与真机执行中均显著优于基线，且无需权重更新。

title: Task-Oriented Visual Feature Compression via Residual Vector Quantization for Device-Edge Multimodal Inference
comment: 13 pages. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing
summary: Large multimodal models (LMMs) support diverse visual understanding and reasoning tasks but are often impractical to run entirely on resource-constrained devices. Device-edge co-inference reduces device computation, yet transmitting visual data over bandwidth-limited uplinks can introduce substantial delay. Task-oriented feature compression (TOFC) reduces the payload through feature aggregation and entropy coding. However, continuous-feature coding remains costly, and query-agnostic aggregation may discard task-relevant local evidence. We propose query-guided task-oriented feature compression (Q-TOFC) for device-edge multimodal inference. Q-TOFC employs residual vector quantization (RVQ) to encode each merged feature as a compact sequence of codebook indices, reducing its representation cost and allowing more features to be transmitted. It further incorporates query relevance into feature aggregation and uses a quantization error compensation adapter to mitigate the distortion introduced by discrete quantization. Experiments on seven multimodal benchmarks show that Q-TOFC reduces the visual payload by 53.6% relative to TOFC while maintaining comparable average normalized task performance. End-to-end latency evaluations further demonstrate lower latency under bandwidth-constrained uplinks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出查询引导的任务导向特征压缩方法Q-TOFC，用于设备-边缘多模态推理，在保持任务性能的同时将视觉传输负载较TOFC降低53.6%。
AI.motivation: 大型多模态模型难以完全在资源受限设备上运行，设备-边缘协同推理虽可减轻设备计算，但带宽受限的上行链路传输视觉数据会带来显著延迟。现有任务导向特征压缩（TOFC）通过特征聚合与熵编码降低负载，但连续特征编码代价高，且与查询无关的聚合可能丢弃任务相关的局部证据。
AI.method: 提出查询引导的任务导向特征压缩（Q-TOFC）：采用残差向量量化（RVQ）将每个合并特征编码为紧凑的码本索引序列，降低表示代价以传输更多特征；在特征聚合中引入查询相关性；并使用量化误差补偿适配器缓解离散量化带来的失真。
AI.result: 在七个多模态基准上，Q-TOFC相对TOFC将视觉负载降低53.6%，同时保持相当的平均归一化任务性能；端到端延迟评估显示在带宽受限上行链路下延迟更低。
AI.conclusion: Q-TOFC通过结合RVQ离散编码、查询相关聚合与量化误差补偿，有效降低设备-边缘多模态推理的传输负载与带宽受限下的延迟，同时维持任务性能。

title: Why MLLMs Struggle to Count: Overcoming Individuation and Aggregation Bottlenecks with ConvStack
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) consistently struggle with fine-grained visual counting, yet the underlying causes remain poorly understood. In this work, we present a mechanistic analysis of this failure mode, identifying two critical bottlenecks inherent to the global attention pipeline of MLLMs. First, we reveal an individuation bottleneck stemming from image patchification: because Vision Transformers process patches independently, they struggle to group fragmented geometric features across boundaries into distinct object representations. Second, we identify a collapse in the subsequent counting aggregation process, where representation separation rapidly diminishes as numerosity increases due to attention compression. Identifying and formalizing these twin bottlenecks constitutes our first major contribution. To overcome them, we propose ConvStack, a lightweight architecture that operates directly in the visual token space to explicitly aggregate and inject local spatial structures via zero-initialized residual connections. By explicitly addressing the individuation bottleneck, ConvStack provides unambiguous geometric evidence for downstream aggregation. Remarkably, by fine-tuning exclusively on counting tasks, the model achieves substantial improvements in dense object counting and broader spatial understanding benchmarks, without compromising on general visual capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文对多模态大语言模型(MLLM)细粒度计数失败进行机制性分析,识别出"个体化瓶颈"与"计数聚合坍缩"两大瓶颈,并提出轻量架构ConvStack,在视觉token空间显式聚合局部空间结构,仅微调计数任务即可显著提升密集计数与空间理解能力。
AI.motivation: MLLM在细粒度视觉计数上持续失败,但其内在原因尚不清晰。作者希望从机制层面揭示失败根源,而非仅做经验性改进。
AI.method: 机制性分析:指出全局注意力流水线中的两个瓶颈——(1)个体化瓶颈,源于图像切块(ViT独立处理patch,难以跨边界将碎片化几何特征分组为独立物体表征);(2)计数聚合坍缩,随数量增加,表示分离度因注意力压缩迅速衰减。对策:提出ConvStack,一种在视觉token空间直接操作的轻量架构,通过零初始化残差连接显式聚合与注入局部空间结构,为下游聚合提供明确几何证据;仅在计数任务上微调。
AI.result: 在密集物体计数及更广泛的空间理解基准上取得显著提升,同时不损害模型的通用视觉能力。
AI.conclusion: 明确并形式化上述双重瓶颈构成首要贡献;显式解决个体化瓶颈可为计数聚合提供明确几何证据,验证了机制性分析指导下轻量模块设计的有效性。

title: Waypoint-1.5: A Real-Time Video World Model for Consumer Hardware
summary: We present Waypoint 1.5, a real-time diffusion world model for interactive video generation on consumer-grade hardware. Unlike general video diffusion models, interactive world models (iWMs) must respond to dense user controls under strict latency and throughput constraints. Waypoint 1.5 is pre-trained on 100,000 hours of diverse, control-aligned video game data across hundreds of games, and generates playable video conditioned on full keyboard and mouse input. The model includes two resolution variants that run across a wide spectrum of consumer hardware. To characterize this unique setting, we distinguish rendered FPS, latent FPS, and control rate. We describe the data pipeline, architecture, training methodology, and runtime system behind Waypoint 1.5. We evaluate interactivity through latency and throughput. Finally, we discuss the safety and ethics considerations unique to iWMs.

AI.tldr: Waypoint 1.5 是一个面向消费级硬件的实时扩散世界模型，用于交互式视频生成，在10万小时游戏视频上预训练，可根据键盘鼠标输入生成可玩视频，并在延迟与吞吐约束下评估交互性。
AI.motivation: 交互式世界模型（iWMs）需在严格的延迟与吞吐约束下响应用户的密集控制，这与通用视频扩散模型不同，因而需要专门的数据、架构、训练与运行时设计。
AI.method: 在10万小时、覆盖数百款游戏的控制对齐视频数据上预训练；以完整键盘与鼠标输入为条件生成视频；提供两种分辨率变体以适配不同消费级硬件；并区分渲染FPS、潜在FPS与控制率三种指标。
AI.result: 论文描述了 Waypoint 1.5 的数据管线、架构、训练方法与运行时系统，并通过延迟与吞吐量评估其交互性能，同时给出两种分辨率变体在消费级硬件上的运行范围。
AI.conclusion: Waypoint 1.5 展示了在消费级硬件上实现实时交互式视频生成的可行性，并讨论了 iWMs 特有的安全与伦理考量，为该方向提供了系统性的设计与评估框架。

title: NRF-GS: Neural Residual Fields for Expressive and Compact Gaussian Splatting
summary: We revisit the role of appearance modeling in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) and show that limited expressiveness in view-dependent reflectance is a key driver of representation redundancy. In standard 3DGS, low-order spherical harmonics (SH) are used, restricting the splats' ability to model high-frequency directional effects, which is typically compensated by increasing the number of splats. We propose \emph{NRF-GS: Neural Residual Fields for Gaussian Splatting}, a hybrid representation that replaces per-splat SH-bases with a shared neural residual field. Each Gaussian encodes a compact set of appearance features and a lambertian base color, while a lightweight \emph{global scene-level MLP} predicts view-dependent residuals conditioned on viewing direction, distance, and per-splat features. This formulation enhances directional reflectance modeling by combining diffuse per-splat reflectance representations with a shared global function for high-frequency details, enabling both higher expressiveness and parameter sharing across splats. Our key insight is that by accurately capturing high-frequency directional reflectance, especially in specular regions, the GS-representation becomes more expressive, reducing the need for geometrically redundant splats. As a result, NRF-GS achieves comparable or better rendering quality while reducing the number of Gaussians by up to 50\%, and produces visibly improved specular and high-frequency details.

AI.tldr: 论文指出3DGS中低阶球谐函数对视角相关反射的建模能力不足，导致表征冗余；提出NRF-GS，用全局神经残差场替代每个高斯的SH基，在减少最多50%高斯数量的同时保持或提升渲染质量。
AI.motivation: 标准3DGS使用低阶球谐函数建模视角相关反射，无法表达高频方向性效果，通常只能通过增加高斯点数量来弥补，造成几何与表征上的冗余。作者希望从外观建模角度提升表达力，从而降低对冗余高斯的依赖。
AI.method: 提出NRF-GS混合表征：每个高斯不再携带独立的SH基，而是编码紧凑的外观特征与Lambertian基色；同时使用一个轻量级的全局场景级MLP，以视角方向、距离和逐高斯特征为条件，预测视角相关的残差，实现漫反射局部表征与共享全局高频函数相结合。
AI.result: NRF-GS在渲染质量上与标准3DGS相当或更优，同时将高斯数量减少最多50%，并在镜面反射和高频细节区域产生可见的改善。
AI.conclusion: 准确建模高频方向性反射（尤其是镜面区域）能使GS表征更具表达力，减少对几何冗余高斯的需求；用共享神经残差场替代逐高斯SH基是一种高效且表达力更强的外观建模方案。

title: EviViT: Evidence-Adaptive Vision Transformers for Fine-Grained Perception
summary: Fine-grained visual perception enables vision-language models to distinguish subtle attributes and ground their answers in visual evidence. In high-resolution scenes, processing the whole image at greater resolution spends visual tokens on irrelevant content, while isolated crops can lose the context needed to interpret the selected evidence. We introduce EviViT, a lightweight attachment that learns where a pretrained vision transformer should acquire detail. Human visual-search traces supervise a question-conditioned evidence density, which guides regional re-reading from the original pixels and the allocation of visual tokens. A sparse, coordinate-aware bridge then connects the regional features to the global scene, allowing the host to interpret precise evidence in context. Learned with the host backbone frozen, the attachment serves both the base model and compatible post-trained descendants without refitting. Experiments across nine hosts show consistent gains in average fine-grained accuracy. Matched-budget comparisons further show that EviViT outperforms global-only processing at every tested token ceiling while using fewer visual tokens.

AI.tldr: EviViT 是一种轻量级附加模块，学习预训练视觉Transformer应在何处获取细节，通过人类视觉搜索轨迹监督问题条件化的证据密度，引导区域重读与视觉token分配，并用稀疏坐标感知桥连接区域特征与全局场景，在不微调主干的情况下提升多种宿主模型的细粒度视觉感知。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率场景下的细粒度视觉感知存在两难：整图高分辨率处理会把视觉token浪费在无关内容上，而孤立裁剪又会丢失理解所选证据所需的上下文。因此需要一种自适应决定"在哪里获取细节"的方法。
AI.method: EviViT作为一个轻量级附件，学习预训练ViT应在何处获取细节：用人类视觉搜索轨迹监督问题条件化的证据密度，据此引导从原始像素进行的区域重读和视觉token分配；再用稀疏的坐标感知桥将区域特征连接到全局场景，使宿主模型能在上下文中解读精确证据。训练时冻结宿主主干，附件可同时服务基础模型与兼容的后训练衍生模型，无需重新拟合。
AI.result: 在九个宿主模型上的实验显示细粒度平均准确率一致提升；在匹配预算比较中，EviViT在每一个测试的token上限下都优于纯全局处理，且使用的视觉token更少。
AI.conclusion: EviViT通过以人眼搜索轨迹监督的证据密度分配视觉token，实现了高效的区域重读与全局上下文结合，作为与主机解耦的轻量附件，在多种预训练及后训练模型上通用地提升了细粒度视觉感知效率与精度。

title: Multi-Granularity Language-Guided Imitation Learning via Instruction Decomposition
summary: Using language instructions as conditions to guide robot policy learning has recently become an important research domain. However, existing language-guided policy learning methods typically use an overall task description to guide the entire demonstration trajectory. For manipulation tasks involving multiple execution stages, these methods assign the same language description to different subtasks, making it difficult to distinguish the behaviors required at different stages. In this work, we propose a multi-granularity language guidance method based on instruction decomposition. The proposed method decomposes an overall task description into more fine-grained, concrete subtask-level language instructions, thereby enhancing learning efficiency and improving performance. We evaluate the proposed method in the setting of multi-task imitation learning and validate its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于指令分解的多粒度语言引导方法，将整体任务描述分解为更细粒度的子任务级语言指令，用于机器人策略学习，并在多任务模仿学习设定下验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有语言引导策略学习方法通常使用整体任务描述来引导整条演示轨迹；对于涉及多个执行阶段的操作任务，同一语言描述被分配给不同子任务，难以区分不同阶段所需行为。
AI.method: 提出基于指令分解的多粒度语言引导方法：将整体任务描述分解为更细粒度、具体化的子任务级语言指令，以增强学习效率并提升性能。
AI.result: 在多任务模仿学习设定下对所提方法进行了评估，验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 多粒度、子任务级的语言指令分解能有效改善多阶段操作任务的策略学习，为语言引导的机器人策略学习提供了一种更精细的条件构造方式。

title: TaoFlowForge: Progressive Native Mesh Generation via Cascaded Flow Matching
summary: 3D content generation technology has significantly advanced the work of designers, as well as the 3D printing and gaming industries. However, it remains difficult to produce lightweight, editable, and topologically clean artistic content that is directly production-ready. To achieve this, we present TaoFlowForge, an artistic mesh foundation model that generates production-ready meshes. Specifically, TaoFlowForge decomposes the mesh generation process into vertices generation and their connectivity prediction, i.e., edges. We formulate vertices generation as a two-stage coarse-to-fine process and incorporate several effective loss functions to further enhance its performance. In the connectivity prediction stage, we propose a simple yet effective method for estimating the connectivity affinity between vertices and additionally predict per-vertex normals, which determines the correct orientation of faces. Besides, we construct a large-scale dataset combining hand-crafted 3D assets with public high-quality topology datasets. Based on this, a carefully designed data curation pipeline is employed to filter the raw dataset, retaining only high-quality topology data for model training. Our model is trained on the combined dataset and tested on both out-of-distribution hand-crafted set of 3D assets and public datasets. Under image-conditioned generation, TaoFlowForge outperforms autoregressive methods and achieves state-of-the-art results among open-source mesh topology generators. We will release all the code and weights together with a portion of our test dataset.

AI.tldr: 提出TaoFlowForge，一种艺术网格基础模型，将网格生成解耦为顶点生成与连接性预测，实现可直接生产的干净拓扑网格生成，在图像条件下达到开源网格拓扑生成的最优结果。
AI.motivation: 现有3D内容生成虽推动了设计、3D打印与游戏行业，但仍难以生成轻量、可编辑、拓扑干净且直接可用的艺术内容，即缺乏"生产就绪"的网格。
AI.method: 将网格生成分解为顶点生成与边（连接性）预测两个阶段：顶点生成采用由粗到细的两阶段流程，并引入多种有效损失函数增强性能；连接性预测中提出简单有效的顶点间连接亲和度估计方法，并额外预测逐顶点法向以确定面的正确朝向。同时构建结合手工3D资产与公开高质量拓扑数据集的大规模数据集，并通过精心设计的数据筛选管线保留高质量拓扑数据用于训练。
AI.result: 在组合数据集上训练，并在分布外手工3D资产集与公开数据集上测试；在图像条件生成下，TaoFlowForge超越自回归方法，在开源网格拓扑生成器中取得state-of-the-art结果。
AI.conclusion: TaoFlowForge能生成生产就绪的网格拓扑，性能领先现有开源方法，并将开源全部代码、权重及部分测试数据集。

title: MSTypography: Multi-character Semantic Typography via Balancing Word Legibility and Object Recognizability
summary: Semantic typography is a design technique where the visual representation of a word conveys its semantic meaning, while maintaining its legibility. Existing digital typography methods mainly focus on single-character scenarios. They suffer from a lack of legibility constraints and insufficient local deformation when extended to multi-character words, as the intricate structures among multiple characters are hardly preserved during the typography process. In this paper, we propose a global-to-local typography framework for multi-character scenarios. It performs mask-driven silhouette approximation at the global level, while semantic-guided refinement at the local level, with a culling step in between to improve efficiency. To preserve word legibility, we designed structural losses (including explicit collision constraints and implicit Jacobian singular value constraints) and an OCR constraint for character-level readability. To enhance the object recognizability, we leverage semantic guidance with diffusion priors, which drives the character glyph toward the target concept while preserving its structural integrity. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first multi-character semantic typography method that effectively balances word legibility and object recognizability. Evaluations on five representative languages (English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic) demonstrate superiority over SOTA methods. Codes will be open-sourced.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出首个多字符语义排版框架，通过全局到局部的形变优化，兼顾单词可读性与物体可识别性，在五种语言上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有数字排版方法主要面向单字符场景，扩展到多字符单词时存在可读性约束不足、局部形变不充分的问题，难以在多字符复杂结构下既保持辨识又体现语义。
AI.method: 提出全局到局部的多字符语义排版框架：全局层面采用掩码驱动的轮廓近似，局部层面进行语义引导的细化，中间加入剔除步骤提升效率。为保持可读性，设计结构损失（显式碰撞约束与隐式雅可比奇异值约束）及面向字符级可读性的OCR约束；为提升物体可识别性，引入扩散先验的语义引导，驱动字形朝向目标概念同时保持结构完整性。
AI.result: 在英语、中文、日语、韩语、阿拉伯语五种代表性语言上的评估显示，该方法优于当前最先进方法，并有效平衡了单词可读性与物体可识别性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次实现多字符语义排版，验证了全局-局部框架与多重约束的有效性，代码将开源。

title: Improved Distributional Diffusion Models
summary: Distributional Diffusion Models (DDMs) replace the standard mean-prediction denoiser with a \emph{distributional} denoiser trained via a scoring rule objective, learning a stochastic approximation to $p(x_1 \mid x_t)$ rather than its conditional mean. However, scaling DDMs to modern image-generation settings faces two obstacles: (i) multi-particle training incurs overhead that scales with the number of particles, (ii) DDMs use globally fixed scoring rule hyperparameters, forcing a single trade-off across sampling budgets. We mitigate these limitations by deferring particle expansion to late transformer layers, and the hyperparameter trade-off by introducing time-dependent scoring rule schedules informed by the dynamical regimes of~\citet{Biroli2024}. Combined with a DiT-based latent setup, these changes make DDM training practical on class-conditional ImageNet-$256^2$, achieving 4.48 FID at 4 steps and 2.38 at 50 steps with DiT-XL/2, from a single model trained from scratch in one stage, without a teacher, self-distillation or JVPs. The result is a stochastic few-step generator whose FID does not degrade as the sampling budget grows from 4 to 50 NFE, and the same recipe transfers to text-to-image generation. Code and pre-trained models available at https://github.com/CompVis/iDDM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 iDDM：通过将粒子扩展推迟到 Transformer 后层，并引入时间依赖的评分规则调度，使分布扩散模型在 ImageNet-256² 上高效训练，4 步 FID 4.48、50 步 FID 2.38，且随采样步数增加 FID 不退化。
AI.motivation: 分布扩散模型（DDM）用分布型去噪器替代均值预测去噪器，能学到 p(x1|xt) 的随机逼近，但在现代图像生成场景下存在两大瓶颈：(1) 多粒子训练的开销随粒子数增长；(2) 评分规则超参数全局固定，导致单一权衡无法适配不同采样预算。
AI.method: 1) 将粒子扩展延迟到 Transformer 的靠后层，以降低多粒子训练开销；2) 依据 Biroli2024 的动力学分区，引入时间依赖的评分规则（scoring rule）调度，缓解固定超参带来的权衡限制；3) 结合 DiT 潜空间（latent）框架构建 DDM 训练方案。
AI.result: 在类别条件 ImageNet-256² 上，DiT-XL/2 单模型、单阶段从零训练、无教师、无自蒸馏、无 JVP，取得 4 步 4.48 FID、50 步 2.38 FID；FID 在 4→50 NFE 的采样预算增长下不退化，且该方案可迁移到文本到图像生成。
AI.conclusion: 通过推迟粒子扩展与时间依赖评分规则调度，DDM 训练在高分辨率潜空间图像生成中变得可行，得到一个采样步数增加时 FID 不劣化的随机少步生成器，并具备向文本到图像任务的迁移能力；代码与预训练模型已开源。

title: End-to-End Self-Supervised RGB-T Tracking without Modality Misleading
summary: RGB-T object tracking leverages the complementary characteristics of visible and thermal infrared modalities to improve robustness under adverse conditions. Existing supervised methods typically rely on costly modality-aligned bounding box annotations, while most self-supervised approaches follow a two-stage pseudo-labeling paradigm, making tracker training sensitive to pseudo-label quality and preventing joint end-to-end optimization. In this paper, we propose ESMTrack, a fully end-to-end self-supervised RGB-T tracking framework without offline pseudo-label generation or dense frame-level bounding box annotations. Given only the standard initial-frame annotation used in visual tracking, ESMTrack learns discriminative and temporally consistent representations through two complementary objectives: a grounding triplet loss on annotated initial frames and a cross-frame temporal triplet loss on unlabeled search frames, with reliable samples selected by forward-backward consistency. To address modality dominance bias, ESMTrack employs a three-branch architecture consisting of a fusion branch and two unimodal branches for RGB and thermal inputs. We quantify modality contributions using the Average Peak-to-Correlation Energy by measuring response discrepancies between the fusion and unimodal branches. The resulting reliability estimates guide a training-time modality decoupling mechanism that suppresses dominant-modality shortcuts and adaptively weights cross-modal contrastive learning for task-level alignment. Extensive experiments on five RGB-T tracking benchmarks show that ESMTrack achieves competitive state-of-the-art performance, strong cross-dataset generalization, and real-time inference speed. The source code is available at https://github.com/LiShenglana/ESMTrack.

AI.tldr: 提出 ESMTrack，一个无需离线伪标签与密集框标注的全端到端自监督 RGB-T 跟踪框架，在五个基准上取得具竞争力的 SOTA 性能、强跨数据集泛化能力与实时推理速度。
AI.motivation: 现有监督式 RGB-T 跟踪依赖昂贵且需模态对齐的边界框标注；多数自监督方法采用两阶段伪标签范式，训练对伪标签质量敏感，且无法联合端到端优化。因此需要一种摆脱离线伪标签生成与帧级密集标注的自监督跟踪方案。
AI.method: 仅使用视觉跟踪中的标准首帧标注，通过两个互补目标学习判别性与时序一致的表示：首帧上的 grounding triplet loss 与无标注搜索帧上的跨帧时序 triplet loss，并用前向-后向一致性筛选可靠样本。针对模态主导偏差，采用三支路架构（融合支路 + RGB/热红外两个单模态支路），以 Average Peak-to-Correlation Energy 通过比较融合支路与单模态支路的响应差异量化模态贡献；由此得到的可靠性估计驱动训练期模态解耦机制，抑制主导模态捷径，并自适应加权跨模态对比学习以实现任务级对齐。
AI.result: 在五个 RGB-T 跟踪基准上的大量实验表明，ESMTrack 达到具有竞争力的 SOTA 性能，具备较强的跨数据集泛化能力与实时推理速度。
AI.conclusion: ESMTrack 验证了无需离线伪标签与密集框标注的全端到端自监督 RGB-T 跟踪的可行性，并通过模态解耦与可靠性引导的跨模态对比学习有效缓解模态主导问题，兼顾精度、泛化与效率。

title: Sparse cubical complexes for efficient topology-preservation in image data
summary: Persistent homology (PH) is a frequently used tool for extracting and preserving topological information from image data, particularly in image segmentation, where preservation of topological structures is important. However, despite its general applicability across dimensionality, domains, and target structures, the runtime cost of PH-based methods often makes their practical use infeasible. In this work, we argue that this runtime cost is largely driven by processing information that is unimportant for downstream application (e.g. as optimization objective). We propose sparse cubical filtrations as an alternative foundation for PH computation, reducing subsequent computational costs by factors of up to 100 on real datasets. We show close agreement with the optimization signal of the dense counterpart and empirically evaluate our solution's effectiveness as an optimization objective in realistic training regimes where other PH-based objectives can practically not operate (i.e., 3D data with large patch sizes). We show how our solution improves topological accuracy by up to 80\% across six diverse datasets while maintaining pixel- and region-based accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出稀疏立方过滤（sparse cubical filtrations），以替代传统持久同调（PH）计算基础，大幅降低计算开销（最高达100倍），并在3D大图像块等训练场景中有效提升拓扑精度（最高80%），同时保持像素与区域准确率。
AI.motivation: 持久同调（PH）能提取并保持图像数据中的拓扑信息，特别适用于图像分割中拓扑结构保真的需求。但PH方法虽在维度、领域和目标结构上具广泛适用性，其运行时间成本高，常使实际应用不可行。作者认为，这一成本主要源于处理了对下游任务（如优化目标）无关紧要的信息。
AI.method: 提出稀疏立方过滤（sparse cubical filtrations）作为PH计算的替代基础，从而在后续计算中降低计算成本。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上计算成本降低最高达100倍；与稠密对应方法的优化信号高度一致；在3D数据、大图像块等传统PH目标难以运行的现实训练场景中验证其作为优化目标的有效性；在六个多样化数据集上，拓扑精度最高提升80%，同时保持像素级与区域级准确率。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏立方过滤可作为高效PH计算基础，在显著降低运行成本的同时保持优化信号一致性，并在实际难以运行其他PH目标的大规模/3D训练场景中提升拓扑精度且不牺牲像素与区域准确率。

title: InsightMap: Structured Spatial Modeling for Embodied Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Language-guided navigation requires connecting partial observations to a persistent spatial reference and learning how actions change that representation. We introduce InsightMap, a framework that uses top-down maps as both explicit spatial memory and action-conditioned prediction targets. Historical views are linked to labeled map locations, and a shared multimodal backbone jointly learns navigation action prediction and post-action map generation. Map prediction provides auxiliary training supervision, while navigation inference decodes actions from the observed spatial context. An aligned RGB-D data pipeline supports a common interface for navigation, visual question answering, situated reasoning, and 3D grounding. On the validation-unseen splits of R2R-CE and RxR-CE, InsightMap achieves success rates (SR) of 56.9% and 54.9%, respectively. Adding map-prediction supervision improves R2R-CE SR by 4.3 and success weighted by path length (SPL) by 3.2 percentage points. On static spatial tasks, InsightMap achieves 103.7 CIDEr on ScanQA, 60.1% exact-match accuracy on SQA3D, and 53.1% grounding accuracy at 0.5 IoU on ScanRefer with detected object proposals. On Unitree Go2, it outperforms NaVid and NaVILA in hallway, lab, and office environments.

AI.tldr: 提出InsightMap框架，以俯视地图作为显式空间记忆和动作条件预测目标，并通过共享多模态骨干联合学习导航动作预测与动作后地图生成，在导航与静态空间任务上均取得领先结果。
AI.motivation: 语言引导导航需要将部分观测关联到持久空间参照，并学习动作如何改变该表示；现有方法缺乏显式空间记忆与动作条件空间预测的联合建模。
AI.method: 将历史视角与带标注的地图位置关联；使用共享多模态骨干联合学习导航动作预测和动作后地图生成；地图预测作为辅助训练监督，导航推理则从观测到的空间上下文解码动作；同时构建对齐的RGB-D数据管线，为导航、视觉问答、情境推理与3D定位提供统一接口。
AI.result: R2R-CE与RxR-CE验证未见集SR分别为56.9%和54.9%；加入地图预测监督使R2R-CE的SR提升4.3个百分点、SPL提升3.2个百分点；静态空间任务上ScanQA CIDEr 103.7、SQA3D精确匹配60.1%、ScanRefer在0.5 IoU下定位精度53.1%（使用检测物体提议）；在Unitree Go2的走廊、实验室和办公室环境中优于NaVid与NaVILA。
AI.conclusion: 以俯视地图作为显式空间记忆与动作条件预测目标，可有效增强语言引导导航与空间理解的统一建模能力，并具备跨任务与真实机器人平台的泛化优势。

title: HaPRL: Human-Anchored Process Reinforcement Learning for Visual Search Agent
summary: Multi-turn visual search agents answer questions about high-resolution images by iteratively deciding where to look. Reinforcement learning for these agents rewards only the final answer, leaving the search process unsupervised. Consequently, faulty routes in which the reasoning process is erroneous yet the final result is correct arise frequently, which in turn leads to ineffective training, i.e., scaling along the wrong paths. In this paper, we introduce HaPRL, the first framework to reinforce the search process with human search behavior. We first build an annotation platform and collect 1K+ human-annotated data with fine-grained behavioral signals. During training, a carefully designed judge scores each rollout with task-adaptive weights, anchored on the distilled trace of how a human annotator actually searched the same image. Extensive experiments show that HaPRL consistently outperforms outcome-based RL, and early-stage process supervision yields 6.7x more improvement in subsequent outcome-based scaling. Our results also demonstrate the importance of aligning model behavior with human process annotation signals, which offer new insight into the training of foundation models.

AI.tldr: 提出 HaPRL 框架，用人类搜索行为监督多轮视觉搜索智能体的搜索过程，缓解仅靠结果奖励导致的"错误路径-正确结果"问题，并显著提升后续结果对齐训练的效率。
AI.motivation: 多轮视觉搜索智能体通过迭代决定"看哪里"来回答高分辨率图像问题，但现有强化学习仅对最终答案给奖励，搜索过程缺乏监督。这导致推理过程错误却答案正确的"错误路径"频繁出现，使训练在错误路径上扩展，效率低下。因此需要引入过程级监督信号来约束搜索轨迹。
AI.method: 构建标注平台，采集 1K+ 条带细粒度行为信号的人类标注数据；训练时设计专门的评判器（judge），以对同一图像的人类标注者真实搜索轨迹的蒸馏结果为锚点，按任务自适应权重为每条 rollout 打分，从而对搜索过程进行强化。
AI.result: 实验表明 HaPRL 持续优于基于结果的 RL；早期过程监督可使后续基于结果的扩展提升达 6.7 倍。结果还显示将模型行为与人类过程标注信号对齐的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 用人类搜索行为强化搜索过程是一种有效的过程监督范式，能改善多轮视觉搜索智能体的训练效果，并为基础模型训练中过程级信号对齐提供新思路。

title: Exploring In-Context Learning for Handwritten Text Recognition
summary:
Handwritten Text Recognition (HTR) systems have become an indispensable tool for the digitization of historical documents. Not only do they cut down time and cost, but they also allow democratizing access and processing of their contents by generating their transcripts. However, literature in HTR currently focuses mostly on specialized models that require large amounts of annotated samples to achieve satisfactory performance.
  We explore the use of In-Context Learning with pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to create a transcription pipeline without updating the model's parameters. We then evaluate this pipeline across multiple collections and models, and demonstrate that general-purpose VLMs can be effectively taught how to transcribe handwritten text from images. To assess how our observations may translate to practical applications, we evaluate the performance in a Cross-Domain (CD) scenario, where context examples are drawn from a different collection than the query image.
  Results in both the controlled In-Domain (ID) scenario and the realistic CD scenario follow the same patterns. First, as context size grows, the error range is expected to narrow towards the average performance. Thus, larger context sizes sacrifice the performance of the oracle-best sampling for lower expected error rates.
  The results obtained show that, without any parameter updates, this methodology has strong potential to compete with traditional HTR in the presence of domain shift. Moreover, we show and argue that some context samplings work better than others and suggest more effort should be put into finding an ideal sampling method in future work.

AI.tldr: 利用预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）的上下文学习（ICL）构建无需参数更新的手写文本识别（HTR）转录流程，并在多集合、多模型及跨域场景下验证其可行性。
AI.motivation: 现有HTR研究多依赖专用模型，需大量标注样本才能达到满意性能，成本高且难以扩展；本文探索无需更新参数的通用VLM方案以降低标注依赖。
AI.method: 采用预训练VLM进行上下文学习（ICL），构建不更新模型参数的转录流程；在多个数据集与多个模型上评估，并设置受控的同域（ID）场景与更贴近实际的跨域（CD）场景（上下文示例取自与查询图像不同的集合）进行对比分析。
AI.result: ID与CD场景呈现一致规律：随着上下文规模增大，误差范围向平均性能收窄，即更大上下文牺牲了oracle最优采样的性能以换取更低的期望误差；无参数更新下该方法在存在域偏移时具备与主流HTR竞争的能力；不同上下文采样方式效果差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 通用VLM通过ICL可被有效"教会"转录手写文本，在域偏移下具有竞争力；上下文采样策略对性能影响显著，未来应着力寻找理想的采样方法。

title: Adaptive Reward Routing: Dynamic Multi-Reward Optimization for Joint Audio-Video Diffusion via Forward-Process RL
summary: Multi-reward guided reinforcement learning (i.e., RL) offers a promising way to improve joint audio-video diffusion models along several complementary objectives, including modality-specific quality, cross-modal semantic alignment, and temporal synchronization. Its effectiveness, however, depends on two quantities that change during training: where reward-driven updates should act, and how competing rewards should be combined. Existing methods tend to rely on fixed routing and reward weights, failing to track evolving model functions. To address these limitations, we propose Adaptive Reward Routing to jointly adapt update locations and reward coordination during forward-process RL (i.e., DiffusionNFT) of joint audio-video diffusion models. Our method consists of two components. (i) Cross-Modal Influence-Guided Routing (Localizing Updates): We use bidirectional cross-attention responses as an efficient proxy for evolving cross-modal influence, dynamically reweighting token-aware losses and scaling gradients across cross-modal layers without additional model interventions. (ii) Preference-Preserving Modality-Aware Reweighting (Coordinating Rewards): We preserve predefined weights as preference priors and use branch-specific reward-gradient interactions as residual corrections after warm-up. This resolves evolving conflicts without letting dominant rewards suppress weak but essential objectives. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in modality quality, semantic consistency, and audio-video synchronization over strong RL baselines. Ablations and mechanism analyses further validate the complementary benefits of adaptive update routing and reward coordination.

AI.tldr: 提出自适应奖励路由（Adaptive Reward Routing），在前向过程强化学习（DiffusionNFT）中联合自适应更新位置与奖励协调，用于联合音视频扩散模型的多奖励优化。
AI.motivation: 多奖励引导的强化学习可提升联合音视频扩散模型的模态质量、跨模态语义对齐与时间同步，但效果依赖两个随训练变化的量：奖励驱动更新应作用于何处，以及竞争性奖励应如何组合。现有方法多采用固定的路由与奖励权重，无法跟踪模型功能的演变。
AI.method: 方法含两个组件：(i) 跨模态影响引导路由（更新定位）：以双向跨注意力响应作为演变中跨模态影响的高效代理，动态重加权 token 感知损失并跨跨模态层缩放梯度，无需额外模型干预；(ii) 保偏好模态感知重加权（奖励协调）：将预定义权重作为偏好先验，预热后以分支特定奖励-梯度交互作为残差修正，从而在不让主导奖励压制弱但必要目标的前提下化解演变中的冲突。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，在模态质量、语义一致性与音视频同步方面相较强 RL 基线取得一致性提升；消融与机制分析进一步验证了自适应更新路由与奖励协调的互补收益。
AI.conclusion: 自适应奖励路由通过联合适配更新位置与奖励协调，有效解决了固定路由与固定权重的局限，为联合音视频扩散模型的多奖励 RL 微调提供了可行且互补的改进方向。

title: ResComEmb: Effective and Efficient Multimodal Embedding via Residual Homogeneity Compression
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for universal multimodal representation learning. However, existing methods either compress each input into a single vector, limiting fine-grained expressiveness, or retain long sequences of visual-token vectors, incurring substantial storage and interaction costs. To resolve this trade-off, we propose ResComEmb, a trainable framework for effective and efficient universal multi-vector multimodal embedding. ResComEmb first encodes each input at native dynamic resolution into ordered global, intermediate, and fine-grained views. After MLLM contextualization and embedding projection, a trainable Residual Homogeneity Compression (RHC) module reduces within-granularity redundancy and cross-granularity repetition under explicit visual token budgets. Then, ResComEmb introduces a length-adaptive Bidirectional Late-Interaction Matching mechanism for robust query-document scoring, which averages the strongest token-level matches in each direction and combines the two scores using a weight based on how many valid tokens each side has. Extensive experiments on MMEB, ViDoRe V1, and ViDoRe V2 show that ResComEmb produces higher-quality universal multimodal embeddings than VLM2Vec-V2, and outperforms ColQwen2.5 in visual document retrieval using only 37.5% of its full visual token budget, demonstrating a favorable effectiveness-efficiency trade-off.

AI.tldr: 提出可训练的多向量多模态嵌入框架ResComEmb，通过残差同质性压缩和长度自适应双向后交互匹配，在显式视觉token预算下兼顾细粒度表达与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态嵌入方法存在两难：将输入压缩为单向量会损失细粒度表达能力，而保留长序列视觉token向量则带来高昂的存储与交互成本。需要一种兼顾有效性与效率的通用多模态嵌入方案。
AI.method: 1) 以原生动态分辨率将输入编码为有序的全局、中间与细粒度三层视图；2) 经MLLM上下文化并做嵌入投影后，使用可训练的残差同质性压缩（RHC）模块，在显式视觉token预算下降低粒度内冗余与跨粒度重复；3) 设计长度自适应的双向后交互匹配机制进行查询-文档打分，对每个方向取最强token级匹配的均值，并依据双方有效token数量加权融合两个分数。
AI.result: 在MMEB、ViDoRe V1与ViDoRe V2上的大量实验表明：ResComEmb生成的通用多模态嵌入质量优于VLM2Vec-V2；在视觉文档检索中仅使用ColQwen2.5全部视觉token预算的37.5%即超越后者，展现出良好的有效性-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: ResComEmb通过多粒度视图、残差同质性压缩与长度自适应双向后交互匹配，缓解了单向量压缩与长token序列之间的权衡，实现了更高质量且更高效的通用多模态嵌入，验证了其在有效性与效率上的优势。

title: AESOP: Asymmetric Human-Camera Generation with Translation-Intensity Control
summary: Human motion defines an action, while a camera trajectory determines how it is presented. Camera generation for a given human motion and joint human-camera generation are usually treated as separate tasks, although both share an asymmetric dependency: human motion can be generated independently, whereas the camera responds to the realized action. We introduce AESOP, a unified framework with an independent human pathway and a shared human-conditioned camera generator. Its asymmetric architecture serves both tasks while preserving the human output during camera generation. Although human context anchors the shot to the action and camera text describes its movement, translation intensity remains underspecified. We therefore construct trajectory pairs that differ in camera translation magnitude while sharing human motion and camera text, then use these pairs to learn an explicit intensity condition. Experiments on the PulpMotion dataset demonstrate strong camera distributional and framing quality in both tasks and effective control over camera translation intensity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AESOP——一个统一框架，包含独立的人体运动生成通路与共享的人体条件相机生成器，以非对称结构同时支持"给定人体运动的相机生成"与"人体-相机联合生成"两项任务，并通过构造平移幅度不同的轨迹对显式学习相机平移强度控制。
AI.motivation: 相机生成与人体-相机联合生成通常被当作两个独立任务处理，但二者共享一种非对称依赖关系：人体运动可独立生成，而相机应当响应已实现的动作。此外，仅有"人体上下文 + 相机文本"时，相机平移强度仍然描述不足（underspecified），缺乏对运动幅度的显式控制。
AI.method: AESOP 采用统一框架：一条独立的人体生成通路，加一个共享的人体条件相机生成器；非对称架构使两项任务共用相机生成器，同时在相机生成时保持人体输出不变。为刻画平移强度，构造轨迹对：共享相同人体运动与相机文本，但相机平移幅度不同，据此学习显式的强度条件（intensity condition）。
AI.result: 在 PulpMotion 数据集上的实验表明，两项任务均取得良好的相机分布质量与取景（framing）质量，并且能有效控制相机平移强度。
AI.conclusion: 人体运动与相机轨迹存在非对称依赖，可用统一的非对称框架同时建模两类生成任务；引入显式强度条件可弥补相机文本的欠指定问题，实现对相机平移幅度的可控生成。

title: Seeing Is Not Addressing: Auditing Linguistic Access to Frozen Visual Geometry
summary: Visual distinctions are often finer than those reflected in linguistic conceptualization. Vision-language models exhibit a similar asymmetry: a distinction can remain discriminable in frozen image geometry while being weakly addressable through the native text interface. We study this gap by separating visual discriminability from linguistic addressability in text-to-image retrieval. Using FactorAtlas, a fully crossed testbed of 23,040 images spanning shape, hue, pattern, and nuisance variation, we compare both readouts on held-out images of the same distinctions. We then derive image-side contrasts that separate each value from its alternatives for matched visual grounding, and test whether this reduces the native-text access gap across factors and models. Direction-specific and visual-absence controls tie these gains to the relevant visual contrast; the gains persist after global alignment and extend to compositional retrieval and natural images. Together, these results show that visual discriminability and linguistic addressability need not coincide, and that matched visual grounding can probe and reduce the resulting access gap.

AI.tldr: 论文研究文本到图像检索中"视觉可区分性"与"语言可寻址性"之间的差距，并提出用匹配的视觉对比（image-side contrasts）来探测并缩小该差距。
AI.motivation: 视觉上的细粒度区分往往比语言概念化更精细。视觉-语言模型存在类似不对称：某一区分在冻结的图像几何中仍可被区分，却难以通过原生文本接口被访问（linguistic addressability 弱）。作者希望系统性地分离并研究这一差距。
AI.method: 构建 FactorAtlas 测试床：23,040 张图像，完全交叉涵盖形状、色调、图案及干扰变量。在留出图像上对比视觉可区分性与语言可寻址性两种读出方式；随后推导图像侧对比（image-side contrasts），将每个取值与其替代值分离以实现匹配的视觉接地，并测试其能否缩小原生文本访问差距；同时设置方向特异性与视觉缺失对照。
AI.result: 匹配视觉接地在多个因素和模型上减小了原生文本访问差距；方向特异性与视觉缺失对照将该增益关联到相关视觉对比；增益在全局对齐后依然存在，并可推广到组合式检索与自然图像。
AI.conclusion: 视觉可区分性与语言可寻址性不必一致；匹配的视觉接地可用于探测并缩小由此产生的访问差距。

title: Codebook-Guided Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation for Structurally Heterogeneous Features
summary: Cross-modal knowledge distillation transfers knowledge from a teacher modality to a student modality. Existing feature-level alignment methods typically assume that teacher and student features reside in structurally alignable representation spaces. However, this assumption does not hold when cross-modal features are structurally heterogeneous and lack clear unit-level correspondence, such as 2D spatial visual grids and 1D temporal audio sequences, thereby limiting the applicability of feature-level alignment. To address this challenge, we propose a cross-modal distillation framework that enables effective knowledge transfer across structurally heterogeneous feature spaces via a vector-quantized codebook. Specifically, teacher features are abstracted into a set of vector-form codes regardless of their original feature structure, and the selected codes serve as concept-level anchors for student learning. Code selection is guided by both task relevance and student compatibility, allowing the student to receive transferable teacher knowledge without requiring direct unit-level feature alignment. Experimental results across diverse cross-modal distillation scenarios demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework on classification and semantic segmentation tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出基于向量量化码本的跨模态蒸馏框架，将异构教师特征抽象为概念级锚点以绕开特征级对齐假设。
AI.motivation: 现有特征级对齐方法假设教师与学生特征处于可结构对齐的表示空间，但当跨模态特征结构异构且缺乏单元级对应关系（如2D空间视觉网格与1D时序音频序列）时该假设不成立，限制了特征级对齐的适用性。
AI.method: 通过向量量化码本将教师特征抽象为向量形式的码，不论其原始特征结构如何；所选码作为学生学习的概念级锚点。码选择由任务相关性与学生兼容性共同引导，使学生无需单元级特征对齐即可获得可迁移的教师知识。
AI.result: 在多种跨模态蒸馏场景下的实验表明，该框架在分类与语义分割任务上均有效。
AI.conclusion: 以概念级码本锚点替代特征级对齐，可突破结构异构跨模态知识迁移的对齐限制。

title: V-JEPA Policy: Building Effective World-Action Models on Predictive Visual Latents
summary: World-action models (WAMs) couple future visual-state prediction with action generation. By adapting video generators or image-editing models pretrained at scale, a prominent line of recent WAMs inherits both predictive knowledge and the models in which it was learned. We ask whether a predictive visual latent space induced by large-scale predictive pretraining can instead provide a sufficient foundation for effective WAM learning without inheriting a complete pretrained visual generative model. To answer this question, we introduce V-JEPA Policy, a simple framework that builds a WAM on the latent space of a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder. An instruction-conditioned future-latent predictor and a flow-matching action expert are jointly learned from scratch in a single downstream stage, with the predictor's future-informed context key--value states conditioning action generation. With 0.9B total parameters, of which 0.6B are trainable, V-JEPA Policy achieves competitive performance with representative WAM and vision-language-action baselines across LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboCasa-GR1. Comparing visual foundations under the same downstream framework and training budget identifies V-JEPA latents as more effective than the discriminative, reconstructive, and video-understanding-oriented alternatives, particularly under distribution shifts. Beyond task-specific learning, pretraining the predictor on DROID video--instruction pairs without action labels and adapting it into a WAM yields substantial gains in downstream control and out-of-distribution generalization. Together, these findings establish predictive visual latents as a foundation for effective WAM learning from task-specific demonstrations and for transferring future-modeling knowledge acquired from broader in-the-wild videos. Our code is available at https://github.com/breez3young/VJEPA-Policy.

AI.tldr: 提出 V-JEPA Policy，在冻结的 V-JEPA 2.1 潜空间上从零联合训练未来潜变量预测器与流匹配动作专家，验证预测性视觉潜空间可作为构建世界-动作模型的有效基础。
AI.motivation: 现有世界-动作模型（WAM）多通过适配大规模预训练的视频生成器或图像编辑模型来继承预测能力，但这种方法必须继承完整的预训练视觉生成模型，成本高且耦合紧。核心问题是：仅由大规模预测性预训练得到的预测性视觉潜空间，能否在不继承完整生成模型的情况下，为 WAM 学习提供充分基础。
AI.method: 构建 V-JEPA Policy 框架，以冻结的 V-JEPA 2.1 编码器潜空间为基础。在下游单阶段中从零联合学习两个模块：指令条件化的未来潜变量预测器（instruction-conditioned future-latent predictor）与流匹配动作专家（flow-matching action expert）；将预测器由未来信息得到的上下文 key-value 状态用于条件化动作生成。总参数 0.9B，其中可训练参数 0.6B。另在 DROID 视频-指令对（无动作标签）上预训练预测器，再适配为 WAM。对比实验在相同下游框架与训练预算下比较不同视觉基础。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 和 RoboCasa-GR1 上，V-JEPA Policy 与代表性 WAM 及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）基线达到有竞争力的性能。相同下游框架与预算下，V-JEPA 潜变量优于判别式、重建式及面向视频理解的替代视觉基础，在分布偏移下优势尤为明显。将预测器在 DROID 视频-指令对上预训练后适配为 WAM，在下游控制与分布外泛化上均取得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 预测性视觉潜空间可作为有效 WAM 学习的基础：既支持从任务特定示范中学习控制，也支持迁移从广泛野外视频中获得的未来建模知识，且无需继承完整的预训练视觉生成模型。

title: Collision-Aware and Observation-Aligned Object-Centric Scene Reconstruction from Point Cloud
summary: Object-centric scene reconstruction requires completing partial object observations while preserving metric alignment and avoiding collisions with the surrounding. Existing generation-based methods are often image-conditioned and suffer from scale ambiguity and insufficient geometric constraints. We propose COOL, a framework for COllision-aware and Observation-aLigned reconstruction. Based on an object generation model, COOL conditions the generation on instance and background point clouds. Instance geometry anchors generation in scene coordinates, while background geometry provides local context for scene-consistent completion. We further introduce an explicit collision loss and use joint optimization and resampling to reduce collisions during inference. Experiments on 3D-Front and Scan2CAD demonstrate strong scene-level fidelity, observation alignment, and collision reduction. Moreover, additional studies validate its robustness to mask errors and its applicability to real-world scene replicas.

AI.tldr: 提出COOL框架，用实例与背景点云条件化生成模型，并引入显式碰撞损失与联合优化/重采样，实现碰撞感知且与观测对齐的物体级场景重建。
AI.motivation: 现有基于生成的方法多为图像条件，存在尺度模糊与几何约束不足的问题，难以在补全部分观测物体的同时保持度量对齐并避免与周围环境碰撞。
AI.method: COOL以物体生成模型为基础，将生成条件设为实例点云与背景点云：实例几何将生成锚定在场景坐标系中，背景几何提供局部上下文以实现场景一致的补全。此外引入显式碰撞损失，并在推理阶段采用联合优化与重采样以降低碰撞。
AI.result: 在3D-Front与Scan2CAD数据集上，方法在场景级保真度、观测对齐与碰撞减少方面表现优异；额外研究验证了对掩码误差的鲁棒性以及在真实场景复制中的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 通过点云条件化生成并显式建模碰撞约束，可在保持度量对齐的前提下完成物体级场景重建，兼具场景一致性与实用性。

title: Beyond Attention Imbalance: Mitigating Hallucinations via Spectral Surgery
summary: While Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) achieve remarkable success, hallucinations remain a significant barrier to their reliable deployment. Recent studies primarily attribute these issues to cross-modal attention imbalances; most solutions therefore focus on reweighting visual tokens or suppressing language priors. However, such approaches often overlook the spectral characteristics of the visual information flow and frequently rely on Contrastive Decoding (CD), which doubles inference time. Instead of following conventional approaches, we identify two distinct hallucination patterns-Perceptual-Semantic Dissociation and Localized Fixation-and propose FLASH (Frequency-Localized Attention SHaping), a training-free and CD-free framework. FLASH utilizes a Spectral Vortex Score to detect vision heads within multi-head attention layers and applies adaptive spectral modulation to rectify the visual information flow during decoding. Empirical results demonstrate that FLASH achieves a superior balance between performance and efficiency compared to SOTA methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的幻觉问题，指出既有方法忽视视觉信息流的频谱特性且依赖对比解码（CD）导致推理耗时翻倍，提出无需训练、无需CD的FLASH框架，通过频谱涡旋分数识别视觉头并施加自适应频谱调制，在性能与效率间取得优于SOTA的平衡。
AI.motivation: LVLMs幻觉阻碍其可靠部署；现有研究多归因于跨模态注意力失衡，解决方案集中于重加权视觉token或抑制语言先验，但忽视了视觉信息流的频谱特征，且常依赖对比解码（CD），使推理时间翻倍。
AI.method: 先归纳出两种不同的幻觉模式——感知-语义解离（Perceptual-Semantic Dissociation）与局部固着（Localized Fixation）；据此提出FLASH（Frequency-Localized Attention SHaping）框架，利用频谱涡旋分数（Spectral Vortex Score）在多头注意力层中检测视觉头，并在解码过程中施加自适应频谱调制以矫正视觉信息流。该方法无需训练、无需对比解码。
AI.result: 实证结果表明，FLASH在性能与效率的平衡上优于当前最先进（SOTA）方法。
AI.conclusion: 从频谱视角切入、避免对比解码，可在不增加推理成本的前提下有效缓解LVLMs幻觉，为高效幻觉缓解提供了新思路。

title: UniAfford: Token-Routed Multitask Learning for Generalizable 2D-3D Affordance Perception
summary: Affordance perception aims to localize actionable regions supporting embodied interaction, yet 2D and 3D affordance grounding have evolved as separate problems, with different task definitions, supervision formats, datasets, and evaluation protocols. This fragmentation limits the learning of transferable object-affordance semantics across visual and geometric spaces. We propose Token Router for Tasks, a multitask training paradigm for MLLM-based systems that routes contextual hidden states to task-specific branches without requiring the language head to generate predefined markers. Routed states are supervised directly by branch-specific objectives, enabling dense prediction losses to shape shared MLLM representations. We instantiate this paradigm as UniAfford, a unified framework for generalizable 2D-3D affordance perception, together with UniAfford-Data, a dataset integrating pixel-level 2D annotations, point-level 3D annotations, and language instructions under a shared object-affordance taxonomy, supporting heterogeneous supervision through semantic-level 2D-3D pairing. UniAfford adopts an MLLM as a shared semantic hub and a modality-aware token router to produce image- and point-cloud-affordance queries. These queries respectively condition a SAM-style pixel decoder and a SONATA-based point decoder, enabling flexible 2D, 3D, and joint affordance inference from image-only, point-cloud-only, or paired multimodal inputs. Experiments demonstrate strong zero-shot generalization across 2D and 3D affordance benchmarks without target-specific fine-tuning, alongside state-of-the-art branch-wise performance under modality-isolated protocols. Ablations validate token routing, joint 2D-3D supervision, and decoder coupling, while language-head diagnostics show that routed latent states carry meaningful object-affordance semantics. Project page: https://4dvlab.github.io/UniAfford

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Token Router for Tasks 多任务训练范式，并实例化为 UniAfford 统一 2D-3D affordance 感知框架，配套 UniAfford-Data 数据集，实现零样本跨模态泛化。
AI.motivation: 2D 与 3D affordance grounding 长期作为独立问题发展，任务定义、监督格式、数据集与评测协议各不相同，这种割裂限制了跨视觉与几何空间的可迁移 object-affordance 语义学习。
AI.method: 提出 Token Router for Tasks：将上下文隐状态路由到任务特定分支，无需语言头生成预定义标记，路由状态由分支特定目标直接监督，使稠密预测损失塑造共享 MLLM 表征。实例化 UniAfford：以 MLLM 为共享语义中枢，用模态感知 token router 生成图像与点云 affordance query，分别驱动 SAM 风格像素解码器与基于 SONATA 的点解码器，支持仅图像、仅点云或配对多模态输入的 2D、3D 与联合推理；并构建 UniAfford-Data，在共享 object-affordance 分类体系下整合像素级 2D 标注、点级 3D 标注与语言指令，通过语义级 2D-3D 配对支持异构监督。
AI.result: 在无需目标域微调的情况下，于 2D 与 3D affordance 基准上展现强零样本泛化能力；在模态隔离协议下取得各分支的最优性能。消融实验验证了 token routing、联合 2D-3D 监督与解码器耦合的有效性；语言头诊断表明路由隐状态携带有效的 object-affordance 语义。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过路由式多任务训练与统一数据体系，将割裂的 2D/3D affordance 感知整合为可泛化的统一框架，实现跨视觉与几何空间的可迁移 affordance 语义学习。

title: SAM Meets VLM: Parameter-Decoupled Full-Parameter Training for Unified Medical Reasoning and Segmentation
summary: Medical multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly expected not only to answer clinical questions, but also to localize the visual evidence behind their predictions. A common strategy connects a vision--language model (VLM) with SAM-style segmentation through a special <SEG> token, yet full-parameter training of this unified architecture is difficult because image-level reasoning and pixel-level segmentation impose different requirements on the shared representation space. To address this issue, we propose a parameter-decoupled training framework for unified medical reasoning and segmentation. The framework treats the <SEG> hidden state as a semantic-to-spatial prompt for the mask decoder and encourages it to become separable from generic language states, reducing ambiguous segmentation prompts and potential disruption to reasoning representations. It first performs medical shallow alignment to adapt visual features to clinical language without disturbing the LLM; then controlled instruction tuning shapes separable <SEG> prompt states, monitored by the Davies--Bouldin Index (DBI), while scaling segmentation gradients entering the language backbone; finally, the SAM branch is specialized with the VLM frozen to improve mask precision without altering reasoning parameters. Experiments on medical referring segmentation, grounding, visual QA, and textual QA benchmarks show that our framework achieves strong language-conditioned segmentation while preserving competitive reasoning ability. Ablations show that two-phase instruction tuning, gradient scaling, and segmentation specialization all contribute to the model.

AI.tldr: 提出一种参数解耦训练框架，使医学多模态大模型在保留推理能力的同时实现语言条件分割。
AI.motivation: 医学MLLM需同时回答临床问题并定位视觉证据，但统一架构中图像级推理与像素级分割对共享表示空间要求不同，全参数训练困难。
AI.method: 将<SEG>隐状态作为掩码解码器的语义到空间提示，并使其与通用语言状态可分。框架分三阶段：医学浅层对齐（不扰动LLM）；受控指令微调（以DBI监控<SEG>提示状态可分离性，同时缩放进入语言骨干的分割梯度）；冻结VLM专化SAM分支以提升掩码精度。
AI.result: 在医学指代分割、定位、视觉问答和文本问答基准上，实现强语言条件分割并保持有竞争力的推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 消融表明两阶段指令微调、梯度缩放和分割专化均有贡献，参数解耦训练可有效缓解统一架构中推理与分割的表示冲突。

title: VISTA-Bench: Benchmarking Multilingual Image Translation with Image-Specific Rubrics
summary: Image translation is a fundamental capability of multimodal models for multilingual applications, requiring visual understanding and meaning preservation across languages. However, existing benchmarks have limited language coverage and often lack explicit image-specific evaluation criteria, making it difficult to comprehensively assess this capability. To systematically evaluate this capability, we introduce VISTA-Bench, covering 22 languages and 10 domains, and develop an image-specific rubric evaluation protocol. The benchmark combines sampling for language and scenario coverage with model-assisted, human-verified annotations that group related text into coherent semantic units and provide multilingual reference translations. The rubrics specify essential content, semantic relations, and acceptable translation variants, yielding separate output-based scores for translation quality and the preservation of visual and knowledge-dependent information. We conduct extensive evaluations of 16 mainstream models, including 12 multimodal models and four text-input models, and provide systematic analyses across languages, domains, and evaluation dimensions.

AI.tldr: 提出VISTA-Bench，覆盖22种语言、10个领域，并设计图像专属评分准则，从翻译质量与视觉/知识信息保留两方面系统评估多模态模型的图像翻译能力。
AI.motivation: 图像翻译是多模态模型面向多语言应用的基础能力，需跨语言完成视觉理解与语义保持。但现有基准语言覆盖有限，且缺乏针对图像特性的明确评价标准，难以全面评估该能力。
AI.method: 构建VISTA-Bench：(1) 覆盖22种语言、10个领域；(2) 采用语言与场景覆盖的采样策略；(3) 模型辅助、人工核验的标注，将相关文本聚合为连贯语义单元并提供多语言参考译文；(4) 设计图像专属评分准则，明确必备内容、语义关系与可接受译文变体，分别给出基于输出的翻译质量分数与视觉及知识依赖信息保留分数。
AI.result: 对16个主流模型（12个多模态模型、4个文本输入模型）进行广泛评测，并在语言、领域与评价维度上开展系统分析。
AI.conclusion: VISTA-Bench 为图像翻译能力提供了更广语言覆盖与图像专属评价标准的系统化评测框架，可细粒度揭示模型在翻译质量与视觉/知识信息保留上的表现差异。

title: Why Cross-Skeleton Retargeting Is Non-Identifiable: Structural Limits of Generative Motion Models
summary: Cross-skeleton motion generation trains generative models to carry action structure and motion intention from one body to another. Yet a target motion that shows the right action has two explanations that the training data cannot tell apart: the model transferred the source clip, or it recovered a typical motion for the requested action. We show that this ambiguity is structural rather than incidental: under standard generative objectives, the source-conditioned retargeting map is non-identifiable in sparse heterogeneous motion domains. Unpaired distribution matching yields gauge non-identifiability: the latent spaces of different skeletons can be transformed relative to one another without changing the training evidence, so different source-conditioned maps fit it equally well. Sparse paired supervision admits the complementary failure mode, \emph{conditional-mean degeneration}: when clips are paired only by action, squared-error training converges to an average target motion that ignores the source clip. To make the missing evidence observable, we introduce Source-Instance Fidelity (SIF), a diagnostic that tests whether outputs differ from one another the way their source clips do, with the target skeleton and action held fixed. Under this diagnostic, methods that succeed at the standard action-level test on animal motion data often sit at the source-blind floor, while the methods that rise above it retain only a partial relational signal. Retargeting therefore needs objectives and evaluations that can identify the source-conditioned map it claims to learn. Project page: https://cross-skeleton-retargeting.netlify.app/.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出跨骨架动作生成存在结构性歧义：在标准生成目标下，源条件重定向映射在稀疏异构动作域中不可辨识；无配对分布匹配导致"规范不可辨识性"，稀疏配对监督导致"条件均值退化"。作者提出源实例保真度（SIF）诊断，发现现有动物动作数据上达标的方法往往处于源盲下限，呼吁重定向任务需采用能辨识源条件映射的目标与评估。
AI.motivation: 跨骨架动作生成旨在把动作结构与运动意图从一个身体迁移到另一个身体。但一个"动作正确"的目标动作存在两种无法被训练数据区分的解释：(1) 模型确实迁移了源片段；(2) 模型只是恢复了该动作的典型运动。作者希望揭示这种歧义并非偶然，而是结构性缺陷，并指出当前评估无法观测到缺失的证据。
AI.method: 作者从理论上分析两种失败模式：无配对分布匹配下的"规范不可辨识性"（gauge non-identifiability），即不同骨架的隐空间可相互变换而不改变训练证据，多个源条件映射能同等拟合；稀疏配对监督下的"条件均值退化"（conditional-mean degeneration），即仅按动作配对时，平方误差训练收敛到忽略源片段的平均目标动作。为让缺失证据可观测，提出源实例保真度（SIF）诊断，固定目标骨架与动作，检测输出之间的差异是否与其源片段之间的差异方式一致。
AI.result: 在SIF诊断下，动物运动数据上通过标准动作级测试的方法往往处于"源盲下限"（source-blind floor），即输出不随源片段变化；而少数高于该下限的方法也只保留了部分关系信号。
AI.conclusion: 跨骨架重定向要想真正学习其所声称的源条件映射，需要采用能够辨识该映射的目标函数与评估指标，而非仅依赖动作级测试。项目主页：https://cross-skeleton-retargeting.netlify.app/。

title: Technical note on: Zero-Training Feature-Space Alignment via Information Geometry
summary: Deep vision models often degrade under distribution shift. Test-time adaptation can improve robustness but typically requires iterative optimization, hyperparameter tuning, and multiple forward-backward passes. We propose Zero-Training Fisher Geometry Alignment (ZFGA), a closed-form method that improves robustness under covariate shift without modifying model parameters. ZFGA is based on the observation that distribution shifts distort feature-space geometry. It estimates the Fisher information matrix of the predictive distribution with respect to feature embeddings and applies a linear transformation that aligns test-feature Fisher geometry with a reference geometry computed from clean data. This provides a natural-gradient-inspired preconditioning step in feature space. We evaluate ZFGA on CIFAR-10-C and ImageNet-C using ResNet-50, DINO ViT-S/16, and CLIP ViT-B/32. ZFGA consistently improves over zero-shot inference across all three models, although it is not the strongest method for every model. Covariance whitening performs better on ResNet-50, while Fisher whitening is statistically indistinguishable from ZFGA on CLIP. Across six training-free and gradient-based alternatives (covariance whitening, Fisher whitening, TENT, T3A, LAME, and AdaNPC), ZFGA is the only method that does not substantially harm any of the three model families. The Fisher geometry distortion is also positively correlated with ZFGA gain (Pearson r = 0.366, p = 0.017), providing preliminary evidence that geometric misalignment contributes to robustness degradation. ZFGA requires only forward passes and matrix operations at inference time, offering a lightweight and deterministic alternative to optimization-based test-time adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出零训练Fisher几何对齐（ZFGA），一种闭式、免优化的测试时自适应方法，通过线性变换将测试特征的Fisher几何对齐到干净数据参考几何，提升分布偏移下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 深度视觉模型在分布偏移下性能下降，现有测试时自适应方法通常需要迭代优化、超参数调优和多次前向-反向传播，计算成本高且不稳定。
AI.method: ZFGA基于"分布偏移扭曲特征空间几何"的观察，估计预测分布关于特征嵌入的Fisher信息矩阵，并施加线性变换，使测试特征的Fisher几何与干净数据计算的参考几何对齐，从而实现自然梯度启发的特征空间预条件，不修改模型参数。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10-C和ImageNet-C上，使用ResNet-50、DINO ViT-S/16和CLIP ViT-B/32评估：ZFGA在三个模型上均优于零样本推理，但并非每个模型上最强（ResNet-50上协方差白化更优，CLIP上Fisher白化与ZFGA无统计差异）。在六种对比方法中，ZFGA是唯一不显著损害任何模型族的。Fisher几何扭曲与ZFGA增益正相关（Pearson r = 0.366, p = 0.017）。
AI.conclusion: ZFGA仅需前向传播和矩阵运算，提供轻量、确定性的测试时自适应替代方案，初步证据表明几何失配是鲁棒性退化的一个贡献因素。

title: FLASH: A "Generate Once, Synthesize Many" Framework for Synthetic Anomaly Generation in Industrial Anomaly Detection
summary: Synthetic anomaly generation helps expand industrial anomaly datasets when real defects are scarce or unavailable. Existing approaches lie at two extremes: procedural approaches are fast but struggle to represent complex anomalies, while generative approaches produce diverse defects but require costly per-sample generation. We present FLASH, a framework that decouples defect generation from anomaly synthesis under a ``generate once, synthesize many'' paradigm. Given only normal images, FLASH uses Vision-Language Model (VLM) guidance and an image-generation model to produce a small set of defect images, from which it extracts, validates, and banks reusable defect patches. For synthesis of anomalous images, Object Boundary Suppression (OBS) first identifies the probable foreground object-aware region of the host image, while Multi-Resolution Spectral Pyramid (MRSP) noise generates diverse, size-controllable masks that determine the defect location and spatial extent. It then composes a large and diverse synthetic anomalous image set by localizing the defect region, sampling size-controllable placement masks and seamlessly blending retrieved defects onto new defect-free images without further need for image generation. Experiments on the MVTec AD 2 dataset show that FLASH-generated anomalies nearly close the calibration gap on real defects, reaching 78.1% image-level F1 against an 83.6% real-anomaly upper bound and providing the most consistent calibration transfer across detectors among procedural and generative alternatives. Moreover, FLASH synthesizes anomalies more than 11.95x faster than per-sample generative approaches.

AI.tldr: FLASH 提出"生成一次、合成多次"范式，将缺陷生成与异常合成解耦，仅用正常图像即可高效合成大规模工业异常样本。
AI.motivation: 工业异常检测中真实缺陷样本稀缺。现有方法处于两个极端：过程式方法速度快但难以表达复杂缺陷；生成式方法缺陷多样但需逐样本生成，成本高昂。目标是兼顾多样性与效率。
AI.method: 框架包含两个阶段。缺陷生成端：在仅给定正常图像条件下，利用 VLM 引导与图像生成模型产出少量缺陷图像，并从中提取、验证、入库可复用缺陷 patch。异常合成端：对象边界抑制（OBS）识别宿主图像中可能的前景目标区域；多分辨率谱金字塔（MRSP）噪声生成多样、尺寸可控的掩码，确定缺陷位置与空间范围；随后定位缺陷区域、采样尺寸可控的放置掩码，将检索到的缺陷无缝融合到新的无缺陷图像上，无需再调用生成模型。
AI.result: 在 MVTec AD 2 上，FLASH 生成的异常接近弥合与真实缺陷的校准差距：图像级 F1 达 78.1%，真实异常上界为 83.6%；在过程式与生成式对比方法中，跨检测器的校准迁移最一致；合成速度比逐样本生成方法快 11.95 倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦缺陷生成与异常合成并复用缺陷 patch，FLASH 在保证缺陷多样性的同时显著提升合成效率，为真实缺陷稀缺场景下的工业异常数据扩充提供了兼顾质量与速度的方案。

title: What Comes Next? Omni-StoryBench for Evaluating Story-Grounded Omnimodal Generation
summary: Omnimodal evaluation should go beyond independent text, image, and speech production: individually plausible outputs may not express a coherent shared event. We introduce Omni-StoryBench, a story-grounded omnimodal benchmark evaluating whether models can coherently continue stories across image, narration, and speech. Each instance provides a current storybook page and structured next-page conditions, requiring models to generate the next illustration, narration, and spoken character utterance. Omni-StoryBench contains 900 rigorously validated story transitions from openly licensed children's books, with ground-truth next-page references and speech metadata. We evaluate systems with modality-specific metrics and consistency-centered LLM-as-a-judge rubrics for context preservation, condition following, reference consistency, and cross-modal coherence. Across 32 baseline configurations spanning orchestration, semi-orchestration, and native any-to-any paradigms, we find orchestration with strong VLM planning most reliable, while current native omnimodal models often struggle with output completeness and controllability. Our analysis shows text-side performance is associated with image and speech quality, but image generation and visual continuity form the clearest observed bottleneck among the evaluated configurations. These results position Omni-StoryBench as a system-level benchmark measuring coherent omnimodal generation beyond isolated modality quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Omni-StoryBench，一个以故事为依托的全模态基准，用于评估模型能否在图像、旁白与语音间连贯续写故事，并揭示图像生成与视觉连续性是目前最明显的瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态评估多局限于独立的文本、图像、语音生成质量，而单独看似合理的输出未必能表达连贯的同一事件，因此需要一个进行系统级、跨模态一致性评估的全模态基准。
AI.method: 构建 Omni-StoryBench：每个实例提供当前故事书页面与结构化下一页条件，要求模型生成下一页插画、旁白与角色语音（口语话语）。数据集包含 900 个经严格校验的故事转换，来自开放许可的儿童读物，并配有真实下一页参考与语音元数据。评估结合模态专属指标与以一致性为核心的 LLM-as-a-judge 评分标准，覆盖上下文保持、条件遵循、参考一致性与跨模态连贯性；共测试 32 种基线配置，涵盖编排式、半编排式与原生任意到任意（any-to-any）范式。
AI.result: 实验发现：具备强 VLM 规划的编排式方法最可靠；当前原生全模态模型常难以保证输出完整性与可控性。分析显示文本侧表现与图像、语音质量相关，但在所评估配置中，图像生成与视觉连续性是最明显的瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: Omni-StoryBench 定位为系统级基准，衡量超越单一模态质量的连贯全模态生成能力，为后续全模态系统研究提供评估依据。

title: The Domain Is a Residue: Adapting Self-Supervised Features, Not Generators
comment: 9 pages main text, 28 pages including appendix. 12 figures, 13 tables
summary: Clearing fog, rain or snow from footage, or turning renders into photographs, must remove the source domain and keep the scene. Unpaired translators carry it through because their generator sees the source appearance (pixels, a near-invertible latent or a control map) and keeps it. A DINO feature map fixes what is in the scene and carries weather, lighting and rendering style as a residue of 13 to 14% of the feature norm. We propose the Representation Feature Adapter (RFA), a 2.9M-parameter network that moves this residue. We train only the adapter and its discriminators; the encoder and a feature-conditioned decoder, trained once for all conditions, stay frozen. Against CycleGAN-Turbo it is ahead on both metrics on fog and on KID on night, and level within noise on snow, rain and haze. On sim-to-real it leads REGEN and HyPER-GAN on both metrics. Only the RFA removes the rain while keeping the scene. The removal costs scene structure: CycleGAN-Turbo keeps more on every condition but fog. On VAE latents the identical adapter collapses to the identity, and decoders from other groups that never saw it render its output. The RFA has about 160 times fewer trainable parameters than CycleGAN-Turbo and under a fifth of its per-condition training time.

AI.tldr: 提出表征特征适配器（RFA），一种仅 2.9M 参数的网络，通过迁移 DINO 特征图中仅占特征范数 13–14% 的"残差"（天气、光照、渲染风格），在冻结编码器与解码器的前提下实现去雾/去雨/去雪及 sim-to-real，参数与训练时间远低于 CycleGAN-Turbo。
AI.motivation: 无配对翻译器需在去除源域（雾、雨、雪、渲染风格）的同时保留场景内容。现有方法依赖生成器直接接触源外观（像素、近似可逆潜变量或控制图）从而保留外观，无法将"场景内容"与"天气/光照/渲染风格"解耦。作者发现 DINO 特征图能固定场景内容，而天气、光照与渲染风格仅以约 13–14% 特征范数的残差形式存在，因此可将去风格问题转化为对该残差的迁移。
AI.method: RFA 为 2.9M 参数的适配器，在冻结的 DINO 编码器与特征条件解码器之间迁移上述残差。仅训练适配器及其判别器；编码器与一次训练即适用于所有条件的特征条件解码器保持冻结。作为对照，在 VAE 潜变量上使用相同适配器。
AI.result: 相对 CycleGAN-Turbo：在雾上两项指标均领先，夜间 KID 领先，雪、雨、雾霾在噪声范围内持平；sim-to-real 上两项指标均优于 REGEN 与 HyPER-GAN。仅 RFA 能在去除雨的同时保留场景，但其去雨以牺牲场景结构为代价——除雾外 CycleGAN-Turbo 在各条件下保留更多结构。在 VAE 潜变量上相同适配器退化为恒等映射，而其他组从未见过该适配器的解码器也能渲染其输出。RFA 可训练参数量约为 CycleGAN-Turbo 的 1/160，单条件训练时间不足其 1/5。
AI.conclusion: 以 DINO 特征残差为操作对象的轻量适配器可有效完成去天气与 sim-to-real，且参数与训练成本极低；但该优势依赖 DINO 特征空间，在 VAE 潜变量上失效（退化为恒等），说明表征空间的选择是关键，且去风格与场景结构保真之间存在权衡。

title: OFBD: Object-Focused Background Debiasing for Long-Tailed Learning
summary: Balancing performance trade-offs on long-tailed data distributions remains a long-standing challenge in visual recognition. Existing methods mainly improve tail classes through re-balancing, representation learning, or data augmentation, but the underlying cause of tail class degradation is still insufficiently explored. In this paper, we find that standard long-tailed training induces background-biased representation and optimization: tail classes suffer larger background distribution shifts and become increasingly driven by background gradients. This reveals that tail degradation is not merely caused by insufficient samples, but also by the learning of irrelevant background features. To tackle this issue, we propose Object-Focused Background Debiasing (OFBD), a framework that mitigates background bias from both distribution and optimization perspectives. Specifically, Foreground-guided CutMix preserves target-related foregrounds while diversifying complementary backgrounds, and Background-guided Feature Rectification suppresses background-biased features without learnable parameters or additional training. Extensive experiments show that our method improves overall accuracy, achieves significant tail-class gains, and can serve as a plug-in for mainstream long-tailed methods without external data or pretrained recognition models. The code is available at: https://ofbd-neurips2026-longtail-learning.github.io/

AI.tldr: 本文揭示长尾训练会导致背景偏置表征与优化，提出OFBD框架，从分布与优化两个角度缓解背景偏置，显著提升尾类性能。
AI.motivation: 长尾数据分布的视觉识别中，尾类性能下降问题突出。现有方法多依赖重平衡、表征学习或数据增强，但尾类退化的根本原因仍缺乏深入探究。
AI.method: 本文发现标准长尾训练会诱发背景偏置表征与优化：尾类经历更大的背景分布偏移，且梯度逐渐由背景主导。基于此提出Object-Focused Background Debiasing（OFBD）框架，包含两个组件：Foreground-guided CutMix在多样化互补背景的同时保留目标相关前景；Background-guided Feature Rectification无需可学习参数或额外训练即可抑制背景偏置特征。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法提升了整体准确率，在尾类上取得显著增益，并可作为插件嵌入主流长尾方法，且无需外部数据或预训练识别模型。
AI.conclusion: 尾类退化不仅源于样本不足，也源于对无关背景特征的学习；从分布与优化两方面进行背景去偏可有效缓解长尾问题。

title: UGO: Unified Architecture for General Multi-Object Tracking by Segmentation
summary: General multi-object tracking (GMOT) tracks all instances of a user-specified category from a single first-frame exemplar. Prior work relies on bounding boxes and surrogate training, and struggles with non-rigid objects, crowded scenes, and distractors. We introduce UGO, a unified GMOT tracker that pairs a pretrained exemplar-conditioned detection head with an instance-propagation head in a common architecture. A novel training-free, energy-minimization consolidation method converts overlapping proposals into exclusive pixel-wise masks and detections, resolving over-segmentation, duplicates, and conflicts. A hierarchical memory spanning global and instance levels improves recall and per-instance segmentation accuracy using a new memory management protocol. UGO sets a new state-of-the-art on GMOT benchmarks and video object counting, and is competitive with specialist MOT methods, establishing a strong paradigm for unified, open-category multi-object tracking.

AI.tldr: 提出统一GMOT跟踪器UGO,结合示例条件检测头与实例传播头,用免训练能量最小化整合方法生成互斥掩码与检测,并设计分层记忆,在GMOT及视频计数基准上达到最新最优。
AI.motivation: 现有通用多目标跟踪(GMOT)方法依赖边界框与代理训练(surrogate training),在非刚性物体、拥挤场景和干扰物存在时表现不佳,亟需统一且开放类别的跟踪范式。
AI.method: UGO在统一架构中并行集成预训练的示例条件检测头(exemplar-conditioned detection head)与实例传播头(instance-propagation head);提出免训练的能量最小化整合方法(training-free energy-minimization consolidation),将重叠候选框转化为互斥的像素级掩码与检测,解决过分割、重复与冲突;并引入跨全局与实例层级的分层记忆(hierarchical memory)及新的记忆管理协议。
AI.result: 在GMOT基准与视频目标计数(video object counting)任务上取得新的state-of-the-art,性能与专业化的MOT方法具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: UGO为统一、开放类别的多目标跟踪建立了强有力的范式,验证了检测与传播统一架构结合像素级整合的有效性。

title: HyperSAM: A Promptable Foundation Model for Hyperspectral Remote Sensing
comment: Accepted by IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Magazine (GRSM)
summary: Hyperspectral remote sensing provides dense spectral measurements that are indispensable for material-level Earth observation, yet the construction of a general-purpose hyperspectral foundation model remains difficult. Two bottlenecks are especially limiting. First, large hyperspectral corpora rarely provide high spatial resolution together with reliable dense annotations. Second, many hyperspectral models are still trained almost from scratch, so the geometric and interactive priors learned by modern vision foundation models are not fully reused. To alleviate these issues, we \highlight{present} \textbf{HyperSAM}, a promptable hyperspectral foundation model that couples a data-centric hyperspectral synthesis pipeline with a spectral adaptation architecture based on Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3). On the data side, HyperSAM synthesizes full-spectrum hyperspectral cubes from high-resolution SpaceNet multispectral imagery through a physics-informed abundance-transfer generator, while SAM3-derived pseudo-masks provide object-centric supervision. On the model side, the latest implementation uses a frozen SAM3 RGB image branch, a trainable hyperspectral side encoder initialized from the RGB vision transformer (ViT), ControlNet-style zero-initialized feature injection, and a lightweight mixture-of-experts mask refiner. To enhance training robustness against noisy pseudo-labels, Cross-modal Sample Selection (CromSS)-style confidence selection is incorporated for noisy-label weighting. Extensive experiments show that HyperSAM obtains strong generalization on diverse hyperspectral tasks (e.g., classification, anomaly detection, change detection, target detection, and airborne oil-spill mapping) and that high-quality synthetic hyperspectral data can be more effective than simply scaling noisy hyperspectral supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HyperSAM，一个可提示的高光谱基础模型，通过物理引导的丰度迁移生成器合成高光谱立方体，并基于SAM3构建光谱适配架构，在多种高光谱任务上取得强泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 高光谱遥感虽能提供密集光谱测量，但通用高光谱基础模型构建面临两大瓶颈：一是大规模高光谱语料难以同时具备高空间分辨率与可靠密集标注；二是多数高光谱模型几乎从零训练，未能充分利用现代视觉基础模型学到的几何与交互先验。
AI.method: 数据侧：HyperSAM通过物理信息引导的丰度迁移生成器，从高分辨率SpaceNet多光谱影像合成全光谱高光谱立方体，并利用SAM3生成的伪掩码提供以对象为中心的监督。模型侧：采用冻结的SAM3 RGB图像分支、由RGB ViT初始化的可训练高光谱侧编码器、ControlNet风格零初始化特征注入，以及轻量级混合专家掩码精化器；同时引入CromSS风格置信度选择以对噪声伪标签加权，增强训练鲁棒性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，HyperSAM在分类、异常检测、变化检测、目标检测及机载溢油制图等多种高光谱任务上均表现出强泛化能力；且高质量合成高光谱数据比单纯扩大含噪高光谱监督更有效。
AI.conclusion: HyperSAM通过数据合成与基于SAM3的光谱适配相结合，有效缓解了高光谱基础模型的数据与先验复用瓶颈，验证了合成数据质量优于监督规模扩张的结论，为通用高光谱基础模型提供了可行路径。

title: When to Retrieve, When to Stay: Uncertainty-Aware Temporal Evidence Allocation for Streaming Video-LLMs
summary: Streaming video understanding requires Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) to reason over continuous visual streams under causal constraints. As the visual history grows, a bounded visual?processing budget requires evidence selection that balances temporal recency with query relevance. Recent-only selection excludes potentially relevant historical evidence, whereas Semantic-only retrieval can displace useful recent context when relevance scores are ambiguous. We introduce WRWS (When to Retrieve, When to Stay), a training-free framework for uncertainty-adaptive evidence allocation. A lightweight external vision-language encoder scores query relevance across the observed history, while an adaptive allocation module uses the normalized entropy of the similarity distribution as a proxy for retrieval uncertainty. WRWS favors semantic retrieval when relevance cues are reliable and strengthens the recency prior under uncertainty. Following a retrieve-first, encode-later pipeline, WRWS selects evidence before target-model visual encoding, such that only the selected observations are processed by the costly target Video-LLM. Experiments across four Video-LLM families and multiple model scales demonstrate competitive accuracy on StreamingBench and OVO-Bench. In our efficiency evaluation, WRWS reduces average vision-to-answer time to 47.93% of the state-of-the-art method. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架WRWS，用相似度分布的归一化熵衡量检索不确定性，自适应地在语义检索与近期先验之间分配视觉证据预算，降低视频LLM计算量。
AI.motivation: 流式视频理解需在因果约束下处理连续视觉流，视觉历史增长时受限于固定的视觉处理预算，必须进行证据选择。现有方法两难：仅选近期会丢弃潜在相关的历史证据，而纯语义检索在相关性分数模糊时会把有用的近期上下文挤掉。
AI.method: WRWS为免训练框架：(1) 轻量外部视觉-语言编码器对已观测历史打分，计算查询相关性；(2) 自适应分配模块以相似度分布的归一化熵作为检索不确定性的代理指标——相关性线索可靠时偏向语义检索，不确定性高时加强近期先验；(3) 采用“先检索、后编码”流程，在目标模型视觉编码前完成证据选择，仅被选中的观测进入昂贵的目标Video-LLM。
AI.result: 在四个Video-LLM系列及多种模型规模上实验，于StreamingBench和OVO-Bench上取得有竞争力的准确率；效率评估中，将平均“视觉到回答”时间降至当前最优方法的47.93%。
AI.conclusion: 通过不确定性自适应的证据分配与检索优先的管线设计，WRWS在无需训练的前提下兼顾了流式视频理解的准确性与推理效率。代码将开源。

title: TAEC: Trajectory-Aware Evidence Coordination for Multi-Step Visual RAG
summary: Multi-step visual retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) answers complex questions by repeatedly retrieving visual evidence, updating an intermediate state, and deciding whether to continue searching or answer. Yet retrieving relevant evidence does not ensure its effective use throughout the reasoning trajectory.
