As multi-step reasoning progresses, redundant sources occupy context capacity needed for missing evidence, observations tied to resolved requirements or unproductive searches linger in context, and visual sources are revisited with insufficient detail for fine-grained reading. We term this loss of usable evidence over a reasoning trajectory trajectory-level evidence utilization degradation. To address it, we propose Trajectory-Aware Evidence Coordination (TAEC), a training-free framework that coordinates evidence use around unresolved answer requirements. TAEC tracks these requirements in a shared trajectory state to guide which evidence enters the context, how accumulated memory is retained, and at what level of detail visual evidence is examined. Under a unified evaluation protocol on ViDoSeek, SlideVQA, and MMLongBench-Doc, TAEC achieves the best overall performance against leading training-free visual RAG baselines, with the highest average accuracy across multiple proprietary vision-language models. These results demonstrate that aligning evidence with evolving reasoning needs improves evidence use throughout multi-step visual RAG.

AI.tldr: 本文提出免训练框架TAEC，通过围绕未解决的答案需求协调证据使用，缓解多步视觉RAG中的"轨迹级证据利用退化"问题。
AI.motivation: 多步视觉RAG通过反复检索视觉证据、更新中间状态并决定是否继续搜索来回答复杂问题。但检索到相关证据并不意味着其在整个推理轨迹中被有效利用：冗余来源占用上下文容量，已解决需求或无产出的搜索观测残留，以及视觉来源被重访时细节不足，作者将此称为"轨迹级证据利用退化"。
AI.method: 提出Trajectory-Aware Evidence Coordination (TAEC)，一个免训练框架。它在共享的轨迹状态中跟踪未解决的答案需求，以此指导哪些证据进入上下文、如何保留累积记忆，以及以何种细节层次检查视觉证据。
AI.result: 在ViDoSeek、SlideVQA和MMLongBench-Doc上采用统一评测协议，TAEC在领先的免训练视觉RAG基线中取得最佳整体表现，并在多个专有视觉语言模型上取得最高平均准确率。
AI.conclusion: 将证据与不断演化的推理需求对齐，能够改善多步视觉RAG中的证据利用；TAEC验证了这一思路的有效性。

title: PCaPaint: Prostate Cancer Inpainting by Mitigating Shortcut Learning
comment: Accepted at the DGM4MICCAI workshop at MICCAI 2026
summary: The development of AI systems for tumor-specific applications is limited by the scarcity of labeled data. Synthetic tumor inpainting offers a promising approach but faces challenges for prostate cancer MRI which contains high-resolution multi-sequence data. Although methods leveraging latent diffusion models (LDMs) enable large-volume synthesis, they are prone to shortcut learning, simply reproducing the condition image created by masking the lesion region. In this work, we introduce PCaPaint, a prostate cancer inpainting method based on LDMs that explicitly addresses this failure mode. To overcome shortcut learning that compromises synthetic tumor texture, we propose a simple yet efficient conditioning strategy in which the condition image is filled with Gaussian noise, and we provide theoretical justification. In addition, we propose a novel training objective for LDM that emphasizes the error within the lesion region. Furthermore, we introduce a multi-sequence latent design, in which T2w scans and DWI&ADC scans are compressed using two separate autoencoders to preserve their distinct frequency characteristics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the generated synthetic data improves downstream performance in prostate lesion segmentation, patient-level classification and lesion-level detection. Furthermore, our method significantly outperforms a recent state-of-the-art LDM-based tumor inpainting method both in downstream performance and in synthetic image quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PCaPaint，一种基于潜扩散模型（LDM）的前列腺癌MRI肿瘤修复方法，通过噪声填充条件图、病灶区域加权训练目标及多序列隐空间设计，解决捷径学习问题，生成的合成数据提升了下游分割、分类与检测性能，并超越现有SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: AI系统在肿瘤特异性应用中受限于标注数据稀缺。合成肿瘤修复是一种有前景的方案，但前列腺癌MRI包含高分辨率多序列数据，带来挑战。现有基于LDM的方法虽能合成大体积图像，却易出现捷径学习，即仅复现由掩码病灶区域生成的条件图像，损害合成肿瘤纹理的真实性。
AI.method: 提出PCaPaint，基于LDM并显式解决捷径学习问题：(1) 提出简单高效的条件策略，将条件图像填充高斯噪声，并给出理论论证；(2) 提出新的LDM训练目标，强调病灶区域内的误差；(3) 引入多序列隐空间设计，使用两个独立自编码器分别压缩T2w与DWI&ADC扫描，以保留其不同的频率特征。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，生成的合成数据提升了前列腺病灶分割、患者级分类和病灶级检测的下游性能；所提方法在下游性能和合成图像质量上均显著优于近期基于LDM的SOTA肿瘤修复方法。
AI.conclusion: PCaPaint通过噪声条件填充、病灶聚焦训练目标及多序列隐空间设计，有效缓解LDM肿瘤修复中的捷径学习，生成高质量合成数据并提升多类下游任务表现，可作为缓解医学肿瘤标注数据稀缺的有效方案。

title: Visual Anomaly Synthesis for Model Selection in Data Scarcity
summary: Defect detection systems for industrial condition monitoring can only be relied upon if they are validated, yet defective samples are rare and, for a specific asset, often nonexistent. We present a framework that synthesizes severity-graded defects on real non-defective images without any defect references for the target asset, that can be used for model selection and validation. A defect taxonomy for common failure modes is distilled from literature into prescriptive prompts at varying defect severities. Regions of interest are cropped from in defect-free images and edited with a pre-trained image generation model ("FLUX.2 [klein]"). Color-matching and blending are employed to improve structural coherence with the original image. Generations are filtered out by a scorer and by estimated detection difficulty. Model selection experiments on MVTecAD show image AUROC choice regret over model selection can be nearly halved compared to the best fixed model chosen with access to test data. Experiments show the need for severity-graded anomaly synthesis. A case study investigates the proposed method for in-situ monitoring of Pelton turbine runners in hydropower, where real defect images are rare and expensive to collect. A PatchCorebased anomaly detection model is fit on Pelton turbine images and selected and validated using synthetic images, showing strong detection performance (94 % correct detection at optimal threshold and AUROC 0.97). The model reliably detects moderate and advanced defects, while early-stage defects remain challenging, indicating the synthetic data meaningfully stresses detector sensitivity.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需目标资产缺陷样本、在真实无缺陷图像上合成"分级"缺陷的框架，用于工业异常检测模型的选型与验证；在MVTecAD上可将模型选型后悔率减半，并在水电站Pelton水轮机监测案例中获得94%检出率与AUROC 0.97。
AI.motivation: 工业状态监测的缺陷检测系统必须经过验证才可信，但缺陷样本稀少，对特定资产甚至完全不存在缺陷参考，导致模型选择与验证缺乏真实数据支撑。
AI.method: 从文献中提炼常见失效模式的缺陷分类体系，转化为不同严重度等级的规定性提示词；在无缺陷图像上裁剪感兴趣区域，用预训练图像生成模型（FLUX.2 [klein]）编辑生成缺陷；通过颜色匹配与融合提升与原始图像的结构一致性；再用评分器与估计的检测难度过滤生成样本。
AI.result: 在MVTecAD上，图像AUROC层面的模型选择后悔率相比"借助测试数据选出的最佳固定模型"降低近一半；实验证明分级异常合成的必要性。Pelton水轮机案例中，用合成图像完成PatchCore模型的选择与验证，最优阈值下检出率94%、AUROC 0.97；可可靠检出中度与重度缺陷，早期缺陷仍具挑战。
AI.conclusion: 无缺陷参考条件下的严重度分级缺陷合成可有效支撑检测模型的选型与验证，并真实地检验检测器灵敏度；早期缺陷检测仍是待解决的难点。

title: Think Before You Score: Thinking Reward Model for Visual Generation
summary: Visual reward models are essential for evaluating and improving visual generation models, yet existing approaches typically map task conditions and candidate outputs directly to scalar rewards, leaving implicit what should be evaluated for each individual case. We introduce Think Before You Score, a paradigm that explicitly determines what matters for each case before judging how well the candidate performs. Following this principle, we propose the Thinking Reward Model (TRM), which formulates case-adaptive rubrics, performs rubric-guided assessment, and produces fine-grained pointwise rewards. We further observe that conventional pairwise preference optimization can induce score polarization, and introduce Pairwise Dual-Group Relative Policy Optimization (PD-GRPO), which leverages pairwise supervision to improve reward discrimination while preserving fine-grained pointwise scoring. Extensive experiments on image generation and editing reward-modeling benchmarks demonstrate that TRM achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source reward models while remaining highly competitive with proprietary alternatives. Moreover, using TRM as a reward for reinforcement learning consistently improves diverse visual generation models, demonstrating that its fine-grained, case-adaptive rewards translate into effective optimization signals for visual generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Think Before You Score"范式及Thinking Reward Model (TRM)，先为每个案例显式构建自适应评分准则再进行评估，产出细粒度pointwise奖励；并引入PD-GRPO解决成对偏好优化导致的分数极化问题。在图像生成与编辑基准上取得开源SOTA，且作为RL奖励可稳定提升多种视觉生成模型。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉奖励模型通常直接将任务条件与候选输出映射为标量奖励，隐含了"每个案例应评估什么"这一关键问题，导致评估标准不透明、缺乏案例适应性，且奖励信号粒度粗糙，难以支撑有效的生成模型优化。
AI.method: 1）提出"Think Before You Score"范式：先显式确定每个案例的关键评估维度，再判断候选输出的表现。2）据此构建TRM：生成案例自适应（case-adaptive）的评分准则（rubrics），执行准则引导的评估，输出细粒度pointwise奖励。3）针对传统成对偏好优化引发分数极化的问题，提出PD-GRPO，利用成对监督提升奖励判别力，同时保留细粒度pointwise打分能力。
AI.result: 在图像生成与图像编辑的奖励建模基准上，TRM在开源奖励模型中达到SOTA，并与闭源方案保持高度竞争力；将TRM用作强化学习奖励时，可一致地提升多种视觉生成模型的表现。
AI.conclusion: 显式、案例自适应的细粒度奖励建模能够转化为有效的优化信号，验证了"先思考评估什么、再打分"范式的有效性与通用性，为视觉生成模型的评估与改进提供了新路径。

title: MG-Thinker: Bi-Axial Self-Reflection for Multi-Image Reasoning Grounding
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has recently delivered substantial gains in multimodal reasoning, opening a promising route for fine-grained visual perception. Yet for multi-image reasoning grounding (MRG), reasoning over real-world multi-image contexts toward pixel-precise localization, existing RL-based approaches overlook two characteristics intrinsic to this paradigm: a coarse-to-fine hierarchical reasoning pattern, and heterogeneously distributed task--sample difficulties. In this work, we present MG-Thinker, a post-training RL framework that advances a new MRG paradigm featuring such hierarchical reasoning, supported by a curated 25K MRG dataset with task-adaptive Chain-of-Thought (CoT) annotations that elicit multi-perspective evidence before conclusion. To remedy the heterogeneous task--sample difficulties, we further propose Bi-Axial DAPO (BiA-DAPO), which decomposes rollout advantages along an intra-group signal axis and an inter-group competence axis through two complementary mechanisms, both grounded on our defined candidate pool for stable group-level statistics. Extensive experiments show that MG-Thinker achieves state-of-the-art performance on multi-image reasoning grounding while consistently improving generalization across multi-image understanding and diverse multimodal benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MG-Thinker，一个面向多图推理定位（MRG）的后训练强化学习框架，并将其归纳为具有由粗到细层级推理的新范式，配合 25K 任务自适应 CoT 标注数据集与 Bi-Axial DAPO 优势分解方法，在多图推理定位上达到 SOTA 并提升泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有多图推理定位（MRG）的 RL 方法忽略了该范式的两个内在特性：一是由粗到细的层级推理模式；二是任务—样本难度的异质分布。这两点导致既有 RL 方案难以实现像素级精确定位与稳定优化。
AI.method: 1) 提出 MG-Thinker 后训练 RL 框架，构建以层级推理为核心的新 MRG 范式；2) 构建 25K 规模 MRG 数据集，配备任务自适应 Chain-of-Thought 标注，引导模型在给出结论前先收集多视角证据；3) 提出 Bi-Axial DAPO（BiA-DAPO），在自定义候选池（保证组级统计稳定）基础上，通过组内信号轴与组间能力轴两个互补机制对 rollout 优势进行分解。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，MG-Thinker 在多图推理定位任务上取得 SOTA 性能，并在多图理解及多种多模态基准上持续提升泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 面向 MRG 的 RL 后训练需显式建模层级推理结构与异质难度分布；层级 CoT 数据与双轴优势分解的组合能有效提升定位精度与跨任务泛化，为细粒度多图视觉感知提供了可行路径。

title: Do-JEPA: From Masking to Intervention in Latent World Models
summary: Latent world models are trained to predict what happens next, so nothing in their objective separates what an action caused from what merely co-occurred with it. Object-masking models such as C-JEPA intervene on what the predictor can see; we intervene on what physically happens. From one saved simulator state we run the dynamics under an action $a$ and under a reference action $a_{\varnothing}$, and train the model to predict the difference $Δz=z^{a}-z^{a_{\varnothing}}$ between the two latent futures. The resulting objective, Do-JEPA, has an effect loss, a support loss (where the action enters), a propagation loss (where its effect travels) and invariance losses (what must not change). In a synthetic system with object-aligned variables, support supervision finds the directly intervened object in 99.95% of test cases, where a sparse action mask sends the action to a nuisance slot in every case, and response-onset supervision recovers the ring-shaped propagation graph (edge AUROC 0.975 vs. 0.624). From pixels, the effect loss beats a control trained on exactly the same data: it lowers latent effect error by 28.4% on an end-to-end LeWM model and physical effect error by 13.5% when trained and tested on natural action sequences, and on three independently generated CausalWorld benchmarks it lowers responsive effect error by about 20% under physics shifts and the latent context sensitivity of predicted effects by 66%. Trained from scratch it costs factual accuracy; fine-tuning an existing model with it removes this cost. Together, these results show that intervening on the world, rather than on what the model sees, helps latent world models predict what their actions cause.

AI.tldr: 提出Do-JEPA：通过在仿真器中对同一状态施加动作a与参考动作a_∅并让模型预测潜空间未来的差Δz，将因果效应直接注入世界模型训练目标，在合成系统和像素任务上显著提升效应定位与泛化。
AI.motivation: 潜世界模型的目标只是预测"接下来发生什么"，无法区分"动作导致的变化"与"仅仅共同发生的变化"，因此模型学到的可能是相关性而非因果效应。已有方法如C-JEPA只在模型可见输入上做干预（对象掩码），并未干预物理世界的真实动态，故本文主张对"物理上真正发生的事"进行干预。
AI.method: 从同一保存的仿真器状态出发，分别在动作a与参考动作a_∅下展开动力学，训练模型预测两个潜未来的差Δz=z^a−z^{a_∅}。该目标Do-JEPA由四部分组成：effect loss（效应损失）、support loss（动作进入的位置）、propagation loss（效应传播路径）以及invariance losses（不应改变的部分）。
AI.result: 在具有对象对齐变量的合成系统中，support监督在99.95%的测试用例中定位到被直接干预的对象，而稀疏动作掩码在所有情况下都把动作误送到干扰槽位；response-onset监督恢复了环形传播图（边AUROC 0.975 vs 0.624）。在像素输入下，effect loss优于在完全相同数据上训练的对照模型：在端到端LeWM上潜效应误差降低28.4%，在自然动作序列上训练与测试时物理效应误差降低13.5%；在三个独立生成的CausalWorld基准上，物理偏移下响应效应误差降低约20%，预测效应的潜上下文敏感性降低66%。从头训练会损害事实准确性，但用其微调已有模型可消除这一代价。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，对世界本身（而非模型所见）进行干预，有助于潜世界模型预测其动作所导致的结果；Do-JEPA作为一种微调手段可在不损失事实准确性的前提下增强因果效应建模能力。

title: Anatomy-Aware Prediction of Bronchoscopic Accessibility from 3D CT
summary: Pre-operative planning for bronchoscopy is critical for the diagnosis of lung lesions. Current accessibility assessment relies on subjective manual inspection of CT scans, which is time-consuming and prone to inter-observer variability. In this paper, we formalize bronchoscopy accessibility prediction as a novel supervised learning task and present the first end-to-end framework to address it. We propose an Anatomy-Aware Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model that integrates specialized modules: a CT Expert for local morphological features, a Lobe Expert for anatomical priors, and a Path Geometry Expert that encodes the sequential constraints of the bronchial tree. To support this task, we curated the first clinical dataset of 438 cases with pre-operative CT scans and documented procedural outcomes. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves an AUROC of 0.8052, significantly outperforming both state-of-the-art baselines and experienced human experts. This work establishes a new benchmark for computer-aided interventional planning in pulmonary medicine. Our data and code will be publicly available at https://nubagcilab.github.io/BronchoAccess/.

AI.tldr: 该论文将支气管镜可及性预测形式化为新的监督学习任务，提出首个端到端框架与解剖感知MoE模型，并在首个438例临床数据集上取得优于现有方法及人类专家的AUROC 0.8052。
AI.motivation: 支气管镜检查的术前规划对肺部病灶诊断至关重要，但当前的可及性评估依赖对CT扫描的主观人工判读，耗时长且存在观察者间差异，缺乏自动化、标准化的解决方案。
AI.method: 将支气管镜可及性预测定义为监督学习任务，提出解剖感知混合专家（MoE）模型，集成三个专门模块：CT专家捕获局部形态特征，肺叶专家引入解剖先验，路径几何专家编码支气管树的序列约束；同时构建首个包含438例术前CT与手术结局记录的开源临床数据集。
AI.result: 方法达到AUROC 0.8052，显著优于最先进基线方法与经验丰富的人类专家。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为肺部医学的计算机辅助介入规划建立了新基准，数据和代码将公开。

title: Multi-task learning for the automatic grading of enlarged perivascular space burden using MRI
summary: Enlarged perivascular spaces (PVS) visible in brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) are increasingly thought to be linked to poor brain health. PVS are elongated structures of less than 3 mm in diameter and can be numerous. To reflect the incidence of PVS, radiologists visually score their burden following a clinical grading scale - a task that would benefit from automation to accelerate analyses and overcome the influence of inter-observer differences. We developed and evaluated methods for training machine learning models to score PVS incidence in the basal ganglia (BG) and centrum semiovale (CSO) leveraging the Potters/Wardlaw scale. The novelty in our work lies in the use of imperfect, semi-automatically generated "silver-standard" PVS segmentation masks during training, in addition to PVS radiological scores. We comparatively evaluated a conditional convolutional neural network (CNN) which accepts PVS masks as an extra input channel, a multi-task CNN which performs both PVS segmentation and scoring, and a logistic regression model which utilises features derived from PVS masks to predict PVS scores. Multi-task learning was the most effective method, achieving a mean average precision of 64.08% compared to 60.22% for the conditional CNN, 52.11% for a baseline CNN trained only to predict PVS scores, and 49.32% for the logistic regression model. The multi-task model showed an ability to localise individual PVS not shown by the other CNNs, and behaved in a probabilistically sensible way, predicting with lower confidence on inherently harder classes. Age, sex, hypertension status, white matter hyperintensity volume, and ischaemic stroke lesion status were shown to be associated with the multi-task model's PVS score predictions and the ground truth in a similar way.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出并比较了三种机器学习方法，利用不完美的“银标准”血管周围间隙（PVS）分割掩膜与放射学评分，自动评估基底节和半卵圆中心的PVS负荷；多任务CNN效果最佳，平均精度达64.08%。
AI.motivation: 脑MRI可见的扩大血管周围间隙（PVS）被认为与脑健康不良相关。放射科医生需按临床分级量表目视评分PVS负荷，该任务耗时且受观察者间差异影响，因此有必要实现自动化以加速分析并消除主观差异。
AI.method: 基于Potters/Wardlaw量表训练模型对基底节（BG）和半卵圆中心（CSO）的PVS进行评分。创新点在于训练中除使用PVS放射学评分外，还引入了半自动生成的不完美“银标准”PVS分割掩膜。对比评估了三种方法：(1)将PVS掩膜作为额外输入通道的条件CNN；(2)同时执行PVS分割与评分的多任务CNN；(3)利用PVS掩膜衍生特征预测评分的逻辑回归模型。
AI.result: 多任务学习最有效，平均精度（mAP）为64.08%，高于条件CNN的60.22%、仅预测评分的基线CNN的52.11%以及逻辑回归的49.32%。多任务模型能定位单个PVS（其他CNN不具备此能力），且预测具有概率合理性，对固有较难类别给出较低置信度。年龄、性别、高血压状态、白质高信号体积及缺血性卒中病灶状态与多任务模型预测评分和真实标签的关联方式相似。
AI.conclusion: 利用不完美的“银标准”分割掩膜进行多任务学习，可有效提升PVS自动评分的性能，并具备单个PVS定位能力与合理的不确定性表达，其预测与已知临床相关因素的一致性支持该方法的有效性。

title: BeatDance: Generating Beat-Consistent 3D Dance with Hierarchical Spatial-Temporal Modeling
summary: Generating realistic 3D dance from music is a challenging task that requires accurate synchronization with musical rhythms while capturing the spatial complexity of human motion. Although existing methods can generate physically plausible dance motions, they often struggle to achieve precise alignment with music, such as the beat. To address this limitation, we propose a novel diffusion-based framework, BeatDance, with two components: 1) We present a Hierarchical Decoupled Attention (HDA) module, which first disentangles the learning of human pose and temporal dynamics. A hierarchical structure is then employed to capture both short-term and long-term dependencies, thereby enhancing spatial-temporal modeling. 2) We adopt cycle-consistent learning by introducing an auxiliary dance-to-music module. During training, discrepancies between the reconstructed and original music induce a stronger loss signal, effectively encouraging the consistency property between the music and dance motion. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our proposed approach outperforms recent competitive methods on two benchmark datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出基于扩散模型的BeatDance框架，通过分层解耦注意力与循环一致性学习提升音乐生成舞蹈的节拍对齐精度。
AI.motivation: 从音乐生成真实3D舞蹈需兼顾与音乐节奏的精确同步及人体运动的空间复杂性。现有方法虽能生成物理合理的舞蹈动作，但难以实现与音乐的精确对齐（如节拍）。
AI.method: 1) 分层解耦注意力（HDA）模块：先将人体姿态与时间动态的学习解耦，再采用分层结构捕捉短期与长期依赖，增强时空建模能力；2) 通过引入辅助的dance-to-music模块实现循环一致性学习，训练时重构音乐与原始音乐之间的差异产生更强的损失信号，促进音乐与舞蹈动作的一致性。
AI.result: 在两个基准数据集上，所提方法优于近期具有竞争力的方法。
AI.conclusion: BeatDance有效改善了音乐与舞蹈的节拍对齐与一致性，验证了分层解耦注意力与循环一致性学习在音乐驱动舞蹈生成中的有效性。

title: Complementary Retrieval-Augmented Prompting for Consistent Long-Form Video Generation
summary: While recent video foundation models excel at generating high-quality short videos, long-form video generation remains a critical challenge, where a major bottleneck lies in conditioning independently generated shots to preserve consistent characters, scenes, and objects throughout a story. Existing training-free approaches typically condition target shots using retrieved historical visuals. However, these references often suffer from severe informational mismatch, either introducing irrelevant contextual redundancy or failing to provide the full combination of required elements for the target shot. To resolve this, we present Complementary Retrieval-Augmented Prompting, an agentic framework that strategically aggregates a compact set of mutually supportive historical references to achieve complete and targeted conditioning for long-form video generation without retraining or modifying the underlying generator. Specifically, our framework explicitly models the visual elements required by each target shot by parsing the narrative script into a text-grounded visual element registry that tracks characters, objects, scenes, and their shot-level states. A VLM-annotated keyframe library further maps these elements to past visual observations. Guided by the required elements, our agent retrieves complementary references that maximize target-element coverage while minimizing historical noise. Finally, the retrieved references, structured element states, and grounding instructions are assembled into a unified prompt for the frozen video generator. This element-aware process provides comprehensive conditioning while remaining fully interpretable. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations on multi-shot story generation demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms recent-frame, memory-based, and entity-level retrieval baselines in cross-shot consistency and text-controllability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出互补检索增强提示框架（Complementary Retrieval-Augmented Prompting），通过智能体聚合互补的历史参考帧，为长视频生成的每个镜头提供完整且有针对性的条件，无需重训练生成器。方法将叙事脚本解析为视觉元素注册表，结合VLM标注的关键帧库，检索能最大化目标元素覆盖、最小化历史噪声的互补参考，组装成统一提示。实验表明其在跨镜头一致性和文本可控性上优于近期帧、记忆库和实体级检索基线。
AI.motivation: 视频基础模型擅长生成高质量短视频，但长视频生成仍是难题，主要瓶颈在于独立生成各镜头时难以保持角色、场景和物体的一致性。现有免训练方法用检索到的历史视觉内容作为条件，但参考信息常存在严重不匹配：要么引入无关上下文冗余，要么无法提供目标镜头所需的完整元素组合。
AI.method: 提出互补检索增强提示的智能体框架。1）将叙事脚本解析为文本接地的视觉元素注册表，跟踪角色、物体、场景及其镜头级状态，显式建模每个目标镜头所需视觉元素；2）用VLM标注的关键帧库将元素映射到过去视觉观测；3）智能体依据所需元素检索互补参考，最大化目标元素覆盖并最小化历史噪声；4）将检索参考、结构化元素状态和接地指令组装为统一提示，输入冻结的视频生成器。整个过程元素感知、可解释，无需重训练或修改生成器。
AI.result: 在多镜头故事生成任务上的定量与定性评估显示，该方法在跨镜头一致性和文本可控性方面持续优于近期帧、基于记忆库以及实体级检索等基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过元素感知的互补检索与提示组装，可在不修改生成器的前提下为长视频生成提供完整、有针对性的条件，显著提升跨镜头一致性与文本可控性，并保持流程的可解释性。

title: LazySloth: Bounded LLM-based Lazy Tree Search for Fast Long Video Comprehension
comment: Under review at conference. Preprints allowed when under review
summary: Modern vision-language models (VLMs) have shown promising results in long-video understanding due to the rich semantic information they can capture. However, most methods focus on coarse captioning of extracted image frames that are computationally inefficient and require models with large context windows. While past work has explored efficient methods through multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), they rely on lossy embeddings that lose temporal context and fine-grained detail. Few works to date have investigated how VLM-based query-relevant information retrieval can be optimized. We introduce LazySloth, an efficient tree-based search method that speeds up video comprehension and retrieval tasks 2.9-8.3x (compared to existing agentic methods) through bounded captioning of portions of the video considered irrelevant by a VLM of the video. Compared to contemporary specialized video-understanding VLMs and RAG-based methods, LazySloth achieved similar or better final task accuracy across two recent open-source base VLMs--Gemma 4 31B and Qwen3.6 27B--across four benchmarks. LazySloth reduced the gap between the base open-source model and a closed-source model, GPT-4o. Ablations showed that replacing VLM scene understanding with CLIP-based retrieval cost 8.8-19.9% in accuracy, while lazy tree construction matches eager construction at a fraction of the captioning cost. With LazySloth, we demonstrate the possibility of faster long-video comprehension without substantial loss in performance.

AI.tldr: LazySloth：基于树的惰性搜索方法，通过仅对VLM判定为不相关的视频片段做有界描述，加速长视频理解与检索2.9–8.3倍，在两个开源基座VLM、四个基准上达到相当或更优精度。
AI.motivation: 现代视觉语言模型（VLM）在长视频理解上表现良好，但主流方法多对抽取帧做粗粒度描述，计算效率低且依赖大上下文窗口。已有的多模态RAG方法虽高效，却依赖有损嵌入，丢失时序上下文与细粒度细节。目前少有工作研究如何优化基于VLM的查询相关信息检索。
AI.method: 提出LazySloth：一种高效的树式搜索方法。由VLM判断视频中不相关的片段，仅对这些部分进行有界（bounded）描述，从而避免对整段视频做昂贵且冗余的captioning，并采用惰性（lazy）树构建策略。
AI.result: 相比已有agentic方法，视频理解与检索任务提速2.9–8.3倍；在Gemma 4 31B与Qwen3.6 27B两个开源基座VLM、四个基准上，相较同期专用视频理解VLM与RAG方法取得相当或更高精度，并缩小了开源基座与闭源模型GPT-4o的差距。消融显示：用CLIP检索替代VLM场景理解会损失8.8–19.9%精度；惰性树构建以极小描述成本达到与eager构建相当的效果。
AI.conclusion: LazySloth证明了在性能无明显损失的前提下实现更快长视频理解的可行性。

title: Event-Only Wingbeat Counting under Camera Motion: A Controlled MuJoCo Benchmark
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Controlled simulation study with an ideal contrast-event sensor. Follow-up to arXiv:2609.17308 using new event-only acquisitions and a motion ablation protocol
summary: Counting completed wingbeats requires identifying individual cycles, including during frequency changes and pauses; estimating a dominant frequency alone is insufficient. Camera motion further mixes target and background brightness changes in event observations. We present a controlled MuJoCo benchmark that separates motion training from event-only image translation compensation. The acquisition contains 324 streams from 24 independent scenes, three flapping geometries, two distances (1.5 and 3.0 m), and static, moderate-motion and stronger-motion views. Fifteen scenes are used for fitting, three for validation and six for held-out testing. A fixed causal temporal convolutional network is evaluated in a matched 2 x 2 ablation with three initialization seeds and compared with ridge, Fourier, autocorrelation and an adapted EEPPR baseline. Under moderate motion, paired motion training reduces count mean absolute error from 31.130 to 3.185 cycles at 1.5 m and from 42.019 to 5.444 at 3.0 m. Adding the tested compensation increases these errors to 4.630 and 10.185, respectively. A Fourier baseline achieves 0.944 cycles at 1.5 m under moderate motion, showing that the neural model is not uniformly best. We report exact-count accuracy and temporally matched cycle F1 alongside count error. These findings support motion-aware training in this small synthetic benchmark, while exposing limits of simple event-background stabilization. They do not establish real-sensor performance, aerodynamic flight, or generalization to unseen vehicle types.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个基于MuJoCo的可控基准，研究从事件相机观测中计数完整振翅周期，并分离运动训练与事件图像平移补偿的贡献。
AI.motivation: 计数完整振翅周期需要识别单个周期，包括频率变化与暂停阶段，仅估计主频不足；同时相机运动会在事件观测中混入目标与背景亮度变化，干扰计数。
AI.method: 构建MuJoCo基准，包含24个独立场景的324条事件流，涵盖3种振翅几何、2个距离（1.5 m与3.0 m）及静态、中等运动、较强运动视图；采用15个场景拟合、3个验证、6个留出测试。使用固定的因果时间卷积网络，在2×2匹配消融下以3个初始化种子评估，并与ridge、Fourier、自相关及改编的EEPPR基线比较。
AI.result: 中等运动下，配对运动训练将计数平均绝对误差从31.130降至3.185周期（1.5 m），从42.019降至5.444（3.0 m）；加入所测试的补偿后误差回升至4.630与10.185。Fourier基线在1.5 m中等运动下达到0.944周期，表明神经模型并非全面最优。报告了精确计数准确率与时间匹配周期F1。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在该小型合成基准中采用运动感知训练，同时揭示简单事件背景稳定的局限；不能据此推断真实传感器性能、气动飞行或对未见飞行器类型的泛化能力。

title: Label Less, Learn More: Resource-Efficient Active Semi-Supervised Learning for Onboard Satellite Image Annotation
summary: Large-scale pervasive sensing increasingly relies on high-resolution satellite imagery, yet task-specific onboard vision is constrained by costly annotation and limited computation, memory, energy, and communication resources. Existing approaches largely rely on either data-hungry supervised learning or large vision-language foundation models, limiting efficient adaptation and deployment under these constraints. We present SatLabel, a resource-aware learning framework that transforms limited satellite labels into progressively refined onboard models through adaptive sample acquisition and semi-supervised model adaptation. Rather than repeatedly training on uniformly sampled labels, SatLabel closes the loop between model uncertainty, class imbalance, and pseudo-label quality to selectively acquire informative samples while exploiting abundant unlabeled imagery. This enables a compact student to adapt to target sensing domains with reduced annotation and inference costs. We further introduce an optional Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) student with graph-based feature refinement to enhance representation capacity while retaining a lightweight footprint. We evaluate SatLabel on 11 remote-sensing datasets spanning core, extended, and unseen domains against RemoteCLIP zero-shot inference. SatLabel improves Macro-F1 on most core and extended datasets while maintaining strong cross-dataset transfer to unseen domains. More importantly, the Balanced student contains only 11.2 M parameters and occupies approximately 42.8 MB, compared with 151.3M parameters and 577 MB for RemoteCLIP, while requiring 3.65 versus 5.89 GFLOPs. Across four efficiency benchmarks, it achieves approximately 2x higher GPU-forward throughput and reduces energy per image on datasets.

AI.tldr: SatLabel：面向资源受限星上遥感的标签高效半监督自适应框架，用有限卫星标签迭代获取信息样本并适配紧凑学生模型，在11个遥感数据集上多数优于RemoteCLIP零样本，且参数/存储/算力与能耗显著更低。
AI.motivation: 大规模普适感知依赖高分辨率卫星影像，但星上任务特定视觉受限于昂贵标注以及计算、内存、能量、通信资源。现有方法多依赖数据饥渴的监督学习或大型视觉-语言基础模型，难以在这些约束下高效适配与部署。
AI.method: 提出SatLabel资源感知学习框架：将有限卫星标签转化为逐步精炼的星上模型，通过自适应样本获取与半监督模型自适应。不同于在均匀采样标签上反复训练，SatLabel在模型不确定性、类别不平衡与伪标签质量之间闭环，选择性获取信息量大的样本，同时利用大量无标注影像，使紧凑学生模型以更低标注与推理成本适配目标感知域。另引入可选MoE学生与基于图的特征精炼，在保持轻量足迹的同时增强表征能力。
AI.result: 在覆盖核心、扩展与未见域的11个遥感数据集上，对比RemoteCLIP零样本推理，SatLabel在多数核心与扩展数据集上提升Macro-F1，并保持较强的跨数据集迁移到未见域。Balanced学生仅11.2M参数、约42.8MB，而RemoteCLIP为151.3M参数、577MB；算力3.65 vs 5.89 GFLOPs。在四个效率基准上，GPU前向吞吐约高2倍，并降低各数据集每张图像能耗。
AI.conclusion: SatLabel表明通过不确定性-类别不平衡-伪标签质量闭环的主动获取与半监督适配，可在星上资源约束下用极少标注获得紧凑而有效的遥感模型，兼顾多数数据集精度提升、跨域迁移与显著效率优势，为资源感知的星上视觉部署提供了可行路径。

title: PoE-Fuse: Precision-Weighted Expert Fusion for Bi-Temporal Change Understanding
summary: Bi-temporal change understanding, which localizes and characterizes what changed between two satellite images, is central to disaster response and environmental monitoring, spanning change detection, building localization, and damage assessment. Strong vision-language models address these tasks, but adapting them typically requires full fine-tuning or reinforcement learning, which is costly and unstable. We propose PoE-Fuse, a parameter-efficient framework that instead composes frozen foundation experts for geometry, grounding, and language, resampling their features onto a shared spatial grid and training only a lightweight fusion trunk. PoE-Fuse treats the aligned features as Gaussian observations of a latent scene state and fuses them by learned per-cell precision. This product-of-experts estimator strictly generalizes uniform summation and scalar gating, and extends to change fields by composing the precisions of the two timestamps. A single shared trunk solves the three tasks at once, reaching a mean F1 of 59.2%, compared with 40.7% for an instruction-tuned temporal vision-language assistant, and surpassing dedicated change-detection models retrained under the same protocol and training budget.

AI.tldr: 提出PoE-Fuse参数高效框架，通过融合冻结的几何、定位与语言基础专家解决双时相变化理解任务，单主干同时完成三项任务。
AI.motivation: 双时相变化理解（变化检测、建筑定位、损伤评估）对灾害响应和环境监测至关重要。强视觉语言模型需全量微调或强化学习来适配，代价高且不稳定，因此需要参数高效的替代方案。
AI.method: PoE-Fuse组合冻结的几何、定位、语言基础专家，将其特征重采样到共享空间网格，仅训练轻量融合主干。方法把对齐特征视为潜在场景状态的高斯观测，按学习的逐单元精度加权融合（专家乘积估计器），严格泛化均匀求和与标量门控，并通过组合两个时间戳的精度扩展到变化场。
AI.result: 单一共享主干同时求解三项任务，平均F1达59.2%，而指令微调的时序视觉语言助手仅为40.7%，并超越在同一协议与训练预算下重训练的专用变化检测模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过概率化专家乘积融合冻结基础模型，可在低训练成本下高效统一多种双时相变化理解任务，性能优于重型微调方案与专用模型。

title: Physics-Guided Flow-Map Matching for Precipitation Nowcasting
summary: Precipitation nowcasting, generating future radar fields from past observations, is critical for flood warning and disaster response. It is also a demanding benchmark for spatiotemporal generative modeling, with chaotic dynamics, heavy-tailed intensities, and rare high-intensity structures that matter most. Deterministic models minimize a pixel loss and are driven toward the conditional mean, which blurs exactly those structures, while generative models that add a stochastic residual on top of a deterministic backbone inherit the same blur. We propose Physics-Guided Flow-Map Matching (PG-FMM), a conditional flow-map model that decouples predictable advection from uncertain small-scale detail. A frozen Lagrangian advection prior transports the radar field and supplies an explicit motion forecast, and a flow-map generative head, conditioned on the past frames and the prior rollout rather than summed onto it, produces sharp stochastic detail in four sampling steps. The prior serves only as guidance, so the head replaces blurred structure instead of inheriting it. Extensive experiments on four radar benchmarks show that PG-FMM outperforms state-of-the-art methods on 18 of 24 metrics, with the largest gains at heavy-rain thresholds, where the critical success index improves by up to 58.9%. The project page can be found at https://neurogica.github.io/PG-FMM.

AI.tldr: 提出物理引导的流映射匹配模型PG-FMM，将可预测的平流与不确定的小尺度细节解耦，用于降水临近预报，在四个雷达基准上24项指标中18项超越SOTA，强降雨阈值下CSI最高提升58.9%。
AI.motivation: 降水临近预报对洪水预警和灾害响应至关重要，但因其混沌动力学、重尾强度分布及罕见高强度结构而成为时空生成建模的严苛基准。确定性模型最小化像素损失会被推向条件均值，模糊关键高强度结构；而在确定性主干上叠加随机残差的生成模型会继承同样的模糊问题。
AI.method: PG-FMM是一种条件流映射（flow-map）模型，将可预测的平流与不确定的小尺度细节解耦。采用冻结的拉格朗日平流先验输运雷达场并提供显式运动预报；流映射生成头以历史帧和先验推演为条件（而非叠加其上），在四步采样中生成锐利的随机细节。先验仅作为引导，使生成头替换模糊结构而非继承它。
AI.result: 在四个雷达基准上开展大量实验，PG-FMM在24项指标中的18项上优于当前最优方法，在强降雨阈值处增益最大，关键成功指数（CSI）最高提升58.9%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将物理先验作为生成引导而非叠加基础，PG-FMM有效避免了条件均值的模糊问题，实现了高质量、少步数的随机降水临近预报，验证了物理引导与流映射生成相结合的有效性。

title: FORUM: Frozen Outputs Reconciled Using Model Agreement for Visual Grounding
summary: Frozen multimodal large language models (MLLMs) now solve standard referring expression comprehension with a single prompted call, yet on adversarial benchmarks with same-category distractors and negation, even the largest models are confidently wrong, and resampling repeats the error. Models built from different data and architectures rarely fall for the same confounder, so their agreement is a strong label-free signal of the correct target. We present FORUM, a training-free test-time fusion of frozen MLLMs guided by two fixed geometric rules: agreement-based selection keeps the region supported by the most distinct models, and medoid localization returns an actual member box instead of a coordinate average, so one loose prediction cannot shift the answer. Fusing three open MLLMs, FORUM surpasses the 397B-parameter published reference by a relative 5% in mean accuracy on the adversarial Ref-Adv-s benchmark, and a plain averaging ensemble by 15%. The gains transfer to standard RefCOCO+, and a balanced lineup with no dominant member still surpasses the 397B model by 5%.

AI.tldr: FORUM：一种免训练、基于几何规则的多模态大模型测试时融合方法，用一致性选择与中心点定位解决对抗性指代理解。
AI.motivation: 冻结的多模态大模型在标准指代理解任务上单次提示即可求解，但在含同类干扰物与否定的对抗基准上，即使最大模型也会自信出错，且重采样无法纠正。不同数据与架构训练的模型很少被同一混淆因素误导，因此模型间一致性可作为无标签的正确目标信号。
AI.method: 提出FORUM，对多个冻结MLLM进行免训练测试时融合，遵循两条固定几何规则：（1）一致性选择，保留被最多不同模型支持的候选区域；（2）中心点定位（medoid），返回真实成员框而非坐标平均，避免单个松散预测影响结果。
AI.result: 融合三个开源MLLM，在对抗基准Ref-Adv-s上平均准确率相对397B参数公开参考模型提升5%，比简单平均集成高15%；该增益可迁移到标准RefCOCO+；即使在不含主导成员的均衡阵容下，仍比397B模型高5%。
AI.conclusion: 免训练、规则驱动的多模型融合能有效提升冻结MLLM在对抗性指代理解上的鲁棒性，且不依赖单一强模型。

title: Attention-Scoped Guidance: Training-Free Spatial Control for Image Editing
summary: Instruction-guided image editing should change what the instruction names and leave the rest of the image untouched. In dual classifier-free guidance (CFG), an editor combines two directions at every denoising step, one that pushes toward the instructed edit and one that pulls back toward the source image, using global weights. We introduce Attention-Scoped Guidance (ASG), a sampler wrapper that makes these weights spatial. It reads a soft support map from the instruction attention that the editor already computes, then weakens text guidance where support is low and strengthens image anchoring where support is high. The wrapper requires no training, no external mask, and no additional network evaluation. On the full MagicBrush and PIE-Bench++ splits, ASG improves preservation-oriented metrics, leading three of four MagicBrush metrics and PIE-Bench++ background PSNR. A dose-matched control that removes the spatial placement loses up to 0.73 CLIP on PIE-Bench++, confirming that the spatial allocation itself carries the gain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Attention-Scoped Guidance (ASG)，一种无需训练的采样器包装，将双 CFG 的全局权重变为空间权重，利用指令注意力读出软支撑图，在支撑低处弱化文本引导、支撑高处强化图像锚定，从而提升指令编辑的保持性能。
AI.motivation: 指令引导的图像编辑应只改变指令所指内容，其余部分保持不变。然而现有双 classifier-free guidance (CFG) 在每个去噪步用全局权重组合"推向编辑"和"拉回原图"两个方向，权重缺乏空间区分度，导致不该改动区域被误改，保持性不足。
AI.method: 提出 ASG 采样器包装：从编辑器已计算的指令注意力中读取软支撑图（soft support map），据此对引导权重进行空间调制——支撑低的区域弱化文本引导，支撑高的区域强化图像锚定。该方法无需训练、无需外部掩码、无需额外网络前向评估。
AI.result: 在完整 MagicBrush 与 PIE-Bench++ 划分上，ASG 提升保持导向指标，在 MagicBrush 四项指标中领先三项，并提升 PIE-Bench++ 的背景 PSNR。剂量匹配对照实验（去除空间分配）在 PIE-Bench++ 上最多损失 0.73 CLIP，证明增益来自空间分配本身。
AI.conclusion: ASG 以零训练、零额外开销的方式实现了空间自适应的引导权重分配，验证了空间化引导对指令编辑保持性的有效性，且增益确由空间分配机制贡献。

title: MotionMaestro: Masked Tokenization for Unified Motion Generation
summary: Human motion generation plays an important role in applications such as character animation, virtual environments, and embodied interaction. While existing approaches have achieved remarkable progress, many of them are developed for individual tasks, including text-to-motion, pose-conditioned generation, and trajectory control. Although these tasks involve different types of conditions, a unified framework capable of handling them within a common representation would greatly simplify motion generation systems. We observe that diverse motion conditions can be naturally formulated as different observation patterns over motion sequences, where each task corresponds to a specific masking strategy. Based on this insight, we introduce MotionMaestro, a unified motion generation framework that learns a shared representation for complete motions and heterogeneous partial observations through masked motion tokenization. MotionMaestro employs a three-stage training strategy that first learns a masked motion tokenizer, then refines its reconstruction ability on clean motions, and finally trains a conditional flow-matching generator in the learned latent space. Furthermore, we introduce an observation map and an observation loss to explicitly preserve provided motion conditions during generation. With this unified representation and conditioning mechanism, MotionMaestro supports text-guided and unconditional synthesis, pose conditioning and partial completion, temporal interpolation, trajectory control, and motion continuation. Experiments on the large-scale RoMo and MotionMillion datasets show state-of-the-art performance across diverse motion generation tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出统一运动生成框架 MotionMaestro，将所有运动条件建模为不同的掩码观测模式，通过掩码运动分词与条件流匹配生成器，在共享表征下统一处理文本、姿态、轨迹等多类运动生成任务，并在 RoMo 与 MotionMillion 上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现有运动生成方法大多针对单一任务（如文本到运动、姿态条件生成、轨迹控制）分别设计，任务之间彼此割裂，系统复杂。作者观察到不同运动条件本质上可归结为运动序列上的不同观测模式，即对应不同的掩码策略，因此存在用一个统一框架与共享表征处理多任务的潜力。
AI.method: MotionMaestro 通过掩码运动分词（masked motion tokenization）学习完整运动与异构部分观测的统一表征，并采用三阶段训练：先学习掩码运动分词器，再在干净运动上精修其重建能力，最后在所学隐空间中训练条件流匹配生成器。此外引入观测图（observation map）与观测损失，在生成过程中显式保持已给定的运动条件。
AI.result: 在 RoMo 与 MotionMillion 两个大规模数据集上，MotionMaestro 在文本引导与无条件合成、姿态条件与部分补全、时序插值、轨迹控制以及运动延续等多种任务中均达到最先进（state-of-the-art）性能。
AI.conclusion: 将多样的运动条件统一建模为运动序列上的掩码观测模式是可行且高效的，MotionMaestro 以掩码分词+条件流匹配+观测约束的方式实现了多任务统一的运动生成，并验证了该范式的通用性与优越性。

title: GeoSET: Generalist Foundation Model for SAR-to-EO Image Translation
summary: Paired synthetic aperture radar (SAR) and electro-optical (EO) imagery is increasingly available across sensors, resolutions, and geographic regions. Yet existing SAR-to-EO image translation (SET) methods are typically trained on a single, limited-scale dataset, producing models specialized to particular sensing conditions. We introduce GeoSET, the first generalist model for SET, built around a single pretrained parent that is adapted to downstream datasets under a common protocol. We curate over 3 million high-quality SAR--EO pairs from a collection of more than 10 million SAR observations, spanning diverse sensors, spatial resolutions, and ground sampling distances. To bridge the modality gap between SAR observations and a pretrained image generator, we develop a speckle-robust SAR encoder and pretrain the conditional generator on this heterogeneous corpus. The resulting parent supports efficient adaptation across downstream datasets through low-rank adaptation (LoRA), updating only 0.60% of the generator parameters and requiring approximately one hour per dataset. Across six downstream benchmarks, GeoSET achieves state-of-the-art results in FID and DISTS with full fine-tuning or LoRA, demonstrating effective transfer across heterogeneous SAR-EO domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GeoSET，首个SAR到光学图像翻译（SET）的通用模型。基于超300万对SAR-EO配对数据预训练，通过斑点鲁棒SAR编码器和LoRA适配，在六个下游基准上取得FID与DISTS最优结果，验证了跨异构域的有效迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有SET方法通常仅在单一、规模有限的数据集上训练，导致模型只适配特定传感条件，泛化能力差。随着多传感器、多分辨率、多地理区域的配对SAR-EO数据日益丰富，亟需一个能跨异构域泛化的通用SET模型。
AI.method: 提出GeoSET通用模型，构建单一预训练父模型，并在统一协议下适配下游数据集。构建超300万高质量SAR-EO配对数据（源自超1000万SAR观测），涵盖多样传感器、空间分辨率和地面采样距离。设计斑点鲁棒的SAR编码器以弥合SAR与预训练图像生成器间的模态差距，并在该异构语料上预训练条件生成器。下游适配采用LoRA，仅更新生成器0.60%参数，每个数据集约需1小时。
AI.result: 在六个下游基准上，GeoSET在使用全参数微调或LoRA时，FID和DISTS均达到最优（state-of-the-art），展现出跨异构SAR-EO域的有效迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: GeoSET验证了构建通用SAR-to-EO翻译模型在数据规模、模态桥接与高效适配上的可行性，为跨异构传感条件的SET任务提供了统一且可扩展的解决方案。

title: Principled MAP estimation for inverse problems: bridging the gap between convergence and performance
summary: Pretrained denoisers provide a powerful way to incorporate image priors into restoration algorithms. Plug-and-Play and RED approaches exploit fixed-noise-level denoisers within first-order optimization schemes, with convergence guarantees, but often struggle to achieve high-quality reconstruction on severely ill-posed inverse problems. In contrast, recent state-of-the-art approaches leverage denoisers derived from flow- or diffusion-based generative models and evaluate them along a sequence of decreasing noise levels. While these methods achieve strong empirical performance, their convergence theory remains limited. In this paper, we bridge this gap by specifically designing an algorithm that combines denoisers at decreasing noise levels with a schedule tailored to ensure convergence. From a Bayesian perspective, we prove that our method converges to a $\textit{Maximum a Posteriori}$ (MAP) estimate, under suitable assumptions. Subsequently, we apply our method to various ill-posed inverse problems and show that it surpasses convergent methods while competing with state-of-the-art empirical ones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合递减噪声水平去噪器与收敛调度算法的图像复原方法，在贝叶斯框架下证明其收敛到MAP估计，并在严重病态逆问题中性能优于收敛方法、媲美最优经验方法。
AI.motivation: 现有Plug-and-Play和RED方法虽具收敛保证但依赖固定噪声水平去噪器，在严重病态逆问题上重建质量不足；而基于flow/diffusion生成模型的去噪方法虽经验性能优异，却缺乏收敛理论。本文旨在弥合收敛性与高性能之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 设计一种算法，将递减噪声水平的去噪器与专门定制的调度策略相结合以确保收敛，并从贝叶斯视角在适当假设下进行收敛性分析。
AI.result: 理论上证明了所提方法收敛到最大后验（MAP）估计；实验上将其应用于多种病态逆问题，结果表明其超越现有收敛方法，并与最先进的经验方法性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过定制调度弥合了收敛理论与高性能经验方法之间的差距，为基于生成模型先验的逆问题求解提供了兼具理论保证与实证竞争力的方案。

title: Weeding Out Bad Seeds: Initial-Noise-Robust Unlearning for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
summary: Machine unlearning has emerged as a critical post-hoc safety measure to erase sensitive concepts from Text-to-Image (T2I) models without prohibitive retraining. However, we reveal that current state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches are brittle due to a severe lack of robustness to noise initialization. We call this phenomenon ``probabilistic forgetting'': suppressed concepts re-emerge under specific random initial noise conditions, despite appearing unlearned on other initializations. We trace this failure to the misalignment between standard Gaussian sampling during unlearning and the unlearning objective. Since the target concept manifests only in specific initial noise regions throughout the unlearning phase, uniform random sampling yields sparse, uninformative gradient updates that fail to drive robust erasure. To overcome this issue, we propose an adaptive, concept-conditioned sampling strategy that dynamically concentrates gradient updates on regions where the target concept manifests, down-weighting uninformative areas. We integrate our framework with six distinct SOTA unlearning methods across four diffusion backbones and evaluate it across safety, object, and artistic-style unlearning, as well as under black-box and white-box adversarial attacks. Our method reduces the conditional nudity re-emergence rate across random initializations by 67.2% on average over four baselines and lowers attack success rates across both adversarial evaluations. Across concept domains, Adaptive Noise Sampling strengthens adversarial robustness and non-target retention while preserving competitive generative quality and target-erasure performance.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示当前文本到图像（T2I）机器遗忘方法存在"概率性遗忘"缺陷，即被抑制概念在特定随机初始噪声下会重新出现，并提出自适应、概念条件化的噪声采样策略来增强遗忘鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I机器遗忘方法虽能移除敏感概念而无需昂贵重训练，但对噪声初始化极度敏感（"概率性遗忘"）。作者将这一脆弱性归因于遗忘阶段标准高斯采样与遗忘目标之间的错位：目标概念仅在特定初始噪声区域显现，均匀随机采样产生稀疏、无信息的梯度更新，无法实现稳健擦除。
AI.method: 提出自适应、概念条件化的采样策略（Adaptive Noise Sampling），动态将梯度更新集中于目标概念显现的噪声区域，并对无信息区域降权。该框架与六种SOTA遗忘方法、四种扩散骨干网络集成，在安全、物体与艺术风格遗忘任务，以及黑盒与白盒对抗攻击下进行评估。
AI.result: 相比四个基线，该方法在随机初始化下将条件裸露概念重现率平均降低67.2%，并在两类对抗评估中降低攻击成功率。跨概念域中，自适应噪声采样增强了对抗鲁棒性与非目标保留能力，同时保持有竞争力的生成质量和目标擦除性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，遗忘的鲁棒性瓶颈源于噪声采样与遗忘目标的不匹配，自适应概念条件化采样可有效缓解"概率性遗忘"，在提升对抗鲁棒性和概念擦除稳健性的同时保持生成质量，为T2I机器遗忘提供通用增强方案。

title: APM-Bench: Benchmarking Cross-session Persistent Memory for Egocentric Streaming Video Assistants
summary: To serve as real-world personal assistants, streaming video models need persistent memory that retains past experiences for later use. Yet existing streaming benchmarks and methods often focus on individual continuous videos or short clips, overlooking that real-world interactions are often intermittent and require memory to persist across interruptions. To fill this gap, we introduce APM-Bench, which reformulates real-world streaming interaction as multi-session life trajectories. It contains 549 sessions, 104 trajectories, and 2,719 candidates, spanning both objective and open-ended questions. Each session is a video with fine-grained annotations, and sessions within a trajectory revolve around related activities. Models then use persistent memory to answer questions about past sessions and provide proactive responses while maintaining real-time interaction. This raises challenges: persistent memory must be storable, selectively retain information, be injected at the right time, and remain efficient. Moreover, finite storage may leave required evidence unavailable, so assistants should recognize missing evidence. Therefore, we systematically evaluate general video models under different memory protocols and diverse specialized streaming memory systems, and test whether models acknowledge insufficient evidence. Our evaluation reveals a clear utility--latency--storage trade-off: existing methods still struggle to simultaneously achieve reliable long-term recall, low overhead, and effective proactive assistance across sessions. APM-Bench provides a comprehensive testbed for developing and comparing persistent memory systems under realistic streaming conditions. We hope it encourages future work that jointly considers utility, latency, and storage toward more practical persistent memory for real-world streaming assistants.

AI.tldr: 本文提出APM-Bench，将真实世界流式交互重构为多会话生活轨迹，用于评测流式视频模型的持久记忆能力，并揭示现有方法在效用-延迟-存储之间存在明显权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有流式视频基准与方法多聚焦于单个连续视频或短片段，忽视真实交互的间歇性与跨中断的持久记忆需求。为填补该空白，需要能评测持久记忆的基准。
AI.method: 提出APM-Bench：包含549个会话、104条轨迹、2719个候选，覆盖客观与开放式问题；每个会话为带细粒度标注的视频，同一轨迹内会话围绕相关活动。模型需用持久记忆回答过往会话问题并做主动响应，同时保持实时交互。系统评测通用视频模型在不同记忆协议下、以及多种专用流式记忆系统的表现，并测试模型是否能识别证据不足。
AI.result: 评测揭示了明显的效用-延迟-存储权衡：现有方法难以同时实现可靠的长期回忆、低开销和有效的跨会话主动辅助。
AI.conclusion: APM-Bench为真实流式条件下持久记忆系统的开发与比较提供了综合测试平台，鼓励未来工作联合考虑效用、延迟与存储，推动更实用的持久记忆流式助手。

title: Decompose Radicals, Then Reward: Fine-Grained Inspection for Accurate Chinese Text Rendering
summary: Rendering accurate Chinese text remains challenging for text-to-image models. Existing OCR-based reinforcement-learning rewards compare decoded transcripts with target strings. Such rewards overlook the compositional nature of Chinese writing: an ideograph consists of reusable components arranged through explicit spatial relations, yet OCR evaluates it as an atomic character. Consequently, visually different radical-level errors may receive equally coarse feedback, encouraging glyphs that merely resemble the target instead of faithfully reproducing its internal structure. We employ Ideographic Description Sequences (IDS), which comprise spatial operators and character components, and train an expert IDS recognizer to transcribe rendered Chinese text into this representation. Building on this recognizer, we introduce IDSpect, which deterministically decomposes the target text into IDS tokens and aligns crop-level visual IDS predictions with the target sequence. Globally unique token credit makes this comparison robust to the order of detected text regions. Combined with a whole-character semantic reward, IDSpect supplies fine-grained credit with component and spatial-relation without changing the image generator or adding inference-time cost. Experiments with GRPO post-training of Qwen-Image demonstrate that IDSpect achieves leading structural quality and semantic alignment on LongText and GenTextEval.

AI.tldr: 提出IDSpect：用表意文字描述序列（IDS）将OCR式奖励细化为“部件+空间关系”级别，对Qwen-Image进行GRPO后训练，在LongText与GenTextEval上获得领先的结构质量与语义对齐，且不改变生成器、不增加推理开销。
AI.motivation: 文生图模型渲染准确中文仍困难，尤其表意文字的构造性（可复用部件按显式空间关系组合）未被现有奖励建模；基于OCR的强化学习奖励将汉字当作原子字符，仅比较解码文本与目标串，导致部首级、部件级差异得到同样粗粒度的反馈，模型倾向生成“形似”而非内部结构正确的字形。
AI.method: 采用表意文字描述序列（IDS），由空间操作符与字符部件组成；训练专家IDS识别器，将渲染的中文文本转写为IDS表示。基于该识别器提出IDSpect：确定性地把目标文本分解为IDS token，并将裁剪级别的视觉IDS预测与目标序列对齐；利用全局唯一token信用，使比较对检测文本区域的顺序鲁棒。再与整字语义奖励结合，提供部件级与空间关系级的细粒度信用，且不修改图像生成器、不增加推理时开销。
AI.result: 在Qwen-Image上进行GRPO后训练的实验表明，IDSpect在LongText与GenTextEval上取得领先的结构质量与语义对齐表现。
AI.conclusion: 将汉字渲染奖励从原子字符级提升到IDS部件与空间关系级，可为文生图强化学习提供更细粒度且顺序鲁棒的信用分配，在无额外推理成本的前提下提升中文文本渲染的结构保真度与语义一致性。

title: Evaluating the Evaluators: Diagnosing Large Multimodal Models for AI-Generated Image Assessment
summary: With the rapid advancement of text-to-image (T2I) generation, robust evaluation becomes critical yet challenging, as traditional metrics fail to capture fine-grained alignment and generative artifacts. While large multimodal models (LMMs) are increasingly adopted as evaluators, existing benchmarks typically study semantic understanding, quality perception, and authenticity identification in isolation, while largely neglecting responsibility detection. This leaves a gap in unified and comprehensive validation. To bridge this gap, we introduce SQUARE-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark that systematically evaluates LMM capabilities as evaluators of AI-generated images across four aspects: Semantics, Quality, Authenticity, and Responsibility. SQUARE-Bench introduces a granular taxonomy of 38 sub-dimensions to evaluate nearly 10K AI-generated images sampled from 22 diverse models, ranging from legacy to state-of-the-art generators, complemented by over 3K real-world images. The images are annotated with curated question-answering pairs. Extensive experiments on 23 LMMs reveal that top proprietary models, such as Gemini-3-Pro, already outperform the individual human expert baseline. However, the performance gap between models remains significant, exhibiting notable disparities in fine-grained inference and domain-specific robustness. Beyond benchmarking, we conduct a proof-of-concept study of LMM-guided iterative editing, in which dimension-specific LMMs provide diagnostic feedback to fixed image editors. The resulting guided system yields selective improvements in semantics, authenticity, and responsibility, while exhibiting a consistent visual-quality trade-off. SQUARE-Bench can serve as both a diagnostic tool for characterizing LMM evaluator capabilities and studying their use in T2I generation refinement. The benchmark and dataset will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SQUARE-Bench，一个系统评估大型多模态模型(LMM)作为AI生成图像评估器的综合基准，涵盖语义、质量、真实性、责任四个维度，含38个细分维度、近10K合成图像与3K真实图像，评测23个LMM并探索LMM引导的迭代编辑。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像生成快速发展，传统指标难以捕捉细粒度对齐与生成伪影；现有LMM评估基准通常孤立研究语义理解、质量感知与真实性识别，忽视责任检测，缺乏统一、全面的验证。
AI.method: 构建SQUARE-Bench基准：定义语义、质量、真实性、责任四方面及38个细粒度子维度；从22个新旧生成模型采样近10K合成图像并补充3K+真实图像，配套人工标注的问答对；在23个LMM上开展广泛实验；并进行LMM引导迭代编辑的概念验证研究，由维度专用LMM为固定图像编辑器提供诊断反馈。
AI.result: 顶级专有模型（如Gemini-3-Pro）已超越单个领域专家基线；但模型间性能差距仍显著，在细粒度推理和领域鲁棒性上差异明显。LMM引导编辑系统在语义、真实性、责任维度带来选择性提升，同时存在一致的视觉质量权衡。
AI.conclusion: SQUARE-Bench既可作为刻画LMM评估器能力的诊断工具，也可用于研究其在T2I生成优化中的应用。基准与数据集将在论文发表后公开。

title: TReVS: Integrating Textual Relevance and Visual Saliency for Efficient Vision-Language Model Token Pruning
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at visual understanding and reasoning but often incur substantial inference costs due to the large number of visual tokens. Recent visual token pruning methods increasingly follow a two-stage paradigm: they first remove visually redundant tokens after the vision encoder and then discard tokens irrelevant to the textual query within the Large Language Model (LLM). However, since the first stage typically relies solely on vision-encoder saliency, it may prematurely eliminate query-relevant tokens, depriving the subsequent text-guided stage of critical visual evidence. Our empirical analysis shows that incorporating query guidance into first-stage pruning better preserves task-relevant evidence and consistently improves performance over vision-only saliency-based pruning. We further find that high-variance attention heads are more sensitive to the textual query and yield more discriminative text-to-vision attention signals for second-stage pruning. Motivated by these findings, we propose TReVS, a training-free framework that combines textual relevance with vision-encoder saliency for pre-LLM pruning and leverages high-variance attention heads to remove task-irrelevant tokens at shallow-to-intermediate layers of the LLM. On LLaVA-1.5-7B, TReVS retains 92.8% of the unpruned baseline performance while pruning 94.4% of visual tokens, outperforming prior state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练视觉token剪枝框架TReVS，将文本相关性引入LLM前剪枝，并利用高方差注意力头在中浅层剪枝任务无关token，在保留92.8%基线性能下剪去94.4%视觉token。
AI.motivation: VLMs因视觉token数量庞大而推理成本高。现有两阶段剪枝中，第一阶段仅依赖视觉编码器显著性，可能过早删除与文本查询相关的token，使后续文本引导阶段失去关键视觉证据。
AI.method: 实证分析表明：在第一阶段剪枝中引入查询引导能更好保留任务相关证据；高方差注意力头对文本查询更敏感。据此提出TReVS：免训练框架，将文本相关性与视觉编码器显著性结合用于pre-LLM剪枝，并利用高方差注意力头在LLM浅至中间层去除任务无关token。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B上，剪去94.4%视觉token的同时保留92.8%未剪枝基线性能，优于此前最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 将查询/文本信息提前融入第一阶段剪枝、并按注意力头方差进行第二阶段剪枝，可在极低token预算下有效保持VLM性能，且无需训练。

title: FedSocket: Recipient-Executable Knowledge Exchange for Heterogeneous Multimodal Federated Learning
summary: Federated knowledge must remain usable by recipients with different modalities, private architectures, and tasks. We present FedSocket, which makes recipient execution a design requirement of the exchanged model. A shared Q combines recipient-computable inputs, task-owned outputs, and ownership-aware aggregation, connecting heterogeneous private models through a common prediction interface. Private models teach local Q copies; the returned Q supports local learning and Joint inference, with only Q parameters and counts exchanged. Across six datasets, FedSocket improves missing-modality recipient accuracy over Local by 14.44 and 15.51 percentage points on MELD and UCF-51. Under matched inference capacity, Joint exceeds independent ensembles by 11.06 points in UCF-51 accuracy and 4.87 points in mean bidirectional Flickr30k R@1. Joint also improves over Q alone on all four heterogeneous endpoints, demonstrating the value of combining local and exchanged predictions. Teacher controls, sharing-path interventions, and component factorials identify the roles of supervision, sharing, and deployment. FedSocket makes exchanged knowledge directly usable from federated training to recipient inference.

AI.tldr: 提出 FedSocket 框架，将"接收方可用性"作为联邦交换模型的设计要求，通过共享 Q 模块连接异构私有模型，实现跨模态、跨架构、跨任务的知识复用。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习中知识交换需适配接收方的不同模态、私有架构与任务，但已有方法多关注发送方视角，交换的知识对接收方往往不可直接使用。
AI.method: 设计共享 Q：整合接收方可计算的输入、任务自有输出与所有权感知的聚合，作为统一预测接口连接异构私有模型；私有模型训练本地 Q 副本，仅交换 Q 参数与样本计数；返回的 Q 支持本地学习与 Joint 推理。
AI.result: 六个数据集上：在 MELD 与 UCF-51 上相比 Local 基线提升缺失模态接收方精度 14.44 与 15.51 个百分点；相同推理容量下，Joint 在 UCF-51 上超过独立集成 11.06 个百分点，在 Flickr30k 平均双向 R@1 上超 4.87；Joint 在四个异构端点均优于单独使用 Q。教师控制、共享路径干预与组件因子实验验证了监督、共享与部署的作用。
AI.conclusion: FedSocket 使交换的知识从联邦训练阶段到接收方推理阶段均可直接使用，为异构联邦场景提供了可落地的知识传递方案。

title: TomoTransformer: Towards a Foundation Model for CT Reconstruction
summary: Supervised deep learning has advanced sparse-view tomographic reconstruction. However, conventional models, which typically map filtered back-projection (FBP) images or sinograms to clean reconstructions, are brittle under distribution shifts. Because they require retraining whenever projection counts and angles, detector resolutions, or data distributions change, their deployment in real-world applications remains limited. To address this, we introduce TomoTransformer, a transformer-based architecture that treats each \textit{local} filtered projection as an individual token and predicts missing views via self-attention. Crucially, TomoTransformer operates in a \emph{back-projection space} that separates projections across spatial locations, making view interpolation geometrically well-posed and invariant to detector size. This design yields a single foundation model that can process any number of input projections, at arbitrary angular locations and detector dimensions, and query any number of target angles without retraining. Trained on a large-scale dataset spanning diverse medical CT anatomies and natural images, TomoTransformer generalizes effectively across anatomies, materials, and resolutions. Extensive evaluations on several benchmark sparse-view datasets show that TomoTransformer significantly outperforms concurrent multi-purpose models like ViewTrans and matches or exceeds strong protocol-specific baselines, while remaining fully agnostic to the number of input and target projections. Furthermore, the model demonstrates robust zero-shot generalization on real experimental nanoscale brain data collected from an X-ray synchrotron, showcasing its practical utility for real-world applications.

AI.tldr: 提出TomotoTransformer：基于Transformer的稀疏视角CT重建基础模型，将滤波投影作为token在反投影空间做自注意力补全缺失视角，单一模型可处理任意数量/角度投影与探测器尺寸，无需重训练，性能超越ViewTrans并在真实纳米脑同步辐射数据上展现零样本泛化。
AI.motivation: 传统有监督稀疏视角重建模型（将FBP图像或正弦图映射为干净重建）在分布偏移下脆弱：投影数量、角度、探测器分辨率或数据分布变化时均需重训练，限制了实际部署。作者希望构建一个无需重训练、可泛化的统一基础模型。
AI.method: TomoTransformer采用Transformer架构，将每个局部滤波投影视为独立token，通过自注意力预测缺失视角。关键设计是工作在"反投影空间"（back-projection space），该空间将投影按空间位置分离，使视角插值在几何上良定义且对探测器尺寸不变。由此单一模型可处理任意数量输入投影、任意角度位置和探测器维度，并查询任意数量目标角度。在大规模覆盖多种医学CT解剖与自然图像的数据集上训练。
AI.result: 在多个稀疏视角基准数据集上，TomoTransformer显著优于ViewTrans等多用途模型，并匹配或超过强的协议专用基线，同时对输入与目标投影数量完全无关。在X射线同步辐射采集的真实纳米级脑实验数据上表现出稳健的零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: TomoTransformer作为单一统一基础模型，实现了跨解剖结构、材料与分辨率的有效泛化，在无需重训练的条件下灵活适配任意投影配置，并在真实实验数据上验证了实用价值，为稀疏视角断层重建提供了可部署的通用方案。

title: Targeted Visual Counterfactual Explanations for Contrastive Vision-Language Model
summary: Current explanation methods for contrastive vision--language models such as CLIP mainly identify important regions without showing how to change the input in order to get a target prediction. We introduce \textbf{M}ask-guided \textbf{A}daptive \textbf{C}ounterfactual \textbf{E}xplanations (\mace), a targeted visual counterfactual method designed specifically for CLIP zero-shot classification. \mace constructs an editable region from either source attribution or source--target attribution differences and expands the mask only when needed to reach a specified target class. A latent diffusion inpainting model then modifies the selected region, while a frozen CLIP model provides modification guidance and anchors the remaining image content to the original input. We evaluate \mace on ImageNet, Food-101, Oxford Pets, and CUB-200. The source-mask variant achieves the highest target top-1 success rate across all four datasets, while the difference-mask variant produces the smallest pixel-level and perceptual changes and the best realism scores. Both variants improve proximity and realism over a Stable Diffusion-only baseline using the same generative backbone. These results show that adaptive mask-guided editing produces effective CLIP counterfactuals. They further reveal a tradeoff between counterfactual validity and source-image preservation.

AI.tldr: 提出MACE，一种面向CLIP零样本分类的掩码引导自适应反事实解释方法，通过构造可编辑区域并用潜在扩散修复模型定向修改，实现目标类别预测。
AI.motivation: 现有CLIP等对比视觉-语言模型的解释方法多只定位重要区域，无法说明如何修改输入以得到目标预测，缺乏定向的反事实解释能力。
AI.method: MACE从源归因或源-目标归因差异构造可编辑区域，仅在需要时扩展掩码以到达指定目标类；随后由潜在扩散修复模型修改所选区域，冻结的CLIP模型提供修改指导并将剩余图像内容锚定到原始输入。
AI.result: 在ImageNet、Food-101、Oxford Pets和CUB-200上评估：源掩码变体在四个数据集上均取得最高目标top-1成功率；差异掩码变体产生最小的像素级与感知变化，并获得最佳真实感得分。两种变体在接近度与真实感上均优于使用相同生成骨干的纯Stable Diffusion基线。
AI.conclusion: 自适应掩码引导编辑能够产生有效的CLIP反事实解释，同时揭示了反事实有效性与源图像保真度之间的权衡关系。

title: VoxelSage: Tool-Augmented 3D CT Analysis and Simulator-Shielded Sequential Resection Planning for Liver Tumors
comment: 21 pages, 10 figures. Technical report. Code at https://github.com/ZJUMAI/VoxelSage
summary: Preoperative liver-tumor assessment requires segmentation, physical-space measurement, visual evidence, and resection planning from the same three-dimensional CT volume. Existing tools often handle these steps separately, while language models cannot reliably compute physical measurements from CT. To provide an integrated workflow, we present VoxelSage, a multi-modal system for two- and three-dimensional visualization, liver-tumor analysis, and preoperative resection planning. Its dual-port architecture separates language-model orchestration from image computation: Port A interprets requests and selects skills, while Port B applies them to CT volumes and segmentation masks and returns structured results. Keeping physical measurements in Port B prevents the LLM from computing them directly and reduces the risk of fabricated numerical results. Eight built-in skills support quantitative analysis, visual evidence generation, three-dimensional reconstruction, segmentation refinement, and sequential resection planning; user-defined skills can extend these functions. For sequence planning, a behavior-cloned neural ranker orders candidate resection targets, while a simulator-based shield checks them against predefined constraints. Across 256 unseen simulator scenes, this approach reduced mean simulated time from 34.274 to 33.388 min (0.886 min, 2.59%) and mean simulated blood loss from 300.847 to 183.852 mL (116.995 mL, 38.89%) relative to a deterministic baseline. These results demonstrate system integration and simulator-level performance, not clinical efficacy or safety. The public implementation is available at https://github.com/ZJUMAI/VoxelSage.

AI.tldr: VoxelSage 是一个双端口多模态系统，将语言模型编排与图像计算分离，实现肝脏肿瘤分割、物理测量、可视化与术前切除规划的一体化流程。
AI.motivation: 术前肝脏肿瘤评估需在同一 CT 体数据上完成分割、物理空间测量、视觉证据与切除规划，但现有工具各步骤相互独立，且语言模型难以可靠地从 CT 计算物理测量，存在数值捏造风险。
AI.method: 采用双端口架构：Port A 由语言模型解释请求并选择技能；Port B 将技能作用于 CT 体数据与分割掩膜并返回结构化结果，使物理测量不交由 LLM 直接计算。内置八项技能覆盖定量分析、视觉证据生成、三维重建、分割精化与序贯切除规划，并支持用户自定义技能扩展；序列规划中使用行为克隆神经排序器对候选切除目标排序，并以基于模拟器的 shield 按预设约束进行校验。
AI.result: 在 256 个未见模拟场景中，相较确定性基线，平均模拟时间由 34.274 min 降至 33.388 min（减少 0.886 min，2.59%），平均模拟出血量由 300.847 mL 降至 183.852 mL（减少 116.995 mL，38.89%）。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明系统集成与模拟器层面的性能改善，不代表临床有效性或安全性；公开实现见 https://github.com/ZJUMAI/VoxelSage。

title: Texture Space Material Diffusion
summary: We present a method for generating high quality materials for 3D objects entirely in texture space. We finetune a video diffusion transformer for text-guided material generation, multi-view material generation, and material upscaling. Our key insight is to use the known projection from image space to texture space, enabling the diffusion process to generalize across arbitrary geometries and texture parameterizations. This approach also avoids the view consistency issues inherent in video and multi-view diffusion models. Because texture space is two dimensional, we can reuse the strong priors of pretrained video diffusion models. We apply our method to high quality material reconstruction from posed photos captured under unknown lighting, as well as to text- and image guided material generation. Our method can scale to high resolutions (8K), 100+ input views, and neural material representations. In quantitative and qualitative evaluations we show state-of-the-art results for material generation and reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出在纹理空间直接生成3D物体高质量材质的方法，微调视频扩散Transformer，实现文本/多视图引导材质生成与材质超分，支持8K分辨率与百级以上输入视图，在材质生成与重建上取得最优结果。
AI.motivation: 现有视频与多视图扩散模型用于材质生成时存在视图一致性问题，且难以泛化到任意几何与纹理参数化。作者希望利用图像空间到纹理空间的已知投影，规避视图一致性缺陷，并复用预训练视频扩散模型的强先验。
AI.method: 在纹理空间（二维）中进行材质生成，微调视频扩散Transformer以支持文本引导材质生成、多视图材质生成和材质超分。核心做法是利用图像空间到纹理空间的已知投影，让扩散过程可跨任意几何与纹理参数化泛化；因纹理空间是二维的，可复用视频扩散模型先验。方法应用于未知光照下拍摄的已定位照片的高质量材质重建，以及文本和图像引导的材质生成。
AI.result: 可扩展到高分辨率（8K）、100+输入视图以及神经材质表示；在定量和定性评估中，材质生成与重建均达到当前最优水平。
AI.conclusion: 在纹理空间建模材质生成可有效规避视图一致性问题，并能借助视频扩散先验实现任意几何的泛化，在材质生成与重建任务上取得领先性能，且具备良好的分辨率、视图数量与表示形式的扩展能力。

title: Exemplar2VQA: A Scalable Exemplar-Driven Visual Question Answering Generation Framework via Multi-Agent Coding
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. 33 pages, 11 figures, 11 tables
summary: Advancing spatial intelligence in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is bottlenecked by the scarcity of complex, scalable 3D question-answer (QA) data. While manual annotation is labor-intensive, directly utilizing LLMs to synthesize these QA pairs often fails due to their inherent deficiencies in spatial and geometric computation. We introduce Exemplar2VQA, a scalable exemplar-driven visual question answering generation framework that rapidly synthesizes large-scale spatial QA pairs in simulated environments via multi-agent coding. By equipping collaborative agents with a meticulously designed library of geometric utilities, Exemplar2VQA bypasses LLMs' spatial reasoning flaws through deterministic code execution. Crucially, the framework exhibits remarkable versatility: taking diverse static object-centric spatial query templates as exemplars, it seamlessly and autonomously scales them into massive, high-fidelity synthetic datasets. Fine-tuning Qwen2.5-VL (3B/7B) exclusively on Exemplar2VQA-generated synthetic indoor data yields significant performance improvements across various diverse benchmarks. Furthermore, its effectiveness is not limited to in-domain indoor datasets but also robustly extends to outdoor and mixed-scene benchmarks. These results establish Exemplar2VQA as a scalable and powerful paradigm for bridging the sim-to-real gap in Embodied AI. Our code is at https://github.com/yingjiayu12/Exemplar2VQA

AI.tldr: Exemplar2VQA：一种基于示例驱动、多智能体编码的3D空间VQA数据自动生成框架，可扩展合成大规模高质量问答数据，显著提升MLLMs空间智能并具跨域泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型的空间智能发展受限于复杂、可扩展的3D问答数据稀缺：人工标注成本高，而直接用LLM合成QA对因其空间与几何计算能力不足而失败。
AI.method: 提出Exemplar2VQA，以示例驱动、多智能体编码的方式在仿真环境中快速合成大规模空间QA对；为协作智能体配备精心设计的几何工具库，通过确定性代码执行规避LLM的空间推理缺陷；以多样化的静态物体中心空间查询模板为示例，自主扩展为大规模高保真合成数据集。
AI.result: 仅用Exemplar2VQA生成的合成室内数据微调Qwen2.5-VL（3B/7B），在多个不同基准上取得显著提升；效果不限于域内室内数据集，还稳健扩展到室外及混合场景基准。
AI.conclusion: Exemplar2VQA为弥合具身智能中的仿真到现实（sim-to-real）差距提供了可扩展且有效的范式。

title: Tracing the Evidence: Faithful Token Attribution Through Vision-Language Reasoning
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) exhibit strong reasoning capabilities, yet the visual and textual evidence supporting the generated responses remains difficult to identify. Faithful token attribution explains an LVLM's response by assigning scores that rank image and prompt tokens by how much the model relies on them, such that removing higher-ranked tokens causes the likelihood of the generated response to drop more rapidly. However, existing token-attribution methods have been developed mainly for text-based language models, and our empirical study reveals two challenges when complex multimodal sources are involved. First, the joint image-text attribution can underrepresent visual evidence relative to text, obscuring the image regions supporting the response. Second, visual evidence may influence the generated response through multiple intermediate reasoning paths, while existing methods trace only a limited subset of these paths, causing important visual contributions to be underestimated. Motivated by these insights, we introduce VTrace, a multimodal token-attribution framework that traces input contributions through intermediate reasoning and calibrates attribution scores across modalities. VTrace constructs pairwise attributions that highlight token-specific contributions and aggregates all forward attribution paths in closed form to account for both direct and indirect contributions. Cross-modal calibration then rescales image and text attribution scores using modality contributions estimated from response-likelihood changes, enabling a unified ranking of input tokens. Evaluations against seven baselines across six visual reasoning benchmarks demonstrate the superior attribution faithfulness. Project page: https://vtrace-attribution.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出VTrace，一种多模态token归因框架，通过追踪中间推理路径并对齐跨模态得分，提升LVLM归因的忠实性。
AI.motivation: LVLM响应所依赖的视觉与文本证据难以识别。现有token归因方法主要面向纯文本语言模型，在多模态场景下存在两个问题：一是图文联合归因会相对低估视觉证据，掩盖支撑响应的图像区域；二是视觉证据可能通过多条中间推理路径影响响应，而现有方法仅追踪部分路径，低估了重要视觉贡献。
AI.method: VTrace构建成对归因以突出token特定贡献，并以闭式形式聚合所有前向归因路径，兼顾直接与间接贡献；随后进行跨模态校准，利用由响应似然变化估计的模态贡献对图像与文本归因得分重新缩放，实现输入token的统一排序。
AI.result: 在六个视觉推理基准上对比七种基线方法，VTrace展现出更优的归因忠实性。
AI.conclusion: 针对多模态归因中的视觉低估与路径遗漏问题，VTrace通过全路径追踪与跨模态校准，实现了更忠实、统一的图文token归因。

title: Are In-Context Images Worth 10 Dimensions?
summary: There has been significant work on understanding the In-Context Learning capabilities of Large Language Models, especially on the induction circuit. For a few-shot classification task, the induction circuit leverages linear representations of each labeled example in-context in order to classify an unlabeled query. However, few works focus on how those linear representations are built in the first place. Leveraging the expressivity of the vision modality compared to text, we uncover a Shared Discriminative Geometry (SDG) inside Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs). It is a low-dimensional space, shared across all image classification tasks, in which in-context images are compressed into linearly separable representations later used to perform classification. We observe that this is the result of the model performing a dimensionality reduction of vision representations in early layers. In order to explain this phenomenon: (1) We show analytically that linear self-attention can perform a dimensionality reduction by projecting in-context data onto its principal components, with each layer implementing one gradient descent step toward this objective. (2) We provide evidence that trained LVLMs reduce the dimensionality of vision representations in early layers via a similar mechanism.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）中存在一个跨任务共享的低维“共享判别几何”（SDG）空间，上下文图像在其中被压缩为线性可分表示；并论证该现象源于早期层的降维机制，理论上等价于线性自注意力逐层执行主成分投影的梯度下降步骤。
AI.motivation: 现有关于大模型上下文学习的研究多集中于归纳电路（induction circuit），即利用上下文中每个带标签样本的线性表示对无标签查询进行分类，但鲜有工作探讨这些线性表示最初是如何构建的。作者借助视觉模态相较文本更强的表达性，试图揭示视觉表示在早期层被压缩、构建的底层机制。
AI.method: 1) 经验观察：在LVLMs中识别出一个低维的共享判别几何（SDG）空间，该空间跨所有图像分类任务共享，上下文图像被压缩为线性可分表示用于分类；2) 理论分析：证明线性自注意力可通过将上下文数据投影到其主成分上实现降维，且每一层相当于朝该目标执行一步梯度下降；3) 实验验证：提供证据表明训练后的LVLMs确实通过类似机制在早期层降低视觉表示的维度。
AI.result: （1）分析性地证明了线性自注意力能够通过投影到主成分实现降维，每一层对应一步梯度下降；（2）提供证据表明训练后的LVLMs在早期层以类似机制降低视觉表示的维度，从而形成共享判别几何空间。
AI.conclusion: LVLMs内部存在跨任务共享的低维判别几何空间，其形成源于早期层的降维过程；该过程在机制上可由线性自注意力逐层逼近主成分投影（等价于梯度下降）来解释，为理解上下文学习中线性表示的构建提供了新视角。

title: Med-RADIO: Reducing All Medical Domains Into One via Multi-Teacher Distillation
summary: The rapid expansion of large-scale medical datasets and computational resources has driven significant progress in medical foundation models. Given the inherent heterogeneity of medical imaging modalities, current research mainly follows two paths: specialized models optimized for specific modalities, and generalist models designed to handle multiple modalities. However, medical generalist models suffer from both insufficient training data scale relative to natural image generalists and inadequate domain-specific depth relative to medical specialists. Empirically, generalist models establish a cross-modality performance baseline, while specialists define the performance ceiling within their respective domains. To elevate this baseline toward these ceilings, we propose Med-RADIO, a medical multi-teacher distillation framework that Reduces All Domains Into One by compressing complementary expertise from multiple domain-specific teachers into a unified medical vision foundation model. Our method curates both generalist and specialist teachers, allocates modality-aligned distillation streams to reorganize generalist pretraining data so it matches specialist domains, and uses a balanced loss to prevent any single teacher from dominating the distillation process. On internal and external classification benchmarks spanning five modalities, Med-RADIO improves over strong medical generalists under linear probing and remains competitive with representative specialists on most evaluated modalities. Code is available at https://github.com/CAIR-HKISI/Med-RADIO.

AI.tldr: 提出 Med-RADIO 医学多教师蒸馏框架，将多个领域专家模型的知识压缩进统一医学视觉基础模型，在五种模态的分类基准上超越通用模型并与专家模型竞争。
AI.motivation: 医学基础模型存在两条路线：面向特定模态的专家模型与面向多模态的通用模型。通用模型相对自然图像通用模型训练数据规模不足，且相对医学专家模型领域深度不够，导致其跨模态性能仅为基础水平，而专家模型代表各领域性能上限。如何将通用基线提升至接近专家上限是本文动机。
AI.method: Med-RADIO 是一个医学多教师蒸馏框架，核心为"Reduces All Domains Into One"：1）选取通用型与专家型教师模型；2）分配模态对齐的蒸馏流，重组通用预训练数据以匹配各专家领域；3）采用平衡损失，防止单一教师在蒸馏中占主导。
AI.result: 在覆盖五种模态的内部与外部分类基准上，Med-RADIO 在线性探测下优于强医学通用模型，并在多数评估模态上与代表性专家模型保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过多教师蒸馏整合互补的领域专家知识，可有效提升医学视觉基础模型的跨模态性能，将通用基线推向专家上限。代码已开源。

title: PAIQ: Patch-Aligned Semantic Injection via Residual Rotation
summary: Language-aligned and self-supervised visual encoders offer complementary strengths in semantic abstraction and spatial detail. Harnessing this complementarity requires enriching local features while retaining distinctions between semantically related patches. We introduce PAIQ, a patch-aligned semantic injection framework that combines content-based cross-encoder matching with orthogonally constrained residual updates. Using DINOv3 patch features as the spatial base, PAIQ aggregates complementary SigLIP features through joint source allocation and injects the aggregate--base differences through a shared orthogonal transformation Q. This rotation adapts update directions while preserving residual norms and pairwise angles. For fixed projected features, we derive conditions for patch separability under similar semantic aggregates and show that rotation adds a nonnegative separation term over direct interpolation when the aggregate is shared. Only the projection and fusion parameters are trained; both visual encoders and the language model remain frozen, and fusion retains 196 visual tokens. Across diverse language backbones, PAIQ yields broad gains in judge-assessed correctness and reductions in hallucination severity over single-encoder interfaces on image description and visual question answering. On the 2B and 9B Qwen backbones, this compact interface outperforms the strongest evaluated fusion or token-compression baselines by about 2.9 correctness points on average.

AI.tldr: 提出PAIQ框架，通过跨编码器匹配与正交约束残差更新实现DINOv3与SigLIP的补丁级语义融合，仅训练少量融合参数即显著提升多模态任务性能。
AI.motivation: 语言对齐编码器（如SigLIP）擅长语义抽象，自监督编码器（如DINOv3）擅长空间细节，二者互补性强。但融合时需在丰富局部特征的同时，保持语义相近补丁间的可区分性。
AI.method: 以DINOv3补丁特征为空间基，通过基于内容的跨编码器匹配聚合SigLIP特征（联合源分配），并将聚合与基之间的差异经共享正交变换Q注入。该旋转在保持残差范数与成对夹角的同时调整更新方向。仅训练投影与融合参数，两个视觉编码器和语言模型均冻结，融合保留196个视觉token。
AI.result: 在固定投影特征下，推导出相似语义聚合下的补丁可分性条件，证明当聚合共享时旋转相比直接插值可带来非负的分离增益。跨多种语言骨干网络，在图像描述与视觉问答任务上，正确性评分普遍提升、幻觉严重度降低。在2B和9B Qwen骨干上，该紧凑接口平均比最强融合或token压缩基线高出约2.9个正确性点。
AI.conclusion: PAIQ以轻量、参数高效的补丁对齐语义注入方式有效融合语言对齐与自监督视觉编码器，在保持token数量不变的前提下提升多模态理解质量并减少幻觉。

title: Honeycomb: Constant-Size Scene Memory Representation for Video World Models
summary: Video world models require persistent scene memory to maintain consistency during long-horizon video generation. Existing spatial memory systems accumulate RGB observations or latent features, causing storage requirements to grow as generation proceeds. We introduce **Honeycomb**, a video world model built on **HexMemory**, a compact low-rank representation that stores scene features in a fixed-size memory comprising six spatial and spatiotemporal planes. A feed-forward writer maps each newly generated video chunk to plane features. As the spatial coverage or temporal range expands, HexMemory warps the existing planes while preserving their dimensions, then integrates new features through confidence-weighted pooling and a learned residual correction. A reader retrieves latent features from HexMemory to condition subsequent video generation. Because the writer processes only observations from the latest chunk, Honeycomb avoids per-scene optimization and repeated processing of the full generation history. Experiments on WorldScore and RealEstate10K demonstrate strong video generation quality and robust consistency when revisiting previously observed regions, while maintaining constant feature-storage requirements throughout generation. Code and additional visualizations are available on our https://jackswl.github.io/honeycomb/.

AI.tldr: Honeycomb 是一种基于 HexMemory（固定尺寸的低秩六平面记忆）的视频世界模型，实现恒定存储下的长时程一致视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型的空间记忆系统累积 RGB 观测或潜在特征，导致存储需求随生成过程不断增长，难以支撑长时程视频生成的一致性。
AI.method: 核心为 HexMemory：固定尺寸记忆，包含六个空间与时空平面，采用低秩表示。前馈写入器将最新生成的视频块映射为平面特征；随空间覆盖或时间范围扩展，HexMemory 对现有平面进行形变同时保持维度不变，再通过置信度加权池化与学习式残差修正融合新特征。读取器从 HexMemory 检索潜在特征以条件化后续视频生成。写入器仅处理最新块观测，避免逐场景优化与对完整生成历史的重复处理。
AI.result: 在 WorldScore 与 RealEstate10K 上展现出色的视频生成质量，在重访已观测区域时具备稳健一致性，且整个生成过程中特征存储需求保持恒定。
AI.conclusion: Honeycomb 通过固定尺寸低秩平面记忆替代无限累积式记忆，兼顾长时程一致性与恒定存储开销，为可扩展的视频世界模型提供可行方案。

title: VIF-Bench: Evaluating Visual Instruction Following in Multi-Reference Image Generation
summary: Recent multimodal image generation models can take multiple images and textual instructions as input, enabling reference-based generation guided not only by text but also by visual instructions such as layouts, arrows, and pose cues. However, existing benchmarks do not evaluate the joint setting in which multiple references must be composed under multiple and heterogeneous visual-instruction images. To address this gap, we introduce VIF-Bench, a benchmark of 1,241 tasks designed to assess the edge of model capabilities in this joint setting by covering: (i) multi-reference generation (up to 7) under multiple heterogeneous visual instructions (up to 6), (ii) cases where reference images can potentially compete with visual instructions (e.g., a strongly posed subject vs. a target pose), and (iii) controlled comparison of visual instructions with text descriptions at different levels of specificity. Using these capabilities, we uncover three findings: (1) models face an adherence-artifact trade-off: once models reach stronger visual instruction adherence, stronger adherence tends to coincide with more instruction artifacts in generated images, (2) visual instruction adherence tends to be lower on tasks whose reference images carry a salient state of the controlled attribute (e.g., a neon-lit subject under a light-direction instruction), most consistently for light and wind, and (3) for models that can understand visual instructions, it is often better to provide visual constraints directly rather than describe them in text; when using text, a moderate level of detail works better than an exhaustive description. VIF-Bench is released as an open benchmark to establish a basis for fair comparison in controllable multi-reference image generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VIF-Bench，一个包含 1,241 个任务的多参考图像+多异构视觉指令联合生成评测基准，并揭示模型在指令遵循与伪影间的权衡等问题。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态图像生成模型可同时接受多张参考图与文本指令，甚至支持布局、箭头、姿态等视觉指令，但已有基准未评测"多参考图 + 多张异构视觉指令图"的联合设置，导致该能力缺乏公平比较的基础。
AI.method: 构建 VIF-Bench，含 1,241 个任务，覆盖三类设置：(i) 最多 7 张参考图搭配最多 6 张异构视觉指令图的多参考生成；(ii) 参考图与视觉指令可能冲突的情形（如有强烈姿态的主体 vs. 目标姿态）；(iii) 视觉指令与不同具体程度文本描述的可控对比。
