AI.result: 得到三项发现：(1) 模型存在"遵循度-伪影"权衡，视觉指令遵循度越高，生成图像中的指令伪影往往越多；(2) 当参考图携带被控属性的显著状态时（如霓虹光主体配合光照方向指令），指令遵循度偏低，在光照与风向上尤为一致；(3) 对能理解视觉指令的模型，直接提供视觉约束常优于用文本描述；若用文本，中等细节程度优于事无巨细的描述。
AI.conclusion: VIF-Bench 作为开放基准发布，为可控多参考图像生成建立公平比较的基础。

title: PolyOCR-Venus: Unified OCR Foundation Models for Text-Centric Visual Intelligence
summary: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) is evolving from plain-text transcription toward general visual intelligence, requiring models to recognize, localize, and reason over textual information in complex visual environments. However, existing OCR systems often excel at only some tasks and struggle to balance recognition, parsing, and reasoning across scenarios. In this report, we present PolyOCR, a family of unified OCR foundation models of varying scales. PolyOCR combines a shared instruction-following framework with a large-scale data engine that converts heterogeneous visual resources into quality-verified OCR supervision. We introduce Competence-Guided Policy Optimization, which combines verifier-based Group Relative Policy Optimization with on-policy distillation through sample-wise routing based on teacher reliability and the teacher--student competence gap. We also introduce OCRBench v2.1, our revision of OCRBench v2 with manually verified annotation corrections and task-aligned scoring metrics. Extensive experiments across OCRBench v2.1, CC-OCR, in-house KIE Benchmark, OmniDocBench v1.6 and MDPBench demonstrate that PolyOCR achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive performance.

AI.tldr: PolyOCR 是一个统一 OCR 基础模型系列，通过共享指令框架、大规模数据引擎与能力引导策略优化，在多个 OCR 基准上实现 SOTA 或极具竞争力表现。
AI.motivation: OCR 正从纯文本转录向通用视觉智能演进，要求模型在复杂视觉环境中识别、定位并推理文本信息。然而现有 OCR 系统通常仅擅长部分任务，难以在识别、解析和推理之间取得跨场景平衡。
AI.method: 提出 PolyOCR 统一 OCR 基础模型系列（多规模），结合共享指令跟随框架与将异构视觉资源转化为质量校验 OCR 监督的大规模数据引擎；引入 Competence-Guided Policy Optimization，融合基于验证器的 Group Relative Policy Optimization 与基于教师可靠性和师生能力差距的样本级路由在线蒸馏；并发布 OCRBench v2.1，包含人工校验的标注修正与任务对齐评分指标。
AI.result: 在 OCRBench v2.1、CC-OCR、内部 KIE Benchmark、OmniDocBench v1.6 和 MDPBench 上的大量实验表明，PolyOCR 达到 SOTA 或极具竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: PolyOCR 通过统一框架、数据引擎与策略优化，有效平衡 OCR 的识别、解析与推理能力，推动 OCR 向通用视觉智能发展。

title: The Camera Inside the Editor: Reading the Implicit Camera of Image Editors with Painted Calibration Patterns
summary: Instruction-based image editors insert objects, restyle scenes and render new viewpoints, but it is unknown which camera they assume when they paint into a photograph. Asked to cover the floor with a checkerboard, an editor paints projective structure from which classical vanishing-point geometry reads pitch, roll, focal length, yaw and, on renders, the principal point, without any training. Unlike a calibrator such as GeoCalib, which estimates the camera of an image, this isolates the camera under which the editor paints. On 120 rendered cameras with exact ground truth, Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 paints tile edges that meet their vanishing points within 0.26 degrees, and its implicit camera matches the true one to 0.8 degrees in pitch and 6% in focal length, more accurately than GeoCalib except in roll. Asked to draw the horizon or mark a vanishing point instead, the editor fails, so this knowledge is revealed by painting and not by the explicit tasks we tried. The implicit camera has two priors: roll is pulled towards level (slope 0.71), and telephoto perspective towards a default of about 30 mm, which roughly matches the camera the models paint without any scene. For Qwen, the priors do not grow when blur removes four fifths of the line evidence. They are stronger on real photographs, and on NYUv2 a shorter wording of the task removes the difference for roll. On photographs from a 24--240 mm zoom lens the painted perspective grows with only 0.62 of the lens's slope, while GeoCalib and MoGe-2 saturate at about 52 and 42 mm. FLUX.1 Kontext and LongCat-Image-Edit are pulled much harder. Finally, from a level camera a camera-control LoRA executes pose commands at only 50--70% of their strength, and a board painted into its output agrees with the camera it produced.

AI.tldr: 指令式图像编辑器在作画时会隐含地"假设"一个相机，且该相机可从所画内容的透视几何中被无反推读出。
AI.motivation: 指令式图像编辑器能够插入物体、重塑场景、渲染新视角，但人们并不清楚它们在往照片中作画时隐含假定了什么相机模型，这一隐含相机的性质此前未被量化研究。
AI.method: 让编辑器在照片地面绘制棋盘格，从其呈现的透视结构出发，用经典消失点几何在无需训练的条件下解读出pitch、roll、焦距、yaw（并在渲染图上读出主点）；以此与GeoCalib等标定器区分——后者估计图像本身相机，而此法隔离出"编辑器作画时所依据的相机"。在120个具有精确真值的渲染相机上测试，并进一步考查模糊、真实照片、NYUv2措辞变体、24–240 mm变焦照片，以及FLUX.1 Kontext、LongCat-Image-Edit、相机控制LoRA等对照设置。
AI.result: Qwen-Image-Edit-2511所绘砖块边缘与其消失点吻合在0.26度内，其隐含相机在pitch上匹配真值至0.8度、焦距匹配至6%，除roll外比GeoCalib更准确；但要求直接画地平线或标记消失点则失败，说明该知识只通过作画显现。隐含相机存在两种先验：roll被拉向水平（斜率0.71），长焦透视被拉向约30 mm默认值；模糊去除五分之四线条证据时Qwen先验不增强，在真实照片上更强，NYUv2上更短措辞可消除roll差异。24–240 mm变焦照片上，所绘透视只以镜头斜率的0.62增长，而GeoCalib和MoGe-2分别在约52 mm和42 mm处饱和；FLUX.1 Kontext与LongCat-Image-Edit被拉扯得更强。此外，水平相机下相机控制LoRA仅以50–70%强度执行姿态命令，其输出中绘制的棋盘与所产生的相机一致。
AI.conclusion: 指令式图像编辑器在作画时携带一个可测量的隐含相机，可由透视几何无反推提取；该相机带有水平化roll与约30 mm焦距的强先验，且这些先验在真实照片与不同模型间表现各异，为理解并校准编辑器的三维一致性提供了新途径。

title: Multi-Site Real-World Performance of Commercial AI for Pulmonary and Incidental Pulmonary Embolism Detection
summary: Pulmonary embolism (PE) is a leading cause of cardiovascular mortality, yet the real-world performance of FDA-cleared AI detection models remains incompletely characterized. We retrospectively evaluated two FDA-cleared AI algorithms from a single commercial platform (Aidoc Medical BriefCase), one for PE triage on dedicated CT pulmonary angiography (CTPA; n = 30,678) and one for incidental PE (iPE) detection on routine contrast-enhanced CTs (n = 37,191), across a 17-facility academic health system. Reference-standard labels were extracted from radiology reports using a validated LLM pipeline (97% accuracy, kappa = 0.94). The PE model achieved 86.8% sensitivity and 99.1% specificity, with sensitivity declining from 99.3% for saddle emboli to 72.9% for subsegmental PE, and from 89.7% for acute to 65.3% for non-acute PE. The iPE model achieved 73.5% sensitivity and 99.8% specificity. Both models demonstrated lower sensitivity than FDA-clearance benchmarks while exceeding cleared specificity, with diminishing performance for peripheral and non-acute emboli mirroring known human reader limitations and underscoring the need for standardized post-market surveillance of AI-enabled medical devices.

AI.tldr: 回顾性评估单一商业平台两款FDA获批AI算法（CTPA肺栓塞分诊与常规增强CT偶发肺栓塞检测），覆盖17家机构，参考标准由经验证的LLM流程从报告提取。两模型敏感性均低于FDA获批基准但特异性更高，对周边型及非急性栓塞性能下降。
AI.motivation: 肺栓塞是心血管死亡的主要原因，但FDA获批AI检测模型在真实世界的表现尚不明确，缺乏上市后性能验证。
AI.method: 在17家机构的学术医疗系统中回顾性评估单一商业平台（Aidoc Medical BriefCase）的两款FDA获批算法：一款用于专用CTPA肺栓塞分诊（n=30,678），一款用于常规增强CT偶发肺栓塞（iPE）检测（n=37,191）。参考标准标签通过经验证的LLM流程（准确率97%，kappa=0.94）从放射学报告中提取。
AI.result: 肺栓塞分诊模型敏感性86.8%、特异性99.1%，敏感性从鞍状栓塞的99.3%降至亚段肺栓塞的72.9%，从急性肺栓塞的89.7%降至非急性肺栓塞的65.3%。iPE模型敏感性73.5%、特异性99.8%。
AI.conclusion: 两款模型敏感性均低于FDA获批基准而特异性高于获批水平，对周边型和非急性栓塞性能下降，与已知人类阅片者局限相似，凸显对AI医疗设备开展标准化上市后监测的必要性。

title: HiRAE: Hierarchical Representation Autoencoding with Residual Budgets
summary: Pretrained visual representations support image generation, but may not fully preserve the fine-grained details needed for faithful reconstruction. Meanwhile, intermediate encoder layers contain complementary visual details, but learning to fuse them for reconstruction can produce a latent distribution that is difficult to model. Existing fusion methods require empirical tuning of layer selection or staged optimization of fusion and decoding, increasing configuration effort or training complexity. We introduce HiRAE (Hierarchical Representation Autoencoder), which learns a hierarchical fusion framework over the full encoder hierarchy to improve reconstruction fidelity while maintaining compatibility with generative modeling. HiRAE groups encoder layers by depth and learns residual corrections to the deepest representation. Group-wise norm caps bound these corrections relative to the deep anchor, with tighter budgets for shallower groups. Our HiRAE-24 preserves the latent token count and channel dimension. On ImageNet-256, HiRAE-24 reduces reconstruction FID from 0.299 to 0.209 relative to RAEv2 while maintaining competitive guided generation quality. For text-to-image generation, HiRAE-24 improves alignment over RAEv2 on GenEval, DPG-Bench, and GenAI-Bench both before and after supervised fine-tuning. Under the same generator-training and evaluation protocol, post-fine-tuning GenEval increases from 84.86 to 87.70.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HiRAE，一个在完整编码器层级上学习分层融合的自编码器框架，在保持生成建模兼容性的同时提升重建保真度。
AI.motivation: 预训练视觉表示虽能支持图像生成，但未必能完整保留忠实重建所需的细粒度细节。编码器中间层含有互补的视觉细节，但学习融合它们进行重建可能产生难以建模的潜在分布。现有融合方法需经验性地选择层或分阶段优化融合与解码，增加了配置成本或训练复杂度。
AI.method: HiRAE 按深度对编码器层分组，学习针对最深表示的残差修正；通过组级范数上限（group-wise norm caps）约束这些修正相对于深层锚点的幅度，对更浅的组施加更紧的预算。HiRAE-24 保持潜在 token 数量与通道维度不变。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet-256 上，HiRAE-24 相对 RAEv2 将重建 FID 从 0.299 降至 0.209，同时保持有竞争力的引导生成质量。在文生图任务中，HiRAE-24 在 GenEval、DPG-Bench 与 GenAI-Bench 上于监督微调前后均优于 RAEv2 的对齐效果；相同生成器训练与评测协议下，微调后 GenEval 从 84.86 提升至 87.70。
AI.conclusion: HiRAE 通过分层残差融合与范数约束，在不增加潜在维度、不引入分阶段优化的情况下，显著提升重建保真度并改善生成对齐。

title: A Benchmark & Dataset for Detecting AI-Manipulated Visual Evidence in the Court System
summary: Photographic evidence is becoming increasingly vulnerable to forms of alteration and fabrication that existing legal and technical workflows are not well equipped to evaluate. Surveillance frames, dashcam stills, and phone photographs may be used to establish presence, sequence, causation, damage, or identity, yet contemporary generative systems allow non-experts to alter or fabricate such images through ordinary prompt-based interfaces. Existing image-forensics benchmarks provide important resources for face manipulation, classical tampering, and general synthetic-image detection, but they are not organized around the forms of visual evidence submitted in courts, the localized edits that can change what an exhibit appears to prove, or the consumer-tool threat model now facing the justice system. We introduce the CIFAR Synthetic Evidence Corpus for Detecting AI-Manipulated Images, a benchmark for evidentiary image authentication in court and justice-system contexts. The corpus contains 1,505 photographic items, including 720 authentic controls and 785 manipulated or fabricated images, spanning surveillance, dashcam, and consumer-photo imagery. Manipulations are organized into scene-condition edits, localized element edits, and full fabrications produced with contemporary generative systems. Each item is released with structured metadata covering source provenance, manipulation tier, subtype, generator, prompt template, and scene attributes, enabling controlled evaluation beyond aggregate binary detection. We also establish baselines with publicly available image-manipulation detectors, showing that current systems exhibit error profiles that remain problematic for evidentiary use. The dataset, prompts, metadata, code, and baseline evaluation scripts are released to support research on visual evidence authentication, information integrity, and trustworthy AI for the justice system.

AI.tldr: 该文发布CIFAR合成证据语料库，面向司法场景的图像鉴真基准，含1,505项图像及结构化元数据。
AI.motivation: 照片证据易被篡改伪造，现有法律与技术流程难以评估；现有图像取证基准未围绕法庭提交的视觉证据形式、可改变证明对象的局部编辑，以及司法系统面临的消费级工具威胁模型进行组织。
AI.method: 构建CIFAR合成证据语料库：1,505项图像（720真实对照、785篡改或伪造），覆盖监控、行车记录仪、消费级照片；篡改分为场景条件编辑、局部元素编辑、完整伪造三层，每项附来源、篡改层级、子类型、生成器、提示模板、场景属性等结构化元数据；并用公开图像篡改检测器建立基线。
AI.result: 现有检测系统在证据用途下仍表现出有问题的错误分布（error profiles）。
AI.conclusion: 发布数据集、提示、元数据、代码与基线评估脚本，支持视觉证据鉴真、信息完整性与司法可信AI研究。

title: Planetary Feature Fields are Scalable Earth Representations
summary: Satellite observations, precomputed embeddings, and map products describe the same evolving Earth, yet are stored as independent, petabyte-scale data products. Their continued growth calls for compact representations of multiple products while preserving spatial and temporal detail. We introduce Planetary Feature Fields (PFFs), which exploit redundancy across data products by modeling them jointly as continuous functions of space and time at planetary scale. PFFs are spatially local explicit-implicit (hybrid) neural fields. Each field shares a factored feature volume---a decomposition of an explicit 3D grid with smaller factors---across products, while lightweight implicit decoders reconstruct individual products across multiple timesteps. PFFs reconstruct EO products over space and time more accurately than single-product fields at matched compression rates. At $1800\times$ compression relative to the uncompressed source data, reconstructed features retain approximately $90\%$ or more of the performance achieved with the original features on pixel-level segmentation, change detection, and patch-level classification tasks. PFFs can add new timesteps by extending their factored feature volumes and add new products by attaching new decoders, while leaving existing outputs unchanged. PFFs reduce end-to-end feature access latency by an order of magnitude relative to evaluated API and cloud-storage pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Planetary Feature Fields（PFFs），一种行星尺度的时空连续神经场，通过跨产品共享显式-隐式混合特征体积，实现多源对地观测产品的联合压缩与重构。
AI.motivation: 卫星观测、预计算嵌入与地图产品描述的是同一动态地球，但被存储为彼此独立的PB级数据产品。其持续增长要求既能压缩多种产品、又能保留时空细节的紧凑表示，而现有方法缺乏跨产品的冗余利用。
AI.method: PFFs将多个数据产品联合建模为行星尺度上空间与时间的连续函数。其形式为空间局部化的显式-隐式混合神经场：所有产品共享一个因子化特征体积（由显式3D网格分解为更小因子构成），而轻量级隐式解码器负责在多个时间步上重构各单独产品。
AI.result: 在相同压缩率下，PFFs对地观测产品的时空重构精度优于单产品神经场。相对未压缩源数据实现1800倍压缩时，重构特征在像素级分割、变化检测和块级分类任务上仍保留约90%或以上的原始特征性能。可通过扩展因子化特征体积添加新时间步，通过挂接新解码器添加新产品，且不改变已有输出。端到端特征访问延迟相比所评估的API与云存储流水线降低一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: PFFs以共享因子化特征体积加多解码器的联合神经场架构，在保持时空细节和高下游任务性能的同时大幅压缩多源对地观测产品，并具备可扩展的增量更新能力与显著降低的访问延迟。

title: CHOQOLATE: Organizing Concept Bottleneck Latent Spaces with Choquet Integrals
summary: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) built on vision-language models such as CLIP represent a latent space as human-understandable concepts. These representations are unfaithful: related concepts are entangled, so individual scores do not reflect their intended meaning. We propose CHOQOLATE, an interpretable-by-design layer based on 2-additive Choquet integrals, which merges correlated concepts into compact nodes. Across four datasets, CHOQOLATE achieves a favorable accuracy-interpretability trade-off, with weight-sparse and semantically coherent nodes. A closed-form gradient derivation, backed by experiments, explains why Choquet layers drive this organization without explicit supervision. Choquet weights also map directly to Shapley values, which enables test-time intervention. On standard bias-mitigation benchmarks, suppressing spurious concepts after training performs on par with methods that require group annotations or retraining, while needing neither.

AI.tldr: 提出CHOQOLATE，一种基于2-可加Choquet积分的可解释层，将相关概念合并为紧凑节点，在四个数据集上实现更优的精度-可解释性权衡，并支持测试时干预。
AI.motivation: 基于CLIP等视觉-语言模型构建的概念瓶颈模型（CBM）将隐空间表示为人类可理解的概念，但这些表示不忠实：相关概念彼此纠缠，使得单个概念得分无法反映其预期含义。
AI.method: 提出CHOQOLATE，一种以2-可加Choquet积分为基础的可解释-by-design层，将相关概念合并为紧凑节点；给出闭式梯度推导以解释Choquet层在无显式监督下驱动该组织方式的原因；Choquet权重直接映射为Shapley值以支持测试时干预。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上取得有利的精度-可解释性权衡，节点权重稀疏且语义连贯；实验验证闭式梯度推导；在标准去偏基准上，训练后抑制虚假概念的效果与需要群体标注或重训练的方法相当，且两者皆不需要。
AI.conclusion: CHOQOLATE通过Choquet积分实现概念的结构化合并，兼具可解释性与精度，并借助Choquet权重-Shapley值映射实现无需额外标注或重训练的测试时干预与去偏。

title: ByteTraX: Enhancing the ByteTrack Architecture with Optimised Thresholding
summary: The ByteTrack algorithm is a widely used and computationally efficient multi-object tracking architecture. Its core innovation lies in the combination of lenient bounding box associations with tracklet similarity matching to robustly deal with object occlusions. However, this strategy is nevertheless vulnerable to erroneous track reclassification and identity switching, as detection confidence scores dictate association priority. To address this, I present a simple enhancement of the ByteTrack architecture, named ByteTraX, that optimises track continuity via a single unified matching threshold, while penalising identity switches through stringent track initiation criteria. This approach achieves consistently improved performance across a range of diverse benchmarks including GMOT-40, LC-MOT, SportsMOT, TeamTrack, DAMUNT, and DeepSea-MOT, while simultaneously increasing processing speed by >10%. Specifically, results demonstrate a >40% reduction in identity switches, accompanied by mean increases in HOTA of 3.6, IDF1 of 5.6, and FPS of 6.3. As such, adoption of the ByteTraX algorithm has the potential to substantially enhance tracking performance over the ByteTrack baseline, while retaining the efficiency needed for real-time deployment. To facilitate usage, I provide the source code, integration functionality for the YOLO family of object detection models, and deployment instructions via an open source repository.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ByteTraX，对 ByteTrack 多目标跟踪架构进行简单改进：采用统一匹配阈值优化轨迹连续性，并通过严格轨迹初始化准则抑制身份切换，在多基准上实现性能与速度双提升。
AI.motivation: ByteTrack 依赖宽松的边界框关联与轨迹相似度匹配来应对遮挡，但其关联优先级由检测置信度决定，容易导致错误的轨迹重分类与身份切换（ID switch）。因此需要一个在保持计算效率的同时提升跟踪连续性的改进方案。
AI.method: 对 ByteTrack 架构进行简单增强，命名为 ByteTraX：使用单一统一匹配阈值来优化轨迹连续性，同时通过严格的轨迹初始化准则来惩罚身份切换。
AI.result: 在 GMOT-40、LC-MOT、SportsMOT、TeamTrack、DAMUNT、DeepSea-MOT 等多个基准上性能一致提升；处理速度提高超过 10%。具体表现为身份切换减少超过 40%，HOTA 平均提升 3.6，IDF1 平均提升 5.6，FPS 平均提升 6.3。
AI.conclusion: 采用 ByteTraX 可在保留实时部署所需效率的前提下，相较 ByteTrack 基线显著提升跟踪性能。作者同时提供源码、YOLO 系列检测模型的集成功能及开源仓库部署说明。

title: Pixel-Level Transformers in Remote Sensing: A Canopy Height Case Study
summary: Predicting canopy height from medium-resolution satellite imagery is a common and scalable approach for assessing the condition of the world's forests, which play a crucial role in climate change mitigation. While Transformer-based architectures have shown strong performance in many domains, their straightforward application to dense (i.e., pixel-level) regression tasks often yields suboptimal results. In particular, the patch size has a crucial impact on the model performance. In this work, we consider pixel-level attention schemes and show that the resulting models generally outperform those relying on larger patch sizes. However, pixel-level attention can be a prohibitively resource-intensive operation. For this reason, we conduct an extensive experimental study using efficient attention variants to identify favorable trade-offs between prediction quality and resource requirements, facilitating the practical deployment of the proposed models. In addition, we perform a comprehensive comparison with several well-established models in the field and show that, with suitable hyperparameter choices, Transformer-based architectures can outperform competing approaches. Our findings provide practical guidance for designing models for pixel-level regression tasks on medium-resolution satellite imagery, including canopy height and biomass estimation, soil moisture mapping, and yield forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于Transformer的像素级回归（树冠高度预测），论证像素级注意力优于大patch方案，并通过高效注意力变体实验在预测质量与资源开销之间寻找平衡，最终在合适超参数下超越领域内成熟模型。
AI.motivation: 利用中分辨率卫星影像预测树冠高度是评估全球森林状况的可扩展手段，而森林对减缓气候变化至关重要。Transformer虽在诸多领域表现优异，但直接用于稠密（像素级）回归任务时效果欠佳，其中patch尺寸对性能影响关键，且像素级注意力计算资源开销极大，限制了实际部署。
AI.method: 采用像素级注意力机制（pixel-level attention）构建Transformer模型，与依赖较大patch尺寸的方案进行对比；并开展大规模实验研究，引入多种高效注意力变体（efficient attention variants），以评估预测质量与资源需求之间的权衡；同时与领域内多个成熟模型进行系统对比并调优超参数。
AI.result: 像素级注意力方案的模型总体优于使用较大patch尺寸的模型；高效注意力变体可在质量与开销间取得有利折衷；在合适的超参数选择下，基于Transformer的架构能够超越竞争方法。
AI.conclusion: 研究为中分辨率卫星影像上的像素级回归任务（包括树冠高度与生物量估计、土壤湿度制图、产量预测等）提供了模型设计的实践指导，表明像素级注意力配合高效实现与恰当超参数可推动Transformer在该类任务中的实用部署。

title: WINGS: Reference-Free Gaussian Splatting Inpainting with 3D-Native Generative Priors
summary: Inpainting 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes, a key challenge in 3D editing, requires generating plausible content within a masked region of 3D space. Prior approaches rely on 2D diffusion models to produce one or several inpainted reference views, making them susceptible to challenges associated with multi-view inconsistency and lengthy optimization times. Departing from these approaches, we introduce a reference-free Gaussian splatting inpainting method operating natively in 3D. Our method leverages the embedding space of a large, pre-trained 3D prior, combined with a structure completion network to feed a generative prior which reconstructs the missing region's geometry and appearance. Performing content generation entirely in 3D, it avoids the need to reconcile inconsistencies of multiple inpainted reference images, and is faster than related 2D-based methods. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method qualitatively and quantitatively, through extensive experiments and a user study. To the best of our knowledge, this work is the first Gaussian splatting inpainting method to operate in the learned representation space of a 3D-native generative prior without relying on inpainted reference views.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需参考视图的3D高斯泼溅修复方法，直接在预训练3D先验的嵌入空间中完成缺失区域的几何与外观生成。
AI.motivation: 3D编辑中的高斯泼溅场景修复需在3D空间掩码区域生成合理内容。现有方法依赖2D扩散模型生成一个或多个修复参考视图，易受多视图不一致困扰且优化耗时较长。
AI.method: 利用大规模预训练3D先验的嵌入空间，结合结构补全网络，将信息馈入生成先验，从而在3D原生空间中重建缺失区域的几何与外观，全程不依赖修复后的参考视图。
AI.result: 通过大量实验与用户研究，在定性和定量层面验证了方法的有效性，并显示其相比相关2D方法速度更快。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个在3D原生生成先验的学习表示空间中运行、且不依赖修复参考视图的高斯泼溅修复方法。

title: Minkowski Attractor Networks: Closed-Form Hyperbolic Flows for Visual Representations
summary:
Geometric representation learning predominantly scaffolds representations onto flat Euclidean subspaces or compact product tori ($\mathbb{T}^K$). However, flat manifolds possess vanishing curvature and polynomial volume growth, inherently suffering from metric distortion when embedding multi-scale, tree-like visual hierarchies. While hyperbolic spaces ($\mathbb{H}^m$) circumvent this via constant negative curvature ($K<0$) and exponential volume expansion, prior hyperbolic deep architectures are hindered by computationally cumbersome Riemannian optimization, non-linear gyrovector calculus, and floating-point instabilities.
  In this work, we introduce \textbf{Minkowski Attractor Networks (MAN)}, an operator-splitting-inspired framework that embeds representations within pseudo-Riemannian Minkowski spacetime ($\mathbb{R}^{1,m}$). By framing hyperbolic manifolds as quadric level sets, MAN resolves hyperbolic geometry by combining linear Lorentz group transport with non-linear cone lifting and closed-form radial rescaling, evaluating in a single forward pass without numerical ODE solvers or iterative retractions. We establish \textbf{MAN-2D} ($\mathbb{R}^{1,1} \to \mathbb{H}^1$) as our primary, high-throughput visual backbone, which maximizes channel factorization granularity into $D/2$ independent two-dimensional Minkowski blocks. We further formulate \textbf{MAN-4D} ($\mathbb{R}^{1,3} \to \mathbb{H}^3$) as a spacetime extension, leveraging a commuting Cartan-subalgebra parameterization of $\mathrm{SO}^+(1,3)$ to evaluate 4D Lorentz isometries via two commuting 2D planar maps without matrix-exponential overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出Minkowski Attractor Networks（MAN），一种基于算子分裂思想、在伪黎曼闵可夫斯基时空（ℝ^{1,m}）中嵌入表征的框架。通过将双曲流形视为二次曲面水平集，MAN以线性Lorentz群输运、非线性锥提升和闭式径向重标定相结合的方式求解双曲几何，可在单次前向传播中完成，无需ODE求解器或迭代回缩。提出MAN-2D（ℝ^{1,1}→ℍ^1）作为高吞吐视觉骨干，以及MAN-4D（ℝ^{1,3}→ℍ^3）作为时空扩展。
AI.motivation: 几何表征学习多依赖平坦欧氏子空间或紧致乘积环面（T^K）。平坦流形曲率为零、体积多项式增长，在嵌入多尺度、树状视觉层级时会产生固有的度量畸变。双曲空间（ℍ^m）凭借常负曲率（K<0）和指数级体积膨胀可缓解此问题，但既有双曲深度架构受制于计算繁重的黎曼优化、非线性陀螺矢量演算与浮点数值不稳定。
AI.method: MAN将双曲流形刻画为伪黎曼闵可夫斯基时空（ℝ^{1,m}）中的二次曲面水平集，用线性Lorentz群输运、非线性锥提升与闭式径向重标定组合求解双曲几何，单次前向传播即完成评估，无需数值ODE求解或迭代回缩。提出MAN-2D（ℝ^{1,1}→ℍ^1）作为主高吞吐视觉骨干，将通道分解粒度最大化到D/2个独立的二维闵可夫斯基块；并构建MAN-4D（ℝ^{1,3}→ℍ^3）作为时空扩展，利用SO^+(1,3)的可交换Cartan子代数参数化，通过两个可交换的二维平面映射评估四维Lorentz等距，避免矩阵指数开销。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体实验数值或基准结果；仅说明MAN在单次前向传播中实现双曲几何评估，MAN-2D实现D/2个独立二维块的通道分解，MAN-4D通过可交换Cartan子代数参数化以两个二维平面映射完成四维Lorentz等距，规避矩阵指数开销。
AI.conclusion: MAN以算子分裂视角把双曲表征学习转化为闵可夫斯基时空中的线性输运、锥提升与径向重标定组合，规避黎曼优化、陀螺矢量演算与数值不稳定问题；MAN-2D提供高吞吐视觉骨干，MAN-4D以Cartan子代数参数化高效处理四维Lorentz等距，为双曲深度架构提供更稳定、更高效的计算路径。

title: ReCaVSR: One-Step Streaming Diffusion Video Super-Resolution with Recycled Latents and Learned Cache Routing
comment: The code is available at https://github.com/kopperx/ReCaVSR
summary: Real-time diffusion-based video super-resolution (VSR) is in high demand for online streaming, yet stringent latency requirements often compromise generative fidelity. We propose ReCaVSR, a Wan2.2-based, one-step framework for streaming VSR that builds on two observations: recycled SR latents retain local temporal context, reducing the need for full historical Key-Value (KV) caches; and individual transformer layers benefit from distinct temporal scopes. ReCaVSR combines three complementary designs: (i) layer-wise cache routing with recycled SR latents: each DiT layer learns its KV-cache temporal scope under a cache budget and exports a static inference schedule, while recycled SR latents propagate local context by conditioning each new block on the model's own preceding predictions. (ii) Multi-Scope Query (MSQ) Discriminator: a compositional discriminator combining global, spatial-window, and temporal-tube feedback for holistic realism, local texture generation, and temporal stability. (iii) LR-conditioned adaptation of FlashDecoder: a VAE decoder that incorporates LR observations for efficient latent decoding. ReCaVSR enables streaming VSR without iterative sampling or full historical KV-cache materialization. Experiments on synthetic and real-world VSR benchmarks show better perceptual quality, temporal consistency, and streaming efficiency than representative VSR baselines. At $1080{\times}1920$ output resolution on a single NVIDIA A100-80GB, ReCaVSR achieves 21.20 FPS with 15.16 GB peak allocated GPU memory, running 2.72$\times$ faster while using 38.0\% less peak allocated memory than FlashVSR Tiny. The code is available at https://github.com/kopperx/ReCaVSR.

AI.tldr: ReCaVSR 是一个基于 Wan2.2 的单步流式视频超分框架，通过层级缓存路由、多尺度查询判别器和 LR 条件化 FlashDecoder，在 1080×1920 分辨率下实现 21.20 FPS 的实时生成，兼顾感知质量与时效性。
AI.motivation: 在线流媒体对实时扩散式视频超分（VSR）需求强烈，但严格的延迟约束往往损害生成保真度。作者观察到两点：回收的 SR 潜变量保留局部时序上下文，可减少对完整历史 KV 缓存的依赖；且不同 Transformer 层受益于不同的时序范围。因此需要一个无需迭代采样或完整历史 KV 缓存物化的流式 VSR 方案。
AI.method: 提出 ReCaVSR，一个基于 Wan2.2 的单步流式 VSR 框架，包含三项互补设计：(i) 结合回收 SR 潜变量的层级缓存路由，每层 DiT 在缓存预算下学习自身 KV 缓存时序范围并导出静态推理调度，回收的 SR 潜变量通过将每个新块条件化于模型自身先前预测来传播局部上下文；(ii) 多尺度查询（MSQ）判别器，融合全局、空间窗口与时序管反馈，实现整体真实感、局部纹理生成与时序稳定性；(iii) LR 条件化的 FlashDecoder 适配，一种引入 LR 观测的 VAE 解码器以实现高效潜变量解码。
AI.result: 在合成与真实世界 VSR 基准上，ReCaVSR 在感知质量、时序一致性和流式效率上优于代表性 VSR 基线。在单张 NVIDIA A100-80GB、输出分辨率 1080×1920 下，达到 21.20 FPS、峰值分配显存 15.16 GB，相比 FlashVSR Tiny 快 2.72 倍且峰值分配显存少 38.0%。
AI.conclusion: ReCaVSR 实现了无需迭代采样或完整历史 KV 缓存物化的流式视频超分，在保持甚至提升感知质量与时序一致性的同时显著改善流式效率，为实时流媒体场景下的扩散式 VSR 提供了可行方案。

title: Evaluation Choices Shape Biomedical ML Claims: A Pediatric Pneumonia Benchmark Case Study
summary: Biomedical machine learning papers often compress model performance into one headline number. That number can look like a property of the model even when it depends strongly on how the benchmark was evaluated. We study this problem on the widely used Kermany pediatric chest radiograph dataset using nine image classifiers and a controlled evaluation protocol. Under the same protocol, the eight pretrained backbones differ by only 0.026 AUROC. In contrast, changing whether the backbone is frozen or fine-tuned changes AUROC by 0.044 on average, and changing the decision threshold changes balanced accuracy by 0.090 on average. The official test split is also measurably different from the training pool: a partition classifier distinguishes them at AUC 0.697, rising to 0.898 for normal radiographs. Most strikingly, a classifier using only file properties, with no image anatomy, reaches 0.992 balanced accuracy within the training pool but falls to 0.496 on the official test split. Validation-fitted thresholds and calibration also transfer imperfectly. These results show that a high benchmark score can support different conclusions when the split, training policy, threshold, metric, calibration, and uncertainty are not communicated with it. We end with a seven-item reporting recommendation in which each item is tied to an effect measured in the study

AI.tldr: 该论文以Kermany儿童胸片数据集为案例，通过九种分类器和受控评估协议证明：基准分数高度依赖评估设计（微调策略、阈值、数据划分、校准等），而非仅反映模型本身能力，并提出七项报告建议。
AI.motivation: 生物医学机器学习论文常将模型性能压缩为单一"头条数字"，该数字看似是模型的固有属性，实则强烈依赖基准评估方式。作者希望揭示这一隐患，说明在不透明评估条件下高分可能导致不同结论。
AI.method: 在广泛使用的Kermany儿童胸片数据集上，采用九种图像分类器和受控评估协议进行系统实验，分别操纵骨干网络选择、冻结/微调策略、决策阈值、数据划分（官方测试集与训练池）、校准以及不确定性等因素，并测量各因素对性能指标的影响；还构造仅使用文件属性（无解剖图像信息）的分类器与划分分类器来检验数据划分差异。
AI.result: 同一协议下八个预训练骨干的AUROC仅相差0.026；而骨干冻结与微调的切换使AUROC平均变化0.044，决策阈值变化使平衡准确率平均变化0.090。官方测试集与训练池存在可测差异：划分分类器以AUC 0.697区分二者，对正常胸片升至0.898。仅用文件属性的分类器在训练池内达到0.992平衡准确率，但在官方测试集上跌至0.496。基于验证集拟合的阈值与校准迁移效果也不理想。
AI.conclusion: 高基准分数在未同时报告数据划分、训练策略、阈值、指标、校准与不确定性时，可能支持不同结论。作者据此提出七项报告建议，每项均对应本研究中测得的某一效应。

title: RelayVSR: Large-Small Model Collaboration for Efficient Real-World Video Super-Resolution
comment: The code is available at https://github.com/kopperx/RelayVSR
summary: Large generative models can recover realistic detail in real-world video super-resolution (VSR), but processing an entire video with them is computationally expensive. In this work, we present RelayVSR, a streaming VSR framework built on the Sparse Generative Relay mechanism. A large generative model generates reference latents for sparse keyframes, while a lightweight VSR network uses these references and low-resolution video to super-resolve every frame. The lightweight VSR network, implemented as a Dual-Memory Video Transformer, reuses keyframe information across frames and updates recent video context, supporting first-keyframe conditioning and dual-endpoint conditioning with bounded lookahead. However, errors in shared keyframes can propagate and accumulate across output frames, making keyframe quality alone an insufficient optimization target. We address this collaboration gap with Video-Aware Reference Optimization (VARO), which uses reinforcement learning to update the large generative model with two reward levels: a system-level reward evaluates videos produced by the fixed lightweight VSR network, while a reference-level reward evaluates decoded keyframe quality. VARO improves final video quality over direct joint training, and its dual-level rewards outperform a system-level reward alone. At 1080p on a single NVIDIA A100 80GB, dual-endpoint RelayVSR with a 15-frame keyframe interval reaches 29.29 FPS, 13.82 GB peak GPU memory, and 0.327 s first-frame model latency, compared with 7.80 FPS, 24.447 GB, and 2.83 s for FlashVSR-Tiny. The code is available at https://github.com/kopperx/RelayVSR.

AI.tldr: 提出 RelayVSR 流式视频超分框架，通过稀疏生成中继机制实现大生成模型与轻量 VSR 网络协作，并设计 VARO 强化学习优化方案，在 1080p 单卡上显著提升效率与质量。
AI.motivation: 大型生成模型可在真实世界视频超分中恢复逼真细节，但逐帧处理整段视频计算代价过高，难以实用。核心挑战在于如何在保留生成模型细节能力的同时降低计算开销，并解决共享关键帧误差在输出帧间传播累积导致的协作缺口，使关键帧质量本身不足以作为优化目标。
AI.method: 1) Sparse Generative Relay 机制：大生成模型仅对稀疏关键帧生成参考潜变量，轻量 VSR 网络结合该参考与低分辨率视频对每帧超分。2) 轻量网络为 Dual-Memory Video Transformer，跨帧复用关键帧信息并更新近期视频上下文，支持首关键帧条件与有界前瞻的双端点条件。3) Video-Aware Reference Optimization (VARO)：用强化学习更新大生成模型，采用系统级奖励（评估固定轻量 VSR 网络输出的视频）与参考级奖励（评估解码关键帧质量）的双层奖励结构。
AI.result: VARO 相比直接联合训练提升最终视频质量，双层奖励优于仅用系统级奖励。1080p 单张 NVIDIA A100 80GB 下，双端点 RelayVSR（15 帧关键帧间隔）达 29.29 FPS、13.82 GB 峰值显存、0.327 s 首帧模型延迟；对比 FlashVSR-Tiny 的 7.80 FPS、24.447 GB、2.83 s。
AI.conclusion: RelayVSR 以稀疏关键帧生成加轻量流式超分的协作范式，在保持生成模型细节恢复能力的同时大幅提升效率；VARO 通过面向系统输出的双层强化学习奖励，缓解关键帧误差传播问题，兼顾质量与速度、显存，适用于高分辨率实时流式 VSR。

title: FlowMap-OPD: Rollout--Kernel Separation for On-Policy Distillation of Few-Step Flow-Map Generators
summary: Few-step flow-map generators, including MeanFlow and consistency models, enable efficient sampling through long-range transport, yet their on-policy distillation remains underexplored. We introduce FlowMap-OPD, an on-policy distillation framework that separates student-state acquisition from teacher--student distribution comparison. A formulation based on state marginals establishes this separation, while flow--velocity consistency connects local supervision to the deployed long-range map. Within this framework, we develop flow-map, induced-velocity, and instantaneous-velocity distribution supervision, each paired with a separately specified native flow-map rollout. Cross-capacity ImageNet experiments across three teacher rewards identify instantaneous-velocity distribution supervision with independently tunable student consistency as the most effective choice. In text-to-image experiments, FlowMap-OPD demonstrates strong multi-specialist consolidation capabilities and surpasses multi-reward Flow-Map GRPO in task performance and convergence speed.

AI.tldr: 提出 FlowMap-OPD 在线策略蒸馏框架，将学生状态获取与师生分布比较解耦，在少步流映射生成器中实现高效采样，并在 ImageNet 与文生图任务中验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 少步流映射生成器（MeanFlow、一致性模型）可通过长程输运高效采样，但其在线策略蒸馏（on-policy distillation）研究尚不充分，缺乏系统性的形式化框架与监督设计。
AI.method: 基于状态边缘分布的形式化推导，将学生状态采样与师生分布比较分离；利用流-速度一致性把局部监督与部署时的长程映射相连接；提出三类分布监督：流映射分布监督、诱导速度分布监督、瞬时速度分布监督，并分别搭配各自指定的原生流映射 rollout。
AI.result: 跨容量 ImageNet 实验（三种教师奖励）表明，瞬时速度分布监督配合可独立调节的学生一致性最为有效；文生图实验中，FlowMap-OPD 展现出强多专家整合能力，在任务性能与收敛速度上均优于多奖励 Flow-Map GRPO。
AI.conclusion: FlowMap-OPD 为流映射生成器的在线策略蒸馏提供了可分解的通用框架，明确了最优监督形式，并验证了其在多专家整合与文生图场景下的优越性。

title: HandAnthro: Automated Hand Anthropometry from a Single Image
comment: 21 pages, including 7 pages of main text and references and 14 pages of supplementary material
summary: Hand anthropometry supports protective-glove design, but existing measurement methods often require trained operators, specialized hardware, or manual landmarking. We present HandAnthro, which estimates 44 projected hand dimensions from a smartphone photograph of a palm-up hand on US letter-size paper. The pipeline reconstructs wrist-occluded paper boundaries for rectification, whitens non-hand pixels, and refines 41 anthropometry-specific landmarks from a fine-tuned You Only Look Once (YOLO) pose model using image-specific geometry and contours. Controlled evaluation comprised 720 captures from 45 held-out participants, each contributing 16 images across two smartphones, two backgrounds, two angles, and two nominal illumination settings. HandAnthro produced complete outputs for 704 captures (97.8%); among these, mean absolute error (MAE) was 3.80 mm per dimension against two trained operators' caliper measurements. Regional MAEs were 2.48 mm for non-thumb fingers, 6.04 mm for thumbs, and 6.17 mm for palm and wrist. In a researcher-assisted mobile-app pilot, automated batch processing returned all 44 dimensions for 260 of 268 retained, researcher-screened firefighter images (97.0%). A descriptive, unpaired comparison with an independent national firefighter reference yielded a mean absolute difference of 2.40 mm across 28 sex-by-dimension group-mean contrasts. These results characterize controlled measurement performance and researcher-assisted field feasibility for future distributed hand-anthropometry studies.

AI.tldr: HandAnthro 通过智能手机拍摄的掌心向上、置于美标信纸上的手部照片，估计 44 项投影手部尺寸，在受控评测中每维度平均绝对误差为 3.80 mm，并在消防员移动应用试点中实现 97.0% 的自动化批量输出成功率。
AI.motivation: 手部人体测量学是防护手套设计的基础，但现有测量方法通常依赖受训操作员、专用硬件或人工标注关键点，难以规模化、分布式地采集数据。作者希望提出一种仅凭智能手机照片即可完成手部尺寸估计的低门槛方案，以支持未来分布式手部人体测量研究。
AI.method: 提出 HandAnthro 流程：输入为掌心向上、手置于美标信纸（US letter-size paper）上的智能手机照片；流程包括重建被手腕遮挡的纸张边界以进行图像校正、将非手部像素白化，并基于微调的 You Only Look Once（YOLO）姿态模型，结合图像特定的几何与轮廓信息，细化 41 个人体测量学专用关键点，最终输出 44 项投影手部尺寸。受控评测包含 45 名留出参与者的 720 次拍摄，每人 16 张图像，覆盖两种智能手机、两种背景、两个角度与两种标称光照设置。另开展研究者辅助的移动应用试点，处理消防员图像，并与独立的国家级消防员参考数据进行描述性、非配对比较。
AI.result: 在 720 次受控拍摄中，HandAnthro 对 704 次（97.8%）输出完整结果；相对两名受训操作员的卡尺测量，每维度平均绝对误差（MAE）为 3.80 mm。分区 MAE 为：非拇指手指 2.48 mm、拇指 6.04 mm、手掌与手腕 6.17 mm。在研究者辅助的移动应用试点中，268 张经研究者筛查保留的消防员图像中有 260 张（97.0%）通过自动化批处理返回全部 44 项尺寸。与独立国家级消防员参考数据的描述性非配对比较显示，28 组“性别×维度”组均值对比的平均绝对差为 2.40 mm。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，HandAnthro 在受控条件下具备可量化的测量性能，并在研究者辅助的现场场景中具有可行性，可为未来分布式手部人体测量研究提供支持。

title: Learning from synthetic photorealistic raindrop for single image raindrop removal
comment: 2019 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision Workshop (ICCVW)
summary: Raindrops adhered to camera lens or windshield are inevitable in rainy scenes and can become an issue for many computer vision systems such as autonomous driving. Because raindrop appearance is affected by too many parameters, therefore it is unlikely to find an effective model based solution. Learning based methods are also problematic, because traditional learning method cannot properly model the complex appearance. Whereas deep learning method lacks sufficiently large and realistic training data. To solve it, in our work, we propose the first photo-realistic dataset of synthetic adherent raindrops for training. The rendering is physics based with consideration of the water dynamic, geometric and photometry. The dataset contains various types of rainy scenes and particularly the rainy driving scenes. Based on the modeling of raindrop imagery, we introduce a detection network which has the awareness of the raindrop refraction as well as its blurring. Based on that, we propose the removal network that can well recover the image structure. Rigorous experiments demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of our proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个基于物理渲染的照片级合成附着雨滴数据集，并设计了具备雨滴折射与模糊感知的检测网络及结构恢复的去除网络，实验达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: 雨天附着于镜头或挡风玻璃的雨滴严重影响自动驾驶等视觉系统。雨滴外观受众多参数影响，基于模型的方案难以奏效；传统学习方法无法建模复杂外观；深度学习方法则缺乏足够大且真实的训练数据。
AI.method: 构建首个照片级合成附着雨滴数据集，渲染基于物理，兼顾水的动态、几何与光度特性，涵盖多种雨天场景，尤其是雨天驾驶场景。基于雨滴成像建模，提出感知雨滴折射与模糊的检测网络，进而提出能良好恢复图像结构的去除网络。
AI.result: 在严格的实验对比中，所提框架展现出最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 物理驱动的合成数据与结合折射/模糊感知的检测-去除一体化框架有效解决了附着雨滴去除问题。

title: EndoPrior-GS: Dynamic Endoscopic Reconstruction with a Joint Texture Prior
summary: Dynamic endoscopic reconstruction is fundamental to robotic surgery and computer-assisted interventions. While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) realises real-time rendering, its application to deformable intraoperative environments remains constrained by spurious geometry and varying illuminations. To address these limitations, we introduce EndoPrior-GS, a novel pipeline that explicitly couples frame-extracted vision heuristics and estimated depth maps. EndoPrior-GS derives a joint texture prior from a tool-filtered valid tissue mask, a non-specular photometric filter, and anatomical structural salience, yielding a probability map that guides primitive initialisation and subsequent density control. The prior is further extended to the temporal domain through a texture-aware term that dynamically weighs pairwise primitive contributions during training. We conduct extensive experiments on benchmark datasets EndoNeRF and SCARED, and the obtained results show that our method EndoPrior-GS reduces Flow Error by 27.7% and 25.8% over the representative approaches while preserving competitive rendering quality and real-time rendering speed. Our project website is available at https://jiaqi-huang-77.github.io/EndoPrior-GS/.

AI.tldr: 提出 EndoPrior-GS，通过显式耦合帧提取的视觉启发式与深度图构建先验，提升可变形内窥镜场景的 3D 高斯泼溅重建质量与实时性。
AI.motivation: 动态内窥镜重建是机器人手术与计算机辅助干预的基础。3D 高斯泼溅（3DGS）虽能实现实时渲染，但应用于可变形术中环境时受伪影几何与光照变化的约束。
AI.method: EndoPrior-GS 从工具过滤后的有效组织掩码、非镜面反射光度滤波器与解剖结构显著性中导出联合纹理先验，生成概率图以引导基元初始化与后续密度控制；并通过纹理感知项将该先验扩展到时间域，在训练中动态加权成对基元贡献。
AI.result: 在 EndoNeRF 与 SCARED 基准数据集上，相比代表性方法，Flow Error 分别降低 27.7% 与 25.8%，同时保持有竞争力的渲染质量与实时渲染速度。
AI.conclusion: 显式引入帧级视觉先验与深度信息可有效抑制伪影几何与光照干扰，在保证渲染质量与实时性的前提下显著改善动态内窥镜场景重建。

title: Visual Branch is What You Need for CLIP-based Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Class-Incremental Learning (CIL) requires models to recognize new classes over time without forgetting previously learned ones. With the rise of vision-language pre-training, CLIP has become a strong foundation for CIL. A common design in CLIP-based CIL is to construct textual classifier weights by encoding class-name templates with the CLIP text encoder, and then classify visual features by image-text cosine similarity. This design is appealing: since CLIP aligns images and text in a shared embedding space, textual weights appear to provide an off-the-shelf classifier for incremental classes. However, we show that this seemingly natural design is not always beneficial, as a modality gap can still separate the two modalities and make textual classifier weights deviate from visual class distributions. Empirically, under identical task-wise CIL training, initializing the cosine classifier with visual class centers yields lower loss and better incremental accuracy than using CLIP textual features.Motivated by these observations, we propose VIS, a visual-only method for CLIP-based CIL that removes the deployed textual branch and constructs the incremental classifier entirely in the visual space. To obtain stronger task-adaptive visual representations, VISuses only base-session data to enhance CLIP's final visual representation with informative visual-layer features. Built on the enhanced visual representation, VISemploys a simple kernelized incremental least-squares SVM, whose classifier weights are solved in closed form from additive sufficient statistics. When new classes arrive, VISaccumulates their sufficient statistics and recomputes the classifier weights for all seen classes, enabling efficient incremental updates while preserving historical class knowledge. Extensive experiments show that VISachieves state-of-the-art performance without a textual branch.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VIS，一种仅依赖视觉空间的CLIP类增量学习方法，去掉文本分类分支，用视觉类中心初始化余弦分类器，并通过核化增量最小二乘SVM实现高效增量更新，达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: CLIP类增量学习中常用文本编码器生成类名模板权重作为分类器，但图像与文本之间存在模态差距，导致文本分类权重偏离视觉类分布。实验表明，在相同任务级CIL训练下，用视觉类中心初始化余弦分类器比CLIP文本特征损失更低、增量精度更好。
AI.method: VIS为纯视觉方法：移除部署的文本分支，分类器完全构建于视觉空间。首先仅用基础会话数据，将CLIP最终视觉表示与有信息的视觉层特征增强，得到更强任务自适应的视觉表示；在此基础上采用简单的核化增量最小二乘SVM，分类器权重由可加充分统计量闭式求解；新类到来时累加其充分统计量并重算所有已见类权重，实现高效增量更新并保留历史知识。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，VIS在没有文本分支的情况下取得了最先进（state-of-the-art）的性能。
AI.conclusion: 基于CLIP的类增量学习并不必须依赖文本分类分支；在视觉空间内构建分类器并配合核化增量最小二乘SVM，可有效缓解模态差距问题，兼顾增量效率与历史类知识保持，实现无需文本分支的SOTA性能。

title: ReCAP: Retrieval-Guided Capability Reuse for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
summary: Multimodal continual instruction tuning (MCIT) aims to enable multimodal large language models to acquire new capabilities from sequential tasks while preserving previously learned knowledge. Existing methods primarily mitigate catastrophic forgetting by constraining parameter updates or separating task-specific adaptations. However, continual adaptation can also benefit from external knowledge that provides domain-specific information and reusable reasoning patterns for solving diverse instructions. For example, to answer "How many red cubes are to the left of the sphere?", domain knowledge can provide relevant concepts about objects and spatial relations, while reasoning knowledge can specify ordered operations such as object recognition, spatial filtering, and counting. Despite this potential, how to leverage external knowledge for continual adaptation remains largely unexplored in existing MCIT methods. To this end, we propose ReCAP, a retrieval-guided framework that leverages external knowledge to guide capability reuse during continual adaptation. At each continual stage, ReCAP uses external search and an LLM to incrementally build a knowledge base of domain, reasoning, and format knowledge based on the current-stage training data. For each instruction, retrieved domain knowledge guides generation, while retrieved reasoning knowledge selects and orders capability modules to form an instance-specific capability path. As these capability modules are reused across stages, subsequent adaptation can overwrite previously learned parameters. To enable stable cross-stage reuse, ReCAP introduces adaptive subspace recycling, which parameterizes reusable capability modules with shared bases and stage-specific cores, protects historically important directions while recycling residual capacity. Extensive experiments on MCIT benchmarks show that ReCAP achieves SOTA performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ReCAP，一个检索引导的多模态持续指令微调框架，通过构建领域、推理与格式知识库并复用能力模块，结合自适应子空间回收实现稳定跨阶段适应，取得 SOTA 性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 MCIT 方法主要依靠约束参数更新或分离任务特定适配来缓解灾难性遗忘，但未探索利用外部知识（提供领域信息与可复用推理模式）来辅助持续适应。例如回答空间推理问题时，领域知识可提供物体与空间关系概念，推理知识可规定识别、过滤、计数等有序操作。如何利用外部知识进行持续适应仍待研究。
AI.method: ReCAP 在每个持续阶段利用外部搜索与大语言模型，基于当前阶段训练数据增量构建包含领域、推理、格式知识的知识库。对每条指令，检索到的领域知识引导生成；检索到的推理知识选择并排序能力模块，形成实例特定的能力路径。由于能力模块跨阶段复用，后续适应可能覆盖先前参数，为此引入自适应子空间回收：用共享基与阶段特定核心参数化可复用能力模块，保护历史重要方向并回收剩余容量。
AI.result: 在 MCIT 基准上的大量实验表明，ReCAP 达到了当前最优（SOTA）性能。
AI.conclusion: ReCAP 通过检索引导的外部知识复用与自适应子空间回收机制，有效提升了多模态大模型持续指令微调中的知识保持与能力复用能力，验证了外部知识在持续适应中的价值。

title: SYNCR: Diagnosing and Learning Cross-Video Reasoning from Simulation
summary: Reasoning across videos requires aligning events, matching identities, comparing motion, and integrating partial observations. Evaluating these capabilities and testing how to improve them requires both reliable labels and targeted supervision. We introduce SYNCR, a simulator-grounded framework that connects these two needs through shared task generators. Built on Habitat, Kubric, and CLEVRER, SYNCR derives answers from environment state and provides 4,000 evaluation questions and 15,960 training questions over disjoint videos, spanning eight cross-video reasoning tasks. Visual ablations and human evaluation assess dependence on the supplied evidence and answer recoverability. Evaluation of 22 multimodal large language models reveals persistent difficulties in physical comparison and scene integration that increasing model size does not consistently resolve. Supervised fine-tuning raises Qwen3-VL-8B's average SYNCR accuracy from 32.6% to 61.6%, with gains extending to task configurations and video sources absent from training for those tasks. Transfer to real footage is most consistent for temporal ordering: accuracy improves by 9.0-20.5 percentage points on constructed Assembly101 and Panoptic ordering sets across three checkpoints spanning two model families and two model sizes, with additional gains on existing temporal reasoning benchmarks. These results establish SYNCR as a controlled setting for diagnosing cross-video reasoning failures, testing their learnability, and identifying where synthetic supervision transfers.

AI.tldr: SYNCR 是一个基于模拟器的跨视频推理框架，通过共享任务生成器同时提供可靠标签与定向监督，包含 4,000 道评测题和 15,960 道训练题，覆盖八类跨视频推理任务，用于诊断多模态大模型的跨视频推理失败并测试其可学习性与迁移性。
AI.motivation: 跨视频推理需要对齐事件、匹配身份、比较运动并整合部分观测，评测这些能力并探索改进方法既需要可靠标注，也需要针对性的监督信号。现有资源难以同时满足这两项需求，因此作者希望构建一个能同时解决标签可靠性与监督针对性问题的统一框架。
AI.method: 基于 Habitat、Kubric 和 CLEVRER 构建 SYNCR 模拟器框架，通过共享任务生成器从环境状态直接推导答案。提供 4,000 道评测题与 15,960 道训练题，二者视频互不重叠，覆盖八类跨视频推理任务。采用视觉消融与人工评估检验答案对给定证据的依赖程度和可恢复性，并在 22 个多模态大语言模型上进行评测，同时开展监督微调实验和向真实视频的迁移测试。
AI.result: 对 22 个多模态大语言模型的评测显示，物理比较与场景整合任务存在持续困难，且增大模型规模并不能稳定解决。监督微调将 Qwen3-VL-8B 的平均 SYNCR 准确率从 32.6% 提升至 61.6%，且增益可扩展到训练中未出现的任务配置与视频来源。向真实视频的迁移在时序排序任务上最为稳定：在两个模型家族、两种模型尺寸的三个检查点上，Assembly101 与 Panoptic 排序集准确率提升 9.0 至 20.5 个百分点，并在现有时序推理基准上取得额外增益。
AI.conclusion: SYNCR 为诊断跨视频推理失败、检验其可学习性以及识别合成监督的迁移边界提供了一个可控的实验环境。

title: EpiCon: Collective Agent Learning through Co-Evolving Multimodal Memory
summary: Agents can learn from past executions, but enabling different agents to reuse and build on one another's experience remains challenging. We introduce EpiCon, a shared multimodal memory framework for agent collective learning without updating host model parameters. EpiCon links question-level memory evolution to a persistent experience bank through two independently trained 2B models: a memory controller and a tree self-organizer. The controller jointly refines textual guidance and visual evidence across attempts and selectively includes visual memory. The self-organizer consolidates lessons hierarchically and retrieves experience and rules for new problems. We evaluate EpiCon on eleven benchmarks spanning four multimodal task domains, using two harnesses and multiple backbones. A frozen bank improves other systems even with a single solving attempt. A second harness raises the original system's macro-average score by 2.6 points across eleven benchmarks. Across four host configurations, EpiCon improves macro-average scores by 1.7 to 4.9 points over No Memory and reduces memory-operation time by 67\% to 74\% relative to backbone-sized memory models.

AI.tldr: 提出 EpiCon——一个不更新宿主模型参数的共享多模态记忆框架，通过记忆控制器与树自组织器两个独立训练的 2B 模型，实现智能体之间的经验复用与集体学习。
AI.motivation: 智能体可从既往执行中学习，但不同智能体之间难以复用并基于彼此的经验进行积累，缺乏跨智能体共享经验的机制。
AI.method: EpiCon 将问题级记忆演化与持久经验库相连接，包含两个独立训练的 2B 模型：记忆控制器负责在多次尝试中联合优化文本引导与视觉证据，并选择性纳入视觉记忆；树自组织器以层级方式整合经验教训，并为新问题检索经验与规则。
AI.result: 在覆盖四个多模态任务域的十一个基准上、使用两种测试框架与多个骨干模型进行评估：冻结的经验库即使仅一次求解尝试也能提升其他系统；第二个测试框架在十一个基准上将原系统宏平均分提升 2.6 分；在四种宿主配置下，相比 No Memory 宏平均分提升 1.7 至 4.9 分，且相对骨干规模的记忆模型将记忆操作时间减少 67\% 至 74\%。
AI.conclusion: 共享多模态记忆可在不更新宿主模型参数的前提下实现智能体的集体学习，兼具效果提升与显著的效率优势。

title: Rollout-Marginal Distillation for Long-Horizon Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion enables low-latency, streamable video generation, but prediction errors often accumulate over long rollouts. Training the generator on its own rollouts exposes it to these imperfect histories. However, existing video-level distribution matching distillation (DMD) scores the whole rollout jointly. Because a chunk is evaluated together with its past and future, its correction can favor matching artifacts in the surrounding context merely to preserve temporal consistency. To provide a clearer visual-quality signal, we introduce Rollout-Marginal Distillation (RMD). RMD retains the generated history for AR prediction but scores each chunk independently against a chunk teacher, ensuring its quality correction is not compromised by an imperfect temporal context. To compensate for the lack of temporal context in independent chunk scoring, RMD subsequently applies video-level DMD to restore temporal coherence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RMD maintains high visual quality far beyond its training horizon and outperforms video-level DMD baselines. Code and video results are available at https://cjeen.github.io/RMD

AI.tldr: 提出 Rollout-Marginal Distillation (RMD)，通过保留生成历史进行自回归预测、但对每个 chunk 独立打分以获得清晰视觉质量信号，再辅以视频级 DMD 恢复时序连贯性。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频扩散可实现低延迟、可流式生成，但预测误差会在长 rollout 中累积。为让生成器适应自身产生的不完美历史，需在其自生成 rollout 上训练。然而现有视频级分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）对整个 rollout 联合打分，某个 chunk 与过去和未来一起被评估，其修正可能为了保持时序一致性而倾向于匹配周围上下文中的伪影，导致视觉质量信号不清晰。
AI.method: 提出 RMD（Rollout-Marginal Distillation）。要点：(1) 保留生成的视频历史用于自回归预测；(2) 对每个 chunk 独立地针对 chunk teacher 打分，使其质量修正不被不完美的时序上下文所损害；(3) 为弥补独立打分缺失的时序上下文，随后应用视频级 DMD 以恢复时序连贯性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，RMD 能在远超训练时间范围（horizon）的情况下保持高视觉质量，并优于视频级 DMD 基线。代码与视频结果见 https://cjeen.github.io/RMD。
AI.conclusion: RMD 通过将视觉质量修正与视频级时序建模解耦——先用 chunk 级独立蒸馏提供清晰质量信号，再用视频级 DMD 恢复时序连贯性——有效缓解了自回归长 rollout 中的质量退化问题，在长程生成中持续保持高视觉质量并超越视频级 DMD 基线。

title: Look Closer: Patch-wise Supervision for AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: How much of an image does a detector need to see? Small RGB regions can retain useful evidence of image synthesis even when they reveal little of the full scene. Motivated by single-patch detection, we study patch-wise supervision: a shared backbone classifies explicit crops, each crop receives its own loss, and patch probabilities are averaged only at inference. The procedure requires neither handcrafted residual filtering nor a learned image-level fusion module. Experiments span single-patch selection, multiple generator collections, and four CNN and Transformer backbones. On GenImage, the reported patch-wise variants improve average accuracy over their whole-image counterparts across all four backbones. Comparisons of supervision granularity, source resolution, crop size, and inference coverage further characterize the approach, while post-processing tests and difficult-image evaluation reveal its limitations. The historical experiments include evaluation-based model selection, so their scores are not presented as a uniformly selected leaderboard comparison. Overall, the study identifies explicit local input and patch-level supervision as a simple, useful combination for investigating generalizable AI-generated image detection.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究"逐块监督"（patch-wise supervision）用于AI生成图像检测：共享骨干网络对显式裁剪的图像块分别分类并各自计算损失，仅在推理时对块概率求平均；无需手工残差滤波或图像级融合模块。
AI.motivation: 动机源于"单块检测"观察：小型RGB区域即使只揭示极少完整场景信息，仍能保留有用的图像合成证据，因此值得研究局部输入与局部监督能否作为通用AIGC检测的简单有效组合。
AI.method: 方法上采用显式裁剪输入 + 逐块损失：共享骨干对每个crop独立分类，每个crop获得自己的损失，推断阶段仅对块概率取平均；不使用手工设计的残差滤波，也不引入学习式图像级融合模块。实验覆盖单块选择、多生成器集合以及4种CNN与Transformer骨干，并考察监督粒度、源分辨率、crop尺寸与推理覆盖范围。
AI.result: 在GenImage上，逐块变体在全部4种骨干上相对整图对应方法均提升了平均准确率；后处理测试与困难图像评估揭示了该方法的局限。此外，历史实验包含基于评测的模型选择，因此其分数不作为统一筛选的排行榜比较呈现。
AI.conclusion: 研究结论认为：显式局部输入与逐块级监督是一种简单且有用的组合，可用于探究具有泛化性的AI生成图像检测。

title: Does Local Video Understanding Transfer Across Encounters? The EgoGears Benchmark
summary: Embodied systems must make knowledge acquired during one encounter usable in another despite changes in viewpoint, motion, and illumination. Yet aggregate cross-video accuracy conflates failures of local perception with failures to preserve observation identity, establish correspondence, and compose evidence, obscuring whether local video understanding actually transfers. We introduce EgoGears, a complementary single- and multi-video benchmark designed to diagnose this transition. It contains 567 single-video and 1,487 multi-video questions derived from 126 human-collected egocentric recordings covering 39 outdoor routes. Repeated traversals across movement speeds and lighting conditions ground comparisons in shared physical environments; 531 questions require alignment across independent recordings. Single-video questions measure the local visual, spatial, and motion evidence available to a model, while multi-video questions test whether evidence remains bound to the correct observation and can be composed into consistent route relationships. We report 29 single-video and 31 multi-video MLLM configurations across six model families in the main leaderboard. Among the 20 configurations evaluated comparably on both splits, every model performs worse on multi-video questions, with a mean decrease of 22.5 percentage points, and the gap persists when answer format and scoring are held fixed. The gap is not explained simply by additional videos or recording boundaries. The central bottlenecks are observation--evidence binding and ordered route-state tracking. The code and benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/lei-qi-233/EgoGears.

AI.tldr: 提出EgoGears基准，通过单视频与多视频诊断性对比揭示具身多模态模型在跨视频证据绑定与路径状态追踪上的瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 具身系统需在视角、运动和光照变化下复用已获得的知识，但聚合式跨视频准确率混淆了局部感知失败与观察身份保持、对应建立、证据组合等失败，无法判断局部视频理解是否真正迁移。
AI.method: 构建EgoGears单/多视频互补基准：567个单视频问题与1,487个多视频问题，源自126段人类采集的第一视角记录，覆盖39条户外路线；通过不同移动速度和光照条件下的重复遍历，使比较落在同一物理环境的共享基础上；其中531个问题需跨独立记录对齐。单视频问题测局部视觉、空间与运动证据，多视频问题测证据是否仍绑定正确观察并可组合成一致的路线关系。主榜评测6个模型族共29种单视频与31种多视频MLLM配置。
AI.result: 在20个可在两个split上可比评估的配置中，所有模型在多视频问题上表现更差，平均下降22.5个百分点；固定答案格式与评分方式后差距依然存在。该差距不能仅由视频数量增加或记录边界解释。
AI.conclusion: 核心瓶颈在于观察—证据绑定与有序路径状态追踪。代码与基准已公开于https://github.com/lei-qi-233/EgoGears。

title: SoL-Refiner: Speed-of-Light One-Step Refinement for High-Resolution Video
summary: High-resolution video generation is expensive, as its cost grows rapidly with the number of spatiotemporal tokens. A practical alternative first generates a lower-resolution video and then applies a refiner, but conventional multi-step refinement introduces a second sampling bottleneck. We present SoL-Refiner, a one-step video refiner that transforms low-resolution model outputs into 4K videos with a single denoising step. Our three-stage recipe combines high-resolution continual training, reinforcement learning (RL) post-training, and a final one-step distillation. We introduce Refiner-Bench, a video refinement benchmark constructed from the outputs of different video generators, and use a shared-input protocol to compare refiners at approximately 2K output resolution. At 2K, the one-step SoL-Refiner outperforms all external refiners on the VBench and UniPercept averages, while at $3840\!\times\!2176$ it improves both metrics over the three-step LTX-2.3 Refiner. With the complete acceleration stack, SoL-Refiner achieves an $8.91\times$ speedup in refinement latency over the same baseline in our 2K latency setting.

AI.tldr: 提出SoL-Refiner，一种单步视频细化器，可将低分辨率生成结果一步去噪提升至4K，达到外部细化器更优质量并实现8.91倍加速。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率视频生成成本随时空token数量急剧增长；先用低分辨率生成再细化的方案较实用，但传统多步细化会引入第二个采样瓶颈。
AI.method: 三阶段方法：高分辨率持续训练、强化学习（RL）后训练、最终单步蒸馏；并构建Refiner-Bench基准，采用共享输入协议在约2K输出分辨率下公平比较细化器。
AI.result: 在2K分辨率下，单步SoL-Refiner在VBench与UniPercept平均指标上优于所有外部细化器；在3840×2176下，其两项指标均优于三步LTX-2.3 Refiner。完整加速栈使细化延迟较同一基线在2K设定下加速8.91倍。
AI.conclusion: 验证了单步细化即可实现4K高质量视频生成，兼顾质量与效率，为高分辨率视频生成的加速提供有效途径。

title: ORMA: Optimization-based Monocular 4D Reconstruction of Articulated Animals
summary: Recovering articulated 4D representations of animals from monocular videos remains challenging due to the large diversity of quadruped morphologies and lack of animal 4D supervision data. Existing learning-based reconstruction methods operate on individual images and rely on synthetic or model-fitted 3D supervision, which inherits the constraints of strong parametric priors and limits generalization to out-of-distribution species. When applied to out-of-distribution animals, they often recover a plausible pose while producing inaccurate geometry because the underlying shape model cannot faithfully represent the observed instance. We present ORMA, a training-free reconstruction framework that decouples articulation from shape, using the predicted pose as reference for optimization while leveraging generative 3D priors for accurate shape reconstruction. Given a reference image, we reconstruct the animal geometry and register it to the parametric model SMAL+, yielding an articulated shape adapted to the observed instance. We then combine per-frame articulated pose estimates with globally consistent camera poses to recover animal motion in a shared world coordinate frame, and further refine the reconstruction using self-supervised DINO correspondences and temporal consistency. To enable quantitative evaluation, we introduce PAW4D, a synthetic multi-species benchmark with ground-truth 3D geometry and camera motion. Experiments on PAW4D, PFERD, and challenging in-the-wild videos demonstrate that ORMA improves reconstruction accuracy while recovering globally consistend animal motion across diverse quadruped species.

AI.tldr: ORMA是一个无需训练的框架，将动物的关节运动与形状解耦：以预测姿态作为优化参考，利用生成式3D先验重建精确几何，并配准到SMAL+模型，从而从单目视频中恢复四足动物的4D表示。
AI.motivation: 从单目视频恢复动物的关节化4D表示面临两大难题：四足动物形态多样性大，且缺乏动物4D监督数据。现有基于学习的方法多针对单张图像，依赖合成数据或模型拟合的3D监督，继承了强参数化先验的约束，导致对分布外物种泛化能力有限，往往只能恢复合理姿态却产生不准确的几何。
AI.method: 提出ORMA训练无关框架，将关节与形状解耦：以预测姿态作为优化参考，利用生成式3D先验进行精确形状重建。给定参考图像，重建动物几何并配准到参数化模型SMAL+，得到适应观测实例的关节形状；再结合逐帧关节姿态估计与全局一致的相机位姿，在世界坐标系中恢复动物运动，并利用DINO自监督对应关系与时序一致性进一步优化。同时构建PAW4D合成多物种基准，提供真实3D几何与相机运动标注。
AI.result: 在PAW4D、PFERD及具有挑战性的野外视频上实验表明，ORMA提升了重建精度，并在多种四足物种上恢复了全局一致的动物运动。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦关节与形状、引入生成式3D先验与自监督优化，ORMA无需训练即可实现跨物种、分布外四足动物的高精度4D重建，配合新基准PAW4D实现定量评估。

title: HybridCUA: Learning to Orchestrate GUI and CLI for Computer-Use Agents
summary: Computer use agents (CUAs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in completing digital tasks. However, existing CUAs either rely solely on graphical user interface (GUI) interactions, which are often inefficient and error prone, or augment GUI interactions with application specific APIs or tools, which require substantial engineering effort and are difficult to scale across applications. We argue that the next generation of CUAs should combine GUI interactions with the command line interface (CLI), leveraging the generality of the GUI and the efficiency of shell commands. A critical challenge, however, is that current models do not know when or how to use the CLI during task execution. To address this challenge, we develop a data construction pipeline that produces three types of trajectories: GUI only, CLI only, and interleaved GUI and CLI trajectories. This pipeline results in HybridCUA-8K, containing 5K hybrid trajectories and 3K verified RLVR tasks. Building on these data, we propose a training framework with two stages: supervised fine tuning on the constructed trajectories, followed by reinforcement learning with our CLI aware rewards that encourages agents to use the CLI selectively and reliably. Experiments show that HybridCUA-9B achieves 53.6% accuracy on OSWorld, improving over the base model by 14.8 percentage points, and improves performance on WindowsAgentArena by 4.0 percentage points. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and cross platform generalizability of the hybrid GUI and CLI paradigm for computer use agents.

AI.tldr: 提出混合GUI与CLI的计算机使用智能体（CUA）范式，构建HybridCUA-8K数据与两阶段训练框架，HybridCUA-9B在OSWorld达53.6%（较基线+14.8pp），WindowsAgentArena提升4.0pp。
AI.motivation: 现有CUA存在两条路线：仅依赖GUI交互，效率低且易出错；或在GUI基础上增加应用专用API/工具，但工程成本高、跨应用难以扩展。因此需要兼顾GUI通用性与CLI效率的新范式，而核心难点在于模型不知道何时、如何调用CLI。
AI.method: （1）数据构建流水线，生成三类轨迹：纯GUI、纯CLI、GUI与CLI交错的轨迹，得到HybridCUA-8K（5K混合轨迹+3K经校验的RLVR任务）；（2）两阶段训练框架：先在构建轨迹上做监督微调，再用CLI感知奖励进行强化学习，使智能体有选择且可靠地使用CLI。
AI.result: HybridCUA-9B在OSWorld上达到53.6%准确率，较基座模型提升14.8个百分点；在WindowsAgentArena上提升4.0个百分点，显示出跨平台泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: GUI与CLI混合范式对计算机使用智能体有效且具备跨平台通用性，为下一代CUA提供了可行方向。

title: From Unity Simulation to Diffusion-Based Augmentation: Quantifying Dataset Balance for Robust Object Detection
summary: Modern computer vision models achieve high accuracy when trained on large-scale annotated datasets. In critical domains such as construction safety monitoring, data collection is costly, hazardous, and ethically constrained. This paper presents a systematic study comparing two complementary data generation paradigms, (1) Unity Simulation-based rendering and (2) Controllable Diffusion-based generation (CIA), for object detection under real data-scarce conditions. A unified experimental framework enables controlled dataset mixing across real, simulated, and generative sources, while maintaining identical model and training settings. Quantitative evaluation using Precision, Recall, mAP, and custom $Δ$-metrics, reveals that neither simulation nor generative augmentation alone achieves optimal transferability. Unity-only training yields an mAP@0.5 drop of $-50\%$ relative to real data, while CIA-only training shows a milder $-16.5\%$ degradation. Hybrid compositions significantly improve performance, with the 90\% real + 10\% Unity configuration achieving the best overall mAP@0.5 of $62.68\%$ ($+7.64\%$ over baseline), and the 90\% real + 10\% CIA configuration maximizing precision at $74.45\%$. Results demonstrate that limited synthetic inclusion enhances generalization, while excessive substitution induces domain drift.

AI.tldr: 在真实数据稀缺场景下系统比较Unity仿真渲染与可控扩散生成(CIA)两种数据生成范式，发现两者单独使用均无法最优迁移，混合少量合成数据可显著提升目标检测性能。
AI.motivation: 大规模标注数据集支撑了现代计算机视觉模型的高精度，但在施工安全监测等关键领域，数据采集成本高、危险且受伦理限制，亟需在真实数据稀缺条件下寻找有效的合成数据生成与增强方案。
AI.method: 构建统一的实验框架，在保持模型与训练设置一致的条件下，实现真实、仿真(Unity)与生成(CIA)三类来源的受控数据混合；采用Precision、Recall、mAP及自研Δ-指标进行定量评估。
AI.result: 仅用Unity训练的mAP@0.5相对真实数据下降50%，仅用CIA下降16.5%(较温和)；混合配置显著提升，90%真实+10% Unity取得最佳mAP@0.5为62.68%(较基线+7.64%)，90%真实+10% CIA取得最高Precision为74.45%。
AI.conclusion: 有限的合成数据加入能增强泛化能力，而过度替换真实数据会引起域漂移；仿真与生成范式均非单用最优，合理混合是数据稀缺下的有效策略。

title: Beyond Lip Sync: Reference-Grounded Oral Refinement for Audio-Driven Portrait Animation
summary: We present RGOR (Reference-Grounded Oral Refinement), an audio-driven lip-sync framework that renders the mouth of the specific person being dubbed rather than a generic one. Existing lip-sync systems follow the audio closely and keep the face recognizable, yet the mouth they render is an average mouth: the shape and texture of the lips, the arrangement of the teeth, and how much of them shows as the mouth opens are not that person's. The problem persists because nothing in current training or evaluation asks for the person's own mouth: perceptual losses accept any plausible mouth, face identity is carried mostly by the skin around it, and the released inference code of inpainting systems uses the unmasked target frame as the reference, which hides the gap. To address this, RGOR conditions every generated frame on frames from separate enrollment recordings of the same person and on HD patches of the mouth that bypass the VAE, and trains the generator against a paired judge that compares each rendered mouth with the person's reference and learns to reject a realistic mouth of someone else. We further build an evaluation protocol and use it to compare open-source and commercial lip-sync systems on held-out identities. Experiments show that RGOR achieves the best or second-best result on most metrics, and preserves the person's own lip and dental detail while keeping synchronization and the rest of the face intact.

AI.tldr: 提出RGOR，一种以参考为依据的口型精修配音框架，使生成口型属于被配音者本人而非"平均嘴"，并通过新评测协议在多数指标上取得最优或次优，同时保持同步性与面部其余部分完整。
AI.motivation: 现有口型同步系统虽能贴合音频并保持人脸可辨识，但渲染的嘴是"平均嘴"：唇形与纹理、牙齿排列及开口时牙齿露出程度都不是该人特有的。该问题长期存在，因为当前训练与评测都不要求使用本人嘴部：感知损失接受任何合理嘴型，人脸身份主要由嘴周皮肤承载，且修复类系统公开的推理代码用未掩码的目标帧作参考，掩盖了这一差距。
AI.method: RGOR将每一生成帧以同一人另外录制（enrollment）的帧以及绕过VAE的嘴部HD patch为条件，并训练生成器对抗一个成对判别器（paired judge）；该判别器将渲染嘴部与本人参考比较，学习拒绝他人逼真嘴型。同时构建了评测协议，在留出身份（held-out identities）上比较开源与商业口型同步系统。
AI.result: 实验显示RGOR在多数指标上取得最优或次优结果，保留本人唇部与牙齿细节，同时维持同步性和面部其余部分的完整性。
AI.conclusion: 通过参考条件化（跨录制帧 + 绕过VAE的嘴部HD patch）与成对判别器，RGOR有效解决了"平均嘴"问题，实现了身份特异的嘴部渲染，并配套评测协议验证了其优越性。

title: EVO-WAM: Evolving World Action Models through Video-Action Verification
summary: Improving robot policies on new tasks without collecting additional expert demonstrations remains a central challenge in robot learning. World action models (WAMs) use broad video priors to jointly predict future videos and actions, offering a potential source of supervision for adapting to new tasks. However, generated videos may fail to depict task completion, and even visually successful videos may be paired with inconsistent actions that lead to execution failure. We propose EVO-WAM, a framework that adapts WAMs to unseen tasks by learning from their own generated video-action trajectories, without executing candidate actions in an external environment. First, we augment WAM training with state prediction and anchored multi-frame context to enable complete autoregressive rollouts without external execution feedback. Second, we identify reliable training experience by selecting task-completing prefixes with a vision-language model and verifying their video-action consistency with an inverse dynamics model. Third, we iteratively train the WAM on verified prefixes and generate new rollouts with the updated model. On seven unseen RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, EVO-WAM increases average success rates from 26.9% to 68.0% for Cosmos3 and from 28.5% to 46.4% for DreamZero, reaching approximately $2.5\times$ and $1.6\times$ their initial success rates. On three unseen long-horizon composite tasks in the real world, it improves Cosmos3's average success rate from 20.0% to 76.7%, a gain of 56.7 percentage points. Project Page: https://evo-wam.github.io/.

AI.tldr: EVO-WAM 通过让世界动作模型利用自身生成的视频-动作轨迹进行自监督适配，在无需额外专家演示和执行反馈的情况下显著提升机器人新任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 机器人策略在新任务上的适配通常依赖额外专家演示，成本高昂。世界动作模型（WAMs）虽能联合预测未来视频与动作，但其生成视频常无法体现任务完成，且视觉上成功的视频也可能对应不一致的动作导致执行失败。
AI.method: 提出 EVO-WAM 框架，分三步：(1) 在 WAM 训练中加入状态预测与锚定多帧上下文，实现无需外部执行反馈的完整自回归 rollout；(2) 用视觉语言模型筛选任务完成的前缀，并用逆动力学模型验证视频-动作一致性以识别可靠训练经验；(3) 在验证过的前缀上迭代训练 WAM 并用更新模型生成新 rollout。
AI.result: 在 7 个未见 RoboTwin 2.0 任务上，Cosmos3 平均成功率从 26.9% 提升至 68.0%（约 2.5 倍），DreamZero 从 28.5% 提升至 46.4%（约 1.6 倍）；在 3 个真实世界长时序复合任务上，Cosmos3 平均成功率从 20.0% 提升至 76.7%，提升 56.7 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: EVO-WAM 证明 WAMs 可借助自身生成并经验证的视频-动作轨迹实现新任务适配，避免额外专家演示与外部环境执行，在仿真与真实场景均取得显著成功率提升。

title: RS-OPSD: Reliable Privileged On-Policy-Self-Distillation for Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing VQA
summary: Ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing visual question answering (VQA) requires models to resolve small visual evidence within extremely large images. Existing approaches typically rely on token pruning, visual search, or tool-augmented reasoning at inference time. We instead investigate whether the benefit of zoom-in visual privilege can be internalized into the model. We introduce RS-OPSD, a reliable privileged on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) framework for UHR remote sensing VQA. To provide high-quality privileged information with explicit question-relevant evidence, we construct GeoEvidence-6K, containing 6,750 VQA samples across seven task categories with evidence-region annotations, and develop Human Feedback-Guided Skill Refinement (HF-SR) for scalable annotation. To address context loss from tight crops and conflicting signals from imperfect teachers, RS-OPSD introduces Context-Preserving Visual Privilege (CPVP) and Correctness-Aligned Distillation (CAD). Without any additional visual search or tool calls at inference time, RS-OPSD achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on XLRS-Bench, MME-RealWorld-RS, and LRS-VQA, outperforming pervious SOTA models of comparable scale by an average of 4.0 percentage points. Moreover, our 2B variant, RS-OPD-Lite, surpasses most 8B-scale models while achieving the fastest measured inference speed. Our Code, GeoEvidence-6K, and the model weights for RS-OPSD and RS-OPD-Lite are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RS-OPSD，一个特权在线策略自蒸馏框架，将"放大细看"的视觉特权内化进模型，无需推理时的额外搜索或工具调用即可实现超高分辨率遥感VQA的SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 超高分辨率（UHR）遥感视觉问答需要模型在超大图像中定位微小视觉证据。现有方法依赖推理阶段的token剪枝、视觉搜索或工具增强推理，计算开销大且流程复杂。作者希望探究能否将放大细看的视觉特权优势内化进模型本身。
AI.method: 提出RS-OPSD——可靠的特权在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）框架。为提供带显式问题相关证据的高质量特权信息，构建GeoEvidence-6K数据集（6,750个VQA样本，涵盖七类任务，含证据区域标注），并提出人工反馈引导技能精炼（HF-SR）实现可扩展标注。针对紧密裁剪导致的上下文丢失与不完美教师带来的冲突信号，引入上下文保持视觉特权（CPVP）与正确性对齐蒸馏（CAD）。
AI.result: 在推理阶段无需任何额外视觉搜索或工具调用的情况下，RS-OPSD在XLRS-Bench、MME-RealWorld-RS和LRS-VQA上均达到SOTA，平均超越同规模先前SOTA模型4.0个百分点；其2B规模变体RS-OPD-Lite超过大多数8B规模模型，并实现最快的实测推理速度。
AI.conclusion: 视觉特权可以被有效内化进模型，RS-OPSD在无需推理期额外搜索/工具的情况下取得SOTA性能且推理高效，为UHR遥感VQA提供了新范式。代码、GeoEvidence-6K数据集及RS-OPSD与RS-OPD-Lite模型权重均已公开。

title: MUGEN: Interactive Panoramic World Exploration via Camera Control
summary: Interactive panoramic video generation aims to synthesize immersive 360\textdegree{} videos that remain visually coherent while following user-specified camera trajectories during exploration. However, progress is limited by a coupled data-and-model gap: existing panoramic video datasets are often short, weakly annotated, or lack camera trajectories, while existing camera-controlled video generation models are designed for perspective videos and do not directly support panoramic geometry. In this paper, we introduce MUGEN and Wan360 to address these limitations. MUGEN is a large-scale real-world panoramic video dataset tailored to interactive 360-degree world exploration, comprising over 1,300 hours of at least 4K panoramic videos with rich semantic and geometric annotations. Built on MUGEN, we further present Wan360, a camera-controllable interactive panoramic video generation model. Panoramic videos are commonly represented by EquiRectangular Projection (ERP), which unfolds a spherical 360-degree view into a rectangular frame with cyclic longitude seams and pole distortions. To this end, Wan360 introduces three parameter-free ERP-aware components: periodic longitude RoPE for seam-consistent positional encoding, ERP-aware padding for reducing boundary artifacts, and random roll yaw for consistent learning. For camera control, Wan360 uses a panoramic Plücker embedding that represents camera motion with ERP rays rather than perspective pinhole rays. Experiments show that MUGEN serves as a data foundation for panoramic world exploration, and that Wan360 enables high-quality, temporally coherent, camera-controllable 360-degree video generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出大规模全景视频数据集MUGEN与相机可控的交互式全景视频生成模型Wan360，通过ERP感知组件与全景Plücker嵌入实现高质量、时序连贯的360度视频生成。
AI.motivation: 交互式全景视频生成面临数据与模型的双重缺口：现有全景视频数据集时长短、标注弱、缺少相机轨迹；而现有相机可控视频生成模型面向透视视频，无法直接支持全景几何。
AI.method: 提出MUGEN数据集（超1300小时、至少4K、含丰富语义与几何标注）作为基础；在其上构建Wan360模型，引入三个无参数ERP感知组件（周期性经度RoPE用于接缝一致位置编码、ERP感知填充减少边界伪影、随机滚转偏航实现一致性学习），并采用以ERP光线表示相机运动的全景Plücker嵌入进行相机控制。
AI.result: 实验表明MUGEN可作为全景世界探索的数据基础，Wan360能够实现高质量、时序连贯、相机可控的360度视频生成。
AI.conclusion: MUGEN填补了交互式全景视频的数据空白，Wan360解决了透视模型难以处理全景几何的问题，二者共同推动了全景世界探索与可控360度视频生成的发展。

title: OmniTaskonomy: When Does Visual Generation Improve Visual Understanding?
summary: Training a model to generate visual content can encourage it to learn rich perceptual capabilities related to geometry, spatial relationships, and objectness; yet, its benefits for visual understanding remain unclear. We ask: when and how does visual generation supervision improve visual understanding? We study controlled pairs of image-to-image (I2I) generation and image-to-text (I2T) understanding tasks that express the same underlying problem in different output modalities. We find that under the correct recipe, I2I training improves downstream I2T performance, with larger gains as the amount of I2I training data increases. We next ask which generation tasks benefit which understanding capabilities. To study transfer beyond paired tasks, we introduce OmniTaskonomy, a unified taxonomy spanning 19 I2I generation tasks and 25 I2T understanding capabilities. The resulting transfer map reveals selective, task-dependent benefits. Some follow intuitive correspondences, e.g., depth prediction improving metric 3D reasoning, object pointing improving counting, and jigsaw reconstruction improving 2D ordering. Interestingly, we also uncover surprising connections: 2.5D segmentation improving category recognition and Z-depth prediction improving localization. To probe these patterns, we analyze gradient alignment between generation and understanding tasks and find that stronger alignment is associated with larger downstream transfer gains. Together, our results highlight visual generation as a rich source of supervision for visual understanding and provide a roadmap for unlocking its benefits through the right training curriculum and task selection. Project page: https://omni-taskonomy.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证了视觉生成任务可作为视觉理解的有效监督来源：在正确的训练配方下，I2I 生成训练能提升 I2T 理解性能，且增益随生成数据量增加而扩大。
AI.motivation: 训练模型生成视觉内容可能促使其学习几何、空间关系与物体性等感知能力，但生成监督对视觉理解的收益尚不明确，作者旨在回答“视觉生成监督何时以及如何提升视觉理解”。
AI.method: 设计控制变量实验，构造成对的 I2I 生成与 I2T 理解任务（同一底层问题、不同输出模态）；进一步提出 OmniTaskonomy 统一分类体系，涵盖 19 个 I2I 生成任务与 25 个 I2T 理解能力，构建迁移图谱；并分析生成与理解任务间的梯度对齐程度。
AI.result: 在正确配方下，I2I 训练提升 I2T 性能且随 I2I 数据量增加增益更大；迁移图谱显示任务依赖的选择性收益，既有直观对应（深度预测→度量 3D 推理、物体指示→计数、拼图重建→2D 排序），也有意外联系（2.5D 分割→类别识别、Z-depth 预测→定位）；更强的梯度对齐对应更大的下游迁移增益。
AI.conclusion: 视觉生成是视觉理解的丰富监督来源，通过合适的训练课程与任务选择可释放其收益，为后续研究提供了路线图。

title: VISTA: Internalizing Collective Visual Experience via On-Policy Distillation for Active Multimodal Agents
summary: Active multimodal agents use visual tools to acquire task-relevant evidence while reasoning. Although reinforcement learning samples multiple interaction trajectories per input, outcome-based objectives primarily use the group to estimate scalar advantages, leaving complementary visual discoveries underused. We introduce VISTA, which internalizes collective visual experience through on-policy distillation by turning observations from same-input rollouts into shared supervision. Collective visual experience distillation (CVED) organizes these observations with their interaction context and aligns them with individual decisions, while heterogeneity-aware policy improvement (HAPI) reinforces successful trajectories and provides experience-guided distillation for unsuccessful attempts. An experience-conditioned teacher evaluates the student's sampled response prefixes, allowing discoveries from one trajectory to guide learning in another without replacing the student's original history or generating new target trajectories. The trained agent retains its visual tools and acts using its own interaction history. VISTA achieves the strongest average performance among the evaluated active multimodal agents of comparable size and consistently outperforms same-backbone training baselines across fine-grained perception and general reasoning tasks, demonstrating the value of collective experience for active multimodal learning.

AI.tldr: VISTA通过在同输入多轨迹采样中利用视觉发现进行在策略蒸馏，将集体视觉经验转化为共享监督信号，在细粒度感知与通用推理任务上取得优于同类规模主动多模态智能体的性能。
AI.motivation: 主动多模态智能体借助视觉工具获取任务相关证据，但主流强化学习虽对同一输入采样多条交互轨迹，却仅用组内轨迹估计标量优势，导致各轨迹中互补的视觉发现被浪费。
AI.method: 提出VISTA框架，通过同策略蒸馏内化集体视觉经验：集体视觉经验蒸馏（CVED）按交互上下文组织观测并与个体决策对齐；异构感知策略改进（HAPI）强化成功轨迹并对失败尝试提供经验引导蒸馏；经验条件化教师评估学生采样响应前缀，使一条轨迹的发现能指导另一条轨迹的学习，同时不替换学生原有历史、也不生成新目标轨迹。
AI.result: 在评估的同等规模主动多模态智能体中取得最强平均性能，并在细粒度感知与通用推理任务上稳定优于同骨干网络训练基线。
AI.conclusion: 集体经验对主动多模态学习具有重要价值；受训智能体保留视觉工具并基于自身交互历史行动，验证了经验蒸馏范式的有效性。

title: Self-Aligned Forcing: Streaming Video Diffusion with Differentiable Noisy History
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion enables interactive streaming generation, but suffers from error accumulation over long rollouts. Self-rollout training reduces exposure bias, yet finite rollouts leave long-range drift unresolved. We observe that the noise level of the history key-value (K/V) representations trades visual quality against motion, and that restoring gradients through the history aligns causal training far more closely with bidirectional training. Motivated by these observations, we introduce Self-Aligned Forcing (SAF), a training scheme that aligns the history of each block with the noise level of the block being denoised. Specifically, the history is the K/V produced by preceding blocks at the same denoising stage, so all blocks at a stage can be denoised in a single forward pass under a causal mask. This keeps the noisy history differentiable, allowing future losses to optimize how it is encoded. SAF therefore avoids a separate no-gradient rollout and per-block timestep-zero recaching, training up to 1.8x faster than prior methods with lower memory. At inference, SAF achieves the highest single-GPU throughput among existing methods and keeps one history bank per stage for a multi-GPU pipeline, reaching 49.1 FPS on 4 GPUs. Experiments show superior long-horizon generation with a better balance between visual quality and motion. Project page: https://anonymous.4open.science/w/self-aligned-forcing/.

AI.tldr: 提出 Self-Aligned Forcing (SAF) 训练方案，通过将每个 block 的历史 K/V 与当前去噪阶段的噪声水平对齐，使历史保持可微，从而缓解自回归视频扩散长时序误差累积，训练提速最高 1.8×，4 GPU 上达 49.1 FPS。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频扩散支持交互式流式生成，但长 rollout 存在误差累积；自 rollout 训练可缓解曝光偏差，但有限的 rollout 无法解决长程漂移。作者观察到历史 K/V 表示的噪声水平在视觉质量与运动之间形成权衡，且恢复历史梯度可使因果训练更接近双向训练，由此提出对齐历史的方案。
AI.method: SAF 将每个 block 的历史与正在去噪 block 的噪声水平对齐。历史由同一去噪阶段的前序 block 产生的 K/V 构成，因此同一阶段所有 block 可在因果掩码下单次前向完成去噪。历史保持含噪且可微，使未来损失能优化历史的编码方式，从而避免独立的无梯度 rollout 和逐 block 的 timestep-zero 重缓存。
AI.result: 训练速度比先前方法最高快 1.8× 且内存更低；推理时在现有方法中取得最高单 GPU 吞吐，并可为多 GPU 流水线每阶段保留一个 history bank，4 GPU 达 49.1 FPS。实验显示长时序生成更优，视觉质量与运动之间平衡更好。
AI.conclusion: SAF 通过历史噪声水平对齐并保持历史可微，显著提升自回归视频扩散的训练效率与长程生成质量，同时兼顾推理吞吐与多 GPU 流水线扩展性。

title: GA-EIRFS: A Geometry-Augmented Repeat-Factor Sampling Method for Long-Tailed LiDAR 3D Object Detection
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures, Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027
summary: Long-tailed 3D object detection is treated as a class-frequency problem, but LiDAR supervision quality depends on object observability: similar frequencies can hide different geometric evidence. We introduce Geometry-Augmented Exponentially Weighted Instance-Aware Repeat Factor Sampling (GA-EIRFS), a detector-agnostic method that modulates a frequency-based repeat factor with a fixed geometry score combining point count, surface-normal entropy, and surface coverage. GA-EIRFS changes only frame-sampling probabilities, leaving the detector and inference unchanged. On nuScenes it improves mean average precision (mAP) and the nuScenes detection score (NDS) in four converged experiments with CenterPoint and PointPillars over two seeds; for CenterPoint at seed 666, mAP rises from 0.552 to 0.563 and bicycle AP from 0.306 to 0.359. Per-class gains correlate with the class sampling-weight increase (Spearman rho=0.70, p=0.025) but not with geometry score alone (rho=0.32, p=0.37), so geometry amplifies frequency-driven need. KITTI results vary across seeds, most for the rarest class. Code: https://github.com/Multimodal-Sensing-Lab/GA-EIRFS.
