AI.tldr: 提出GA-EIRFS采样方法，用几何分数调制频率重复因子，仅改帧采样概率，在nuScenes上稳定提升长尾3D检测性能。
AI.motivation: 长尾3D目标检测通常被视为类别频率问题，但LiDAR监督质量实际取决于目标可观测性——相似频率的类别可能对应差异很大的几何证据量，因此仅按频率采样不足。
AI.method: GA-EIRFS（Geometry-Augmented Exponentially Weighted Instance-Aware Repeat Factor Sampling）：在基于频率的重复因子上引入固定几何分数，几何分数由点云点数、表面法向熵和表面覆盖率组合而成；仅改变帧采样概率，检测器结构与推理流程不变，与检测器无关。
AI.result: 在nuScenes上，CenterPoint与PointPillars两个检测器、两个随机种子的四次收敛实验均提升mAP与NDS；CenterPoint在seed 666下mAP由0.552升至0.563，bicycle AP由0.306升至0.359。各类别增益与采样权重增量相关（Spearman rho=0.70, p=0.025），但与几何分数单独不相关（rho=0.32, p=0.37）。KITTI结果随种子波动，最稀有类别波动最大。
AI.conclusion: 几何可放大频率驱动的采样需求，但几何分数需与频率耦合才有效；GA-EIRFS是一种即插即用、检测器无关的采样策略，跨数据集稳定性仍受随机种子影响。

title: VideoLoop: Looped Working Memory Against Semantic Thrashing in Long-Form Video Agents
summary: Long-form video understanding requires multimodal agents to iteratively gather evidence over many reasoning steps. However, most existing agentic methods suffer from semantic thrashing: as append-only working memory grows, attention to key evidence collapses, and the agent loses access to what it has already found. First, we provide a structural argument showing that append-only memory can incorporate newly observed target evidence, but cannot remove accumulated noise or prevent ordered context growth without a rewrite operator. Second, motivated by this analysis, we propose VideoLoop, a multimodal agent with two coupled loops. The outer loop reasons over the video and the inner loop, after each step, retrieves artifacts from an unbounded filesystem of past observations and intermediate analysis, and rewrites a bounded working memory. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of VideoLoop, which improves four popular LVLM backbones in a plug-and-play manner, with an average gain of 4.2% points over baseline on VideoMME (long). Further analysis of working memory suggests that VideoLoop mitigates semantic thrashing: on the hardest quarter of VideoMME (long) questions, a blind judge that reads only the agent's context answers 81.1% correctly, versus 60.9% for the append-only agent. With Gemini 3.1 Pro, VideoLoop reaches 88.3% on VideoMME (long), 88.8% on VideoMMMU, and 80.9% on LongVideoBench (long).

AI.tldr: VideoLoop 是一种带内外双循环记忆重写机制的多模态智能体，通过有界工作记忆缓解长视频理解中的"语义抖动"问题。
AI.motivation: 长视频理解要求多模态智能体在多步推理中迭代收集证据，但现有智能体方法普遍存在"语义抖动"（semantic thrashing）：随着仅追加式（append-only）工作记忆不断增长，模型对关键证据的注意力崩溃，导致智能体丧失对已发现信息的可访问性。
AI.method: 首先从结构上论证：仅追加式记忆能纳入新观察到的目标证据，但在缺少重写算子的情况下无法移除累积噪声、也无法阻止上下文有序增长。据此提出 VideoLoop：外循环在视频与内循环上进行推理；内循环在每步之后，从存储历史观测与中间分析的无限文件系统中检索相关产物，并对有界工作记忆执行重写。
AI.result: VideoLoop 以即插即用方式提升四个主流 LVLM 主干，在 VideoMME (long) 上平均较基线提升 4.2 个百分点；在 VideoMME (long) 最难的四分之一问题上，仅读取智能体上下文的盲评判官正确率为 81.1%，而仅追加式智能体为 60.9%。搭配 Gemini 3.1 Pro 时，VideoMME (long) 达 88.3%、VideoMMMU 达 88.8%、LongVideoBench (long) 达 80.9%。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入重写算子和双循环检索-重写机制，VideoLoop 有效缓解了语义抖动，验证了有界工作记忆对长视频多模态智能体推理的关键作用，并在多个长视频基准上取得领先性能。

title: HelixWorld: A Real-time Interactive Audio-Visual World Model
summary: World simulation is inherently multisensory, demanding synchronized visual and acoustic dynamics in real time. Yet prevailing interactive world models remain strictly silent, focusing exclusively on visual rendering and control while overlooking the acoustic dimension. We present HelixWorld, a real-time interactive audio-visual world model where visual scenes and camera-grounded spatial stereo sound co-evolve natively under user interaction. We curate a high-fidelity spatial audio-visual dataset with true stereo acoustics and metric camera poses, upon which we pre-train a bidirectional teacher conditioned on 6-DoF camera trajectories and user actions. To enable low-latency causal interaction, we distill the teacher into a few-step streaming student via an online trajectory distillation loss, sustaining drift-free joint audio-visual rollouts at 24 FPS on a single GPU. Furthermore, we formalize spatial-acoustic consistency and introduce HelixBench to evaluate whether synthesized sound fields faithfully track dynamic viewpoint motion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HelixWorld matches state-of-the-art silent world models in visual fidelity and responsiveness, while significantly surpassing existing baselines in camera-aligned spatial-acoustic immersion.

AI.tldr: 提出 HelixWorld，一个实时交互式音视频世界模型，实现视觉场景与相机锚定的空间立体声在用户交互下的原生协同演化，单GPU达24 FPS，并建立 HelixBench 评测空间声学一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式世界模型仅专注视觉渲染与控制，普遍"静音"，忽视声学维度；而真实世界模拟本质上是多感官的，需要视觉与声学动态实时同步。因此亟需构建同时生成并控制空间音频的交互式世界模型。
AI.method: 1) 构建带真实立体声声学与度量相机位姿的高保真空间音视频数据集；2) 基于6-DoF相机轨迹与用户动作预训练双向教师模型；3) 通过在线轨迹蒸馏损失将教师蒸馏为少步流式学生模型，实现低延迟因果交互；4) 形式化空间—声学一致性，并提出 HelixBench 评测合成声场是否忠实跟随动态视点运动。
AI.result: 在视觉保真度与响应性上匹配当前最先进的"静音"世界模型，并在相机对齐的空间声学沉浸感上显著超越现有基线；单GPU上以24 FPS维持无漂移的联合音视频推演。
AI.conclusion: HelixWorld 将声学维度引入交互式世界模型，实现视觉与空间立体声的实时原生协同演化，为多感官世界模拟提供了数据集、蒸馏训练范式与一致性评测基准。

title: CLeaR: A Unified Framework for Resolving the Leakage-Degradation Dilemma in Style Transfer
summary: Style transfer aims to render target content in the style of a reference image, but existing methods often suffer from content leakage, where objects, layouts, or semantics from the style reference appear in the generated output. Although prior data-driven and training-free methods can reduce leakage, they often face a leakage-degradation dilemma: stronger content suppression may weaken style fidelity, while richer style preservation may reintroduce unwanted reference content. We identify this dilemma across the full style-transfer pipeline, including feature separation, feature-space grounding, and diffusion generation. To address these issues, we propose CLeaR, a training-free framework for content-leakage-resistant style transfer. CLeaR first uses Orthogonal Subspace Projection to define content-reduced style targets in each vision foundation model (VFM) feature space. It then performs Ensemble Inversion, which optimizes a shared pixel-space style anchor satisfying style constraints across multiple VFMs. Finally, Energy-Guided Calibration maintains style alignment during diffusion sampling by steering the denoising trajectory toward the ensemble-defined style manifold. We further provide a theoretical analysis showing that the style-anchor estimation error decreases with the number of VFMs. Experiments on StyleBench demonstrate that CLeaR improves style alignment, reduces content leakage, and achieves better LLM-as-Judge evaluation compared with existing methods. The code is available at \href{https://github.com/0606zt/CLeaR}{https://github.com/0606zt/CLeaR}.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架CLeaR，通过正交子空间投影、集成反演与能量引导校准，缓解风格迁移中的内容泄漏与风格退化的两难问题。
AI.motivation: 现有风格迁移方法存在内容泄漏，即参考图中的物体、布局或语义渗入生成结果；数据驱动或免训练方法虽可缓解，却陷入"泄漏—退化"两难：抑制内容会削弱风格保真度，保留风格又会引入参考内容。作者在特征分离、特征空间接地、扩散生成全流程中识别出该问题。
AI.method: CLeaR为免训练框架，包含三步：1）正交子空间投影（Orthogonal Subspace Projection），在各视觉基础模型（VFM）特征空间中定义去内容的风格目标；2）集成反演（Ensemble Inversion），优化一个共享的像素空间风格锚点，使其满足多VFM的风格约束；3）能量引导校准（Energy-Guided Calibration），在扩散采样时引导去噪轨迹趋向集成定义的风格流形。
AI.result: 理论分析表明风格锚点估计误差随VFM数量增加而减小；在StyleBench上实验显示，CLeaR相比现有方法提升了风格对齐、减少了内容泄漏，并在LLM-as-Judge评测中取得更优结果。
AI.conclusion: CLeaR通过多VFM集成与流形引导，有效缓解内容泄漏与风格退化的两难，兼顾风格保真与内容纯净，代码已开源。

title: Breaking the Uniformity Trap: Scaling Video Diffusion Model via SplitMoE
comment: Accepted as a Spotlight paper at NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://yuci-gpt.github.io/SplitMoE/
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), popularized by large language models, is a promising paradigm for scaling visual generative models. However, conventional token-wise MoE routes tokens independently within a homogeneous expert pool and regularizes expert usage toward uniformity, making it poorly matched to video data that is spatiotemporally redundant and semantically long-tailed. We show that existing visual MoEs fall into a uniformity trap: semantically under-organized routing, compounded by uniform expert-usage regularization, scatters coherent patches across disparate experts, causing routing fragmentation and structural distortion. To address this, we propose SplitMoE, a split-role sparse architecture that breaks the shackles of uniformity. To accommodate the inherent semantic imbalance, we explicitly bifurcate the expert pool into semantic experts and generic experts, with semantic experts capturing high-level semantic abstraction and generic experts preserving residual visual information and flexible generative capacity. Leveraging prototype-guided routing and pull-push regularization, SplitMoE enables tokens to cluster naturally by semantic attributes rather than arbitrary balancing constraints. Extensive results show that under an equivalent activated-parameter budget, SplitMoE outperforms traditional load-balanced MoEs in convergence speed, routing coherence, and video generation quality across standard benchmarks. By revealing an emergent coarse-to-fine denoising logic, SplitMoE provides the community with a modality-aware scaling path, serving as a critical reference for building large-scale video world models.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出视觉MoE存在"均匀性陷阱"，提出SplitMoE分裂角色稀疏架构，将专家池划分为语义专家与通用专家，配合原型引导路由与推拉正则，实现视频生成的质量与收敛提升。
AI.motivation: 传统token级MoE独立路由token并将专家使用正则化趋向均匀，与视频数据的时空冗余和语义长尾特性不匹配，导致路由碎片化和结构失真。
AI.method: SplitMoE将专家池显式二分为语义专家（高层语义抽象）与通用专家（保留残差视觉信息与生成灵活性），采用原型引导路由和推拉正则，使token按语义属性自然聚类而非服从均衡约束。
AI.result: 在等效激活参数预算下，SplitMoE在收敛速度、路由一致性和视频生成质量上均优于传统负载均衡MoE，并展现出粗到细的去噪逻辑。
AI.conclusion: SplitMoE打破均匀性束缚，提供面向模态的扩展路径，可作为构建大规模视频世界模型的重要参考。

title: LIFT: Layout-In-Future Video Generation under Large Viewpoint Change via On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: We introduce LIFT, a unified image-to-video generation framework that complements camera control with Layout-In-FuTure control, enabling users to specify what should appear in a future view and where it should appear. This addresses a practical need in controllable video generation: given an initial image, users often care not only about how the camera moves, but also about what the scene should look like at key future moments, especially the final frame. Existing camera controls specify viewpoint trajectories, while text prompts provide only coarse semantic guidance; neither precisely determines the content and spatial layout of future views. This limitation becomes particularly pronounced under large viewpoint changes, where the camera reveals regions that are not visible in the first frame. LIFT therefore uses the last-frame layout as an explicit control signal for the desired future scene. Since learning from such sparse layout guidance is substantially more challenging than conditioning on dense per-frame layouts, we introduce on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) to transfer the control capability of a dense-layout teacher to a last-frame-layout student. We further curate LIFT-Vista, a dataset featuring large viewpoint changes with camera and temporally consistent layout annotations. Experiments show that LIFT improves video quality, future-layout controllability, and camera controllability over other methods.

AI.tldr: LIFT是一个统一的图像到视频生成框架，通过"末帧布局（Layout-In-FuTure）"控制与相机控制互补，让用户指定未来视图中出现的内容及其空间位置。
AI.motivation: 现有相机控制只指定视点轨迹，文本提示仅提供粗粒度语义引导，二者都无法精确确定未来视图的内容与空间布局。在大视角变化下问题尤为突出，因为相机会揭示首帧中不可见的区域，用户不仅关心相机如何运动，也关心关键未来时刻（尤其是末帧）场景应呈现的样子。
AI.method: 以末帧布局作为未来场景的显式控制信号。由于从稀疏布局引导中学习远比基于逐帧稠密布局的条件生成困难，提出on-policy self-distillation（OPSD），将稠密布局教师模型的控制能力迁移到末帧布局学生模型。此外构建LIFT-Vista数据集，包含大视角变化以及相机与时间一致的布局标注。
AI.result: 实验表明，LIFT在视频质量、未来布局可控性和相机可控性方面均优于其他方法。
AI.conclusion: LIFT通过末帧布局控制与OPSD蒸馏策略，结合LIFT-Vista数据集，实现了对图像到视频生成中未来内容与空间布局的精确可控，弥补了相机控制与文本提示的不足。

title: FracGen: Learning How Objects Stretch and Tear with Physics-Informed Video Generation
summary: We introduce FracGen, a fracture-aware video generation model that produces plausible, controllable fracture dynamics from a single image of an intact object, conditioned on physics signals. To train FracGen, we build FracSim, a fracture-aware simulation framework that augments material point method (MPM) simulation with a continuum damage model, producing paired fracture videos and dense, pixel-aligned physical fields at no additional cost beyond standard rendering. FracGen leverages these maps in two ways: it is trained to jointly predict them alongside RGB video, encouraging the model to capture physical state rather than surface appearance; and it is supervised with physics-informed losses that encourage consistency among the predicted maps. As a result, FracGen captures distinct material-specific fracture behavior without expensive test-time simulation or per-scene tuning, while offering fine-grained control over where an object tears, how fast the crack propagates, and how much deformation precedes failure. We further introduce a benchmark for evaluating the physical plausibility of generated fracture video, and show through extensive experiments that FracGen outperforms existing video generation baselines in both physical and visual fidelity. Results are best viewed in our project website: https://fracgen.github.io/.

AI.tldr: FracGen 是一个从单张完整物体图像生成可控断裂动力学的视频生成模型，结合连续损伤模型的 MPM 仿真数据与物理信号条件，实现材料特异的逼真断裂效果，并提出物理合理性评测基准。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型难以产生物理上合理的断裂动力学，且依赖昂贵的测试时仿真或逐场景调参，缺乏对断裂位置、裂纹传播速度、失效前变形的细粒度控制。
AI.method: 构建 FracSim 仿真框架：在 MPM 上加入连续损伤模型，零额外代价生成配对断裂视频与密集像素对齐物理场；FracGen 联合预测物理场与 RGB 视频，并施加物理信息损失约束各预测图之间的一致性，以物理信号为条件实现可控生成。
AI.result: 无需测试时仿真或逐场景调参即可捕捉材料特异的断裂行为；可控制断裂位置、裂纹传播速度与失效前变形量；在物理保真度与视觉保真度上均优于现有视频生成基线，并提出了断裂视频物理合理性评测基准。
AI.conclusion: FracGen 通过仿真数据与物理信息监督相结合，实现了可控且物理合理的断裂视频生成，并建立了相应评测基准，为物理感知视频生成提供了新范式。

title: PowerSim: Differentiable Physics Simulation and Rendering with Power Diagrams
summary: We introduce PowerSim, a method to bring physically grounded, differentiable dynamics to PowerFoam's power diagram based 3D representation. PowerSim directly couples a pre-trained PowerFoam scene to the Material Point Method (MPM) by exploiting a natural alignment between the two: the geometric and appearance properties of each primitive correspond closely to the quantities MPM already tracks as an object deforms. Consequently, simulated motion can drive the scene's geometry and appearance directly, without an auxiliary representation in between. Built on this framework, we enable a range of applications on real and synthetic scenes: (1) simulating a static scene under user interaction, (2) recovering spatially varying material fields, (3) compositing primitives from independently captured scenes into a single simulation-ready scene and (4) ray-tracing reflections that update consistently as the object deforms. Our results suggest that PowerSim excels over previous frameworks for physically grounded dynamics, while unlocking unique advantages-such as secondary ray lighting effects on dynamic scenes. Results are best viewed on our project website: https://power-sim.github.io/.

AI.tldr: PowerSim 将预训练的 PowerFoam 场景直接耦合到物质点法（MPM），实现可微、物理驱动的 3D 动态仿真。
AI.motivation: 现有物理仿真与 3D 场景表示之间通常需要辅助表示进行转换，本文旨在将物理仿真直接作用于 PowerFoam 的 power diagram 表示，省去中间环节。
AI.method: 利用 PowerFoam 每个图元的几何与外观属性与 MPM 追踪量之间的天然对齐，将预训练场景直接耦合到 MPM，使仿真运动直接驱动场景的几何与外观。
AI.result: 实现了四类应用：用户交互下的静态场景仿真、空间变化材质场恢复、独立采集场景的图元合成与仿真、随形变实时更新的光线追踪反射。
AI.conclusion: PowerSim 在物理驱动动态方面优于以往框架，并解锁了动态场景次级光线光照效果等独特优势。

title: LongLive-Plug: Once-for-All Distillation for Video Generation
comment: Code and models are available at https://github.com/NVlabs/LongLive
summary: Video diffusion models are increasingly developed into specialized models for diverse downstream tasks, and this development often includes a distillation stage, for example to accelerate sampling or to improve long-video generation. This stage is typically repeated for every specialized model. We introduce LongLive-Plug, a once-for-all distillation framework that learns reusable capabilities as LoRAs on a base model for training-free, plug-and-play deployment to compatible downstream models. These capabilities include single-pass classifier-free guidance, few-step sampling, and long-context error correction for autoregressive generation. The adapters remain reusable even when downstream models add conditioning branches, expand output channels. Despite training at a fixed guidance scale, our dedicated CFG LoRA provides text guidance control through its inference weight. Combining it with a few-step LoRA simultaneously preserves few-step generation and CFG controllability on downstream tasks. We verify training-free deployment on 54 downstream models across three backbone families and eight task categories, including world modeling, robotics, editing, and multimodal generation. The approach may support additional compatible models. Each capability can thus be distilled once per backbone family and reused without per-target retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出 LongLive-Plug 一次性蒸馏框架，把可复用能力（CFG、少步采样、长上下文纠错）学成 LoRA，免训练即插即用迁移到下游模型。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散模型日益专用化，每个下游模型通常都要单独重复一次蒸馏阶段（如加速采样、改进长视频生成），成本高且不可复用。因此需要一种"一次蒸馏、多模型复用"的方案。
AI.method: 在基座模型上以 LoRA 形式学习可复用能力，包括单次前向的无分类器引导（single-pass CFG）、少步采样、面向自回归生成的长上下文误差纠正；适配器在下游模型新增条件分支、扩展输出通道时仍可复用；用专门的 CFG LoRA 在固定引导尺度训练下，通过推理权重实现文本引导控制，并与少步 LoRA 组合以同时保持少步生成与 CFG 可控性。
AI.result: 在 3 个骨干家族、8 类任务（含世界建模、机器人、编辑、多模态生成）的 54 个下游模型上验证了免训练部署，且方法可能支持更多兼容模型。
AI.conclusion: 每项能力只需在每个骨干家族上蒸馏一次即可复用，无需针对每个目标模型重新训练。

title: Beyond the Timeline: Augmenting Long-Video Memory with Grounded Entity Biographies
summary: Answering questions about long videos often requires connecting events involving the same objects across hours or days. Chronological descriptions and text-derived entities can leave physical identity unresolved: different objects may share a description, while observations of the same object remain disconnected across events. Retrieving relevant events therefore does not necessarily recover the "biography" of the particular entity a question concerns. To address this, we introduce Grounded Entity Biographies (GEB), a long-video memory framework that groups visually grounded observations of the same physical instance across clips into retrievable biographies while preserving the context of each moment. During question answering, the biography is retrieved alongside episodic evidence, allowing the model to follow an entity through events using identity links established during memory construction. Evaluations across four benchmarks, including day-long and week-long recordings, demonstrate improvements over prior memory frameworks in both multiple-choice and open-ended question answering. On EgoLifeQA, GEB achieves 72.0% accuracy, 4.4 percentage points above the best published result. Ablations show that grounded identity association and biography reading both contribute to the gains, which additional descriptions alone do not fully recover.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Grounded Entity Biographies（GEB），一种长视频记忆框架，通过将跨片段的同一物理实例的视觉 grounding 观测聚合为可检索的"传记"，并在问答时结合片段证据检索，从而解决实体身份跨事件断裂的问题，在四个基准上超越现有记忆框架，EgoLifeQA 上达到72.0%准确率。
AI.motivation: 长视频问答需要跨小时甚至跨天连接涉及同一物体的事件，但按时间顺序的描述和从文本派生的实体无法解决物理身份问题：不同物体可能共享同一描述，而同一物体的观测在不同事件间彼此割裂。因此，仅检索相关事件未必能还原问题所关注特定实体的"传记"。
AI.method: GEB 在记忆构建阶段将跨片段的同一物理实例的视觉 grounding 观测分组为可检索的 biography，同时保留每个时刻的上下文；问答阶段将 biography 与片段式证据一同检索，使模型可借助记忆构建时建立的 identity links 沿事件追踪实体。
AI.result: 在包括整日与整周录像的四个基准上，GEB 在多项选择与开放式问答中均优于此前的记忆框架；在 EgoLifeQA 上达到72.0%准确率，比最佳已发表结果高4.4个百分点。消融实验显示，grounded identity association 与 biography reading 均有贡献，而仅增加描述无法完全复现这些增益。
AI.conclusion: 以视觉 grounding 的实体身份关联为核心构建可检索的实体传记，是提升长视频问答中跨事件实体追踪能力的有效途径，且其收益不能由单纯的描述增强替代。

title: DMA$^2$: Pixel-space Distribution Matching with Adversarial and Anchor Losses
summary: Distribution matching distillation (DMD) provides a general framework for few-step diffusion generation, but its modern text-to-image instantiations have been developed primarily around latent diffusion. It therefore overlooks key properties and design opportunities of native RGB. We revisit two DMD interfaces for pixel-space teachers. On the teacher-matching side, diagnostics show low-noise RGB matching is dominated by a local-texture cue, motivating a fixed high-noise matching band. On the real-data side, native clean-RGB outputs allow guidance from an external visual representation without traversing a decoder or sharing the heavy fake-score critic. DINO-Adv removes this critic from the adversarial gradient path and supplies local parametric patch guidance. For distribution-level guidance, we introduce AF-Loss, a parameter-free auxiliary semantic distribution-field objective designed for text-to-image DMD. It operates on detached rolling real and generated supports in the shared DINOv2 space while preserving prompt-conditioned teacher supervision. AF-Loss adds no learnable parameters or inference-time computation. Together these designs form DMA$^2$. Across DPG-Bench, GenEval, VQAScore, and COCO30K, the four-step DMA$^2$ student performs better than the 25-step teacher and evaluated few-step distillers.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对原生RGB像素空间的扩散蒸馏，重新审视DMD的两个接口，提出DINO-Adv与AF-Loss，合称DMA^2，四步学生模型在多个基准上超过25步教师与已有少步蒸馏方法。
AI.motivation: 现有分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）的现代文生图实例主要基于潜空间扩散，忽略了原生RGB像素空间教师的关键特性与设计机会，因此需要针对像素空间教师重新设计DMD的两个接口。
AI.method: 在教师匹配侧，诊断发现低噪声RGB匹配由局部纹理线索主导，据此采用固定的高噪声匹配带；在真实数据侧，原生干净RGB输出可直接从外部视觉表示获得引导，无需经过解码器或共享沉重的假分数判别器。提出DINO-Adv，将判别器从对抗梯度路径中移除并提供局部参数化patch引导；提出AF-Loss，一种无参数的辅助语义分布场目标，在共享DINOv2空间中对分离的滚动真实与生成支撑集操作，同时保留提示条件教师监督。AF-Loss不增加可学习参数或推理开销。二者共同构成DMA^2。
AI.result: 在DPG-Bench、GenEval、VQAScore和COCO30K上，四步DMA^2学生模型优于25步教师以及所评估的少步蒸馏方法。
AI.conclusion: 针对像素空间教师的DMD接口重新设计是有效的，DMA^2通过DINO-Adv与AF-Loss在无额外参数与推理成本的情况下实现高质量少步文生图生成。

title: Rethinking Representations for World-Action Modeling
summary: World-action models jointly learn robot policies and predict future observations, making the representation space an interface between control and prediction. We study the design of this space through controlled comparisons, finding that neither reconstruction fidelity nor pre-trained perceptual features alone ensure effective policy learning. These findings motivate ReWAM, a representation-centric world-action model built on pre-trained DINO features. Feature Calibration and a Temporal Representation Bottleneck organize these features into compact world states suited to dynamics modeling. Action-Grounded Representation Shaping routes only action-loss gradients to the bottleneck, thereby letting the policy shape what the representation encodes while the world model learns how it evolves. Without generative video pre-training, ReWAM achieves 93.6% success on RoboTwin 2.0. On RoboDojo, it achieves an average score of 12.29 and a success rate of 8.28% using approximately 600 hours of embodied pre-training data.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究世界-动作模型中表示空间的设计，提出以预训练DINO特征为核心的ReWAM模型，通过特征校准、时序表示瓶颈和动作锚定表示塑造实现紧凑世界状态，无需生成式视频预训练即在RoboTwin 2.0达到93.6%成功率。
AI.motivation: 世界-动作模型需同时学习机器人策略与预测未来观测，表示空间成为控制与预测的接口。但现有设计缺乏对该空间的受控比较，尚不清楚何种表示对策略学习有效。
AI.method: 通过受控对比实验发现：重建保真度或预训练感知特征单独均不足以保证有效策略学习。据此提出ReWAM：基于预训练DINO特征，采用特征校准(Feature Calibration)与时序表示瓶颈(Temporal Representation Bottleneck)组织为紧凑世界状态；并通过动作锚定表示塑造(Action-Grounded Representation Shaping)仅将动作损失梯度回传至瓶颈，使策略塑造表示编码内容，世界模型学习其演化。
AI.result: 无需生成式视频预训练，ReWAM在RoboTwin 2.0上达到93.6%成功率；在RoboDojo上使用约600小时具身预训练数据，取得平均分12.29、成功率8.28%。
AI.conclusion: 以预训练感知特征为基础、经结构化组织与动作梯度引导的表示空间，可有效支撑世界-动作模型，在无视频预训练条件下取得强策略性能，表明表示设计是控制与预测协同的关键。

title: Cropland PAtteRNS: Parallel Dimensional Attention Networks and Attention to Dataset Disparity for Crop Segmentation in Satellite Imagery Time Series Data
comment: Main body: 19 pages, 7 figures; Appendices: 15 pages, 16 figures. All code and models associated with this work are available at https://github.com/JoeMetc/CroplandPAtteRNS , along with preparation guides for the two publicly available crop segmentation datasets used in this work
summary: The landscape of satellite imagery time series datasets and boundary-pushing architectures for cropland segmentation has never been richer. However, in this gold rush, important truths are being missed on both fronts, as a drive for the most novel concepts or the largest datasets pushes finer details to the side. In this paper, we present our hybrid transformer-convolutional model, Cropland Parallel Attention and Refinement Network for Segmentation (PAtteRNS), the first model to use self-attention mechanisms separately for each of the temporal, spectral, and spatial aspects of Sentinel-2 multispectral SITS data. To achieve fully-factorised attention in our proposed model, we introduce a novel parallel transformer architecture which significantly reduces the computational complexity of triple-factorised self-attention. We validate our architecture with an in-depth ablation study, and analyse the performance of our model against state-of-the-art crop segmentation models on multiple tile-size variants of the popular PASTIS and MTLCC datasets. Our findings show our model to outperform all others in the task of crop class segmentation, verified across multiple important segmentation metrics, with especially strong performance against compared models seen in the often under-reported parcel delineation quality, for which we use the Boundary IoU metric. We also find that flawed class groupings within datasets can have a significant negative impact on model performance, and report that alternate tile-size variants of crop segmentation datasets produce results incomparable to one-another, invalidating fair comparison between model performance when trained on different tile-sizes. Based on these findings, we suggest further work is required to standardise best practices when constructing SITS crop segmentation datasets, and to enable future dynamic-tile-sizing for ideal model performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出混合Transformer-卷积模型PAtteRNS，首次对Sentinel-2多光谱SITS数据的时序、光谱和空间三个维度分别应用自注意力机制，通过新型并行Transformer架构降低三因子分解自注意力的计算复杂度。
AI.motivation: 当前遥感耕地分割领域过度追逐新颖架构与超大数据集，忽视了细节问题：一方面缺乏对SITS数据多维度（时序、光谱、空间）注意力的精细化建模，另一方面数据集本身存在类别分组缺陷与瓦片尺寸不统一等问题，导致模型性能比较不公。
AI.method: 提出Cropland Parallel Attention and Refinement Network for Segmentation（PAtteRNS），一种Transformer-卷积混合模型。其核心是并行Transformer架构，对Sentinel-2多光谱SITS数据在时序、光谱、空间三个维度分别独立施加自注意力，实现完全因子化注意力，并显著降低三因子分解自注意力的计算复杂度。作者还进行了深入的消融实验，并在PASTIS和MTLCC数据集的多种瓦片尺寸变体上与当前最先进作物分割模型对比。
AI.result: PAtteRNS在作物类别分割任务上优于所有对比模型，在多个重要分割指标上得到验证，尤其在鲜有报告的地块边界划分质量（采用Boundary IoU度量）上表现显著领先。此外，研究发现数据集内错误的类别分组会显著负面影响模型性能；不同瓦片尺寸变体的作物分割数据集产生的结果无法相互比较，使得基于不同瓦片尺寸训练的模型性能之间无法进行公平对比。
AI.conclusion: 需要进一步工作来标准化SITS作物分割数据集构建的最佳实践，并支持未来的动态瓦片尺寸机制以获得理想模型性能。

title: Adversarial Training for Pixel Diffusion
summary: Pixel diffusion models generate RGB images directly, avoiding the bottleneck of an autoencoder, yet their outputs still systematically underrepresent fine-scale natural-image statistics. We show that adversarial learning provides an effective post-training correction for this deficiency. Starting from a pretrained model, we retain its original diffusion or flow-matching objective and add an adversarial loss to the predicted output at non-high-noise timesteps, leaving the model architecture and sampling procedure unchanged. To our knowledge, this is the first systematic study of adversarial post-training for pixel diffusion. Across two pixel backbones, the method jointly improves distribution fidelity, coverage, prompt alignment, and perceptual quality. We further investigate why it works. Frequency-band and power-law analyses show that the original models systematically underproduce natural-image high-frequency content, while adversarial post-training restores this missing spectral power. In contrast, perceptual loss also increases high-frequency content but sacrifices distribution fidelity and prompt alignment. Nearest-neighbor, recall, and matched no-GAN SFT controls further rule out memorization, mode dropping, and additional optimization as simple explanations. Finally, we examine the boundary of this effect. Under the tested latent diffusion configurations, the same procedure does not produce comparable joint gains and adds almost no decoded high-frequency power. These results identify direct output access to the image statistics being corrected as a key factor governing when adversarial post-training succeeds.

AI.tldr: 本文证明对抗式后训练能有效修正像素扩散模型对自然图像高频统计量的系统性欠表征：在保留原扩散/流匹配目标和非高噪声时间步上加入对抗损失，可同时提升分布保真度、覆盖度、提示对齐与感知质量，而潜空间扩散中同样步骤几乎无效。
AI.motivation: 像素扩散模型直接生成 RGB 图像，避开了自编码器瓶颈，但其输出仍系统性欠表征细尺度自然图像统计量（如高频内容）。作者希望找到一种不改架构、不改采样流程的后训练修正手段，并系统厘清其作用机理与适用边界。
AI.method: 在预训练像素扩散模型基础上做对抗式后训练：保留原有扩散或流匹配目标，仅在非高噪声时间步对预测输出施加对抗损失，模型架构与采样过程不变。在两个像素骨干网络上验证，并通过频带与幂律分析、感知损失对照、最近邻/召回率/无 GAN 的 SFT 对照，以及潜空间扩散配置的边界实验进行机理与边界分析。
AI.result: 在两个像素骨干上，该方法联合改善分布保真度、覆盖度、提示对齐与感知质量。频带与幂律分析显示原模型系统性少生成自然图像高频成分，对抗后训练恢复了缺失的谱功率；感知损失虽也增加高频，却牺牲分布保真度与提示对齐。最近邻、召回率与匹配的无 GAN SFT 对照排除了记忆化、模式丢弃和额外优化等简单解释。在测试的潜空间扩散配置下，同样流程没有可比的联合增益，且几乎未增加解码后的高频功率。
AI.conclusion: 对抗式后训练是像素扩散的有效修正手段，其成功的关键在于模型能否直接访问待修正的图像统计量（直接输出访问）；潜空间扩散因解码器阻隔而效果受限。

title: Imagine3D-LLM: Teaching MLLMs to Imagine 3D Scenes Before Answering
summary: Reasoning about the 3D world from multi-view images remains a fundamental challenge for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). While modern MLLMs handle single-image inputs effectively, they struggle to integrate evidence across viewpoints into a coherent 3D understanding. A growing body of work attempts to close this gap by injecting 3D awareness into MLLMs, either by boosting fine-grained pixel-level cross-view correspondence or by fusing features from 3D geometry foundation models, yet a substantial gap to human reasoning persists. In this work, we revisit human spatial reasoning, which suggests that rather than relying on fine-grained geometry cues, humans roughly identify common objects across views, infer the relative geometry between viewpoints, and assemble a coarse 3D layout of the scene. Inspired by this process, we introduce Imagine3D-LLM, an MLLM that learns to assemble a similar compact 3D representation of the scene and conditions its answer on this representation. Concretely, we append a small set of learnable summary tokens after the image tokens, decode them into a compact 3D Gaussian Splatting representation supervised by a photometric reconstruction loss, and train jointly with the standard next-token prediction objective. Notably, although only the summary tokens receive direct reconstruction supervision, this objective also induces stronger cross-frame correspondence within the LLM's underlying image features, suggesting that learning to reconstruct propagates 3D-aware signals throughout the model. As a result, Imagine3D-LLM consistently outperforms prior approaches across multiple spatial reasoning and 3D understanding benchmarks, suggesting that imagining the scene can be more effective than being told its pixel-wise geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Imagine3D-LLM，受人类粗略空间推理启发，通过可学习的 summary tokens 解码出紧凑的 3D Gaussian Splatting 表示，并以光度重建损失与下一 token 预测联合训练，从而提升 MLLM 的多视图 3D 空间推理能力。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在单图输入上表现良好，但难以整合多视角证据形成一致的 3D 理解。现有方法通过增强像素级跨视图对应或融合 3D 几何基础模型特征来注入 3D 感知，但与人类推理仍有明显差距。作者重新审视人类空间推理：人类并不依赖细粒度几何线索，而是粗略识别跨视图同物、推断视点间相对几何，并组装粗略的 3D 场景布局。
AI.method: 提出 Imagine3D-LLM：在图像 tokens 后附加少量可学习的 summary tokens，将其解码为紧凑的 3D Gaussian Splatting 表示，并用光度重建损失监督，同时与标准 next-token prediction 目标联合训练。尽管仅 summary tokens 接受直接重建监督，但该目标也在 LLM 底层图像特征中诱导出更强的跨帧对应，说明学习重建可将 3D 感知信号传播至整个模型。
AI.result: Imagine3D-LLM 在多个空间推理与 3D 理解基准上一致优于先前方法，表明“想象场景”比直接获知像素级几何更有效。
AI.conclusion: 以紧凑、可重建的 3D 表示作为答案条件，可有效弥合 MLLM 的多视图 3D 推理差距；重建式监督不仅作用于 summary tokens，还能反向增强图像特征中的跨视图对应，是一种优于显式注入细粒度几何线索的范式。

title: Point2Part: Unified 3D Partitioning from Point Prompts
summary: Existing 3D part decomposition methods do not necessarily partition the original shape into non-overlapping parts that collectively cover the entire shape, allowing overlaps or gaps that hinder downstream part-level applications. We instead formulate part decomposition as a joint partitioning of the entire shape, where the predicted parts are non-overlapping and jointly recover the entire shape. Our key insight is that part decomposition should consider all desired parts jointly, rather than modeling each part independently. To this end, we develop a promptable model for 3D part decomposition from images or meshes. Users can specify desired parts through 3D point prompts for controllable decomposition. Given one point prompt per desired part, our model produces the corresponding parts as a complete partition of the entire shape. We build on a pretrained 3D generation model and first obtain a shape latent from either an input image or mesh. We then introduce a prompt encoder that maps each 3D point prompt to a part token while attending to the shape latent. To decode the desired parts, we propose a novel part decoder jointly scoring the entire shape against all part tokens in a coarse-to-fine manner, assigning every position within the shape volume to exactly one part. We perform part decomposition in this shared shape latent space, enabling a unified model for image-to-part generation, mesh-to-part generation, and part segmentation. Our method outperforms existing works on all part-quality metrics across all three tasks, and improves compatibility among parts by an order of magnitude over previous SOTA methods. Code and models will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出可提示的3D部件分解模型，将形状联合划分为互不重叠且完整覆盖的部件，统一支持图像/网格到部件生成及部件分割。
AI.motivation: 现有3D部件分解方法不保证部件互不重叠且完整覆盖原形状，存在重叠或缝隙，阻碍下游部件级应用。作者的关键洞见是：部件分解应联合考虑所有目标部件，而非独立建模每个部件。
AI.method: 基于预训练3D生成模型，从图像或网格获取形状潜变量。引入提示编码器，将每个3D点提示映射为部件token并关注形状潜变量。提出新型部件解码器，以粗到细方式联合对所有部件token评分整个形状，将形状体积内每个位置恰好分配给一个部件。整个过程在共享形状潜空间中完成。
AI.result: 在全部三类任务（图像到部件生成、网格到部件生成、部件分割）的所有部件质量指标上均优于现有方法，部件兼容性较此前SOTA提升一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 将部件分解建模为对整个形状的联合划分，并在共享潜空间中统一处理多任务，可有效实现可控、完整且互不重叠的3D部件分解。代码与模型将开源。

title: PrototypeNAS: Rapid Design of Deep Neural Networks for Microcontroller Units
comment: Accepted at ECML-PKDD 2026. 18 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables. This work was funded by the European Commission as part of the MANOLO project under the Horizon Europe programme Grant Agreement No.101135782
summary: Enabling efficient deep neural network (DNN) inference on edge devices with different hardware constraints is a challenging task that typically requires DNN architectures to be specialized for each device separately. To avoid the huge manual effort, one can use neural architecture search (NAS). However, many existing NAS methods are resource-intensive and time-consuming because they require the training of many different DNNs from scratch. Furthermore, they do not take the resource constraints of the target system into account. To address these shortcomings, we propose PrototypeNAS, a zero-shot NAS method to accelerate and automate the selection, compression, and specialization of DNNs to different target microcontroller units (MCUs). We propose a novel three-step search method that decouples DNN design and specialization from DNN training for a given target platform. First, we present a novel search space that not only cuts out smaller DNNs from a single large architecture, but instead combines the structural optimization of multiple architecture types, as well as optimization of their pruning and quantization configurations. Second, we explore the use of an ensemble of zero-shot proxies during optimization instead of a single one. Third, we propose the use of Hypervolume subset selection to distill DNN architectures from the Pareto front of the multi-objective optimization that represent the most meaningful tradeoffs between accuracy and FLOPs. We evaluate the effectiveness of PrototypeNAS on 12 different datasets in three different tasks: image classification, time series classification, and object detection. Our results demonstrate that PrototypeNAS is able to identify DNN models within minutes that are small enough to be deployed on off-the-shelf MCUs and still achieve accuracies comparable to the performance of large DNN models.

AI.tldr: 提出零样本NAS方法PrototypeNAS，可快速自动化地为不同MCU选择、压缩并特化DNN架构，无需从头训练即可在数分钟内找到满足资源约束且精度可比的模型。
AI.motivation: 在边缘设备（尤其是不同硬件约束的MCU）上高效部署DNN推理，通常需要为每个设备单独特化网络架构。手工特化代价巨大，而现有NAS方法存在两大不足：一是需要从零训练大量不同DNN，资源消耗大、耗时长；二是未将目标系统的资源约束纳入搜索考量。因此需要一种快速、自动化且资源感知的方案。
AI.method: PrototypeNAS是一种零样本NAS方法，核心是解耦DNN设计与特化同训练的三步搜索：1）设计新搜索空间，不仅从单一大型架构中裁剪出更小的DNN，还融合多种架构类型的结构优化，以及剪枝与量化配置的优化；2）使用零样本代理（zero-shot proxies）集成而非单一代理进行优化；3）采用超体积子集选择（Hypervolume subset selection）从多目标优化的Pareto前沿中提取在精度与FLOPs间最具意义权衡的DNN架构。
AI.result: 在图像分类、时间序列分类和目标检测三类任务的12个数据集上进行评估。结果表明PrototypeNAS能在数分钟内识别出可部署于现成MCU的小型DNN模型，且精度与大模型相当。
AI.conclusion: PrototypeNAS通过零样本代理集成、多架构/剪枝/量化联合搜索空间及超体积子集选择，有效避免了从零训练的高昂开销，实现了面向不同MCU的快速、自动化、资源感知的DNN选择与特化，在多个任务上兼顾小体积与高精度。

title: HeadGuard: Selective Head Protection for Low-Bit VLM KV-Cache Quantization
summary: Low-bit key-value (KV) cache quantization saves storage but can sharply degrade vision-language model (VLM) accuracy. We introduce HeadGuard, a composable head-protection method that augments a base KV-cache quantizer with a fixed high-precision mask. Image-sensitivity and output-sensitivity scores select physical KV heads offline, with approximately 1/8 protected in the main experiments; their image keys and optionally values remain in bfloat16 (BF16), while the base quantizes unprotected image entries. Across eight VLMs, three base quantizers, and eight benchmarks (six discriminative and two generative), HeadGuard recovers a substantial fraction of lost accuracy on weaker quantizers, with the strongest gains for Qwen and InternVL. At 2 bits, the six-task discriminative mean over eight models rises from 0.436 to 0.580 on the weakest base; protection can also improve generated answers and caption fidelity to BF16 outputs. Mean accuracy gains persist across all three quantizers with both tested calibration datasets. Keys-only protection retains substantial recovery at lower modeled storage cost. Evaluated through simulated quantization, HeadGuard offers a composable way to improve low-bit VLM accuracy without replacing the underlying quantizer.

AI.tldr: HeadGuard：一种可组合的注意力头保护方法，通过固定高精度掩码保护约1/8对图像和输出敏感的KV头，显著缓解极低位VLM KV缓存量化带来的精度损失。
AI.motivation: 低位KV缓存量化可节省存储，但会严重降低视觉语言模型（VLM）精度，需要一种不替换底层量化器、可叠加使用的补救方案。
AI.method: HeadGuard采用即插即用的头保护策略：离线计算图像敏感度与输出敏感度分数以筛选物理KV头，主实验中约保护1/8的头；被保护头的图像Key（可选Value）保持BF16，未被保护图像条目由基础量化器处理。方法在8个VLM、3种基础量化器和8个基准（6判别+2生成）上评估，并测试了两种校准数据集及仅保护Key的变体，采用模拟量化实现。
AI.result: 在较弱量化器上挽回大量精度损失，Qwen与InternVL增益最大；2比特下8模型六任务判别均值从0.436提升至0.580；生成答案与描述保真度也可改善；三种量化器、两种校准集上均值增益一致；仅Key保护在更低存储成本下仍保留可观恢复。
AI.conclusion: HeadGuard是一种可组合的通用增强手段，无需替换底层量化器即可提升低位VLM精度，且具备跨模型、量化器与任务的稳健性。

title: PACT: Pairwise-Anchored Calibrated Tuning for Single-Token Typed Decisions
summary: Single-token typed-decision models answer a schema question by reading the logits of a few one-letter answer codes at a single position: they are fast and return a probability for every allowed answer, but they are trained with plain cross-entropy that ignores most of the structure in their training data. We study such a model whose data is curated as contrastive pairs---two contexts that differ in one edited fact that flips the answer---each carrying a machine-checked certificate that deleting the decisive sentence makes the fact unknown. We propose PACT, which turns this structure into four training terms that need no new annotation: a difference-in-differences margin over each pair that is invariant to any shared logit offset, a permutation-consistency term against answer-code position bias, an evidence-necessity term on certificate-verified ablated contexts, and an ordinal transport cost for rubric fields, plus a three-parameter contextual temperature. On a frozen 324-item holdout with three seeds, PACT matches the published recipe in accuracy ($84.6\%$ vs. $85.2\%$; McNemar $p \ge 0.50$ at every seed) while giving the lowest position bias of all runs (answer flips under relabelling $9.8\%$ vs. $13.8\%$) and the lowest ordinal error on rubric fields (MAE $0.232$ vs. $0.311$). Against a control with the same optimiser and schedule but cross-entropy only, PACT is significantly more accurate at two of three seeds, halves the seed-to-seed spread and lowers NLL by $26\%$. Seed-matched ablations and pre-specified falsification tests locate these gains precisely: no single term raises raw accuracy, and the method's value lies in robustness and stability rather than headline accuracy. Code, data splits, trained adapters, and all run records are available at https://github.com/BennyLinntu/PACT-Pairwise-Anchored-Calibrated-Tuning-for-Single-Token-Typed-Decisions.

AI.tldr: PACT将对比对与机器校验证书结构转化为四个无需新标注的训练项，在单token类型化决策模型中匹配基线准确率，同时显著降低位置偏差、序数误差与种子间波动。
AI.motivation: 单token类型化决策模型虽快速且可为每个允许答案给出概率，但仅用普通交叉熵训练，忽略了训练数据中的大部分结构（对比对、可翻转答案的编辑事实、机器校验的删除决定性句子即未知的证书）。作者希望在不增加新标注的前提下把这些结构用于训练。
AI.method: PACT将数据结构转为四个训练项：（1）每对对比样本上的双重差分margin，对任意共享logit偏移不变；（2）针对答案代码位置偏差的排列一致性项；（3）在证书验证的消融上下文上的证据必要性项；（4）面向评分字段的序数传输代价；外加一个三参数的上下文温度。
AI.result: 在冻结的324项留出集、三种子下：PACT准确率与已发表配方相当（84.6% vs 85.2%；各种子McNemar p≥0.50），但位置偏差最低（重标注下答案翻转9.8% vs 13.8%），评分字段序数误差最低（MAE 0.232 vs 0.311）。相对同优化器与调度但仅用交叉熵的对照，PACT在三个种子中的两个显著更准，种子间波动减半，NLL降低26%。种子匹配消融与预设证伪检验表明：无单项提升原始准确率，价值在于鲁棒性与稳定性而非头部准确率。
AI.conclusion: PACT在不牺牲准确率的前提下，利用对比对与机器校验证书的结构显著提升单token类型化决策模型的鲁棒性与稳定性（降低位置偏差、序数误差、种子方差与NLL）；其收益来源于各训练项的组合而非单一项，方法价值在于稳健性而非头部精度。

title: The Decision Value of Perception Compute
summary: Adaptive perception spends extra computation on inputs where perception is expected to improve. When perception feeds a downstream decision system, a better perception output need not produce a better decision. We define the decision value of perception compute as the change in downstream loss from escalating an input from a cheap to an expensive perception mode. Because this value can be negative, the allocation of perception compute should be judged against a budget-constrained decision oracle, with uniform full-fidelity inference as a baseline rather than an upper bound. We introduce DEEP (Decision Evaluation for Escalated Perception), a benchmark that scores pre-escalation allocators against this oracle under selection, latency and energy budgets, charging each allocator for its own computation. With deployed monocular geometry on KITTI and nuScenes, we find that 34--54% of the escalations that change downstream loss make it worse; harmful escalations also occur for the published PDM-Closed planner, evaluated open-loop on nuPlan with real detector outcomes. On nuScenes, perception-level gain frequently disagrees in sign with decision value. This mismatch has practical consequences: choosing among fixed deployable signals by missed-object perception gain rather than by decision value reduces realized test decision gain by 7.4% of the all-cheap loss on average. Learned allocators recover part of the oracle's value by finding beneficial escalations but select nearly as much harm as random, and once their own computation is charged at a 20% latency budget, only the lightweight routers, at about 3.5\% of a full detector pass, still beat random.

AI.tldr: 本文定义"感知算力的决策价值"(决策损失变化)，提出DEEP基准，以预算受限的决策神谕为参照评测预升级分配器，发现34–54%的升级反而使决策变坏，且感知增益与决策价值常不同号。
AI.motivation: 自适应感知通常假定"感知更好→决策更好"，但当感知服务于下游决策系统时，更优的感知输出未必带来更优决策。因此需要重新界定感知算力分配的评判标准，并量化感知增益与决策价值之间的错配及其后果。
AI.method: 定义"感知算力的决策价值"为输入从廉价模式升级到昂贵模式所导致的下游损失变化；以预算受限的决策神谕(budget-constrained decision oracle)为评判基准，将统一全保真推理视为基线而非上界。提出DEEP基准，在选择、延迟与能量预算下对预升级分配器打分，并对分配器自身计算计费。在KITTI、nuScenes(单目几何)与nuPlan(PDM-Closed规划器，真实检测器输出，开环)上进行评测。
AI.result: 34–54%的改变下游损失的升级使损失变坏；该有害升级在PDM-Closed规划器上同样出现。nuScenes上感知级增益与决策价值常符号不一致。按漏检感知增益而非决策价值来选择固定可部署信号，会使实际测试决策增益平均下降相当于全廉价损失的7.4%。学习型分配器能找回部分神谕价值，但其选出的有害升级接近随机水平；在20%延迟预算并对自身计算计费后，仅轻量路由器(约全检测器一遍的3.5%)仍优于随机。
AI.conclusion: 感知算力的分配应以决策价值而非感知指标为准则，感知增益并非决策价值的有偏代理；现有学习型分配器在计入自身开销后优势有限，只有极轻量路由仍具价值。

title: Making Cross-Continental Federated Learning Repeatable with FLIP: a Multi-Application Study
comment: 25 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/londonaicentre/FLIP
summary: Federated learning (FL) in healthcare remains challenging, as the overhead of rebuilding governance guarantees for every collaboration stops most projects at the proof-of-concept stage. Here we present FLIP (Federated Learning Interoperability Platform), an open-source, multi-application platform that makes FL training and evaluation repeatable. FLIP implements common FL workflows as a set of composable services: cohort queries against per-site structured databases, on-demand DICOM retrieval from institutional PACS, per-site project approval, and reusable FL job types. To demonstrate FLIP, we ran two distinct use cases, federated fine-tuning and federated evaluation, on synthetic chest X-ray cohorts across two client nodes based in the United Kingdom (UK) and Thailand. In FLIP, each institution independently approves its participation in each project and operates its own node under local IT security processes. This study makes an operational rather than an algorithmic claim. It does not compare federated with centralised training; for that question, we refer the reader to existing systematic reviews and meta-analyses. The central result is evidence that such platforms enable international FL collaboration and improve repeatability, auditability, and site-specific governance. We also present a comprehensive comparison of existing platforms to help researchers and operators choose the right platform for their use case.

AI.tldr: 提出开源多应用平台FLIP，将联邦学习常见流程实现为可组合服务（队列查询、DICOM按需获取、站点级项目审批、可复用FL作业类型），并在英国与泰国两节点上用合成胸部X光队列完成联邦微调与联邦评估两个用例，证明该平台可支撑国际FL协作并提升可复现性、可审计性与站点自治治理。
AI.motivation: 医疗领域联邦学习的主要障碍并非算法，而是每次协作都需重建治理保障，导致多数项目停留在概念验证阶段，缺乏可复用的流程与平台支撑。
AI.method: 开发开源多应用平台FLIP（Federated Learning Interoperability Platform），把常见FL工作流抽象为一组可组合服务：针对各站点结构化数据库的队列查询、从机构PACS按需检索DICOM、站点级项目审批、可复用的FL作业类型；每个机构独立审批参与并依据本地IT安全流程运行自有节点；在两节点（英国、泰国）上以合成胸部X光队列执行联邦微调与联邦评估两个用例；并对现有平台进行系统比较。
AI.result: 在两个国际节点上成功完成联邦微调和联邦评估两类用例，表明平台能够支持国际FL协作，并改善复现性、可审计性与站点特定治理；同时给出了现有平台的综合对比，供研究者与运维者选型参考。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献为操作性而非算法性主张，不比较联邦与集中式训练（该问题参考既有系统综述与元分析）；核心结论是此类平台可使国际联邦学习协作可行并提升可复现性、可审计性和站点自治治理。

title: On the spectral properties of generative denoiser Jacobians
summary: Generative denoising models, such as diffusion and flow-matching, learn to sample from complex distributions by training a deep neural network denoiser to recover clean data from noise-corrupted samples. While such models are typically compared on the quality of their synthesized samples, these metrics provide limited insight into how the underlying denoiser, which drives generation, differs. In this work, we propose to analyze the spectrum of the denoiser Jacobian as a tool to characterize these differences. Across pre-trained denoising models, we observe that better generative performance is associated with larger Jacobian eigenvalues. Motivated by this, we introduce a regularization scheme that controls the Jacobian spectrum by training the denoiser on perturbed inputs, with perturbations suppressing or amplifying Jacobian responses. On ImageNet, we test whether directly modifying the Jacobian spectral properties leads to improved generations. Our findings suggest that denoisers benefit from both strengthening responses along data-relevant principal eigen-directions and suppressing the noisy, data-irrelevant ones. This establishes the denoiser Jacobian as a useful tool for identifying differences between generative denoising models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以去噪器雅可比谱作为分析工具，发现更好生成性能对应更大雅可比特征值，并提出通过扰动输入正则化控制雅可比谱，在ImageNet上验证增强数据相关主特征方向、抑制无关噪声方向可提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 生成式去噪模型（扩散、流匹配）通常以合成样本质量进行比较，但这类指标难以揭示驱动生成的核心组件——去噪器本身的结构差异，缺乏对去噪器内在性质的刻画工具。
AI.method: 提出分析去噪器雅可比矩阵的谱（Jacobian spectrum）；在此基础上引入正则化方案，通过在扰动输入上训练去噪器来控制雅可比响应（抑制或放大），从而直接修改雅可比谱性质。
AI.result: 在预训练去噪模型中观察到更好的生成性能与更大的雅可比特征值相关联；在ImageNet上，直接调控雅可比谱性质可带来生成改进，表明去噪器既受益于增强数据相关主特征方向的响应，也受益于抑制噪声化的、数据无关方向的响应。
AI.conclusion: 去噪器雅可比可作为识别生成式去噪模型差异的有效工具，雅可比谱与生成性能存在关联，且可通过正则化主动调控以提升生成效果。

title: One-Step Next-Latent Prediction Is Not a World Model
summary: Next-latent prediction fits a map from the current embedding to the next one. LeNEPA carries this objective to time series, replacing the stop-gradient of next-embedding prediction with the isotropy penalty of LeJEPA. A world model is a transition kernel that can be rolled out. The one-step regression identifies a conditional mean, and a mean is a kernel only in special cases. For a linear-Gaussian Markov latent, the mean transition and the innovation covariance are fixed by the one-step problem, and the open-loop squared error at horizon $K$ equals the trace of the sum of the pushed-forward innovation covariances. That error grows with $K$ after the one-step fit is exact. If the conditional mean is nonlinear, composing it is not the multi-step conditional mean. If the observation is a non-injective function of a Markov state, a memoryless one-step map does not determine future observations, while a short window can. An isotropy penalty is a function of the embedding marginal, so its partial derivative in the transition weights is zero. On a scalar autoregression with coefficient $0.9$, the one-step mean squared error is $0.998$ and the $16$-step open-loop error is $5.10$. On a hidden rotation, an eight-step window reaches $16$-step error $0.056$, while the current scalar alone reaches $0.778$. Raising the isotropy weight from $0.1$ to $10$ leaves eight-step latent error inside $[0.78,0.85]$ on three seeds.

AI.tldr: 该文分析LeNEPA将下一潜变量预测目标用于时间序列的可行性，指出单步回归只识别条件均值、不构成一般转移核，因而开环多步误差随步长增长；实证显示窗口输入与各向同性惩罚无法解决该结构性缺陷。
AI.motivation: 将next-latent prediction（下一嵌入预测）目标迁移到时间序列，并用LeJEPA的各向同性惩罚替代stop-gradient，试图构建可展开（rollout）的世界模型。作者需要检验：单步预测拟合出的映射是否真的构成多步可用的转移核。
AI.method: 理论分析：从转移核与条件均值的关系出发，在linear-Gaussian Markov latent下推导单步问题对均值转移与创新协方差的约束，并计算horizon K的开环平方误差；讨论非线性条件均值复合、非单射观测下的可辨识性，以及各向同性惩罚仅依赖嵌入边缘分布（对转移权重的偏导为零）。实验：系数0.9的标量自回归、隐藏旋转任务、调整各向同性权重（0.1→10）与多种子测试。
AI.result: 标量自回归（系数0.9）单步MSE为0.998，16步开环误差升至5.10；隐藏旋转任务中，8步窗口使16步误差降至0.056，而仅用当前标量时为0.778；将各向同性权重从0.1提高到10，三个种子下8步潜变量误差仍落在[0.78,0.85]区间。
AI.conclusion: 单步回归只识别条件均值，仅在特殊情形下才构成转移核，故其开环误差在单步拟合精确后仍随K增长；非线性均值复合不等于多步条件均值，非单射观测下无记忆单步映射无法决定未来观测；各向同性惩罚对转移权重梯度为零，无法纠正该问题。因此LeNEPA式目标不足以支撑可靠的多步展开世界模型。

title: PyroStack: A Multi-Band Spatio-Temporal Sub-Daily Dataset for Wildfires in the United States
summary: Wildfires are an increasing hazard to ecosystems, air quality, and human systems, creating a growing need for datasets that support systematic development and evaluation of models for predicting fire spread across diverse landscapes. Effective prediction requires integrating meteorological conditions, fuels, vegetation, and topography at spatial and temporal resolutions suitable for both physical simulation and data-driven approaches. However, existing datasets often lack the resolution and coverage needed to capture these interacting controls. The PyroStack dataset addresses this gap by providing a harmonized, event-based collection of wildfire and environmental data across the contiguous United States and Alaska. It integrates satellite-derived fire observations with atmospheric reanalysis, vegetation, fuel characteristics, and topographic information into a unified framework spanning 6994 wildfires that occurred between 2012 and 2024 across a wide range of ecosystems and climate conditions. PyroStack offers spatial resolutions ranging from 30 m to 9 km and hourly temporal resolution, along with fire progression data at 12-hour intervals to support model initialization and evaluation. By combining broad spatial coverage with fine spatial and temporal detail, the dataset enables systematic analysis of wildfire dynamics and supports both physics-based and machine learning approaches, providing a foundation for benchmarking and improving fire spread models, with future extensions aimed at incorporating additional regions and fire suppression data streams to further advance wildfire prediction.

AI.tldr: PyroStack是一个覆盖美国本土与阿拉斯加、包含6994起野火的事件化协调数据集，融合卫星火情观测、大气再分析、植被、燃料与地形数据，提供30 m–9 km空间分辨率和逐小时/12小时间隔时序，用于野火蔓延模型的发展与评估。
AI.motivation: 野火对生态系统、空气质量和人类系统构成日益严重的威胁，迫切需要能支持野火蔓延模型系统开发与评估的数据集。有效预测需在多时空尺度上整合气象条件、燃料、植被和地形，但现有数据集在分辨率和覆盖范围上不足，难以刻画这些相互作用的控制因素。
AI.method: 构建PyroStack数据集：以事件为单位，将卫星遥感火情观测与大气再分析、植被、燃料特征和地形信息整合到统一框架中，覆盖美国本土与阿拉斯加的6994起野火（2012–2024年），空间分辨率30 m–9 km，时间分辨率逐小时，并提供12小时间隔的火蔓延进展数据以支持模型初始化与评估。
AI.result: 数据集涵盖多种生态系统和气候条件下的6994起野火，具备广域空间覆盖与精细时空细节，可支持野火动态的系统性分析，并同时适用于物理模拟与机器学习方法，为火蔓延模型的基准测试与改进提供基础。
AI.conclusion: PyroStack通过协调多源异构数据、兼顾大范围覆盖与高时空分辨率，缓解了现有数据集在野火蔓延建模方面的不足，为物理模型与数据驱动方法的基准评估提供支撑；未来将扩展至更多区域并纳入灭火/消防抑制数据流。

title: AdaKerNet: Neural Kernel Decoding for Task-Adaptive Prediction with Multimodal Large Models
summary: Large foundation models have been introduced with the promise of efficient adaptation to downstream tasks. Yet, under limited supervision, MLLMs, an important class of large foundation models, remain challenging to adapt to various downstream tasks. Adaptation typically relies either on MLLM parameter fine-tuning or on training neural-based decoders. Both approaches struggle under limited supervision, while fine-tuning additionally requires access to model parameters, which is often unavailable for closed-source models. We introduce AdaKerNet, a novel learnable task-adaptive neural kernel decoder. AdaKerNet is fully agnostic to the parameters of the underlying MLLM and operates solely on its (frozen) rich representations obtained from the diverse available modalities. AdaKerNet relies on (i) a set of learnable, Lipschitz-controlled multimodal features derived from these MLLM representations; (ii) a reference kernel that provides a soft structural prior on those features; and (iii) a lightweight nonlinear neural predictor that adaptively deforms that structure. Learning the kernel representation and the neural predictor jointly within a unified optimization framework allows AdaKerNet to capture features and geometric relationships relevant to the downstream task. Numerical tests across four MLLMs: BLIP-2, LLaVA-1.5, Qwen2.5-VL, and Gemini Embedding 2, and multimodal inputs spanning text, audio, images, and tabular measurements demonstrate significant and consistent improvements over direct MLP, attention-, autoencoder- and kernel-based decoders, across a range of scarce-label budgets, with average error reduction of up to 41% across baselines. These results establish AdaKerNet as an effective approach for prediction from frozen multimodal representations in the scarce label regime. Additional structural ablations highlight the complementary contributions of AdaKerNet's components.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AdaKerNet——一种可学习的任务自适应神经核解码器，在冻结的多模态大模型（MLLM）表征上工作且无需访问模型参数，在稀缺标签条件下显著优于现有解码器。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型（MLLM）虽承诺可高效适配下游任务，但在有限监督下适配仍很困难。现有适配方法主要有两类：对 MLLM 参数进行微调，或训练神经解码器。二者在稀缺标签下均表现不佳，且微调还需要访问模型参数，而闭源模型往往无法获取。因此亟需一种与 MLLM 参数无关、且能在少标签条件下有效适配的解码方案。
AI.method: 提出 AdaKerNet，一种可学习的任务自适应神经核解码器，完全与底层 MLLM 参数无关（agnostic），仅作用于其冻结表征（覆盖多模态）。其核心由三部分组成：(i) 一组可学习、Lipschitz 可控的多模态特征，源自 MLLM 表征；(ii) 一个参考核，为这些特征提供软结构先验；(iii) 一个轻量非线性神经预测器，对上述结构进行自适应形变。核表征与神经预测器在统一优化框架内联合学习，从而捕捉与下游任务相关的特征及几何关系。
AI.result: 在四种 MLLM（BLIP-2、LLaVA-1.5、Qwen2.5-VL、Gemini Embedding 2）及横跨文本、音频、图像和表格数据的多模态输入上开展实验，相比直接 MLP、基于注意力、自编码器和基于核的解码器，在多种稀缺标签预算下均取得显著且一致的提升，平均误差降低最高达 41%。额外的结构消融实验验证了各组成部分的互补贡献。
AI.conclusion: AdaKerNet 是冻结多模态表征在稀缺标签场景下进行预测的有效方法，具备参数无关、跨模型与跨模态的通用性。

title: FineART: Fine-grained Annotated Robotic Trajectory Dataset and Vision-Language-Action Model for Bimanual Manipulation
comment: 26 pages. Code and model weights will be integrated into Hugging Face LeRobot https://github.com/huggingface/lerobot
summary: Robots operating in real-world environments must execute complex, multi-step bimanual tasks over long horizons rather than single, isolated actions. Current manipulation datasets struggle to support this capability: although single-arm datasets reach hundreds of thousands of trajectories, they typically provide only one high-level instruction per episode while the rare bimanual effort that does label subtasks annotates only a fraction of its hours. We present FineART, a densely annotated bimanual manipulation dataset of 40,543 episodes, 1,718 hours, and 533,913 subtasks across 151 tasks. We also introduce FineART-VLA, a vision-language-action policy that predicts its own next subtask, and show that mid-training it this way yields substantial gains. Specifically, success on a spatial disambiguation task increases from 32.0% to 100.0%, and step-by-step human subtask guidance lifts success on an unseen long-horizon task from 16.0% to 76.0%. Furthermore, after minimal fine-tuning on a new robot, the policy requires one-tenth the data of baselines without mid-training and generalizes zero-shot to completely unseen tasks on the new hardware. We open-source the full dataset, model weights, and training code.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FineART，一个密集标注的双臂操作数据集（40,543条轨迹、1,718小时、533,913个子任务、151个任务），并基于其训练FineART-VLA策略，使模型能自预测下一子任务，从而显著提升复杂长时序双臂任务的表现。
AI.motivation: 真实环境中的机器人需执行复杂、多步骤、长时序的双臂任务，而非孤立单步动作。现有操作数据集难以支撑该能力：单臂数据集虽规模大（数十万条轨迹），但通常每个episode仅提供一条高层指令；少数双臂数据集虽标注子任务，也仅覆盖其时长的一小部分，缺乏密集的子任务标注。
AI.method: 构建FineART数据集，提供密集子任务标注的双臂操作数据（40,543个episode、1,718小时、533,913个子任务、151个任务）。在此基础上提出FineART-VLA，一种视觉-语言-动作策略，能够预测自身的下一子任务，并采用该方式对模型进行mid-training。
AI.result: mid-training带来显著增益：空间消歧任务成功率从32.0%提升至100.0%；在未见长时序任务上，逐步人工子任务引导将成功率从16.0%提升至76.0%。在新机器人上仅需极少微调，策略所需数据量为未做mid-training基线的十分之一，并且能在新硬件上零样本泛化到完全未见过的任务。
AI.conclusion: 密集子任务标注与子任务自预测式mid-training是提升双臂长时序操作泛化与数据效率的有效途径。作者开源了完整数据集、模型权重与训练代码。

title: Losing the name before the box: measuring and repairing what narrow fine-tuning costs a detector outside its deployment vocabulary
comment: 25 pages, 3 figures. Supplementary material (69 pages) is included as an ancillary file. Submitted to the International Journal of Computer Vision
summary: A detector pretrained on a broad corpus is fine-tuned on a narrow domain, its in-domain accuracy improves, and it ships. We ask what happens meanwhile to its coverage of objects the vocabulary never names, which in obstacle detection and inspection carry the risk. No in-domain test set holds an example of one. We give a longitudinal protocol: one pretrained checkpoint against its own fine-tuned descendants. It tracks held-out top-$K$ proposal coverage $C_τ$: of categories pretraining covered and the vocabulary omits, the share of boxes a detector's top $K$ regions still cover. The quantity is the open-world proposal literature's; the longitudinal reading is not. $C_τ$ falls while in-domain accuracy rises, on four architectures and three domains, by $5.12$ to $63.35$ points on boxes above $1024$ px$^2$. No in-domain number identifies the fall, and neither does detection average precision, which charges a missed and a misnamed box alike. On the one architecture scoring both, adaptation costs $87\%$ of the AP against a fifth of the coverage, and the naming goes first at all six depths of its freeze ladder, every run. What breaks is structured: three architectures sharing no pretraining run agree on which categories lose coverage, and those a model never learned do not lose any. A repair follows and needs no training: mixing a quarter of the pretrained state back, normalisation statistics included, raises coverage on every cell swept for at most $2.47$ points of in-domain accuracy. Seeing it costs one extra evaluation pass.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示检测器在下游领域微调中出现的"隐性覆盖损失"：预训练模型在窄域微调后，域内精度上升，但对词表未命名类别的top-K提案覆盖度$C_\tau$显著下降（$5.12$–$63.35$个百分点），且该损失不被任何域内指标或AP识别；作者提出一种无需训练的修复方法——回混四分之一预训练权重（含归一化统计量）。
AI.motivation: 在障碍物检测与巡检等安全攸关场景中，真正的风险来自词表从未命名、域内测试集也不包含的物体。微调后的模型会"发布上线"，但其对这些未命名类别的覆盖能力是否被破坏，现有评测体系完全无法回答。论文试图建立一种纵向视角，量化预训练检测器在被微调为下游后代模型过程中，对预训练已覆盖但词表遗漏类别的提案覆盖变化。
AI.method: 提出纵向对比协议：以同一预训练checkpoint与其微调后代模型作对照，追踪留出的top-$K$提案覆盖度$C_\tau$。$C_\tau$定义为：在预训练已覆盖、但微调词表遗漏的类别中，检测器top-$K$区域仍能覆盖的框的比例。该指标源自开放世界提案文献，但纵向解读是本文新增。在4种架构、3个领域上验证，并按边界框面积（如大于$1024$ px$^2$）分层统计。此外设计冻结阶梯实验（6个深度）与结构化分析，并测试一种免训练修复：回混预训练状态（含归一化统计量）。
AI.result: 域内精度上升的同时$C_\tau$下降，四种架构、三个领域一致，在大于$1024$ px$^2$的框上降幅为$5.12$至$63.35$个百分点。任何域内指标都无法识别该下降，检测AP也不能，因为AP对漏检与错命名一视同仁。在同时报告AP与覆盖的架构上，适应过程以约$87\%$的AP损失换取约五分之一覆盖损失；命名能力在冻结阶梯的6个深度上均最先退化，且每次都如此。退化具有结构一致性：三个无共享预训练的架构对哪些类别失去覆盖存在共识，而模型从未学过的类别则毫无损失。修复无需训练：回混四分之一预训练状态（含归一化统计量）在每个扫描单元都提升覆盖，代价至多$2.47$个百分点的域内精度；仅需一次额外评估前向。
AI.conclusion: 微调会在提升域内精度的同时系统性侵蚀对未命名类别的提案覆盖，且这一退化对现有域内评测与AP均不可见；退化模式具有跨架构的结构一致性，并可通过免训练的预训练状态回混（四分之一权重含归一化统计量）以极小域内精度代价修复，仅增加一次评估开销。论文据此呼吁在检测器部署评测中引入$C_\tau$类纵向覆盖指标。

title: Fisher-IRG: Fisher-Induced Local Invariant Representation Geometry across Language and Vision Models
summary: Semantic-preserving transformations can induce substantial motion in learned representations, while small changes may strongly affect model predictions, raising a basic question: what local metric best captures semantically consequential variation? We propose Fisher-induced invariant representation geometry (Fisher-IRG), which measures local representation directions through their predictive sensitivity. Around each representation, we construct semantic-preserving and semantic-changing neighborhoods, aggregate their local Fisher information, and recover invariant directions through a contrastive generalized eigenvalue problem. Controlled displacement analyses first show that comparable Euclidean motion can have substantially different predictive consequences, supporting the need for a predictive geometry. Across language and vision models, Fisher-IRG yields stronger semantic-versus-nuisance predictive selectivity and generally more reproducible subspaces than covariance-based geometry, while recovering systematically distinct local directions. Representation interventions further localize semantic effects to the Fisher-derived subspace, and held-out separation and retrieval show that the recovered geometry generalizes beyond the discovery neighborhoods. These results support Fisher-IRG as a principled framework for characterizing local invariant representation geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Fisher诱导不变表示几何（Fisher-IRG），通过预测敏感性度量局部表示方向。围绕每个表示构建语义保持与语义改变邻域，聚合局部Fisher信息，并通过对比广义特征值问题提取不变方向。在语言与视觉模型上，Fisher-IRG比协方差几何具有更强的语义-噪声预测选择性、更可复现的子空间，且表示干预与检索结果验证其可泛化性。
AI.motivation: 语义保持变换可能在学得表示中引发显著位移，而微小变化又可能强烈影响预测。这引出一个基本问题：哪种局部度量最能刻画语义相关的变异？现有几何（如协方差）未必与预测敏感性对齐，因此需要一种基于预测敏感性的几何来刻画语义上有意义的变化方向。
AI.method: 提出Fisher诱导不变表示几何（Fisher-IRG）。对每个表示，构建语义保持邻域与语义改变邻域，分别聚合其局部Fisher信息；随后通过对比广义特征值问题求解不变方向，从而以预测敏感性度量局部表示方向。并辅以受控位移分析，比较相同欧氏位移在预测后果上的差异。
AI.result: 受控位移分析显示，可比的欧氏运动可能具有显著不同的预测后果，支持采用预测几何的必要性。在语言与视觉模型中，Fisher-IRG相较基于协方差的几何表现出更强的语义-噪声预测选择性与更可复现的子空间，同时恢复出系统上不同的局部方向。表示干预将语义效应定位到Fisher导出的子空间；留出集分离与检索表明该几何可泛化到发现邻域之外。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明Fisher-IRG可作为刻画局部不变表示几何的一个有原则的框架。

title: Staircase Policy: Streaming Inference for World-Action Models with Large Action Chunks
summary: World-Action Models (WAMs) improve robotic manipulation by conditioning action generation on predicted future observations, but future prediction adds further inference overhead to already expensive iterative action generation. Action chunking can amortize this cost over multiple actions, yet performance degrades over long execution horizons because later actions remain conditioned on stale observations. We introduce STAIRCASE POLICY, a streaming inference and training framework that turns a flow-matching VLA into a JEPA-style WAM and partitions a large action chunk into sub-chunks at staggered denoising stages. Near-term actions are executed as soon as they become available, while later actions continue to be refined. At each sub-chunk boundary, the future latent is re-predicted from the latest observation and used to update all unexecuted actions, enabling long-horizon execution without repeated full policy inference. The resulting future-prediction error can further serve as a signal for adaptive chunking. S-WAM achieves 97.7% on LIBERO and 87.9% on LIBERO-Plus, and improves performance across multiple policy backbones and real-robot tasks. It reaches 292.7 executed actions per second, $3.62\times$ the throughput of conventional execution at comparable accuracy, while reducing time-to-first-action from 123.6 to 73.3 ms. With additional inference optimizations, throughput further increases to 642.9 actions per second.

AI.tldr: 提出STAIRCASE POLICY（S-WAM）流式推理与训练框架，将流匹配VLA转为JEPA式WAM，通过子块交错去噪实现长时程执行与高吞吐。
AI.motivation: 世界-动作模型（WAM）通过预测未来观测来条件化动作生成，提升了机器人操作的性能，但未来预测为本身已很昂贵的迭代动作生成带来额外推理开销。动作分块（action chunking）可将该开销摊销到多个动作上，然而在长执行时程中后期动作仍以过时（stale）观测为条件，导致性能下降。
AI.method: 提出STAIRCASE POLICY（S-WAM）：一种流式推理与训练框架。将流匹配VLA改造为JEPA式WAM，并把大的动作块划分为处于交错去噪阶段（staggered denoising stages）的子块。近期动作一就绪即执行，较后动作继续细化；在每个子块边界，基于最新观测重新预测未来潜变量并更新所有未执行动作，从而在无需重复完整策略推理的情况下实现长时程执行。未来预测误差还可用作自适应分块的信号。
AI.result: 在LIBERO上达到97.7%，LIBERO-Plus上达87.9%，并在多种策略骨干和真实机器人任务上均有提升。吞吐达每秒292.7个执行动作，在精度相当情况下是常规执行吞吐的3.62倍，同时将首动作时延从123.6 ms降至73.3 ms；配合额外推理优化，吞吐进一步提升至每秒642.9个动作。
AI.conclusion: 通过在子块边界以最新观测重预测未来潜变量并持续细化未执行动作，S-WAM在保持精度的同时显著提升长时程执行效率与吞吐、降低首动作时延，且未来预测误差可作为自适应分块信号，具备跨骨干与真实场景的通用性。

title: Similar Choices, Different Attention: Cross-Modal Associations in Humans and Vision-Language Models
summary: Cross-modal associations are systematic pairings of features across modalities, such as the association of 'bouba' with round shapes and 'kiki' with sharp shapes. Prior work has compared humans and vision-language models (VLMs) on such associations, but often using different stimuli or tasks between humans and models. Here, we ask whether VLMs align with humans not only in choices, but also in where they look when making those choices. We study both VLMs and humans (N = 53), presenting them with the same stimuli, a pseudo-word and two images, and record participants' choices and eye movements, which we release. We find choice alignment in a few larger VLMs, but their saliency matches human gaze less closely than a center-bias baseline, a fixed Gaussian at the center of each image. Fine-tuning small VLMs on human choices brings their choice alignment to the level of a human majority-vote reference on unseen words and images, yet their attention still matches human gaze less closely than this baseline. Training model attention on human gaze raises attention-gaze correlation without improving choice alignment, and a single average gaze map per image position raises it by a similar amount. Matching human choices, or even human gaze patterns, is therefore not sufficient evidence of human-aligned cross-modal processing.

AI.tldr: 该研究用相同刺激和任务对比人类与视觉语言模型（VLM）在跨模态（bouba/kiki）关联中的选择与眼动，发现选择对齐不等于注意对齐：选择可对齐人类，但模型显著性图与人类注视的匹配度甚至低于中心偏置基线；用人类注视训练注意力能提高注意-注视相关，却不提升选择对齐。
AI.motivation: 已有工作比较人类与VLM在跨模态关联（如bouba/kiki效应）上的表现，但常在人类与模型之间使用不同刺激或不同任务，导致比较不严格，且仅关注选择结果而忽略加工过程。作者希望在同刺激、同任务条件下，进一步检验VLM是否在"看哪里"（注视/注意力）上也与人类一致，即选择对齐能否作为人类对齐跨模态加工的证据。
AI.method: 让VLM与人类被试（N=53）接受完全相同的刺激与任务：呈现一个伪词与两张图片，记录其选择与眼动数据（并公开数据）。在此基础上，将模型的显著性/注意力图与人类注视进行相关对比，并以每幅图像中心的固定高斯（center-bias baseline）作为基准。进一步对小型VLM用人类选择进行微调，并在未见过的词和图像上评估其选择对齐；另将模型注意力用人类注视进行训练，与"每幅图像位置对应一张平均注视图"的对照方案比较。
AI.result: 少数较大的VLM在选择上与人类对齐；但其显著性图与人类注视的匹配程度低于中心偏置基线（固定中心高斯）。用人类选择微调小型VLM后，其选择对齐达到人类多数投票参考水平（在未见词与图像上），但注意力与人类注视的匹配仍低于该基线。用人类注视训练模型注意力可提高注意力-注视相关，却不改善选择对齐；而使用每幅图像位置的单张平均注视图可获得相近幅度的提升。
AI.conclusion: 仅在选择上匹配人类，甚至仅在注意模式上匹配人类注视，都不足以证明模型具有人类对齐的跨模态加工。选择对齐与注意对齐可分离：注意力对齐的提升未必带来行为选择对齐，因此评估VLM与人类相似性时需同时考察行为与过程指标，并对注意对齐证据保持审慎。

title: Distilling Privileged Control Barrier Functions into RGB-Only Safety Filters for Dynamic Visual Navigation
summary: RGB-only end-to-end visual navigation policies remain vulnerable to collisions in real-world dynamic environments, motivating a dedicated safety layer. Existing visual Control Barrier Function (CBF) approaches seek to provide safety from RGB observations, but often rely on real-time rendering or explicit scene reconstruction and are primarily designed for static scenes, limiting their practicality for onboard deployment. We propose a teacher-student visual distillation framework that transfers the safety behavior of a privileged CBF teacher to an RGB-only student filter for dynamic environments. The student maps a short RGB history, robot velocity, and a nominal control action directly to a safe action, while the teacher uses ground-truth robot and obstacle states in a real-to-sim dynamic Gaussian Splatting environment. To reduce the teacher-student information gap, the teacher constructs safety constraints only from obstacles observable within the student's RGB history. It also accounts for obstacle-velocity uncertainty to improve robustness to motion variations, while action augmentation exposes the student to diverse safe and unsafe nominal actions to better capture the safety boundary. At deployment, the student requires only RGB observations and robot velocity, without explicit 3D reconstruction or online rendering. Experiments show that the proposed method outperforms visual CBF baselines and improves the safety of RGB-based navigation policies under dynamic obstacle motion. Project page: https://syeon-yoo.github.io/distill-cbf-site/.

AI.tldr: 提出教师-学生视觉蒸馏框架，将特权CBF教师的安全行为迁移到仅用RGB的学生滤波器，用于动态环境，无需3D重建或在线渲染。
AI.motivation: 仅RGB端到端视觉导航策略在真实动态环境中仍易发生碰撞，需要专用安全层。现有视觉CBF方法依赖实时渲染或显式场景重建，且主要针对静态场景，难以在机载部署。
AI.method: 采用教师-学生视觉蒸馏：学生将短RGB历史、机器人速度和名义控制动作直接映射为安全动作；教师在real-to-sim动态高斯泼溅环境中使用机器人及障碍物真值状态。教师仅从学生RGB历史中可观测的障碍物构建安全约束以缩小信息差，并考虑障碍物速度不确定性以提升对运动变化的鲁棒性；通过动作增强让学生接触多样安全与不安全名义动作，更好刻画安全边界。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法优于视觉CBF基线，并在动态障碍物运动下提升了基于RGB导航策略的安全性。
AI.conclusion: 该学生滤波器部署时仅需RGB观测与机器人速度，无需显式3D重建或在线渲染，适用于动态环境下的机载安全导航。

title: PE-OPSD: Internalizing Prompt Enhancement into Flow-matching Models via On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Text-to-image users often provide concise and underspecified prompts, whereas generative models benefit from detailed textual conditions for reliable instruction following. Existing systems bridge this gap with Prompt Enhancers (PEs) that rewrite raw prompts at inference time, introducing additional latency and leaving prompt elaboration external to the generator. We instead view enhanced prompts as privileged training information and ask whether their benefits can be internalized. We propose Prompt-Enhanced On-Policy Self-Distillation (PE-OPSD) for text-to-image flow-matching models. During training, a raw-prompt student follows its own generation trajectory, while an enhanced-prompt teacher provides vector-field targets at the states visited by the student. This on-policy supervision distills the behavior induced by enhanced prompts into the raw-prompt student without requiring additional text--image pairs. At inference, both the PE and teacher are removed, and the student generates directly from raw prompts. Across multiple model families, PEs, and benchmarks, PE-OPSD achieves the strongest aggregate prompt fidelity among the evaluated baselines, yields positive aggregate visual appeal gains, and retains the base-model inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出PE-OPSD方法，将提示增强（PE）重写的增强提示作为特权训练信息，通过在线策略自蒸馏把增强提示带来的行为内化进原始提示的学生模型，推理时移除PE与教师模型，可直接从原始提示生成。
AI.motivation: 文生图用户常给出简短、欠充分的提示，而生成模型需要详细文本条件才能可靠遵循指令。现有做法是用提示增强器（Prompt Enhancers, PEs）在推理时重写原始提示，但这会引入额外延迟，且提示细化过程外在于生成器，未真正提升模型本身能力。因此作者希望把增强提示视为特权训练信息，探究其收益能否被内化。
AI.method: 提出Prompt-Enhanced On-Policy Self-Distillation（PE-OPSD），面向文生图流匹配（flow-matching）模型。训练时，学生模型基于原始提示沿自身生成轨迹采样，教师模型基于增强提示，在学生访问到的状态上提供向量场（vector-field）目标。该在线策略监督将增强提示所诱导的行为蒸馏到原始提示学生模型中，且无需额外的文本-图像配对数据。
AI.result: 在多个模型家族、多种提示增强器与多个基准上，PE-OPSD在所评估基线中取得最强的综合提示保真度（prompt fidelity），并在视觉吸引力上获得总体正向增益，同时保持基座模型的推理效率。
AI.conclusion: 将提示增强作为特权信息并通过在线策略自蒸馏内化，可在不增加推理开销、不依赖额外数据的前提下提升原始提示下的生成质量，为提示增强与生成器的融合提供了新思路。

title: Emergent Specialization in Populations of Self-Supervised Collaborative Vision Experts Without a Shared Gate or Cross-Agent Gradients
summary: Can a population of neural networks develop a useful division of labor without a shared gate or gradients between agents? We study a setting where each network has its own weights, trains independently on the same heterogeneous data, and can ask another agent for help through a forward pass. Unlike mixtures of experts, where a jointly trained gate assigns inputs to experts, specialization here must emerge without central control. We test this in a small scale proxy for predictive visual pretraining. Initially identical agents are finetuned on an unlabeled mixture of six visual domains using masked prediction of frozen DINOv3 features. We measure specialization by asking whether the best agent for an input aligns with its latent domain, and utilization by asking whether responsibility is distributed across agents. We progressively remove central control, ending with DISCO (DIStributed COllaboration) where each agent locally selects a helper, reads its internal state through a gradient free channel, and rewards its router only for the improvement that help provides. Specialization emerges and is useful. Randomly routed populations underperform a single generalist, while semantically routed populations outperform it, showing that specialization rather than population size drives the gain. Specialization persists without a central router, and gradient free communication lets nonexperts exploit emergent expertise. In DISCO, a random agent helped by the expert matches the solo generalist, while experts surpass it, including on data outside the specialization mixture. Local routers select the emergent expert for 98% of inputs. These effects persist across population size, model capacity, data imbalance, and finetuning seeds, providing measurable evidence for the dynamics needed by decentralized predictive pretraining.

AI.tldr: 本文研究无共享门控、无梯度通信的多智能体神经网络群体能否自发形成有用的分工。在六个视觉域上微调同质智能体，逐步移除中心控制，最终提出DISCO框架：智能体本地选择助手、通过无梯度通道读取内部状态、仅按帮助带来的提升奖励路由器。结果表明语义路由群体超越单一通才，本地路由器98%输入选择涌现专家。
AI.motivation: 混合专家(MoE)依赖联合训练的门控将输入分配给专家，需要中心控制。作者想探究：若无共享门控、无智能体间梯度，仅靠各自独立训练和按需请求帮助，专业化分工能否自发涌现并带来收益，从而为去中心化预测式预训练提供依据。
AI.method: 以预测性视觉预训练的小规模代理实验为载体：初始相同的智能体在六个视觉域的无标签混合数据上，用冻结DINOv3特征的掩码预测进行微调。逐步移除中心控制，最终设计DISCO(DIStributed COllaboration)：每个智能体本地选择助手，通过无梯度通道读取其内部状态，并仅就帮助带来的改进奖励自身路由器。评估专业化(最佳智能体是否与输入潜在域一致)与利用率(责任是否分散)。
AI.result: 专业化自发涌现且有用。随机路由群体表现不如单一通才，而语义路由群体优于通才，说明收益来自专业化而非群体规模。无中心路由器时专业化仍持续，无梯度通信使非专家能利用涌现的专长。DISCO中，被专家帮助的随机智能体可匹敌单通才，专家则超越之，且在专业化混合之外的数据上亦然。本地路由器对98%的输入选择涌现专家。这些效应在群体规模、模型容量、数据不平衡和微调随机种子上均稳健。
AI.conclusion: 无中心门控与梯度通信的神经网络群体能够自发形成有用分工，专业化而非规模是性能增益的驱动因素，本地路由可高效识别涌现专家。这为去中心化预测式预训练所需的动态机制提供了可测量的证据。

title: DRHeC: Differentiable Rendering for Hand-Eye Calibration with RGB-Based Gradients
summary:
Accurate hand-eye calibration is crucial for precision manipulation. Traditional methods rely on markers, with their precision dependent on marker accuracy and observability. In contrast, markerless methods, such as learning-based approaches, use deep neural networks to directly extract keypoints or features from images, enabling the computation of hand-eye transformation with a single image and without the need for physical markers. Recently, differentiable rendering-based methods for hand-eye calibration have leveraged physical models to render binary masks and compare them with observations, enabling hand-eye calibration without fiducial markers in the calibration stage and providing interpretable optimization. While the state-of-the-art differentiable rendering methods achieve remarkable accuracy, the use of binary masks can result in the loss of internal profile details, reducing precision. Additionally, these methods can also suffer from unstable optimization and local minima.
  In this study, we propose a novel RGB-based differentiable rendering framework that provides richer geometric and appearance cues by incorporating color and mask geometric features, thereby improving calibration accuracy and optimization stability. Additionally, we propose a mask-guided image-to-image translation method to ensure explicit preservation of color and geometric consistency throughout the translation. Our approach is validated through both simulation and real-world experiments, with results demonstrating strong accuracy and robustness and clear improvements over existing differentiable rendering methods. Our method achieves a grasping success rate of 88.9% and insertion success rate of 57.4% on the UR5e real-world experiment, outperforming the state-of-the-art differentiable rendering hand-eye calibration method EasyHeC by 46.3 and 48.1 percentage points, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出基于RGB的可微渲染手眼标定框架，引入颜色与掩膜几何特征，并结合掩膜引导的图像翻译，提升精度与优化稳定性，真实实验中抓取88.9%、插入57.4%。
AI.motivation: 无标记手眼标定中，现有可微渲染方法仅用二值掩膜，会丢失内部轮廓细节，导致精度下降，并且优化不稳定、易陷入局部极小值。
AI.method: 提出RGB-based可微渲染框架，融合颜色与掩膜几何特征以提供更丰富的几何与外观线索；并提出掩膜引导的图像到图像翻译方法，在翻译过程中显式保持颜色与几何一致性。
AI.result: 仿真与真实实验验证了精度和鲁棒性；UR5e真实实验中抓取成功率88.9%、插入成功率57.4%，分别比EasyHeC高出46.3与48.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: RGB-based可微渲染手眼标定显著优于现有二值掩膜方法，精度与稳定性更强，明显超越SOTA方法EasyHeC。

title: Rethinking Multimodal Fake News Detection in the Generative AI Era
summary: Generative content is increasingly entering the production and dissemination of news, transforming fake news from manually fabricated or simply manipulated material into complex forms in which native and generated content jointly participate. Existing multimodal fake news detection research primarily focuses on veracity assessment and rarely characterizes how generativity differences affect the reliability of evidence. In contrast, AIGC detection primarily determines whether content is generated or modified by generative models, but it does not by itself establish whether the underlying news event is true. To bridge the separation between these tasks in data and evaluation, we construct Weibo26, a multimodal fake news detection dataset for generative-content scenarios. On this basis, we propose the Generativity-Aware Hierarchical Reasoning (GAHR) framework, which combines global judgment with local correction so that generativity information participates in news-veracity reasoning. Experiments on multiple existing fake news detection benchmarks and Weibo26 show that GAHR achieves competitive veracity-detection performance while effectively identifying generative content.

AI.tldr: 论文面向生成式内容参与新闻传播的新场景，构建Weibo26多模态虚假新闻检测数据集，并提出Generativity-Aware Hierarchical Reasoning (GAHR)框架，将生成性信息融入新闻真实性推理，实现全局判断与局部校正结合。在多个现有基准及Weibo26上，GAHR在保持竞争力真实性检测性能的同时有效识别生成式内容。
AI.motivation: 现有工作存在任务割裂：多模态虚假新闻检测侧重真实性评估，但很少刻画"生成性差异"如何影响证据可靠性；AIGC检测只判断内容是否由生成模型产生或修改，却不能直接判定新闻事件本身是否真实。两者在数据与评价上彼此分离，难以应对原生内容与生成内容混合参与的复杂虚假新闻形态。
AI.method: 构建Weibo26——面向生成式内容场景的多模态虚假新闻检测数据集；提出Generativity-Aware Hierarchical Reasoning (GAHR)框架，采用全局判断与局部校正相结合的分层推理机制，使生成性信息参与新闻真实性推理过程。
AI.result: 在多个现有虚假新闻检测基准以及Weibo26上的实验表明，GAHR取得了具有竞争力的真实性检测性能，同时能够有效识别生成式内容。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过数据集与框架的双重构建，弥合了虚假新闻检测与AIGC检测在数据和评价上的分离，表明将生成性信息纳入真实性推理可同时兼顾真实性判断与生成内容识别。

title: RAEGNet: Relation-Aware Evidence Graph Network for Harm-Aware Multimodal Fake News Detection
summary: Existing multimodal fake news detection methods often introduce external information to assist detection. However, most of them rely on entity-level retrieval and are therefore prone to introducing event-irrelevant noise. Meanwhile, existing methods mainly focus on improving overall performance and do not account for differences in the degree of harm posed by different instances of fake news. To address these limitations, we design an Event-Level Evidence Retrieval Framework (ELERF) and propose a Relation-Aware Evidence Graph Network (RAEGNet). ELERF retrieves external evidence based on the complete event semantics of a news item. RAEGNet constructs a directed graph that incorporates news-evidence stance relations and evidence-evidence interaction relations, and introduces a conditional-harm branch to jointly model authenticity and potential harm. Experimental results demonstrate that RAEGNet outperforms multiple baseline methods across all evaluated metrics on Weibo-21, Fakeddit, and our self-constructed SSS dataset.

AI.tldr: 该文提出事件级证据检索框架ELERF与关系感知证据图网络RAEGNet，通过事件语义检索外部证据并建模新闻-证据立场及证据间交互关系，同时引入条件危害分支联合建模真实性与潜在危害，在多数据集上超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态假新闻检测依赖实体级检索引入事件无关噪声，且只关注整体性能而忽略不同假新闻实例危害程度的差异。
AI.method: ELERF基于新闻完整事件语义检索外部证据；RAEGNet构建含新闻-证据立场关系与证据-证据交互关系的有向图，并引入conditional-harm分支联合建模真实性与潜在危害。
AI.result: 在Weibo-21、Fakeddit及自建SSS数据集上，RAEGNet在所有评估指标上均优于多个基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 事件级检索可缓解噪声，关系感知图建模结合危害建模能同时提升检测性能与危害区分能力。

title: Track-and-Complete: Learning Humanoid Skills from a Single Failed Human Video
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Project website: https://tracc-humanoid.github.io
summary: Learning humanoid skills from videos typically requires a successful human demonstration, which often demands custom data collection.
