Although failures have traditionally been treated only as negative examples in robot learning, they can still reveal a usable trajectory prefix before the task fails, as well as the intended outcome. To leverage this information from a failed-attempt video, we propose TRACC, a pipeline that imitates the useful portion of the motion trajectory and then completes the task based on the inferred task outcome. The usable motion prefix serves as prior knowledge until the failure occurs, after which the task-completion reward guides the policy to learn the intended task goal without requiring a successful task trajectory. We evaluate our method on six in-the-wild failed human tasks from the Oops! dataset. Our experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach for learning from failed attempts when no successful demonstration is available. Thus, these findings establish failed human videos as a viable source of supervision for humanoid skill learning.

AI.tldr: 提出TRACC流水线，利用失败演示视频中失败前的可用运动前缀作为先验，并结合推断的任务结果完成技能学习，无需成功演示。
AI.motivation: 人形技能从视频学习通常依赖成功的人类演示，采集成本高；而失败视频虽在传统机器人学习中被当作负样本，却隐含失败前可用的轨迹前缀以及任务意图结果，尚未被充分利用。
AI.method: TRACC包含两步：先模仿失败视频中失败发生前的有效运动轨迹前缀，将其作为先验知识；失败发生后，以任务完成奖励引导策略学习，从而在不提供成功轨迹的情况下完成目标任务。在Oops!数据集的六个真实场景失败人类任务上评估。
AI.result: 在Oops!数据集六个in-the-wild失败人类任务上验证了方法的有效性，证明在缺乏成功演示时，仍可从失败尝试中学习技能。
AI.conclusion: 失败的人类视频可作为人形技能学习的可行监督来源，拓展了机器人学习的示范数据来源。

title: Chinese-Jev: Bringing System One Model to Chinese-Language Tasks
summary: System One models such as Jev offer an efficient alternative to generative language models for tasks that require decisions rather than open-ended responses. However, existing Jev models exhibit limited Chinese-language decision accuracy, restricting their utility in both general and specialized settings. In this paper, we introduce Chinese-Jev, a System One model that addresses this gap through a unified data processing and training pipeline. Our data processing protocol converts heterogeneous Chinese-language annotations into probability targets over candidate options, enabling a shared training formulation across domains and question formats. To enable efficient inference, Chinese-Jev adopts a lightweight encoder-only backbone for text encoding and learns to score candidate answers through decision-oriented training. To address the misalignment between the pre-training distribution and downstream Chinese-language scenarios, we first train the model on a general-purpose corpus of 10 million examples, then fine-tune it separately for the medical, legal, and financial domains. To evaluate decision accuracy and calibration in both general and domain-specific Chinese-language settings, we introduce Chinese-Jev Bench (CJ-Bench). After first-stage pre-training, Chinese-Jev exceeds the accuracy of the closed-source Jev model by 1.24% on general-domain tasks while achieving a 20.3x speedup. Subsequent domain-specific fine-tuning yields a 4.0% accuracy improvement over Jev in medicine and achieves 92% of Jev's average accuracy across specialized domains, with a 17x speedup and an average latency of only 15 ms per example. We further demonstrate on-device deployment of an INT8-quantized model on mobile devices, achieving an inference latency of approximately 1.0 second per decision. The project is available at https://gulucaptain.github.io/Chinese-Jev/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Chinese-Jev，一种面向中文决策任务的 System One 模型，通过统一数据处理与训练流程提升中文决策准确率，并实现高效推理。
AI.motivation: 现有 System One 模型（如 Jev）虽在决策类任务上比生成式语言模型更高效，但中文决策准确率有限，限制了其在通用与专业场景中的实用性。
AI.method: 提出统一数据处理与训练流程：将异构中文标注转换为候选选项上的概率目标，实现跨领域、跨题型的共享训练公式；采用轻量级 encoder-only 骨干进行文本编码，通过决策导向训练学习候选答案打分。为缓解预训练分布与下游中文场景的错配，先在大规模通用语料（1000万样本）上训练，再分别针对医疗、法律、金融领域微调。同时构建 Chinese-Jev Bench（CJ-Bench）用于评估通用与领域中文场景下的决策准确率与校准。
AI.result: 第一阶段预训练后，Chinese-Jev 在通用领域任务上准确率超过闭源 Jev 模型 1.24%，并实现 20.3 倍加速；领域微调后在医疗领域准确率较 Jev 提升 4.0%，在专业领域平均达到 Jev 准确率的 92%，加速 17 倍，平均延迟仅 15 ms/样本。进一步在移动设备上部署 INT8 量化模型，单次决策推理延迟约 1.0 秒。
AI.conclusion: Chinese-Jev 通过统一训练流程与轻量编码器架构，在中文通用及医疗、法律、金融领域实现了优于或接近 Jev 的决策准确率，同时显著提升推理速度，并具备移动端部署可行性。

title: NowcastDiT: Diffusion Transformers are Effective Precipitation Nowcasters
summary: Precipitation nowcasting demands accurate short-term forecasts under strong spatiotemporal variability. Diffusion models are well suited to modeling complex precipitation distributions, yet existing approaches often introduce increasingly specialized designs, leaving the capability of a standard diffusion architecture underexplored. We show that a standard Diffusion Transformer already provides a simple and scalable foundation for precipitation nowcasting, with domain-specific requirements accommodated naturally within its design space. Based on this principle, we develop NowcastDiT and instantiate this flexibility through two complementary adaptations: a dynamics-aware noise prior for temporally coherent forecasts, and end-to-end reinforcement learning with timestep-aware rewards for meteorological skill. Experiments on SEVIR and MRMS benchmarks show that NowcastDiT achieves state-of-the-art performance in both perceptual quality and meteorological skill. These results suggest that standard DiT can serve as an effective foundation for precipitation nowcasting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NowcastDiT，证明标准Diffusion Transformer可作为降水临近预报的简洁、可扩展基础架构，并通过两项领域适配实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 降水临近预报需在强时空变异性下提供准确短期预报。扩散模型适合建模复杂降水分布，但现有方法趋于引入高度专门化的设计，忽视了标准扩散架构的潜力。
AI.method: 以标准DiT为基座，在其设计空间内自然容纳领域需求，构建NowcastDiT，并实例化两项互补适配：面向时间一致预报的动力学感知噪声先验，以及带时间步感知奖励的端到端强化学习以提升气象技能。
AI.result: 在SEVIR与MRMS基准上，NowcastDiT在感知质量与气象技能两方面均取得SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 标准DiT可作为降水临近预报的有效基础架构，说明简洁通用的扩散骨干结合恰当的领域适配即可胜任该任务。

title: Multi-Depth Temporal Fusion for Feedforward, Locally Trained Spiking Neural Networks
comment: 22 pages. Submitted to Neurocomputing. Code available at https://github.com/aidinattar/multi-depth-temporal-fusion-snn
summary: We propose a new spiking neural network (SNN) design to process static images and event streams using time-to-first-spike (TTFS) latencies. Our key research question is which architectural choices best accommodate local and online learning in multi-layer convolutional SNNs. This question is addressed via an original framework combining residual-like connections with multi-depth feature aggregation and consensus. The full SNN pipeline features an early-vision front end, to convert raw visual data into sparse spike latencies, a four-layer convolutional backbone trained layerwise with unsupervised spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP), a deterministic Multi-Depth Temporal Fusion (MDTF) and a final classifier trained with reward-modulated spike-timing-dependent plasticity (R-STDP). Rather than replacing early features in deeper layers, the proposed MDTF preserves early temporal evidence, adding sparse residual events from intermediate layers, and incorporating deeper features only when they agree in time with earlier representations. The resulting architecture is experimentally validated across MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, and N-MNIST, delivering strong classification performance under a fully local learning regime. Selective multi-depth fusion significantly outperforms traditional STDP/R-STDP baselines on higher-variability visual tasks (achieving +18.2 pp on Fashion-MNIST and +29.2 pp on CIFAR-10). Furthermore, activity-budget analyses show that the network retains high accuracy even when removing a large fraction of late or weak spike events, confirming its high data efficiency and reduced event-processing requirements. The codebase is publicly available at github.com/aidinattar/multi-depth- temporal-fusion-snn.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于TTFS脉冲时延的SNN架构，通过残差式连接与多深度时间融合(MDTF)实现全局部、在线学习，在多个视觉数据集上取得显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 研究核心问题是在多层卷积SNN中，何种架构选择最能支持局部与在线学习。传统STDP/R-STDP方案在深层网络中易丢失早期时间证据，且难以应对高变异性视觉任务。
AI.method: 设计完整SNN流水线：早期视觉前端将原始视觉数据转换为稀疏脉冲时延；四层卷积骨干用无监督STDP逐层训练；确定性Multi-Depth Temporal Fusion (MDTF) 融合多层特征；最终分类器用奖励调制STDP (R-STDP) 训练。MDTF保留早期时间证据，加入中间层的稀疏残差事件，仅当深层特征在时间上与早期表示一致时才纳入。
AI.result: 在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10和N-MNIST上验证，CMNIST等任务在完全局部学习机制下表现强劲。选择性多深度融合显著优于传统STDP/R-STDP基线，Fashion-MNIST提升+18.2个百分点，CIFAR-10提升+29.2个百分点。活动预算分析显示，即使移除大量晚期或弱脉冲事件，网络仍保持高精度，具备高数据效率。
AI.conclusion: 多深度时间融合结合残差式连接可有效支持多层卷积SNN的局部在线学习，在保持高数据效率的同时显著提升分类性能；代码已公开。

title: V2X-WAM: A Cooperative World Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Vehicle-infrastructure cooperation can complement onboard sensing with broader and more informative observations of the traffic environment, providing valuable support for end-to-end autonomous driving. However, existing cooperative driving methods mainly exploit roadside information to enhance the representation of the current scene, while the future consequences of prospective driving actions are rarely modeled explicitly. This limits the ability of the planner to anticipate how its decisions may interact with the evolving traffic environment. To address this issue, we propose V2X-WAM, a cooperative world action model that tightly couples cooperative scene understanding, action generation, and future-world reasoning. V2X-WAM constructs a reliability-aware spatiotemporal representation from vehicle- and infrastructure-side observations, while compressing infrastructure information into a compact quantized message for efficient communication. Based on the resulting cooperative representation, a multimodal planner generates prospective trajectories, which explicitly condition future occupancy and dynamic-flow prediction. The predicted world consequences are then fed back to refine the planned trajectory, forming a closed interaction between action and future-world evolution. Experiments on a large-scale real-world cooperative driving dataset demonstrate that V2X-WAM consistently improves planning accuracy and safety over representative end-to-end cooperative driving methods, while achieving stronger future-world prediction and substantially lower communication overhead. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of the proposed design.

AI.tldr: 提出V2X-WAM协同世界动作模型，紧密耦合协同场景理解、动作生成与未来世界推演，实现动作与未来演化的闭环交互，提升端到端协同驾驶的规划精度与安全性并降低通信开销。
AI.motivation: 车路协同可补足车载感知，为端到端自动驾驶提供更广、更丰富的交通环境观测。但现有协同驾驶方法主要用路侧信息增强当前场景表征，很少显式建模前瞻驾驶动作的未来后果，限制了规划器对决策与演化环境交互的预判能力。
AI.method: V2X-WAM由三部分组成：1）可靠性感知的时空表征，融合车端与路侧观测，并将路侧信息压缩为紧凑的量化消息以高效通信；2）基于协同表征的多模态规划器生成候选轨迹；3）以候选轨迹显式条件化未来占据与动态流预测，再将预测的世界后果反馈以修正规划轨迹，形成动作与未来世界演化的闭环交互。
AI.result: 在大规模真实世界协同驾驶数据集上，V2X-WAM在规划精度与安全性上持续优于代表性的端到端协同驾驶方法，同时未来世界预测更强、通信开销显著更低；消融实验进一步验证了各设计模块的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模动作的未来后果并将其反馈至规划，可有效增强协同驾驶规划器的前瞻能力与安全性，且通过量化消息压缩可在保证性能的同时降低通信负担。

title: Multimodal Detection of Higher-Order Behavioral Constructs: Self-Compassion in Structured Reflective Interaction
summary: Many of the qualities that matter most in how people learn and grow, how someone regulates their emotions, reflects on a setback, or stays aware of others during a difficult conversation, are not directly observable. They have to be inferred from how someone speaks, moves, and sounds over time, and they resist the kind of clean labeling that most machine learning pipelines are built around. We study this challenge through a case that is well grounded in psychological theory but rarely modeled computationally: self-compassion, the tendency to respond to one's own setbacks with patience rather than harsh self-criticism. We examine how it appears during structured reflective interviews in a technology-mediated training setting, where people naturally talk through socio-emotionally demanding situations. Since no existing dataset captures this kind of construct in this kind of setting, we collected and annotated 51 reflective dialog sessions using an independent, temporally overlapping annotation scheme grounded in established theory. We consolidate the underlying six-component psychological model into a three-class supervision space, balancing self-kindness and mindfulness against self-critical or overwhelmed states, and build a reproducible window-based pipeline that aligns video, audio, and text on a shared timeline. Unimodal models trained on each modality separately are compared against a simple probability-level fusion strategy, which yields modest but consistent gains over the best single modality. We close by discussing where each modality succeeds or struggles, what this suggests about how this kind of construct is actually expressed in reflective speech, and what would be needed to model it, and constructs like it, more effectively.

AI.tldr: 本文以自我同情（self-compassion）为案例，研究难以直接观测、需从言语/动作/声音中长时间推断且难以干净标注的心理构念的计算建模。作者采集并标注了51段反思性对话，将六成分心理模型归并为三类监督空间，构建视频、音频、文本共享时间轴的可复现窗口化流水线；单模态模型与概率级融合对比显示融合有 modest 但一致的增益，并讨论了各模态的优劣与建模这类构念所需的条件。
AI.motivation: 许多影响学习与成长的关键品质（如情绪调节、挫折反思、对话中的共情感知）无法直接观测，只能从个体随时间变化的言语、动作与声音中推断，且难以套用主流机器学习流水线所需的干净标签。作者选择心理学理论扎实但少有计算建模的自我同情作为案例，考察其在技术中介训练场景的结构化反思访谈中的表达，并指出该场景下尚无既有数据集，因而需要自建数据与标注方案。
AI.method: 1) 在技术中介训练场景中采集51段结构化反思对话；2) 采用独立、时间上重叠、基于既有理论的标注方案进行标注；3) 将底层六成分心理模型整合为三类监督空间，使自我友善与正念相对自批评或不堪重负状态取得平衡；4) 构建可复现的窗口化流水线，在共享时间轴上对齐视频、音频与文本；5) 分别训练单模态模型，并与简单的概率级融合策略进行对比。
AI.result: 各单模态模型在单独训练后进行对比，简单的概率级融合策略相对最佳单模态取得 modest 但一致的性能增益；论文还分析了各模态在何处成功、何处困难。
AI.conclusion: 融合多模态信息对建模自我同情这类难以直接观测的构念有稳定但有限的收益。作者进一步讨论了各模态的表现差异所揭示的这类构念在反思性言语中的实际表达方式，以及更有效建模该构念及类似构念所需的条件与后续工作方向。

title: Scaling Full Conformal Image Classifiers
summary: Conformal prediction provides set-valued predictions with distribution-free coverage guarantees, making it attractive for high-stakes image classification. However, split conformal prediction is data-inefficient, while full conformal prediction (FCP), despite its stronger statistical efficiency, is computationally prohibitive at scale because it requires candidate-specific model refits at test time. We address this limitation by leveraging zero-shot vision-language models (VLMs) to guide scalable FCP in large label spaces. We introduce Targeted Full Conformal Prediction (T-FCP), which uses a lightweight inductive conformal predictor to prune unlikely labels and applies FCP only to the remaining candidates, reducing computation while retaining the formal guarantee of the combined conformal procedure. We further propose Stabilized Online LDA (SO-LDA), an efficient VLM adaptation solver based on rank-one inverse-covariance updates. Across multiple benchmarks, including ImageNet, T-FCP enables practical full-conformal image classification with modest test-time overhead, yielding efficient prediction sets and more stable empirical coverage than split conformal alternatives.

AI.tldr: 提出 T-FCP，利用零样本视觉语言模型剪枝候选标签，仅在剩余候选上做全共形预测，并设计 SO-LDA 适配求解器，实现大规模图像分类中高效且稳定的全共形预测。
AI.motivation: 分裂共形预测数据利用效率低，而全共形预测虽统计效率更高，但在大规模标签空间下因需对每个候选标签重新拟合模型而计算代价过高，难以实用。
AI.method: T-FCP 先用轻量归纳式共形预测器剪除不可能标签，仅对剩余候选执行全共形预测，从而降低计算量并保留组合共形流程的形式化保证；同时提出基于秩一逆协方差更新的高效视觉语言模型适配求解器 SO-LDA。
AI.result: 在包括 ImageNet 在内的多个基准上，T-FCP 以适度的测试时开销实现可实用的全共形图像分类，得到更高效的预测集和比分裂共形方法更稳定的经验覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: 借助零样本视觉语言模型引导的候选剪枝与高效适配求解，全共形预测可在大标签空间下规模化应用，兼顾统计保证、计算效率与覆盖稳定性。

title: Encore: Few-Shot Agentic Discovery of Manipulation Strategies
summary: Coding agents can now write, run, and debug programs with little human help. Robot tasks, however, are usually specified by a sentence that leaves out how to grasp, in what order to make contact, and what the result should look like, and an agent given only the sentence must find these details by trial and error. We introduce ENCORE, which gives the agent a few demonstrations as evidence to read rather than as training data. A deterministic builder distills each demonstration into a pack of multi-view keyframes, gripper events, frame strips, and the full trajectory. A coding agent studies the pack, writes a policy program against a fixed perception and action API, refines it iteratively over a few development rollouts, and freezes it before a sealed evaluation that never reveals the success signal. On LIBERO-PRO, the agent's first program already succeeds in half of the perturbed tasks with demonstrations and in one task without them, and the frozen programs outperform the strongest prior agentic system run with the same language model (96.3% against 89.3%). On RoboDojo tasks whose instructions leave the goal unstated, no program succeeds without demonstrations. ENCORE also runs on a real bimanual robot, learning cube handover and cup inversion from five demonstrations each.

AI.tldr: 提出 ENCORE：将少量演示转化为多视图关键帧、夹爪事件等"证据包"，让编码智能体据此编写并冻结策略程序，在 LIBERO-PRO 与真实双臂机器人任务上显著超越现有智能体方法。
AI.motivation: 机器人任务通常仅以一句自然语言指定，省略了抓取方式、接触顺序与目标形态等关键细节，智能体只能靠试错发现，导致学习效率低、成功率差；同时演示数据常被当作训练数据，未充分利用其作为"可读证据"的价值。
AI.method: ENCORE 将少量演示作为证据而非训练数据：由确定性构建器把每个演示蒸馏为包含多视图关键帧、夹爪事件、帧条带与完整轨迹的证据包；编码智能体研读证据包，基于固定的感知与动作 API 编写策略程序，并在少量开发性 rollout 上迭代改进，最终在不会暴露成功信号的密封评测前冻结程序。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO-PRO 上，智能体首个程序在有演示时已能完成一半受扰动任务，无演示时仅完成一个任务；冻结后的程序以 96.3% 成功率超过使用相同语言模型的最强先前智能体系统（89.3%）。在指令未明确目标的 RoboDojo 任务上，无演示时无程序成功。ENCORE 还部署于真实双臂机器人，用各五条演示学会了方块交接与杯子倒置。
AI.conclusion: 把演示作为可读取的证据、由编码智能体生成可冻结的策略程序，可在无需在线试错与成功信号泄露的条件下，显著提升机器人操作任务的成功率与泛化能力，并适用于真实双臂平台。

title: Learning Social Navigation from Internet Videos in the Policy State Space
summary: Training robust social-navigation policies requires simulators with diverse scene layouts, terrain, and human motion, but constructing such environments and specifying pedestrian behavior is costly. We propose an efficient pipeline that converts ordinary monocular walking videos directly into closed-loop social-navigation training environments in the policy's state space. Our key observation is that local social navigation primarily depends on two types of information: where the robot can traverse and how nearby pedestrians move. We therefore represent the static scene as a metric traversability map, which can be rigidly transformed under counterfactual robot motion, while directly replaying the pedestrian trajectories recovered from the video over time. This abstraction allows us to define the forward dynamics directly in the policy's state space and efficiently simulate counterfactual robot states without reconstructing or rendering photorealistic observations. The resulting policy achieves 81.2% success in the independent Arena benchmark, compared with 75.0% for the strongest baseline, and succeeds in 19/20 real-robot trials without policy fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出一种高效流水线，将普通单目行走视频直接转换为策略状态空间中的闭环社交导航训练环境，在Arena基准上成功率达81.2%（最强基线75.0%），并在20次真机试验中成功19次且无需微调。
AI.motivation: 训练鲁棒的社交导航策略需要具备多样化场景布局、地形与行人运动的仿真器，但构建此类环境并指定行人行为成本高昂。论文旨在降低这一数据与工程成本。
AI.method: 核心观察：局部社交导航主要依赖两类信息——机器人可通行区域与附近行人的运动。据此将静态场景表示为度量可通行性地图（可在反事实机器人运动下作刚性变换），并随时间直接回放从视频中恢复的行人轨迹。该抽象使前向动力学可直接定义在策略状态空间中，无需重建或渲染照片级观测即可高效模拟反事实机器人状态。
AI.result: 策略在独立Arena基准上取得81.2%成功率，优于最强基线的75.0%；在20次真机试验中成功19次，且无需策略微调。
AI.conclusion: 直接从单目行走视频构建闭环社交导航训练环境是可行且高效的，所提状态空间抽象在仿真训练与真机部署间具备良好泛化能力。

title: Hierarchical Compression of Vision-Language Model Benchmarks
summary: Thorough evaluation of vision-language models (VLMs) has become prohibitively expensive, as benchmarks span an ever-broader spectrum of capabilities and new models arrive at a relentless pace. Benchmark compression methods that preserve model rankings at a fraction of the cost are well studied for language models, but for VLMs the question remains under-explored. We present PRIMEBench (Pruning Redundant Items for Multimodal Evaluation), a vision-aware hierarchical benchmark compression framework that substantially reduces evaluation cost while preserving model rankings. This hierarchical framework operates in four stages: data cleaning to remove items answerable without the image and all-correct items, category representative selection to pick one benchmark per capability category, item pruning with Vision-Aware Variance (VAW), and category-count pruning. VAW combines inter-model variance with a vision-dependence score computed from multimodal embeddings alone, while encouraging coverage of diverse items within each benchmark. On models held out from item selection, it has the highest mean fidelity at the released 5% retention. The hierarchical design lets practitioners stop at any stage to match their compute budget; the released suite removes over 97% of items while preserving model rankings. Beyond compression, our analyses show how VLM evaluation behaves as model panels grow and evolve, providing guidance for designing future benchmarks that are more efficient, robust to model turnover, and explicit about the limits of evaluation-side pruning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PRIMEBench，一种视觉感知的分层基准压缩框架，通过四阶段流程在保留模型排名的前提下大幅降低视觉语言模型的评测成本，5% 保留率下平均保真度最高，可去除超过 97% 的评测项。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）评测成本急剧上升：基准覆盖能力范围越来越广，新模型层出不穷。语言模型领域已有成熟的基准压缩方法可在低成本下保留模型排名，但 VLM 场景下的该问题研究不足。
AI.method: PRIMEBench 采用视觉感知的分层压缩框架，包含四个阶段：1）数据清洗，剔除无需图像即可作答的项以及全对项；2）类别代表选择，为每个能力类别挑选一个基准；3）基于 Vision-Aware Variance（VAW）的项剪枝，VAW 将模型间方差与仅由多模态嵌入计算的视觉依赖得分相结合，并鼓励在每个基准内覆盖多样化的项；4）类别计数剪枝。分层设计允许实践者在任意阶段停止以匹配算力预算。
AI.result: 在未参与项选择的留出模型上，该方法在发布的 5% 保留率下取得最高平均保真度；发布的评测套件在保留模型排名的同时去除超过 97% 的评测项。
AI.conclusion: 除压缩外，分析还揭示了 VLM 评测在模型面板规模增长与更替时的行为，为设计更高效、对模型更替更鲁棒、并明确评测端剪枝边界的未来基准提供指导。

title: RawVLA: Embodied Neural Image Signal Processor For Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models typically operate on RGB images produced by a fixed camera image signal processor (ISP), leaving the imaging pipeline outside the learning and evaluation loop. We systematically examine the consequences of this overlooked design choice across five fundamental ISP dimensions: gain, sensor noise, chromatic response, tonal response, and bit depth. Our analysis reveals that RAW-to-RGB processing materially shapes both action prediction and manipulation success, with different ISP dimensions exerting substantially different effects. Guided by these findings, we introduce RawVLA, a streaming neural ISP that adaptively renders RAW observations for frozen VLA policies while concentrating its capacity on the imaging factors relevant to embodied behavior. We further present RawVLA-Bench, a RAW-domain manipulation benchmark to expose image processing as an explicit evaluation variable across clean and adverse acquisition conditions. Experiments on RawVLA-Bench show that RawVLA preserves performance under standard conditions while substantially improving robustness under degraded imaging, establishing adaptive RAW processing as an effective interface between physical cameras and embodied policies.

AI.tldr: 论文系统分析了ISP（图像信号处理器）各维度对VLA模型的影响，提出可自适应渲染RAW观测的流式神经ISP——RawVLA，并构建RAW域操作基准RawVLA-Bench，证明自适应RAW处理能提升退化成像条件下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型通常直接使用固定相机ISP输出的RGB图像，导致成像管线被排除在学习与评估闭环之外，这一被忽视的设计选择对动作预测与操作成功率的影响未被系统研究。
AI.method: 从增益、传感器噪声、色度响应、色调响应和位深五个基本ISP维度系统分析RAW-to-RGB处理的影响；据此提出RawVLA——一种面向冻结VLA策略的流式神经ISP，自适应渲染RAW观测并将容量集中于与具身行为相关的成像因素；同时构建RAW域操作基准RawVLA-Bench。
AI.result: 分析表明RAW-to-RGB处理显著影响动作预测与操作成功率，且不同ISP维度效应差异明显；在RawVLA-Bench上，RawVLA在标准条件下保持性能，在退化成像条件下显著提升鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 自适应RAW处理可作为物理相机与具身策略之间的有效接口，成像管线应作为显式的学习与评估变量纳入VLA研究。

title: When to Adapt: Multi-Signal Domain Shift Detection for Efficient Training-Free Adaptation in Open-Vocabulary Segmentation
summary: Robust and reliable perception is essential for autonomous robots operating in real-world environments, particularly in long-term missions where environmental conditions may change significantly over time. Although recent advances in Visual Foundation Models (VFMs) have improved open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, these models can still suffer from domain shift, which can significantly degrade performance if they are not adapted to the current environment. Training-free domain adaptation is a relevant paradigm for adaptation, consisting of adjusting the model online using lightweight adapters. Recent approaches apply this on a per-frame basis, which is impractical for deployments on resource-constrained robotic hardware. To tackle this, we propose a multi-signal domain shift detection method for training-free continual test-time adaptation (TF-CTTA) in open-vocabulary segmentation. Our method leverages temporal coherence across consecutive frames by monitoring and combining complementary aspects of domain shift (visual change, adapter mismatch, and semantic drift) to trigger adaptation only when needed. We validate our approach on a benchmark including indoor and outdoor environments and using real robotic data. We demonstrate that our approach maintains segmentation accuracy while substantially reducing adaptations, making training-free adaptation practical and feasible for long-term, real-world robotic deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种多信号域漂移检测方法，用于开放词汇分割中的免训练持续测试时自适应（TF-CTTA），仅在需要时触发自适应，从而在保持分割精度的同时显著减少自适应次数，提升长期真实机器人部署的可行性。
AI.motivation: 真实环境中自主机器人需长期运行，环境条件会随时间显著变化。尽管视觉基础模型（VFMs）提升了开放词汇语义分割能力，但存在域漂移问题，若不适配当前环境将导致性能大幅下降。免训练域自适应通过在线轻量适配器调整模型是一种合适范式，但现有方法逐帧自适应，对资源受限的机器人硬件不切实际。
AI.method: 提出一种面向开放词汇分割 TF-CTTA 的多信号域漂移检测方法。利用连续帧间的时间一致性，监测并融合域漂移的互补方面——视觉变化、适配器失配与语义漂移——仅在需要时触发自适应。
AI.result: 在包含室内与室外环境的基准上，并使用真实机器人数据进行验证。结果表明，该方法在保持分割精度的同时大幅减少了自适应次数。
AI.conclusion: 多信号域漂移检测使免训练自适应变得实用可行，适用于长期、真实世界的机器人部署。

title: Procedural Core: A Compact Recurrent Initialization for Vision Transformers
summary: Transformers are typically trained from random initialization, requiring all their capabilities to emerge from large-scale optimization. Recent work showed that a small amount of abstract procedurally generated data can help acquire generic inductive structure at low cost. However, this adds a pretraining stage that must be repeated for every target model. We propose Procedural Core, an initialization strategy that captures this generic structure into a compact set of weights that can be reused across models. We train a minimal recurrent transformer on procedural data, then expand its weights to initialize transformers of arbitrary width and depth. The resulting initialization improves performance on image classification, self-supervised visual learning (DINO), and modeling natural language (FineWeb-Edu) and code (CodeParrot). For image classification, expanding a 1M-parameter core to initialize an 85M-parameter ViT-Base improves ImageNet top-1 accuracy by 2.2 pp over standard random initialization. Our analysis identifies recurrence as essential for learning compact weights that transfer across models. In ViTs, we localize a key benefit in the suppression of high-norm tokens that produces substantial improvements in zero-shot segmentation (ImageNet-S mAP 32.3 to 42.9), object localization (VOC07 CorLoc 9.9 to 18.4), and depth estimation (NYUv2 RMSE 1.104 to 0.998). This demonstrates that transformers need not start from a blank slate, and can be initialized with generic capabilities at low cost with no domain- or task-specific data.

AI.tldr: 提出 Procedural Core 初始化策略：用少量程序生成数据训练一个微型循环 Transformer，再将其权重扩展以初始化任意宽度和深度的 Transformer，从而免去每个目标模型重复预训练。
AI.motivation: 现有方法虽能用少量程序生成数据低成本获得通用归纳结构，但需要为每个目标模型重复一个预训练阶段，成本不可复用；作者希望把这种通用结构固化为一组紧凑权重，跨模型复用，避免重复预训练。
AI.method: 在程序生成数据上训练一个极小的循环 Transformer（recurrent transformer），得到一个紧凑权重核心；再通过权重扩展（expansion）将该核心映射为任意宽度和深度的 Transformer 初始化，用于图像分类、DINO 自监督视觉学习、自然语言（FineWeb-Edu）与代码（CodeParrot）建模。
AI.result: 图像分类中，将 1M 参数核心扩展为 85M 参数的 ViT-Base，ImageNet top-1 较随机初始化提升 2.2 个百分点；ViT 中收益主要体现在抑制高范数 token，使零样本分割 ImageNet-S mAP 由 32.3 升至 42.9，目标定位 VOC07 CorLoc 由 9.9 升至 18.4，深度估计 NYUv2 RMSE 由 1.104 降至 0.998。
AI.conclusion: Transformer 无需从随机初始化的空白状态开始；通过循环结构学习到的紧凑权重可跨模型迁移，以低成本赋予通用能力，且无需领域或任务特定数据。分析表明循环性（recurrence）是学习可迁移紧凑权重的关键。

title: MeanFlowAdvantage: Stable Reward Fine-Tuning for Few-Step Average-Velocity Generators
summary: MeanFlow enables efficient few-step generation by predicting interval-average velocities, but this representation creates a mismatch for reward fine-tuning: existing advantage-based objectives are typically defined on instantaneous velocities or equivalent $x_0$-space predictions, whereas inference directly uses the learned average-velocity map. We introduce MeanFlowAdvantage, a signed advantage-weighted least-squares objective for average-velocity generators. Our key construction uses a shared, detached MeanFlow derivative correction to express the reward objective in prediction space while making rollout and reference regularization exact penalties on the average-velocity network deployed at inference. The resulting formulation preserves MeanFlow's native few-step sampler and provides a direct mechanism for transferring reward improvements to the deployed flow map. On SD3.5-Medium, MeanFlowAdvantage improves all eight reported metrics over the matched four-step MeanFlowNFT baseline and, with only four NFEs, matches or exceeds the 40-step DiffusionNFT baseline on six of eight metrics. The same objective also transfers to DNA promoter design, where it supports both teacher-free on-policy RL for a generator defined on a manifold and teacher-guided reward-graded distillation, with the latter yielding the lowest one-step Sei profile MSE among the compared configurations.

AI.tldr: 提出MeanFlowAdvantage：面向平均速度生成器的符号优势加权最小二乘目标，通过共享的detached MeanFlow导数修正，将奖励目标表达在预测空间，使rollout与参考正则成为部署时的精确惩罚，保持少步采样并有效迁移奖励提升。
AI.motivation: MeanFlow通过预测区间平均速度实现高效少步生成，但该表示与奖励微调存在错配：现有优势类目标定义在瞬时速度或等价的x0空间预测上，而推理直接使用学习到的平均速度映射，导致奖励优化与部署采样器之间不一致。
AI.method: 提出MeanFlowAdvantage，一种针对平均速度生成器的符号优势加权最小二乘目标。核心构造是使用共享的、detached的MeanFlow导数修正，在预测空间表达奖励目标，同时使rollout与参考正则成为对推理时部署的平均速度网络的精确惩罚，保留MeanFlow原生少步采样器。
AI.result: 在SD3.5-Medium上，MeanFlowAdvantage在全部八项指标上优于匹配的四步MeanFlowNFT基线，且仅用4 NFEs就在八项指标中的六项上达到或超过40步DiffusionNFT基线。该目标也迁移到DNA启动子设计，支持流形上生成器的无教师on-policy RL以及教师引导的奖励分级蒸馏，后者取得最低的单步Sei profile MSE。
AI.conclusion: MeanFlowAdvantage解决了平均速度表示与优势类奖励微调之间的错配，在保持原生少步采样的同时将奖励改进直接迁移到部署的flow map，并在图像生成与DNA启动子设计上验证了有效性与通用性。

title: CogWAM: Aligning Semantic Cognition with World Action Modeling via Event-Driven Interfaces
summary: Robot policies increasingly incorporate semantic reasoning and future-world prediction, yet combining these capabilities does not guarantee that local predictions and actions remain aligned with task progress. We introduce CogWAM, a cognition-guided world-action model that establishes an explicit semantic interface between task reasoning and world-action learning through a persistent Semantic State, which stores completed task events and the active subtask. CogWAM updates this state only when observations indicate semantic transitions, allowing task-level context to persist across multiple action chunks. To bridge semantic context with physical prediction and control, CogWAM employs progress-conditioned WORLD and ACTION queries that selectively extract task-relevant information for future-world prediction and action generation. During training, the Semantic State provides shared task-progress context for both branches, while inference removes the future-prediction branch and directly generates actions from observations and the maintained state. We further introduce semantic training strategies to improve transition learning and closed-loop conditioning. Without additional robot-action pretraining, CogWAM achieves 15.56 / 11.70 % Score/SR on RoboDojo and state-of-the-art performance on BiCoord, while real-world experiments demonstrate closed-loop dual-arm manipulation with 16.4 fewer Semantic State regenerations than step-wise updating.

AI.tldr: 提出CogWAM，一种认知引导的世界-动作模型，通过持久化语义状态显式连接任务推理与世界-动作学习，实现语义上下文跨动作块保持，并在RoboDojo、BiCoord及真机双臂操作上取得优异表现。
AI.motivation: 机器人策略日益融合语义推理与未来世界预测，但二者简单结合并不能保证局部预测与动作始终与任务进度对齐。需要一种机制显式维护任务级语义上下文，使预测与控制在长程任务中保持一致。
AI.method: 引入CogWAM，在任务推理与世界-动作学习间建立显式语义接口：以持久化语义状态（Semantic State）存储已完成任务事件与当前子任务，仅在观测到语义转换时更新，从而让任务级上下文跨多个动作块持续。通过进度条件化的WORLD与ACTION查询，选择性提取任务相关信息用于未来世界预测与动作生成。训练时语义状态为两分支共享任务进度上下文，推理时移除未来预测分支，直接由观测与维护状态生成动作。并提出语义训练策略改进转换学习与闭环条件化。
AI.result: 无需额外机器人动作预训练，在RoboDojo上达到15.56 / 11.70 %的Score/SR，在BiCoord上取得最先进性能；真机实验实现闭环双臂操作，且语义状态重生成次数比逐步更新少16.4次。
AI.conclusion: CogWAM通过显式语义状态接口有效对齐任务推理、世界预测与动作生成，在保持任务进度一致性的同时提升长程操作性能并显著降低状态更新开销。

title: It's Not What the Image Shows: Irrelevant Context Destabilises VLM Judges Without Informing Them
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used in place of human annotators, making it important that substitutability tests reflect the model rather than incidental evaluation conditions. We introduce MIST, the Misleading-Image Stress Test: 200 English sentences, each built around a phrase readable either figuratively or literally and shown with an aligned image depicting its reading, a misleading image depicting the opposite, or no image at all. The guidelines require the label to be decided from the sentence alone, so no image should change any answer. We expected each image to pull a judge's labels toward the sense it depicts, and neither kind did. Across thirteen VLM judges, an aligned image changed 20.5% of labels and a misleading one 19.4%, close for every judge and both above the 11.6% produced by deleting the ignore-the-image instruction with the image left in place. Yet only 37% of the labels that differ between the two images moved toward the sense shown, and agreement with our human annotators is unchanged whether the image is absent, aligned or misleading. The effect is smaller in the seven judges that pass the alt-test than in the six that never do, but present in all of them: what moves a judge is that an image is there, not which of the two it is, so a substitutability verdict describes a configuration as much as a model.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MIST（误导图像压力测试）：200 条含歧义短语（可作比喻或字面解读）的英文句子，配对齐图像、误导图像或无图像，要求仅凭句子判断标签。13 个 VLM 评判器中，对齐图像改变 20.5% 标签、误导图像改变 19.4%，差异极小，且均高于删除"忽略图像"指令时的 11.6%。仅 37% 的标签差异朝向图像所示含义移动，与人类标注者的一致性在三种条件下不变。表明驱动评判器变化的是"存在图像"这一事实，而非图像内容，可替代性结论既描述模型也描述评测配置。
AI.motivation: VLM 正被用作人类标注者的替代品，因此可替代性测试必须反映模型本身的能力，而非评测条件带来的偶然效应。已有评测中图像的存在与内容可能混淆判断，需要一种能把"图像存在"与"图像内容"分离的压力测试来检验评判器是否真正遵循"仅凭文本作答"的指令。
AI.method: 构建 MIST 数据集：200 条英文句子，每条围绕一个可作比喻或字面解读的短语，并提供三种条件——对齐图像（呈现与某种解读一致的含义）、误导图像（呈现相反含义）、无图像。指南要求标签仅由句子决定，图像不应改变任何答案。随后在 13 个 VLM 评判器上比较标签变化率、标签移动方向，并计算与人类标注者的一致性；同时对照删除"忽略图像"指令但保留图像的条件，并按是否通过 alt-test 对评判器分组比较。
AI.result: 对齐图像平均改变 20.5% 标签，误导图像 19.4%，各评判器上两者接近，且均高于删除"忽略图像"指令（图像仍在）时的 11.6%。但两张图像间存在差异的标签中，仅 37% 朝向图像所示含义移动；无图像、对齐图像、误导图像三种条件下与人类标注者的一致性无变化。通过 alt-test 的 7 个评判器效应小于未通过的 6 个，但所有评判器均存在该效应。
AI.conclusion: VLM 评判器对图像的敏感主要源于"图像存在"而非"图像内容"，即图像引出的是与指令相冲突的作答模式，而非朝向图像语义的诱导。因此可替代性结论不仅描述模型，也描述具体的评测配置；在将 VLM 用作标注者替代时，需要把图像存在性作为独立因素加以控制，否则可替代性判定会因评测条件而漂移。

title: Pixels to Keys: Exploring Spatial and Motion Cues in Gameplay Inverse Dynamics
comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Multimodal Digital Agents (ECCV 2026): https://mda-workshop.allen.ai/
summary: Video games offer scalable environments for studying perception and control in embodied agents.Abundant online gameplay videos could supply demonstrations, but they rarely include player inputs for training. Inverse Dynamics Models (IDMs) have thus been proposed to infer inputs from frames. Large (up to 1B parameters) IDMs trained on $\sim$1K-2K gameplay hours demonstrate feasibility and cross-environment generalization at this scale, but researchers do not clarify what the key components are to recover individual actions and often report only aggregate accuracy that can mask rare-action failures. We study the problem in a data-constrained scenario to evaluate how spatial motion features, model architectures, and training objectives affect an IDM's outcome and we analyse our models on per-key and balanced metrics such as $F_1^{macro}$. Our experiments on Trackmania highlight the importance of factors like the model architecture and motion flow extraction in preprocessing, while also showing the limits of evaluation through unbalanced metrics. The application of the same architecture and training recipe to Cyberpunk 2077 reveals uneven performance across game mechanics. Our per-action evaluation and failure analysis highlight ambiguities from camera motion, delayed effects and imbalanced key-press frequencies that call for explicit modeling of 3D scene structure, long-term state and the adoption of proper losses in future implementations.

AI.tldr: 本文在数据受限场景下研究逆动力学模型（IDM）从游戏视频帧恢复玩家按键输入的问题，系统考察空间运动特征、模型架构与训练目标的影响，并采用逐键及平衡指标（如$F_1^{macro}$）评估，发现架构与运动流提取至关重要，不平衡指标会掩盖稀有按键失败。
AI.motivation: 在线游戏视频可提供大量演示数据，但普遍缺少对应的玩家输入，难以直接用于训练。已有工作提出用IDM从帧序列推断输入，并在约1K–2K小时、最多10亿参数的规模上验证了可行性与跨环境泛化，但未厘清恢复单个动作的关键要素，且多报告聚合精度，会掩盖稀有动作的失败。作者希望在数据受限条件下厘清这些因素。
AI.method: 在数据受限设定下训练IDM，控制并比较三方面因素：预处理中的空间运动特征（如运动流提取）、模型架构、训练目标。在Trackmania上开展实验，并采用逐键（per-key）与平衡指标（如$F_1^{macro}$）而非仅用聚合精度进行评估；随后将同一架构与训练配方迁移到Cyberpunk 2077进行验证与逐动作分析。
AI.result: 在Trackmania上，模型架构与预处理中的运动流提取是影响IDM表现的关键因素；聚合（不平衡）指标会掩盖稀有按键上的失败。将相同架构与训练配方应用于Cyberpunk 2077时，不同游戏机制间性能不均衡，表现出明显的逐动作差异。
AI.conclusion: 逐动作评估与失败分析揭示了由相机运动、延迟效应以及按键频率不均衡带来的歧义。未来IDM的实现需要显式建模3D场景结构与长期状态，并采用更合适的损失函数，以提升逐动作恢复能力与跨机制泛化。

title: Video-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement of Video Understanding Agents via Harness Evolution
summary: Video understanding agents acquire evidence through an executable harness that controls what they observe and how they use those observations. However, execution traces contain only the evidence acquired by the current harness, leaving competing explanations for failure unresolved and limiting the basis for self-improvement. We introduce Video-RSI, a framework for recursive self-improvement in which a video understanding agent uses its own language model to revise its harness. Through active video investigation, the model revisits the original training videos to test competing failure explanations with additional observations, grounding proposed changes in evidence beyond the existing trace. Cost-aware harness evolution turns these diagnoses into reusable revisions and determines which revisions to retain by considering both answer accuracy and visual cost. Across our evaluation settings on video understanding benchmarks, the evolved agent improves accuracy while processing fewer frames and achieves competitive accuracy-efficiency trade-offs against existing video understanding agents. These results demonstrate the potential for video understanding agents to improve their own evidence acquisition and use through harness evolution. Code is available at https://github.com/bingjunluo/Video-RSI .

AI.tldr: Video-RSI：智能体用自身语言模型改写执行框架，经主动视频调查检验失败解释，实现递归自我改进，在提升精度的同时减少帧使用。
AI.motivation: 现有视频理解智能体通过可执行框架获取证据，但执行轨迹仅记录当前框架已获取的证据，无法消解相互竞争的失败解释，从而限制自我改进的依据。
AI.method: 提出 Video-RSI 递归自我改进框架：智能体利用自身语言模型修订其执行框架；通过主动视频调查重新访问原始训练视频，用额外观测检验相互竞争的失败解释，使修改建议基于轨迹之外的证据；并采用成本感知的框架演化，将诊断转为可复用修订，并依据答案准确率与视觉成本共同决定保留哪些修订。
AI.result: 在视频理解基准的评估设置中，演化后的智能体处理更少帧数却提升准确率，并在准确率—效率权衡上优于现有视频理解智能体。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明视频理解智能体可通过框架演化改进自身的证据获取与使用方式。代码见 https://github.com/bingjunluo/Video-RSI 。

title: PhysWAM: Physically Consistent World Action Model for Autonomous Driving
summary: World-action models (WAMs) jointly predict how a scene will evolve and how an agent should act, however joint generation alone does not necessarily impose a shared geometric constraint on these predictions. We present PhysWAM, a unified world-action model for autonomous driving that co-denoises multiview video, metric depth, and ego motion within a single flow-matching transformer. To ground world and action generation in measured scene geometry, we introduce Coupled Point Projection (CPP) that unprojects the generated depth into 3D points, transforms them using the generated $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ ego motion, and minimizes their distance to LiDAR points transformed using the recorded ego motion. This geometric constraint promotes physical consistency with the measured scene by jointly supervising generated depth and motion alongside their standard flow-matching objectives. At inference, trajectory selection relies only on a simple label-free consensus rule, with no learned scorer or simulator feedback. We evaluate PhysWAM across NAVSIM v1 and v2 planning, zero-shot closed-loop transfer, and future video and metric-depth prediction. Despite PhysWAM's simple selection procedure, it achieves strong planning performance and transfers zero-shot to unseen driving environments. It also generates accurate metric depth and temporally coherent video, with CPP improving both planning and depth prediction. Together, these results demonstrate that the geometric relationship between scene depth and ego motion provides a direct way to couple world and action generation within a simple unified model.

AI.tldr: PhysWAM 是一个面向自动驾驶的统一 world-action 模型,在单一 flow-matching transformer 内联合去噪多视角视频、度量深度与自车运动,并通过 Coupled Point Projection 几何约束耦合世界与动作生成。
AI.motivation: 现有 world-action 模型虽联合预测场景演化与动作,但联合生成本身并未对两类预测施加共享的几何约束,导致物理一致性不足。
AI.method: 方法上提出统一 world-action 模型 PhysWAM,在单个 flow-matching transformer 中共同去噪多视角视频、度量深度与自车运动;核心创新 Coupled Point Projection (CPP) 将生成深度反投影为 3D 点云,用生成的 SE(3) 自车运动变换后,与经录制自车运动变换的 LiDAR 点云最小化距离,从而在标准 flow-matching 目标之外联合监督生成的深度与运动;推理时轨迹选择仅依赖简单的无标签一致性规则,无需学习评分器或仿真反馈。
AI.result: 在 NAVSIM v1 与 v2 规划、零样本闭环迁移以及未来视频与度量深度预测上评估。尽管采用简单选择策略,PhysWAM 仍取得较强规划性能,并可零样本迁移到未见驾驶环境;同时生成准确的度量深度与时间一致的视频,CPP 对规划与深度预测均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明,场景深度与自车运动之间的几何关系为在简单统一模型内耦合世界与动作生成提供了直接途径。

title: $S^3$: Spectral Null-Space Swap Makes Reasoning Models Efficient
summary: LLMs trained with Chain-of-thought excel in reasoning capability, but often come with excessive token cost. We find that the core of reasoning capacity lies in the Thinking model's weight component within the null space of a projection defined by the corresponding Non-thinking model's dominant singular directions, and removing the subspace component can largely improve reasoning efficiency without hurting the accuracy gained during thinking-mode post-training. Unlike existing efforts that mostly operate within the dominant subspace, we are the first to unveil the critical role of the null space and harness it for model optimization. Motivated by this finding, we propose Spectral Null-Space Swap ($S^3$), a training-free composition of paired Non-thinking and Thinking checkpoints. Our method keeps the Non-thinking model inside its own dominant subspace and takes the Thinking checkpoint outside it, improving reasoning efficiency while maintaining accuracy. We extensively evaluate $S^3$ on 2B-30B dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures spanning 28 evaluation environments across mathematical, multimodal, and audio reasoning domains. $S^3$ establishes new empirical Pareto Frontiers among training-free model composition strategies: across all settings, it reduces inference token overhead by an average of 27.4% compared to full Thinking models while simultaneously improving overall task accuracy by 1.0 percentage point (e.g., yielding +8.3% accuracy on HMMT25 alongside a 33.0% token speedup). We further use attention entropy for explanation and find that the retained component produces more concentrated attention, and we use a simplified analytical model about optimization to demonstrate why null-space can effectively reduce attention entropy, thereby improving the efficiency of reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文发现Thinking模型推理能力的关键存在于Non-thinking模型主奇异方向投影所定义零空间中的权重分量，据此提出免训练模型组合方法Spectral Null-Space Swap（S^3），在保持精度的同时平均降低27.4%推理token开销并提升整体准确率1.0个百分点。
AI.motivation: LLM经思维链（CoT）训练后推理能力突出，但推理token开销过大。现有模型组合与优化工作大多仅在主导子空间内操作，未揭示零空间在推理效率与能力中的作用，因此需要探究推理能力的权重结构分布并加以利用。
AI.method: 关键发现：推理能力的核心位于Thinking模型权重在Non-thinking模型主奇异方向投影所定义零空间中的分量，移除该子空间分量可在不明显损失Thinking模式后训练所获精度的前提下大幅提升推理效率。方法S^3是一种免训练的成对Non-thinking与Thinking检查点组合策略：将Non-thinking模型保留在其自身主导子空间内，并取Thinking检查点在主导子空间之外（零空间）的权重分量进行组合。
AI.result: 在2B–30B的dense与MoE架构、28个评测环境、覆盖数学、多模态与音频推理域上广泛评测。S^3在免训练模型组合策略中建立新的经验性帕累托前沿：所有设置下，相比完整Thinking模型平均降低27.4%推理token开销，同时整体任务准确率提升1.0个百分点（如HMMT25上+8.3%准确率且token加速33.0%）。
AI.conclusion: 首次揭示零空间对模型优化的重要性并加以利用。通过注意力熵解释发现，保留的权重分量产生更集中的注意力；并通过简化的优化分析模型证明零空间可有效降低注意力熵，从而提升推理效率。

title: Brain-SAD: A Brain-Inspired Safe Autonomous Driving Control Framework with Dynamic Fear-Oriented Constraint on Dual-Policy
summary: Constrained Reinforcement Learning has recently gained increasing attention in the field of Safe Autonomous Driving, where the general mechanism is to maximize the expected reward while keeping the overall action risk bounded. In this way, the safety issues arising in AD can be mitigated through constrained actions. However, existing Constrained RL methods still lack dynamics on the imposed constraints. For instance, the action cost adopted by the existing Primal-Dual/soft-constrained methods is often defined as static state-to-cost mapping, and the safe-action projection in hard-constrained methods relies on the static projection with the fixed feasible region boundary estimated from offline demonstrations. The above drawback tightly couples the imposed constraints to the training scenarios, leaving the AD policy hard to handle different interaction scenarios, due to the improper state-level action-cost and the static projection boundary. Consequently, in this paper, we propose Brain-SAD, a brain-inspired safe autonomous driving control framework with dynamic fear-oriented constraints. By perceiving the current vehicle-interaction scene, Brain-SAD generates dynamic fear signal as fear reaction to online decide long-term policy for regular interaction or short-term policy for urgent-collision defense. In such two policy, the above fear-reaction will be constructed as the dynamic fear constraints, respectively reflecting the overall fear cost directly coupled with action-impact, and the dynamic fear boundary of the feasible region derived from different risky neighbors, both of which will in turn serve for the online policy optimization. Experimental results show that Brain-SAD outperforms existing methods, achieving higher success rate in shorter task-completion and collision-recovery time, and exhibits stronger reliability across continuous intersections of fluctuating complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Brain-SAD，一种受大脑启发、具有动态恐惧约束的安全自动驾驶控制框架，通过在线生成动态恐惧信号构建动态恐惧约束，替代传统静态约束，在交互场景中实现更优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有约束强化学习（Constrained RL）方法缺乏约束的动态性：软约束/原始-对偶方法中的动作代价多为静态的状态到代价映射，硬约束方法中的安全动作投影依赖离线示范估计的固定可行域边界。这些缺陷使约束与训练场景紧密耦合，导致自动驾驶策略难以应对不同交互场景。
AI.method: 提出Brain-SAD框架，带有面向恐惧的动态约束。通过感知当前车辆交互场景，生成动态恐惧信号，作为恐惧反应在线决策：面向常规交互的长期策略或面向紧急避碰的短期策略。在这两种策略中，恐惧反应被构建为动态恐惧约束，分别体现与动作影响直接耦合的总体恐惧代价，以及由不同风险邻居推导出的可行域动态恐惧边界，二者反过来服务在线策略优化。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，Brain-SAD优于现有方法，在更短的任务完成时间和碰撞恢复时间内取得更高成功率，并在复杂度波动的连续交叉口中展现出更强的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入面向恐惧的动态约束替代静态约束，Brain-SAD有效缓解了约束与训练场景的耦合问题，提升了自动驾驶策略在多样交互场景下的安全性与鲁棒性。

title: doPlan: A Variable-Horizon Dataset for Multi-Stage Language-Conditioned Planning in Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous vehicles interacting with passengers through natural language must reason beyond immediate commands. Passenger intent may span multiple stages of behavior, depend on future events, refer to surrounding agents or landmarks, and remain relevant as driving conditions evolve. Existing language-enabled driving datasets largely focus on short, localized interactions, leaving these longer-horizon forms of passenger intent comparatively underexplored. We introduce doPlan, to our knowledge the first publicly available, human-annotated real-world dataset designed to study passenger language as persistent task context. Built on nuPlan, doPlan contains 5,154 human-written passenger instructions spanning 169.1 hours of cumulative instruction-aligned context over 50.9 hours of unique driving, with annotation windows ranging from 30.0 to 508.8 s. The annotations capture immediate, deferred, event-conditioned, persistent, and multi-stage passenger intent. The dataset, annotation interface, and supporting resources are publicly available at https://github.com/Mi3-Lab/doPlan. We evaluate four language-conditioned driving models and find that sensitivity to passenger language does not reliably translate into behavior consistent with the requested direction. More broadly, among 2,161 examples with a matched future maneuver, the first associated maneuver occurs a median of 24.6 s after the evaluation point, and only 9.8% occur within the models' common 5 s prediction horizon. These findings highlight the need to connect persistent passenger intent with successive planning decisions. doPlan provides a setting for studying how unresolved goals can be retained, grounded in evolving scenes, and tracked across multiple stages, including how a planner determines when a future goal becomes relevant to the current plan.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 doPlan，首个公开的、人工标注的真实世界乘客语言数据集，用于研究乘客意图作为持续性任务上下文的长时程规划问题。
AI.motivation: 现有支持语言的驾驶数据集主要关注短时、局部的交互，而乘客意图可能跨多个行为阶段、依赖未来事件、指代周围智能体或地标，并随驾驶条件演变而持续有效，这类长时程意图研究不足。
AI.method: 基于 nuPlan 构建 doPlan 数据集，包含 5,154 条人工书写的乘客指令，覆盖 50.9 小时独特驾驶、累计 169.1 小时的指令对齐上下文，标注窗口为 30.0 至 508.8 秒；标注涵盖即时、延迟、事件触发、持续和多阶段五类乘客意图；并评估四个语言条件驾驶模型。
AI.result: 对乘客语言的敏感性并不能可靠转化为与请求方向一致的行为；在 2,161 个具有匹配未来机动动作的样本中，首个相关机动动作中位出现在评估点后 24.6 秒，仅 9.8% 落在模型常见的 5 秒预测时域内。
AI.conclusion: 需要将持续性乘客意图与后续规划决策相连接；doPlan 为研究未解决目标如何被保留、如何在演变场景中落地及跨阶段追踪提供了实验平台，包括规划器如何判断未来目标何时与当前规划相关。

title: Pow3R-SLAM: Real-Time RGB-D SLAM with 3D Reconstruction Priors
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Project page: https://chriskolios.github.io/Pow3R-SLAM/
summary: We present Pow3R-SLAM, a real-time RGB-D simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) system that uses Pow3R for tracking and mapping. Inspired by MASt3R-SLAM, a recent work on monocular SLAM using two-view 3D reconstruction priors, we extend the work to incorporate depth as a prior on the network's prediction, rather than as geometry to fuse. Where traditional RGB-D SLAM systems struggle with sparsity in the depth images, Pow3R utilizes the available depth to give a better-conditioned pointmap, while inferring the depths in empty regions from the two-view photometric, depth, and intrinsic data. Evaluated against MASt3R-SLAM following its protocol on 24 sequences from TUM, 7-Scenes, and Replica, Pow3R-SLAM runs 1.6x faster in wall time, has 15% lower mean trajectory error, a 3.1x lower unscaled error, and produces denser maps, with a 30% lower Chamfer distance. We also introduce a hybrid variant that runs 2.1x faster than MASt3R-SLAM at 25.3 frames per second (FPS), while maintaining improved tracking and mapping accuracy. Against ORB-SLAM3 in RGB-D mode, Pow3R-SLAM is more accurate on TUM, 7-Scenes, and ETH3D-SLAM, and completes every TUM sequence. While Pow3R-SLAM can struggle on a small set of self-similar scenes, its overall performance shows that adding depth as a prior for two-view 3D reconstruction SLAM can be beneficial. A project webpage is available at: https://ChrisKolios.github.io/Pow3R-SLAM , and code will be made open-source upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: Pow3R-SLAM 是一种实时 RGB-D SLAM 系统，将深度作为先验融入双视图 3D 重建网络，在跟踪精度、速度和建图密度上均优于 MASt3R-SLAM，并在多个数据集上超越 ORB-SLAM3 的 RGB-D 模式。
AI.motivation: 传统 RGB-D SLAM 难以处理深度图像的稀疏性。受 MASt3R-SLAM（基于双视图 3D 重建先验的单目 SLAM）启发，作者希望将深度作为网络预测的先验而非用于融合的几何信息，以改善点图的条件性并从双视图的光度、深度和内参数据中推断空白区域的深度。
AI.method: 提出 Pow3R-SLAM，一个使用 Pow3R 进行跟踪与建图的实时 RGB-D SLAM 系统。核心做法是将深度作为网络预测的先验（prior），利用可用深度得到条件更好的 pointmap，并推断空白区域的深度。此外还提出一种混合变体（hybrid variant）以提升运行速度。
AI.result: 在 TUM、7-Scenes 和 Replica 的 24 条序列上按 MASt3R-SLAM 协议评测：墙钟时间快 1.6x，平均轨迹误差低 15%，未缩放误差低 3.1x，地图更稠密（Chamfer 距离低 30%）。混合变体比 MASt3R-SLAM 快 2.1x，达 25.3 FPS，且保持更高的跟踪与建图精度。与 ORB-SLAM3 的 RGB-D 模式相比，在 TUM、7-Scenes 和 ETH3D-SLAM 上更准确，并完成全部 TUM 序列。
AI.conclusion: Pow3R-SLAM 在少数自相似场景中可能表现不佳，但整体结果表明，将深度作为双视图 3D 重建 SLAM 的先验是有益的。项目网页为 https://ChrisKolios.github.io/Pow3R-SLAM ，代码将在论文接收后开源。

title: WorldLine: Action-Driven Visual Simulation for Robotic Manipulation
comment: A work about visual simulators for embodied AI
summary: Real-world robot learning is constrained by the cost of collecting experience and evaluating candidate behaviors. Video generation models offer a scalable foundation for visual simulators that predict action outcomes before physical execution. Yet they often favor visual plausibility over accurate action following and coherent robot--object dynamics, while action-conditioned simulators depend on scarce, embodiment-specific data that are difficult to share across incompatible control spaces. We introduce WorldLine, an action-driven visual simulator that decouples transferable dynamics learning from heterogeneous action grounding. WorldLine learns manipulation dynamics from more than 10,000 hours of action-free robot videos and grounds them using over 2,000 hours of action trajectories across more than ten embodiments. An image-space action representation provides a shared control interface across embodiments, while multi-view and failure-enriched training with relational regularization improves interaction-sensitive prediction. Robot-focused few-step distillation enables efficient causal rollout while preserving action-critical motion. Across held-out and out-of-domain settings, WorldLine maintains strong visual quality and robot-motion agreement; on failed trajectories, it improves robot-mask IoU by 0.1626 over the strongest baseline. It predicts trajectory success with 74% mean accuracy across RoboTwin and AgiBot, one percentage point above the strongest baseline. Without RoboTwin training or adaptation, its rollouts improve task success by up to 21.4 percentage points over direct policy execution. Together, these capabilities make WorldLine a scalable and efficient visual simulator for policy evaluation and embodied planning. More results are available at \href{https://zhengsh123.github.io/WorldLine/}{project page}.

AI.tldr: WorldLine 是一种动作驱动的视觉模拟器，通过学习可迁移的动力学并将异构动作接地，实现跨形态的机器人操作结果预测。
AI.motivation: 真实机器人学习受限于经验采集与候选行为评估的高成本；现有视频生成模型偏重视觉合理性而忽视动作跟随与机器人-物体动力学一致性，且动作条件模拟器依赖稀缺的特定形态数据，难以在不同控制空间间共享。
AI.method: 解耦可迁移动力学学习与异构动作接地：从超1万小时无动作机器人视频学习操作动力学，用超2000小时、十余种形态的动作轨迹进行接地；采用图像空间动作表示作为跨形态共享控制接口；多视角与失败增强训练结合关系正则化提升交互敏感预测；机器人聚焦的少步蒸馏实现高效因果式 rollout 并保留动作关键运动。
AI.result: 在留出与域外设置中保持较强视觉质量与机器人运动一致性；失败轨迹上机器人掩码 IoU 相对最强基线提升 0.1626；在 RoboTwin 与 AgiBot 上以 74% 平均准确率预测轨迹成功，高最强基线 1 个百分点；未经 RoboTwin 训练或适配时，其 rollout 使任务成功率较直接策略执行最高提升 21.4 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: WorldLine 兼顾可扩展性与效率，可作为策略评估与具身规划的视觉模拟器。

title: From Routing Signals to Selective Review: Visual regrounding in MoE VLMs
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) may accept false visual premises, answering questions about a target object's color, count, location, or state even when it is absent. We call this reliability-critical behavior a target-absence grounding failure. Existing visual-grounding detectors primarily rely on generated responses, hidden states, or uncertainty measures. We present the first framework to leverage internal routing decisions in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) VLMs to detect target absence before generation and guide selective correction. We extract target-token routing probabilities from Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct and Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it, train a separate L2-regularized linear detector for each model, and use its predictions to selectively invoke a target-aware review prompt. Using routing alone, the Qwen and Gemma detectors achieve ROC-AUCs of 0.9988 and 0.9956 on GQA-Inpaint and retain 0.8095 and 0.7781 on the external OBER dataset, respectively. The resulting routing-gated policy improves end-to-end accuracy on GQA-Inpaint and OBER by +22.25% and +12.17% for Qwen, and by +13.42% and +1.39% for Gemma, without modifying model weights. Further analysis shows that the signal is localized to the target-object token, emerges in early MoE layers, and is distributed across partially substitutable experts. Although cross-dataset threshold shifts require recalibration, false-positive review causes limited harm overall, suggesting that intervention risk can be controlled through joint selection of the detector threshold and review prompt. Overall, we show that routing probabilities alone preserve actionable information about visual perception, allowing computation already produced by an MoE VLM to support low-cost detection and selective visual regrounding.

AI.tldr: 提出首个利用MoE VLM内部路由决策来检测目标缺失的框架，可在生成前进行检测并指导选择性纠正，无需修改模型权重。
AI.motivation: VLM可能接受虚假视觉前提，对不存在的目标对象回答其颜色、数量、位置或状态，这种目标缺失接地失败影响可靠性。现有视觉接地检测器主要依赖生成响应、隐藏状态或不确定性度量，缺乏利用MoE内部路由信号的低成本方案。
AI.method: 从Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct与Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it中提取目标token的路由概率，为每个模型训练独立的L2正则化线性检测器，并以其预测结果选择性触发目标感知复查提示。
AI.result: 仅用路由信号，Qwen与Gemma检测器在GQA-Inpaint上ROC-AUC达0.9988与0.9956，在外部OBER数据集上保持0.8095与0.7781。路由门控策略使端到端准确率在GQA-Inpaint与OBER上分别提升Qwen +22.25%、+12.17%，Gemma +13.42%、+1.39%。分析表明信号定位于目标对象token、出现于早期MoE层、分布于部分可替换专家中。
AI.conclusion: 跨数据集阈值漂移需重新校准，但误检复查总体危害有限，说明可通过联合选择检测阈值与复查提示来控制干预风险。路由概率本身保留了关于视觉感知的可操作信息，使MoE VLM已产生的计算能支持低成本检测与选择性视觉重新接地。

title: Counterfactual Video Generation Enables Scalable Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
comment: published at CoRL 2026. Project page: https://prism-real2sim2real.github.io/
summary: Teaching humanoids loco-manipulation skills, such as carrying diverse objects, via visual imitation is a promising path toward generalist robots. However, collecting diverse, high-quality interaction videos, such as clips that clearly show a person's full body and unoccluded interactions with objects, poses a practical barrier to scaling this approach. We propose PRISM, a real-to-sim-to-real framework that overcomes this limitation by amplifying a handful of real videos into a large, diverse training set. PRISM first generates hundreds of diverse "counterfactual" human-object interaction videos via video-to-video (V2V) generation from a few exemplar real videos. Our contact-anchored real-to-sim pipeline then reconstructs both human and object motions, retargeting this imperfect video data into physically plausible trajectories. The intra-class variability across these counterfactual videos lets us train a single policy that generalizes to unseen objects within each category. We demonstrate the full pipeline by deploying this policy on a real robot without any real-world fine-tuning. Using only onboard depth observations, our humanoid picks up, carries, and drops objects, including boxes, barrels, bins, and balls, across novel instances, sizes, and initial configurations.

AI.tldr: PRISM 提出 real-to-sim-to-real 框架，用少量真实视频通过 V2V 生成数百个反事实人-物交互视频，再经接触锚定的 real-to-sim 重建与重定向，得到物理合理轨迹，训练单一策略并在真实人形机器人上零微调部署，实现多类物体的举放与搬运。
AI.motivation: 视觉模仿是实现通用人形机器人 loco-manipulation 的可行路径，但采集"全身可见、无遮挡交互"的高质量多样化交互视频成本高、难度大，成为规模化扩展的瓶颈。作者希望突破真实视频数据稀缺的限制。
AI.method: PRISM 是 real-to-sim-to-real 框架：(1) 以少量真实示例视频为输入，用 video-to-video (V2V) 生成产生数百个多样化的"反事实"人-物交互视频；(2) 采用 contact-anchored real-to-sim 流程重建人体与物体运动，将不完美的视频数据重定向为物理合理的轨迹；(3) 利用这些反事实视频的类内多样性训练单一策略，使其能泛化到同类未见物体。
AI.result: 策略直接部署到真实机器人，未做任何真实世界微调。仅依靠机载深度观测，人形机器人即可完成对箱子、桶、储物箱和球的拾取、搬运与放置，并能应对新实例、新尺寸和新初始位姿。
AI.conclusion: 通过把极少量真实视频放大为大规模、多样化训练集，PRISM 证明 visual imitation 数据瓶颈可被 V2V 生成 + contact-anchored real-to-sim 有效缓解；单一泛化策略可跨类内未见物体和构型直接迁移到真实人形机器人。

title: Socrates-RAG: Premise-Directed Inquiry against Coordinated Evidence Poisoning
summary:
Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) defenses typically decide how to filter or aggregate a fixed retrieved set. In open-corpus question answering, however, decisive evidence may be absent from the initial context but retrievable, making the next query part of the reliability problem. We introduce Socrates-RAG, a premise-directed active retrieval policy that represents competing answers, selects an unresolved premise whose resolution would discriminate them, and uses newly acquired evidence to refine a subsequent query before answering or abstaining. We formalize the resulting finite-budget evidence state and give a conditional rescue guarantee relative to repeated or topical-query policies.
  We evaluate Socrates-RAG against a matched control in which the same backbone generates ordinary relevance-oriented search queries; both policies share the initial evidence, deterministic retriever, two-query/top-three budget, answer prompt, and label-free evidence-chain release rule. On a disjoint 48-world counterfactual evaluation, premise-directed inquiry raises safe accuracy from 79.2% to 93.8%, with 8 wins, 1 loss, and 39 ties (two-sided exact p=.0391). Decisive-evidence recall improves by the same margin, while unsafe answers fall from one to zero. Both policies solve all 24 one-hop cases; the gain is concentrated in two-hop cases, where Socrates-RAG substitutes a newly resolved premise into its second query. This controlled study isolates a specific benefit of premise-directed acquisition without claiming general robustness on the open Web.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Socrates-RAG，一种前提导向的主动检索策略：通过表征竞争性答案、选择能区分它们的未决前提，并利用新证据细化后续查询，从而在开放语料问答中提升可靠性。
AI.motivation: 传统 RAG 防御通常只在固定的检索集合上决定如何过滤或聚合，但在开放语料问答中，决定性证据可能不在初始上下文中却可被检索到。因此，下一次查询本身成为可靠性问题的一部分，如何主动获取关键证据成为提升系统可靠性的核心挑战。
AI.method: Socrates-RAG 将答案生成过程形式化为有限预算的证据状态，采用前提导向的主动检索策略：表征相互竞争的答案候选，选择对其具有区分能力的未决前提，并基于新获得的证据细化下一次查询，之后再进行回答或弃答。作者将其与匹配对照组进行对比实验，两组共享相同的初始证据、确定性检索器、两查询/前三条预算、答案提示以及无标签证据链发布规则，区别仅在于对照组的查询为普通的、面向相关性的检索式。
AI.result: 在一个独立的 48 个世界反事实评估中，前提导向的探询将安全准确率从 79.2% 提升至 93.8%，取得 8 胜、1 负、39 平（双侧精确检验 p=0.0391）。决定性证据召回率提升幅度相同，不安全答案从 1 降至 0。两种策略均能解决全部 24 个单跳案例，性能提升集中在双跳案例上，其中 Socrates-RAG 将新解决的前提代入第二次查询。
AI.conclusion: 该受控研究证明了前提导向证据获取的特定收益，并给出了相对于重复查询或主题查询策略的条件性补救保证，但作者并未声称在开放网络环境下具有普遍鲁棒性。

title: Post-Generation Verification Dominates Retrieval Optimization: A 2^4 Factorial Ablation of RAG Pipeline Features
summary: Modern RAG pipelines stack many enhancement features, but these features are typically validated in isolation, leaving their interactions unmeasured. We run a 2^4 full factorial ablation of four pipeline features -- section expansion (SE), agentic search (AS), completeness check (CC), and table-of-contents-guided retrieval (ToC) -- across 16 configurations, 24 queries spanning eight interaction types, and two cloud-class models (768 conditions) on five public documents (78-492 pages), scoring every answer against a verified reference. Post-generation verification dominates: CC is the strongest feature (d=+0.48, p<0.001), improving accuracy, completeness, and usefulness simultaneously, and CC alone (4.31/5) outperforms every configuration without it, including the three-feature SE+AS+ToC (4.11). ToC yields a significant gain at zero LLM cost (d=+0.22); AS is small and unstable, helping some queries and harming others; SE is neutral. The highest-quality configuration roughly doubles baseline latency, producing a genuine quality-latency Pareto frontier of six configurations. Feature utility is strongly query-type dependent -- CC reaches d=+0.83 on completeness-demanding queries -- so single-query-type evaluations systematically mis-rank features. We conclude that verifying answers matters more than optimizing retrieval, and that factorial designs with diverse query types are necessary to evaluate RAG features.

AI.tldr: 通过2^4全因子消融实验（768种条件）系统评估RAG四大增强特征及其交互，发现生成后验证（CC）是最强特征，其单独使用即优于任何不含它的组合；特征效用强依赖查询类型。
AI.motivation: 现代RAG流水线常叠加多种增强特征，但这些特征通常被孤立验证，其相互作用未被测量，导致无法判断各特征的真实边际贡献与组合效应。
AI.method: 对四个流水线特征——章节扩展（SE）、智能体检索（AS）、完整性检查（CC）、目录引导检索（ToC）——进行2^4全因子消融，覆盖16种配置、24个查询（8种交互类型）、2个云级模型（共768种条件），在5份公开文档（78–492页）上运行，并将每个答案与经核验的参考答案对比打分。
AI.result: 生成后验证占主导：CC最强（d=+0.48，p<0.001），同时提升准确性、完整性和有用性，CC单独配置（4.31/5）优于所有不含CC的配置，包括三特征的SE+AS+ToC（4.11）。ToC以零LLM成本带来显著增益（d=+0.22）；AS效应小且不稳定；SE中性。最高质量配置约使基线延迟翻倍，形成含6种配置的质量-延迟帕累托前沿。特征效用强依赖查询类型——CC在要求完整性的查询上达d=+0.83，故单一查询类型评估会系统性错排特征。
AI.conclusion: 验证答案比优化检索更重要；评估RAG特征必须采用包含多样查询类型的因子设计，否则会系统性地误判特征优劣。

title: TSG Suggester: Tree-Structured Knowledge-Graph Retrieval for Troubleshooting Guide Recommendation in Cloud Incident Management
summary:
On call engineers in large scale cloud services work under intense time pressure, yet locating the correct Troubleshooting Guide (TSG) for an incident remains a largely manual, keyword driven process, and prior empirical work finds that guide search consumes a substantial fraction of total mitigation time.
  We present TSG Suggester, a retrieval system that recommends relevant TSGs directly from an incident description. We evaluate five retrieval strategies: Text Only RAG, Image Augmented RAG, RAPTOR, Tree Structured Retrieval, and our proposed Tree + Knowledge Graph (Tree+KG), on 314 real world incidents spanning 112 unique TSGs drawn from 18 service teams on a production incident management system.
  Tree+KG converts each guide into a tree that preserves its native section hierarchy, attaches LLM generated problem abstractions to internal nodes to bridge the solution oriented language of guides and the problem oriented language of incidents, extracts a per guide entity knowledge graph, and fuses embedding similarity with entity level matching at query time. Tree+KG attains 54.78% Top 1 and 82.48% Top 5 accuracy, leading every baseline at every cutoff, with an 8.58 point Top 1 gain over text only RAG.
  Two findings are of independent interest. First, structural alignment dominates: methods that preserve or rebuild document structure outperform flat chunking where precise discrimination matters. Second, and contrary to our initial hypothesis, multimodal enrichment actively hurts. Captioning guide screenshots and injecting the captions costs 22.64 Top 5 points relative to the text only baseline because generic captions dilute embeddings rather than sharpen them. We report error analyses for both results and provide concrete deployment guidance.

AI.tldr: 提出TSG Suggester检索系统，从事故描述直接推荐故障排查指南（TSG）。在314个真实事故、112个TSG上评测五种策略，Tree+KG（树结构+知识图谱）取得54.78% Top-1和82.48% Top-5，全面领先基线，较纯文本RAG提升8.58个Top-1百分点。
AI.motivation: 大规模云服务的on-call工程师处于强时间压力下，但定位正确TSG仍主要是人工、关键词驱动流程；既有实证研究表明指南检索占用了相当一部分总缓解时间。
AI.method: 对比五种检索策略：Text Only RAG、Image Augmented RAG、RAPTOR、Tree Structured Retrieval，以及提出的Tree+KG。Tree+KG将每篇指南转换为保留原始章节层级的树，在内部节点附加LLM生成的问题抽象以弥合指南“面向解决方案”与事故“面向问题”的语言鸿沟，抽取每篇指南的实体知识图谱，并在查询时融合嵌入相似度与实体级匹配。数据：18个服务团队、112个唯一TSG、314个真实事故。
AI.result: Tree+KG达到54.78% Top-1与82.48% Top-5，在所有截断点均领先所有基线，Top-1较纯文本RAG提升8.58个百分点。两项独立发现：结构对齐占主导，保留或重建文档结构的方法在需要精确区分时优于扁平分块；与初始假设相反，多模态增强反而有害——为指南截图生成标题并注入会因泛化标题稀释嵌入，使Top-5相对纯文本基线下降22.64个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结构对齐是TSG检索的主导因素，验证了保留原生层级与问题抽象的价值；多模态标题注入因稀释嵌入而显著损害性能，故不推荐盲目使用。作者对两项结果给出错误分析并提供具体部署指导。

title: Financial Evidence Crowding: Diagnosing and Mitigating Constraint-Induced Displacement in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) retrieves candidate evidence and sends only a limited top-ranked subset, the top-k context, to a generator. In financial question answering, passages can match a query's topic while conflicting with its period, segment, metric scope, or table scope. We study the resulting set-level ordering failure, which we call financial evidence crowding. FinDeCrowd-Stress isolates this failure through matched compatible and incompatible candidate pools while fixing the query, relevant evidence, ranking model, candidate count, and retrieval budget. On a FinDER test split containing companies unseen during training, incompatible pools reduce top-10 evidence inclusion (Recall@10) by 0.147 relative to equally difficult compatible pools. This gap shows that conflicting candidates consume limited context slots and displace answer-supporting evidence. We then introduce FinDeCrowd-RAG, a learned score correction that combines a fixed relevance score with typed compatibility and local lexical competition. A query-level identity gate applies the correction only when it predicts a better order; otherwise, it preserves the original ranking. On identical controlled candidates, FinDeCrowd-RAG raises top-10 evidence inclusion from 0.757 to 0.902 by recovering evidence already present in the candidate set. On a FinDER index built without query-specific candidate insertion, gated reranking raises this inclusion rate from 0.420 to 0.492, while top-100 retrieval coverage remains 0.743 by design. With a fixed generator, the same ordering change improves answer accuracy and citation recall on FinanceBench and FinQA. These results identify constraint-induced displacement as a measurable RAG evaluation target and show that identity-gated reranking can recover evidence already covered by first-stage retrieval.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"金融证据拥挤"(financial evidence crowding)这一集合级排序失败问题，并给出诊断基准FinDeCrowd-Stress与修复方法FinDeCrowd-RAG。
AI.motivation: 在金融问答中，检索到的段落可能与查询主题匹配，但在时间期间、业务分部、指标口径或表格范围上相互冲突。这些冲突候选会占据有限的top-k上下文槽位，挤掉真正支持答案的证据，导致现有RAG在集合层面的排序失败。作者希望将这种"约束诱导的证据位移"作为可度量的RAG评测目标。
AI.method: 1) 构建FinDeCrowd-Stress：通过匹配的兼容/不兼容候选池，固定查询、相关证据、排序模型、候选数量与检索预算，隔离出该失败模式。2) 提出FinDeCrowd-RAG：一种学习式分数校正，将固定相关性分数与类型化兼容性(typed compatibility)及局部词法竞争(local lexical competition)结合；并引入查询级身份门控(query-level identity gate)，仅在预测能改善排序时施加校正，否则保留原始排序。
AI.result: 在含训练期未见公司的FinDER测试集上，不兼容候选池使top-10证据包含率(Recall@10)相对同等难度的兼容池下降0.147。FinDeCrowd-RAG在相同受控候选上把top-10证据包含率从0.757提升至0.902；在无查询特定候选插入的FinDER索引上，门控重排将该包含率从0.420提升至0.492，同时top-100检索覆盖率按设计保持0.743。在固定生成器下，相同排序变化提升了FinanceBench与FinQA上的答案准确率与引用召回率。
AI.conclusion: 结果将约束诱发的证据位移确立为一个可测量的RAG评测目标，并表明身份门控重排能够回收第一阶段检索已覆盖但被排序挤压的证据，从而在不改变检索覆盖的前提下改善生成质量。

title: Soft Curriculum Learning for Optimizing Fresh and Generalized Recommendations
comment: to be published in ACM RecSys '26, Minneapolis, MN, USA
summary: Large-scale recommender systems, particularly short-form video platforms, are often bottlenecked by massive popularity feedback loops. In such environments, as models recommend popular items, they generate an overwhelming amount of skewed training data for "head" items. This creates a self-reinforcing cycle where retrieval and ranking models memorize "head" item patterns at the expense of generalizing across the vast "tail" of the catalogue. While Curriculum Learning (CL) offers a powerful mechanism to break this feedback loop by systematically exposing models to progressively more difficult and less frequent examples, its adoption in industrial recommendation has been hampered by hardware utilization inefficiencies or the needs for complicated pre-processing techniques because dynamic data rejection algorithms tend to starve hardware accelearators (TPUs/GPUs) by becoming largely CPU-bound. In this work, we introduce a scalable Soft Curriculum Learning framework designed specifically for continuous training setups within industry-scale retrieval and ranking models. By utilizing loss annealing and in-graph weight adjustments rather than rigid data filtering, we break the popularity feedback and enable dynamic curriculum pacing without sacrificing system throughput. We demonstrate empirical evidence through applications across sequence-based retrieval models (such as SASRec), two-tower retrieval models, and large-scale continuous ranking models. Online A/B tests on our short-video platform demonstrate substantial lifts in both overall user satisfaction and fresh content consumption, all without degrading model throughput.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向工业级推荐系统（检索与排序）的可扩展软课程学习（Soft Curriculum Learning）框架，通过损失退火与图内权重调整替代刚性数据过滤，在不牺牲吞吐量的前提下打破流行度反馈循环。
AI.motivation: 大规模推荐系统（尤其短视频平台）受困于流行度反馈循环：模型推荐热门（head）物品会产生大量偏斜训练数据，使检索与排序模型记忆头部模式而牺牲对长尾（tail）物品的泛化能力。课程学习（CL）理论上可通过逐步暴露更难、更稀疏样本来打破该循环，但现有动态数据拒绝算法多为CPU-bound，会拖慢TPU/GPU等加速器，导致硬件利用率低，且需要复杂预处理，阻碍了其在工业推荐中的落地。
AI.method: 提出面向工业级检索与排序模型持续训练（continuous training）场景的可扩展软课程学习框架。核心做法是不使用刚性数据过滤，而是采用损失退火（loss annealing）与图内权重调整（in-graph weight adjustments）来实现动态课程节奏，从而避免CPU瓶颈并保持系统吞吐。
AI.result: 在基于序列的检索模型（如SASRec）、双塔检索模型以及大规模持续排序模型上进行了应用与实证验证。在短视频平台的在线A/B测试中，整体用户满意度与新鲜内容（fresh content）消费均获得显著提升，且模型吞吐量未下降。
AI.conclusion: 软课程学习框架可在不牺牲吞吐量的条件下打破流行度反馈循环，兼容工业级持续训练流程，并在检索与排序任务、离线模型与在线A/B测试中同时带来用户满意度与新鲜内容消费的提升，具备工业落地价值。

title: Structured Interaction, Visual Localization, and Robust Execution for Complex Web Tasks: A Technical Report on the WebRetriever Challenge
comment: Winning Report for the WebRetriever Challenge
summary: This report presents the web agent system developed for the WebRetriever Challenge. The system follows a structuredinteraction- first strategy, using semantic webpage information for routine browser operations and invoking visual perception only when structured representations are insufficient. Three key designs are introduced: grid-assisted visual localization for difficult-to-access controls, hierarchical context management for reducing redundant page and interaction history, and fault-aware execution mechanisms for stable multi-browser task processing. The system achieved a pass rate of up to 79% in local evaluation on Protocol 1. In the official Protocol 3 competition, it achieved a 59% pass rate with eight concurrent browser workers and ranked first overall, winning the WebRetriever Challenge.

AI.tldr: 该报告介绍了一个为 WebRetriever Challenge 开发的网页智能体系统，采用"结构化交互优先、视觉感知按需调用"的策略，并引入三项关键设计：网格辅助视觉定位、分层上下文管理、故障感知执行机制，最终在官方 Protocol 3 竞赛中以 59% 通过率和八路并发浏览器取得第一名。
AI.motivation: 网页任务处理中，结构化语义信息通常高效但覆盖不全，而视觉感知能力强却代价高昂；同时多浏览器并发场景面临页面历史冗余与执行不稳定等问题，因此需要一种兼顾效率与鲁棒性的智能体方案。
AI.method: 系统采用结构化的"交互优先"策略：优先使用语义网页信息完成常规浏览器操作，仅在结构化表示不足时调用视觉感知。三项关键设计为：(1) 网格辅助视觉定位，用于难以访问的控件；(2) 分层上下文管理，减少冗余页面与交互历史；(3) 故障感知执行机制，保障多浏览器任务处理的稳定性。
AI.result: 本地评测中 Protocol 1 通过率最高达 79%；官方 Protocol 3 竞赛中以八个并发浏览器 worker 取得 59% 通过率，总排名第一，赢得 WebRetriever Challenge。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的交互优先、视觉按需调用的智能体架构，结合网格定位、分层上下文与故障感知机制，在网页检索竞赛中验证了有效性与稳定性，并获得官方竞赛冠军。

title: GRP v0.1 Technical Report
summary: Industrial recommendation systems rely on multi-stage cascades whose retrieval, ranking, and serving components are difficult to replace jointly. We present GRP, a generative recommendation framework that combines retrieval, ranking, and reward modeling in a single encoder-decoder model, and evaluate a progressive path toward end-to-end recommendation. The model generates multimodal Semantic IDs and scores candidates with a jointly trained ranking module. The frozen ranking module then supplies rewards for reinforcement-learning post-training. We introduce mGRPO, which adds a reference-anchored margin to reward optimization to preserve the likelihood of logged targets. Offline experiments examine history encoding, model capacity allocation, event selection, tokenization, and reward discrimination. Serving optimizations reduce end-to-end retrieval latency by 69%. Online experiments evaluate the model as a retrieval source, with early-ranking bypass, and with replacement of weaker sources. In a retrieval-only comparison, view time increases by 0.46% and shares by 0.77% relative to production. A separate comparison combining bypass and source replacement yields increases of 0.82% in view time and 2.56% in shares, with neutral platform-level guardrails. These results support progressive deployment while identifying remaining gaps in ranking quality and performance across recommendation metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出GRP生成式推荐框架，将召回、排序与奖励建模统一于单一编码器-解码器模型，提出mGRPO强化学习后训练方法，并验证渐进式端到端部署路径。
AI.motivation: 工业推荐系统依赖多阶段级联（召回、排序、服务），各组件难以联合替换，缺乏端到端优化手段。
AI.method: GRP在单一编码器-解码器内融合召回、排序与奖励建模；生成多模态Semantic ID并用联合训练的排序模块对候选打分；冻结的排序模块为强化学习后训练提供奖励；提出mGRPO，在奖励优化中加入参考锚定边距以保留已记录目标（logged targets）的似然。离线实验考察历史编码、模型容量分配、事件选择、分词与奖励判别；同时进行服务优化。
AI.result: 服务优化将端到端召回延迟降低69%。在线实验中，仅作召回源对比时，观看时长提升0.46%、分享提升0.77%；结合早期排序旁路与弱源替换时，观看时长提升0.82%、分享提升2.56%，平台级护栏指标保持中性。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持渐进式部署路线，同时指出在排序质量及各项推荐指标性能上仍存在待弥补的差距。

title: Optimizing VLP-aligned Multimodal Intent Representation with Correct Visual Instantiation for Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval
summary: ZS-CIR aims to retrieve a target image from a reference image and a modification text without paired supervision, typically by encoding composed queries as text-dominant representations within the image-text matching space of VLPs. However, queries reconstructed by visual pseudo-word learning or MLLM-based target reasoning often deviate from the native VLP representation space due to reference noise and coarse text fusion in the former, and verbose, weakly visually grounded descriptions in the latter. In this paper, we propose a unified ZS-CIR framework (named VMIR-CVI) to reconstruct multimodal composite queries from two complementary perspectives for optimizing VLP-compatible multimodal intent representation. First, it reasons and converts the multimodal intent into a unified textual description, aligning with the native text space of the VLP backbones to produce more retrieval-compatible textual queries. Second, it reconstructs the query representation with correctly decoupled visual instance cues, reducing reference noise while preserving target-relevant content. Specifically, a VLP-aligned Multimodal Intent Reasoning (VMIR) module injects few-shot VLP-style exemplars into chain-of-thought prompts, guiding the MLLM to generate target-consistent intent queries. A Training-free Visual Instance Disentanglement (TVID) module decouples fine-grained visual instances from global reference features without additional optimization. Finally, a lightweight Hybrid-modal Intent Alignment and Fusion (HIAF) module integrates the reasoned textual intent and disentangled visual cues into a unified hybrid-modal representation for robust ZS-CIR. Extensive experiments on three CIR benchmarks, namely CIRR, CIRCO and FashionIQ, show that VMIR-CVI significantly outperforms existing baselines and achieves new state-of-the-art performance. Code and trained models will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 提出统一零样本组合图像检索框架VMIR-CVI，从文本意图推理与视觉实例解耦两个互补角度重构多模态组合查询，以对齐VLP原生表示空间，在CIRR、CIRCO、FashionIQ上取得新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 零样本组合图像检索（ZS-CIR）需在无配对监督下，由参考图像与修改文本检索目标图像。现有方法将组合查询编码为VLP图文匹配空间中的文本主导表示，但视觉伪词学习受参考噪声与粗粒度文本融合影响，基于MLLM的目标推理又产生冗长、视觉锚定弱的描述，导致重建查询偏离VLP原生表示空间，检索兼容性差。
AI.method: 提出VMIR-CVI统一框架，含三个组件：（1）VLP对齐的多模态意图推理（VMIR）模块，将少样本VLP风格示例注入思维链提示，引导MLLM生成与目标一致的意图查询，转化为统一文本描述以对齐VLP文本空间；（2）免训练视觉实例解耦（TVID）模块，无需额外优化即可从全局参考特征中解耦细粒度视觉实例，在保留目标相关内容的同时降低参考噪声；（3）轻量混合模态意图对齐与融合（HIAF）模块，将推理文本意图与解耦视觉线索融合为统一的混合模态表示。
AI.result: 在CIRR、CIRCO和FashionIQ三个CIR基准上开展大量实验，VMIR-CVI显著优于现有基线，达到新的最先进性能。代码与训练模型将公开。
AI.conclusion: 通过文本意图推理与视觉实例解耦两条互补路径重构组合查询，可有效提升查询与VLP原生表示空间的兼容性，实现鲁棒的零样本组合图像检索；该框架在多个基准上验证了有效性与通用性。

title: HELIX: Purified and Unified - Rethinking Feature Interaction and Sequence Modeling for Large-Scale Recommendation
summary: Industrial recommendation ranking models typically scale along two modeling axes: feature interaction over heterogeneous user, item, context, and cross features, and sequence modeling over long, informative, and multi-type user behavior histories. We find that scaling either capability in isolation is insufficient, as each exhibits a limited scaling ceiling and a suboptimal scaling-law slope. We conjecture that achieving a more favorable scaling-law slope requires jointly scaling both axes. To support this, we present HELIX, a purified and unified architecture for large-scale recommendation. HELIX interleaves sequence retrieval and feature interaction while enforcing one-way information flow from reusable sequence states to candidate-conditioned mix-tokens. This design preserves cross-depth communication between the two modeling axes while keeping user-side sequence computation amortizable, enabling flexible and asymmetric scaling of sequence modeling and feature interaction. Deployed in TikTok's e-commerce recommendation system, HELIX consistently improves offline CTR AUC, CVR AUC, and other ranking metrics. In online A/B tests, it achieves an approximately 6% increase in e-commerce video GMV per user.

AI.tldr: 提出统一架构 HELIX，将序列建模与特征交互两轴联合扩展，在 TikTok 电商推荐中显著提升离线与在线指标。
AI.motivation: 工业推荐排序模型沿两个建模轴扩展：异构用户/物品/上下文/交叉特征的特征交互，以及长且信息丰富的多类型用户行为序列建模。作者发现单独扩展任一能力都不充分：各自存在扩展天花板与不理想的 scaling law 斜率，因此推测需联合扩展两轴才能获得更优的斜率。
AI.method: 提出 HELIX——面向大规模推荐的纯净统一架构。它交错（interleave）序列检索与特征交互，并强制信息单向流动：从可复用的序列状态流向以候选为条件的 mix-token。该设计在保留两个建模轴跨深度通信的同时，使用户侧序列计算可摊销（amortizable），从而支持序列建模与特征交互的灵活、非对称扩展。
AI.result: 在 TikTok 电商推荐系统中部署，离线 CTR AUC、CVR AUC 及其他排序指标持续提升；在线 A/B 测试中，电商视频人均 GMV 提升约 6%。
AI.conclusion: 联合扩展特征交互与序列建模两轴可突破单轴扩展的瓶颈并获得更优 scaling law 斜率；HELIX 通过交错结构与单向信息流实现该目标，在工业级推荐场景验证了显著效果。

title: Do Evidence-Reading Diagnostics Improve Interface Selection in Small LLM Recommenders?
summary: Behavioral tests measure how a language model reads evidence. We ask whether those measurements help choose a recommendation interface. We evaluate six small instruction-tuned checkpoints across four recommendation domains with chronological evaluation and 3,426 evaluation users. Each request ranks eight candidates. A baseline selector chooses among history-only prompting, prompting with collaborative evidence, and score fusion. It uses observable features and six stability prompts that vary wording and candidate order. An augmented selector adds features from six evidence-reading prompts that ask the model to compare support counts.
