An interface chosen once on development (validation) data for each domain and checkpoint scores 0.5524 NDCG@5, compared with 0.5447 for the baseline selector and 0.5428 for the augmented selector. Adding the diagnostic features changes NDCG@5 by -0.0019 (95% interval [-0.0046, 0.0004]). The interval includes zero, and its upper bound is below the analysis plan's 0.005 improvement target. Matching the selectors' hyperparameters also leaves the interval upper bound below that target. Evidence from retrieved similar users improves prompting by 0.0999 NDCG@5 over a control using randomly selected users matched for activity. The evidence-reading tests also reveal answer-position and tie-response biases. These results concern the tested selectors and candidate sets. They illustrate why diagnostic measurements should be evaluated by whether they improve recommendation choices beyond existing features and a fixed interface.

AI.tldr: 该研究测试行为化"证据阅读"诊断指标能否帮助选择推荐接口。在6个小型指令微调模型、4个推荐领域、3426名用户上，加入诊断特征的增强选择器NDCG@5为0.5428，反而低于基线的0.5447；固定接口为0.5524。诊断特征带来的变化为-0.0019，置信区间包含零且上界低于0.005的目标，说明诊断测量未带来实质增益。
AI.motivation: 行为测试能衡量语言模型如何"阅读"证据，但尚不清楚这些测量结果是否对工程决策（如选择推荐接口）有实际指导价值。作者希望检验诊断指标能否超越现有可观测特征与固定接口，改善推荐选择。
AI.method: 采用时间序列评估设置，覆盖6个小型指令微调检查点和4个推荐领域，共3426名评估用户，每次请求对8个候选排序。对比三个选择器：(1) 基线选择器，基于历史提示、协同证据提示和分数融合，使用可观测特征与6个稳定性提示（变换措辞与候选顺序）；(2) 增强选择器，额外加入6个"证据阅读"提示特征（要求模型比较支持计数）；(3) 每领域、每检查点在验证数据上一次性选定的固定接口。评价指标为NDCG@5，并进行超参数匹配的稳健性检验。
AI.result: 固定接口NDCG@5为0.5524，基线选择器0.5447，增强选择器0.5428。加入诊断特征使NDCG@5变化-0.0019（95%区间[-0.0046, 0.0004]），区间包含零且上界低于预设0.005改进目标；匹配超参数后区间上界仍低于目标。检索相似用户证据相比随机匹配活动度用户对照，提示效果提升0.0999 NDCG@5。证据阅读测试还揭示答案位置偏差与平局响应偏差。
AI.conclusion: 诊断性测量应以其能否在现有特征和固定接口之外改善推荐选择来评判，而非仅凭其本身的测试表现。本文结论限于所测试的选择器与候选集，提示相关诊断指标在当前设置下缺乏实用增益。

title: MERGE: Multi-LLM Ensemble for Retrieval via Generative Enrichment
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to enrich user queries in information retrieval (IR) so that a standard retriever such as BM25 can bridge vocabulary gaps with the target corpus. Any single LLM, however, is limited by its training data and architectural biases, and its enrichment behavior depends on hand-crafted prompts that must be re-engineered for each new model -- an expensive and poorly scalable process. We present MERGE (Multi-LLM Ensemble for Retrieval via Generative Enrichment), a two-stage framework: three heterogeneous 7-8B open-source LLMs independently produce candidate expansions, and a larger LLM generatively synthesizes them into a single query. To make prompt engineering scalable across the ensemble, we integrate a task-grounded Automatic Prompt Optimization (APO) loop into both stages. Unlike APO methods that judge candidates with an LLM evaluator, our loop scores each candidate by its downstream retrieval performance and runs a small tournament between the current champion prompt and optimizer-proposed drafts, terminating once the champion survives two consecutive rounds; a history-augmented variant additionally feeds the recent tournament trajectory back to the optimizer. MERGE is retriever-agnostic and issues a single BM25 pass with no rank fusion, no supervised document expansion, and no re-indexing. On five BEIR benchmarks (NQ, SciFact, FiQA, Touche-2020, DBPedia), MERGE improves BM25 nDCG@10 over the original queries by +2.1 to +14.9 points and matches or outperforms strong LLM-based query-expansion baselines despite using only compact open-source models. Ablations confirm that the Stage-2 ensemble beats any single Stage-1 LLM, and that task-grounded APO converts large seed-prompt regressions into consistent gains without hand-tuning.

AI.tldr: MERGE是一个两阶段多LLM集成查询扩展框架，用小型开源模型生成候选扩展并由大模型合成，配合面向检索性能的自动提示优化，在五个BEIR基准上显著提升BM25的nDCG@10。
AI.motivation: 单一LLM受训练数据与架构偏见限制，其查询扩展行为依赖人工设计的提示词，且每换一个新模型都需重新设计提示，成本高、可扩展性差。作者希望用多模型集成克服单一模型局限，同时让提示优化自动化以摆脱手工调参。
AI.method: MERGE分两阶段：阶段一由三个异构的7-8B开源LLM各自独立生成候选扩展；阶段二由更大的LLM以生成方式将他们合成为单一查询。两阶段均嵌入任务驱动的自动提示优化（APO）循环，与用LLM评判候选的方法不同，该循环以下游检索性能对候选打分，并在当前冠军提示与优化器新提案间进行小型锦标赛，冠军连续两轮存活即终止；另有历史增强变体将近期锦标赛轨迹反馈给优化器。MERGE与检索器无关，只执行一次BM25检索，不做秩融合、不做有监督文档扩展、不做重索引。
AI.result: 在五个BEIR基准（NQ、SciFact、FiQA、Touche-2020、DBPedia）上，MERGE相对原始查询将BM25的nDCG@10提升+2.1至+14.9个点，且仅使用紧凑开源模型即可匹配或超过强LLM查询扩展基线。消融实验证实阶段二集成优于任一阶段一单模型，任务驱动的APO能将较大的种子提示回退转化为稳定增益，无需手工调优。
AI.conclusion: 多LLM集成结合以检索性能为信号的自动提示优化，可在不重索引、不做秩融合、仅一次BM25检索的低成本条件下有效弥合查询与语料的词汇鸿沟，是一种检索器无关、可扩展的查询扩展方案。

title: Towards Semi-Automatically Comparing Keyword-Based and Semantic Search Accuracy
summary: The increasing importance of Information Retrieval (IR) in managing large datasets has highlighted significant limitations in traditional keyword-based search systems. Context-aware chat-based search methods, such as Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), have recently emerged, but their evaluation compared to keyword-based systems often relies on subjective user feedback. A rigorous, quantitative comparison between these paradigms remains lacking. This work introduces a novel, preliminary framework to quantitatively assess IR accuracy of search systems that produce different output formats, such as lists and messages. It focuses on two key aspects: the ranking accuracy for keyword-based systems and the completeness of retrieved information for semantic chat-based systems. Our approach enables semi-automatic comparisons of semantic and keyword-based methods using interchangeable equivalence classes tailored to domain-specific contexts (e.g., companies or problems). We validate the framework through an industrial case study, demonstrating statistically significant improvements in context-aware search over keyword-based methods, supported by analyses including the Mann-Whitney U-Test. With its adaptable design, the proposed framework provides a strong foundation for objectively assessing keyword-based and semantic chat-based search methods.

AI.tldr: 提出一种可半自动量化比较关键词检索与语义对话式检索（如RAG）准确性的初步框架，并在工业案例中验证上下文感知检索显著优于关键词方法。
AI.motivation: 信息检索在管理大规模数据集中愈发重要，传统关键词检索存在明显局限；RAG等上下文感知对话式检索虽已出现，但其与关键词系统的对比评估多依赖主观用户反馈，缺乏严格的定量比较。
AI.method: 构建一个可评估不同输出格式（列表、消息）检索系统IR准确性的定量框架，聚焦关键词系统的排序准确性与语义对话系统的信息完整性；通过面向领域语境（如企业或问题）的可互换等价类，实现语义方法与关键词方法的半自动比较；以工业案例研究进行验证，并采用Mann-Whitney U检验等统计分析。
AI.result: 工业案例研究表明，上下文感知检索相较关键词方法取得统计显著提升，并获得Mann-Whitney U检验等分析的支撑。
AI.conclusion: 该框架设计具备良好适应性，为客观评估关键词检索与语义对话式检索方法提供了坚实基础。

title: Generated Query Expansion Still Helps Strong Sparse Retrieval: A Controlled Study with SPLADE-v3
summary: Scientific queries are often brief, while relevant papers use specialized vocabulary. Generated query expansion can bridge this mismatch, but earlier work suggests that its value shrinks as the underlying retriever becomes stronger. We test the four generated formats of term lists, a pseudo-document, multiple pseudo-references, and corpus-steered text all together with SPLADE-v3 on NFCorpus, TREC-COVID, and SciDocs. Every condition searches the same frozen document index and follows the same query-side integration rule and 256-dimension budget, isolating the effect of the added content. All twelve method-collection comparisons improve aggregate nDCG@10, with best relative gains of 4.81%, 8.92%, and 9.47%. Eleven remain significant after Holm correction. The gain persists in 103 of 114 interpolation settings, including every setting that assigns at least 30% of the mixture weight to the original query. Shuffled-text and non-contextual lexical-bag controls also remain above baseline in all 24 aggregate comparisons, showing that the added vocabulary carries most of the benefit. A corpus-induced typed concept graph, by contrast, produces no consistent gain, and its relation, depth, validation, random, and gating controls do not rescue it. Generated vocabulary can therefore complement a strong learned sparse retriever, provided that the original query remains strongly represented.

AI.tldr: 本文检验四种生成式查询扩展格式与强学习稀疏检索器SPLADE-v3结合的效果，发现只要原查询保留足够权重，生成词汇可持续提升检索性能。
AI.motivation: 科学查询通常简短，而相关论文使用专业词汇，二者存在词汇鸿沟。已有研究认为，随着检索器变强，生成式查询扩展的增益会缩小。作者希望验证在强学习稀疏检索器上，生成式扩展是否仍有价值，并厘清增益来源。
AI.method: 在NFCorpus、TREC-COVID和SciDocs三个数据集上，将四种生成格式（词项列表、伪文档、多条伪参考文献、语料引导文本）与SPLADE-v3结合。所有条件共享同一冻结文档索引、同一查询侧集成规则和256维预算，仅改变新增内容；采用Holm校正做显著性检验，并设置插值权重、乱序文本、非上下文词袋、语料诱导类型概念图等多组对照。
AI.result: 12组方法-数据集比较的聚合nDCG@10全部提升，最佳相对增益分别为4.81%、8.92%和9.47%，其中11组经Holm校正后仍显著。在114种插值设置中有103种保持增益，且所有给原查询分配至少30%混合权重的设置均有效。乱序文本与非上下文词袋对照在全部24组聚合比较中仍高于基线，表明增益主要来自新增词汇。语料诱导类型概念图无一致增益，其关系、深度、验证、随机与门控对照均未能挽救。
AI.conclusion: 生成词汇能够补充强学习稀疏检索器，但前提是原查询在混合查询中保持强表示；增益主要来自生成内容带来的额外词汇，而非结构化概念图。

title: Effective Dense Retrieval using Only In-Context Examples
summary: Turning decoder-only large language models (LLMs) into strong dense retrievers typically requires some form of retriever training. In this paper, we ask whether LLMs can instead be prompted to produce effective representations for dense retrieval given only a few in-context examples. To answer this, we introduce RICE (Representations from In-Context Examples), a simple "training-free" approach that extracts high-quality dense representations from LLMs. To do so, RICE conditions the LLM on examples that provide a shared context for query and document encoding. Our results demonstrate that RICE embeddings can substantially improve the accuracy of prompt-based LLM embeddings, establishing it as a simple method to build LLM-based dense retrievers that do not require training. We release our code at https://github.com/nourj98/RICE.

AI.tldr: 提出 RICE 方法，通过少量上下文示例提示 LLM 直接生成高质量稠密检索表示，无需任何训练即可显著提升基于提示的 LLM 嵌入效果。
AI.motivation: 将仅解码器 LLM 转为强稠密检索器通常需要某种形式的检索器训练。本文探究是否仅用少量上下文示例进行提示，就能让 LLM 生成有效的稠密检索表示，从而免去训练成本。
AI.method: 提出 RICE（Representations from In-Context Examples），一种简单的"免训练"方法：通过为查询编码和文档编码提供共享上下文的示例来条件化 LLM，从而从 LLM 中提取高质量稠密表示。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，RICE 嵌入能大幅提升基于提示的 LLM 嵌入的准确率。
AI.conclusion: RICE 是一种构建基于 LLM 的稠密检索器的简单方法，无需训练即可获得有效检索表示。代码已开源。

title: Mnemon: Raw Records, Fast Judgments, Slow Thoughts
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Code, prompts and run records: https://github.com/Grivn/mnemon-memory-agent
summary:
Long-term memory lets an LLM assistant use a history it can no longer reread, and most memory systems build it by rewriting conversations into facts, graphs or typed memories at write time. We argue that the work of memory divides, as thinking does, into two systems. Most of it is fast System 1 work: many small, independent yes/no judgments about records, such as whether a record is needed or no longer current, which a decision model makes by the dozen in a third of a second. Only a little is slow System 2 work: writing a few search queries, naming what the reply needs and composing the answer, which an LLM does well but slowly. We present Mnemon, a memory agent built on this division. It keeps conversations as raw, dated records; an LLM (System 2) plans searches over them, a decision model, Jev (System 1), judges what the searches return, and rules with explicit budgets turn the judgments into a small View for an unchanged answering model. A background pass consolidates each record once into topic timelines, value histories and standing instructions linked to the records, so that questions about a whole conversation reach evidence their own searches miss. Because nothing is decided about a record when it is written, the same agent can read any store that returns dated records.
  With gpt-4.1-mini answering, as in a public re-evaluation of 14 systems, Mnemon scores 91.7% on LoCoMo, the highest among them, and 83.8% on LongMemEval-S, from under 4k tokens of context per question, with the lowest effective cost index on LoCoMo. With a reasoning model answering, it reaches 92.2% on LoCoMo and 94.4% on LongMemEval-S, the latter on par with the best published results. From 100K to 10M tokens of history on BEAM, its cost per question grows by a factor of 1.11. On the same records, Jev separates gold evidence better than two LLMs and is 3-11 times faster.

AI.tldr: Mnemon 将记忆工作按"双系统"分工：System 1 用决策模型 Jev 做大量快速的是/否判断，System 2 用 LLM 做少量慢速的搜索规划与答案组织，从而在保持原始对话记录的前提下实现高效长时记忆。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆系统在写入时就把对话改写为事实、图或类型化记忆，这种"写入即决策"的方式固化了对记录的处理，限制了灵活性。作者认为记忆工作与思维一样可分为快、慢两个系统：大部分是快速的独立判断，只有少数是慢速的规划与写作。
AI.method: Mnemon 保留原始带日期记录。LLM（System 2）规划搜索；决策模型 Jev（System 1）以每秒数十次的速度对检索结果做是/否判断；规则与显式预算把判断汇总成一个小的 View 交给不变的答题模型。后台流程把每条记录一次性整合为主题时间线、取值历史与常驻指令，并链接回原记录。由于写入时不做任何决策，同一 agent 可读取任何返回带日期记录的存储。
AI.result: 在 gpt-4.1-mini 答题、公开复评 14 个系统的设置下，Mnemon 在 LoCoMo 得 91.7%（最高），LongMemEval-S 得 83.8%，每题上下文不足 4k token，LoCoMo 上有效成本指数最低。换用推理模型答题时，LoCoMo 达 92.2%，LongMemEval-S 达 94.4%（与最佳已发表结果持平）。在 BEAM 上历史从 100K 增至 10M token，每题成本仅增长 1.11 倍。同样记录下，Jev 区分金标证据的能力优于两个 LLM，且快 3-11 倍。
AI.conclusion: 将记忆工作拆分为快速 System 1 判断与慢速 System 2 规划，并以原始记录为唯一存储、写入时不做决策，可在极低上下文与成本下取得领先性能，同时保持对不同存储格式的通用性；专用决策模型在速度与证据区分上均优于通用 LLM。

title: GeoOutageBench: Benchmarking Ambiguity-aware, Ontology-grounded Geospatiotemporal KGQA for Multimodal Power Outage and Resilience Analysis
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables. Accepted to the 34th ACM International Conference on Advances in Geographic Information Systems (SIGSPATIAL '26), November 3-6, 2026, Riverside, CA, USA
summary: We introduce GeoOutageBench, a benchmark for assessing LLM-based geospatiotemporal KGQA for multimodal outage and resilience analysis. Unlike existing KGQA benchmarks for Web knowledge, GeoOutageBench considers a spatiotemporal KG that integrates visual, textual, and structured data from outage records, remote sensing, weather observations, storm and power events, geographic entities, and domain ontologies. It provides a competency query taxonomy at different difficulty levels from spatiotemporal containment and proximity, spatiotemporal co-occurrence analysis, multimodal evidence, to hypothetical evaluation. Over multimodal KG and query classes, GeoOutageBench provides user-configurable evaluation of three important, highly coherent yet less studied tasks: (1) LLMs' understanding for ambiguous geospatiotemporal questions in terms of NL to SPARQL interpretation, (2) query-driven assessment of ontology utility, and (3) answer accuracy of multimodal KGQA retrieval. GeoOutageBench provides a design principle and foundation for assessing LLM-KG systems that support real-world infrastructure resilience analysis. Our benchmark, source code, data, results, and other documentation are available at https://github.com/UCF-SAGE/GeoOutageBench.

AI.tldr: 提出 GeoOutageBench，一个面向多模态停运与韧性分析的 LLM 地理时空 KGQA 基准，覆盖多难度查询分类并提供三类可配置评测任务。
AI.motivation: 现有 KGQA 基准主要针对 Web 知识，缺乏面向地理时空场景、融合多模态数据并服务现实基础设施韧性分析的评价基础。
AI.method: 构建整合视觉、文本与结构化数据的时空知识图谱（含停运记录、遥感、气象观测、风暴与电力事件、地理实体及领域本体），设计多难度 competency query taxonomy，从时空包含与邻近、时空共现分析、多模态证据到假设性评估；提供用户可配置的三项评测任务：NL 到 SPARQL 歧义理解、查询驱动的本体效用评估、多模态 KGQA 检索答案准确率。
AI.result: 给出覆盖多模态 KG 与多类查询的基准，可实现三项任务的可配置评测，并公开基准、源码、数据与结果（https://github.com/UCF-SAGE/GeoOutageBench）。
AI.conclusion: GeoOutageBench 为评估支持现实基础设施韧性分析的 LLM-KG 系统提供了设计原则与基础。

title: ThuRunel: Dynamic Decoupling for Structured Advisory Dialogue
summary: High-stakes advisory domains such as medical aesthetics, legal consultation, and educational planning exhibit a two-phase structure. The early phase requires empathetic elicitation and emotional support, and the late phase requires authoritative specialist judgment. Neither fully automated agents nor human junior consultants adequately address this structure at scale. We formalize the core design challenge as dynamic decoupling, asking how an AI advisory agent should decide what to ask, when to stop, what to resolve autonomously, and what to forward to the specialist. We present ThuRunel, an advisory agent combining a finite-state belief management framework, a chain-of-thought teacher synthesis protocol, and learned generation adapters. Against eleven baselines, ThuRunel achieves consistent improvements in elicitation completeness and specialist brief quality. ThuRunel is publicly deployed as a bilingual web application in which the same decoupling decisions operate from the client's side, grounded in a curated knowledge base that cites its sources in every answer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出高利害咨询场景的"两阶段结构"与"动态解耦"设计问题，并给出咨询智能体 ThuRunel，通过有限状态信念管理、思维链教师合成协议与学习式生成适配器实现，在多项指标上优于11个基线，并已作为中英双语Web应用上线。
AI.motivation: 医疗美容、法律咨询、教育规划等咨询场景具有先共情引导、后专家判断的两阶段结构；全自动智能体与人类初级顾问均难以规模化满足该结构需求，核心难题在于如何决定问什么、何时停止、哪些自主解决、哪些转交专家。
AI.method: 将核心设计挑战形式化为动态解耦；提出 ThuRunel，组合三部分：有限状态信念管理框架、思维链教师合成协议、学习式生成适配器。
AI.result: 在11个基线对比中，ThuRunel 在引导完整性（elicitation completeness）与专家简报质量（specialist brief quality）上取得一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: ThuRunel 已公开部署为中英双语Web应用，同一套解耦决策也可从客户侧运行，并基于精选知识库在每次回答中标注引用来源。

title: Better Nearest Neighbor Graph Indices via (Efficient) LLM-Guided Pruning
summary: Graph-based approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS) is widely used for large-scale semantic search. Its indices are constructed primarily based on geometric relationships among embeddings of an input dataset (e.g., documents or images), rather than explicitly optimizing for semantic relevance. However, when using these indices for downstream query retrieval, performance is evaluated based on the semantic relevance of the retrieved results to the query. This creates a fundamental "geometry-semantic" mismatch between how the indices are constructed and how their retrieval results are evaluated. While existing LLM-based reranking methods can partially mitigate this mismatch at query time, they leave this underlying structural problem in the graph unresolved. We therefore propose LLM-Guided Graph Pruning (LGP), a general framework that addresses this mismatch directly by leveraging LLM reasoning to refine an existing ANN graph index itself. LGP identifies structurally "low-value" neighbors of nodes and replaces them with LLM-selected alternatives that provide useful semantic information while retaining desired geometric structures of the original graph, including sparsity and efficient navigability. Experiments on representative semantic retrieval benchmarks show that LGP consistently improves end-to-end retrieval performance over both vanilla greedy graph search and LLM-based reranking across widely used graph-based ANN indices such as DiskANN and HNSW.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LLM-Guided Graph Pruning (LGP)框架，利用LLM推理直接优化ANN图索引结构，通过替换结构上"低价值"的邻居节点来缓解图索引构建（几何关系）与检索评估（语义相关性）之间的"几何-语义"不匹配问题。
AI.motivation: 基于图的近似最近邻搜索（ANNS）索引主要依据嵌入向量间的几何关系构建，而非显式优化语义相关性；但下游检索性能却以语义相关性评估，导致索引构建方式与评估方式之间存在根本性的"几何-语义"不匹配。现有基于LLM的重排序方法只能在查询时部分缓解该问题，无法解决图结构中固有的结构性缺陷。
AI.method: LGP是一个通用框架，直接利用LLM推理精炼已有的ANN图索引：识别节点在结构上"低价值"的邻居，并用LLM选择的替代邻居进行替换；这些替代邻居既提供有用的语义信息，又保留原图所需的几何结构特性（如稀疏性和高效可导航性）。
AI.result: 在代表性语义检索基准上，LGP在DiskANN、HNSW等广泛使用的图ANN索引上，端到端检索性能一致优于原始贪心图搜索以及基于LLM的重排序方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将LLM推理引入图索引本身的构建/精炼过程，LGP有效弥合了几何与语义之间的鸿沟，为提升图ANN检索的端到端语义检索性能提供了一种通用且有效的方案。

title: ARCagent: An Adaptive Retrieval Calibration Agent for Clinical Question Answering
summary: In diseases where clinical guidelines are incomplete, contested, or mutually contradictory, knowledge completeness and dynamic conflict-aware synthesis are two safety-critical properties that standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems do not provide. Therefore, we present \sysname, an adaptive retrieval calibration clinical question-answering agent for ME/CFS, a disease where diagnostic frameworks coexist and major guidelines actively contradict each other on treatment. ARCagent contributes three components. First, a 1,706-chunk, 10-source knowledge base with a structured inter-guideline conflict registry spanning all active ME/CFS diagnostic frameworks. Second, a conflict-aware retrieval calibration pipeline that re-ranks retrieved evidence using query-specific focus and conflict signals. Third, a benchmark scored by LLM-as-Judge, avoiding systematic underestimation averaging 10.1 percentage points caused by keyword matching. ARCagent achieves 95.3%, outperforming all base LLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/Yukyin/ARCagent.

AI.tldr: 针对临床指南不完整或相互矛盾的疾病，提出ARCagent——面向ME/CFS的自适应检索校准临床问答智能体，通过冲突感知的检索校准与LLM-as-Judge评测，达到95.3%的准确率，优于所有基座大模型。
AI.motivation: 标准检索增强生成（RAG）系统无法在指南不完整、存在争议或彼此冲突的临床场景中同时保证知识完整性与动态的冲突感知综合能力，而这些是安全攸关的属性。ME/CFS正是此类疾病：多种诊断框架并存，主要指南在治疗上互相矛盾。
AI.method: 提出ARCagent，包含三个组件：(1) 由1,706个文本块、10个来源构成的知识库，并配有覆盖全部现役ME/CFS诊断框架的结构化跨指南冲突注册表；(2) 冲突感知的检索校准流水线，利用查询特定的关注点与冲突信号对检索到的证据进行重排序；(3) 采用LLM-as-Judge打分的基准测试，以避免关键词匹配导致的系统性低估。
AI.result: 关键词匹配方式会造成平均10.1个百分点的系统性低估；ARCagent在评测中取得95.3%的得分，优于所有基座大模型。
AI.conclusion: ARCagent表明，在指南相互矛盾的临床领域，将冲突注册表与检索校准相结合可显著提升问答可靠性，为冲突感知的临床RAG提供了可行范式。

title: Retrieval Sensitivity to Identity Signals in Queries
comment: EMNLP 2026 camera-ready, with a correction to Fig. 4
summary: Dense retrievers decide which documents reach users and the language models that use them, yet they are typically evaluated with neutral queries. We ask whether the identity signals that real users express in their queries---political ideology and dialect---bias what a retriever returns. We design evaluations in two domains, political news and consumer-health questions, each pairing a controlled synthetic set that varies only the identity signal with naturalistic queries. Across five dense retrievers and a sparse baseline, every retriever (i) retrieves articles that align with the query's own political lean and (ii) performs worse for questions written in African American Language (AAL) than in White Mainstream English (WME). Two analyses tie these gaps to queries' identity signals beyond surface vocabulary: partialling out an aggregate lexical-asymmetry score leaves the synthetic gaps largely intact, and linear probes recover lean and dialect from the retrievers' query embeddings beyond token-level features. Left unaddressed, such retrieval biases risk contributing to polarization and reinforcing the health disparities already faced by AAL speakers. Code is available at https://github.com/Andrewtcr/bias-ret.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验真实用户查询中的身份信号（政治倾向与方言）是否会系统性偏置稠密检索器的返回结果，发现所有检索器都会优先返回与查询政治倾向一致的文档，且对非裔美国人英语（AAL）查询的检索性能低于白人主流英语（WME）。
AI.motivation: 稠密检索器决定了用户能接触到哪些文档，也影响下游语言模型，但现有评测通常只使用中性查询，忽视了真实用户查询中携带的身份信号。作者由此提出：查询中表达的政治意识形态与方言是否会偏置检索结果，若存在则可能加剧极化并强化AAL使用者的健康信息不平等。
AI.method: 在两个领域（政治新闻与消费者健康问题）设计评测，各自包含一个仅改变身份信号的受控合成查询集与一组自然主义查询；对比五种稠密检索器与一个稀疏基线。另做两项分析：控制词层面词汇不对称聚合分数后检验差距是否残留，并用线性探针从查询嵌入中解码政治倾向与方言，验证身份信号是否超越表层词汇特征被编码。
AI.result: 所有稠密检索器（i）倾向于检索与查询自身政治倾向一致的新闻文章；（ii）对用AAL撰写的查询检索性能低于WME。部分剔除词汇不对称分数后，合成查询上的差距基本保持不变；线性探针能从查询嵌入中恢复政治倾向与方言信息，且不依赖词元级特征。
AI.conclusion: 检索偏置并非仅由表层词汇差异造成，而是被编码在查询嵌入中；若不加以干预，此类偏置可能助长政治极化，并加剧AAL使用者已面临的健康信息获取不平等。代码已公开。

title: Follow the Entities: A Corpus Map for Agentic Search
summary: Answering questions and completing tasks over large document collections often requires connecting evidence spread across multiple documents, such as a project's approval recorded in one, its requirements in another, and its latest status in a third. Recent LLM agents approach this by iteratively searching the full corpus rather than reading only a fixed set of top-ranked documents. However, when the corpus is exposed only as a flat collection of files, a relevant document gives no indication of how it relates to others, so the agent must rediscover these relationships for every query, often missing complementary evidence while simultaneously consuming substantial additional tokens. To address this, we introduce CorpusMap, a navigation layer that organizes the corpus around its recurring entities, which are identifiable from the documents themselves and can link a single document to many others across sources. Specifically, CorpusMap represents each recurring entity as an Entity Page that aggregates information about it and links to every document that refers to it, forming a graph between entities and documents that the agent can traverse to gather otherwise disconnected evidence. Moreover, since CorpusMap is constructed offline by resolving mentions of the same entity across documents, its links are shared across queries rather than rediscovered repeatedly at inference time. Using 7 different models with 3 benchmark datasets, we show that CorpusMap improves both evidence discovery and answer quality over raw-corpus agentic search while using fewer tokens on average, and further outperforms 4 alternative navigation layers, suggesting that entities serve as effective anchors for navigating large document collections.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CorpusMap，一种以重复出现的实体为锚点组织语料库的导航层，通过离线构建实体页与文档间的图结构，使 LLM agent 能跨文档遍历证据，在提升证据发现与答案质量的同时平均消耗更少 token。
AI.motivation: 大规模文档集合上的问答与任务完成需要连接分散在多个文档中的证据（如项目审批、需求、最新状态分别位于不同文件）。现有 LLM agent 采用迭代式全语料检索，但当语料仅以扁平文件集合呈现时，相关文档不提供与其他文档的关系信息，agent 必须为每个查询重新发现这些关系，既易遗漏互补证据，又消耗大量额外 token。
AI.method: 提出 CorpusMap 导航层，围绕语料库中可识别的重复实体组织文档。将每个重复实体表示为一个 Entity Page，聚合该实体的信息并链接到所有引用它的文档，从而在实体与文档之间形成可遍历的图，使 agent 能汇聚原本割裂的证据。CorpusMap 通过离线跨文档实体提及消解构建，其链接在查询间共享，而非在推理时反复重新发现。
AI.result: 在 3 个基准数据集、7 个不同模型上评估，CorpusMap 相比原始语料库的 agentic search 在证据发现与答案质量上均有提升，且平均使用更少 token；同时优于 4 种替代导航层。
AI.conclusion: 实体可作为导航大规模文档集合的有效锚点。

title: ReMem: Rethinking Perception and Memory in Long-Context Recommendation Agents
summary: Recent Recommendation Agents (RecAgents) offer a promising alternative by shifting recommendation to an active, user-side paradigm, where generative agents autonomously perceive external platforms, reason over user preferences, and execute decisions. However, existing RecAgents still suffer from two critical limitations: brittle item perception based on noisy and heterogeneous item pages, and inefficient long-context reasoning over extended user histories and multi-step interaction traces. To address these challenges, we propose a novel recommendation agent framework, termed as ReMem, that combines OCR-based multimodal perception with time-evolving dynamic memory. Instead of parsing raw HTML, ReMem observes item pages through screenshots and extracts structured multimodal information via an OCR tool, enabling a more humanoid and platform-agnostic perception mechanism. To support long-horizon preference modeling, ReMem further introduces a chunk-wise sequential memory update strategy, where the agent selectively maintains a fixed-size memory of informative historical interactions while processing arbitrarily long contexts with linear inference complexity and bounded context length. This design allows the agent to preserve evolving user preferences without relying on external memory modules or disrupting the standard autoregressive generation process. To enhance the dynamic memory instruction, we further develop a multi-memory GRPO variant, which propagates the final-answer advantage to all intermediate conversations that contribute to the final response. Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate that ReMem consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an average improvement of 5.16\% across three recommendation agent tasks, namely searching, ranking, and judging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ReMem，一种结合 OCR 多模态感知与时间演化动态记忆的推荐智能体框架，通过分块顺序记忆更新与多记忆 GRPO 强化学习，实现平台无关的感知与线性复杂度的长上下文建模，在搜索、排序、评判三类任务上平均提升 5.16%。
AI.motivation: 现有推荐智能体（RecAgents）将推荐从平台侧转向用户侧主动范式，但存在两大瓶颈：一是依赖含噪、异构页面导致的物品感知脆弱；二是对超长用户历史与多步交互轨迹的长上下文推理效率低下。论文旨在同时解决感知鲁棒性与长程推理效率问题。
AI.method: 提出 ReMem 框架，包含三点核心设计：(1) 感知层以截图替代原始 HTML 解析，借助 OCR 工具抽取结构化多模态信息，实现类人、平台无关的物品感知；(2) 记忆层采用分块顺序记忆更新策略，选择性维护固定规模的高信息量历史交互记忆，从而支持任意长上下文且推理复杂度线性、上下文长度有界，无需外部记忆模块，也不破坏标准自回归生成；(3) 训练层提出多记忆 GRPO 变体，将最终答案优势传播到所有对最终响应有贡献的中间对话轮次，以优化动态记忆指令。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上的大量实验表明，ReMem 持续优于现有最先进基线，在搜索（searching）、排序（ranking）、评判（judging）三项推荐智能体任务上取得平均 5.16% 的提升。
AI.conclusion: ReMem 通过 OCR 多模态感知与时间演化动态记忆的协同设计，有效缓解了页面噪声感知与长上下文推理两大限制，为构建高效、平台无关的用户侧推荐智能体提供了可行方案。

title: Relevance Is Not Sufficient Evidence: Detecting Evidence Gaps Before Generation in RAG
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds large language models in external sources, but retrieved passages often name the right entities without providing the facts needed to answer. Even when instructed to abstain, 12 generators answer 40.0-99.3% of insufficient-evidence questions. Training generators to abstain ties the decision to model weights, may reward answers recalled from parametric knowledge, and still requires a full generator call. Can sufficiency be judged from the question and evidence alone, before any answer exists? We identify pitfalls in constructing insufficient-evidence tests: removing relevant evidence or pairing evidence with unrelated questions can reveal labels through lexical overlap or evidence position. We build a paired benchmark using substitution, deletion, and question-swap constructions that vary answer support while controlling selected surface features, such as word use. Sufficiency can be judged without generating an answer, but no single signal works across all datasets. We introduce RINSE (Relevance Is Not Sufficient Evidence), which combines three signals: whether every part of the question is covered, whether any passage offers an answer, and whether a small language model reading the passages together judges them sufficient. Across six datasets, RINSE ranks sufficient above insufficient evidence with a score of 0.837 (chance 0.5), exceeding the best of 10 prior methods (0.746) and a frontier model queried through an API (0.784). Its weakest dataset scores higher than any other method's weakest (0.684 vs. 0.676). RINSE runs locally before generation, taking 36.5 ms per question on a single GPU.

AI.tldr: 提出RINSE方法，在生成答案前判断检索证据是否充分，无需调用完整生成器，在六个数据集上以0.837的排序分数优于10种现有方法和前沿模型API。
AI.motivation: 检索增强生成中，检索到的段落常提及正确实体但不提供回答问题所需的事实。即使要求弃答，12个生成器仍对40.0-99.3%的证据不足问题给出答案。训练生成器弃答会将决策绑定在模型权重上、可能奖励来自参数化知识的答案，且仍需完整生成器调用。因此希望探究：能否仅凭问题和证据、在答案生成之前判断证据充分性。
AI.method: 首先揭示构建证据不足测试的陷阱：移除相关证据或将证据与无关问题配对，会通过词汇重叠或证据位置泄露标签。据此构建配对基准，采用替换、删除和问题交换三种构造方式，在控制词使用等表层特征的同时改变答案支持度。提出RINSE（Relevance Is Not Sufficient Evidence），融合三个信号：问题各部分是否被覆盖、是否有段落提供答案、以及小语言模型共读段落后判断是否充分。
AI.result: 在六个数据集上，RINSE将充分证据排在不足证据之上的得分为0.837（随机为0.5），超过10种先前方法中的最佳者（0.746）以及通过API查询的前沿模型（0.784）。其最弱数据集得分（0.684）高于任何其他方法的最弱得分（0.676）。RINSE在单GPU上于生成前本地运行，每题耗时36.5 ms。
AI.conclusion: 证据充分性可在生成答案之前判断，但不存在跨所有数据集通用的单一信号，多信号组合的RINSE能有效且高效地完成该判断，为RAG提供生成前的本地充分性过滤。

title: BITEM at the NTCIR-19 R2C2 Task: Predicting Confidence from Agentic RAG Pipeline Signals
comment: 8 pages. Participant paper for the NTCIR-19 R2C2 task
summary: The BITEM team entered both subtasks of the NTCIR-19 R2C2 task with a single agentic pipeline, in which a model searches, reads and records evidence over a movie corpus while an orchestrator holds the record and rules on what may be submitted. A claim is admitted only once an entailment cascade has checked it against the passage it cites, and an answer is released only once enough checked evidence stands behind it. Each question is run three or four times, every pass retrieving from a corpus stripped of what the earlier passes have already seen. The confidence filed with each answer is computed by the orchestrator from what the run leaves behind and is never asked of the model, which is offered no way to rate itself. The two retrieval runs placed 4th and 5th of 22, pooling the passes was worth 0.0709 nDCG@20, and the gain was largest on the multi-hop and post-processing-heavy questions, where the organisers rank the pooled run top of the field. Sixteen of the 25 answer runs were built on passages these two runs supplied, 12 of them filed by other teams. HMR rewards a system whose confidence is high where it answers right and low where it answers wrong. The pipeline reached an accuracy of 0.9219, 6th of 25, while the confidence filed with those answers gave an HMR of 0.4915, 13th. A few rules crafted over those same recorded signals, with no further model call and no further retrieval, raise that to an accuracy of 0.9375, 5th, and an HMR of 0.6985, 9th. Ranking on HMR alone can reward a system for answering wrongly with low confidence, so we propose accHMR, the accuracy multiplied by HMR, which reports the reward in proportion to the accuracy, and on which the revised rules would have scored 0.6549, 5th. For future work, fitting a model on the numbers the pipeline already produces, rather than writing such rules by hand, would be a real step forward.

AI.tldr: BITEM团队以单一智能体流水线参加NTCIR-19 R2C2两个子任务：检索运行列22队中第4、5名，池化多轮提升0.0709 nDCG@20；答案运行准确率0.9219（第6/25），HMR 0.4915（第13），经规则修订提升至0.9375与0.6985，并提出accHMR=准确率×HMR。
AI.motivation: R2C2任务要求系统同时具备高质量检索与可靠的答案置信度估计，而HMR单独排序可能奖励"低置信度答错"的系统，因此需要一个兼顾准确率与置信度校准的联合指标，并探索无需额外模型调用即可改进置信度的手段。
AI.method: 采用单一智能体流水线：模型在电影语料上搜索、阅读并记录证据，orchestrator持有证据记录并裁定可提交内容；答案需先通过蕴含级联（entailment cascade）对照其引用段落核验方可准入，且须有足量已核验证据支撑才释放；每题运行3–4次，每轮从剔除前轮已见内容的语料中检索；置信度由orchestrator基于运行留下的记录计算，模型不参与自评。此外，在既有记录信号上手工编写若干规则（不额外调用模型与检索），并定义accHMR=准确率×HMR。
AI.result: 检索两次运行位列22队中第4、5名，池化各轮带来0.0709 nDCG@20增益，在多跳及后处理密集问题上增益最大，该问题上组织方将池化运行列为全场第一；25个答案运行中16个建立在上述两次运行的段落之上，其中12个由其他团队提交。HMR指标方面，流水线准确率0.9219（第6/25），其提交置信度对应HMR 0.4915（第13）；加入基于记录信号的手工规则后提升至准确率0.9375（第5）、HMR 0.6985（第9）；修订规则在accHMR上为0.6549（第5）。
AI.conclusion: orchestrator式的证据核验与外部置信度计算能有效支撑检索与答案生成，且额外增益可来自对已记录信号的后处理规则而无需再调用模型；未来应直接对流水线已产出的数值进行模型拟合，以替代手工规则。

title: Auditable Long-Term Memory: A Deterministic Retrieval Chain Measured at 479/475 of 500 on LongMemEval-S
comment: Technical report, 14 pages. Evidence repository (reader outputs, judge verdicts, control records, judge harness): https://github.com/cjchanh/longmemeval-evidence (MIT). Re-scoring any run under the official judge costs about $1.28
summary: We evaluate an auditable long-term memory system on LongMemEval-S. Its retrieval chain uses hybrid candidate retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, coverage-first packet compilation, and deterministic reasoning scaffolds; an LLM is used only as a replaceable final reader. The chain places all gold sessions in the candidate pool for 468/470 answerable questions and produces gold-complete packets for 462/470. With a Claude Opus reader called through an unpinned CLI alias, two 500-question passes score 479/500 and 475/500 under GPT-4o. The 72 answerable knowledge-update rows used a substantively modified scoring prompt whose effect under the official text has not been measured. The pair straddles Chronos High's published 478/500; differences in reader generation, scoring prompt, and possibly data version, plus within-system variance, establish neither superiority nor equivalence. A grok-4.6-high reader on the same packets scores 476/474, while a maximum-reasoning-effort agentic variant regresses to 461/465. The headline passes differ on eight verdict-flip rows. A second judge agrees with the headline judge on 493/500 rows (98.6%) in each pass and scores both passes 472/500; the official judge also flips three verdicts when re-scoring byte-identical pass-1 answers. Negative controls rejected a verifier that repaired three wrong drafts but broke eleven correct drafts. All components were developed on the same 500 questions, with no held-out evaluation or independent human adjudication; retrieval and scaffold method sources and transcript-derived audits are held; and the headline reader received extra operator context, its complete requests were not retained, and MCP tool availability is unresolved. We release materialized packets, scaffolds, reader outputs, judge verdicts, and controls for inspection and re-scoring.

AI.tldr: 评估了一个可审计的长时记忆系统在LongMemEval-S上的表现：检索链几乎完备（468/470入池、462/470成包），但配对实验得分与Chronos High的478/500交叉，因阅读器版本、评分提示、可能的数据版本及系统内方差，既不能证明更优也不能证明等效；同时缺乏留出集与独立人工裁决。
AI.motivation: 作者希望以可审计的方式评估一个长时记忆系统的检索与阅读链路，并将结果与已发布的Chronos High基线进行对照，同时明确披露可能影响可比性的实验设置差异与评估局限。
AI.method: 在LongMemEval-S上评估该系统的检索链：混合候选检索、交叉编码器重排序、覆盖率优先的包编译、确定性推理脚手架；LLM仅作为可替换的最终阅读器。使用通过未固定CLI别名调用的Claude Opus阅读器进行两次500题评测（GPT-4o评分），并用官方文本未测的新评分提示处理72条知识更新行；另用grok-4.6-high阅读器及最大推理努力度的智能体变体作对照；进行第二评审一致性检验、官方评审重复评分、负对照（验证器）与翻转行分析。
AI.result: 候选池覆盖468/470可答题的金标会话，金标完整包462/470；两次500题评测得479/500与475/500，与Chronos High的478/500交叉。grok-4.6-high在同一包上得476/474，最大推理努力度智能体变体降至461/465。头条两次通过仅在8条判定翻转行上不同。第二评审与头条评审一致493/500（98.6%），两轮均给472/500；官方评审对字节相同的第1轮答案重评时翻转3个判定。负对照拒绝了"修复3份错误草稿却破坏11份正确草稿"的验证器。
AI.conclusion: 结果既不支持该系统的优越性也不支持等效性：阅读器生成、评分提示、可能的数据版本差异与系统内方差构成混淆。所有组件均在相同500题上开发，无留出评估与独立人工裁决，方法与转写审计未公开，头条阅读器获得额外操作者上下文、完整请求未留存、MCP工具可用性未定。作者公开物化包、脚手架、阅读器输出、评审判定与对照以供检视与重评分。

title: Toward Generative Video Communication: A Dual-Stream Digital Transmission Framework
comment: This paper has been accepted by the IEEE Wireless Communications Magazine
summary: Generative video communication has shown promise for bandwidth-constrained wireless transmission and has the potential to support personalized content delivery. In this article, we propose a dual-stream digital generative video communication (DGVC) framework that integrates a traditional digital link with a generative link. The traditional link provides source-grounded visual references, while the generative link conveys compact semantic and perceptual information for receiver-side generation. We further discuss three bandwidth-dependent operating regimes and key technologies for dual-stream coordination, synchronization, reliability, and latency control. A practical case study demonstrates the perceptual and temporal-quality benefits of DGVC under wireless fading channels. Finally, we discuss open challenges and future research directions for generative video communication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双流数字生成视频通信（DGVC）框架，将传统数字链路与生成链路结合，实现带宽受限无线传输下的个性化内容分发。
AI.motivation: 生成式视频通信在带宽受限的无线传输和个性化内容分发方面具有潜力，但需要兼顾"源真实视觉参考"与"紧凑语义/感知信息"的双重需求。
AI.method: 提出DGVC双流框架：传统数字链路提供源端真实视觉参考，生成链路传递紧凑的语义与感知信息供接收端生成；并讨论三种带宽相关的工作模式及双流协调、同步、可靠性与时延控制的关键技术。
AI.result: 通过实际案例研究，验证了DGVC在无线衰落信道下在感知质量和时间质量方面的优势。
AI.conclusion: DGVC框架展现出无线视频通信的性能与体验收益，并展望了生成式视频通信的开放挑战与未来研究方向。

title: Enabling Immersive Audio-Visual Experience from Any Video
summary: Most videos capture only a narrow field of view and provide no spatial audio, limiting the sense of immersion they can provide. Recent video generation models can expand perspective videos into panoramic ones, but do not provide the corresponding spatial soundscape. Without spatially consistent audio, these expanded visual worlds remain incomplete. This paper presents OmniDream, a training-free framework that transforms a silent monocular video into an immersive audiovisual experience, where viewers can freely look around while sounds remain spatially aligned with the visual scene. At the core of OmniDream is an object-centric audio representation that disentangles each sound source's intrinsic audio content from its scene-dependent acoustic effects, enabling independent audio generation, physics-based simulation of propagation effects, and flexible spatial audio rendering. Experiments show improved audio-visual alignment, spatial correctness, and perceptual immersiveness over baselines. Examples are available on https://huggingface.co/spaces/CuriousAlien000/spatial-audio-360-demo

AI.tldr: OmniDream 是一个无需训练的框架，可将静音单目视频转化为沉浸式视听体验：在拓展为全景画面的同时生成与之空间一致的空间音频，实现自由环顾且声源空间对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有视频多为窄视角且无空间音频，沉浸感受限；已有视频生成模型可将透视视频扩展为全景视频，但缺少配套的空间声场，导致扩展后的视觉世界不完整。
AI.method: 以对象为中心的音频表示为核心，将每个声源的固有音频内容与其依赖场景的声学效果解耦，从而支持独立音频生成、基于物理的传播效果模拟以及灵活的空间音频渲染；整体为无需训练（training-free）框架。
AI.result: 与基线方法相比，在音视频对齐、空间正确性和感知沉浸感方面均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦式对象中心音频表示与物理模拟，可在无训练条件下为全景视频补全空间一致声场，提升沉浸式视听体验；示例已在线公开。

title: Prediction-Layer Branch Calibration for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
summary: Multimodal sentiment analysis integrates textual, acoustic and visual cues, yet current language-model-based fusion methods typically leave prediction-layer branch allocation implicit. We introduce Branch-Calibrated Multimodal Language Fusion (BC-MLF), which explicitly models prediction-layer branch allocation through a Branch-Calibrated Task Head (BCHead), complemented by Fusion Token Contrastive Learning (FTCL) for sentiment-aware fusion-token regularization. FTCL organizes mean-pooled fusion-token representations according to continuous sentiment affinity, while BCHead combines fusion, text and audiovisual predictions through a lightweight sample-adaptive constrained mixture. Without modifying the fusion backbone, BC-MLF consistently improves the reproduced DeepMLF baseline and achieves the strongest results among the compared methods on CMU-MOSEI and CH-SIMS across classification and regression metrics. The controlled ablations show that sample-adaptive prediction-layer branch allocation consistently outperforms static branch aggregation. Code is available at https://github.com/sunyulin0421/BC-MLF.

AI.tldr: 提出BC-MLF框架，通过分支校准任务头（BCHead）显式建模预测层分支分配，并辅以融合Token对比学习（FTCL）正则化，在不改动融合主干的前提下提升多模态情感分析性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态情感分析中基于语言模型的融合方法通常将预测层的分支分配隐式处理，缺乏对融合、文本、视听等各分支预测如何组合的显式建模，导致融合潜力未被充分挖掘。
AI.method: BC-MLF包含两部分：（1）分支校准任务头（BCHead），通过轻量级、样本自适应的约束混合（constrained mixture）组合融合、文本与视听三种预测；（2）融合Token对比学习（FTCL），按连续情感亲和度组织均值池化的融合Token表示，实现情感感知的融合Token正则化。
AI.result: 在CMU-MOSEI与CH-SIMS数据集上，BC-MLF在分类与回归指标上均优于所比较方法，并稳定超过复现的DeepMLF基线。受控消融实验表明，样本自适应的预测层分支分配持续优于静态分支聚合。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模预测层分支分配是多模态语言融合的有效改进方向，BC-MLF无需修改融合主干即可带来一致增益，且样本自适应分配优于静态聚合，代码已开源。

title: Massively Parallel Reinforcement Learning with a Chaotic Reconfigurable Clockless Chip
summary: Hardware accelerators based on physical dynamical systems offer an attractive route toward energy-efficient reinforcement learning applications. However, their scalability is challenging because it requires many statistically independent entropy sources. Here, we introduce a quasi-analog decision-making architecture based on asynchronous Boolean networks (or lattices) implemented on a clockless reconfigurable chip. Each node in the network consists of a single logic element that acts as an autonomous entropy source. This architecture gives rise to distributed Boolean chaos, in which a spatially coupled network generates parallel streams of chaotic Boolean transitions with very low statistical dependence between nodes. We experimentally demonstrate parallel decision-making on a 1024-armed bandit problem, which is beyond the scale of previous hardware implementations, while significantly improving power-law scaling performance. Separately, we scale the proposed entropy source to 5120 parallel channels, yielding an aggregate sample generation rate of 2.14 TS/s. Our solution is implemented on a commercial reconfigurable CMOS chip and offers high integration density and ease of programmability. Our results pave the way for using distributed Boolean chaos as a valuable hardware substrate for large-scale reinforcement learning and for the development of fully integrated, high-throughput decision-making accelerators.

AI.tldr: 提出基于异步布尔网络（时钟无关可重构芯片）的准模拟决策架构，利用分布式布尔混沌生成大量低统计相关熵源，实验实现1024臂赌博机并行决策，并将熵源扩展至5120通道（2.14 TS/s）。
AI.motivation: 基于物理动力系统的硬件加速器有望实现高能效强化学习，但其可扩展性受限于需要大量统计独立的熵源，因此亟需一种可大规模集成且易于编程的并行熵与决策硬件方案。
AI.method: 在商用可重构CMOS芯片上，以异步布尔网络（格）构建准模拟决策架构；网络每个节点仅由单个逻辑元件充当自主熵源；通过空间耦合网络产生分布式布尔混沌，从而并行输出统计相关性极低的混沌布尔跃迁流，并支持并行决策。
AI.result: 在1024臂赌博机问题上实现并行决策，规模超越此前硬件实现，并显著改善幂律缩放性能；独立地，将熵源扩展至5120个并行通道，聚合采样生成速率达2.14 TS/s；整体方案具备高集成密度与易编程性。
AI.conclusion: 分布式布尔混沌可作为大规模强化学习与全集成高吞吐决策加速器的有效硬件基质。

title: NeuroDyn-EEG: An Interpretable Pre-trained Model for EEG Based on Neural Dynamics
comment: Yi Cui and Tong Zhao contributed equally. Corresponding authors: Ling Zhang, Yuxiang Yan, and Bo Hong
summary:
Clinical scalp electroencephalography (EEG) offers a noninvasive window into neural dynamics of neuropsychiatric disorders. However, discriminative deep models often lack anatomically indexed physiological interpretability. We propose NeuroDyn-EEG, a pretraining framework integrating generative priors from neural dynamics. It couples an extended Jansen-Rit neural mass model, leadfield-based source projection, and simulation-based parameter inversion. Trained on synthetic parameter-EEG pairs within physiological ranges, NeuroDyn-EEG estimates 11 regional parameter families across 90 AAL regions plus one global parameter from standard 19-channel EEG, using only ~2.43M trainable parameters.
  We evaluate the framework across three levels. First, controlled simulations demonstrate robust parameter recovery under diverse noise conditions, while real resting-state EEG evaluations confirm spectral and phase consistency in an inverse-forward closed loop. Second, on four clinical benchmarks (AD65, PD31, Figshare MDD, and TUAB), NeuroDyn-EEG achieves competitive classification performance, securing the highest BACC, AUROC, and AUCPR on PD31 and MDD, and highest BACC on AD65. Third, post hoc regional analyses reveal disease-specific alterations: local synaptic connectivity C_1 involves the most altered regions in AD65, whereas the firing threshold theta ranks first in MDD, offering testable mechanistic hypotheses.
  Overall, NeuroDyn-EEG maps scalp EEG to anatomically indexed dynamical parameters, bridging representation learning and mechanistic neurophysiology. Code: https://github.com/Gnosis-Neurodynamics/NeuroDyn-EEG.

AI.tldr: NeuroDyn-EEG：融合神经动力学生成先验的预训练框架，从19通道头皮EEG反演90个AAL脑区+1个全局动力学参数，仅2.43M可训练参数，在多个临床基准上取得竞争性分类性能并提供疾病特异性机制解释。
AI.motivation: 临床头皮EEG是观察神经精神障碍神经动力学的无创窗口，但具判别力的深度模型通常缺乏"解剖索引"的生理可解释性，即难以将模型表征对应到具体脑区与生理机制参数。
AI.method: 提出NeuroDyn-EEG预训练框架，整合三类生成先验：扩展Jansen-Rit神经质量模型、基于leadfield的源投影、基于仿真的参数反演。在生理范围内生成合成"参数-EEG"配对数据训练，实现从标准19通道EEG估计11类区域参数族（覆盖90个AAL脑区）及1个全局参数；模型仅约2.43M可训练参数。
AI.result: 1）受控仿真显示在多种噪声条件下参数恢复稳健，真实静息态EEG在"反演-前向"闭环中验证了频谱与相位一致性；2）在四个临床基准（AD65、PD31、Figshare MDD、TUAB）上分类性能具竞争力，在PD31与MDD上取得最高BACC、AUROC、AUCPR，在AD65上取得最高BACC；3）事后区域分析揭示疾病特异性改变：AD65中局部突触连接C_1涉及最多改变脑区，MDD中放电阈值θ排首位，提供可检验的机制假设。
AI.conclusion: NeuroDyn-EEG将头皮EEG映射到具解剖索引的动力学参数，在表示学习与机制神经生理学之间建立桥梁，兼具判别性能与生理可解释性。

title: Adaptive Rotation for iSOMA: Geometry, Benchmarking, and Noise Robustness in Variational Quantum Objectives
summary: We study whether the coordinate dependence of the improved Self-Organizing Migrating Algorithm (iSOMA) can be reduced while retaining its inexpensive leader-directed migration mechanism. We introduce iSOMA-AR, which learns a basis from successful migration displacements and selectively applies the standard perturbation mask in that basis. On the complete noiseless BBOB suite, iSOMA- AR significantly outperformed baseline iSOMA across matched conditions, with the largest gains on geometrically difficult landscapes. A targeted ablation shows that the learned orientation is beneficial on a rotated ill-conditioned landscape and that moderate changes of the gate threshold and rotation cap preserve the qualitative result. On CEC 2011 Real World Optimization Problems, iSOMA-AR outperformed iL-SHADE on most problems, although its advantage over baseline iSOMA was not statistically significant. A canonical-jSO rerun is reported as a post-hoc sensitivity check alongside the original jSO-derived comparator. On frustrated-spin variational quantum objectives, adaptive rotation improved most transverse-field conditions, while gains on the diagonal and anisotropic models were absent or selective. Under strong effective sampling noise, the SOMA variants were the most robust population-based methods in the comparison, but iSOMA-AR was not significantly better than baseline iSOMA. Repairing all-zero PRT masks greatly reduced repeated-point evaluations without changing endpoint quality significantly, making this implementation detail unlikely to explain the noise result. Overall, adaptive rotation is most useful on coordinate-sensitive deterministic problems, while the observed noise robustness appears to arise mainly from the underlying SOMA migration mechanism.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 iSOMA-AR，通过学习成功迁移位移的基方向，在该基下选择性应用标准扰动掩码，以降低 iSOMA 的坐标依赖性，同时保留低成本的“领导者导向迁移”机制。
AI.motivation: iSOMA 的性能依赖于坐标轴假设，在几何复杂或旋转病态景观上表现受限；作者希望在不显著增加计算成本（保持廉价领导者导向迁移机制）的前提下，减少其坐标依赖性，从而提升在坐标敏感问题上的适应性。
AI.method: 提出 iSOMA-AR：从成功迁移位移中学习一组基方向，并在该学习基下选择性地应用标准扰动（PRT）掩码，实现自适应旋转。实验包括：完整无噪声 BBOB 套件与基线 iSOMA 在匹配条件下的对比；针对学习方向、门限阈值与旋转上限的消融；CEC 2011 真实世界优化问题（与 iL-SHADE、原始 jSO 派生比较器及 jSO 复跑敏感性检验对比）；受挫自旋变分量子目标；强有效采样噪声下的鲁棒性测试；以及全零 PRT 掩码修复的影响分析。
AI.result: 在完整无噪声 BBOB 上，iSOMA-AR 在匹配条件下显著优于基线 iSOMA，在几何困难景观上增益最大；消融表明学习方向在旋转病态景观上有效，门限阈值与旋转上限的中等变化不改变定性结论。CEC 2011 上多数问题优于 iL-SHADE，但相对基线 iSOMA 的优势不显著。量子目标上，自适应旋转改善了多数横向场条件，而对角各向异性模型增益缺失或具选择性。强采样噪声下 SOMA 变体是最鲁棒的种群方法，但 iSOMA-AR 未显著优于基线 iSOMA；修复全零 PRT 掩码大幅减少重复点评估，且不显著改变最终解质量，说明该实现细节不太能解释噪声结果。
AI.conclusion: 自适应旋转在坐标敏感的确定性问题上最有用；而观察到的噪声鲁棒性主要源于 SOMA 迁移机制本身，而非所学基方向。整体上，iSOMA-AR 降低了坐标依赖并保持了低成本迁移优势，但收益具有问题依赖性。

title: Graph neural networks for sampling-invariant embeddings of organized signal sets
summary: Sensor networks and radars can deliver signals as organized sets, e.g. ordered signals, signals describing range cells within a grid or signals perceived as graph nodes. Within such sets, individual signals may be characterized by distinct sampling parameters. This paper investigates organized signal sets neural network encoders. In the context of this work, the purpose of such encoders is to project heterogeneously sampled signal sets into an arbitrary fixed-size vectors space. This new representation space is designed so that signal sets can be processed as vectors rid of sampling differences to allow for arbitrary topology-aware processing with no signal processing constraints. Within this representation space designed to reduce the influence of heterogeneous sampling parameters, the relevance of signal sets representations is evaluated by considering signal sets discrimination potential with a focus on waveforms separation. The encoding and embeddings discrimination experiments conducted rely exclusively on synthetic complex-valued radiofrequency signals.

AI.tldr: 本文研究面向"有组织信号集"的神经网络编码器，目标是将异构采样的信号集映射到固定维向量空间。在专门设计的表征空间中，以波形分离为切入点评估信号集表征的判别能力，实验完全基于合成复值射频信号。
AI.motivation: 传感器网络与雷达输出的信号常以有组织形式出现（有序信号、网格内距离单元信号、图节点信号），且集合内各信号可能具有不同采样参数。这种异构采样会带来处理约束，作者希望消除采样差异的影响，使信号集能像普通向量一样进行任意拓扑感知处理。
AI.method: 提出并研究"有组织信号集神经网络编码器"，将异构采样的信号集投影到任意固定大小的向量空间；该表征空间旨在降低异构采样参数的影响，从而支持无需信号处理约束的任意拓扑感知处理。评价方式为考察信号集的判别潜力，聚焦波形分离；编码与嵌入判别实验均使用合成的复值射频信号。
AI.result: 论文通过编码和嵌入判别实验，在设计的表征空间内评估了信号集表征的判别潜力，重点关注波形分离效果；所有实验均基于合成复值射频信号完成。（摘要未给出具体量化指标。）
AI.conclusion: 组织化信号集可经神经网络编码器映射为固定维向量表征，在降低异构采样参数影响后，可支持不受信号处理约束的拓扑感知处理，并在波形分离任务上体现判别能力；相关结论目前由合成射频信号实验支撑。

title: HeurEvo: Agentic Evolution of Hybrid Solver-Augmented Heuristics for Time-Critical Mathematical Optimization
summary: Recent advances in agentic heuristic design use AI agents and execution feedback to automate algorithm discovery for challenging optimization problems. In many practical settings, high-quality solutions must be obtained under strict runtime constraints, motivating hybrid approaches that combine problem-specific heuristics with powerful mathematical programming solvers. However, existing approaches typically improve heuristic components within predefined procedures or tune solver configurations in isolation. This limits holistic adaptation of where to allocate computation, how to leverage solvers, and how to refine the overall algorithmic structure. To address these limitations, we propose HeurEvo, an automated plan--code--component co-evolution framework that jointly evolves the high-level algorithmic structures, their implementations, and a shared pool of reusable components. A planner determines which algorithmic components to use, how to combine them, and how to allocate runtime across stages, a coder realizes the resulting plan as executable code, while a component evolver updates the shared component pool. Within an island-based evolutionary framework, plans and implementations co-evolve with feedback from an interpreter agent that analyzes execution results and identifies opportunities for improvement. Across diverse combinatorial optimization benchmarks and challenging MIPLIB instances, HeurEvo finds high-quality solutions within tight runtime budgets, often matching or surpassing state-of-the-art optimization solvers given hours or days of computation. On several nonlinear geometry problems such as hexagon packing, it also improves upon the best previously reported results. These results highlight the value of jointly searching over algorithmic structure and implementation for agentic heuristic design.

AI.tldr: 提出 HeurEvo——自动化"计划-代码-组件"协同进化框架，联合进化高层算法结构、实现代码与可复用组件池，在严格运行时约束下求解组合优化与MIPLIB问题，常以数分钟级预算匹配或超越数小时至数天的SOTA求解器，并在六边形填充等非线性几何问题上刷新最优记录。
AI.motivation: 实际优化任务常需在严格运行时约束下取得高质量解，因此需要将问题专用启发式与强大数学规划求解器结合。但现有方法要么仅在预定流程内改进启发式组件，要么孤立地调优求解器配置，无法整体地决定计算资源分配位置、求解器利用方式以及整体算法结构的优化，限制了端到端的自适应能力。
AI.method: HeurEvo 是一个自动化的 plan--code--component 协同进化框架：planner 决定使用哪些算法组件、如何组合它们以及各阶段的运行时分配；coder 将计划实现为可执行代码；component evolver 更新共享可复用组件池。三者与解释器智能体反馈在岛屿式进化框架内协同进化，解释器分析执行结果并识别改进机会，从而联合搜索算法结构与实现。
AI.result: 在多样化组合优化基准及具有挑战性的 MIPLIB 实例上，HeurEvo 在紧张运行时预算内找到高质量解，常常与给予数小时甚至数天计算的SOTA优化求解器持平或更优；在六边形填充等若干非线性几何问题上，还改进了此前公开报道的最好结果。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，对算法结构与实现进行联合搜索，对智能体式启发式设计具有显著价值，可作为在严格时间预算下超越传统求解器与孤立调优范式的有效途径。

title: Where Does Randomness Matter in Neural Cellular Automata?
summary: Stochastic cell updates are often used throughout the life of a neural cellular automaton (NCA), from backpropagation through time to final rollout. This leaves two questions entangled: does update randomness help learn a useful rule, and must that randomness remain at execution? We separate training and evaluation update modes in controlled Growing NCA experiments, then vary the states shown during training. Under the standard constant-rate persist recipe, asynchronous training passes the short-horizon quality test in 10/10 runs, compared with 3/10 synchronous runs. All ten asynchronous models also retain the target for 4,096 steps under deterministic evaluation. For a scalar translation-invariant lattice, we derive an exact mean-square criterion: random masking can damp mean modes, but it also injects variance, and a mean-only test misclassifies four non-marginal settings. Finally, among 30 models that all pass the same reconstruction test, eight of ten grow-trained models become off-target at 4,096 steps, while all persist and regenerate models retain the target; damage recovery separates persist from regenerate. The results distinguish optimization reliability, execution mode, and task-specific behavior instead of treating them as one stability property.

AI.tldr: 本文将神经细胞自动机（NCA）训练期的随机更新与执行期的确定性更新解耦，通过受控的Growing NCA实验和标量平移不变格点分析，证明随机性对学习有用但执行时不必然需要，并区分了优化可靠性、执行模式与任务特定行为三种性质。
AI.motivation: NCA在整个生命周期（含BPTT与最终rollout）普遍使用随机细胞更新，导致两个问题纠缠不清：随机性是否有助于学到有用规则，以及执行阶段是否必须保留随机性。作者希望将训练与评估的更新模式分离，厘清随机性作用与执行模式的关系。
AI.method: 1）在受控的Growing NCA实验中分离训练与评估的更新模式；2）在标准constant-rate persist配方下对比异步与同步训练；3）变化训练时展示的状态；4）针对标量平移不变格点推导精确的均方判据，分析随机掩码对均值模态与方差注入的影响；5）在30个通过相同重建测试的模型上比较grow、persist、regenerate三种训练方式在长时程与损伤恢复上的表现。
AI.result: 异步训练在短时程质量测试中10/10通过，同步仅3/10；全部10个异步模型在确定性评估下保持目标4,096步。均方分析显示随机掩码虽能抑制均值模态但会注入方差，仅用均值检验会误判四种非边缘设置。在30个通过重建测试的模型中，10个grow训练模型有8个在4,096步时偏离目标，而persist与regenerate模型全部保持目标，且损伤恢复可将persist与regenerate区分开。
AI.conclusion: 训练期随机性提升优化可靠性（异步优于同步），但执行期无需保留随机性即可维持长时程稳定；稳定性不应被视为单一属性，而应分解为优化可靠性、执行模式与任务特定行为三个独立维度。

title: A neural network that maintains and retrieves memories based on context
summary: Every day, people continuously infer situational context and adjust the way they understand and remember the world. Context, signaled by the prefrontal cortex, is known to modulate working memory and episodic memory, but the algorithmic understanding of this modulation remains limited. Here, we train a recurrent neural network (RNN), augmented with an episodic memory buffer, to infer context using Bayesian inference as it continuously makes predictions of upcoming scenes while watching naturalistic movies. When the inferred context modulates the RNN's recurrent connectivity (the basis of working memory) in a low-rank manner, the model's activity patterns best match neural responses in human participants who watched the same movies during fMRI. Context also modulates episodic memory retrieval, such that the model retrieves memories based on not only content similarity but also context similarity. This is implemented as a key-value system with self-attention, designed to additionally encode context and retrieve context-congruent memories. The resulting model not only better resembles human brain representations but also learns to retrieve memories like humans much faster than a model without context modulation. Together, our findings suggest a computational mechanism by which context modulates information maintenance and long-term memory retrieval in naturalistic environments.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了带情景记忆缓冲的RNN，用贝叶斯推断持续推断情境，并以低秩方式调制循环连接、以键值自注意力机制实现情境一致性记忆提取，使模型活动与人类fMRI反应更吻合，且记忆提取更快。
AI.motivation: 情境由前额叶皮层发出信号，已知可调节工作记忆与情景记忆，但其背后的算法机制尚不清楚；作者希望在自然主义电影观看任务中，用计算模型刻画情境对信息维持与长时记忆提取的调制机制。
AI.method: 训练一个增强情景记忆缓冲的循环神经网络（RNN），在观看自然主义电影、持续预测后续场景时，用贝叶斯推断估计情境。其一，用低秩方式让推断出的情境调制RNN的循环连接（工作记忆基础）；其二，将情景记忆提取实现为带自注意力的键值系统，额外编码情境并提取与情境一致（context-congruent）的记忆。
AI.result: 当情境以低秩方式调制循环连接时，模型活动模式与观看相同电影的人类被试fMRI神经反应匹配最佳；在情景记忆方面，模型不仅依据内容相似性、也依据情境相似性提取记忆；该模型更接近人脑表征，且比无情境调制的模型更快学会像人类一样提取记忆。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出了一种计算机制：在自然主义环境中，情境通过低秩调制循环连接影响信息维持，并通过情境一致性的键值检索影响长时记忆提取，从而解释情境对工作记忆与情景记忆的调控。

title: Kolmogorov-Arnold Classifier Systems as Universal Approximators
summary: As the input dimension $n$ grows, rule-based machine learning, such as Learning Classifier Systems (LCSs), faces a fundamental scalability bottleneck for function approximation: both rule count and parameter count grow exponentially with $n$. Traditional LCSs partition the $n$-dimensional input space directly, requiring $\mathcal{O}(m^n)$ rules for adequate coverage, where $m$ is the per-variable resolution. This article breaks from this paradigm by reorganizing rules dimension-wise, guided by the Kolmogorov-Arnold representation theorem: any continuous $n$-dimensional function can be expressed as a finite superposition of one-dimensional functions. The proposed Kolmogorov-Arnold Classifier System (KACS) decomposes the target function into one-dimensional subproblems and assigns a dedicated ruleset to each, reducing the worst-case rule count from $\mathcal{O}(m^n)$ to $\mathcal{O}(mn^2)$ and replacing $n$-dimensional local models with one-dimensional models requiring only two parameters per rule, independent of $n$. We also provide the first constructive proof that an LCS, namely KACS, is a universal approximator for continuous functions on compact domains. Evaluated against a direct $n$-dimensional input space partitioning approach under otherwise identical conditions, KACS achieves competitive accuracy in many settings while using only 2\% to 40\% of the parameters. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/YNU-NakataLab/KACS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KACS（Kolmogorov-Arnold分类器系统），基于Kolmogorov-Arnold表示定理将规则按维度重组，把LCS的最坏情况规则数从O(m^n)降至O(mn^2)，并首次构造性证明LCS是连续函数的通用逼近器。
AI.motivation: 传统基于规则的方法（如LCS）直接划分n维输入空间，规则数与参数数随n指数增长，形成可扩展性瓶颈：需O(m^n)条规则才能充分覆盖，其中m为每变量分辨率。
AI.method: KACS依据Kolmogorov-Arnold表示定理（任何连续n维函数可表示为有限个一维函数的叠加），将目标函数分解为一维子问题，为每个子问题分配专用规则集；用仅需每规则两个参数、与n无关的一维局部模型替代n维局部模型。
AI.result: 在其余条件相同的情况下，与直接n维输入空间划分方法相比，KACS在多种设定下达到有竞争力的精度，同时仅使用2%至40%的参数。代码开源于 https://github.com/YNU-NakataLab/KACS。
AI.conclusion: 规则按维度重组可显著降低LCS的规则与参数复杂度，KACS在参数效率上具优势，且首次为LCS的通用逼近能力提供了构造性证明。

title: Passive-Dynamic-Walking-Inspired Dynamics Guidance for Energy-Efficient Humanoid Locomotion
summary: Learning energy-efficient humanoid locomotion requires discovering mechanically economical gait coordination, not merely reducing actuator effort. Reinforcement learning promotes efficiency through effort-related reward penalties, which guide the step-to-step mechanics of walking only indirectly. This article proposes a framework inspired by passive dynamic walking (PDW) that temporarily creates slope-equivalent conditions favorable to economical gait discovery and removes all PDW-specific guidance before nominal-dynamics optimization. During early training, a tilted-gravity field assists sagittal progression on flat collision geometry, complemented by curriculum-coupled reward terms. The core framework requires no reference trajectories, gait phases, or contact schedules. In a five-seed forward-locomotion study on a 29-DoF Unitree G1, the framework reduces mechanical cost of transport by 6.8-15.2% over commanded speeds of 0.5-2.0m/s without degrading velocity tracking. Mechanical-work decomposition attributes the reduction to positive actuator work, and reward-matched comparisons separate the guided regime's faster gait acquisition from the tilt's additional benefit to converged economy. The framework extends to unassisted omnidirectional locomotion, where its benefit persists once a walking-specific motion prior supplies kinematic coordination, the combination reducing speed-matched cost of transport by 18.7%. On hardware, forward cost of transport falls by 16.3% with the motion prior and by 4.5% without it, the latter within the trial-to-trial spread.

AI.tldr: 提出受被动动态行走启发的训练框架：早期用倾斜重力场营造"等效斜坡"条件促进经济步态发现，训练后期移除该引导进行标称动力学优化，在Unitree G1上显著降低机械运输成本。
AI.motivation: 类人机器人节能行走的关键在于发现机械上经济的步态协调模式，而非单纯减小执行器出力。现有强化学习通过与做功相关的奖励惩罚来促进能效，这种方法只能间接引导行走的步-步力学，难以直接塑造经济的步态结构。
AI.method: 受被动动态行走（PDW）启发的训练框架：早期训练阶段在平坦碰撞几何上施加倾斜重力场，模拟下坡的等效条件以辅助矢状面推进，并配合与课程学习耦合的奖励项；在标称动力学优化前完全移除所有PDW特定引导。框架无需参考轨迹、步态相位或接触时序。在29自由度Unitree G1上进行五随机种子的前向运动实验。
AI.result: 在0.5–2.0 m/s指令速度范围内，机械运输成本降低6.8%–15.2%，且不损害速度跟踪性能。机械功分解表明成本下降主要来自正向执行器做功；奖励匹配对照实验区分了引导阶段更快的步态习得与倾斜带来的收敛后经济性增益。框架可扩展至无辅助全向运动，配合行走专用运动先验时速度匹配运输成本降低18.7%。硬件实验中，前向运输成本在含运动先验时下降16.3%，不含时下降4.5%（处于试验间波动范围内）。
AI.conclusion: 临时构建类似斜坡的有利条件可有效促进经济步态的发现，且该引导在标称动力学优化前被移除而不残留依赖。该方法无需参考轨迹与步态先验即可提升能效，并能扩展至全向运动与真实硬件，验证了PDW思想与现代强化学习结合的有效性。

title: In-Context Learning for Robots: Methods and Applications
comment: 100 pages, 26 figures, 25 tables. Project page: https://jethrojames.github.io/awesome-robots-icl/ ; Code and literature: https://github.com/JethroJames/awesome-robots-icl
summary: General-purpose robots must infer what a new task requires and translate that understanding into appropriate physical action. In-context learning (ICL) for robots supports this process by using demonstrations and interaction to direct existing competence with neural parameters held fixed during deployment. We organize this literature review around the interfaces connecting contextual evidence to execution, distinguishing four families: context-conditioned policies, geometric demonstration transfer, world-model-based control, and skill- and agent-based execution. Comparing these interfaces clarifies their transfer assumptions and the roles of training, correspondence, and memory in making context useful. Across manipulation and navigation, we examine how these mechanisms preserve taught requirements as objects, environments, and execution conditions change. This analysis links method design to evaluation practices that distinguish responsiveness to teaching, physical transfer, and benefits from retained experience. The resulting agenda connects compositional task acquisition and faithful transfer with physical recursive self-improvement, in which experience improves the ability to learn subsequent tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于机器人情境学习（ICL）的综述，围绕"情境证据→执行"的接口将文献划分为四类：情境条件策略、几何示范迁移、世界模型控制、技能与智能体执行。
AI.motivation: 通用机器人需从少样本示范与交互中推断新任务要求，并转化为物理动作；而现有研究分散在不同技术路线下，缺乏统一视角来比较"情境如何被利用"以及迁移假设与评测方式的差异。
AI.method: 以连接情境证据与执行的"接口"为组织框架，将机器人ICL文献归纳为四大家族，并比较各自在训练、对应关系（correspondence）与记忆方面的作用假设；结合操作与导航任务，考察在物体、环境、执行条件变化时如何保持教学要求。
AI.result: 分析厘清了四类接口的迁移假设，并将方法设计与评测实践相衔接，区分对教学的响应性、物理迁移能力以及保留经验带来的收益。
AI.conclusion: 提出一条研究议程，将组合式任务获取与忠实迁移同物理递归自我改进相联系，即经验提升后续任务的学习能力。

title: SAKI: Skill Assembly and Kinematic Imitation from Human Videos for Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation
summary: Learning from human videos offers a promising route to acquiring diverse manipulation skills. Extending this capability beyond tabletop settings to long-horizon mobile manipulation requires adapting and composing demonstrated interactions across changing scenes and robot configurations. We present Skill Assembly and Kinematic Imitation (SAKI), a framework connecting human-video skill acquisition, cross-demonstration assembly and closed-loop whole-body execution. SAKI prepares reusable object-centric skills that preserve task-critical interactions while allowing transfer paths to adapt. Given a goal and supplied task dependencies, it selects and orders skills, binds their object roles to the current scene, and carries scene estimates and robot configuration between successive skills. Whole-body kinematic imitation generates coordinated base, arm and gripper motion. During execution, persistent object estimates maintain task references across viewpoint changes, while visual feedback updates remaining trajectories. Real-robot experiments demonstrate skill reuse across layouts and the composition of independently demonstrated interactions into continuous mobile tasks, including tidying and wiping. Ablation results show that task-conditioned reference preparation substantially improves long-horizon task completion with whole-body optimisation and visual feedback held fixed. Check https://aus.bot/research/saki/ for video demos!

AI.tldr: SAKI 提出一个框架，将人类视频中的操作技能转化为可复用的以物体为中心的技能，并通过跨演示组装与全身运动学模仿，实现长时程移动操作任务。
AI.motivation: 人类视频蕴含多样的操作技能，但将其从桌面场景扩展到长时程移动操作面临挑战：演示跨场景与机器人构型变化时需要适配与组合。因此需要一个能连接技能获取、跨演示组装和闭环全身执行的框架。
AI.method: SAKI 准备可复用的以物体为中心的技能，保留任务关键交互同时允许迁移路径适配。给定目标与任务依赖，它选择并排序技能，将物体角色绑定到当前场景，并在相邻技能间传递场景估计与机器人构型。全身运动学模仿生成协调的底盘、手臂与夹爪运动；执行期间持久物体估计维持跨视角变化的任务参考，视觉反馈更新剩余轨迹。
AI.result: 真机实验表明技能可在不同布局间复用，并能将独立演示的交互组合成连续移动任务（如整理与擦拭）。消融结果显示，在全身优化与视觉反馈固定的条件下，任务条件化的参考准备显著提升长时程任务完成率。
AI.conclusion: SAKI 有效桥接了人类视频技能学习与长时程移动操作，实现技能复用与跨演示组合的闭环全身执行。

title: MagNav: A Dual-Core Magnetic Track Guidance Framework for Lighting-Invariant Navigation in Two-Wheeled Robots
comment: 6 pages, 10 figures, 1 table. Accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Signal Processing and Effective Communication Technologies (INSPECT), organized by Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Patna
summary: Two-Wheeled Inverted Pendulum (TWIP) robots are useful for studying how to control systems that are naturally unstable and have fewer actuators than degrees of freedom. Adding autonomous line-following to these robots is challenging because steering and balancing are closely linked. Most existing systems use infrared sensors, which can be affected by changes in lighting, such as sunlight or shadows, making them reliable only indoors. This paper presents a self-balancing robot that can follow a line using a magnetic track guidance system. By using a five-channel analog Hall-effect sensor array, the robot is not affected by optical interference. The control system uses a cascaded PID structure: the inner loop keeps the robot balanced using data from an inertial measurement unit with a complementary filter, while the outer loop adjusts steering based on the magnetic sensor readings. Stepper motors provide precise torque control without needing extra rotary encoders. For comparison, an optical sensor module was also included. Tests show that the magnetic guidance system keeps accurate tracking even in very bright lighting, over 10,000 Lux, while the optical system loses accuracy and sometimes fails. This design provides a reliable, lighting-independent solution for autonomous navigation in places like factories, warehouses, and outdoor paths.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于五通道模拟霍尔传感器阵列的磁轨循迹自平衡两轮倒立摆机器人，采用串级PID控制（内环平衡、外环转向），在超过10000 Lux强光下仍能精确循迹，克服了红外/光学方案受光照干扰的缺陷。
AI.motivation: 两轮倒立摆（TWIP）机器人本身欠驱动且自然不稳定，转向与平衡强耦合，实现自主循迹具有挑战性。现有方案多采用红外传感器，易受阳光、阴影等光照变化影响，仅适合室内使用。作者希望提供一种不受光照条件制约、可用于工厂、仓库及室外路径的可靠自主导航方案。
AI.method: 采用磁轨制导系统，使用五通道模拟霍尔效应传感器阵列感知磁场，避免光学干扰。控制系统为串级PID结构：内环基于惯性测量单元（IMU）配合互补滤波器实现姿态平衡；外环根据磁传感器读数调节转向。执行器选用步进电机，无需额外旋转编码器即可提供精确转矩控制。同时集成光学传感器模块作为对照。
AI.result: 实验对比表明：在超过10,000 Lux的强光照明下，磁制导系统仍能保持精确循迹；而光学系统精度下降，时而出现失效。磁方案在光照鲁棒性上显著优于光学方案。
AI.conclusion: 该设计为自主导航提供了一种可靠且不依赖光照条件的解决方案，适用于工厂、仓库及室外路径等场景。

title: Scouting the Dynamics Gap: Test-Time Policy Adaptation via Action-Outcome Feedback
comment: Accepted to Conference of Robot Learning (CoRL) 2026
summary: While pretrained robotic policies exhibit impressive capabilities in controlled environments, unobserved physical properties and dynamics require these policies to rapidly adapt during deployment. Existing test-time adaptation methods typically rely on sparse scalar rewards, failing to exploit the rich geometric and dynamic feedback from the environment during physical interaction. To address this challenge, we propose SCOUT, a dynamics-aware meta-learning framework that enables manipulation policies to rapidly adapt by continuously revising their internal beliefs about environment dynamics. Our approach couples an action-prediction policy with a forward dynamics model via a shared belief latent space. During meta-training, an inner loop updates this shared belief latent by minimizing the dynamics prediction error against the observed action outcome, while the outer loop optimizes the network for action selection. At deployment, this structure allows the agent to infer and adapt to unknown physical dynamics on the fly. By updating its latent belief based on action-outcome mismatches, the policy automatically adapts without risking catastrophic forgetting. We demonstrate that SCOUT significantly accelerates online adaptation across simulated manipulation benchmarks and achieves robust sim-to-real transfer in the real world. Project webiste can be found here: https://liy1shu.github.io/SCOUT/

AI.tldr: SCOUT：一种动力学感知的元学习框架，通过共享信念隐空间在线修正对环境动力学的内部信念，实现操作策略的快速测试时自适应与sim-to-real迁移。
AI.motivation: 预训练机器人策略在受控环境中表现良好，但面对未观测的物理属性与动力学时需在部署中快速适应。现有测试时自适应方法多依赖稀疏标量奖励，未能充分利用物理交互过程中丰富的几何与动力学反馈。
AI.method: 将动作预测策略与前向动力学模型通过共享的信念隐空间耦合。元训练中，内循环以观测到的动作结果为监督，通过最小化动力学预测误差来更新共享信念隐变量；外循环则优化网络以改进行为选择。部署时，智能体依据动作-结果失配在线更新隐信念，从而推断并适应未知物理动力学；该机制无需梯度重训，可避免灾难性遗忘。
AI.result: 在多个仿真操作基准上显著加速了在线自适应，并在真实世界中实现了鲁棒的仿真到现实（sim-to-real）迁移。
AI.conclusion: 通过以动力学预测误差为自监督信号维护可在线更新的信念隐变量，SCOUT为物理交互中的测试时自适应提供了高效且抗遗忘的解决方案，并具备实际部署的迁移能力。

title: KPI: A Promptable Kernel for Physical Interaction on Humanoids
summary: Humanoids now walk, balance and reach with remarkable generality: one whole-body tracking policy follows references from a human, or from an end-to-end policy. That generality travels in the trajectory, and a trajectory alone carries limited information about the interaction it should produce: at contact, the executing controller determines how the robot behaves. Single-task policies usually reach hard interactions by optimising trajectory and controller together in simulation; general stacks usually assume a preset or hand-chosen controller. We present KPI, a promptable kernel for physical interaction between the trajectory source and an unmodified whole-body tracker. Instead of a controller fixed before the task, the trajectory source sends a contract: per direction, track, comply, or hold a force range. From tracking error and a wrench estimate, the kernel adapts the arms' stiffness, damping, reference and feedforward toward it at contact rate. We demonstrate KPI through an agentic framework: from one instruction, a vision-language agent writes both the reference trajectory and the contract, with no task-specific code. We demonstrate instruction-driven winch operation, door opening, and box transport, alongside scripted surface-interaction experiments. In the winch demonstration, the humanoid is able to turn a crank to hoist a second robot fully off the ground.

AI.tldr: 提出KPI（可提示交互内核），在轨迹源与未修改全身跟踪器之间插入一个"接触契约"，按方向指定跟踪/顺应/保持力区间，基于跟踪误差与力旋量估计在接触频率下实时调节手臂刚度、阻尼、参考与前馈；由视觉语言智能体从单条指令同时生成参考轨迹与契约，无需任务专用代码，实现绞盘操作、开门、搬箱等交互任务。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人全身跟踪策略通用性强，但通用性体现在轨迹上，而轨迹本身对"应产生何种交互"携带的信息有限；接触行为实际由执行控制器决定。单任务策略需在仿真中联合优化轨迹与控制器，通用栈则通常预设或手工挑选控制器，二者难以兼顾通用性与硬交互能力。
AI.method: KPI作为插在轨迹源与现成全身跟踪器之间的可提示内核，不改动跟踪器。轨迹源不再提供固定控制器，而是下发契约：对每个方向规定跟踪、顺应或保持某一力区间。内核利用跟踪误差与力旋量估计，在接触频率下自适应调整手臂的刚度、阻尼、参考轨迹与前馈项以达成契约；并通过智能体框架，由视觉语言智能体从单条指令同时写出参考轨迹与契约，无任务专用代码。
AI.result: 在指令驱动下展示了绞盘操作、开门与箱子搬运，并配合脚本化的表面交互实验；绞盘演示中，人形机器人能转动曲柄将第二台机器人完全吊离地面。
AI.conclusion: 以"契约+自适应内核"替代预设控制器，可在保持全身跟踪通用栈不变的前提下实现强接触交互，并可通过视觉语言智能体从单一指令端到端生成轨迹与交互规范，无需任务专用实现。

title: SkillWeaver: Agentic Exploration over Neural Interaction Skills for Scalable Robot Data Generation
summary: Large-scale demonstrations have driven unprecedented progress in robot learning, yet collecting robot data through teleoperation is expensive and difficult to scale to diverse environments and long-horizon tasks. Simulation offers a scalable alternative, but existing data-generation pipelines often rely on open-loop controllers, scripted skill sequences, or task-specific programs. We introduce SkillWeaver, an agentic framework that autonomously generates robot experience by exploring over Neural Interaction Skills (NIS): reusable, parameterized, closed-loop policies that expose learned physical interaction capabilities to a reasoning agent. Given a task and a simulated environment, a VLM agent reasons about what to do next, invokes and parameterizes NIS to interact with the environment, observes their outcomes, and generates verification, reflection, and memory to guide subsequent exploration. We instantiate NIS as reinforcement-learned policies for closed-loop, contact-rich manipulation and organize exploration as verifier-guided tree search, enabling the agent to discover successful long-horizon behaviors without relying on predetermined execution pipelines. SkillWeaver scales autonomously to 39.1K demonstrations across 14.1K scenes, which we distill into visuomotor policies. Across simulation benchmarks and real-world manipulation, training on SkillWeaver-generated experience substantially improves generalization to novel objects, spatial configurations, tasks, and environments, and enables zero- and few-shot sim-to-sim and sim-to-real transfer. Our results suggest agentic exploration over neural interaction skills as a scalable alternative for robot data generation.

AI.tldr: SkillWeaver 提出一种由 VLM 智能体驱动的自主机器人经验生成框架，通过探索可复用的神经交互技能（NIS）并以验证器引导的树搜索组织探索，自动生成大规模示范数据并蒸馏为视觉运动策略，显著提升泛化与仿真到现实迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 机器人学习依赖大规模示范数据，但遥操作采集成本高、难以扩展到多样环境和长时程任务；现有仿真数据生成流程多依赖开环控制器、脚本化技能序列或任务专用程序，缺乏闭环交互与自主性，难以泛化。
AI.method: 提出 SkillWeaver 智能体框架：以神经交互技能（NIS）为核心，NIS 是可复用、参数化、闭环的策略，暴露已学习的物理交互能力给推理智能体。给定任务与仿真环境，VLM 智能体推理下一步动作，调用并参数化 NIS 与环境交互，观察结果并生成验证、反思与记忆以指导后续探索。NIS 实例化为强化学习策略，用于闭环、接触丰富的操作；探索被组织为验证器引导的树搜索，无需预定执行流水线即可发现长时程成功行为。
AI.result: SkillWeaver 自主扩展至 39.1K 条示范、14.1K 个场景，并蒸馏为视觉运动策略。在仿真基准与真实机器人操作中，使用 SkillWeaver 生成经验训练显著提升对新物体、空间配置、任务和环境的泛化，并支持零样本与少样本的 sim-to-sim 及 sim-to-real 迁移。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，基于神经交互技能的智能体式探索是机器人数据生成的可扩展替代方案。

title: Test-Time Adaptation of Manipulation Policies Under Actuator Degradation
summary: Robot manipulation policies are usually trained under the assumption that a commanded action produces the same motion as it did during training even after hours of operation. Real hardware violates this assumption as the motors gradually heat up, current saturates near contact, voltage sags under load, thus the same policy action can produce a weaker, delayed, or noisier motion. These conditions are already measured by onboard telemetry, such as joint temperature, motor current, and supply voltage, yet this signal is typically used only for logging or safety checks rather than policy adaptation. We introduce Telemetry-Aware Action Rectification (TeAR), a policy-agnostic method that turns a frozen manipulation policy into a telemetry-conditioned policy by rectifying its outgoing action before it reaches the low-level controller. TeAR learns a lightweight Transformer that combines the proposed action with live actuator telemetry and amplifies, damps, or biases individual action components. We evaluate TeAR across 18 policy-task pairs spanning 8 policy families and 5 manipulation tasks. In an additional paired evaluation with degradation-model mismatch, TeAR achieves 31.8% success, compared with 25.6% for the base policy and 30.6% for an assumed-model inverse. On a physical arm, TeAR improves success under heating by 10-15% without on-robot fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出TeAR，一种与策略无关的方法，利用执行器遥测信号对冻结的操作策略输出动作进行校正，使其变为遥测条件化策略，从而在硬件退化时维持或提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人操作策略通常假设"指令动作在执行时产生的运动与训练时一致"，但真实硬件中电机发热、接触附近电流饱和、负载下电压跌落等因素会破坏该假设，导致相同动作产生更弱、延迟或更嘈杂的运动。这些状况已被板载遥测（关节温度、电机电流、供电电压）记录，但该信号通常仅用于日志或安全检查，而未用于策略自适应。
AI.method: TeAR将冻结的操作策略转化为遥测条件化策略：不再改动原策略本身，而是在其输出动作送入底层控制器之前进行校正。具体做法是学习一个轻量级Transformer，将拟执行动作与实时执行器遥测结合，对动作的各个分量进行放大、衰减或偏置。评估覆盖18个策略-任务对，涉及8个策略家族和5个操作任务，并额外进行了退化模型失配的配对评估及物理机械臂实验。
AI.result: 在退化模型失配的配对评估中，TeAR成功率为31.8%，基线策略为25.6%，假设模型求逆方法为30.6%。在物理机械臂上，TeAR在发热条件下无需机器人端微调即可将成功率提升10-15%。
AI.conclusion: 利用执行器遥测对策略输出动作进行校正，是一种策略无关且有效的硬件退化补偿手段，可在不微调原策略的前提下提升真实硬件上的操作鲁棒性。

title: Design and Validation of an Antagonistic Tendon-Driven Dexterous Robotic Hand with Bidirectional Operation
summary: Dexterous robotic hands typically reproduce human hand morphology but inherit its one-sided grasping workspace, requiring wrist or arm reorientation to grasp from the opposite side. Existing reversible hands generally rely on non-anthropomorphic, soft, or task-specific finger arrangements, whereas conventional five-digit anthropomorphic hands remain designed primarily for palmar-side grasping. This paper presents an anthropomorphic, human-scale (200 mm length), lightweight (220 g), 3D-printed, 17-DoF robotic hand built on a bidirectional antagonistic tendon-routing mechanism, in which flexion/extension (except the coupled joint) and abduction/adduction at joints are actively driven without passive return springs. The proposed routing mechanism allows all degrees of freedom to cross their neutral configuration and form grasp closures on either the palmar or dorsal side. Experimental evaluation demonstrates an average motor-to-joint transmission error of 3.0%, an average joint transmission bandwidth of 13.2 Hz, a maximum fingertip force of 29 N, and a positioning repeatability up to 0.15 mm. The hand further achieves a Kapandji score of 8, successfully performs all 33 GRASP Taxonomy grasp types, and performs palmar- and dorsal-side grasping tasks, validating bidirectional operation in a compact, human-scale platform.

AI.tldr: 提出一种仿人、人尺度、轻量化的3D打印17自由度机械手，基于双向拮抗腱驱动机构实现掌侧与背侧双侧抓握。
AI.motivation: 传统仿人五指机械手继承了人手单侧（掌侧）抓握工作空间的局限，需通过腕部或臂部重新定向才能从对侧抓握。现有可反转手多依赖非仿人、软体或任务专用指构型，而常规仿人五指手仍主要面向掌侧抓握。
AI.method: 采用双向拮抗式腱驱动布线机制，除耦合关节外的屈伸及内收外展关节均由主动驱动，无被动回位弹簧，使各自由度均可跨越中立位，从而在掌侧或背侧形成抓握闭合。
AI.result: 电机-关节平均传动误差3.0%，平均关节传动带宽13.2 Hz，最大指尖力29 N，定位重复精度达0.15 mm；Kapandji评分8，成功完成全部33种GRASP Taxonomy抓握手势，并实现掌侧与背侧抓握任务。
AI.conclusion: 该手在紧凑的人尺度平台上验证了双向抓握操作能力，为人形机器人手部提供兼顾仿人形态与双侧抓握能力的新方案。

title: Bilinear World Models: Learning Representations with Structured Dynamics for Efficient Control
summary: World models jointly learn latent representations and dynamics that predict how high-dimensional observations evolve under actions. In this work, we propose a JEPA-style world model in which, rather than learning arbitrary latent dynamics, we restrict them to follow a bilinear parameterization. This structure enables efficient planning and control while shifting the modeling burden onto the encoder, encouraging richer representations that expose the controllable geometry of the system. In particular, this structured parameterization allows us to structurally enforce action recoverability, thereby preventing representation collapse by construction. Although prescribing a bilinear parametrization may appear restrictive, we show that a broad class of nonlinear dynamical systems admits a transformation under which the dynamics become bilinear. Empirically, we show across standard 2D and 3D control tasks that representations with bilinear-parameterized dynamics can be learned directly from high-dimensional observations, reducing planning time by nearly three orders of magnitude while retaining or even improving control accuracy. We also propose more demanding regimes of longer-horizon planning and real-time control, and demonstrate that our method succeeds in both, moving JEPA-style world models beyond short-horizon offline planning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种JEPA风格的世界模型，将隐空间动力学限制为双线性参数化形式，使动作可恢复性在结构上得到保证，从根本上避免表征坍缩；理论上证明一大类非线性动力系统可通过变换转为双线性，实验表明在2D/3D控制任务中规划时间缩短近三个数量级，控制精度保持或提升。
AI.motivation: 世界模型通常同时学习隐表征与动力学以预测高维观测在动作下的演化，但隐动力学往往是任意形式的，导致规划控制效率低、易发生表征坍缩，且难以在长时程与实时场景下扩展。作者希望引入结构化约束，把建模负担转移到编码器上，使隐空间暴露系统可控几何，从而兼顾效率与可解释性。
AI.method: 提出JEPA风格世界模型，将隐动力学限制为双线性参数化（bilinear parameterization），而非任意隐动力学。该结构可显式地在构造上强制动作可恢复性（action recoverability），从而防止表征坍缩。理论上论证广泛的非线性动力系统存在某种变换使其动力学变为双线性形式。
