AI.result: 在标准2D与3D控制任务上，可直接从高维观测中学习具备双线性参数化动力学的表征；规划时间缩短近三个数量级（约1000倍），同时控制精度保持甚至提升。方法在长时程规划与实时控制两种更苛刻的场景下均取得成功。
AI.conclusion: 双线性参数化虽看似限制性强，但实际上覆盖一大类非线性系统，并能将表示学习与规划控制高效解耦。该工作推动JEPA风格世界模型超越短时程离线规划，向长时程规划与实时控制拓展。

title: ATLAS: Aligned Transport of Latent Structure for Reliable World Model Planning
summary: Latent world models rely on representation geometry for planning, yet regularizing the latent marginal alone does not determine the state-to-state relationships used for action selection. We show that this can cause planning-relevant novelty structure to be weakened as representations are transformed into the final latent used by the planner. We introduce Aligned Transport of Latent Structure (ATLAS), a training objective that explicitly preserves relational geometry while calibrating the global latent distribution. ATLAS transfers normalized pairwise structure from an informative encoder representation to the planning latent and uses Wasserstein embedding matching (WEMReg) to calibrate its marginal through one-dimensional Wasserstein-2 transport. Our analysis shows that relational preservation and marginal calibration impose non-redundant constraints, and connects finite-candidate planning stability to relational distortion, latent-scale mismatch, and prediction error. Instantiated in LeWM, ATLAS improves mean goal-reaching success across PushT, TwoRoom, and OGBench-Cube on both lower- and higher-novelty evaluation subsets, with the largest gain on higher-novelty TwoRoom episodes. Representation and rollout diagnostics further show stronger novelty-related structure in the planning latent, improved marginal calibration, and lower multi-step prediction error. Together, these results highlight preservation of planning-relevant latent geometry as an important ingredient for reliable world-model planning. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/atlas-world-model-72C4/.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ATLAS 训练目标，通过关系几何保持与边缘分布校准，改善潜世界模型规划中的规划相关新颖性结构。
AI.motivation: 潜世界模型依赖表示几何进行规划，但仅正则化潜变量边缘分布无法决定用于动作选择的状态间关系；这会导致在表示变换为规划器所用最终潜变量时，规划相关的新颖性结构被削弱。
AI.method: ATLAS 显式保持关系几何并校准全局潜分布：将来自信息量较高编码器表示的归一化成对结构迁移到规划潜变量，并使用 Wasserstein 嵌入匹配（WEMReg），通过一维 Wasserstein-2 传输校准其边缘分布。理论分析表明关系保持与边缘校准施加非冗余约束，并将有限候选规划稳定性与关系失真、潜尺度失配及预测误差联系起来。在 LeWM 中实例化。
AI.result: 在 PushT、TwoRoom 和 OGBench-Cube 上，ATLAS 在较低和较高新颖性评估子集上均提升平均目标到达成功率，其中在较高新颖性 TwoRoom 回合上增益最大。表示与 rollout 诊断进一步显示规划潜变量中新颖性相关结构更强、边缘校准改善、多步预测误差降低。
AI.conclusion: 保持规划相关潜几何是可靠世界模型规划的重要要素。

title: DORA: Divergence-Oriented Data-Relay Algorithm for Partially Connected Robot Teams
summary: Teams of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) deployed for search and monitoring missions frequently operate as partially connected networks, forcing each robot to trade off exploring the environment against relaying information to teammates. This tradeoff is especially acute when robots are semantically heterogeneous: an observation that appears uninformative to the robot that made it may be critical to a teammate with complementary detection capabilities. In this work, we formalize this setting as the heterogeneous mission-aware coverage (HMAC) problem, which couples complete multi-robot coverage of an area with capability-constrained mission-relevant target (MRT) discovery under intermittent communication. We then present DORA, a divergence-oriented data-relay algorithm that drives communication by the value of information to the team rather than by discovery alone. DORA quantifies the mission-relevant divergence between a robot's current information state and its estimate of each teammate's knowledge, capturing mission relevance, discovery novelty, sensor uncertainty, and the age of information. We evaluate DORA in simulation across four environments with differing object densities and spatial structure, and validate it on a physical UAV platform. Our results show that DORA improves MRT resolution delay by up to 74.8% over traditional time-based communication scheduling methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出异构任务感知覆盖（HMAC）问题，并设计DORA算法，以信息价值驱动通信调度，在多机器人间歇通信下提升任务相关目标发现效率。
AI.motivation: UAV团队执行搜索与监测任务时常处于部分连通网络，机器人需在探索环境与向队友中继信息之间权衡；当机器人语义异构时，某一机器人认为无用的观测对具备互补探测能力的队友可能至关重要，该权衡尤为突出。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为HMAC问题，耦合区域完整多机器人覆盖与间歇通信下能力受限的任务相关目标（MRT）发现；提出面向分歧的数据中继算法DORA，以团队信息价值而非仅发现事件驱动通信；DORA量化机器人当前信息状态与其对每个队友知识估计之间的任务相关分歧，包含任务相关性、发现新颖性、传感器不确定性与信息年龄。
AI.result: 在四种不同物体密度与空间结构的仿真环境中评估，并在实体UAV平台上验证；结果显示DORA相比传统基于时间的通信调度方法，将MRT解译延迟最多降低74.8%。
AI.conclusion: 以任务相关信息价值驱动的通信调度能有效缓解异构UAV团队在间歇通信下的探索—中继权衡，显著提升任务相关目标发现性能。

title: One from Infinity: Actualizing Futures from Pretrained World Models into Robot Actions
summary: A pretrained video world model admits many plausible futures for a scene, but a robot must realize the exact task-conditioned one. To turn world models into executable robot policies, existing methods fine-tune the heavy world model backbone using large-scale robot data and computational resources. Challenging this status quo, we argue that the expensive part has already been paid in the world model pretraining since the representation space of a video world model lays out the diverse potential futures. In this case, what remains is to select the future that accomplishes the task and to read out the actions that realize it. We formalize this task as actualization, which learns a task-conditioned selection and realization on top of a prior supplied by a frozen world model. This can be solved by a tiny actualizer model. We implement RoboActualizer with as few as 60M parameters on top of a frozen world model encoder. The actualizer is composed of two lightweight DiT experts that jointly predict future latents and actions by flow matching. The model can be trained entirely on a single GPU with 32 GB peak memory. With up to 100x fewer trainable parameters than existing WAMs and VLAs, RoboActualizer reaches great performance on simulation benchmarks including LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin 2.0 and five tasks on two real-world platforms, with a low latency of 39 ms that allows real-time control.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"实际化"（actualization）范式，主张视频世界模型预训练已完成昂贵部分，只需在冻结世界模型之上学习任务条件化的未来选择与动作读出，用一个约60M参数的轻量实际化器（RoboActualizer）即可把世界模型转化为可执行机器人策略。
AI.motivation: 现有将世界模型转为机器人策略的方法需用大规模机器人数据与算力微调沉重的世界模型骨干，成本高昂。作者认为世界模型预训练已支付了昂贵的代价，因其表征空间已蕴含多样的潜在未来，真正欠缺的只是选定能完成任务的未来并读出相应动作。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为"actualization"，在冻结世界模型提供的先验之上学习任务条件化的选择与实现，可由极小的实际化器完成。RoboActualizer 基于冻结世界模型编码器，最少60M参数，由两个轻量DiT专家组成，通过流匹配联合预测未来隐状态与动作。仅需单张32GB显存GPU即可完成训练。
AI.result: 可训练参数量比现有WAMs与VLAs少多达100倍，在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 2.0等仿真基准及两个真实平台上的五项任务中取得优异性能，推理延迟仅39 ms，可支持实时控制。
AI.conclusion: 冻结世界模型加轻量实际化器是一种高性价比、可实时部署的机器人策略新范式，验证了"昂贵部分已在预训练中支付"这一主张，为世界模型到可执行策略的转化提供了高效路径。

title: World4Scorer: Outcome-Grounded World Modeling for Autonomous Driving
comment: 28 pages, 14 figures, 13 tables. Project page: https://guobapei.github.io/World4Scorer/
summary: Autonomous driving requires choosing a safe and efficient plan as surrounding traffic evolves. Generate-and-select planners propose multiple trajectories and score them for execution, and they have outperformed representative direct-prediction baselines on NAVSIM. Their scorer must compare plans that were never executed. Driving logs record the future of only the executed trajectory, so matching the logged future can leave predictions for the alternatives unconstrained; a simulator, in contrast, can label the outcome of every candidate. We introduce World4Scorer, which builds the scorer as a trajectory-conditioned JEPA-style predictor: it predicts a state for each candidate and reads the candidate's scores from that state. Simulator outcome labels supervise the states of all candidates, and the observed future of the executed trajectory anchors the predictor to real scene evolution. Because one predictor produces every candidate's state, the anchor can constrain shared parameters used to score unexecuted plans, while the future itself is needed only during training. Generated candidates mostly score well, so a scene-matched bank adds low-scoring plans to the outcome supervision; framewise choices can conflict, so inertial re-ranking keeps consecutive selections consistent. World4Scorer achieves state-of-the-art NAVSIM-v2 performance and a strong adapted-system result on closed-loop Bench2Drive. With the LeWM world model and planning budget fixed, outcome-based scoring also improves manipulation planning on the OGBench-Cube benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 World4Scorer，将生成-选择规划器中的评分器构建为轨迹条件化 JEPA 式预测器：为每个候选轨迹预测其对应状态并读出分数，用仿真器结果标签监督所有候选状态、用已执行轨迹的真实未来锚定预测器，在 NAVSIM-v2 上取得 SOTA，并在 Bench2Drive 与 OGBench-Cube 上验证了泛化性。
AI.motivation: 生成-选择（generate-and-select）规划器已优于直接预测基线，但其评分器需要对从未执行过的候选轨迹进行打分，而驾驶日志只记录已执行轨迹的未来，导致以"匹配日志未来"为目标的监督对备选轨迹的预测缺乏约束、评分不可靠。仿真器虽可为每个候选标注结果，但仅靠仿真标签又会偏离真实场景演化，因此需要一种既能获得全候选结果监督、又能保持与真实未来一致的学习范式。
AI.method: 将评分器设计为轨迹条件化的 JEPA 式预测器：对每个候选轨迹预测一个状态，并从该状态读出候选得分。训练时以仿真器结果标签监督所有候选的状态，同时用已执行轨迹的观测未来作为锚点约束预测器贴近真实场景演化；由于所有候选共享同一预测器参数，该锚点可间接约束用于给未执行轨迹打分的那部分共享参数，而真实未来仅在训练阶段需要。针对候选质量偏高的分布问题，引入场景匹配的候选库以补充低分轨迹参与结果监督；针对逐帧选择可能冲突的问题，采用惯性重排序保持连续选择的一致性。
AI.result: 在 NAVSIM-v2 上达到 SOTA 水平，在闭环 Bench2Drive 上取得较强的适配系统结果；在规划预算与 LeWM 世界模型固定的条件下，基于结果的评分方法在 OGBench-Cube 操作规划基准上也带来提升。
AI.conclusion: 用仿真结果标签监督共享预测器的候选状态、并用真实执行的未来做锚点，可以同时兼顾全候选监督与真实性约束，从而显著提升生成-选择规划器的评分质量；该范式在自动驾驶与操作规划任务上均具可迁移性。

title: DQ-MPCC: Dual-Quaternion MPCC for Quadrotor Racing
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters
summary: Quadrotor racing demands aggressive attitude and progress control while passing through every gate, and conventional quadrotor MPCC formulations state the prediction model in inertial coordinates and the attitude error in the body frame. We present a Dual-Quaternion Model Predictive Contouring Control (DQ-MPCC) for quadrotor racing in which the pose is a unit dual quaternion and the contouring errors are projected onto the tangent space of the dual quaternion manifold, expressed in the desired body frame: the same rigid-body dynamics as the conventional model, in unified pose-twist coordinates in the body frame. We compare DQ-MPCC against a baseline MPCC through Monte Carlo software-in-the-loop simulations and real-world racing on an eight-gate circuit of 11x4.5x3.65 m. With the same gains in simulation and hardware, DQ-MPCC keeps every crossing of its completed flights within the prescribed geometric margin, whereas the baseline exceeds it, its median worst-gate offset growing by 71.5% sim-to-real against a 10.1% decrease for DQ-MPCC. Among the configurations that keep every simulated gate crossing within the geometric margin, DQ-MPCC also reduces the minimum lap time by 6.7%, and by 10.5% in the real-world flights, while running onboard at 100 Hz.

AI.tldr: 提出双四元数模型预测轮廓控制（DQ-MPCC），将位姿表示为单位双四元数并在其切空间投影轮廓误差，实现四元数无人机竞速的高精度姿态与进度控制。
AI.motivation: 四旋翼竞速需要激进的姿态与进度控制并穿越每个门框。传统MPCC将预测模型建立在惯性系、姿态误差建立在机体系，坐标系混用限制了穿越精度与泛化性（sim-to-real）。
AI.method: 以单位双四元数表示位姿，轮廓误差投影到双四元数流形的切空间并表达在期望机体系；动力学与常规模型相同，统一采用机体系的位姿-旋量坐标。通过蒙特卡洛软件在环仿真与8门（11×4.5×3.65 m）赛道实机竞速，与基线MPCC对比。
AI.result: 仿真与硬件采用相同增益：DQ-MPCC所有完成飞行的每次过门均在规定几何裕度内，基线则超出；基线最差门偏移中位数sim-to-real增长71.5%，DQ-MPCC下降10.1%。在所有仿真过门均满足几何裕度的配置中，DQ-MPCC最小圈时仿真减少6.7%、实机减少10.5%，且以100 Hz机载运行。
AI.conclusion: 在统一机体系位姿-旋量坐标下的双四元数MPCC，可同时提升过门几何精度与sim-to-real一致性，并在保证裕度的前提下缩短圈时，具备机载实时性。

title: Closed-Form Cartesian Forward Kinetostatics for Spatial Multi-Segment Tendon-Driven Continuum Robots
summary: Forward kinetostatics of spatial tendon-driven continuum robots typically requires a nonlinear equilibrium solve for each actuation input. This paper develops a force-to-Cartesian-configuration model with a closed-form solution in quadratures for spatial multi-segment robots under tendon actuation. The Cartesian backbone centerline and accumulated material twist serve as generalized coordinates, from which the strain measures and tendon geometry are derived. Variational equilibrium yields explicit axial and bending relations and establishes zero equilibrium material twist within the proposed model for admissible longitudinal non-helical routing. The solution is propagated segment by segment without an iterative equilibrium solve, while retaining axial deformation, spatially varying axial and bending stiffnesses and tendon-routing diameter, and segment-dependent tendon participation. Numerical comparisons with a full-strain geometric variable-strain model (GVS) yield maximum length-normalized tip-position discrepancies of 8.91 x 10^-6 and 1.01 x 10^-5 for the single- and three-segment robots, respectively. Mean evaluation times of 1.52 μs and 2.94 μs, with corresponding speedups of approximately 1864x and 3348x over the baseline, demonstrate the computational advantage of the explicit force-to-configuration mapping in the reported benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种肌腱驱动空间多段连续体机器人的力-笛卡尔构型模型，可求得闭式解，无需逐输入迭代求解平衡方程。
AI.motivation: 空间肌腱驱动连续体机器人的正运动静力学通常需要对每个驱动输入非线性求解平衡方程，计算代价高，因此需要一种高效、显式的力到构型映射方法。
AI.method: 以笛卡尔骨干中心线与累积材料扭转作为广义坐标，推导应变度量和肌腱几何；通过变分平衡得到显式轴向与弯曲关系，并在允许的纵向非螺旋布线下证明材料扭转的零平衡；逐段传播求解，保留轴向变形、空间变化的轴向与弯曲刚度、肌腱布线直径及分段相关的肌腱参与。
AI.result: 与全应变几何变应变模型（GVS）对比，单段和三段机器人最大长度归一化尖端位置偏差分别为8.91×10^-6和1.01×10^-5；平均评估时间为1.52 μs和2.94 μs，相对基线加速约1864倍和3348倍。
AI.conclusion: 该显式力-构型映射在计入多种实际因素的同时避免了迭代平衡求解，在保持与GVS模型高度一致精度的前提下显著提升计算效率。

title: LIBERO-MAX: Do Robot Policies Adapt When the World Changes?
summary: Robots must often continue a task after a target moves, the viewpoint shifts, or an obstacle appears, even though their earlier observations and committed actions reflect the previous scene. Many simulation robustness benchmarks fix external conditions at reset, leaving this temporal challenge underexamined. We introduce LIBERO-MAX, a benchmark of 8,000 paired cases spanning eight types of changes to geometry, observations, appearance, clutter, and paths. Each pair compares task execution with and without a mid-task event, holding the task, initial state, policy seed, and pre-event action sequence fixed. This controlled comparison distinguishes event-associated regressions from failures already present without the change. Across fourteen current VLA, hybrid, and world-action policies, events reduce success by 11.0-25.7 percentage points. Event profiles reveal shared vulnerabilities to geometry and observation changes, while policy-family rankings interleave. Camera controls show that robustness reflects both competence under the changed conditions and the trajectory from which they are encountered; varying query cadence does not eliminate the gap. Together, the paired protocol and temporal diagnostics establish LIBERO-MAX as a reproducible testbed for diagnosing failures under mid-execution changes and measuring progress toward robot policies that remain effective as the world changes.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LIBERO-MAX 基准，通过 8000 组配对案例系统评估机器人在任务执行中途发生环境变化时的鲁棒性，揭示现有 VLA 等策略在此类时序挑战下成功率下降 11.0–25.7 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 机器人需在目标移动、视角变化或障碍出现后继续任务，但其先前观测与已执行动作反映的是旧场景。现有多数仿真鲁棒性基准在重置时固定外部条件，未能考察这一"执行中途变化"的时序挑战，相关问题研究不足。
AI.method: 构建 LIBERO-MAX 基准，含 8000 组配对案例，覆盖几何、观测、外观、杂乱与路径等八类变化。每组配对在任务、初始状态、策略随机种子及事件前动作序列固定的条件下，对比有/无中途事件的任务执行，从而将事件相关性能退化与原本就存在的失败区分开。在 14 个 VLA、混合及 world-action 策略上进行评估，并做事件剖面与相机控制分析。
AI.result: 中途事件使 14 个策略成功率下降 11.0–25.7 个百分点；事件剖面显示对几何与观测变化的共同脆弱性，而不同策略族的排名相互交错；相机控制实验表明鲁棒性既取决于变化条件下自身能力，也取决于遭遇变化时所处轨迹，调整查询频率无法消除差距。
AI.conclusion: 配对协议与时间诊断方法使 LIBERO-MAX 成为可复现的测试平台，用于诊断执行中途变化导致的失败，并衡量机器人策略在动态世界中保持有效性的进展。

title: Trajectory-Level Mode Guidance for Controllable Diffusion-Based Multi-Robot Motion Planning
summary: Motion planning often admits multiple feasible solutions, making multimodal generation valuable, particularly for flexible multi-robot coordination. Diffusion models naturally learn such trajectory distributions, yet incorporating coarse and partial trajectory priors without restricting generation remains challenging. Such priors indicate a desirable region of the solution space rather than a single solution, motivating conditioned generation that preserves multimodality. In this paper, we guide trajectory generation in the clean trajectory space and progressively incorporate trajectory priors with a timestep-dependent guidance strength. At each reverse diffusion step, the reconstructed clean trajectory provides a unified space for integrating planning costs and partial trajectory priors. Planning costs are incorporated through gradient-based refinement, while the partial prior is progressively injected at the corresponding noise levels with decreasing guidance strength. This guides generation toward the prior in early stages while gradually releasing the constraint to preserve the inherent multimodality of the diffusion model. The framework naturally extends to multi-robot planning by incorporating inter-robot collision costs. Experiments on single- and multi-robot planning tasks demonstrate controllable trajectory synthesis, diverse feasible solutions, and safe multi-agent coordination.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在"干净轨迹空间"中引导扩散模型的轨迹生成，并采用随扩散时间步递减的引导强度逐步注入粗粒度/部分轨迹先验，从而在满足规划代价与先验约束的同时保留模型固有的多模态性，并自然扩展到多机器人协同规划。
AI.motivation: 运动规划通常存在多个可行解，多模态生成对灵活的多机器人协同尤为重要。扩散模型能天然学习这种轨迹分布，但如何在不限制生成多样性的前提下融入"粗糙且部分"的轨迹先验仍具挑战。这类先验指示的是解空间中的一个期望区域而非单一解，因此需要保持多模态的条件生成方法。
AI.method: 在干净轨迹空间中进行引导，并以与时间步相关的引导强度逐步融入轨迹先验。在每个反向扩散步，重建出的干净轨迹提供一个统一空间，用于整合规划代价与部分轨迹先验：规划代价通过基于梯度的细化引入，部分先验则在对应噪声水平上以降序的引导强度逐步注入。早期阶段强引导使生成趋向先验，随后逐渐释放约束以保留扩散模型固有的多模态性。通过引入机器人间碰撞代价，框架可自然扩展到多机器人规划。
AI.result: 在单机器人与多机器人规划任务上的实验表明：该方法能够实现可控的轨迹合成、生成多样化的可行解，并实现安全的多智能体协同。
AI.conclusion: 通过在干净轨迹空间中进行引导并采用时间步相关的递减引导强度，可在注入规划代价与部分轨迹先验的同时保留扩散模型的多模态生成能力，并为多机器人协同规划提供统一且可扩展的框架。

title: Asymmetric Scout-Worker Reconnaissance for Route Validation in Unknown Environments
summary: This paper studies asymmetric scout-worker reconnaissance in unknown environments, where a small, agile autonomous scout explores routes for a larger worker robot that must visit an ordered sequence of goal locations. Because the scout has a smaller footprint and greater mobility, a scout-traversable route may be infeasible for the worker; worker feasibility must therefore be inferred from scout observations. This setting is not explicitly addressed by existing exploration and replanning methods, which typically assume a single traversability model and seek optimal paths for the same robot performing the exploration. We introduce a symbiotic scout-based framework that exploits the scout's superior mobility to explore only the portions of the unknown environment needed to identify worker-feasible path segments connecting the ordered goals. Evaluations in simulated and real-world settings demonstrate that the proposed approach validates feasible routes, repairs blocked segments with validated worker-feasible detours, and substantially reduces scout travel compared to baseline exploration and planning methods. A real-world indoor deployment further demonstrates the scout navigating narrow corridors to identify a worker-feasible route.

AI.tldr: 研究未知环境下"侦察者-工作者"异构机器人协同：敏捷小侦察者仅探索识别工作者可行路径所需的区域，为必须按序访问目标的较大工作者寻找可行路线。
AI.motivation: 侦察者足迹小、机动性强，其可通行路径对工作者未必可行，因此工作者可行性必须由侦察者观测推断。现有探索与重规划方法通常假设单一可通行性模型，并为同一机器人求最优路径，未显式处理该异构可行性差异问题。
AI.method: 提出共生的基于侦察者的框架（symbiotic scout-based framework），利用侦察者更优的机动性，仅探索未知环境中识别连接有序目标的工作者可行路径段所必需的部分，并据此验证可行路径、对受阻段用经侦察验证的工作者可行绕行进行修复。
AI.result: 仿真与真实世界评估表明：该方法能验证可行路径、以验证过的工作者可行绕行修复阻塞路段，且相较基线探索与规划方法大幅减少侦察者行驶距离；真实室内部署中，侦察者穿越狭窄走廊识别出工作者可行路径。
AI.conclusion: 证实了在未知环境中利用异构侦察者推断大机器人可行性的必要性与有效性，所提共生侦察框架在保证工作者可行性的同时显著降低探索开销，并具备真实场景可行性。

title: Reactive Real-Time Flow Policies via Asynchronous Distribution Alignment
summary: Generalist robot policies such as vision-language-action models (VLAs) have achieved remarkable generalization, but their inference delays can conflict with the demands of real-time control. Asynchronous execution avoids pauses between action chunks by predicting the next sequence of actions while the robot carries out the previous one. In this paper, we study whether asynchronous execution produces the same action distribution as the original VLA. We find that, for non-Markovian demonstrations, asynchronous execution can produce a fundamentally different action distribution, which can limit the policy's reactivity. In our method, we seek to restore this reactivity by aligning the asynchronously produced action distribution with that of the original VLA through two complementary mechanisms. First, Recursive Flow-Field Distillation trains the asynchronous policy using the VLA's action-generation flow. We characterize the learned distribution theoretically and show experimentally that our asynchronous policy can generate nearly the full range of actions the original VLA would produce, while existing asynchronous methods recover only a fraction of that range. Second, Propose-Resolve prepares multiple action sequences asynchronously and uses the latest observation to select among them based on a lightweight approximation of their likelihood under the VLA's action distribution. Our resulting method matches the original VLA's success on LIBERO and retains about 80% of its success on RoboMimic, about 30 percentage points more than existing asynchronous methods.

AI.tldr: 本文研究异步执行是否会改变VLA策略的动作分布，发现非马尔可夫示教下会产生根本不同的分布，进而提出递归流场蒸馏与“提议-求解”两机制恢复反应性，在LIBERO与RoboMimic上显著优于现有异步方法。
AI.motivation: 通用机器人策略（如VLA）推理延迟与实时控制需求冲突；异步执行虽能避免动作块之间停顿，但可能导致其动作分布与原VLA不一致，限制策略反应性，因此需要探究并修复这一问题。
AI.method: 提出两种互补机制：(1) 递归流场蒸馏（Recursive Flow-Field Distillation），利用VLA的动作生成流训练异步策略，并对所学分布进行理论刻画；(2) 提议-求解（Propose-Resolve），异步生成多条动作序列，并用最新观测基于VLA动作分布下的轻量似然近似进行选择。
AI.result: 理论刻画显示异步策略能生成原VLA几乎完整的动作范围，而现有异步方法仅恢复其中一部分；在LIBERO上达到与原VLA相当的成功率，在RoboMimic上保留约80%成功率，比现有异步方法高约30个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 对于非马尔可夫示教，异步执行会产生与原VLA根本不同的动作分布并削弱反应性；通过递归流场蒸馏与提议-求解对齐分布，可在保持异步效率的同时恢复反应性并显著缩小性能差距。

title: Planning Oriented 3D Scene Completion via Coupled TUDF Occupancy Representation Learning from Partial Observations
summary: Partial observability remains a fundamental challenge in robotic navigation, where limited sensor coverage and occlusions leave large portions of the environment unobserved. Existing scene completion methods primarily focus on improving incomplete mapping or reconstructing partially observed 3D structures, but rarely investigate how scene completion can be designed to benefit downstream tasks such as path planning. In this work, we propose a path-planning-oriented 3D scene completion framework that moves beyond pure occupancy modeling toward a coupled geometric formulation. Specifically, given partial LiDAR observations as input, the proposed framework jointly predicts completed Truncated Unsigned Distance Field (TUDF)-based continuous geometric representations and voxel-wise occupancy maps. This coupled representation allows the network to better reason about obstacle boundaries and free-space geometry. To fully exploit the synergy between the two representations, we introduce a bidirectionally coupled learning scheme, where TUDF features provide dense geometric guidance to improve occupancy reconstruction, while occupancy features in turn offer complementary structural constraints that refine distance-field estimation. Consequently, the proposed network directly predicts complete occupancy and TUDF representations, allowing seamless integration of TUDF into trajectory planning without post-processing. Extensive experiments on unseen environments demonstrate that the proposed method consistently improves both geometric reconstruction quality and downstream planning performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向路径规划的3D场景补全框架，以部分LiDAR观测为输入，联合预测TUDF连续几何表示与体素占据栅格，并通过双向耦合学习提升几何重建与下游规划性能。
AI.motivation: 机器人导航中部分可观测问题突出，传感器覆盖有限与遮挡导致环境中大范围区域未被观测。现有场景补全方法多聚焦于改进不完整建图或重建部分观测的3D结构，很少研究如何设计场景补全以服务于路径规划等下游任务。
AI.method: 提出面向路径规划的3D场景补全框架，超越纯占据建模，采用耦合几何形式。输入部分LiDAR观测，网络联合预测基于截断无符号距离场（TUDF）的连续几何表示与体素级占据图。引入双向耦合学习机制：TUDF特征为占据重建提供稠密几何引导，占据特征反向提供结构约束以精化距离场估计。网络直接预测完整占据与TUDF表示，无需后处理即可将TUDF接入轨迹规划。
AI.result: 在未见环境上的大量实验表明，该方法在几何重建质量与下游规划性能两方面均取得一致改进。
AI.conclusion: 通过耦合TUDF与占据的双表示及双向学习，场景补全可有效增强障碍边界与自由空间几何推理，并直接服务于路径规划，验证了面向下游任务设计场景补全的可行性与有效性。

title: Learning to Explore Hidden Kinematics for Articulated Object Manipulation
summary: The kinematics of an articulated object is often ambiguous from vision alone. Interaction resolves the ambiguity, and active perception methods exploit this by searching for the single action that most sharpens a belief over the kinematic parameters at each step. Such greedy search cannot be extended over a horizon without forward models of the contact and inertial dynamics, which are themselves unknown. We instead amortize action selection into training. We maintain a belief distribution over joint type and parameters, initialized from a generative prior and updated by Bayesian filtering on the observed part motion. To condition the policy on this belief, we render it as a per-point articulation flow field, the motion that the current posterior predicts for every point on the object. Carrying the inductive bias of articulated motion, this representation generalizes better than a latent encoding of the belief or flow tracked from observation. We train the policy with reinforcement learning, rewarding the entropy that each interaction removes from the posterior, so that informative exploration becomes learned behavior rather than a search at every step. Our method outperforms previous approaches across door and drawer manipulation on the PartManip benchmark, and reaches 61.7% success on ArticuRiddle, a new dataset of objects whose appearance implies the wrong articulation, against 44.4% for the best previous method. Project Website: https://hiddenkinematics.github.io/

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将主动感知中的动作选择"摊销"到训练阶段：维护关节类型与参数的信念分布，并将其渲染为逐点关节流场来条件化策略，用强化学习以"信念熵减少"为奖励训练策略，在PartManip与ArticuRiddle上超越先前方法。
AI.motivation: 仅从视觉推断铰接物体（如门、抽屉）的运动学参数往往是歧义的，交互可以消解歧义。但现有主动感知方法采用贪心搜索，每一步寻找最能锐化信念的单一动作；这种贪心策略无法扩展到多步规划，因为需要接触动力学与惯性动力学的前向模型，而这些模型本身未知。因此需要一个无需显式前向模型、可学习长时程信息性探索的方法。
AI.method: 1) 维护关节类型与参数的信念分布，由生成式先验初始化，并基于观测到的部件运动通过贝叶斯滤波更新；2) 将该信念渲染为逐点关节流场（posterior预测的每个点的运动），以此条件化策略；3) 该表示携带铰接运动的归纳偏置，比信念的隐编码或从观测追踪的流场具有更好泛化性；4) 用强化学习训练策略，奖励为每次交互从后验中消除的熵，使信息性探索成为学习到的行为而非每步搜索。
AI.result: 在PartManip基准的门与抽屉操作任务上优于先前方法；在ArticuRiddle（新数据集，物体外观暗示错误的关节方式）上达到61.7%成功率，而最佳先前方法为44.4%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将动作选择摊销到训练中，并以信念条件化的逐点关节流场表示加熵减奖励的强化学习，可在不使用未知动力学前向模型的条件下实现有效的信息性主动感知，在标准与外观误导场景下均取得显著性能提升。

title: A robust single-sensing-element tactile sensor for concurrent pressure and tackiness detection with real-time signal decoupling capability
summary: Integrating tackiness sensation into the artificial skin of humanoid robots significantly enhances their cognitive and operational capabilities. However existing tactile sensors face challenges in decoupling of the multimodal signal and stability. Here we present a surface-soft tactile sensor that incorporates a Hall effect sensor and a soft magnetic composite within a robust elastic framework. The sensor surface indents under pressure and bulges prominently when retracted from sticky surfaces dynamically altering the Hall sensor-magnet distance. This generates whole-process-traceable and baseline-separated signals enabling real-time differentiation between pressure and pull-off force. This single-sensing-element design facilitates bimodal sensing at the same contact spot while eliminate stress cross-talk enhancing both accuracy and sensitivity. The fusion of a robust framework and magneto-mechanical sensing mechanism equips the sensor with exceptional reliability and excellent signal baseline stability. This tactile sensor holds substantial potential for advancing robotic capabilities in evaluating adhesive properties monitoring rubber aging precisely handling lightweight objects and cognizing natural objects surface characteristics.

AI.tldr: 提出一种表面柔软触觉传感器，将霍尔效应传感器与软磁复合材料集成于弹性框架中，利用按压凹陷与脱粘隆起导致霍尔-磁体距离变化的机制，实现压力与拉脱力的实时双模态区分，并具备高可靠性与基线稳定性。
AI.motivation: 将粘性感（tackiness）融入人形机器人人工皮肤可显著提升其认知与操作能力，但现有触觉传感器在多模态信号解耦和稳定性方面存在挑战。
AI.method: 在坚固弹性框架内集成霍尔效应传感器与软磁复合材料；传感器表面受压时凹陷、从粘性表面脱离时显著隆起，动态改变霍尔传感器与磁体之间的距离，从而产生全过程可追踪且基线分离的信号。
AI.result: 单一传感元件在同一接触点实现双模态感知，消除应力串扰，提升精度与灵敏度；坚固框架与磁-机械传感机制的融合带来优异可靠性与出色信号基线稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 该触觉传感器在评估粘附性能、监测橡胶老化、精确操作轻质物体以及认知自然物体表面特性等机器人能力方面具有重大应用潜力。

title: Riemannian Splat Regression Models for Learning Time Fields on Arbitrary Riemannian Manifolds
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, Spotlight Paper at IEEE/RSJ IROS Workshop on Geometric Representations in Robotics
summary: Motion planning on arbitrary Riemannian manifolds is an important and difficult problem that frustrates typical planning methods for Euclidean spaces. In particular, motion planning methods that approximate optimal time-to-go functions with neural networks, e.g., Neural Time Fields (NTFields), cannot be directly applied without using ad-hoc coordinate projections into higher dimensions. Using these methods directly without such projections is desirable, as it promises to provide the lowest-possible-runtime method for obtaining optimal plans on high-dimensional manifolds while using minimal model capacity. In this work, we develop a model that requires no coordinate projection and can learn arbitrary functions on Riemannian manifolds by combining splat regression models with splats defined by wrapped Gaussian distributions. We successfully apply this model for learning arrival time fields on several Riemannian manifolds, and we compare the accuracy and model size of this approach with multi-layer perceptrons adapted to work on each manifold individually.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于包裹高斯分布样条回归的模型，无需坐标投影即可在任意黎曼流形上学习到达时间场，用于运动规划。
AI.motivation: 黎曼流形上的运动规划是重要且困难的问题，传统欧氏空间方法难以直接适用。基于神经网络的到达时间（time-to-go）函数逼近方法（如NTFields）若要不依赖人为的高维坐标投影，就无法直接应用。作者希望找到一种无需坐标投影、模型容量最小且运行时间最低的方法，从而在高维流形上获得最优规划。
AI.method: 将splat regression（样条回归）模型与由wrapped Gaussian分布（包裹高斯分布）定义的splats（样条基函数）相结合，构造出可直接定义在黎曼流形上的函数逼近模型，无需任何坐标投影。
AI.result: 在多个黎曼流形上成功学习了arrival time fields（到达时间场），并与分别为每个流形定制的多层感知机（MLP）比较了精度和模型规模。
AI.conclusion: 该方法无需坐标投影，可在任意黎曼流形上学习任意函数，并成功应用于到达时间场学习，为流形上的高效运动规划提供了新途径。

title: EquivDP3: A SIM(3)-Invariant Point-Cloud Encoder for Data-Efficient Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. A shorter version has been submitted to ICASSP 2027
summary: Visuomotor policies for humanoid loco-manipulation must generalize across object poses and lighting from only a handful of demonstrations. 3D Diffusion Policy (DP3) conditions a diffusion-based action generator on point-cloud features, but its PointNet-style encoder has no built-in equivariance to the rotations, translations, and scalings (SIM(3)) that manipulation tasks respect. EquiBot closed this gap for wheeled manipulators with a SIM(3)-equivariant Vector Neuron Network (VNN) encoder. We extend this to a substantially more complex embodiment, the 43-joint Unitree G1 humanoid, and propose EquivDP3: a two-stage policy where a high-level diffusion planner with a SIM(3)-equivariant VNN encoder emits 6 Hz whole-body command chunks, executed at 50 Hz by a frozen, pre-trained RL locomotion policy and a differential inverse-kinematics module for the arms, trained end-to-end by behavior cloning. Across two simulated IsaacLab benchmarks and four non-equivariant baselines (5-100 demonstrations, in- and out-of-distribution), EquivDP3's advantage concentrates in the low-data regime: at 5-10 demonstrations it reaches 67.1% success versus 38.2-52.4% for the baselines, while by 50-100 all encoders converge (74.3-85.2%) and the ordering is no longer meaningful. A proprioception-only control confirms this gap is genuinely perceptual: with the point cloud removed, success drops to 31% vs. 60% (EquivDP3) at 5 demonstrations and 78% vs. 99% at 10, but vanishes by 50-100, showing the high-data plateau reflects a benchmark ceiling, not five encoders learning the same invariance. The encoder costs only 0.8 ms of extra latency per action chunk over the PointNet encoder it replaces. Baking geometric symmetry into a hierarchical diffusion policy's perception backbone is a practical, nearly free way to improve data efficiency for humanoid loco-manipulation when demonstrations are scarce.

AI.tldr: 提出EquivDP3：将SIM(3)等变VNN编码器引入分层扩散策略，用于Unitree G1人形机器人全身运动-操作，在少样本（5-10次演示）下成功率67.1%，显著优于非等变基线，编码器仅增加0.8 ms延迟。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人loco-manipulation的视觉运动策略需仅凭少量演示泛化到不同物体位姿与光照。DP3用点云特征条件化扩散动作生成器，但其PointNet式编码器不具备操纵任务所需的SIM(3)（旋转、平移、缩放）内禀等变性；EquiBot已在轮式机械臂上用SIM(3)等变VNN编码器弥补该缺陷，但尚未扩展到更复杂的人形本体，且需验证其数据效率增益是否真实来源于感知等变性。
AI.method: 提出EquivDP3两阶段策略：高层扩散规划器配备SIM(3)等变VNN编码器，输出6 Hz全身指令块；由冻结的预训练RL运动策略以50 Hz执行下肢，手臂由差分逆运动学模块执行，整体以行为克隆端到端训练。在Unitree G1（43关节）上验证，对比2个IsaacLab仿真基准与4个非等变基线，覆盖5-100次演示及分布内/外条件；另设仅本体感觉对照实验以分离感知贡献，并测量编码器延迟。
AI.result: 优势集中于低数据区间：5-10次演示时EquivDP3成功率达67.1%，基线为38.2-52.4%；50-100次演示时所有编码器收敛（74.3-85.2%），排序不再有意义。仅本体感觉对照显示：移除点云后，5次演示成功率降至31%（EquivDP3为60%），10次为78% vs. 99%，但50-100次时差距消失，说明高数据平台期是基准上限而非各编码器学到相同不变性。编码器相对所替换的PointNet仅增加0.8 ms/动作块延迟。
AI.conclusion: 将几何对称性嵌入分层扩散策略的感知主干，是人形loco-manipulation在演示稀缺时提升数据效率的实用且近乎零成本的手段；低数据区间的增益确为感知层面等变性带来的，且不牺牲推理效率。

title: Inferring Soil Friction Angle from Robot Foot-Ground Force Histories: A Bayesian Inverse Approach to Proprioceptive Soil Sensing
summary: Foot-ground interaction signals recorded by quadruped robots may enable spatially distributed, in situ characterization of soil strength. As a first step, we test whether the internal friction angle $φ$ of cohesionless soil can be identified from the force history of a simplified rotating leg. A two-dimensional continuum model implemented with the material point method, benchmarked against measured rotating-leg force histories, generates the training data, and two Gaussian-process surrogates support Bayesian inversion of the full histories. In matched-model experiments, the framework recovers 14 off-grid friction angles with a median absolute error of approximately $0.1^\circ$ (maximum $\sim 0.7^\circ$); the reported credible intervals contain the true value in every case. These results establish that $φ$ is identifiable when the forward model is correctly specified, and support further development of proprioceptive soil sensing for spatially variable terrain, with applications from physics-grounded world models for robot training to post-wildfire slope assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文验证了四足机器人腿部与地面交互力信号能否用于识别无黏性土的内摩擦角φ。研究采用物质点法建立二维连续介质模型并生成训练数据，结合两个高斯过程代理模型进行贝叶斯反演。在同模型实验中，框架对14个非网格摩擦角的识别中位绝对误差约0.1°，最大约0.7°，且可信区间均覆盖真值。
AI.motivation: 四足机器人记录的地面交互信号有望实现空间分布式、原位土壤强度表征，但尚不明确土的力学参数能否从腿部力历史中被有效识别。本文旨在验证在正向模型正确设定时，无黏性土的内摩擦角φ是否可从简化旋转腿的力历史中识别，为利用本体感知进行土壤传感奠定基础。
AI.method: 采用物质点法实现二维连续介质模型，并以实测旋转腿力历史进行基准验证；利用该模型生成训练数据，训练两个高斯过程代理模型，从而支持对完整力历史的贝叶斯反演，实现对φ的后验推断。
AI.result: 在同模型（matched-model）实验中，框架成功恢复14个非网格摩擦角，中位绝对误差约0.1°，最大约0.7°；所报告的可信区间在全部案例中均包含真值，表明反向推断具有高精度和良好校准性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在正向模型正确设定的条件下，内摩擦角φ具有可识别性；这支持进一步发展本体感知土壤传感，用于空间变异地形的表征，并可应用于机器人训练的物理世界模型构建以及野火后边坡评估等场景。

title: Cooperative Multi-Agent Vision-Language-Action Models via Reinforced Fine Tuning
summary: We study reinforcement learning (RL) methods for cooperative multi-agent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. This problem is challenging because VLAs are pretrained on large-scale single-agent data and therefore lack the fine-grained coordination skills required for inter-robot collaboration. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on multi-robot demonstrations partially bridges this gap, but its performance is bounded by the demonstration data and cannot improve from its own experience. We present a three-stage reinforced fine-tuning (RFT) pipeline for multi-agent VLAs. First, initialization-aware data collection sweeps over initial configurations and invokes human demonstrations only when the pretrained VLA repeatedly fails, yielding robustness to initialization shift with reduced human cost. Second, offline credit-filtered tuning assigns credit to individual agents and fine-tunes on per-agent trajectories with positive advantage rather than on entire joint rollouts. Third, we find existing online RL for VLAs are less effective for hard multi-agent tasks, which we attribute to noisy co-exploration and unstable updates. We instead use online latent-space fine tuning, which freeze the VLA and perform RL in its latent noise space. We evaluate our multi-agent VLA with both $π_0$ and $π_{0.5}$ backbones across 11 tasks in RoboTwin, RoboFactory and real-world manipulation with two Franka robots. Our multi-agent VLA improves the average success rate by $+23.1\%$, $+16.4\%$, and $+44\%$ on RoboTwin, RoboFactory, and real-world tasks, respectively. Code available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/mavla_rft-2BC0/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向多智能体视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的三阶段强化微调（RFT）流程，通过初始化感知数据采集、离线信用过滤微调与在线潜空间微调，显著提升协作操作任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 多智能体VLA在单智能体大规模数据上预训练，缺乏机器人间细粒度协作能力；多机器人示教上的SFT受限于示教数据质量，且无法从自身经验中持续改进。
AI.method: 三阶段RFT管道：（1）初始化感知数据采集，遍历初始配置并仅在预训练VLA反复失败时调用人类示教，兼顾初始化偏移鲁棒性与低人工成本；（2）离线信用过滤微调，为各智能体分配信用，仅在个体轨迹正优势样本上微调，而非整条联合轨迹；（3）在线潜空间微调，针对硬多智能体任务中在线RL因协同探索噪声与更新不稳定而失效的问题，冻结VLA并在其潜在噪声空间进行RL。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin、RoboFactory及两台Franka真机操作共11个任务上，使用π₀与π₀.₅主干评估，平均成功率分别提升+23.1%、+16.4%与+44%。
AI.conclusion: 分层RFT（数据采集—离线信用过滤—在线潜空间RL）可有效将单智能体预训练VLA适配为协作多智能体策略，在仿真与真实场景均取得显著增益。

title: Simple Agentic Memory for Generalist Robot Policies
summary: Visual-memory systems commonly retain or compress past observations. Robot control additionally requires interaction-derived state that no individual frame may explicitly represent, such as persistent identity relations, accumulated progress, or ordered procedures. We introduce Simple Agentic Robot Memory (SimpleARM), a training-free memory layer for frozen generalist robot policies. From the task instruction, SimpleARM specifies what to monitor; frozen perceptual tools maintain compact typed state online; structured access retrieves that state only when a proposed subgoal depends on history; and current-view grounding resolves recalled entities before execution. We evaluate SimpleARM on RoboMME, a benchmark of memory-dependent robot manipulation tasks that require history information no longer available in the current observation. Across all 16 tasks and three policy seeds, SimpleARM achieves 67.17% mean success, compared with 44.51% for the strongest non-oracle baseline. Matched ablations show mechanism specificity: removing relation, reference, progress, or route state produces large losses where the affected state is retrieved for control, while largely sparing other tasks. These results support a state-based view of robot memory: effective memory for control is not simply retained visual history, but compact task-relevant state derived from the interaction history.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练记忆层SimpleARM，为冻结的通用机器人策略维护紧凑的类型化交互状态，在RoboMME的16个记忆依赖任务上平均成功率67.17%，显著优于44.51%的最强非oracle基线。
AI.motivation: 视觉记忆系统通常只保留或压缩过去的观测，但机器人控制还需要无法由单帧显式表示的交互派生状态，如持续的身份关系、累积进度或有序流程。因此需要一种面向控制的记忆机制，而非简单的视觉历史保留。
AI.method: SimpleARM是免训练的记忆层，附加在冻结的通用机器人策略之上。它由任务指令指定需要监控的内容；冻结的感知工具在线维护紧凑的类型化状态；结构化访问仅在提议的子目标依赖历史时检索该状态；当前视图接地在执行前解析被回忆的实体。
AI.result: 在RoboMME基准（需历史信息的记忆依赖机器人操作任务）上，覆盖16个任务与3个策略种子，SimpleARM平均成功率67.17%，最强非oracle基线为44.51%。匹配消融显示机制特异性：移除关系、引用、进度或路径状态，会在相应状态被检索用于控制的任务上造成大幅损失，而对其他任务影响很小。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持机器人记忆的"状态观"：面向控制的有效记忆并非简单保留的视觉历史，而是从交互历史中导出的紧凑任务相关状态。

title: HACo: Learning Haptic Active Compliance for Force-Aware Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Contact-rich dexterous manipulation requires policies that translate physical feedback into motion commands while regulating interaction loads across evolving multi-contact interactions. This requires haptic observations of contact state and action supervision showing how commands should adapt. Existing policies often overlook complementary fingertip tactile and joint-torque feedback, while common action targets either encode excessive loading or omit motion constrained by the object. We introduce HACo, a Haptic Active Compliance policy that learns force-regulating actions directly from haptic feedback. Compliance-regulated teleoperation converts operator inputs into controller-executable compliant actions that preserve motion intent while regulating loads. HACo learns these actions directly, using command-state discrepancy as auxiliary compliant-intent supervision. It combines local fingertip tactile responses with joint-torque feedback capturing load transmission through the articulated hand, including contacts beyond tactile coverage. A Compliance Grounding Module uses gated haptic cross-attention to ground action generation in the evolving haptic state, enabling closed-loop force regulation without explicit online contact modeling. We evaluate HACo on a real-world benchmark covering multi-contact friction, tangential interaction, fragile curved-surface contact, rotational torque, and deformable-object manipulation. Across 20 trials per task, HACo achieves an 83% mean success rate, compared with 35% for the strongest evaluated baseline. These results demonstrate active compliance across diverse force-sensitive dexterous manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HACo，一种基于触觉反馈的主动柔顺策略，直接从触觉反馈中学习力调节动作，在力敏感灵巧操作任务上达到83%平均成功率，显著优于最强基线35%。
AI.motivation: 接触丰富的灵巧操作需要将物理反馈转化为运动指令，并在多接触交互中调节接触载荷，这依赖于对接触状态的触觉观测以及指令如何调整的动作监督。然而现有策略常忽略指尖触觉与关节力矩反馈的互补性，且常用动作目标要么编码过大载荷，要么遗漏被物体约束的运动。
AI.method: 提出HACo（Haptic Active Compliance）策略，从触觉反馈直接学习力调节动作。采用柔顺调节遥操作，将操作者输入转换为控制器可执行的柔顺动作，在保持运动意图的同时调节载荷；以指令-状态差异作为柔顺意图的辅助监督。融合局部指尖触觉响应与关节力矩反馈（捕捉关节手内的载荷传递，包括触觉覆盖之外的接触）。引入Compliance Grounding Module，通过门控触觉交叉注意力将动作生成锚定于演化的触觉状态，实现无需显式在线接触建模的闭环力调节。
AI.result: 在涵盖多接触摩擦、切向交互、易碎曲面接触、旋转力矩与可变形物体操作的真实世界基准上评估，每任务20次试验，HACo平均成功率达83%，最强基线为35%。
AI.conclusion: HACo通过融合指尖触觉与关节力矩反馈并基于触觉状态锚定动作生成，实现了跨多种力敏感灵巧操作任务的主动柔顺，验证了触觉驱动动作学习在闭环力调节中的有效性。

title: Executor-aware Candidate Selection via a Feasibility Certificate
summary:
Modular robotic systems often separate motion planning from a downstream executor that enforces state-dependent hard constraints. A candidate that is geometrically valid may therefore be incompatible with the executor's available command set. We present a certificate-based candidate-selection framework that constructs a command witness from the executor hard set at predicted rollout states and verifies it against the original constraints, without changing candidate generation, ranking, or the executor.
  Across 5,085 geometry-valid numerical evaluations on two robot models, 795 admitted no executor-feasible command. The certificate is sufficient but conservative: none of the 795 was certified, while 7.09\% of reference-feasible cases remained uncertified. In controlled FR3 and fixed-base RB-Y1 simulations, certificate admission frequently changed candidate selection, and a post-hoc exact linear-programming (LP) admission baseline revealed platform-dependent conservatism. Relative to geometry-based selection, certificate admission was associated with lower planner-command coverage and higher nominal tracking error, without a consistent advantage in reached-state interaction reserve. A planner-generated MoveIt/OMPL study further evaluates the same admission rule on externally generated candidate pools.

AI.tldr: 提出基于证书的候选选择框架：在执行器硬约束集合上构造命令见证并在预测展开状态处对原约束验证，从而在不改动候选生成、排序与执行器的前提下筛除几何可行但执行器不可行的候选。
AI.motivation: 模块化机器人系统中运动规划与下游执行器分离，执行器施加状态相关的硬约束，导致几何有效的候选可能与执行器可用命令集不兼容。
AI.method: 在预测展开状态处，从执行器硬集合构造命令见证，并将其对原始约束进行验证的证书式候选准入框架；保持候选生成、排序和执行器不变，并与后验精确线性规划（LP）准入基线对比。
AI.result: 5,085次几何有效数值评估（两个机器人模型）中795次不存在执行器可行命令；该证书充分但保守，795例均未获认证，而参考可行案例中7.09%未被认证。FR3与固定基座RB-Y1仿真中认证准入常改变候选选择，LP基线显示平台相关保守性；相较几何选择，认证准入伴随更低规划器-命令覆盖率与更高标称跟踪误差，且未在到达状态交互裕度上体现一致优势；另以MoveIt/OMPL研究在外部候选池上评估同一准入规则。
AI.conclusion: 证书式准入提供了充分但保守的执行器可行性筛选，能检测部分不可行候选；其选择效应与性能影响依平台而异，未显示交互裕度上的稳定收益。

title: OTRetarget: Joint Robot and Object Motion Retargeting via Optimal Transport
summary: Transferring human motion to humanoid robots requires adapting the demonstrated motion to the robot morphology while preserving interactions with the environment. This is particularly challenging for loco-manipulation tasks, where contacts with the ground and manipulated objects must remain consistent despite differences in body proportions. Yet, skeletal motion alone does not fully describe these interactions, and fixing object trajectories limits the adaptation to a new embodiment. In this paper, we introduce OTR ETARGET, a unified approach to jointly retarget robot and multi-object motion from human demonstrations. Our approach represents surface interactions through signed distances, closest surface points, and relative directions, and uses entropic optimal transport to transfer these quantities across human, robot, and object geometries. We incorporate the resulting interaction targets into a constrained inverse kinematics formulation that balances contact preservation with motion style and jointly optimizes robot and object poses at each frame. This formulation accommodates robot-object and object-object interactions without rescaling the scene or the demonstration. We validate the proposed approach on OMOMO, where it achieves a robot- object interaction Jaccard score of 87% and a depth error of 8.7 mm, compared with 28% and 29.3 mm for OmniRetarget. Finally, we demonstrate transfer to a physical G1 humanoid using whole-body policies trained with reinforcement learning on the retargeted references, across motions including two-handed box pick-and-place onto a table.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OTR ETARGET，一种联合重定向机器人与多物体运动的方法，通过表面交互表示与熵最优传输将人类演示迁移至人形机器人，兼顾接触保持与运动风格。
AI.motivation: 将人类运动迁移到人形机器人时，需在保持与环境交互的前提下适配机器人形态。对于移动操作任务，地面与操作对象接触需在身体比例差异下保持一致，而仅靠骨骼运动无法完整描述交互，固定物体轨迹又限制了新形态的适配。
AI.method: 以有符号距离、最近表面点与相对方向表示表面交互，使用熵最优传输在人类、机器人、物体几何间迁移这些量；将得到的交互目标纳入约束逆运动学，平衡接触保持与运动风格，并逐帧联合优化机器人与物体位姿，支持机器人-物体及物体-物体交互，无需对场景或演示进行缩放。
AI.result: 在OMOMO上，机器人-物体交互Jaccard得分达87%、深度误差8.7 mm，而OmniRetarget分别为28%和29.3 mm。进一步在实体G1人形机器人上，利用重定向参考经强化学习训练全身策略，完成双手搬箱并放置到桌面等动作。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可有效联合重定向机器人与多物体运动，显著提升接触一致性，并成功迁移至真实人形机器人。

title: RoboChrono: A Real Robot Benchmark for Streaming Task Understanding
comment: 15 pages, 7 figures. Project website: https://continuity3.github.io/robochrono/ ; Code: https://github.com/mfan-res/ROBOCHRONO ; Datasets: https://huggingface.co/datasets/gimai/RC-Tianji and https://huggingface.co/datasets/gimai/RC-GIM
summary: Understanding ongoing robot manipulation requires models to interpret visual observations in relation to interaction history and task progress. We introduce RoboChrono, a benchmark for streaming task understanding comprising 39 scenarios and 34,713 evaluation instances, constructed from real robot executions and complementary bare-hand human recordings. The benchmark evaluates seven tasks grouped into recognition, alignment, and temporal grounding, covering action understanding and anticipation, visual correspondence, temporal ordering, and action localization. Zero-shot evaluation of 18 vision-language models reveals substantial differences across tasks. GPT-6-Astra achieves 98.3% accuracy on Frame Matching but 68.3% on Frame Ordering, while RynnBrain1.1-122B-A10B exhibits a larger gap, reaching 95.4% and 32.9%, respectively. Input ablations on matched questions with five open-weight models further reveal distinct dependencies on visual evidence: removing visual observations reduces Current Action Recognition accuracy by 22.1 percentage points, whereas Next Action Prediction decreases by only 0.7 points. These findings show that strong visual matching does not consistently coincide with strong temporal ordering, and suggest that next-action prediction can be supported by task and action priors even when visual evidence is unavailable. RoboChrono provides a diagnostic setting for examining these differences, highlighting the need for capability-specific evaluation beyond aggregate scores when assessing task understanding in robot manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RoboChrono，一个面向机器人操作流式任务理解的基准，包含 39 个场景、34,713 个评测实例，覆盖识别、对齐与时间定位三类共七项任务；对 18 个视觉-语言模型的零样本评测显示模型能力差异显著，且强视觉匹配并不等同于强时间排序能力。
AI.motivation: 理解持续的机器人操作要求模型将视觉观测与交互历史和任务进度关联起来，但现有评测多依赖聚合分数，难以诊断模型在具体能力维度上的真实表现。
AI.method: 构建 RoboChrono 基准：基于真实机器人执行与配套的裸手人类录制数据，涵盖 39 个场景、34,713 个评测实例；设计七项任务并归为识别、对齐、时间定位三组，涉及动作理解与预测、视觉对应、时间排序和动作定位；对 18 个视觉-语言模型进行零样本评测，并对 5 个开源权重模型在匹配问题上做输入消融实验。
AI.result: GPT-6-Astra 在 Frame Matching 上达 98.3%，但在 Frame Ordering 上仅 68.3%；RynnBrain1.1-122B-A10B 差距更大，分别为 95.4% 与 32.9%。输入消融显示，移除视觉观测使 Current Action Recognition 准确率下降 22.1 个百分点，而 Next Action Prediction 仅下降 0.7 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 强视觉匹配能力不必然带来强时间排序能力；下一动作预测即使在缺乏视觉证据时也可由任务与动作先验支撑。RoboChrono 提供了诊断性评测环境，表明评估机器人操作任务理解时需要面向具体能力而非仅依赖聚合分数。

title: Foundation-Model-Guided Topology-Aware Semantic Risk Fields for Manipulation
summary: Robot motion planning in everyday environments must satisfy hard geometric constraints while accounting for context-dependent semantic risk. We present a foundation-model-guided, topology-aware semantic risk field that extends manipulation safety beyond collision avoidance. For each manipulated-object/scene-object pair, a foundation model provides six directional risk weights and a pair-specific spatial decay scale. The method combines these priors with voxelized 3D scene geometry using topology-aware shielding and geodesic spatial decay. A GPU-parallel backend batches object-level distance and risk computations to construct a dense 3D field that serves as a modular cost for downstream motion planning. We evaluate the field's shielding behavior under full and partial barriers and compare its 3D workspace representation with a pixel-wise semantic-prior baseline. Across three household simulation scenarios, trajectories optimized with the proposed field have lower semantic exposure than collision-only trajectories under the same geometric constraints. We also evaluate the computational practicality and reliability of the supporting pipeline. Together, these results support the proposed field as a practical topology-aware semantic cost representation for manipulation planning beyond collision avoidance.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于基础模型的拓扑感知语义风险场，将六向风险权重与对特定空间衰减尺度融入体素化3D几何，通过拓扑感知屏蔽与测地衰减构建稠密3D场作为运动规划模块化代价，实验表明其语义暴露低于纯避碰轨迹且计算可行。
AI.motivation: 日常环境中机器人运动规划不仅要满足硬几何约束，还需考虑依赖上下文的语义风险；传统避碰仅保证几何安全，无法刻画操作物体与场景物体之间的语义风险暴露，因此需要一种能将语义先验与几何约束统一表达的代价表示。
AI.method: 对每个被操作物体/场景物体对，用基础模型给出六个方向性风险权重和一个对特定空间衰减尺度；将这些先验与体素化3D场景几何结合，采用拓扑感知屏蔽和测地空间衰减；GPU并行后端批量计算物体级距离与风险，构建稠密3D语义风险场，作为下游运动规划的模块化代价。
AI.result: 在完整与部分屏障条件下评估屏蔽行为，并将3D工作空间表示与逐像素语义先验基线对比；在三个家庭仿真场景中，相同几何约束下用该场优化的轨迹语义暴露低于仅避碰轨迹；同时评估了支撑流程的计算实用性与可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明该语义风险场可作为超越避碰的、拓扑感知的实用语义代价表示，用于操作规划，兼顾语义安全与几何约束，并具备计算可行性。

title: Where Predictive Supervision Goes Shapes What VLA Policies Learn
comment: 38 pages (9 pages main text + appendix), 13 figures, 21 tables
summary: Future prediction is increasingly used to improve vision-language-action (VLA) policies, based on the premise that anticipating scene evolution encourages representations useful for control. However, forecast quality alone does not establish that a policy has learned a better representation for action. This distinction matters under distribution shift, where successful control depends on preserving spatial state and likely scene change beyond familiar configurations. We study what determines whether predictive supervision improves the visual representation used by a VLA policy. Through controlled comparisons with matched target constructions, prediction horizons, and training conditions, we find that different prediction interfaces produce markedly different forecasts and visual representations, including in the spatial, dynamics, and action information that transfers beyond familiar scenes. We trace these differences to how predictive errors shape the policy's visual stream. Consistent with this controlled finding, VLA policies trained with more direct, scene-matched future supervision show stronger robustness under simulated and physical distribution shifts. Together, our results frame future prediction as a representation-learning design problem whose value for control depends on whether its supervision reaches the representations through which the policy acts.

AI.tldr: 本文研究未来预测监督如何影响VLA策略的视觉表征：预测质量本身不等于控制所需的表征质量，只有"直接、场景匹配"的未来监督才能真正提升分布偏移下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 未来预测被广泛用于改进VLA策略，其前提是"预判场景演化能促使表征有利于控制"。但预测质量好并不必然意味着策略学到了更好的动作表征，这一区分在分布偏移下尤为关键——此时控制成功依赖保持空间状态与合理的场景变化。论文旨在厘清：何种因素决定预测监督能否改进VLA策略实际使用的视觉表征。
AI.method: 在匹配目标构造、预测时域与训练条件下进行受控对比，比较不同预测接口（不同形式的未来监督）所生成的预测与视觉表征，并追踪预测误差如何塑造策略的视觉流。随后在仿真与物理分布偏移下验证受控结论。
AI.result: 不同预测接口产生显著不同的预测结果与视觉表征，差异体现在可迁移到新场景的空间、动态与动作信息上；这些差异源于预测误差对策略视觉流的不同塑造方式。与受控发现一致，采用更直接、场景匹配的未来监督训练的VLA策略，在仿真与物理分布偏移下展现出更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 未来预测应被视为一个表征学习的设计问题：它对控制的价值取决于其监督信号是否能作用于策略据以行动的表征。预测质量高不等于表征好，监督的"可达性/匹配度"才是关键。

title: Kinematic Nonlinear Spatio-Temporal Trajectory Warping for Contact-Rich Dexterous Manipulation Demonstrations
summary: We present a straightforward but effective method for repurposing existing contact-rich dexterous manipulation demonstrations. Starting from inputs of hand and object trajectories, our method outputs high-quality nonlinear trajectory warps that account for intermediate waypoints, environmental barriers, temporal shifts, and varied start/end configurations. Foundational to our method is the utilization of contact distributions, which we show allows us to reliably compute complex and high-dimensional dexterous hand trajectories following a simple object-centric warp specification pipeline. We evaluate our method across 12 variations sourced from 4 demonstrations in a publicly available dataset of human hand motion data, perform baseline comparisons, and demonstrate generalization of our approach to different manipulators. Results and code will be made available on publication.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于接触分布的高质量非线性轨迹变形方法，用于复用已有的富接触灵巧操作示范，支持中间路点、障碍物、时间偏移及不同起止构型，并在12种变体上验证，且可泛化到不同机械手。
AI.motivation: 已有灵巧操作示范数据获取成本高，直接复用困难；现有方法难以处理中间路点、环境障碍、时间偏移和起止构型变化等高维复杂需求。作者希望以简单有效的方式改造（repurpose）现有富接触灵巧操作示范。
AI.method: 以手部和物体轨迹为输入，围绕"接触分布"这一核心表征，采用简单的以物体为中心的warp specification流程，计算并输出高质量非线性轨迹变形，从而生成满足中间路点、环境障碍、时间偏移与不同起止构型的新的灵巧手轨迹。
AI.result: 在公开人手运动数据集上，基于4个示范构造12种变体进行评估，并与基线方法比较；同时展示了方法向不同机械手（manipulator）的泛化能力。结果与代码将在论文发表时公开。
AI.conclusion: 接触分布可作为可靠的核心表征，使高维灵巧手轨迹的复杂变形得以通过简单的以物体为中心的规范流程实现；方法在多种变体和不同机械手上均有效，为示范复用提供了通用途径。

title: T$^2$Mem: Learning Test-Time Memory for Robotics
summary: Memory-dependent robotic manipulation requires policies to use information that is no longer available in the current observation. Retaining history alone is insufficient: memory must preserve information that supports future actions. One challenge is whether a memory-free foundation model can learn to retain and use historical information from action demonstrations alone, without external memory support. We introduce T$^2$Mem, a framework that develops this capability within a pretrained vision-language-action policy, without external reasoning models or memory-specific annotations. T$^2$Mem uses test-time training to encode observation history into compact fast weights through online self-supervised updates, avoiding repeated processing of the full history. An observation-grounded interface extracts vision-language information for memory formation and supplies retrieved context to the action expert. Action supervision shapes what the memory learns to retain and use, while alternating memory-policy learning gives each component a fixed counterpart during optimization. Across 16 RoboMME tasks, T$^2$Mem improves average success from 17.93% to 56.83% over the memory-free base policy and outperforms the recurrent-memory methods reported in the benchmark, while controlled profiling indicates at least 3x inference speedup over explicit methods. Project website: https://yzliu84.github.io/T2MEM-project/

AI.tldr: T²Mem 让无记忆的预训练视觉-语言-动作策略通过测试时训练将观测历史压缩为快速权重，从而获得记忆依赖的机器人操作能力。
AI.motivation: 记忆依赖的机器人操作要求策略利用当前观测中已不存在的信息，而仅保留历史并不足够，记忆必须保留能支持未来动作的信息。核心问题在于：无记忆的基础模型能否仅从动作示范中学会保留并使用历史信息，而不依赖外部记忆支持或记忆专用标注。
AI.method: T²Mem 在预训练视觉-语言-动作策略内构建该能力，无需外部推理模型或记忆专用标注。它采用测试时训练，通过在线自监督更新把观测历史编码为紧凑的快速权重，避免重复处理完整历史；并以观测为锚的接口提取视觉-语言信息用于记忆形成，向动作专家提供检索到的上下文。动作监督塑造记忆保留和使用的内容，交替的记忆-策略学习保证优化时各组件拥有固定的对应方。
AI.result: 在 16 个 RoboMME 任务上，T²Mem 将平均成功率从无记忆基策略的 17.93% 提升至 56.83%，优于基准中报告的循环记忆方法；受控剖析显示其相对显式方法至少有 3 倍推理加速。
AI.conclusion: 无记忆的预训练 VLA 策略无需外部记忆模块或标注，仅借助测试时训练与动作监督即可在策略内部习得并有效利用历史信息，在成功率与推理效率上均优于现有记忆方法。

title: Degeneracy-Orthogonal Geometric Constraints for LiDAR SLAM
summary: Autonomous robot navigation relies on simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) to estimate motion and maintain an accurate pose within an environment. However, in axially uniform corridors such as long tunnels and pipelines, LiDAR odometry is fundamentally limited by unconstrained drift along the feature-weak travel direction. This structural degeneracy cannot be resolved by local scan matching alone. To address this challenge, we propose the Degeneracy-orthogonal Contour Offset Descriptor (DeCOD), a structure-aligned geometric descriptor for cross-sectional landmarks. Cross-sectional boundaries, such as pipe joints and structural rings, provide metric constraints along this degenerate axis, but distinguishing individual landmarks requires capturing subtle surface variations across nearly identical profiles. The descriptor parameterizes signed normal deviation from estimated boundary contours, and matching explicitly resolves heading ambiguity and decouples first-order contour errors by distortion estimation. Matched landmarks yield geometric factors that enforce agreement in cross-section position and corridor axis alignment during pose-graph optimization, correcting longitudinal drift while leaving rotation about the common axis unconstrained. On a public benchmark and in field experiments, DeCOD achieves robust landmark retrieval over standard 3D descriptors and successfully stabilizes trajectories across different odometry frontends, reliably constraining longitudinal drift under geometric degeneracy.

AI.tldr: 提出DeCOD——一种结构对齐的截面地标几何描述子，利用管道接头、结构环等截面边界为退化方向提供度量约束，通过在位姿图优化中引入几何因子校正轴向漂移，在公开基准与实地实验中稳定了多种里程计前端的轨迹。
AI.motivation: 在长隧道、管道等轴向均匀场景中，LiDAR里程计因行进方向特征稀疏而产生不可约束的漂移，这种结构性退化无法仅靠局部扫描匹配解决，需要引入沿退化轴具有度量信息的截面地标。
AI.method: 将截面边界（管道接头、结构环）建模为地标，参数化其相对估计边界轮廓的有符号法向偏差构成描述子；匹配时显式消解航向歧义，并通过畸变估计解耦一阶轮廓误差；匹配后的地标生成几何因子加入位姿图优化，约束截面位置与巷道轴向对齐，而不约束绕公共轴的旋转。
AI.result: 在公开基准和实地实验中，DeCOD的地标检索鲁棒性优于标准3D描述子，并在不同里程计前端下成功稳定轨迹，在几何退化条件下可靠约束纵向漂移。
AI.conclusion: 面向轴向均匀走廊的几何退化问题，结构对齐的截面地标描述子可有效补充局部扫描匹配的不足，为长隧道与管道环境提供稳定的纵向约束方案。

title: LexiconVLA: Learning Reusable Atomic Action Codebooks for Unseen Tasks
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models struggle to reuse recurring interactions in unseen tasks. Our diagnostic study reveals that reliable task completion does not imply consistent execution of constituent atomic actions across task contexts. We present LexiconVLA, a retrievable atomic-action lexicon for cross-task reuse. Global and detail codebooks capture shared interaction structure and fine-grained execution variation, respectively, preserving both reusable patterns and execution details. Visual-Atomic Action Alignment couples trajectory reconstruction from visual state changes with visual outcome prediction from action codes, grounding the lexicon in motion and its effects. We learn these codebooks with trajectory reconstruction and visual alignment on our AtomAction Dataset of 57,803 segments from 69 tasks. A planner and scene-aware adapter translate new goals into code-conditioned subtasks for a shared policy, without skill-specific experts or deployment-time parameter updates. Across five policy backbones on 26 RLBench tasks, LexiconVLA largely maintains performance on 18 seen tasks while improving success on 8 tasks held out from policy training. With BridgeVLA, unseen-task success rises from 16.67% to 34.17% (+17.50 percentage points), and overall success reaches 71.08%, the highest among methods with reported results. Real-robot experiments demonstrate stepwise execution and failure recovery.

AI.tldr: LexiconVLA 提出可检索的原子动作词典，用于跨任务复用交互模式，在多个策略骨架上提升未见任务成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型难以在未见任务中复用反复出现的交互；诊断研究发现任务完成可靠并不代表组成原子动作在各任务上下文中执行一致，说明存在跨任务复用障碍。
AI.method: 构建全局与细节双码本以分别捕捉共享交互结构和细粒度执行变化；通过视觉-原子动作对齐，将视觉状态变化驱动的轨迹重建与动作码驱动的视觉结果预测耦合；在 AtomAction Dataset（69 任务、57,803 段）上以轨迹重建和视觉对齐学习码本；用规划器与场景感知适配器将新目标转化为码条件子任务，交给共享策略执行，无需技能专家或部署期参数更新。
AI.result: 在 26 个 RLBench 任务、5 种策略骨架上，18 个已见任务性能基本保持，8 个策略训练未见任务成功率提升；与 BridgeVLA 结合时，未见任务成功率从 16.67% 提升至 34.17%（+17.50 个百分点），总体成功率达 71.08%，为已报道结果中最高；真实机器人实验展示逐步执行与失败恢复。
AI.conclusion: 可检索原子动作词典能有效支持跨任务复用，在不牺牲已见任务性能的前提下增强未见任务泛化，并具备真实机器人部署潜力。

title: Scale-Invariant Manipulability Shape Tracking Across Heterogeneous Manipulators
summary: When transferring manipulability across systems with different sizes and kinematic structures, matching absolute ellipsoid scale may be unnecessary when the goal is to reproduce orientation and semi-axis length ratios. Full-matrix tracking, however, penalizes both shape and absolute-scale differences, even when only shape matching is required. We therefore propose a scale-invariant manipulability shape-tracking method that treats matrices differing only by a positive scalar factor as equivalent and uses their unit-determinant representatives. We derive the differential of the unit-determinant shape representative and an orthonormal coordinate representation of the tangent tracking residual under the affine-invariant Riemannian metric (AIRM). The resulting scale-invariant objective is integrated with position and end-effector direction tasks in a constrained joint-velocity quadratic program. Simulations with four heterogeneous robots evaluate robot-to-robot and human-to-robot transfer. On three followers, the proposed method achieves endpoint shape distances of 9.30 x 10^-5 without scale tuning. With robot-specific target scales tuned during motion, the Full method retains endpoint axis-ratio errors of 0.19-0.31 on KR500 and UR20. For human reaching with concurrent tasks, the proposed method yields dual force shapes elongated along X like the human target on all four robots, with endpoint position errors of 2.4-5.6% of reference arm length versus up to 75% for the Full method tracking the original human ellipsoid.

AI.tldr: 提出尺度不变的"可操作度形状跟踪"方法，以单位行列式矩阵为代表，在AIRM下的切空间残差与位置/末端方向任务统一求解，实现异构机器人间及人-机器人迁移。
AI.motivation: 跨尺寸、跨运动学结构系统迁移可操作度时，若目标只是复现椭球的朝向与半轴长度比，则无需匹配绝对尺度；而全矩阵跟踪会同时惩罚形状与绝对尺度差异，造成不必要的约束与误差。
AI.method: 将仅相差正标量因子的矩阵视为等价，取单位行列式代表进行形状表征；推导单位行列式形状代表的微分，并在仿射不变黎曼度量(AIRM)下给出切空间跟踪残差的正交坐标表示；将所得尺度不变目标与位置、末端方向任务一起纳入带约束的关节速度二次规划。
AI.result: 在四台异构机器人上评估机器人-机器人及人-机器人迁移。三台跟随者无需尺度调参即达到9.30×10^-5的末端形状距离；在KR500与UR20上，边运动边调参的Full方法末端轴比误差仍为0.19-0.31。人类伸手并发任务中，所提方法在四台机器人上均得到沿X方向拉长的双力形状，与人类目标一致，末端位置误差为参考臂长的2.4%-5.6%，而Full方法跟踪原始人类椭球时误差最高达75%。
AI.conclusion: 以形状（而非绝对尺度）为跟踪目标可显著提升异构系统间可操作度迁移的精度与鲁棒性，并在多任务并发场景下保持末端位置与力形状的一致性。

title: TaRL: Learning General and Physical Rewards from Tactile Demonstrations
summary: Contact-rich manipulation requires robots to sequence precise contacts, maintain stable grasps, and apply directed forces. Reinforcement learning (RL) can acquire such behaviors automatically, but its performance hinges on reward design: sparse rewards reduce the learning efficiency, while dense rewards are hard to specify. Visual reward learning addresses this by inferring rewards from action-free demonstrations. Because it conditions only on visual observations, it fails to capture rewards beyond visual goals. We propose Tactile Reward Learning (TaRL), a framework that learns rewards from tactile demonstrations. TaRL takes a sequence of tactile deformation maps as input, and regresses task-completion progress from both successful and failed demonstrations. Because TaRL captures local robot-object interaction, it provides informative feedback to learn firm grasps and correctly directed forces; meanwhile, it is robust to changes in scene layout such as object position. We evaluate TaRL on four manipulation tasks in simulation and two in the real world. Used as a shaping reward, it substantially improves both sample efficiency and final success rate, raising success on Nut threading from 34% to 56% in simulation and on cube pickup from 37% to 97% in the real world. Combining tactile with visual rewards improves performance further. TaRL also generalizes across object instances: trained on box placement and directly deployed to can placement, it significantly improves policy learning on the new task. Project page is available at https://embodiedai-ntu.github.io/tarl.

AI.tldr: TaRL：从触觉演示中学习奖励，用于接触丰富的机器人操作任务，显著提升样本效率与成功率。
AI.motivation: 接触丰富操作（如精细接触、稳定抓取、定向施力）是机器人操作的核心难点。RL 可自动习得此类行为，但高度依赖奖励设计：稀疏奖励学习效率低，稠密奖励难以人工设定。已有的视觉奖励学习虽能从无动作演示中推断奖励，但仅以视觉观测为条件，无法刻画视觉目标之外的奖励信号（如抓取力、接触状态）。
AI.method: 提出触觉奖励学习框架 TaRL，以触觉形变图序列为输入，从成功与失败演示中回归任务完成进度，作为奖励信号。由于触觉捕获的是局部机器人-物体交互信息，TaRL 能提供关于牢固抓取和正确施力方向的丰富反馈，且对物体位置等场景布局变化具有鲁棒性。可与视觉奖励结合使用。
AI.result: 在仿真4个任务和真实世界2个任务上评估：作为塑形奖励显著提升样本效率与最终成功率。仿真中螺母穿线成功率从34%提升至56%；真实世界中方块抓取从37%提升至97%；触觉与视觉奖励结合可进一步提升性能；且在螺母/方块任务上训练后可直接迁移至罐体放置等新任务，显著改善新任务策略学习。
AI.conclusion: 触觉演示可作为有效的奖励学习来源，弥补视觉奖励对非视觉目标（如力、接触）刻画不足的缺陷，兼具高信息量与跨场景、跨实例泛化能力，为接触丰富操作提供了一条实用且可扩展的奖励设计路径。

title: Spotter: Let the Embodied Model Lead, and the VLM Reflect for It
summary: Current embodied models do not respond to their own failures, although what just went wrong could inform a small adjustment on the next attempt, the kind of reflection behind the gains of thinking in language models. We test whether they can repair a known error, which requires producing a correction and judging whether it is right. Stopped at a failure and allowed to retry, they seldom repair it through their own randomness or from a language description of the error, and best-of-N selection cannot pick the successful candidate after a failure. We attribute this to training only on successful demonstrations and to inputs too narrow to show what went wrong, and conclude that reflection must come from a vision-language model (VLM), which takes in far more information, such as the episode history and text, and is more general. Prior VLM-led work has the VLM plan every step and invoke the embodied model as a tool, placing the VLM on the critical path. We propose Spotter, which reverses the roles: the embodied model leads and executes continuously, while the VLM runs in parallel, monitors through a lightweight local screener, intervenes only when an error is detected, reflects on and corrects it, and returns control. We run Spotter with Qwen and with GPT as the VLM, and both improve the embodied models; with GPT, Spotter improves Cosmos Policy and $π_{0.5}$ by 5.6 and 7.5 percentage points on RoboCasa, and raises $π_{0.5}$ from 47.2% to 57.0% on the Hard setting of RoboTwin 2.0 and from 53% to 83% on a real robot. Because the VLM steps in only when an error is confirmed, a successful episode with Qwen takes only 13 to 16 s longer than with the embodied model alone and about 70% less time than with a VLM-led baseline using the same model. Our code is available at https://github.com/zqc3117/Spotter.

AI.tldr: 提出Spotter框架，让具身模型主导连续执行、VLM并行监控并在检测到错误时介入反思与纠正，在多个基准和真机上显著提升性能且额外开销小。
AI.motivation: 现有具身模型无法对自身失败做出反应，即使出错信息可用于下次尝试的微调。作者测试其能否修复已知错误——需要生成纠正并判断是否正确。结果显示：被停止在失败处并允许重试时，模型很少能靠自身随机性或错误的语言描述完成修复，best-of-N选择也无法在失败后挑出成功候选。作者将此归因于仅用成功示范训练、输入信息过窄无法显示出错原因，故认为反思必须来自能接收更丰富信息（如回合历史与文本）且更通用的视觉语言模型（VLM）。
AI.method: 既有VLM主导方案让VLM规划每一步并将具身模型当工具调用，使VLM处于关键路径。作者提出Spotter，反转角色：具身模型主导并连续执行，VLM并行运行，通过轻量级本地筛查器（screener）监控，仅在检测到错误时介入，进行反思与纠正后交还控制权。使用Qwen与GPT作为VLM验证。
AI.result: 两种VLM均可提升具身模型。以GPT作为VLM时，Spotter在RoboCasa上将Cosmos Policy和π_{0.5}分别提升5.6和7.5个百分点；在RoboTwin 2.0的Hard设置上将π_{0.5}从47.2%提升至57.0%，在真实机器人上从53%提升至83%。因仅在确认错误时介入，使用Qwen时一次成功episode仅比单独具身模型多耗时13–16秒，比使用同一模型的VLM主导基线快约70%。
AI.conclusion: 反思能力需由信息更丰富、更通用的VLM提供；通过反转VLM与具身模型的主导关系、仅在检测到错误时介入，可在显著提升成功率的同时保持较低时延。代码已开源。

title: VidAct: Learning Manipulation from In-the-Wild Videos with Object-Centric 3D Awareness
summary: Video demonstrations offer a scalable alternative to costly robot data for learning manipulation, yet existing reconstruction-based approaches often rely on constrained camera viewpoints or human-to-robot retargeting, while the reconstructed trajectories are difficult to adapt to new objects configurations without distorting the trajectory shape. Another key limitation is that the resulting policies often lack precise object-level 3D geometry awareness, limiting object grounding and object shape awareness critical for precise manipulation. To bridge these gaps, we propose VidAct, an efficient video-to-robot framework that learns object-centric, 3D-aware manipulation policies from a single monocular video per task and enables zero-shot real-world deployment. VidAct consists of three key components. First, VidAct reconstructs object meshes and motion from arbitrary demo videos and canonicalizes the motion in the static object frame, avoiding embodiment-specific retargeting and accommodating diverse camera viewpoints. Second, VidAct employ residual trajectory transfer for adapting the reconstructed motion to novel object configurations while preserving its motion shape. Finally, as the key policy-learning component, VidAct predicts simulation-provided privileged complete-object point clouds at each frame as an auxiliary task while retaining RGB-only deployment, providing dense object-centric supervision over both object pose and 3D geometry. Experiments on human, robot, generated, and internet videos demonstrate broad video applicability and zero-shot deployment. Per-frame complete-object 3D supervision improves policy generalization and sim-to-real success, while residual trajectory transfer enables reliable trajectory adaptation with better shape preservation.

AI.tldr: 提出VidAct框架，从单目视频学习物体中心、3D感知的操作策略，实现零样本真机部署。
AI.motivation: 现有基于重建的视频学习操作策略方法依赖受限相机视角或人到手重定向，重建轨迹难以适应新物体配置且易失真；同时策略缺乏精确的物体级3D几何感知，限制物体定位与形状理解。
AI.method: VidAct包含三部分：(1)从任意演示视频重建物体网格与运动，并在静态物体坐标系中规范化运动，避免具身特定重定向并适应多样视角；(2)采用残差轨迹迁移将运动适配到新物体配置，同时保持运动形状；(3)作为核心策略学习组件，在每帧预测仿真提供的特权完整物体点云作为辅助任务，同时保持仅RGB部署，提供对物体位姿与3D几何的密集物体中心监督。
AI.result: 在人类、机器人、生成及网络视频上验证了广泛的视频适用性与零样本部署能力；逐帧完整物体3D监督提升了策略泛化与sim-to-real成功率；残差轨迹迁移实现可靠轨迹适配并更好地保持形状。
AI.conclusion: VidAct通过物体中心3D感知与残差轨迹迁移，有效弥合视频演示到机器人操作策略的差距，支持多源视频与零样本真实部署。

title: PreferenceFlow: Test-Time Guidance of Flow-Matching Robot Policies from Human Interventions
summary: Flow-matching policies can represent complex robot behaviors but remain susceptible to local errors under distribution shift at deployment. Many reinforcement learning approaches to policy improvement require reward signals that are difficult to specify or obtain in real-world manipulation. We present PreferenceFlow, a framework for improving a pretrained flow policy at test time without environment rewards or updates to the base policy. Human intervention chunks are paired with robot chunks generated from the same initial conditioning state to train a preference model. During infer- ence, we adopt the QGF sampling update, replacing its value gradient with the preference gradient evaluated at an estimated clean action. A gradient-cap loss penalizes excessive gradients on intervention pairs, while a zero-gradient loss discourages guidance near actions from expert demonstrations. On four real-world precision insertion tasks with a Franka robot, Pref- erenceFlow achieves a mean success rate of 90.5%, compared with 69% for the frozen policy. Ablations support the roles of gradient regularization and correctly ordered preference labels in the evaluated settings. These results demonstrate the utility of human interventions as local preference supervision for guiding frozen generative robot policies.

AI.tldr: PreferenceFlow：无需环境奖励、不更新基础策略，利用人类干预作为局部偏好监督，在测试时改进预训练流匹配策略。
AI.motivation: 流匹配策略能表达复杂机器人行为，但部署时受分布偏移影响易发生局部错误。现有强化学习策略改进方法依赖奖励信号，而真实操作中奖励难以设定与获取。
AI.method: 将人类干预片段与同一初始条件状态生成的机器人片段配对，训练偏好模型。推理时采用 QGF 采样更新，把其价值梯度替换为在估计的干净动作处评估的偏好梯度；引入梯度上限损失惩罚干预对上的过大梯度，并用零梯度损失抑制专家示范动作附近的引导。
AI.result: 在 Franka 机器人四项真实精密插入任务上，平均成功率 90.5%，而冻结策略为 69%。消融实验支持梯度正则化与正确排序偏好标签的作用。
AI.conclusion: 人类干预可作为局部偏好监督，有效引导冻结的生成式机器人策略，验证了该测试时改进框架的实用性。

title: NIDAR: NIR-Guided Intrinsic Decomposition for Scalable Scene-Agnostic LiDAR Intensity Reconstruction
comment: 9 pages, 8 figures. Accepted by IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026
summary: LiDAR return intensity provides complementary surface-response cues for robotic perception and state estimation, yet many simulation pipelines omit it or reproduce it using reconstruction methods that require real intensity supervision and per-scene optimization. These requirements increase data-collection and fitting costs and limit reuse across simulated scenes. We present NIDAR, a feed-forward framework that synthesizes dense intensity-like observations from RGB appearance and simulator geometry. NIDAR combines pretrained pseudo-NIR translation, hierarchical intrinsic decomposition, geometry-aware modulation, and source-domain distribution calibration to transfer reflectance-related image cues to simulated point clouds. Its learned components are trained offline using Waymo data; their weights and calibration remain fixed during evaluation on Waymo and nuScenes. Deployment therefore requires neither target-scene intensity labels nor target-scene gradient-based fitting. The reported comparisons show competitive pixel-wise accuracy and favorable structural and perceptual fidelity against the evaluated reconstruction baselines. A controlled pseudo-NIR-versus-RGB diagnostic further shows that the pseudo-NIR prior is most beneficial when used through the paper-aligned reflectance-and-remapping route, rather than as a simple direct intensity regressor. We further integrate NIDAR with Unreal Engine 5, Isaac Sim, and a generative LiDAR pipeline. Two intensity-aware SLAM systems evaluated in two simulated indoor scenes suggest potential downstream utility, but do not constitute real-robot validation. NIDAR therefore offers a scalable intensity-synthesis interface for the evaluated settings; cross-wavelength, camera-configuration, embedded, and real-sensor validation remain future work.

AI.tldr: NIDAR：一种前馈式框架，用RGB表观与仿真器几何合成稠密类强度观测，离线训练后权重固定，可直接部署于新场景而无需目标场景强度标签或逐场景拟合。
AI.motivation: LiDAR回波强度为机器人感知与状态估计提供补充性的表面响应线索，但现有仿真流程常将其省略，或用需要真实强度监督与逐场景优化的重建方法来复现，导致数据采集与拟合成本高、难以跨仿真场景复用。
AI.method: NIDAR由预训练伪近红外（pseudo-NIR）翻译、层级本征分解、几何感知调制、源域分布校准四部分构成，将反射率相关图像线索迁移到仿真点云。可学习组件在Waymo数据上离线训练，评估时权重与校准保持固定；并引入受控的伪NIR与RGB对比诊断。
AI.result: 在Waymo与nuScenes上的对比显示像素级精度具竞争力，结构保真度与感知保真度优于所评估的重建基线。诊断实验表明，伪NIR先验经由"反射率—重映射"路径使用比直接强度回归更有效。与Unreal Engine 5、Isaac Sim及生成式LiDAR管线集成，两个仿真室内场景中两套强度感知SLAM系统提示潜在下游价值。
AI.conclusion: NIDAR为所评估的设置提供了可扩展的强度合成接口；但结果不构成真机验证，跨波长、相机配置、嵌入式平台与真实传感器验证仍属未来工作。

title: All Roads Lead to Rome: Flow-driven Multi-Anchor Exploration for Open-Environment Active 3D Mapping
summary: To advance the development of embodied intelligence, Open-Environment Active 3D Mapping has attracted increasing attention, aiming to perform a long-horizon and shortest trajectory exploration for reconstructing unseen scenarios. Since only limited information about unseen environments is available, methods built on the closed-set assumption, i.e., assuming that the test environments are similar to those seen during training, cannot generalize satisfactorily. In existing active mapping methods, long-horizon exploration is often guided by predicting a coarse long-range goal and then converting it into an executable path. However, this stage is usually formulated as single-point prediction. Under partial observability, the same local observation may correspond to multiple plausible exploration directions, making such deterministic prediction prone to brittle decisions and degraded performance in unseen scenarios. Our experiments further verify that this is a key factor underlying their weak generalization. To address this issue, we reformulate long-horizon target prediction as conditional multimodal anchor generation using Conditional Flow Matching.Instead of predicting a single goal, our method learns a conditional distribution over coarse exploration anchors from the current mapping state. These anchors are first converted into executable candidate paths through obstacle-aware planning. We then apply exploration-mode clustering to compress geometrically similar trajectories and reduce candidate redundancy. Finally, a hierarchical selection module selects the most promising mode and reranks paths within it to produce the final executable trajectory. Experiments show that our method improves generalization and reconstruction efficiency in open environments.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对开放环境主动3D建图中的长程探索问题，将长程目标预测从单点确定性预测重构为基于条件流匹配的多模态锚点生成，并结合障碍感知规划、探索模式聚类与分层选择，提升未见场景下的泛化与重建效率。
AI.motivation: 开放环境主动3D建图要求智能体在仅掌握有限未知环境信息的情况下完成长程、最短路径探索以重建场景。现有方法多基于闭集假设，难以泛化到训练分布之外的测试环境。已有主动建图方法通常先预测一个粗略的远距离目标点，再将其转换为可执行路径，但该阶段被建模为单点预测。在部分可观测条件下，同一局部观测可能对应多个合理的探索方向，确定性单点预测容易产生脆弱决策，导致未见场景性能下降。实验进一步验证，这是其泛化能力弱的关键因素。
AI.method: 将长程目标预测重新表述为基于条件流匹配（Conditional Flow Matching）的条件多模态锚点生成问题。方法不预测单一目标点，而是从当前建图状态学习粗粒度探索锚点的条件分布。具体流程为：1）生成的锚点先经障碍感知规划转换为可执行的候选路径；2）采用探索模式聚类压缩几何相似轨迹，减少候选冗余；3）使用分层选择模块先选出最有前景的探索模式，再在模式内对路径重排序，输出最终可执行轨迹。
AI.result: 实验表明，所提方法在开放环境中提升了泛化能力与重建效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过将长程目标预测由单点确定性预测改为条件多模态生成，并配合障碍感知规划、模式聚类与分层选择，能够缓解部分可观测下的脆弱决策问题，从而改善开放环境主动3D建图的泛化性与探索重建效率。

title: AeroManip-VLA: Scalable Vision-Language-Action Learning for Aerial Manipulation with RL-Generated Demonstrations
summary: Aerial manipulators extend robotic manipulation into 3D workspaces that are difficult for ground-based robots to access, creating new opportunities for general-purpose manipulation. However, extending Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to aerial robots introduces distinct challenges due to the tight coupling between manipulation and flight, continuously changing observations, and safety-critical physical interactions. These challenges demand diverse training data and systematic policy evaluation, yet collecting demonstrations and evaluating policies directly on physical aerial platforms are costly, difficult to scale, and hard to repeat under controlled conditions. We present AeroManip-VLA, a scalable benchmark for aerial VLA data generation and policy evaluation. AeroManip-VLA provides a GPU-accelerated simulation framework with low-level payload-aware flight and manipulation control in massively parallel environments. Building on this framework, we combine reusable reinforcement learning policies with expert task rules to automatically generate demonstrations without human teleoperation across diverse objects, environments, and randomized initial conditions. The generated data include basic skills such as grasping and placing, as well as long-horizon tasks that require both navigation and manipulation. We further introduce automated event labeling and trajectory categorization to filter demonstrations. These mechanisms enable fine-grained analysis of task progress, behavioral outcomes, and safety-related failures. Finally, we evaluate a range of imitation learning and VLA baselines across different task settings, revealing their performance characteristics and failure modes. Together, AeroManip-VLA enables scalable aerial manipulation data generation, structured trajectory analysis, and systematic VLA evaluation in simulation prior to real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: AeroManip-VLA：面向空中机械臂VLA的可扩展仿真基准，支持数据生成与策略评估。
AI.motivation: 空中机械臂可进入地面机器人难以抵达的三维空间，但将VLA模型迁移到空中平台面临操作与飞行紧耦合、观测持续变化、物理交互安全关键等挑战。真实平台采集演示与评估代价高、难扩展、难复现，因此亟需可扩展的仿真基准。
AI.method: 提出AeroManip-VLA：基于GPU加速的大规模并行仿真框架，具备载荷感知的低层飞行与操作控制；结合可复用强化学习策略与专家任务规则，自动生成无需人工遥操作的演示数据，覆盖多样物体、环境与随机初始条件；引入自动事件标注与轨迹分类以过滤演示，支持任务进度、行为结果与安全失败的细粒度分析。
AI.result: 生成数据涵盖抓取、放置等基本技能，以及需要导航与操作协同的长时序任务；在多种任务设定下评估了多种模仿学习与VLA基线，揭示其性能特征与失效模式。
AI.conclusion: AeroManip-VLA实现可扩展的空中操作数据生成、结构化轨迹分析与系统化VLA仿真评估，为真实部署前的验证提供支撑。

title: ComManip: Overfitting Manipulation Policies to Comfortable Regions
summary: Training robot manipulation policies relies on costly robot demonstrations, making large-scale data collection impractical. Meanwhile, to improve policy generalization, existing approaches seek greater diversity in visual observations by varying object placements, viewpoints, and robot configurations during data collection. However, under a limited demonstration budget, this strategy forces the policy to model diverse visual observations, providing insufficient supervision to learn reliable observation-action correspondences under similar local conditions.
