Our study reveals that policies trained under this strategy achieve lower task success rates than those trained within a compact, visually and kinematically stable region. We refer to these stable regions as comfortable manipulation regions. To exploit this finding, we propose ComManip, a learning paradigm that specializes manipulation policies to comfortable manipulation regions. During inference, ComManip repositions the mobile base until the detected target center enters the familiar image-space range estimated from comfortable-region demonstrations. It then executes the same manipulation policy, enabling effective manipulation across diverse target locations. We conduct extensive experiments across multiple manipulation tasks, demonstration budgets, and policy families including ACT, $π_{0.5}$, RDT, OpenVLA-OFT, and SmolVLA. The results demonstrate that ComManip improves task success by roughly 20 percentage points or more across different policy architectures in large workspaces under limited demonstration budgets, suggesting that specializing manipulation policies to comfortable regions provides a more data-efficient learning paradigm for manipulation.

AI.tldr: 提出 ComManip 学习范式：将操作策略专门化到"舒适操作区域"，推理时通过移动底座将目标中心置于熟悉的图像空间范围内，从而在有限示教预算下大幅提升任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作策略训练依赖昂贵的机器人示教，难以大规模采集数据。为提升泛化性，现有方法在采集时刻意增加视觉观测的多样性（物体位置、视角、机器人构型），但在有限示教预算下，这迫使策略去建模多样化的视觉观测，导致相似局部条件下的观测-动作对应监督不足。研究发现：这种策略训练出的策略，其任务成功率反而低于在紧凑、视觉与运动学稳定的区域内训练的策略——作者称该稳定区域为"舒适操作区域"。
AI.method: 提出 ComManip 学习范式，将操作策略专门化于舒适操作区域。具体做法：训练阶段仅在舒适区域内采集示教以学习专用策略；推理阶段先检测目标中心，移动移动底座直至目标中心进入由舒适区域示教估计出的熟悉图像空间范围，随后执行同一操作策略。这样无需扩大策略的视觉建模负担，即可在多样目标位置下完成操作。
AI.result: 在多种操作任务、示教预算和策略族（ACT、π_{0.5}、RDT、OpenVLA-OFT、SmolVLA）上进行了大量实验。结果表明，在大工作空间、有限示教预算条件下，ComManip 在不同策略架构上可将任务成功率提升约 20 个百分点甚至更多。
AI.conclusion: 将操作策略专门化到舒适操作区域是一种更具数据效率的学习范式：相比追求视觉观测多样性，聚焦于稳定区域并配合推理时的底座重定位，能在有限示教预算下显著提升操作性能。

title: Beyond Token Importance: Preserving Spatial Scaffolds for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Inference
summary: Existing VLA pruning strategies primarily select individual visual tokens according to task-level semantic relevance, while overlooking the spatial information required for robotic manipulation. To examine this limitation, we construct a simple Stride baseline that uniformly samples tokens along the flattened one-dimensional visual sequence, representing a purely geometric pruning strategy. Surprisingly, Stride outperforms semantic pruning and random pruning at certain pruning ratios, but collapses when the token budget is only slightly reduced. We characterize this phenomenon through the spatial coverage radius, defined as the largest spatial blind spot induced by the retained token set after pruning. Our analysis reveals a strong correlation between the spatial structure of retained tokens and task success, suggesting that reliable VLA pruning requires preserving not only task-relevant tokens but also the spatial scaffold of the scene. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose GeoScaffold, a training-free visual token pruning method that partitions each image into spatial regions, allocates inter-region token budgets using task-relevance weights, and selects intra-region scaffold tokens via farthest point sampling to reduce the local coverage radius. On pi 0.5 and LIBERO, GeoScaffold retains only 20% of visual tokens while preserving a 93.2% average success rate, and achieves a 1.78 times prefill speedup over the unpruned baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有VLA视觉token剪枝忽略空间结构，提出基于空间覆盖半径的诊断，并提出免训练的GeoScaffold剪枝方法，在保留20% token时维持93.2%成功率并实现1.78倍加速。
AI.motivation: 已有视觉语言动作（VLA）模型的token剪枝策略主要依据任务级语义相关性挑选单个视觉token，忽视了机器人操作所需的空间信息。作者通过构建仅按一维展平序列均匀采样的Stride几何基线发现，它在某些剪枝率下优于语义剪枝和随机剪枝，但token预算稍降即性能崩溃，说明任务相关性不足以支撑可靠剪枝，空间结构本身是成功的关键因素。
AI.method: 作者提出“空间覆盖半径”指标，定义为剪枝后保留token集所诱导的最大空间盲区，用以刻画剪枝后token的空间结构。基于该诊断，提出免训练的GeoScaffold方法：先将每张图像划分为若干空间区域，依据任务相关性权重在各区域间分配token预算，再在区域内通过最远点采样（farthest point sampling）选取“脚手架”token，以降低局部覆盖半径。
AI.result: 分析表明，保留token的空间结构与任务成功率高度相关。在pi 0.5与LIBERO上，GeoScaffold仅保留20%的视觉token即可维持平均93.2%的成功率，并相较未剪枝基线实现1.78倍的prefill加速。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的VLA剪枝不仅需保留任务相关token，还需保留场景的空间脚手架。GeoScaffold以免训练方式兼顾任务相关性与空间覆盖，在显著降低token预算的同时保持操作成功率并获得实际推理加速，为VLA视觉token剪枝提供了空间结构视角的新范式。

title: All You Need Is Low Fidelity: Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real of Learned Robotic Fish Control
comment: 8 pages, 10 figures, submitted to ICRA 2027. Liam Maloney and Simon Ramchandani contributed equally
summary: Complex tasks for underwater robots remain limited by the capabilities of their controllers. Learning a better one for a soft, underactuated robotic fish trades simulator cost against fidelity. We show that an intentionally low-fidelity simulator is enough: a stateless, quasi-steady fluid model with no wake and no added-mass history suffices to learn a \emph{general}, closed-loop controller that transfers to hardware without tuning. Our platform is a soft, single-motor, tendon-driven fish whose policy observes only what the hardware can measure. A staged pipeline grounds the simulator in two independent identifications, fixing the tail dynamics and a stateless fluid model; the policy then acts through a band-limited rhythmic trajectory generator rather than commanding the tail directly. Deployed unchanged in an outdoor pool, a single policy performs closed-loop target reaching, disturbance rejection, and out-of-distribution target acquisition and tracking. The transfer rests on the constraint rather than the fidelity: the generator cannot leave the band over which the fluid was identified. This raises the question of how much of the physics can reside in the controller rather than in the simulator.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明：对软体、欠驱动的机器鱼，一个有意的低保真、无状态准稳态流体模型即可学习出可零调参迁移到硬件的通用闭环控制器；迁移成功的关键是控制器结构约束（带限节奏轨迹生成器）而非仿真保真度。
AI.motivation: 水下机器人的复杂任务受限于控制器能力。为软体、欠驱动鱼形机器人学习更好的控制器时，常面临"仿真保真度 vs 计算代价"的权衡：高保真仿真昂贵，低保真仿真又担心迁移失败。作者希望探究能否用极低保真仿真训练出可直接上硬件的控制器，并追问"多少物理可以放在控制器里而非仿真器里"。
AI.method: 平台为软体、单电机、腱驱动的机器鱼，策略仅使用硬件可测的观测量。采用分阶段流水线：通过两项独立辨识（尾部动力学、无状态流体模型）将仿真器锚定到硬件。策略不直接控制尾部，而是通过"带限节奏轨迹生成器"输出动作。仿真器有意采用无尾流、无附加质量历史的无状态准稳态流体模型，保真度低。
AI.result: 在户外水池中不加修改部署同一策略，可完成闭环目标到达、干扰抑制，以及分布外目标的获取与跟踪，均无需调参（without tuning）。
AI.conclusion: 成功迁移依赖于控制器的结构约束而非仿真保真度：轨迹生成器无法离开流体辨识所覆盖的频带。由此提出开放问题——控制器的物理内嵌程度与仿真器保真度之间如何权衡/替代。

title: FACT: Fidelity-Aware Construction of Articulated Twins
summary: Visually plausible articulated assets may still fail during contact interactions or exhibit inaccurate motion. We present FACT (Fidelity-Aware Construction of Articulated Twins), an agentic framework that progressively constructs articulated twins to improve geometry, contact, and dynamic fidelity. The agent drives an evidence--diagnosis--revision loop on a shared editable representation, selecting measurements and model edits using quantitative feedback, while numerical tools execute and validate the updates. It reconstructs editable articulated geometry from images through feature planning, targeted measurements, and diagnostic refinement. On this reference, it repairs collision proxies through task-aware local repartitioning before fidelity-constrained compression. Finally, it constructs response models from passive-response videos, using simulation residuals to guide model revision and constrained physical parameter fitting. Experiments show that FACT improves geometric reconstruction over baselines, enables more reliable interaction with simpler collision proxies, and better reproduces held-out physical responses than direct parameter inference.

AI.tldr: 提出FACT智能体框架，通过证据-诊断-修正闭环逐步构建铰接孪生体，提升几何、接触与动力学保真度。
AI.motivation: 视觉上合理的铰接资产在接触交互中仍可能失败或运动不准确，现有方法难以同时保证几何、接触与动力学多方面的保真度。
AI.method: FACT为智能体框架，在共享可编辑表示上运行证据-诊断-修正循环，由智能体依据定量反馈选择测量与模型编辑，数值工具负责执行与验证更新。流程包括：从图像重建可编辑铰接几何（特征规划、定向测量、诊断细化）；通过任务感知的局部重划分修复碰撞代理，再进行保真度约束压缩；由被动响应视频构建响应模型，用仿真残差指导模型修正并进行约束物理参数拟合。
AI.result: 实验表明，FACT在几何重建上优于基线方法，使用更简单的碰撞代理即可实现更可靠的交互，并且相比直接参数推断能更好地复现存留（held-out）物理响应。
AI.conclusion: FACT通过渐进式、诊断驱动的闭环构建，有效提升了铰接孪生体在几何、接触与动力学方面的综合保真度。

title: Predictive Safety Curricula for Robust Legged Locomotion
summary: Rare but consequential failures can persist in learned locomotion policies for legged robots even when average task performance is high, in part because standard curricula primarily adapt task difficulty rather than the distribution of safety-critical experience. We introduce Predictive Safety Curricula (PSC), a framework for allocating locomotion training experience using learned predictions of future safety cost. PSC trains a distributional safety critic from policy rollouts and uses its predictions to prioritize both terrain contexts and previously encountered randomized events. The resulting curriculum modifies the training distribution while leaving the task reward and policy-optimization loss unchanged. We evaluate PSC in controlled rough-terrain locomotion and in production locomotion systems. PSC improves reliability relative to standard terrain progression, advantage-based replay, and learning-progress curricula, with the largest gains on difficult terrain and under degraded observations. The same allocation principle transfers to two production locomotion stacks. On ANYmal-D hardware, PSC reduces shank-collision incidence by $63\%$ relative to the learning-progress curriculum across three matched training seeds, with a reduction in every seed. On a production stair-climbing platform, PSC eliminates observed shank collisions in the evaluated hardware trials. These results show that learned predictions of future safety cost can provide an effective signal for allocating training experience toward rare failure modes and improving locomotion reliability.

AI.tldr: 提出预测安全课程（PSC）框架，利用对未来安全代价的学习预测来分配机器人运动训练经验，在不改变任务奖励和策略优化损失的前提下优先训练安全关键经验，显著提升可靠性并减少硬件碰撞。
AI.motivation: 足式机器人运动策略即使平均任务性能很高，仍会残留罕见但后果严重的失败。部分原因是标准课程主要调整任务难度，而非调整安全关键经验的分布，导致稀有失败模式训练不足。
AI.method: PSC 从策略 rollout 中训练一个分布式安全评论家（distributional safety critic），用其预测值同时优先化地形上下文与先前遇到的随机化事件，从而修改训练分布；该方法仅改变经验分配，保持任务奖励与策略优化损失不变。
AI.result: 在受控崎岖地形与生产级运动系统中评测：相比标准地形进阶、优势回放和学习进度课程，PSC 提升可靠性，在困难地形和观测退化下增益最大。ANYmal-D 硬件上，跨三个匹配训练种子将小腿碰撞率较学习进度课程降低 63%，且每个种子均下降；在生产攀爬台阶平台上，评估的硬件试验中消除了观测到的小腿碰撞。
AI.conclusion: 学习到的未来安全代价预测可有效作为分配训练经验、聚焦稀有失败模式的信号，从而提升运动可靠性，并具备向多种生产系统迁移的通用性。

title: From Sky to Soil: A Morphing Aerial-Ground Robot for Seed Deployment
summary: Aerial seed broadcasting can reach remote restoration sites, but provides limited control over seed placement within the soil. This paper presents a geometry-assisted, tri-functional morphing robot that combines aerial access, ground locomotion, and controlled-depth seed embedding in a fly-drive-plant architecture. After landing, the platform reconfigures into a four-wheeled planting configuration: an electronically coupled dual-motor drive folds the rear arms outward to form ground wheels, while a descending front tray engages the propulsion motors with a drill gear train. Reusing the propulsion motors for drilling eliminates a dedicated drill drive. The planting sequence forms a hole, dispenses a seed, and allows the vehicle to reposition on the ground or return to its flight configuration. Ground mobility supports repeated planting without requiring a separate flight between adjacent sites. A companion controller issues reconfiguration, tray, and seed-gate commands, while a dedicated autopilot handles flight control. The morphing and planting mechanisms are validated using a hardware prototype that demonstrates ground repositioning and seed embedding. This proof of concept establishes a hardware basis for aerial-ground seed embedding through coordinated reconfiguration and actuator reuse.

AI.tldr: 提出一种几何辅助的三功能变形机器人，融合飞行、地面行驶与定深播种的"飞行-行驶-播种"架构，通过复用推进电机驱动钻头实现种子定深埋入，验证了空地一体化播种的硬件可行性。
AI.motivation: 空中撒播虽可抵达偏远修复场地，但对种子在土壤中的落位缺乏控制。为实现可控深度的精准播种，需要一种既能空中抵达又能地面重复作业的平台。
AI.method: 设计几何辅助、三功能变形机器人：着陆后重构为四轮播种构型，电子耦合双电机驱动使后臂外展形成地面车轮；下落式前托盘将推进电机与钻齿轮系啮合，复用推进电机实现钻孔，省去专用钻机驱动。播种序列为成孔—投放种子—地面重新定位或恢复飞行构型。随附控制器负责重构、托盘与种子闸门指令，专用自动驾驶仪负责飞行控制。
AI.result: 硬件原型验证了变形与播种机构，演示了地面重新定位与种子埋入功能。
AI.conclusion: 该概念验证为通过协同变形与执行器复用实现空中-地面种子埋入奠定了硬件基础。

title: BCNav: Bearing-Conditioned Depth Policies for Sound Source Navigation
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Accepted to IEEE RO-MAN 2026
summary: The ability to navigate toward sound sources extends a robot's reach beyond its visual field, enabling response to auditory events in unknown environments. To equip robots with this capability, existing methods couple acoustic and visual information through joint audio-visual learning in acoustic simulators. However, acoustic simulation is both low-fidelity and expensive, producing a domain gap that prevents reliable real-world deployment, while the discrete action spaces inherited from grid-based simulators introduce an additional kinematic gap on physical robots. To alleviate these issues, we propose BCNav, a decoupled framework that separates the acoustic module from the learned navigation policy using direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation: an estimator provides a scalar bearing to the sound source, so the navigation policy only processes depth images and a bearing angle, two inputs whose domain gaps are well characterized. We collect shortest-path demonstrations with calibrated bearing noise injection and train the policy via imitation learning to output continuous velocity commands directly executable on ground robots. We demonstrate the method in simulation and on a physical robot, navigating unknown environments without any acoustic fine-tuning, prior mapping, or real-world audio data collection. Code is available at https://github.com/york1to/bcnav.

AI.tldr: BCNav 提出一种解耦的声源导航框架，将声学模块与导航策略分离，通过 DOA 估计提供标量方位角，使导航策略仅处理深度图像与方位角，从而规避声学仿真与离散动作空间带来的域差距与运动学差距，在仿真与真实机器人上实现无需声学微调、先验建图或真实音频采集的未知环境导航。
AI.motivation: 让机器人具备朝声源导航的能力可将其感知范围拓展到视觉域之外，从而对未知环境中的听觉事件作出响应。然而现有方法在声学仿真器中通过联合音视频学习耦合声学与视觉信息，存在两类问题：一是声学仿真保真度低、成本高，产生域差距，阻碍真实部署；二是源于网格化仿真器的离散动作空间，在物理机器人上引入额外的运动学差距。
AI.method: 提出 BCNav，一个解耦框架，将声学模块与学得的导航策略分离，利用到达方向（DOA）估计：估计器输出指向声源的标量方位角，导航策略仅处理深度图像和该方位角这两个域差距已被充分刻画的输入。通过注入校准后的方位角噪声收集最短路径演示，并采用模仿学习训练策略，直接输出可在地面机器人上执行的连续速度指令。
AI.result: 在仿真和物理机器人上进行了验证，能够在未知环境中导航，且无需任何声学微调、先验建图或真实世界音频数据采集。
AI.conclusion: BCNav 通过解耦设计与 DOA 标量接口，缓解了传统联合音视频学习中的域差距和运动学差距，实现了从仿真到真实机器人的可迁移声源导航，且无需真实音频采集与声学微调。

title: Multifunctional Locomotion Control of Multi-Jointed BURs with Swimming and gait Capabilities
comment: Preprint version of an article published in Advanced Robotics (2026)
summary: Multimodal biomimetic underwater robots (BURs) can conduct underwater tasks suitable for the environment. Combining the characteristics of aquatic organisms enables the swimming and leggedlocomotion required for underwater exploration. Locomotion control mechanism relies on rule-based behavior selection and the designer's discretion. This limits the robot's ability to acquire new behavioral capabilities to the predetermined range of behaviors. To address these challenges, we propose a mechanism and control system that enables the expression of multimodal locomotion capabilities from the same multi-jointed structure. A mechanism equipped with four leg-fins each having four axes is used. This controller achieves nonlinear behavior based on sensor modalities, rather than relying on predefined conditional rule-based on locomotion functions. This system was validated through both physical and simulation testing based on multiple sensor data and behavioral patterns. Utilizing a potential function in multimodal locomotion control was verified to enable transitions between two or three behaviors. Implementing the control method as a multimodal controller is expected to enhance its application in underwater exploration. Our project page is at https://tasada038.github.io/multi-jointed-bur/.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种基于势函数的多模态仿生水下机器人控制机制，利用同一四轴四腿鳍结构实现多种运动模式，并通过物理与仿真实验验证了行为间转换能力。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态仿生水下机器人的运动控制依赖基于规则的行为选择与设计者主观判断，导致机器人只能执行预先设定的行为范围，难以获得新的行为技能。
AI.method: 设计配备四条腿鳍、每条腿鳍具四个轴的多关节机构，使同一结构可表达多模态运动能力；控制器不依赖预定义的条件-规则式运动函数，而是基于多种传感器模态产生非线性行为，并引入势函数实现多模态运动控制。
AI.result: 通过基于多传感器数据与行为模式的物理实验和仿真测试完成验证，结果表明势函数可用于多模态运动控制，能够实现两种或三种行为之间的转换。
AI.conclusion: 将所提控制方法实现为多模态控制器，有望提升仿生水下机器人在水下探索任务中的适用性；项目主页为 https://tasada038.github.io/multi-jointed-bur/。

title: Adversarially Robust Geometric Safety Certificates for Nonholonomic Robots Against Maneuvering Obstacles
summary: Safe navigation against obstacles that can actively maneuver within bounded capabilities remains challenging: robust control barrier function methods typically treat obstacle actions as generic disturbances, while differential-game approaches are computationally expensive for online navigation. We propose an adversarially robust geometric certificate that accounts for the worst-case effect of admissible obstacle maneuvers directly in the safe-set geometry through a closed-form contraction of the certificate parameters. The construction exploits a structural property of line-of-sight (LoS) certificates: the robot and obstacle actions enter the certificate through a common state-dependent geometric gain. This gain cancels in the worst-case comparison, reducing the differential game to a direct comparison between obstacle maneuvering capability and the weaker of the robot's longitudinal and steering authorities. Instantiated on the parabolic certificate, the construction yields Adversarially Robust Dynamic Parabolic Control Barrier Functions (AR-DPCBF), for which we establish sufficient conditions for forward invariance of the contracted safe set against all admissible obstacle maneuvers under kinematic bicycle dynamics with bounded inputs. When the obstacle capability is unknown, a sliding-window estimator supplies a high-probability upper bound, allowing the guarantee to be retained with the corresponding coverage probability. We further formulate soft and buffered variants to recover feasibility in dense environments. Simulations across obstacle capabilities, densities, and capability mismatch show substantial reductions in barrier violations and collisions and demonstrate that pointwise robustification of the barrier derivative cannot substitute for contraction of its geometry.

AI.tldr: 提出一种对抗鲁棒几何证书（AR-DPCBF），通过对视线证书参数的闭式收缩，将障碍机动的worst-case效应直接纳入安全集几何，实现有界能力机动障碍下的安全导航。
AI.motivation: 在有界能力内可主动机动的障碍物下实现安全导航仍然困难：鲁棒控制障碍函数方法通常把障碍动作当作一般扰动处理，而微分博弈方法在线导航计算代价高。
AI.method: 利用视线（LoS）证书的结构性质——机器人与障碍动作通过共同的、状态相关的几何增益进入证书，且该增益在worst-case比较中相消，从而把微分博弈化简为障碍机动能力与机器人纵向、转向能力中较弱者的直接比较。在抛物型证书上实例化为AR-DPCBF，给出在有界输入运动学自行车动力学下收缩安全集前向不变性的充分条件；障碍能力未知时用滑窗估计器给出高概率上界；并构造软约束与缓冲变体以恢复密集环境中的可行性。
AI.result: 在障碍能力、密度与能力失配不同的仿真中，屏障违反与碰撞显著减少；并表明仅对障碍函数导数做逐点鲁棒化无法替代对其几何的收缩。
AI.conclusion: 通过闭式收缩证书几何即可在对admissible障碍机动下获得前向不变的安全保证，为对抗鲁棒安全导航提供了计算高效且可扩展的框架。

title: ReF-HIL: Shaping the Critic around Human Action Neighborhoods for Efficient Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures. Shaoyin Luo and Song Wang contributed equally to this work
summary: Human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning (HIL-RL) offers a promising route to efficient training of robotic manipulation policies by combining autonomous learning with human demonstrations and online corrections. However, insufficient use of successful human experience in value learning prolongs costly real-world training, while persistent imitation penalties can limit value-driven policy improvement. To address these limitations, we propose ReF-HIL, an efficient HIL-RL framework that uses human guidance to accelerate the learning process. Human-Reference-Guided Value Shaping learns an independent value reference from successful human experience to guide online value learning, while incorporating local corrective feedback. A Human Action Fence defines a learned human-action neighborhood, allowing value-driven optimization for better performance without imitation penalties inside while constraining policy and value updates outside. Experiments on five diverse and challenging real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate improved overall learning efficiency and higher success rates compared with the evaluated baselines. Specifically, ReF-HIL reaches 90% autonomous success in only 18-63 minutes of active training and achieves final success rates of 91.7-100%. These results highlight the potential of human-guided reinforcement learning to acquire reliable manipulation skills efficiently in the real world. Project website: https://anonymous.4open.science/w/ReF-HIL-7762/

AI.tldr: 提出ReF-HIL框架，通过人类参考引导的价值塑造与人类动作围栏，提升真实世界机器人操作的人机回环强化学习效率。
AI.motivation: 现有HIL-RL方法对成功人类经验的利用不足导致真实世界训练成本高，且持续的模仿惩罚限制了价值驱动的策略改进。
AI.method: ReF-HIL包含两个核心组件：人类参考引导的价值塑造（从成功人类经验中学习独立价值参考以引导在线价值学习，并融合局部纠正反馈）与人类动作围栏（学习人类动作邻域，围栏内允许无模仿惩罚的价值驱动优化，围栏外约束策略与价值更新）。
AI.result: 在五个多样化且具挑战性的真实世界操作任务上，整体学习效率与成功率均优于所评估基线；仅需18-63分钟主动训练即达90%自主成功率，最终成功率为91.7%-100%。
AI.conclusion: 人类引导强化学习可在真实世界中高效获得可靠的操作技能。

title: CoRe-VLA: Preserving Cross-View Coordination in VLAs under Camera Shifts
summary: VLAs combine pretrained vision-language representations with action generation to enable language-guided control across diverse tasks, becoming a mainstream paradigm in embodied intelligence. However, multiple studies have reported VLA's substantial declines in task success under camera shifts, revealing a key vulnerability that limits reliable deployment. To address this vulnerability, existing methods collect paired observations of the same scene from different viewpoints to fine-tune the VLA or train visual adaptation modules. Unfortunately, they require additional data collection and VLA training costs. In this paper, we first identify \emph{cross-view coordination breakdown} under external camera shifts: the robot may rely too heavily on wrist-view cues and consequently execute subtasks in the wrong order when losing global view. Motivated by this, we propose CoRe-VLA, a plug-and-play framework requiring neither additional multi-view data collection nor VLA fine-tuning, which can incorporate with exsiting VLAs. It reconstructs a scene point cloud and renders the observation from the VLA's training viewpoint to restore cross-view coordination. In CoRe-VLA, Render-to-Camera (R2C) Restoration reduces rendering-induced visual degradation, while Execution-Trajectory-Conditioned Alignment (ETCA) reduces robot idle time and mitigates motion conflicts during asynchronous execution. Experiments on 5 real-robot tasks, LIBERO-100 and LIBERO-Plus demonstrate CoRe-VLA substantially improves task success across mainstream VLAs under camera shifts. For example, CoRe-VLA raises PI0.5's success rate from 13.3% to 83.3% at a 1.6m camera shift in real-robot environment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出即插即用框架 CoRe-VLA，无需额外多视角数据采集或 VLA 微调，通过重建场景点云并渲染 VLA 训练视角的观测，恢复跨视角协调能力，从而在相机偏移下显著提升主流 VLA 的任务成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA 在相机偏移下任务成功率大幅下降，限制可靠部署。现有方法需采集同一场景不同视角的配对观测来微调 VLA 或训练视觉适配模块，带来额外的数据采集与训练成本。作者进一步识别出外部相机偏移下的"跨视角协调失效"：机器人过度依赖腕部视角线索，丢失全局视角时以错误顺序执行子任务。
AI.method: 提出 CoRe-VLA，一种即插即用框架，可接入现有 VLA，无需额外多视角数据与 VLA 微调。核心为重建场景点云并从 VLA 的训练视角渲染观测，以恢复跨视角协调。其中 Render-to-Camera (R2C) Restoration 减少渲染引起的视觉退化；Execution-Trajectory-Conditioned Alignment (ETCA) 减少机器人空闲时间并缓解异步执行中的运动冲突。
AI.result: 在 5 个真实机器人任务、LIBERO-100 与 LIBERO-Plus 上，CoRe-VLA 在相机偏移下对主流 VLA 均大幅提升任务成功率。例如在真实机器人环境中相机偏移 1.6m 时，将 PI0.5 的成功率从 13.3% 提升至 83.3%。
AI.conclusion: CoRe-VLA 以低成本、即插即用的方式有效缓解 VLA 在相机偏移下的跨视角协调失效问题，显著增强其鲁棒性与可部署性，并可泛化到多种主流 VLA 与多样化任务基准。

title: Disentangling Spurious Correlations in Vision-Language-Action Models via Predicting Domain-Invariant Latent Lookahead
comment: Accepted to CoRL 2026. Project website: https://dill-vla.github.io/
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models remain brittle under visual distribution shifts, often relying on spurious correlations tied to domain-specific factors rather than task-relevant structure. We propose Domain-Invariant Latent Lookahead (DILL), a representation-learning framework that mitigates shortcut learning in VLA policies. Our key idea is to supervise policies with domain-invariant future latents learned from domain-transformed trajectory data. A Task-Domain Encoder is trained with contrastive objectives and Gaussian disentanglement regularization to separate task-relevant structure from domain-specific visual variation. The learned encoder then provides future latents for VLA policy learning through lookahead prediction and domain disentanglement, encouraging the policy to focus on task-relevant structure rather than incidental visual factors. Counterfactual task-view evaluations show that DILL reduces shortcut reliance, while LIBERO-Plus evaluations demonstrate improved visual robustness, with 69.1% average success, 11.4 percentage points above the strongest baseline. Real-world manipulation experiments further support DILL's applicability beyond controlled simulation. Complementary latent-space diagnostics show that these behavioral gains are accompanied by representations that better preserve task-consistent structure while suppressing domain-specific variation. Our project page is available at https://dill-vla.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出 DILL 表示学习框架，通过域不变未来隐变量监督 VLA 策略，抑制视觉分布偏移下的捷径学习，在 LIBERO-Plus 上取得 69.1% 平均成功率（较最强基线提升 11.4 个百分点）。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型在视觉分布偏移下表现脆弱，倾向于依赖与特定域相关的虚假关联（捷径），而非任务相关的结构信息。
AI.method: （1）基于域变换后的轨迹数据学习域不变未来隐变量，并以此监督策略；（2）设计 Task-Domain Encoder，采用对比目标与高斯解耦正则，将任务相关结构与域相关视觉变化分离；（3）通过前瞻预测（lookahead prediction）与域解耦为 VLA 策略学习提供未来隐变量，引导策略关注任务相关结构。
AI.result: 反事实任务-视角评估显示 DILL 降低了对捷径的依赖；LIBERO-Plus 上平均成功率 69.1%，较最强基线提升 11.4 个百分点；真实世界操作实验验证了其超出仿真环境的适用性；隐空间诊断表明表征更好地保留任务一致结构并抑制域相关变化。
AI.conclusion: DILL 能有效缓解 VLA 策略中的捷径学习，提升视觉鲁棒性与真实场景适用性，其行为收益与更优的隐空间表征结构相一致。

title: EgoHumanoid-V2: Human-to-Humanoid Transfer of Coordinated Whole-Body Skills for Loco-Manipulation
summary: Human demonstrations capture diverse scenes and rich whole-body skills without requiring robot teleoperation. Prior work on egocentric transfer has emphasized scene generalization in loco-manipulation under decoupled control, leaving direct transfer of coordinated whole-body skills less explored. We present EgoHumanoid-V2, the first egocentric human-to-humanoid skill transfer framework for coordinated whole-body loco-manipulation. At its core, coarse-to-fine action alignment combines kinematic reference correction with dynamics-aware refinement. It improves end-effector pose accuracy while preserving whole-body coordination. We also use robot-arm rendering and training-time image augmentation to reduce the visual embodiment gap and improve viewpoint robustness. On four real-world tasks, vision-language-action (VLA) policies trained on aligned human data show zero-shot skill transfer without target-task robot demonstrations. Task scores are comparable to those of policies trained on teleoperation data at a lower collection cost. These results support human data as direct skill supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出EgoHumanoid-V2，首个面向协调全身移动操作的自中心人类到人形机器人技能迁移框架，通过粗到细动作对齐与视觉域适配，实现零样本技能迁移。
AI.motivation: 人类示范能提供多样场景与丰富全身技能，无需机器人遥操作；但既有自中心迁移研究多聚焦解耦控制下的场景泛化，协调性全身技能的直接迁移尚缺探索。
AI.method: 核心为粗到细动作对齐：结合运动学参考修正与动力学感知精修，提升末端执行器位姿精度并保持全身协调；同时采用机器人手臂渲染与训练期图像增强，缩小视觉具身差距、增强视角鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在四个真实世界任务上，基于对齐后人类数据训练的VLA策略无需目标任务机器人示范即可零样本迁移，任务得分与遥操作数据训练的策略相当，且采集成本更低。
AI.conclusion: 人类数据可作为协调全身移动操作技能的直接监督来源，具备替代遥操作数据采集的潜力。

title: Recovering the View: Benchmarking Physical Active Vision for Occlusion Recovery in Robotic Manipulation
summary: Physical active vision allows robots to change their viewpoint when task-relevant observations become unreliable, yet existing manipulation benchmarks provide limited support for studying how policies recover from occlusion during execution. We introduce BAVO-Bench (Bimanual Active Vision under Occlusion), a bimanual active-vision benchmark that systematically controls external visibility through Clean, Stage Occlusion, and Random-time Occlusion conditions, enabling evaluation of both manipulation performance and active visual recovery. Building on this setting, we present A-FAR (Active Future-Aware Recovery), an active-vision policy for joint viewpoint and manipulation control. A-FAR represents moving-camera observations in a unified robot-centric 3D frame and distills relational structure together with its future evolution from a pretrained 4D model, providing the policy with future-aware geometric guidance without requiring future observations at deployment. Experiments across multiple manipulation tasks show that A-FAR improves robustness to both structured and temporally shifted occlusions while maintaining strong performance under clean observations.

AI.tldr: 提出双臂主动视觉遮挡基准 BAVO-Bench 及主动视觉策略 A-FAR，将移动相机观测统一到机器人中心 3D 坐标并蒸馏 4D 模型的关系结构与未来演化，提升遮挡下的操作鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有操作基准对策略在执行中如何从遮挡恢复的支持有限，无法系统评估主动视觉恢复能力，而物理主动视觉在观测不可靠时对机器人至关重要。
AI.method: BAVO-Bench 通过 Clean、Stage Occlusion、Random-time Occlusion 三种条件系统控制外部可见性，同时评估操作性能与主动视觉恢复；A-FAR 为联合视角与操作控制的主动视觉策略，将移动相机观测表示在统一机器人中心 3D 框架中，并从预训练 4D 模型蒸馏关系结构及其未来演化，部署时无需未来观测即可获得未来感知几何引导。
AI.result: 多任务实验表明，A-FAR 对结构化遮挡与时间偏移遮挡的鲁棒性均提升，同时在干净观测下保持较强性能。
AI.conclusion: BAVO-Bench 为主动视觉遮挡下的双臂操作提供了可控评测平台，A-FAR 通过未来感知 3D 表示有效实现视角与操作联合控制，兼顾鲁棒性与干净条件下的性能。

title: Remember What You Did: Action-History Memory with Dual-Expert Denoising for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have driven rapid progress in robotic manipulation, demonstrating strong fine-grained control and promising performance on long-horizon tasks. However, many existing VLAs lack explicit access to interaction history, making them vulnerable to perceptual aliasing: similar current observations and robot states at different task stages may induce action ambiguity and lower success rate. Existing methods incorporate temporal or progress cues through feature conditioning, action-prior modification, or sampling guidance. However, methods that jointly fine-tune memory modules and the base VLA incur additional policy-training costs, motivating the separation of trainable history-conditioned steering from frozen base-policy refinement. We propose ActMem-VLA, a dual-expert handover architecture that augments a frozen, fine-tuned VLA with a memory plugin comprising a Mamba-based memory module and a lightweight PreAction Expert (PAE). Specifically, Mamba encodes executed-action history into memory that conditions PAE alongside current context. With these inputs, PAE steers task progression during early, high-noise denoising, then passes the partially denoised action to the frozen Action Expert (AE) to refine action details during the remaining low-noise steps. The fine-tuned base VLA remains frozen throughout training, while only the Mamba module and PAE are jointly optimized. On LIBERO-Mem, ActMem-VLA achieves 80.8\% average success across all ten tasks, compared with 65.2\% for $π_{0.5}$ and 49.5\% for MemoryVLA, while introducing only 3.45\% additional parameters. Across four real-world tasks, it improves the average success rate over $π_{0.5}$ by 28.8\%.

AI.tldr: 提出ActMem-VLA双专家交接架构，在冻结基座VLA上仅训练Mamba记忆模块和轻量PAE，解决感知混叠问题，以3.45%额外参数在LIBERO-Mem达80.8%成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型缺乏对交互历史的显式访问，易受感知混叠影响：不同任务阶段出现相似的当前观测与机器人状态时，会产生动作歧义并降低成功率。已有方法通过特征调制、动作先验修改或采样引导引入时序/进度线索，但联合微调记忆模块与基座VLA会带来额外的策略训练开销，因此需要将可训练的历史条件引导与冻结基座策略的精炼过程分离。
AI.method: ActMem-VLA采用双专家交接架构，在冻结的微调VLA上增加记忆插件，由基于Mamba的记忆模块和轻量PreAction Expert（PAE）组成。Mamba将已执行动作历史编码为记忆，与当前上下文共同条件化PAE。PAE在早期高噪声去噪阶段引导任务推进，随后将部分去噪的动作传递给冻结的Action Expert（AE），在剩余低噪声步骤中精炼动作细节。训练中基座VLA始终冻结，仅联合优化Mamba模块与PAE。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-Mem上，ActMem-VLA全部十项任务平均成功率达80.8%，而π_{0.5}为65.2%、MemoryVLA为49.5%，仅引入3.45%额外参数。在四项真实世界任务中，相比π_{0.5}平均成功率提升28.8%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将可训练的历史条件引导（Mamba记忆+PAE）与冻结的基座VLA精炼相分离，ActMem-VLA以极低参数开销显著缓解感知混叠，在仿真与真实任务上均大幅优于现有方法，验证了双专家交接与记忆条件化去噪的有效性。

title: Battery-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Aggressive Quadrotor Flight
comment: 9 pages, 9 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to ICRA 2027. Supplementary video: https://youtu.be/-JTRXvstFAo
summary: Agile flight tasks such as drone racing and pursuit-evasion require strong acceleration and precise turns, but the available thrust changes as the battery discharges and voltage drops under load. Conservative command limits make this variation easier to tolerate, at the cost of unused performance. We investigate how learned controllers can use that additional thrust while retaining the flight controller's voltage compensation and rate control. Our training simulator couples an identified load-transient battery model to rotor dynamics and firmware saturation. The feedforward policy receives filtered voltage during both training and deployment. Controlled ablations distinguish the benefit of a larger thrust-command range from that of voltage information. On a 38 g Crazyflie Brushless, the resulting policy reduces circle tracking error by 49% relative to stock-authority RL at 3.84 m/s, while preserving easy-task precision. Mean 20-lap race time decreases from 106.22 s to 95.24 s. Compared with a voltage-blind policy with the same increased authority, hardware error and race time are lower by 15.3% and 4.5%, respectively. In simulation, replacing the policy's voltage input with a recording from a different battery condition worsens hard-circle tracking, with a smaller, voltage-dependent effect in racing. Together, these results show where a simple voltage input complements existing actuator compensation in aggressive learned flight.

AI.tldr: 本文将电池负载-电压瞬态模型耦合进旋翼动力学与固件饱和仿真，训练带电压输入的前馈策略以在保留飞控电压补偿与角速率控制的前提下释放更大推力指令范围；在38 g Crazyflie Brushless实机上，圆周跟踪误差较基线RL降低49%，20圈平均竞速时间从106.22 s降至95.24 s。
AI.motivation: 敏捷飞行（如竞速与追逃）需要大加速度与精确转向，但电池放电、负载下电压跌落会改变可用推力。保守的指令限幅虽能容忍该变化，却牺牲了未利用的性能。作者希望在学习型控制器中利用这部分额外推力，同时不破坏飞控已有的电压补偿与角速率控制。
AI.method: 构建将辨识得到的负载瞬态电池模型与旋翼动力学、固件饱和相耦合的训练仿真器；前馈策略在训练与部署时均接收滤波后的电压信号；通过受控消融实验，分离“更大的推力指令范围”与“电压信息”各自的贡献；与同权限但电压盲的策略及stock-authority RL进行对比；并在仿真中把策略的电压输入替换为不同电池工况下的记录，以检验电压输入的作用。
AI.result: 在38 g Crazyflie Brushless上，所得策略在3.84 m/s下将圆周跟踪误差较stock-authority RL降低49%，同时保持简单任务精度；20圈平均竞速时间由106.22 s降至95.24 s。相比同样增大权限但电压盲的策略，硬件误差与竞速时间分别低15.3%与4.5%。仿真中，将电压输入替换为不同电池工况记录会恶化困难圆周跟踪，在竞速中影响较小且依赖电压状态。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在激进的学习型飞行中，一个简单的电压输入能够与现有执行器补偿形成互补，从而安全地利用随电池状态变化的额外推力，提升跟踪精度与竞速表现。

title: Taming VLAs under Robot Execution Errors: Self-Compensation and Stress Testing
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies often fail when a robot's executed motion deviates from their commanded action. Such execution errors arise from the robot's mechanics and operating conditions, such as wear and payload changes. We propose self-compensating VLA, a deployment-time adaptation method that enables a VLA policy to pre-compensate for the robot's execution errors when generating commands. Without task rewards or labels, it updates the policy online using the residual between the action commanded by a VLA and the motion executed by the robot. To stress-test VLA robustness across execution conditions that are impractical to cover with physical robots alone, we introduce RoboStress, a controlled simulation benchmark. It combines established joint-level models of friction, backlash, compliance, and gravity-compensation error into seven deployment scenarios whose execution errors depend on the robot's state and motion history. On RoboStress, self-compensating VLA achieves higher average task success than both the base policies and methods that build in robustness during training. On two physical robot arms with different usage histories, it raises the average task success rate by more than 30 percentage points on each arm, and the gains extend to objects not seen in the task demonstrations.

AI.tldr: 提出自补偿VLA：部署时在线自适应方法，利用指令动作与执行动作的残差更新策略以预补偿机器人执行误差；并构建RoboStress仿真基准，在仿真与两台实体机械臂上均显著提升任务成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA（视觉-语言-动作）策略在机器人实际执行动作偏离指令动作时会失败。此类执行误差源于机器人机械特性与运行条件，如磨损、负载变化。现有工作多在训练阶段增强鲁棒性，难以覆盖多样的真实执行工况。
AI.method: 部署时自适应：不依赖任务奖励或标签，利用VLA输出的指令动作与机器人实际执行运动之间的残差，在线更新策略，使其在生成指令时预先补偿执行误差。同时构建RoboStress仿真基准，将摩擦、回差（间隙）、柔顺性、重力补偿误差等关节级模型组合为7种部署场景，其执行误差依赖机器人状态与运动历史。
AI.result: 在RoboStress上，自补偿VLA的平均任务成功率高于基础策略以及训练阶段注入鲁棒性的方法。在两台使用历史不同的实体机械臂上，平均任务成功率分别提升超过30个百分点，且增益可泛化到任务演示中未见过的物体。
AI.conclusion: 执行误差可视为部署时可观测的残差信号，通过在线自补偿即可有效缓解；该方法无需奖励或标签，优于训练期鲁棒化方案，并在真实机械臂与未见物体上具备泛化性，表明部署时自适应是提升VLA执行可靠性的有效途径。

title: DROM: A Language-Guided Diffusion Framework for Multi-Skill Robotic Manipulation
summary: Learning robust manipulation policies for diverse, long-horizon tasks from limited demonstrations remains a fundamental challenge in robotics. We present DROM, a language-guided diffusion framework that enables robots to learn, represent, and compose multiple manipulation skills within a single generative policy. DROM leverages Dynamic Movement Primitives (DMPs) to augment a small set of expert demonstrations into expressive multi-skill datasets, substantially reducing data collection while improving spatial generalization beyond the demonstrated workspace. Building upon Motion Planning Diffusion (MPD), we extend the diffusion architecture to support language-conditioned multi-skill trajectory generation through cross-attention, allowing a single model to generate skill-consistent motions for a diverse set of manipulation primitives, including orientation-sensitive behaviors that are difficult to design using conventional motion planning or hard-coded controllers. For long-horizon manipulation, a large language model decomposes high-level operator requests into executable sequences of skills, enabling natural language interaction and autonomous task execution. We validate DROM on a Franka Emika Panda robot, a FANUC CRX25ia robot, and in MuJoCo simulation across a wide range of manipulation tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that DROM outperforms Motion Planning Diffusion and Behavior Cloning baselines, achieves robust multi-skill generalization, and composes learned skills to reliably execute long-horizon manipulation tasks from natural language instructions using only a limited number of human demonstrations. Datasets, simulation environments, and more at https://github.com/automation-robotics-machines/drom.

AI.tldr: DROM：一种语言引导的扩散框架，用少量演示学习、表示并组合多种操作技能，实现长时序任务的自主执行。
AI.motivation: 从有限演示中学习适用于多样、长时序任务的鲁棒操作策略仍是机器人领域的根本挑战；传统运动规划或硬编码控制器难以设计朝向敏感等复杂行为，且数据采集成本高。
AI.method: 利用 Dynamic Movement Primitives（DMPs）将少量专家演示增强为多技能数据集，提升空间泛化；在 Motion Planning Diffusion（MPD）基础上扩展扩散架构，通过交叉注意力实现语言条件下的多技能轨迹生成；由大语言模型将高层操作指令分解为可执行技能序列。
AI.result: 在 Franka Emika Panda、FANUC CRX25ia 机器人及 MuJoCo 仿真上验证，DROM 优于 Motion Planning Diffusion 与 Behavior Cloning 基线，实现鲁棒的多技能泛化，并能依据自然语言指令组合已学技能可靠完成长时序操作任务。
AI.conclusion: DROM 以单一生成式策略统一多技能学习与组合，仅需少量人类演示即可通过语言交互实现长时序操作，为语言引导的机器人操作提供了有效方案。

title: Towards Spatial Perception for Heterogeneous Robot Collaboration in Subterranean Mining Environments
summary: The autonomous extraction of deep mineral deposits in abandoned underground mines is fundamentally a multi-agent integration problem. No single platform simultaneously offers the mobility to traverse kilometers of degraded drifts and the sensing payload required to characterize an ore body. This article presents the onboard perception pipeline that bridges two heterogeneous agents within the PERSEPHONE autonomous mining mission. Which consist of a lightweight Explorer robot that maps an unknown mine and generates a 3D scene graph of inspection targets, by running a zero-shot, vision-language semantic segmentation stack that detects mineral deposits directly from natural-language prompts. The map and the graph are then handed to a second Inspector robot, which carries an advanced sensing payload and uses them to plan close-range inspection viewpoints. We detail the complete pipeline, with emphasis on the geometric abstraction that turns raw detections into actionable inspection targets, spanning per-view bounding-box generation, cross-view box merging, plane fitting, and polygon extraction, and we report an extensive field validation in a subterranean test facility and in an active magnesite mine, covering both iron-vein and magnesite mineralization under realistic, perceptually degraded conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PERSEPHONE自主采矿任务中连接异构Explorer与Inspector双机器人的机载感知流水线，实现退化矿井环境下深部矿体的自主探测与近距离巡查。
AI.motivation: 单一平台无法同时兼顾穿越数公里退化巷道的机动性与表征矿体所需的传感载荷，因此需要多智能体协同。地下废弃矿井深部矿体的自主开采本质上是一个多智能体整合问题。
AI.method: 由轻量级Explorer机器人以零样本视觉-语言语义分割栈，从自然语言提示直接检测矿藏，构建未知矿井地图与巡检目标的三维场景图；将地图与场景图传递给搭载高端传感载荷的Inspector机器人，用于规划近距离巡检视点。完整的流水线包含几何抽象环节：逐视角边界框生成、跨视角框合并、平面拟合与多边形提取，将原始检测转化为可执行的巡检目标。
AI.result: 在地下测试设施及一座在产菱镁矿中开展了广泛的现场验证，覆盖铁矿脉与菱镁矿成矿，并在逼真且感知退化的条件下完成测试。
AI.conclusion: 该异构双机器人感知流水线可在地下退化环境中有效完成矿藏检测、地图与场景图构建及巡检视点规划，验证了多智能体整合方案在自主采矿中的可行性。

title: FP2: Equipping Robotic Foundation Models with Force Control
summary: Robotic foundation models (RFMs) are increasingly capable of general-purpose manipulation, yet reliable physical interaction remains challenging in contact-rich settings. We present FP2, a lightweight downstream interface that equips task-adapted RFMs with explicit force control while preserving their action-generation capability. FP2 adopts an action-regulation decomposition: the task-adapted RFM serves as a foundation policy responsible for task-level action generation, while a high-frequency force control policy focuses solely on interaction regulation. To condition force regulation on the ongoing manipulation, FP2 compresses foundation-policy contextual representations and combines them with wrench and proprioceptive histories to predict structured force-control parameters. We evaluate FP2 with four RFM backbones across four real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks. FP2 consistently improves task performance and force regulation quality over the corresponding foundation policies, while comparing favorably with representative force-aware and force-control baselines. Ablations further show that foundation-policy context and physical feedback are complementary for effective force regulation, while preserving foundation-policy action generation improves both efficiency and novel-object generalization. Project website: http://force-policy.github.io/fp2

AI.tldr: 提出FP2，一种轻量级下游接口，将显式力控制能力赋予任务适配的机器人基础模型（RFM），同时保留其动作生成能力。
AI.motivation: 机器人基础模型虽具备通用操作能力，但在接触密集场景下的可靠物理交互仍具挑战；现有RFM缺乏显式力控制能力。
AI.method: 采用动作调节分解：任务适配RFM作为基础策略负责任务级动作生成，高频力控制策略仅负责交互调节；FP2压缩基础策略的上下文表征，并与力/力矩（wrench）及本体感受历史融合，预测结构化力控制参数。
AI.result: 在4种RFM骨干、4个真实世界接触密集操作任务上评估：FP2持续提升任务性能与力调节质量，优于对应基础策略及代表性力感知与力控制基线。
AI.conclusion: 消融表明基础策略上下文与物理反馈对有效力调节具有互补性，且保留基础策略动作生成能力可同时提升效率与新物体泛化。

title: Anisotropic Representations Improve Planning in JEPA World Models
summary: Latent world models learn action-conditioned dynamics in representation space and often score candidate actions by Euclidean distance to a goal representation. Joint training typically regularizes the representation to prevent collapse, but the resulting representation geometry also determines how terminal errors are weighted during planning. We show that accurate prediction and noncollapsed representations do not guarantee a task-aligned latent planning cost: isotropic Gaussian regularization can induce a geometry that ranks feasible outcomes differently from the task cost. To address this mismatch, we introduce AnisoWM with $Λ$Reg, which replaces the fixed isotropic Gaussian target with a learnable diagonal covariance under fixed-trace and anisotropy constraints. The prediction objective, predictor architecture, and Euclidean planner remain unchanged; the target is used only during training. Our analysis characterizes the prediction-driven allocation of target variance, its dependence on the training distribution, and the conditions under which the induced metric reduces planning regret. Across four visual control environments, AnisoWM improves planning success over LeWorldModel in all four. Its latent planning cost also shows better agreement with task outcomes. Project website: https://rkdrn79.github.io/AnisoWM-page/

AI.tldr: AnisoWM 通过学习各向异性的对角协方差正则项（ΛReg），使潜在世界模型的表示几何与任务代价对齐，从而在不改动预测器与欧氏规划器的情况下提升视觉控制规划成功率。
AI.motivation: 潜在世界模型通常在表示空间学习动作条件动力学，并用候选动作到目标表示的欧氏距离打分。联合训练中常用的各向同性高斯正则虽能防止表示坍塌，但其诱导的表示几何会决定规划时终端误差的加权方式。论文指出：准确的预测与非坍塌表示并不能保证任务对齐的潜在规划代价——各向同性正则可能使潜在空间的排序与真实任务代价不一致。
AI.method: 提出 AnisoWM 与 ΛReg：将固定的各向同性高斯目标替换为可学习的对角协方差，并施加固定迹（fixed-trace）与各向异性（anisotropy）约束。预测目标函数、预测器架构与欧氏规划器均保持不变，该目标仅在训练阶段使用。理论上分析预测驱动的目标方差分配、其对训练分布的依赖，以及诱导度量在何种条件下降低规划遗憾（planning regret）。
AI.result: 在四个视觉控制环境中，AnisoWM 的规划成功率均优于 LeWorldModel（四个环境全部提升）；其潜在规划代价与任务结果之间的一致性也更好。
AI.conclusion: 表示的非坍塌性与预测精度不足以保障任务对齐的规划代价；通过 ΛReg 调整潜在目标的各向异性几何，可有效对齐潜在规划度量与任务目标，提升规划性能，且无需修改模型主体架构或规划算法。

title: Surgical Master Console Using General-Purpose Robot Arms and a Separable Articulated Distal Interface: Porcine In-Vivo Evaluation
summary: High-performance surgical master consoles offer intuitive articulated manipulation but are expensive and difficult to reproduce, while accessible commercial haptic devices lack built-in interfaces for surgical wrist articulation and continuous grasp. We present a laparoscopic master in which general-purpose robot manipulators provide the programmable base and surgical-specific interaction is concentrated in a separable distal adapter. Each 6-DoF arm carries a custom 2-DoF direct-drive wrist, continuous grasp sensing, and clutch-based workspace management; the complete bimanual hardware costs approximately US$5,500, below common bimanual commercial haptic references. To support sustained hand-guided use, we characterize current scaling, gravity, and break-away friction and use them for posture-dependent gravity compensation and motion-gated assistance, reducing continuous actuation and thermal loading. A common master state drives either Isaac Sim or an RCM-constrained dual-FR3 platform. Master-state publication to FR3 target update adds at most 8 ms, and tip tracking shows 0.31-0.66 mm mean delay-aligned residuals. In a porcine cholecystectomy experiment, five common operator-side metrics and hand/tip-speed distributions were compared descriptively with human in-vivo telemetry from 120 clinical Versius recordings of 99 cholecystectomy procedures; no interruption originated from the master console, and no abnormal clinical signs were recorded during the 7-day postoperative observation period. These results demonstrate a surgical master built from general-purpose robot arms with surgical-specific interaction concentrated in a separable distal interface.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种腹腔镜主手，将通用机器人机械臂作为可编程基座、把手术专用交互集中于可分离远端适配器，双手硬件成本约5500美元，并通过重力补偿与运动门控辅助实现持续手控使用。
AI.motivation: 高性能手术主控制台操作直观但昂贵且难以复现，而可获得的商用触觉设备缺乏手术腕部关节 articulation 与连续夹持的内置接口，因此需要一种低成本、可复现且具备手术专用交互能力的主手方案。
AI.method: 每条6自由度机械臂搭载定制2自由度直驱腕部、连续夹持传感和基于离合的工作空间管理；表征电流缩放、重力与启动力摩擦，用于姿态相关重力补偿和运动门控辅助；同一主手状态驱动Isaac Sim或RCM约束的双FR3平台；开展猪胆囊切除实验，并与120例临床Versius记录进行描述性对比。
AI.result: 完整双手硬件成本约5500美元，低于常见商用双手触觉参考设备；主手状态发布到FR3目标更新最多增加8 ms，末端跟踪显示0.31–0.66 mm平均延迟对齐残差；在猪胆囊切除实验中，五项常见操作者侧指标和手/末端速度分布与人体在体遥测进行描述性比较，主控制台未造成中断，术后7天观察期内未记录异常临床体征。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，可以用通用机器人机械臂构建手术主手，并将手术专用交互集中于可分离远端接口，从而实现低成本、可复现且适用于持续手控操作的手术主手方案。

title: Contact-Adaptive Robotic Ultrasound Probe Control for Tissue Exploration and Continuous Task-Relevant Visualization Using Robot-Free Image-Motion Demonstration
summary: Robotic ultrasound commonly targets standardized views, predefined scanning protocols, or expert-scan reproduction. We target a different role: while a clinician performs the primary procedure, a robotic assistant maintains a clinician-selected view so that changing tissue remains observable. We present contact-adaptive robotic ultrasound monitoring derived from robot-free demonstrations. Sonologger clamps a six-axis inertial sensor to the clinician-operated probe and records synchronized ultrasound and probe-frame relative rotations without a robot, camera, or tracker. Rather than imitating trajectories, the recordings measure which probe axis and sign the clinician uses to correct an image offset. A measured image latency is removed before still-move-still segmentation yields relative-rotation labels; translation is excluded from control because of inertial drift. These measurements parameterize the Demonstration-Informed Image-Motion Controller (DIMC), an interpretable, non-learned controller combined with beam-axis force regulation and an independent safety supervisor with 5 N forced retreat. On a dynamic bladder phantom, DIMC acquired and held a task-relevant view in 7 of 7 blind, pose-paired trials versus 1 of 7 for a static hold (McNemar p = 0.031), and retained the view during syringe-driven hydro-distension while the supervisor bounded the force excursion. The framework offers an operational representation of ultrasound context for contact-adaptive intraoperative monitoring; clinical validation remains future work.

AI.tldr: 提出 Sonologger 无机器人示教采集框架与 DIMC 控制器，使机械臂在临床医生操作时自动维持选定超声切面，实现接触自适应术中监测。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人超声多聚焦于标准化切面、预设扫描协议或复现专家扫查，而临床中更需要的是一种"辅助"角色：在医生执行主操作时，机器人持续维持医生选定的切面，使组织变化始终可见。该需求与轨迹复现范式本质不同，且需应对探头-组织接触变化与力安全问题。
AI.method: 1) Sonologger：将六轴惯性传感器夹持在医生手持探头上，无需机器人、相机或外部跟踪器，同步记录超声图像与探头坐标系相对旋转；2) 从示教中测量医生用于纠正图像偏移的探头轴与方向符号，而非模仿轨迹；3) 标定并剔除图像延迟，经静止-移动-静止分割生成相对旋转标签，因惯性漂移而排除平移控制；4) 用这些量参数化 DIMC——一种可解释、非学习的图像-运动控制器，并叠加声束轴向力调节与独立安全监控器（5 N 强制撤退）。
AI.result: 在动态膀胱体模上，7 组位姿配对的盲测中 DIMC 有 7/7 成功获取并保持任务相关切面，静态保持仅 1/7（McNemar p = 0.031）；在注射器驱动的膀胱充盈扩张过程中仍能维持切面，同时安全监控器限定了力超调。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为接触自适应术中监测提供了一种可操作的超声上下文表示，验证了"医生主操作+机器人维持切面"这一新角色的可行性；临床验证仍为后续工作。

title: Waggle-Dance-Inspired Multi-UAV Recruitment with RGB and Synthetic Event Vision
summary: The honeybee waggle dance motivates a communication mechanism in which one agent's motion guides the subsequent work of other agents. For aerial robots, realizing this mechanism requires a link from observed movement to a complete message, local task selection, and execution. This paper presents a MuJoCo system for comparing RGB and synthetic event vision within that link. One performer broadcasts six-bit task offers to one to three observers, each of which independently decodes both offers before selecting a task. The RGB receiver extracts trajectories using sparse optical flow; the event receiver uses only local event support and packet timing. Both use a common motion alphabet and explicit null delimiters. Because event silence does not establish target visibility, the event version includes a physical acquisition motion and continuity-qualified null confirmation. In the nominal three-observer case, each version produced 12 complete message receptions, six completed work units, and reassignment after withdrawal of a depleted task. Six paired functional cases produced the same message and work counts; an additional event-stream dropout case preserved inactivity of the affected observer. Replaying 42,060,633 recorded synthetic events reproduced all 12 event-message payloads and completion timestamps. Total nominal mission time was 493.80 s for RGB and 517.40 s for events, with the difference dominated by the event acquisition schedule. These fixed simulation results establish functional feasibility across two receiver implementations, rather than a sensor-performance advantage or hardware validation.

AI.tldr: 该论文在MuJoCo中实现蜜蜂摇摆舞启发的通信机制，对比RGB与合成事件视觉两种接收方案，验证从运动到完整报文、任务选择与执行的功能可行性。
AI.motivation: 空中机器人需要一种由单个智能体运动引导其他智能体后续工作的通信机制，但需建立从观测运动到完整报文、局部任务选择与执行的链路；同时需比较RGB与事件视觉在该链路中的实现差异。
AI.method: 构建MuJoCo系统：一名表演者广播六位任务邀约，1至3名观察者各自独立解码两份邀约后选择任务。RGB接收端用稀疏光流提取轨迹；事件接收端仅用局部事件支持与数据包时序。两者共用运动字母表和显式空分隔符。由于事件静默不能证明目标可见性，事件版本加入物理采集运动与连续性限定空确认。
AI.result: 标称三观察者情形下，两种版本均产生12次完整报文接收、6个完成工作单元，并在耗尽任务撤除后重新分配。6组配对功能案例得到相同报文与工作计数；额外的事件流丢包案例保持受影响观察者不活动。回放42,060,633个记录合成事件复现全部12个事件报文载荷与完成时间戳。标称任务总时长为RGB 493.80 s、事件517.40 s，差异主要来自事件采集调度。
AI.conclusion: 固定仿真结果确立两种接收实现的功能可行性，而非传感器性能优势或硬件验证。

title: Video2STL: Grounding VLM-Generated Temporal Specifications for Robot Learning
summary: Video-based policy learning is particularly promising, as it illustrates target behaviors without requiring action annotations or embodiment-matched demonstrations. A central challenge is deciding what information should be transferred from the video to the robot. Existing approaches commonly convert visual observations into scalar similarity or value signals, or ask foundation models to directly generate reward code. These approaches can make the temporal structure of a task difficult to inspect, ground, and reuse. We present Video2STL, a framework that converts observation-only videos into parametric Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifications and uses the resulting formal representation for robot learning. A vision-language model extracts an embodiment-independent semantic event trace and constructs a bank of symbolic temporal specifications. The model determines the task structure, while numerical predicate thresholds and temporal bounds are grounded from successful robot trajectories. For policy learning, we separate short- and long-timescale temporal information: short-horizon specifications provide dense rewards through rolling-window quantitative robustness, while a causal monitor over a retained long-horizon specification provides one-time progress rewards for valid temporal prefixes. The same representation supports cross-embodiment transfer from human or animal videos to robot control. Across four manipulation tasks, Video2STL achieves $85.8\%$ average success-once and $67.0\%$ success-at-end, compared with $81.5\%/59.5\%$ for native dense PPO and $65.0\%/42.3\%$ for Text2Reward; in quadruped locomotion, Qwen-3.8 and GPT-5.6-based Video2STL policies achieve $100\%$ success across velocities from $0.3$ to $2.1\,\mathrm{m/s}$ while remaining competitive in high-speed energy efficiency. Project webpage: \href{https://video2stl.github.io/}{video2stl}.

AI.tldr: Video2STL 将纯观测视频转化为参数化信号时序逻辑（STL）规范，并以该形式化表示驱动机器人策略学习，在四类操作任务和四足运动任务上显著优于 PPO 与 Text2Reward。
AI.motivation: 基于视频的策略学习无需动作标注或同构演示，但核心难点在于"从视频中迁移什么信息"。现有方法将视觉观测压缩为标量相似度/价值信号，或让基础模型直接生成奖励代码，导致任务的时间结构难以被检查、落地和复用。
AI.method: 将观测视频转化为参数化 STL 规范：（1）视觉语言模型提取与本体无关的语义事件轨迹，构建符号化时序规范库，由模型确定任务结构；（2）数值谓词阈值与时序边界从成功机器人轨迹中落地。策略学习上分离短/长时标信息：短时域规范通过滑动窗口定量鲁棒性提供稠密奖励，保留的长时域规范经因果监视器为有效时序前缀提供一次性进度奖励。同一表示支持从人类或动物视频到机器人控制的跨本体迁移。
AI.result: 四类操作任务中，Video2STL 平均 success-once 达 85.8%、success-at-end 达 67.0%，优于原生稠密 PPO（81.5%/59.5%）和 Text2Reward（65.0%/42.3%）。四足运动任务中，基于 Qwen-3.8 与 GPT-5.6 的 Video2STL 策略在 0.3–2.1 m/s 速度范围内实现 100% 成功率，并在高速能效上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 以参数化 STL 作为视频到机器人学习的中间形式化表示，可显式呈现、落地并复用任务时间结构，兼顾稠密与里程碑式奖励，并天然支持跨本体迁移，在操作与运动任务上均验证了有效性与泛化性。

title: Wrench-ACT: Enhancing Robot Policies for Contact Rich Behavior Using Direct Wrench Control
summary: While contact-rich manipulation requires deliberate regulation of interaction forces, recent approaches to robot manipulation learning predominantly represent actions as target positions or poses. Even methods that incorporate force sensing either use it solely as an observation or, when predicting forces as part of the output, rely on a hybrid force controller. In this paper, we propose an imitation learning policy that predicts wrenches as its sole action output for direct use by a pure force controller. Our studies suggest that force-domain imitation learning depends critically on data collection, with force-feedback teleoperation improving policy performance by capturing the operator's deliberate force regulation. Using Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) as the base architecture, we train single-task models on bilateral wrench demonstrations and evaluate them on five contact-rich manipulation tasks. The wrench policy matches or outperforms position-based baselines across all tasks, with gains varying according to the degree of deliberate force regulation each task requires. Cross-condition ablations show that the bilateral data collection interface and the wrench action space each contribute independently to performance. To support further research, we will release over 1000 wrench-action demonstrations spanning these tasks on a companion website upon publication.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种以wrench（力/力矩）为唯一动作输出的模仿学习策略，直接由纯力控制器执行，用于接触丰富的操作任务。基于ACT架构在双边力反馈遥操作数据上训练，在五项任务上匹配或超越位置基线，并将公开1000余条wrench动作演示数据。
AI.motivation: 接触丰富的操作需要主动调节交互力，但现有机器人操作学习大多以目标位置或位姿表示动作；即使引入力传感，也仅将其作为观测，或在输出力时依赖混合力控制器，缺乏将力/力矩直接作为动作空间、配合纯力控制器的方案。同时，力域模仿学习的数据采集方式（是否包含力反馈遥操作）对策略性能的影响尚不明确。
AI.method: 提出以wrench（力与力矩）作为唯一动作输出的模仿学习策略，直接供纯力控制器使用。以Action Chunking with Transformers（ACT）为基础架构，在双边（bilateral）wrench演示数据上训练单任务模型，并在五项接触丰富操作任务上评估；通过跨条件消融实验分别考察双边数据采集接口与wrench动作空间对性能的独立贡献。
AI.result: wrench策略在全部五项任务上匹配或超越基于位置的基线，增益大小随各任务所需的主动力调节程度而变化。消融实验表明，双边数据采集接口与wrench动作空间各自独立地对性能有贡献。将随论文发表公开1000余条覆盖这些任务的wrench动作演示数据。
AI.conclusion: 力域模仿学习关键在于数据采集，力反馈遥操作能捕捉操作者的主动力调节，从而提升策略性能；将wrench作为动作空间并配合纯力控制器，是接触丰富操作任务中可行且优于位置基线的方案。

title: Risk-Aware Semantic Grounding for Trustworthy LLM-Based Robot Planning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as high-level planners in robot navigation, but their outputs may become unreliable when instructions are ambiguous, unsupported by the environment, or semantically inconsistent. This paper presents a Risk-Aware Semantic Grounding framework for trustworthy LLM-based robot planning. Unlike existing LLM-based planners that primarily optimize plan generation, we formulate semantic grounding reliability as a multi-dimensional risk estimation problem. The proposed architecture explicitly models grounding uncertainty through ambiguity, hallucination and semantic-conflict risks before planning occurs, enabling the system to decide whether to execute the instruction, request clarification, or reject it. To evaluate the approach, we introduce TRUST-NAV, a benchmark containing both standard navigation tasks and risk-inducing instruction scenarios. Experimental results show that while conventional LLM planners achieve strong performance on valid navigation tasks, the proposed framework substantially improves ambiguity detection and semantic conflict rejection. These findings suggest that trustworthy robot planning should be evaluated not only by task completion, but also by the ability to recognize when execution should not occur.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出风险感知语义落地框架，将LLM机器人规划中的语义落地可靠性建模为多维风险估计问题，并构建TRUST-NAV基准来评估歧义、幻觉与语义冲突风险。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地被用作机器人导航的高层规划器，但当指令存在歧义、缺乏环境支持或语义不一致时，其输出可能不可靠。现有LLM规划器主要优化计划生成，忽视了在执行前判断指令是否应当被执行的问题。
AI.method: 提出风险感知语义落地（Risk-Aware Semantic Grounding）框架，将语义落地可靠性形式化为多维风险估计问题。该架构在规划发生之前，显式建模歧义风险、幻觉风险和语义冲突风险等落地不确定性，从而决定执行指令、请求澄清还是拒绝指令。同时引入TRUST-NAV基准，包含标准导航任务和诱发风险的指令场景。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，传统LLM规划器在有效导航任务上表现较强，但所提框架在歧义检测和语义冲突拒绝方面有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 可信机器人规划不应仅以任务完成度来评价，还应考察系统识别"何时不应执行"的能力。研究强调落地风险估计是实现可信LLM机器人规划的关键维度。

title: RoboFin3D: A Sim-to-Real Platform for Robotic Surface Finishing
comment: Accepted for poster presentation at the IROS 2026 Workshop on Sim2Real and Classical Control: From Rigorous Theory to Data-Driven Robotics
summary: Grinding and sanding are fundamental processes in industrial robotic surface finishing. However, physical trials are expensive and consume workpieces, making reproducible experiments difficult. We present RoboFin3D, a sim-to-real platform built on Isaac Sim and the Newton physics engine, that provides physics-based grinding and sanding simulation for cheap and repeatable robotic surface finishing experiments. RoboFin3D utilizes a signed distance field (SDF) to model the changing geometry of the workpiece, enabling contact computation, live updates and rendering without an intermediate mesh. It additionally uses a separate surface field to model progressive surface appearance change during sanding. We also introduce WeldGen, a weld sampling module, to generate weld beads on 8,918 real-world workpiece meshes for providing diverse simulation assets. The simulation parameters are calibrated on real experimental results and our evaluation demonstrates our simulation's fidelity against the real world. We also demonstrate that simulation-generated data can be used to improve the performance of perception models. Simulation-only fine-tuning of SAM2 improves IoU for segmentation of unsanded regions from 77.15% to 84.47%, while combined synthetic and real training reaches 97.41%.

AI.tldr: RoboFin3D 是一个基于 Isaac Sim 与 Newton 物理引擎的仿真到现实平台，用 SDF 建模工件几何变化、用独立表面场建模打磨外观演变，并提供 WeldGen 生成焊缝资产，用于可重复、低成本的机器人磨削与砂磨实验。
AI.motivation: 工业机器人表面精加工中的磨削与砂磨依赖实物试验，成本高且消耗工件，导致实验难以复现；因此需要一个物理真实的仿真平台来低成本、可重复地开展此类实验。
AI.method: 构建 RoboFin3D：基于 Isaac Sim 和 Newton 物理引擎；使用有符号距离场（SDF）表示并动态更新工件几何，无需中间网格即可进行接触计算、实时更新与渲染；另设独立表面场建模砂磨过程中表面外观的渐进变化；提出 WeldGen 焊缝采样模块，在 8,918 个真实工件网格上生成焊缝；仿真参数依据真实实验结果标定。
AI.result: 评估表明仿真与真实世界具有较高保真度；仿真生成数据可提升感知模型性能：仅用仿真数据微调 SAM2，未打磨区域分割 IoU 从 77.15% 提升至 84.47%；合成与真实数据联合训练达到 97.41%。
AI.conclusion: RoboFin3D 提供了物理真实的磨削/砂磨仿真能力，可支持可重复实验，并能有效提升下游感知模型的性能，具备较强的仿真到现实迁移价值。

title: RoboHarn-Evo: Evolving Hierarchical Physical Knowledge for Self-Improving Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-language models can coordinate long-horizon robot manipulation, yet successful task reasoning still depends on whether local physical interactions produce the intended effects. We study how repeated interaction can improve this capability without updating the base model. We introduce RoboHarn-Evo, a dual-loop harness that evolves Hierarchical Physical Knowledge (HPK) from physical experience. HPK couples two levels of reusable knowledge: Task Knowledge captures which subtask should be executed and when it is complete, while Action Knowledge captures object-relative geometric strategies and their physical effects. During execution, the agent retrieves knowledge at the corresponding decision level and grounds it in the current scene under the task goal. Across episodes, physical feedback is used to revise historical knowledge, update its applicability, and organize reusable entries for subsequent retrieval. Experiments on RMBench show that HPK improves average success by up to 24.2 percentage points across different agent models. With 80 interaction rollouts, held-out success rises from 48.3% to 75.0% for GPT-5.5 and from 70.0% to 88.3% for GPT-6. RoboHarn-Evo also resolves over 83% of historical knowledge errors while retaining 95.8% of valid knowledge, and transfers zero-shot from RMBench to RoboDojo with gains of 35.0 and 25.0 percentage points. These results demonstrate that physical interaction can be accumulated into reusable knowledge for improving subsequent manipulation.

AI.tldr: 提出 RoboHarn-Evo 双环框架，在不更新基座模型的前提下，通过物理交互累积可复用的分层物理知识（HPK），显著提升视觉语言模型的机器人操作成功率。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型虽能协调长程操作任务，但其任务推理成败仍取决于局部物理交互能否产生预期效果；作者希望在不微调基座模型的情况下，利用重复交互提升这一能力。
AI.method: 提出 RoboHarn-Evo 双环框架，从物理经验中演化分层物理知识 HPK。HPK 包含两层可复用知识：任务知识（判断执行哪个子任务及完成时机）与动作知识（物体相对几何策略及其物理效果）。执行时按决策层级检索知识，并在任务目标下与当前场景做 grounding；跨回合利用物理反馈修正历史知识、更新适用性并组织可复用条目以供后续检索。
AI.result: 在 RMBench 上，HPK 使不同智能体模型平均成功率提升最多 24.2 个百分点；80 次交互 rollout 后，留出集成功率 GPT-5.5 从 48.3% 升至 75.0%，GPT-6 从 70.0% 升至 88.3%。RoboHarn-Evo 可修正 83% 以上的历史知识错误并保留 95.8% 的有效知识，从 RMBench 零样本迁移到 RoboDojo 分别提升 35.0 与 25.0 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明物理交互可被累积为可复用知识，从而改进后续机器人操作，且无需更新基座模型。

title: Credit-Guided Policy Improvement for Test-time Adaptive Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Test-time adaptation for vision-language navigation (TTA-VLN) enables pretrained policies to adapt online to unseen environments using only test-time observations and interaction history. However, distribution shifts can distort local action preferences and lead to off-course decisions. Existing methods rely on predictive uncertainty, trajectory-level feedback, or accumulated adaptation experience to correct such deviations. These signals, however, do not directly reveal whether an executed action supports instruction-guided progress toward the goal. Moreover, a plausible corrective signal does not guarantee a reliable policy update. The key challenge is thus twofold: identifying interactions that support goal-directed improvement and determining whether the resulting updates are worth retaining. We observe that each executed action induces an immediate observation transition, providing evidence of its local consequences. Based on this insight, we propose Credit-Guided Policy Improvement (CGPI), which recovers signed, reference-relative decision credit from action-induced observation transitions without external outcome feedback. With the pretrained navigation policy frozen, CGPI uses this credit to propose lightweight adaptation updates and verifies them against prior credit-supported interactions. Updates are retained only when supported and rolled back otherwise. CGPI achieves consistent gains across the evaluated VLN benchmarks and navigation backbones, while qualitative robot trials further illustrate the feasibility of zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出信用引导策略改进（CGPI），从动作诱导的观测转移中恢复带符号的相对决策信用，用于测试时自适应视觉语言导航。
AI.motivation: TTA-VLN中分布偏移会扭曲局部动作偏好导致偏离航线，现有基于预测不确定性、轨迹级反馈或累积适应经验的信号无法直接揭示动作是否支持目标导向进展，且可信的纠正信号不保证更新的可靠性。
AI.method: 基于每次执行动作都会产生即时观测转移这一洞察，CGPI在无外部结果反馈下，从动作诱导的观测转移中恢复带符号的、参考相对的决策信用；冻结预训练导航策略，用该信用提出轻量自适应更新，并依据此前信用支持的交互进行验证，支持则保留更新，否则回滚。
AI.result: 在评估的VLN基准与导航主板上取得一致性提升，定性机器人试验进一步展示了零样本仿真到真实迁移的可行性。
AI.conclusion: CGPI通过信用引导的更新验证机制，解决了"识别目标导向交互"与"判断更新是否值得保留"的双重挑战，为TTA-VLN提供了一种无需外部反馈的有效方案。

title: BlenDAgger: Blended Shared Control for Interactive Imitation Learning
summary: Robot policies are frequently trained from human corrections, yet teleoperating a robot to provide corrections is burdensome, and human demonstrators are not always optimal. We propose Blended DAgger (BlenDAgger), an approach for collecting data to train imitation learning policies by using shared control to blend the policy's and demonstrator's actions during interventions. By blending human and policy actions, we aim to improve the autonomous performance of manipulation policies. We validate our approach across five manipulation tasks, two in the real world and three in simulation. Our approach achieves higher autonomous performance by 30 or more percentage points on two real-world tasks compared to a typical human-gated correction approach (HG-DAgger). We also investigate the advantages of BlenDAgger that allow for higher autonomous performance, finding that BlenDAgger results in 57% smoother transitions between policy control and human interventions, and 14% higher trajectory similarity to the training data. In a user study (n=14) on two real-world tasks, we find that BlenDAgger results in faster data collection (BF=13.32), and we do not find a difference in subjective perceptions. These results show that blended shared control leads to higher autonomous performance compared to typical methods for fine-tuning robot policies from fully teleoperated interventions.

AI.tldr: 提出 BlenDAgger，通过共享控制在人工干预时混合策略与示范者动作来收集模仿学习数据，在真实与仿真操作任务上提升自主性能。
AI.motivation: 机器人策略常依赖人类纠正数据训练，但遥操作提供纠正负担重，且人类示范者并非总是最优。传统 HG-DAgger 依赖完全遥操作的干预，效率与效果受限。
AI.method: BlenDAgger：在干预阶段利用共享控制，将策略动作与示范者动作进行混合，从而生成训练数据，用于微调模仿学习策略。
AI.result: 在五个操作任务（2 个真实、3 个仿真）上验证。相比 HG-DAgger，两个真实任务自主性能提升 30 个百分点以上；控制切换更平滑（提升 57%），轨迹与训练数据相似度更高（提升 14%）；用户研究（n=14）显示数据采集更快（BF=13.32），主观感受无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 混合共享控制的 BlenDAgger 相比完全遥操作干预的典型微调方法，能带来更高的自主性能，同时加快数据采集且不损害主观体验。

title: Cascaded consensus splitting for multi-branch contingency games
summary: Contingency games enable agents to anticipate and plan for other agents' hypothetical intents by constructing trajectories with a shared prefix and intent-dependent branches. While contingency games capture intent uncertainty, existing formulations rely on a single branching time, oversimplifying interactions in which different agents' intentions are revealed at different times. Moreover, the computational cost of such problems grows rapidly with the number of agents and intents, as all scenario-dependent best responses must be solved jointly. We introduce a multi-branch contingency architecture in which sources of intent uncertainty can be resolved progressively at different branching times, allowing the planned trajectories to adapt to the asynchronous revelation of intents. We also develop an ADMM-based solver that exploits scenario-level parallelism. Experiments on tightly coupled three-agent interactions support that the proposed architecture outperforms the conventional single-branch while achieving a lower mean receding-horizon solve time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多分支contingency架构，允许意图不确定性在不同分支时刻渐进揭示，并设计基于ADMM的场景级并行求解器，在三智能体紧耦合交互中优于单分支方法且平均滚动时域求解时间更低。
AI.motivation: 现有contingency games仅采用单一分支时刻，简化了不同智能体意图在不同时间揭示的交互情形；同时其计算成本随智能体与意图数量迅速增长，因为所有场景相关的最优响应需联合求解。
AI.method: 引入多分支contingency架构，使意图不确定性来源可在不同分支时刻被逐步揭示，从而让规划轨迹适应意图的异步揭示；并开发基于ADMM的求解器以利用场景级并行性。
AI.result: 在三智能体紧耦合交互实验中，所提架构优于传统单分支方法，并实现更低的平均滚动时域求解时间。
AI.conclusion: 多分支contingency架构结合ADMM并行求解，可更真实地刻画意图异步揭示并提升计算效率，适用于紧耦合多智能体交互规划。

title: Semantic Map Sharing and Capability-Aware Coverage Planning for AI-Native 6G Robotic Coordination
comment: An alternative version of this work was accepted for presentation at IEEE CSCN 2026
summary: Search and Rescue (SAR) operations increasingly deploy heterogeneous teams of aerial and ground robots. However, conventional coverage methods typically do not translate perceived terrain into platform-specific reachability, while continuous image exchange imposes a high communication cost. We propose an edge-centric, semantic-aware coverage planning framework that integrates aerial terrain perception, robot-specific traversability reasoning, and payload-efficient semantic state sharing. Aerial observations are converted into compact semantic grid maps, enabling reachability-constrained area decomposition and capability-aware coverage paths that assign only regions admitted by each robot's capability profile. The resulting perception-sharing-planning loop feeds semantic corrections into traversability reasoning and replanning, forming an application-level mechanism motivated by AI-enabled goal-oriented communication envisioned for AI-native 6G networks. For the high-update case, transmitting semantic corrections reduces the application payload by a factor of approximately $82$ relative to periodic full-map sharing. Across matched benchmark scenarios, the proposed method achieved $91.5\%$ coverage with no capability-infeasible allocations, compared with $78.8\%$ coverage and a $21.5\%$ capability-infeasible allocation rate for LS-MCPP. Semantic corrections update the shared planning state without requiring repeated transmission of the complete map.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向异构空地机器人搜救的边缘中心、语义感知覆盖规划框架，将空中地形感知、机器人通行性推理与高效语义状态共享结合，实现约82倍负载降低并达到91.5%覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 异构空地机器人协同搜救中，传统覆盖方法未将感知地形转化为平台特定的可达性约束，且持续图像交换带来高通信开销，难以满足AI原生6G中面向目标的通信需求。
AI.method: 构建边缘中心的语义感知覆盖规划框架：空中观测转为紧凑语义栅格地图，进行可达性约束的区域分解，并按机器人能力画像生成能力感知覆盖路径；感知-共享-规划闭环将语义修正反馈至通行性推理与重规划，高更新场景下仅传输语义修正而非周期全图。
AI.result: 高更新场景下，语义修正传输相比周期全图共享将应用负载降低约82倍；在匹配基准场景中，所提方法覆盖率达91.5%且无能力不可行分配，而LS-MCPP仅为78.8%覆盖率、21.5%能力不可行分配率。
AI.conclusion: 语义修正可在不重复传输完整地图的前提下更新共享规划状态，验证了语义状态共享与能力约束覆盖规划在异构SAR中的有效性与通信效率。

title: Learning Expressive and Compositional Motion Representation via Spectral Skills
summary: Robotic foundation models offer a promising path toward general-purpose humanoid robot control, often through hierarchical architectures. However, their effectiveness depends on the command interface between the planner and the controller, which must support accurate execution while remaining easy to predict, and ideally allow new behaviors to be composed from prior ones. In this work, we introduce spectral skills, a latent representation of this interface that meets these requirements through predictive representation learning. By design, spectral skills compactly encode short motion segments and are learned by predicting subsequent motion rather than reconstructing the encoder input. On a 29-DoF humanoid, a controller conditioned on spectral skills reduces global tracking error by 62\% relative to the state of the art. The same frozen controller chains independently encoded skills without a separate transition policy. It also composes new behaviors by adding orthogonal directions to any compatible base skill, producing combinations unseen in the training data. We demonstrate tracking, chaining, and composition, as well as control through a language-conditioned planner, on Unitree G1 hardware. Project page: https://spectral-skill.github.io

AI.tldr: 本文提出"频谱技能"（spectral skills），一种用于人形机器人分层控制中规划器-控制器接口的潜在表示，通过预测式表示学习获得。它紧凑编码短运动片段，支持精确跟踪、技能串联与新行为组合。在29自由度人形机器人上，全局跟踪误差较SOTA降低62%，并在Unitree G1硬件上验证了跟踪、串联、组合及语言条件规划控制。
AI.motivation: 机器人基础模型常采用分层架构实现通用人形控制，但其效果高度依赖规划器与控制器之间的命令接口。该接口需同时满足三点：支持精确执行、易于预测，并理想地允许从已有行为组合出新行为。现有接口难以兼顾这些要求。
AI.method: 提出"频谱技能"作为该接口的潜在表示，通过预测式表示学习获得。设计上，频谱技能紧凑编码短运动片段，其学习目标为预测后续运动而非重构编码器输入，从而提升可预测性与执行精度。控制器以频谱技能为条件；同一冻结控制器可直接串联独立编码的技能，无需单独过渡策略；并通过在任意兼容基础技能上叠加正交方向实现新行为组合。
AI.result: 在29自由度人形机器人上，以频谱技能为条件的控制器将全局跟踪误差较当前最优方法降低62%。冻结控制器无需过渡策略即可串联独立编码的技能；叠加正交方向可组合出训练数据中未出现的新行为。在Unitree G1硬件上展示了跟踪、串联、组合以及通过语言条件规划器进行的控制。
AI.conclusion: 频谱技能作为一种预测式学习的潜在接口表示，兼顾精确执行、可预测性与行为组合能力，为分层人形机器人控制提供了有效方案，并在真实硬件上得到验证。

title: ProAct-VLM: Pre-Failure Vision-Language Task Replanning with Continuous Perception Feedback
comment: Accepted to the IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026). Project page: https://github.com/moured/ProAct-VLM
summary: Long-horizon robotic tasks are vulnerable to unexpected environmental changes that can render planned actions ineffective or unsafe. To address this, robots must detect such changes as they occur, interpret their impact, and adjust their actions accordingly. Traditional rule-based decision-making pipelines are brittle in open-world conditions, as they are hand-tuned for specific scenarios and lack generalization. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) offer a promising alternative as they combine broad world knowledge with unified visual--text reasoning, enabling them to generalize across diverse scenarios and generate accurate, grounded task plans. However, for effective deployment in dynamic real-world settings, VLMs must be embedded into frameworks capable of handling uncertainty and environmental changes. Existing frameworks broadly address this reactively, triggering replanning only after execution failures or post-task checks, risking failed actions. Some methods verify conditions before actions, but these discrete checks miss changes occurring during execution. To address this, we present ProAct-VLM, an adaptive, physically grounded task planning framework that integrates VLMs within a real-time perception--feedback loop. ProAct-VLM continuously monitors the environment and re-plans as soon as relevant changes are detected, enabling adaptation before failure occurs. Evaluations against multiple baselines and across different VLM backbones show that our framework improves both success rates and efficiency in dynamic, long-horizon manipulation tasks. Project page: https://github.com/moured/ProAct-VLM

AI.tldr: 提出 ProAct-VLM，一种将 VLM 嵌入实时感知-反馈闭环的自适应、物理接地任务规划框架，在环境变化发生时即时重规划，从而在动态长时程操作任务中提升成功率与效率。
AI.motivation: 长时程机器人任务易受突发环境变化影响，导致既定动作失效或不安全。机器人需即时检测变化、理解其影响并调整动作。传统规则式决策流程针对特定场景手工调参，在开放世界中脆弱且缺乏泛化能力。VLM 具备广泛世界知识与统一视觉-文本推理，可泛化至多样场景并生成准确、有依据的任务规划，但需嵌入能处理不确定性与环境变化的框架。现有框架多为被动应对：仅在执行失败或任务后检查时才触发重规划，存在动作失败风险；部分方法在动作前验证条件，但这种离散检查会遗漏执行过程中发生的变化。
AI.method: 提出 ProAct-VLM 自适应、物理接地的任务规划框架，将 VLM 集成于实时感知-反馈闭环中。框架持续监测环境，一旦检测到相关变化即立即重规划，实现失败前的提前适应，而非事后补救或离散条件检查。
AI.result: 与多个基线方法及不同 VLM 主干网络的对比评估表明，该框架在动态、长时程操作任务中同时提升了任务成功率与执行效率。
AI.conclusion: 将 VLM 嵌入实时感知-反馈闭环、以变化驱动的即时重规划替代被动/离散验证，是提升动态开放环境下长时程机器人任务鲁棒性与效率的有效途径。项目页面：https://github.com/moured/ProAct-VLM

title: Recompositional Robotics: Cross-Domain, Open-set, and Lifelong Modularity Beyond Morphology
comment: 2026 IEEE/RSJ IROS Workshop on Reconfigurable Modular Robots
summary: Research in modular robotics has produced capable approaches allowing a robot's morphology to change online, with recent efforts also developing approaches to decide which morphology to assume and automatically propagate that decision into the robot's motion planning and control. These approaches are powerful and increase adaptability in the field. However, an alternative objective is not to build robots whose structures can change, but robots whose fundamental capabilities can change, where capability is a joint function across several domains, including kino-dynamics, perception, compute, and high-level coordinating behaviors. A robot designed to be reconfigured across these domains has a greater capacity to alter its capability than one that can be reconfigured in a single domain. We refer to this cross-domain reconfigurability as integration span, and recognize a complementary measure of the resistance to reconfiguration, which we refer to as integration inertia. Current modular robots have reduced integration inertia in the structural domain while it remains high in the other domains that contribute to integration span. We assert that the systems that can provide the most utility through reconfiguration in practice are those maximizing span and minimizing inertia and call this general problem recompositional robotics: adaptation over a heterogeneous set of modules including hardware, software, compute, and behavior that abstracts each component by the interfaces it requires and provides such that they can be reasoned over holistically. We define the problem, ground it in two deployed systems and active research efforts, and pose open questions about the future of recompositional robotics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"重组机器人学"（recompositional robotics）这一新问题框架，主张机器人研究的核心目标应从"结构可变"转向"能力可变"，并引入"集成跨度"与"集成惯性"两个互补度量来刻画跨域重构能力。
AI.motivation: 现有模块化机器人研究虽已实现形态在线改变并能自动将形态决策传播到运动规划与控制中，但这类工作仅聚焦于结构域的重构。本文认为，更有价值的目标是构建"基本能力"可变的机器人，而能力是运动动力学、感知、计算与高层协调行为的联合函数。仅在单一域可重构的机器人，其能力改变能力受限，因此需要从跨域视角重新审视重构问题。
AI.method: 作者以概念定义与问题形式化为主：提出"集成跨度"（integration span）描述跨域重构的范围，"集成惯性"（integration inertia）描述对重构的阻力；将系统效用刻画为最大化跨度、最小化惯性；并将该一般性问题命名为"重组机器人学"，即在一个包含硬件、软件、计算与行为的异构模块集合上进行自适应，各组件通过其所需与所提供的接口进行抽象，从而实现整体化推理。作者进一步以两个实际部署系统和若干活跃研究作为该问题的现实基础。
AI.result: 分析指出，当前模块化机器人在结构域已实现较低的集成惯性，但在构成集成跨度的其他域（感知、计算、行为等）中惯性依然很高，形成"结构域低惯性、其他域高惯性"的不平衡现状，从而限制了机器人通过重构获得的实际效用。
AI.conclusion: 作者将重组机器人学界定为一个正式问题并给出其现实依据，认为通过重构提供最大实用价值的系统应当是那些最大化集成跨度并最小化集成惯性的系统，同时就重组机器人学的未来提出了若干开放性问题。

title: Faster and Better? Benchmark Bugs and Design Limitations Distort the Evaluation of Vision-Language-Action Acceleration
summary: Simulated manipulation benchmarks are the standard tool for evaluating vision-language-action (VLA) policies and the acceleration methods that reduce their inference latency for on-robot deployment. On these benchmarks, we observe that some training-free acceleration methods, which approximate the baseline policy's computation, achieve higher measured success rates than the baseline itself. Success rates alone cannot establish whether such gains come from better task execution or from evaluation flaws. We therefore investigate two kinds of benchmark flaws behind these gains: bugs, where the implementation does not match the intended task or evaluation protocol, and design limitations, where success criteria and simulation settings do not fully capture how acceleration affects task execution. Starting from tasks with anomalous gains, we localize root causes by plotting object trajectories against checker acceptance regions, and classify the resulting bugs into task consistency, initialization, and reproducibility. Extending this audit to seven benchmarks, including RoboTwin, LIBERO-Plus, and VLABench, we identify 22 bugs of these types and 4 design limitations. For the latter, we revise permissive success checkers, correct unrealistic object masses, and add a motion-aware score that favors smoother actions. Experiments show that bug fixes can reverse method rankings, moving the baseline from last to first on one task. Addressing design limitations can likewise remove anomalous gains: on another task, the baseline moves from 21 percentage points behind an accelerated method to 5 points ahead. Gains attributed to acceleration can therefore be artifacts of the benchmark rather than better task execution. We release our bug fixes and revised benchmark settings to support trustworthy evaluation of VLA acceleration.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计了模拟操作基准中的缺陷，发现部分免训练加速方法看似优于基线实为评测假象，并给出修复方案。
AI.motivation: 模拟操作基准是评估VLA策略及其加速方法的标准工具，但作者观察到一些免训练加速方法（近似基线计算）的成功率反而高于基线。仅凭成功率无法判断这种提升来自更好的任务执行还是评测缺陷，因此需要系统审计基准的可靠性。
AI.method: 从出现异常增益的任务入手，通过将物体轨迹与检查器接受区域进行对比来定位根因，并将缺陷分为两类：实现层面的bug（任务一致性、初始化、可复现性）和设计层面局限（成功判据与仿真设置）。将审计扩展到七个基准（含RoboTwin、LIBERO-Plus、VLABench），并针对设计局限采取修订宽松的成功检查器、修正不真实的物体质量、增加偏好平滑动作的运动感知评分等措施。
