AI.result: 在七个基准中共识别出22个bug和4项设计局限。修复bug可逆转方法排名，某任务上基线从最后升至第一；处理设计局限也能消除异常增益，另一任务上基线从落后加速方法21个百分点变为领先5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 归因于加速方法的性能增益可能是基准伪影而非更优的任务执行，说明现有VLA加速评测不可靠。作者发布了bug修复和修订后的基准设置，以支持可信的评估。

title: Urgent Actions Go First: Urgency-Aware Denoising for Real-Time VLA Control
summary: Diffusion and flow-matching Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies generate action chunks through iterative denoising, incurring substantial inference latency that severely limits real-time robotic control. Existing acceleration methods treat an action chunk as a monolithic computational unit, ignoring a crucial physical reality of receding-horizon control: actions are generated jointly but consumed sequentially, resulting in inherently heterogeneous execution urgencies. We exploit this asymmetry to introduce Urgency-Aware Denoising (UAD), a novel inference-time framework that allocates denoising computation according to when each action is physically needed. UAD releases time-critical urgent actions after fewer denoising steps while overlapping the continued background refinement of tail actions with physical execution. However, heterogeneous denoising introduces two key challenges: early-release errors in urgent actions and trajectory inconsistency in tail actions. UAD elegantly resolves both through two core mechanisms: Trajectory Reconciliation, which reconstructs unified internal state evolution to restore joint denoising coherence without additional model evaluations, and Ghost Action Correction, which leverages non-executed ghost continuations to dynamically compensate for early-release errors across remaining executable actions. Extensive evaluations across multiple VLA architectures, simulation benchmarks, and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that UAD achieves up to a 1.89x speedup in average action availability latency while maintaining comparable success rates to vanilla inference with optimal denoising budget, offering a more favorable success-latency trade-off than state-of-the-art VLA acceleration baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出Urgency-Aware Denoising (UAD)推理框架，利用滚动时域控制中动作"联合生成、顺序执行"的异质性紧迫度，对紧迫动作少步去噪提前释放、尾部动作后台细化与执行重叠，并借助轨迹调和与Ghost Action Correction解决误差与不一致，实现最高1.89x加速且保持成功率。
AI.motivation: 扩散与流匹配VLA策略通过迭代去噪生成动作块，推理延迟高，严重制约实时机器人控制。现有加速方法将动作块当作单一整体计算单元，忽视了滚动时域控制中动作"联合生成但顺序执行"这一物理事实，导致执行紧迫度本质异构，未被利用。
AI.method: UAD为推理时框架，按各动作被物理需要的时间分配去噪算力：对时间紧迫的动作减少去噪步数提前释放，同时将尾部动作的持续后台细化与物理执行重叠。针对由此产生的两个问题——紧迫动作的提前释放误差与尾部动作的轨迹不一致——设计两个机制：Trajectory Reconciliation在不增加模型评估的前提下重建统一的内部状态演化以恢复联合去噪一致性；Ghost Action Correction利用未执行的ghost续段动态补偿剩余可执行动作上的提前释放误差。
AI.result: 在多种VLA架构、仿真基准与真实机器人操作任务上评估，UAD在平均动作可用延迟上最高取得1.89x加速，同时成功率与采用最优去噪预算的原版推理相当，成功率-延迟权衡优于当前最先进的VLA加速基线。
AI.conclusion: 动作块内紧迫度异构是VLA加速中可被利用的关键结构性先验；UAD通过异质去噪调度及轨迹调和、ghost动作校正，在无需额外模型评估的情况下实现了推理加速与任务成功率的更好平衡。

title: Geometry-Preserving Human-to-Robot Upper-Body Motion Retargeting from Monocular Video
summary: Monocular RGB video provides an accessible source of human demonstrations for upper-body robot motion, yet video-driven human-to-robot transfer remains challenging because body and hand motion are recovered at different spatial scales, human and robot kinematics differ substantially, and fine distal motion is difficult to preserve across embodiments. We present a geometry-preserving motion-retargeting framework that integrates unified body--hand reconstruction with morphology-independent geometric transfer. Frame-wise body estimates, video-level observations, and detailed hand evidence jointly constrain a single differentiable Momentum Human Rig (MHR) state, while transient hand artifacts are repaired in parameter space. The reconstructed motion is represented by arm-segment directions, elbow configuration, relative palm orientation, and bilateral wrist relations, and is realized on the target robot through multi-stage inverse kinematics and robot-specific hand adaptation. Within the broader system, Across-VAM provides video generation, whereas Across-WAM performs human-to-robot motion mapping. The method is evaluated on 16 monocular videos comprising 1,769 source frames, including 10 signing and six reach-to-grasp sequences. Unified reconstruction reduces mean hand reprojection error from 22.36 to 7.21 pixels relative to SAM 3D Body. All 16 retargeted trajectories completed kinematic simulation playback, and representative signing and reach-to-grasp motions were further demonstrated on a physical robot. The results demonstrate a unified pipeline from monocular human video to coordinated upper-body motion on a dual-arm dexterous robot.

AI.tldr: 提出几何保持的运动重定向框架，将单目RGB视频中的身体-手部统一重建并映射到双臂灵巧机器人上肢动作。
AI.motivation: 单目RGB视频是获取上肢机器人示教的便捷来源，但人体到手部运动在不同空间尺度上重建、人机运动学差异显著、末端精细动作跨具身难以保持，使视频驱动的人到机器人迁移极具挑战。
AI.method: 集成统一身体-手部重建与形态无关的几何迁移：逐帧身体估计、视频级观测与手部细节证据共同约束单一可微MHR状态，并在参数空间修复瞬时手部伪影；重建动作以臂段方向、肘部构型、相对手掌朝向及双侧腕部关系表示，通过多阶段逆运动学与机器人专用手部适配在目标机器人上实现。系统中Across-VAM负责视频生成，Across-WAM负责人体到机器人运动映射。
AI.result: 在16段单目视频（共1769帧源帧，含10段手语和6段伸手抓取序列）上评估：统一重建将平均手部重投影误差从SAM 3D Body的22.36像素降至7.21像素；全部16条重定向轨迹完成运动学仿真回放，代表性手语与伸手抓取动作在实体机器人上进一步演示。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明可实现从单目人体视频到双臂灵巧机器人协调上肢运动的统一流程。

title: MVG-WAM: Multiple View Geometry-Aware World-Action Modeling for Robotic Manipulation
summary: World-Action Models (WAMs) couple visual dynamics with action prediction, bringing the rich priors of pretrained video models to robotic manipulation. However, their multi-view interfaces typically tile images or concatenate tokens, leaving the geometric relationships among synchronized cameras implicit. This makes it harder to connect global scene context with the local geometry required for interaction. We introduce the Multi-View Geometry-Aware World-Action Model (MVG-WAM), which organizes these observations as related projections of one physical world rather than separate images on a canvas. Our model combines an epipolar-constrained global state with view-indexed geometric states jointly inferred from synchronized observations. Camera-aware routing supplies each video region with its corresponding geometric context and the shared global state, explicitly structuring the representation used for action prediction. We further ground the geometry-aware representation in metric scale through multi-horizon future-depth supervision, without requiring depth decoding during action rollout. MVG-WAM achieves average success rates of 99.1% on LIBERO and 92.07% on RoboTwin 2.0, demonstrating competitive performance across both benchmarks. Real-world experiments on Cobot Magic further demonstrate a 91.3% success rate across 150 trials spanning three manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多视角几何感知世界-动作模型（MVG-WAM），将多相机观测建模为同一物理世界的相关投影而非独立图像拼接，通过极线约束的全局状态与视角索引几何状态、相机感知路由以及多时段未来深度监督，在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0与真机任务上取得高成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有世界-动作模型虽结合视觉动态与动作预测并借助预训练视频模型先验，但其多视角接口通常采用图像平铺或token拼接，导致同步相机间的几何关系被隐式处理，难以将全局场景上下文与交互所需的局部几何有效关联。
AI.method: MVG-WAM将多视角观测组织为同一物理世界的相关投影：构建由极线约束引导的全局状态，以及与视角索引对应的几何状态，二者由同步观测联合推断；采用相机感知路由为每个视频区域提供相应的几何上下文与共享全局状态，显式结构化动作预测所用表征；并通过多时段未来深度监督将几何感知表征锚定到度量尺度，且在动作推演阶段无需深度解码。
AI.result: 在LIBERO上平均成功率达99.1%，在RoboTwin 2.0上达92.07%；在Cobot Magic真机实验中，跨三项操作任务、150次试验取得91.3%的成功率。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模多视角几何关系并结合相机感知路由与度量尺度深度监督，可有效提升世界-动作模型在仿真与真机操作任务中的表现。

title: Explore, Execute, Evolve: A Skill Acquisition and Reuse Loop for Embodied Agents
summary: Vision-language-action and world-action models have demonstrated impressive capabilities in robotics, yet generalization to unseen tasks remains challenging. More recently, general-purpose multimodal agents have shown great potential for zero-shot robotic task solving. However, they often incur high execution costs by reasoning and exploring the physical world from scratch. To reduce these costs, we introduce RoboSkill, a framework that connects skill acquisition and reuse through an Explore, Execute, Evolve loop. Within this loop, the agent explores to gather task-relevant information, executes tasks while adapting to feedback, and evolves its skill library based on execution records. It then reuses these skills to guide exploration and execution in the next cycle, closing the loop. To improve loop efficiency, we complement vision with tactile feedback to reduce uncertainty during physical interaction. We further augment textual guidance with reusable code to reduce reasoning overhead during skill reuse. On LIBERO-10, RoboSkill improves first-episode success rates by 12.5--25.0 percentage points and reduces average runtime by 7.6--72.4% across four agents. On real robots, it improves success rates by 8.3 percentage points and reduces average runtime for successful trials by at least 14.4%.

AI.tldr: RoboSkill 通过"探索—执行—演化"闭环将技能获取与复用耦合，并结合触觉反馈与可复用代码，降低通用多模态智能体解决机器人任务的开销。
AI.motivation: VLA 与世界动作模型在机器人任务上表现优异，但泛化到未见任务仍困难；通用多模态智能体虽具零样本潜力，却需从零推理并探索物理世界，导致执行成本高。
AI.method: 提出 RoboSkill 框架，以 Explore-Execute-Evolve 循环连接技能获取与复用：智能体探索收集任务相关信息、执行任务并适应反馈、依据执行记录演化技能库，再复用技能指导下一轮探索与执行；引入触觉反馈补充视觉以降低物理交互不确定性，并用可复用代码增强文本指导以减少技能复用时的推理开销。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO-10 上，四种智能体的首回合成功率提升 12.5–25.0 个百分点，平均运行时间降低 7.6–72.4%；在真实机器人上，成功率提升 8.3 个百分点，成功试验的平均运行时间至少降低 14.4%。
AI.conclusion: 通过技能库闭环演化与多模态（视觉+触觉）及代码化指导的增强，RoboSkill 能显著提升成功率并降低推理与执行开销，验证了技能复用对通用机器人智能体的有效性。

title: ExceptionDrive: A Planning-Oriented Counterfactual Corner-Case Benchmark for Autonomous Driving
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables; supplementary material included
summary: Average performance on routine driving benchmarks does not establish planner reliability under rare, safety-critical hazards. We proposed ExceptionDrive, a counterfactual planning benchmark that uses VLM-assisted screening, localized multi-view editing, and quality auditing to insert hazards into real nuScenes scenes while preserving their context. Its 21 tasks span six safety families and define hazard or conflict regions, local safety constraints, and acceptable responses. Because hazard insertion can invalidate the recorded human trajectory, our reference-free protocol evaluates edited predictions using Unsafe Rate (UR), Hazard Clearance Compliance (HCC), Hazard Proximity Response (HPR), and Counterfactual Trajectory Shift (CTS), which measure core-region intrusion, clearance compliance, clearance relative to a prescribed margin, and counterfactual trajectory change. Seven representative planners frequently intrude into hazard regions or provide insufficient clearance. We also develop a Reminder Agent that, without sample-specific task labels, converts visual evidence and the shared taxonomy into structured records of hazard presence, type, and a recommended high-level strategy. The agent neither predicts trajectories nor controls the vehicle; its records guide a VLM-based decision agent. In zero-shot experiments, the reminders improve strategy accuracy and reduce under-warning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ExceptionDrive——一个反事实规划基准，通过 VLM 辅助筛选、局部多视图编辑与质量审计，将危险场景插入真实 nuScenes 片段，并配套无参考评估协议与 Reminder Agent，用以检验规划器在罕见安全关键危险下的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 常规驾驶基准上的平均性能无法反映规划器在罕见、安全关键危险场景下的可靠性，而此类场景在真实数据中稀缺且难以标注，导致现有评测缺乏对危险应对能力的针对性检验。
AI.method: 方法包含三部分：（1）数据构建：利用 VLM 辅助筛选、局部多视图编辑与质量审计，在保留上下文的前提下向真实 nuScenes 场景注入危险，形成覆盖六类安全族、共 21 项任务的基准，并定义危险/冲突区域、局部安全约束与可接受响应；（2）评估协议：因危险插入使原有人类轨迹失效，采用无参考指标——Unsafe Rate（UR）、Hazard Clearance Compliance（HCC）、Hazard Proximity Response（HPR）与 Counterfactual Trajectory Shift（CTS），分别度量核心区域侵入、净空合规、相对规定余量的净空以及反事实轨迹变化；（3）Reminder Agent：不依赖样本级任务标签，将视觉证据与共享分类体系转为关于危险存在性、类型及建议高层策略的结构化记录，仅用于引导基于 VLM 的决策智能体，不预测轨迹、不控制车辆。
AI.result: 七种代表性规划器频繁侵入危险区域或提供的净空不足；在零样本实验中，Reminder Agent 提供的提醒提升了决策智能体的策略准确率，并减少了预警不足（under-warning）的情况。
AI.conclusion: 规划器在罕见安全关键危险下的可靠性不能被常规基准的平均表现所代表；ExceptionDrive 提供了可复现的反事实危险注入与无参考评估框架，并表明结构化危险提醒能有效改善零样本决策的策略选择与预警充分性。

title: WayFinder: Hierarchical Visual-Language-Action for Zero-Shot Waypoint Generation and Low-Level Kinematic Control
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables, Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
summary: Visual Language Action (VLA) models offer unprecedented generalization for autonomous robots; however, their real-world deployment is frequently bottlenecked by unreliable execution and the prohibitive computational cost of fine-tuning for specific robot embodiments and tasks. To bridge this gap, we propose WayFinder, an end-to-end, closed-loop hierarchical VLA framework that circumvents the need for fine-tuning by decoupling high-level task reasoning from low-level kinematic control. WayFinder utilizes a zero-shot, offboard Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) policy to process linguistic context and state maps for strategic waypoint generation. Asynchronously, a lightweight, onboard policy executes real-time kinematic control at high frequency based on continuous sensor feedback. We evaluate WayFinder in Microsoft AirSim, testing on four environments of varying complexity and three MLLM scales to balance prediction efficacy with computational efficiency. Our results demonstrate that WayFinder achieves superior navigation reliability compared to baseline low-level policies. By querying the high-level MLLM only during navigation failures, WayFinder eliminates the need for fine-tuning, minimizes expensive inferences, and significantly increases navigation success rates by up to 27.45%.

AI.tldr: 提出闭环分层VLA框架WayFinder，通过解耦高层推理与底层控制规避微调，成功率最高提升27.45%。
AI.motivation: VLA模型泛化能力强，但实际部署受制于执行不可靠与针对特定机器人形态和任务进行微调的高昂计算成本。
AI.method: WayFinder采用端到端闭环分层架构：离板零样本MLLM策略处理语言上下文与状态地图，生成战略路点；异步的轻量级在板策略基于连续传感器反馈进行高频实时运动控制。仅在导航失败时查询高层MLLM。
AI.result: 在Microsoft AirSim中，跨四个复杂度不同环境和三种MLLM规模评估；相比基线底层策略，导航可靠性更优，成功率最高提升27.45%，并减少昂贵推理。
AI.conclusion: 分层解耦与失败触发的按需推理，可在无需微调的前提下提升VLA导航可靠性并显著降低计算开销。

title: Comparing Utility of Inertial, Occupancy, Semantic, and Intent Information in Human Motion Prediction During Daily Tasks
comment: 9 pages, 13 figures. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Accurate human motion prediction is crucial for robotic systems operating around people, particularly in complex indoor spaces. In this study, we assess the relative importance of different sources of information in indoor motion prediction with a human motion diffusion model. We collected a dataset of nine naive human subjects conducting simulated indoor daily activities while wearing a pair of Meta Aria glasses. This dataset includes ten buildings from a university campus, and encompasses 238 minutes of navigation between daily tasks. Overall, we demonstrate a 42% improvement beyond a constant velocity baseline. Including body motion, scene representation, and eye gaze fixation data significantly reduced prediction error. Semantic information was found to be useful for indoor motion prediction, but to a lesser degree than in outdoor navigation. Providing explicit intent information reduced error beyond any other addition, suggesting that incorporating explicit intent estimation or user input are fundamental for finer prediction of indoor motion. One of the few indicators of intent, eye gaze fixation, was found to be especially useful in predicting deceleration, and provided basic spatial information to the model in the absence of an occupancy map. These results are a first step towards predicting human motion in highly ambiguous indoor scenarios. Code will be made public upon acceptance. Project page: https://human-motion-diffusion.github.io/

AI.tldr: 该研究利用扩散模型评估室内人体运动预测中不同信息源的相对重要性，发现显式意图信息、眼动注视、场景表征与身体运动均能显著降低预测误差。
AI.motivation: 机器人在有人类活动的复杂室内环境中运行需准确预测人体运动，但室内场景高度模糊，不同信息源对预测的贡献尚不明确。
AI.method: 采集9名受试者佩戴Meta Aria眼镜执行模拟室内日常活动的数据集，涵盖校园10栋建筑、238分钟导航；采用人体运动扩散模型，对比身体运动、场景表征、眼动注视、语义信息与显式意图等不同信息源对预测的影响。
AI.result: 整体较匀速基线提升42%；加入身体运动、场景表征与眼动注视显著降低预测误差；语义信息有用但作用弱于室外导航；显式意图信息降低误差的效果优于其他所有信息源；眼动注视对预测减速尤为有效，且在无占据地图时提供基本空间信息。
AI.conclusion: 显式意图估计或用户输入对室内运动的精细预测至关重要，该工作为高度模糊室内场景下的人体运动预测迈出第一步。

title: EgoAlign: Bridging the Human-Humanoid Gap for Long-Range Loco-Manipulation
summary: Egocentric human demonstrations offer an accessible source of task experience, but differences in body scale and controller response, together with missing robot states, limit their value as humanoid training supervision. We present EgoAlign, a data-construction framework that converts these demonstrations into action and state supervision compatible with a general-purpose, continuous whole-body controller, without collecting physical-robot demonstrations. Using the target-robot model and simulator, EgoAlign guides demonstration collection through execution feedback. It preserves locomotion references for visually guided periodic stepping while adapting upper-body interaction geometry through scale alignment and controller-in-the-loop refinement. A final causal replay reconstructs the corresponding robot states and motion-token labels for training with the human observations. We assess the resulting supervision by fine-tuning a vision--language--action model solely on adapted human demonstrations and deploying it zero-shot on a physical humanoid. The resulting policies perform long-range object relocation, navigation to unseen goal positions, and independently evaluated foot interaction. Refinement improves simulated hand alignment and physical pickup success over kinematic alignment alone, while human collection reduces on-site acquisition time relative to teleoperation. https://lambdahumanoid.github.io/EgoAlign/

AI.tldr: 提出 EgoAlign 数据构建框架，将第一视角人类演示转化为与通用连续全身控制器兼容的动作与状态监督，无需采集实体机器人演示即可微调 VLA 模型并零样本部署于实体人形机器人。
AI.motivation: 第一视角人类演示是易获取的任务经验来源，但存在体型尺度差异、控制器响应差异以及机器人状态缺失等问题，限制了其作为人形机器人训练监督的价值。
AI.method: 利用目标机器人模型与仿真器，通过执行反馈引导演示采集：保留运动参考以支持视觉引导的周期步态，借助尺度对齐与控制器在环优化适配上半身交互几何，最后通过因果回放重建对应机器人状态与运动 token 标签，与人类观测配对用于训练。
AI.result: 仅用适配后的人类演示微调 VLA 模型并零样本部署于实体人形机器人，策略可完成长距离物体搬运、导航至未见目标位置，以及独立评估的足部交互；控制器在环优化相比纯运动学对齐提升了仿真手部对齐精度与实体抓取成功率；相比遥操作，人类采集降低了现场采集时间。
AI.conclusion: EgoAlign 表明第一视角人类演示经尺度对齐、在环优化与因果回放后可有效充当人形机器人全身控制器的监督信号，为免实体遥操作的数据获取提供了可行路径。

title: A QCQP-Representable IMU Pre-Integration Factor for Certifiable State Estimation
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) 2027
summary: We propose a QCQP-representable IMU pre-integration factor that enables certifiable estimation with pre-integrated inertial measurements. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to directly incorporate IMU pre-integration into certifiable estimation. Inertial sensing is a common and reliable modality in robotics, and incorporating it broadens the practical scope of certifiable estimation. The main challenges are obtaining the required algebraic structure and a sufficiently tight convex relaxation. Standard IMU pre-integration relies on the exponential map, which does not admit an exact polynomial representation. Moreover, obtaining a QCQP formulation requires auxiliary lifting variables, for which the standard semidefinite programming (SDP) relaxation can be loose. We address these issues by deriving an IMU pre-integration factor based on the Cayley map and an explicit set of redundant constraints that tighten the resulting relaxation. To validate the proposed factor, we apply it to certifiable GNSS-IMU smoothing and evaluate it on synthetic and real-world data. The results show that the proposed formulation yields tight relaxations and solves the resulting estimation problems to verified global optimality.

AI.tldr: 提出首个可QCQP表示、可认证的IMU预积分因子：基于Cayley映射并引入冗余约束以收紧SDP松弛，在GNSS-IMU平滑中获得紧松弛并验证全局最优。
AI.motivation: 惯性传感是机器人中常见且可靠的模态，将其纳入可认证（certifiable）估计可拓展其实用范围。但标准IMU预积分依赖指数映射，缺乏精确多项式表示；转为QCQP需辅助lifting变量，而标准SDP松弛可能过松。作者旨在解决这两大障碍，实现首个直接融合IMU预积分的可认证估计。
AI.method: 推导基于Cayley映射的IMU预积分因子，以替代无法精确多项式化的指数映射，从而获得所需代数结构；针对QCQP所需的辅助lifting变量，显式构造一组冗余约束以收紧半定规划松弛。将该因子应用于可认证GNSS-IMU平滑，并在合成与真实数据上评估。
AI.result: 所提公式产生紧的凸松弛，并能在合成与真实数据上将估计问题求解至经验证的全局最优性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次将IMU预积分直接纳入可认证估计，通过Cayley映射与冗余约束实现QCQP可表示且松弛紧致的因子，拓宽了可认证估计在惯性感知场景中的适用范围。

title: MotorMind: Scaffolding General Vision Language Models for Zero-Shot Robot Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have advanced robotic manipulation, but their zero-shot generalization in new tasks and environments remains limited, and their reliance on specialized training keeps them from benefiting directly from rapidly advancing general-purpose vision-language models (VLMs). In parallel, recent agentic robotic systems leverage VLMs for high-level reasoning or coding agents for robot control, but often depend on extensive external models and tools, introducing additional complexity and cost. This motivates us to ask: Can a general-purpose VLM itself operate a robot more like the human teleoperator by reasoning directly from observations, issuing actions, and continuously adapting to execution feedback, without relying on external models such as learned action experts, coding agents or grounding tools like SAM3? In this work, we introduce MotorMind, a robot manipulation harness that connects VLM-proposed mid-level actions to deterministic robot control and feedback, with asynchronous monitoring and background memory updates. Without task-specific policy training, coding agents, or additional grounding tools such as SAM3, MotorMind achieves 66.7% success on the base LIBERO-PRO suites and 53.8% under perturbations, compared with at most 13.3% and 19.2%, respectively, for the prior zero-shot methods we evaluate. The same interface reaches 95% average success on a real xArm6 robot across direct manipulation and human-perturbation settings. Replacing the backbone with a stronger VLM further improves performance, while the remaining failures - primarily due to visual grounding, embodied reasoning, and action knowledge - decrease as VLM capability improves. These results show that a general-purpose VLM, when equipped with an appropriate mid-level action representation and asynchronous execution harness, can perform effective zero-shot robotic manipulation.

AI.tldr: 提出 MotorMind，一种让通用 VLM 直接操作机器人的操纵框架，将 VLM 提出的中层动作接入确定性机器人控制与反馈，实现零样本抓取操作，无需专用策略训练、编码代理或额外定位工具。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型零样本泛化能力有限且依赖专用训练，无法直接受益于快速迭代的通用 VLM；现有智能体机器人系统则依赖大量外部模型与工具（如学习型动作专家、编码代理、SAM3 等定位工具），带来额外复杂度与成本。作者希望验证：通用 VLM 能否像人类遥操作员一样，直接从观测推理、下达动作并持续适应执行反馈来操控机器人。
AI.method: 设计 MotorMind 框架：把 VLM 提出的中层动作映射到确定性机器人控制与反馈回路，并引入异步监控与后台记忆更新机制。全程不使用任务专用策略训练、编码代理或额外定位工具。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO-PRO 基础套件上成功率达 66.7%，扰动条件下为 53.8%，而所对比的既往零样本方法最高仅 13.3% 与 19.2%。同一接口在真实 xArm6 机器人上，直接操作与人为扰动场景平均成功率达 95%。替换为更强的 VLM 可进一步提升性能，剩余失败（主要源于视觉定位、具身推理与动作知识）随 VLM 能力增强而减少。
AI.conclusion: 通用 VLM 在配备合适的中层动作表示与异步执行框架后，能够实现有效的零样本机器人操作；性能瓶颈主要来自 VLM 自身能力，而非框架依赖的外部工具。

title: CrossBFM: Distilling a Shared Latent Behavior Space Across Humanoid Embodiments
summary: Behavior Foundation Models (BFMs) give humanoids a promptable policy over a latent behavior space, enabling one single vector to represent a motion to imitate, a pose to reach, or a reward to maximize. Forward-Backward representations successfully produce such spaces, but at the cost of hundreds of GPU-hours for a single robot. Moreover, when the training process is repeated for a second robot, it produces a second space unrelated to the first, resulting in embodiment-specific latents that do not unify or transfer. We address these problems with CrossBFM, treating the latent space as the transferable asset for various embodiments. As retargeting provides frame-level cross-embodiment correspondence, we propose a unified encoder architecture with no robot-specific parameters for distilling the behavior space to address all training embodiments simultaneously in less than a GPU-hour. Following this encoder, latent-conditioned trackers turn the distilled latent into whole-body control in a conventional PPO training manner in just 10 more GPU-hours. On three distilled humanoids, all three prompting modes transfer: motion tracking with latent-conditioned policy losing only $0.025$ rad to its joint-conditioned counterpart, smooth goal reaching between poses with no falls, and reward optimization for all $41$ reward prompts. Our experiments further reveal that 1) regressing the encoder on a quarter of the motion corpus costs only $5\%$ of tracking performance and 2) training the encoder on a subset of robots and evaluating on an unseen one recovers up to $89\%$ of the tracking performance of seen robots, demonstrating cross-embodiment generalization to morphologically similar robots. We also verify the pipeline on real robots across all three prompting modes and with flow-based generated latents. Project website: https://dotandung.github.io/crossbfm/

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 CrossBFM，将行为基础模型（BFM）的隐空间视为可跨本体迁移的资产，通过统一编码器+潜在条件跟踪器，将单机器人训练成本从数百 GPU 小时降至约 10 余 GPU 小时，并在三个类人机器人上实现运动跟踪、姿态到达与奖励优化三类提示的迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有 Forward-Backward 表示虽能生成可提示的潜在行为空间，但单机器人训练需数百 GPU 小时；且为第二个机器人重复训练会得到互不相关的隐空间，导致隐变量与本体绑定，无法统一或迁移。
AI.method: 利用重定向（retargeting）提供的帧级跨本体对应关系，设计无机器人特定参数的统一编码器架构，将行为空间蒸馏到多个训练本体（同时处理，耗时不足 1 GPU 小时）；随后用潜在条件（latent-conditioned）跟踪器，以常规 PPO 训练方式将蒸馏隐变量转为全身控制（额外约 10 GPU 小时）。
AI.result: 在三个蒸馏类人机器人上，三种提示模式均可迁移：运动跟踪的潜在条件策略相比关节条件策略仅损失 0.025 rad；姿态间平滑目标到达无摔倒；41 个奖励提示全部可优化。消融显示：在四分之一运动语料上回归编码器仅损失 5% 跟踪性能；在部分机器人上训练编码器、在未见机器人上评估可恢复最高 89% 的已见机器人跟踪性能，体现出对形态相似机器人的跨本体泛化。并在真实机器人上验证了三类提示模式及基于流的生成隐变量。
AI.conclusion: CrossBFM 表明潜在行为空间可作为跨本体的可迁移资产，显著降低训练成本并实现多本体统一的行为基础模型，且具备对形态相似新机器人的泛化能力，并在真机上得到验证。

title: FORM: Robot Manipulation through Direct Material Law Identification
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures. Project page: https://form-robots.github.io/ . Code: https://github.com/form-robots/FORM
summary: When interacting with an unfamiliar deformable material, a robot lacks prior knowledge of its physical properties and how it will respond to applied forces and motion. Rapid online identification is therefore essential for reliable manipulation. We present FORM (From Observed Response to Material laws), which identifies material properties from a single robot interaction and reuses the recovered model to plan manipulation under new actions and geometries. We use weak-form momentum balance to convert observed material motion and contact forces into linear equations in the unknown material parameters. These equations are assembled using the same material point method discretization as the forward simulator, so identification reduces to linear least-squares solves whose solutions can be used directly for prediction without refitting or conversion. Across four material classes, FORM reduces identification time from roughly 10--25 minutes for iterative baselines to 2--5 seconds, while maintaining competitive accuracy on new motions, initial conditions, and geometries. We demonstrate our approach in simulation and on hardware across four manipulation tasks: elastic rod insertion, golf putting with an elastic club, elastoplastic shaping, and target-volume pouring. In each task, the model identified from a single interaction is reused to plan new motions or manipulate a different geometry. FORM estimates elastic properties within 3.4% and elastoplastic properties within 2%, achieves 72.4--77.8% IoU in dough shaping, and keeps mean pouring error at 3.8 mL across target volumes of 60--160 mL.

AI.tldr: FORM 通过弱形式动量平衡与 MPM 离散，从单次机器人交互中快速辨识可变形材料参数，并将辨识模型直接复用于新动作与新几何下的操作规划。
AI.motivation: 机器人在操作不熟悉的可变形材料时缺乏其物理属性及力响应先验，需要快速的在线辨识才能实现可靠操作；而传统迭代辨识耗时长（约 10–25 分钟），难以满足实际需求。
AI.method: 利用弱形式动量平衡，将观测到的材料运动与接触力转化为关于未知材料参数的线性方程；方程采用与正向仿真器相同的物质点法（MPM）离散进行组装，使辨识问题化为线性最小二乘求解，其解可直接用于预测，无需重新拟合或转换。
AI.result: 在四类材料上，辨识时间从迭代基线的约 10–25 分钟降至 2–5 秒，同时在新动作、初始条件和几何上保持有竞争力的精度。在仿真与硬件上完成四项操作任务：弹性杆插入、弹性球杆高尔夫推杆、弹塑性塑形和目标体积倒料。弹性属性估计误差在 3.4% 以内，弹塑性属性误差在 2% 以内，面团塑形 IoU 达 72.4–77.8%，目标体积 60–160 mL 范围内平均倒料误差为 3.8 mL。
AI.conclusion: FORM 证明基于单次交互的弱形式线性辨识可显著加速材料参数估计，且辨识所得模型可跨动作与几何直接复用于操作规划，在多种材料与任务上兼顾速度与精度。

title: Rho: A Foundation for Efficiently Adaptable VLA Models
summary: General-purpose physical AI models must combine broad visual and linguistic capabilities with precise control across robot embodiments and efficient adaptation to downstream tasks. We introduce Rho, a family of open-weights VLA models for bimanual manipulation designed for data-light task adaptation on 3 embodiments representative of dual-arm robots across research labs and the industry -- YAM Box, UR AI Trainer, and FR3 Duo. We systematically ablate Rho's action-expert architecture and training recipe, and show in controlled simulation and physical-robot experiments that embodiment midtraining improves downstream adaptation. The resulting Rho variants for YAM Box, UR AI Trainer, and FR3 Duo match or outperform existing open-weights VLAs and achieve the strongest overall performance across the tasks, embodiments, and baselines evaluated in this report. We further demonstrate the Rho model family's built-in capacity for online adaptation: an internal latent policy learns from corrective feedback to select observation-conditioned noise inputs for the frozen flow-matching action expert. With as few as 15 corrected episodes, adapting this lightweight module enables Rho to handle task situations at the fringe of its offline finetuning distribution. Together, these results position Rho as both a strong general-purpose robotic manipulation model and a practical foundation for adaptation. We release the base Rho model and the embodiment-specific checkpoints to facilitate Rho's deployment in research experiments and practical industrial use cases.

AI.tldr: Rho是一族开源权重的双臂操作VLA模型，覆盖三种双臂机器人本体，通过本体中期训练提升下游适配，并具备基于纠正反馈的在线适配能力。
AI.motivation: 通用具身AI模型需兼顾广泛视觉语言能力、跨本体精确控制以及低成本的任务适配，而现有开源VLA在数据高效适配与在线适应方面仍有不足。
AI.method: 提出Rho系列开源VLA模型，面向YAM Box、UR AI Trainer、FR3 Duo三种双机械臂本体；系统消融动作专家结构与训练配方；采用本体中期训练促进下游适配；并引入内部潜策略，从纠正反馈中学习为冻结的流匹配动作专家选择观测条件噪声输入，实现轻量在线适配。
AI.result: 受控仿真与真机实验表明本体中期训练可提升下游适配效果；各本体Rho变体匹配或超越现有开源VLA，在评测任务、本体与基线中取得最强综合性能；仅需15个纠正回合即可让轻量模块适配离线微调分布边缘的任务情境。
AI.conclusion: Rho既是强通用机器人操作模型，也是实用的适配基础，并开源基础模型与各本体检查点以支持研究与工业部署。

title: In-context Robot Learning Made Simple: A Democratized Recipe for Manipulation Tasks
summary: We study robotic in-context learning (ICL), an emerging paradigm that enables robots to infer and execute tasks from visual demonstrations. Despite its growing promise, the problem itself remains under-defined: a visual demonstration simultaneously conveys action trajectories, object semantics, manipulation affordances, spatial relations, and task goals, making it unclear what information the robot is actually expected to follow. In this work, we first provide a clear problem definition of robot ICL that explicitly defines its learning target and resolves this fundamental prompt ambiguity. Building on this definition, we develop a minimalist and reproducible ICL framework (SimpleICL) with a visual prompt encoder and a low-cost data collection protocol. Without massive pre-training or specialized data infrastructure, our framework achieves strong performance in both simulation and real-world environments. Extensive experiments further reveal several key properties of robot ICL, including action, semantic, composition, and affordance discrimination. We will fully open-source our data and training pipeline to facilitate systematic and reproducible research on robot ICL. The project page can be found at https://simpleicl.github.io/simpleicl.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对机器人上下文学习（ICL）问题定义不清、视觉示范信息耦合导致提示歧义的问题，给出明确的Robot ICL问题定义，并提出极简可复现框架SimpleICL，在仿真与真实环境中均取得良好性能，并开源数据与训练流程。
AI.motivation: 视觉示范同时传递动作轨迹、物体语义、操作可供性、空间关系与任务目标，导致机器人ICL的学习目标不明确、提示存在根本歧义，问题本身缺乏清晰界定，阻碍了系统化研究。
AI.method: 首先给出机器人ICL的清晰问题定义，显式界定学习目标并消除提示歧义；在此基础上构建极简、可复现的ICL框架SimpleICL，包含视觉提示编码器与低成本数据采集协议，无需大规模预训练或专用数据基础设施。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实环境中均取得较强性能；大量实验揭示了机器人ICL的若干关键特性，包括动作、语义、组合与可供性方面的判别能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为机器人ICL提供了明确的问题定义与高效可复现的基线框架，并将完全开源数据与训练流程，以促进机器人ICL的系统化与可复现研究。

title: Skill-Space Shooting for Autonomous Robot Policy Improvement
summary: Robots deployed in the physical world must be able to improve beyond their initial training as they encounter new situations and failures. For this improvement to scale across tasks, it must make effective use of experience without requiring human demonstration of each correction. Recent agentic systems offer a way to reduce this reliance on human effort by using foundation models to autonomously compose learned behaviors to complete tasks. Yet completing tasks this way does not itself teach a task policy to overcome its own failures; that requires turning these behaviors into learnable corrections for the policy. Our insight is that many such corrections are familiar short behaviors, or skills: they recur across tasks and describe actions that foundation models can reason about from a scene. We introduce skill-space shooting, which uses foundation model guidance to explore corrections through these reusable skills and turn successful trials into policy improvement. Real-world experiments show repeated improvement in policies acting autonomously, while skills can also be shared to reduce the teaching needed to improve on new tasks. By making reusable skills a source of corrective supervision, skill-space shooting enables scalable and generalizable policy improvement within and across tasks. Additional results and videos at https://skill-space-shooting.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出"技能空间射击"(skill-space shooting)方法,利用基础模型引导在可复用技能空间中探索纠错行为,将成功试验转化为策略改进,实现自主可扩展的机器人策略提升。
AI.motivation: 物理世界中的机器人需在训练后持续改进以适应新情况和失败。但改进要跨任务扩展,必须有效利用经验而不依赖人类对每次纠正的演示。现有agentic系统虽用基础模型自主组合已学行为来减少人力,但仅完成任务并不会让任务策略学会克服自身失败,这需要把这些行为转化为可学习的纠正信号。
AI.method: 核心洞见是许多纠正属于熟悉的短行为(技能):它们跨任务复现,且其动作可被基础模型从场景中推理。据此提出skill-space shooting,用基础模型引导在技能空间内探索纠正,并将成功试验转化为策略改进。
AI.result: 真实世界实验表明,自主行为的策略可反复改进;技能还能被共享,从而减少在新任务上改进所需的示教。
AI.conclusion: 通过将可复用技能作为纠正性监督来源,skill-space shooting 实现了任务内及跨任务的可扩展、可泛化的策略改进。

title: GeoWind2Plan: Mission-Time 3D Urban Wind Prediction for Energy-Efficient UAV Planning
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Spotlight). 31 pages. Code and dataset: https://github.com/DUAL-Xiao/GeoWind2Plan/
summary: In urban low-altitude flight, buildings reshape ambient wind into spatially varying 3D flow, making unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) energy depend on local wind exposure as well as path length. However, building-resolved wind information is rarely available when a mission must be planned. Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) can produce high-fidelity urban flow fields, but each simulation is tied to a fixed inflow boundary condition and can take hours to days, which is incompatible with urban UAV missions that typically last minutes to tens of minutes. We present GeoWind2Plan, a geometry-to-wind-to-planning framework for mission-time 3D urban wind prediction and energy-efficient UAV planning. Given only a background wind vector, 3D building geometry, and a start-goal pair, GeoWind2Plan transforms the building geometry into a reference-wind frame, predicts mission-relevant 3D wind patches with a localized geometry-conditioned neural operator, stitches them into a queryable local wind field, and optimizes a feasible 3D path and speed profile using a physically grounded UAV energy model. Rather than pursuing CFD-perfect reconstruction, GeoWind2Plan targets decision-useful wind prediction: trajectories are planned with predicted wind and evaluated under high-fidelity CFD wind. Across held-out urban domains, wind speeds, and mission wind-angle regimes, GeoWind2Plan performs corridor-localized wind inference in about 3 seconds, compared with roughly 8 hours for CFD. Under CFD evaluation, trajectories planned with GeoWind2Plan reduce energy by 6.9%, 12.7%, and 4.5% in tailwind, headwind, and crosswind missions relative to wind-agnostic planning, recovering 87.9%, 85.7%, and 75.0% of CFD-reference savings. These results show that fast, corridor-localized 3D urban wind prediction can make wind-aware UAV energy planning practical at mission time.

AI.tldr: 提出 GeoWind2Plan 框架，仅凭背景风矢量、三维建筑几何与起终点，用几何条件神经算子在约3秒内预测任务相关三维城市风场并优化无人机能耗路径，在CFD评估下节能4.5%–12.7%。
AI.motivation: 城市低空飞行中建筑使环境风演变为空间变化的三维流场，无人机能耗不仅取决于路径长度，还取决于局部风暴露；然而任务规划时通常缺乏建筑解析的风场信息。CFD虽能提供高保真城市流场，但每次仿真绑定固定入流边界条件且耗时数小时至数天，与仅持续数分钟到数十分钟的城市无人机任务不兼容。
AI.method: 提出 GeoWind2Plan，一个"几何—风—规划"框架：输入仅为背景风矢量、三维建筑几何和起终点对；将建筑几何变换到参考风坐标系，用局部化的几何条件神经算子预测任务相关的三维风斑块，拼接成可查询的局部风场，再基于物理驱动的无人机能耗模型优化可行的三维路径与速度剖面。该方法不追求CFD级完美重构，而是面向决策有用的风预测。
AI.result: 在留出城市域、风速及任务风角工况下，GeoWind2Plan 约3秒完成走廊局部化风推断，而CFD约需8小时。CFD评估下，相比风无关规划，使用其预测风规划的轨迹在顺风、逆风、侧风任务中分别节能6.9%、12.7%、4.5%，分别恢复CFD参考节能量的87.9%、85.7%、75.0%。
AI.conclusion: 快速、走廊局部化的三维城市风预测可使风感知的无人机能耗规划在任务时变得切实可行。

title: ChronoSRL: Temporal Geometry for Self-Supervised Reinforcement Learning
summary: A goal that is close in space can be far away in time. Obstacles, terrain, and the agent's own capabilities determine how long it takes to get there. Yet, critics in contrastive and survival reinforcement learning do not measure the distances in their representation space in units of time. We therefore introduce ChronoSRL, which gives the critic's embeddings an explicit temporal geometry. The distance between state-action and goal embeddings is trained to match the time that the agent takes to reach the goal (goal-reaching time), while goals that were not reached, and goals from other trajectories, are pushed at least one discount horizon away. Furthermore, reaching a goal quickly once does not mean that reaching it is reliable in general, so the policy should not follow the temporal distance directly. Instead, we build on survival reinforcement learning and predict from our temporal embeddings not only the full distribution of goal-reaching times but also the time spent near the goal. Thereby, the policy is trained to favor actions that reach the goal sooner and more reliably and that keep the agent near it. ChronoSRL learns faster and reaches higher performance than contrastive, action-chunked contrastive, and survival reinforcement learning baselines on seven standard locomotion and navigation benchmarks, even with much smaller networks. To test the limits of self-supervised reinforcement learning, we introduce velocity tracking, goal-position reaching, and box climbing tasks with a quadruped robot in a realistic sim-to-real locomotion setup, and show how the shaping terms that are typical for robotics can be naturally incorporated into our framework. ChronoSRL is the only one of the tested self-supervised reinforcement learning methods that learns to stay at the commanded velocities and goal positions, and climbs the highest boxes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ChronoSRL，在 critic 的嵌入空间中引入显式时间几何：使状态-动作与目标嵌入之间的距离对应到达目标所需时间，从而比对比式与生存式强化学习基线更快、更强。
AI.motivation: 空间中接近的目标在时间上可能很远，障碍、地形与智能体自身能力决定到达目标所需时间。然而对比式与生存式强化学习的 critic 并未在其表示空间中以“时间”为单位度量距离，缺乏显式的时间几何。
AI.method: ChronoSRL 为 critic 嵌入赋予显式时间几何：训练状态-动作与目标嵌入之间的距离以匹配智能体实际到达目标时间；未到达的目标及来自其他轨迹的目标被推至至少一个折扣视界之外。由于快速到达一次不等于可靠到达，策略不直接沿时间距离行动，而是基于生存式强化学习，从时间嵌入中预测到达目标时间的完整分布以及停留在目标附近的时间，从而偏好更快、更可靠到达并保持在目标附近的动作。
AI.result: 在七个标准运动与导航基准上，ChronoSRL 比对比式、动作分块对比式及生存式强化学习基线学习更快、性能更高，且网络规模小得多。在四足机器人真实感 sim-to-real 运动设置中，作者引入速度跟踪、目标位置到达与爬箱任务，并自然纳入机器人学常用的 shaping 项；ChronoSRL 是唯一学会保持指令速度与目标位置、并爬上最高箱子的自监督强化学习方法。
AI.conclusion: 以时间为单位在表示空间中度量到目标的距离，并联合预测到达时间分布与目标附近停留时间，可有效提升自监督强化学习的学习效率、性能与可靠性，并在真实感机器人任务中展现优势。

title: Action Chunking Proximal Policy Optimization with Feedback Correction
summary: Action chunking provides temporal abstraction in reinforcement learning by selecting short action sequences instead of individual actions, but many existing approaches face two limitations in high-dimensional robotic control. First, many rely on value functions over action chunks, which can be difficult to learn as action dimensionality and chunk length grow. Second, executing chunks open-loop removes within-chunk feedback, limiting reactivity in contact-rich tasks. We present Action Chunking PPO (ACPPO), a PPO extension that uses a chunked actor while retaining a standard state-value critic, thereby avoiding chunked Q-functions. We further propose ACPPO-Corr, which augments the chunk planner with a stepwise feedback corrector that adjusts planned actions online within each chunk. Across 25 simulated robotics tasks from IsaacGym and Bi-DexHands, spanning locomotion, arm manipulation, and dexterous hand-object interaction, ACPPO-Corr achieves the strongest aggregate performance among evaluated methods and performs best on both decision-frequency-sensitive and decision-frequency-neutral task subsets. Ablations show that moderate chunk lengths work best and that corrector regularization is important for balancing chunk-level planning with local feedback. These results suggest that action chunking can be effective in online PPO when chunk-level planning is paired with closed-loop correction. The code is available at: https://github.com/hshhahn/ACPPO.

AI.tldr: 提出ACPPO与ACPPO-Corr，用分块actor但保留标准状态值critic避免学习分块Q函数，并加入步级反馈校正器，在25个仿真机器人任务上取得最佳综合性能。
AI.motivation: 动作分块虽提供时间抽象，但在高维机器人控制中存在两个问题：一是许多方法依赖动作块上的价值函数，随动作维度和块长增长难以学习；二是开环执行整块动作缺乏块内反馈，限制了接触密集任务中的反应能力。
AI.method: ACPPO是PPO的扩展：采用分块（chunked）actor，同时保留标准的状态值critic，从而无需学习分块Q函数。ACPPO-Corr在此基础上为分块规划器增加一个步级反馈校正器，在每个块内在线调整已规划动作。
AI.result: 在IsaacGym与Bi-DexHands的25个仿真机器人任务（涵盖locomotion、机械臂操作与灵巧手-物体交互）上，ACPPO-Corr在评估方法中综合性能最强，并在对决策频率敏感与不敏感的两个任务子集上均表现最佳。消融实验表明中等块长效果最好，校正器正则化对平衡块级规划与局部反馈很重要。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，当块级规划与闭环校正结合时，动作分块在在线PPO中可以是有效的。代码见https://github.com/hshhahn/ACPPO。

title: Diffusion Policy Improvement with Proposal-Conditioned Refinement Flows
summary: Diffusion and flow policies can model complex behaviors in offline reinforcement learning (RL). However, penalizing their KL divergence from the behavior policy can discourage actions having high critic values with low behavior density. Directly refining behavior proposals may be an alternative, yet Gaussian or deterministic editors limit expressiveness to represent multiple separated modes for the same proposal. In this work, we introduce Proposal-Conditioned Refinement Flows (PReFlow), a policy extraction method combining critic-based proposal selection with a conditional refinement flow. To optimize proposal selection and refinement together, we formulate a KL-regularized objective whose optimum induces a Gibbs policy over final actions under a Gaussian-smoothed behavior prior. The refinement flow can represent multiple high value modes, while a proposal-centered Gaussian reference regulates large action changes. This Gaussian reference further enables us to make use of simulation-free, closed form adjoint matching targets from sampled endpoints and critic gradients, yielding a single velocity regression loss without a backward adjoint solve. On 50 OGBench tasks, PReFlow achieves competitive offline performance and the highest aggregate score among the compared methods after online fine-tuning, reaching 91\% after 500K environment steps.

AI.tldr: PReFlow 提出一种策略提取方法，将基于 critic 的提案选择与条件精炼流结合，用 KL 正则化目标导出高斯平滑行为先验下的 Gibbs 策略，无需反向伴随求解即可训练。
AI.motivation: 扩散与流策略可建模离线 RL 中的复杂行为，但对其与行为策略的 KL 散度施加惩罚会抑制那些 critic 价值高、而行为密度低的动作。直接用高斯或确定性编辑器精炼行为提案，又受限于表达能力，难以表示同一提案下的多个分离模态。
AI.method: 提出 Proposal-Conditioned Refinement Flows（PReFlow）：结合 critic 引导的提案选择与条件精炼流，联合优化提案选择与精炼过程；构造 KL 正则化目标，其最优解在高斯平滑行为先验下诱导出关于最终动作的 Gibbs 策略。精炼流可表示多个高价值模态，而以提案为中心的高斯参考分布约束动作的过大偏移。该高斯参考还支持利用采样端点与 critic 梯度构造无模拟、闭式的伴随匹配目标，得到单一速度回归损失，无需反向伴随求解。
AI.result: 在 50 个 OGBench 任务上取得有竞争力的离线性能；在线微调后在所比较方法中聚合得分最高，500K 环境步后达到 91%。
AI.conclusion: PReFlow 通过提案条件化的精炼流与 KL 正则化目标，在保留多模态表达能力的同时避免了行为密度惩罚的限制，并以闭式伴随匹配实现高效训练，在离线与在线微调场景中均表现优异。

title: Direct Experience World-Model Optimization: Learning the World Beyond Action Imitation
comment: World Action Model; post-deployment training; dexterous manipulation
summary: World-Action Models (WAMs) couple action generation with predictions of how physical interactions unfold. However, current post-deployment learning paradigms typically improve behavior without requiring better world predictions. Especially in dexterous manipulation, small execution errors can compound in high-dimensional action spaces, hindering policy improvement and pushing interactions beyond the world model's training distribution. Motivated by this, we propose Direct Experience World-Model Optimization (DEWO), a post-deployment learning paradigm for WAMs that, alongside action imitation, refines world representations through visual experience to better condition action generation. Specifically, it identifies interaction turning points and learns from successful and failed futures to support classifier-free guidance. An additional value head estimates task progress from video representations and activates guidance when progress stalls during inference. Across five DexJoCo tasks, DEWO improves average success across all three WAM formulations. Ablations show that visual supervision from successful and failed continuations improves both prediction and control beyond action supervision alone. On four real-world tasks across Wuji and Sharpa, 3 x 3 grid evaluations show that two rounds of deployment learning increase success from 51.0% to 71.7% in cells with at least one initial success, a gain of 20.7 percentage points. These findings support continued predictive learning for improving control through deployment experience, making world modeling an active part of WAM adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出DEWO——一种面向World-Action Models的后部署学习范式，通过视觉经验精炼世界表征以更好条件化动作生成，在DexJoCo与真实机器人任务上均提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 当前WAMs的后部署学习通常只改进行为而不要求更好的世界预测；在灵巧操作中，高维动作空间的小误差会累积，阻碍策略改进，并使交互偏离世界模型训练分布。
AI.method: DEWO在动作模仿之外，利用视觉经验精炼世界表征：识别交互转折点，从成功与失败未来中学习以支持classifier-free guidance；额外引入value head，从视频表征估计任务进度，并在推理时进度停滞时激活引导。
AI.result: 在五个DexJoCo任务上，DEWO对三种WAM形式均提升平均成功率；消融显示成功/失败续帧的视觉监督在预测与控制上均优于仅动作监督。在Wuji与Sharpa四个真实任务、3×3网格评估中，两轮部署学习将至少有一次初始成功格子的成功率从51.0%提升至71.7%，提高20.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明持续预测学习可通过部署经验改善控制，使世界建模成为WAM自适应的主动组成部分。

title: Learning from Shared-Control Overrides: Context-Driven Acceleration Profile Prediction for Personalized Overtaking
summary: Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) systems are typically calibrated for an average driver, often resulting in a mismatch between vehicle behavior and individual expectations during time-critical maneuvers such as highway overtaking. When the ACC is perceived as too conservative and inconsistent, drivers intervene through throttle overrides, providing implicit feedback on the system's behavior. This paper reframes these override actions as human-in-theloop supervisory signals and proposes a data-driven framework for personalized vehicle adaptation, termed Context-driven Personalized ACC (CoP-ACC). Rather than relying solely on end-to-end regression, which tends to over-smooth dynamic responses, we introduce a hybrid pipeline combining: (i) unsupervised hierarchical clustering to extract representative acceleration profiles from override events; (ii) a context classifier that maps pre-maneuver driving conditions to the appropriate profile; and (iii) a residual regressor that refines the selected profile into a smooth, personalized acceleration profile tailored to the immediate context. Evaluated on real-world public-road data against a withheld forced-ACC baseline, the approach demonstrates high reconstruction fidelity and generates acceleration profiles that tend toward the driver's expected behavior in potential override contexts. The results highlight the potential of learning from shared-control overrides to enable anticipatory, personalized ACC behavior, reducing manual interventions and improving ride comfort.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoP-ACC框架，将驾驶员油门超越操作视为人机协同监督信号，通过层次聚类、上下文分类与残差回归的混合流程，实现个性化自适应巡航控制加速度曲线的生成。
AI.motivation: ACC系统通常按"平均驾驶员"标定，在高速公路超车等时间关键场景下，车辆行为与个体预期不符。当ACC被感知为过于保守或不一致时，驾驶员通过油门超越进行干预，这些行为蕴含了对系统行为的隐式反馈，但此前未被作为监督信号加以利用。
AI.method: 提出CoP-ACC（Context-driven Personalized ACC）数据驱动框架，不依赖易过度平滑动态响应的端到端回归，而是采用混合流程：(i) 无监督层次聚类，从超越事件中提取代表性加速度曲线；(ii) 上下文分类器，将机动前的驾驶条件映射到合适的曲线；(iii) 残差回归器，将所选曲线细化为平滑且适配当前上下文的个性化加速度曲线。
AI.result: 在真实公开道路数据上，以保留的强制ACC基线进行对比评估，该方法展现出高重构保真度，并能在潜在发生超越的场景中生成趋向驾驶员预期行为的加速度曲线。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，从共享控制中的超越操作学习，有望实现具备前瞻性的个性化ACC行为，从而减少人工干预并提升乘坐舒适性。

title: Multi-Agent Flow Matching with Decoupled Generative Guidance
summary: Generative modeling is widely used for producing diverse objects from complex, multimodal distributions. However, its expressivity does not, in general, come with formal guarantees that the generated objects satisfy hard constraints or requirements. In multi-agent generation, this problem becomes more challenging because a hard requirement can depend on multiple agents, while each agent may need to determine its own guidance input without relying on the simultaneously computed guidance inputs of other agents. To this end, we introduce DeGG-Flow, a general framework for multi-agent flow matching with decoupled generative guidance. By representing the generative process as a control-affine dynamical system, we develop guidance conditions for two classes of coupled requirements: shared requirements whose satisfaction depends on multiple agents together, and private requirements associated with each individual agent dependent on its neighbors. For both classes, we establish feasibility conditions and finite-horizon convergence guarantees. We further derive a Wasserstein bound that characterizes the distributional deviation induced by the guidance. We demonstrate DeGG-Flow on multi-robot collaboration for crossing a spatial gap by reconfiguring the environment, and on multi-object scene generation with affordance requirements. Across both applications, DeGG-Flow directly generates objects that satisfy all corresponding hard requirements, including at team sizes unseen during training.

AI.tldr: 提出 DeGG-Flow，一种带解耦生成引导的多智能体流匹配框架，用于在生成过程中满足多智能体耦合的硬约束，并给出可行性与有限时域收敛保证。
AI.motivation: 生成模型虽能建模复杂多模态分布，但通常缺乏形式化保证，无法确保生成对象满足硬约束。在多智能体生成中，硬需求可能依赖多个智能体，而各智能体需独立确定自身引导输入，无法依赖其他智能体同时计算出的引导，问题更具挑战性。
AI.method: 将生成过程表示为控制仿射动力系统，提出解耦生成引导的多智能体流匹配框架 DeGG-Flow；针对两类耦合需求——依赖多智能体共同满足的共享需求，以及与个体智能体相关、依赖其邻居的私有需求——建立引导条件，并给出可行性条件与有限时域收敛保证；进一步推导刻画引导引起分布偏移的 Wasserstein 界。
AI.result: 在穿越空间间隙并通过重构环境实现多机器人协作，以及带可供性要求的多物体场景生成两个任务上验证；DeGG-Flow 直接生成满足所有相应硬需求的对象，且在训练时未见的团队规模下仍然有效。
AI.conclusion: DeGG-Flow 为多智能体生成中的硬约束满足提供了具有理论保证的通用流匹配引导框架，实验中无需后处理即满足硬需求，并具备跨团队规模的泛化能力。

title: Estimation of Room Impulse Responses from Handclaps
summary: Handclaps provide an equipment-free excitation for room acoustics, but their unknown and variable source waveform makes room impulse response (RIR) estimation challenging. In this work, we investigate whether RIRs can be estimated directly from handclaps. To this end, we introduce an anechoic handclap dataset containing 2,540 claps from 17 participants, designed to capture variability across natural claps and different hand configurations. We first establish the performance attainable when the excitation clap is known using regularized deconvolution, and show that approximating the unknown excitation by windowing the direct sound from the reverberant recording is insufficient. To estimate the RIR without a known excitation, we propose using the anechoic handclap recordings to train a deep neural network with a supervised regression objective. Evaluated on a controlled synthetic benchmark, the proposed neural regressor significantly outperforms windowing-based baselines across all instrumental metrics. Furthermore, we test the proposed method on handclap recordings measured in real acoustic spaces, showing that the inferred RIR spectra are consistent across different handclap measurements taken in the same room location. These results showcase the feasibility of directly estimating RIRs from natural handclaps without requiring knowledge of the excitation signal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用消声手拍数据集训练深度神经网络，直接从自然手拍录音中估计房间脉冲响应（RIR），在合成基准上显著优于加窗基线，并在真实空间中验证了推断RIR频谱的一致性。
AI.motivation: 手拍作为房间声学的无设备激励源，使用方便，但其源波形未知且多变，导致RIR估计困难。已有的加窗近似方法（用混响录音中的直达声作为激励近似）不足以解决问题，因此需要探索在激励未知条件下直接估计RIR的可行性。
AI.method: 1) 构建消声手拍数据集，包含17名参与者、2,540次手拍，覆盖自然手拍与不同手型的变化；2) 先用正则化反卷积建立已知激励下可达到的性能上界，并证明加窗近似不足；3) 提出用消声手拍录音训练深度神经网络，以监督回归为目标，在激励未知情况下估计RIR。
AI.result: 在受控合成基准上，所提神经回归器在全部器乐指标上显著优于基于加窗的基线方法；在真实声学空间中测量手拍录音进行测试，显示同一房间位置下不同手拍测量推断出的RIR频谱具有一致性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，无需已知激励信号，直接从自然手拍估计RIR是可行的，为便捷的房间声学测量提供了新思路。

title: HEAR: Real Voices, Real Bias: A Large-Scale Human-Recorded, Demographically Diverse Benchmark for Audio Language Models
summary:
We introduce HEAR (Human-recorded Evaluation of Audio-LLM bias by Real speakers), a large-scale, ecologically valid benchmark comprising 87k real human audio samples from 843 demographically diverse participants. HEAR enables comprehensive evaluation through Multiple Choice Question Answering (MCQA) and open-ended long-form tasks. To our knowledge, this is the first large-scale voice benchmark grounded entirely in authentic human speech.
  We evaluate model behavior across both real-time speech-to-speech and speech-to-text architectures. Our results reveal that voice-conditioned bias is a model-specific property. Furthermore, we demonstrate that personalization instructions consistently exacerbate demographic disparities. Our findings establish that voice bias is a controllable model characteristic, providing a foundational framework for future bias mitigation and evaluation in Audio-LLM development.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出HEAR——首个完全基于真实人类语音的大规模、生态有效的音频-LLM偏见评测基准，包含来自843名多样化参与者的87k条真人音频样本，覆盖选择题问答与开放式长文本任务，并据此揭示语音条件偏见是模型特有属性、个性化指令会加剧人口统计差异。
AI.motivation: 现有音频-LLM偏见评测多依赖合成语音或小规模数据，生态效度不足，难以反映真实语音条件下的模型偏见行为，因此需要基于真实说话人语音的大规模评测基准。
AI.method: 构建HEAR基准，采集843名人口统计多样化参与者的87k条真实人类音频样本；设计选择题问答（MCQA）与开放式长文本两类任务；在实时语音到语音与语音到文本两种架构上评测模型行为。
AI.result: 语音条件偏见是模型特有的属性（model-specific property）；个性化指令一致性地加剧了人口统计差异（demographic disparities）。
AI.conclusion: 语音偏见是可控制的模型特征，HEAR为音频-LLM开发中的偏见缓解与评测提供了基础性框架。

title: Distill Locally, Schedule Globally: Flow Maps for Few-Step Text-to-Speech
summary: Flow-matching text-to-speech (TTS) models achieve high synthesis quality but require many neural function evaluations (NFEs) to integrate their generative trajectories. Recent few-step flow-map distillation approaches for TTS construct targets from numerically integrated teacher trajectories, creating a trade-off between target accuracy and training cost. We propose Local Flow-Map Distillation (LFMD), which adapts Eulerian Map Distillation to conditional TTS and avoids teacher trajectory integration during target construction. For inference, we derive a sampling schedule (TD-DP) from teacher dynamics and consistency of the learned maps, with a single cost graph supporting multiple NFE budgets without external audio-metric evaluation. Because scheduling offers no flexibility at one NFE, we refine this regime with alignment-aware temporal self-distillation using soft-DTW. Across Seed-TTS and LibriSpeech-PC, LFMD improves low-NFE synthesis over a matched integral-distillation baseline. On Seed-TTS, the refined student reaches 1.80% WER with 1-NFE, compared with 1.76% for its 32-NFE teacher.

AI.tldr: 提出局部流图蒸馏（LFMD）用于TTS少步生成，避免教师轨迹数值积分，并给出无需外部指标的自适应采样调度，1-NFE下接近32-NFE教师性能。
AI.motivation: 流匹配TTS质量高但推理需大量NFE（函数评估）来数值积分生成轨迹；现有的少步流图蒸馏依赖对教师轨迹的数值积分构造目标，存在目标精度与训练成本的权衡。目标是降低推理NFE同时保持合成质量，并摆脱对教师轨迹积分的依赖。
AI.method: 将欧拉图蒸馏（Eulerian Map Distillation）适配到条件TTS，提出局部流图蒸馏（LFMD），在构造蒸馏目标时不做教师轨迹积分。推理阶段基于教师动力学与所学映射的一致性推导采样调度（TD-DP），用单一代价图支持多种NFE预算，且无需外部音频指标评估。针对1-NFE时调度无自由度的问题，用基于soft-DTW的对齐感知时序自蒸馏进一步改进该极低步数情形。
AI.result: 在Seed-TTS与LibriSpeech-PC上，LFMD在低NFE合成上优于同等条件的积分式蒸馏基线。在Seed-TTS上，精炼后的学生在1-NFE下WER为1.80%，其32-NFE教师为1.76%。
AI.conclusion: LFMD通过免轨迹积分的局部流图蒸馏，结合TD-DP调度与soft-DTW对齐自蒸馏，显著降低TTS推理NFE，1-NFE学生性能逼近32-NFE教师，验证了该蒸馏与调度框架的有效性。

title: Trigger Sound Suppression for Misophonia
summary: Misophonia, a disorder of decreased tolerance to specific sounds, affects 5-20% of the population, yet sufferers have no good options: therapy helps a minority, and earplugs or noise cancellation silence everything. We present a study for neural trigger sound suppression for misophonia, selectively removing trigger sounds. We curate a dataset covering the 10 most common trigger classes. Using streaming dual-path networks operating on 6 ms audio chunks, we explore both one-hot and multi-hot-conditioned models that suppress 1-3 triggers from the acoustic scene. We validate our model outputs in a listening study with 30 adults with clinically elevated misophonia impairment. Participants reported significantly lower distress and arousal, and improved valence, for suppressed audio.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于恐音症的神经触发音抑制方法，基于流式双路径网络从音频场景中选择性去除1-3类触发音，并经30名临床显著恐音症受试者的听感实验验证有效降低不适与唤醒、改善情绪效价。
AI.motivation: 恐音症患者对特定声音耐受性降低，影响5-20%人群，但现有方案不佳：治疗仅对少数人有效，耳塞或降噪会屏蔽所有声音。因此需要能选择性去除触发音而不影响整体声场的技术。
AI.method: 构建覆盖10种最常见触发类别的数据集；采用基于6 ms音频块的流式双路径网络；探索one-hot与multi-hot条件模型，从声学场景中抑制1-3个触发音。随后开展30名临床显著恐音症受损成人的听感验证实验。
AI.result: 在听感实验中，受试者对被抑制音频报告显著更低的痛苦与唤醒水平，以及更好的情绪效价。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明神经触发音抑制在恐音症干预中具有可行性，可选择性去除触发音并带来主观症状改善，为该类人群提供了潜在的新型干预途径。

title: UDSS-BWE: Uncertainty- and Decision-Science Inspired Swin BandWidth Extension
summary: Bandwidth extension (BWE) is fundamentally localized: the most perceptual distortions are not average-case distortions, but rare high-frequency (HF) transients that standard, risk-neutral objectives tend to smooth away. To close this gap, we seek solutions in the risk-sensitive and uncertainty-aware decision science rules and present UDSS-BWE, which introduces five decision-science and uncertainty-aware discriminators: CVaRD (does tail pooling to amplify HF artifacts), CCD (a primal-dual augmented Lagrangian to prevent HF overboost), MCUD (a learnable utility over spectral flatness/ centroid/ rolloff), EDD (captures epistemic uncertainty), and DROD (captures entropic KL-DRO aggregation). UDSS-BWE is also designed as a complex valued adversarial BWE framework that uses Swin-based generators, a lightweight dual-stream shifted-window backbone, to capture local and long-range structure efficiently, while learnable lattice coupling provides controlled cross-stream exchange. UDSS-BWE is optimized extensively and achieves better perceptual quality with 3.89x fewer parameters (72M vs.18.5M) over two English and French datasets under clean and noisy conditions. To the best of our knowledge, this work shows how multi disciplinary decision-science-inspired and uncertainty theories can be successfully used to design efficient discriminators for producing more nuanced audios, establishing a new baseline in the BWE task.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出UDSS-BWE，一个风险敏感、不确定性感知的复数域对抗带宽扩展框架，通过五种决策科学与不确定性驱动的判别器，在更少参数下实现更优感知质量。
AI.motivation: 带宽扩展（BWE）问题本质上是局部化的：最具感知意义的失真并非平均情况下的失真，而是罕见的高频瞬态，而标准的风险中性目标往往会将这些瞬态平滑掉。因此需要引入风险敏感与不确定性感知的决策科学方法来弥补这一差距。
AI.method: 提出UDSS-BWE框架，引入五个决策科学与不确定性感知判别器：CVaRD（尾部池化以放大高频伪影）、CCD（原始-对偶增广拉格朗日法防止高频过冲）、MCUD（对频谱平坦度/质心/滚降的可学习效用）、EDD（捕捉认知不确定性）、DROD（捕捉熵KL-DRO聚合）。框架为复数域对抗BWE，采用基于Swin的生成器（轻量双流位移窗口主干）高效捕捉局部与长程结构，并通过可学习格耦合实现受控的跨流交换。
AI.result: 在两个英语和法语数据集上，在干净与噪声条件下，UDSS-BWE取得了更好的感知质量，同时参数减少3.89倍（72M vs. 18.5M）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了如何成功运用多学科决策科学启发与不确定性理论来设计高效判别器以产生更细腻的音频，为BWE任务建立了新的基线。

title: Emergent Tonal Structure in Learned Chord Embeddings and Its Relation to Tonal Tension
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables, Accepted at the 27th International Society for Music Information Retrieval Conference (ISMIR) 2026
summary: Several tonal pitch spaces and computational models have been proposed to analyze tonal structure in Western tonal music, many of them grounded in principles from music theory and used to support tonal analysis with important implications for tonal tension. In parallel, data-driven methods such as skip-gram have been used to learn chord embeddings from symbolic corpora, but their ability to recover tonal structure and its relation to tonal tension remains underexplored. In this work, we investigate how skip-gram chord embeddings reflect tonal structure and whether they provide a useful basis for analyzing structural aspects of tonal tension. Using chord sequences with and without transposition-based augmentation, we evaluate the learned spaces from geometric, functional, and tension-related perspectives. We show that augmented embeddings exhibit strong transposition equivariance, recover a clear circle-of-fifths structure, and support interpretable shifts between key-related regions of the learned space. We then derive embedding-based measures from chord-to-key distance and contextual chord-distance relations, and show that they capture meaningful aspects of tonal tension structure through correspondence with matched tonal measures and moderate alignment with human tension profiles. Across analyses, transposition-based augmentation generally improves the stability, tonal coherence, and interpretability of the learned space.

AI.tldr: 该论文探究skip-gram和弦嵌入能否反映调性结构并用于分析调性张力，发现经移调增强的嵌入具有强移调等变性、能恢复五度圈结构，其派生指标与调性张力度量及人类张力感知存在对应关系。
AI.motivation: 已有调性音高空间与计算模型多基于乐理原理，用于调性分析及调性张力研究；而skip-gram等数据驱动方法虽可从符号语料学习和弦嵌入，但其恢复调性结构、关联调性张力的能力尚缺乏充分探索。论文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 使用带与不带移调增强的和弦序列训练skip-gram和弦嵌入，从几何、功能、张力相关三个视角评估所学空间；并基于和弦-调距离及上下文和弦距离关系推导嵌入型度量，与匹配的调性度量及人类张力轮廓进行对照分析。
AI.result: 移调增强嵌入表现出强移调等变性，恢复出清晰的五度圈结构，并支持调性相关区域间可解释的位移；所推导的嵌入度量与调性度量存在对应，与人类张力轮廓呈中等程度一致；移调增强总体上提升了嵌入空间的稳定性、调性连贯性与可解释性。
AI.conclusion: skip-gram和弦嵌入可有效反映调性结构，并可作为分析调性张力结构方面的有用基础；基于移调的增强是提升嵌入空间稳定性、调性一致性和可解释性的有效手段。

title: InterBias-SV: Compound Conditions in Speaker Verification
summary: Speaker verification systems encounter combinations of noise, channel distortion, and changes in speech. Evaluating each condition separately does not establish whether their effects add. InterBias-SV organises this question around a four-term comparison: joint error, two marginal errors, and a common reference. Its results artefact contains 4,068 scored records across 17 experiments, 12 encoder labels, and six speech corpora, totalling 12 million trial evaluations. Three experiment families contain the same-corpus terms needed to compute additive contrasts. For labels assigned to speaker-trained encoders, their mean contrasts are +0.0026, +0.0088, and +0.0024 in equal error rate (EER), with larger variation across settings. These descriptive averages do not establish equivalence to additivity: trial matching, checkpoint identity, and parts of the condition metadata remain unverified. We also examine two interpretation problems. Near-chance EER can make additive predictions difficult to interpret, but chance performance is not a hard EER ceiling, and correlation with the prediction does not identify a saturation mechanism. Ratios of demographic gaps are unstable when their clean reference is near zero; absolute gaps provide a more direct summary. The benchmark provides condition definitions, analysis scripts, and explicit requirements for interpretable compound-condition comparisons, while separating recomputable summaries from claims that require further experimental validation.

AI.tldr: InterBias-SV通过四项对比框架（联合误差、两个边际误差与共同参照）检验噪声、信道失真与语音变化在说话人确认中的可加性，并给出含4,068条评分记录的分析资源库与两项解释性问题讨论。
AI.motivation: 说话人确认系统常同时面临噪声、信道失真与语音变化的组合影响，但分别评估各条件无法判断效应是否可加，因此需要一个统一的对比框架来检验可加性假设，并厘清复合条件比较中的解释性陷阱。
AI.method: 构建InterBias-SV基准，围绕四项对比（联合误差、两个边际误差与共同参照）组织分析；结果资源库包含17个实验、12个编码器标签、6个语料库的4,068条评分记录，共1,200万次试次评估；其中三个实验族包含计算可加性对比所需的同语料项，并对说话人训练编码器标签计算EER对比均值；同时讨论近随机EER的可解释性与人口统计学差距比值的稳定性问题。
AI.result: 说话人训练编码器标签的平均EER对比为+0.0026、+0.0088和+0.0024，跨设置变异更大；这些描述性均值不能确立与可加性的等价性，因为试次匹配、检查点身份及部分条件元数据尚未核实。近随机EER会使可加性预测难以解释，但随机性能并非EER硬上限，且与预测的相关性不能识别饱和机制；当干净参照接近零时人口统计学差距比值不稳定，绝对差距更直接。
AI.conclusion: 该基准提供条件定义、分析脚本及可解释复合条件比较的明确要求，并将可重算的汇总结果与需要进一步实验验证的论断相区分；其贡献在于框架与规范性指引，而非对可加性的确证结论。

title: Long-Term Memory-Guided Enhancement for Target Perception in Audio-Language Models
summary: Audio large language models (ALLMs) can reason about the content of audio recordings to perform complex tasks. However, these capabilities usually collapse in real-world environments when background noise and competing sources mix the target sound. Inspired by long-term memory in human listening, we propose Long-Term Memory-Guided Audio Enhancement (LTM-AE) to improve selective target perception by refining the audio representations of ALLMs without training. LTM-AE extracts representations in hidden states from separate clean reference recordings as long-term memory for each category, guiding enhancement toward a user-specified listening target. We reconstruct incoming audio tokens in the selected category long-term memory and interpolate the reconstructions with the original tokens before language backbone decoding. This interpolation controls the influence of stored auditory experience while keeping all ALLM parameters fixed. Diagnostic readouts across twenty sound categories and three ALLMs show that LTM-AE strengthens responses to a specified target amid three interfering sources. Averaged over constrained and free-form classification, accuracy gains over raw mixtures range from 29.53 to 46.15 percentage points across multiple open source models. For speech content recovery, LTM-AE with an additional learned token-level gate reduces Qwen2-Audio's word error rate from 23.07% to 14.77%. This work takes an initial step toward using principles of human long-term memory to enhance ALLMs for real-world listening. Our code is available at https://github.com/aynlp/ltm-audio-code

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的长时记忆引导音频增强（LTM-AE），用干净参考录音的隐状态作为类别长时记忆，重构并插值音频token，提升ALLM在噪声与干扰下的选择性目标感知。
AI.motivation: 音频大语言模型（ALLM）虽能推理音频内容，但在真实环境中因背景噪声与竞争声源混合目标声音，其能力通常崩塌。受人类听觉长时记忆启发，作者希望在不训练的前提下改善选择性目标感知。
AI.method: LTM-AE从各类别的单独干净参考录音中提取隐状态表示，作为该类别的长时记忆；对输入音频token按用户指定目标类别进行重构，并将重构结果与原始token插值后再送入语言主干解码。插值控制存储听觉经验的影响强度，同时保持ALLM全部参数冻结。针对语音内容恢复，额外引入可学习的token级门控。
AI.result: 在二十个声音类别与三个ALLM上的诊断读出显示，LTM-AE在三个干扰源存在时增强了对指定目标的响应。约束与自由形式分类平均而言，相较原始混合输入，多个开源模型准确率提升29.53至46.15个百分点。语音内容恢复中，加入可学习token级门控的LTM-AE将Qwen2-Audio的词错误率从23.07%降至14.77%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作是将人类长时记忆原理用于增强ALLM真实场景听觉的初步尝试，方法免训练、即插即用，代码已开源。

title: Reconstructing the Vocal Tract with Differentiable Acoustic Simulation
comment: Accepted as NeurIPS 2026 spotlight paper. Supplementary material at https://people.csail.mit.edu/echen/vocal_recon/
summary: The vocal tract is the region of the human body responsible for filtering one's voice to create speech. In this paper, we present a differentiable and GPU accelerated acoustic simulator for the vocal tract. The differentiable simulator synthesizes speech by propagating sound along an acoustic tube model of the vocal tract, and via its gradients, can solve the inverse problem: reconstructing the shape of the vocal tract solely from the sound it produces. Although the inverse mapping between geometry and sound is notoriously non-convex, we discover that gradient descent succeeds with three technical contributions: (1) we design a frequency domain formulation of the vocal tract's fluid dynamics that is 70x more GPU parallelizable than finite differences in time, (2) we integrate a differentiable model for turbulence to synthesize consonants, and (3) similar to prior work in implicit neural representations (INRs) and neural fields, we find that parameterizing the geometry with a neural network accelerates convergence and escapes local minima that trap discrete representations. Because the simulator is differentiable, it is readily integrated with other deep learning pipelines to enable novel linguistics and medical imaging applications. (1) We demonstrate self-supervised autoencoding of vocal tract shapes across 11 languages, and (2) we couple our simulator with a generative model of MRI (magnetic resonance imaging) images to reconstruct one's moving vocal tract from only their speech without paired data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可微分、GPU加速的声道声学模拟器，通过频域流体力学建模与可微湍流模型，仅凭语音即可重建声道形状，并应用于多语言声道自编码与基于语音的MRI运动声道重建。
AI.motivation: 声道是人体用于滤波发声以产生语音的区域，但从声音反推声道几何形状（逆问题）高度非凸、求解困难。作者希望构建可微分模拟器，使逆问题可通过梯度下降求解，并无缝接入深度学习流程，从而推动语音学与医学影像应用。
AI.method: 1）提出声道流体力学的频域公式，相较时域有限差分有70倍更高的GPU并行度；2）引入可微的湍流模型以合成辅音；3）借鉴隐式神经表示（INR）/神经场思想，用神经网络参数化声道几何，从而加速收敛并跳出离散表示易陷入的局部极小。模拟沿声道声管模型传播声音实现语音合成，并利用梯度求解逆映射。
AI.result: 实验显示：（1）实现跨11种语言的声道形状自监督自编码；（2）将该模拟器与MRI图像的生成模型耦合，在无配对数据条件下仅由语音重建个人运动中的声道。梯度下降在几何到声音的逆映射中取得成功。
AI.conclusion: 可微分GPU加速声道模拟器能有效求解声道逆问题，并可与其他深度学习管线集成，开启新的语音学与医学影像应用方向。

title: When Capabilities Fail to Compose: Diagnosing the Compositionality Gap in Large Audio-Language Models
comment: Submitted to ICASSP 2027, 5 pages, 6 tables, 1 figure
summary: Large audio-language models (LALMs) perform strongly on individual audio tasks, but whether these capabilities can be reliably composed remains underexplored. We conduct a controlled diagnostic study of capability composition in LALMs, requiring models to integrate audio-attribute recognition, cue-conditioned segment selection, and downstream ASR or question answering. We construct two-utterance inputs with distinct acoustic cues to evaluate composition across environmental sound, gender, and emotion cues, with ASR, Math QA, and Factual QA as downstream tasks. Across four open-source LALMs, compositional QA accuracy decreases in 39 of 40 model-task-cue settings, by an average of 26.7 percentage points. ASR exhibits a similarly consistent degradation, with WER increasing in 39 of 40 settings by an average of 28.5 percentage points, while the magnitude of degradation varies across models, cue types, and cue salience. We further probe these failures through output format, positional preference, and chain-of-thought (CoT) analyses. Our study reveals a systematic gap between possessing individual audio capabilities and reliably composing them.

AI.tldr: 该研究对大型音频-语言模型（LALMs）的能力组合进行受控诊断，发现模型虽具备单项音频能力，但在需整合多项能力时出现系统性性能下降。
AI.motivation: LALMs在单项音频任务上表现优异，但其能力能否被可靠地组合（composition）尚缺乏系统研究。作者旨在揭示"拥有单项能力"与"可靠组合能力"之间的差距。
AI.method: 构建受控诊断任务，要求模型整合三类音频属性识别（环境音、性别、情绪线索）、线索条件化的片段选择，以及下游任务（ASR、数学QA、事实QA）。采用含不同声学线索的双语音输入，在4个开源LALMs上进行评估，并通过输出格式、位置偏好和思维链（CoT）分析探究失败原因。
AI.result: 组合式QA准确率在40个模型-任务-线索设置中有39个下降，平均降幅26.7个百分点；ASR的WER在40个设置中39个上升，平均增幅28.5个百分点。退化幅度因模型、线索类型及线索显著性而异。
AI.conclusion: LALMs存在"具备单项音频能力"与"可靠组合这些能力"之间的系统性差距，能力组合是当前模型的薄弱环节。

title: Interpreting and Evaluating Dynamic-Rate Speech Codec Boundaries
summary: Dynamic-frame-rate neural speech codecs replace a uniform frame grid with variable-duration tokens, making boundary placement part of the representation itself. Yet it is unclear what these boundaries encode and whether interpretable boundaries are also useful for neural speech reconstruction. This work combines boundary interpretation and controlled reconstruction analysis by comparing predicted boundaries with linguistic and acoustic references. We find that boundary meaning depends on the underlying speech representation. For the ASR-oriented SenseVoice and Whisper encoders, shallow layers emphasize phonetic, voicing, and acoustic transitions, whereas deeper layers shift toward syllable and subword structure. In a comparison of six dynamic-frame-rate algorithms and a uniform (fixed-frame-rate) baseline, higher-level linguistic alignment is associated with lower pooling distortion and better reconstruction from semantic tokens. Frame-rate-matched boundary tests make the distinction concrete: a syllable-derived partition improves over both Uniform and Similarity, while a phoneme-derived partition does not improve over Uniform. We infer that for semantically rich speech representations, useful codec boundaries are best understood as allocation decisions organized around the syllable scale.

AI.tldr: 本文通过边界解释与受控重构分析，研究动态帧率神经语音编解码器中边界所编码的信息及其对重构的价值，发现边界含义依赖底层语音表征，且高层语言对齐（音节尺度）与更低池化失真和更好重构相关。
AI.motivation: 动态帧率语音编解码器用变长token取代均匀帧网格，使边界位置成为表征的一部分，但边界究竟编码什么、可解释的边界是否也有助于神经语音重构尚不明确，因此需要将边界解释与受控重构分析结合。
AI.method: 将预测边界与语言学和声学参照进行比较；分析ASR导向的SenseVoice与Whisper编码器不同深度的边界含义；对比六种动态帧率算法与均匀（固定帧率）基线；进行帧率匹配的边界测试，比较音节派生划分、音素派生划分与Uniform、Similarity。
AI.result: 边界含义依赖底层语音表征：SenseVoice和Whisper浅层强调语音、清浊和声学转变，深层转向音节和子词结构；六种动态帧率算法与均匀基线对比中，更高层语言对齐对应更低池化失真和从语义token更好的重构；帧率匹配测试中，音节派生划分优于Uniform和Similarity，而音素派生划分未优于Uniform。
AI.conclusion: 对于语义丰富的语音表征，有用的编解码器边界最好理解为围绕音节尺度的分配决策。

title: RVQ Position Aware Speculative Decoding for On Device Text to Speech
summary: Autoregressive decoding (AR) with Transformer models is memory bandwidth bound at single stream inference, the typical deployment regime for on device text to speech (TTS). Real time streaming with Qwen3-TTS requires more than 200 sequential model calls per second, dominated by the inner loop MultiCodeDecoder that emits the 15 residual vector quantization (RVQ) codes per 80 ms audio frame. We propose RVQ position aware speculative decoding for the MultiCodeDecoder, attaining 2.47 accepted tokens per model call at $5\times10^{-4}$ percent added parameters and 10 to 20 percent per round speculation/verification overhead, reducing real time synthesis from 200 to 88 sequential model calls per second. The scheme is distributionally lossless under the deployed top-k sampling, and WER parity with the original system is consistent with this guarantee. We deliver 2 to 2.2x speedup for RVQ token generation with Qwen3-TTS 0.6B on recent iPhone and Apple Silicon Mac devices.

AI.tldr: 本文针对设备端TTS中Qwen3-TTS的MultiCodeDecoder，提出RVQ位置感知的推测解码方法，以极少参数开销将实时合成的顺序模型调用从200次/秒降至88次/秒，在iPhone与Apple Silicon Mac上实现2–2.2倍RVQ token生成加速。
AI.motivation: 自回归Transformer在单流推理下受内存带宽限制，这是设备端文本转语音（TTS）的典型部署场景。Qwen3-TTS实现实时流式合成需要每秒200次以上的顺序模型调用，瓶颈在于内层循环的MultiCodeDecoder——它为每80ms音频帧生成15个RVQ（残差矢量量化）码。因此亟需降低顺序模型调用次数以满足实时性需求。
AI.method: 提出RVQ位置感知的推测解码（RVQ position aware speculative decoding）用于MultiCodeDecoder。该方法仅增加5×10⁻⁴百分比的参数（即0.0005%的额外参数），每轮推测/验证带来10%–20%的开销，通过推测多个RVQ token并批量验证来减少顺序调用。
AI.result: 每次模型调用达到2.47个被接受的token；实时合成的顺序模型调用从200次/秒降至88次/秒；在Qwen3-TTS 0.6B上，于近期iPhone和Apple Silicon Mac设备上实现2–2.2倍的RVQ token生成加速。该方案在部署所用的top-k采样下具有分布无损性（distributionally lossless），且与原系统的WER（词错率）持平，与该无损保证一致。
AI.conclusion: RVQ位置感知推测解码以极小参数增量、可接受的开销，有效缓解了设备端TTS自回归解码的内存带宽瓶颈，将实时顺序调用次数显著减半以上，并在保持分布无损与WER持平的前提下，在移动与桌面Apple芯片上取得2–2.2倍加速，适用于设备端实时流式TTS部署。

title: ReDimNet2+: Multi-Corpus Data Scaling for Robust Speaker Verification
summary: Automatic speaker verification must remain reliable across devices, rooms, and compression pipelines. We present ReDimNet2+, which scales training of the compact ReDimNet2 backbone across seven public corpora (63,934 speakers, about 8,675 hours). Analysis of a VoxBlink2 subset reveals a shift in predicted spectral coloration, motivating codec and waveform augmentation alongside this multi-corpus training, large-margin fine-tuning (LMFT), and graph-based retrieval reranking. With random 4-second evaluation windows for all models, ReDimNet2+ LMFT reduces pooled VoxCeleb1 EER from 2.42% to 0.82% and a 26-condition robustness stress-test EER from 7.21% to 1.99%. Under this shared local protocol, it reaches 0.35% EER on VoxCeleb1-O versus 0.787% for the best evaluated WeSpeaker checkpoint. On a VoxBlink2 retrieval subset, reranking improves the final model's Pr@k from 0.7413 to 0.7687.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 ReDimNet2+，通过多语料训练、编解码与波形增强、大间隔微调（LMFT）及基于图的重排序，显著提升说话人验证的鲁棒性与精度。
AI.motivation: 自动说话人验证需在设备、房间和压缩管线变化下保持可靠；现有紧凑模型在跨域鲁棒性上仍有不足，且训练数据规模有限。
AI.method: 以紧凑 ReDimNet2 为主干，在 7 个公开语料（63,934 说话人、约 8,675 小时）上扩展训练；基于 VoxBlink2 子集分析发现预测频谱着色偏移，据此引入编解码与波形增强，并结合多语料训练、大间隔微调（LMFT）与基于图的检索重排序。
AI.result: 在统一随机 4 秒评估窗下，ReDimNet2+ LMFT 将 VoxCeleb1 汇总 EER 从 2.42% 降至 0.82%，26 条件鲁棒性压力测试 EER 从 7.21% 降至 1.99%；VoxCeleb1-O 上 EER 为 0.35%，优于最佳 WeSpeaker 检查点的 0.787%；VoxBlink2 检索子集上重排序将 Pr@k 从 0.7413 提升至 0.7687。
AI.conclusion: 多语料训练配合针对性增强、LMFT 与图重排序可显著提升紧凑说话人验证模型在同协议下的精度与跨条件鲁棒性。

title: RAWD-TTS: Ratio-Free Reward Alignment for Discrete-Diffusion Voice Cloning
summary: Zero-shot text-to-speech synthesizes new utterances in a speaker's voice from a short reference recording. Voice cloning requires accurate content and preserved speaker identity, but supervised acoustic-token prediction does not directly optimize these waveform-level properties. Reward-based post-training addresses this mismatch, but in discrete diffusion, token choices and reveal positions jointly define the sampling trajectory, complicating alignment. We introduce RAWD-TTS (Ratio-free Advantage-Weighted Denoising), which scores decoded samples with recognition and speaker rewards and uses group-relative advantages to weight masked-token reconstruction of those samples, without reverse-trajectory likelihoods or target audio. On 500 Russian CV3-Eval voice-cloning prompts, joint alignment reduces word error rate from 3.18% to 2.42% at the reward-selected checkpoint (24.0% relative) and to 2.58% at the final checkpoint (19.0%), while WavLM speaker cosine rises from 0.733 to 0.748 and 0.755. Controlled experiments characterize recognition-identity trade-offs and the effects of corruption count, group composition, and weighting.

AI.tldr: 提出RAWD-TTS，用识别与说话人奖励的组相对优势加权离散扩散掩码重建，无需逆轨迹似然或目标音频，在俄语CV3-Eval克隆任务上同时降低WER并提升说话人相似度。
AI.motivation: 零样本TTS需兼顾内容准确与说话人身份保持，但监督式声学token预测未直接优化这些波形级属性；奖励后训练可弥合该错配，但离散扩散中token选择与揭示位置共同决定采样轨迹，使对齐复杂化。
AI.method: RAWD-TTS（Ratio-free Advantage-Weighted Denoising）：用识别奖励与说话人奖励对解码样本打分，计算组相对优势，用以加权这些样本的掩码token重建；不依赖逆轨迹似然，也不需要目标音频。
AI.result: 在500条俄语CV3-Eval语音克隆提示上，联合对齐使WER从3.18%降至奖励选中checkpoint的2.42%（相对降24.0%）、最终checkpoint的2.58%（降19.0%）；WavLM说话人余弦从0.733升至0.748与0.755。对照实验刻画了识别-身份权衡及破坏数量、组构成、加权方式的影响。
AI.conclusion: 无需逆轨迹似然或目标音频的奖励加权去噪后训练可有效对齐离散扩散TTS，同时改善内容准确性与说话人相似度，并揭示识别与身份之间的可控权衡。

title: Multichannel Audio Quality Assessment: Extending Pretrained Perceptual Models to Spatial Audio
summary: Accurate perceptual quality assessment is essential for evaluating and optimizing spatial audio, where perceived quality depends on both signal fidelity and inter-channel spatial relationships. However, subjective evaluation is costly, while existing perceptual models are often trained for limited channel configurations and cannot be directly applied to higher-channel-count audio. This raises the question: how can pretrained perceptual knowledge be effectively reused for multichannel spatial audio? Using 5.1-channel audio, we study four levels of multichannel integration: signal, prediction, latent, and feature and propose two learned approaches: latent-level aggregation of spatial-group representations and the feature-level Feature-Band Group Attention (FGAtt), which adaptively fuses spatial groups at the feature level before perceptual processing. Across five 5.1-channel test sets, FGAtt achieves the strongest over- all performance, demonstrating the effectiveness of feature-level adaptation for reusing pretrained perceptual knowledge

AI.tldr: 该论文研究如何将预训练的感知模型知识有效复用于多声道空间音频质量评估，以5.1声道为例比较了信号、预测、潜在和特征四种多声道整合层级，提出潜在层空间组表征聚合和特征层 Feature-Band Group Attention (FGAtt) 两种方法，FGAtt在五个测试集上取得最佳整体性能。
AI.motivation: 空间音频的感知质量既依赖信号保真度，也依赖声道间空间关系，准确评估对音频优化至关重要。但主观评测成本高，而现有感知模型多针对有限声道配置训练，无法直接迁移到更高声道数音频。核心问题在于：如何有效复用预训练的感知知识以处理多声道空间音频。
AI.method: 以5.1声道音频为对象，系统研究四个多声道整合层级：信号层、预测层、潜在层、特征层。提出两种可学习方法：(1) 潜在层对空间组表征进行聚合；(2) 特征层 Feature-Band Group Attention (FGAtt)，在感知处理之前于特征层自适应融合各空间组。
AI.result: 在五个5.1声道测试集上，FGAtt取得最强的整体性能，验证了特征层自适应在复用预训练感知知识方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 特征层整合是复用预训练感知知识用于多声道空间音频质量评估的有效策略，FGAtt是其中表现最优的方案。

title: Bad: Taming the Bioacoustic Data Deluge with a Bat Acticity Detector
summary: Passive Acoustic Monitoring of bats generates massive ultrasonic datasets (>27 GB/night per node), straining edge storage and battery life. Legacy triggers fail against acoustic confusers, while deep models exceed microcontroller limits. We present a hardware-aware Bat Activity Detector (BAD) specifically designed to discriminate bat calls from hard biological and environmental confusers across variable sampling rates (192-384 kHz). Tailored for the Silicon Labs EFM32PG26 (MVP) in 8-bit integer precision, our model achieves 100 percent hardware offload across all 14 layers (17.2 KB Flash, 73.1 KB RAM). End-to-end preprocessing (74.00 ms for 76 frames) and inference (30.00 ms) of 100 ms clips at 192 kHz require 104.00 ms per clip. On spatially out-of-domain recordings under a realistic low-prevalence regime (r_pos = 0.05), BAD achieves an AUC-ROC of 0.9748 and suppresses 99.4% of non-target noise frames while retaining 65.3% of bat calls - delivering a >33x precision gain over classical Goertzel baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出硬件感知的蝙蝠活动检测器（BAD），可在资源受限的EFM32PG26单片机上全层8位整数离线运行，实现高精度蝙蝠叫声与干扰源判别。
AI.motivation: 被动声学监测产生超大规模超声数据（每节点>27 GB/夜），对边缘存储和电池寿命造成压力；传统触发器难以区分干扰源，深度模型又超出微控制器资源限制。
AI.method: 设计面向硬件的蝙蝠活动检测器BAD，针对Silicon Labs EFM32PG26（MVP）以8位整数精度部署，覆盖192–384 kHz可变采样率，专门区分蝙蝠叫声与生物及环境干扰源；模型14层全部实现硬件卸载。
