AI.result: 模型占用17.2 KB Flash、73.1 KB RAM；192 kHz下100 ms音频片段的端到端预处理（76帧，74.00 ms）加推理（30.00 ms）共104.00 ms；在空间域外录音、低流行率（r_pos=0.05）下AUC-ROC为0.9748，抑制99.4%非目标噪声帧并保留65.3%蝙蝠叫声，较经典Goertzel基线精度提升>33倍。
AI.conclusion: BAD在严苛资源约束下实现了可靠的边缘蝙蝠活动检测，显著优于传统基线，可有效降低数据存储与能耗负担。

title: Rate-Agnostic Bioacoustics: Heterogeneous Multi-Taxa Classification with Continuous Filterbanks and Fourier Neural Operators
summary: Conventional bioacoustic classification models rely on fixed-rate spectral representations, requiring recordings acquired at heterogeneous sampling rates to be resampled before analysis. We propose a Sampling-Frequency-Independent (SFI) frontend that processes each recording directly at its native sampling rate, coupled with a Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) backbone featuring progressive temporal-scale fusion. This framework avoids fixed-rate resampling and high-frequency information loss while producing fixed-size representations across sampling rates. Mild training-time sampling-rate (\textit{sr}) augmentation further improves robustness to unseen rate variations. Evaluated on a multi-taxa corpus comprising 84 classes and 60 sampling rates, the proposed SFI-FNO configuration outperforms fixed-rate and corpus-maximum-rate baselines, achieving .906 accuracy, .921 balanced accuracy, and a Macro-F1 score of .899.

AI.tldr: 提出采样率无关（SFI）前端与渐进时尺度融合的傅里叶神经算子（FNO）骨干，直接在原生采样率处理录音，避免重采样与高频信息损失，在多类群数据集上优于固定采样率基线。
AI.motivation: 传统生物声学分类模型依赖固定采样率的频谱表示，对异质采样率的录音必须先重采样，这会引入高频信息损失并增加预处理负担；作者希望直接在原生采样率处理录音，同时获得跨采样率统一尺寸的表示，并提升对未见采样率变化的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 设计采样率无关（SFI）前端，按每条录音的原始采样率直接处理；采用带渐进时间尺度融合（progressive temporal-scale fusion）的傅里叶神经算子（FNO）作为骨干，从而在不同采样率下输出固定尺寸表示；训练时施加温和的采样率（sr）增强以增强对未见采样率变化的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在包含 84 个类别、60 种采样率的多类群语料库上，SFI-FNO 配置优于固定采样率和语料最大采样率基线，达到 0.906 准确率、0.921 平衡准确率和 0.899 的 Macro-F1。
AI.conclusion: 该框架无需固定采样率重采样，避免高频信息损失，并能跨采样率产生固定尺寸表示；结合温和采样率增强可提升对未见采样率变化的鲁棒性，在异质采样率生物声学分类任务上取得优于固定采样率基线的性能。

title: Learning as Deepfakes Evolve: RF-Prompt for Continual Audio Deepfake Detection
summary: Continual audio deepfake detection requires learning newly emerging deepfake methods while retaining discrimination of previously encountered speech. Existing dataset-incremental evaluation changes both real-speech domains and deepfake mechanisms, making their effects difficult to distinguish. We construct five task organizations over identical training, development, and evaluation pools to study these factors under a controlled sample budget. Our proposed Real-Anchored Mechanism-Incremental (RAMI) protocol reflects the practical setting in which available real speech provides a recurring mixed-domain reference while new deepfake mechanisms arrive incrementally. We further propose RF-Prompt, an asymmetric continual prompt-learning method that preserves reusable real-speech knowledge through a shared real prompt and expands mechanism-specific knowledge through inherited fake experts with orthogonal residuals. Input-adaptive soft fusion combines the accumulated experts into a fixed number of injected tokens without requiring task identity at inference. On RAMI, RF-Prompt achieves 10.110% average EER and 10.370% pooled EER, outperforming all evaluated continual-learning baselines. Across the five controlled protocols, RAMI yields the lowest common-average and pooled EER. Component ablations, limited-data experiments, and cross-backbone evaluations further validate the proposed design.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究持续音频深度伪造检测，提出可控的五种任务组织与RAMI协议，并设计RF-Prompt非对称持续提示学习方法，在RAMI上取得10.110%平均EER与10.370%池化EER，优于所有对比基线。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集增量评估同时改变真实语音域与深度伪造机制，难以区分二者对持续学习的影响；同时实际场景中真实语音是反复出现且跨域的参考，而伪造机制才逐步新增。
AI.method: 构建五个在相同训练、开发与评估池上的任务组织以在受控样本预算下分离因素；提出Real-Anchored Mechanism-Incremental（RAMI）协议；提出RF-Prompt非对称持续提示学习，用共享真实提示保留可复用真实语音知识，用继承式伪造专家加正交残差扩展机制知识，并通过输入自适应软融合将累积专家合并为固定数量注入token，推理时无需任务身份。
AI.result: 在RAMI上RF-Prompt达到10.110%平均EER和10.370%池化EER，优于所有评估的持续学习基线；在五种受控协议中RAMI取得最低的common-average与池化EER；组件消融、有限数据实验和跨骨干评估进一步验证了设计有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过RAMI协议与RF-Prompt方法，实现了对真实语音知识保留与新增伪造机制学习之间的有效平衡，并在受控协议下验证了其优越性与鲁棒性。

title: AS$^2$D: Accelerating On-Demand Audio Understanding on Mobile Devices
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by using a smaller drafter to propose tokens for batched verification by a larger target. However, conventional speculative decoding couples drafting to the target's evolving verified prefix, serializing drafting and verification. We ask whether this dependency is necessary for source-conditioned generation. Our key observation is that, for audio language models, the input audio and user request can provide useful speculative candidates without following the target's evolving text prefix. We propose AS$^2$D (Audio Speculative Speculative Decoding), which enables target-decoupled drafting: an audio-conditioned drafter follows its own generation history while the target independently verifies and corrects ready candidates. Without usable candidates, the target advances alone. Thus, target feedback determines which candidates are committed but no longer determines when the drafter can make progress, enabling drafting and verification to proceed concurrently while retaining target-side verification and correction. We implement AS$^2$D in MNN for Android and evaluate two target models across four phones, seven datasets, and three tasks covering 12.2 hours of audio. Across four phones, AS$^2$D improves pooled ASR throughput by 42-76% over target-only decoding, while only 5.7% of evaluation windows are slower than target-only, compared with 58.1-63.0% for speculative baselines. For ASR, AS$^2$D reaches 97.33-98.20% of a hindsight per-window oracle's pooled throughput over the evaluated drafter/budget catalog. Native on-demand execution with a 7B target achieves up to 78% higher throughput than target-only. These results show that source-conditioned audio generation can relax the conventional dependence of speculative drafting on the target's evolving output prefix, exposing substantial parallelism for efficient inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AS²D（Audio Speculative Speculative Decoding），实现与目标模型解耦的草稿生成：由音频条件驱动的草稿器沿自身生成历史独立推进，目标模型独立验证并修正就绪候选，从而使草稿与验证并发进行，同时保留目标侧验证与纠错。
AI.motivation: 传统投机解码将草稿生成耦合到目标模型不断演进的已验证前缀上，导致草稿与验证串行化执行。作者质疑这种依赖对源条件生成是否必要，并观察到在音频语言模型中，输入音频与用户请求本身就能提供有价值的投机候选，无需跟随目标模型演进的文本前缀。
AI.method: 提出 AS²D：采用音频条件草稿器（audio-conditioned drafter），沿自身生成历史推进；目标模型独立地验证并修正已就绪的候选。当无可用候选时，目标模型单独前进。目标反馈仅决定候选是否被提交，而不再决定草稿器何时能推进，从而在保留目标侧验证与修正的前提下实现草稿与验证的并发。在 MNN 上针对 Android 实现，评估 2 个目标模型、4 部手机、7 个数据集、3 类任务，覆盖 12.2 小时音频。
AI.result: 在四部手机上，AS²D 的池化 ASR 吞吐量相比仅目标解码提升 42–76%；仅 5.7% 的评估窗口慢于仅目标解码，而投机基线为 58.1–63.0%。在 ASR 任务上，AS²D 在评估的草稿器/预算组合范围内达到事后逐窗口 oracle 池化吞吐量的 97.33–98.20%。使用 7B 目标模型进行原生按需执行时，吞吐量最高比仅目标解码提升 78%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，源条件音频生成可以放松投机草稿对目标模型演进输出前缀的传统依赖，从而为高效推理暴露可观的并行性。

title: Do Music Generative Models Understand Musical Qualities? Automatic Music Evaluation with Model-Intrinsic Signals
comment: Accepted by the 27th International Society for Music Information Retrieval Conference (ISMIR 2026)
summary: Current music generative models can produce high-quality music, but does this ability imply that they ``understand'' the musical qualities of their outputs, and is that understanding aligned with human evaluation? Previous attempts to use the likelihood of a generative model to evaluate music, an approach commonly used in text, have proven unsuccessful, leading researchers to rely on standalone supervised music evaluation models. In this paper, we answer this question affirmatively: we show that a model's intrinsic signals---derived from its hidden representations and predictions---are strongly correlated with human ratings. In particular, we study MusicGen and consider three types of features: (1) prediction loss, (2) prediction entropy, and (3) concepts extracted from the model using a sparse autoencoder (SAE). Using these features, we train a lightweight prediction model to estimate subjective ratings. We evaluate these features both individually and in combination. We hypothesize that these signals parallel the listening process: the temporal and frequency-domain structure of loss and entropy reflects listeners' expectation and surprise, while gradient directions in SAE latent space predict perceived quality. Experiments on five human-evaluation benchmarks spanning continuous ratings and pairwise preferences confirm this hypothesis, with SAE latents carrying most of the predictive signal.

AI.tldr: 本文证明音乐生成模型MusicGen的内在信号（预测损失、预测熵、SAE提取概念）与人类主观评分高度相关，可用轻量模型预测音乐质量评价。
AI.motivation: 此前用生成模型似然评估音乐效果不佳，研究者多依赖独立的监督式音乐评估模型。作者欲探究生成模型能否"理解"其输出音乐质量，且这种理解是否与人类评价一致。
AI.method: 以MusicGen为对象，提取三类特征：(1)预测损失、(2)预测熵、(3)通过稀疏自编码器（SAE）从模型提取的概念。用这些特征训练轻量预测模型估计主观评分，并分别及组合评估。假设这些信号对应聆听过程：损失与熵的时频结构反映听者预期与惊讶，SAE潜空间梯度方向预测感知质量。
AI.result: 在五个涵盖连续评分与成对偏好的人类评价基准上，实验证实该假设，其中SAE潜变量承载了大部分预测信号，模型的固有信号与人类评分强相关。
AI.conclusion: 生成模型的内在信号可作为有效音乐质量评估依据，与人类评价对齐，SAE提取的概念最为关键，支持模型对音乐质量具有一定"理解"能力的观点。

title: 2-Dimensional spectral gating for denoising bioacoustics recordings
summary: Isolating vocalizations from noise in bioacoustics recordings is a prerequisite to many ecological analyses, including species identification, animal communication understanding, and individual or population-level variability studies. However, when recordings are acquired in open environments, vocalizations, noise, or signal-to-noise ratio can vary widely across individuals, species, environment, and recording conditions, making it hard to develop robust and generalizable methods for ecological analyses. To account for these challenges, noise reduction techniques are used to remove noise before downstream analyses. Popular methods such as Noisereduce rely on spectral gating, which estimates a noise threshold for each frequency channel. We propose a further improvement to Noisereduce, leveraging the fact that most animal sounds have structure across multiple frequencies. We apply our method on bird and marine mammals recordings and show that our extension of Noisereduce leads to improved denoising in both above and under water acoustic recordings, without impacting speed of preprocessing.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出对Noisereduce谱门限降噪方法的改进，利用动物发声在多个频率上的结构特征，在鸟类和海洋哺乳动物录音上实现更优降噪且不增加预处理耗时。
AI.motivation: 生物声学录音多在开放环境中采集，发声、噪声及信噪比在个体、物种、环境和录音条件间差异极大，导致下游生态分析（物种识别、动物交流研究、个体或种群变异性研究）难以建立稳健且可泛化的方法，因此需在下游分析前进行降噪。
AI.method: 在流行方法Noisereduce（基于谱门限，为每个频率通道估计噪声阈值）基础上进行改进，利用多数动物声音在多个频率上具有结构这一事实，跨频率地联合估计与施加降噪。
AI.result: 在鸟类和海洋哺乳动物录音上进行实验，改进后的Noisereduce在水上和水下声学录音中均取得更好的降噪效果，且未影响预处理速度。
AI.conclusion: 跨频率结构信息可有效增强谱门限降噪，该扩展兼具通用性与效率，适用于开放环境下的生物声学录音预处理。

title: Pruning for Efficiency, Paying in Fairness: Demographic Disparities in Pruned Speech-LLMs
summary: Speech-LLMs are expensive to run, making compression important for real-world deployment. However, compressed models are usually selected using aggregate word error rate (WER), which can hide how pruning affects different demographic groups. In this work, we systematically study the effect of audio encoder pruning on SLAM-ASR for different demographic groups. Using the Fair-Speech and Common Voice datasets, we found that the pruning does not affect all demographic groups equally; the gap between best- and worst-performing groups increases in fold. These disparities appear across all three encoder scales, but only the largest model initially hides them behind aggregate WER. LoRA adaptation improves WER for every group, but benefits groups already performing well more strongly and widens for certain groups. On Common Voice English, Danish, and Dutch, accent gaps persist but do not clearly widen, showing that the fairness effects of pruning vary across datasets and must be measured directly. Our findings suggest that for pruned models, deployment decisions should include per-group WER, with the worst-performing group's error rate as an explicit criterion.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了音频编码器剪枝对SLAM-ASR在不同人口统计群体上的公平性影响，发现剪枝会加剧群体间WER差距，且聚合WER会掩盖这一问题，建议部署时纳入分群体WER指标。
AI.motivation: 语音大模型运行成本高，压缩对实际部署至关重要，但通常仅用聚合词错误率（WER）来选择压缩模型，这可能掩盖剪枝对不同人口统计群体造成的差异化影响，从而带来公平性隐患。
AI.method: 在SLAM-ASR上系统研究音频编码器剪枝对不同人口统计群体的影响，使用Fair-Speech和Common Voice数据集，覆盖三种编码器规模，并评估LoRA适配的效果，同时考察英语、丹麦语、荷兰语的口音差异。
AI.result: 剪枝对各群体影响不均，最佳与最差群体间的差距随剪枝而扩大；三种编码器规模均存在该差异，但仅最大模型最初会因聚合WER而掩盖它；LoRA适配提升了所有群体的WER，但对表现已较好的群体增益更强，并使某些群体差距扩大；在Common Voice英语、丹麦语、荷兰语上，口音差距持续存在但未明显扩大，说明公平性效应因数据集而异。
AI.conclusion: 剪枝模型的公平性影响必须直接测量，部署决策应包含分群体WER，并以最差表现群体的错误率作为明确标准。

title: EmoRES-TTS: Residual-Enhanced Vector Steering for Emotional Speech Generation
comment: Work done at Meta. Code at https://github.com/facebookresearch/EmoRES-TTS
summary: Emotion-conditioned text-to-speech (TTS) models may fail to express the requested emotion reliably, and improving controllability by additional training is costly in both computation and emotion-labeled speech training data. We therefore study vector steering, a training-free approach that modifies the internal representations of a frozen model. CoCoEmo, a conventional vector steering method for emotion TTS, treats each emotion vector as an indivisible direction controlled by a single global strength, limiting adherence to the requested emotion. In this work, we first discover that an emotion vector can be decomposed into a shared component that moves speech away from neutral expression and a residual component that directs generation toward the requested emotion. Building on this finding, we propose Emotion Residual-Enhanced Steering for TTS (EmoRES), a novel method that controls the two components without retraining the backbone. On IEMOCAP, EmoRES outperforms CoCoEmo across all four objective emotion metrics on the IndexTTS-2 and CosyVoice2 backbones. Rank correlation improves by 26.13 and 12.97 percentage points, corresponding to relative gains of 118.8% and 33.1%, while emotion hit rate improves by 12.95 and 6.92 points, corresponding to relative gains of 20.1% and 9.8%. Human evaluation further shows a relative improvement up to 35.0% in the rate at which listeners correctly identified the dominant requested emotion and up to a 17.3% improvement in fidelity, while listeners prefer EmoRES for naturalness in up to 63.8% of pairwise comparisons. Component ablations further demonstrate that effective control benefits from preserving the shared component while strengthening the residual of the emotion steering vectors.

AI.tldr: EmoRES：一种免训练的情感TTS向量引导方法，将情感向量分解为共享分量与残差分量并分别控制，在IEMOCAP上全面优于CoCoEmo。
AI.motivation: 情感条件TTS模型难以稳定表达指定情感，而通过额外训练提升可控性在算力与情感标注语音数据上代价高昂，因此需要免训练的表示层干预方案。既有向量引导方法CoCoEmo将每个情感向量视为不可分割的整体方向、仅用单一全局强度控制，限制了对目标情感的贴合度。
AI.method: 采用免训练的向量引导（vector steering），在冻结的TTS骨干内部修改表示。首先发现情感向量可分解为两部分：将语音推离中性表达的共享分量，以及将生成导向目标情感的残差分量。基于此提出EmoRES，对这两个分量分别施加控制，且不重新训练骨干模型。
AI.result: 在IEMOCAP上，EmoRES在IndexTTS-2与CosyVoice2两个骨干上于全部四项客观情感指标上均优于CoCoEmo。排序相关性分别提升26.13与12.97个百分点（相对提升118.8%与33.1%）；情感命中率分别提升12.95与6.92个百分点（相对提升20.1%与9.8%）。人工评测显示，听者正确识别主导目标情感的比率相对提升最高达35.0%，保真度相对提升最高达17.3%，且在最多63.8%的成对比较中听者更偏好EmoRES的自然度。分量消融表明，保留共享分量同时增强情感引导向量的残差，能带来更有效的控制。
AI.conclusion: 情感向量的共享—残差分解是有效的免训练引导依据；分别控制共享分量与残差分量可在不重训练骨干的前提下显著提升情感TTS的情感可控性与自然度。

title: $τ$-Multilingual: Benchmarking Voice Agents Across Languages
summary: English-only benchmarks expose only a narrow slice of voice-agent behavior. We introduce $τ$-Multilingual, extending $τ$-Voice to Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Hindi, Korean, and Mandarin with native-speaker review and evaluation of generated language and spoken output. Across 4,500 full-duplex calls and five voice configurations, Spanish, Portuguese, and Hindi remain within 3.2 task-completion points of English, but Korean and Mandarin fall by 14.7 and 8.4 points. The failure modes also vary: Korean systems miss more responses, Mandarin systems interrupt more often, and both struggle with tools and entities. Grok leads task completion but scores lowest on generation quality, motivating separate task, interaction, and generation reporting. We release language packs, validated judges, and tools for community-built multilingual voice-agent evaluation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 τ-Multilingual，将 τ-Voice 语音代理基准扩展到西班牙语、巴西葡萄牙语、印地语、韩语和中文，通过母语者审核评估生成语言与语音输出，揭示英语基准之外的跨语言行为差异及失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有语音代理评测基准以英语为主，仅覆盖狭窄的行为切片，无法反映多语言场景下的真实表现，因此需要构建多语言语音代理评测基准。
AI.method: 在 τ-Voice 基础上扩展至西班牙语、巴西葡萄牙语、印地语、韩语和普通话，并由母语者进行审核，对生成语言与语音输出进行评估；共开展 4,500 次全双工通话测试，覆盖五种语音配置。
AI.result: 西班牙语、葡萄牙语和印地语的任务完成率与英语差距在 3.2 个百分点以内，而韩语和普通话分别下降 14.7 和 8.4 个百分点。失败模式存在差异：韩语系统漏答更多，普通话系统打断更频繁，二者均在工具与实体处理上表现不佳。Grok 任务完成度领先，但生成质量得分最低。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言语音代理表现差异显著且失败模式各异，因此有必要将任务、交互与生成质量分开报告；作者发布语言包、经验证的评判器及工具，以推动社区构建多语言语音代理评测。

title: Almost Human, Except When It Matters: VoxParity and the Decisions a Voice Should Change
comment: 38 pages, 11 figures, 15 tables. Code, scorer and development-split data at https://github.com/bhavik-mangla/voxparity-bench and https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23008159
summary: A voice agent can handle almost every call on the words alone and still fail the few its sector's rules were written for. Emergency-call standards, fraud guidance, radio phraseology and vulnerability rules recognise that how a caller sounds, or what else is audible, can change the right action. VoxParity tests whether agents act on it. In 183 scenarios from 14 sectors, one transcript stays fixed while the audio changes (a coaching voice, a medical monitor beeping, a mayday under a radio check, noise over a drug name, a child's voice placing a bet, a frightened whisper), and with it the correct typed tool call. A words-only null test credits a system only if hearing the call moves its actions more than it moves a pipeline that only reads the words. Only 11 of the 23 systems that can also be run on the transcript pass. Descriptively, errors run toward the words: when the audio calls for protection, all 28 systems carry out the routine request more often than they over-react on clean calls (41% against 12% pooled; the words-only pipeline, 58% against 15%). Exploratory analyses place most of the leading systems' misses on cues they heard; systems beat the null almost entirely on items that state the rule; the leading systems overrule heard resignation or confusion far more often than acute alarm; and, in the models tested, describing the voice and stating the rule each recover part of the shortfall, leaving a gap on emotion.

AI.tldr: VoxParity基准通过"文本不变、音频改变"的配对设计，检验语音智能体是否真正依据副语言与声音线索改变行动，而不仅仅是处理文字。23个系统中仅11个通过文字单模态零假设检验。
AI.motivation: 现有语音智能体评测多聚焦于文字内容，但应急呼叫标准、反欺诈指引、无线电通话规程与弱势群体保护规则均承认：呼叫者的声音特征及背景可听信息会影响正确处置方式。论文旨在检验智能体是否真的"听"进这些线索并据此行动，而非仅凭转写文本作决策。
AI.method: 构建VoxParity基准：覆盖14个行业、183个场景。每个场景固定同一份转写文本，仅改变音频（如教练口吻、医疗监护仪蜂鸣、无线电检查中的求救信号、药品名称上的噪声、儿童下注的声音、惊恐低语），并相应改变正确的结构化工具调用。设计"纯文字零假设"对照：只有当听觉信息推动系统行动的改变显著大于纯文字流水线的改变时，系统才算通过。共23个可同时在转写文本上运行的系统参与测试。
AI.result: 23个系统中仅11个通过零假设检验。错误呈"向文字倾斜"态势：当音频要求保护性处置时，28个系统执行常规请求的比例（41%）明显高于在干净呼叫中过度反应的比例（12%）；纯文字流水线为58%对15%。探索性分析显示：多数领先系统的失误集中在其确实听到的线索上；系统几乎只在明确陈述规则的条目上胜过零假设；对听出的无奈或困惑的推翻频率远高于对急性警报的推翻；在受测模型中，描述声音与陈述规则各能弥补部分缺口，但在情绪维度上仍留有余量。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠文字训练与评测不足以保障语音智能体在规则敏感场景下的正确行为；系统普遍存在"听到却未依此行动"的缺陷，且对情绪类线索的利用最薄弱。描述声音特征与显式陈述规则可作为部分缓解手段，但情绪理解缺口仍待解决。

title: MultiTalk: Scaling Full-Duplex Speech Models to Long, Multi-Party, Bilingual Conversation
summary: End-to-end full-duplex speech models have brought open-source machine conversation closer to human-like interaction, yet existing systems remain limited in two intertwined dimensions: long-context robustness and multi-party interaction. Real-world scenarios such as meetings, group lessons, and social-robot reception require a single model to track, contextualize, and respond to multiple speakers over extended durations. Progress is constrained by both data and evaluation: open multi-party speech corpora remain small and are not designed for codec-frame-level full-duplex modeling, while existing long-audio benchmarks focus on passive listening and speech-to-speech benchmarks are mostly short and dyadic. We extend the Moshi paradigm jointly along the long-horizon and multi-party axes in English and Chinese. First, we release 57.6k hours of synthetic training data ($\href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/MultiTalk/MultiTalkPT}{MultiTalkPT}$ and $\href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/MultiTalk/MultiTalkFT}{MultiTalkFT}$) for long-form, multi-party, English-Chinese full-duplex dialogue, with controllable length, participant count, turn-taking, overlap, backchannels, interruptions, addressee shifts, and long-range coreference. Second, we introduce $\href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/MultiTalk/MultiTalkBench}{MultiTalkBench}$, built from real human recordings, for evaluating long-form, multi-party, bilingual full-duplex dialogue. Conversations average 32.6 minutes and include probes for long-range entity tracking, topic coherence, and addressee selection. Third, we train a bilingual Moshi-style model that sustains coherent multi-party English-Chinese conversations over extended durations and substantially outperforms open-source baselines including Moshi, MiniCPM-o-4.5, and Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct on MultiTalkBench.

AI.tldr: 本文沿"长时程"与"多方交互"两个维度扩展Moshi范式，发布中英双语长时多方全双工对话数据MultiTalkPT/MultiTalkFT（5.76万小时）、真实录音构建的评测集MultiTalkBench（平均32.6分钟），并训练出可持续长时程中英多方对话、显著超越Moshi、MiniCPM-o-4.5、Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct等开源基线的双语模型。
AI.motivation: 端到端全双工语音模型虽推动机器对话接近拟人交互，但现有系统在长上下文鲁棒性与多方交互两个相互交织的维度上仍受限。会议、小组课堂、社交机器人前台等真实场景要求单一模型在长时程内跟踪、语境化并回应多位说话人。进展受数据与评测双重制约：开源多方语音语料规模小，且未面向codec帧级全双工建模设计；现有长音频基准侧重被动聆听，语音到语音基准多为短时双人对话。
AI.method: 沿长时程与多方两个轴联合扩展Moshi范式，覆盖中英双语：(1) 构建并开源5.76万小时合成训练数据MultiTalkPT与MultiTalkFT，用于长时程、多方、中英全双工对话，可控长度、参与人数、轮次转换、重叠、反馈语、打断、受话人切换与长距离共指；(2) 基于真实人类录音构建MultiTalkBench，评测长时程、多方、双语全双工对话，平均对话时长32.6分钟，含长距离实体跟踪、话题连贯性与受话人选择探针；(3) 训练双语Moshi风格模型。
AI.result: 所训双语Moshi风格模型可在长时程内维持连贯的中英多方对话，在MultiTalkBench上显著优于开源基线，包括Moshi、MiniCPM-o-4.5与Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct。
AI.conclusion: 通过长时程与多方两个维度的联合扩展，配合大规模可控合成训练数据与真实录音评测基准，可在中英双语场景下实现长时程多方全双工对话，验证了数据—评测—模型协同推进路径的有效性。

title: Repetition, Not Length: Isolating the Counting Failure in Neural Text-to-Speech
comment: Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027. Code and data: https://github.com/lab260ru/tts-counting-failure
summary: Text-to-speech models loop, truncate and lose count on text that repeats a phrase many times. We show that repetition itself is what breaks them, not the length that comes with it. Every repeated sentence in our test set is paired with a control of matched sentence and word count in which no word ever repeats back-to-back. Six models from three architectures render the controls almost perfectly and fail the repeated twins: 94.3% against 18.2% exactly right at k >= 6. The gap survives greedy decoding, repetition-penalty sweeps, four independent speech recognisers and 420 analysis specifications without once reversing sign; a held-out fourth architecture lands within a point of its predicted gap, and one of two non-autoregressive baselines shows the same failure. Varying the period of the text shows the failure grows smoothly with periodicity, half of it surviving when no word is adjacent to itself.

AI.tldr: 文本重复（而非长度）导致TTS模型在重复短语处循环、截断与计数错误。
AI.motivation: 探究TTS模型在重复文本上失效的根因：是重复本身，还是随之而来的长度。
AI.method: 将每个重复句子与句式/词数匹配但无相邻词重复的对照配对；测试三种架构的六个模型，配合贪心解码、重复惩罚扫描、四个独立语音识别器、420种分析设定；引入留出的第四种架构与两个非自回归基线；改变文本周期。
AI.result: k≥6时完全正确率为94.3%对18.2%；差距在所有设定下符号不反转；留出架构落在预测差距一个百分点内；两个非自回归基线之一出现同样失败；失败随周期性平滑增长，无相邻词重复时仍存一半。
AI.conclusion: 重复本身是失效主因而非长度，为TTS重复失败提供了可控、可复现的诊断基准。

title: Wasserstein Causal Forests for Distribution-Valued Outcomes
summary: This paper proposes Wasserstein Causal Forests (WCF) for settings in which each unit's outcome is itself a probability distribution. This study also defines finite-grid transformed average and conditional average treatment effects, including a reference-distance contrast that asks whether treatment moves unit-level distributions toward a prespecified benchmark. Simulations cover null effects, location and shape changes, limited overlap, equal-mean but different laws, heterogeneous effects, multimodality, and structural zeros. WCF is most accurate on the conditional-law metric in most reported designs and sharply improves reference-effect estimation in the principal location-and-shape settings, but it is less accurate than the forest baselines for multimodal settings. WCF is applied to the famous Project STAR \citep{word1990state}, revealing that small classes alter more than the mean: they raise within-grade mathematics achievement by $0.161$ standard deviations on average (SE $0.028$); but the gain is not a uniform location shift, it is larger in the upper part of the classroom score distribution ($+0.179$ at the ninetieth percentile versus $+0.091$ at the tenth) and, in descriptive stratum estimates, largest in the schools serving the most economically disadvantaged students (highest free-lunch quartile, $+0.262$, versus $+0.092$ to $+0.164$ elsewhere), while overall dispersion is essentially unchanged.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Wasserstein 因果森林（WCF），用于处理"每个个体的结果本身是一个概率分布"的因果推断场景，并定义了有限网格变换下的平均与条件平均处理效应。
AI.motivation: 传统因果森林与处理效应估计方法假设结果变量为标量，无法刻画处理对个体层面整条分布（位置、形状、多峰性、离散质量点）的影响，也缺乏衡量"处理是否使个体分布向某一基准靠拢"的度量。
AI.method: 提出 Wasserstein 因果森林（WCF），基于 Wasserstein 距离处理分布型结果；定义有限网格变换的平均处理效应与条件平均处理效应，并引入参考距离对比量，用于判断处理是否把个体分布推向预设基准；通过模拟覆盖零效应、位置与形状变动、重叠不足、均值相同但分布不同、异质性效应、多峰与结构性零点等设计进行验证。
AI.result: 在多数模拟设计中，WCF 在条件律度量的精度最高；在主要的位置—形状设定下显著改善参考效应估计；但在多峰设定下精度不及森林类基线方法。应用于 Project STAR 发现：小班使同年级数学成绩平均提高 0.161 个标准差（SE 0.028），且并非均匀位置平移，第 90 百分位增幅（+0.179）大于第 10 百分位（+0.091）；描述性分层估计显示，在经济最弱势学生占比最高的学校（免费午餐最高四分位）增幅最大（+0.262，其余为 +0.092 至 +0.164），总体离散度基本不变。
AI.conclusion: WCF 为分布型结果的异质性因果效应提供了可行工具，能揭示均值之外的处理效应结构；其在位置—形状类设定与参考效应估计上表现突出，但多峰场景下仍弱于森林基线，且 Project STAR 的应用结果属描述性，需谨慎解读因果外推。

title: LOCO-AdaMP: Built-in LOCO Inference for Adaptive Minipatch Ensembles with Enhanced Prediction
summary: As black-box machine learning models become increasingly common, extracting interpretations with uncertainty quantification has become a critical challenge. One popular type of interpretation is leave-one-covariate-out (LOCO) feature importance, while prior LOCO inference methods often require data-splitting or model-refitting. A recent ensemble framework, LOCO-MP, addresses these challenges using minipatches that subsample both observations and features, but massive feature subsampling can hurt prediction in high-dimensional sparse settings. Motivated by this limitation, we consider minipatch ensembles with adaptive feature sampling guided by LOCO importance, and propose LOCO-AdaMP, which enables free LOCO inference for the resulting adaptive minipatch ensemble. We show that LOCO-AdaMP yields substantially improved predictive models while retaining asymptotically valid feature importance inference without data-splitting, despite the complex dependence between the adaptive sampling distribution and the LOCO importance statistics. Our analysis relies on a careful leave-two-out perturbation bound for the iteratively updated sampling probabilities together with the stability of LOCO scores induced by observation subsampling. Empirical results on synthetic and real datasets demonstrate advantages of LOCO-AdaMP over existing methods in predictive performance, inferential power, and stability. Overall, LOCO-AdaMP provides a flexible ensemble framework (agnostic to base models) that delivers both strong predictive performance and asymptotically valid, powerful feature importance inference for regression.

AI.tldr: 提出LOCO-AdaMP，一种以LOCO重要性引导自适应特征抽样的minipatch集成框架，可在不分拆数据、不重拟合的情况下实现渐近有效的LOCO特征重要性推断，同时显著提升预测性能。
AI.motivation: 黑箱模型日益普及，需要带不确定性量化的解释方法。LOCO特征重要性是常用手段，但既有LOCO推断方法多依赖数据分拆或模型重拟合，代价高。已有的集成框架LOCO-MP通过同时对观测与特征二次抽样（minipatch）规避了这些问题，但在高维稀疏场景下，大规模特征二次抽样会损害预测性能。因此需要一种既能保持无分拆有效推断、又能改善预测的自适应抽样方案。
AI.method: 提出LOCO-AdaMP：在minipatch集成中引入由LOCO重要性引导的自适应特征抽样，使抽样分布随迭代更新的LOCO重要性统计量动态调整，并为该自适应集成提供"免费"的LOCO推断。理论分析上，针对迭代更新的抽样概率建立精细的leave-two-out扰动界，并结合观测二次抽样所诱导的LOCO得分稳定性，证明自适应抽样分布与LOCO统计量之间复杂依赖下推断仍渐近有效。框架与基模型无关（model-agnostic）。
AI.result: 在合成与真实数据集上，LOCO-AdaMP在预测性能、推断功效与稳定性方面均优于现有方法，同时得到显著改进的预测模型，并保持无需数据分拆的渐近有效特征重要性推断。
AI.conclusion: LOCO-AdaMP提供了一个灵活的集成框架，对回归任务兼具强预测性能与渐近有效、高功效的特征重要性推断，解决了自适应抽样与推断有效性之间的张力。

title: Hierarchical Utility Calibration for Structured Multiclass Decisions
summary: In multiclass probabilistic prediction, Utility Calibration (UC), which focuses auditing on specified utilities, has recently received attention as a way to guarantee downstream decisions while controlling computational and sample requirements. At the same time, some multiclass problems have meaningful label hierarchies that play important roles in medicine and image classification, yet how UC evaluates utility within a hierarchy remains insufficiently understood. We show that the difference between realized utility and predicted mean utility admits an exact decomposition into a sum of contributions from the internal nodes of the label tree. This decomposition shows that positive and negative contributions from different nodes can cancel, and that even when UC is small, the utility errors remaining in parts of the hierarchy need not be small. To address this problem, we propose Hierarchical Utility Calibration (HUC), which evaluates each node contribution before summation while retaining the same target utility, subgroup, and predicted-utility interval. We further provide finite-sample evaluation over all predicted-utility intervals and propose HUC-Boost, which updates only violated internal nodes, with theoretical guarantees for both.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究多分类概率预测中层级标签下的效用校准问题，证明实现效用与预测平均效用之差可精确分解为标签树内部节点贡献之和，揭示节点间正负贡献可相互抵消导致局部效用误差被掩盖，并提出Hierarchical Utility Calibration (HUC)在求和前逐节点评估贡献，同时给出全体预测效用区间的有限样本评估及仅更新违规内部节点的HUC-Boost，二者均有理论保证。
AI.motivation: 多分类概率预测中，Utility Calibration (UC) 通过在指定效用上审计，兼顾下游决策保证与计算、样本需求控制。但许多多分类问题具有有意义的标签层级，在医学与图像分类中起重要作用；UC如何在层级结构内评估效用尚不清晰。作者发现实现效用与预测平均效用之差可分解到标签树内部节点，且不同节点的正负贡献会抵消，导致即便整体UC很小，层级中部分区域的效用误差仍可能不小，因此需要新的校准方法。
AI.method: 首先给出实现效用与预测平均效用之差的精确分解：将其表示为标签树内部节点贡献之和。基于此提出Hierarchical Utility Calibration (HUC)，在求和前逐一评估每个节点的贡献，同时保留与UC相同的目标效用、子群及预测效用区间。进一步提供覆盖所有预测效用区间的有限样本评估，并提出HUC-Boost，仅更新被违反的内部节点。
AI.result: 理论分析表明，实现效用与预测平均效用的差可精确分解为内部节点贡献之和，且节点间正负贡献可抵消，因此UC较小并不意味着层级各部分的效用误差都小。HUC通过逐节点评估避免了这种掩盖效应，并给出所有预测效用区间上的有限样本评估保证；HUC-Boost仅更新违规内部节点，并附有理论保证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了UC在层级标签情形下可能掩盖局部效用误差的问题，提出HUC与HUC-Boost，在保持相同校准目标和预测效用区间的前提下实现逐节点评估与高效更新，并对有限样本评估和更新算法给出理论保证。

title: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Is Hard to Beat, Yet Superlinear Drift Ships Lower Transport Costs
summary: Brešar and Mijatović \cite{bresar2025} show that Ornstein--Uhlenbeck diffusion is hard to beat in forward convergence under assumptions that exclude superlinear drift. We instead test superlinear Langevin diffusions for score-based image generation, computing their conditional scores numerically from a Fokker--Planck equation. In our experiments, the superlinear models beat the Ornstein--Uhlenbeck baseline on empirical Wasserstein distance across nearly the entire tested grid and show less variation across diffusion horizons. The ``hard to beat'' verdict of \cite{bresar2025} thus fails to be universal.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了Brešar与Mijatović关于Ornstein–Uhlenbeck扩散在前向收敛中"难以超越"的结论，通过测试超线性Langevin扩散在基于分数的图像生成中的表现，发现超线性模型在经验Wasserstein距离上几乎全面优于OU基线。
AI.motivation: Brešar和Mijatović（2025）在排除超线性漂移的假设下证明了Ornstein–Uhlenbeck扩散在前向收敛方面难以被超越。作者希望检验这一结论是否具有普遍性，特别是在允许超线性漂移的情形下。
AI.method: 作者对基于分数的图像生成任务测试了超线性Langevin扩散，并通过Fokker–Planck方程数值计算其条件分数（conditional scores）。
AI.result: 在实验中，超线性模型在几乎整个测试网格上均在经验Wasserstein距离上超越了Ornstein–Uhlenbeck基线，并且在不同的扩散时程（diffusion horizons）上表现出更小的波动。
AI.conclusion: Brešar与Mijatović的"难以超越"论断并非普遍成立，超线性扩散在实践中有可能优于OU扩散。

title: A Finslerian Approach for Embedding Directed Data
summary: Many datasets carry an intrinsic directionality: citations point backward in time, cells differentiate along lineages, and traffic follows preferred routes. Spectral embedding methods, including most of their extensions to directed graphs, discard this information: they symmetrize the data and map it into a Euclidean space where asymmetry cannot be represented. We instead model directed data as sampled from a Finsler manifold, whose distance depends on the direction of travel, and study the kernel operator built from this asymmetric distance. Through a moment expansion of this operator, we show that its symmetric and antisymmetric parts separate geometry from direction. As the bandwidth of the kernel vanishes, the symmetric part converges to a weighted Laplacian, recovering diffusion maps in the Riemannian case, while the antisymmetric part converges to a first-order transport operator that encodes the directionality. We prove that the corresponding graph operators, built from finitely many samples, converge uniformly and almost surely to these limits. For Randers metrics, this vector field is explicit and yields an embedding algorithm recovering both the manifold structure, from the spectrum of the symmetric part, and the underlying drift. We illustrate the approach on synthetic directed graphs and point-clouds.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用Finsler流形建模有向数据，通过核算子的矩展开将对称部分（几何）与反对称部分（方向）分离，并证明有限样本图算子几乎必然一致收敛到加权拉普拉斯与一阶输运算子，进而给出恢复流形结构与漂移的嵌入算法。
AI.motivation: 许多数据集天然具有方向性（引用指向过去、细胞沿谱系分化、交通遵循优选路径），但谱嵌入方法（包括多数有向图扩展）会丢弃方向信息：它们将数据对称化并映射到欧氏空间，无法表示非对称性。
AI.method: 将方向性数据建模为来自Finsler流形的采样，其距离依赖行进方向；构造基于该非对称距离的核算子，并通过核算子的矩展开分析其对称与反对称部分。对称部分在带宽趋于零时收敛到加权拉普拉斯（Riemann情形下即扩散映射），反对称部分收敛到编码方向性的一阶输运算子。对Randers度量，该向量场可显式给出，从而得到同时恢复流形结构与漂移的嵌入算法。
AI.result: 证明由有限样本构造的图算子几乎必然一致收敛到上述极限；对Randers度量，显式得到方向向量场，嵌入算法能从对称部分谱恢复流形结构、并恢复底层漂移；在合成有向图和点云上验证了方法。
AI.conclusion: Finsler流形视角为方向性数据提供了统一的谱嵌入框架，将几何与方向解耦，并具有收敛性保证；但摘要未给出具体定量误差界与更广泛真实数据集上的评估。

title: Post-Anomaly Detection Inference for Deep SVDD
summary: Deep Support Vector Data Description (Deep SVDD) has become a prominent framework for unsupervised anomaly detection by learning latent representations that compactly characterize normal data around a center. Despite its empirical success, anomaly decisions produced by Deep SVDD are typically made solely based on anomaly scores without rigorous statistical guarantees, thereby limiting their reliability in safety-critical and high-stakes applications where false positives must be strictly controlled. In this paper, we propose PADI (Post-Anomaly Detection Inference), a novel framework that equips a trained and frozen Deep SVDD detector with statistically valid inference by leveraging the Selective Inference framework. Specifically, PADI performs inference conditional on the event that a test instance is identified as anomalous by Deep SVDD, thereby enabling rigorous statistical assessment of anomaly decisions. Based on this formulation, we derive valid selective p-values that quantify the statistical significance of the detected anomaly. Using these p-values, we theoretically establish control of the false positive rate (FPR) at a user-specified significance level $α$ (e.g., $α=0.05$). Furthermore, we extend the proposed framework to Deep Semi-Supervised Anomaly Detection (Deep SAD), providing a principled approach for statistically reliable inference in semi-supervised anomaly detection settings. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world benchmark datasets robustly support the theoretical findings. The results demonstrate that PADI consistently achieves proper FPR control while attaining superior true positive rates compared with existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PADI框架，为已训练的Deep SVDD异常检测器赋予统计有效的推断能力，通过选择性推断导出选择性p值，实现对假阳性率的理论控制。
AI.motivation: Deep SVDD虽在无监督异常检测中表现优异，但其异常判定仅依赖异常分数，缺乏严格的统计保证，导致在安全关键、高风险应用中可靠性不足，尤其难以严格控制假阳性。
AI.method: 提出PADI（Post-Anomaly Detection Inference），在冻结的Deep SVDD检测器上引入选择性推断框架：以测试样本被Deep SVDD判定为异常这一事件为条件进行推断，据此推导有效的选择性p值；并将框架扩展至Deep SAD半监督异常检测。
AI.result: 理论上证明了在用户指定的显著性水平α（如α=0.05）下对假阳性率（FPR）的控制；在合成与真实基准数据集上的大量实验支持理论结论，PADI在实现合理FPR控制的同时取得了优于现有方法的真阳性率（TPR）。
AI.conclusion: PADI为Deep SVDD及Deep SAD提供了统计可靠、可控制FPR的异常检测推断方法，兼顾假阳性控制与检测性能，提升了异常检测在高风险场景中的可靠性。

title: Identifiability Guarantees for Drivers and Dynamics of Delayed Physical Systems
summary: A wide range of methods have been proposed, including physics-informed neural networks, which are powerful but do not guarantee identifiability of the dynamics, symbolic regression, which requires a set of precomputed operations, and causal discovery, which is more principled but usually relies on strong assumptions that physical systems may violate. In this work, we develop a theory-grounded method and prove that under a set of permissive assumptions, the structural drivers and drift of stochastic delayed differential equations are identifiable. Our method outperforms others on a benchmark for driver identifiability, and on a second benchmark to evaluate physical consistency of the learned dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种有理论基础的方法，在较为宽松的假设下证明随机时滞微分方程的结构驱动因素与漂移项是可识别的，并在两个基准上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法各有局限：物理信息神经网络强大但不保证动力学可识别性；符号回归需要预先计算的操作集合；因果发现更具原则性但通常依赖强假设，物理系统可能违背这些假设。因此需要一个兼顾理论保证与物理适用性的方法。
AI.method: 提出一种有理论根基的方法，在一组宽松假设下证明随机时滞微分方程的结构驱动因素与漂移项具有可识别性。
AI.result: 在驱动因素可识别性基准上优于其他方法，并在评估所学动力学物理一致性的第二个基准上也取得更优表现。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在宽松假设下为随机时滞微分方程的可识别性提供了理论保证，并在两个基准任务上验证了其优越性与物理一致性。

title: Latent Inference-Time Guidance of Time Series Foundation Models
summary: Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) currently provide state-of-the-art results in forecasting tasks. They are available out-of-the-box and rely on in-context learning to make their predictions, which makes the quality of their performance highly sensitive to the user-selected lookback, covariates, horizon and training data distributions. In practise, the quality of the forecasts are variable but complementary, which highlights the need for a principled ensembling approach, rather than selecting the best context. This paper introduces Latent Inference-Time Guidance for TSFMs, which adaptively combines a pool of TSFM forecasts through a time-dependent latent space with independent components. The framework comes equipped with identifiability and reconstruction guarantees, whilst maintaining the off-the-shelf aspect of foundation models. We provide experiments on datasets at various frequencies and from multiple domains: these show that the approach is competitive with traditional ensembling approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Latent Inference-Time Guidance（潜在推理时引导）框架，通过时间相关的独立分量潜在空间自适应融合一组时序基础模型（TSFM）的预测，无需微调即可保持基础模型的开箱即用特性，并在多频率、多领域数据集上展现出与传统集成方法相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 时序基础模型（TSFM）在预测任务中已达 SOTA，但其依赖上下文学习，性能高度依赖用户选定的回看窗口、协变量、预测视野及训练数据分布，导致预测质量波动但彼此互补。因此，需要一个有原则的集成方法，而非简单地选择最佳上下文。
AI.method: 提出 Latent Inference-Time Guidance for TSFMs：在一个具有独立分量的时间相关潜在空间（time-dependent latent space with independent components）中，对一组 TSFM 预测进行自适应组合。该框架具备可辨识性（identifiability）与重构（reconstruction）保证，同时保持基础模型的开箱即用（off-the-shelf）属性。
AI.result: 在多种频率、多个领域的数据集上开展实验，结果显示该方法与传统集成方法具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为 TSFM 提供了一种有理论保证的推理时集成方案，可在不微调模型的前提下自适应融合多组预测，性能与传统集成方法相当。

title: ReCIRC: Rectified Conformal Risk Control
summary: Many applications of black-box predictive models require controlling task-relevant error rates, such as missed lesion pixels in segmentation or missed labels in multilabel classification. Conformal risk control (CRC; Angelopoulos et al., arXiv:2208.02814) gives distribution-free guarantees for such losses, but it calibrates a single threshold shared by all inputs. Because conditional risk varies with the input, this marginal guarantee often overprotects easy cases and underprotects hard ones. We propose ReCIRC (Rectified Conformal Risk Control), which inverts each input's estimated local risk curve to reparameterize the calibrated threshold as a risk budget $a$ representing a common target conditional risk, and then applies CRC unchanged to the resulting family. ReCIRC retains CRC's finite-sample marginal guarantee regardless of the accuracy of the estimated curves, while accurate curves yield approximate conditional risk control and, under additional conditions, asymptotically exact conditional risk control; they also support a risk-calibration diagnostic. Across three synthetic and five real-data settings spanning segmentation, multilabel and multiclass classification, and regression, ReCIRC attained the lowest average worst-group risk and mean positive group excess in every setting, while maintaining marginal risk close to the target, whereas changes in prediction size were application-dependent.

AI.tldr: ReCIRC通过反演每个输入的局部风险曲线，将共享阈值重新参数化为共同目标条件风险预算，再对由此得到的阈值族应用CRC，从而在保留CRC有限样本边际保证的同时实现（近似/渐近精确的）条件风险控制。
AI.motivation: 许多黑盒预测模型应用需要控制任务相关的错误率（如分割中漏检的病灶像素、多标签分类中漏检的标签）。Conformal risk control (CRC) 虽能对这类损失提供分布无关保证，但只校准一个所有输入共享的阈值。由于条件风险随输入而异，这种边际保证往往对简单样本过度保护、对困难样本保护不足，因而需要一种能兼顾条件风险控制又不失原保证的方法。
AI.method: 提出ReCIRC（Rectified Conformal Risk Control）：先估计每个输入的局部风险曲线，反演该曲线，将校准阈值重新参数化为一个风险预算a（代表共同的目标条件风险），然后对由此得到的阈值族原样应用CRC。
AI.result:
在3个合成数据集和5个真实数据场景（涵盖分割、多标签分类、多分类与回归）中，ReCIRC在每一个场景都取得了最低的平均最差组风险与平均正组超额；同时其边际风险保持在接近目标值。
预测规模（prediction size）的变化则因应用而异。
AI.conclusion: ReCIRC无论估计曲线是否准确，都保留CRC的有限样本边际保证；曲线准确时可获得近似条件风险控制，在额外条件下还可获得渐近精确的条件风险控制，并支持风险校准诊断，是一种兼顾保证与条件风险均衡的实用方案。

title: Serverless gossip training of LSTM failure detectors: A matched-protocol comparison with federated, local and centralized learning on NASA C-MAPSS
summary: Industrial predictive maintenance increasingly depends on learning from equipment spread across sites whose sensor data cannot easily be pooled. Federated averaging (FedAvg) solves this with a central aggregation server; gossip learning removes the server, but its behaviour for recurrent failure-detection models has not been measured under controlled conditions. We compare synchronous ring gossip with FedAvg, isolated local training and a centralized reference for a stacked LSTM that detects imminent failure on the NASA C-MAPSS turbofan benchmark. All methods share one open implementation, architecture, initialization, optimizer, data split and training budget, and the primary endpoint uses one terminal window per test engine to avoid the statistical dependence of overlapping windows. On FD001 (five seeds), gossip reached a terminal-window F1 of 89.6 +/- 1.3%, compared with 89.9 +/- 1.1% for FedAvg, 83.6 +/- 6.7% for local training and 93.5 +/- 2.1% for centralized training, while transmitting the same payload as FedAvg without a coordinator. Node models agreed closely but not exactly (1.8% pairwise decision disagreement versus 5.6% without communication). Across FD002-FD004, peer communication improved terminal-window F1 over local training by 13-28 points; gossip matched FedAvg on FD003 and FD004 but was 4.3 points lower on the multi-condition FD002 subset. Simulated message loss, node failure and server outage changed neither method appreciably, whereas larger rings degraded gossip faster. Ring gossip is therefore a practical serverless alternative when data heterogeneity is moderate, and faster-mixing topologies become important as heterogeneity grows.

AI.tldr: 该论文在NASA C-MAPSS涡扇发动机基准上，用统一实现、架构、初始化与训练预算，系统对比同步环形gossip学习、FedAvg、孤立本地训练和集中式训练对堆叠LSTM故障检测模型的表现，重点评估gossip在无中心服务器场景下的可用性。
AI.motivation: 工业预测性维护的数据分散于不同站点，传感器数据难以集中汇总。FedAvg依赖中心聚合服务器，而gossip学习无需服务器，但其在循环故障检测模型上的行为尚未在受控条件下被测量，因此需要系统评测。
AI.method: 在NASA C-MAPSS涡扇发动机基准上，使用堆叠LSTM检测临近故障。所有方法共享同一开源实现、架构、初始化、优化器、数据划分和训练预算。主终点采用每台测试发动机一个终端窗口，以避免重叠窗口的统计依赖性。对比同步环形gossip、FedAvg、孤立本地训练及集中式训练，并测试消息丢失、节点故障、服务器中断和不同环形规模的影响。
AI.result: 在FD001（5个随机种子）上，gossip终端窗口F1为89.6±1.3%，FedAvg为89.9±1.1%，本地训练为83.6±6.7%，集中式训练为93.5±2.1%；gossip与FedAvg传输相同负载但无需协调者。节点模型高度接近但不完全一致（成对决策分歧1.8%，无通信时为5.6%）。在FD002–FD004上，对等通信相比本地训练将终端窗口F1提升13–28个百分点；gossip在FD003和FD004上与FedAvg持平，但在多工况FD002上低4.3个百分点。模拟消息丢失、节点故障和服务器中断对两种方法影响均不明显，而更大的环形规模使gossip退化更快。
AI.conclusion: 当数据异构性适中时，环形gossip是实用的无服务器替代方案；随着异构性增强，更快混合的拓扑结构变得更重要。

title: Learning from the Gap Between Pass@K and Pass@1
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly trained with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR). An exact verifier can also support test-time scaling by selecting a passing response from multiple samples, while other deployments use beam search, adaptive sampling, or tools. We study single-sample decoding, where each query receives one response without search, to ask whether search-exposed behavior can be absorbed into the model. Existing verified-response post-training recipes do not generally distinguish problems already solved on the first decode from failures recovered within K samples. Under a fixed budget, this can spend examples repeating behavior the deployed policy already has. We introduce GapFT, which selects training evidence by the source checkpoint's single-sample outcome and fine-tunes on the Pass@K-Pass@1 gap: problems the policy fails on one sample but solves within K samples. We match training examples, processed tokens, and optimizer steps while keeping the objective unchanged. GapFT fills the matched budget with recovered failures and uses an exact decomposition to distinguish corrections of recovered and missed failures from regressions on first-decode successes. On LogiQA 2.0 and ReClor with Llama-3.1-8B, GapFT improves Pass@1 by 14.4 and 13.9 points over the source model, outperforms budget-matched uniform verified RFT at the same learning rate, and matches fine-tuning on the full verified pool using one third of the data. A single decode matches the source model's verifier-selected Pass@4 accuracy. A randomized control attributes gains to covering distinct failures, and our analysis relates available gains to transferable failure support. A three-seed Qwen2.5-7B replication retains positive gains over uniform RFT on both logic tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GapFT，一种基于 Pass@K 与 Pass@1 差距选取训练样本的微调方法，将搜索暴露的行为吸收进单样本解码策略，在相同预算下显著提升 Pass@1。
AI.motivation: 现有基于可验证奖励的后训练方法通常不区分"首次解码即解决"与"K 次采样内恢复"的问题。在固定预算下，这会浪费样本重复已掌握的行为，导致训练效率低下。作者希望研究：无搜索的单样本解码场景下，能否将搜索暴露的能力内化到模型中。
AI.method: GapFT 依据源检查点的单样本结果筛选训练证据，专门针对 Pass@K−Pass@1 的差距——即策略在单样本上失败但在 K 次采样内成功的问题进行微调。通过匹配训练样本数、token 量与优化步数，并保持目标函数不变，将预算全部用于恢复失败样本；同时采用精确分解区分"恢复失败修正""遗漏失败修正"与"首次解码成功的性能回退"。
AI.result: 在 LogiQA 2.0 与 ReClor 上，基于 Llama-3.1-8B，GapFT 相比源模型 Pass@1 分别提升 14.4 与 13.9 个点；在相同学习率下优于预算匹配的均匀验证 RFT，并用三分之一数据达到全验证池微调的效果。单次解码即可匹配源模型经验证器选择的 Pass@4 精度。随机对照实验表明增益来自覆盖不同失败样本，分析将可得增益与可迁移失败支撑关联。三个随机种子的 Qwen2.5-7B 复现实验在两个逻辑任务上均保持正向增益。
AI.conclusion: 按 Pass@K−Pass@1 差距选择训练证据是一种高效的后训练策略，可在固定预算下显著提升单样本解码性能，并将搜索暴露的行为有效吸收进模型，为 RLVR 场景下的测试时扩展与部署提供新思路。

title: FluxLite: Inference-Time Proposal Control for Discrete Diffusion Models
summary: Many inference-time tasks for pretrained discrete diffusion models and diffusion language models reduce to drawing samples from a tilted version of the pretrained distribution. Feynman-Kac sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) makes this correction exact in principle, but its prescribed weights routinely degenerate when the proposal dynamics are misaligned with the tilt, capping the practical gains from additional particles. We introduce FluxLite, a lightweight, training-free proposal-control framework for discrete diffusion. On the sparse directed graph of pretrained reverse rates, any sparse jump-rate perturbation can be exactly compensated by a $q_t$-weighted graph-divergence term in the Feynman-Kac potential; the target path is therefore preserved while the residual reweighting variance becomes a local convex objective. We instantiate this principle as two practical samplers: a one-hop local reallocation rule (HEU) and a small nonnegative quadratic program over pretrained-rate bases (D-VCG). We further prove population stability under the standard score-entropy training loss, identifying a tilted-path coverage factor that governs robustness to score error, together with finite-particle convergence for a fixed controlled Feynman-Kac recursion. Empirically, FluxLite improves over standard Feynman-Kac SMC baselines by up to two orders of magnitude in terminal KL on an analytically tractable finite-state CTMC benchmark, and reduces row-correlation MSE on 2D Ising sampling by 5-7x in geometric mean and up to 55x at peak.

AI.tldr: FluxLite是一个面向离散扩散模型的轻量、免训练提议控制框架，通过在预训练逆向速率稀疏有向图上补偿稀疏跳率扰动来降低Feynman-Kac SMC权重退化，并提升倾斜采样效果。
AI.motivation: 预训练离散扩散模型与扩散语言模型的许多推理任务可归结为从预训练分布的倾斜分布中采样。Feynman-Kac序贯蒙特卡洛原则上可精确修正，但当提议动态与倾斜不匹配时，其权重常发生退化，增加粒子数量也难以获得实际收益。
AI.method: 在预训练逆向速率的稀疏有向图上，作者指出任意稀疏跳率扰动都可由Feynman-Kac势中的q_t加权图散度项精确补偿，从而保持目标路径不变，同时将残余重加权方差转化为局部凸目标。据此实例化两种采样器：单跳局部重分配规则HEU，以及基于预训练速率基的小型非负二次规划D-VCG。作者还证明标准得分熵训练损失下的总体稳定性，识别控制得分误差鲁棒性的倾斜路径覆盖因子，并给出固定受控Feynman-Kac递推的有限粒子收敛性。
AI.result: 在解析可处理的有限状态CTMC基准上，FluxLite相较标准Feynman-Kac SMC基线在终端KL上最多提升两个数量级；在二维Ising采样上，行相关MSE的几何平均降低5-7倍，峰值最多降低55倍。
AI.conclusion: FluxLite为离散扩散的倾斜采样提供了一种免训练、可精确保持目标路径的提议控制方法，并通过理论分析与多基准实验验证了其对SMC权重退化的缓解作用与采样精度提升。

title: Intrinsic Associative Memory on Riemannian Manifolds: Curvature, Capacity, and Emergent Modes
summary: Geometry does more than constrain an associative memory: curvature determines what it remembers and which states it creates. We develop intrinsic dense associative memories on Riemannian manifolds by casting memory as Epanechnikov kernel-density mode seeking. We compare geodesic and volume-corrected energies and show that curvature separates their behavior. We prove that geodesic memory always retains an isolated pattern, while corrected memory obeys a sharp Ricci-curvature threshold: positive curvature can erase memories in high dimensions, while negative curvature reinforces them. We derive geodesic capacity scalings of $q_β^{-1/2}$ for retaining every pattern and $q_β^{-1}$ for a typical one, where $q_β$ is the pairwise kernel-overlap probability. We show how overlap \emph{creates} novel memories: designed $N$-pattern configurations realize all $2^N-1$ subset modes, but random data at the storage threshold yield only a Poisson number. We establish exact one-step recall using Riemannian mean shift. In simulations, we recover the predicted curvature transition and every designed mode. On WordNet's full noun hierarchy, we demonstrate that volume correction improves low-capacity retrieval. Together, our work shows that curvature is a design variable for associative memory, not merely a property of the data.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出黎曼流形上的内在稠密联想记忆（将记忆视为Epanechnikov核密度众数搜索），证明曲率决定记忆的保持、擦除与新生，并给出容量标度与精确一步召回机制。
AI.motivation: 传统联想记忆多建立在欧氏空间或仅用几何作为约束，未把曲率本身当作设计变量；作者希望揭示曲率如何主动决定记忆保留、擦除与涌现，从而将几何从被动约束提升为可设计的记忆属性。
AI.method: 在黎曼流形上构造内在稠密联想记忆：把记忆建模为Epanechnikov核密度众数搜索；对比测地能量与体积校正能量；用Ricci曲率阈值分析；推导测地容量标度；用黎曼均值漂移实现一步召回；并在仿真与WordNet名词层级上验证。
AI.result: 测地记忆总能保留孤立模式，而体积校正记忆遵循锐利的Ricci曲率阈值：正曲率在高维可擦除记忆，负曲率则强化记忆。容量标度为q_β^{-1/2}（保留全部模式）与q_β^{-1}（典型模式）。重叠可"创造"新记忆：设计N模式可实现全部2^N-1个子集模式，而随机数据在存储阈值处仅得Poisson数量。仿真复现曲率转变与全部设计模式；在WordNet完整名词层级上，体积校正提升低容量检索。
AI.conclusion: 曲率是联想记忆的设计变量，而不仅是数据属性；几何决定记忆什么、以及生成哪些状态。

title: Can Representation Learning Decouple from Loss Minimization? Polar Updates Have an Answer
summary: Does representation learning stop when the training loss stops improving? We study this question for matrix Muon, whose polar-normalised updates have a step length set by the gradient's rank rather than its norm. Near the edge of stability, full-batch Muon on teacher-student problems enters approximately period-2 loss oscillations that persist for thousands of steps: the cycle-mean loss stays flat or rises, yet the weights keep moving and the learned features continue to align with the teacher subspace. For linear teacher-student learning toys, we derive explicit cycle and alignment formulas and conditional plateau and decay bounds. For a population mean-field ReLU model, we prove that, under stated dimension, initialisation and small-head conditions, the leading eigenspace of the average gradient outer product (AGOP) recovers the teacher subspace exactly during a loss plateau, before the loss later drops. In all 33 ReLU, GELU and SiLU teacher configurations we study, direction-only alignment metrics show the student AGOP aligned with, or still aligning to, the teacher subspace during the period-2 oscillations; projected head refitting on selected configurations shows that the learned directions are useful for prediction, and further measurements distinguish AGOP alignment from weight-mass concentration. In deep residual ReLU students, freezing the downstream layers while the first layer trains with full-batch exact polar updates recreates a nearly flat cycle-mean loss with improving input-AGOP alignment; freezing and unfreezing switch between this plateau and loss decrease, and the effect is sensitive to momentum and to the choice of orthogonaliser.

AI.tldr: 该研究探究Muon优化器在训练损失停止改善时表征学习是否继续。发现在损失平台期（周期2振荡）权重仍在移动、特征持续对齐教师子空间，并从玩具模型到ReLU平均场及深度残差网络给出理论与实证证据。
AI.motivation: 核心动机是质疑"训练损失不再下降即表征学习停止"的常规假设。因Muon的极坐标归一化更新步长由梯度秩而非范数决定，在稳定边缘处可能产生持续数千步的损失周期2振荡，此处损失平坦但权重仍移动，提示存在损失平台下的隐式表征学习。
AI.method: 对线性教师-学生玩具模型推导显式周期与对齐公式及条件性平台与衰减界；对总体平均场ReLU模型，在给定维度、初始化与"小头"条件下，证明损失平台期间平均梯度外积(AGOP)的主特征空间可精确恢复教师子空间；并在33种ReLU/GELU/SiLU教师配置上进行方向性对齐度量与投影头重拟合实验，及深度残差ReLU学生中冻结下游层、仅首层全批量精确极坐标更新的消融。
AI.result: 全批量Muon在边缘稳定处进入持续数千步的周期2损失振荡，周期均值损失持平或上升，但权重持续移动、学到的特征持续对齐教师子空间；玩具模型给出闭式周期与对齐公式及平台/衰减界；平均场ReLU中AGOP主特征空间在损失平台期精确恢复教师子空间，随后损失才下降；33种配置中方向性指标显示学生AGOP对齐或仍在对齐教师子空间；投影头重拟合显示所学方向对预测有用；AGOP对齐可区别于权重质量集中；深度残差学生中冻结下游层可复现近乎平坦的周期均值损失同时提升输入AGOP对齐，冻结/解冻切换平台与损失下降，且效果对动量和正交化器选择敏感。
AI.conclusion: 表征学习并不随训练损失停止改善而停止：Muon在损失平台期仍持续进行有效表征学习，AGOP对齐可作为比损失更敏感的表征学习度量。学习进程可被下游冻结与正交化器等设计选择所调控，表明损失平台应被视为潜在的表征演化阶段而非学习终止。

title: The Signed Geometry of One-Shot Recourse: On-Path Validity and the Signed-Curvature Criterion
comment: Main text 8 pages; 57 pages including appendix and checklist
summary:
Closed-form recourse moves a rejected user along the unit gradient $\hat g$ of the classifier score $f$ by the promised distance $d_p=|f(x)|/\|
abla f(x)\|$, at which the linearized score reaches zero. We ask when this one-shot step succeeds and what additional model queries change. To leading order the step ends on the favorable side exactly when the path curvature $κ=\hat g^	op
abla^2 f(x)\,\hat g$ is nonnegative. Across 80 shallow models, the fraction of rejected users whose step ends there and the fraction with $κ\ge0$ correlate at $r=0.985$, although on Fashion-MNIST the first falls below the second by 8.2 points on average. No rule that uses only the score value and gradient can be valid for every score with path curvature bounded by $K$ without overshooting some by order $Kd_p^2/\|
abla f(x)\|$. When the curvature is also Lipschitz and the step is short, one evaluation of $f$ at the promised point attains the minimax rate among deterministic one-query rules that know the curvature bound and its Lipschitz constant, and split-conformal calibration makes such a rule reach the first crossing or abstain with probability at least $1-δ$. Training with an asymmetric curvature penalty lets 99-100% of paths cross within the promised step on undershoot-prone shallow data, at about 4-22 times the overshoot of symmetric penalties (Fashion-MNIST, COMPAS). Because $κ$ and $d_p$ depend on how the score is scaled, part of this gain can be a longer promised step, and at matched validity a smaller audit of briefly trained models finds no uniform advantage over tuned inflation. Where a per-user line search along the ray is affordable, it is exact to grid resolution and preferable.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"闭式救济"（closed-form recourse）一步移动的成功条件：一阶近似下，当分类器分数的路径曲率 κ≥0 时，沿单位梯度移动承诺距离 d_p=|f(x)|/‖∇f(x)‖ 恰好落到有利一侧；并分析额外模型查询能否改善效果及代价。
AI.motivation: 实践中给被拒用户提供救济方案时常用一步闭式移动（沿梯度移动承诺距离）来使分类分数达到零。作者希望明确这种一次性步骤何时真正成功，以及增加模型查询能在多大程度上改善，从而厘清救济方法的理论边界与实际收益。
AI.method: 对线性化分数做渐近展开，引入路径曲率 κ=ĝᵀ∇²f(x)ĝ；在 80 个浅层模型上做相关性分析；给出曲率有界下的下界（任意仅用分数值与梯度的规则都会以 O(Kd_p²/‖∇f(x)‖) 过冲）；在曲率 Lipschitz 且步长较短时构造一次查询的极小极大最优规则，并用分裂共形校准达到 ≥1−δ 的首次穿越或弃权保证；另用非对称曲率惩罚训练，并做匹配有效性下的审计对比与逐用户线搜索基线。
AI.result: 在 80 个浅层模型上，落到有利一侧的比例与 κ≥0 的比例相关系数 r=0.985；Fashion-MNIST 上前者平均低于后者 8.2 个百分点。任何只用分数值与梯度的规则无法对曲率界 K 内所有分数都有效而不产生 O(Kd_p²/‖∇f(x)‖) 量级的过冲。Lipschitz 曲率与短步长下，一次查询的规则达到极小极大速率并经共形校准实现 ≥1−δ 的穿越/弃权保证。非对称曲率惩罚使 99–100% 的路径在承诺步内穿越，但过冲为对称惩罚的约 4–22 倍（Fashion-MNIST、COMPAS）；其部分增益来自更长的 d_p，在匹配有效性下短暂训练模型的审计未发现相对调优膨胀法的统一优势。
AI.conclusion: 曲率非负是闭式一步救济成功的一阶判据，但与实际穿越比例存在系统性差距；仅用分数值与梯度的规则有本质局限。若沿射线的逐用户线搜索可承受，它在网格精度下精确且更优，应优先采用；额外查询带来的收益需在有效性匹配的公平对比下审慎评估。

title: OTROPE: Optimal Transport-based Robust Off-policy Evaluation for Large Language Models
summary: Reliable evaluation of large language models (LLMs) is essential for their development and deployment, yet is often costly, risky, and difficult to perform safely online. We study off-policy evaluation for LLMs, where limited human-labeled data from a behavior model are used to evaluate a newer target LLM. This setting is challenging because labels are scarce, behavior--target distribution shift is common, and response likelihoods are often unavailable for black-box LLMs. We propose the Optimal Transport-based Robust Off-Policy Evaluation (OTROPE), a likelihood-free evaluation that performs distributional correction in a semantic space via optimal transport to align labeled behavior-policy samples with unlabeled target-policy samples. OTROPE combines corrected human-labeled residuals with proxy predictors, yielding a doubly robust-style evaluation without behavior-policy modeling or density-ratio estimation. We theoretically characterize why baseline evaluators fail under LLM distribution shift, and establish consistency and convergence rates for OTROPE when either the reweighted behavior distribution or the proxy predictor converges. Experiments on synthetic and real LLM evaluation tasks show that OTROPE consistently outperforms baselines while enabling ensembles of weaker LLM evaluators to approach and sometimes surpass stronger evaluators. Code is available at https://github.com/LinerXiang/OTROPE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OTROPE，一种基于最优传输的鲁棒离策略评估方法，用于大语言模型（LLM）的免似然评估。它在语义空间中进行分布校正，将行为模型的带标签样本与目标策略的无标签样本对齐，结合校正残差与代理预测器实现双重鲁棒式评估。理论与实验表明其在分布偏移下优于基线，并使弱评估器集成逼近乃至超越强评估器。
AI.motivation: 可靠评估LLM十分必要，但在线评估成本高、风险大、难以安全实施。离线场景中仅有行为模型的少量人工标注数据，却要评估更新的目标LLM，存在标注稀缺、行为-目标分布偏移、黑盒模型响应似然不可得三大困难。现有基线评估器在此设置下失效，需要一种免似然、鲁棒的评估方案。
AI.method: 提出OTROPE（Optimal Transport-based Robust Off-Policy Evaluation）。核心是在语义空间中利用最优传输进行分布校正，将带标签的行为策略样本与无标签的目标策略样本对齐；随后将校正后的人工标注残差与代理预测器（proxy predictor）结合，形成双重鲁棒风格的评估，无需行为策略建模，也无需密度比估计，且不依赖响应似然。
AI.result: 理论上刻画了基线评估器在LLM分布偏移下失效的原因，并为OTROPE建立了当重加权行为分布或代理预测器任一收敛时的一致性保证与收敛速率。在合成与真实LLM评估任务上，OTROPE持续优于基线；同时使多个较弱LLM评估器的集成能够逼近、有时甚至超越更强的单一评估器。
AI.conclusion: OTROPE为黑盒、标注稀缺且存在分布偏移条件下的LLM评估提供了免似然、鲁棒且具理论保障的方案，验证了语义空间最优传输分布校正与双重鲁棒结合的有效性，并展示了弱评估器集成替代强评估器的潜力。代码已开源。

title: Stochastic Optimization Under Power-Law Spectra: Tight Bounds and Shuffling Analysis
summary: Recent work has established that power-law spectral conditions on data enable tight convergence bounds for deterministic gradient descent, resolving the conflict between classical exponential bounds and observed power-law learning curves. In this work, we extend this result to the stochastic regime of high-dimensional machine learning. We provide two main contributions: (1) We generalize the power-law spectral theory to Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD), showing that the same spectral exponents govern stochastic dynamics; (2) For the fundamental case of isotropic Gaussian data, we provide a precise analysis of data shuffling, deriving exact constants that prove Single Shuffle is strictly superior to Flip-Flop and IID sampling. Our results bridge the gap between abstract spectral theory and practical stochastic training choices, offering a unified picture of how data geometry drives optimization speed.

AI.tldr: 本文将幂律谱理论从确定性梯度下降推广到随机梯度下降，证明同一谱指数支配随机动态；并针对各向同性高斯数据精确分析数据洗牌，给出证明单次洗牌严格优于Flip-Flop和IID采样的显式常数。
AI.motivation: 近期研究表明，数据的幂律谱条件可为确定性梯度下降提供紧的收敛界，从而调和了经典指数界与观测到的幂律学习曲线之间的矛盾。然而这一理论尚未覆盖高维机器学习中更常见的随机训练情形，作者希望将其扩展到随机机制，弥合抽象谱理论与实际随机训练选择之间的差距。
AI.method: 理论分析：一是将幂律谱理论推广至随机梯度下降（SGD），刻画谱指数对随机动态的控制；二是针对各向同性高斯数据这一基本情形，对数据洗牌（data shuffling）进行精确分析，推导精确常数以比较不同采样策略。
AI.result: 同一幂律谱指数同样支配SGD的随机动态；在各向同性高斯数据下得到精确常数，证明单次洗牌（Single Shuffle）严格优于Flip-Flop与IID采样。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将幂律谱理论推广到随机优化领域，并给出数据洗牌策略的精确比较，提供了一幅统一图景：数据几何（谱结构）如何驱动优化速度，从而连接抽象谱理论与实际随机训练中的策略选择。

title: GNA: Granular Neighbor Assembly for Retrieval-Augmented Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Deep forecasters predict from a fixed-length lookback window, and lengthening it gives diminishing returns at a growing cost. Retrieval augmentation instead shows the model how similar past situations continued. Retrieving a whole past window gives every variate the continuation of the same past moment. In multivariate series, however, the best past match differs from variate to variate. We present GNA (Granular Neighbor Assembly), a retrieval layer for forecasting backbones that assembles neighbors at two granularities: whole past windows, which keep the variates coherent, and per-variate neighbors, in which each variate takes its future from its own best-matching past. A learned gate decides, per forecast step and variate, how much to trust these futures against a persistence forecast, next to the backbone's own forecast. Candidates come from an embedding trained to predict each window's future, and retrieval is strictly causal: a past window is used only once its future has been observed. With the same lookback for every model and the same retrieval constants for all datasets, GNA improves two Transformer backbones in 85 of 96 dataset-horizon settings, gives the lowest MSE on 8 of 12 standard benchmarks and beats its backbone in every seed on 10 of them. Both granularities are needed, and neighbors of mismatched queries are worse than none. Retrieval helps most where the lookback says least: the gate shifts trust to retrieved futures further ahead. Where it fails, on hourly non-stationary series at long horizons, the loss is consistent with a drifting level of the retrieved futures.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 GNA（Granular Neighbor Assembly）检索增强层，在两个粒度上为多变量时间序列预测组装近邻：整窗口近邻保持变量间一致性，逐变量近邻让每个变量采用自身最匹配历史未来的预测，并通过学习门控按预测步和变量信任这些未来。
AI.motivation: 固定长度回看窗口的深度预测器面临"延长窗口收益递减、成本上升"的问题；检索增强可展示相似历史情形如何延续，但检索整个过去窗口会让所有变量共享同一历史时刻的延续，而多变量序列中最佳历史匹配往往因变量而异。
AI.method: GNA 作为预测主干的检索层，在两个粒度组装近邻：整窗近邻（保持变量一致性）与逐变量近邻（每个变量从其自身最佳匹配历史取未来）；用学习门控在每个预测步和每个变量上决定相对于持续性预测的信任度，并与主干自身预测并列。候选来自一个被训练用于预测各窗口未来的嵌入，检索严格因果：过去窗口只有在其未来被观测到之后才可使用。
AI.result: 在所有模型使用相同回看长度、所有数据集使用相同检索常数的条件下，GNA 在 96 个"数据集-预测期"设置中有 85 个改进两个 Transformer 主干，在 12 个标准基准中有 8 个取得最低 MSE，并在其中 10 个基准上于每个随机种子均优于主干。两种粒度都是必需的，查询不匹配的近邻比没有近邻更差；检索在回看信息最少处帮助最大，门控在更远的预测步上将信任转向检索到的未来；在小时级非平稳序列的长预测期上失效，损失与检索未来的水平漂移一致。
AI.conclusion: 检索增强应以多粒度方式融入多变量预测：整窗近邻维持变量间一致性，逐变量近邻捕捉异质延续模式，因果检索与学习门控共同决定信任分配。检索的收益集中在回看信息不足的远期预测，其主要失效模式是检索未来存在水平漂移。

title: MoRE: Scaling mixture of experts with hardware-aware low-rank routing
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers are central to frontier language models, and recent architectures push toward more and smaller experts. In this regime, the standard linear router becomes a bottleneck: with $M$ experts and hidden dimension $h$, its per-token cost $Θ(Mh)$ dominates the MoE layer once $M$ is large. We introduce MoRE (Mixture of Rank-reduced-routed Experts), which factorizes the router weight matrix at rank $r$ and reduces the routing cost to $O((h + M)r)$. We prove that rank logarithmic in $M$ suffices for routing expressivity when the number of active experts is fixed, and is necessary up to precision factors. We also prove that logarithmic rank preserves load balance in a Gaussian memorization model, and training on a synthetic phonebook task shows that low rank does not hurt memorization. At matched active FLOPs, the factorization allows a factor of $Θ(h/r)$ more experts. To realize this gain in wall-clock time, we design a fused Triton kernel at inference that avoids expensive memory operations on HBM. Empirically, MoRE improves memorization on the phonebook task and performance on knowledge-intensive Q\&A benchmarks after pretraining, while matching reasoning ability. Code available at https://github.com/Matheart/MoRE_code.

AI.tldr: MoRE通过将MoE路由权重矩阵低秩分解，把路由成本从Θ(Mh)降至O((h+M)r)，理论证明对数秩即可保持路由表达力与负载均衡，并配以融合Triton核，实现更多专家与更好记忆/知识表现。
AI.motivation: 前沿MoE架构趋向"更多、更小"的专家，导致标准线性路由器成为瓶颈：当专家数M较大时，每token路由成本Θ(Mh)主导整个MoE层。需降低路由成本以支撑大规模专家并兑现效率收益。
AI.method: 提出MoRE，对路由权重矩阵做秩r分解，将路由成本降至O((h+M)r)；理论上证明：固定激活专家数时，秩对数于M即可保证路由表达力（且在精度因子下为必要条件）；并证明对数秩在高斯记忆模型中保持负载均衡。推理侧设计融合Triton核，避免HBM上昂贵的内存操作。
AI.result: 在相同激活FLOPs下，分解允许使用Θ(h/r)倍更多的专家；合成phonebook任务显示低秩不损害记忆，MoRE提升记忆表现；预训练后在知识密集型Q&A基准上性能提升，同时推理能力持平；融合Triton核带来wall-clock时间收益。
AI.conclusion: 低秩路由可在不牺牲表达力、负载均衡与推理能力的前提下大幅扩展专家规模，并配合高效内核兑现实际加速，为更大规模细粒度MoE提供可行方案。代码已开源。

title: Cheap and Powerful Tests for Supervised Subspaces: Per-Component Inference for PLS
comment: 41 pages, 5 figures, 28 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Code and results: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23004298
summary: Partial Least Squares (PLS) regression extracts a few outcome-aligned directions in a high-dimensional X and is widely used across applied science, but inference on the resulting fit is either expensive, biased and discouraged, or absent. We reduce inference to held-out OLS refits of the supervised subspace, a primitive shared by PLS, supervised PCA, and linear probes, and supply two tests using held-out correlations: a Nadeau-Bengio corrected asymptotic t-test as a fast approximation, and a permutation test with comparable power, finite-sample valid under outcome-predictor independence and iid rows. Held-out predictions are unchanged under any orthogonal rebasing of the supervised span, so an interpretable basis such as varimax inherits the joint claim but not a per-axis p-value; per-component claims come from a fixed-sequence test on the PLS extraction order. We validate on synthetic geometries, two NIR chemometric datasets, and cross-lingual word-embedding regressions; the exact test also transfers to supervised PCA and a ridge probe. The proposed tests have more power than CV-permutation-Q^2, at a fraction of its cost. A pre-run check on n and the spectrum of X says when the approximation is safe. We release a Rust library with Python, R, and Julia bindings, plus a Python text pipeline.

AI.tldr: 该文将PLS（及监督PCA、线性探针）的推断归约为对监督子空间的留出OLS重拟合，提出两种基于留出相关性的检验：Nadeau-Bengio校正的渐近t检验（快速近似）与有限样本有效的置换检验，并给出逐成分的固定序列检验，附Rust库及多语言绑定。
AI.motivation: PLS回归在高维X中提取少量与结果对齐的方向，应用广泛，但对其拟合结果的推断要么代价高、有偏且被劝阻，要么完全缺失。
AI.method: 将推断归约为监督子空间的留出OLS重拟合这一原语，并提出两种基于留出相关性的检验：(1) Nadeau-Bengio校正的渐近t检验作为快速近似；(2) 在结果-预测变量独立且行iid下有限样本有效的置换检验。留出预测在任何正交重构基（如varimax）下不变，故可继承联合结论但不产生逐轴p值；逐成分结论通过PLS提取顺序上的固定序列检验获得。
AI.result: 在合成几何、两个NIR化学计量数据集及跨语言词嵌入回归上验证；精确检验也可迁移到监督PCA与岭回归探针。所提检验比CV-permutation-Q²更具功效，且成本仅为其一小部分；并给出关于n与X谱的预运行检查以判断近似何时安全。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为PLS类监督子空间方法提供了廉价且有效的推断框架，兼顾功效与计算成本，并发布带Python、R、Julia绑定的Rust库及Python文本流水线。

title: Adapting Linear-Time Architectures for Tabular In-Context Learning
comment: 31 pages, 13 figures, 10 tables. Code available at https://github.com/schnurrd/ICL-Architectures
summary: Tabular foundation models achieve strong performance by conditioning on labelled examples in context, but softmax attention limits their use on large datasets. Existing linear-time alternatives, however, are mostly causal, and their potential for tabular in-context learning (ICL) remains underexplored. To address this, we (1) revisit causal training setups, (2) compare linear sequence mixers, and (3) investigate their ICL generalisation beyond the pretraining context length. First, we show that the best training setup for causal models resembles next-token prediction. Then, perhaps surprisingly, the most promising linear sequence mixer is causal: DeltaNet outperforms even non-causal linear attention. However, it degrades beyond $2$-$4\times$ the pretraining context length, and existing mitigation strategies such as bidirectionality defer the problem at best. A hidden-state oracle shows that this is not a capacity problem. Instead, our analysis points to an instability in the recurrent state, which drifts in deeper layers of causal models. Since DeltaNet's learned write rates overfit to the pretraining regime, we modulate them with a time-dependent decay schedule intervention to stabilise length generalisation. Finally, re-introducing non-causality by reading out from the final state allows us to closely match a controlled softmax attention baseline on OpenML-CC18 and TabArena.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究线性序列混合器在表格上下文学习（ICL）中的潜力，发现因果DeltaNet优于非因果线性注意力，但其长度泛化受循环状态漂移所限，通过时间依赖衰减调度干预并恢复非因果读出可缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型依赖上下文中的标注样例取得强性能，但softmax注意力的二次复杂度限制了其在大数据集上的应用；现有线性时间替代方案多为因果结构，其在表格ICL中的潜力尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: （1）重新审视因果训练设置；（2）比较多种线性序列混合器；（3）考察预训练上下文长度之外的ICL泛化。基于此提出时间依赖衰减调度干预，调制DeltaNet学习到的写入速率，并重新引入非因果读出（从最终状态读取）。
AI.result: 因果模型最优训练设置近似下一词元预测；因果DeltaNet优于非因果线性注意力，但在超过预训练长度2–4倍时性能下降，双向性等缓解策略至多推迟问题。隐藏状态oracle表明并非容量问题，而是因果模型深层循环状态不稳定漂移。衰减调度干预稳定了长度泛化，非因果读出使模型在OpenML-CC18与TabArena上接近受控softmax注意力基线。
AI.conclusion: 因果线性混合器（尤其DeltaNet）在表格ICL中表现突出，其长度泛化瓶颈源于循环状态不稳定性而非容量，通过写入速率衰减干预与非因果读出可有效缓解并逼近softmax注意力基线性能。

title: Optimal Multi-Reward Reinforcement Learning
summary: We study an unknown-transition finite-horizon Markov decision process (MDP) with a finite collection of known reward functions $\{r^1, r^2, \ldots, r^M\}$. The goal is to output an $ε$-optimal policy for every reward using online episodic interaction only. Performance is measured by the policy error $V_{0}^{*, m} - V_{0}^{\widehatπ^{m}, m}$ where $m\in [M]$ represents the reward function and $V_{0}^{*, m}=\mathbb{E}_{s_1\sim μ}[V_{1}^{*, m}(s_1)]$. Under this setting, we design a provably efficient algorithm to establish a minimax sample complexity bound of $$ O\left(\frac{SAH^3}{ε^2}\log M \mathrm{polylog}\left(\frac{SAH\log M}{\min\left\{ε, 1\right\}δ}\right)\right)$$ episodes, with no additional burn-in cost. This matches the information-theoretic lower bound up to a factor of $ \mathrm{polylog}(SAH\log M/(\min\left\{ε, 1\right\}δ))$. Our method combines three technical ingredients. First, we adapt MVP to reward-switching learning to construct optimistic value estimates. Second, we use fresh replay samples to conservatively evaluate the candidate policies. Third, gap-based multiplicative weights updates adjust the reward-sampling distribution using the differences between these estimates, converting weighted learning progress into simultaneous guarantees for all rewards.

AI.tldr: 本文研究未知转移、有限时域、具有有限个已知奖励函数集合的MDP，在仅在线回合交互下为每个奖励输出ε-最优策略，提出算法达到O(SAH³/ε²·log M·polylog)的minimax样本复杂度，匹配下界至polylog因子。
AI.motivation: 在多奖励共享同一未知转移的设定下，需要仅通过在线回合交互同时为所有奖励学习近似最优策略，并追求无额外预热成本、接近信息论下界的样本效率。
AI.method: 方法包含三个技术要素：将MVP适配到奖励切换学习以构造乐观价值估计；使用新回放样本对候选策略进行保守评估；基于估计差异的gap-based乘法权重更新调整奖励采样分布，将加权学习进展转化为对所有奖励的同时保证。
AI.result: 建立了O(SAH³/ε²·log M·polylog(SAH log M/(min{ε,1}δ)))回合的minimax样本复杂度界，且无额外预热成本，与信息论下界匹配至polylog因子。
AI.conclusion: 该算法在无预热成本下实现了近最优的多奖励MDP同时学习，样本复杂度接近信息论下界。

title: Understanding Private Evolution as Learning-Augmented Clustering
summary: Private Evolution (PE) is a differentially private algorithm for synthetic data generation. While it can be viewed as a Wasserstein learning algorithm, it performs much better in practice than worst-case Wasserstein analyses would predict. We recast PE as generative model-augmented Wasserstein learning. We show theoretically that when we take into account the use of a generative model that is able to capture something about the true distribution, then we can obtain much better performance bounds. For example, if the generator gives samples in the same low-dimensional space as the distribution, then sample complexity depends on intrinsic, not ambient, dimension. We also show that standard variants of PE can fail to converge on simple well-clustered instances, and propose a new geometry-aware version of PE with provable convergence on such instances. Experimentally, we show that our new algorithm is competitive with standard baselines and can improve recall.

AI.tldr: 该文将 Private Evolution (PE) 重新解释为生成模型增强的 Wasserstein 学习，从理论上刻画了生成模型如何改善 PE 的样本复杂度，并提出几何感知 PE 变体以保证在良好聚类实例上的收敛性，实验显示其竞争力并提升召回率。
AI.motivation: PE 作为差分隐私合成数据生成算法，实际表现远好于最坏情况 Wasserstein 分析预测。作者希望解释这种差距，并解决标准 PE 变体在简单聚类实例上不收敛的问题，从而提升理论与实际性能。
AI.method: 将 PE 重铸为生成模型增强的 Wasserstein 学习，在理论中引入生成模型对真实分布的捕获能力；据此推导更优性能界（如生成样本与分布处于同一低维空间时，样本复杂度依赖内在维度而非环境维度）；同时分析标准变体在良好聚类实例上的失败，并提出几何感知版本 PE。
AI.result: 理论上，生成模型增强的 Wasserstein 学习可获得更优的性能界；当生成器位于与分布相同的低维空间时，样本复杂度取决于内在维度而非环境维度。标准 PE 变体在简单良好聚类实例上可能不收敛；新几何感知 PE 在该类实例上具有可证明的收敛性。实验上，新算法与标准基线具有竞争力，并能提升召回率。
AI.conclusion: 通过生成模型增强的 Wasserstein 视角，可更准确解释并改进 PE；所提几何感知 PE 在聚类实例上具备收敛保证，实验中具有竞争力且能改善 recall。

title: When Is Coarse Supervision Worth It? Cost-Aware Learning under Unknown Aggregation
summary: Modern learning systems often acquire supervision at multiple resolutions, trading annotation cost against information content. We study cost-aware two-resolution learning, where expensive fine labels reveal a vector response and cheaper coarse labels reveal a scalar aggregate formed with unknown weights, while the target remains the full response. The challenge is that unknown aggregation changes which directions coarse data can identify, so the value of coarse supervision depends jointly on cost, noise, and identification. We characterize this information geometry and develop an estimate-and-track policy that learns the aggregation rule and tracks the optimal resolution mix. We derive a closed-form break-even condition for coarse supervision and prove that the online policy attains the optimal leading cumulative-risk coefficient, with a matching local asymptotic minimax lower bound. Synthetic experiments support the predicted all-fine/mixed transition, show the online learner approaching the oracle-share benchmark, and demonstrate a finite-budget gain over all-fine acquisition when coarse supervision is sufficiently favorable. Our results provide a principled way to balance information and annotation cost across supervision resolutions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究成本感知的双分辨率学习：昂贵细标签给出向量响应，廉价粗标签给出未知权重的标量聚合，目标为完整响应。作者刻画了其信息几何，提出估计-追踪策略学习聚合规则并追踪最优分辨率混合，给出粗监督的闭式盈亏平衡条件，证明在线策略达到最优领先累积风险系数并具匹配的局部渐近极小极大下界。
AI.motivation: 现代学习系统常以多分辨率获取监督，需要在标注成本与信息量之间权衡。粗标签更便宜但仅提供未知权重的标量聚合，其可识别方向随未知聚合而变化，因此粗监督的价值同时取决于成本、噪声与可识别性，需要统一刻画与优化。
AI.method: 研究成本感知双分辨率学习：细标签提供向量响应，粗标签提供未知权重的标量聚合，目标为完整响应。刻画该信息几何，设计“估计-追踪”（estimate-and-track）策略，在线学习聚合规则并追踪最优分辨率混合比例，同时推导粗监督的闭式盈亏平衡条件。
AI.result: 证明在线策略达到最优领先累积风险系数，并给出匹配的局部渐近极小极大下界。合成实验验证了理论预测的全细/混合相变，显示在线学习器接近神谕份额基准，并在粗监督足够有利时相较全细采集取得有限预算收益。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为跨监督分辨率平衡信息与标注成本提供了有原则的方法，量化了粗监督何时值得使用，并给出可证明最优的在线分配策略。

title: Federated Clustering with Unknown Local and Global Cluster Cardinalities
summary: Federated clustering methods that do not require the global number of clusters $K$ still assume that each client knows its local number $K_g$. This assumption is hard to justify when clients know no more about their data than the server does, as in fault diagnosis across independently operated industrial sites. We propose a two-phase framework in which neither count is known: each client first estimates $K_g$ from its own data, and an aggregator that requires local counts, such as FedGEM, then uses these estimates in place of the true values. For the first phase we introduce Adaptive Split--Merge (ASM), which grows a spherical Gaussian mixture by BIC-driven splitting and then merges excess components. ASM uses no labels, selects its hyperparameters on held-out client data only, and makes no assumption about how clusters are shared across clients. We derive a closed-form split criterion whose critical cluster size falls with anisotropy and rises with dimension, and show empirically that over-fragmentation grows with the number of points per cluster, which federation divides among clients. Across eight datasets, ASM with FedGEM attains a mean ARI of 0.333, against 0.256 for the next best label-free estimator and 0.361 when the true local counts are supplied. It also gives the most reliable global estimates of $K$ and is robust when client size is decoupled from local cardinality.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段联邦聚类框架，在全局与本地簇数均未知时，先用ASM估计各客户端局部簇数，再供FedGEM等聚合器使用。
AI.motivation: 现有免全局簇数K的联邦聚类方法仍假设各客户端已知其局部簇数K_g，这在客户端对自身数据了解不优于服务器时（如独立运营工业站点的故障诊断）难以成立。作者希望放松这一假设，实现全局与局部簇数均未知的联邦聚类。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段每个客户端自行估计K_g；第二阶段需要局部簇数的聚合器（如FedGEM）用这些估计值替代真实值。第一阶段提出Adaptive Split--Merge（ASM）：通过BIC驱动的分裂增长球形高斯混合模型，再合并多余分量；不使用标签，超参数仅在留出的客户端数据上选择，且不假设簇在客户端间的共享方式。同时推导出闭式分裂准则，其临界簇大小随各向异性降低、随维度上升。
AI.result: 理论：闭式分裂准则显示临界簇大小随各向异性上升而下降、随维度上升；实验显示过分裂随每簇点数增加而增长，而联邦化会将点分散到各客户端。八个数据集上，ASM+FedGEM平均ARI为0.333，优于次优无标签估计器的0.256，接近提供真实局部簇数时的0.361；同时还给出最可靠的全局K估计，并在客户端规模与局部基数解耦时保持鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: ASM使联邦聚类摆脱对局部簇数已知的依赖，性能接近使用真实局部簇数的上界，并能可靠估计全局K。

title: Beyond Conditional Independence: Root Cause Analysis with Deep Causal Models
summary: Root cause analysis (RCA) is a critical problem in many real-world scenarios. RCA enables the identification of faulty or failing mechanisms in a system by comparing anomalous observations with corresponding reference (i.e., regular) observations. However, existing approaches rely either on heuristic methods or on conditional independence tests with a strong unconfoundedness assumption, and thus fail to exploit other complicated distributional constraints in the presence of latent variables. To relax these assumptions, we model the underlying system as a causal model and the anomalous system as a change in the structural functions of the same causal model. Specifically, to handle unobserved confounders, we establish an implicit connection between distributional constraint testing and root cause analysis. To adapt our approach to data generated from arbitrary causal models, we employ the deep causal model (DCM) framework, in which we design the causal model using neural networks. Finally, we illustrate how our method, RCA-DCM, can utilize different levels of partial graphical knowledge to perform RCA. We evaluate RCA-DCM against state-of-the-art baselines on simulated datasets, a physics-based causal chamber and two micro-service applications. RCA-DCM improves top-1 accuracy over the strongest baseline on both Sock Shop (0.880 vs. 0.752) and Online Boutique (0.776 vs. 0.712), and when the true root cause in the causal chamber is unobserved and acts as a latent confounder, it recovers the exact root-cause set more often than any competing method (perfect recovery rate (PRR) 0.846 vs. 0.731).

AI.tldr: 该论文提出RCA-DCM，将系统建模为因果模型，把异常视为结构函数的变化，通过分布约束检验与深度因果模型处理潜在混杂，实现无需无混杂假设的根因分析，并在多个数据集上超过最强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有根因分析（RCA）方法依赖启发式方法或条件独立性检验，且需要强无混杂性（unconfoundedness）假设，在存在潜在变量时无法利用复杂的分布约束，因而假设不成立时性能受限。
AI.method: 将底层系统建模为因果模型，把异常系统视为同一因果模型中结构函数的变化；建立分布约束检验与根因分析之间的隐式联系以处理未观测混杂；采用深度因果模型（DCM）框架，用神经网络实现因果模型，使方法适配任意因果模型生成的数据；并支持利用不同层次的部分图结构知识进行RCA。
AI.result: 在模拟数据集、基于物理的因果腔室以及两个微服务应用上与SOTA基线对比：Sock Shop top-1准确率0.880 vs. 0.752，Online Boutique为0.776 vs. 0.712；当因果腔室中真实根因未被观测且作为潜在混杂时，完美恢复率（PRR）为0.846 vs. 0.731。
AI.conclusion: RCA-DCM通过因果建模与深度因果模型，放宽了无混杂假设，能有效利用潜在混杂与部分图知识，在多种场景下取得优于最强基线的根因分析性能。

title: Scalable Diffusion SBI for Compositional Inference under Simulator Misspecification
summary: Simulation-based inference is challenging when many heterogeneous observations must be composed, hierarchical latent structure must be preserved, and the simulator is misspecified relative to observed data. We develop sampling and fine-tuning methods for diffusion-based inference in design-conditional settings, where the same simulator is queried across different experimental conditions $ξ$. We extend compositional score-based inference with a continuous-time diffusion coefficient that accounts for the number of observations, avoiding Jacobian and auxiliary-covariance corrections. We introduce Hierarchical Blockwise Diffusion Sampling (HBDS), which infers shared parameters and group-specific latent states using a single pretrained model, with the hierarchy specified only at sampling time. Together, these methods support variable observation sets and groupings without retraining. To address misspecification, we introduce path-regularized fine-tuning that adapts the learned likelihood to observations and transfers corrections to posterior inference. Using Girsanov's theorem, we quantify path divergence between pretrained and fine-tuned models across experimental designs and interpret it alongside predictive errors to distinguish candidate misspecification correction from unnecessary adaptation.
