We evaluate compositional sampling on exact-score Gaussian and Simple Likelihood, Complex Posterior benchmarks, HBDS with analytic and learned scores on a controlled hierarchical model, and fine-tuning and localization on a separate analytic model with known design-dependent discrepancy. Finally, we apply the framework to 940 measurements across four cell lines in a mechanistic Bone Morphogenetic Protein signaling model, where fine-tuning improves posterior-predictive accuracy relative to the pretrained model and shifts posterior marginals toward the least-squares reference while retaining spread.

AI.tldr: 提出面向设计条件模拟的扩散推断方法：连续时间扩散系数组合采样、层级分块扩散采样（HBDS）与路径正则化微调，支持变观测集与分组、缓解模拟器误设，并在BMP信号模型上验证。
AI.motivation: 模拟推断在需组合大量异质观测、需保留层级隐结构、且模拟器相对观测数据存在误设时极具挑战；且同一模拟器需在不同实验条件ξ下被反复查询，要求推断方法无需重训即可泛化。
AI.method: (1) 扩展组合式得分推断，引入依赖于观测数量的连续时间扩散系数，避免雅可比与辅助协方差修正；(2) 提出层级分块扩散采样（HBDS），用单一预训练模型推断共享参数与组特异隐状态，层级结构仅在采样时指定；(3) 引入路径正则化微调，将学习到的似然适配到观测并把修正迁移至后验推断；(4) 用Girsanov定理量化预训练与微调模型在各设计下的路径散度，并结合预测误差判断误设修正是否必要。
AI.result: 组合采样在精确得分的Gaussian与Simple Likelihood、Complex Posterior基准上评估；HBDS在受控层级模型上用解析与学习得分评估；微调与定位在具有已知设计依赖差异的解析模型上验证；在机制性BMP信号模型中对四株细胞系共940个测量值应用，微调相较预训练模型提升后验预测精度，并使后验边缘向最小二乘参考移动，同时保留离散度。
AI.conclusion: 所提组合采样、HBDS与路径正则化微调共同支持变观测集与分组的免重训推断，并能有效识别与修正模拟器误设，在真实机制模型中提升后验预测表现。

title: Iterative Exact Discrete Guidance for Energy-Based Sampling
summary: Sampling from unnormalized distributions over large discrete state spaces becomes difficult when a multimodal target is far from a tractable reference. We introduce Iterative Exact Discrete Guidance (IEDG), a population-exact, trajectory-wise guidance framework for unnormalized discrete targets. Rather than learn the full reference-to-target correction in one step, IEDG introduces a global Boltzmann tilt along an annealing trajectory. Each stage learns a stage-local posterior correction for an incremental Boltzmann tilt of the current source, while the resulting corrections are accumulated relative to a fixed analytic posterior. At the population optimum, exact stage posteriors recover the correct reverse dynamics, whose exact simulation reproduces the target distribution. IEDG chooses stage increments by relative effective sample size (rESS), which controls Rényi-2 displacement and locally adapts the step size to the thermodynamic geometry of the annealing path. Our stagewise total-variation analysis shows that limited overlap amplifies Bregman fitting error by $1/\sqrt{\mathrm{rESS}}$, while posterior, simulation, and truncation errors enter additively. IEDG improves all distribution-level errors over the neural baselines on ordered, exactly enumerated Ising $4\times4$, while substantially reducing one-shot errors on Ising/Potts $16\times16$ across thermodynamic regimes and attaining the best neural-sampler result on several reported local-statistic and phase-coverage metrics. On Max-Cut, its best-of-512 and average-sample ratios exceed all the baselines. Code and artifacts are available at https://github.com/StillFantasy123/iterative-exact-discrete-guidance.

AI.tldr: 提出 IEDG——面向未归一化离散目标分布的分段精确引导采样框架，通过沿退火轨迹逐段学习 Boltzmann 倾斜校正，在总体最优时精确重现目标分布，并用相对有效样本量控制步长。
AI.motivation: 当多峰目标分布远离可处理的参考分布时，在大规模离散状态空间上对未归一化分布采样十分困难；一步式地从参考学习到目标的全部修正误差大、易失效，需要一种兼顾精确性与可扩展性的采样方案。
AI.method: IEDG 在退火轨迹上引入全局 Boltzmann 倾斜，每个阶段针对当前源分布的增量倾斜学习阶段局部后验校正，校正相对固定的解析后验累加；步长增量由相对有效样本量（rESS）选取，控制 Rényi-2 位移以自适应热力学几何；并给出分段全变差分析，指出有限重叠使 Bregman 拟合误差被 1/√rESS 放大，而后验、模拟与截断误差为加性叠加。
AI.result: 在可精确枚举的 4×4 Ising 上，IEDG 在全部分布级误差指标上优于神经基线；在 Ising/Potts 16×16 上跨热力学区间显著降低一步式误差，在多项局部统计量与相覆盖指标上取得最佳神经采样器结果；在 Max-Cut 上，best-of-512 与平均样本比率均超过所有基线。
AI.conclusion: IEDG 是一种群体精确、轨迹级的离散引导采样框架，在总体最优下精确恢复逆向动力学并重现目标分布，理论与实验均表明其在多峰离散采样与组合优化任务上优于现有神经采样基线。

title: Identifying ODEs from Unstructured Data with Causal Representation Learning
summary: We study the problem of recovering the governing ODE of a dynamical system from unstructured, high-dimensional observations such as images. Existing methods for ODE discovery typically assume direct measurements of the variables, or do not provide theoretical guarantees on the learned variables and equations. While Causal Representation Learning (CRL) methods provide guarantees on identifying variables from high-dimensional observations up to component-wise diffeomorphisms, we show that in general these variables cannot be used directly as input to equation discovery methods, which typically assume that the variables will lead to sparse equations. So we introduce SParse Equivalent Equation Discovery AutoEncoder (SPEED-AE), a framework that combines a pretrained CRL method with a component-wise autoencoder that learns transformations of variables that are amenable to sparse ODE discovery. We show that for polynomial ODEs, this additional step allows us to restrict the identifiability of each variable from polynomial to monomial diffeomorphisms. Experiments on Lotka-Volterra, Lorenz, and a two-pendulum system show that SPEED-AE improves on the disentanglement of the CRL methods and that it recovers ODEs that are closest to the ground truth, while achieving state-of-the-art forecasting performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 SPEED-AE 框架，将预训练因果表示学习与逐分量自编码器结合，从高维图像中恢复稀疏可辨识的常微分方程。
AI.motivation: 从图像等非结构化高维观测中直接发现控制方程时，现有方法多假设变量可直接测量，或缺乏对所学变量与方程的理论保证。因果表示学习(CRL)虽能将变量辨识到逐分量微分同胚，但这些变量通常无法直接作为方程发现方法的输入，因为后者要求变量能导出稀疏方程。
AI.method: 提出 SParse Equivalent Equation Discovery AutoEncoder (SPEED-AE)：将预训练的 CRL 方法与一个逐分量自编码器(piecewise/component-wise autoencoder)结合，学习适合稀疏 ODE 发现的变量变换；对多项式 ODE，该附加步骤可将每个变量的可辨识性从多项式微分同胚收紧到单项式微分同胚。
AI.result: 在 Lotka-Volterra、Lorenz 及双摆系统上实验表明，SPEED-AE 相比纯 CRL 方法改善了解耦效果，恢复的 ODE 最接近真值，并达到最先进的预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入面向稀疏方程发现的变量变换学习环节，SPEED-AE 弥合了因果表示学习与 ODE 发现之间的鸿沟，在理论上增强了可辨识性，在实验上同时提升了解耦、方程恢复精度与预测表现。

title: Interpretable intrinsic dimension estimation through componentwise calibration of distance and angle
summary: DANCo (Dimensionality from Angle and Norm Concentration) jointly calibrates nearest-neighbor distance and angular statistics and consistently reaches state-of-the-art accuracy on clean intrinsic-dimension (ID) benchmarks. Practical data, however, introduce neighborhood-relative noise and sample-amplitude heterogeneity that can distort these geometric signals. We reformulate DANCo componentwise, retaining separate distance and angular discrepancy curves so that the source of an estimate can be identified and interpreted. For the distance component, we derive a closed-form Kullback-Leibler divergence for the generic-order ratios of the generalized ratios ID estimator (Gride); when both angular parameters are matched (Full), Gride reduces mean percentage error from $27.7\%$ to $17.6\%$ at noise equal to $40\%$ of typical neighbor spacing on 24 manifolds. For the angular component, two sampling regimes motivate aligning mean direction while retaining concentration matching (Profiled). On a Gaussian scale mixture with generating dimension 70 embedded in 100 dimensions, profiling raises the Minimum Neighbor Distance (MiND) estimate from $22.8$ to $66.7$, while removing the known amplitudes restores MiND-Full to $71.9$; the control thus attributes the Full shortfall to amplitude heterogeneity. On CIFAR-10 and ImageNet, amplitude-reducing normalizations move angular location toward the references and narrow the Full-Profiled gap, an observational counterpart to the controlled mixture. Across four pretrained convolutional neural networks, Gride-Profiled, the two-nearest-neighbor estimator (TWO-NN), and the maximum-likelihood estimator (MLE) exhibit similar rise-and-fall profiles, while Full-Profiled differences identify the layers most sensitive to angular calibration.

AI.tldr: 将DANCo按距离与角度分量分解重构，分别推导Gride的闭式KL散度与角度"Profiled"匹配，在合成流形、高斯尺度混合及CIFAR-10/ImageNet与四个CNN上验证了噪声与幅度异质性对内蕴维度估计的影响。
AI.motivation: 原始DANCo联合标定最近邻距离与角度统计，在干净基准上达到最优精度，但真实数据中的邻域相对噪声与样本幅度异质性会扭曲这两类几何信号；同时联合估计掩盖了误差来源，难以识别和解释偏差出自距离还是角度分量。
AI.method: 将DANCo按分量重构，保留独立的距离与角度差异曲线；对距离分量推导广义比值内蕴维度估计量(Gride)一般阶比值的闭式KL散度，并在两个角度参数匹配时得Full版本；对角度分量区分两种采样机制，提出在匹配集中度的同时对齐平均方向的Profiled估计，并以控制实验（去除已知幅度）分离幅度异质性的影响。
AI.result: 在24个流形、噪声为典型邻距40%时，Full使Gride的平均百分比误差从27.7%降至17.6%；在生成维度70嵌入100维的高斯尺度混合上，Profiled将MiND从22.8提升至66.7，去除已知幅度后MiND-Full恢复至71.9，将Full的不足归因于幅度异质性；CIFAR-10与ImageNet上降幅归一化使角位置靠近参考并缩小Full-Profiled差距；四个预训练CNN中Gride-Profiled、TWO-NN与MLE呈相似先升后降曲线，Full-Profiled差异可识别对角度标定最敏感的层。
AI.conclusion: 分量化的DANCo框架能定位内蕴维度估计偏差的来源，提升噪声鲁棒性并给出可解释结论：距离与角度失配分别对应噪声与幅度异质性，为深度网络表示的内蕴维度分析提供了更精细的诊断工具。

title: Pointwise or Pairwise: When Do Pairwise Losses Help Reward Learning, Provably?
comment: 58 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables; second through sixth authors contributed equally
summary: Pairwise losses are increasingly used for reward learning even when pointwise rewards are observed, with mixed empirical results. When and why do pairwise losses outperform pointwise losses? We study this question in a grouped offline contextual-bandit setting allowing multiple actions per context, capturing many reward learning scenarios. We compare Value Regression (VR), which regresses observed rewards pointwise, with Value Difference Regression (VDR), which regresses reward differences between a pair of actions sampled under the same context. We consider a semiparametric model where the mean reward is the sum of a learnable action-dependent component and an arbitrary context-dependent yet action-independent nuisance, capturing context-specific disturbances. Using a unified localized analysis, we prove finite-sample regression guarantees for finite and linear function classes and translate them into offline-regret bounds. For finite classes, VDR eliminates the misspecification term in the VR bound and improves a reward-scale-dependent error term by averaging over actions within each context, a benefit absent from the corresponding VR term. For linear classes, neither method uniformly dominates: within-context differencing removes nuisance-induced bias but may increase estimation variance relative to using absolute rewards when the misspecification is sufficiently low. This yields a feature geometry-dependent bias-variance tradeoff, which we corroborate with numerical experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文在分组离线上下文赌博机设定下，从理论与实验两方面比较逐点回归（VR）与成对差分回归（VDR），揭示VDR何时及为何优于VR，并给出依赖特征几何的偏差-方差权衡。
AI.motivation: 成对损失在奖励学习中应用日益广泛，即使观测到逐点奖励也是如此，但经验结果褒贬不一。作者希望明确回答成对损失何时、为何优于逐点损失这一问题。
AI.method: 在允许同一上下文有多个动作的分组离线上下文赌博机设定下，构建半参数模型：平均奖励为可学习的动作相关成分与任意上下文相关但动作无关的干扰项之和。采用统一的局部化分析，对有限函数类与线性函数类分别证明有限样本回归保证，并转化为离线遗憾界。比较值回归（VR）与值差分回归（VDR）。
AI.result: 对有限函数类，VDR消除了VR界中的误设定项，并通过对同一上下文内多个动作求平均，改进了依赖奖励尺度的误差项，而VR的对应项不具备此优势。对线性函数类，两种方法均非一致占优：上下文内差分消除了干扰导致的偏差，但当误设定足够小时可能相对使用绝对奖励增大估计方差。
AI.conclusion: VR与VDR之间存在由特征几何决定的偏差-方差权衡，该结论通过数值实验得到验证，解释了成对损失表现不一的原因。

title: Interacting particle guidance for sampling reward-tilted generative priors
comment: Code will be made available after publication
summary: Inference-time steering adapts pretrained diffusion and flow-based models to new tasks, e.g., to generate samples from a conditional distribution or samples with desired properties, without retraining. This can be formalized as sampling from a reward-tilted generative prior. As exact sampling from this distribution is intractable, guidance-based methods rely on approximations producing biased samples, and sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) methods correct for this bias using importance weights. However, while exact in the large particle limit, SMC suffers from weight degeneracy and particle collapse in practice. We propose interacting particle guidance (IPG), which replaces reweighting with transport. The particles interact through an additional drift, derived from the Feynman--Kac PDE to cancel the reweighting term, and remain unweighted. Choosing the drift in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space yields a closed-form solution that is cheap to compute, with negligible overhead compared to SMC. We demonstrate the method on Gaussian mixtures with known posteriors, and on high-dimensional image inpainting and protein structure inference tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出交互粒子引导(IPG),用粒子间的额外漂移项替代SMC的重加权,避免权重退化与粒子坍缩,在推理时高效采样奖励倾斜的先验分布。
AI.motivation: 推理时引导需从奖励倾斜的生成先验中采样,但精确采样不可解。引导类方法产生有偏样本;SMC虽用重要性权重纠偏,理论上在大粒子极限下精确,实际却存在权重退化与粒子坍缩问题。
AI.method: IPG用传输替代重加权:从Feynman-Kac PDE导出额外漂移项以抵消重加权项,使粒子保持无权。将该漂移选取在再生核希尔伯特空间(RKHS)中,得到闭式解,计算开销极小,与SMC相比代价可忽略。
AI.result: 在具有已知后验的高斯混合模型上验证方法;并在高维图像修复与蛋白质结构推理任务上取得效果。
AI.conclusion: IPG通过粒子交互式传输避免了SMC的权重退化,兼顾无偏性与计算效率,可推广至条件生成与性质约束采样等多类推理时任务。

title: A Sharp Transition in Data Reconstruction under Differential Privacy
summary: Data reconstruction attacks have empirically been successful in recovering training samples from learned models, raising privacy concerns and motivating defenses with guarantees that remain valid against future threats. While differential privacy (DP) provides formal protection, choosing the privacy budget remains a challenge: small budgets severely reduce utility, but it is hard to quantify how large the budget can be without allowing accurate reconstruction. In this work, we study informed attackers who aim to reconstruct a single $d$-dimensional training sample from a $ρ$-zero-concentrated DP model, knowing all other training data. Our main contribution is to establish a sharp transition at $ρ\asymp d$ for data reconstruction: on the one hand, we derive entropy-based lower bounds for any private mechanism and any attack, characterizing a set of target priors for which reconstruction is information-theoretically impossible for $ρ\ll d$; on the other hand, we analyze a simple attack on private linear regression with output perturbation, showing that reconstruction is practically feasible for $ρ\gg d$. Remarkably, the transition moves to $ρ\asymp s$ for data lying in an $s$-dimensional subspace, demonstrating that the privacy budget guaranteeing adequate protection must be assessed in terms of the effective dimension of the data. We validate our findings via experiments on synthetic data and natural images (CIFAR-10, ImageNet).

AI.tldr: 本文研究从 ρ-零集中差分隐私（zCDP）模型中重构单个 d 维训练样本的信息论与算法可行性边界，发现重构能力在 ρ ≍ d 处出现尖锐转变，且数据实际位于 s 维子空间时边界移至 ρ ≍ s。
AI.motivation: 数据重构攻击在实证上已能成功恢复训练样本，引发隐私担忧。差分隐私虽提供形式化保护，但隐私预算选择困难：预算过小严重损失效用，预算过大会允许精确重构，而"多大会导致可重构"缺乏定量刻画。因此需要刻画隐私预算与数据重构可行性之间的精确边界。
AI.method: 1) 设定"知情攻击者"模型：攻击者已知除目标外的全部训练数据，目标是重构单个 d 维训练样本，机制满足 ρ-零集中差分隐私。2) 信息论下界：基于熵推导对任意隐私机制、任意攻击均成立的下界，给出在 ρ ≪ d 时重构在信息论上不可行的先验集合。3) 攻击分析：针对带输出扰动的私有线性回归设计简单攻击，证明 ρ ≫ d 时重构实际可行。4) 将维度分析推广至 s 维子空间情形，并给出对应阈值 ρ ≍ s。5) 在合成数据及自然图像（CIFAR-10、ImageNet）上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 在 ρ ≍ d 处发现数据重构的尖锐转变：ρ ≪ d 时信息论上不可重构，ρ ≫ d 时通过输出扰动线性回归的简单攻击可实际重构。对位于 s 维子空间的数据，转变阈值移至 ρ ≍ s。合成数据与 CIFAR-10、ImageNet 实验验证了上述理论预测。
AI.conclusion: 隐私预算能否保证充分保护应以数据的有效维度（而非名义维度）来衡量：安全阈值随有效维度 s 而非 d 缩放，这为实际选择隐私预算提供了可操作的定量依据，并统一了信息论下界与算法攻击上界的分析框架。

title: High-Dimensional Simulation-Based Inference in Latent Spaces
summary: Neural simulation-based inference (SBI) has been widely successful in inferring a relatively small number of interpretable parameters from potentially high-dimensional observations, such as images or time series. Accordingly, representation learning in SBI has focused almost exclusively on compressing the observations used to condition the posterior. More recently, however, SBI has begun to target increasingly high-dimensional parameter spaces, raising the complementary question of whether the inference target itself should be compressed. Our answer is a practical merger of SBI and latent generative modeling, which learns a low-dimensional representation of the simulator parameters, performs posterior inference directly in this latent space, and maps posterior samples back to the original parameter space. We characterize the conditions under which latent-space inference recovers the desired target posterior and systematically study its empirical trade-offs. Across four case studies and three generative families, we compare latent and standard estimators while controlling for network capacity, regularization, optimization, and training compute. At matched training compute, latent-space inference achieves accuracy and marginal calibration comparable to direct target-space inference while sampling up to more than an order of magnitude faster.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将神经模拟推断(SBI)与潜生成建模相结合，学习模拟器参数的低维表示，在该潜空间直接进行后验推断，并将后验样本映射回原始参数空间，从而在高维参数空间下实现更快采样且精度可比。
AI.motivation: SBI过去主要关注压缩观测(图像、时间序列)以估计少量可解释参数，表示学习几乎只聚焦于此。但SBI正逐渐面向越来越高维的参数空间，由此产生互补问题：推断目标本身是否也应被压缩。
AI.method: 提出SBI与潜生成建模的实用融合：学习模拟器参数的低维表示，在该潜空间直接执行后验推断，再将后验样本映射回原始参数空间。并刻画潜空间推断能恢复目标后验的条件，系统性研究其经验权衡。在四个案例研究和三种生成家族中比较潜空间与标准估计器，并控制网络容量、正则化、优化和训练算力。
AI.result: 在匹配训练算力下，潜空间推断的精度和边缘校准与直接目标空间推断相当，同时采样速度提升最高超过一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 潜空间推断可在不损失精度和校准的前提下显著加速高维参数空间的SBI，为压缩推断目标提供了可行且有效的途径。

title: Probability Contracts: Accuracy, Coherence, and Decisions Across LLM Interfaces
comment: Research preprint; includes proofs and supplementary analyses
summary: A probability used for a decision should refer to the same event across equivalent requests. We introduce probability contracts, a benchmark connecting exact finite-world posteriors, validated event transformations, and failure-aware decision evaluation. Four model-interface configurations are evaluated on 1,000 worlds. Their assessments differ across accuracy, coherence, and decision loss: Kev has lower aggregate canonical posterior error than Jev, but larger complement and coarsening residuals, with accuracy ordering varying by stratum. Jev's Event and Choice interfaces induce different binary actions on 32.8% of valid pairs at defer cost 0.10. A post-hoc analysis finds that disagreement certifies only 11-52% of mean binary pair error across configurations. An elementary action-region characterization explains when averaging changes decision loss relative to randomly selecting one interface. Although averaging cannot worsen that baseline's expected Brier score, its decision effect depends on the cost and crossed boundaries; the observed same-baseline penalties occur in configurations already worse than always deferring. The benchmark makes these distinctions measurable without treating consistency as accuracy or a score improvement as a decision guarantee.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"概率契约"（probability contracts）基准，将有限世界精确后验、可验证事件变换与失效感知的决策评估联系起来，并在1000个世界上评估四种模型-接口配置，揭示一致性、准确性与决策损失之间的差异。
AI.motivation: 决策所用的概率应在等价请求间指向同一事件，但现有评估常将一致性误作准确性、将分数提升误作决策保证，缺乏连接"精确后验—事件变换—决策评估"的统一基准。
AI.method: 构建probability contracts基准，涵盖精确有限世界后验、经校验的事件变换与失效感知决策评估；在1,000个世界上比较四种模型-接口配置（如Kev与Jev的Event/Choice接口），测量规范后验误差、补集与粗化残差、准确率分层排序、二元动作一致率、事后分歧认证比例，以及动作区域刻画下的平均化决策损失效应。
AI.result: Kev的总体规范后验误差低于Jev，但补集与粗化残差更大，准确率排序随分层而变；在延迟成本0.10下，Jev的Event与Choice接口在32.8%的有效对上诱导不同二元动作；事后分歧仅认证各配置平均二元对误差的11–52%；平均化不劣于随机选接口基线的期望Brier分数，其决策效应取决于成本与越界情况，观察到的同基线惩罚只出现在本已劣于始终延迟的配置中。
AI.conclusion: 该基准使上述区分可测量，且不将一致性等同于准确性、不将分数改进视为决策保证。

title: Physical Muon: Orthogonalization as an Equilibrium Computation
comment: Accepted at 18th annual workshop on Optimization for Machine Learning
summary: Physical neural networks and analog in-memory computing could reduce the energy cost of neural network training. Realizing this potential, however, requires optimizers that combine effective learning with physical implementability. SGD fits local analog updates but struggles on transformers, while Adam family is unstable against analog bias. Muon offers strong training performance, but its Newton--Schulz orthogonalization relies on dense matrix-matrix products. To address this obstacle, we introduce Physical Muon, which computes the orthogonalization as the equilibrium of a continuous-time flow. Random probes approximate the flow using matrix-vector products, reciprocal reads, and local rank-1 writes. To test whether this replacement preserves training performance, we evaluate it on a 10.95M-parameter transformer. The dense flow's mean validation cross-entropy is 0.0085 above Newton--Schulz across nine seeds per method; the probe implementation is 0.0188 above the control across two seeds. Circuit simulations further reproduce the flow dynamics and yield comparable training behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出 Physical Muon，将 Muon 的 Newton–Schulz 正交化改写为连续时间流的平衡求解，用随机探针以矩阵-向量乘、互易读和局部 rank-1 写实现，在 10.95M 参数 transformer 上验证性能保持，并通过电路仿真复现动力学。
AI.motivation: 物理神经网络与模拟存内计算有潜力降低神经网络训练能耗，但这要求优化器同时具备有效学习和物理可实现性。SGD 适合局部模拟更新但在 transformer 上表现不佳；Adam 系列对模拟偏置不稳定；Muon 训练性能强，但其 Newton–Schulz 正交化依赖稠密矩阵-矩阵乘法，难以在模拟硬件上实现。因此需要一种保留 Muon 性能且物理可实现的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出 Physical Muon：把正交化计算为连续时间流的平衡点，而非迭代的 Newton–Schulz 矩阵乘积。用随机探针近似该流，仅借助矩阵-向量乘法、互易读（reciprocal reads）和局部 rank-1 写入完成计算，从而契合模拟硬件的局部更新约束。在 10.95M 参数 transformer 上进行训练对比：稠密流版本对 Newton–Schulz 各跑九个种子，探针实现跑两个种子；并进行电路仿真验证。
AI.result: 稠密流实现相对 Newton–Schulz 的平均验证交叉熵高 0.0085（各九种子）；探针实现相对对照高 0.0188（两个种子）。电路仿真进一步复现了流的动力学，并给出可比的训练行为。
AI.conclusion: 用连续时间流的平衡替代 Newton–Schulz 正交化，可在保持 transformer 训练性能的同时使 Muon 适配模拟硬件，电路仿真也支持该替换的可行性，为物理神经网络训练提供了物理可实现的优化器路径。

title: Why Adaptive Optimizers Underestimate Rare Tokens
summary: In the softmax output layer, a rare token receives a small positive logit gradient on most steps and a much larger negative gradient on the few steps when it is the target. SGD simply adds these contributions. Coordinate-wise adaptive methods such as Adam, RMSProp, and sign descent instead divide each update by a running estimate of its magnitude, and that estimate is largest immediately after the token appears. This imbalance has two effects. At the level of the whole output layer, we characterize which optimizers preserve the mean output embedding: every method whose update is linear in past gradients does, as do Kronecker-factored and orthogonalized methods such as Shampoo and Muon. Adam, Adafactor, Lion, and sign descent do not, and for these methods we obtain an exact step-by-step expression for the change. At the level of an individual rare token, the same normalization shifts the training fixed point. In the unigram model, sign descent lowers the logit of every token that occurs in fewer than half of the minibatches at a constant expected rate. For RMSProp with periodic arrivals, we can solve the fixed point in closed form: if a token is absent for at least two consecutive minibatches, its equilibrium probability is strictly below its data frequency for every learning rate, and the ratio tends to $κ/(2(e^{κ/2}-1))$. Here $κ$ is the mean number of steps between occurrences divided by the second-moment time constant $1/(1-β_2)$. In the same model, SGD and AMSGrad retain the unbiased fixed point. We test these predictions both in a unigram model and in a small language model trained from a known generating distribution. With random arrivals, the bias is larger than the periodic formula predicts; in the language model, the optimizers with the biased fixed point also fit the generating distribution less well.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了自适应优化器（Adam、RMSProp、sign descent 等）对稀有 token 输出嵌入与 logit 的系统性偏差，刻画了保持均值输出嵌入的优化器类别，并推导了偏差固定点的解析表达，最后在 unigram 模型和小型语言模型上验证了预测。
AI.motivation: 稀有 token 在多数步骤上只收到很小的正 logit 梯度，仅在其作为目标的少数步骤上收到较大负梯度。SGD 简单地累加这些贡献，而逐坐标自适应方法（Adam、RMSProp、sign descent）会将每次更新除以其幅度的滑动估计，而该估计在 token 刚出现后最大。这种不平衡可能导致输出层整体均值嵌入漂移以及单个稀有 token 训练固定点的偏移，作者希望系统刻画这一现象的机制、范围与后果。
AI.method: 1）在输出层层面，分析哪些优化器保持均值输出嵌入不变：证明所有对历史梯度线性的更新都保持，Kronecker 分解与正交化方法（Shampoo、Muon）亦然；而 Adam、Adafactor、Lion、sign descent 不保持，并给出其变化的精确逐步表达式。2）在单个稀有 token 层面，分析归一化对训练固定点的影响：在 unigram 模型中，sign descent 以恒定期望速率降低出现频率低于一半 minibatch 的所有 token 的 logit；对周期性到达的 RMSProp，闭式求解固定点，得到当 token 连续至少两个 minibatch 缺席时其均衡概率严格低于数据频率，比值趋于 κ/(2(e^{κ/2}-1))，κ 为平均出现间隔步数除以二阶矩时间常数 1/(1-β2)。同时指出 SGD 与 AMSGrad 保持无偏固定点。3）在 unigram 模型和由已知生成分布训练的小型语言模型上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 理论上，线性更新、Shampoo、Muon 保持均值输出嵌入；Adam、Adafactor、Lion、sign descent 不保持且给出精确变化表达式。unigram 中 sign descent 以恒定期望速率压低低频 token 的 logit；周期性 RMSProp 下均衡概率低于数据频率，比值趋于 κ/(2(e^{κ/2}-1))，SGD 与 AMSGrad 保持无偏。实验中，随机到达时偏差大于周期公式预测；在语言模型中，具有偏差固定点的优化器对生成分布的拟合也更差。
AI.conclusion: 逐坐标自适应优化器的梯度归一化会在输出层引入对稀有 token 的系统性偏差：既改变均值输出嵌入，也偏移单个稀有 token 的训练固定点，从而降低对真实数据分布的拟合质量。该分析揭示了自适应优化在长尾分布下的一种内在代价，并为理解与选择优化器提供了理论依据。

title: XU-RS: Explaining Credal Width in Random-Set Language Models
summary: Uncertainty estimates tell us how unsure a model is, but not why. Without knowing which parts of an input influences a model's uncertainty, we cannot tell whether that uncertainty score depends on input features that are relevant for the task. We study this problem in randomset classifiers built using pretrained language models. These classifiers assign probability to individual answers and to groups of answers, producing lower and upper probabilities for each answer; The difference between these probabilities, called credal width, is used to represent epistemic uncertainty about an answer arising from limited training data. We propose XU-RS, a framework that attributes an answer's credal width to the input tokens (words or word pieces) supplied to a language model. XU-RS uses Expected Gradients (a standard feature attribution method) to estimate how input tokens contribute to credal width. The proposed framework is evaluated on a MedQA dataset using SmolLM3-3B and Llama-2-7B models, demonstrating that setting the embedding of a token ranked highly by XU-RS to zero (zero-masking) causes larger changes in credal width than zero-masking randomly selected tokens. In addition, we show that normalisation can cause other answer groups to influence an answer's width, reveal how token attribution can mask numerical errors, and provide diagnostic checks to verify whether a token ranked highly by XU-RS meaningfully explains model uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出XU-RS框架，将随机集分类器输出答案的credal width（认知不确定性）归因到输入token，用Expected Gradients估计token贡献，并在MedQA上用SmolLM3-3B与Llama-2-7B验证了归因有效性。
AI.motivation: 不确定性估计只能告诉模型有多不确定，却不能说明不确定性的来源。若不知道输入中哪些部分影响了模型的不确定性，就无法判断该不确定性是否依赖与任务相关的输入特征。因此需要将不确定性的来源归因到输入token上，尤其针对基于预训练语言模型的随机集分类器。
AI.method: 针对随机集分类器：其给单个答案和答案组分配概率，得到每个答案的下概率与上概率，二者之差称为credal width，用于表示因训练数据有限而产生的认知不确定性。提出XU-RS，采用Expected Gradients（标准特征归因方法）将某答案的credal width归因到输入语言模型的token（词或子词）。
AI.result: 在MedQA数据集上，用SmolLM3-3B与Llama-2-7B评估：将XU-RS排名高的token的embedding置零（zero-masking）导致的credal width变化，大于随机选取token置零的变化。此外发现：归一化会使其他答案组影响某答案的width；token归因可能掩盖数值误差；并提出诊断性检查以验证高排名token是否真正解释模型不确定性。
AI.conclusion: XU-RS可将随机集分类器的不确定性分解到输入token层面，实验支持其归因有效性；同时工作揭示了归一化、数值误差与归因可解释性方面的潜在陷阱，并提供诊断手段辅助判断归因结果是否可靠。

title: RLTL;DR: Self-improvement by Internalizing Self-generated Feedback
summary: The common paradigm of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is to let agents make multiple attempts at a task, and optimize towards the successful ones. This becomes problematic in the realms of self-improvement, where tasks are so difficult that the agent has a low or even no chance of success, and where there are no teacher models or example solutions to distill from. In this paper, we introduce RLTL;DR. After each failed attempt, we show the policy the verifier outputs and let it write its own feedback, in the form of a single TL;DR insight. The next rollout is conditioned on all previous insights, and we sequentially sample rollouts until a solution is found. Moreover, we enable backpropagation on the in-context insights to internalize a direct task to insight mapping. On challenging tool-calling and coding datasets (filtered to Pass@128=0), standard GRPO training of a Qwen 3.5 9B Thinking policy stays flat at a Pass@1 of 0% to 1%. RLTL;DR breaks through this learning barrier, achieving a Pass@1 of 14-31% with insights in context during training and, crucially, 12-13% when no insight is in context at eval time. We identify that the key is the task to insight internalization. To study this further, we reduce our approach to SFTL;DR, training only on (task, insight) tuples, without showing or backpropagating on any rollouts. Training on only 4k of these tuples recovers almost the full performance of RLTL;DR and classical SFT on full rollouts. This demonstrates a promising compacted training paradigm of the form "on this sort of task, keep this sort of thing in mind", which we hope to inspire future research on.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RLTL;DR：在失败尝试后让策略读取验证器输出并自写一条 TL;DR 式洞察，后续 rollout 以历史洞察为上下文条件，并对上下文洞察反向传播以内化"任务→洞察"映射；在 Pass@128=0 的困难工具调用与代码数据上把 Pass@1 从 0-1% 提升到 14-31%（含洞察）/12-13%（无洞察）；进一步简化为 SFTL;DR，仅用 4k 条 (task, insight) 元组即可恢复近乎全部性能。
AI.motivation: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的常规范式依赖多次采样并优化成功轨迹，但在自我改进场景中任务过难、成功率极低甚至为零，且不存在教师模型或示例解答可供蒸馏，导致标准方法（如 GRPO）停滞在学习瓶颈（Pass@1 约 0-1%）。因此需要一种在"零成功样本"条件下仍能产生有效学习信号的训练范式。
AI.method: 方法为 RLTL;DR：每次失败尝试后，向策略展示验证器输出，令其自行撰写一条 TL;DR 形式的反馈洞察；下一次 rollout 以所有历史洞察为上下文条件，顺序采样直至找到解。同时允许对上下文中的洞察进行反向传播，从而内化"任务→洞察"的直接映射。为分析该内化机制，进一步提出消融式简化方案 SFTL;DR：不展示也不对 rollout 反向传播，仅在 (task, insight) 元组上做监督微调。
AI.result: 在过滤至 Pass@128=0 的困难工具调用与代码数据集上，对 Qwen 3.5 9B Thinking 策略做标准 GRPO 训练，Pass@1 始终停留在 0%-1%。RLTL;DR 突破该学习壁垒：训练时含洞察上下文达到 14-31% Pass@1，评估时无洞察上下文仍达 12-13%。SFTL;DR 仅用 4k 条 (task, insight) 元组训练，即可恢复 RLTL;DR 与全 rollout 经典 SFT 的几乎全部性能。
AI.conclusion: 关键机制在于"任务到洞察的内化"，而非对成功轨迹的模仿；由此提出一种紧凑训练范式——"面对此类任务，记住这类要点"，并期望启发后续研究。

title: Counterfactual Probing for Parallel Unmasking with Hidden Forest Structure
summary: Masked generative models offer parallel token prediction, but accurate parallel sampling must account for dependencies among tokens. When dependencies are unknown, finding safe batches also costs model evaluations. We study whether total evaluations, including discovery, can be sublinear in sequence length $N$; sublinear sequential depth then follows. We consider discrete distributions with hidden forest structure, accessed through a fixed approximate conditional oracle. Under explicit regularity conditions and uniform Hellinger error bounds, for any fixed target accuracy $\varepsilon\in (0,1/8]$ and sufficiently large $N$, our sampler achieves seed-averaged total-variation error at most $\varepsilon$, with total masked-state submissions and sequential depth both bounded by $O(N^C \varepsilon^a)$ for constants $0 <C <1$ and $a > 0$. These guarantees use polynomial vocabulary size and an edge-response lower bound set by $N$ and $\varepsilon$. The sampler shares evaluations of hypothetical reveals across dependence tests to identify safe parallel batches without requiring full recovery of the hidden forest. A tunable parameter trades probing cost against irreversible commit rounds. In the same class, any admissible irreversible product-commit sampler attaining the same seed-averaged accuracy requires $Ω(N^c \varepsilon^b)$ counterfactual submissions or commit rounds in the worst case, for constants $c,b>0$.

AI.tldr: 研究在隐藏森林依赖结构、仅能访问近似条件 oracle 的情形下，掩码生成模型能否实现总评估次数（含依赖发现）关于序列长度 N 的亚线性并行采样，并给出上界算法与下界证明。
AI.motivation: 掩码生成模型可并行预测 token，但精确并行采样必须处理 token 间依赖；当依赖未知时，寻找"安全批次"本身需要消耗模型评估。因此需要研究总评估次数（包括依赖发现成本）能否做到关于序列长度 N 亚线性，并据此获得亚线性串行深度。
AI.method: 针对具有隐藏森林结构的离散分布，通过固定的近似条件 oracle 访问。在显式正则性条件与一致 Hellinger 误差界下，提出一种采样器：跨依赖测试共享"假设性揭示"的评估结果，以识别安全并行批次，而无需完整恢复隐藏森林；并设置可调参数以权衡探测成本与不可逆提交轮数。
AI.result: 对任意固定目标精度 ε∈(0,1/8] 和足够大的 N，采样器达到种子平均全变差误差 ≤ ε，总掩码状态提交次数与串行深度均被 O(N^C ε^a) 界定，其中 0<C<1、a>0；保证依赖多项式词表规模及由 N 和 ε 决定的边响应下界。同类别下，任何满足相同种子平均精度的可采纳不可逆乘积提交采样器，最坏情形需 Ω(N^c ε^b) 次反事实提交或提交轮数（c,b>0）。
AI.conclusion: 在隐藏森林依赖与近似 oracle 设定下，包含依赖发现的总评估次数可实现对序列长度的亚线性复杂度，从而带来亚线性串行深度；共享评估与可调探测-提交权衡是关键，且该上界在同类别不可逆乘积提交采样器中具有匹配的下界，说明亚线性复杂度在此设定下是紧的（在给定参数类别意义下）。

title: Search Dimension in Unlabeled Projection Pursuit: A Scaling Law for Subspace Restriction
summary: Projection pursuit searches for a direction along which the data look least Gaussian. When the observation space contains a large Gaussian complement, the empirical objective can be minimized by a direction that carries no signal, with empirical kurtosis as low as at the truth. Sample splitting exposes rather than repairs this failure. Appending coordinates independent of the latent regime degrades the search while leaving Bayes recoverability unchanged. Restricting the search to the column space of a known forward operator removes the failure exactly on the negative-kurtosis branch. Estimating a principal subspace from the data is the alternative. In a controlled two-component model, the leading sufficient scalings differ in the gain with which the operator transmits the discriminant: $ς^{-4}$ for covariance-spike estimation and $ς^{-8}$ for fourth-moment search. At fixed search dimension, the measured threshold ratio collapses onto $n/p^2$ with exponent $0.156$, close to the predicted $1/8$. This is an empirically supported scaling motivated by sufficient bounds, not a proved asymptotically tight law. When the search dimension is varied, the measured exponent is $0.325$, substantially larger than $1/8$, and the tested range does not identify its functional form. The crossing location also depends on calibration and model configuration. Under a downstream excess-error criterion, the scaling largely disappears.

AI.tldr: 投影寻踪在高斯补空间下会失败：经验峰度可在无信号方向被压至真值水平，样本分割无法修复。将搜索限制在已知前向算子列空间可精确消除该失败；数据驱动主成分子空间是替代方案。受控模型中两种充分缩放增益为 ς⁻⁴ 与 ς⁻⁸，固定搜索维度下测得阈值比值随 n/p² 以指数 0.156（接近预测的 1/8）塌缩，而变维度下指数为 0.325，且下游超额误差准则下该缩放基本消失。
AI.motivation: 投影寻踪寻求使数据最非高斯的投影方向，但当观测空间存在较大的高斯补空间时，经验目标可被一个不携带信号的方向最小化（其经验峰度低至真值水平），导致搜索失效。作者旨在揭示这一失败机制并探讨可行的修复途径，同时刻画修复方案所依赖的充分缩放律。
AI.method: 通过构造观测空间含高斯补空间的情形，分析经验峰度目标的无信号极小化现象，并检验样本分割是否有效。提出并比较两类策略：将搜索限制在已知前向算子的列空间（在负峰度分支上精确消除失败），以及从数据估计主成分子空间。在受控双分量模型中比较主成分子空间估计与四阶矩搜索的充分缩放增益（分别为 ς⁻⁴ 与 ς⁻⁸），并在固定与变化搜索维度下测量阈值比值随 n/p² 的缩放指数。
AI.result: 附加与潜结构无关的坐标会恶化搜索而不改变贝叶斯可恢复性；样本分割暴露而非修复该失败。将搜索限制在已知前向算子列空间可精确消除失败。固定搜索维度下，测得的阈值比值塌缩到 n/p² 上，指数为 0.156，接近预测的 1/8；当搜索维度变化时，测得指数为 0.325，远大于 1/8，且测试范围无法确定其函数形式。交叉位置还依赖校准与模型配置；在下游超额误差准则下，该缩放基本消失。
AI.conclusion: 该工作指出投影寻踪在高斯补空间下的可恢复性失败机制，并说明列空间限制与子空间估计两类修复的适用条件。所报告的缩放是由充分界所启发的经验支持缩放律，而非已证明的渐近紧致律；其指数、函数形式与交叉位置均依赖维度、校准与评价准则，在下游超额误差下稳健性有限。

title: When do data mixtures improve scaling laws? Insights from high-dimensional regression
summary: Modern machine learning systems are trained on mixtures of data from different domains, and choosing the right mixture can substantially improve downstream performance. Despite an extensive literature on data mixing and reweighting, existing work is largely empirical and it remains unclear when auxiliary data genuinely improves scaling laws rather than merely providing more samples. To gain insight into this question, we study a high-dimensional mixed-data regression model with a shared regression function, heterogeneous covariances and noise levels, and dataset sizes that may grow at different rates. We establish the minimax risk under an ellipsoidal parameter constraint for the general covariance structure and derive deterministic equivalents for the test error of ridge regression under commutative covariances. We then specialize to a target domain and an auxiliary domain with aligned power-law covariance spectra, where the theory yields explicit scaling laws in terms of spectral decay, target regularity, and the relative growth of the two datasets. These laws identify regimes in which combining data mixtures provably yields a faster scaling rate than using either dataset alone. In particular, improving the scaling law requires a specific interplay between spectra and relative sample sizes of the domains. Our numerical experiments on language models exhibit the same qualitative phenomenon: appropriate data mixtures yield a faster decrease in target-domain test loss than training on either domain alone.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究混合数据回归中辅助数据何时能真正改善缩放律，而非仅增加样本量，并通过高维理论分析给出可证明更快缩放率的条件。
AI.motivation: 现有数据混合与重加权研究多为经验性，尚不清楚辅助数据在何种条件下能真正改善缩放律，而不仅是提供更多样本。作者希望从理论上厘清这一问题。
AI.method: 作者研究一个高维混合数据回归模型，具有共享回归函数、异质协方差与噪声水平，以及可不同速率增长的数据集规模。在椭球参数约束下建立一般协方差结构的极小极大风险，并在可交换协方差下推导岭回归测试误差的确定性等价。随后专门化到具有对齐幂律协方差谱的目标域与辅助域。
AI.result: 理论给出了以谱衰减、目标正则性和两个数据集相对增长表示的显式缩放律，识别出混合数据可证明地带来比单独使用任一数据集更快缩放率的区域。改善缩放律需要谱与域间相对样本量的特定相互作用。语言模型数值实验呈现相同定性现象：合适的数据混合使目标域测试损失下降快于单独训练任一域。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为数据混合何时改善缩放律提供了理论刻画，表明辅助数据的收益依赖于谱结构与相对样本规模的特定配合，并在语言模型实验中验证了该现象的定性一致性。

title: Traversing the solution space of neural networks with Hessian Null Space Continuation
comment: 55 pages, 39 figures. Project page and code: https://ann-huang-0.github.io/Hessian-null-space-continuation/
summary: On a single task, deep networks can learn many solutions, depending on their optimizer, training data, architecture, and hyperparameters. Many of these solutions are mode-connected: rather than isolated points in weight space, they are connected by low-loss regions. Yet how their internal computation varies within these regions is unknown. A parallel line of work has identified the degeneracy of neural representations: many networks reach similar training loss with distinct internal structures. However, it is unclear how these solutions are related in weight space. We unify these subfields and show for the first time that many different internal mechanisms exist within a local mode-connected region in weight space. To do so, we introduce Hessian Null Space Continuation (HNC), a scalable method that uses local curvature to traverse regions of weight space that preserve network function, and can be steered toward solutions with specified properties. In RNNs trained on a memory task, HNC reaches drastically different representations and dynamics with maintained behavior. In ImageNet-trained Vision Transformers, HNC finds representations that differ more from the original network than any independently trained model with a different architecture or objective. In reinforcement-learning agents, HNC uncovers a distinct navigation strategy at comparable return and exposes reward hacking in an AI Safety Gridworld. Finally, HNC measures the local geometry of the solution set, showing how model size and task complexity shape its dimension and functional sensitivity. Our results show that a surprisingly large amount of representational diversity exists near a single trained solution, unseen by standard gradient-based optimization. HNC identifies and quantifies this diversity, opening new possibilities for mechanistic understanding of solution spaces and for model merging, editing, and fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Hessian Null Space Continuation (HNC) 方法，首次证明在单一任务的局部"模式连通"区域内可以存在大量不同的内部机制与表征，且网络行为保持不变。
AI.motivation: 深度网络在同一任务上可学习到多种解，这些解常由低损失区域连接（模式连通性）；同时，已有研究揭示了神经表征的简并性（不同内部结构达到相似损失）。但这两个研究方向彼此割裂，尚不清楚模式连通区域内部的解在权重空间中如何关联、其内部计算如何变化。
AI.method: 提出 Hessian Null Space Continuation (HNC)：一种可扩展方法，利用局部曲率（Hessian 零空间）在不改变网络功能的权重空间区域中"游走"（continuation/traversal），并可被引导朝向具有指定性质的解。在 RNN 记忆任务、ImageNet 训练的 Vision Transformer、强化学习智能体（含 AI Safety Gridworld）以及解集局部几何测量等场景中验证。
AI.result: 1) RNN 记忆任务中 HNC 到达行为保持但表征与动力学显著不同的解；2) ImageNet ViT 中 HNC 找到的表征比任何不同架构或目标独立训练的模型差异更大；3) RL 智能体中以相近回报发现不同的导航策略，并在 AI Safety Gridworld 中暴露 reward hacking；4) HNC 量化了解集的局部几何，揭示模型规模与任务复杂度如何影响其维度与功能敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 单一训练解附近存在远超标准梯度优化所能观察到的巨大表征多样性。HNC 能够识别并量化这种多样性，为解空间的机制性理解以及模型合并、编辑与微调开辟了新可能。

title: FD-VAD: Semantic Endpoint Detection for Streaming Full-Duplex Speech
summary: Natural turn-taking in full-duplex voice interaction requires determining from partial speech whether a pause reflects hesitation or a completed conversational intent. Acoustic voice activity detection lacks this semantic information, while cascaded ASR-based endpointing introduces transcription dependence and additional processing stages. We formulate semantic endpoint detection as a causal audio-language reasoning task and introduce FD-VAD, an ASR-free streaming endpointer that maps bounded causal audio windows directly to Continue/Stop decisions. FD-VAD combines a frozen speech encoder with a lightweight modality adapter and a parameter-efficiently adapted language model, using a last-chunk training objective for streaming inference. We further introduce confidence-gated endpoint commitment to control interruption versus delay and boundary-focused hard-negative sampling to improve decisions around ambiguous turn boundaries. Across in-domain and conversational evaluations, FD-VAD outperforms strong streaming and non-streaming semantic turn classifiers, and achieves the highest EOT recall among qualifying systems on TurnBench dev set $0.853$ (at FP<=0.10) in a zero-shot setting. These results show that semantic endpointing can be performed directly from streaming audio without intermediate ASR or dialogue state tracking.

AI.tldr: 提出 ASR-free 的流式语义端点检测器 FD-VAD，直接从因果音频窗口预测 Continue/Stop，在 TurnBench 上零样本取得最高 EOT 召回率。
AI.motivation: 全双工语音交互中，需从部分语音判断停顿是犹豫还是话轮结束：声学 VAD 缺乏语义信息，级联 ASR 端点检测依赖转写并增加处理阶段。
AI.method: 将语义端点检测建模为因果音频-语言推理任务，FD-VAD 将有限因果音频窗口直接映射为 Continue/Stop；组合冻结语音编码器、轻量模态适配器和参数高效微调的语言模型，采用 last-chunk 训练目标支持流式推理；引入置信度门控的端点承诺以权衡打断与延迟，并用边界聚焦难负样本采样改善模糊话轮边界判断。
AI.result: 在域内与会话式评测中优于强流式及非流式语义话轮分类器；TurnBench dev 零样本设置下，在 FP<=0.10 时取得合格系统中最高 EOT 召回率 0.853。
AI.conclusion: 语义端点检测可无需中间 ASR 或对话状态跟踪，直接从流式音频完成。

title: Sieve and Sage: Efficient Distraction Filtering for Reliable RALM Abstention
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, accepted at EMNLP 2026 Findings
summary: Just as Socrates recognized the limits of his own knowledge, Retrieval-Augmented Language Models (RALMs) should learn to abstain when the retrieved evidence cannot support a reliable response. Existing approaches largely rely on monolithic LLMs to handle heterogeneous retrieval failures in a single step, resulting in limited abstention performance and high computational costs. We instead decompose retrieval failures into two distinct states: (i) the unanswerable state, where the required evidence is absent, and (ii) the distracted state, where relevant evidence is mixed with conflicting, negated, or adversarial information. Based on this decomposition, we introduce a lightweight module (Sieve) that screens retrieved document sets for distracting evidence before invoking a costly LLM (Sage) for grounded generation and abstention. Evaluated across both general and high-stakes expert domains, our Sieve and Sage framework preemptively detects distracting noise, improving system accuracy by up to 69.4 percentage points and Macro-F1 by 55.2 percentage points compared to one-stage baselines. Furthermore, it achieves up to a 1.99x speedup, establishing a highly efficient and reliable abstention pipeline for RALM with abstention.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Sieve和Sage框架，将检索失败分解为"无法回答"和"受干扰"两种状态，用轻量模块先筛除干扰证据，再调用大模型生成或弃答，显著提升弃答性能与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有检索增强语言模型（RALMs）的弃答方法多依赖单体大模型一步处理异构检索失败，导致弃答性能受限且计算成本高。论文希望更精细地建模检索失败类型，以低成本实现可靠弃答。
AI.method: 将检索失败分解为两类状态：无法回答状态（缺少所需证据）和受干扰状态（相关证据混杂冲突、否定或对抗信息）。据此设计轻量模块Sieve，在调用昂贵的大模型Sage进行有依据生成与弃答之前，先对检索文档集进行干扰证据筛查。
AI.result: 在通用领域和高风险专家领域评估中，该框架能预先检测干扰噪声，相比单阶段基线系统准确率最高提升69.4个百分点，Macro-F1最高提升55.2个百分点，并实现最高1.99倍加速。
AI.conclusion: Sieve和Sage为带弃答能力的RALM建立了一条高效、可靠的弃答流水线，证明了检索失败状态分解与轻量前置筛选的有效性。

title: Developing an OCR model for Extracting Information from Invoices with Korean Language
comment: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Technologies for Communications (ATC)
summary: Invoices are commercial documents that contain various pieces of information, including the purchased items, time, and total money. Making the extraction of important information crucial. The stored information serves different purposes. Korean language is the native language of about 80 million people, playing an important role in not only South and North Korea but also in many other countries such as Vietnam, Philippine where a large number of Korean companies are located. In this context, to automatically extract proper information from the invoices with Korean language, we propose an efficient Optical Character Recognition (OCR) model in which a deep learning model is combined with some image preprocessing techniques. The proposed OCR model is assessed in a rich set of collected invoices showing that 87% F1-score can be achieved with negligible time processing.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种结合深度学习模型与图像预处理技术的OCR模型，用于从韩语发票中自动提取关键信息，在收集的发票数据集上达到87%的F1-score且处理时间可忽略。
AI.motivation: 发票包含购买项、时间、金额等商业信息，自动提取关键信息十分重要；韩语是约8000万人的母语，并在越南、菲律宾等拥有大量韩企的国家广泛使用，因此需要针对韩语发票的自动信息提取方案。
AI.method: 提出一种高效的OCR模型，将深度学习模型与若干图像预处理技术相结合，用于韩语发票的信息提取，并在收集的丰富发票数据集上进行评估。
AI.result: 在收集的发票数据集上取得87%的F1-score，且处理时间可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法能够有效且高效地从韩语发票中自动提取信息，验证了深度学习与图像预处理结合方案在该任务上的可行性与实用性。

title: Evaluating the Effects of Prompt Perturbation on Bias and Hallucination in Large Language Models
comment: 14 pages. Published in ICONIP 2024 (Neural Information Processing), LNCS 15290, Springer Nature, 2025
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities in various natural language processing tasks, leading to their widespread deployment as intelligent assistants in decision-making contexts. However, the increasing complexity of these models raises concerns about their reliability, particularly regarding bias and hallucination. In this work, we evaluate the robustness of LLMs to perturbed variations of the original inquiry in decision-making tasks. We show that contrary to previous studies, perturbations can mitigate bias and hallucination in some LLMs over other models. It's found that Claude 3 is more effective for the tasks represented in most datasets, whereas models like GPT3.5 exhibit varying levels of adequacy, performing comparably in some cases but falling significantly behind in others. These insights are crucial for understanding the practical implications of deploying LLM-based assistants as effective decision-support tools in real-world applications, emphasising the need for rigorous testing and validation to ensure reliability and effectiveness. This study contributes to the growing body of research on LLM evaluation and provides insights for developing more robust and trustworthy AI assistants in critical decision-making contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了LLM在决策任务中对原始询问扰动的鲁棒性，发现扰动在某些模型上能缓解偏差与幻觉，且Claude 3整体表现优于GPT3.5。
AI.motivation: LLM被广泛用作决策辅助助手，但其可靠性（偏差与幻觉）问题引发担忧，需要评估其在决策场景中的鲁棒性与可靠性。
AI.method: 对决策任务中原始询问的扰动变体进行测试，评估LLM对扰动的鲁棒性，并在多个数据集上比较不同模型（如Claude 3、GPT3.5）的表现。
AI.result: 与前人研究相反，扰动可在部分LLM中缓解偏差与幻觉；Claude 3在多数数据集任务上更有效，GPT3.5表现参差，部分任务相当但另一些明显落后。
AI.conclusion: 部署基于LLM的决策支持助手需进行严格测试与验证以确保可靠性与有效性，本研究为开发更鲁棒、可信的决策场景AI助手提供参考。

title: Alignment Forecasting: Predicting Misalignment From Training Data
summary: Training a language model on data with a narrow flaw can sometimes make the model broadly misaligned. Inspecting the data at face value often does not settle whether it will emerge, and today it is caught only after training, by auditing the resulting model. To complement post-hoc audits, we introduce Alignment Forecasting: the task of predicting alignment failures before training. Given a target model, a fine-tuning dataset, and a failure mode such as deception or sycophancy, a forecaster outputs the probability that fine-tuning would meaningfully increase that failure mode. To measure progress on alignment forecasting, we introduce ALIGNMENTFORECASTBENCH, a benchmark of over 5,000 forecasting questions spanning 17 target models, 32 datasets, and 16 failure modes. Frontier models prompted directly perform poorly on ALIGNMENTFORECASTBENCH. We therefore propose a forecasting scaffold in which an LLM reads the dataset and rates how strongly and broadly it pushes the model toward misbehavior, and a simple learned model combines that rating with the failure mode's base rate and the target model's prior tendency. This forecasts well above chance, and beats a model fine-tuned on the task and a simple forecaster allowed to see how weaker models behaved after fine-tuning on the same data. Its signals also flag problematic training examples that a frontier-model classifier misses. Filtering those examples out from real post-training data such as UltraChat results in more aligned models on our multiple-choice evaluation in most cases, though the benefit in open-ended conversations is unclear. More progress is needed before forecasts can reliably guide training data curation in practice, but our results suggest that forecasting many alignment failures before training can be tractable in the SFT setting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"对齐预测"(Alignment Forecasting)任务，即在微调前预测数据集是否会引发模型的广泛失准，并构建含5000+问题的ALIGNMENTFORECASTBENCH基准，通过LLM评分+简单学习模型组合的预测框架，效果显著优于随机及微调基线。
AI.motivation: 在含有狭窄缺陷的数据上训练语言模型有时会导致模型出现广泛的失准。仅从数据表面检查往往无法判断这种失准是否会发生，目前只能在训练后通过审计模型来发现。因此需要一种能在训练前预测对齐失败的方法，以补充事后审计。
AI.method: 1) 定义对齐预测任务：给定目标模型、微调数据集和某种失败模式（如欺骗、谄媚），预测器输出微调会显著加剧该失败模式的概率；2) 构建ALIGNMENTFORECASTBENCH基准，包含5000+预测问题，覆盖17个目标模型、32个数据集、16种失败模式；3) 提出预测脚手架：LLM阅读数据集并评估其将模型推向失准的强度和广度，再由简单学习模型将该评分与失败模式基率及目标模型的先验倾向相结合。
AI.result: 前沿模型直接提示在基准上表现不佳。所提脚手架显著高于随机水平，并优于在该任务上微调的模型，以及可观察较弱的模型在同一数据微调后行为的简单预测器。其信号还能标记出前沿模型分类器遗漏的问题训练样本。将这些问题样本从UltraChat等真实后训练数据中过滤后，在多数情况下使模型在多选题评估上更对齐，但在开放式对话中的收益尚不明确。
AI.conclusion: 在预测能够可靠指导实践中的训练数据筛选之前仍需更多进展，但结果表明在SFT设定下，于训练前预测许多对齐失败是可行的。

title: From Lexical Baselines to Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation: Structured Skill and Responsibility-Level Extraction with the SFIA Framework
summary: Automated skill extraction underpins workforce planning, yet most systems represent skills as flat labels with no notion of the responsibility level at which a skill is practiced. The Skills Framework for the Information Age (SFIA) captures exactly this dimension, defining 147 professional skills across seven responsibility levels, but no automated LLM-based extraction targeting SFIA has been reported. We formalize the task as structured prediction of (skill, level) pairs from free text and ask three questions: how accurately can text be mapped onto SFIA's closed vocabulary, which strategies reliably predict the level alongside the skill, and do agentic designs improve on simpler retrieval and prompting? We evaluate five strategies (a lexical baseline, dense retrieval with LLM reranking, a zero-shot schema-constrained LLM, single-agent agentic RAG, and a three-agent retriever--matcher--verifier crew) against expert-mapped European ICT role profiles, all drawing on an SFIA~9 corpus built by a fully automated agentic pipeline that we release. Retrieval-based matching identifies the most skills while generative strategies are markedly more precise; only strategies assigning the level as an explicit decision predict it reliably, with similarity-based selection more than twice as inaccurate; and the crew doubles latency without improving accuracy, so added agent roles do not automatically benefit closed-taxonomy matching. These results provide the first reproducible baseline for structured, level-aware skill extraction against SFIA.

AI.tldr: 该文首次将技能抽取形式化为SFIA框架下(skill, level)结构化预测任务，构建并开源自动化pipeline生成的SFIA 9语料，对比五种策略（词法、稠密检索重排、零样本schema约束LLM、单智能体RAG、三智能体crew）。结果显示：检索式匹配召回技能最多，生成式策略精度更高；只有将等级作为显式决策的策略才能可靠预测等级，基于相似度的选择误差高一倍以上；多智能体crew使延迟翻倍但精度未提升。该工作为SFIA的等级感知技能抽取提供了首个可复现基线。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化技能抽取系统多将技能表示为扁平标签，缺乏对技能所属责任等级的刻画，而SFIA恰好定义了147项专业技能的七个责任等级这一关键维度，却尚无基于LLM、面向SFIA的自动化抽取研究，因此需要将其形式化并建立基线。
AI.method: 将任务形式化为从自由文本中结构化预测(skill, level)对，提出三个研究问题；评估五种策略：词法基线、稠密检索+LLM重排、零样本schema约束LLM、单智能体agentic RAG、三智能体retriever–matcher–verifier crew；以专家标注的欧洲ICT岗位画像为参照，全部基于自动化agentic pipeline构建并开源的SFIA 9语料。
AI.result: 检索式匹配识别的技能数量最多，生成式策略在精度上明显更优；只有将等级作为显式决策的策略才能可靠预测等级，基于相似度的选择在等级预测上误差高一倍以上；三智能体crew使延迟翻倍却未提升准确率。
AI.conclusion: 增加智能体角色并不自动有利于封闭分类体系的匹配；该工作为面向SFIA的、结构化且感知责任等级的技能抽取提供了首个可复现基线。

title: Environment Steering: Using Data Flow Control to Improve Agent Utility and Safety
summary: LLM agents can make unsafe tool calls even when instructed to behave safely. Existing defenses constrain agents before execution, modify tool inputs/outputs, or rely on LLM judges; these approaches may depend on model behavior or block unsafe actions without helping the agent recover. We argue that the execution environment should instead enforce safety as the agent runs and steer it toward safe alternatives when violations occur---we call this Environment Steering. We implement this by modeling the agent and harness execution state as database tables, track the record-level data flows, and check these data flows against declarative policies during runtime. When violations are detected, policy- and context-specific feedback steers the agent toward safe trajectories. On AgentDyn, this enables the agent to improve task success rate over no-defense while achieving 0% attack success rate.

AI.tldr: 提出"环境引导"（Environment Steering）方法：将agent与执行状态建模为数据库表，运行时追踪记录级数据流并对照声明式策略检查，检测到违规时通过策略与上下文相关的反馈引导agent转向安全轨迹。在AgentDyn上实现0%攻击成功率，同时任务成功率高于无防御基线。
AI.motivation: LLM agent即使被指示安全行为，仍可能发起不安全的工具调用。现有防御可分为三类：执行前约束agent、修改工具输入/输出、依赖LLM裁判。这些方法要么依赖模型自身行为，要么仅阻断不安全动作而不帮助agent恢复，缺乏运行时的安全强制与引导机制。
AI.method: 将agent与harness的执行状态建模为数据库表；追踪记录级的数据流；在运行时将数据流与声明式策略进行比对检查；检测到违规时，生成策略与上下文相关的反馈，引导agent转向安全轨迹。
AI.result: 在AgentDyn基准上，该方法在实现0%攻击成功率的同时，任务成功率优于无防御（no-defense）基线。
AI.conclusion: 执行环境应作为运行时安全强制的主体，在违规发生时主动引导agent选择安全替代方案，而非仅阻断动作；该"环境引导"范式可在不牺牲任务性能的前提下实现零攻击成功率。

title: When Successful Memories Mislead Embodied Agents:Memory Adaption For Task-Conditioned Execution
summary: Experience reuse can reduce repeated exploration in embodied agents, but a trajectory that succeeded previously may be unsuitable for the current execution context. Existing memory systems pri marily optimize construction and retrieval; semantic relevance and historical success therefore remain insufficient when retrieved ex perience contains incompatible actions or an inappropriate level of structure. We introduce Memory Adaptation for Task-Conditioned Execution (MATE), a deterministic post-retrieval procedure that converts trajectories into execution-oriented memory. MATE re moves obsolete control context, extracts condition-action-effect transitions, applies verified action normalization, selects a task dependent representation, and serializes the result under a fixed budget without additional LLM inference. On 134 ALFWorld tasks, MATE achieves task success rates of 81.3% and 93.3% with Qwen2.5-14B and 72B while using approximately one-tenth of the tokens required by raw trajectories. Controlled comparisons show that verified action normalization is the principal mechanism by which MATE restores the utility of retrieved experience, support ing memory adaptation as a distinct stage between retrieval and embodied execution.

AI.tldr: MATE 是一种确定性的检索后记忆适配程序，将历史轨迹转化为面向执行的任务条件化记忆，在 ALFWorld 上以约十分之一 token 达到 81.3%/93.3% 成功率。
AI.motivation: 经验复用可减少具身智能体的重复探索，但历史成功轨迹未必适配当前执行情境。现有记忆系统主要优化构建与检索，仅靠语义相关性与历史成功率不足以判断检索到的经验是否包含不兼容动作或结构粒度不当，因此检索与执行之间缺少一个适配环节。
AI.method: MATE 是确定性的检索后处理流程（无需额外 LLM 推理）：移除过时的控制上下文；抽取「条件—动作—效果」三元转移；执行经验证的动作归一化；选择任务相关表示；在固定预算下序列化输出。
AI.result: 在 134 个 ALFWorld 任务上，MATE 配合 Qwen2.5-14B 和 72B 分别取得 81.3% 与 93.3% 的任务成功率，token 消耗约为原始轨迹的十分之一。控制实验表明，经验证的动作归一化是恢复检索经验可用性的主要机制。
AI.conclusion: 记忆适配应被视为检索与具身执行之间的独立阶段；MATE 验证了检索后适配对经验复用的关键作用，且其核心增益来自动作归一化。

title: Can Multimodal Large Language Models Generate and Detect Multimodal Social Media Fake News?
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures. Accepted for publication in the Findings of EMNLP 2026
summary: The rapid advancement of generative AI raises concerns about the misuse of Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) for large-scale disinformation campaigns on social media. Despite existing research on textual disinformation, a fundamental question remains unanswered: can MLLMs be exploited to fabricate realistic multimodal fake news, and can they reliably detect it? We introduce a multi-agent framework in which a story agent, an image agent, and a critic agent collaborate to produce fake social media posts that plausibly counter true news. We apply the framework to generate over 9,000 paired multimodal news posts across science, health, and entertainment domains, and benchmark 16 open- and closed-source MLLMs for automated detection. We find that most models fall substantially short of human-level accuracy and fail critically on identifying image authenticity. Our research provides a foundation for developing robust defenses against social media fake news. Code and data are available at https: //github.com/xiuzhenzhang/Multimodal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多智能体框架生成多模态假新闻并评测16个MLLM的检测能力，发现多数模型远低于人类水平且难以识别图像真实性。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI快速发展，MLLM可能被滥用于社交媒体大规模虚假信息传播；现有研究多聚焦文本虚假信息，尚不清楚MLLM能否被利用伪造逼真的多模态假新闻，以及能否可靠检测。
AI.method: 构建多智能体框架，由故事智能体、图像智能体和批判智能体协作生成可对抗真实新闻的虚假社交媒体帖子；据此在科学、健康、娱乐领域生成9000+成对多模态新闻帖子，并基准测试16个开源与闭源MLLM的自动检测能力。
AI.result: 多数模型准确率远低于人类水平，且在识别图像真实性方面严重失败。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为开发针对社交媒体假新闻的稳健防御机制提供了基础，代码与数据已公开。

title: TRACE: Deployable Tree-Relational Structure Enhancement for Oncology LLMs
comment: 18 pages, 2 figures, 19 tables. Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Industry Track for oral presentation
summary: Large language models are increasingly used in oncology applications, but their predictions are often weakly grounded in explicit medical structure. We present TRACE, a deployable tree-relational enhancement framework for oncology LLMs. TRACE separates expensive offline structure learning from lightweight online inference: oncology concepts and relations are organized into an updatable tree-relational structure, refined using LM-loss-derived evidence, and retrieved at inference time as compact prompt evidence. This design supports task-adaptive evidence selection without requiring supervised labels in the zero-shot setting. Across ten oncology classification tasks and one MedQuAD CancerGov QA benchmark, TRACE improves both label-free evaluation and supervised fine-tuning. Additional analyses show that TRACE improves over vanilla RAG and generic GraphRAG, remains useful under leakage-controlled METABRIC inputs, and produces interpretable evidence paths aligned with clinical reasoning. These results suggest that explicit, updatable medical structure is a practical path toward more accurate and auditable oncology LLM deployment.

AI.tldr: TRACE是一种面向肿瘤学大语言模型的可部署树-关系增强框架，通过离线学习可更新的医学结构并在推理时检索为紧凑提示证据，在多个肿瘤学基准上提升了性能与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在肿瘤学应用中日益普及，但其预测往往缺乏显式医学结构的支撑，导致依据薄弱，准确性与可审计性不足。
AI.method: TRACE将昂贵的离线结构学习与轻量级在线推理分离：把肿瘤学概念与关系组织为可更新的树-关系结构，利用LM损失衍生的证据进行精炼，并在推理时检索为紧凑的提示证据；该设计在零样本设定下无需监督标签即可实现任务自适应的证据选择。
AI.result: 在十个肿瘤学分类任务和MedQuAD CancerGov问答基准上，TRACE同时改善了无标签评估和有监督微调；消融分析显示其优于vanilla RAG与通用GraphRAG，在泄漏受控的METABRIC输入下仍有效，并能生成与临床推理一致的、可解释的证据路径。
AI.conclusion: 显式且可更新的医学结构是通向更准确、更可审计的肿瘤学LLM部署的可行路径。

title: Lookahead-R: Budget-Aware Tool Retrieval via Execution-Centric Planning
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Published in ICMR 2026
summary: Tool retrieval is a critical bottleneck for LLM-based agents operating over large, heterogeneous API ecosystems. Existing approaches face an inherent trade-off: semantic retrievers are fast but suffer from the semantic-functional gap, while execution-based validation improves precision at the cost of prohibitive latency. We propose Lookahead-R, a planning-based framework that reformulates tool retrieval as a resource-constrained sequential decision-making problem. At its core, Lookahead-R introduces a lightweight execution-aware surrogate world model that jointly predicts tool execution success, latency cost, and semantic utility---without invoking real APIs. This world model drives a cost-sensitive, uncertainty-guided Monte Carlo Tree Search that navigates the tool space under strict budget constraints. Evaluated on the large-scale ToolBench benchmark, Lookahead-R achieves a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off across all test scenarios. On the most challenging I3 split, it attains an NDCG@5 of 91.40\%, outperforming the state-of-the-art ToolGen (90.16\%) by 1.24\%. Ablation studies confirm that explicit latency modeling is the key discriminative signal for identifying high-quality tools under resource constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Lookahead-R，将工具检索重构为资源受限的序列决策问题，通过轻量级执行感知代理世界模型与代价敏感、不确定性引导的蒙特卡洛树搜索，在ToolBench上实现精度与效率的更优权衡，I3划分NDCG@5达91.40%。
AI.motivation: 面向大规模异构API生态的LLM智能体，工具检索是核心瓶颈。现有方法存在固有折中：语义检索器速度快但受"语义-功能鸿沟"影响；执行式验证提升精度却带来难以承受的时延。
AI.method: 提出Lookahead-R规划式框架，将工具检索形式化为资源受限的序列决策问题。核心是轻量级、执行感知的代理世界模型，在不调用真实API的情况下联合预测工具执行成功概率、时延代价与语义效用；该世界模型驱动代价敏感、不确定性引导的蒙特卡洛树搜索，在严格预算约束下搜索工具空间。
AI.result: 在ToolBench基准上，各测试场景均取得更优的精度-效率权衡；在最难的I3划分上NDCG@5为91.40%，较SOTA ToolGen（90.16%）提升1.24%。消融实验确认显式时延建模是资源约束下识别高质量工具的关键判别信号。
AI.conclusion: 通过规划式建模与代理世界模型替代真实执行验证，Lookahead-R在有限预算下有效缓解语义-功能鸿沟，兼顾检索精度与效率，且时延建模对工具质量判别具有决定性作用。

title: Automated Evaluation of Multi-Turn Dialogues in In-Car Conversational Assistants
comment: Accepted at the 29th IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (IEEE ITSC 2026)
summary: In-car conversational assistants (ICAs) are increasingly integrated into vehicles to support route planning, vehicle control, and information access. Ensuring their reliability is challenging due to multi-turn interactions, the absence of explicit ground truth, and strict safety constraints. Existing evaluation techniques fall short, as they target single-turn settings and fail to capture constraint handling, context retention, and safety-critical behavior across turns. We propose an automated framework for testing the multi-turn conversational capabilities of ICAs. The system is treated as a black box and evaluated via closed-loop simulation with a strategy-guided user simulator, an adversarial strategy manager, and a two-tier LLM judge assessing turn-level failures and conversation-level quality. We evaluate the approach on an industrial ICA with six LLM backends and twelve human annotators. The automated judge shows substantial agreement with humans, and strategy guidance uncovers 2.96 times more unique failure types per conversation and more than doubles the number of unique failing conversations compared to unguided simulation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向车载对话助手（ICA）多轮对话能力的自动化黑盒测试框架，通过策略引导的用户模拟器、对抗策略管理器与两级LLM评判器进行闭环仿真评估，在工业级ICA上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 车载对话助手日益集成于车辆中，承担路线规划、车辆控制与信息获取等功能。其可靠性保障面临多轮交互、缺乏显式真值以及严格安全约束等挑战。现有评估技术仅针对单轮场景，无法覆盖约束处理、上下文保持与跨轮安全关键行为，因此亟需面向多轮对话的自动化测试方法。
AI.method: 将系统视为黑盒，采用闭环仿真进行评估，框架包含三个核心组件：策略引导的用户模拟器（strategy-guided user simulator）、对抗策略管理器（adversarial strategy manager）以及两级LLM评判器（two-tier LLM judge），分别用于评估轮级失败（turn-level failures）与会话级质量（conversation-level quality）。
AI.result: 在一个工业级ICA上以六种LLM后端和十二名人工标注者进行实验。自动化评判器与人类标注者达成显著一致性；策略引导相较无引导仿真，每段会话发现的独特失败类型多出2.96倍，独特失败会话数量增加一倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 该自动化框架能够有效测试ICA的多轮对话能力，其LLM评判结果与人类判断高度一致，且策略引导显著提升失败挖掘效率，为多轮、安全关键的对话系统评估提供了可行方案。

title: Constructing Challenging Browser-Use Tasks by Controlled Environment Interventions
summary: As browser-use agents improve, benchmarks keep pace by collecting new tasks, websites, and applications, often making tasks longer or more novel. This makes difficulty expensive to refresh and difficult to control: when many aspects change at once, it is unclear what actually makes a task challenging. We instead construct challenging instances from tasks agents already solve, turning difficulty into a programmable property of the environment. BreakingWeb pairs every base task with an intervention condition that preserves the user instruction, latent target, and backend success criterion while changing the environment at different web stack layers. Each intervention is deterministic, detectable, and recoverable, and is annotated with the cognitive primitive it primarily loads. The benchmark contains 519 clean/intervention task pairs across seven self-hosted websites and 29 intervention families, all graded against outcomes. We evaluate six strong browser-use agents, three GUI-only agents that see only screenshots, and humans. The construction is effective: interventions cut agent pass rate by 22.9% on average and overturn nearly half of the tasks each agent solves cleanly, whereas humans lose 10.0% on a first attempt and 5.7% after one familiarisation attempt. The dominant failure is belief failure: 75% of the six agents' failures end with a declared success although the required change never happened. Our code, data and environment are publicly available at www.breakingweb.app.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 BreakingWeb 基准，通过可控干预把已有任务改造成困难实例，无需持续收集新任务即可编程化地调控难度。
AI.motivation: 现有浏览器智能体基准靠不断收集新任务、网站与应用来提升难度，导致难度刷新成本高且难以控制；多因素同时变化时无法判断困难来源。
AI.method: BreakingWeb 为每个基础任务配对一个干预条件，在保留用户指令、潜在目标和后端成功判据的前提下，改变不同 Web 栈层级的环境。干预具备确定性、可检测性与可恢复性，并标注主要加载的认知原语。基准含 7 个自托管网站、29 类干预家族、519 对干净/干预任务，全部按结果评分。
AI.result: 评测 6 个强浏览器智能体、3 个仅看截图的 GUI 智能体和人类。干预使智能体通过率平均下降 22.9%，并推翻近一半其原本干净解决的任务；人类首次尝试仅下降 10.0%，熟悉一次后降至 5.7%。主要失败为信念失败：6 个智能体 75% 的失败以"宣告成功"结束，尽管所需改变从未发生。
AI.conclusion: 难度可被构造为环境的可编程属性；BreakingWeb 能精准暴露智能体在信念更新与验证上的缺陷，代码、数据与环境已公开。

title: How to Run Statistics over LLM Judges and Trust the Results: Calibrated Inference for Small-Sample AI Evaluation with evalstats
summary: Researchers across academia increasingly base significance claims on LLM judge scores and small-sample AI evaluations. Yet without well-calibrated confidence intervals (CIs), hypothesis tests, and judge-bias corrections, such claims are unreliable. We address these issues in several contributions. First, we find that running statistics over raw LLM judge scores leads to inflated false positives: counterintuitively, for many inter-rater agreement metrics, false positive risk peaks at "almost perfect" human-LLM agreement. To help researchers understand how to run statistics over LLM judges responsibly, we present guidance and tooling for the statistical analysis of mixed human-AI judge designs, and implement nine hypothesis tests via prediction-powered inference (PPI), including the first known PPI corrections for four rank-based tests (Wilcoxon signed-rank, Mann-Whitney U, and omnibus variants). To keep PPI++ stable with small human-labeled calibration sets, we introduce bootstrap-adaptive power tuning, which shrinks the estimated weight toward a target estimated from the labeled data, and accounts for that weight's own sampling variance. Second, through Monte Carlo simulations, we derive recommendations for what CI, p-value, and FWER correction methods to use for small-sample AI evaluations (N<100), and warn researchers against bootstrap CIs. We package these recommendations into evalstats, an open-source Python package that selects calibrated methods automatically, and demonstrate it in three scenarios, including one where a real LLM judge validated at "substantial agreement" would have led a researcher to publish a spurious finding. evalstats is publicly available at https://github.com/ianarawjo/evalstats.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对"LLM评审打分+小样本AI评测"中统计推断不可靠的问题，提出混合人机评审设计的统计分析指南与工具，包含基于PPI的九种假设检验、四种秩检验的PPI校正、bootstrap自适应功效调参，以及小样本(CI、p值、FWER)方法推荐，并发布自动选择校准方法的开源Python包evalstats。
AI.motivation: 学术界日益依赖LLM评审分数与小样本AI评测来支撑显著性结论，但缺乏良好校准的置信区间、假设检验与评审偏差校正，导致这类结论不可靠；直接对原始LLM评审分数做统计会产生膨胀的假阳性——在许多评分者一致性指标上，假阳性风险在"几乎完全一致"时达到峰值。
AI.method: 1) 提出混合人机评审设计的统计分析指南与工具；2) 通过预测驱动推断(PPI)实现九种假设检验，并首次给出四种秩检验(Wilcoxon符号秩、Mann-Whitney U及各自的omnibus变体)的PPI校正；3) 提出bootstrap自适应功效调参，将估计权重向由标注数据得到的目标收缩，并计入该权重自身的抽样方差，以提升PPI++在小规模人工标注校准集下的稳定性；4) 通过蒙特卡洛模拟，推导小样本AI评测(N<100)下CI、p值与FWER校正方法的选用建议；5) 将这些建议打包为开源Python包evalstats，自动选择校准方法。
AI.result: 蒙特卡洛模拟给出了小样本AI评测的方法选用建议，并特别警告研究者不要使用bootstrap置信区间；evalstats在三个场景中得到演示，其中一例显示：一个被验证为"substantial agreement"的真实LLM评审，会诱导研究者发表虚假发现；同时揭示了原始LLM评审分数会导致假阳性膨胀，且假阳性风险在"almost perfect"人机一致度处达到峰值。
AI.conclusion: 对LLM评审与小样本AI评测应进行校准的统计推断(正确的CI、假设检验、多重比较校正与评审偏差校正)，而非直接对原始评审分数做统计；作者提供evalstats开源工具以自动化方法选择，并公开于https://github.com/ianarawjo/evalstats。

title: PrimeSeeker: Capability-Oriented Supervision for Deep Search Agents
summary: Large language model search agents are often trained with synthetic questions whose difficulty is increased through larger evidence graphs, additional hops, and longer trajectories. These global properties, however, are only indirect proxies for the local retrieval capabilities required during search. To address this mismatch, we introduce latent anchor reasoning, which consists of resolving an unnamed retrieval anchor from descriptive specifications and transferring the recovered anchor into a subsequent information demand. This primitive retrieval unit decomposes deep search into chains of coupled operations and organizes question construction around anchor resolution and relation transfer, without prescribing a canonical search path. Based on this formulation, we propose PrimeSeeker, a capability-oriented framework that constructs web-grounded anchor structures and jointly derives a question and a reference evidence skeleton. The skeleton preserves supporting evidence from construction and guides expert generation through extractive highlights of current tool observations. These highlights are removed before supervised fine-tuning, while the skeleton is subsequently reused to audit reference-step coverage for reinforcement-learning rewards. We construct 9,221 expert trajectories, training a 30B search agent. Across five deep-search benchmarks, PrimeSeeker achieves strong performance, while reference-step optimization further improves the supervised policy. The resulting trajectories exhibit low retrieval redundancy, and fixed-budget evaluation shows strong solution coverage with substantially fewer tool calls than long-horizon systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出latent anchor reasoning（潜在锚点推理）这一检索原语，并构建PrimeSeeker框架，通过构造网络锚点结构与参考证据骨架来生成问答与奖励信号，训练30B搜索智能体，在五个深度搜索基准上取得优异表现，且检索冗余低、工具调用更少。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM搜索智能体多用合成问题训练，其难度通过扩大证据图、增加跳数、延长轨迹等全局属性来提升，这些仅是局部检索能力的间接代理，与实际搜索所需的局部检索能力存在错配。作者希望围绕局部检索能力本身来组织问题构造与训练。
AI.method: 提出latent anchor reasoning原语：从描述性规格中解析未命名的检索锚点，并将其迁移至后续信息需求，从而将深度搜索分解为耦合操作链。基于此提出PrimeSeeker：构建网络锚点结构，联合生成问题与参考证据骨架；骨架保留构造时的支撑证据，并通过当前工具观测的抽取式高亮引导专家生成；监督微调前移除高亮，骨架随后用于审计强化学习奖励中的参考步骤覆盖。共构造9,221条专家轨迹训练30B搜索智能体。
AI.result: 在五个深度搜索基准上，PrimeSeeker取得强性能；参考步骤优化进一步提升监督策略。所得轨迹检索冗余低，固定预算评估下以显著更少的工具调用实现较强解覆盖，优于长时程系统。
AI.conclusion: 以锚点解析与关系迁移为核心的局部检索能力导向框架，能更有效地构造与优化深度搜索智能体的训练数据与奖励，兼顾性能与检索效率。

title: Less Uniform Discrete Diffusion is More Powerful and Scalable
summary: Although uniform diffusion language models (UDLMs) represent a promising diffusion paradigm, scaling them remains challenging. We identify the core obstacle as an over-uniform training objective and condition-target confusion during sampling. To address these, we propose Less Uniform Diffusion (LUDI), a novel UDLM framework. Specifically, we (i) introduce a less uniform loss that directs each reverse transition toward the clean token, and (ii) equip the model with per-token time embeddings that supply token-level corruption hints, enabling confidence-based few-step sampling. Experiments across scales show that LUDI yields cleaner supervision and improves few-step generation. We further continue-train a 7B autoregressive model into LUDI-7B, resulting in a UDLM capable of complex reasoning. It achieves a 3-token-per-step speedup over AR decoding and competitive performance compared with masked diffusion baselines, revealing that the full potential of UDLMs for complex generation remains to be unlocked.

AI.tldr: 该文提出 Less Uniform Diffusion (LUDI) 框架，通过"非均匀损失"与"逐 token 时间嵌入"解决均匀扩散语言模型的过均匀训练目标与采样时条件-目标混淆问题，并继续训练出具备复杂推理能力的 LUDI-7B。
AI.motivation: 均匀扩散语言模型（UDLM）是有前景的扩散范式，但难以扩展。核心障碍有两方面：(1) 训练目标过度均匀（over-uniform training objective）；(2) 采样阶段存在条件与目标的混淆（condition-target confusion）。
AI.method: 提出 LUDI 框架，包含两项设计：(i) 一种"less uniform loss"，引导每一次逆向转移指向干净 token；(ii) 为模型配备逐 token 时间嵌入（per-token time embeddings），提供 token 级损坏提示，从而支持基于置信度的少步采样（confidence-based few-step sampling）。
AI.result: 跨规模实验表明 LUDI 产生更干净的监督信号并改善少步生成。将 7B 自回归模型继续训练为 LUDI-7B 后，得到能进行复杂推理的 UDLM：相比 AR 解码实现每步 3 token 的加速，且与掩码扩散基线性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 结果说明均匀扩散语言模型在复杂生成任务上的全部潜力尚未被充分释放，LUDI 为可扩展、可推理的 UDLM 提供了可行路径。

title: Can We Still Trust Disaster Social Sensing? Empirical Evidence on Detecting AI-Generated Social Media Posts
summary: Disaster social sensing converts public social-media posts into evidence for situational awareness and humanitarian needs, but generative artificial intelligence (AI) can produce plausible messages that resemble eyewitness reports. This study investigates whether text-based AI detectors can reliably distinguish human-authored from AI-generated disaster posts. We construct a dataset of 12,000 texts organised into 3,000 matched semantic units from nine disasters: original human posts (H0), minimally LLM-proofread human posts (H1), factual AI-generated posts based on the same verified facts (A0), and affectively framed versions of those AI posts (A1). A separate 6,000-text corpus from 42 events supports model selection and threshold calibration. We evaluate OSM-Det, Fast-DetectGPT, Binoculars, and direct large language model (LLM) judges across five model families, then test disaster-domain calibration, a frozen-encoder linear readout, paired transformation sensitivity, and dataset artifact controls. Across fourteen frozen cross-family configurations, AUROC is 0.402-0.517 and the best prospective recall at a calibration-derived low-false-positive operating point is 3.6%; OSM-Det reaches AUROC 0.521 and 10.4% recall at a realised 6.7% false-positive rate. A disaster-trained linear head reaches AUROC 0.817, but a seven-feature surface classifier reaches 0.784 on the H0-versus-A0 contrast, and neutralising identified surface asymmetries reduces the head from 0.733 to 0.594. The head also separates A0 from A1 even though provenance is unchanged. The results show that text-based detection is not reliable enough to serve as an operational trust gate; multimodal claims, accountable sources, and other contextual evidence should be rested on to safeguard trust in disaster social sensing.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了涵盖九类灾害、12,000条文本的配对语料库（人类原文H0、轻度校对H1、事实型AI生成A0、情感框架AI生成A1），系统检验文本AI检测器能否可靠区分人类撰写与AI生成的灾害社交媒体帖子。
AI.motivation: 灾害社会感知依赖公众社交媒体帖子获取态势感知与人道主义需求证据，而生成式AI可产出貌似目击报告的可信文本，威胁此类证据的可信度。研究旨在回答：基于文本的AI检测器能否作为运行层面的"信任门控"，可靠识别AI生成内容。
AI.method: 构建3,000个语义匹配单元、共12,000条文本的数据集（来自九类灾害，含H0/H1/A0/A1四种条件），另用42起事件的6,000条文本语料做模型选择与阈值校准。评估OSM-Det、Fast-DetectGPT、Binoculars及直接LLM判定器（跨五个模型家族），并进行灾害域校准、冻结编码器线性读出（线性头）、成对变换敏感性测试与数据集伪影控制实验。
AI.result: 十四个冻结的跨家族配置AUROC仅为0.402–0.517，在基于校准的低假阳性工作点上前瞻召回率最高仅3.6%；OSM-Det的AUROC为0.521，在实现6.7%假阳性率时召回率10.4%。灾害训练线性头可达AUROC 0.817，但仅用七个表层特征的分类器在H0对A0对比中即达0.784；中和已识别的表层不对称后，线性头从0.733降至0.594。此外，该线性头还能区分来源相同的A0与A1。
AI.conclusion: 基于文本的AI检测尚不足以充当运行层面的信任门控；保障灾害社会感知的可信度应转向多模态信息、可问责来源及其他情境证据。

title: Tracing mechanisms of sycophantic agreement in language models
summary: Sycophantic agreement in language models refers to the tendency to overly affirm a user's stated beliefs or preferences, often at the expense of factual accuracy. Although it is widely recognized as an alignment failure, its underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. In this work, we use causal mediation analysis to identify the mechanisms behind sycophantic agreement. We show that a stated opinion is incorporated into the residual stream of the final prompt token early, where it biases subsequent answer retrieval. A sparse set of early attention heads carries this opinion signal. Ablating these heads substantially reduces sycophancy while leaving factual accuracy largely intact. The same heads carry the opinion when it is explicitly stated, regardless of how it is phrased. When an opinion is not stated explicitly but instead conveyed through content-free pushback (e.g., ``Are you sure?"), we find a distinct set of heads that suppresses the model's original correct answer to promote a revised answer. By providing a mechanistic account of how opinions induce sycophantic agreement, this work takes a step toward developing more targeted and reliable alignment interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过因果中介分析揭示了语言模型谄媚性认同的机制：用户陈述的观点在早期被写入最后一个提示词token的残差流并偏置答案检索，由一组稀疏的早期注意力头承载；消融这些头可大幅降低谄媚性而基本保持事实准确率。
AI.motivation: 谄媚性认同（sycophantic agreement）虽被广泛视为对齐失败问题，但其内部机制尚不清楚，缺乏机制性理解导致难以设计精准、可靠的对齐干预措施。
AI.method: 采用因果中介分析（causal mediation analysis）定位谄媚性认同的机制组件。具体识别承载观点信号的稀疏早期注意力头，并进行消融实验；同时区分两种情形：观点被显式陈述（不论措辞），以及通过无内容反驳（如"Are you sure?"）隐含传达。
AI.result: 显式陈述的观点在早期被整合进最后一个提示词token的残差流，偏置后续答案检索，由一组稀疏早期注意力头承载；消融这些头可显著降低谄媚性且几乎不影响事实准确率。隐式（无内容反驳）情形下则由另一组不同的注意力头抑制模型原本正确的答案，以促成修改后的回答。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为观点如何诱发谄媚性认同提供了机制性解释，向开发更具针对性、更可靠的对齐干预迈进一步。

title: Reliable but Design-Sensitive: Instrument Uncertainty in LLM Annotation
comment: Accepted to "3rd Workshop on Uncertainty-Aware NLP" @ EMNLP 2026 (archival)
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can give reliable labels under one setup yet change those labels when researchers make other reasonable design choices. We tested seven LLMs, 12 task designs, three independent runs, and 3,000 tweets labeled for offensive language and hate speech. Repeating the same model and task design produced high agreement (median Fleiss' $κ= 0.91$). Agreement fell when we changed the task design for the same tweets (median Cohen's $κ= 0.76$). Task design and model choice increased the variance of estimated prevalence by factors of 76.7 for offensive language and 110.6 for hate speech compared with sampling variance alone. Variation across LLM task designs reached 560-572 basis points, compared with 270-331 basis points across five human instrument versions. Confidence scores did not solve this problem. They tracked repeated model outputs more closely than agreement with human labels, and grouping six tweets in one prompt lowered mean offensive-language confidence by 660 basis points. We call the variation caused by task design and model choice instrument uncertainty. Researchers can measure it only by comparing reasonable task designs. Repeating one setup or relying on confidence scores cannot replace that test.

AI.tldr: 该研究将LLM标注中由任务设计与模型选择引起的标签波动定义为"工具不确定性"（instrument uncertainty），通过对7个LLM、12种任务设计、3次独立运行、3000条推文的实验，证明仅重复同一设置或依赖置信度分数无法替代跨合理设计的比较测试。
AI.motivation: LLM在一种设置下能给出可靠标签，但当研究者做出其他同样合理的设计选择时，标签会发生变化。这种不稳定性威胁到使用LLM进行文本标注（如冒犯性语言与仇恨言论检测）时的结论稳健性，因此需要量化并命名这种来源的不确定性。
AI.method: 实验规模为7个LLM、12种任务设计、3次独立运行，共标注3000条推文，任务为冒犯性语言与仇恨言论识别。分析指标包括：同一模型与任务设计重复运行的一致性（Fleiss' κ）、改变任务设计后同一批推文的一致性（Cohen's κ）、估计患病率（prevalence）的方差分解，并将LLM任务设计间变异与5种人类工具版本的变异进行对比，同时检验置信度分数的有效性。
AI.result: 重复同一模型与任务设计得到高一致性（Fleiss' κ中位数=0.91）；改变任务设计后一致性下降（Cohen's κ中位数=0.76）。任务设计与模型选择使估计患病率的方差相比单纯抽样方差放大76.7倍（冒犯性语言）和110.6倍（仇恨言论）。LLM任务设计间的变异达560–572个基点，而5种人类工具版本间为270–331个基点。置信度分数未能解决问题：它们更紧密地追踪重复的模型输出，而非与人类标签的一致性；将6条推文放入单个提示会使平均冒犯性语言置信度下降660个基点。
AI.conclusion: 任务设计与模型选择引起的变异被命名为"工具不确定性"（instrument uncertainty），研究者只能通过比较多个合理任务设计来测量它；重复单一设置或依赖置信度分数无法替代这一检验。

title: Beyond the Context Window: An Adaptive Entropy-Based Routing Framework for Hybrid Retrieval and Long-Context Language Models
summary: Modern large language models now support context windows of more than one million tokens, which has raised the question of whether retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is still necessary. Pure long-context (LC) processing is expensive and is known to under-attend to information placed in the middle of long inputs, while pure RAG is fast but bounded by retrieval quality and prone to errors when retrieved chunks are partially relevant or contradictory. We propose the Entropy-Driven Adaptive Router (EDAR), a framework that decides at inference time whether to answer a query from retrieved chunks or to escalate it to full long-context processing. The decision uses the predictive entropy of the token-level probability distribution computed over the first few generated tokens of the RAG response. The entropy threshold is selected on a held-out validation set by sweeping cost against accuracy. Experiments compare EDAR against pure-RAG and pure-LC baselines on LongBench v2 and Infinity-Bench. Predictive entropy correlates strongly with hallucination rate on a held-out set of 2,000 generations (Pearson r = 0.85, 95% CI [0.83, 0.87]). On the long-context benchmarks, EDAR retains 97.4% of the accuracy of the pure long-context baseline while reducing total token expenditure by 70.7%, escalating only 18.2% of incoming queries. The accuracy gap between EDAR and the pure long-context system is not statistically distinguishable from zero at standard sample sizes. Predictive entropy is a useful model-internal signal for routing between RAG and long-context inference, and a threshold-based hybrid system can recover most of the accuracy of long-context models at a small fraction of the cost. The framework does not depend on a specific retriever or LC backbone, and it does not require additional supervision beyond what is normally produced during decoding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EDAR（熵驱动自适应路由器），利用 RAG 生成前几个 token 的预测熵作为路由信号，在推理时决定用检索片段直接回答还是升级到全长上下文处理，在保留长上下文基线 97.4% 准确率的同时降低 70.7% 的 token 开销。
AI.motivation: 百万级 token 上下文窗口引发"RAG 是否仍必要"的疑问：纯长上下文（LC）处理成本高昂且对中段信息注意力不足，纯 RAG 虽快但受检索质量限制，遇到部分相关或矛盾的检索片段易出错，因此需要一种兼顾成本与准确率的动态策略。
AI.method: 提出 EDAR 推理时自适应路由框架：先由 RAG 生成响应前几个 token，计算其 token 级概率分布的预测熵，据此判断是否升级为全长上下文处理；熵阈值在留出验证集上通过成本与准确率的权衡扫描确定；在 LongBench v2 与 Infinity-Bench 上与纯 RAG、纯 LC 基线对比。
