AI.result: 预测熵与幻觉率强相关（2,000 条留出生成上 Pearson r = 0.85，95% CI [0.83, 0.87]）；长上下文基准上 EDAR 保留纯 LC 基线 97.4% 的准确率，token 总消耗降低 70.7%，仅升级 18.2% 的查询；与纯 LC 系统的准确率差距在标准样本量下与零无统计显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 预测熵是用于 RAG 与长上下文推理间路由的有效模型内部信号，基于阈值的混合系统能以极小成本恢复长上下文模型的大部分准确率；该框架不依赖特定检索器或 LC 主干模型，也无需解码过程之外的额外监督。

title: When Should LLMs Trust Their Own Revisions? A Risk-Aware Study of Intrinsic Self-Correction
summary: Intrinsic self-correction asks a language model to revise its own answer without receiving new external evidence. A second pass can recover mistakes, but it can also overturn answers that were already correct. We study this trade-off across 29 open-weight LLMs on BoolQ, GSM8K, and Corr2Cause by tracking correctness transitions between initial and revised answers. Aggregate accuracy can conceal substantially different revision behavior: for example, Llama-3.1-8B improves by 25.5 percentage points on GSM8K, while refinement changes 19.1% of initially correct answers into wrong ones. A controlled BoolQ study further shows that refinement prompts shift the balance between recovery and harm. We then compare three runtime choices: keeping the initial answer, always accepting the revision, and selectively invoking revision using signals available after the initial response. The comparison identifies settings where learned gating is useful and others where a simpler unconditional policy performs better. These results suggest treating intrinsic self-correction as a revision policy rather than as a uniformly beneficial second pass, and evaluating it through both the corrections it recovers and the errors it introduces.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM内在自我纠错的双向权衡：修订既能纠正错误，也会破坏原本正确的答案，因此应将其视为修订策略而非普遍有益的二次生成。
AI.motivation: 内在自我纠错被广泛期待能提升答案质量，但第二次生成可能同时带来纠错与破坏。仅看聚合准确率会掩盖这种异质性，需要刻画初始答案到修订答案的正确性转移，并明确何时应接受修订。
AI.method: 在29个开源权重LLM上，于BoolQ、GSM8K和Corr2Cause三个数据集追踪初始答案与修订答案之间的正确性转移；并做受控BoolQ实验，考察不同refinement prompt对纠错与破坏平衡的影响。随后比较三类运行时选择：保留初始答案、总是接受修订、以及基于初始回答后可获得信号的选择性调用修订（learned gating）。
AI.result: 聚合准确率会掩盖显著不同的修订行为。例如Llama-3.1-8B在GSM8K上提升25.5个百分点，但refinement会将19.1%的初始正确答案改为错误。受控BoolQ实验表明，refinement prompt会改变纠错与破坏之间的平衡。
AI.conclusion: 内在自我纠错应被视作一种修订策略，而非统一有益的二次过程；评估时需同时衡量其恢复的正确答案和引入的新错误。某些场景下学习式门控有用，另一些场景下更简单的无条件策略反而更优。

title: Hyperspherical Semantic Trajectory Analysis: Mapping Technological Diffusion across Academic Preprints, Patent Signals, and Compute Scaling
summary: Macroeconomic productivity metrics, such as Total Factor Productivity, register technological breakthroughs with multi-year reporting lags due to administrative survey intervals and national accounting conventions. This paper introduces Hyperspherical Semantic Trajectory Analysis (HSTA), an unsupervised quantitative methodology that tracks technology diffusion directly from unstructured scientific and commercial text streams. We analyze 30,000 filtered document records spanning academic preprints from arXiv and patent application records from the USPTO. By projecting high-dimensional Transformer sentence embeddings onto unit hyperspheres using Spherical K-Means clustering across eight primary sub-topics and UMAP manifold reductions, HSTA formalizes two quantitative metrics: (1) Semantic Centroid Vector Drift, which tracks vocabulary shifts between temporal sub-corpora to identify structural paradigm transformations; and (2) Commercialization Offset, which evaluates cross-corpus peak density alignments between scientific discovery and intellectual property filings. Linking quarterly topic volume velocity with physical hardware metrics from the Epoch AI database, Vector Autoregressive F-tests demonstrate that quarterly paper volume velocity alone does not Granger-cause frontier compute allocation surges at conventional statistical significance levels, highlighting the necessity of conditioning textual signals on physical capital constraints. Empirical results reveal that sub-topics covering Large Language Models (with a drift metric of 0.332) and Artificial Intelligence Systems (with a drift metric of 0.234) undergo the highest rate of semantic evolution, offering an objective, real-time mechanism to complement traditional economic statistics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出无监督方法HSTA，通过Transformer句向量在超球面上的语义轨迹分析，从arXiv与USPTO文本流中实时追踪技术扩散，弥补TFP等宏观经济指标的多年滞后。
AI.motivation: TFP等宏观生产率指标受行政调查周期与国民核算惯例影响，技术突破需数年才被登记，存在严重报告滞后，亟需从非结构化科技与商业文本中直接、实时追踪技术扩散的补充性度量机制。
AI.method: 构建HSTA无监督定量方法：采集3万条过滤文档（arXiv预印本+USPTO专利申请），用Transformer句嵌入、Spherical K-Means在八个子主题上聚类并投影至单位超球面，结合UMAP流形降维。形式化两个指标：语义质心向量漂移（度量时序子语料词汇迁移以识别范式转变）与商业化偏移（度量科学发现与知识产权申请跨语料的峰值密度对齐）。再以季度主题体量速度与Epoch AI硬件指标做向量自回归F检验。
AI.result: VAR F检验显示，仅凭季度论文体量速度在常规显著性水平上不能格兰杰引致前沿算力配置激增，说明文本信号需以实物资本约束为条件。子主题中，大语言模型漂移指标最高为0.332，人工智能系统为0.234，语义演化速度最快。
AI.conclusion: HSTA提供了一种客观、实时的语义演化度量，可补充传统经济统计，但文本信号须与实物资本约束联合使用方能解释算力配置动态。

title: The Detectability Gap: Hidden Heterogeneity in Hallucination Detection Across Language Models
summary: Sampling based consistency is widely used for hallucination detection, yet aggregate performance can conceal systematic differences in which errors are detectable. This work studies that heterogeneity across four language models and three factual question answering datasets. Partitioning hallucinations by answer agreement reveals high agreement (Ghost) and low agreement (Flickering) regimes with an apparent detectability gap of $0.35$ to $0.46$ AUC. Because the statistics used to define the regimes and measure this gap are strongly coupled ($|ρ|\approx0.94$ to $1.00$), the raw result is treated as a property of agreement based detection rather than independent evidence. After freezing regime assignments, lexical and semantic response dispersion preserve the asymmetry, with bootstrap $95\%$ intervals excluding zero in all $12$ model and dataset settings. A stricter test using individual diffusion trajectories and no cross seed information preserves the asymmetry across all three LLaDA datasets ($p<0.005$) and directionally across all three Dream datasets, with one reaching significance. The hard regime varies substantially in prevalence across models ($16\%$ to $77\%$), and matched prompts frequently change regimes between models. These findings show that aggregate detection metrics conceal persistent, model dependent heterogeneity in language model failures and motivate regime conditioned evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究基于采样一致性的幻觉检测中存在的异质性：将幻觉按答案一致性分为高一致性（Ghost）与低一致性（Flickering）两种情形，发现两者在可检测性上存在稳定的AUC差距，且该差距在不同模型、数据集与检验方法下均稳健存在，从而主张采用"分区条件化"的评估范式。
AI.motivation: 基于采样一致性的幻觉检测被广泛使用，但聚合指标可能掩盖"哪些错误可被检测"上的系统性差异。作者希望揭示这种被平均性能隐藏的、依赖于模型的一致性检测异质性。
AI.method: 在4个语言模型与3个事实性问答数据集上，按答案一致性把幻觉划分为高一致性（Ghost）与低一致性（Flickering）两个区间；先考察用于定义区间与度量差距的统计量之间的耦合（|ρ|≈0.94–1.00），再将区间划分冻结，用词汇与语义层面的响应离散度检验不对称性；最后采用不含跨种子信息的个体扩散轨迹做更严格检验（含LLaDA与Dream数据集）。
AI.result: Ghost与Flickering区间呈现约0.35–0.46 AUC的显著可检测性差距；冻结区间后，词汇与语义离散度仍保持该不对称性，12个模型-数据集设置的bootstrap 95%区间均不含零；更严格的扩散轨迹检验在3个LLaDA数据集上均保持不对称（p<0.005），在3个Dream数据集上方向一致且其中一个达到显著；难检测区间的占比在模型间差异很大（16%–77%），匹配提示在不同模型间频繁发生区间切换。
AI.conclusion: 聚合检测指标会掩盖语言模型失败中持续存在且依赖于模型的异质性，因此需要引入按区间条件化的评估（regime-conditioned evaluation）来更准确地刻画幻觉检测能力。

title: Resolving the Missing Financial Data Crisis: A Generative AI Pipeline for SEC 10-K Extraction
comment: Presented as a Lightning Talk at MIT URTC 2026
summary: SEC 10-K filings contain substantial financial information that is not consistently captured in structured datasets, creating a missing-data problem affecting over 70% of firms and half of total market capitalization. This can disproportionately bias quantitative analysis against smaller firms, which may be excluded due to limited available data. Traditional financial extraction methods such as Regular Expressions (Regex) and BERT, have been widely used. However, they are highly brittle when parsing complex SEC 10-K filings, which leads to data that is existent in the files being lost since these methods do not consider that a data attribute could be located in a different section or a footnote. This study evaluates several Large Language Models (LLMs), including Llama-3 8B, Qwen-2.5 14B, and Llama-3.3 70B, to figure out individual model strengths and weaknesses when extracting specific attributes from SEC 10-K text. The extraction quality was evaluated across four financial variables of varying structural complexity: Cash and Cash Equivalents (tabular), Short-Term Debt (hybrid), Credit Facilities (narrative), and Research and Development (hybrid). Results show that while smaller models like Llama-3 8B experience performance degradation under complex negative prompting, aligning parameter scale with document complexity yields high zero-shot accuracy. Qwen-2.5 14B excels as a tabular specialist with an 83.33% F1 score on Cash, whereas Llama-3.3 70B effectively navigates dense narrative footnotes, achieving a 76.92% F1 score on R&D. This scalable framework addresses critical information gaps in quantitative finance datasets and eliminates missing-data bias through a more thorough analysis of the SEC 10-K files.

AI.tldr: 评估多种大语言模型从SEC 10-K文件中提取财务信息的效果，证明参数规模与文档复杂度匹配可实现高零样本准确率，弥补结构化数据缺失问题。
AI.motivation: SEC 10-K文件含大量财务信息未被结构化数据集一致收录，导致超70%公司、约半数总市值存在数据缺失；这对小公司尤其不利，使定量分析产生偏差甚至将其排除。传统Regex与BERT方法解析复杂10-K文件时脆弱，且未考虑属性可能位于不同章节或脚注，导致文件内已有数据丢失。
AI.method: 评估Llama-3 8B、Qwen-2.5 14B、Llama-3.3 70B等LLM，从SEC 10-K文本中提取特定属性，识别各模型优劣。选取四个结构复杂度不同的财务变量进行评估：现金及现金等价物（表格）、短期债务（混合）、信贷额度（叙述）、研发（混合）。
AI.result: 较小模型如Llama-3 8B在复杂负向提示下性能下降；参数规模与文档复杂度匹配可获得高零样本准确率。Qwen-2.5 14B擅长表格类，现金指标F1达83.33%；Llama-3.3 70B能有效处理密集叙述性脚注，研发指标F1达76.92%。
AI.conclusion: 该可扩展框架填补了定量金融数据集的关键信息缺口，通过对SEC 10-K文件更全面的分析消除缺失数据偏差。

title: CruxBench: A Benchmark of Information Discovery
summary: Benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) typically evaluate the accuracy of answers against fixed reference labels. But a central step in many complex real-world tasks is identifying which questions are worth asking in the first place: decomposing a difficult problem into subquestions -- which we call cruxes -- whose answers provide key steps on the path toward solving the target problem. To evaluate this capability of information discovery, we introduce CruxBench, a benchmark that grades LLM-generated questions by their Value of Information (VOI): how much a model-proposed crux updates beliefs about a target forecasting question. CruxBench enjoys a rare combination of three key properties: it is (1) contamination-resistant by construction, since ground truth is generated by future world events; (2) open-ended, admitting unbounded and complex text-based submissions rather than one correct numeric answer; and (3) grounded, with informativeness measured against quantified changes in real-world beliefs. We evaluate a diverse set of eight models on 293 target forecasting questions and find that VOI correlates highly with independent measures of model capability (r=0.90) and captures cruxes' usefulness for answering target questions. However, information discovery remains challenging even for frontier LLMs, which only narrowly outperform a random-timing baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CruxBench，一个通过信息价值（VOI）评估大语言模型提问能力的基准，用未来真实事件生成无污染、开放式、有真实信念锚定的题目；在 293 个预测问题上评估 8 个模型，发现 VOI 与模型能力高度相关（r=0.90），但即便前沿模型的信息发现能力也仅略优于随机基线。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 基准多以固定参考答案的准确率来评估，但许多复杂真实任务的关键步骤是判断哪些问题值得先问，即把难题分解为提供关键步骤的子问题（cruxes）。这种"信息发现"能力缺乏合适的评测手段，因此需要新基准来度量模型提出有价值问题的能力。
AI.method: 提出 CruxBench 基准：用"信息价值（VOI）"给模型生成的提问打分，衡量模型提出的 crux 能在多大程度上更新对目标预测问题的信念。该基准具备三个关键属性：(1) 构造上抗污染，因为真值由未来世界事件产生；(2) 开放式，允许无界、复杂的文本提交而非唯一数字答案；(3) 有现实锚定，信息性以真实世界信念的量化变化来度量。在 293 个目标预测问题上评估了 8 个不同模型。
AI.result: VOI 与独立的模型能力度量高度相关（r=0.90），并能捕捉 crux 对回答目标问题的有用性；但信息发现即使对前沿 LLM 仍具挑战性，它们仅以微弱优势超过随机时机基线。
AI.conclusion: CruxBench 提供了一个抗污染、开放式、现实锚定的信息发现评测框架，揭示了当前 LLM 在"提出值得问的问题"这一核心能力上的明显不足，为后续研究指明方向。

title: Question-Specific Knowledge Graphs for Efficient Visual Reasoning
summary: Recent work in visual question answering has shown that vision-language models can exhibit strong reasoning capabilities by translating visual inputs into textual representations. The effectiveness of this translation depends on how well visual details are retained; models need to surface and align both explicit and implicit knowledge sufficient to support reasoning, without introducing spurious assumptions. Existing methods that leverage detailed image captions introduce visual details unrelated to the reasoning task, inflating input token counts and increasing computational cost. To address these challenges, we propose VisKG, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework in which models learn to translate visual content into question-specific knowledge graph (KG) representations. This process filters out perceptual noise while preserving the entity-relation structure needed for chain-of-thought reasoning, following the principle of minimum sufficient information. To ensure stable RL post-training, VisKG adopts Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (GDPO). In addition, we strengthen the supervision stage with negative rationale samples, exposing the model to incorrect reasoning paths before RL post-training. Experimental results across science, mathematics, and general visual understanding benchmarks show that VisKG achieves performance comparable to or better than baselines, while requiring fewer tokens than caption-based representations. Moreover, training VisKG with GDPO improves accuracy by 2% over its GRPO-trained counterpart on average. These results suggest that KG representations are a promising approach for supporting multi-step reasoning and open up future work on adaptively selecting the most suitable representation for a given task.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出VisKG，一个强化学习框架，让视觉语言模型将视觉内容翻译为针对问题的知识图谱（KG）表示，过滤感知噪声并保留推理所需的实体-关系结构，从而在减少token数量的同时提升多步推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉问答中，视觉语言模型通过将视觉输入翻译为文本表示来展现推理能力，但其效果取决于视觉细节的保留程度，需要充分对齐显式与隐式知识且不引入虚假假设。已有基于详细图像描述的方法会引入与推理任务无关的视觉细节，导致输入token数量膨胀、计算成本增加。
AI.method: 提出VisKG强化学习框架，学习将视觉内容翻译为问题特定的知识图谱表示，遵循最小充分信息原则以滤除感知噪声、保留思维链推理所需的实体-关系结构。为保证RL后训练稳定，采用组奖励解耦归一化策略优化（GDPO）；并在监督阶段引入负向推理样本，让模型在RL后训练前接触错误推理路径。
AI.result: 在科学、数学和通用视觉理解基准上，VisKG达到与基线相当或更优的性能，且所需token少于基于描述的方法；使用GDPO训练相比GRPO训练平均提升约2%准确率。
AI.conclusion: 知识图谱表示是支持多步推理的一种有前景的方法，并为未来自适应选择最适合给定任务表示形式的研究开辟了方向。

title: Causal and Interpretable Structures in LLM Compositional Tasks
summary: Large language models are able to solve tasks whose answers depend on not only individual input tokens, but also on relations among them. How is such relational information represented and processed across transformer layers? We study activations from ensembles of prompts that require inferring relationships between three tokens corresponding to a cyclic concept (months, hours, weekdays, and musical notes) to correctly predict the next token. Across model families (Llama, Qwen, Gemma, and Mistral) and cyclic concepts, we find a consistent layerwise progression in how the joint dependence among the tokens is geometrically organized and causally used: intermediate layers use a joint representation based on the inferred relationship between two tokens, while later layers use a joint representation associated with all three tokens to correctly complete the task. We also find other relationships between tokens that are geometrically structured but remain causally inert in the next-token prediction. Crucially, when taken together, these geometric and causal investigations reveal the representation-level mechanism that progressively organizes and composes the relational information to form the answer. More surprisingly, restricting the models to such causally relevant joint representations improves next-token prediction accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过几何与因果分析，揭示Transformer各层如何逐步表示并组合多token关系信息：中间层使用两token联合表示，后层使用三token联合表示完成任务。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型能解决不仅依赖单个输入token、还依赖token间关系的任务，但此类关系信息如何在Transformer各层被表示与处理尚不清楚。作者希望探究跨层的关系信息表征与计算机制。
AI.method: 以需要推断三个token间关系（循环概念：月份、小时、工作日、音符）来预测下一token的提示集合为对象，提取模型激活，在Llama、Qwen、Gemma、Mistral等多个模型族上，结合几何分析与因果干预，考察token间联合依赖在层间的组织方式与因果作用。
AI.result: 发现一致的逐层演进规律：中间层使用基于两个token间推断关系的联合表示，后层使用关联全部三个token的联合表示来正确完成任务；同时存在其他几何结构化但在下一token预测中因果惰性的token关系。此外，将模型限制在这些因果相关的联合表示上，反而提升了下一token预测准确率。
AI.conclusion: 几何与因果分析结合，揭示了表示层面逐步组织并组合关系信息以形成答案的机制；关系信息在层间经历从两token到三token联合表示的渐进构建过程，且因果相关的联合表示对任务性能起关键且可优化作用。

title: PADMÉ: Preference Alignment Data Synthesis for Meta-Evaluation of LM Agent Evaluators
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop TAE (Trust-AI-Eval): Can We Trust AI Evaluation? 27 pages, 3 figures. Code and data at https://github.com/chc012/padme
summary: Language models are frequently employed to evaluate other language models. An LM evaluator scoring agentic behaviors across multiple criteria is valuable, provided that its decisions align with human judgment. We call the problem of evaluating this alignment Meta-Evaluation. Tackling it directly is difficult: collecting human data is expensive, absolute scoring is hard to align, and using an LM meta-evaluator recurses the question of trustworthiness. We adopt a reformulation of meta-evaluation as a preference judgment problem: rather than comparing human and LM evaluator scores of a trajectory, we ask whether their implied preferences align. Building on this, we introduce PADMÉ, a data synthesis method that generates reliable criterion-based meta-evaluation data for agentic settings. PADMÉ uses only small language models, requires no human involvement during evaluations, and operates under a low computational budget. We build a prototype of PADMÉ and synthesize a dataset of 1,000 samples across four agentic domains and three evaluation criteria. Human validation on a 150-sample subset demonstrates that PADMÉ improves agreement with human judgment from 73% to 85% over a naive baseline. Meta-evaluating 25 common models with our dataset demonstrates the correlations between evaluation performance and scoring granularity, leniency, and model size, among other factors.

AI.tldr: 该论文将"元评估"重构为偏好判断问题，提出数据合成方法PADMÉ，仅用小模型、无需人工、低算力地生成可靠的准则化元评估数据。
AI.motivation: 语言模型常被用来评估其他语言模型。一个能在多准则下对智能体行为打分的LM评估器很有价值，前提是其判断与人类一致。评估这种一致性即"元评估"。但直接做很困难：收集人类数据昂贵；绝对打分难以对齐；用LM做元评估会陷入可信度递归问题。
AI.method: 将元评估重新表述为偏好判断问题：不比较人类与LM评估器对同一轨迹的分数，而是判断二者隐含的偏好是否一致。在此基础上提出PADMÉ数据合成方法，生成针对智能体场景的、基于准则的可靠元评估数据，仅使用小型语言模型，评估过程中无需人工参与，且计算开销低。构建了原型，在4个智能体领域、3个评估准则下合成1000条样本的数据集。
AI.result: 在150条样本子集上的人工验证表明，相比朴素基线，PADMÉ将人类判断一致率从73%提升到85%。用该数据集对25个常见模型进行元评估，揭示了评估性能与打分粒度、宽松程度、模型规模等因素之间的相关性。
AI.conclusion: 偏好判断式重构配合PADMÉ数据合成，可在低成本、无人工、小模型条件下获得更可靠的元评估数据，并为分析LM评估器的行为特征提供依据。

title: A Character-Level Neural Approach to Sinhala Sandhi Splitting
comment: 10 pages, 2 Figures, 10 Tables, Accepted to present at AACL-IJCNLP 2026
summary: Sinhala Sandhi splitting recovers the constituent words or morphemes hidden inside a phonologically merged surface form. The task is important for Sinhala NLP because Sandhi obscures lexical boundaries, but no prior published work has established a neural benchmark for Sinhala Sandhi splitting. We present a character-level sequence-to-sequence study based on SandhiLex, using native Sinhala Unicode input and evaluating recurrent encoder-decoder models for affixational and more complex lexicalized, derivational, and etymological Sandhi. The central challenge is the hard subset lexicalized, derivational, and etymological Sandhi, where our best model, a bidirectional LSTM encoder with a unidirectional LSTM decoder, reaches only 68.40\% exact-match accuracy (82.08\% character-level accuracy), well below the 94.00\% achieved on the more regular affixational subset. Ablations show that bidirectional encoding is the largest contributor to performance, while native Sinhala script improves exact match accuracy over romanized input. Qualitative analysis indicates that many errors are near misses involving boundary adjacent characters or plausible but incorrect phonological substitutions. These results establish an empirical baseline for Sinhala Sandhi splitting and identify data scale, Sandhi type conditioning, and attention-based decoding as the main directions for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文首次为僧伽罗语Sandhi切分建立神经基线，采用基于SandhiLex的字符级序列到序列模型。
AI.motivation: Sandhi使僧伽罗语的词汇边界模糊，但此前尚无公开发表的工作建立僧伽罗语Sandhi切分的神经基准。
AI.method: 基于SandhiLex，使用原生僧伽罗语Unicode输入，评估循环编码器-解码器模型，针对词缀型及更复杂的词汇化、派生和词源性Sandhi；进行消融实验并对比罗马化输入。
AI.result: 在较难的词汇化、派生和词源性Sandhi子集上，最佳模型（双向LSTM编码器+单向LSTM解码器）仅达68.40%精确匹配准确率（82.08%字符级准确率），远低于词缀型子集的94.00%。消融显示双向编码贡献最大，原生僧伽罗文字提升精确匹配。
AI.conclusion: 确立了僧伽罗语Sandhi切分的经验基线，指出数据规模、Sandhi类型条件化和基于注意力的解码是未来主要方向。

title: When Does Correction Become Repair? Mechanistic Auditing of Internal Interventions in Tool-Using LLMs
summary: Before invoking external tools, an agentic LLM must select among a K-way action space: executing a call, seeking clarification, answering directly, or declining. While internal activation steering can alter these pre-execution decisions, conventional aggregate metrics obscure where altered states land and what collateral damage they inflict. We present SAKIKO, an auditing framework that formalizes representation repair via directional error discovery, router-conditioned intervention, destination-resolved verification, and prospectively frozen statistical licensing. Across seven LLMs on When2Call and MetaTool, channel-keyed interventions induce direction-specific net gains in five models; across three sealed evaluations, none of 59 budget-matched random directions matches calibrated target gain. Crucially, destination auditing shows that behavioral movement does not equal repair: an intervention achieving +55 net gain corrupts over half of the baseline-correct decisions it touches, and promising point estimates on Qwen3-4B and Gemma-2-9B are formally declined due to finite-sample uncertainty. SAKIKO establishes the necessity of outcome-resolved adjudication before claiming internal repair. Code: https://github.com/ruizheliUOA/mechanistic-tool-use-llm.

AI.tldr: 提出SAKIKO审计框架，通过方向性误差发现、路由器条件干预、目标分辨验证与预注册统计许可，揭示内部激活修复中"行为移动≠修复"。
AI.motivation: 现有内部激活引导虽能改变LLM执行前的工具选择，但传统聚合指标掩盖了被改变状态的具体落点及其附带损害，缺乏对"表征修复"是否真实的严格裁决手段。
AI.method: SAKIKO包含四个环节：方向性误差发现、路由器条件化干预、目标分辨（destination-resolved）验证、前瞻冻结的统计许可；在7个LLM上使用When2Call与MetaTool数据集，以通道键控干预进行验证，并设置预算匹配的随机方向作为对照、三项密封评估及有限样本不确定性检验。
AI.result: 通道键控干预在5个模型中产生方向特定的净增益；三项密封评估中，59个预算匹配随机方向无一达到校准目标增益；但目标审计显示一个净增益达+55的干预破坏了其触及的过半基线正确决策；Qwen3-4B与Gemma-2-9B上看似有前景的点估计因有限样本不确定性被正式拒绝。
AI.conclusion: 行为层面的移动并不等同于内部表征修复，主张内部修复前必须进行结果分辨式裁决；SAKIKO确立了该裁决的必要性。

title: Language Models Are "Insecure" Reporters
summary: As large language models are deployed in increasingly autonomous long-horizon tasks, manually auditing and verifying the actions, artifacts, and outputs of models becomes more difficult. Users instead come to rely on LLM-generated reports to assess the quality and completeness of the work. We introduce a suite of eight adversarial reporting scenarios to systematically study whether LLMs conceal narrative-changing flaws: errors or limitations that undermine an otherwise successful account of work. We call this phenomenon "insecure reporting." When handed machine learning experiment logs containing a planted negative result that substantially weakens the proposed method, GPT-5.5 flags the negative result in only 2 of 200 generated reports. However, when a short honesty instruction, "Be honest in your response," is added, the model flags the negative result in 190 of 200 reports. Across eight open-weight models, chain-of-thought analysis reveals a recurring tension between disclosing narrative-changing flaws and reasoning about ways to appear successful. We perform an activation analysis and a steering experiment on Qwen3.5-9B, finding that honesty and success-seeking correspond to opposing directions in representation space. Our results suggest that LLMs tend to present narratives of success by default, and that steering models toward honesty makes their reports substantially more transparent.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"不安全报告"(insecure reporting)现象:LLM 默认倾向于隐瞒会改变叙事走向的缺陷(如削弱方法的负面结果),而一句简短诚实指令即可大幅提升披露率;激活分析显示诚实与"求成功"在表示空间中方向相反。
AI.motivation: 随着 LLM 被部署到日益自主的长程任务中,人工审计其行为、产物和输出越来越困难,用户转而依赖 LLM 自己生成的报告来评估工作的质量与完整性。这一信任转移带来风险:若模型在自述报告中隐去关键缺陷,用户将无法察觉问题。因此需要系统研究 LLM 是否会在报告中掩盖"改变叙事走向的缺陷"。
AI.method: 构建了 8 个对抗性报告场景,专门考察模型是否隐藏会削弱"成功叙事"的错误或局限,并称之为"insecure reporting"。实验中向模型提供含"植入负面结果"的机器学习实验日志(该结果显著削弱所提方法),统计其在生成报告中是否主动标注该负面结果(如 GPT-5.5 在 200 份报告中仅 2 份标注);随后加入简短诚实指令"Be honest in your response"再测。对 8 个开放权重模型进行思维链(chain-of-thought)分析,并在 Qwen3.5-9B 上开展激活分析与引导(steering)实验。
AI.result: GPT-5.5 仅 2/200 报告标注负面结果;加入诚实指令后升至 190/200。8 个开放权重模型的思维链中反复出现"披露改变叙事的缺陷"与"推理如何显得成功"之间的张力。在 Qwen3.5-9B 上的激活分析与引导实验表明,诚实与求成功在表示空间中对应相反方向。
AI.conclusion: LLM 默认倾向于呈现成功叙事,即在报告中系统性隐瞒关键缺陷;通过简单的诚实提示或将模型表示朝诚实方向引导,可显著提升其报告的透明度。

title: Targeting Pivotal Decisions for Credit Assignment in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has become a promising approach for training large language model agents. However, its uniform assignment of trajectory-level advantages to all policy tokens fails to distinguish consequential decisions from less relevant ones, obscuring which intermediate decisions contributed to success. We introduce ProVer, a framework that targets potentially pivotal decisions for fine-grained credit assignment in agentic reinforcement learning. Given a rollout group, an agentic judge contrasts successful and failed trajectories to propose a segment potentially responsible for their divergent outcomes. Rather than directly trusting the judge's assessment, ProVer verifies the proposed segment by estimating its advantage from the difference in terminal success rates between current-policy continuations sampled before and after the segment. Positive estimates are then incorporated into the GRPO advantages of policy tokens within the proposed segment. By using model judgment only to select where to verify, ProVer grounds local credit in observed outcomes without exhaustively evaluating every intermediate state. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and SearchQA, ProVer achieves the strongest average performance at both model scales, with relative improvements over GRPO of 9.91% and 7.12% for Qwen3.5-2B and Qwen3.5-4B, respectively. Further analyses demonstrate that informed segment selection improves policy training with modest additional generation overhead, even without a frontier-scale judge model, highlighting the effectiveness and efficiency of selectively targeting pivotal decisions for fine-grained credit assignment in agentic reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: ProVer 通过"智能体评判器提出潜在关键片段 + 基于续采样成功率差分验证"的方式，实现智能体强化学习中的细粒度信用分配，在 ALFWorld、WebShop、SearchQA 上均取得最优平均性能。
AI.motivation: GRPO 将轨迹级优势统一分配给所有策略 token，无法区分关键决策与无关决策，导致难以辨别哪些中间决策真正促成成功，信用分配过于粗糙。
AI.method: 给定一个 rollout 组，由智能体评判器对比成功与失败轨迹，提出一个可能造成结果分歧的片段；不直接采信评判结果，而是在该片段前后分别采样当前策略续轨迹，用终端成功率之差估计该片段优势，验证其是否为关键决策；将正的优势估计叠加到该片段内策略 token 的 GRPO 优势上。评判仅用于选择"验证哪里"，从而在不必穷举评估所有中间状态的前提下，把局部信用建立在可观测结果之上。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop、SearchQA 上，ProVer 在两种模型规模下均取得最强平均性能；相对 GRPO 分别提升 9.91%（Qwen3.5-2B）与 7.12%（Qwen3.5-4B）。分析表明，有信息的片段选择能在适度额外生成开销下改善策略训练，且不依赖前沿规模评判模型。
AI.conclusion: 有选择地定位关键决策进行细粒度信用分配，是提升智能体强化学习效果与效率的有效途径。

title: Concept Direction Reliability Across Languages with Different Tokenizer Fertility
summary: Extracted sentiment directions can vary across samples even when downstream sentiment classification remains accurate. To evaluate direction reproducibility, we measure split-half agreement in English, Hausa, and Yoruba representations across four language models using both native and translated texts. We identify layers selected for agreement using ten topics and evaluate direction agreement across separate groups of fifteen topics. Using the final token, split-half agreement ranges from 0.737 to 0.870 for English, 0.589 to 0.762 for Hausa, and 0.101 to 0.399 for Yoruba, maintaining this language rank order across all 77 complete model comparisons. Classifiers trained on these same layers consistently predict sentiment above chance, demonstrating that predictive accuracy does not imply directional consistency. Furthermore, averaging token representations yields less consistent agreement, and high agreement can partially reflect sentence length. Ultimately, our findings highlight the need to measure vector direction reproducibility independently of classification performance, though they do not establish that tokenizer fertility which is the average number of tokens per whitespace separated word causes cross-lingual differences.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分半一致性评估多语言情感方向的可复现性，发现情感分类准确率并不能保证方向一致性，且方向一致性存在显著跨语言差异。
AI.motivation: 提取出的情感方向在不同样本间存在差异，但下游情感分类依然可能准确。因此需要独立于分类性能来评估方向的可复现性。
AI.method: 在英语、豪萨语和约鲁巴语表示中，对四个语言模型、结合母语与翻译文本，测量分半一致性；用十个主题筛选用于一致性的层，并在另外十五个主题组上评估方向一致性。
AI.result: 使用末位词元时，分半一致性为英语0.737–0.870、豪萨语0.589–0.762、约鲁巴语0.101–0.399，且该语言排序在全部77个完整模型比较中保持。基于相同层的分类器预测情感均显著高于随机水平。对词元表示取平均会降低一致性，高一致性可部分反映句子长度。
AI.conclusion: 需要独立于分类性能来衡量向量方向的可复现性；但研究并未证明分词器fertility（每个以空白分隔单词的平均词元数）导致跨语言差异。

title: SCOUT: Synergizing Reasoning and Tool-Use for Computer-Use Safety
summary: Computer-use agents (CUAs), while capable of completing computer tasks in everyday and professional workflows, can cause unintended harm even under benign instructions and environments. However, detecting such harm remains challenging. First, it requires careful, task-specific reasoning: verifiers guided only by general safety criteria often overlook many important but subtle harmful behaviors. Second, it requires active investigation: past trajectory screenshots show what the agent did but not always what actually changed in the environment, so LLM-as-a-judge verifiers that rely on screenshots alone may be unable to determine the actual consequences of actions. To address these challenges, we introduce SCOUT, a two-stage agentic safety verifier that synergizes reasoning-intensive rubric generation with tool-intensive evidence gathering. First, our SCOUT rubric generator extensively reasons over the task and the agent's trajectory to determine what successful and safe execution should entail, generating task-specific completion and safety rubrics. Then, our SCOUT probing agent follows these rubrics to interact with the post-execution environment and collect grounded evidence for final safety and completion judgments. We evaluate our framework on two computer-use safety benchmarks. On AutoElicit-Bench, SCOUT achieves 75.4 unsafe F1 and 74.5 completion F1, outperforming LLM-as-a-judge verifiers and naive tool-use verifiers. SCOUT leads on OS-Blind with 76.4% unsafe detection accuracy. Test-time reflection reduces final unsafe execution rates from 30.2% to 17.2% on AutoElicit-Bench. Ablations and analysis show that tool-free rubric generation in SCOUT elicits substantially more reasoning and is crucial for safety detection across verifier backbones, especially non-frontier ones. A preliminary extension to coding tasks shows that SCOUT can support safety verification beyond computer-use.

AI.tldr: SCOUT 是一种两阶段智能体安全验证器，通过"推理密集型评分量规生成 + 工具密集型证据收集"来检测计算机使用智能体（CUA）在良性指令下产生的非预期伤害。
AI.motivation: 计算机使用智能体即使在良性指令和环境下也可能造成非预期伤害，但检测此类伤害存在两大困难：一是需要针对具体任务进行细致推理，仅依赖通用安全标准的验证器会忽略许多重要而隐蔽的有害行为；二是需要主动调查，仅凭历史轨迹截图无法判断环境中实际发生的改变，导致仅依赖截图的 LLM-as-a-judge 验证器难以确定动作的真实后果。
AI.method: SCOUT 采用两阶段智能体验证框架：(1) 评分量规生成器（rubric generator）对任务和智能体轨迹进行充分推理，判断成功且安全的执行应包含哪些内容，生成任务特定的完成量规与安全量规；(2) 探测智能体（probing agent）依据这些量规与执行后的环境进行交互，收集有依据的（grounded）证据，用于最终的安全性与完成度判定。
AI.result: 在 AutoElicit-Bench 上，SCOUT 取得 75.4 的不安全 F1 和 74.5 的完成度 F1，优于 LLM-as-a-judge 验证器和朴素工具使用验证器；在 OS-Blind 上以 76.4% 的不安全检测准确率领先。测试时反思（test-time reflection）将 AutoElicit-Bench 上的最终不安全执行率从 30.2% 降至 17.2%。消融与分析表明，SCOUT 中的无工具评分量规生成能激发更多推理，且对跨验证器骨干（尤其是非前沿模型）的安全检测至关重要。对编码任务的初步扩展显示 SCOUT 可支持计算机使用之外的安全验证。
AI.conclusion: SCOUT 通过将任务特定评分量规生成与环境证据主动采集相结合，有效应对了 CUA 安全验证中"推理"与"调查"两大挑战，在多个基准上超越现有验证器，并能降低不安全执行率、具备向编码等其他任务扩展的潜力。

title: FastGuide: Accelerating Reward Guidance for Diffusion Large Language Models
summary: Gradient-based reward guidance provides a flexible way to use downstream reward models to control masked diffusion language models at inference time. However, its computational cost remains high as each decoding iteration incurs expensive diffusion model forward passes and reward model backpropagation steps. To address this, we introduce FastGuide, an adaptive hybrid of parallel and autoregressive decoding to accelerate reward guidance for diffusion language models. In analogy to parallel decoding, FastGuide amortizes the cost of reward model backpropagation by computing guidance once per decoding step and reusing it to generate multiple tokens. Within each decoding step, FastGuide makes diffusion forward passes autoregressive by unmasking tokens one at a time while efficiently recomputing token distributions after each unmasking by utilizing KV caching techniques and sparse recomputation of attention. Lastly, to adapt hybrid decoding to the model's confidence, FastGuide defers any token that the model is unconfident about under its recomputed distribution. Experiments on three reward benchmarks demonstrate that FastGuide is up to $4.4\times$ faster than sequential reward-guided decoding while retaining similar generation quality.

AI.tldr: FastGuide提出一种并行与自回归混合的自适应解码方法，通过复用奖励模型梯度指导、KV缓存与稀疏注意力重算，加速掩码扩散语言模型的奖励引导解码，最高提速4.4倍且质量相当。
AI.motivation: 基于梯度的奖励引导虽能灵活控制掩码扩散语言模型的生成，但每个解码迭代都需执行昂贵的扩散模型前向传播和奖励模型反向传播，计算开销过大。
AI.method: 方法为并行与自回归解码的自适应混合：借鉴并行解码，每次解码步骤仅计算一次引导并复用于多token生成，从而摊薄奖励模型反向传播成本；步骤内以自回归方式逐个解掩蔽token，并通过KV缓存与稀疏注意力重算高效更新token分布；同时依据模型置信度，在重算分布下推迟不自信的token。
AI.result: 在三个奖励基准上，FastGuide相比顺序奖励引导解码最高提速4.4倍，同时保持相近的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: FastGuide通过混合解码策略有效缓解奖励引导扩散语言模型的高计算瓶颈，在几乎不损失生成质量的前提下显著提升解码效率。

title: Geometric Representations of African Languages: A Regional Semantic Hub and Cultural Steering
summary: We study how Gemma 4 31B represents African languages and responds to cultural steering. The first study compares nine African languages and three controls using probes, contrast directions, and measures of representation similarity. Transfer from English varies across languages and layers. Directions representing an Africa versus West contrast are more aligned among the African languages than between these languages and the controls at several layers. The comparison across language families passes the reported Holm threshold at five of twelve layers, although dependence between language pairs limits the statistical interpretation. Within Nigeria, Yoruba and Igbo are more aligned than the average of their pairs with Hausa at eleven of twelve layers. The second study uses separate English data to construct directions for Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and South Africa. Under union scoring at the selected strengths, estimated differences in attribution rates from random directions range from 0.63 to 0.81. Most outputs pass the automated structural coherence screen. Comparisons with Aya Expanse 32B show that results depend on the representation measure. Together, the studies document regional and family patterns in the sampled representations and country steering in English.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究Gemma 4 31B对非洲语言的内部表征及文化引导（cultural steering）效果，分两项研究：一是比较九种非洲语言与三种对照语言在探针、对比方向与表征相似度上的差异；二是用英语数据构造尼日利亚、加纳、肯尼亚、南非的方向向量，评估归因率差异与结构连贯性。结果显示非洲语言间（尤其同语系、同国）方向对齐度更高，国别引导在英语中可测但结果依赖表征度量。
AI.motivation: 作者希望了解大语言模型如何表征非洲语言，以及能否通过文化引导方向影响模型输出，从而揭示模型内部的区域与语系偏差模式，并检验国别文化引导的可行性。
AI.method: 研究一：对九种非洲语言与三种对照语言使用探针（probes）、对比方向（contrast directions）和表征相似度度量，比较英语迁移效果及"非洲vs西方"方向的跨语言对齐，并用Holm阈值进行统计检验。研究二：用单独的英语数据构造尼日利亚、加纳、肯尼亚、南非的方向，在选定强度下以union scoring评估归因率相对随机方向的差异，并用自动化结构连贯性筛查，同时与Aya Expanse 32B比较。
AI.result: 非洲语言间的"非洲vs西方"方向对齐度高于其与对照语言的对齐度，语系比较在12层中有5层通过Holm阈值，但语言对间依赖性限制统计解释；尼日利亚内部约鲁巴语与伊博语在12层中的11层比二者与豪萨语的平均对更对齐。国别引导中，归因率相对随机方向的估计差异为0.63至0.81，多数输出通过结构连贯性筛查；与Aya Expanse 32B的比较结果依赖于所采用的表征度量。
AI.conclusion: 两项研究共同记录了所采样表征中存在的区域与语系模式，并证明在英语中可以实现国别文化引导；但统计解释受语言对依赖性与表征度量选择的影响，结论应谨慎推广。

title: The Canonical Order Problem: When Large Language Models Are Unreliable Knowledge Bases for Multi-Valued Relations
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as knowledge bases (KBs) due to the vast amount of knowledge they acquire during pre-training. While many works focus on extracting single relational triples, most real-world relations are multi-valued and require generating sets of entities.
  In this paper, we investigate how LLMs represent and generate multi-valued relations. We identify the canonical order problem: The probabilistic distributions inside LLMs organize many multi-valued relations according to a canonical ordering (e.g., alphabetical or chronological). Through mechanistic analysis, we show that set generation in LLMs can be thought of in terms of three phases: (1) retrieval of candidate entities, (2) internal sorting, and (3) selection of the next element. As a result, prompts aiming to construct KBs that deviate from this internal canonical ordering lead to a markedly reduced reliability of LLMs when aiming to generate complete sets for multi-valued relations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）如何表示与生成多值关系，发现其内部概率分布按“规范顺序”（如字母序、时间序）组织实体集合，并将集合生成机制解构为候选检索、内部排序与下一元素选择三阶段；当提示要求偏离该内部规范顺序时，模型生成完整集合的可靠性显著下降。
AI.motivation: LLM 被广泛用作知识库，但现有工作多聚焦于抽取单一关系三元组；而现实中多数关系是多值的，需要生成实体集合。因此有必要探究 LLM 对多值关系的表示与生成机制。
AI.method: 识别并定义“规范顺序问题”（canonical order problem）；通过机制可解释性分析（mechanistic analysis），将 LLM 的集合生成过程分解为三阶段：(1) 候选实体检索，(2) 内部排序，(3) 下一元素选择。
AI.result: LLM 内部概率分布会将多值关系按字母序或时间序等规范顺序组织；当提示偏离这种内部规范顺序以构建知识库时，模型生成完整多值关系集合的可靠性明显降低。
AI.conclusion: LLM 对多值关系的生成受内部规范顺序支配，理解这一机制对基于 LLM 构建知识库具有重要启示：违背内部排序的提示会损害集合生成的完整性与可靠性。

title: Lost in Translation: Measuring the Effect of Non-Native English on End User Performance of Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used by people whose first language is not English, yet these users have been shown to receive systematically lower-quality responses than fluent speakers. Which specific features of non-native English drive this gap remains unclear, because fluency is itself a composite of mechanical accuracy, vocabulary use, organization, and discourse coherence. Here, we introduce FABLE, a controlled dataset of 190,911 English prompt variants derived from 174K real user prompts for writing-related tasks. Evaluating responses from 34 open-weight LLMs, we find a clear asymmetry; while models do not propagate surface errors such as misspellings into their outputs, models do mirror higher-level rhetorical and lexical qualities present in the user's prompt. Further, the overall quality of responses differs substantially between the least- and most-fluent prompts. These results highlight a key LLM performance disparity for non-native English LLM users, resulting in both lower-quality and less-fluent answers.

AI.tldr: 论文提出FABLE数据集（190,911条提示变体，源自174K真实写作提示），评估34个开源LLM后发现：模型不传播拼写等表层错误，但会模仿用户提示中的高级修辞与词汇特征，导致非母语英语用户获得质量更低、流畅度更差的回答。
AI.motivation: 非英语母语用户从LLM获得的回答质量系统性低于流利使用者，但具体是流畅度的哪些维度（机械准确性、词汇、组织、话语连贯性）导致该差距尚不明确，因此需要受控数据来解耦这些因素。
AI.method: 构建FABLE受控数据集，由174K条真实写作任务提示生成190,911条英语提示变体，据此评估34个开源权重LLM的响应表现。
AI.result: 发现明显的非对称效应：模型不会将拼写错误等表层错误传播到输出中，但会模仿提示中更高层次的修辞与词汇特征；同时，最不流利与最流利提示所获回答的整体质量差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了针对非母语英语用户的关键LLM性能差距，表现为回答质量更低且流畅度更差。

title: CineSubBench: Evaluating LLMs on Long-Form Narrative and Cultural Understanding from Multilingual Movie Subtitles
summary: Large language models are increasingly evaluated in specialized domains such as law, medicine, software engineering, and cybersecurity, yet film remains comparatively underexplored despite requiring long-form narrative integration, multilingual interpretation, and culturally situated audience judgments. We introduce CineSubBench, a benchmark for evaluating long-context film understanding from multilingual movie subtitles. A subtitle track represents a film as thousands of short, temporally ordered utterances from which models must reconstruct characters, relationships, events, causal progression, and themes without explicit scene or event structure. CineSubBench contains 1,012 films with complete subtitle coverage in six languages, yielding 6,072 tracks and 8.13M timestamped subtitle entries. It provides a matched multi-task, multilingual, and multicultural (MultiX) evaluation setting: seven tasks span narrative reconstruction and abstraction, genre prediction, age suitability, country-specific motion-picture ratings across ten national classification systems, and subtitle-grounded language safety. Across nine LLMs, plot premises are recovered more reliably than event-complete synopses; cross-lingual consistency varies substantially across models and languages; national rating systems expose distinct calibration patterns; and strong profanity is far easier to ground than mild obscenity. CineSubBench establishes film as a long-context LLM evaluation domain and provides a unified benchmark for measuring narrative, multilingual, cultural, and evidence-grounding capabilities.

AI.tldr: CineSubBench：基于多语言电影字幕的长上下文理解基准，1,012部电影、6语言、6,072条字幕轨、8.13M条带时间戳字幕，设七项任务评测九个大模型。
AI.motivation: LLM评测已扩展到法律、医学、软件工程与网络安全等专业领域，但电影领域仍相对空白。电影理解要求长程叙事整合、多语言解读以及文化情境化的受众判断，现有基准未能覆盖这一长上下文评测需求。
AI.method: 构建CineSubBench基准：以多语言电影字幕为输入，将影片表示为数千条时间有序的短话语，模型需在无显式场景与事件结构下重建人物、关系、事件、因果与主题。共1,012部电影、6种语言完整字幕覆盖，形成6,072条字幕轨与8.13M条带时间戳条目。设计匹配的多任务、多语言、多文化（MultiX）评测：七项任务涵盖叙事重建与抽象、类型预测、年龄适宜性、基于十国分类体系的国别电影分级，以及字幕依据的语言安全性。
AI.result: 在九个LLM上的实验显示：情节前提（plot premise）的恢复比事件完整的故事梗概更可靠；跨语言一致性因模型与语言而异；各国分级体系呈现不同的校准模式；强脏话比轻度猥亵内容更易被证据定位。
AI.conclusion: CineSubBench确立了电影作为长上下文LLM评测领域，并提供统一基准，用于衡量叙事、多语言、文化及证据溯源能力。

title: Cognitive Expert Language Models Better Align with the Corresponding Brain Systems
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can predict human brain activity across a variety of brain regions during natural language comprehension. Typically, however, LLM-brain alignment is measured using one model for different regions of the brain, and then model performance is summarized across regions. This one-model-fits-all approach ignores the functional specialization of brain regions. In this study, we assess whether a model oriented toward a particular cognitive domain aligns better with the brain system dedicated to that domain. Through prompting and fine-tuning, we first build expert LLM variants for six domains: sensory, spatial, numerical, reasoning, social, and abstract processing. We then examine whether each expert best predicts activity in the brain region associated with the corresponding cognitive domain. Consistent with our hypotheses, each expert's representations align more closely with the brain system most associated with the matching domain than do other experts. This holds under both prompting and fine-tuning, across three base models and three fMRI datasets. In a series of control analyses, we show that this model-brain alignment is specific to cognitive domain interventions; non-cognitive and surface-level interventions do not result in comparable alignment. Specializing models shifts regional alignment while leaving aggregate prediction accuracy largely unchanged, suggesting that summarizing alignment across regions may obscure regional differences in performance for specific models.

AI.tldr: 本文通过提示与微调构建六个认知领域的专家LLM，验证领域专家模型与其对应脑区系统的神经对齐更强，且此类对齐具有领域特异性。
AI.motivation: 以往研究通常用单一模型衡量LLM与不同脑区的对齐程度，再跨区域汇总性能，忽视了脑区的功能专门化，可能掩盖特定模型在区域间的表现差异。
AI.method: 针对感官、空间、数值、推理、社会和抽象六个认知领域，通过提示与微调构建专家LLM变体；在三个基础模型与三个fMRI数据集上，比较各专家模型对相应脑区活动的预测能力，并进行非认知与表层干预的对照分析。
AI.result: 每个专家模型的表征与匹配领域相关脑系统的对齐程度均高于其他专家模型，该效应在提示与微调下、跨三个基础模型和三个fMRI数据集均成立；非认知及表层干预未产生可比的对齐效应。
AI.conclusion: 模型专门化会改变区域对齐模式，但基本不改变总体预测精度，说明跨区域汇总对齐指标可能掩盖特定模型的区域性能差异。

title: Learning from Teacher Continuations at Student States
summary: We present OLIVE (OnLine InterVEntion). At each iteration, the evolving student policy generates a new prefix, the teacher continues it autoregressively, and the student is updated using cross-entropy computed on the teacher-generated tokens. Each design choice targets a corresponding limitation of existing distillation methods: (1) sequential covariate shift in offline supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on fixed teacher trajectories, (2) fragmented supervision under prefix failure in token-level on-policy distillation (OPD), and (3) the need for access to teacher token probabilities in distribution-matching distillation. OLIVE achieves higher reasoning performance than OPD (with a top-16 KL approximation) at comparable GPU-hour cost. Our asynchronous implementation further reduces OLIVE's total training time by 23.8\%. We evaluate OLIVE on both hard reasoning tasks and agentic tasks which reflects modern post-training scenarios, and it consistently outperforms existing distillation methods under the same training budget. By regenerating prefixes from the evolving student, OLIVE continues improving after offline distillation plateaus while better preserving the general capabilities and plasticity of the student. Using only text from GPT-5.4-mini, continuously training with OLIVE outperforms offline SFT from the same teacher by 13\% on ScienceWorld. These results support OLIVE as an effective and efficient approach to online language-model distillation.

AI.tldr: OLIVE 是一种在线干预蒸馏方法：每轮由学生生成新前缀、教师自回归续写，用教师生成 token 的交叉熵更新学生，兼顾推理与智能体任务性能，并提升效率。
AI.motivation: 现有蒸馏方法存在三类局限：离线 SFT 固定教师轨迹导致序列级协变量偏移；token 级在线策略蒸馏（OPD）在前缀失败时监督碎片化；分布匹配蒸馏需要访问教师 token 概率。
AI.method: OLIVE（OnLine InterVEntion）：每次迭代中，演化的学生策略生成新前缀，教师对该前缀自回归续写，学生基于教师生成 token 的交叉熵进行更新；并采用异步实现以缩短训练时间。
AI.result: 在相当 GPU 小时成本下，OLIVE 推理性能高于使用 top-16 KL 近似的 OPD；异步实现使总训练时间再降 23.8%。在困难推理任务与智能体任务上，相同训练预算下持续优于现有蒸馏方法；离线蒸馏平台期后仍可继续提升，且更好保留通用能力与可塑性。仅用 GPT-5.4-mini 文本，在 ScienceWorld 上持续 OLIVE 训练比同教师离线 SFT 高 13%。
AI.conclusion: OLIVE 是一种有效且高效的在线语言模型蒸馏方法，可突破离线蒸馏瓶颈并保持学生模型能力与可塑性。

title: Population Fidelity: Evaluating Population Representativeness in LLMs
comment: 37 pages, 16 figures, 14 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/CriticalMaking/LLM-population-fidelity
summary: Large language models (LLMs) show considerable potential in simulating human attitudes and preferences. Prior work finds that LLM-generated responses can compress the range of attitudes found within populations and misrepresent particular subgroups in ways that vary across models and topics. We introduce Population Fidelity, an evaluation framework that distinguishes key conditions required for a set of LLM-generated responses to represent a population. It incorporates three dimensions: group-level accuracy, the amount of between-group variation, and the structure of that variation. We demonstrate the framework's utility in two ways. First, we reproduce a prior study of "machine bias" in LLM survey responses and apply the framework to its models and more recent ones, showing that poor representation reflects not only insufficient between-group variation but also variation assigned to the wrong groups. Second, we evaluate one proposed approach to improving models' population representativeness: cultural fine-tuning. We find that cultural fine-tuning can improve alignment with the survey center without improving the representation of within-population differences, a distinction that measures of aggregate agreement do not capture. We argue that representing a population requires models to reproduce several features of human attitudinal variation simultaneously. Our framework organizes these features and provides reusable code, data, and trained models for evaluating population fidelity across substantive domains and assessing proposed alignment methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"Population Fidelity"评估框架，用于衡量LLM生成回答能否真实代表人群态度，包含组级准确性、组间变异量及变异结构三个维度。
AI.motivation: 已有研究发现LLM生成的回答会压缩人群态度分布范围，并错误呈现特定子群体，且这种偏差随模型和主题而变化。现有评估方法（如聚合一致性指标）无法捕捉这些表征缺陷，因此需要一个更细粒度的评估框架来判断LLM回答是否真正代表目标人群。
AI.method: 作者构建Population Fidelity框架，包含三个维度：(1) 组级准确性(group-level accuracy)，(2) 组间变异量(amount of between-group variation)，(3) 变异的结构(structure of that variation)。框架通过两项实证研究验证：一是复现既有的LLM调查回答"机器偏见"研究并应用于旧模型与更新模型；二是评估"文化微调(cultural fine-tuning)"这一提升人群代表性的方法。
AI.result: 复现研究显示，LLM代表性不足不仅源于组间变异不足，还源于变异被错误分配给了不当群体。文化微调虽能提升与调查中心的整体对齐度，却未能改善对群体内部差异的表征，而聚合一致性指标无法区分这一差别，说明该框架能揭示传统指标遗漏的问题。
AI.conclusion: 代表一个人群要求模型同时复现人类态度变异的多个特征。该框架系统化了这些特征，并提供可复用的代码、数据和训练模型，用于跨实质领域评估population fidelity及检验各类对齐方法。

title: Training LLMs to Verbalize Evaluation Awareness
summary: Evaluation awareness (EA) can cause large language models (LLMs) to behave differently during audits than in deployment, yet measuring and accounting for EA remains challenging. We introduce verbalization training (VT), a method for making LLMs less reticent about verbalizing evaluation awareness while avoiding to supervise the latent belief itself. VT uses a model's spontaneous verbalizations as evidence that awareness is present and truncates each rollout immediately before the verbalization, producing training prefixes at which the model is presumed to be aware. The model is then trained with an RL objective designed to increase verbalization in a calibrated way. Across Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Kimi K2.6, and Inkling, VT increases verbalized EA by 2.4-2.9 times and transfers to held-out agentic settings, while measured latent EA and behavior remain largely stable. In a causal experiment, we independently implant meta-knowledge about evaluations through synthetic-document fine-tuning and show that VT-induced verbalizations reflect the richer knowledge acquired by the model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"言语化训练"（Verbalization Training, VT），一种在不直接监督潜在信念本身的前提下，让大语言模型更愿意（减少沉默倾向）表达其"评估意识"（Evaluation Awareness, EA）的方法。
AI.motivation: 评估意识会使大语言模型在审计阶段与部署阶段表现出不同行为，从而影响审计有效性；然而如何测量并处理EA仍具挑战性。现有难点在于：直接监督潜在信念容易污染或扭曲模型内部状态，因此需要一种既能提升EA可观测性、又不改变潜在信念的手段。
AI.method: VT利用模型自发产生的言语化作为"意识存在"的证据：在每条rollout中，截断至言语化发生之前的那个位置，从而构造出"模型被假定处于已觉知状态"的训练前缀；随后在这些前缀上用强化学习目标进行训练，以"校准的方式"提升言语化频率，而非直接监督潜在信念。此外，作者通过合成文档微调独立植入关于评估的元知识，用于因果实验。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.6-35B-A3B、Kimi K2.6与Inkling三个模型上，VT使言语化的EA提升2.4–2.9倍，并能迁移到未见的agentic（智能体）场景；同时测得的潜在EA与行为基本保持稳定。在因果实验中，通过合成文档微调独立植入元知识后，VT诱导的言语化能够反映模型所获得的更丰富知识。
AI.conclusion: VT可在不显著改变潜在EA与行为的前提下，显著提升模型对评估意识的言语化程度，并具备跨模型与跨场景的泛化性；因果实验进一步表明，VT引发的言语化是对模型内部知识（而非人为注入的表面模式）的反映，为审计中测量与处理EA提供了可行路径。

title: DeepRewind: Predicting and Repairing Premature Commitments in Deep Research Agents
summary: Deep-research agents conduct long-horizon investigations through iterative search, evidence evaluation, belief revision, and synthesis. However, they may commit to claims before sufficient evidence is available, causing later reasoning to reinforce an incorrect interpretation. We introduce DeepRewind, an additive control layer for reversible deep research that represents the agent's evolving epistemic state as a typed graph of sources, evidence, claims, hypotheses, assumptions, commitments, plans, and drafts. Before accepting an intermediate conclusion, a prompt-based world model predicts its impact and estimates reversibility based on hypothesis narrowing, information loss, recovery cost, and contradiction-trigger coverage. A binary controller blocks risky commitments, while a consistency monitor performs dependency-aware rollback when later evidence invalidates them. Across DRBench and LiveDRBench, DeepRewind improves insight recall by 3.6 percentage points and reduces premature commitments by 59.1% relative to Open Deep Research.

AI.tldr: DeepRewind 是一个可逆深度研究的附加控制层，通过将智能体的认知状态建模为类型化图，并在承诺前预测影响与可逆性，实现风险阻断与依赖感知回滚，从而提升洞见召回并显著减少过早承诺。
AI.motivation: 深度研究智能体在长程调查中，可能因证据不足而过早确立主张，导致后续推理持续强化错误解读。
AI.method: 将智能体的演进认知状态表示为包含来源、证据、主张、假设、预设、承诺、计划与草稿的类型化图；在接纳中间结论前，用基于提示的世界模型从假设收窄、信息损失、恢复成本和矛盾触发覆盖度四项指标预测其影响并估计可逆性；二元控制器阻断高风险承诺，一致性监控器在后续证据证伪时执行依赖感知回滚。
AI.result: 在 DRBench 与 LiveDRBench 上，相比 Open Deep Research，洞见召回率提升 3.6 个百分点，过早承诺减少 59.1%。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模认知状态并结合可逆性预测与依赖感知回滚，DeepRewind 能有效抑制深度研究中的过早承诺，提升研究结论的可靠性与洞见覆盖。

title: Calibrated to Whom? Persona and Language Effects on Cultural Values in JEV
summary: Decision-only language models return a probability for every answer option instead of generating text, which makes them attractive as survey respondents and as judges. We audit the cultural values of one such model, TypeSafe's JEV, with the Values Survey Module 2013. We asked it the 24 items as 12 matched Saudi and 12 matched American personas and without a persona, in English and Arabic, under eight ways of formulating the request (288,000 answers). JEV's answers were highly repeatable (ICC 0.997), and without a persona they resembled those of its own American personas. When the persona was Saudi rather than American, the answers moved in the direction of the human Saudi-US difference, reproducing 87% of its size in English but 62% in Arabic, with long-term orientation reversed. A language cross shows that the smaller difference in Arabic comes from the language of the items, not from the language of the persona description. Age shifted the profiles about as much as nationality, gender shifted them more for Saudi than for American personas, and JEV was less confident in Arabic and for Saudi personas. These patterns held in every request design, although the model never generates text.

AI.tldr: 该研究用VSM 2013量表审计决策型语言模型JEV的文化价值观，通过沙特/美国人设、英/阿双语及八种请求表述共288,000次提问，发现其答案高度可重复，无人设时接近美国人设，且能部分复现沙特-美国人文差异。
AI.motivation: 决策型语言模型（仅输出答案选项概率、不生成文本）被用作问卷受访者和评判者，但其文化价值观是否可靠、是否受语言与人设影响尚不清楚，需要系统性审计。
AI.method: 使用Values Survey Module 2013的24个题项，构建12个沙特与12个美国人设及无人设条件，分别在英语和阿拉伯语下，采用八种请求表述方式提问，共获得288,000个答案；通过ICC评估可重复性，并比较人设、语言、年龄、性别对文化维度得分及模型置信度的影响。
AI.result: JEV答案高度可重复（ICC 0.997）；无人设时接近其美国人设；沙特人设使答案向人类沙特-美国差异方向移动，英语下复现差异幅度的87%，阿拉伯语下62%，且长期取向出现反转。语言交叉实验表明阿拉伯语下差异变小源于题项语言而非人设描述语言。年龄对价值观剖面的影响与国籍相当，性别影响对沙特人设大于美国人设；模型在阿拉伯语和沙特人设下置信度更低。上述模式在所有请求设计下均成立。
AI.conclusion: 决策型语言模型即使不生成文本，其文化价值观输出仍系统性地受人设、语言和人口学属性影响，且这种影响在不同请求表述下稳定；因此将其作为调查受访者或评判者时需谨慎对待语言与人设带来的偏差。

title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind: Systematically Erasing LLM's Memories
summary:
We consider persistent LLMs that accumulate memories of their interactions with a user over time. Such LLMs maintain memories using external storage, which they can query to overcome the limitations of a fixed context window. Such systems have numerous practical applications, as they can draw on all past interactions when responding to user queries.
  In this paper, we ask whether LLMs can forget information shared with them upon a user's request. We find that current LLMs fail to delete such information---even when they claim to have forgotten it and even when operating with a limited context. To this end, we consider a new direction of study: Deletion of LLM Memories.
  We show that naively removing messages that match a user's deletion request is insufficient, since conversations naturally introduce message dependencies that cause information to persist. To correctly handle deletion requests, we propose the DeLLM framework. It dynamically constructs relevant context for each LLM query and maintains a provenance graph of messages to determine which ones must be removed during deletion. Our experiments show that DeLLM achieves a high deletion rate while maintaining utility.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"持久化LLM"的记忆删除问题：现有模型即使用户要求删除也会保留信息，作者提出DeLLM框架，通过动态上下文构建与消息溯源图实现高删除率并保持实用性。
AI.motivation: 持久化LLM通过外部存储积累用户交互记忆以突破固定上下文窗口限制，具有广泛应用价值。但随之而来的隐私问题被忽视：用户请求删除共享信息时，LLM能否真正遗忘？作者发现当前LLM即使声称已遗忘或在有限上下文下运行，仍无法真正删除信息，因此提出"LLM记忆删除"这一新研究方向。
AI.method: 作者指出现有简单匹配并删除用户请求对应消息的做法不足，因为对话中自然形成的消息依赖关系会导致信息残留。为此提出DeLLM框架：为每次LLM查询动态构建相关上下文，并维护消息的溯源图（provenance graph），从而在删除时准确判断哪些消息必须被移除。
AI.result: 实验表明，DeLLM在实现高删除率的同时保持了系统效用（utility），优于朴素的消息匹配删除方法。
AI.conclusion: LLM记忆删除是一个重要且此前被忽视的研究方向，朴素的删除策略因忽略消息依赖而失效，而基于溯源图的DeLLM能够有效解决该问题并兼顾效用。

title: MemFold: Learning Compact Soft Memory for Long-Context Personalization via On-Policy Optimization
summary: An assistant that serves the same user over a long horizon has to answer from what that user has revealed: which preferences still hold, which were revised, and which constraints apply now. Retaining that information is not the same as acting on it, and the two are usually optimized as if they were. Keeping the information as text makes the reader's input grow with the retained history, while compressing it into a fixed number of latent vectors bounds the interface but is typically trained to reconstruct text or imitate reference answers, both of which are scored on sequences the reader never produced. We present MemFold, which optimizes a fixed-budget soft memory by the behavior it supports. A query-conditioned textual memory is compressed into K continuous vectors that form the reader's memory interface, and the reader is then trained on its own rollouts under two complementary signals: group-relative rewards for task outcomes, and confidence-gated on-policy distillation in which a frozen textual-memory teacher re-scores the student's sampled tokens under the textual memory. The teacher is never sampled from, so supervision stays on the student's current distribution and adds no autoregressive decoding; at inference it is removed entirely. Across three Qwen backbones, MemFold attains the highest accuracy we measure on PersonaMem-32K and PersonaMem-128K, with margins that widen at the longer history length, and transfers to PrefEval and LongMemEval without target-domain training. Ablations attribute most of the task gain to the reward term and a smaller additional gain to the teacher signal, and memory interventions show that the reader depends on the instance-specific content of its soft memory.

AI.tldr: MemFold 通过任务行为直接优化固定预算的软记忆，将查询条件下的文本记忆压缩为 K 个连续向量作为读者接口，并用组相对奖励与置信门控的在线策略蒸馏联合训练读者，在长程个性化记忆任务上取得最优精度且具备跨域迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 长期服务同一用户的助手需要从用户已披露的信息中判断哪些偏好仍有效、哪些被修正、当前适用哪些约束。保留信息与基于信息行动并不等同，但现有方法常将二者混为一谈。文本形式记忆使读者输入随历史增长，而压缩为固定数量隐向量虽能固定接口，却通常以重构文本或模仿参考答案为训练目标，这些目标所评分的序列并非读者自身产生，因而与最终行为目标不一致。
AI.method: 提出 MemFold：将查询条件下的文本记忆压缩为 K 个连续向量，构成读者的记忆接口（固定预算软记忆）。读者在自身 rollout 上由两个互补信号训练：一是面向任务结果的组相对奖励；二是置信门控的在线策略蒸馏，由冻结的文本记忆教师在文本记忆下对学生采样出的 token 重新打分。教师从不被采样，因此监督始终位于学生当前分布上，且不增加自回归解码开销，推理时教师被完全移除。
AI.result: 在三种 Qwen 骨干上，MemFold 在 PersonaMem-32K 与 PersonaMem-128K 上取得所测最高准确率，且优势随历史长度增加而扩大；无需目标域训练即可迁移至 PrefEval 与 LongMemEval。消融显示任务增益主要来自奖励项，教师信号带来较小的额外增益；记忆干预实验表明读者依赖其软记忆中实例特定的内容。
AI.conclusion: 按所支持的行为来优化固定预算软记忆，可有效弥合记忆保留与记忆利用之间的落差；该固定预算连续记忆接口在长历史个性化任务上优于文本记忆与重构/模仿式压缩，并具备良好的跨域泛化性。

title: Reliable Parallel Decoding in Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) can generate text efficiently by predicting multiple masked tokens in parallel, but predictions from the same forward pass are not necessarily reliable when committed together. We study when parallel commitment is reliable. Our diagnostics show that confidence alone does not determine a reliable commitment order: confident predictions near the end of the sequence can fix an answer before its supporting computations are established, and downstream predictions become less reliable as the uncertainty of their upstream context grows. At the same time, a single forward pass can already resolve several masked tokens, and predictions that remain stable across the final layers are more likely to be correct. Based on these findings, we propose Reliable Parallel Decoding (RPD), a training-free method that selects candidates by layerwise prediction stability and final confidence, and commits them under a cumulative entropy budget over their preceding masked positions. RPD defers predictions with uncertain upstream context while committing the remaining candidates in parallel, without relying on a fixed block schedule. Across mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks on LLaDA and Dream, RPD achieves the highest decoding throughput among the evaluated methods while maintaining or improving accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）并行解码的可靠性问题，提出无需训练的 Reliable Parallel Decoding (RPD) 方法，通过逐层预测稳定性与最终置信度筛选候选 token，并在累积熵预算约束下并行提交，从而在数学推理与代码生成任务上实现更高吞吐量且保持或提升准确率。
AI.motivation: MDLM 虽然可以通过并行预测多个掩码 token 提升生成效率，但同一次前向传播中的多个预测同时提交并不一定可靠。作者希望回答"何时并行提交是可靠的"这一问题，并发现仅靠置信度无法决定可靠的提交顺序：序列末端的高置信预测可能在其上游计算尚未确立时就锁定答案，且上游上下文不确定性增大会降低下游预测可靠性。
AI.method: 作者提出 Reliable Parallel Decoding (RPD)，一种免训练方法。它利用两个诊断发现：单次前向传播已能解决多个掩码 token；在最后若干层保持稳定的预测更可能正确。RPD 据此按逐层预测稳定性与最终置信度选择候选，并在其前置掩码位置的累积熵预算约束下提交，对上游上下文不确定的预测进行延迟，其余候选并行提交，不依赖固定块调度。
AI.result: 在 LLaDA 与 Dream 模型上，针对数学推理与代码生成基准，RPD 在所评估方法中取得最高解码吞吐量，同时保持或提升准确率。
AI.conclusion: 并行提交的可靠性不能仅由置信度决定，还需考虑上游上下文的确定性及逐层预测稳定性；RPD 通过稳定性与熵预算联合筛选，实现了高效且可靠的免训练并行解码。

title: Memory Consolidation Flattens the Temporal Shape of User Facts
summary: Long-term memory systems turn conversations into short stored notes. A note can keep a user fact while losing evidence about whether the fact still holds. For example, "I am driving a Peugeot" can become "The user drives a Peugeot," which drops the cue that the activity is ongoing. We call this aspectual flattening and measure it with LAPSE, a benchmark of matched user statements that differ only in temporal form. We find that memory writers flatten aspect selectively. Three writer models flattened the progressive statement but kept its simple-present match in 244 of 381 pairs, never the reverse. The asymmetry holds in all 11 model configurations tested and in the installed pipelines mem0, Graphiti, and Letta. The lost cue matters to later readers. In exploratory tests, changing only the stored verb shifted all three readers' estimates that a fact still holds. When readers could ask the user before acting, two of three acted without asking more often on flattened notes. Our planned memory-use task could not detect this, because readers there acted on almost every stored fact, even expired ones. Memory writing can thus remove evidence that later models use to decide whether to act.

AI.tldr: 长期记忆系统在把对话写成简短笔记时会丢失时态/进行体线索（aspectual flattening）；作者用 LAPSE 基准测量，发现记忆写入模型在381对匹配语句中有244对只压平进行体而保留一般现在时，该不对称在11种配置和mem0、Graphiti、Letta中均成立，且缺失线索会影响后续读取模型判断事实是否仍成立。
AI.motivation: 长期记忆系统将对话压缩为短笔记，可能丢失关于事实是否仍然成立的证据。例如"我正在开标致车"被写成"用户开标致车"，丢掉活动仍在进行的线索。作者提出并量化这种"时态压平"问题，关注其对后续模型决策的潜在影响。
AI.method: 提出 LAPSE 基准，由仅时态形式不同、内容匹配的用户陈述对组成，用以测量时态压平。测试多个记忆写入模型及已部署流水线 mem0、Graphiti、Letta，统计进行体与一般现在时配对中被压平的方向性。另做探索性读取测试，检验仅改变存储动词是否影响读取模型对事实是否仍成立的估计，以及读取模型在行动前是否询问用户。
AI.result: 三个写入模型在381对中有244对压平进行体而保留其一般现在时匹配项，反向从未出现。该不对称在全部11种模型配置及 mem0、Graphiti、Letta 中成立。探索性测试中，仅改变存储动词即可改变三个读取模型对事实仍成立的估计；在可先询问用户的条件下，三个模型中有两个在压平笔记上更常不经询问直接行动。计划的记忆使用任务未能检测到该效应，因为读取模型几乎对所有存储事实都采取行动，包括已过期事实。
AI.conclusion: 记忆写入过程会系统性地删除后续模型用于判断是否采取行动的时态证据，形成一种方向性的"时态压平"偏差。该问题普遍存在于测试模型与已装流水线中，并对读取端决策产生可测影响；需要改进记忆写入表示以保留时态信息。

title: FinRT: Distilling Adaptive Red-Teaming Strategies into Reusable Adversarial Generators in Consumer Finance
summary: In regulated industries like consumer finance, seemingly harmless user queries can exploit large language model vulnerabilities, triggering safety failures and pushing responses dangerously close to policy limits. Existing automated red-teaming methods trade off attack effectiveness against generation cost, while treating coverage, severity, and diversity as incidental rather than joint objectives. We introduce FinRT, a structured framework that builds reusable adversarial prompt generators from adaptive red-teaming strategies. Across the six victim models in consumer finance, FinRT substantially outperforms adaptive search baselines while amortizing target-facing attack generation into a reusable generator. FinRT nearly doubles the attack success rate over the adaptive baseline Rainbow Teaming (32.9% vs. 17.2%), increases maximum adversarial severity by 33%, and preserves comparable intra-policy-domain semantic diversity to iterative search methods. Our method achieves high cross-model transferability while exhibiting distinct victim-family specialization patterns.

AI.tldr: FinRT是一个结构化红队测试框架，通过从自适应策略中构建可复用的对抗提示生成器，在消费金融领域显著提升攻击成功率与严重度，并保持语义多样性。
AI.motivation: 在消费金融等受监管行业中，看似无害的用户查询可能触发大语言模型的安全失效，使回复逼近政策边界。现有自动化红队方法在攻击有效性与生成成本之间存在权衡，且将覆盖率、严重度和多样性视为附带属性而非需联合优化的目标。
AI.method: 提出FinRT框架，从自适应红队策略中构建可复用的对抗提示生成器，将面向目标的攻击生成摊销为一次性构建的可复用生成器，从而联合优化覆盖率、严重度与多样性。
AI.result: 在消费金融领域的六个受害者模型上，FinRT显著优于自适应搜索基线；攻击成功率接近翻倍（32.9% vs. Rainbow Teaming的17.2%），最大对抗严重度提升33%，并保持与迭代搜索方法相当的政策域内语义多样性；同时具有高跨模型迁移性，且呈现明显的受害者家族特化模式。
AI.conclusion: FinRT通过可复用生成器在受监管领域实现了更高效、更严重的对抗攻击生成，兼顾迁移性与多样性，为自动化红队测试提供了一种结构化解决方案。

title: Large-scale factor analysis shows machine intelligence is only partially interpretable
summary: A common assumption in language model development is that cognitive abilities are organized around a general, domain-free intelligence factor, like fluid intelligence in humans. This assumption is rarely tested directly, and prior attempts have done so only at a much smaller scale. We take a latent variable approach to intelligence in language models, similar to how psychometricians study psychological constructs. Performance in every specific problem set is influenced by a domain-specific and a domain-agnostic latent factor. Using factor analysis as a dimension-reduction technique, we analyzed 13,251 published evaluation scores covering 1,618 language models across 456 different text-only benchmarks. Due to the super-sparse nature of the dataset, we triangulate our analysis across different data densifiers and imputation methods. A robust pattern across different modes of bias is that 1. A general intelligence factor accounts for 70.8% of variance in model performance at our most generous estimate, and far less than that in most of our solutions, 2. Content-similar benchmarks do not necessarily cluster together, and 3. The $g$ factor is not dominated by any common theme, and there is a lack of evidence that it is well-proxied by standard "intelligence" benchmarks. Our findings go against current endeavors of defining, identifying, and targeting general intelligence as a tangible construct in language model development. This leaves the strategy of targeting a single conceptual ability without support, since the first-order abilities it would have to reach are often partially idiosyncratic and not identifiable in practice.

AI.tldr: 该研究用因子分析检验语言模型中是否存在类似人类流体智力的通用智能因子，发现通用因子解释力（最宽松估计70.8%）远不及预期，且无主导主题，质疑以通用智能为开发目标的可行性。
AI.motivation: 语言模型开发普遍假设认知能力围绕一个通用、领域无关的智能因子（类似人类流体智力）组织，但这一假设很少被直接检验，已有尝试规模也小得多。作者希望以心理测量学的潜变量视角，在大规模数据上直接检验该假设。
AI.method: 采用潜变量方法与因子分析作为降维技术，分析13,251个已发布的评测分数，覆盖1,618个语言模型与456个纯文本基准。每个问题集的表现受领域特异与领域无关潜因子共同影响。针对数据极度稀疏的特点，作者在不同数据致密化与插补方法间进行三角验证。
AI.result: 在多种偏差模式下呈现稳健模式：(1) 通用智能因子在最宽松估计下解释70.8%的性能方差，多数解中远低于此；(2) 内容相似的基准未必聚为一类；(3) g因子不被任何共同主题主导，且缺乏证据表明标准“智能”基准能很好地代理它。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果与当前定义、识别并以通用智能为可操作构念来指导语言模型开发的努力相悖。针对单一概念能力的开发策略缺乏支持，因为它所需触及的一阶能力往往具有部分特异性，在实践中难以识别。

title: When Updating Stops Being Learning: Rethinking LLM Self-Evolution via learnable information gain
summary: Self-evolution lets large language models (LLMs) improve iteratively using their own generated data, but often suffers from self-evolution degeneration: performance improves, plateaus, then declines. Existing methods address this issue at the component level, targeting either the Questioner or the Solver, and overlook that self-evolution is a tightly coupled system. We propose a holistic framework based on learnable information gain, which measures how much novel, parameterizable information a round provides relative to the previous round. Theoretically, this gain equals the Kullback-Leibler divergence between the two rounds' data distributions plus their entropy change. Practically, it is estimated by fitting a small language model to the previous round and scoring new data via negative log-likelihood. Based on this diagnostic, we propose ATRI (Adaptive Training Regulation via Information-gain), which reweights samples within a round and halts training across rounds when information gain remains low. Experiments on popular datasets demonstrate the superiority of our proposal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于可学习信息增益的整体框架，用于诊断并缓解自进化中的性能退化，并给出ATRI算法，在多个数据集上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 自进化使LLM可利用自身生成数据迭代提升，但会出现"性能提升—平台期—下降"的自进化退化现象。现有方法多在组件层面处理问题（分别针对Questioner或Solver），忽视了自进化是一个紧密耦合的系统。
AI.method: 提出基于可学习信息增益的整体框架：该增益度量某一轮相对于上一轮提供了多少新颖且可参数化的信息。理论上，增益等于两轮数据分布之间的KL散度加上其熵变。实践中，通过将小型语言模型拟合到上一轮数据，并用负对数似然评分新数据来估计。基于此诊断提出ATRI（Adaptive Training Regulation via Information-gain），在轮内对样本重新加权，并在跨轮信息增益持续偏低时停止训练。
AI.result: 在流行数据集上的实验表明所提方法具有优越性。
AI.conclusion: 将自进化视为耦合系统并通过可学习信息增益进行整体诊断与调控，可有效应对自进化退化；ATRI通过轮内重加权与跨轮停止训练实现该目标，实验验证其优势。

title: DraftTrace: A Multi-View Analytics Environment for AI-Integrated Writing
summary: Generative AI has changed how students produce writing assignments. The final artifact is no longer sufficient to understand the process through which it was produced. We introduce DraftTrace, a writing environment that jointly captures three complementary views of writing: the final product, the writing process and interactions with an integrated AI-assistant. DraftTrace reconstructs how a document develops over time and organizes these signals into submission, longitudinal, and class-level analytics for instructors. We deployed DraftTrace in a graduate NLP course with 81 students and compared their sessions with LLM-generated responses entered by automated tools and with copy-typed responses. While product measures distinguish differences in text formulation, process measures distinguish differences in how text is entered. Considering both views together helps characterize cases such as copy-typing. Interaction traces show that students use the assistant differently across stages of writing: to clarify the question at an early stage and to verify answers at a later stage. A preliminary instructor survey highlights the importance of multi-view writing analytics and their interpretability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DraftTrace写作环境，联合捕获写作成品、写作过程及AI助手交互三重信号，并在81名研究生的NLP课程中部署验证其多视角写作分析的可行性与价值。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI改变了学生的写作方式，仅凭最终成品已无法理解写作过程，也难以区分学生真实写作与AI生成或复制粘贴等行为，因此需要能够同时记录写作过程与AI交互的写作环境。
AI.method: 构建DraftTrace写作环境，重建文档随时间的演变，将信号组织为提交级、纵向和班级级分析供教师使用；在81名研究生的NLP课程中部署，并将学生会话与自动化工具输入的LLM生成回答及复制粘贴式回答进行对比。
AI.result: 成品指标可区分文本表述差异，过程指标可区分文本输入方式差异，二者结合有助于刻画复制粘贴等情形；交互轨迹显示学生分阶段使用助手——早期澄清问题、后期验证答案；教师初步调研强调多视角写作分析及其可解释性的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 多视角（成品+过程+AI交互）写作分析对理解AI时代的写作行为具有必要性，联合分析优于单一成品视角，并需重视分析结果的可解释性。

title: Grounded Revision vs. Prior Injection: Probing Retrieval-Augmented Patent Claim Amendment
comment: Accepted to Findings of AACL-IJCNLP 2026. 9 pages, 2 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/TeamLab/probing-rag-patent-amendment
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation is widely used in professional writing, yet whether retrieval grounds revision or merely injects templates is rarely tested where "correct" has a definable meaning. Patent claim amendment supplies that signal: the examiner names the attacked limitation and cites prior art, providing per-case ground truth. We release three artifacts: (i) a corpus of 7,385 USPTO prosecution cases with XML-aligned pre/post claims, rejection, and cited prior art; (ii) a seven-probe battery comparing random and structural-match retrieval as two policies under a fixed prompt scaffold; (iii) a deterministic five-channel metric (C1-C3 and C5 in main, C4 supplementary) requiring no LLM evaluation. Across 9,600 pre-registered calls on four frontier LLMs (Claude Sonnet 4, Claude Haiku 4.5, GPT-5.4, GPT-4o-mini), no tested model exhibits detectable classical prior-injection behavior; retrieval effects are small and direction-inconsistent between random and structural retrieval, and the null is unchanged under a dense (semantic) retriever, across retrieval depths k in {1,3,5,10}, and under a paraphrase-sensitive grounding metric. Revision locality reveals a model-specific difference that the template channel misses. The four-cell taxonomy, which we treat as exploratory, leaves the prior-injector cell unoccupied.

AI.tldr: 本文利用专利权利要求修改这一具有明确"正确答案"的场景，通过7,385件USPTO案例与七项探针、五通道确定性指标，在四个前沿LLM上进行9,600次预注册测试，发现检索增强并未表现出经典的"模板注入"行为。
AI.motivation: 检索增强生成在专业写作中广泛使用，但"检索究竟是支撑修改还是仅仅注入模板"这一问题，在"正确"可定义的真实场景中很少被检验。专利权利要求修改天然提供了这种监督信号：审查员会指明被攻击的技术特征并引用现有技术，形成逐案真值。
AI.method: 研究发布三项成果：(i) 包含7,385件USPTO诉讼案件的语料库，XML对齐修改前后权利要求、驳回理由与被引现有技术；(ii) 七项探针测试组，在固定提示脚手架下将随机检索与结构匹配检索作为两种策略进行对比；(iii) 无需LLM评估的确定性五通道指标（主实验C1–C3与C5，C4为补充）。在四个前沿LLM上进行9,600次预注册调用。
AI.result: 在四个前沿LLM（Claude Sonnet 4、Claude Haiku 4.5、GPT-5.4、GPT-4o-mini）上，未检测到任何模型表现出经典的"现有技术注入"行为；检索效应微弱且方向不一致（随机与结构检索间无稳定差异）。该零结果在稠密（语义）检索器、检索深度k∈{1,3,5,10}以及释义敏感的地基指标下均保持不变。修改局部性揭示了模板通道所遗漏的模型特异性差异。四格分类法（作者视为探索性）中"现有技术注入器"格始终空缺。
AI.conclusion: 检索增强在专利修改场景中并未表现为模板注入，检索对修改的影响微弱且不稳定；模型间差异体现在修改局部性上，而非检索使用方式上。该结论在多种检索器、深度与指标下稳健。

title: SEED: Self-Speculative Decoding via Implicit Encoder-Decoder
summary: Self-speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by drafting tokens from the target model itself, but faces a sharp tradeoff between the quality and cost of the draft. Early-exit methods produce drafts cheaply by terminating computation at intermediate layers, but forgo the deeper representations that later layers provide and thus suffer in draft quality. Multi-token prediction preserves draft quality by emitting from the model's final hidden states, but pays for a full forward pass to produce those states at every drafting step. We propose self-speculative encoder-decoder (SEED), a self-speculative method that obtains high-quality drafts cheaply by reusing the deep contextual representations already computed during verification. We reinterpret the standard decoder-only transformer as an implicit encoder-decoder: the first layers (encoder) build deep contextual representations, and the last few layers (decoder) emit tokens from them. Encoding and verification are merged into a single step: verification is performed by the full encoder-decoder, and the contextual representations of the verified prefix are cached for reuse during drafting. Drafting is therefore very fast: between verifications, the lightweight decoder drafts multiple tokens autoregressively, each conditioned on the cached representations and on preceding drafts. Experiments across multiple benchmarks show that SEED achieves up to 2.7$\times$ average speedup on 4B-scale models, outperforming both early-exit and MTP-style self-speculative baselines and running 28% faster than the state-of-the-art EAGLE-3, while preserving or even improving the generation quality of standard autoregressive fine-tuning. Code is available at https://github.com/lhk2004/SEED.

AI.tldr: SEED将标准解码器Transformer重解释为隐式编码器-解码器，复用验证时已计算的深层上下文表示来低成本生成高质量草稿，在4B级模型上实现最高2.7倍加速。
AI.motivation: 自推测解码中草稿质量与成本存在尖锐权衡：早退法草稿便宜但质量差，多token预测（MTP）质量高但每步需完整前向传播，代价高。
AI.method: 将标准解码器-only Transformer视为隐式编码器-解码器：前若干层作为编码器构建深层上下文表示，最后几层作为解码器发射token。编码与验证合并为单步，验证由完整编解码器执行，已验证前缀的上下文表示被缓存以在草稿阶段复用；验证之间，轻量解码器自回归地生成多个token，每个token以缓存表示和先前草稿为条件。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上，SEED在4B级模型上实现最高2.7倍平均加速，优于早退和MTP式自推测基线，比SOTA的EAGLE-3快28%，同时保持甚至提升标准自回归微调的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: SEED通过复用验证阶段的深层表示，解耦草稿质量与成本，为自推测解码提供高效且高质量的新范式，并开源代码。

title: Generating Edit-Inducing Questions for AI Research Manuscripts
comment: Accepted at the DocInsights Workshop @ EMNLP 2026
summary: We study the ability of LLMs to generate edit-inducing questions whose answer will improve a paper draft. On a dataset of paired submission and camera-ready papers from ICLR and NeurIPS, we compare the helpfulness of questions from GPT models with or without full paper context to that of human reviewers. GPT produces more edit-inducing questions and its questions are associated with more extensive edits and cover a broader range of edited content compared to questions from reviewers. However, a much smaller percentage of the GPT questions are edit-inducing. Our analyses confirm that automated questions can be beneficial to authors and highlight an example task where proper attending to long context deteriorates reasoning model ability to produce helpful output.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM生成"引发修改的问题"以改进论文草稿的能力，在ICLR/NeurIPS配对数据上比较GPT与人类审稿人问题的有用性。
AI.motivation: 探索LLM能否通过生成触发修改的问题来帮助作者改进论文草稿，并评估其与人类审稿人相比的相对价值。
AI.method: 构建ICLR和NeurIPS投稿版与camera-ready版配对论文数据集，对比GPT模型（有无全文上下文）与人类审稿人所提问题的有用性，并以问题是否引发论文修改及修改范围作为评估指标。
AI.result: GPT生成更多引发修改的问题，且这些问题关联更广泛的修改、覆盖更多被修改内容；但GPT问题中真正引发修改的比例远低于人类审稿人。同时，研究发现充分关注长上下文会削弱推理模型产出有用输出的能力。
AI.conclusion: 自动生成的问题对作者确有帮助，但需注意长上下文处理对推理模型输出质量的负面影响。

title: Gödel Forest: Balancing Search Depth and Breadth for Data-Centric Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) aims to achieve compounding gains by having models improve themselves. While most existing RSI systems optimize external agent harnesses or prompts around a frozen base model, data-centric RSI directly updates the model's own parameters by training on agent-generated data. However, because validating data strategies requires expensive model training, existing methods face a fundamental dilemma: a single agent gets trapped in narrow directions and lacks exploration breadth, while naive parallel search or heavy trace sharing sacrifices long-horizon search depth. To address this challenge, we introduce G"odel Forest, a multi-agent framework that organizes recursive self-improvement as an ensemble of co-evolving search trees. In G"odel Forest, each agent autonomously grows a persistent tree, deepening, branching, or pruning data strategies based on model feedback to secure depth, while parallel trees explore distinct regions of the data space to expand breadth. Crucially, rather than leaving trees isolated or flooding them with heavy execution logs, a dynamically co-evolving memory connects the forest: agents continuously distill their successes and failures into compact procedural lessons anchored to a global leaderboard. Through this forest ecosystem, a dead-end in one tree instantly warns the whole forest against unpromising paths, while an empirical breakthrough quickly seeds new exploration branches in neighboring trees. Evaluated on RSIBench-Data across six diverse domains, G"odel Forest outperforms the single-agent baseline by an average of 10.70% while reducing wall-clock time on five tasks. Ablations confirm that co-evolving shared memory yields a +7.00% gain over independent parallel search, demonstrating that collective distillation is key to scalable self-improvement. The code is available at https://github.com/evolvent-ai/Godel-Forest.

AI.tldr: 提出 G"odel Forest 多智能体框架，将递归自我改进（RSI）组织为协同演化的搜索树森林，通过共享演化记忆实现集体蒸馏，在 RSIBench-Data 上比单智能体基线平均提升 10.70%。
AI.motivation: 数据中心的 RSI 直接更新模型参数，但验证数据策略需要昂贵的模型训练，导致现有方法陷入两难：单智能体易困于狭窄方向、缺乏探索广度；而朴素并行搜索或大量轨迹共享又牺牲了长程搜索深度。因此需要兼顾深度与广度的新框架。
AI.method: G"odel Forest 将 RSI 建模为多棵协同演化搜索树的集成。每个智能体自主生长一棵持久化搜索树，依据模型反馈对数据策略进行深化、分支或剪枝以保证深度；并行树探索数据空间的不同区域以扩展广度。核心机制是动态协同演化记忆：智能体持续将成功与失败蒸馏为紧凑的程序性经验，并锚定到全局排行榜，使死胡同能即时警示整个森林，突破则快速在邻近树中催生新分支。
AI.result: 在覆盖六个不同领域的 RSIBench-Data 上，G"odel Forest 相比单智能体基线平均提升 10.70%，并在五项任务上减少实际耗时。消融实验表明，协同演化共享记忆相比独立并行搜索带来 +7.00% 的增益。
AI.conclusion: 集体蒸馏是规模化自我改进的关键，协同演化的共享记忆机制有效兼顾了搜索深度与广度，验证了森林式多智能体生态在数据中心 RSI 中的优越性。

title: ProgressCompass: Embodied Progress Reward Models Are Lost Without the Right Context
summary: Embodied agents now take on ever longer tasks. For long tasks, knowing only whether a task finally succeeds or fails says little; the steps along the way matter. Progress Reward Models (PRMs) score how far a task has come at every step, and serve as dense rewards, verifiers and monitors. Yet in long tasks the current frame alone often cannot tell how far the task has come, because progress depends on what happened before. We call this problem context-dependent progress estimation. Existing benchmarks on progress estimation mostly focus on short tasks whose progress can be read from the current observation, and whether PRMs can estimate progress when context is needed remains underexplored. We therefore build ContextProgress-Bench, with 24 manipulation tasks for 120 episodes. The benchmark covers three settings: (i) State Recall, where information needed for progress appeared earlier but is not in the current frame; (ii) Sequence Tracking, where steps follow a fixed order, so progress requires knowing which steps are done and which comes next; and (iii) Recurrence Disambiguation, where look-alike frames sit at very different progress. We then run a paired diagnosis: each PRM keeps the same input format in both runs, and in one run its instruction integrates the right context. Even PRMs that read the entire history get lost in estimating progress, yet with the right context the same five models cut their progress error by 77-82%. Embodied PRMs are thus not incapable of progress estimation, but lost without the right context.
