We therefore propose ProgressCompass, an autonomous agentic loop that reorients an existing PRM and uses current general-purpose VLMs to supply the context the PRM needs. Wrapped in the loop, the same frozen PRM cuts its progress error by 63% and raises its rank agreement by 76%. With such a compass, PRMs estimate progress far better on longer, more complex tasks.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出长任务中进度估计依赖历史上下文，提出 ContextProgress-Bench 基准并诊断现有 PRM 的上下文缺失问题，进而提出 ProgressCompass 自主代理循环，用通用 VLM 为冻结 PRM 提供上下文，显著降低进度误差并提升排序一致性。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体承担的任务越来越长，仅凭最终成败难以评价过程，需要 Progress Reward Model（PRM）对每一步进度打分以充当密集奖励、验证器和监控器。但长任务中当前帧往往无法反映进度，因为进度取决于此前发生的事件，即"上下文依赖的进度估计"问题。现有进度估计基准多聚焦可从当前观测直接读取进度的短任务，PRM 在需要上下文时能否估计进度尚缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 构建 ContextProgress-Bench，包含 24 个操作任务、120 个回合，覆盖三种设置：State Recall（进度所需信息出现在早期但不在当前帧）、Sequence Tracking（步骤固定顺序，需判断已完成与下一步）、Recurrence Disambiguation（外观相似的帧对应差异很大的进度）。随后进行配对诊断：每个 PRM 两次运行的输入格式相同，其中一次在其指令中整合正确上下文。进一步提出 ProgressCompass，一个自主代理循环，重新定向既有 PRM，并利用当前通用 VLM 为其提供所需上下文。
AI.result: 即使读取完整历史的 PRM 也会在进度估计中迷失；一旦获得正确上下文，同样的五个模型将进度误差降低 77–82%。在 ProgressCompass 循环包裹下，同一个冻结 PRM 的进度误差降低 63%，排序一致性提升 76%。
AI.conclusion: 具身 PRM 并非缺乏进度估计能力，而是在缺少正确上下文时"迷失"。通过 ProgressCompass 自主代理循环为冻结 PRM 注入由通用 VLM 提供的上下文，PRM 能在更长、更复杂的任务上更准确地估计进度。

title: Video2Skill: From Streaming Experience to Reusable Embodied Skills
summary: Manipulation behaviors vary widely across objects and scenes, but they share a small set of reusable skills, and planning with these skills helps embodied agents generalize to new tasks. Yet an agent can only plan with skills it knows. Recovering skills from observed experience, the inverse of planning, builds this knowledge over time and yields skill data for training future agents. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) describe individual manipulation events well, but can they organize a stream of events into reusable skills? We formulate this problem as Streaming Embodied Skill Discovery (SESD): a model watches videos in sequence and maintains a persistent skill library that shapes its later decisions. To systematically measure this ability, we introduce Video2Skill, a benchmark that covers robot tabletop manipulation and human kitchen activity and tests three core capabilities: (i) locating manipulation events in time, (ii) grouping events of the same transformation, and (iii) deciding when to reuse an existing skill or create a new one. Across 19 open-source VLMs, many models group events at near-chance level, and scale does not consistently help. Their errors depend on how perception and library updates are coupled: joint models merge distinct transformations into one skill, while models that update the library from text descriptions duplicate recurring ones. Supervised fine-tuning, including our counterfactual library-state rebalancing (CLaRe), improves grouping but exposes a deeper bottleneck: trained models consolidate familiar skills yet rarely expand the library. Their libraries stall below half the reference size, and transformations unseen in training are located in time but almost never given a new skill. Recognizing when existing skills are insufficient thus emerges as the central challenge.

AI.tldr: 论文提出流式具身技能发现（SESD）任务与Video2Skill基准，系统评测19个开源VLM从连续视频中恢复可复用技能库的能力，发现模型分组能力近随机水平，且微调后仍难以扩展技能库。
AI.motivation: 操作行为因物体与场景而异，但共享少量可复用技能，智能体借助技能规划可泛化到新任务；而智能体只能使用已知技能，因此需要从观察经验中逆向恢复技能并持续构建技能库。尽管VLM擅长描述单个操作事件，其能否将事件流组织为可复用技能尚不明确。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为流式具身技能发现（SESD）：模型顺序观看视频并维护一个持续更新的技能库以影响后续决策。构建Video2Skill基准，覆盖机器人桌面操作与人类厨房活动，测试三项核心能力：时间定位操作事件、将同一变换的事件分组、以及判断复用已有技能还是新建技能。评测19个开源VLM，并提出反事实库状态重平衡（CLaRe）等监督微调方法。
AI.result: 多数VLM分组能力接近随机水平，规模扩大并无稳定增益。错误模式与感知和库更新的耦合方式相关：联合模型将不同变换合并为同一技能，而仅依赖文本描述更新库的模型会重复创建已存在的技能。CLaRe等监督微调可改善分组，但训练后模型仅巩固熟悉技能，库规模停滞在参考规模的一半以下；训练中未见过的变换虽能被时间定位，却几乎不会被赋予新技能。
AI.conclusion: 识别现有技能何时不足（即决定新建技能）成为核心挑战；当前VLM在技能库扩展而非技能固化方面存在根本瓶颈。

title: Lost in Conversation or Lost in Translation? Diagnosing Multi-Turn Degradation in RAG
summary: When conversing with large language models (LLMs), users often begin with a simple question and build towards a multi-hop question through follow-up turns. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and its graph-based variant (GraphRAG) have become the dominant approaches for grounding LLM responses in external evidence, yet both are evaluated almost exclusively on single-turn, fully specified queries. We systematically investigate this evaluation mismatch through a large-scale simulation study. Building on prior work on multi-turn LLM evaluation, we transform questions from multi-hop question answering (QA) benchmarks into underspecified conversations and evaluate ten LLM assistants with eight retrieval systems across 1.5 million simulated conversations. Our findings reveal that multi-turn interaction causes widespread performance degradation, incurring relative performance drops of up to 21% and increasing unreliability by 47%, making RAG systems simultaneously less accurate and less reliable. We identify two distinct failure modes behind this degradation. Systems are either lost in translation, where conversational rephrasing distorts the retrieval query, or lost in conversation, where retrieval succeeds but the LLM fails to synthesize evidence distributed across turns.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模模拟实验揭示：现有RAG/GraphRAG评测几乎只针对单轮、完整表述的查询，而真实对话是多轮且逐步明确化的；将多跳QA问题改写为欠指定对话后发现多轮交互导致性能最大相对下降21%、不可靠性增加47%，并归纳出"lost in translation"和"lost in conversation"两种失败模式。
AI.motivation: 用户与LLM对话时通常先问简单问题，再通过追问逐步构建多跳问题；但RAG与GraphRAG的评测几乎都基于单轮、完整指定的查询，存在评测与真实使用场景的错配。作者希望系统性地量化这一错配带来的影响。
AI.method: 基于已有关于多轮LLM评测的工作，将多跳问答（multi-hop QA）基准中的问题转化为欠指定的多轮对话；共评估10个LLM助手与8种检索系统，覆盖150万次模拟对话，形成大规模模拟研究。
AI.result: 多轮交互导致普遍的性能退化：相对性能下降最高达21%，不可靠性上升47%，即RAG系统同时变得更不准确、更不可靠。
AI.conclusion: 性能退化源于两种不同失败模式：一是"lost in translation"，对话式改写扭曲了检索查询；二是"lost in conversation"，检索成功但LLM无法综合跨轮次分布的证据。

title: LAURA: Knowledge Distillation for Interpretable Ambiguous Clause Identification in Legal Contracts
summary: Legal contracts contain ambiguities that expose enterprises to financial and legal risks. Some ambiguities allow flexible interpretation without triggering disputes, while others lead to significant legal conflicts. This makes identification alone insufficient, and interpretable rationale analysis essential. We propose LAURA, a post-training framework for interpretable ambiguous clause identification. LAURA leverages knowledge distillation with an IRAC-Unlearning prompting technique to transfer knowledge from a teacher LLM to an open-weight student model (<=1B parameters), which is then trained using a joint objective combining classification and rationale generation losses. The framework supports both legal and non-legal stakeholders in making informed decisions about which ambiguities require further attention. Extensive experiments across 7 baselines and 7 open-weight models demonstrate that LAURA with Flan-T5 (250M) delivers state-of-the-art interpretability over all interpretable baselines while matching the identification performance of the best-performing opaque baseline.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LAURA，一个可解释的歧义条款识别后训练框架，通过结合 IRAC-Unlearning 提示的知识蒸馏，将教师 LLM 的知识迁移到 ≤1B 参数的学生模型，并用分类与理由生成的联合目标训练，实现识别性能与可解释性的双重目标。
AI.motivation: 法律合同中的歧义会使企业面临财务与法律风险。部分歧义可通过灵活解释化解，而另一些则引发重大法律冲突，因此仅识别歧义并不充分，还需可解释的理由分析来支撑利益相关者的决策。
AI.method: LAURA 采用后训练框架：利用 IRAC-Unlearning 提示进行知识蒸馏，将教师 LLM 的知识迁移到开放权重的小规模学生模型（≤1B 参数），再以分类损失与理由生成损失组成的联合目标进行训练。
AI.result: 在 7 个基线和 7 个开放权重模型上的大量实验表明，搭载 Flan-T5（250M）的 LAURA 在所有可解释基线中取得最优可解释性，同时识别性能与最佳的不透明基线持平。
AI.conclusion: LAURA 证明小型开放权重模型无需牺牲识别精度即可提供可解释的歧义条款分析，为法律与非法律相关方判断哪些歧义需重点关注提供了实用支持。

title: ATTUNER: Recomputation-Free KV Cache Reuse via Query-Side Adaptation
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents repeatedly load reusable content, such as skills, documents, and memory entries, into the current context. Re-encoding this content for every request wastes computation. Position-independent caching (PIC) alleviates this by encoding each artifact independently and reusing its key-value (KV) states at arbitrary positions, but it incurs a quality loss relative to full-context prefill. Existing methods repair this loss by restoring global position IDs or recomputing selected tokens. In this work, we isolate the source of the loss, finding that the positional mismatch has minor effect, and independently cached artifacts retain faithful representations: reading a provided artifact stays largely accurate, and performance degrades only when the model must select among multiple artifacts. Moreover, replacing PIC's attention scores with full-prefill scores recovers performance with the cached KV unchanged, localizing the failure to the attention rather than KV recomputation. Motivated by this, we propose \textsc{Attuner}, a query-side adaptation method that learns to read a frozen artifact cache. \textsc{Attuner} inserts low-rank adapters into the query projections and is trained by distilling full-prefill distribution into the student. It trains fewer than 0.05\% of the model parameters and, at inference, requires neither cache recomputation nor a full-context reference. On Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B across seven benchmarks covering skills, documents, memory, and code, \textsc{Attuner} substantially outperforms prior PIC baselines in both in-domain and out-of-domain settings, matches full-context prefill quality while providing up to $3.73\times$ speedup.

AI.tldr: 提出 Attuner：一种查询侧低秩适配方法，学习读取冻结的位置无关缓存，恢复 PIC 质量并实现最高 3.73× 加速。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体需反复将可复用内容（技能、文档、记忆条目）载入上下文，逐次重编码浪费算力。位置无关缓存（PIC）虽可独立编码并在任意位置复用 KV 状态，但相较全上下文 prefill 存在质量损失，现有修复方法需恢复全局位置 ID 或重算部分 token，代价高且未定位损失根源。
AI.method: 先做归因分析：发现位置错配影响轻微，独立缓存的 artifact 表示保真（读取单个 artifact 基本准确），仅在需在多个 artifact 间选择时性能下降；用全 prefill 注意力分数替换 PIC 分数即可在 KV 不变下恢复性能，说明失效源于注意力而非 KV 重算。据此提出 Attuner：在 query 投影中插入低秩适配器，通过将全 prefill 分布蒸馏到学生模型进行训练；训练参数少于 0.05%，推理时既不需重算缓存也不需全上下文参考。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-4B 与 Qwen3-8B 上，覆盖技能、文档、记忆、代码四类共七个基准，Attuner 在域内与域外设置下均显著优于既有 PIC 基线；达到与全上下文 prefill 相当的质量，同时提供最高 3.73× 加速。
AI.conclusion: PIC 的质量损失主要源于注意力而非 KV 重算，可通过轻量查询侧适配修复；Attuner 以极小训练开销实现免重算、免全上下文参考的高效高质量复用缓存方案。

title: Distilling What Matters: Confidence-Aware Selective Distillation for Large Language Models
summary: Knowledge Distillation (KD) trains a smaller-capacity student model to imitate a larger-capacity teacher model by matching output distributions, implicitly assuming the teacher to be a reliable oracle. In large language models (LLMs), this assumption often fails: teacher predictions can exhibit high entropy and hallucinations, causing standard KD to degrade well-calibrated student priors. We propose CaRE-KD, a confidence-gated distillation framework that replaces static objectives with uncertainty-adaptive optimization. CaRE-KD has two components: a token-level loss (CaRE-Divergence) that adaptively switches between Forward and Reverse KL divergence based on teacher--student confidence, and a batch-level epistemic rejection mechanism (Revival) that suppresses updates when the teacher is more uncertain than the student. We provide a gradient-level analysis showing how this dual-granularity design induces a conditional calibration mechanism that prior static divergences cannot reproduce. Empirically, across eight teacher--student pairs and eleven benchmarks spanning instruction following, chat alignment, code generation, and mathematical reasoning, CaRE-KD delivers consistent gains over strong baselines (Skewed-KL, $α$--$β$ divergence). Highlights include up to $+3.2$ average ROUGE-L on instruction-following tasks, $+2.1$ pass@1 on MBPP, $+1.7$ accuracy on GSM8k, and $+1.8$ accuracy on CollegeMath over the strongest baseline, with consistent gains in LLM-as-a-judge factuality (up to $+2.5$ per task over Skewed-RKL). Revival further acts as a principled, loss-agnostic plug-in that systematically strengthens existing distillation objectives by filtering epistemically unreliable teacher supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出CaRE-KD置信度门控蒸馏框架，用不确定性自适应优化替代静态目标，缓解LLM教师高熵与幻觉导致的蒸馏退化。
AI.motivation: 传统知识蒸馏假设教师是可靠预言机，但在大语言模型中该假设常不成立：教师预测具有高熵和幻觉，标准KD会破坏学生的良好校准先验。
AI.method: CaRE-KD包含两个组件：令牌级损失CaRE-Divergence，依据师生置信度在正向与反向KL散度间自适应切换；批级认知拒绝机制Revival，当教师比学生更不确定时抑制更新。并给出梯度级分析，说明该双粒度设计诱导出静态散度无法复现的条件校准机制。
AI.result: 在八个师生对与十一个基准（涵盖指令跟随、对话对齐、代码生成、数学推理）上，一致优于Skewed-KL、α–β散度等强基线：指令跟随平均ROUGE-L提升至+3.2，MBPP pass@1 +2.1，GSM8k +1.7，CollegeMath +1.8，LLM-as-a-judge事实性每任务最高+2.5（相对Skewed-RKL）。
AI.conclusion: CaRE-KD通过不确定性自适应优化有效缓解教师不可靠问题；Revival可作为与损失无关的通用插件，通过过滤认知不可靠的教师监督，系统性增强现有蒸馏目标。

title: VAA-CSEC: Vote-guided Advantage Allocation for Chinese Semantic Error Correction
summary: Chinese Semantic Error Correction (CSEC) targets semantic errors in Chinese text, which are typically more subtle and complex than spelling and grammatical errors but remain relatively underexplored. Existing LLM-based approaches face two recurring obstacles in this task: over-correction, and unclear interaction between Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning and self-consistency decoding, such that the benefits brought by CoT cannot be reliably transferred to final corrections. We propose Vote-guided Advantage Allocation for CSEC (VAA-CSEC), a multi-stage framework that combines CoT distillation, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Reinforcement Learning (RL) and self-consistency decoding. During RL, we design a task-specific reward function that directly aligned with the minimal-editing principle of CSEC. We further introduce Group-Level Relative Policy Optimization (GLPO), which reallocates GRPO advantages according to the margin between individual rollout rewards and the vote-aggregated group reward, aligning the RL training objective with the self-consistency objective used at inference time. Experiments on CSED-C and NaSGEC-Exam show that VAA-CSEC outperforms all LLM-based baselines on CSED-C with an F0.5 of 47.72%, achieves the highest recall of 42.15% among all methods, and establishes a new state of the art of 41.55% F0.5 on NaSGEC-Exam.

AI.tldr: 提出VAA-CSEC多阶段框架，通过投票引导的优势分配将思维链推理与自一致性解码有效结合，缓解过纠问题，在两个中文语义纠错数据集上取得最优结果。
AI.motivation: 中文语义纠错（CSEC）针对的是比拼写和语法错误更隐蔽、更复杂的语义错误，但研究相对不足。现有基于大语言模型的方法面临两大障碍：过纠（over-correction），以及思维链（CoT）推理与自一致性解码之间交互不清，导致CoT带来的收益无法可靠地传递到最终纠错结果中。
AI.method: 提出VAA-CSEC多阶段框架，融合CoT蒸馏、监督微调（SFT）、强化学习（RL）与自一致性解码。在RL阶段设计任务特定奖励函数，直接对齐CSEC的最小编辑原则；并引入组级相对策略优化（GLPO），根据单条轨迹奖励与投票聚合组奖励之间的差距重新分配GRPO优势，使RL训练目标与推理时的自一致性目标保持一致。
AI.result: 在CSED-C和NaSGEC-Exam数据集上，VAA-CSEC在CSED-C上优于所有基于LLM的基线，F0.5达47.72%；在所有方法中取得最高召回率42.15%；在NaSGEC-Exam上以41.55%的F0.5刷新最优结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过投票引导的优势分配机制，VAA-CSEC有效弥合了训练目标与推理阶段自一致性解码之间的差距，在缓解过纠的同时提升中文语义纠错性能，验证了CoT蒸馏、RL与自一致性解码协同的有效性。

title: Momentum-Coupled Rubric Adaptation for Detailed Image Captioning
comment: 28 pages, natural language processing, computer vision
summary: Detailed image captioning requires accurate and comprehensive descriptions of fine-grained visual content, yet caption quality spans factual accuracy, information coverage, and clarity. Compared with conventional methods that rely mainly on high-quality supervision or holistic rewards, rubric-based reinforcement learning decomposes these requirements into explicit criteria and provides targeted, structured feedback. However, existing methods often use separate models for caption generation, rubric construction, and judging, which may lead to inconsistent interpretations across roles. Some dynamic rubric methods alternate updates between the caption policy and rubric generator while keeping the judge fixed, but staged optimization may still leave rubric construction and judging out of step with policy optimization. We propose MoCo Rubric, a two-stage framework that coordinates these roles. First, role-conditioned, shared-parameter multi-task supervised fine-tuning equips a single vision--language model to serve as the Caption Policy, Rubric Generator, and Rubric Judge. Then, the Generator constructs rubrics online from captions sampled by the current Policy, reference captions, and image evidence. The Judge provides rubric-based rewards, and only the Policy receives GRPO updates. As Policy updates change the candidates being evaluated, we use an exponential moving average of the Policy parameters to update one momentum model shared by the Generator and Judge. This gradual transfer lets both rubric roles track Policy updates without separate RL optimization while smoothing parameter changes that could disrupt their rubric capabilities under direct synchronization. Across five captioning benchmarks, MoCo Rubric achieves an average pairwise win rate of 72.83\%, the best mean rank in blind ranking, and the highest average score in caption-based question answering.

AI.tldr: 提出MoCo Rubric两阶段框架，通过共享参数多任务SFT与动量模型协同Caption Policy、Rubric Generator和Rubric Judge三个角色，实现细粒度图像描述。
AI.motivation: 详细图像描述需要兼顾事实准确性、信息覆盖度和清晰度。基于评分标准的强化学习可将这些要求分解为显式准则并提供结构化反馈，但现有方法中生成、建标与评判常使用独立模型，导致角色间解读不一致；部分动态评分方法在策略与评分生成器间交替更新而固定评判器，分阶段优化仍会使建标与评判同策略优化脱节。
AI.method: MoCo Rubric为两阶段框架。（1）采用角色条件、共享参数的多任务监督微调，使单一视觉-语言模型同时充当Caption Policy、Rubric Generator和Rubric Judge。（2）Generator依据当前Policy采样的描述、参考描述和图像证据在线构建评分标准；Judge提供基于评分标准的奖励，仅Policy接受GRPO更新。由于Policy更新会改变被评估的候选描述，使用Policy参数的指数移动平均更新一个由Generator和Judge共享的动量模型。该渐进式传递使两个评分角色能跟踪Policy更新，无需单独RL优化，同时平滑参数变化，避免直接同步破坏其评分能力。
AI.result: 在五个图像描述基准上，MoCo Rubric取得平均72.83%的成对胜率、盲排序中最佳平均排名，以及基于描述的问答任务中最高平均分。
AI.conclusion: 通过共享参数多任务SFT与基于EMA动量模型的角色协同，MoCo Rubric缓解了多角色解读不一致和优化脱节问题，在多项描述评测中验证了有效性。

title: BaLEEN: Biasing with Latent Encoded Entities for Context-Aware ASR
summary: Transcribing domain-specific entities and rare proper nouns remains a major challenge in automatic speech recognition (ASR). In this paper, we propose BaLEEN (Biasing with Latent Encoded Entities), a lightweight, hypernetwork-based framework for dynamic contextual adaptation without fine-tuning the underlying ASR model. BaLEEN encodes variable-length contextual keywords using a pretrained language model, compresses them into a fixed sequence of latent vectors via a Perceiver bottleneck, and injects context-dependent bias vectors directly into the intermediate encoder representations of the ASR model. Because both the language model and the backbone ASR model remain entirely frozen during training, BaLEEN operates as a plug-and-play adapter that incurs zero computational overhead at inference time when context biases are precomputed. We evaluate our method on a CTC-based ASR model using a Wikipedia-derived corpus with annotated named entities and synthetic speech. Experimental results demonstrate that BaLEEN reduces keyword miss rate by 8.7% on the test set relative to the unbiased baseline while simultaneously improving overall word error rate by 21% and character error rate by 28%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BaLEEN，一种基于超网络的轻量级上下文自适应框架，通过将可变长度关键词编码为固定潜在向量并注入ASR编码器，实现免微调的动态偏置，在降低关键词漏检率的同时改善整体识别性能。
AI.motivation: 自动语音识别在转录领域特定实体和罕见专有名词时仍面临重大挑战。现有方法通常需要对底层ASR模型进行微调，成本高且不灵活，因此需要一种无需微调、可即插即用的动态上下文适配方案。
AI.method: 提出BaLEEN（Biasing with Latent Encoded Entities）框架：使用预训练语言模型编码可变长度的上下文关键词，通过Perceiver瓶颈压缩为固定长度的潜在向量序列，并将上下文相关的偏置向量直接注入ASR模型的中间编码器表示中。训练过程中语言模型和主干ASR模型均保持冻结，使其成为即插即用适配器；当上下文偏置预计算时，推理阶段零额外计算开销。在基于CTC的ASR模型上，使用带有命名实体标注的维基百科衍生语料及合成语音进行评估。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，相对无偏置基线，BaLEEN在测试集上将关键词漏检率降低8.7%，同时整体词错误率（WER）改善21%，字符错误率（CER）改善28%。
AI.conclusion: BaLEEN验证了基于超网络的潜在实体编码偏置方法在免微调条件下可同时提升关键词召回与整体识别精度，为ASR动态上下文自适应提供了一种轻量、高效且即插即用的解决方案。

title: Can Language Models Learn to Forecast Stock Prices
summary: Post-training has been shown to significantly improve language models' performance on tasks with verifiable outcomes, including mathematical reasoning, software engineering, and computer use. However, whether the same approach can improve forecasting in financial markets is much less clear. Compared with tasks with verifiable outcomes, not only are realized returns noisy, but even what constitutes a relevant information set for making effective predictions is not obvious a priori: the model must decide which observations to gather and then commit to a numerical judgment before the outcome is known. We study this question in a chronological stock-price sandbox, where a language model gathers price, volume, relative-performance, and market-context evidence and predicts a future return. We post-train Qwen3-4B with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on tool-use demonstrations, then proximal policy optimization (PPO) with a terminal reward given by the forecast score against the realized return. The resulting AURA-4B more than doubles the starting direction--magnitude score, from 20.94 to 43.31, and is comparable to frontier language models on this benchmark. Conditional magnitude agreement rises from 33.3 to 66.2, while directional accuracy changes from 62.9 to 65.4. SFT expands tool use, and PPO further increases the share of ranking and market-context queries. These results show that post-training can substantially improve financial forecasting performance, together with changes in how the model investigates the market, on this outcome-selected benchmark.

AI.tldr: 该研究在按时间顺序构建的股价沙盒中，用SFT+PPO对Qwen3-4B进行后训练，使AURA-4B的预测方向-幅度得分从20.94提升至43.31，接近前沿模型水平。
AI.motivation: 后训练在数学推理、软件工程等可验证任务上效果显著，但在金融市场预测中是否同样有效尚不明确。金融预测的回报噪声大，且相关信息集事先不明确，模型需自行决定采集哪些信息并在结果未知前给出数值判断，因此构成一个更具挑战性的问题。
AI.method: 构建按时间顺序的股价沙盒环境，语言模型收集价格、成交量、相对表现与市场背景证据并预测未来收益。先用工具使用示范对Qwen3-4B做监督微调（SFT），再以基于已实现收益的预测得分作为终端奖励进行近端策略优化（PPO），得到AURA-4B。
AI.result: 方向-幅度得分从20.94提升至43.31，翻倍以上，在该基准上与前沿语言模型相当；条件幅度一致率由33.3升至66.2；方向准确率由62.9变为65.4。SFT扩大了工具使用，PPO进一步提高了排序查询和市场背景查询的占比。
AI.conclusion: 在该基于结果筛选的基准上，后训练能显著提升金融预测表现，同时改变模型调查市场的方式。但结论受限于基准的结果选择性，泛化性仍需进一步验证。

title: Benchmarking Automatic Speech Recognition Tools for Iberian Languages
summary: Comprehensive evaluations of automatic speech recognition (ASR) for Iberian languages remain limited, and low-resource languages, biases, and efficiency trade-offs are underexplored. We benchmark eleven systems, ten open-weight models and one commercial API, across five Iberian languages (Basque, Catalan, Galician, Portuguese, Spanish), with German and Turkish as controls. Evaluation uses an 85-hour dataset covering read speech, broadcast media, and audiobooks, assessing accuracy and efficiency via word error rate (WER) and real-time factors (RTF/RTFx). Results show no single model dominates: accuracy, efficiency, and language coverage present clear trade-offs. Low-resource languages, especially Basque, degrade significantly, highlighting the role of training coverage. We observe consistent sex disparities across most systems, highlighting fairness challenges in multilingual ASR. Overall, the benchmark provides practical guidance for real-world model selection.

AI.tldr: 该研究对11个ASR系统（10个开源模型+1个商用API）在5种伊比利亚语言上进行准确率与效率基准评测，揭示精度、效率与语言覆盖之间存在权衡，低资源语言（尤其巴斯克语）性能显著退化，并发现普遍的性别差异。
AI.motivation: 伊比利亚语言的ASR综合评测仍较有限，低资源语言、偏差及效率权衡问题尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 构建85小时数据集，涵盖朗读语音、广播媒体和有声书；以巴斯克语、加泰罗尼亚语、加利西亚语、葡萄牙语、西班牙语为目标语言，德语和土耳其语为对照；评测11个系统（10个开源权重模型+1个商用API），采用WER衡量准确率，RTF/RTFx衡量效率。
AI.result: 无单一模型在所有维度占优，准确率、效率与语言覆盖呈明显权衡；低资源语言（尤其巴斯克语）性能显著下降，反映训练覆盖的影响；多数系统存在一致的性别差异。
AI.conclusion: 该基准为多语言ASR的实际模型选择提供实用指导，并凸显低资源语言覆盖与公平性问题。

title: Dating the Model: Hidden Dates in System Prompts Affect LLM Evaluation
summary: Reproducibility is essential for scientific research, yet prior work shows that LLM outputs vary with hardware and batching. We identify an overlooked factor: the hidden injection of the current date into system prompts, which users cannot control and which changes every day. Across 9 recent LLMs and 6 datasets spanning multiple-choice QA (MCQA), math reasoning, code generation, and machine translation, performance varies solely with the current date, with deltas of up to 6% on MCQA, 14% on math reasoning, 7% on code generation, and 2.84 BLEU on machine translation. Model rankings also shift, affecting leaderboards. This date effect exceeds other sources of non-determinism, such as batch size and numerical precision. Standard prompting techniques -- chain-of-thought and few-shot prompting -- do not reduce the sensitivity; chain-of-thought even amplifies it. Our findings underscore the need for careful evaluation protocols to ensure reproducibility and fair comparisons in LLM research.

AI.tldr: LLM 系统提示中会被隐式注入当前日期（用户无法控制且每日变化），该日期单独即可导致模型性能显著波动并改变模型排名，是此前被忽视的可复现性风险源。
AI.motivation: 已有研究显示 LLM 输出会因硬件与批处理而变化，但尚未有人识别出"系统提示中隐式注入当前日期"这一不可控因素。作者希望揭示该因素对可复现性与公平比较的威胁。
AI.method: 在 9 个近期 LLM 与 6 个数据集上开展实验，任务覆盖多选问答（MCQA）、数学推理、代码生成和机器翻译；仅改变当前日期，观察性能变化，并与批大小、数值精度等其他非确定性来源对比；同时检验 chain-of-thought 与 few-shot 提示是否缓解该敏感性。
AI.result: 性能仅随当前日期变化即出现显著波动：MCQA 最高 6%、数学推理 14%、代码生成 7%、机器翻译 2.84 BLEU。模型排名也发生变动，影响排行榜。日期效应超过批大小和数值精度等非确定性来源。CoT 与 few-shot 提示无法降低敏感性，CoT 反而放大该效应。
AI.conclusion: 隐式日期注入是 LLM 评估中被忽视的重要混淆因素，其影响力超过常见非确定性来源且难以通过提示技巧消除。LLM 研究需建立更严格的评估协议，以保证可复现性与公平比较。

title: ER-JEPA: Experience Replay Improves Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning in Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) excel at token-level generation but may learn undesirable abstract semantics and lack comprehensive perception. LLM-JEPA mitigates this by aligning different views of the same underlying knowledge via a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA). However, strong alignment does not necessarily lead to accurate, stable predictions. To address this, we propose ER-JEPA, which adds an episodic replay path to LLM-JEPA. ER-JEPA stores training pairs in a memory. At each step, it stores and retrieves relevant data to provide additional supervision. This enables learning from both the current batch and stored training pairs, providing additional supervision for token prediction and representation alignment. Experiments across multiple datasets (NL-RX, GSM8K, Spider, and NQ-Open) demonstrate that ER-JEPA consistently outperforms LLM-JEPA.

AI.tldr: ER-JEPA在LLM-JEPA基础上引入情景重放路径，通过在记忆中存储并检索训练对来提供额外监督，在多个数据集上稳定超越LLM-JEPA。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型擅长token级生成，但可能学到不理想的抽象语义且感知能力不足。LLM-JEPA通过联合嵌入预测架构对齐同一知识的多种视图来缓解该问题，但强对齐并不必然带来准确、稳定的预测。
AI.method: 提出ER-JEPA，在LLM-JEPA上增加情景重放路径。该方法将训练对存入记忆，每一步存储并检索相关数据以提供额外监督，从而同时从当前批次和已存储训练对中学习，为token预测与表征对齐提供额外监督信号。
AI.result: 在NL-RX、GSM8K、Spider和NQ-Open等多个数据集上的实验表明，ER-JEPA始终优于LLM-JEPA。
AI.conclusion: 情景重放能够为LLM-JEPA补充额外监督，改善token预测与表征对齐，是一种有效且一致的增强方案。

title: AMU:Admission and Memory Update for Personalized Conversations---Structured Memory with SLM Guided Control
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures. Source code and implementation are available at: https://github.com/UnicusT11/AMU-memory
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have become the foundation of personalized assistants, but maintaining persistent user memory across long-term interactions remains challenging. Existing memory systems often focus on storage, retrieval, or consolidation, while memory writing remains less controlled: transient requests, duplicate statements, and outdated user states may enter memory and later be retrieved for personalization. In this paper, we present AMU: Admission and Memory Update for Personalized Conversations, an SLM-guided (Small language model guided) structured framework for writing-time memory control. AMU uses structured memory filtering to decide what should enter memory and SLM-guided storage management to determine whether an admitted record should be stored separately, discarded as a duplicate, or fused as an update. We evaluate AMU in a controlled memory writing and retrieval setting. Experimental results show that AMU maintains cleaner and more retrievable personalized memories.

AI.tldr: 提出AMU框架，用SLM引导的结构化方法在写入阶段控制个性化对话记忆的准入与更新。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM个性化助手的记忆系统多聚焦存储、检索与巩固，记忆写入环节缺乏控制，导致临时请求、重复表述和过时用户状态进入记忆并被检索用于个性化。
AI.method: AMU由两部分组成：结构化记忆过滤决定哪些内容可进入记忆；SLM引导的存储管理判断被准入记录应单独存储、作为重复项丢弃还是融合为更新。在受控的记忆写入与检索设置下评估。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，AMU能够维持更干净、更可检索的个性化记忆。
AI.conclusion: 在写入阶段引入受控的记忆准入与更新机制，可有效提升个性化对话记忆的质量与可检索性。

title: SRJudge: Empowering Large Language Models with Selective Reasoning for Fine-Grained Knowledge Concept Tagging
summary: Knowledge concept tagging aims to assign specific concept or topic labels to educational content, which is essential for both educators and learners in traditional and online teaching practices. Recent work has explored large language models (LLMs) for this task, achieving promising performance. However, LLMs still struggle to select the correct concept from a large-scale candidate set due to the high dimensionality of the decision space. In this paper, we propose a novel three-stage Select-Reason-Judge (SRJudge) framework, which empowers LLMs with selective reasoning capability for fine-grained knowledge concept tagging. Specifically, the Selector in Stage 1 first narrows the candidate concepts to a top-K shortlist by fine-tuning a small language model (SLM), e.g., BERT, since the top-$K$ predictions hit the correct concept in most cases, thereby reducing the decision space of correct candidates. Next, the Stage 2 Reasoner employs a lightweight LLM for refined reasoning over the shortlisted candidates. It further integrates an improved reinforcement learning strategy with a dynamic task-specific reward function and a pruning mechanism to better align with human reasoning preferences. Finally, a larger LLM acts as a judger that evaluates the overall rationality of the reasoning process and its explanations to determine the final output. In addition, we construct two high-quality datasets for further validation, i.e., the biology dataset S_Bio and the physics dataset S_Phy. Experimental results demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across benchmark datasets, verifying its effectiveness and superiority. Resources are available at: https://github.com/Nicozwy/SRJudge.

AI.tldr: 提出SRJudge三阶段框架（Select-Reason-Judge），通过SLM缩小候选集、轻量LLM强化学习推理、大LLM评判，实现细粒度知识概念标注。
AI.motivation: 知识概念标注对教学至关重要，但LLM在大规模候选集中因决策空间高维而难以选对正确概念。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：Stage1 Selector用微调SLM（如BERT）将候选缩至top-K短名单；Stage2 Reasoner用轻量LLM精炼推理，结合改进强化学习策略（动态任务奖励函数与剪枝机制）对齐人类推理偏好；Stage3用更大LLM作judger评估推理合理性及解释以确定最终输出。另构建S_Bio与S_Phy两个数据集。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上持续优于最先进基线，验证了方法的有效性与优越性。
AI.conclusion: SRJudge通过选择性推理有效缓解大候选集决策空间问题，为细粒度知识概念标注提供有效方案，并开源资源。

title: CypherTurn: A Multi-Turn Benchmark for Conversational Text-to-Cypher Evaluation and the Autonomy Divergence
comment: Accepted as an oral paper at EMNLP 2026
summary: Graph databases are increasingly queried through natural language, yet every existing benchmark evaluates isolated single-turn queries rather than the multi-turn sessions through which analysts actually work. We introduce CypherTurn, the first benchmark for conversational Text-to-Cypher evaluation, comprising 721 sessions and 5,927 turns across 7 knowledge graphs and 13 conversational phenomena. We evaluate 15 models under a guided oracle protocol and a fully autonomous agentic protocol, yielding four findings. First, the best model reaches only 64.7% execution accuracy, and session-level correctness remains below 5%. Second, despite strong overall rank correlation, frontier models exhibit a consequential reordering of the top of the leaderboard under autonomous operation, a phenomenon we term the Autonomy Divergence, which reveals error-management as a partially independent capability from raw generation skill. Third, scaling action budgets from x3 to x10 fails to close the autonomy gap, as the strongest frontier models self-limit to approximately two actions per turn regardless of available budget. Fourth, single-turn Cypher fine-tuning degrades multi-turn instruction following, while architecture-appropriate specialization outperforms several frontier models. These results establish CypherTurn as an open challenge for conversational graph database reasoning. Code and data are available at https://github.com/BarryQ/CypherTurn.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个面向会话式 Text-to-Cypher 的基准 CypherTurn（721 个会话、5,927 轮、7 个知识图谱、13 类会话现象），在引导式 oracle 与全自主 agentic 两种协议下评测 15 个模型，揭示会话级正确率不足 5% 等四项核心发现。
AI.motivation: 现有图数据库自然语言查询基准仅评测孤立的单轮查询，而分析人员的真实工作方式是多轮会话交互，二者存在显著错位，因此缺乏面向多轮会话的 Text-to-Cypher 评测手段。
AI.method: 构建 CypherTurn 基准：721 个会话、5,927 个轮次，覆盖 7 个知识图谱与 13 类会话现象；在引导式 oracle 协议与完全自主的 agentic 协议两种设置下对 15 个模型进行评测，并分析动作预算、微调策略等因素的影响。
AI.result: （1）最佳模型执行准确率仅 64.7%，会话级正确率低于 5%；（2）整体排名相关性强，但自主运行下前沿模型榜首排序发生重排（Autonomy Divergence），说明错误管理能力与原始生成能力部分独立；（3）动作预算从 ×3 扩至 ×10 无法弥合自主性差距，最强模型每轮自我限制在约 2 个动作；（4）单轮 Cypher 微调会损害多轮指令遵循能力，而架构适配的领域特化模型优于若干前沿模型。
AI.conclusion: CypherTurn 确立了会话式图数据库推理的开放挑战，表明多轮 Text-to-Cypher 在会话级正确率、自主错误管理与训练策略适配方面仍有巨大提升空间。

title: LatCom: Cross-Agent Latent Compression for Efficient Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) increasingly use latent collaboration to avoid the information loss and repeated encoding-decoding overhead of natural-language communication. However, directly forwarding all sender latents makes the receiver-side context scale with both the number of agents and the reasoning length, increasing computation, memory usage, and collaboration latency. A natural solution is latent compression. But we find that cross-agent redundancy remains unresolved in existing latent compression approaches, which typically compress each sender independently and then concatenate the results. We propose LatCom, a cross-agent latent compression framework for efficient multi-agent latent collaboration. LatCom maps multiple sender latents into a fixed number of receiver-readable and task-relevant slots. Rather than reconstructing all sender hidden states, it optimizes the compressed latents for receiver-side task utility. LatCom trains the compressor in two stages: single-sender readability learning first establishes a latent interface interpretable by the frozen receiver, and multi-sender fusion learning then trains the compressor to fuse complementary evidence and remove redundancy across agents. Experiments on multiple benchmarks with Qwen3-4B show that LatCom achieves an average 2.46x inference speed-up over LatentMAS and reduces output token usage by 70.3% while maintaining comparable average accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LatCom，一种面向多智能体潜在协作的跨智能体潜在压缩框架，通过将多个发送方的潜在表示映射到固定数量的接收方可读且任务相关的槽位中，在保持精度基本不变的同时显著提升推理速度并降低输出 token 消耗。
AI.motivation: 基于 LLM 的多智能体系统（MAS）日益采用潜在协作以规避自然语言通信的信息损失与反复编解码开销。然而，直接转发所有发送方潜在表示会使接收方上下文随智能体数量和推理长度增长，导致计算、内存占用与协作延迟上升。潜在压缩是自然的解决思路，但现有方法通常各自独立压缩每个发送方再拼接，未能解决跨智能体冗余问题。
AI.method: LatCom 将多个发送方的潜在表示映射为固定数量的、接收方可读且任务相关的槽位，并不以重构全部发送方隐状态为目标，而是针对接收方任务效用优化压缩后的潜在表示。其压缩器采用两阶段训练：第一阶段为单发送方可读性学习，建立可被冻结接收方解释的潜在接口；第二阶段为多发送方融合学习，训练压缩器融合互补证据并消除智能体间冗余。
AI.result: 在多个基准上使用 Qwen3-4B 的实验表明，LatCom 相较 LatentMAS 平均实现 2.46 倍推理加速，输出 token 用量减少 70.3%，同时保持相当的平均准确率。
AI.conclusion: 跨智能体潜在压缩能够有效缓解潜在协作中的上下文膨胀与冗余问题，LatCom 通过面向接收方任务效用的固定槽位压缩与两阶段训练，在效率与精度之间取得了良好平衡。

title: Selecting The Most Informative Tokens in Natural Language Autoencoders
summary: Natural language autoencoders translate a language model's internal activations into readable explanations. Explaining every token position is costly. Which positions should an auditor inspect to understand a potential threat? We study this question across $4.7$ million explanations on prompt injection and concealment. We compare signals from model computation with a ranker trained only on chat structure. Chat structure usually selects more relevant explanations than the computational signals, without requiring a model forward pass for position selection. On three of four datasets, explaining just $5\%$ of positions retains nearly all of the success rate from explaining every position, where success means obtaining an explanation about the threat. The benefit varies with the audit task. We also show that pretrained verbalizers recover words that models have learned to conceal through fine-tuning, without additional verbalizer training. These results identify where auditors can concentrate explanation generation and show that useful explanations can extend beyond the model a verbalizer was trained to describe.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自然语言自编码器解释生成的位置选择问题，发现仅用对话结构（chat structure）训练的位置排序器比计算信号更能选出相关解释，且在多数数据集上仅解释5%位置即可保留几乎全部威胁检出成功率；同时预训练verbalizer无需再训练即可恢复模型微调后习得隐藏的词。
AI.motivation: 自然语言自编码器可将语言模型内部激活转化为可读解释，但对每个token位置都生成解释成本高昂。审计者需要知道：在理解潜在威胁时，应优先检查哪些位置，以在有限预算下获得高价值解释。
AI.method: 在470万条针对prompt injection与信息隐藏（concealment）的解释数据上开展研究。将模型计算产生的信号与仅基于对话结构训练的排序器（ranker）进行对比，评估其选择解释的相关性；并测量只解释部分位置时威胁检出成功率相对全位置解释的保留程度；此外测试预训练verbalizer对微调后隐藏词的恢复能力。
AI.result: 对话结构排序器通常比计算信号选出更相关的解释，且位置选择无需模型前向传播。在四个数据集中的三个上，仅解释5%的位置即可保留接近全位置解释的成功率（成功定义为获得关于威胁的解释）。该收益随审计任务而变化。预训练verbalizer无需额外训练即可恢复模型经微调学会隐藏的词。
AI.conclusion: 研究指明了审计者可集中生成解释的位置，降低审计成本；并表明有用解释可超越verbalizer原本被训练描述的模型范围，对话结构是高效且实用的位置选择信号。

title: Learning from Think-Mode Advantage via On-Policy Distillation
summary: Explicit intermediate reasoning gives large language models (LLMs) a stronger problem-solving mode. We study learning from this think-mode advantage via on-policy distillation (OPD). OPD preserves student-generated trajectories and provides dense token-level teacher targets at student-visited prefixes. Privileged reasoning is used during distillation rather than student inference. Uniform ThinkOPD, a natural think-enabled OPD baseline, conditions a fixed teacher on one shared think trace and uniformly distills every sibling student response. Although its prefixes are on-policy, the trace need not follow a route compatible with every complete response: the same privileged trace can induce different teacher-student discrepancies even when responses reach the same outcome. We summarize this interaction with trace-response divergence (TRD) and introduce ThinkOPD, which routes supervision at the response level by combining group-relative reward gain with a TRD-based compatibility proxy. Final response weights are normalized within each rollout group. Across mathematical reasoning and code generation, ThinkOPD outperforms Uniform ThinkOPD in both same-model settings and both cross-model teacher-student pairs, and it exceeds representative rationale and self-distillation baselines in a controlled comparison. Controlled interventions show that outcome benefit and the TRD-based proxy provide complementary routing signals in this setting. Think-enabled OPD provides a controlled setting for studying how teacher advantage becomes transferable along student responses.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究"显式推理（think-mode）优势"的可迁移性，提出 trace-response divergence (TRD) 刻画特权推理轨迹与不同学生响应之间的不兼容，并据此提出 ThinkOPD：在响应级别结合组内相对奖励增益与 TRD 兼容性代理进行路由式监督，权重在 rollout 组内归一化。在数学推理与代码生成上均优于 Uniform ThinkOPD 及多种蒸馏基线。
AI.motivation: 显式中间推理赋予 LLM 更强的解题模式，但如何通过 on-policy distillation (OPD) 有效学习这种 think-mode 优势尚不清晰。OPD 在学生学习轨迹上提供稠密的 token 级教师目标，而特权推理仅用于蒸馏阶段而非学生推理阶段。朴素的 think-enabled OPD（Uniform ThinkOPD）让固定教师条件于同一条共享思维轨迹，对同一组内所有兄弟响应统一蒸馏；但其前缀虽为 on-policy，该轨迹未必与每个完整响应路径兼容——即便响应结果相同，同一特权轨迹也可能造成不同的教师-学生差异。作者由此动机在于用 TRD 总结这一交互，并设计更合理的监督路由。
AI.method: 1) 定义 trace-response divergence (TRD)，度量共享特权思维轨迹与各学生响应之间的分歧/兼容性。2) 提出 ThinkOPD：在响应级别进行监督路由，将组内相对奖励增益（group-relative reward gain）与基于 TRD 的兼容性代理（compatibility proxy）相结合，得到每个响应的权重，并在每个 rollout 组内归一化。3) 对照基线为 Uniform ThinkOPD（固定教师、共享 think trace、统一蒸馏）。4) 评估覆盖数学推理与代码生成，包含同模型设置与两对跨模型 teacher-student 组合，并与代表性 rationale 蒸馏与自蒸馏基线做受控比较；另设受控干预实验分析两类路由信号的贡献。
AI.result: 在数学推理与代码生成任务上，ThinkOPD 在同模型设置与两对跨模型 teacher-student 组合中均优于 Uniform ThinkOPD，并在受控比较中超过代表性的 rationale 蒸馏与自蒸馏基线。受控干预实验表明，结果收益（outcome benefit）与基于 TRD 的代理在本设定下提供互补的路由信号。
AI.conclusion: think-enabled OPD 为研究"教师优势如何沿学生响应迁移"提供了一个受控场景；在 OPD 中，简单地对共享 think trace 做统一蒸馏并不充分，需要在响应级别依据结果收益与 TRD 兼容性联合路由监督，才能更有效地把 think-mode 优势传递给学生。

title: Traverse: Learning When to Remember, Reset, and Redirect for Long-Horizon Web Search
summary: Long-horizon information-seeking agents often accumulate noisy or misleading context, causing early mistakes to persist and making recovery increasingly difficult. We introduce an autonomous search harness in which the agent manages its own search process through three states: Rubric, Answer, and Verify. The agent first defines criteria for a valid answer, searches under these criteria, and then independently verifies the result before deciding whether to terminate or continue searching. It is further equipped with a Seal Memory tool that enables active context management. Training this behavior with reinforcement learning, however, can induce Seal Collapse, resulting in unstable training and preventing the agent from reliably learning when and how to use its memory tools. We solve this with a simple strategy that trains only the final segment after context management. Our 35B model achieves 72.83 on BrowseComp, outperforming comparable open-source systems, and consistently improves over the base model across BrowseComp-ZH, xbench, DeepSearchQA, WideSearch, financial investigation, and product search. Ablations show that autonomous compression outperforms automatic compaction and validate our RL design.

AI.tldr: 提出自主搜索框架（Rubric-Answer-Verify三状态）与Seal Memory主动上下文管理工具，并用"仅训练上下文管理后最终段"的策略解决RL中的Seal Collapse问题，35B模型在BrowseComp达72.83。
AI.motivation: 长程信息检索智能体会不断累积噪声或误导性上下文，导致早期错误持续存在、恢复愈发困难。
AI.method: 构建自主搜索框架：智能体通过Rubric（定义有效答案标准）、Answer（按标准搜索）、Verify（独立验证并决定终止或继续）三状态自主管理搜索过程；配备Seal Memory工具进行主动上下文管理；采用仅训练上下文管理后最终段的简单策略缓解RL中的Seal Collapse。
AI.result: 35B模型在BrowseComp上取得72.83，优于同类开源系统，并在BrowseComp-ZH、xbench、DeepSearchQA、WideSearch、金融调查和产品搜索上持续优于基座模型；消融实验表明自主压缩优于自动压缩，并验证了RL设计。
AI.conclusion: 自主上下文管理与合理RL训练设计可有效缓解长程搜索中的错误累积问题，提升信息检索智能体性能。

title: What Does Post-Training Change in Multilingual Reasoning?
comment: 20 pages, 9 figures, 21 tables. Main paper and supplementary material in one document
summary: Open-source reasoning models provide unequal access to reasoning capability across languages. When a model can solve a problem but cannot deliver a complete solution in the user's language, language becomes an access barrier rather than merely a source of performance variation. We audit Qwen3 checkpoints on competition-mathematics tasks in eleven languages. Across the ten non-English languages, only 15.4-17.9% of problems receive a correct, terminating solution with visible reasoning in the requested language in any of 16 samples, compared with 92.9% in English. To identify the source of this disparity, we evaluate thirteen endpoints from one model family, spanning released checkpoints, multilingual supervised fine-tuning (SFT) at two scales, controlled SFT ablations, and three reinforcement-learning (RL) reward formulations. We jointly track correctness, language adherence, termination, and delivery efficiency. The dominant bottleneck shifts across post-training stages. Released models often reason in English. Multilingual SFT restores target-language reasoning, but accuracy declines across multilingual, English-only, and single-language SFT runs, showing that this cost is not specific to multilingual mixing; non-English reasoning traces additionally become prone to non-terminating loops. RL restores termination in both arms at no cost in accuracy, but only the arm whose reward includes a language term delivers: rewarding correctness alone returns the model to English. Together, these stages establish a constructive post-training path from English-pivoted capability to multilingual reasoning that is reliably delivered.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计了Qwen3在11种语言竞赛数学任务上的表现，发现非英语语言存在"可解题但无法用用户语言交付完整解答"的访问障碍，并通过跨后训练阶段的对比实验定位了瓶颈迁移规律。
AI.motivation: 开源推理模型在不同语言间提供不平等的推理能力访问。当模型能解决问题却无法用用户语言给出完整解答时，语言就从单纯的性能差异来源变成了访问门槛。作者希望识别这一差异的来源，并找到一条从英语中心化能力走向可靠多语言推理的后训练路径。
AI.method: 在11种语言的竞赛数学任务上审计Qwen3各检查点，评估同一模型家族的13个端点，覆盖已发布检查点、两种规模的多语言SFT、受控SFT消融，以及三种RL奖励形式；联合追踪正确性、语言依从性、终止性和交付效率。
AI.result: 十种非英语语言中，任意16次采样内仅15.4-17.9%的问题能获得用所请求语言进行可见推理且正确终止的解答，而英语为92.9%。已发布模型常以英语推理；多语言SFT恢复了目标语言推理但使准确率下降（多语言、纯英语、单语言SFT均如此，说明该代价并非多语言混合特有），且非英语推理轨迹易出现不终止循环；RL在两种设置下均恢复了终止性且不损失准确率，但只有奖励中包含语言项的设置能保持目标语言，仅奖励正确性会使模型回到英语。
AI.conclusion: 这些后训练阶段共同建立了一条建设性路径，从英语中心的推理能力过渡到能够可靠交付的多语言推理。

title: Cross-Linguistic Effects in Bilingual Phoneme BabyLMs
comment: 13 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables; Accepted at the 2nd BabyLM Workshop at EMNLP 2026
summary: Cross-linguistic effects are a central topic in bilingual first-language acquisition. Artificial learners can help investigate L1-L2 interactions by enabling controlled comparisons across language combinations and learning conditions. Recent work explores this direction by training bilingual language models under developmentally plausible constraints. However, human and model learners still diverge in fundamental ways, with one major difference being input modality: children learn primarily from spoken input, whereas language models are typically trained on orthographic text. To reduce this gap, researchers have trained models on phonemic representations of speech. In this work, we combine these research directions to train bilingual BabyLMs with phonemic input. We keep English fixed as the L2 and vary the L1 across German, Swedish, Persian, and Basque, selected to represent contrasting combinations of syntactic and phoneme-inventory distance from English. Our results show stronger L1-related variation in grammatical learning trajectories under phonemic than orthographic input, while early lexical differences align with phoneme-inventory similarity.

AI.tldr: 该研究训练了以音素（phonemic）输入的双语 BabyLM，固定英语为 L2，变换 L1（德语、瑞典语、波斯语、巴斯克语）以考察跨语言效应；结果显示音素输入比正字法输入导致更强的 L1 相关语法学习轨迹差异，而早期词汇差异与音素库存相似性一致。
AI.motivation: 跨语言效应是双语一语习得的核心议题，人工学习器可通过受控的语言组合与学习条件比较来研究 L1-L2 交互。当前双语语言模型虽在发展上更贴近真实学习条件，但与人类学习者仍存在根本差异，其中最突出的是输入模态：儿童主要从口语输入学习，而语言模型通常训练于正字法文本。为缩小该差距，作者将"音素表征训练"与"双语 BabyLM"两条研究路线结合。
AI.method: 训练双语 BabyLM，输入为音素表征。固定英语为 L2，L1 在德语、瑞典语、波斯语、巴斯克语之间变化，这些语言在句法距离与音素库存距离上与英语构成不同的对比组合。通过对比音素输入与正字法输入下的学习表现，考察 L1 相关变异。
AI.result: 在音素输入下，语法学习轨迹表现出比正字法输入更强的、与 L1 相关的变异；早期词汇层面的差异则与音素库存相似性一致。
AI.conclusion: 音素输入能放大 L1 对 L2 语法学习轨迹的影响，而早期词汇学习受音素库存相似性驱动，表明输入模态在双语建模与跨语言迁移研究中具有关键作用。

title: LLM unbranding: Erasing Commercial Identity while Preserving Generic Utility
summary:
Establishing unbranding as a critical practice to prevent visual logos from acquiring negative connotations is standard in image generation. Large Language Models (LLMs) now face a parallel and emerging challenge. These models frequently generate brand descriptions within diverse contexts. This frequency introduces significant risks, such as trademark dilution, false attribution, and brand defamation. In response, we formally define the novel task of LLM Unbranding. We specifically address the complex challenge of managing trade dress within textual outputs. This involves neutralizing characteristic language, slogans, and stylistic markers that define brand identity. Crucially, these elements are less evident than explicit visual logos. To benchmark this task, we introduce a comprehensive evaluation dataset incorporating prominent brands from multiple commercial domains. We rigorously evaluate existing state-of-the-art machine unlearning models using this benchmark. This evaluation identifies their limitations in selective textual unbranding. Finally, we propose MUTE, a novel inference-time method that effectively neutralizes textual trade dress while preserving the LLM's general capabilities and utility. By leveraging an iterative refinement loop, MUTE systematically optimizes system instructions to safely eliminate brand leakage without requiring fragile parameter updates.
  Code and dataset: The evaluation dataset and code for LLM Unbranding are available at https://github.com/KajetanOzog/LLM_unbranding. The implementation of MUTE is available at https://github.com/KajetanOzog/MUTE.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"LLM Unbranding"新任务，旨在消除LLM文本输出中的"文本商业外观"（trade dress），如品牌特征用语、口号与风格标记，以规避商标稀释、错误归属与品牌诽谤风险。作者构建了跨商业领域的评测数据集，评估现有机器遗忘方法后发现其在选择性文本去品牌化上表现有限，进而提出MUTE——一种推理时迭代优化系统指令的方法，在有效消除品牌泄漏的同时保持模型通用能力，无需脆弱的参数更新。
AI.motivation: 图像生成领域已将"去品牌化"确立为防止视觉logo产生负面联想的常规实践。LLM在多样语境中频繁生成品牌描述，带来商标稀释、错误归属和品牌诽谤等风险。而文本中的trade dress（特征语言、口号、风格标记）比显式视觉logo更隐蔽，现有方法难以处理，因此需要正式定义并解决LLM去品牌化任务。
AI.method: 1) 形式化定义新任务"LLM Unbranding"，聚焦文本输出中的trade dress管理；2) 构建涵盖多个商业领域知名品牌的综合评测数据集；3) 用该基准严格评估现有SOTA机器遗忘模型；4) 提出MUTE：一种推理时方法，通过迭代精炼循环（iterative refinement loop）系统优化系统指令，实现品牌泄漏消除，无需参数更新。
AI.result: 对现有SOTA机器遗忘模型的评估揭示了它们在选择性文本去品牌化方面的局限性。MUTE能够有效中和文本trade dress，同时保留LLM的通用能力与实用性，且不依赖脆弱的参数更新。评测数据集与代码已在GitHub公开。
AI.conclusion: 文本去品牌化是LLM面临的新兴且重要挑战，参数层面的机器遗忘方法难以胜任选择性的trade dress消除；基于推理时系统指令迭代优化的MUTE提供了一种有效、稳健且不损害模型通用能力的解决方案，并为该方向提供了公开基准。

title: Bridging Semantic Gaps in RAG through Generated Context Knowledge Fusion
comment: This paper is accepted by NLPCC 2026
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation has established itself as a fundamental framework in natural language processing, seamlessly integrating information retrieval with the generative capabilities of large language models. However, this process is fundamentally constrained by a critical challenge: semantic space mismatch between queries and retrieved contexts. We propose Knowledge-Aware Semantic Bridging (KASB), a novel framework that improves passage selection quality through semantic space alignment between queries and retrieved documents through intelligent knowledge fusion. Our approach leverages the complementary strengths of generative and retrieval-based knowledge through a multistage process that enhances both relevance and accuracy. We evaluate KASB on three popular open-domain Question Answering datasets to demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出知识感知语义桥接（KASB）框架，通过多阶段知识融合对齐查询与检索文档的语义空间，以提升RAG中的段落选择质量。
AI.motivation: 检索增强生成（RAG）虽已整合信息检索与大语言模型生成能力，但受限于查询与检索上下文之间的语义空间失配这一关键挑战，导致段落选择质量受损。
AI.method: KASB：通过智能知识融合，在查询与检索文档之间进行语义空间对齐；采用多阶段流程，融合生成式知识与检索式知识的互补优势，以同时提升相关性与准确性。
AI.result: 在三个主流开放域问答数据集上进行评估，验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: KASB通过语义桥接与知识融合有效缓解语义空间失配问题，改善段落选择质量，为RAG框架提供了一种可行增强方案。

title: VLM Fine-Tuning for End-to-End Combinatorial Optimization
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have provided a unified interface for end-to-end combinatorial optimization (CO), but textual serialization alone may obscure spatial and relational structures that are important for generating effective CO solutions. This paper presents a general-purpose vision-language solver that augments textual instance descriptions with input-derived visual representations. A single vision-language model (VLM) is applied across different CO tasks and trained using supervised fine-tuning followed by verifier-guided reinforcement learning. While the visual inputs contain no gold solutions or solution-derived information, our experiments show that the VLM generally improves solution quality over its text-only counterpart, with particularly clear gains on more complex CO problems such as CVRP and JSSP. The advantage of visual information is more pronounced at large problem scales.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种通用视觉-语言求解器，通过为文本实例描述增加由输入导出的视觉表示来增强端到端组合优化，单一VLM经SFT与验证器引导的强化学习训练后可跨任务求解，并在复杂和大规模问题上优于纯文本版本。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的端到端组合优化主要依赖文本序列化，可能掩盖对生成有效解至关重要的空间与关系结构。
AI.method: 构建通用视觉-语言求解器：在文本实例描述基础上加入由输入派生的视觉表示（不含金标准解或解相关信息），使用单一VLM跨不同CO任务，先监督微调，再进行验证器引导的强化学习训练。
AI.result: 实验表明VLM整体上比纯文本版本提升解质量；在CVRP、JSSP等更复杂问题上增益尤为明显，且视觉信息的优势在大规模问题上更显著。
AI.conclusion: 视觉模态可为端到端组合优化提供有效补充，通用VLM跨任务求解具有潜力，尤其在复杂和大规模场景下。

title: CredWise: A Controlled Agentic Decision-Intelligence Framework for Explainable and Auditable Credit-Risk Assessment
summary: Credit-risk prediction is important in banking, but a prediction alone does not explain why an applicant is risky or how it should be combined with other evidence. This paper presents CredWise, a decision-support framework that integrates credit-risk prediction, probability calibration, explainable artificial intelligence, policy retrieval, SQL analytics, and controlled agent-based workflows. An XGBoost model is trained on Lending Club data (1,345,310 loans, 18 features) using a temporal split: 2007--2016 for training, 2017 for validation, and 2018 for testing. On the 2018 test set, the calibrated model achieved a ROC-AUC of 0.7109, PR-AUC of 0.2993, F1-score of 0.3714, and accuracy of 65.44\%. Calibration reduced the Brier score from 0.2157 to 0.1273 and the expected calibration error from 0.2862 to 0.0585. SHAP explanations were temporally stable, with a Spearman correlation of 0.9959 between 2017 and 2018 feature rankings. On 28 labeled queries covering nine policy sections, FAISS achieved the best Hit@1 (0.929) and MRR (0.964), while all three retrieval methods reached Hit@5 = 1.0. Agent routing achieved 95.6\% accuracy (43 of 45 cases), and the SQL benchmark scored 1.0 on exact-match, execution-success, and result-match across six cases. These results show that CredWise can combine predictions, explanations, policy evidence, and structured analytics in one controlled workflow. It is an academic research prototype, and final decisions remain with a human reviewer.

AI.tldr: CredWise是一个整合信用风险预测、概率校准、可解释AI、政策检索、SQL分析与受控智能体工作流的决策支持框架，在Lending Club数据上验证了各模块的有效性。
AI.motivation: 单一的风险预测分数无法解释申请人为何有风险，也无法说明预测结果应如何与其他证据（如政策条款、结构化数据）结合；银行实际风控需要可解释、可追溯、可审计的综合决策支持。
AI.method: 基于Lending Club数据（1,345,310笔贷款、18个特征），按时间切分（2007–2016训练、2017验证、2018测试）训练XGBoost模型；结合概率校准、SHAP可解释性分析、基于FAISS等的政策检索、SQL分析基准，以及受控的智能体（agent）路由工作流。
AI.result: 2018测试集上校准模型ROC-AUC 0.7109、PR-AUC 0.2993、F1 0.3714、准确率65.44%；校准将Brier分数由0.2157降至0.1273，ECE由0.2862降至0.0585；SHAP解释时间稳定（2017与2018特征排序Spearman相关0.9959）。在覆盖九个政策章节的28条标注查询上，FAISS取得最佳Hit@1（0.929）与MRR（0.964），三种检索方法Hit@5均达1.0；智能体路由准确率95.6%（45例中43例）；SQL基准在六个用例上精确匹配、执行成功与结果匹配均为1.0。
AI.conclusion: CredWise能够在单一受控工作流中整合预测、解释、政策证据与结构化分析，验证了多组件协同的可行性；但其定位为学术研究原型，最终决策仍由人工审核者负责。

title: SemOPT: Fixing Semantic Errors in LLM-based Optimization Modeling via Reward-Guided Search
summary: Operations research supports decision-making in domains such as energy, economics, and healthcare. Solving operations research problems typically begins with optimization modeling, which translates a natural-language problem description into executable solver code. LLMs offer a promising way to automate this process, but they remain prone to errors. In practice, these errors can be divided into two categories: syntactic errors refer to solver code that fails to run successfully or is judged infeasible by the solver; semantic errors refer to solver code that successfully returns an objective value but violates the intent of the original problem. Since semantic errors do not trigger runtime failures, they are difficult to detect and rectify. To address this problem, we introduce SemOPT, a semantic-guided framework for correcting LLM-based optimization models. SemOPT combines a semantic reward model that distinguishes faithful math models from plausible but incorrect ones with an adaptive correction system that applies hierarchical reward-guided search over the modeling space. Experiments on seven optimization modeling benchmarks show that SemOPT establishes a new state of the art and achieves an average 7.6% accuracy improvement over the strongest baseline on complex datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出SemOPT框架，通过语义奖励模型与自适应纠错系统，修正LLM生成的优化建模代码中的语义错误，在七个基准上达到新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 运筹优化问题求解依赖优化建模，即将自然语言描述转为可执行求解器代码，LLM可自动化该过程但易出错。错误分为两类：语法错误（代码无法运行或被判定不可行）和语义错误（代码返回目标值但违背原问题意图）。语义错误不触发运行时失败，因而难以检测与修正，这是本文要解决的核心问题。
AI.method: SemOPT是一个语义引导的纠错框架，包含两部分：(1) 语义奖励模型，用于区分忠实于原问题的数学建模与看似合理但错误的建模；(2) 自适应纠错系统，在建模空间上执行分层奖励引导搜索。
AI.result: 在七个优化建模基准上，SemOPT建立了新的最先进水平，在复杂数据集上相较最强基线平均提升7.6%的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 语义引导的奖励建模结合分层搜索可有效检测并修正LLM优化建模中的语义错误，显著优于现有基线。

title: Compiling Learning Problems into Adaptation Programs for Language Models
summary: Model adaptation is typically governed by a fixed recipe, even though different update programs can produce substantially different behavioral outcomes. We introduce adaptation compilation, which reframes where, how, and to what extent a model should adapt as a joint prediction and decision problem. Rather than searching over candidate programs anew for each learning episode, a compiler learns from prior adaptations to predict a vector-valued counterfactual response surface over candidate programs---their expected effects on acquisition, transfer, boundedness, and preservation---and selects a program before adaptation begins. Because this predicted geometry captures multiple behavioral consequences rather than a single winner or scalar score, it can be reused under different downstream priorities without retraining. Across five learning types, preferred programs vary meaningfully across episodes, and this variation is predictable from pre-adaptation information. On Llama-3.1-8B, compiler-selected programs approach exhaustive search while outperforming global and objective-specific defaults. Replication on Gemma-2-9B preserves program heterogeneity and selection headroom, but shows that exploiting this headroom requires accounting for uncertainty when departing from strong defaults. Together, these results show that adaptation search can be amortized across related learning problems, turning prior adaptation experience into a basis for deciding how future learning should occur.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"适应编译"（adaptation compilation），将模型适应视为联合预测与决策问题：编译器从既往适应经验中学习，预测候选更新程序的反事实响应曲面（对习得、迁移、有界性、保持性的影响），并在适应开始前选择程序。在Llama-3.1-8B上，编译器选择的程序接近穷举搜索，优于全局与针对特定目标的默认设置；Gemma-2-9B上的复现验证了程序异质性与选择空间的存在。
AI.motivation: 现有模型适应通常遵循固定配方，但不同更新程序会产生显著不同的行为结果。逐次为每个学习任务重新搜索候选程序代价高昂，且单一标量评分无法刻画多种行为后果。作者希望将适应搜索跨相关学习问题摊销，使先前的适应经验成为决定未来学习方式的依据。
AI.method: 提出适应编译框架：不再对每个学习回合重新搜索候选程序，而是让编译器从先前的适应经验中学习，预测候选程序上的向量值反事实响应曲面——即这些程序在习得（acquisition）、迁移（transfer）、有界性（boundedness）与保持性（preservation）上的预期效果；在适应开始前即选择程序。由于该预测"几何结构"刻画了多种行为后果而非单一赢家或标量分数，因此可在不同下游优先级下复用而无需重训练。
AI.result: 在五种学习类型上，偏好程序在不同回合间存在显著变化，且这种变化可由适应前信息预测。在Llama-3.1-8B上，编译器选择的程序接近穷举搜索的性能，并优于全局默认与针对特定目标的默认设置。在Gemma-2-9B上的复现保持了程序异质性与选择空间，但表明要利用该空间，需在偏离强默认设置时考虑不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 适应搜索可以跨相关学习问题被摊销，从而把既往适应经验转化为决定未来学习应如何进行的依据。响应曲面式预测支持在多种下游优先级下复用，是替代固定适应配方与逐次搜索的有效途径；同时在强默认存在时，选择需纳入不确定性考量。

title: Look What You Made Us Cluster: Hate Narrative Extraction from Reddit Discourse
summary: Narrative extraction allows us to identify online hate narratives, supporting the construction of rigorous detection systems. Existing computational approaches, however, are limited in precision as they rely on semantic representations, which tend to capture only surface-level meaning. To detect more precise and interpretable narratives, we present an extraction pipeline that represents narratives as entity-evaluation pairs. Narratives are extracted using a Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning process that extends Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis, identifying the aspect, classifying its judgement type as the basis for evaluation, and deriving the evaluation accordingly. Extracted narratives are then clustered using Leiden, following which clusters are resolved to an intended level of granularity through an LLM-guided refinement process. We illustrate this narrative pipeline with English Reddit comments from 2024 that criticize Taylor Swift, analyzing a representative cluster that exhibits hate speech patterns to demonstrate its interpretive value.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将在线仇恨叙事表示为"实体-评价"对的抽取流水线，利用LLM推理扩展基于方面的情感分析，并通过Leiden聚类与LLM引导的细化获得所需粒度的叙事簇，以批评Taylor Swift的Reddit评论为例验证其解释力。
AI.motivation: 现有计算式叙事抽取方法依赖语义表示，往往只能捕捉表层含义，导致精度有限，难以识别精确且可解释的在线仇恨叙事，从而制约了严谨检测系统的构建。
AI.method: 将叙事表示为实体-评价对；采用LLM推理过程，扩展基于方面的情感分析（ABSA），依次识别方面、判定其评判类型并据此推导评价；随后用Leiden算法对抽取的叙事聚类；再通过LLM引导的细化过程，将簇解析到目标粒度层级。
AI.result: 以2024年批评Taylor Swift的英文Reddit评论为案例演示该流水线，并对一个呈现仇恨言论模式的代表性簇进行分析，展示了其在解释性方面的价值。
AI.conclusion: 该实体-评价对表示结合LLM推理与聚类细化，能够提升叙事抽取的精度与可解释性，为在线仇恨叙事识别及检测系统构建提供可行路径。

title: Learning to Retrieve Missing Evidence for Long-Term Memory QA
summary: Long-term memory enables language models to use past interactions in future conversations. However, evidence needed to answer a question may be scattered across distant turns, while the question itself omits clues needed to locate it. Retrieved facts can reveal these clues, motivating retrieval decisions conditioned on evidence already found. We introduce MERA (Missing-Evidence Retrieval Augmentation), which separates globally searchable memory from a question-specific evidence state. Verified evidence guides subsequent retrieval without restricting access to the global memory. We train a lightweight planner through reinforcement learning, rewarding queries that recover previously missing evidence. MERA achieves strong answer accuracy across Qwen3-30B and GPT-4o-mini backbones. With Qwen3-30B for evidence processing and answer generation, the trained 0.6B planner achieves 77.40% accuracy on LoCoMo and 71.29% on LongMemEval-S, exceeding a 30B planner without retrieval-grounded training by 4.10% and 3.96%, respectively. On LoCoMo, later retrieval rounds increase cumulative evidence recall from 55.5% to 80.5%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MERA（Missing-Evidence Retrieval Augmentation），将全局可搜索记忆与问题特定的证据状态分离，用已检索到的证据引导后续检索，并通过强化学习训练轻量规划器以奖励能补全缺失证据的查询。在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S上取得显著准确率提升。
AI.motivation: 长时记忆使语言模型能在未来对话中利用过去交互，但回答问题所需的证据常分散在相距很远的对话轮次中，而问题本身又缺少定位这些证据的线索。检索到的事实可以揭示这些线索，因此需要基于"已找到的证据"来动态决定后续检索。
AI.method: 提出MERA框架，将全局可搜索的记忆与问题特定的证据状态相分离：已验证的证据用于引导后续检索，但不限制对全局记忆的访问。采用强化学习训练一个轻量级规划器，奖励那些能够找回此前缺失证据的查询。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-30B和GPT-4o-mini两种骨干模型上均取得较高答案准确率。以Qwen3-30B进行证据处理与答案生成时，训练后的0.6B规划器在LoCoMo上达77.40%、LongMemEval-S上达71.29%，分别超过未做检索接地训练的30B规划器4.10%和3.96%。在LoCoMo上，后续检索轮次将累计证据召回率从55.5%提升至80.5%。
AI.conclusion: 基于已检索证据条件化检索、并让轻量规划器经强化学习优化的MERA，能有效解决证据分散且问题缺线索的长时记忆问答，且小规划器性能优于大规划器，检索轮次越多累计证据召回率越高。

title: Regime Boundary Alignment for Evidence-Gated Question Answering
summary: Retrieval-augmented language models are expected to answer from the retrieved evidence, but in practice they often keep answering when that evidence is missing. We trace this behavior to the training signal: answer-focused fine-tuning assigns no target to unsupported contexts, so it cannot distinguish a reader that abstains from one that guesses, and unsupported answering stays near 100% even as supported accuracy improves. We introduce Regime Boundary Alignment (RBA), which trains a single reader on matched variants of the same question and gold answer. The reader is trained to produce the gold answer when the context supports it, including when conflicting evidence is also present, and to abstain when the correct support is removed; inference is ordinary decoding, with no verifier, threshold, or regime label. On three multi-hop QA datasets across three seeds, RBA reduces the unsupported-answer rate by more than sixty percentage points relative to conflict-focused training while matching its supported accuracy. On a held-out TriviaQA retrieval-miss slice, the same reader reduces unsupported answering from 100% to below 1% while also improving supported accuracy. These results indicate that evidence-gated answering must be learned on both sides of the support boundary.

AI.tldr: 提出 Regime Boundary Alignment (RBA)，通过在支持/不支持上下文的配对样本上训练单一 reader，使模型在证据存在时作答、证据缺失时拒答，无需 verifier 或阈值。
AI.motivation: 检索增强语言模型本应"依据检索证据回答"，但实际中即使证据缺失仍持续作答。作者将该行为归因于训练信号：answer-focused fine-tuning 对不支持上下文不设目标，无法区分"拒答"与"猜测"，导致 unsupported answering 在 supported accuracy 提升时仍接近 100%。
AI.method: Regime Boundary Alignment (RBA)：在同一问题的匹配变体（同一 question 与 gold answer）上训练单一 reader。当上下文支持答案时（包括同时存在冲突证据）输出 gold answer；当正确支撑被移除时输出拒答。推理为常规 decoding，不使用 verifier、threshold 或 regime label。
AI.result: 在 3 个 multi-hop QA 数据集、3 个随机种子上，RBA 相比 conflict-focused training 将 unsupported-answer rate 降低超过 60 个百分点，同时 supported accuracy 相当。在留出的 TriviaQA retrieval-miss 切片上，同一 reader 将 unsupported answering 从 100% 降至 1% 以下，并同时提升 supported accuracy。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，evidence-gated answering（证据门控作答）必须在支持边界的两侧同时学习。

title: Your Benchmark Is Not Saturated: Reviving Multiple-Choice Evaluation with Answer Pooling
summary: Multiple-choice benchmarks are cheap to grade and are running out of room, and the standard remedy, writing harder items, is slow and repeated for every benchmark. A saturated benchmark still holds a harder task. Each question's wrong options are written for that question alone, so a model can score by eliminating a few options. We propose AnswerPool: take $N$ questions that share a context, pool all their options into one list, and ask the model to assign every question its answer. No item is written and no label changes. The chance of guessing a group right falls from $10^{-3}$ to $5\times10^{-7}$ for five four-option questions, and a model that recognizes its answers keeps its multiple-choice score, so the accuracy lost to pooling measures the credit the format gave for elimination. Deleting answers from the pool makes questions unanswerable with exact ground truth, so abstention is scored in the same pass. Across eight text, image, and video benchmarks and eighteen models, pooling is harder for every model, the elimination credit is largest for the weakest models, and seven of eight open-weight models answer 87 to 100% of unanswerable questions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AnswerPool：将共享同一上下文的 N 道多选题的全部选项汇入一个选项池，要求模型为每题分配答案。该方法在不新写题目、不改变标签的前提下提升基准难度，并在八个文本、图像、视频基准和十八个模型上验证其有效性与诊断能力。
AI.motivation: 现有多选题基准评分成本低但趋于饱和，而通过编写更难题目来补救既缓慢又需对每个基准重复进行。饱和基准中仍隐含更难的任务：由于每题的干扰项仅为该题设计，模型可通过排除少量选项来得分，从而高估了模型能力。
AI.method: AnswerPool 选取 N 道共享同一上下文的问题，将其所有选项合并为统一选项池，要求模型为每道题指定答案。方法不新写题目、不改变标签；通过共享选项池消除跨题排除线索，使五道四选项题的整组猜对概率从 10^{-3} 降至 5×10^{-7}。同时从池中删除正确答案可使问题在精确真值下不可回答，从而在同一轮测评中对弃答行为进行评分。
AI.result: 在八个文本、图像和视频基准及十八个模型上，汇池对每个模型都更难。因格式带来的排除优势（elimination credit）在最弱模型上最大；八个开放权重模型中有七个对 87%–100% 的不可回答问题仍给出答案，暴露出其随机作答倾向。
AI.conclusion: AnswerPool 提供了一种低成本、无需新题即可提升并诊断多选题基准的范式：准确率下降量可量化格式所给予的排除得分，同时可评估模型的弃答能力。结果表明现有基准普遍高估模型能力，且开放权重模型在不可回答问题上的过度作答问题严重。

title: Larry Caused the Car to Stop, But the Model Didn't Notice: Transformer Blindness to the M-Heuristic
summary: Modern transformer models excel at capturing semantic relationships through sentence embeddings, yet their ability to perform pragmatic reasoning remains understudied. This paper investigates whether encoder-based transformers such as DeBERTa employ the M-Heuristic (the neo-Gricean principle that marked linguistic forms implicate marked meanings). We test this hypothesis by contrasting lexical causatives (e.g., ``Larry stopped the car'') with periphrastic causatives (e.g., ``Larry caused the car to stop'') using a Natural Language Inference framework. Our experiments across 188 conditions with 15 ambitransitive verbs reveal that DeBERTa, RoBERTa, and BART show no evidence of capturing the pragmatic distinction between these forms, with DeBERTa predicting ``Neutral'' for 100% of cases. Probing analysis initially suggested a representation-use dissociation, but control experiments reveal the probe was tracking syntactic complexity, not causative pragmatics. Semantic similarity over 30 triplets places periphrastic causatives closer to unmediated manner descriptions in 29/30 cases, opposite to M-Heuristic predictions in the embedding space. Under explicit metalinguistic framing, Gemini Flash-Lite reaches 100% with item-specific traces, so the principle is available under instruction yet unused in default NLI.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验编码器式Transformer是否掌握"标记形式蕴含标记意义"的M-Heuristic语用原则，以词汇使役与迂说使役的对比为切入点。结果显示DeBERTa、RoBERTa、BART在默认NLI中均未捕捉该语用区分，DeBERTa对100%案例预测为Neutral；探针最初显示的表征-使用分离被控制实验证伪（探针实际追踪句法复杂度）；嵌入空间中迂说使役反而更接近无中介方式描述（29/30）。仅在显式元语言提示下Gemini Flash-Lite达到100%，说明该原则可被调用但默认不被使用。
AI.motivation: 现代Transformer在句子嵌入层面擅长捕捉语义关系，但其语用推理能力研究不足。作者想检验这类模型是否内化了新格赖斯语用原则（M-Heuristic：标记的语言形式蕴含标记的意义），即模型能否区分"Larry stopped the car"（词汇使役，无标记）与"Larry caused the car to stop"（迂说使役，有标记）所隐含的语用差异。
AI.method: 采用自然语言推理（NLI）框架，对比词汇使役与迂说使役句式；覆盖15个兼作及物/不及物动词、共188个条件；测试DeBERTa、RoBERTa、BART。辅以探针分析（probing）考察表征中是否编码该语用信息，并设计控制实验排除混淆因素；另用30组三元组做语义相似度分析，并测试显式元语言提示下Gemini Flash-Lite的表现。
AI.result: 三个编码器模型均无证据表明捕捉到两类使役的语用区分，DeBERTa在100%的案例中预测为"Neutral"。探针分析起初暗示存在"表征—使用"分离，但控制实验表明探针实际追踪的是句法复杂度而非使役语用。30组三元组的语义相似度显示，迂说使役在29/30案例中更接近无中介的方式描述，与M-Heuristic在嵌入空间的预测相反。显式元语言提示下，Gemini Flash-Lite达到100%准确率并提供针对具体条目的推理痕迹。
AI.conclusion: 编码器式Transformer在默认NLI设置下不运用M-Heuristic语用原则，其嵌入空间的组织方式甚至与该原则相悖；探针所反映的"表征"实为句法复杂度的伪信号。该语用原则在显式指令条件下是可调用的（如Gemini Flash-Lite所示），但在默认推理中未被使用，揭示了模型语用能力的"可用而不用"特性。

title: The Rashomon Wikipedia: A Data-Perspectivist Analysis of Divergent Historical Narratives
summary: Wikipedia aims to provide a unified, neutral record of history, yet its independent language editions often function as distinct epistemic communities, creating divergent narratives around contested events. This paper investigates cross-lingual historiographical bias by analyzing Wikipedia articles across five languages (Romanian, Hungarian, Russian, Turkish, and English) focusing on three contentious events in Romanian history: the Battle of Posada (1330), the Soviet occupation of Bessarabia (1940), and the Night Attack at Targoviste (1462). Using human annotators and Large Language Models (LLMs) to classify citation stance and quantify narrative evolution from 2005 to 2024, we identify a phenomenon of "citation isolation". In the case of the Battle of Posada, only 2 out of 119 citations were shared between language editions, with the Romanian edition exhibiting a 91% pro-national bias compared to the balanced Hungarian edition. Longitudinal analysis reveals that these narratives are volatile and responsive to contemporary geopolitics, evidenced by a significant shift in the Russian framing of Bessarabia in 2024. Finally, we propose a "Peace-Maker" pipeline to automate conflict reconciliation. We demonstrate that while standard prompting leads models to hallucinate consensus, "adversarial" prompting, which explicitly instructs the model to preserve and attribute disagreement, achieves near-perfect neutrality scores.

AI.tldr: 本文研究维基百科跨语言史学偏见，以罗马尼亚历史三大争议事件为例，揭示"引用隔离"现象，并提出"Peace-Maker"流水线实现叙事调和。
AI.motivation: 维基百科虽以中立统一的历史记录为目标，但其各语言版本实为不同的认知共同体，围绕争议事件形成分歧叙事。现有研究缺乏对跨语言史学偏见的系统量化，尤其是引用来源结构与叙事随时间演变的实证分析。
AI.method: 选取罗马尼亚语、匈牙利语、俄语、土耳其语和英语五个语言版本的维基百科，聚焦波斯达战役（1330）、苏联占领比萨拉比亚（1940）和特尔戈维什泰夜袭（1462）三个争议事件。结合人工标注者与大型语言模型，对引用立场进行分类，并量化2005至2024年的叙事演变。最后提出"Peace-Maker"流水线，采用对抗式提示策略进行冲突调和。
AI.result: 发现"引用隔离"现象：波斯达战役案例中，119条引用仅2条为各语言版本共享，罗马尼亚语版本呈现91%的亲民族偏见，而匈牙利语版本较为平衡。纵向分析显示叙事具有波动性并对当代地缘政治敏感，2024年俄语对比萨拉比亚的叙述框架出现显著转变。在调和实验中，标准提示导致模型虚构共识，而对抗式提示（明确要求保留并归属分歧）可达到近乎完美的中立性评分。
AI.conclusion: 维基百科各语言版本的历史叙事存在系统性偏见与引用隔离，且随现实政治动态演变。通过对抗式提示策略的"Peace-Maker"流水线，可在自动化调和分歧的同时保留观点差异，为实现跨语言叙事的中立性提供了可行路径。

title: Who Warmed the Archives? LLMs Overestimate Historical Warmth
summary: Historical archives are an under-used source for extending the instrumental climate record backward in time, and LLMs offer a way to extract the indices climatologists derive by hand. Beyond measuring how well systems extract this signal, we check whether their errors are safe to use for cross-century comparison, since a good correlation score does not rule out systematic, era-linked bias. Comparing lexical baselines, fine-tuned historical transformers, and LLM prompting on the Pfister temperature index across five centuries of German text, lexical methods beat every fine-tuned transformer we test, including one pretrained from scratch on historical German (r=-0.016). All six LLMs we test (Gemini 2.5 Flash, GPT-5-mini, DeepSeek v4 Flash, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Qwen3.7-Plus, Kimi-K2.6-Fast) show a warm bias that grows with calendar year, with the same sign in every model (slopes +0.13 to +0.34/century, p<0.01). The effect is modest in size (r-squared approx equal to 0.01 to 0.05) but consistent across six independently developed models. The best-correlated of the six, Gemini 2.5 Flash, matches the best lexical correlation (r=0.32) at double the error. An ablation stripping explicit dates and calendar-era markers from the quotes leaves this trend essentially unchanged, favoring an anachronistic present-day prior over the model correctly inferring the quote's era. Correlation alone is thus insufficient for vetting an LLM as a historical-climate-index oracle.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验用大语言模型（LLM）从德语历史文献中提取Pfister温度指数以延展器测气候记录，发现LLM虽相关性尚可，但普遍存在随年代增长的系统性"暖偏差"，说明仅凭相关性不足以验证其作为历史气候代用指标提取工具的有效性。
AI.motivation: 历史档案是延展器测气候记录的未充分利用来源，LLM可自动提取气候学家手工推导的指数。但仅靠相关性评分无法排除系统性、与年代相关的偏差，因此需要检验LLM误差是否可用于跨世纪比较。
AI.method: 在跨越五个世纪的德语文本上提取Pfister温度指数，比较三类方法：词法基线、微调的历史Transformer（包括从头在历史德语上预训练的模型）、以及LLM提示。测试了六个LLM（Gemini 2.5 Flash、GPT-5-mini、DeepSeek v4 Flash、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Qwen3.7-Plus、Kimi-K2.6-Fast）。并设计消融实验，去除引文中的显式日期和历法年代标记。
AI.result: 词法方法胜过所有微调Transformer（其中一个r=-0.016）。六个LLM均表现出随日历年增长的暖偏差，符号一致（斜率+0.13至+0.34/世纪，p<0.01），效应量较小（r²约0.01-0.05）但跨六个独立模型一致。相关性最佳者Gemini 2.5 Flash达到最佳词法相关性（r=0.32），但误差翻倍。去除日期和年代标记的消融实验显示趋势基本不变。
AI.conclusion: LLM表现出随时间增加的暖偏差，消融实验表明其源于模型的时代错置的当代先验，而非正确推断引文年代。因此仅凭相关性不足以验证LLM作为历史气候指数提取工具的可靠性。

title: Evaluating Bounded Autonomy in Regulated Agentic AI: A Diagnostic Harness with Constitutional Rewards, Escalation Labels, and Runtime Governance
comment: 9 pages; ancillary evaluation artefacts. Previously submitted to NLLP 2026
summary: We propose RegLLM, a diagnostic harness for bounded autonomy in regulated agentic workflows. It instruments six trustworthiness signals: citation validity, source grounding, schema compliance, escalation correctness, constitutional alignment, and unsafe-action rate. Signals are distinguished by their source of supervision: programmatic verifiers, task-level escalation labels, or AI-judge scores. A deterministic runtime supervisor blocks ungrounded answers and forces escalation, logging interventions. The same domain constitution informs evaluation, training rewards, and serving guardrails. Task-level should-escalate labels make the act-versus-defer decision a measurable training signal. We demonstrate the harness at smoke scale. An offline reference run (n=12) lifts escalation recall from 0 to 0.67 and reduces unsafe-action rate from 0.33 to 0.08 when governance is enabled. Two single-GPU Qwen2.5-3B LoRA/DPO pilots (n=8, same seed and evaluation split) expose substantial variation: nominally identical RL-base configurations yield task success of 0.25 versus 0.12 and escalation recall of 1.0 versus 0.5. An answer-quality adapter changes recall from 1.0 to 0.5 in Run A, but from 0.5 to 1.0 in Run B. An escalation-aware variant produces no measurable change in Run B. These small pilots do not establish reliable adapter effects or production readiness. Their contribution is diagnostic: configuration variance can overwhelm apparent tuning effects on bounded-autonomy metrics, motivating larger evaluation sets and repeated runs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出RegLLM——一个面向受监管智能体工作流的"受限自主性"诊断测试框架，通过六类可信度信号和确定性运行时监督器量化评估，小规模试点显示治理机制有效，但配置方差可能掩盖调优效果。
AI.motivation: 受监管智能体工作流中，智能体需在"行动"与"上报升级"之间做出边界化决策，而现有评估缺乏系统的可信度诊断工具。作者希望将宪法规则同时贯穿评估、训练奖励与服务护栏，并把"应否升级"的判断转化为可测量的训练信号，从而暴露调优效果与配置噪声之间的混淆问题。
AI.method: 提出RegLLM诊断框架，监测六类可信度信号：引用有效性、来源可溯性、模式合规性、升级正确性、宪法对齐性、不安全行为率，并按监督来源区分（程序化验证器、任务级升级标签、AI评判分数）。以确定性运行时监督器阻断无依据回答并强制执行升级，记录干预情况；同一领域宪法同时指导评估、训练奖励和服务端护栏；任务级"应升级"标签使行动/延迟决策成为可测训练信号。在冒烟规模上开展离线参考运行（n=12）与两个单GPU Qwen2.5-3B LoRA/DPO试点（n=8，同随机种子与评测切分）。
AI.result: 启用治理后，离线参考运行将升级召回率从0提升至0.67，不安全行为率从0.33降至0.08。两个试点间差异显著：名义相同的RL-base配置任务成功率为0.25对0.12，升级召回率为1.0对0.5；答案质量适配器在Run A使召回率由1.0变为0.5，在Run B却由0.5变为1.0；升级感知变体在Run B无可测变化。
AI.conclusion: 小规模试点不足以确立可靠的适配器效应或生产就绪性。其贡献在于诊断层面：配置方差可能压倒受限自主性指标上的表面调优效果，因此需要更大的评测集与重复运行来获得可靠结论。

title: From Dissonance to Orchestration: Teacher Intervention in On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own reasoning trajectories using feedback from a stronger teacher. Teacher interventions can improve these trajectories, but also change the distribution on which the student learns. Our controlled studies show that rollout quality alone is an incomplete criterion for allocating teacher guidance. Deeper intervention yields diminishing gains in rollout accuracy while increasing off-policy load. In a training probe with a restricted rollout horizon, peak student accuracy and performance retention favor different intervention strengths. The preferred intervention depth and placement also vary across benchmarks. These findings motivate MAESTRO, which uses local policy disagreement to jointly adapt when the teacher takes over and how long it generates. Its {policy disagreement score} combines teacher-weighted candidate coverage with local distribution similarity and is aggregated within reasoning paragraphs. Across eight mathematical reasoning benchmarks, MAESTRO achieves the highest macro-average accuracy among the compared methods for both 0.6B and 1.7B Qwen3 students, with the 1.7B student leading on every benchmark. MAESTRO also reduces average training response length by 67.3\% relative to standard OPD. The code is available at https://github.com/yhao-wang/MAESTRO.

AI.tldr: 本文通过控制实验揭示同策略蒸馏中教师干预深度与位置的重要性，并提出MAESTRO方法，利用局部策略分歧自适应调节教师接管时机与生成时长，在8个数学推理基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 标准同策略蒸馏（On-policy Distillation, OPD）依靠更强教师模型对学生自身推理轨迹进行反馈，教师干预虽能改善轨迹质量，却同时改变了学生学习所依赖的分布。仅以rollout质量作为教师指导的分配标准并不充分：更深的干预在提升rollout准确率上收益递减，反而增加off-policy负担；在受限rollout horizon的训练探针中，峰值学生准确率与性能保持率对应的最优干预强度并不一致；最优干预深度和位置还随基准变化。这些发现表明需要一种能自适应决定教师何时接管、生成多久的机制。
AI.method: 提出MAESTRO，利用局部策略分歧（local policy disagreement）同时自适应调整教师接管时机与生成时长。其策略分歧分数（policy disagreement score）结合教师加权候选覆盖率与局部分布相似度，并在推理段落（reasoning paragraphs）内进行聚合。
AI.result: 在八个数学推理基准上，MAESTRO在0.6B与1.7B的Qwen3学生模型上均取得最高宏平均准确率，其中1.7B学生在每个基准上都领先。相比标准OPD，MAESTRO将平均训练响应长度减少67.3%。
AI.conclusion: 教师干预深度与位置需根据局部策略分歧自适应调节；MAESTRO在多个数学推理基准上实现最优精度并显著缩短训练响应长度，验证了该自适应机制的有效性。

title: E-MoE: Enhanced Mixture-of-Experts for Non-Factorized Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) generate sequences by progressively unmasking several tokens per denoising step, but their reverse process is typically factorized over positions, limiting sample quality in the few-step regime where diffusion's speed advantage over autoregressive decoding matters most. A recent line of work introduces a continuous Gaussian latent, trained as a variational autoencoder, to capture correlations across positions, but such approaches are prone to posterior collapse, where the latent is silently ignored. We propose Enhanced Mixture-of-Experts (E-MoE), which builds the reverse process as a mixture of factorized distributions over a discrete shared latent given by the expert-routing decisions of a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) backbone, without increasing active parameters over the factorized baseline. Across synthetic multi-modal benchmarks, binarized MNIST, and LM1B, E-MoE improves few-step generation over factorized baselines.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出E-MoE，用MoE路由决策构成的离散共享隐变量构建反向过程，将反向过程表示为因子化分布的混合，在不增加激活参数的情况下改进掩码扩散模型的少步生成质量。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散模型（MDM）的反向过程通常在位置上因子化，在少步（few-step）生成场景下限制样本质量，而这一场景正是扩散相对自回归解码的速度优势最关键的场合。已有工作引入连续高斯隐变量（以VAE训练）来捕捉跨位置相关性，但容易发生后验坍缩（posterior collapse），隐变量被静默忽略。
AI.method: 提出Enhanced Mixture-of-Experts（E-MoE）：以Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）骨干网络的专家路由决策作为离散共享隐变量，将反向过程构建为该隐变量条件下的因子化分布的混合，从而在反向过程中引入跨位置相关性，且不增加相对于因子化基线的激活参数量。
AI.result: 在合成多模态基准、二值化MNIST以及LM1B上，E-MoE相比因子化基线在少步生成上取得提升。
AI.conclusion: 以MoE路由构成离散隐变量并用其混合因子化分布，可规避连续隐变量的后验坍缩问题，在保持激活参数不变的前提下有效提升掩码扩散模型的少步生成质量。

title: RunyaNER: Auxiliary Language Selection for Runyankore NER
comment: Accepted to the 6th Workshop on Multilingual Representation Learning (MRL 2026) at EMNLP 2026. Camera-ready version. 4 figures
summary: Cross-lingual zero-shot transfer and multilingual fine-tuning are promising approaches for NLP tasks such as Named Entity Recognition (NER) in low-resource languages, but in the absence of target language benchmarks, it is unclear which auxiliary language selection strategy leads to the best transfer. We introduce RunyaNER, the first publicly available NER benchmark for the East African language Runyankore, and use it to investigate the choice of which languages to use for transfer. Created with a semi-automated pipeline and fully manually verified, RunyaNER contains over 237k annotated words across 30k sentences. We benchmark pretrained models on RunyaNER, establishing that our dataset is of sufficient quality and size to produce effective Runyankore NER models. We then use RunyaNER to investigate auxiliary language selection in cross-lingual zero-shot and multilingual fine-tuning settings. Our experiments show that while transfer performance is highly sensitive to auxiliary language selection, embedding-based measures computed from labelled training spans correlate more strongly with downstream transfer performance than traditional linguistic features based on metadata or typology.
