summary: Large language models can reason in continuous space instead of decoded text, by recurring on their own hidden states or by passing those states between agents, while training supervises only the Cross-Entropy (CE) of the final decoded answer and does not constrain the thought. Theoretical and empirical analyses establish and confirm four failures of CE-only training that lead to a lower probability of the correct answer such as collapsing thoughts across distinct questions and retaining irrelevant information. We introduce REST (REpresentation-Supervised Thoughts), a training objective that turns four properties of a valid thought representation (causality, minimality, separability, and stability) into differentiable losses added to CE. We instantiate it in latent single-agent and multi-agent systems, without architectural changes or added parameters at inference. Across 7 benchmarks spanning mathematics, science, medicine, and code generation, with the same training data, compute, and latent budget, REST increases accuracy over CE-only training across agent settings and model sizes by up to 7.5 percentage points and convergence on a final answer by 30\%. Furthermore, REST thoughts encode more of what is required to achieve the correct answer, and decoding them better recovers the intended output of the agent, which makes latent communication easier to interpret. Project Website: https://fard-lab.github.io/REST

AI.tldr: 论文提出REST训练目标，通过将有效思维表示的四个属性（因果性、最小性、可分离性、稳定性）转化为可微损失并与CE联合优化，改善连续空间推理（潜空间/多智能体）中的思维质量，在7个基准上最高提升7.5个百分点准确率并将终答收敛提升30%。
AI.motivation: 大模型可在连续空间而非解码文本中推理（复用自身隐状态或在智能体间传递隐状态），但训练仅监督最终解码答案的交叉熵（CE），不对思维过程施加约束。理论与实证分析表明，仅用CE训练会导致四类失效，例如不同问题思维坍缩、保留无关信息，从而降低正确答案的概率。
AI.method: 提出REST（REpresentation-Supervised Thoughts），把有效思维表示的四个属性——因果性、最小性、可分离性、稳定性——转化为可微损失，与CE相加作为训练目标；在单智能体潜空间与多智能体潜空间系统中实例化，不改变架构、不增加推理时参数。
AI.result: 在数学、科学、医学、代码生成等7个基准上，在相同训练数据、算力与潜空间预算下，REST相较仅CE训练在不同智能体设置与模型规模上准确率最多提升7.5个百分点，终答收敛提升30%；REST思维编码了更多达成正确答案所需信息，解码后能更好恢复智能体意图输出，使潜空间通信更易解释。
AI.conclusion: 对连续潜空间思维进行表示级监督（REST）可有效克服仅CE训练的固有缺陷，提升推理准确率与收敛性，并增强潜空间通信的可解释性，且无需架构改动或额外推理参数。

title: In-Context Learning Amplifies a Latent Symbolic Circuit
comment: Accepted to the Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop at ICML 2026
summary: Large language models can learn abstract rules from just a few in-context examples, but how their internal mechanisms activate as examples accumulate is not well understood. We trace a three-stage symbolic reasoning circuit (abstraction, induction, retrieval) across shot counts in three model families and find it is detectable and functional well before the model achieves high accuracy. Per-head causal contribution grows up to 8x from 1- to 10-shot, and cross-shot activation patching raises accuracy from 1% to 56% at 0-shot and 17% to 88% at 1-shot. Function vectors scaled and injected at 0-shot rescue accuracy up to 86%, largely substituting for the induction stage but depending critically on an intact downstream retrieval stage. The infrastructure for abstract rule-following is present in the weights before any demonstrations; in-context examples, function vectors, and related interventions appear to supply input to the same latent circuit.

AI.tldr: 抽象规则遵循的三阶段符号推理电路（抽象→归纳→检索）在模型达到高准确率之前即可被检测并具功能性；上下文示例、函数向量及干预手段均为同一潜在电路提供输入。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型可仅凭少量上下文示例学习抽象规则，但随示例累积，其内部机制如何被激活尚不清楚。本文旨在揭示该过程中推理电路的逐阶段（shot）动态。
AI.method: 在三个模型族中，跨不同示例数（shot）追踪三阶段符号推理电路；进行逐头（per-head）因果贡献分析、跨示例激活修补（cross-shot activation patching）、函数向量缩放与注入实验，并结合下游检索阶段的消融验证。
AI.result: 该电路在高准确率前即被检测且具功能性；逐头因果贡献从 1-shot 到 10-shot 增长至 8 倍；跨示例激活修补使 0-shot 准确率由 1% 升至 56%，1-shot 由 17% 升至 88%；0-shot 注入缩放后的函数向量可将准确率恢复至 86%，基本替代归纳阶段，但依赖完整的下游检索阶段。
AI.conclusion: 抽象规则遵循的基础设施在任何示例出现前已存在于权重中；上下文示例、函数向量及相关干预为同一潜在电路提供输入。

title: When Trees Are Not Enough: Learning Mixed-Topology Feature Graphs with Adaptive Graph Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) expose interpretable features in large language model activations, yet existing structured SAEs impose single-parent trees or forests, while post-hoc graphs permit multiple parents but neither guide feature learning nor ensure reliable relation recovery. We introduce the Adaptive Graph Sparse Autoencoder (AG-SAE), a structure-guided training paradigm that treats each feature's complete parent set as an atomic structural hypothesis and lets evidence select zero, one, or multiple parents. By competing complete parent sets against null, subset, and alternative explanations, AG-SAE identifies jointly necessary multi-parent relations while rejecting redundant or spurious alternatives and verifying that each child contributes beyond its parents. The induced topology over SAE features then defines a differentiable structural loss that guides SAE training, while topology-guided refinement mitigates feature absorption and uses persistent reconstruction gaps exposed by the learned structure to initialize new features. The entire graph is then induced again from the revised dictionary by reassessing every feature's complete parent set, closing the dictionary-graph self-consistency cycle. Experiments demonstrate exact mixed-topology recovery in a controlled toy model, greater relational reliability and semantic validity than structured and post-hoc baselines on real LLM activations, and stronger feature-level causal interventions than conventional SAE features. AG-SAE thereby turns recovered mixed-topology feature structure into an unsupervised training signal that improves the dictionary, enables reliable feature organization beyond the topological limitations of trees, and exhibits stronger causal control beyond reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应图稀疏自编码器（AG-SAE），一种结构引导的训练范式，将每个特征的完整父集视为原子结构假设，允许证据选择零个、一个或多个父节点，从而实现混合拓扑特征结构的可靠恢复并用作无监督训练信号。
AI.motivation: 现有结构化 SAE 仅施加单父树或森林结构，无法建模多父关系；而事后图（post-hoc graphs）虽允许多父，但既不引导特征学习，也无法保证关系恢复的可靠性。因此需要一种既支持混合拓扑、又能同时指导特征学习的结构引导方法。
AI.method: 提出 AG-SAE：将每个特征的完整父集作为原子结构假设，通过将完整父集与空集、子集及替代解释竞争，识别联合必要的多父关系，同时拒绝冗余或虚假替代，并验证子节点在其父节点之外有额外贡献。诱导出的拓扑定义了一个可微的结构损失以指导 SAE 训练；拓扑引导的细化缓解特征吸收，并利用学习结构暴露的持续重建差距初始化新特征。随后从修订后的字典重新诱导整个图，闭合字典-图自一致性循环。
AI.result: 在受控玩具模型中实现精确的混合拓扑恢复；在真实 LLM 激活上比结构化与事后基线具有更高的关系可靠性与语义有效性；相比传统 SAE 特征具有更强的特征级因果干预能力。
AI.conclusion: AG-SAE 将恢复的混合拓扑特征结构转化为无监督训练信号，改进字典，实现超越树拓扑限制的可靠特征组织，并展现出超越重建的更强因果控制能力。

title: Fractional State Space Transition for Long Sequence Modeling
summary: State Space Models (SSMs) compress sequence history into a bounded recurrent state, making the resulting memory law a central architectural choice for long-context performance. Most modern SSMs rely on ODE-based dynamics that lead to exponential forgetting, limiting their ability to retain information over broad temporal ranges. We introduce FRAC, a selective SSM architecture derived from fractional dynamics that replaces this exponential decay with power-law long memory. To make fractional dynamics practical, FRAC approximates the heavy-tailed target kernel with a finite-state, log-spaced sum of exponential modes. This construction turns fractional memory into an efficient recurrent module with parallel training and prefill, while retaining bounded-state autoregressive decoding. Extensive experiments, including 1.3B-parameter language modeling, demonstrate that FRAC consistently improves long-context performance over state-of-the-art SSM baselines while staying competitive on short-context. These results show that fractional dynamics provide a practical and effective prior for long-context SSMs.

AI.tldr: FRAC是一种基于分数阶动力学的选择性SSM架构，用幂律长记忆取代指数遗忘，通过有限状态的对数间隔指数模态和逼近重尾核，实现高效递归与长上下文性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现代SSM多依赖ODD式动力学，导致指数遗忘，难以在宽时间范围内保留信息，成为长上下文性能的瓶颈。
AI.method: 从分数阶动力学推导出FRAC，将重尾目标核用有限状态、对数间隔的指数模态之和近似，从而把分数阶记忆转化为支持并行训练与预填充、并保留有界状态自回归解码的高效递归模块。
AI.result: 包括1.3B参数语言建模在内的大量实验表明，FRAC在长上下文任务上持续优于最先进SSM基线，同时在短上下文上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 分数阶动力学为长上下文SSM提供了一种实用且有效的先验。

title: Invariant Atoms: Sparse Coordinates of Local Semantic Geometry in Language Model Representations
summary: Large language models often preserve meaning despite substantial changes in wording, style, and syntax, while small semantic edits can systematically alter their hidden representations. This suggests that semantic variation may be organized along recurring local directions. We propose the Invariant Atom Hypothesis: local semantic motion admits preferred sparse coordinates along directions that remain stable under meaning-preserving transformations. We learn a shared semantic frame and sparse coordinates that reconstruct semantic displacements while suppressing nuisance variation, with anchor-dependent diagonal modulation adjusting atom strengths without sample-specific rotations. Empirically, the atoms exhibit strong semantic--nuisance separation, sparse reconstruction, reproducible directions, and causal effects on model predictions. The learned geometry generalizes to unseen semantic neighborhoods and nuisance families, while local reweighting improves semantic selectivity and preserves a consistent global-to-local structure. Atom signatures also remain stable under model modification. These findings support reusable invariant directions as a sparse coordinate system for local semantic geometry in language models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"不变原子假说"：局部语义位移可由一组在保义变换下稳定的稀疏方向（原子）稀疏表示，实验验证了其语义-噪声分离、可复现性、因果性与泛化性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在措辞、风格、句法大幅变化时仍能保持语义，而细微的语义编辑却会系统性地改变隐藏表示。这说明语义变化可能沿某些反复出现的局部方向组织，作者据此提出假设并试图验证这种潜在几何结构。
AI.method: 提出不变原子假说：局部语义运动在保义变换下沿稳定的稀疏坐标展开。通过学习一个共享语义框架与稀疏坐标来重建语义位移，同时抑制噪声变化；并采用依赖锚点的对角调制调整原子强度，而不引入样本特定的旋转。
AI.result: 经验上，原子表现出较强的语义-噪声分离能力、稀疏重建性能、方向可复现性，以及对模型预测的因果影响；所学几何可泛化到未见语义邻域与噪声族，局部重加权提升语义选择性并保持一致的全局-局部结构，原子签名在模型修改后仍稳定。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现支持将可复用的不变方向作为语言模型局部语义几何的稀疏坐标系。

title: Adapting Context Compression for Long-Horizon Agents with Counterfactual Continuations
summary: Long-horizon agents require context compression to manage growing interaction histories. Compression quality, however, is ultimately determined by downstream execution. Existing prompt-adaptation methods infer compression errors by comparing full-context and compressed trajectories. Such comparisons cannot isolate individual compressions and are confounded by agent stochasticity. We first find that compression degrades reliability before solvability. Using matched counterfactual continuations that compare execution from the same agent state with versus without compression, we further show that severe degradation concentrates at isolated compression events. Motivated by this finding, we propose PAIR (Prompt Adaptation using Interventional Rollouts) for adapting structured compression prompts. PAIR identifies individual compressions that degrade subsequent execution, diagnoses their effects, and revises the relevant sections of a fixed compression template. PAIR achieves the strongest cross-run reliability among compressed methods in every main benchmark-scope combination, consistently exceeding the competing prompt-adaptation baseline. Without modifying the downstream agent, PAIR brings compressed execution close to the no-compression baseline and sometimes numerically exceeds it.

AI.tldr: 提出PAIR方法，通过干预式回滚（matched counterfactual continuations）定位并修复单次压缩事件导致的执行退化，自适应修改结构化压缩提示模板，从而显著提升长时程智能体的跨运行可靠性。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体交互历史不断增长，需依靠上下文压缩管理；但压缩质量最终由下游执行效果决定。现有提示自适应方法通过对比“全上下文”与“压缩后”轨迹来推断压缩错误，既无法隔离单次压缩事件，又受智能体随机性干扰，因而难以准确定位问题来源。
AI.method: 首先发现压缩先损害可靠性、后损害可解性；随后采用匹配的反事实延续（matched counterfactual continuations），从同一智能体状态出发对比有/无压缩的执行结果，证明严重退化集中于孤立的个别压缩事件。基于此提出PAIR（Prompt Adaptation using Interventional Rollouts）：识别导致后续执行退化的单次压缩，诊断其影响，并针对性修订固定压缩模板中的相关段落。
AI.result: 在所有主要“基准-范围”组合中，PAIR在各类压缩方法里取得最强的跨运行可靠性，持续优于竞争性提示自适应基线；在不修改下游智能体的前提下，使压缩后执行效果接近无压缩基线，有时在数值上甚至超过该基线。
AI.conclusion: 压缩导致的执行退化可归因于孤立的压缩事件，通过干预式回滚进行因果定位与诊断，可有针对性地修订压缩提示模板，从而在保持下游智能体不变的情况下显著缩小甚至消除压缩带来的可靠性损失。

title: Triadic Linear Attention: Three-Dimensional Recurrent States for Long-Context Sequence Modeling
summary: Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) compress the historical context into a memory state of fixed size, thus allowing for constant-time inference. The memory state size is a crucial factor in their performance, as exemplified by the strong performance and resurgence of linear attention, which extends the vector-valued hidden states of ordinary RNNs to matrix-valued hidden states. Crucially, linear attention does so in a parameter-efficient way, in particular by using an outer product of the key and value vectors to write to the matrix-valued hidden state. We generalize this construction and propose triadic linear attention, which writes the triadic outer product of a key, a second key, and a value, into a third-order (i.e., 3D) tensor state, and reads from it by contracting both key axes with two queries. An $E$-dimensional second key thus yields an $E$-fold increase in state size while adding only two projections. Triadic linear attention is compatible with data-dependent forgetting, the delta rule, and chunkwise-parallel training. Applied to Gated DeltaNet and scalar-gated linear attention, triadic linear attention substantially improves long-context language modeling and recall, outperforming alternatives that enlarge the state.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 triadic linear attention，将 key-value 外积写入矩阵隐状态推广为 key-key-value 三阶外积写入三阶张量隐状态，以极低参数量实现隐状态规模扩展，并兼容数据依赖遗忘、delta rule 与分块并行训练。
AI.motivation: RNN 以固定大小记忆状态压缩历史上下文，从而实现常数时间推理，而记忆状态大小对其性能至关重要。线性注意力通过将普通 RNN 的向量值隐状态扩展为矩阵值隐状态、并利用 key 与 value 的外积写入，参数高效地扩大了状态。作者希望进一步推广这一构造，在不显著增加参数的前提下继续扩大记忆状态。
AI.method: 提出 triadic linear attention：将一个 key、第二个 key 与一个 value 的三重外积写入三阶（3D）张量状态，并通过两个 query 分别与两个 key 轴收缩来读取。一个 E 维的第二 key 仅需新增两个投影，即可带来 E 倍的隐状态规模增长。该方法兼容数据依赖遗忘、delta rule 以及分块并行训练。
AI.result: 将 triadic linear attention 应用于 Gated DeltaNet 和标量门控线性注意力后，显著提升了长上下文语言建模与召回性能，并优于其他扩大状态的替代方案。
AI.conclusion: 通过三阶外积构造张量隐状态，可在参数开销极小的条件下有效扩展 RNN/线性注意力的记忆容量，证明 triadic 构造是一种有效且可扩展的状态扩展途径。

title: Transformers Stop Thinking Too Early, and a Tiny LoRA Fixes It
summary: Pretrained transformers use little of their depth to follow references in context. Thirteen base models reliably follow only 1.4-3.6 lines, and extra pretrained loops add little. A task-trained rank-8 LoRA at one early layer extends this computation with all model weights frozen. Qwen3-8B improves from 15.5% to 99% exact accuracy on 24-line chains; a longer-trained LoRA reaches 50 lines. Ouro-1.4B reaches 60 lines after four loops and at least 160 after eight. The LoRA starts a relay: program lines pass on their chain identity through a short range of middle layers. Frozen heads read progressively further up the chain, and removing parent-line attention stops the relay. A frozen-model measurement locates the last useful intervention layer within tolerance in three of four held-out models. Task-specific LoRAs also improve MuSiQue. Default answers therefore understate the computation accessible through a tiny edit. Code and an interactive demo are available at https://lunamos.github.io/stop-thinking-too-early/

AI.tldr: 预训练Transformer在上下文引用跟踪任务中仅用到很浅的深度（约1.4–3.6行），但在单个早期层注入rank-8 LoRA（冻结全部权重）可将近似能力扩展至数十甚至上百行，并通过"接力"机制实现。
AI.motivation: 作者希望探究：预训练模型在上下文引用（如程序行链式引用）任务上，其有效计算深度是否被"默认答案"所低估；即模型是否本身具备更深层计算能力，只是未被充分激活。
AI.method: 在13个基础模型上测量引用跟踪行数；在一个早期层训练rank-8 LoRA并冻结所有模型权重；在Qwen3-8B（24行链）、Ouro-1.4B（多循环）等模型上评估；通过消融（移除父行注意力）与冻结模型测量定位关键干预层，并在MuSiQue及4个留出模型上验证。
AI.result: 基础模型仅可靠跟踪1.4–3.6行，额外预训练循环收益甚微；任务训练LoRA使Qwen3-8B从15.5%提升至99%精确准确率（24行链），长训练版本达50行；Ouro-1.4B四循环达60行，八循环至少160行。移除父行注意力会中断接力；冻结模型测量在4个留出模型中的3个能定位最后有效干预层。
AI.conclusion: 默认答案低估了通过微小编辑（单层LoRA）即可访问的计算能力；LoRA通过在中层短程传递链身份启动"接力"，使冻结的注意力头逐步读取更上游的链。任务特定LoRA也能提升MuSiQue表现。

title: Act First, Reason Later: Accelerating On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents via Reference-Conditioned Inverse Dynamics
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains multi-turn language agents with dense teacher supervision on student-generated responses. However, standard think-then-act rollouts require lengthy reasoning before each short action, delaying environment transitions and experience collection. Generating actions directly reduces this delay but can degrade rollout quality. To address this, we propose ActFirst-OPD, an act-first, reason-later training framework that decouples environment interaction from full-response generation. The student infers and executes actions through reference-conditioned inverse dynamics using its current interaction context and a reference next observation, and switches to autonomous next-action prediction when the resulting transition deviates from the reference trajectory. From the collected interaction contexts, the student asynchronously generates full think-then-act responses for token-level teacher supervision. Experiments across 0.6B-, 1.7B-, and 4B-parameter Qwen3 students show that ActFirst-OPD achieves average wall-clock training speedups of $2.3\times$ on ALFWorld, $1.8\times$ on WebShop, and $4.9\times$ on ScienceWorld over Vanilla OPD. It matches or exceeds all compared OPD baselines in mean task success rate across eight of nine benchmark-model settings. These results demonstrate that reasoning need not block acting during multi-turn agent distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ActFirst-OPD，一种“先行动、后推理”的多轮语言智能体在线策略蒸馏框架，将环境交互与完整响应生成解耦，在保持或提升任务成功率的同时显著加速训练。
AI.motivation: 标准 think-then-act（先推理后行动）的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）在每次短动作前都需冗长推理，延迟了环境状态转移与经验收集，导致训练效率低下；而直接生成动作虽降低延迟，却会损害 rollout 质量。因此需要一种既保持高质量监督又加快交互节奏的训练范式。
AI.method: 提出 ActFirst-OPD：学生模型借助当前交互上下文与参考下一观测，通过参考条件逆动力学（reference-conditioned inverse dynamics）推断并执行动作；当实际转移偏离参考轨迹时，切换为自主的下一动作预测。随后从收集的交互上下文中异步生成完整的 think-then-act 响应，用于 token 级教师监督。
AI.result: 在 0.6B、1.7B、4B 参数量的 Qwen3 学生模型上，相比 Vanilla OPD，ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld 上的墙钟训练加速平均分别为 2.3×、1.8×、4.9×；在九组基准-模型设置中有八组的平均任务成功率持平或超过所有对比 OPD 基线。
AI.conclusion: 在多轮智能体蒸馏中，推理不必阻塞行动；ActFirst-OPD 证明了将交互与完整响应生成解耦可在不牺牲（甚至提升）任务表现的前提下大幅提升训练效率。

title: What Makes Recurrence Effective in Looped Language Models?
summary: Looped language models (LoopLMs) increase computational depth through parameter sharing, offering a path to scale inference computation without adding parameters. However, it remains unclear when additional recurrence is beneficial and how architectural choices affect its effectiveness. Through controlled experiments, we systematically examine (1) when recurrence helps, (2) where it should be applied, and (3) how its conditioning affects performance. Our evaluation covers inference budgets below, within, and beyond the training horizon under knowledge and reasoning tasks. (1) We find that recurrence can improve reasoning beyond the training horizon while degrading knowledge performance, but harder reasoning instances do not consistently benefit more. (2) Performance also depends on how distinct layers and recurrent iterations are allocated, showing that effective depth alone is insufficient to predict behavior. Non-recurrent output layers improve robustness to under-unrolling, while the preferred placement of input and output layers varies with inference budget. (3) Finally, we find that conventional initial-state injection offers limited robustness to varying recurrence depth. We therefore propose history-state injection as an alternative, and show that channel-wise history-state injection combined with timestep conditioning offers a low-cost and more effective design, better preserving knowledge under extended unrolling while improving robustness across inference budgets. Overall, our results clarify when recurrent computation helps, where it fails, and offer practical guidelines for designing LoopLMs across variable inference budgets.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究循环语言模型（LoopLMs）中循环计算何时有益、应施加于何处，以及条件注入方式如何影响性能，并提出历史状态注入设计以提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: LoopLMs通过参数共享增加计算深度，可在不增参数情况下扩展推理计算，但额外循环何时有益、架构选择如何影响其有效性尚不明确。
AI.method: 通过受控实验，在训练视野之下、之内与之外的推理预算下，针对知识与推理任务，考察循环的作用时机、施加位置（输入/输出层及循环迭代分配）以及条件注入方式（初始状态注入 vs 历史状态注入，含通道级与时步条件）。
AI.result: 循环可提升训练视野之外的推理性能但损害知识表现，且更难推理实例未必获益更多；性能依赖层与迭代分配，有效深度不足以预测行为；非循环输出层提升欠展开鲁棒性，输入输出层最优位置随推理预算变化；传统初始状态注入鲁棒性有限，通道级历史状态注入结合时步条件成本低且更有效。
AI.conclusion: 研究阐明了循环计算何时有益、何处失效，并为不同推理预算下的LoopLM设计提供了实用指南。

title: Replay the Curvature: Accurate and Scalable NVFP4 Quantization for Large Language Model Inference
summary: Large language models make weight storage and memory traffic major inference costs, motivating low-precision formats that represent each weight with only a few bits. Such formats use a scale to map floating-point values into a small codebook; NVFP4 improves local range utilization by letting every 16 E2M1 weights share an E4M3 block scale. Choosing that scale is difficult in GPTQ because quantizing one column updates those that follow, so evaluating a block independently can misestimate its final reconstruction error. Large models pose a second challenge: full-precision weights, calibration activations, and second-order state cannot all remain on one accelerator, while assigning complete layers to devices leaves each time-consuming layer solve serial. We introduce \emph{Schur Replay}, a scale-selection algorithm that reproduces the GPTQ updates caused by each block scale and scores the resulting block error after accounting for compensation from unquantized columns. Separately, our execution infrastructure keeps only the active layer resident, tiers activations across device, host, and disk, retires full-precision layers after export, and distributes independent output rows across tensor-parallel ranks. Together, the algorithm and infrastructure attain $99.35\%$ and $100.84\%$ question-weighted recovery from BF16 across seven benchmarks on Qwen3.5-397B-A17B and Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct. On the 397B model, the infrastructure reduces measured per-layer time by $15.17\times$ over ModelOpt and $23.14\times$ over LLM Compressor, with lower memory used per GPU.

AI.tldr: 提出Schur Replay尺度选择算法与配套执行基础设施，解决NVFP4 GPTQ量化中块尺度难评估及大模型显存与串行求解瓶颈，在397B/70B模型上实现近无损BF16恢复并大幅加速逐层量化。
AI.motivation: 低精度格式（如NVFP4，每16个E2M1权重共享一个E4M3块尺度）可显著降低权重存储与访存开销，但GPTQ中量化某一列会更新后续列，导致独立评估某块尺度会误估其最终重建误差。此外，大模型无法同时容纳全精度权重、校准激活与二阶状态于单卡，而按整层分配设备又使每层求解串行化。
AI.method: 算法侧提出Schur Replay：在尺度选择时复现每个块尺度所引发的GPTQ更新，并在计入未量化列补偿后对该块误差打分。基础设施侧：仅保留当前活跃层驻留显存，将激活分级存放于设备、主机与磁盘，导出后即释放全精度层，并把相互独立的输出行分配到张量并行各rank上并行求解。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-397B-A17B与Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct上、七个基准测试中，问题加权恢复率分别达99.35%和100.84%（相对BF16）。在397B模型上，逐层量化实测时间较ModelOpt减少15.17倍、较LLM Compressor减少23.14倍，且每GPU显存占用更低。
AI.conclusion: 通过将尺度选择算法与面向大模型的执行基础设施协同设计，该方法在保持接近BF16精度的同时，显著降低NVFP4 GPTQ量化的时间与显存成本，使超大模型的低比特后训练量化变得可行。

title: MARCO: Multi-Round Agentic Reinforcement for Conditional Molecular Optimization
summary: Molecular optimization is inherently iterative: a candidate is proposed, evaluated against several objectives, and revised while preserving a relationship to the source molecule. Most instruction-following models instead emit one edited molecule, forcing validity, property improvement, and similarity control into a single response. We introduce MARCO, an evaluator-grounded reinforcement-learning framework that trains molecular editors on bounded proposal--feedback--revision trajectories. MARCO aggregates shaped turn rewards into an undiscounted trajectory return for group-relative policy optimization. We evaluate two consequences of this training: Same-1 tests the trained policy under a one-response budget, while Same-5 tests whether the same policy can use verifier feedback when up to five responses are available. Across the three-objective MuMOInstruct benchmark, three Qwen backbones, and seen/unseen instruction splits, SFT-initialized MARCO obtains the highest product of property success rate and similarity in every reported primary setting. Same-5 further improves the observed score under the tested budget, while four-objective and public-checkpoint experiments test transfer across constraint sets and initialization regimes.

AI.tldr: MARCO是一个基于评估器反馈的强化学习框架，通过有界的"提议—反馈—修订"轨迹训练分子编辑器，将多轮塑形奖励聚合成无折扣轨迹回报用于组相对策略优化，在MuMOInstruct等多目标基准上取得最高综合得分。
AI.motivation: 分子优化本质上是迭代过程：先提出候选分子，针对多个目标进行评估，再在保持与源分子关系的前提下进行修订。然而，多数指令跟随模型只输出一个编辑后的分子，把有效性、性质提升和相似度控制压缩进单次响应中，无法体现迭代优化特性。
AI.method: 提出MARCO框架，在有限步数的"提议—反馈—修订"轨迹上训练分子编辑器；将各轮次的塑形奖励聚合成无折扣的轨迹回报，用于组相对策略优化（GRPO）；并以SFT初始化策略。评估两种设定：Same-1（单次响应预算下测试策略）与Same-5（最多五次响应，测试策略能否利用验证器反馈）。
AI.result: 在三目标MuMOInstruct基准、三种Qwen主干网络以及已见/未见指令划分上，SFT初始化的MARCO在所有报告的主要设定中均取得"性质成功率×相似度"乘积的最高值；在测试预算下Same-5进一步提升观测得分；四目标实验与公开检查点实验验证了跨约束集合与不同初始化机制的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 将分子编辑建模为基于评估器反馈的有界迭代轨迹，并通过轨迹级强化学习优化，能有效兼顾性质提升与相似度控制，且在多目标、多主干、跨约束与跨初始化场景下具备泛化与迁移能力。

title: CHAIN: Calibrated LLM Forecasting via Causal-Temporal Hypergraph Inference
summary: Large language models have achieved significant progress in event forecasting, yet their probability outputs exhibit systematic calibration bias that varies heterogeneously across different domains and question types, undermining the trustworthiness of probabilistic outputs for decision-making under uncertainty. However, existing calibration methods typically correct probability outputs after prediction is complete, without modeling the structural sources of bias within the prediction process itself. To address this challenge, we decompose probabilistic prediction over causal-temporal hypergraphs into three stages, evidence weighting, evidence aggregation, and source fusion, and propose CHAIN, which designs stage-specific mechanisms to mitigate bias at each stage: (i) modulating the temporal decay function by causal topological distance, (ii) aggregating approximately independent causal chains via Noisy-OR after direction-aware deduplication, and (iii) driving adaptive fusion by causal coverage and directional balance. Experimental results on cross-domain forecasting benchmarks show CHAIN outperforms existing methods in expected calibration error, Brier score, and accuracy. Our project is available at https://github.com/QwenQKing/Chain.

AI.tldr: 提出CHAIN框架，将因果-时间超图上的概率预测分解为证据加权、证据聚合、来源融合三阶段，在各阶段设计针对性机制以缓释校准偏差。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在事件预测中概率输出存在系统性校准偏差，且在不同领域和问题类型上呈现异质性，影响不确定性决策的可信度；现有校准方法多在预测完成后修正概率，未建模预测过程内部的结构性偏差来源。
AI.method: 将因果-时间超图上的概率预测拆解为三阶段并逐阶段干预：(i) 用因果拓扑距离调制时间衰减函数；(ii) 在方向感知去重后，以Noisy-OR聚合近似独立的因果链；(iii) 由因果覆盖度与方向平衡度驱动自适应融合。
AI.result: 在跨领域预测基准上，CHAIN在期望校准误差（ECE）、Brier分数和准确率上均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过在预测过程内部建模并分阶段纠正偏差来源，可有效提升大语言模型事件预测概率输出的校准质量与准确性，代码已开源。

title: Can Agents Design Libraries for Agents?
comment: 26 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/SprocketLab/librarydesignbench
summary: Agents increasingly build on code written by other agents, and they reimplement rather than reuse, growing the codebases later agents must work in. To measure how well agents design libraries for other agents, we introduce LibraryDesignBench, a two-phase benchmark in which an agent implements a full-featured library from a specification that defines required capabilities and potential use cases without prescribing the design. We evaluate the library through the correctness and simplicity of programs written by three user agents from different model families. The benchmark spans 242 expert-validated programming problems across 15 library-design tasks in four languages. On eleven of the fifteen tasks, agent designers reproduce the abstractions of the human-written production library. Downstream agents adopt agent- and human-written libraries alike but underuse them, reimplementing capabilities the library already provides. Our failure analysis finds that downstream agents write extra code mainly because agent-written libraries are rigid or hard to use, not because capabilities are missing. We also experiment with giving designers more prescriptive, agent-first guidance and having them test their library with subagents; this improves downstream scores and yields simpler programs. LibraryDesignBench provides both a testbed for evaluating library-design practices for agent users and an initial design baseline that improves downstream reuse.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LibraryDesignBench，一个两阶段基准，用于衡量智能体为其他智能体设计库的能力，覆盖 4 种语言、15 个库设计任务与 242 个经专家验证的编程问题。
AI.motivation: 智能体日益建立在其他智能体编写的代码之上，但它们倾向于重新实现而非复用已有代码，导致后续智能体所面对的代码库不断膨胀。现有工作缺乏对"智能体为其他智能体设计库"这一能力的系统度量。
AI.method: 构建两阶段基准：第一阶段由设计者智能体依据仅规定所需能力与潜在用例、不规定设计的规范，实现一个功能完整的库；第二阶段由来自不同模型家族的三个用户智能体编写程序，通过正确性与简洁性来评估该库。基准包含 4 种语言、15 个库设计任务、242 个专家验证的编程问题。此外还进行了两类干预实验：给设计者更规定性的、面向智能体的指导，以及让设计者用子智能体测试自己的库。
AI.result: 在 15 个任务中的 11 个上，智能体设计者复现了人类生产库的抽象。下游智能体对智能体编写库和人类编写库的采用程度相近，但均存在使用不足、重复实现库已提供能力的情况。失败分析表明，下游智能体写出额外代码的主要原因是智能体编写的库僵硬或难以使用，而非能力缺失。更规定性的智能体优先指导与子智能体自测能提升下游分数并产生更简洁的程序。
AI.conclusion: LibraryDesignBench 既为评估面向智能体用户的库设计实践提供了测试平台，也提供了一个可提升下游复用率的初始设计基线。

title: Backpropagated Output Momentum: Relocating Optimizer History from Parameters to Task Space
summary: Optimizer momentum is usually stored as a parameter-sized moving average of past gradients, which makes history costly and fixes each past signal in the coordinates in which it was computed. We introduce Backpropagated Output Momentum (BOM), which instead stores a compact moving average of prediction errors at the model output and reprojects that history through the current network at every step. A batch-level analysis characterizes the information retained and omitted by this relocation, while the implementation preserves the current supervised gradient and can replace the first-moment component of several adaptive optimizers. As a plug-in for momentum-based optimizers, including ones that already compress their state, BOM reduces parameter-shaped optimizer state by 49.7-99.8% in three compositions and, averaged over three language backbones, paired step time by 4.0%. It also improves mean validation performance across language and vision fine-tuning, by 1.42 points in the primary five-task comparison. Language and vision pretraining studies, together with matched mechanism controls, further test the construction across output spaces and model scales.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Backpropagated Output Momentum (BOM)，将优化器动量从"参数级梯度滑动平均"改为"模型输出端预测误差的紧凑滑动平均"，并在每步通过当前网络反向重投影该历史。BOM 可与动量型/自适应优化器结合，作为一阶动量替换，在保持当前监督梯度的同时显著压缩优化器状态并提升性能。
AI.motivation: 传统优化器动量以参数规模的滑动平均存储历史梯度，导致两个问题：(1) 存储开销随参数量线性增长，历史代价高昂；(2) 每个历史信号被固定在计算时的参数坐标中，当网络更新后这些坐标已不再对应，历史信息与当前参数空间失配。
AI.method: BOM 不在参数空间存储动量，而是在模型输出端存储预测误差的紧凑滑动平均，并在每一步将其通过当前网络重新投影（反向传播）到参数空间。作者给出了批次级分析，刻画这种"位置迁移"所保留与丢弃的信息；实现上保留当前监督梯度不变，仅替换若干自适应优化器的第一动量分量。可作为插件接入基于动量的优化器，包括已对状态做压缩的优化器。
AI.result: 在三种组合下，BOM 将参数形状的优化器状态减少 49.7%–99.8%；在三个语言骨干网络上平均将配对步时间降低 4.0%；在语言与视觉微调上提升平均验证性能，主要五任务对比中提升 1.42 个点。语言与视觉预训练研究及匹配的机制对照实验，进一步在不同输出空间与模型规模上验证了该构造。
AI.conclusion: 将动量历史从参数空间迁移到输出空间并经当前网络重投影，是一种可行且高效的动量重构方式：既能大幅压缩优化器状态、降低步时，又能提升多任务微调与预训练性能，具备良好的通用性与即插即用特性。

title: SIPO: Unifying Reinforcement Learning with On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a standard paradigm for improving large language models (LLMs) on various tasks, yet its sparse outcome rewards lack token-level credit assignment for intermediate steps. To address this, on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) leverages a self-teacher with privileged context to provide additional dense learning signals. However, because the self-teacher is often overconfident and imposes excessive penalties on long reasoning trajectories, OPSD frequently struggles in practice. To mitigate this, we propose self-instructing policy optimization (SIPO) with a contrastive self-teacher to provide dense credit. At each iteration, SIPO samples multiple rollouts per prompt from the current policy, scores them with environment rewards, and constructs two teacher contexts for each rollout by pairing the reference answer with mistakes made within the group. The model then re-evaluates its own responses under both contexts, using the difference between the two teacher log-probabilities as token-level feedback, so that biases shared by both contexts are expected to largely cancel. The resulting objective yields a token-level advantage for every rollout: the reward still sets the main direction of each update while the self-teacher redistributes credit across tokens. Even in groups where every rollout fails and group-relative advantages vanish, SIPO still provides a learning signal. By preserving direct optimization of the task reward while providing dense, token-level feedback, this approach bridges reinforcement learning and on-policy self-distillation. Extensive experiments across multiple reasoning and code-generation benchmarks demonstrate that SIPO outperforms both RLVR and OPSD baselines without an external teacher or additional generation.

AI.tldr: 提出SIPO，用对比式自教师提供token级密集信用分配，兼得RLVR与在线自蒸馏优势。
AI.motivation: RLVR仅用稀疏结果奖励，缺乏token级信用分配；现有在线自蒸馏(OPSD)依赖特权上下文的"自教师"，但教师过度自信且对长推理轨迹惩罚过重，实践中效果受限。
AI.method: SIPO每轮对同一提示采样多条rollout并用环境奖励打分；为每条rollout构造两个教师上下文（正确答案配对组内错误），让模型在两上下文中重评自身回答，以两教师对数概率之差作为token级反馈，使共享偏差相互抵消；由此得到每条rollout的token级优势——奖励决定更新主方向，自教师重分配token信用。无需外部教师或额外生成。
AI.result: 在多个推理与代码生成基准上，SIPO优于RLVR与OPSD基线。即使组内全部失败、组相对优势消失时，仍能提供学习信号。
AI.conclusion: 保留任务奖励直接优化，同时提供密集token级反馈，SIPO弥合了强化学习与在线自蒸馏，且不依赖外部教师或额外生成。

title: Group-Marginalized Self-Rewarding RL Drives Zero-Label Self-Evolving
summary: Self-rewarding reinforcement learning (RL) enables large language models (LLMs) to self-evolve without human labels. Existing ensemble-based methods construct reward references from rollout groups and assign rewards accordingly. However, a response's reward representation also depends on its randomly sampled group context, i.e., the other responses in its group. Using only one group-context realization may miss desired reward signals and provide unreliable guidance for policy optimization. To address this issue, we propose Group-Marginalized Advantage Estimation (GMAE), which aggregates reward realizations across possible contexts into a response-level distribution and estimates expected advantages. Experiments across eight benchmarks and four base models demonstrate strong performance and cross-domain generalization. GMAE also exhibits stable learning, low extra cost, and good applicability across training datasets and RL backbones.

AI.tldr: 提出Group-Marginalized Advantage Estimation (GMAE)，通过对不同组上下文下的奖励实现进行聚合来估计期望优势，提升自奖励强化学习的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有基于集成的自奖励RL方法从rollout组构建奖励参考并分配奖励，但一个响应的奖励表示还依赖其随机采样的组上下文（即同组其他响应）。仅使用单一组上下文实现可能遗漏期望的奖励信号，为策略优化提供不可靠的指导。
AI.method: 提出GMAE，将跨可能上下文的奖励实现聚合为响应级分布，并据此估计期望优势，从而减少对单次组上下文采样的依赖。
AI.result: 在八个基准和四个基础模型上的实验表明方法性能强劲且具备跨域泛化能力；同时GMAE学习稳定、额外成本低，并在不同训练数据集和RL骨干网络上具有良好适用性。
AI.conclusion: GMAE通过边缘化组上下文来改进自奖励RL的优势估计，兼顾性能、泛化性、稳定性与低成本。

title: QuantMLA: Function-Aligned Dual-Path Quantization for Low-Bit MLA KV Caching
summary: Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) enables expressive multi-head attention with compact caches for its content and decoupled RoPE paths, yet cache memory still scales linearly with context length and batch size. In this work, we establish a systematic model of MLA's dual-path quantization errors, characterizing their distinct effects on attention-output distortion and explaining the pronounced amplification of RoPE-path errors. Guided by this analysis, we introduce QuantMLA, a function-aligned framework for low-bit dual-path quantization. We derive path-specific transformation spaces that preserve full-precision computation while remaining fully fusible into model parameters offline, eliminating online transformation overhead. Within these spaces, QuantMLA learns path-specific transformations with function-aligned objectives: attention-output reconstruction captures the content path's coupled matching and aggregation errors, while positional QK reconstruction preserves the RoPE-induced component of the attention logits and admits a theoretical bound on output distortion. Across four MLA model families, QuantMLA enables, to our knowledge, the first reported joint INT4 caching of the content and RoPE caches with minimal accuracy degradation. Further compressing the content cache to INT2 while retaining the RoPE key cache at INT4 maintains competitive performance on challenging reasoning and code benchmarks. We develop a native low-bit MLA attention kernel that integrates unpacking and dequantization directly into attention computation. The physical cache layout provides 3.59x compression at 128K context, while a cache-pressure serving workload achieves 5.168x higher whole-job output throughput than BF16. The code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出QuantMLA，一个面向MLA双路径（content与RoPE）低比特量化的功能对齐框架，实现首个INT4联合缓存并进一步支持content INT2、RoPE INT4，配合原生低比特注意力内核显著降低缓存并提升吞吐。
AI.motivation: MLA虽以紧凑缓存实现多头的表达力，但其缓存内存仍随上下文长度和批量大小线性增长。现有低比特量化对MLA中content路径与解耦RoPE路径的量化误差特性缺乏系统理解，尤其RoPE路径误差被显著放大，导致难以在低比特下保持精度。
AI.method: 1）建立MLA双路径量化误差的系统模型，刻画两类误差对注意力输出失真的不同影响，并解释RoPE路径误差的放大机制；2）提出QuantMLA函数对齐框架：推导路径特有的变换空间，在保持全精度计算的同时可离线完全融合进模型参数，消除在线变换开销；3）在该空间内以功能对齐目标学习路径特有变换：content路径用注意力输出重构来捕捉耦合匹配与聚合误差，RoPE路径用位置QK重构来保留注意力logits中的RoPE分量，并给出输出失真的理论界；4）开发原生低比特MLA注意力内核，将解包与反量化直接融入注意力计算。
AI.result: 在四个MLA模型族上，QuantMLA据称首次实现content cache与RoPE cache的联合INT4缓存，精度退化极小；将content cache进一步压到INT2而RoPE key cache保持INT4时，在困难推理与代码基准上仍保持有竞争力的性能。物理缓存布局在128K上下文下实现3.59倍压缩；在缓存压力服务负载下，整任务输出吞吐较BF16提升5.168倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过系统分析MLA双路径量化误差并设计功能对齐的可融合变换，QuantMLA在低比特下实现MLA缓存的显著压缩与吞吐提升，兼顾精度与部署效率；代码将在接收后开源。

title: CorrGRPO: Correlation-Normalized GRPO for Multi-Reward Learning
summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely used to train reasoning language models, where it computes advantages by centering and normalizing rewards across rollouts of the same prompt. For multiple rewards, GRPO sums the reward components and normalizes the total reward by its within-group standard deviation. The corresponding variance equals the sum of all pairwise reward covariances. For a fixed centered reward, larger aggregate covariance produces smaller advantages, and vice versa, allowing update magnitudes to adapt to reward dependence. However, correlated rewards with large scales can dominate this normalization and suppress signals from smaller-scale rewards. We propose Correlation-Normalized GRPO (CorrGRPO), which normalizes pairwise covariances into Pearson correlation coefficients. CorrGRPO keeps the centered total reward unchanged while balancing the influence of differently scaled rewards on the correlation-based normalization. This allows advantage magnitudes to adapt to reward correlations without the normalization being dominated by large-scale reward components. We compare CorrGRPO with GRPO and other variants on code generation, tool calling, and agent security, using models ranging from 0.5B to 8B parameters. These tasks all involve multiple rewards that can improve together or present tradeoffs. Results show improvements across three domains, including code generation, tool calling, and agent security. Our code is available at https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/CorrGRPO.

AI.tldr: GRPO 在组内对多奖励总和做归一化时，其方差等于所有奖励两两协方差之和，大规模相关奖励会主导归一化并压制小尺度奖励信号；本文提出 CorrGRPO，将两两协方差归一化为 Pearson 相关系数，在保持中心化总奖励不变的前提下平衡不同尺度奖励的影响，在代码生成、工具调用与智能体安全三个任务上均取得提升。
AI.motivation: GRPO 广泛用于推理语言模型训练，其优势通过同一 prompt 的多次 rollout 奖励中心化与归一化计算。多奖励场景下，GRPO 将各奖励分量求和并用组内标准差归一化总奖励，而该方差恰为所有两两奖励协方差之和。对于固定的中心化奖励，聚合协方差越大优势越小，反之亦然，从而让更新幅度自适应奖励相关性。但问题在于：当存在尺度较大的相关奖励时，它们会主导归一化项，压制小尺度奖励的信号，导致优化失衡。
AI.method: 提出 Correlation-Normalized GRPO（CorrGRPO）。核心做法是将成对协方差归一化为 Pearson 相关系数，用相关性而非协方差参与归一化；同时保持中心化总奖励不变。这样优势幅度仍能随奖励相关性自适应调整，但归一化不再被大尺度奖励分量主导，从而平衡不同尺度奖励对归一化的影响。
AI.result: 在代码生成、工具调用和智能体安全三类任务上，使用 0.5B 到 8B 参数的模型，将 CorrGRPO 与 GRPO 及其他变体进行对比。这些任务均涉及可协同提升或存在权衡的多奖励。结果显示 CorrGRPO 在三个领域均取得改进。代码已开源：https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/CorrGRPO。
AI.conclusion: CorrGRPO 通过将协方差归一化为相关系数，缓解了 GRPO 多奖励归一化中大尺度相关奖励主导的问题，在保持中心化总奖励不变的同时实现更均衡的优势估计，并在多领域多规模模型上验证了有效性。

title: Harness Evolution as Learning: Approximation, Generalization, and Optimization Limits of Self-Improving Personal Agents
summary: As the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) continue to advance, increasing attention is turning to how to translate their abilities into useful behavior. Personal agents bring this question into everyday settings, where models are expected to serve individual users and continually adapt to their preferences. With the underlying model held fixed, such adaptation relies on harness engineering: designing and evolving the surrounding layer that manages context, memory, tools, and execution. Despite rapid progress, the factors governing effective harness evolution remain insufficiently understood. To narrow this gap, we investigate three central questions concerning harness architecture, harness scale, and self-evolution algorithms through complementary empirical and theoretical analyses. Empirically, we introduce a preference-oriented benchmark and systematically characterize the capabilities and limitations of personal agents associated with these three dimensions. Theoretically, we formulate harness evolution as a learning problem and explain these phenomena through approximation, generalization, and optimization errors. Analyses of reachable policies, capacity under finite interaction evidence, and biased update dynamics provide theoretical accounts of the observed phenomena. Together, these results offer a unified perspective on the limits of personalization through harness evolution and inform future harness design.

AI.tldr: 本文研究个人智能体在底层大模型固定的前提下如何通过"外骨骼（harness）工程"实现个性化适应，围绕架构、规模与自演化算法三个维度展开实证与理论分析。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM能力提升，如何将能力转化为有用行为成为关键问题；个人智能体需要在日常场景中持续适应用户偏好。在模型参数固定的条件下，这种适应依赖harness engineering（管理上下文、记忆、工具与执行的外围层）的设计与演化，但决定harness演化效果的因素尚缺乏系统理解。
AI.method: 采用互补的实证与理论分析：(1) 实证上提出面向偏好的基准（preference-oriented benchmark），系统刻画个人智能体在harness架构、harness规模与自演化算法三个维度的能力与局限；(2) 理论上将harness演化形式化为一个学习问题，用近似误差、泛化误差与优化误差解释观察到的现象，并分析可达策略、有限交互证据下的容量以及有偏更新动力学。
AI.result: 在三个维度上系统表征了个人智能体的能力边界与局限；理论分析为可达策略范围、有限交互证据下的容量约束以及有偏更新动态提供了统一解释，与实证现象相互印证。
AI.conclusion: 研究给出了关于harness演化实现个性化之局限的统一视角，可为未来harness设计提供指导。

title: CoEM: Empowering Long-Context Reasoning with Commit-on-Evidence Memory
summary: Long-context reasoning is essential for complex and long-horizon tasks, yet the performance of large language models (LLMs) degrades as context length increases. Recent approaches address this by processing input chunk by chunk while maintaining a bounded textual memory in model context. However, premature information compression can discard critical details essential for subsequent reasoning. In this paper, we introduce Commit-on-Evidence Memory (CoEM), which learns when to convert source evidence into compact memory facts. Specifically, under a fixed context-memory budget, CoEM preserves potentially useful source excerpts verbatim in a pending set, allowing subsequent context to clarify their relevance before irreversible compression. As new context arrives, a learned policy revisits each pending excerpt and decides whether to promote it to the committed memory, retain it for further consideration, or discard it. A frozen verifier ensures proposed facts are accepted only if supported by retained excerpts and current context. To further guide effective memory management, we train this policy using reinforcement learning by combining fine-grained, step-level evidence rewards with final answer rewards. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CoEM consistently improves long-context reasoning. When evaluated on 6,400 documents long-context input, CoEM outperforms the strongest memory baseline by 10.4-11.4 F1 points on Qwen3.5-9B. Code repository: https://github.com/benmagnifico/CoEM.

AI.tldr: 提出 Commit-on-Evidence Memory (CoEM)：在固定上下文-记忆预算下，将可能有用的源证据以原文形式暂存于待定集合，学习策略决定何时将证据"提交"为紧凑记忆事实，从而缓解长上下文推理中的过早信息压缩问题。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理对复杂、长程任务至关重要，但随上下文长度增加，LLM 性能下降。现有方法采用分块处理并维持有界文本记忆，然而过早压缩信息会丢弃后续推理所需的关键细节。
AI.method: CoEM 在固定预算下把潜在有用的源摘录逐字保留在 pending set 中，等待后续上下文澄清其相关性，避免不可逆压缩。新上下文到来时，学习到的策略重新审视每条待定摘录，决定将其提升为已提交记忆、保留继续观察或丢弃；同时用冻结的验证器确保所提出事实仅在被保留摘录与当前上下文支持时才被接受。策略通过强化学习训练，结合细粒度步级证据奖励与最终答案奖励。
AI.result: 大量实验表明 CoEM 一致提升长上下文推理性能。在 6,400 篇文档的长上下文输入评测中，CoEM 在 Qwen3.5-9B 上比最强记忆基线高出 10.4–11.4 个 F1 点。
AI.conclusion: 延迟且基于证据的记忆提交（结合学习式决策与验证机制、步级与答案级联合奖励）能有效缓解过早压缩带来的信息损失，显著提升长上下文推理表现。代码已开源。

title: Cool the Sampler, Not the Learner: Sampling Temperature Moves the Staleness Cliff of Importance-Corrected GRPO
summary: Production RL for language models lets the sampler fall behind the learner and repairs the resulting mismatch with a truncated importance weight. We ask how long the sampler can go without a refresh under that correction, and find a cliff: on Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B and GSM8K, importance-corrected GRPO refreshed every 192 updates learns well for 180 steps and then degrades severely in all three data seeds before the refresh arrives. Published remedies for staleness act on the update; we act on the sampler instead. Decoupled cooling draws samples at temperature 0.8 while the learner, the reference model and the importance weights stay at temperature 1, with the behaviour probability recorded from the tempered distribution, so the learner's objective is unchanged. All corresponding cooled runs are stable, and the longer interval keeps what the short one delivered: at the same update budget, a cooled sampler refreshed every 192 steps matches an uncooled sampler refreshed every 96 at the end of training (0.857 for both) and averaged over it (0.79), whereas lowering the learning rate to a safe value ends 3-7 points lower. On Qwen2.5-Math-7B the degradation points at interval 192 predict that an interval of 144 is fatal without cooling and survivable with it; on two data seeds the uncooled runs degrade before their first refresh and the cooled runs pass it and end at 92-93% against 68-81%, with one cooled run degrading transiently late in the second cycle. The benefit has a window: at three times the safe interval and in a high-mismatch MATH setting cooling delays degradation without preventing it, stronger cooling is not better, and cooling without the correction collapses. Sampling temperature is a control on staleness tolerance, and temperature and refresh interval should be chosen together.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究生产级强化学习（Production RL）中采样器滞后于学习器所导致的不匹配问题，提出"解耦冷却"（Decoupled cooling）策略：仅对采样器使用温度0.8采样，而学习器、参考模型与重要性权重保持温度1，从而在不改变学习器目标的前提下提升对陈旧样本（staleness）的容忍度，使刷新间隔得以延长。
AI.motivation: 在语言模型的生产级RL中，采样器会滞后于学习器，产生训练数据与当前策略的不匹配，现有方法依赖截断重要性权重进行修正。作者希望探究：在这种修正下，采样器可以维持多久不刷新？并发现存在一个"悬崖"现象——重要性修正的GRPO在每192次更新刷新一次时，前180步学习良好，随后在刷新到来前出现严重退化。已发表的缓解陈旧性的方法作用于更新（update），而本文选择作用于采样器本身。
AI.method: 提出"解耦冷却"（Decoupled cooling）：采样器以温度0.8采样，而学习器、参考模型和重要性权重均保持温度1，行为概率从带温度的分布中记录，因此学习器的目标函数保持不变。此方法不改变优化目标，仅调节采样分布的"温度"，从而作为控制陈旧性容忍度的手段。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B与GSM8K上，所有冷却后的运行均保持稳定：在相同更新预算下，每192步刷新的冷却采样器与每96步刷新的未冷却采样器在训练结束时表现相当（均为0.857），训练全程平均为0.79；而将学习率降至安全值则最终低3-7个点。在Qwen2.5-Math-7B上，间隔192的退化点预测间隔144在无冷却时致命、有冷却时可存活；在两个数据种子上，未冷却运行在首次刷新前即退化，冷却运行则通过该点并以92-93%对68-81%收尾（其中一次冷却运行在第二周期后期出现短暂退化）。该收益存在窗口：在安全间隔三倍时以及高不匹配的MATH设定下，冷却只能延迟退化而无法阻止；更强的冷却并非更优；无修正的冷却会崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 采样温度是控制陈旧性容忍度的一个有效变量，且温度与刷新间隔应当联合选择。解耦冷却通过仅作用于采样器而不改变学习器目标，能够在相同预算下以更长刷新间隔达到与更频繁刷新相当的性能，但该收益存在适用窗口，超过界限或在高不匹配设定下效果有限。

title: VStress: Correlation-Aware Auditing and Adaptive Budget Allocation for Repeated Verifiers
summary: Repeated verifier calls are useful only when they contribute conditional information. We introduce VStress, an auditable replay contract, and VStress-CA, a correlation-aware allocation policy that estimates the conditional marginal information of an unqueried verifier on a sealed calibration split, discounts uncertainty, normalizes by call cost, and stops or abstains when the next call is not informative. The controller freezes its decision and cost ledger before joining the clean oracle; a dependence-shift alarm disables channel preference and falls back to exact-stop. The controlled audit gives the mechanism boundary: at 35% symmetric corruption, majority-5 improves balanced accuracy from 0.6578 to 0.7739, whereas at 65% it loses 0.1226 points. In the matched fixed-budget comparison, breadth, redundancy, and adaptive allocation obtain balanced accuracies 0.6048, 0.6375, and 0.6538, with 3.4216 calls per item and an RLVR score of 0.6417 for VStress-CA. Dependence diagnostics also increase from same-model repeats to cross-family channels, with conditional marginal gains of 0.0126, 0.0462, and 0.0913. These measurements turn correlation from a post-hoc warning into an auditable allocation decision.

AI.tldr: 提出 VStress 可审计重放契约与相关性感知分配策略 VStress-CA，通过估计未查询验证器的条件边际信息并按调用成本归一化，决定何时停止或弃答，把相关性从事后警告变为可审计的分配决策。
AI.motivation: 重复调用验证器只有在提供条件信息时才有价值。现有多数方法把验证器间相关性当作事后警示，缺乏可审计的分配机制与边界刻画，因此需要将相关性纳入调用分配决策。
AI.method: VStress 为可审计重放契约：控制器在接入 clean oracle 前冻结决策与成本账本，并设依赖漂移告警以关闭通道偏好、回退精确停止。VStress-CA 在密封校准集上估计未查询验证器的条件边际信息，对不确定性贴现、按调用成本归一化，若下一次调用信息量不足则停止或弃答。
AI.result: 在 35% 对称污染下，majority-5 将平衡准确率从 0.6578 提升至 0.7739；在 65% 污染下反而损失 0.1226 点。固定预算匹配比较中，breadth、redundancy、adaptive allocation 的平衡准确率分别为 0.6048、0.6375、0.6538，VStress-CA 为每项 3.4216 次调用、RLVR 分数 0.6417。依赖诊断从同模型重复到跨家族通道递增，条件边际增益为 0.0126、0.0462、0.0913。
AI.conclusion: 受控审计刻画了机制边界；通过可审计的成本账本与条件边际信息量化，将验证器相关性从后验警告转变为可审计的分配决策。

title: VACE: Validation-Gated Alternating Co-Evolution of Agent Models and Harnesses
summary: Language model agents can be improved by updating their model weights or refining the harness that guides task execution. These components are coupled: weight updates change how the model uses the harness, while harness updates change the trajectories used for training. We propose VACE, Validation-Gated Alternating CoEvolution, which alternates agentic reinforcement learning with trajectory-driven harness refinement. After each RL stage, VACE reuses the collected trajectories to propose a harness revision and evaluates the incumbent and candidate with the updated model held fixed. The candidate guides subsequent training only if it improves validation performance. With Qwen3.5-9B, VACE achieves 45.26% test accuracy on OfficeQA and a mean partial-credit score of 75.19% on AutomationBench, exceeding weight-only RL by 6.43 and 9.09 percentage points and ungated alternation by 4.59 and 6.95 points, respectively. Across 44 harness proposals, 17 reduce validation performance at the updated checkpoint and are rejected before subsequent RL training, highlighting the importance of validation gating.

AI.tldr: VACE通过验证门控的交替协同进化，将智能体强化学习与轨迹驱动的脚手架优化交替进行，在OfficeQA和AutomationBench上显著优于仅权重RL与无门控交替方案。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体可通过更新模型权重或改进引导任务执行的脚手架（harness）来提升，但两者相互耦合：权重更新改变模型对脚手架的使用方式，脚手架更新又改变用于训练的轨迹。现有方法往往孤立处理二者，且缺乏对脚手架修订效果的可靠筛选，可能引入负面更新。
AI.method: 提出VACE（验证门控交替协同进化），在智能体强化学习与轨迹驱动脚手架优化之间交替。每个RL阶段后，复用已收集轨迹提出一个脚手架修订候选，在固定更新后模型的前提下评估现有脚手架与候选脚手架；仅当候选在验证集上提升性能时，才用其引导后续训练形成门控机制。
AI.result: 基于Qwen3.5-9B，VACE在OfficeQA上达到45.26%测试准确率，在AutomationBench上平均部分得分75.19%，分别超过仅权重RL 6.43和9.09个百分点，超过无门控交替4.59和6.95个百分点。44个脚手架提案中有17个在更新检查点上降低验证性能，并在后续RL训练前被拒绝。
AI.conclusion: 验证门控是协同进化智能体的关键组件：在权重与脚手架相互耦合的情况下，先验证后采纳可有效过滤有害更新，保证协同进化稳定提升性能。

title: Unlocking the Critic: Reward-Free Policy Optimization for LLM Post-Training
summary: Recent approaches to reinforcement learning (RL) post-training for large language models increasingly remove the critic to reduce training instability and memory overhead. Even where a critic is trained, it is discarded once training ends, although it has learned to predict outcomes. We revisit this trend and show that a pretrained critic's ability to predict future outcomes can make it a valuable asset for efficient long-horizon reasoning. First, we find that instability in critic-based RL for long chain-of-thought reasoning is largely an optimization artifact: keeping policy updates small and low in variance restores stable convergence. Second, a well-pretrained critic estimates the posterior probability of eventual success from later trajectory states and unfinished prefixes. Its predictions provide outcome-derived, dense, per-prefix learning signals that, during policy optimization, require neither completed rollouts, step-level annotations, nor external reward labels. Building on this insight, we introduce Reward-Free Policy Optimization (RFPO), which repurposes a single calibrated, frozen critic as a rollout-level reward, a value baseline for generalized advantage estimation, and a success forecaster for unfinished prefixes. We further show that binarizing the debiased score stops the policy from exploiting the critic's length bias. Binarized, RFPO matches supervised PPO without a single label in the training loop, while cutting compute and memory overhead. This makes RFPO well suited to long-horizon reasoning tasks, where outcomes arrive late and generation dominates cost: because rollouts can be rewarded before they finish, training no longer has to pay for waiting on every trajectory to complete. Our findings challenge the prevailing critic-free paradigm and establish critic-based, reward-free optimization as a scalable and computationally efficient path for LLM post-training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Reward-Free Policy Optimization（RFPO），重新利用预训练且冻结的critic，将critic的预测作为rollout级奖励、GAE值基线和成功预测器，从而在无标签、无完成rollout的条件下实现稳定的长程推理RL后训练，性能媲美监督PPO并显著降低计算与内存开销。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM的RL后训练趋势是去除critic以降低训练不稳定性和内存开销，且即便训练了critic，训练结束后也会被丢弃。作者质疑这一范式，指出critic已学到结果预测能力，可成为长程推理的高效资产。同时，长程推理任务中结果反馈延迟、生成成本占主导，等待完整rollout代价高昂，因此需要一种能利用未完成前缀进行奖励的方法。
AI.method: 作者首先分析critic-based RL的不稳定性，发现其主要是优化伪影，通过保持策略更新幅度小、方差低即可恢复稳定收敛。其次，预训练良好的critic能从后续轨迹状态和未完成前缀中估计最终成功的后验概率，提供结果驱动、稠密、逐前缀的学习信号，无需完整rollout、步级标注或外部奖励标签。基于此提出RFPO：将单个校准后的冻结critic同时用作rollout级奖励、广义优势估计（GAE）的值基线以及未完成前缀的成功预测器。此外，对去偏分数进行二值化，以阻止策略利用critic的长度偏差。
AI.result: 二值化后的RFPO在训练循环中不使用任何标签即可匹配监督PPO，同时减少计算和内存开销。由于rollout可在完成前获得奖励，训练无需等待每条轨迹完成，特别适合结果延迟、生成成本占主导的长程推理任务。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果挑战了当前主流的critic-free范式，确立了基于critic的、无奖励优化（reward-free optimization）作为LLM后训练中可扩展且计算高效的路径。

title: Trajectory Soup: Pushing the Compute-Scaling Frontier of LLM Mid-training via Diverse Trajectories
summary: Mid-training equips pretrained large language models with specialized and reasoning capabilities, but the returns of this stage are bounded since additional serial compute yields little further downstream improvement and can even degrade some capabilities, which places a practical ceiling on how much compute mid-training absorbs. We revisit how this compute should be allocated to a single run or multiple similar optimizations. We find that branches forked from a shared checkpoint under various controlled recipe reaches measurably different regions of parameter space, and establish a form of compatible diversity that extending one run cannot supply. Therefore, we introduce Trajectory Soup, which distributes a mid-training budget over several independent branches, and consolidates strongest checkpoints selected on validation through intra- and inter-trajectory averaging into a single model. A local bias and variance analysis separates the two averaging levels, showing that inter-trajectory averaging removes residual error beyond the reach of averaging within a trajectory, while checkpoint selection carries a bias that bounds how many checkpoints are worth merging. Across model scales, learning-rate schedules, token budgets, and trajectory counts, Trajectory Soup improves aggregate downstream performance over the strongest single-trajectory average under matched budgets and keeps improving as budgets expand, with the advantage preserved after an identical post-training pipeline. These results position trajectory allocation and merging as a practical way to extend the compute-scaling frontier of mid-training beyond serial saturation.

AI.tldr: 提出 Trajectory Soup：将 mid-training 预算分配给多条独立分支训练轨迹，再通过轨迹内与轨迹间平均合并验证集上最优的检查点，从而突破单条串行训练的计算饱和上限。
AI.motivation: mid-training 虽能赋予预训练大模型专门能力与推理能力，但收益有界：额外串行计算对下游提升甚微，甚至损害部分能力，形成实际的计算吸收天花板。作者希望重新思考如何把该阶段的计算分配到单次或多次相似优化中。
AI.method: 发现从同一共享检查点出发、在不同受控配方下分叉出的分支会到达参数空间中可测量的不同区域，形成一种串行延伸无法提供的"兼容多样性"。据此提出 Trajectory Soup：把 mid-training 预算分散到多条独立分支，基于验证集挑选最强检查点，再通过轨迹内平均与轨迹间平均汇总为单一模型。并用局部偏差-方差分析分离两个平均层次：轨迹间平均可消除轨迹内平均无法触及的残余误差，而检查点选择引入的偏差决定了值得合并的检查点数量上限。
AI.result: 在多种模型规模、学习率调度、token 预算和轨迹数量设置下，Trajectory Soup 在预算匹配条件下均优于最强的单轨迹平均结果，且随预算扩大持续提升；经过相同后训练流程后优势依然保持。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹分配与合并是将 mid-training 的计算扩展前沿推进到串行饱和之外的一种实用途径。

title: Asking for What Was Never Requested: Horizontal and Vertical Proactivity in Agents
summary: An agent that uses tools typically responds to what the user explicitly asks, yet completing the task may require information the user never requested. Work on proactive agents mainly studies whether and when an agent should act on its own, not what information it should pursue. We study a distinct axis of proactivity: its content. Horizontal proactivity pursues unstated information that the current context already identifies, and vertical proactivity pursues needs that only earlier evidence reveals. A need graph, recovered from a benchmark's own decomposition, records which needs depend on which, so both forms, and whether the agent stops at the right time, can be scored from a transcript without a model judge. To learn this behavior, we propose Q&D (questioner and drafter), which trains a questioner to prefer the question whose continuation retrieves more of the required evidence, with no reward model or judge. On held-out splits of three multi-hop question-answering benchmarks, at equal retrieval spend, the trained questioner improves both forms of proactivity over the same model, prompted, and outperforms a prompted model $15\times$ larger in the same role on two of the three, and the gain persists after controlling for question volume and length. Without further training, we place the questioner in an interactive customer-service agent with a simulated customer, where it completes more tasks while asking fewer questions, and in retail it outperforms the $15\times$ larger model with fewer follow-up turns from the customer. These results show that proactivity depends not only on whether an agent acts without being asked, but also on what it chooses to pursue and when it stops.

AI.tldr: 本文将主动性区分为"横向主动性"(追问当前上下文已隐含但用户未明说的信息)与"纵向主动性"(追索只有先前证据才揭示的需求),提出基于需求图的转录评分法,并训练 Q&D(提问者-起草者)让提问者偏好能检索到更多必要证据的问题,在三个多跳问答基准及客服/零售交互场景中提升主动性并优于 15 倍规模的大模型。
AI.motivation: 现有主动型智能体研究主要关注"是否以及何时"主动行动,而忽视了"追求什么信息"这一内容维度。但仅回应用户显式提问往往不足以完成任务,因为任务所需信息用户从未要求过,因此需要研究主动性的内容轴。
AI.method: 1) 提出横向与纵向两种主动性的形式化区分;2) 从基准自身的任务分解中恢复"需求图",记录需求之间的依赖关系,从而无需模型裁判即可从对话转录中为两种主动性及"是否正确停止"打分;3) 提出 Q&D(提问者与起草者),用"问题续写能检索到多少必要证据"作为偏好信号训练提问者,不使用奖励模型或裁判模型。
AI.result: 在三个多跳问答基准的留出划分上,在相同检索开销下,训练后的提问者在两种主动性上均优于同一模型的提示版本;在三个基准中的两个上超过 15 倍规模提示模型扮演的相同角色;控制提问数量与长度后增益依然存在。无需额外训练,将提问者置于带模拟客户的交互式客服智能体中,可完成更多任务且提问更少;在零售场景中也优于 15 倍规模模型,并减少客户后续追问轮次。
AI.conclusion: 主动性不仅取决于智能体是否在未被要求时行动,还取决于它选择追求什么以及何时停止。研究证明主动性的"内容"是一个独立且有价值的轴,值得单独建模与评测。

title: Hidden Reasoning Must Leak, but Need Not Be Readable: Fundamental Opportunities and Limits for Chain-of-Thought Monitoring
summary: Can reasoning models trick chain of thought (CoT) monitors and perform hidden computation without revealing it in their thinking traces? We show that the answer depends on the underlying task difficulty and the model size. Simple computations can be performed covertly; however, beyond a threshold depending on model size, successfully solving the task necessarily leaks a near-linear amount of information about the covert task input into the CoT. Therefore, sufficiently complex hidden computation always leaves an information-theoretic footprint. However, concerningly, this leakage need not be readable: Under plausible cryptographic assumptions, even a one-layer Transformer can encrypt its reasoning online so that no polynomial-time monitor can extract information about the hidden computation. Overall, our theoretical and empirical results provide a holistic view of both the opportunities and the limitations of CoT monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文研究推理模型能否欺骗思维链（CoT）监控并在思考轨迹中隐藏计算。结论取决于任务难度和模型规模：简单计算可隐蔽完成，但超过与模型规模相关的阈值后，成功求解任务必然向CoT泄露近线性量的隐藏任务输入信息，即足够复杂隐藏计算必留信息论足迹；然而该泄露不一定可读，在合理密码学假设下，即便单层Transformer也能在线加密推理，使多项式时间监控者无法提取隐藏计算信息。
AI.motivation: 探究推理模型是否能在不暴露思维链的前提下进行隐藏计算，以评估CoT监控的安全性与可靠性边界。
AI.method: 结合理论分析与实证实验，考察任务难度、模型规模、信息泄露量以及密码学假设下的加密推理能力。
AI.result: 简单计算可被隐蔽执行；超过依赖模型规模的阈值后，成功求解任务必然向CoT泄露与隐藏任务输入近线性相关的信息；但该泄露未必可读，在合理密码学假设下单层Transformer即可在线加密推理，使多项式时间监控者无法提取信息。
AI.conclusion: 研究从信息论与计算复杂度两个层面刻画了CoT监控的机遇与局限，说明监控存在原则性上限。

title: Solving Without Stopping: On-Policy Distillation at Small Scale
summary: On-policy distillation, where a student learns from a stronger teacher's feedback on its own outputs, is a common way to pass reasoning to smaller models. We analyze what it transfers at small scale, distilling Qwen3-8B into Qwen3 4B, 1.7B and 0.6B students, in thinking mode (reason at length, then end the reasoning and answer) and, for comparison, in non-thinking mode (no separate reasoning phase). Long reasoning needs two abilities, solving a problem and knowing when it is solved, and we find that distillation transfers the first, but in thinking mode not the second. Solving improves at every size, up to two ceilings, which we measure comprehensively across both modes and all student sizes: a student's single attempt never exceeds what it could already reach in many attempts before training, and the smaller the student, the further it stays below the teacher. Stopping is where the modes part. In non-thinking mode every student keeps stopping; in thinking mode students stop ending their reasoning early in training, and the smaller the student, the less of this ability survives: the teacher signals a stop almost only where a student already ends its reasoning, so distillation teaches no new stops; it only keeps the student's existing stops that land on a right answer, and a weak student has few such stops. The smallest students often reach the right value but do not commit to it: they either rarely mark it or mark it and write past it. Together, these results describe how small students behave under on-policy distillation, and a diagnostic that separates answer marking, correctness and stopping.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析小规模on-policy蒸馏究竟迁移了什么：将Qwen3-8B蒸馏到4B/1.7B/0.6B学生模型，发现在thinking模式下蒸馏迁移了"解题"能力但未迁移"知道何时已解出"（停止）能力；并揭示两个性能天花板及停止行为随规模缩小的退化规律。
AI.motivation: On-policy蒸馏（学生从更强教师对其自身输出的反馈中学习）是向小模型传递推理能力的常用方法，但其在小规模下究竟迁移了什么、哪些能力可被转移、哪些不能，尚缺乏细致的实证分析。作者希望厘清thinking模式与non-thinking模式下蒸馏的差异，尤其是长推理所需的两种能力——解题与判断何时已解出（停止）——是否都能被迁移。
AI.method: 以Qwen3-8B为教师，蒸馏到Qwen3 4B、1.7B、0.6B三个尺寸的学生模型；分别在thinking模式（先长推理再结束推理并作答）与non-thinking模式（无独立推理阶段）下进行对比实验；在两种模式、所有学生尺寸上全面测量性能天花板；并提出一个可分离"答案标记（answer marking）、正确性（correctness）与停止（stopping）"的诊断方法，用于分析停止行为。
AI.result: 1）解题能力在每种尺寸下都有提升，但存在两个天花板：学生的单次尝试从不超过其训练前多次尝试已能达到的水平；且学生越小，其表现距教师越远。2）停止行为是两种模式的分水岭：non-thinking模式下所有学生都能保持停止；thinking模式下学生在训练早期就逐渐不再结束推理，且学生越小该能力留存越少。3）教师几乎只在学生本身已结束推理的位置发出停止信号，因此蒸馏不教新的停止点，只保留学生已有且落在正确答案上的停止；弱学生此类停止很少。4）最小尺寸学生常能触及正确值却不"承诺"于它：要么极少标记，要么标记后继续写下去（写过头）。
AI.conclusion: On-policy蒸馏在小规模下主要迁移解题能力而非停止/自我判断能力；停止能力能否保留取决于学生原有行为，且随规模缩小而下降更快。作者据此刻画了小学生在on-policy蒸馏下的行为特征，并提出一个将答案标记、正确性与停止相分离的诊断工具，为理解与改进蒸馏提供依据。

title: Port-Hamiltonian Latent Deliberation: Mitigating the Deliberation Drift Cliff in Test-Time Compute Scaling
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Code and evaluation artifacts available
summary: Test-time compute scaling has emerged as a cornerstone of advanced machine reasoning, yet performing iterative deliberation directly within continuous latent representation spaces reveals a catastrophic pathology: the Deliberation Drift Cliff. While unconstrained recurrent latent models achieve initial reasoning gains at short horizons (K <= 4), their reasoning collapses when extrapolated to deeper thinking steps (K >= 16), dropping by 22% to 62% across standard logical benchmarks. We resolve the trilemma among expressivity, Lyapunov stability, and computational efficiency in test-time latent reasoning through a 22-round empirical and theoretical investigation. We demonstrate that strictly conservative scalar potential gradient flows suppress long-range drift (cliff 3.40%) but bottleneck peak reasoning accuracy at 32.73%, whereas unconstrained rotational flows achieve high symbolic expressivity (82.33%) but suffer a severe 36.87% drift cliff. To resolve this geometric duality, we establish Port-Hamiltonian Latent Deliberation (PH-LD) and propose the Direct-Gradient Pure-Tensor Helmholtz-Hodge Decomposition (DG-HHD). DG-HHD parameterizes the attracting flow as a tangent projection tensor network while orthogonally decoupling non-zero circulation (Hodge machine error 1.65e-17, contraction error 5.55e-17), eliminating runtime autograd dependencies to achieve 1.84x vector field and 2.09x RK45 rollout speedups. In a 15-arm symmetrical Pareto benchmark, DG-HHD achieves 58.67% peak accuracy (+25.94% absolute gain over conservative HHD) and retains 35.27% at K=32. Transferred to small language model (SLM) multi-hop causal reasoning, DG-HHD delivers monotonic compute scaling (49.33% to 51.56%) and suppresses out-of-distribution drift (cliff -0.66%). All 30 Level 0 deterministic invariants are certified.

AI.tldr: 该论文识别了连续潜在空间测试时推理中的"Deliberation Drift Cliff"现象，并通过Port-Hamiltonian潜在 deliberation框架与DG-HHD分解方法，在表达性、Lyapunov稳定性与计算效率之间取得平衡。
AI.motivation: 测试时计算扩展是高级机器推理的基石，但在连续潜在表示空间中进行迭代 deliberation 会出现"Deliberation Drift Cliff"病理：无约束循环潜在模型在短视野（K≤4）有初步增益，但在更深思考步（K≥16）时推理崩溃，逻辑基准下降22%~62%。核心动机是解决表达性、Lyapunov稳定性与计算效率之间的三难困境。
AI.method: 通过22轮经验与理论研究，对比了严格保守标量势梯度流（抑制漂移但峰值精度受限）与无约束旋转流（高表达性但漂移严重）的几何对偶性。提出Port-Hamiltonian Latent Deliberation（PH-LD）框架，并设计Direct-Gradient Pure-Tensor Helmholtz-Hodge Decomposition（DG-HHD）：将吸引流参数化为切空间投影张量网络，同时正交解耦非零环流，消除运行时自动微分依赖。
AI.result: 保守标量势梯度流的悬崖为3.40%，但峰值推理精度仅32.73%；无约束旋转流达到82.33%符号表达性，但漂移悬崖高达36.87%。DG-HHD实现Hodge机误差1.65e-17、收缩误差5.55e-17，向量场与RK45 rollout分别加速1.84倍与2.09倍。在15臂对称Pareto基准中，峰值精度58.67%（较保守HHD绝对提升25.94%），K=32时保持35.27%。迁移至SLM多跳因果推理后实现单调计算扩展（49.33%→51.56%），OOD漂移悬崖为-0.66%，30项Level 0确定性不变量全部通过认证。
AI.conclusion: DG-HHD有效缓解了连续潜在 deliberation 中的漂移悬崖问题，在表达性、稳定性与效率之间实现了更优的Pareto权衡，并展现出向小型语言模型因果推理任务迁移的潜力。

title: Risk-Controlled Selective LLM Answering by Pricing Label-Free Checks
comment: 29 pages, 6 figures, 24 tables. Dongyub Jude Lee and Jungseob Lee contributed equally
summary: Serving an answer from a large language model requires deciding when to abstain, yet a verifier's ranking accuracy alone does not determine the error rate among served answers. We introduce PriceCheck, which builds a compact family of decision rules from label-free checks such as re-solving a problem. Each check has a price: its agreement rates on correct and incorrect answers and its cost per run. Prices fitted on a small, class-enriched labelled set compose into predictions of a schedule's coverage and cost, guiding which checks to run and when to stop. A calibration test then selects a schedule at a stated selective-risk target. In mathematics, the selected schedules serve 76.1% of answers on average and keep held-out selective risk below 1.5% on all 15 splits. Under the shared testing protocol, PriceCheck serves more answers at that target than reward models, a prompted judge, the generator's confidence and a trained correctness classifier. At matched coverage, it keeps the fewest wrong answers among these scorers. Across 118 diagnostic schedules, price-based coverage predictions have a rank correlation of 0.97 with observed coverage. These results show that choosing how checks are combined and stopped matters alongside how well a verifier ranks answers. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/PriceCheck.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PriceCheck，用无标签检查（如重解问题）构建决策规则族，通过拟合每种检查在正确/错误答案上的同意率与单次成本，预测调度方案的覆盖率与开销，并按给定选择性风险目标选取调度方案。在数学任务上，所选调度平均服务 76.1% 的答案，且所有 15 个划分的留出选择性风险均低于 1.5%，优于奖励模型、提示评判器、生成器置信度与训练的正确性分类器。
AI.motivation: 大模型作答时需决定何时弃答，但验证器的排序准确率本身并不能决定被服务答案中的错误率；现有做法忽略了如何组合与何时停止这些检查，缺少在给定选择性风险目标下显式权衡覆盖率与成本的决策机制。
AI.method: PriceCheck 从无标签检查（如重解问题）构建紧凑的决策规则族。每种检查带有“价格”：在正确答案与错误答案上的一致率，以及单次运行成本。在小规模、类别增强的标注集上拟合这些价格，用于预测某调度方案的覆盖率与成本，从而指导该运行哪些检查、何时停止。随后通过校准测试，在指定的选择性风险目标下选择调度方案。
AI.result: 数学任务中，所选调度平均服务 76.1% 的答案，并在全部 15 个划分上把留出选择性风险控制在 1.5% 以下。在共享测试协议下，同一目标下 PriceCheck 服务的答案多于奖励模型、提示评判器、生成器置信度和训练的正确性分类器；在覆盖率相同时，其错误答案最少。在 118 个诊断调度上，基于价格的覆盖率预测与观测覆盖率的秩相关达 0.97。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，除了验证器排序答案的能力外，如何组合与停止检查同样关键；基于价格的调度框架能在满足选择性风险约束的前提下有效提升服务覆盖率并降低错误答案数量。

title: Rational Clarification by Assistive Agents via Value-of-Information Reasoning
summary: Users of language-based assistive agents often make ambiguous requests. In response, an assistant can either directly act on its interpretation of the request --- risking misalignment with the user --- or ask a clarifying question. Which option is the most safe and helpful? A common approach is to ask questions that minimize uncertainty about the user's intent until a threshold is reached. However, this neglects the impact of uncertainty reduction on downstream performance, the costs of asking versus acting immediately, and the possibility that users may provide corrections without being asked. To navigate these trade-offs, we introduce Rational Enquiry via Value-of-Information Reasoning (REVOIR). REVOIR makes clarification decisions via inference-time reasoning about the value-of-information of a question, which captures the expected improvement in task reward due to the answer received. In two assistive tasks --- ambiguous question answering (CondAmbigQA) and preference-aligned household task planning (ADAPT) --- we show that REVOIR achieves greater success with fewer questions than approaches based on prompting, chain-of-thought, fine-tuning, or information gain, improving preference satisfaction on ADAPT by 13-15% over a fine-tuned clarification policy while requiring no training and asking five times fewer questions. Furthermore, when the assistant can receive cheap user corrections after acting, REVOIR naturally infers that asking questions is not always efficient, demonstrating the adaptivity of our approach. In contrast, we find that vanilla reasoning agents fail to adaptively clarify user requests, and request fewer clarifications as reasoning effort increases.

AI.tldr: REVOIR：基于信息价值推理的澄清决策方法，在更少提问下实现更高任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 语言辅助智能体常面对模糊请求，需在"直接按理解行动（可能偏离用户意图）"与"提问澄清"之间权衡。常见做法是机械地提问以最小化意图不确定性直至阈值，但忽视了不确定性降低对下游性能的实际影响、提问与立即行动的成本对比，以及用户可能主动给出纠正的情形。
AI.method: 提出 REVOIR（Rational Enquiry via Value-of-Information Reasoning）：在推理时估计每个问题所带来答案的期望任务奖励提升（信息价值），据此决定是否澄清或直接行动，无需训练。
AI.result: 在模糊问答（CondAmbigQA）与偏好对齐家务规划（ADAPT）两个任务上，REVOIR 相比基于提示、思维链、微调及信息增益的方法，成功率更高且提问更少；在 ADAPT 上偏好满足率较微调澄清策略提升 13-15%，且无需训练、提问次数减少五倍。当行动后可获得低成本用户纠正时，REVOIR 能自动推断提问并非总是高效。相反，普通推理智能体无法自适应澄清，且随推理力度增加反而更少请求澄清。
AI.conclusion: 以信息价值为核心的推理时澄清决策能更好地权衡提问与行动，实现更安全高效的人机协作，并具备对低成本纠正场景的自适应性。

title: FOCUS: Training-Free Decision-Preserving Context Compression for LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents accumulate interaction histories that grow linearly with task length, causing quadratic inference cost scaling and performance degradation from attention dilution. Existing context-compression methods learn what to discard offline: by contrastively optimizing guidelines, distilling compressors, or training compression policies. This incurs a substantial cost. Further, the compression policy is learned a priori and is not dynamically conditioned on the evolving test-time trajectories. In this paper we ask a complementary question: Which past interactions causally shape the agent's future decisions? We recast context compression as a causal decision preservation problem over discrete interaction units and introduce FOCUS, a training-free context compression framework that operates entirely at test time. Our method requires no offline data collection or fine-tuning, and is architecture-agnostic, attaching to any closed-API frontier model as a modular compression layer. We evaluate FOCUS on diverse agentic benchmarks including API and tool-calling, QA, web domain and multi-turn dialogue. Our method establishes new state of the art performance, cutting peak context by up to 48% and dependency by 73% while improving task success by up to 8.9 percentage points over uncompressed execution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FOCUS，一种无需训练、完全在测试时运行的上下文压缩框架，将上下文压缩重构为离散交互单元上的因果决策保持问题，可在任何闭源API模型上即插即用，在多个智能体基准上实现SOTA：峰值上下文最多降低48%，依赖降低73%，任务成功率最多提升8.9个百分点。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体的交互历史随任务长度线性增长，导致推理成本二次方级上升，并因注意力稀释而性能退化。现有上下文压缩方法依赖离线学习（对比优化指南、蒸馏压缩器或训练压缩策略），成本高昂，且压缩策略是先验学习的，无法根据测试时不断演化的轨迹动态调整条件。本文因此提出一个互补性问题：哪些过去的交互因果性地塑造了智能体未来的决策？
AI.method: 将上下文压缩重构为离散交互单元上的因果决策保持问题，提出FOCUS框架。该框架无需训练，完全在测试时运行，不需离线数据收集或微调，且与架构无关，可作为模块化压缩层挂接到任意闭源API前沿模型上。
AI.result: 在涵盖API与工具调用、问答、网页领域和多轮对话等多种智能体基准上评估。FOCUS取得新的SOTA性能：峰值上下文最多减少48%，依赖减少73%，相比未压缩执行任务成功率最多提升8.9个百分点。
AI.conclusion: FOCUS表明，通过因果性视角识别真正塑造未来决策的交互单元，可在测试时实现无需训练、即插即用的上下文压缩，同时降低上下文规模与依赖并提升任务成功率，优于依赖离线学习的现有压缩方法。

title: Authority Bias in Language Models: Source Deference and User Agreement Are Not Interchangeable
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Main Conference, Poster). 33 pages, 8 figures. Project page: https://authority-bias.vercel.app/ . Code: https://github.com/Lossfunk/authority-bias
summary: Language models tend to agree with whatever a user asserts, and post-training increasingly targets this sycophancy so that models evaluate claims on their merits rather than deferring to the user. Yet the same models are far more compliant when a wrong answer is attributed to a verified source, which is how retrieval results, tool outputs, and grounded-search content often present information. We measure this gap across five open-weight families and three closed APIs. A single verified-source note endorsing a wrong answer flips 45-88% of baseline-correct responses in seven of eight models, and compliance rises with how authoritative the note sounds. Source deference and user agreement are not behaviorally interchangeable inside the model: on matched items with the same wrong answer, causal interventions can selectively suppress one without equally affecting the other. In three open-weight families, removing a fitted source direction lowers source compliance by 65-80 percentage points while removing a user or assistant direction has far smaller effects, and removing the user direction shows the reverse preference. A separately fitted intervention derived from source-versus-user cue activations moves compliance in both directions while leaving the prompt text unchanged. An authority direction fitted on trivia also transfers to PIQA and multi-turn SYCON dialogues without refitting, and removing it lowers wrong-source compliance by tens of percentage points in four of five families with no detected change in MMLU-Pro or GSM8K accuracy at our evaluation sizes. Source deference and user agreement therefore need separate evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现语言模型对"已验证来源"的错误信息高度顺从（source deference），这与用户顺从（sycophancy）是两种可分离的内部机制，需分别评估与干预。
AI.motivation: 现有后训练主要针对"用户顺从"（模型迎合用户断言）进行矫正，但检索结果、工具输出、有依据搜索等内容常以"已验证来源"形式呈现信息，模型对这类来源的错误答案表现出更高顺从，而这一来源顺从问题未被单独评估。
AI.method: 在5个开源权重模型家族与3个闭源API上测量该顺从差距；通过因果干预（移除拟合的"来源方向""用户方向""助手方向"及来源对用户线索激活拟合的干预）在匹配样本上选择性抑制一种顺从；并测试权威方向在trivia上拟合后向PIQA与多轮SYCON对话的零样本迁移。
AI.result: 单条支持错误答案的"已验证来源"提示在8个模型中的7个翻转了45-88%的原先正确回答，顺从度随来源权威性上升；在3个开源家族中移除来源方向使来源顺从下降65-80个百分点，而移除用户或助手方向影响很小，移除用户方向则呈现相反偏好；权威方向从trivia迁移到PIQA与SYCON无需重拟合，移除后在5个家族中的4个使错误来源顺从下降数十个百分点，且MMLU-Pro与GSM8K准确率在评估规模内无检测到的变化。
AI.conclusion: 来源顺从与用户顺从不具行为可互换性，是模型内部可分离的机制，因此二者需分别评估；这为针对检索/工具输出场景的独立对齐与干预提供了依据。

title: KUPAS MASTER: Distilling the Tacit Expertise of Master Practitioners into Agent-Ready Experience Corpora
comment: Technical Report. Official website: https://lsf.kupasai.com/ Report homepage: https://tongjiai4e.github.io/KUPAS-MASTER-Report/
summary: Experienced professionals know more than just facts and conclusions. They know which cues matter, why a judgment is reasonable, and which action to take. Routine work records often leave out this tacit knowledge, making it difficult for Large Language Model (LLM) agents to use professional experience effectively. We introduce KUPAS MASTER, an experience engineering platform built around nine-layer cognitive corpus construction. It turns heterogeneous work records and practitioner interviews into traceable, reusable experience corpora for agents. Six case elements preserve the task process: context, cues, judgment, action, boundaries, and outcomes. Nine-layer cognitive corpus construction organizes tacit experience along nine extraction dimensions and stores the resulting assets in six libraries: rules, constraints, best practices, negative examples, corner cases, and skills. Semantic alignment, individual experience distillation, organizational consolidation, and cross-review preserve source evidence, conditions of use, and unresolved disagreements. The platform packages these assets into callable skills with explicit inputs, steps, dependencies, and stopping conditions, connecting experience collection to task execution and evaluation feedback. Using authorized samples from 20 randomly selected practitioners, the platform processed 1,576 source files into 23,024 individual experience records and 13,113 organizational assets. The evaluation spans multiple professional domains. Under common task inputs and scoring criteria, the base model, raw corpus retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and KUPAS MASTER agent scored 70.63, 79.75, and 89.58, respectively. The KUPAS MASTER agent improved on raw-corpus RAG in all seven scoring dimensions. The platform provides a practical path from individual tacit experience to organizational knowledge and agent capabilities.

AI.tldr: KUPAS MASTER 是一个以九层认知语料构建为核心的"经验工程"平台，将碎片化的工作记录与从业者访谈转化为可追溯、可复用的经验语料与可调用技能，使 LLM 智能体能够有效使用专业经验。
AI.motivation: 资深专业人员的知识不仅包含事实与结论，还包括哪些线索重要、判断为何合理、应采取何种行动等隐性知识。常规工作记录往往遗漏这些隐性知识，导致 LLM 智能体难以有效利用专业经验。因此需要一种将个体隐性经验转化为组织知识与智能体能力的方法与平台。
AI.method: 提出 KUPAS MASTER 经验工程平台，围绕九层认知语料构建：以六类案例要素（情境、线索、判断、行动、边界、结果）保留任务过程；沿九个抽取维度组织隐性经验，并将资产存入六个库（规则、约束、最佳实践、反例、边界情形、技能）。通过语义对齐、个体经验蒸馏、组织级整合与交叉复核，保留原始证据、使用条件与未解决分歧；最终封装为具备明确输入、步骤、依赖与停止条件的可调用技能，连接经验采集、任务执行与评估反馈。
AI.result: 在随机选取的 20 名从业者的授权样本上，平台将 1,576 个源文件处理为 23,024 条个体经验记录与 13,113 项组织资产。评估覆盖多个专业领域：在统一任务输入与评分标准下，基座模型、原始语料 RAG 与 KUPAS MASTER 智能体分别得分 70.63、79.75 和 89.58；KUPAS MASTER 智能体在全部七个评分维度上均优于原始语料 RAG。
AI.conclusion: 该平台为个体隐性经验向组织知识和智能体能力的转化提供了可行路径。

title: When Models Don't Manipulate Manifolds: The Geometry of a Comparison Task
summary: One of the current premises of mechanistic interpretability research is that detailed accounts of the geometry of neural network representations can tell us how models perform computations, and how to effectively intervene on them. While low dimensional manifolds have been observed for multiple concepts in the literature (e.g. numbers encoded on helices, days of the week on a circle, ...), with structure believed to reflect properties of data and tasks, the extent to which models rely on them for computation, and how they manipulate them, remains unclear. We characterize precisely the geometry of computation in a number-comparison task, as an abstraction of comparison for decision making, and how models utilize geometry in an elegant fashion to implement it. Specifically, we study the causal geometry of number comparison in Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, a capable and widely studied open-weight model, and find Qwen largely uses linear representations of numbers despite the presence of curved geometry. To compare two numbers, the model first encodes each number along a vector and adds the two representations using attention and the residual connection, bringing them into a shared space in the residual stream. Then, the model uses MLP neurons to compare the pair of numbers on local regions in this shared space, which correspond to smaller intervals of input numbers, and combines these to obtain the position of the maximum. In fact, this reliance on linear representations for comparison also persists when the model compares three numbers. Our findings demonstrate that the manifold hypothesis can co-exist with linear representations: while concepts that are ordered may have manifold structure in representations, the model may use an underlying linear structure of the concept in certain computations.

AI.tldr: 本文精确刻画了Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct在数字比较任务中的"因果几何"，发现尽管表示中存在弯曲流形结构，模型实际主要依赖线性表示完成比较计算。
AI.motivation: 机制可解释性研究的一个前提是：神经网络表示的几何结构能够揭示模型如何计算以及如何被干预。已有文献观察到多个概念（如数字编码于螺旋、星期编码于圆环）存在低维流形，且其结构被认为反映了数据与任务性质。然而，模型在多大程度上依赖这些流形进行计算、又如何操纵它们，仍不清楚。作者希望以数字比较任务为抽象范本，精确刻画计算几何及其实现方式。
