AI.method: 作者研究Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct中数字比较任务的"因果几何"。具体而言，模型首先通过注意力与残差连接将两个数字的向量表示相加，将其带入残差流的共享空间；随后利用MLP神经元在该共享空间的局部区域上比较这对数字，这些局部区域对应较小的输入数字区间，再将这些局部比较结果组合以得到最大值所在位置。作者还检验了模型比较三个数字时的情形。
AI.result: 发现尽管表示中存在弯曲几何（curved geometry），Qwen主要使用数字的线性表示来完成比较；该线性表示依赖在比较三个数字时依然存在。局部区域上的比较由MLP神经元实现，并组合得到最大值位置。
AI.conclusion: 流形假设可以与线性表示共存：有序概念在表示中可能具有流形结构，但在某些计算中模型可能使用该概念的底层线性结构。这一发现表明，几何结构的存在并不意味着模型必然以流形方式进行计算与干预。

title: EngiWorld: What Can Frontier Agents Deliver in Professional Engineering Environments?
summary: Autonomous agents have made rapid progress in general-purpose computer use, but reliable automation of professional industrial engineering remains out of reach, as engineering workflows demand reasoning over geometric and physical constraints and dependencies preserved across software and design stages. We present EngiWorld, the first benchmark structured around the complete design loop: 1,301 expert-curated tasks spanning 6 engineering domains (CAD, CAE, CAM, BIM, EDA, and 3D visualization) and 26 professional software platforms, with both GUI and CLI interfaces and 6 task types ranging from software-selection to open-ended tasks. We further introduce an artifact-centric evaluation methodology built on a unified domain-verifier suite, which programmatically checks the geometric validity, physical feasibility, and rule compliance of final and intermediate artifacts, and scores quantitative design tasks continuously by specification attainment rather than binary success. Evaluation of seven frontier models reveals a substantial capability gap: the strongest model achieves an EngiScore of only 44.3, and just 3.6% of multi-software attempts succeed. EngiWorld provides the first rigorous foundation for measuring progress toward agents that operate professional engineering software end to end.

AI.tldr: EngiWorld是首个围绕完整工程设计闭环构建的基准，含1,301个专家策划任务，覆盖6个工程领域、26个专业软件、GUI与CLI双接口及6类任务；并提出以工件为中心、基于统一领域验证器套件的评估方法。评测七个前沿模型，最高EngiScore仅44.3，多软件任务成功率仅3.6%。
AI.motivation: 通用计算机智能体进展迅速，但专业工业工程自动化仍不可靠，因为工程流程需要对跨软件与设计阶段保持一致的几何与物理约束及依赖关系进行推理。现有基准缺乏针对完整设计闭环、可验证工程工件质量的严谨评测基础。
AI.method: 构建EngiWorld基准：1,301个专家策划任务，覆盖CAD、CAE、CAM、BIM、EDA、3D可视化6个领域与26个专业软件平台，支持GUI和CLI接口，包含从软件选择到开放式的6类任务；提出以工件为中心的评估方法，基于统一领域验证器套件，对最终与中间工件程序化检验几何有效性、物理可行性与规则合规性，并以规格达成度对定量设计任务连续打分而非二值判定。
AI.result: 对七个前沿模型的评测显示存在显著能力差距：最强模型EngiScore仅为44.3，多软件任务尝试成功率仅3.6%。
AI.conclusion: EngiWorld为衡量端到端操作专业工程软件的智能体进展提供了首个严谨基础。

title: Predictive Geometry of Hidden Trajectories in Transformers
summary: Decoder-only transformers are trained only through a terminal next-token prediction loss, yet this loss constrains every intermediate hidden state through the fixed downstream computation. We formalize this constraint by studying layerwise loss-to-go functions: the terminal loss obtained by continuing a candidate hidden state through the remaining transformer blocks. Around successful validation trajectories, we show that the local second-order geometry of these functions is governed, up to low-loss residual terms, by a pullback Fisher operator on hidden-state space. Its spectrum identifies output-sensitive directions and approximately prediction-null directions, yielding a local observable subspace of the residual stream. For causal transformers, the same geometry induces a tokenwise curvature score: a Fisher-weighted sensitivity of the target logits to perturbations of each token's hidden state. This score vanishes outside the causal ancestor set of the target and is controlled by downstream Jacobian couplings, making it a loss-aware alternative to attention magnitude. We estimate these quantities using matrix-free Jacobian-vector and vector-Jacobian products and evaluate them across decoder-only language models on WikiText, OpenWebText, and FineWeb. Empirically, the induced geometry predicts perturbation sensitivity, supports nonuniform layerwise rank allocation, yields competitive structured token-pruning signals, and improves low-rank student recovery when added to stronger autoregressive distillation objectives such as reverse KL and skew KL. These results support a predictive-geometric view of transformer computation: near successful trajectories, the terminal loss induces a thin, anisotropic set of output-relevant hidden-state directions that can be measured and exploited for compression and distillation.

AI.tldr: 该论文用"逐层剩余损失函数"刻画解码器-only Transformer中终末next-token损失的隐式约束，证明其局部二阶几何近似为隐状态空间上的pullback Fisher算子，并据此构造tokenwise曲率分数，用于扰动敏感性预测、非均匀层秩分配、结构化token剪枝与低秩蒸馏，在WikiText、OpenWebText、FineWeb上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 解码器-only Transformer仅通过终末next-token预测损失训练，但该损失经由固定的下游计算路径约束了每一中间隐状态，这种隐式约束缺乏显式刻画。作者希望形式化并度量该约束，从而获得可观测的、与输出相关的隐状态子空间，为压缩与蒸馏提供理论依据。
AI.method: 定义逐层loss-to-go函数：将候选隐状态经剩余Transformer块继续前向所得的终末损失。在成功验证轨迹附近分析其局部二阶几何，证明在低损失残差项意义下由隐状态空间上的pullback Fisher算子支配；该谱识别输出敏感方向与近似预测零方向，形成残差流的局部可观测子空间。对因果Transformer，同几何诱导tokenwise曲率分数（目标logits对每个token隐状态扰动的Fisher加权敏感度），该分数在目标因果祖先集之外为零，并受下游Jacobian耦合控制。使用矩阵-free的JVP/VJP估计这些量。
AI.result: 在WikiText、OpenWebText、FineWeb上对多种解码器-only语言模型评估：所诱导几何可预测扰动敏感性；支持非均匀逐层秩分配；给出有竞争力的结构化token剪枝信号；在加入reverse KL、skew KL等更强的自回归蒸馏目标时，改善低秩学生模型恢复。
AI.conclusion: 支持一种"预测-几何"视角的Transformer计算观：在成功轨迹附近，终末损失诱导出一组薄而各向异性的、与输出相关的隐状态方向，这些方向可被测量并用于压缩与蒸馏。

title: Context Language Models
summary: We introduce Context Language Models (CLMs), language models that natively manage their own context. We implement this by treating the context as a file and allowing the model to make unrestricted updates to this file. This allows the model to learn what is most important to maintain in context, and naturally extends to multi-agent systems where multiple agent contexts coexist as files. Building CLMs zero-shot with existing models outperforms SOTA context management strategies across a variety of tasks: 11.4% higher accuracy with 21.5% fewer FLOPs on BrowseComp-Plus, 5% higher scores with 59% fewer FLOPs on 12-hour EdgeBench, and 65% greater improvement with the same compute on a 24-hour multi-repository agent-swarm task. Moreover, by shifting context management from external harness control to intrinsic model behavior, CLMs naturally enable both in-context and parametric learning of context-management strategies. We show that CLMs can be steered with natural-language instructions evolved through a standard skill-optimization loop, improving held-out accuracy by up to 35.9 points on a context-management task while reducing compute. We also introduce an online reinforcement learning method for CLMs, improving Qwen3.5-9B performance on BrowseComp-Plus by 47.6% while using 12% fewer FLOPs. Finally, we co-design Suffix Cache Reuse for CLM serving, further reducing server-side compute by 35% relative to standard SGLang at matched performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出上下文语言模型（CLM），将上下文视为文件并允许模型自主无限制更新，实现内在化的上下文管理，在多任务上超越现有上下文管理策略，并支持指令与强化学习优化及高效服务。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文管理依赖外部框架（harness）控制，模型无法自主学习哪些信息值得保留；多智能体场景下上下文协调困难。作者希望将上下文管理从外部控制转为模型内在行为，从而提升效率与可学习性。
AI.method: 将上下文建模为文件，允许模型对该文件进行无限制更新，从而原生管理自身上下文；该机制天然扩展到多智能体系统中多个代理上下文以文件形式共存。基于现有模型零样本构建CLM；通过标准技能优化循环进化自然语言指令来引导模型；提出面向CLM的在线强化学习方法；并为CLM服务协同设计后缀缓存复用（Suffix Cache Reuse）。
AI.result: 零样本CLM在多任务上优于SOTA上下文管理策略：BrowseComp-Plus上准确率高11.4%且FLOPs少21.5%；12小时EdgeBench得分高5%且FLOPs少59%；24小时多仓库智能体集群任务同等算力下提升65%。技能优化循环使留出准确率最多提升35.9分并降低算力；在线强化学习使Qwen3.5-9B在BrowseComp-Plus上性能提升47.6%且FLOPs减少12%；后缀缓存复用相较标准SGLang在同等性能下再降服务器端算力35%。
AI.conclusion: 将上下文管理由外部框架控制转为模型内在行为，可同时支持上下文内学习与参数化学习上下文管理策略，并在准确率、算力效率与服务效率上取得显著收益，为多智能体与长时任务提供可扩展方案。

title: Can a Cacheable Decision Model Follow Rules?
summary:
Certo is a small non-generative decision model (Qwen3-4B): it scores candidate actions from their text and returns a probability, instead of generating an answer. The accurate design reads the state, the rules, and each candidate together (a joint scorer), so cost grows with the menu. Independent encoding lets each candidate be encoded once and reused across states (about 5x cheaper at 77 candidates), but separates state from candidate. We ask how much rule-sensitivity survives that move, and whether it can be trained back.
  Four experiments on Certo: (1) the tested conversion to cacheable scoring loses rule-sensitivity (recall@1 1.00 -> 0.24) while the joint scorer holds 1.00, and a shortlist+rerank rescue fails; (2) targeted counterfactual supervision restores strong performance on held-out synthetic rule tasks (paraphrase, counterfactual, composition; reproducible across seeds), though we do not isolate whether predictions depend on the supplied rule; (3) on real rules the added benefit is not established -- after fixing a truncation confound, the joint scorer wins significantly on the short tier (0.861 vs 0.500) and directionally on the hard tier (0.655 vs 0.483, n=29); (4) a matched cross-domain real-prose mixture did not help and reduced contract accuracy (-9.3, -16.2 points). A cacheable encoder can be made rule-sensitive on its training distribution, but transfer to unseen-source real rules is not established; the joint scorer keeps an edge at the cost of caching.

AI.tldr: Certo是一个小型非生成式决策模型（Qwen3-4B），通过文本对候选动作打分返回概率。研究考察将联合打分器转为可缓存独立编码后，规则敏感性损失及能否训练恢复。
AI.motivation: 可缓存编码器（独立编码候选，跨状态复用，77候选时约便宜5倍）能降低计算成本，但将状态与候选分离。作者研究这种转换会损失多少规则敏感性，以及能否通过训练恢复。
AI.method: 在Certo上进行四组实验：(1)对比联合打分器与可缓存评分，并用shortlist+rerank挽救；(2)用针对性反事实监督训练独立编码器；(3)在真实规则上评估，修正截断混淆；(4)测试跨域真实文本混合数据的效果。
AI.result: (1)可缓存评分规则敏感性下降（recall@1 1.00→0.24），联合打分器保持1.00，shortlist+rerank挽救失败；(2)反事实监督在合成规则任务上恢复强性能（复述、反事实、组合，跨种子可复现），但未隔离预测是否依赖所给规则；(3)真实规则上收益未确立——修正混淆后联合打分器在short tier显著占优（0.861 vs 0.500），hard tier方向性占优（0.655 vs 0.483, n=29）；(4)匹配的跨域真实文本混合无帮助，合同准确率下降（-9.3, -16.2点）。
AI.conclusion: 可缓存编码器可在训练分布上具备规则敏感性，但向未见来源的真实规则迁移尚未确立；联合打分器保持优势，代价是无法缓存。

title: Storage Is Not Strategy: State-Conditioned Support Control for LLM Unlearning
summary: Many localized large language model (LLM) unlearning methods select a small parameter subset from a localization signal and keep it fixed during optimization. The parameters most associated with a target, however, need not be the best ones to update, and candidate interventions can change value as optimization proceeds. In a controlled experiment, a storage-localization score reaches an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.981, yet storage identity agrees with the better intervention on only 17/36 targets, while low-rank adaptation (LoRA) wins 35/36. We introduce Intervention Score, which ranks editable groups by the predicted effect of the actual unlearning update while accounting for collateral damage, and use it to form the static intervention-value baseline (Static-IV). We then introduce selective dynamic intervention re-ranking (DIR-R), which revisits that subset only when a calibrated probe justifies the comparison. On the Natural-TOFU dataset, our method has positive descriptive margins in 19/20 comparisons between methods and objectives, although several are near zero. On the LACUNA localization-precision benchmark, our mean terminal utility is higher in all six negative preference optimization (NPO) and SimNPO comparisons: NPO margins range from +0.431 to +0.848, and SimNPO margins range from +0.503 to +0.571. The gradient-difference (GradDiff) objective reveals substantial field dependence. Relative to Static-IV, the primary four-field GradDiff evaluation has six wins, six ties, and no losses, with mean and median paired gains of +0.165 and +0.0025. The evidence supports separating localization, initial intervention selection, and checkpoint-dependent support revision.

AI.tldr: 该文指出定位分数高并不等于适合更新，提出以“干预分数”排序可编辑参数组，并引入选择性动态重排序（DIR-R），在TOFU、LACUNA等基准上普遍优于静态干预选择基线。
AI.motivation: 现有局部化LLM遗忘方法多依据定位信号选定一个小子集并在优化中固定不变，但“与目标最相关的参数”未必是“最该被更新的参数”，且候选干预的价值会随优化推进而变化。实验显示存储定位分数AUROC达0.981，但存储身份仅在17/36个目标上与更优干预一致，而LoRA胜出35/36，说明定位与可编辑性需区分。
AI.method: 提出Intervention Score：按实际遗忘更新带来的预测效果对可编辑参数组排序，并计入附带损伤，据此构建静态干预价值基线（Static-IV）。进一步提出选择性动态干预重排序（DIR-R）：仅在校准探针证明必要时，才对子集进行重新比较与重排。
AI.result: Natural-TOFU上，方法-目标配对的20次比较中19次具有正向描述性优势（部分接近零）。LACUNA定位精度基准上，NPO与SimNPO各三种比较的平均终末效用均更高：NPO增益+0.431至+0.848，SimNPO增益+0.503至+0.571。GradDiff目标表现出明显场依赖性；相对Static-IV的四场主评估为6胜6平0负，配对增益均值+0.165、中位数+0.0025。
AI.conclusion: 证据支持将“定位”“初始干预选择”与“依赖检查点的支持集修订”三者分离处理；静态定位子集并非最优，动态且有条件的干预重排序可稳定提升遗忘效用。

title: Learning Beyond What You Sample: Off-Policy-Aware Cross-Model Trajectory Exchange for RLVR
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) methods such as GRPO rely on successful self-generated trajectories, but finite rollout budgets can produce all-fail groups with no reward-based policy-gradient signal. While additional rollouts improve the chance of success at higher cost, successful trajectories missing from one model's rollouts may already have been discovered by another. Indeed, we observe that heterogeneous models often succeed on complementary prompts, creating opportunities for mutual learning without a designated stronger teacher. To exploit this complementarity, we propose GRAFT (Gated Replacement of Answer-Failed groups with peer Trajectories), an off-policy-aware framework that replaces all-fail groups with informative peer groups. GRAFT transfers both successful and unsuccessful peer responses with peer-computed advantages, while controlling cross-model mismatch through sequence-level compatibility weighting and token-level importance ratio clipping. Across three heterogeneous model pairs and five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, GRAFT consistently improves both models over GRPO with the same per-model rollout budget, gaining 2.1 points on average and up to 4.5 points in model-level average performance. Stored peer trajectories preserve most of the gains, improving over GRPO by 1.8 points on average without simultaneous co-training.

AI.tldr: 提出GRAFT框架，用异构同伴模型的成功轨迹替换全失败组，在相同rollout预算下提升RLVR训练效果。
AI.motivation: RLVR方法（如GRPO）依赖模型自生成的成功轨迹，但有限的rollout预算常导致全失败组，无法产生基于奖励的策略梯度信号。增加rollout可提高成功概率但成本更高；而一个模型rollout中缺失的成功轨迹可能已被另一模型发现。
AI.method: 观察到异构模型常在互补提示上成功，无需指定更强教师即可互学。提出GRAFT（Gated Replacement of Answer-Failed groups with peer Trajectories），一种off-policy感知框架，用有信息的同伴组替换全失败组。迁移成功与失败的同伴响应及同伴计算的advantage，并通过序列级兼容性加权和token级重要性比率裁剪控制跨模型失配。
AI.result: 在三对异构模型和五个数学推理基准上，相同单模型rollout预算下，GRAFT持续优于GRPO，平均提升2.1分，模型级平均性能最高提升4.5分。存储的同伴轨迹保留大部分收益，无需同步协同训练即比GRPO平均提升1.8分。
AI.conclusion: 利用异构模型间的互补性进行同伴轨迹迁移，可在不增加rollout预算、无需更强教师的前提下缓解全失败组问题，显著提升RLVR训练效果，且离线存储轨迹仍具实用价值。

title: Overcoming Scaling Limits in On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a student to match a privileged teacher distribution along its own sampled trajectory. Standard OPSD applies this supervision to unverified student rollouts while conditioning the teacher on privileged context, typically a reference solution. We separate these roles in a factorial analysis and find that scaffold correctness has a stronger effect on downstream accuracy than context correctness. Unverified scaffolds create an imitation gap because the teacher can use information unavailable to the student. This gap shrinks with model scale, yet OPSD continues to supervise mostly unverified trajectories. In contrast, verified scaffolds remain effective even when the teacher is conditioned on the student's own unsuccessful rollout. Based on this finding, we introduce OASIS, which retains the OPSD objective but supervises mostly verified by label on-policy trajectories and replaces written solutions with unverified model-generated attempts as the teacher context. OASIS therefore requires only final-answer labels. Across Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B on AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and HMMT 2025, OASIS improves over the base model by 3.2--3.8 points on average, while OPSD's gain falls from 3.05 points at 1.7B to 0.14 at 8B. At 8B, OASIS improves over OPSD by 3.05 points, showing that verified on-policy scaffolds preserve the effectiveness of self-distillation as models scale.

AI.tldr: 论文通过因子分析揭示OPSD中"脚手架正确性"比"上下文正确性"更关键，据此提出OASIS方法：仅需最终答案标签，主要监督已验证的on-policy轨迹，并用模型自生成解答替代参考解作为教师上下文，在模型规模扩大时保持自蒸馏有效性。
AI.motivation: 标准on-policy自蒸馏（OPSD）将监督施加于未验证的学生轨迹，并以特权上下文（通常是参考解）为条件来指导教师分布。这产生了一个imitation gap：教师可利用学生无法获取的信息。该差距随模型规模缩小，但OPSD仍主要监督未验证轨迹，导致其收益随规模增长而消失。论文旨在厘清"脚手架正确性"与"上下文正确性"各自的作用，并设计出在规模扩展下仍有效的自蒸馏方案。
AI.method: 论文首先进行因子分析，将脚手架正确性与上下文正确性分离，检验两者对下游正确率的影响。基于"已验证脚手架更有效"的发现，提出OASIS：保留OPSD的蒸馏目标，但主要监督由标签验证的on-policy轨迹，并用未经验证的模型自生成尝试替代书面参考解作为教师上下文。该方法仅依赖最终答案标签。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B模型上，于AIME 2024、AIME 2025和HMMT 2025基准评测：OASIS平均较基座模型提升3.2--3.8分；而OPSD的增益从1.7B时的3.05分降至8B时的0.14分。在8B规模下，OASIS较OPSD提升3.05分。
AI.conclusion: 已验证的on-policy脚手架能够在模型规模扩展时保持自蒸馏的有效性，而标准OPSD的收益随规模增大而衰减。OASIS通过仅使用最终答案标签并采用模型自生成上下文，实现了更稳健、可扩展的自蒸馏训练。

title: Time-Anchored Diffusion Language Models: Latent-Space Caching for Fast Generation
summary: Recent work on anchored diffusion language models improves denoising by shaping an intermediate latent space with supervised important-token targets. In this work, we introduce time-based (self-supervised) anchoring, which learns and reuses latent anchors without requiring such targets. Our key observation is that anchors encode persistent properties of the clean sequence, such as its semantic intent, global structure, or intermediate plan. Although their hidden representations become stale as the token canvas evolves, their semantic content remains useful across nearby diffusion times. This is implemented through a two-stage architecture consisting of a relatively expensive anchor network that generates the latent cache state and a lightweight denoising network that intelligently combines the cached latent state with the current state at each reverse step using a fusion module. This gives anchoring a latent-space caching interpretation: the anchor network is evaluated periodically, while its cached representation is reused across multiple reverse steps. We instantiate this framework as TADM:Post-train, which time-anchorizes pretrained DLMs, and TADM:Pretraining, which learns time-based anchors during pretraining. Applied to DiffusionGemma-26B, TADM:Post-train improves throughput by approximately 49% to 79% on several math, code, and STEM benchmarks (GSM8K, AIME26, GPQA-Diamond, LiveCodeBench-v6, HumanEval, MMLU-Pro). TADM:Pretraining reduces Transformer-layer computation by up to 38% relative to a standard single-stage DLM, achieves up to 73% higher measured throughput than ADLM.

AI.tldr: 提出基于时间的自监督锚定机制（TADM），通过潜在空间缓存复用锚表示，在扩散语言模型中实现约49%–79%的吞吐提升，并在预训练中减少最多38%的Transformer层计算。
AI.motivation: 现有锚定扩散语言模型依赖监督式重要token目标来塑造中间潜在空间，需要额外标注/目标信号，限制了其适用性与效率。作者希望以自监督方式学习并复用潜在锚，捕捉干净序列的持久属性（语义意图、全局结构、中间计划），从而在不依赖监督目标的前提下提升去噪质量与推理效率。
AI.method: 提出时间基（自监督）锚定与两阶段架构：一个较昂贵的锚网络生成潜在缓存状态，一个轻量去噪网络在每个反向步骤中通过融合模块将缓存潜在状态与当前状态智能结合。其本质是潜在空间缓存：锚网络周期性求值，缓存的表示在多个反向步骤间复用。实例化为两种方案——TADM:Post-train（对预训练DLM进行时间锚定化后训练）与TADM:Pretraining（在预训练阶段学习时间锚）。
AI.result: 在DiffusionGemma-26B上，TADM:Post-train在数学、代码与STEM基准（GSM8K、AIME26、GPQA-Diamond、LiveCodeBench-v6、HumanEval、MMLU-Pro）上吞吐提升约49%–79%；TADM:Pretraining相对标准单阶段DLM减少最多38%的Transformer层计算，实测吞吐较ADLM高最多73%。
AI.conclusion: 时间基自监督锚定可有效替代监督锚定目标，通过潜在空间缓存复用显著提升扩散语言模型的推理吞吐并降低计算量，同时兼容后训练与预训练两种设定。

title: SelfSearch: Reward-Free Search for Self-Improving Agents
summary: Advances in the coding capabilities of LLM agents allow them to inspect and modify their own instructions, tools, and execution procedures. Existing approaches use this ability to search for improved agents through repeated downstream evaluation, which incurs substantial costs and ties the search to the evaluated tasks. We introduce \textbf{SelfSearch}, a reward-free search procedure in which agents modify themselves using records of previous self-improvement episodes. These records capture the reasoning, tool actions, and outcomes of earlier modification attempts, providing concrete experience for improving both task solving and self-modification. Without downstream reward signals during search, SelfSearch improves population-mean success over the initial agent in all six model--benchmark settings, with individual agents gaining up to 11.2 percentage points on Terminal-Bench 2.1. On SWE-bench Multilingual, an agent improves success by \textbf{5.0} percentage points while reducing execution cost by \textbf{38.5}\% on tasks solved by both the initial and evolved agents. SelfSearch achieves competitive task success with evaluation-guided search baselines at lower search cost. With only \textbf{\$4.03} in search cost, it produces a harness that solves \textbf{82.0}\% of Terminal-Bench 2.1 tasks with DeepSeek V4 Flash under the settings of a public nine-harness comparison, matching the top-scoring harness, Codex. These results suggest that experience gained through self-modification can improve agents' downstream capabilities and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出 SelfSearch：一种无需奖励信号的自我改进搜索方法，智能体利用以往自我修改记录来改进自身（指令、工具、流程），在多个模型-基准上提升了成功率并降低了成本。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体具备检查和修改自身指令、工具与执行流程的编码能力，但现有方法依赖反复的下游评估来搜索更优智能体，成本高昂且搜索过程与被评测任务强绑定，泛化性受限。作者希望摆脱对下游奖励信号的依赖，利用自我修改的历史经验来实现更高效、更通用的自我改进。
AI.method: SelfSearch 是一种无奖励（reward-free）搜索过程：智能体基于以往自我改进回合的记录来修改自身。这些记录包含此前修改尝试的推理过程、工具动作与结果，为改进任务求解能力和自我修改能力提供具体经验。搜索期间不使用下游奖励信号。
AI.result: 在全部六个模型-基准设置中，SelfSearch 相较初始智能体提升了群体平均成功率，单个智能体在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上最多提升 11.2 个百分点；在 SWE-bench Multilingual 上，成功率提升 5.0 个百分点，同时在初始与进化后智能体均解决的任务上降低 38.5% 执行成本。与评估引导的搜索基线相比，SelfSearch 以更低搜索成本达到有竞争力的任务成功率；仅用 4.03 美元搜索成本，在公开九种 harness 对比设置下，用 DeepSeek V4 Flash 生成的 harness 解决 82.0% 的 Terminal-Bench 2.1 任务，匹配最高分的 Codex。
AI.conclusion: 通过自我修改获得经验可以同时提升智能体的下游能力与效率；无奖励、基于自我改进记录的搜索是评估引导搜索的一种低成本且有竞争力的替代方案。

title: On Trajectory-Aware Training for Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) generate text by unmasking several tokens per step, but they are trained and sampled under different conditions. The model is trained on randomly masked sequences, whereas inference follows a trajectory shaped by the model's own predictions. Additionally, each step has no access to what the previous one computed. Recent methods narrow these limitations from separate angles, leaving open how these choices interact. We introduce PUMBA, a unified framework for trajectory-aware training that trains the denoiser on consecutive steps of policy-induced trajectories, passes information between steps, and optimizes them jointly by backpropagation through time. A controlled study of this design space shows that i) exact train--inference alignment fails due to local overfitting, whereas a looser alignment still brings training masks closer to those seen at inference; ii) passing continuous information outperforms discrete gradient estimators through the commitment at each step; and iii) performance improves as backpropagation through time spans more steps, which we support theoretically. Combined, these components match the best checkpoint of a same-size autoregressive model. Building on these findings, we scale PUMBA to supervised fine-tuning of LLaDA-8B, where it improves the trade-off between performance and number of function evaluations (NFEs) in both full-canvas and block diffusion generation. At matched performance, it needs up to 22% fewer NFEs than standard fine-tuning with twice the budget in full-canvas generation, and up to 26% fewer than standard fine-tuning for the same number of steps in block diffusion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PUMBA，一个面向掩码扩散模型（MDM）轨迹感知训练的统一框架，通过在同一策略诱发轨迹的连续步骤上训练去噪器、在步骤间传递信息并利用时间反向传播联合优化，缓解训练与推理条件不一致的问题。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散模型在训练时使用随机掩码序列，而推理时则沿模型自身预测形成的轨迹进行；并且每一步都无法访问前一步的计算结果。已有方法仅从各自角度部分地缩小这一差距，但这些设计选择之间如何相互作用仍不清楚，因此需要统一研究该设计空间。
AI.method: PUMBA 在策略诱发轨迹的连续步骤上训练去噪器，在步骤之间传递信息，并通过时间反向传播（BPTT）对各步联合优化。作者对设计空间进行受控研究，比较不同对齐程度、信息传递方式（连续信息 vs. 离散梯度估计器）以及 BPTT 跨步数的影响，并给出理论支持。随后将 PUMBA 扩展到 LLaDA-8B 的监督微调。
AI.result: 受控研究表明：i) 精确的训练-推理对齐会因局部过拟合而失败，较宽松的对齐仍能使训练掩码更接近推理时的掩码；ii) 通过每步 commitment 传递连续信息优于离散梯度估计器；iii) BPTT 跨步数越多性能越好，并有理论支撑。组合这些组件后可匹配同规模自回归模型的最佳检查点。在 LLaDA-8B 微调上，PUMBA 在 full-canvas 与 block diffusion 生成中均改善性能与 NFE 的权衡：相同性能下，full-canvas 生成比预算翻倍的标准微调少用最多 22% NFE，block diffusion 在相同步数下比标准微调少用最多 26% NFE。
AI.conclusion: PUMBA 通过统一轨迹感知训练显著缩小了掩码扩散模型训练与推理之间的差距，验证了对齐程度、连续信息传递与 BPTT 跨步数三个关键设计选择的有效性，并在大规模模型微调中实现了更优的性能-NFE 权衡。

title: Dr. OPD: Learning What to Follow for Optimal On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own generated responses using dense, token-level supervision from a stronger teacher. Vanilla OPD treats all teacher signals equally, assuming that the teacher's supervision is equally important for every token. However, teacher signals at different tokens may have very different effects on the student's performance: some correct important reasoning errors, while others have little effect on the final answer. Motivated by this observation, we introduce Dr. OPD (OPD Done Right), which defines the optimal weighted OPD to maximize the student's performance. We formulate Dr. OPD as a bilevel optimization problem in which the student learns from weighted teacher supervision, while the weights are selected to maximize the expected reward of the resulting student. To solve Dr. OPD, we develop an efficient iterative solver that updates the token weights and student policy alternatively. At each round, it updates weights in closed form and then takes one gradient step on the resulting weighted OPD objective. Under regularity conditions, we show that this weighted update achieves a higher expected reward than a vanilla OPD update. Empirically, across strong-to-weak and same-size distillation on math and code, Dr. OPD consistently outperforms all evaluated baselines. In particular, in the strong-to-weak distillation setting, Dr. OPD improves average math performance by $9.7$ points over vanilla OPD, and enables the smaller student to surpass its larger teacher.

AI.tldr: 提出 Dr. OPD，将 on-policy distillation 中的 token 级教师监督加权问题形式化为双层优化，用迭代求解器交替更新权重与学生策略，理论证明其优于 vanilla OPD，并在数学与代码任务上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: Vanilla OPD 对所有 token 的教师信号一视同仁，但不同 token 的监督对学生性能影响差异很大：部分信号能纠正关键的推理错误，另一些则对最终答案影响甚微。因此需要按重要性对教师监督进行加权。
AI.method: 定义最优加权 OPD 以最大化学生性能，并形式化为双层优化：内层学生按加权教师监督学习，外层选择权重以最大化学生期望奖励。提出高效迭代求解器，交替更新 token 权重与学生策略——每轮以闭式解更新权重，再在加权 OPD 目标上做一步梯度更新。
AI.result: 在正则条件下证明该加权更新比 vanilla OPD 更新获得更高的期望奖励。实验覆盖数学与代码上的强到弱及同规模蒸馏，Dr. OPD 一致优于所有对比基线；强到弱设置下数学平均性能比 vanilla OPD 提升 9.7 分，并使较小的学生模型超过其较大的教师模型。
AI.conclusion: 教师信号的 token 级差异化加权是提升 OPD 效果的关键；Dr. OPD 通过双层优化与闭式权重更新实现了这一目标，兼具理论保证与实证优势。

title: AdviSD: Learning to Advise Frontier LLMs via Targeted Multi-Turn Self-Distillation
summary: A small trainable advisor can steer a frozen language-model executor using natural-language advice. In addition to learning from task rewards, the advisor can use feedback from completed interactions to improve its advice. However, a plausible correction need not change execution, yet learning from such corrections can still affect the advisor's future decisions in other contexts. In a shared-parameter model, we prove that such corrections can limit learning if their targets favor useful advice less strongly than those of other corrections. Keeping them less often than the rest improves the model's eventual performance compared to learning from every correction. Motivated by this, our method, Advisor Self-Distillation (AdviSD), pairs outcome-based reinforcement learning with self-distillation from a feedback-conditioned copy of the advisor selectively. Reflection proposes corrections, and the advisor scores the same recorded executor response with and without its issued advice, using the magnitude of the difference to select decisions for supervision. This approach does not require executor likelihoods or additional executor rollouts. Experiments with Qwen3-8B advisors for Gemini and Claude show that AdviSD outperforms advisor-GRPO by 4.2-6.4 percentage points on BFCL-v3 and by 3.9-5.1 score points on EnvScaler. The trained advisors generalize to out-of-domain tasks and transfer across different executor versions and model families. AdviSD also beats matched-count random selection, supporting the value of its selection rule.

AI.tldr: AdviSD通过"选择性自蒸馏"——只对反馈中能显著改变执行器行为的建议进行监督，避免了无效纠正对共享参数顾问学习的负面影响，在多个基准上超越 advisor-GRPO。
AI.motivation: 小型可训练顾问用自然语言建议引导冻结的语言模型执行器。顾问既可从任务奖励学习，也可利用已完成交互的反馈改进建议。但问题在于：看似合理的纠正未必真正改变执行结果，若从这类纠正中学习，仍会在共享参数模型中影响顾问在其他情境下的未来决策。论文由此提出：这类纠正可能损害学习。
AI.method: 理论部分：在共享参数模型中证明，若某些纠正的目标对"有用建议"的偏好弱于其他纠正，则学习这些纠正会限制学习；少用它们反而能提升模型最终表现。方法 AdviSD：将基于结果的强化学习与自蒸馏结合。反思模块提出纠正，顾问对同一记录的执行器响应在"有建议"与"无建议"两种条件下打分，用得分差幅度来筛选需要监督的决策。该方法不需要执行器似然或额外执行器 rollout。
AI.result: 以 Qwen3-8B 作为顾问、面向 Gemini 和 Claude 执行器的实验中，AdviSD 在 BFCL-v3 上比 advisor-GRPO 高 4.2–6.4 个百分点，在 EnvScaler 上高 3.9–5.1 分。训练后的顾问可泛化到域外任务，并能跨执行器版本和模型族迁移。AdviSD 也优于数量匹配的随机选择，验证了其选择规则的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 反馈纠正并非都有学习价值；通过"是否真正改变执行"来筛选监督信号，AdviSD 在共享参数顾问上实现了更强的强化学习效果，并具备良好的泛化与迁移能力。

title: Learning Meta-Skills for Agent Harness Design in Test-Time AI4AI
summary: Agent performance depends on both reasoning ability and the environment in which it acts. We study test-time AI-for-AI, asking how a Builder can learn to construct better execution environments for a Target while both models' weights remain fixed. To make the Builder's experience reusable, we introduce Meta-Skill: principles specifying when support is needed and what resources to provide. The Builder learns these principles from Target's execution feedback on the development set, then uses the frozen skill bank to construct harnesses for unseen tasks. Across Harness-Bench and NewtonBench, full-bank meta-skills improve macro-average performance by 8.95 percentage points over no-skill construction, and 12.02 points over direct delivery of the same bank to the Target. These results highlight the value of translating experience into executable support. Gains when the same model serves both roles further suggest a path to system level self-improvement through learning to build better environments.

AI.tldr: 提出Meta-Skill方法：Builder从Target执行反馈中学习"何时提供支持、提供何种资源"的原则，构建冻结技能库，在测试时为未见任务构造执行环境。在Harness-Bench与NewtonBench上，完整技能库较无技能构建提升8.95个百分点，较直接交付技能库提升12.02个百分点。
AI.motivation: Agent性能同时取决于推理能力与所处环境。既有工作多聚焦模型能力提升，而如何在模型权重冻结的前提下改善执行环境尚缺乏系统研究。作者希望让Builder的经验可复用，实现测试时"AI为AI"的环境构建，并探索系统级自我改进的路径。
AI.method: 提出Meta-Skill——规定何时需要支持以及提供何种资源的原则。Builder在开发集上依据Target的执行反馈学习这些原则，形成冻结的技能库；测试阶段利用该技能库为未见任务构造harness（执行环境），Builder与Target权重均保持固定。
AI.result: 在Harness-Bench与NewtonBench上，完整技能库的Meta-Skill相比无技能构建，宏平均性能提升8.95个百分点；相比将同一技能库直接交付给Target，提升12.02个百分点。当同一模型同时担任Builder与Target时，仍能获得增益。
AI.conclusion: 将经验转化为可执行的支持具有实际价值，优于直接传递知识。同模型兼任双角色时的增益表明，通过"学习构建更好环境"有望实现系统级自我改进。

title: Calibration-First Cross-Cohort Multimodal Temporal Learning for Transferable Asthma-Risk Forecasting
summary: Asthma deterioration forecasting must remain reli- able when patient populations, sensor ecosystems, and available modalities change across cohorts. Existing models commonly optimize within-cohort discrimination and may produce poorly calibrated probabilities after transfer. We present CALIBRA, a calibration-first multimodal temporal framework for short- horizon risk prediction with incomplete data. Dedicated recurrent encoders process environmental, pulmonary, symptom, medication, wearable, and context streams; a reliability-conditioned gate suppresses stale or absent modalities, while gradient-reversal training discourages avoidable cohort signatures. A shrinkage- based hierarchical logistic layer calibrates probabilities using a patient-disjoint target subset, and split conformal prediction provides abstention-capable prediction sets. To avoid fabricating clinical evidence, we evaluate the complete implementation on a documented three-cohort semi-synthetic benchmark with controlled distribution shift, informative missingness, and sealed target patients. Across five configured seeds, CALIBRA achieved mean target-test AUPRC 0.224 versus 0.240 for the strongest non-ablation comparator, TemporalTransformer; mean AUROC was 0.717, and Brier score was 0.098. Experiments additionally assess complete-modality failures, calibration, conformal coverage, decision curves, subgroup behavior, ablations, runtime, and parameter count. The results verify the method and reproducible pipeline under controlled shift, but do not establish clinical effectiveness. External validation on harmonized real asthma. Overall this artifact provides evidence for carefully governed real-cohort validation.

AI.tldr: CALIBRA：面向跨队列迁移与不完整数据的“校准优先”多模态时序哮喘恶化短期风险预测框架。
AI.motivation: 现有模型多在单队列内优化判别性能，跨队列迁移后概率校准差，且难以应对人群、传感生态与模态可用性变化；同时需避免虚构临床证据。
AI.method: 多流专用循环编码器处理环境、肺功能、症状、用药、可穿戴与情境数据；可靠性条件门控抑制陈旧/缺失模态；梯度反转训练削弱可避免的队列特征；收缩式分层逻辑层用患者不重叠目标子集进行概率校准；分裂保形预测给出可弃权的预测集。
AI.result: 在具受控分布偏移、信息性缺失与封存目标患者的公开三队列半合成基准上，5个随机种子下平均目标测试 AUPRC 0.224（最强非消融对照 TemporalTransformer 为 0.240），平均 AUROC 0.717，Brier 0.098；并评估全模态失效、校准、保形覆盖、决策曲线、亚组表现、消融、运行时与参数量。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了方法及可复现流程在受控偏移下的有效性，但未确立临床有效性；需在统一化真实哮喘数据上开展外部验证，该工作为审慎治理的真实队列验证提供证据。

title: Binarization Flattens the Score Space
summary: Large language model (LLM) judges are often used as rewards to train policies on objectives that deterministic verifiers cannot capture. However, these rewards are often collapsed to pass/fail ({0, 1}), which reports the verdict but not how well a response met each criterion. We model each pass/fail verdict as a score on an unreported scale, compared with one cutoff. A stretch of that scale moves every score proportionally toward or away from the cutoff, but never across it, so no verdict changes. A policy is therefore free to apply any stretch without changing anything the panel reports. Under a joint-Gaussian model, a third grade adds a second threshold and removes this affine stretch ambiguity. On MATH and SciBench outputs from one seven-criterion judge, all 14 constructed criterionwise stretches were invisible after binarization but visible with three grades. At $n=1{,}024$, a test given both population laws had at least 96.5% power at a $1.5\times$ stress. Retaining grades closes one blind spot created by binarization, but verdicts alone remain insufficient as some changes are still indistinguishable from genuine improvement. These include arbitrary within-grade changes and fixed-covariance, loading-aligned mean shifts -- the signature of a sycophancy-shaped lift the panel reads as competence. The shared-factor reference approximation fit MATH and SciBench but not HealthBench, delineating its empirical scope. We recommend keeping at least three grades (for example, asking the judge whether each criterion is fully, partially, or not met and rewarding {0, 0.5, 1}), and externally validating gains along the remaining direction, which no finer scale removes.

AI.tldr: 将LLM评审的通过/不通过二元判定建模为未报告连续尺度上相对单一阈值的比较，指出二值化会引入仿射拉伸盲点；保留三级评分（0/0.5/1）可消除该盲点，但仍有无法区分的伪提升方向需外部验证。
AI.motivation: LLM评审常用作奖励信号，但其被压缩为0/1通过/不通过，只报告结论而不报告各准则的达成程度，导致奖励信号损失信息、可能掩盖真实质量差异。
AI.method: 把每个通过/不通过判定视为未报告尺度上的分数与单一截断值比较；在同为高斯模型下引入第三档（第二阈值），构造逐准则的仿射拉伸以检验二值化可见性，并在MATH与SciBench输出上比较二值化与三档评分，进行功效分析（n=1,024）与均值漂移、因子参考近似拟合度检验。
AI.result: 在单一七准则评审的MATH与SciBench输出上，14个构造的逐准则拉伸在二值化后全部不可见，而三档评分下全部可见；n=1,024、1.5倍压力下检验至少有96.5%功效。但仍存在无法区分的伪提升，包括档内任意变化及固定协方差、载荷对齐的均值漂移（谄媚型提升）。共享因子参考近似在MATH与SciBench上拟合良好，在HealthBench上不成立。
AI.conclusion: 建议保留至少三档评分（如完全/部分/未达成，奖励0/0.5/1），并对剩余不可去除的提升方向进行外部验证；保留档位可消除二值化盲点，但仅靠判定仍不足。

title: Learned Compression of SAR Phase-History Data: A Rate-Honest Feasibility Study on GOTCHA
summary: On-board compression of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) phase history is bandwidth-critical, and block-adaptive quantization (BAQ) remains the operational standard. We test whether a small convolutional autoencoder, with its encoder on the sensor, can compete with BAQ on complex phase-history patches from the AFRL GOTCHA collection. Every method is charged for all transmitted bits, rates are reported in bits per complex sample (b/cs), and detection is scored by one-to-one matching of CA-CFAR detections. The autoencoder (28,656 encoder parameters) loses at every rate. At 16 b/cs it reaches -2.87 dB NMSE, against -35.5 dB for 8-bit BAQ with $\pm 3σ$ clipping and -41.0 dB with a tuned clipping range. It also loses to a $16 \times 16$ block Karhunen-Loève transform (KLT), a local linear coder with a tenth of its encoder cost (-5.39 dB). Running the network in a companded Fourier domain helps, but its detection F1 remains bounded at 33%. The evidence points to this model, its normalization, and its objective, not to a fundamental limit of learned coding. Per patch, the data have modest lag-1 coherence ($|ρ| \approx 0.3$) and patch-specific spectral concentration. Two findings concern evaluation itself. First, 97% of CFAR crossings on raw $64 \times 64$ patches are border artifacts of the zero-padded detector. Second, on interior cells BAQ's clipping range decides detection: 8-bit BAQ keeps 69% F1 with tuned clipping but 17% at $\pm 3σ$, and at 8 b/cs or less adaptive FFT thresholding preserves more detections than BAQ. We close with an evaluation protocol for learned radar compression.

AI.tldr: 小型卷积自编码器在SAR相位历史星上压缩任务中全面落后于BAQ、KLT及自适应FFT阈值方法，并揭示了两项关键评测缺陷。
AI.motivation: 星上SAR相位历史压缩对带宽极为敏感，BAQ是现行运行标准。作者旨在检验仅将编码器置于传感器端的小型卷积自编码器能否在复杂相位历史块上与该标准竞争，并厘清失败究竟源于模型本身还是学习式编码的根本极限。
AI.method: 在AFRL GOTCHA数据集的复相位历史块上进行统一比特记账（b/cs），所有方法均计入全部传输比特，检测性能按CA-CFAR检测的一对一匹配评分。对比对象包括：28,656参数的卷积自编码器、8-bit BAQ（±3σ与调优裁剪）、16×16块KLT，以及自适应FFT阈值法；并测试了在压扩傅里叶域中运行网络的变体。
AI.result: 自编码器在所有码率下均落败：16 b/cs时NMSE为-2.87 dB，而8-bit BAQ（±3σ裁剪）为-35.5 dB，调优裁剪范围下达-41.0 dB；也劣于仅其十分之一编码器开销的KLT（-5.39 dB）。压扩傅里叶域可改善性能，但检测F1上限仍为33%。数据方面，逐块lag-1相干性较弱（|ρ|≈0.3）且频谱集中度因块而异。评测方面有两项发现：原始64×64块上97%的CFAR过点是零填充检测器的边界伪影；在内部单元上，BAQ的裁剪范围决定检测效果（8-bit BAQ调优裁剪F1为69%，±3σ仅17%），且在≤8 b/cs时自适应FFT阈值保留的检测数多于BAQ。
AI.conclusion: 该自编码器的失败归因于模型结构、归一化方式与优化目标，而非学习式编码的根本极限。作者据此提出面向学习式雷达压缩的评测协议。

title: A Mesoscopic View of Transformer Weights Through Row and Column Scale Fields
comment: 37 pages, 14 figures, 5 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/tiexinding/NPM-Weibull-public (directory scale_field, tag p5-scale-field-v1)
summary: Pooled statistics of Transformer weights obscure how magnitude is distributed across functional channels, while individual weights are too numerous to compare directly. We study the mesoscopic level between them: row and column scale fields, the median-centred log-RMS profiles of a weight matrix over its channels, which together with a global scale and a full balanced core represent the matrix exactly. Across public Pythia checkpoints at four sizes and controlled runs from three initialization families, balancing reveals similar measured core magnitude profiles. A mixture bridge, with its form fixed before the analysis and its coefficients fitted, predicts the pooled-shape departure from field width on held-out runs and data arms of the controlled grid. The indexed fields retain further structure: they align across projections that share a functional channel, and query/key profiles follow reassigned RoPE frequencies rather than fixed matrix coordinates. Training trajectories show early field formation followed by component-dependent broadening or recession. Extending the channel-based analysis to AdamW's second moment reveals related functional organization in its log-space row and column factors. Finally, edits of a frozen checkpoint separate reciprocal scale balance, which preserves the forward computation, from relative channel gain: flattening the gain increases in-distribution loss while preserving matrix norms and the balanced core. Row and column scale fields thus connect pooled magnitude statistics to channel organization and provide coordinates for tracking and testing trained weight structure.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“中观层次”的行/列尺度场（median-centred log-RMS profile），配合全局尺度与均衡核心可精确分解权重矩阵；在多组Pythia与受控实验中发现更均衡的核心幅值剖面、可预测的形状偏离、跨投影共享通道对齐、随RoPE重分配的q/k剖面向量，以及AdamW二阶矩的功能组织，并通过冻结检查点编辑证明相对通道增益与互逆尺度平衡的可分离性。
AI.motivation: 池化统计掩盖了Transformer权重幅值在功能通道间的分布，而逐权重比较又过于海量，缺少介于两者之间的可分析结构层次；作者希望找到能把池化幅值统计与通道组织联系起来的中间坐标。
AI.method: 定义行/列尺度场：对权重矩阵按通道计算log-RMS，做中位数中心化后得到剖面，与全局尺度和全均衡核心一起构成矩阵的精确表示（平衡分解）。在四个规模的公开Pythia检查点及三个初始化系列的受控运行上进行测量；用一个在分析前固定形式、仅拟合系数的混合桥模型，预测池化形状对场宽的偏离并做留出验证；考察索引场跨共享功能通道投影的对齐、q/k剖面相对RoPE频率的再分配；追踪训练轨迹；将通道分析扩展到AdamW二阶矩的log空间行/列因子；最后通过对冻结检查点的编辑分离互逆尺度平衡与相对通道增益。
AI.result: 均衡后核心幅值剖面在Pythia与受控运行间相似；混合桥能在留出运行与数据臂上预测池化形状偏离；索引场在共享功能通道的投影间对齐，q/k剖面跟随重分配的RoPE频率而非固定矩阵坐标；训练中先形成尺度场，随后出现成分相关的展宽或收敛；AdamW二阶矩呈现相关的功能组织；编辑实验表明压平相对通道增益会在保持矩阵范数与均衡核心的同时提高分布内损失，而互逆尺度平衡保持前向计算不变。
AI.conclusion: 行/列尺度场是连接池化幅值统计与通道功能组织的有效中观坐标，可用于追踪与检验训练得到的权重结构，并区分保持前向等价的尺度平衡与影响性能的通道增益。

title: Position: Let's Strengthen Verifiability If We Can't Enforce Reproducibility
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Position Paper Track
summary: In the field of Machine Learning, many papers contain empirical results supporting claimed statements or illustrating the performance of a proposed method. However, most practitioners know that (1) results are generally hard to reproduce, and increasingly so, (2) code is not often available to do so, and (3) it hinders the development of research. In this position paper, we analyze and quantify these issues, and make concrete proposals to improve result checkability, if not reproducibility. Code and supporting materials are available at https://github.com/giddyyupp/position-enforce-verifiability.

AI.tldr: 本文立场论文指出机器学习领域普遍存在结果难以复现、代码难以获取的问题，并量化分析了这一现状，提出具体建议以提升结果的"可检验性"乃至"可复现性"。
AI.motivation: 机器学习论文多以实证结果支撑其主张或展示方法性能，但实践者普遍面临三大困境：结果难以复现且难度日益增加、代码常常不可获取、这阻碍了研究的发展。作者因此撰文分析并量化这些问题。
AI.method: 作为立场论文（position paper），作者对上述复现性与代码可得性问题进行分析与量化，并基于分析提出具体建议，旨在改进结果的"可检验性"（result checkability）。配套代码与材料已公开于 GitHub 仓库。
AI.result: 论文对复现困难、代码缺失及其对研究发展的阻碍进行了分析与量化（具体数据见原文），并给出配套的代码与支撑材料（见 GitHub 链接）。
AI.conclusion: 作者呼吁改进机器学习研究中的结果检验机制，即便无法完全实现复现，也应提升可检验性；并提出了可供社区采纳的具体方案。

title: Mara Chain: Rethinking Failure as a Stepping Stone for AI System Auto-Evolution
summary: Optimizing deployed AI systems increasingly amounts to editing prompts, skills, harnesses, and code rather than model weights. Existing approaches commonly optimize these artifacts through propose-evaluate-select procedures, where candidate configurations are evaluated and only those meeting an acceptance criterion are selected. Yet our analysis shows that discarded candidates often contain information critical for subsequent optimization. Discarding them causes later proposals to revisit the same failure modes. We introduce Mara Chain, a refinement procedure that turns rejected candidates into stepping stones. Rather than discarding a rejected candidate, Mara Chain retains and iteratively refines it using evidence accumulated across preceding attempts. The procedure limits each refinement chain to a fixed depth and applies Pareto-filtered Top-N selection to bound the candidate pool. Across AppWorld skill optimization, TerminalBench 2.1 harness optimization, and MuSiQue retrieval-pipeline optimization, Mara Chain delivers greater task-performance gains with fewer rollouts. It outperforms GEPA, ACE, and SkillOpt-Lite by up to 20.5% in relative performance on AppWorld, reaching the target score with 65.5% fewer rollouts than GEPA. It improves the pass rate by 20.2 and 22.5 percentage points over AHE and Meta-Harness on TerminalBench 2.1, respectively, and improves MuSiQue test nDCG@10 and Recall@10 by 0.104 and 0.131 over a hand-written retrieval pipeline.

AI.tldr: Mara Chain：将被拒绝的候选配置保留并迭代精炼，把“失败经验”转化为后续优化的垫脚石，在 AppWorld、TerminalBench 2.1、MuSiQue 上以更少 rollout 取得更大增益。
AI.motivation: 部署态 AI 系统的优化对象已从模型权重转向 prompt、skill、harness 与代码等工件。现有 propose-evaluate-select 流程只保留满足接受准则的候选，丢弃被拒候选，导致后续 proposal 重复落入相同失败模式，浪费了其中对后续优化至关重要的信息。
AI.method: 提出 Mara Chain 精炼流程：不丢弃被拒候选，而是保留并利用前序尝试积累的证据对其进行迭代精炼；每条精炼链限制固定深度，并用 Pareto 过滤的 Top-N 选择约束候选池规模。
AI.result: 在 AppWorld skill 优化、TerminalBench 2.1 harness 优化、MuSiQue 检索管线优化三项任务上均以更少 rollout 获得更大性能提升。AppWorld 上相对性能最高超 GEPA、ACE、SkillOpt-Lite 20.5%，达到目标分数所需 rollout 比 GEPA 少 65.5%；TerminalBench 2.1 上通过率比 AHE、Meta-Harness 分别高 20.2 与 22.5 个百分点；MuSiQue 上测试 nDCG@10 与 Recall@10 比手写检索管线分别高 0.104 与 0.131。
AI.conclusion: 被拒绝的候选本身携带可复用的失败与改进信号，将其纳入迭代精炼链而非丢弃，可显著提升优化效率与效果，为 prompt/skill/harness/代码级优化提供了一种更充分利用搜索历史的通用流程。

title: Beyond Keywords: Leveraging Generative LLMs and Label Aggregation to Classify Economic Policy Uncertainty in News Articles
summary: This research describes the adaptation of Large Language Models (LLMs) for economic monitoring in the public sector to automatically determine whether an article discusses Economic Policy Uncertanity (EPU) and to identify its specific type. Previous studies either rely on keywords, which often result in a high count of false positives, or use machine learning approaches that require a large number of quality human labeled data that is costly and time consuming to acquire. In this study, we propose approaches based on weak supervision techniques, using generative LLMs to create synthetic labels through prompting, making the approach both cost-effective and scalable. Additionally, we propose methods for for multi-label and hierarchical classification of articles related to EPU.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出基于弱监督与生成式LLM的合成标注方法，实现公共部门经济政策不确定性（EPU）文章的二分类判别、具体类型识别及多标签/层级分类，兼顾成本与可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 既有EPU监测方法存在明显缺陷：关键词法假阳性率高；监督式机器学习依赖大量高质量人工标注数据，成本高、耗时长。因此需要一种低成本、可扩展的替代方案。
AI.method: 采用弱监督技术，利用生成式大语言模型通过提示（prompting）生成合成标签，替代人工标注；并进一步提出面向EPU相关文章的多标签分类与层级分类方法。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体实验数据或性能指标，仅报告了方法的可行性与设计（合成标签生成、多标签与层级分类框架）。
AI.conclusion: 生成式LLM驱动的弱监督合成标注可在公共部门EPU监测中实现成本有效且可扩展的自动分类，并支持细粒度的多标签与层级识别，具备替代关键词法与高成本监督学习的潜力。

title: ReLOBGen: Replayable Limit Order Book Message Generation
summary: We propose ReLOBGen, a method for generating limit order book (LOB) messages that are replayable by construction. Replayability is required for closed-loop market simulation, yet existing LOB message generators may produce non-replayable raw messages, i.e., messages inconsistent with the current market state. These generators therefore rely on post-hoc correction or rejection followed by resampling, which may alter the replayed message distribution or increase inference cost. ReLOBGen instead ensures replayability during generation: it selects the referenced order from the resting orders in the current LOB and then generates the remaining message fields to be consistent with that order and the market state. For realistic reference selection, ReLOBGen samples from a learned distribution over eligible resting orders, efficiently computed from cached order representations and a context-dependent query. It then enforces the consistency of the remaining fields by masking out invalid tokens. Together, these components enable efficient generation of realistic messages without post-hoc correction or resampling. In 500-message rollouts, ReLOBGen achieves 100% replayability, improves market realism, particularly for top-of-book statistics and the relative prices of LOB messages, and provides a $2.7\text{-}3.6\times$ speedup per replayed message over the LOBS5 baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出 ReLOBGen，一种"构造即可回放"的限价订单簿（LOB）消息生成方法，在生成过程中保证可回放性，并在真实性与效率上优于基线。
AI.motivation: 闭环市场模拟要求生成的 LOB 消息可被回放，但现有生成器可能产出与当前市场状态不一致的原始消息（不可回放）。这些方法需依赖事后修正或拒绝重采样，可能改变回放后的消息分布或增加推理成本。
AI.method: ReLOBGen 在生成阶段即保证可回放性：先从当前 LOB 的挂单中选出被引用的订单，再生成与所选订单及市场状态一致的其余字段。参考订单选择通过从学得的挂单分布中采样实现，该分布基于缓存的订单表示与上下文相关查询高效计算；其余字段则通过屏蔽非法 token 来强制一致性。
AI.result: 在 500 条消息的 rollout 中，ReLOBGen 实现 100% 可回放性，提升市场真实性，尤其体现在盘口顶部统计与 LOB 消息相对价格上，并且相比 LOBS5 基线，每条回放消息的处理速度提升 2.7–3.6 倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过将可回放性内嵌到生成过程（参考订单选择 + 无效 token 屏蔽），ReLOBGen 无需事后修正或重采样，即可高效生成既真实又可回放的 LOB 消息。

title: Hybrid Ensemble Learning for EEG-Based Epileptic Seizure Forecasting
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE Cyber Awareness Research Symposium (CARS 2026)
summary: Epileptic seizure forecasting aims to provide actionable warnings before seizure onset, yet patient-independent generalization and false-alarm control remain major challenges. We propose a calibrated hybrid ensemble for EEG-based seizure forecasting that combines five deep learning models and three classical machine learning models through a logistic regression stacking meta-learner. The proposed pipeline integrates signal preprocessing, handcrafted feature extraction, class-imbalance handling, probability calibration, and clinically motivated post-processing. We evaluate the framework on CHB-MIT using strict Leave-One-Patient-Out (LOPO) cross-validation, with threshold and post-processing parameters selected only on held-out meta data. On the filtered cohort, excluding patients with anomalous preictal rates below 1\% or above 15\%, the model achieves 74.2\% seizure-level sensitivity at 1.24 false alarms per hour, with an average warning time of 16.9 minutes. A test-tuned oracle constrained to the target false-alarm budget achieves 60.9\% sensitivity at 0.951 false alarms per hour, highlighting the importance of reporting sensitivity together with realized false-alarm rates. Our code is available at: https://github.com/DanaMason/IEEE-CARS-Hybrid-Ensemble-Learning-for-EEG-Based-Epileptic-Seizure-Forecasting

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种校准的混合集成模型用于EEG癫痫发作预测，通过逻辑回归堆叠融合5个深度模型与3个经典机器学习模型，在CHB-MIT上采用严格LOPO交叉验证，达到74.2%灵敏度与1.24次/小时误报。
AI.motivation: 癫痫发作预测需要提前给出可操作的预警，但患者独立泛化能力与误报控制仍是主要挑战，现有方法在这两方面难以兼顾。
AI.method: 构建校准的混合集成框架：结合5个深度学习模型和3个经典机器学习模型，通过逻辑回归堆叠（stacking）元学习器融合；流程整合信号预处理、手工特征提取、类别不平衡处理、概率校准与临床启发的后处理。在CHB-MIT上采用严格留一患者（LOPO）交叉验证，阈值与后处理参数仅在留出的元数据上选择。
AI.result: 在过滤队列（排除前驱期比例低于1%或高于15%的异常患者）上，达到74.2%的发作级灵敏度，每小时1.24次误报，平均预警时间16.9分钟。受限于目标误报预算的测试调优oracle在0.951次/小时误报下达到60.9%灵敏度，表明需同时报告灵敏度与实现误报率。
AI.conclusion: 该校准混合集成在患者独立设定下实现了较好的灵敏度与误报率权衡，并强调评估癫痫预测时应将灵敏度与真实误报率联合报告；代码已开源。

title: From Static Policies to Adaptive Priors in Offline Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS Position Paper Track, 2026
summary: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) has traditionally focused on learning policies for direct deployment under conservative objectives, where uncertainty outside the offline dataset is treated pessimistically to ensure robustness. We argue that this formulation becomes incomplete when an offline-trained policy is subsequently updated through online interaction, as increasingly occurs in modern intelligent systems through test-time adaptation and online fine-tuning. This position paper argues that, in such settings, the objective of offline RL should extend beyond immediate deployment and instead prioritize learning adaptive policy priors: policies that preserve the capacity to improve during subsequent interaction through memory, exploration, and self-correction. We formalize this perspective as adaptive offline reinforcement learning (AORL), distinguish it from offline-to-online RL, and explain why adaptability becomes important under distributional shift, limited dataset coverage, and changing test-time conditions. We further discuss Bayesian offline RL as one principled direction for constructing adaptive policy priors by preserving epistemic uncertainty over plausible environments. Finally, we outline connections, open challenges, and research directions for treating offline RL as preparation for future experience rather than as a static deployment problem.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文,主张离线强化学习(RL)不应仅以直接部署为目标,而应转向学习"自适应策略先验",使策略具备后续在线交互中持续改进的能力,并提出自适应离线强化学习(AORL)这一新视角。
AI.motivation: 传统离线RL以保守目标学习可直接部署的策略,对数据集外的不确定性持悲观态度以保证鲁棒性。但现代智能系统中,离线训练的策略常通过测试时自适应和在线微调被进一步更新,这使得"仅保证部署稳健"的公式化目标变得不完整,忽略了策略后续改进的能力。
AI.method: 本文为立场论文,通过概念论证与形式化开展工作:提出并形式化AORL框架;将其与offline-to-online RL进行区分;针对分布偏移、数据集覆盖有限和测试时环境变化等情形论证适应性的重要性;并讨论以贝叶斯离线RL作为构建自适应策略先验的原则性方向,通过保留对可能环境的情节不确定性来支撑适应性。
AI.result: 论文并未给出实验性结果,而是提出并论证了AORL这一新视角,阐明其与offline-to-online RL的差异,指出贝叶斯离线RL是构建自适应策略先验的一条原则性路径,并梳理了相关联系、开放挑战与研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 离线RL应被视为对未来经验的准备而非静态部署问题;其目标应扩展为学习具备记忆、探索与自我纠正能力的自适应策略先验,从而在后续交互中持续提升。

title: Learning in the Transverse Subspace: A Minimal Representation for Divergence-Free Operator Learning
summary:
Divergence-free vector fields are fundamental state variables in incompressible flows and many PDE systems. Redundant parameterizations, including Neural Conservation Law (NCL) potentials, map multiple auxiliary representations to the same physical field. Our experiments show that this redundancy can reduce static representation-fitting error by enlarging the set of equivalent solutions, but the resulting many-to-one mapping does not provide a unique state for operator learning.
  We introduce a minimal representation that encodes a real \(D\)-component divergence-free vector field on a \(D\)-dimensional domain as a real \((D-1)\)-component field on the same domain. Exploiting the transverse structure imposed by incompressibility in Fourier space, we use a Householder orthogonal transformation to construct the reduced coordinates directly. For periodic and closed impermeable fields, the transform is invertible, isometric, and angle-preserving. For open nonperiodic flows, Fourier extension constructs a compatible periodic field, and a minimum-energy rule selects a unique reduced representation.
  Neural operators then learn temporal evolution entirely in this reduced space. At inference, the predicted \((D-1)\)-component field is decoded directly into a physical divergence-free \(D\)-component field, without predicting an ambient field or applying post-hoc projection.
  Experiments on static fitting and temporal prediction reveal a task-dependent trade-off: redundancy facilitates static optimization, whereas unique invertible coordinates provide a well-defined state for temporal dynamics. By removing unconstrained longitudinal or null directions from the learned state space, the proposed formulation achieves lower prediction error and greater robustness while preserving divergence freedom by construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种最简表示，将 D 维域上的实 D 分量无散向量场编码为同域上的实 (D-1) 分量场，利用 Householder 正交变换在傅里叶空间构造约化坐标，使神经算子在该约化空间内学习时间演化，从而在保持无散性的同时获得唯一、可逆的状态表示并降低预测误差。
AI.motivation: 无散向量场是湍流与多类 PDE 系统的基本状态变量，但常见的冗余参数化（如 NCL 势函数）将多个辅助表示映射到同一物理场。实验表明，这种冗余虽可通过扩大等价解集降低静态拟合误差，但其多对一映射无法为算子学习提供唯一状态，从而不利于时间动力学的学习。
AI.method: 作者提出一种最小表示：把 D 维域上的实 D 分量无散向量场编码为同域上的实 (D-1) 分量场。基于不可压缩性在傅里叶空间中诱导的横向结构，使用 Householder 正交变换直接构造约化坐标；对周期与封闭不可渗透场，该变换可逆、等距且保角。对开放非周期流，采用傅里叶延拓构造兼容的周期场，并以最小能量准则选取唯一约化表示。随后神经算子在约化空间中学习时间演化，推理时直接将预测的 (D-1) 分量场解码为物理无散 D 分量场，无需预测环境场或做后处理投影。
AI.result: 在静态拟合与时间预测实验中呈现出任务相关的权衡：冗余有利于静态优化，而唯一可逆坐标则为时间动力学提供良定义的状态。通过从学习状态空间中移除无约束的纵向或零方向，该表示取得了更低的预测误差与更强的鲁棒性，同时由构造保证无散性。
AI.conclusion: 无散场的冗余参数化与唯一约化表示在静态拟合与时间预测中各有优势。本文提出的 (D-1) 分量最小表示在保持无散性（by construction）的同时为算子学习提供唯一、可逆、等距的状态，从而提升时间预测精度与鲁棒性，并避免后处理投影。

title: Learn Now, Use Next, Trust Later: Prequential Test-Time Learning for LLM Agents
summary: Adapting large language model agents during deployment requires not only retaining past experience, but also turning new observations into timely guidance. Many test-time learning methods, however, acquire knowledge from completed episodes. Feedback from an ongoing interaction may therefore not be distilled into knowledge soon enough to help the next decision. Acquiring knowledge at the granularity of individual transitions could reduce this delay, but raises a separate challenge: a rule that is useful within one episode may not be reliable enough to guide future episodes. Waiting for validation can forfeit immediate benefits, whereas unrestricted reuse can propagate accidental or misattributed guidance. We introduce StepLearn, a nonparametric framework that separates immediate use from persistent trust. It turns informative transitions into hypotheses that can guide the next step, while requiring prospective validation before reuse across episodes. Their predicted effects are checked against subsequent observations outside the source episodes, and only sufficiently supported hypotheses become available for persistent guidance. This process updates external knowledge while keeping all model parameters fixed. Over five rounds on WebArena-Lite and ALFWorld, StepLearn achieves average success rates of 59.9% and 84.0% with GPT-5-mini, and 57.8% and 88.1% with Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, respectively. It outperforms EvoTest, the strongest baseline, by 2.2-12.7 percentage points across the four settings. Learning dynamics further shows that these gains are not restricted to the final repetition, with advantages already present on first task attempts in most settings.

AI.tldr: StepLearn是一个非参数框架，将"即时使用"与"持久信任"分离：把有信息量的状态转移转化为可指导下一步的假设，但跨情节复用前需经前瞻性验证，仅充分支持的假设才成为持久指导，全程不更新模型参数。在WebArena-Lite和ALFWorld上五轮平均成功率最高达59.9%/84.0%（GPT-5-mini）与57.8%/88.1%（Qwen3.5-35B-A3B），较最强基线EvoTest提升2.2–12.7个百分点。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在部署时既需保留过往经验，又需将新观察及时转化为指导。现有测试时学习方法多从已完成情节中获取知识，导致正在进行中的交互反馈无法及时蒸馏用于下一次决策。若改为按单步转移粒度获取知识，可缩短延迟，但会带来新问题：单个情节内有效的规则未必足够可靠以指导未来情节——等待验证会丧失即时收益，而无限制复用又会传播偶然或错误归因的指导。
AI.method: StepLearn采用非参数框架，将即时使用与持久信任分离。具体地，将有信息量的状态转移转化为假设，用于指导下一步决策（即时使用）；但这些假设在跨情节复用前须经前瞻性验证。验证方式是在源情节之外，用后续观测检验假设的预测效果；只有获得充分支持的假设才被允许用于持久指导。整个过程通过更新外部知识实现，所有模型参数保持固定。
AI.result: 在WebArena-Lite与ALFWorld上经五轮实验：GPT-5-mini平均成功率分别为59.9%和84.0%；Qwen3.5-35B-A3B分别为57.8%和88.1%。在四种设置下均优于最强基线EvoTest，提升2.2–12.7个百分点。学习动态分析显示增益不局限于最后一轮，多数设置下在首次任务尝试时已出现优势。
AI.conclusion: 通过将即时指导与持久信任分离，并按状态转移粒度获取知识、辅以跨情节前瞻性验证，StepLearn在无需更新模型参数的前提下显著提升LLM智能体的部署期学习效果与成功率，且优势在早期尝试即已显现。

title: Replication Failure and Trivial Baselines in Road-Level Crash Prediction
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Code and reproduction scripts: https://github.com/Maurya1112-sudo/greyspot
summary: Graph neural networks are increasingly applied to road-level crash prediction, but the stability of their reported gains has received little scrutiny. We independently reconstruct the data pipeline of a recent uncertainty-aware model and evaluate eleven of its design decisions across three London boroughs under an expanding-window protocol. Four survive replication on a second borough; seven do not, and four of those reverse sign rather than attenuate. Multi-seed evaluation is decisive: one effect reverses sign between random seeds within a single borough, and the reference architecture exhibits per-borough seed spreads of up to 35.7 points against 4 points for ours. We further compare both networks against a parameter-free baseline that ranks segments by cumulative past crash count. At matched history depth our model is statistically indistinguishable from that baseline ($-0.90$ points, $p=0.61$), and the reference architecture loses to it on 18 of 18 held-out windows ($-17.37$, $p<10^{-6}$). Sweeping the baseline's lookback horizon shows it spans 22.71% to 83.94% accuracy on that variable alone, and that every published figure in this line of work is matched by the baseline at a horizon of one to five years. We argue that the apparent margin of graph networks over historical baselines in this task is substantially an artefact of the short horizons those baselines were computed over, and recommend horizon-matched baselines and multi-seed reporting as minimum practice.

AI.tldr: 该论文独立复现了一个不确定性感知的道路级事故预测模型，发现其大部分设计增益不可复现，且图网络相对无参数历史基线的优势主要源于基线回看窗口过短。
AI.motivation: 图神经网络在道路级事故预测中应用日增，但其报告的性能增益的稳健性缺乏审查；作者希望检验这些增益是否可复现，以及是否因基线设定不当而被高估。
AI.method: 独立重建某近期不确定性感知模型的数据管线，在伦敦三个行政区、采用扩展窗口协议评估其11项设计决策；使用多种子评估检验方差，并引入无参数基线（按累计历史事故数对路段排序），扫描该基线的回看窗口长度。
AI.result: 11项设计决策中仅4项能在第二个行政区复现，7项不能，其中4项符号反转；一种效应在单一行政区内不同随机种子间即发生符号反转；参考架构的区间种子波动高达35.7个百分点，而作者模型仅4个百分点。在匹配历史深度下，作者模型与无参数基线统计不可区分（-0.90分，p=0.61），参考架构在18/18个留出窗口上均劣于该基线（-17.37，p<10^-6）。基线仅改变回看窗口即从22.71%到83.94%准确率，且该领域所有已发表数字都能被基线在1至5年窗口下匹配。
AI.conclusion: 图网络在此任务上相对历史基线的表面优势在很大程度上是基线回看窗口过短的假象；建议至少采用窗口匹配的基线与多种子报告作为最低实践标准。

title: Normative Loss Landscape Navigation: A Trajectory-Based Approach to Mitigating Forgetting in Incremental Learning
summary: Continual learning models suffer from catastrophic forgetting when trained sequentially on non-stationary data distributions. Previously, this has been addressed through weight regularization. While preconditioning gradients offer a promising alternative to mitigate forgetting, current approaches are myopic. Conversely, standard regularization methods apply rigid, scalar Euclidean penalties that entirely ignore the underlying Riemannian geometry of the parameter space. To overcome this gap, we propose TMLN (Trajectory-Modulatory Landscape Navigation), a normative navigation policy that formalizes continual learning as an optimal control problem over a curved loss landscape. TMLN utilizes a memory-efficient diagonal empirical Fisher Information Matrix (FIM) to define a localized Riemannian manifold. To compensate for the spatial limitations of the diagonal approximation, TMLN dynamically modulates a preconditioner using the normalized historical trajectory of the network's parameter values. By integrating this trajectory-based preconditioning directly into the gradient update, we actively shield historically critical parameter directions without relying on additive penalties. Empirical evaluations on class- and domain-incremental benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly reduces the loss barrier between consecutive tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TMLN，将持续学习形式化为弯曲损失景观上的最优控制问题，用对角经验FIM构造局部黎曼流形，并结合归一化历史参数轨迹动态调制预条件子，从而在梯度更新中主动保护历史关键参数方向，显著降低连续任务间的损失屏障。
AI.motivation: 持续学习模型在非平稳数据分布上顺序训练时存在灾难性遗忘。权重正则化方法采用刚性的标量欧氏惩罚，完全忽略参数空间的黎曼几何结构；而现有的梯度预条件方法则是短视的。作者希望弥合这一空白。
AI.method: 提出TMLN（Trajectory-Modulatory Landscape Navigation），一种规范性导航策略，把持续学习建模为弯曲损失景观上的最优控制问题。具体地：1）使用内存高效的对角经验Fisher信息矩阵（FIM）定义局部黎曼流形；2）为弥补对角近似的空间局限，用网络参数值的归一化历史轨迹动态调制预条件子；3）将基于轨迹的预条件直接集成到梯度更新中，无需依赖加性惩罚即可保护历史关键参数方向。
AI.result: 在类增量与域增量基准上的实证评估表明，该方法显著降低了连续任务之间的损失屏障（loss barrier）。
AI.conclusion: TMLN通过将黎曼几何与历史轨迹调制的预条件相结合，为缓解灾难性遗忘提供了不依赖加性惩罚的新范式，并在类/域增量任务上验证了其有效性。

title: CADENCE: A Confidence-Adaptive Dual-Expert Network for Fast and Accurate Time Series Classification
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures. Code and benchmark evaluation scripts available at https://github.com/onisa-jr/CADENCE.git
summary:
Time series classification (TSC) exhibits a sharp trade-off between accuracy and computational scalability. Meta-ensembles like HIVE-COTE 2.0 reach state-of-the-art accuracy but require extensive compute, whereas ultra-fast random convolutional transforms (e.g., MiniRocket, Hydra) run in seconds but struggle with phase-independent distributions, signal kinematics, and decision tree fragmentation on large class counts.
  In this work, we present CADENCE (Confidence-Adaptive Dual-Expert Network for time series Classification Excellence), a unified, CPU-native dual-expert architecture. CADENCE decouples representation learning into two specialized pathways: (i) a Convolutional Linear Expert pairing 10,000 deterministic dilated features with closed-form L2-regularized Woodbury ridge classification, and (ii) a Distributional Interval Expert pairing competing dilated kernels (Hydra) with dyadic Cornish-Fisher moment approximations across signal kinematics and FFT spectral bands, fitted with an ExtraTrees ensemble. An internal validation meta-router with rare-class preservation dynamically selects between pure expert routing and confidence-weighted soft blending, followed by a full refit on 100% of training data.
  Evaluated across all 109 equal-length UCR Archive datasets over 30 resamples (3,270 total runs), CADENCE achieves a grand mean accuracy of 0.8864. This ranks #2 across the archive, surpassed only by HIVE-COTE 2.0 (0.8895, p_Holm = 0.295, no statistically significant difference), while outperforming Hydra+MultiRocket (0.8818), MultiRocket (0.8797), and HIVE-COTE 1.0 (0.8786, p_Holm = 0.048). CADENCE closes the gap to HIVE-COTE 2.0 to 0.31 percentage points while taking an average of only 17.53 seconds per dataset on a dual-core CPU. Source code and evaluation scripts: https://github.com/onisa-jr/CADENCE.git

AI.tldr: CADENCE：一种CPU原生的双专家置信度自适应时间序列分类架构，通过卷积线性专家与分布区间专家协同，在109个UCR数据集上以0.8864的平均准确率位列第二，接近HIVE-COTE 2.0且单数据集仅需约17.5秒。
AI.motivation: 时间序列分类（TSC）在精度与计算可扩展性之间存在尖锐权衡：元集成方法（如HIVE-COTE 2.0）精度达SOTA但计算开销巨大；超快随机卷积变换（如MiniRocket、Hydra）虽秒级运行，却在相位无关分布、信号运动学建模及大类数下决策树碎片化等问题上表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出CADENCE（Confidence-Adaptive Dual-Expert Network），一种统一的CPU原生双专家架构。将表示学习解耦为两条路径：(i) 卷积线性专家：将10,000个确定性膨胀特征与闭式L2正则化Woodbury岭回归分类相结合；(ii) 分布区间专家：将竞争性膨胀核（Hydra）与跨信号运动学及FFT频带的二进Cornish-Fisher矩近似配对，用ExtraTrees集成拟合。内部验证元路由器结合稀有类保护，动态选择纯专家路由或置信度加权软混合，随后在100%训练数据上完整重拟合。
AI.result: 在109个等长UCR Archive数据集、30次重采样（共3,270次运行）上评估，CADENCE平均准确率为0.8864，位列全档案第2，仅次于HIVE-COTE 2.0（0.8895，pHolm=0.295，无统计显著差异），优于Hydra+MultiRocket（0.8818）、MultiRocket（0.8797）及HIVE-COTE 1.0（0.8786，pHolm=0.048）。双核CPU上每数据集平均仅耗时17.53秒。
AI.conclusion: CADENCE在将精度差距缩小至HIVE-COTE 2.0仅0.31个百分点的同时，显著降低计算成本，实现了CPU高效的近SOTA时间序列分类。

title: KernelOnet: An Interpretable Neural Operator Based on Kernel Functions
summary: This paper proposes an interpretable neural operator framework, the Kernel Operator Network (KernelOnet), which incorporates kernel functions explicitly into the neural operator architecture, so that the operator structure matches the kernel-expansion form used in boundary-type kernel-expansion methods. Unlike traditional neural operators such as DeepONet, which learn basis functions implicitly through deep networks, KernelOnet replaces the trunk network with explicit kernels and offers three complementary kernels: a data-driven learnable kernel, in which a neural network parameterizes a radial basis function learned from data, and which for constant-coefficient linear problems can be regarded as a non-singular fundamental solution; a physics-informed kernel, which embeds physical information such as analytic fundamental solutions into the network structure, so that the expansion satisfies the governing equation automatically and can be trained without supervision on boundary conditions alone, with no interior solution data; and a hybrid kernel, which splits the solution, according to the linear principal part of the governing equation, into a homogeneous part spanned by analytic fundamental solutions and a source part carried by low-rank learned correction kernels, thereby balancing physical priors against data fitting on nonlinear problems lacking an analytic fundamental solution. On three benchmarks and one engineering problem in a shallow-water waveguide, KernelOnet attains high accuracy; where comparable with DeepONet, it is more accurate with fewer learnable parameters. Its unsupervised configuration needs no interior solution labels, and its per-query inference cost is far below that of per-instance solvers, offering an effective route to acoustic propagation in unbounded exterior domains that general-purpose neural operators struggle to handle.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可解释神经算子框架 KernelOnet，将核函数显式嵌入网络结构，使其与边界型核展开方法的展开形式一致；提供数据驱动核、物理信息核与混合核三种互补形式，在精度、参数效率与无监督训练方面优于 DeepONet，并在浅水波导等问题上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 传统神经算子（如 DeepONet）通过深度网络隐式学习基函数，缺乏可解释性，且通用神经算子在无界外域（如声传播）问题上表现不佳；作者希望将核展开方法的显式结构引入神经算子，以兼顾物理先验、数据拟合与可解释性。
AI.method: 提出 Kernel Operator Network（KernelOnet），用显式核函数替代 DeepONet 的 trunk 网络，使算子结构与边界型核展开形式一致。设计三种核：(1) 数据驱动可学习核——用神经网络参数化从数据中学到的径向基函数，对常系数线性问题可视为非奇异基本解；(2) 物理信息核——将解析基本解等物理信息嵌入网络结构，使展开自动满足控制方程，可仅用边界条件无监督训练，无需内部解数据；(3) 混合核——按控制方程线性主部把解分解为由解析基本解张成的齐次部分与由低秩学习修正核承载的源项部分，在缺乏解析基本解的非线性问题上平衡物理先验与数据拟合。
AI.result: 在三个基准问题和一个浅水波导工程问题上，KernelOnet 均取得高精度；在与 DeepONet 可比较的场景下，以更少可学习参数获得更高精度；其无监督配置无需内部解标签；单次查询推理成本远低于逐实例求解器，为通用神经算子难以处理的无界外域声传播问题提供了有效途径。
AI.conclusion: KernelOnet 通过将显式核函数引入神经算子架构，实现了结构与物理先验的可解释融合，兼具高精度、参数高效、可无监督训练与低推理成本的优势，是处理无界外域等难题的有效方案。

title: EnJoi: Ensemble Joint Score Filter for Generative Data Assimilation
summary: Data Assimilation (DA) aims to recover the full state of a dynamical system that is only partially observed. A solution is to use Score-based models to generate physically consistent trajectories that agree with the observations. These Autoregressive Diffusion models are trained by conditioning on the previous state; however, they do not take into account the uncertainty of their past predictions. We propose a new diffusion-based assimilation algorithm that dynamically balances the confidence in the current state and the new observations. Crucially, we choose to learn the distribution of the joint state containing both the past and future. This allows us to use a modified version of En4DVar, a classical DA algorithm that relies on the covariance of an ensemble of particles. Experiments on fluid and traffic flow simulations show improved reconstruction performance, especially in situations where observations are sparse and non-homogeneous.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于扩散模型的数据同化算法，学习过去与未来的联合状态分布，并借助改进的En4DVar动态平衡当前状态置信度与新观测权重，在稀疏、非均匀观测下取得更优重建。
AI.motivation: 现有基于分数的自回归扩散同化模型虽能生成与观测一致的物理轨迹，但仅以先前状态为条件进行训练，未考虑历史预测本身的不确定性，导致置信度分配不合理。
AI.method: 提出新的扩散式同化算法：不再仅建模条件于前一状态的分布，而是学习包含过去与未来的联合状态分布；在此基础上采用改进版En4DVar，利用粒子集合协方差动态平衡当前状态置信度与新观测的权重。
AI.result: 在流体与交通流仿真实验中，重建性能优于基线，尤其在观测稀疏且非均匀的情形下提升明显。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合状态建模与集合协方差驱动的动态置信度平衡，可使扩散同化在困难观测条件下更鲁棒、更准确。

title: ROSS: Relearning from Self-Generated Rollouts through Selective Supervision
summary: Large language model post-training generates self-generated rollouts through reinforcement learning and on-policy distillation, yet this experience is often treated as stale once the policy advances. Historical rollouts can remain compatible with a later policy while preserving behaviors that the policy no longer expresses reliably. However, they may also contain mistakes, abandoned attempts, and redundant actions that should not be imitated, motivating finer-grained selective supervision. We introduce ROSS (Relearning from Self-Generated Rollouts through Selective Supervision), which preserves the full historical trajectory as context while applying loss only to selected model-generated continuations. Across domain-specific reinforcement learning, multi-teacher on-policy distillation, and agentic reinforcement learning, ROSS consistently improves upstream checkpoints and outperforms baselines across mathematics, code generation, instruction following, and software engineering. On Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, ROSS improves the six-benchmark MOPD average from 58.40% to 62.20% and SWE-bench Verified from 64.20% to 68.40%. These results show that self-rollout training leaves behind reusable behavioral experience that can yield further gains through offline supervised fine-tuning (SFT), without additional policy rollouts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ROSS，通过选择性监督从历史自生成 rollout 中离线学习，将完整历史轨迹作为上下文但仅对选定的模型续写计算损失，在多种训练范式和多项基准上稳定提升，且无需额外 rollout。
AI.motivation: 大模型后训练通过强化学习和 on-policy 蒸馏生成自生成 rollout，但这些经验在策略更新后常被视为过期而被丢弃。历史 rollout 可能与后续策略兼容，并保留策略当前无法稳定表达的行为，其中也包含错误、被放弃的尝试与冗余动作，因此需要更细粒度的选择性监督来复用这些经验。
AI.method: ROSS 将完整历史轨迹保留为上下文，仅对选定的模型生成续写施加损失，实现离线 SFT 式的选择性监督。方法在领域特定强化学习、多教师 on-policy 蒸馏和智能体强化学习三类场景中应用。
AI.result: ROSS 持续提升上游 checkpoint 并优于基线，覆盖数学、代码生成、指令遵循和软件工程。在 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 上，六基准 MOPD 平均分从 58.40% 提升至 62.20%，SWE-bench Verified 从 64.20% 提升至 68.40%。
AI.conclusion: 自 rollout 训练遗留了可复用的行为经验，可通过离线监督微调进一步获得收益，而无需额外的策略 rollout。

title: Preferent Compression Bounds Are Tight
comment: 14 pages, 6 figures, to appear at the 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC 2026)
summary: The lack of rigorous safety and performance certificates remains a key bottleneck to the deployment of modern learning-based methods. Sample compression has recently emerged as a powerful tool for deriving such certificates, with particularly sharp bounds available for algorithms satisfying a so-called preference property -- also known as stability in the learning theory literature. These bounds find direct application across domains as different as the Scenario Approach, Pick-to-Learn, and Support Vector methods. However, whether they are tight has remained an open problem. In this paper we resolve this question affirmatively and show that the state-of-the-art bound for preferent compressions is provably tight. We establish this by exhibiting an explicit construction based on the uniform distribution and order statistics that attains the bound in the limit. Along the way, we also provide a considerably shorter and more accessible proof of this bound, requiring only elementary counting arguments and no infinite-dimensional duality.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了偏好压缩（preferent compression）的最优泛化界是可证的紧的，并通过基于均匀分布与次序统计量的显式构造在极限意义下达到该界，同时给出了仅用初等计数论证的更短证明。
AI.motivation: 现代基于学习的方法部署的关键瓶颈在于缺乏严格的安全性与性能证书。样本压缩是推导此类证书的有力工具，对满足偏好性质（preference property，即学习理论中的稳定性）的算法可得到尤为紧的界，并应用于Scenario Approach、Pick-to-Learn与支持向量方法等。但该界是否紧一直悬而未决。
AI.method: 通过基于均匀分布与次序统计量的显式构造，证明偏好压缩的最先进界在极限意义下可被达到；并给出一个更短、更易理解的证明，仅依赖初等计数论证，无需无穷维对偶。
AI.result: 肯定性地解决了该开放问题：偏好压缩的最先进界是可证紧的，且存在达到该界的显式构造（极限意义下）。同时获得该界的简化证明。
AI.conclusion: 偏好压缩界的最优性得到确认，为相关证书的可靠性提供了理论保障，并降低了证明门槛，便于在Scenario Approach、Pick-to-Learn与支持向量等方法中推广应用。

title: TORQUE: Optimizing What (not) to Quantize Before and After Rotation
summary:
Uniform random rotations are an effective preprocessing step for quantization: they make normalized coordinate distributions approximately Gaussian, enabling the use of codebooks optimized offline. We introduce TORQUE, a framework that improves on previous quantization works that use random rotations by jointly optimizing how many and which coordinates to preserve at high precision both before and after rotation, under a fixed overall expected bit budget.
  Intuitively, before rotation, preserving large input coordinates at high precision can reduce overall error by preventing the rotation from spreading their values across many coordinates. Likewise, after rotation, preserving a small fraction of the largest-magnitude coordinates at high precision allows the remaining values to be quantized more accurately using codebooks optimized offline for the resulting truncated Gaussian distribution.
  We derive a quantization error upper bound and prove that top-$k$ pre-rotation retention minimizes it for each $k$. This reduces the search over coordinate subsets to an optimization over $k$, enabling a fast optimizer that uses offline codebooks and parallel parameter selection for practical implementation. We demonstrate an improved tradeoff between reconstruction accuracy and storage cost through numerical evaluation under the Gaussian model and experiments on nearest-neighbor retrieval, KV-cache compression, and activation compression.

AI.tldr: TORQUE 通过联合优化旋转前与旋转后保留哪些高精度坐标，在固定比特预算下提升随机旋转量化的精度-存储权衡。
AI.motivation: 随机旋转可将归一化坐标分布近似为高斯分布，便于使用离线码本量化；但以往方法未优化精度保留策略，旋转会把大坐标值扩散到多个坐标，增加误差。
AI.method: 提出 TORQUE 框架，在固定整体期望比特预算下，同时优化旋转前和旋转后需要高精度保留的坐标数量与位置；推导量化误差上界，证明对每个 k，旋转前保留 top-k 大坐标可使该上界最小，从而将子集搜索简化为对 k 的优化，并使用离线码本和并行参数选择实现快速优化器。
AI.result: 在高斯模型下的数值评估以及最近邻检索、KV-cache 压缩和激活压缩实验中，展示了重建精度与存储成本之间更好的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 联合优化旋转前后高精度坐标保留策略，可在固定比特预算下显著改善量化误差与存储效率的平衡，适用于多种压缩与检索任务。

title: Neural networks for spectral optimization
summary: Given a functional dependent on the spectrum of a differential operator, we address the problem of finding a domain which optimizes this functional. PDE solvers might be used to tackle this optimization. It is however computationally expensive. We propose two neural network models which learn the spectrum directly from the geometry of the domain and can be used to optimize the domain from one or more eigenvalues. We investigate two representations. The first encodes the domain through Fourier coefficients and a light MLP, which is efficient on star-shaped geometries, achieving a precision of 0.2\%. Through a rescaling of the coefficients the designed models satisfy the scaling law of the eigenvalues. Additionally, averaging the outputs of the trained surrogates over rotations and reflections induces invariance for these transformations. The second is a model that takes the landscape function, the indicator function and the gradient of the landscape function. A Gram-Schmidt process produces orthogonal eigenfunctions as output of the model along with the associated eigenvalues. The landscape model reaches 1\% mean relative error on the first ten eigenvalues, compared with 4\% for an FNO model. Replacing the landscape by an SDF worsened both prediction and optimization errors. The trained model also generalizes from synthetic shapes to domains given as classical image dataset. The resulting surrogates of both approaches recover classical spectral optima such as the disk for the first eigenvalue or the conjectured minima of higher eigenvalues. This confirms that our models produce accurate differentiable estimates of eigenvalues, which can be used in shape optimization problems involving spectral quantities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种神经网络代理模型，直接从区域几何预测微分算子谱，用于谱泛函的域优化；Fourier系数+轻量MLP方案在星形区域精度达0.2%，并满足特征值缩放律、旋转与反射不变性；landscape函数方案在前十个特征值上平均相对误差约1%，优于FNO的4%。
AI.motivation: 传统谱泛函域优化依赖PDE求解器反复计算特征值，计算成本高昂；需要能够直接从几何快速、可微地估计谱的代理模型，以加速形状优化。
AI.method: 提出两类模型：其一以Fourier系数编码区域并接轻量MLP，通过系数重缩放满足特征值缩放律，并对旋转、反射输出取平均实现不变性；其二输入landscape函数、指示函数及其梯度，经Gram-Schmidt正交化输出正交特征函数及对应特征值，并与FNO及以SDF替换landscape的变体作对比。
AI.result: Fourier+MLP模型在星形几何上精度0.2%；landscape模型对前十个特征值平均相对误差1%，FNO为4%，SDF替换后预测与优化误差均变差；模型可从合成形状泛化到经典图像数据集域，并恢复圆盘（第一特征值）及高阶特征值猜想极小值等经典谱最优解。
AI.conclusion: 两种代理模型均能给出精确且可微的特征值估计，可直接嵌入涉及谱量的形状优化问题，避免昂贵PDE求解，验证了神经谱代理在谱泛函域优化中的有效性。

title: Improving scalable oversight with co-trained monitors
summary: Worker-monitor setups are a promising approach to AI oversight, but training workers against fixed monitors can incentivize monitor evasion. We study whether this failure mode can be avoided by co-training the monitor alongside the worker, and explore both supervised and self-supervised approaches. In the supervised setting, we prove a characterization: monitoring is possible with vanishing error and query rates exactly when the class of possible monitor functions has finite Littlestone dimension. This connects worker monitoring with an established literature on adversarial online learning. For self-supervision, we propose a co-training procedure based on test-time distillation: the monitor uses additional test-time compute to generate training labels, then trains its standard-compute policy on those labels. For majority-vote labels, we give a finite-sample sharpening guarantee under adaptive worker distributions with action coverage, that shows that the monitor's verdicts converge to its initial modal verdicts. We stress-test the former in code-security settings where the worker is trained adversarially to fool the monitor. Our results suggest that adaptive monitors are better at keeping pace with evolving worker strategies, while fixed monitors are more vulnerable to evasion.

AI.tldr: 本文研究工作-监控（worker-monitor）设置中的监控器规避问题，提出将监控器与工作者协同训练（监督与自监督两种范式），并从理论与实验两方面刻画其可行性与优势。
AI.motivation: 对抗固定监控器训练工作者会激励其规避监控，导致监控失效。作者希望验证：让监控器与工作者一同进化（co-training）能否避免这一失效模式。
AI.method: 1）监督设定：证明“监控可达到误差与查询率趋零”当且仅当可能监控函数类的 Littlestone 维有限，将监控问题与对抗在线学习文献建立联系；2）自监督设定：提出基于测试时蒸馏的协同训练流程——监控器利用额外测试时算力生成训练标签，再据此训练标准算力策略；对多数投票标签，在自适应工作者分布与动作覆盖条件下给出有限样本锐化保证。此外在代码安全场景中对监督方法进行压力测试，工作者被对抗训练以欺骗监控器。
AI.result: 理论上给出了监控可行性的充要刻画（Littlestone 维有限）以及自监督多数投票的有限样本锐化保证（监控器裁决收敛到其初始众数裁决）；实验上表明自适应监控器更能跟上不断演化的工作者策略，而固定监控器更易被规避。
AI.conclusion: 协同训练的监控器比固定监控器更鲁棒，能在一定程度上缓解工作者规避问题；监控可行性与监控函数类的在线学习复杂度（Littlestone 维）紧密相关。

title: ABC: Advantage-Based Control Variates for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
summary: Recent progress in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has highlighted the effectiveness of simple critic-free policy-gradient methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). In contrast, actor-critic methods rely on learned value functions whose approximation error can introduce bias through commonly used advantage estimators such as temporal-difference error. Motivated by this observation, we revisit trajectory-level control variates through an advantage-value formulation, which we call Advantage-Based Control Variates (ABC). This formulation reveals that the covariance structure is closely related to the return decomposition used in Direct Advantage Estimation (DAE). Finally, we combine ABC with DAE into a single actor-critic algorithm and evaluate it in an offline-to-online RLVR setting, where the critic is first trained on previously collected trajectories and adapted during online learning. On mathematical reasoning tasks, ABC achieves performance competitive with GRPO using substantially fewer online optimization steps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Advantage-Based Control Variates (ABC) 框架，重新审视轨迹级控制变量，揭示其与 Direct Advantage Estimation (DAE) 中回报分解的协方差结构联系，并将 ABC 与 DAE 结合为单一 actor-critic 算法。
AI.motivation: RLVR 中无评论家的策略梯度方法（如 GRPO）表现优异，而 actor-critic 方法因学习值函数的近似误差，会通过时序差分误差等优势估计器引入偏差。作者希望借助控制变量减少此类偏差。
