AI.method: 提出TDGE——一种人类启发、模型无关的算法，能够自动构建"任务—维度—特征—物品"的层级结构。其核心是自顶向下的探索策略：第一步选择任务相关的特征维度，第二步在这些维度内识别信息性特征，第三步基于所选特征推荐具体物品。该算法不依赖特定模型，可与其他基座方法结合使用。
AI.result: 在MovieLens-20M、Last.fm与Amazon三个推荐数据集上的实验表明，TDGE相较基线算法大幅提升了探索效率与冷启动适应能力。与其他结构化算法的对比及消融实验将性能增益归因于其层级结构与语义特征空间探索，结果在不同聚类方法和不同层级深度下均保持稳健。推荐轨迹可视化也呈现出与人类维度引导行为相似的探索模式。
AI.conclusion: TDGE验证了将人类维度引导降维探索机制算法化的有效性，其层级结构与语义特征空间探索是性能提升的关键来源，且对聚类方法与层级深度具有稳健性。该工作为高维决策空间中的高效探索与冷启动问题提供了一种模型无关的通用思路，并展现出与人类行为一致的探索轨迹。

title: Where Root Cause Analysis Fails: A Retrieval-Reranking Decomposition
summary: Identifying the root cause of an anomaly among hundreds of sensors is critical for preventing safety incidents and costly downtime in complex monitored systems. Existing studies evaluate root cause analysis (RCA) methods using top@k accuracy. We show that this metric has a fundamental blind spot: it conflates two failure modes, retrieval failure, where the true cause is never considered, and reranking failure, where it is considered but ranked too low. In this work, we introduce a retrieval-reranking decomposition and audit four well-known benchmarks to expose this blind spot. Our experiments show that, on benchmarks with complex faults, statistical baselines mis-rank the true cause 79-100% of the time, and graph-based methods never clearly beat the best statistical baseline, whether their causal graphs are learned on short fault windows, on retrieved candidate pools guaranteed to contain the cause, or on multi-day normal-operation data. Meanwhile, on simple benchmarks where faults manifest significantly at their origin, retrieval is nearly solved (98-100%). Guided by the decomposition, we build a two-stage pipeline combining a multi-signal retriever with an LLM reranker that, as one fixed configuration, matches or exceeds the best baseline's top@1 accuracy on all six benchmark suites (by up to +12 points), with no causal graph or labeled data required. When all methods rank the same retrieved candidates with the true cause guaranteed present, adding a short system-description document lets the reranker lead the best baseline by +7 to +18 points on every benchmark. Code is available at https://github.com/cruiseresearchgroup/DecompRCA.

AI.tldr: 本文指出常用RCA评价指标top@k混淆了"检索失败"与"重排失败"两种失效模式，提出检索-重排分解框架，审计四个基准揭示该盲点，并据此构建"多信号检索器+LLM重排器"的两阶段流水线，在六个基准套件上达到或超过最佳基线。
AI.motivation: 复杂监控系统中从数百个传感器中定位异常根因对防止安全事故与高昂停机至关重要，但现有RCA研究普遍以top@k准确率作为评价指标，该指标无法区分根因从未被检索到与根因被检索到但排序过低两种情况，掩盖了方法的真实能力边界，使得难以判断改进究竟来自检索还是重排。
AI.method: 提出检索-重排分解（retrieval-reranking decomposition），将RCA失败拆分为检索失败与重排失败两类；据此审计四个知名基准以暴露指标盲点。进一步设计两阶段流水线：第一阶段用多信号检索器生成候选池，第二阶段用LLM重排器对候选进行排序，无需因果图与标注数据；并验证在候选池保证含真因的条件下添加简短系统描述文档对重排效果的影响。
AI.result: 在复杂故障基准上，统计基线将真因排错的比例达79%-100%，图方法在短故障窗口、保证含真因的检索候选池、多天正常数据三种因果图学习设定下均未明显优于最佳统计基线；在故障在起源处显著显现的简单基准上，检索近乎被解决（98%-100%）。所提两阶段流水线以单一固定配置在全部六个基准套件上达到或超过最佳基线的top@1（最高提升12个百分点）；在候选集相同且保证含真因时，加入简短系统描述文档可使重排器在每个基准上领先最佳基线7-18个百分点。
AI.conclusion: top@k指标存在结构性盲点，检索-重排分解能更清晰地刻画RCA方法的能力来源；以此为指导构建的LLM重排流水线无需因果图与标注数据即可在多个基准上取得最优表现，且系统描述文档可作为有效补充信息，为RCA评价与方法设计提供了新范式。

title: Normalize-Then-Precondition: A Hierarchical Approach to Marginal Scale and Interaction Geometry for LLM Training
summary: Matrix optimizers have emerged as a promising direction, with Muon standing out as a prominent design. Revisiting Muon through its full-Gram representation, we observe that it jointly processes marginal-scale and interaction information. This opens an alternative way to organize geometric information hierarchically, motivating the Normalize-Then-Precondition framework. Specifically, it first uses diagonal-Gram information to construct a marginally normalized update, then applies spectral preconditioning to its directional interaction geometry. Building on this framework, we develop NormPre with NormPre-G and NormPre-L adopting global and localized spectral preconditioning, grounded in spectral-norm steepest descent and a regularized formulation followed by leading mode selection, respectively. To enable large-scale training, NormPre-G uses Newton-Schulz iterations and NormPre-L employs randomized sketching to approximate the leading interaction eigenspace. Theoretically, we establish $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/2})$ convergence guarantees for simplified versions of NormPre. Across extensive pretraining experiments on GPT-2 Small, LLaMA and Qwen3, both variants consistently outperform AdamW, Muon and MANO under matched training budgets. Further efficiency and spectral analyses reveal the complementary strengths of two variants and characterize their performance-efficiency trade-off. We open-source our code through a GitHub repository at https://github.com/zx-gong/NormPre.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Normalize-Then-Precondition 框架及 NormPre 系列矩阵优化器（NormPre-G 与 NormPre-L），通过先做边际归一化再施加谱预条件，在大规模预训练中超越 AdamW、Muon 与 MANO。
AI.motivation: 矩阵优化器（尤以 Muon 为代表）是新兴方向。作者从 Muon 的 full-Gram 表示出发，发现它同时处理边际尺度信息与交互信息，这为分层组织几何信息提供了新思路，从而引出 Normalize-Then-Precondition 框架的动机。
AI.method: 提出 Normalize-Then-Precondition 框架：先用对角-Gram 信息构造边际归一化更新，再对其方向性交互几何施加谱预条件。据此开发 NormPre，含两个变体：NormPre-G 采用全局谱预条件，基于谱范数最速下降；NormPre-L 采用局部化谱预条件，基于正则化公式加主模态选择。为支持大规模训练，NormPre-G 使用 Newton-Schulz 迭代，NormPre-L 使用随机素描（randomized sketching）近似主导交互特征子空间。
AI.result: 理论上为 NormPre 的简化版本建立了 O(T^{-1/2}) 收敛保证。在 GPT-2 Small、LLaMA 与 Qwen3 的广泛预训练实验中，两个变体在相同训练预算下均持续优于 AdamW、Muon 和 MANO。进一步的效率与谱分析揭示了两个变体的互补优势，并刻画了其性能-效率权衡。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: NormPre 通过分层组织边际尺度与交互几何信息，提供了有理论保证且实验有效的矩阵优化方案，两种变体各具互补优势。代码开源于 https://github.com/zx-gong/NormPre。

title: Know Thyself, Teach Thyself: Internal Information Flow for Selective Self-Distillation
summary: Self-distillation turns knowledge distillation into a closed learning loop and offers a path toward recursive self-improvement. Without an external teacher, however, the model must determine both what information can improve its supervision and which induced changes should be learned. Existing methods typically improve teacher-generated data or select training examples in isolation, leaving the information transferred between these stages unmeasured. We introduce InFlow, a retrieval-guided on-policy self-distillation framework that models this process as potential-to-realized information flow. InFlow first retrieves potentially informative sources using certainty-calibrated hidden-state trajectories, then measures their realized effect through the Jensen--Shannon divergence between the teacher's initial and retrieval-conditioned answer beliefs. Examples with larger belief shifts are selected for on-policy distillation. Our analysis formalizes the information optimized by retrieval and selection and relates the answer-level shift to the teacher--student distillation gap. Across four open-weight language models and three knowledge domains, InFlow achieves the strongest cross-model average among the compared selection methods, with ablations supporting both stages of the framework. Our code is available at https://github.com/1240148048/INFLOW.

AI.tldr: 提出InFlow，将自蒸馏建模为"潜在信息→实现信息"的流动过程，用检索与选择两阶段引导在线策略自蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 自蒸馏形成闭环学习，无需外部教师即可自我改进，但模型须自行判断何种信息能改进监督、哪些变化应被学习。现有方法或改进教师生成数据、或孤立地筛选样本，且两阶段间传递的信息未被度量。
AI.method: InFlow以potential-to-realized information flow建模该过程：先用确定性校准的隐状态轨迹检索潜在信息源；再用教师初始答案信念与检索条件化答案信念间的Jensen-Shannon散度度量已实现效果，选取信念偏移更大的样本进行on-policy蒸馏。理论分析形式化检索与选择所优化的信息，并将答案层面的偏移与师生蒸馏差距关联。
AI.result: 在四个开放权重语言模型和三个知识域上，InFlow在对比的样本选择方法中取得最强的跨模型平均表现，消融实验支持框架的两个阶段。
AI.conclusion: 将自蒸馏中的检索与选择统一为可度量的信息流，能有效筛选高价值样本并提升自蒸馏效果；代码已开源。

title: Learned Queries and Keys Are All You Need: Replacing the Value Projection with Structured Transforms
summary: To reduce the number of parameters and cache memory requirements of transformers we introduce dual-headed transformers instead of three heads. We studied Walsh-Hadamard Transform (WHT), Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT), Discrete Fourier Transform, filterbank based Shearlet Transform, and Multiplication-Avoiding (MA) operators to construct dual heads. We combine spatial patches and their orthogonal transforms (or Shearlet and MA operators) in a structure similar to the attention block. We obtained better results than triple headed transformers in ImageNet. Extensive simulation examples are presented.

AI.tldr: 提出双头Transformer替代三头结构，通过将空间块与其正交变换（WHT/DCT/DFT/Shearlet）或乘法避免算子结合，在ImageNet上取得优于三头Transformer的结果，同时减少参数量与缓存需求。
AI.motivation: Transformer的三头结构参数量大、缓存内存需求高，需要降低资源开销。
AI.method: 用双头Transformer替代三头；研究Walsh-Hadamard变换、离散余弦变换、离散傅里叶变换、基于滤波器组的Shearlet变换及乘法避免（MA）算子来构造双头；在类注意力块结构中结合空间块与其正交变换（或Shearlet与MA算子）。
AI.result: 在ImageNet上结果优于三头Transformer；给出了大量仿真示例。
AI.conclusion: 双头Transformer可有效降低参数量与缓存需求，并保持甚至提升性能。

title: CALIBUDGET: Calibration-Guided Source Allocation for Fixed-Budget Mixed-Reasoning Adaptation
summary: Fixed-budget adaptation from heterogeneous data sources requires deciding not only how much data to use, but how much exposure each source receives. Size-proportional rules can crowd out small sources, whereas difficulty-only rules can chase noisy estimates or allocate residual budget to nearly saturated pools. We introduce CALIBUDGET, a floor-protected, reliability-aware integer allocator that treats source exposure as an explicit adaptation variable. From small train-internal calibration splits, it combines model need, post-floor availability, and bootstrap stability, then produces exact capacity-respecting quotas without changing the model, objective, or total budget. In a controlled setting combining mathematical and commonsense data, CALIBUDGET improves CommonAvg, FragileAvg, and MacroAvg over validation-error-with-floor, the strongest matched comparator, in all three paired LLaMA-2-7B LoRA+ runs. The respective mean gains are 0.56, 0.46, and 0.41 percentage points (pp). Overall increases by 0.18 pp, whereas MathAvg decreases by 0.20 pp, exposing a coverage-retention boundary rather than a uniform gain. CALIBUDGET changes only 1.14-1.42% of the source budget but improves performance in 15 of 24 comparisons across commonsense tasks and seeds. These results suggest that small changes in source quotas can matter; example-level selection can then determine which examples fill each quota.

AI.tldr: CALIBUDGET：一种带下限保护、可靠性感知的整数预算分配器，将数据源曝光量作为显式的自适应变量，在不改变模型、目标函数和总预算的前提下分配各源配额。
AI.motivation: 固定预算下从异构数据源自适应面临两个分配问题：不仅要用多少数据，还要决定每个源获得多少曝光。按规模成比例分配会挤压小数据源；仅按难度分配会追逐噪声估计，或把剩余预算分给已接近饱和的数据池。
AI.method: CALIBUDGET 利用小型训练内部校准划分，综合模型需求、扣减下限后的可用量以及bootstrap稳定性三项信号，生成严格满足容量约束的整数配额，且不改变模型、目标函数或总预算。
AI.result: 在数学与常识数据组合的受控实验中，CALIBUDGET 在三次配对的 LLaMA-2-7B LoRA+ 运行中，相较最强匹配基线（带下限的验证误差法）在 CommonAvg、FragileAvg、MacroAvg 上分别平均提升 0.56、0.46、0.41 个百分点；Overall 提升 0.18 pp，但 MathAvg 下降 0.20 pp。该方法仅改变 1.14–1.42% 的源预算，却在 24 组常识任务与随机种子的对比中有 15 组获得提升。
AI.conclusion: 源配额的微小调整即可产生显著影响，且非均匀增益表明存在覆盖保持边界；在配额确定后，可由样本级筛选进一步决定填充各配额的具体样本。

title: Routing in Gradient Space: Balanced Usage Is Not Expert Specialization
summary: Sparse expert models can distribute traffic evenly while still grouping incompatible training signals within the same experts. We study routing as a gradient-partitioning problem and introduce gradient-aligned routing (GAR), whose load-normalized router objective rewards grouping observations with aligned gradients. On five multi-task text-classification mixtures, we compare GAR with task-loss-only routing, gradient-combination and gradient-conflict methods, and load-balancing losses. With a fully trainable RoBERTa backbone and classification-head experts, GAR has the highest aggregate validation accuracy, 1.07 percentage points above task-loss-only routing. With frozen DeBERTa and Qwen3-1.7B backbones and low-rank adapter experts, it again ranks first, 1.10 points above task-loss-only routing, with better-balanced expert load and higher gradient-mass purity, the share of each expert's gradient-norm mass from its dominant task; the load-balancing losses flatten load further but leave this purity near its task-loss-only level. Top-1 routing, trainable full-parameter feed-forward network (FFN) experts, and a larger backbone also show positive aggregate gains. The results distinguish expert-load balance from gradient-based routing organization and indicate the predictive value of gradient-informed routing in multi-task text classification.

AI.tldr: 该文提出梯度对齐路由（GAR），将路由视为梯度划分问题，用负载归一化的路由目标奖励梯度对齐的样本分组；在多种多任务文本分类混合上，GAR 取得了最高的聚合验证准确率。
AI.motivation: 稀疏专家模型虽然能均衡分配流量，但仍可能把不兼容的训练信号分到同一专家中。作者希望从梯度划分的角度研究路由，使同一专家内的样本具有更一致的梯度方向，从而改善多任务学习中的任务干扰问题。
AI.method: 提出 GAR：以负载归一化的路由目标奖励梯度对齐的观测分组。在五个多任务文本分类混合数据上，与仅用任务损失的路由、梯度组合与梯度冲突方法、负载均衡损失进行对比。实验覆盖全可训练 RoBERTa 主干＋分类头专家、冻结 DeBERTa 与 Qwen3-1.7B 主干＋低秩适配器专家；并考察 Top-1 路由、可训练全参数 FFN 专家、更大主干等设置。评价指标包括聚合验证准确率、专家负载均衡度、梯度质量纯度（各专家梯度范数质量中来自其主导任务的占比）。
AI.result: GAR 在全可训练 RoBERTa 设置下聚合验证准确率最高，比仅用任务损失的路由高 1.07 个百分点；在冻结 DeBERTa 与 Qwen3-1.7B＋低秩适配器设置下再次排名第一，高 1.10 个百分点，同时专家负载更均衡、梯度质量纯度更高。负载均衡损失能进一步压平负载，但纯度仍接近仅用任务损失路由的水平。Top-1 路由、可训练全参数 FFN 专家和更大主干也带来正向聚合增益。
AI.conclusion: 结果区分了“专家负载均衡”与“基于梯度的路由组织”，表明梯度信息指导的路由在多任务文本分类中具有预测价值。

title: Efficient Offline Learning of Ranking Policies via Top-$k$ Policy Decomposition
comment: Published as a conference paper at CIKM 2026
summary: Many recommender systems such as for e-commerce and news platforms aim to provide users with rankings they are likely to interact with. Off-Policy Learning (OPL) of ranking policies enables us to learn new ranking policies using only historical logged data. However, ranking settings make OPL remarkably challenging because their action spaces consist of permutations of unique items, being extremely large. Existing methods primarily use either policy- or regression-based approaches. The policy-based approach, which typically uses importance-weighted policy gradients, can suffer from high variance due to large action spaces. The regression-based approach, on the other hand, estimates the expected reward using conventional machine learning methods, avoiding variance issues but potentially suffering from severe bias. To circumvent these issues of existing methods, we propose a new OPL method for ranking, named Ranking Policy Optimization via Top-$k$ Policy Decomposition (R-POD), which combines the policy- and regression-based approaches in an effective fashion. Specifically, R-POD decomposes a ranking policy into a first-stage policy for selecting top-$k$ actions and a second-stage policy for choosing the bottom actions given the top-$k$ actions. It learns the first-stage policy using a new policy gradient estimator and the second-stage policy via the regression-based approach. This method can substantially reduce variance, since it applies importance weighting only to the top-$k$ actions. We also demonstrate that our policy-gradient estimator for the first-stage policy is unbiased under a conditional pairwise correctness condition, which only requires that the expected reward differences of pairs of rankings sharing the same top-$k$ actions can be estimated correctly.

AI.tldr: 提出R-POD，将排序策略分解为top-k选择的第一阶段策略与底部排序的第二阶段策略，分别用策略梯度估计与回归方法学习，降低方差并保持无偏性。
AI.motivation: 排序策略的离策略学习（OPL）面临动作空间极大（唯一项的排列）的挑战；纯策略梯度方法方差高，纯回归方法偏差大，需兼顾二者优势。
AI.method: 将排序策略分解为两阶段：第一阶段策略选择top-k动作，用新的策略梯度估计器学习；第二阶段在给定top-k的条件下用回归方法选择底部动作。重要性加权仅作用于top-k动作。
AI.result: 相较现有方法显著降低方差；在条件成对正确性条件下，第一阶段策略的策略梯度估计器是无偏的。
AI.conclusion: R-POD有效结合策略型与回归型方法，为排序场景的OPL提供低方差且（在温和条件下）无偏的解决方案。

title: cktFormer: Transformer-Based Approach for Automated Analog Circuit Design
comment: 6 pages, 6 figures, IECON 2025 51st Annual Conference of the IEEE Industrial Electronics Society
summary: Circuit design is a complex and iterative process that requires expertise in electronic engineering. It involves selecting components while meeting performance constraints, such as power efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and signal integrity. However, manual design is time-consuming and prone to errors. Although other stages of the manufacturing pipeline have benefited from AI-driven optimizations, circuit design remains a bottleneck, limiting overall productivity. Generative AI and machine learning offer the potential to automate and improve this stage, boosting efficiency and accuracy. To address this, we introduce a dual transformer architecture that bridges the gap between AI and circuit design by leveraging attention mechanisms to model complex, non-sequential circuit relationships. Our approach structures netlist data into graph-based representations, enabling effective learning of circuit topology and component interactions. The system consists of two interlinked models: a node prediction model that proposes components and an edge prediction model that infers valid connections. This collaborative and decoupled design captures both component-level semantics and global structural coherence. In our experiments, this architecture outperforms recent models such as AnalogGenie and cktGNN in the validity of generated circuits. By addressing key limitations in existing methods, our work advances automation in electronics engineering and contributes a benchmark for AI-driven circuit synthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种双Transformer架构，将网表数据建模为图结构，通过节点预测模型与边预测模型协同完成电路元件选择与连接推断，实现AI驱动的电路设计自动化，在生成电路有效性上优于AnalogGenie和cktGNN。
AI.motivation: 电路设计是复杂且迭代的过程，需人工选择元件并满足功耗、成本、信号完整性等约束，耗时且易出错。虽然制造流程其他环节已受益于AI优化，电路设计仍是瓶颈。生成式AI与机器学习有望自动化并提升该环节的效率与准确性，但现有方法在建模电路复杂、非序列化关系方面存在局限。
AI.method: 提出双Transformer架构，利用注意力机制建模复杂非序列化的电路关系。将网表数据组织为基于图的表示，以学习电路拓扑与元件交互。系统包含两个相互关联的模型：节点预测模型负责提出元件，边预测模型负责推断有效连接。该协作且解耦的设计同时捕获元件级语义与全局结构一致性。
AI.result: 在实验中，该架构在生成电路的有效性方面优于AnalogGenie和cktGNN等近期模型。
AI.conclusion: 该工作针对现有方法的关键局限进行改进，推动了电子工程自动化的进展，并为AI驱动的电路综合提供了基准。

title: Graph-Spectral Flow Matching for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Multivariate time series anomaly detection typically relies on evaluating discrepancies between observations and outputs produced by models trained on normal data. An alternative perspective is to characterize the distribution of normal data through the generative dynamics, i.e., the velocity field, of flow matching models. However, standard flow matching typically adopts linear probability paths that overlook dependencies among variables, leading to a misalignment with the structured data distribution. To address this issue, we propose GRASP, a flow matching framework with a graph-spectral path for multivariate time series anomaly detection. GRASP incorporates graph structure into the probability path by minimizing a fixed-endpoint action that combines kinetic energy with graph Dirichlet energy. This formulation yields a closed-form path based on graph-frequency-dependent hyperbolic interpolation. A velocity predictor trained on normal data then detects anomalies using weighted velocity discrepancies aggregated across source samples, flow times, and graph frequencies. Theoretically, we establish that GRASP is invariant to the choice of Laplacian eigenbasis and decompose its expected oracle anomaly score into bounded endpoint uncertainty and graph-frequency-weighted Fisher discrepancy. Experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate the superior anomaly detection performance of GRASP and validate the effectiveness of its graph-spectral path and weighting mechanism.

AI.tldr: 提出GRASP框架，将图结构与流匹配概率路径融合，用于多元时间序列异常检测。
AI.motivation: 标准流匹配采用线性概率路径，忽略变量间依赖关系，导致与结构化数据分布不匹配，从而影响多元时间序列异常检测效果。
AI.method: GRASP通过最小化结合动能与图狄利克雷能量的固定端点作用量，将图结构引入概率路径，得到基于图频率相关双曲插值的闭式路径。基于正常数据训练速度预测器，利用跨源样本、流时间与图频率聚合的加权速度差异进行异常检测。
AI.result: 理论上证明GRASP对拉普拉斯特征基选择具有不变性，并将期望oracle异常分数分解为有界端点不确定性与图频率加权Fisher差异。在四个基准数据集上，GRASP展现出更优的异常检测性能，并验证了图谱路径与加权机制的有效性。
AI.conclusion: GRASP通过图谱路径流匹配有效建模变量依赖，提升多元时间序列异常检测性能，理论与实验均支持其设计合理性。

title: When Can Prefixes Compile LoRA? Exact Resource-Capped Tests for Frozen Attention
summary: Can a fixed continuous prefix replace a given low-rank adapter while the attention head stays frozen? In this research, we show that the answer depends on the adapter's target through three conditions. First, observability: at one causal readout, every independent key--value prefix sees the content only through the query, attention partition, and value numerator, so a target that differs on two inputs with equal summaries incurs an error floor at every prefix length; norm caps extend this floor to nearly equal summaries. Second, realizability: at a common query, any prefix reduces exactly to two aggregate variables, and the norm-capped optimum is an attained second-order-cone program, also after a fixed output projection; it places two equal-norm rank-one value updates on opposite sides of compilability. Third, implementation: under affine query exposure, $2r$ signed slots approximate a rank-$r$ value update, but their values grow as $O(ε^{-3/2})$, and the construction passes all 400 tolerance checks in float64 yet only 38 in bfloat16. A first-layer GPT-2 readout with fixed token and position meets the common-query condition without clamping activations; at three such heads, the capped optimum leaves 18.4\% to 74.2\% of the projected adapter effect uncompiled, with a head-dependent value--query ordering. All claims concern local approximation at one head, not whole-network equivalence.

AI.tldr: 本文研究：固定连续前缀能否替代某个低秩适配器（注意力头保持冻结）。结论取决于适配器的作用目标，由可观测性、可实现性、实现方式三个条件决定。
AI.motivation: 探究用固定连续前缀替代低秩适配器的可行性，明确替代成立的条件及其局限。
AI.method: 通过可观测性分析（一处因果读出下独立key-value前缀仅经query、注意力划分与value分子观察内容，存在误差下界）、可实现性分析（公共query下前缀化为两个聚合变量，范数受限最优解为二阶锥规划）、实现分析（仿射query暴露下用2r个带符号槽位近似秩r的value更新）展开理论与数值验证（含GPT-2首层读出实验）。
AI.result: 不可观测目标在每个前缀长度上存在误差下界；范数受限最优解为可达的二阶锥规划，并将两个等范数秩一value更新置于可编译性的两侧；2r带符号槽位可近似秩r更新但取值按O(ε^{-3/2})增长，float64通过全部400项容差检验而bfloat16仅38项；GPT-2首层三头未能编译18.4%–74.2%的投影适配器效应。
AI.conclusion: 固定连续前缀替代低秩适配器的可行性受目标可观测性、可实现性与数值精度制约；结论仅限单头局部近似，不等价于整网等价。

title: Harnessing Large Language Models to Compile Task-Relevant Context into Bayesian Optimisation
summary: Incorporating rich task-relevant context, such as domain knowledge and external observations, is a key capability yet remains challenging for Bayesian optimisation (BO). Recently, practitioners have started to use large language models (LLMs) to generate and execute BO programs through coding harnesses. In such emerging practices, the posterior belief is shaped not only by Bayesian inference but also by LLM-generated model and data artefacts, offering a flexible route for task context to enter BO as executable code. To study whether and how LLMs can be harnessed to compile diverse contextual signals for BO, we formulate LLM-compiled BO as generalised-context decision making. We propose HarBO, a BO-specialised harness that compiles generalised context into the core artefacts of standard BO through a validated multi-stage workflow. Our theory analyses the regret under imperfect compilation and the effect of adding new context. Across synthetic functions and real-world benchmarks, we find that LLM harnesses can effectively compile context into standard BO, achieving competitive performance with specialised LLM-embedding-based and direct LLM-in-the-loop BO methods. General coding harnesses can be effective in familiar domains such as hyperparameter optimisation, but fall short in unfamiliar, context-rich domains. Together, these results establish LLM harnesses as a promising, but not automatically reliable, route for making rich task context usable in BO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HarBO——一种面向贝叶斯优化（BO）的 LLM 专用编码框架，将通用上下文编译为标准 BO 的核心组件，并通过遗憾分析与多类基准实验验证其有效性及局限。
AI.motivation: BO 融入任务相关上下文（领域知识、外部观测）能力强但实现困难。近期实践者用 LLM 通过编码框架生成并执行 BO 程序，使后验信念不仅由贝叶斯推断塑造，也受 LLM 生成的模型与数据产物影响，为上下文以可执行代码形式进入 BO 提供灵活路径。作者希望系统研究 LLM 能否及如何被用于编译多样化的上下文信号以服务于 BO。
AI.method: 将 LLM-compiled BO 形式化为广义上下文决策问题（generalised-context decision making）；提出 HarBO——一个 BO 专用编码框架，通过经校验的多阶段工作流把广义上下文编译进标准 BO 的核心组件（模型与数据产物）。并从理论上分析不完美编译下的遗憾界以及新增上下文带来的影响。
AI.result: 在合成函数与真实基准上，LLM 编码框架能有效将上下文编译为标准 BO，性能与基于 LLM 嵌入的专用方法及直接 LLM-in-the-loop 的 BO 方法具有竞争力。通用编码框架在超参数优化等熟悉领域表现良好，但在不熟悉、上下文丰富的领域效果不足。
AI.conclusion: LLM 编码框架是将丰富任务上下文用于 BO 的一条有前景但并非自动可靠的路径，其可靠性依赖于领域熟悉度与编译质量。

title: RAE-PPG: Duration-Grounded Retain-and-Extend Pretraining for PPG Foundation Models
summary: Signal features derived from photoplethysmography (PPG) require different signal durations to characterize. Existing PPG foundation models treat duration as a pretraining or evaluation condition rather than using the different durations required by PPG features to organize self-supervision. We hypothesize that self-supervision should expand with signal duration, allowing a single encoder to progressively acquire additional features while preserving and reusing earlier learning. We introduce Retain-and-Extend PPG (RAE-PPG), which trains a single Transformer encoder successively on 10 s, 30 s, and 240 s inputs, adding supervision for signal features supported by each longer observation. The encoder is partitioned into duration-specific parameter groups, allowing later stages to reuse earlier groups while updating only the group assigned to the current stage. Selected earlier targets are reused to supervise later stages, encouraging the corresponding features to remain accessible in longer-input representations. Direct decoding from the final encoder shows that earlier features remain recoverable from longer-input representations, while later-stage features show higher mean decoding performance at their introduction durations. Controlled comparisons further show that prior-stage learning provides a better basis for learning newly introduced features at both transitions. Across 18 tasks from eight datasets, the final frozen encoder achieves the best observed score on 12 tasks compared with five existing PPG foundation models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RAE-PPG：一种按 10s→30s→240s 逐级扩展自监督的 PPG 基础模型预训练框架，单一 Transformer 编码器通过“保留—扩展”的分组参数与目标复用机制，在长时输入下保持早期特征可解码，并在 18 项任务中的 12 项取得最优。
AI.motivation: PPG 不同信号特征所需的时间长度不同，但现有 PPG 基础模型仅把时长当作预训练或评测条件，未利用“特征所需的差异化时长”来组织自监督学习，导致无法在延长观测时系统性地积累与复用已学特征。
AI.method: RAE-PPG 使用单个 Transformer 编码器，依次在 10s、30s、240s 输入上训练；编码器按时长划分为特定参数组，后续阶段可复用早期参数组，仅更新当前阶段对应的参数组；同时为每个更长观测所支持的信号特征增加监督目标，并复用部分早期目标来监督后续阶段。由此实现自监督随信号时长扩展，并在长输入表示中保留早期特征。
AI.result: 对最终编码器的直接解码显示：早期特征在长输入表示中仍可恢复，后期阶段特征在其引入时长下平均解码性能更高。受控对比表明，在两个阶段切换处，前序阶段的学习均为新引入特征的学习提供了更好的基础。在来自 8 个数据集的 18 项任务上，冻结的最终编码器在 12 项任务上取得了所观测到的最佳分数，优于五个现有 PPG 基础模型。
AI.conclusion: 按信号时长扩展自监督、并以分组参数保留早期知识、复用早期目标，可使单一 PPG 编码器随观测时长渐进获得更多特征而不遗忘已有能力，从而在广泛下游任务上取得优于现有 PPG 基础模型的迁移性能。

title: EasyPPO: Stabilizing the Critic Is Key
summary: A key strength of Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) is its learned critic, which uses historical trajectories collected during reinforcement learning to estimate expected returns and reduce policy-gradient variance. However, we find that the critic is also a major source of instability in reinforcement learning for large language models (LLMs). We identify two critic failure modes that destabilize PPO. First, filtering truncated rollouts from both actor and critic shifts the policy objective to reward conditioned on completion, allowing truncation to increase even as conditional reward improves. Second, heterogeneous return noise can cause high-variance prompts to dominate critic updates in finite batches. We introduce EasyPPO to address these failures. Actor-only overlong filtering trains the critic on returns from both completed and truncated rollouts. Noise-normalized critic regression weights each prompt's critic loss by the inverse standard deviation of its sampled returns, balancing noise contributions across prompts. Moderately smaller critic mini-batches confine outlier influence to fewer rollouts during gradient clipping. Across continuous-reward coding on FrontierCS, binary-reward mathematical reasoning on AIME24, and multi-turn search on Search-R1, EasyPPO remains stable throughout the full training horizon and consistently outperforms vanilla PPO, VAPO, and HL-Gauss PPO. Its best validation scores show relative gains of 14.89%, 2.28%, and 9.47% over PPO, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文发现PPO用于大语言模型强化学习时，其critic是导致训练不稳定的主要来源，并提出EasyPPO通过actor-only超长过滤、噪声归一化critic回归和适度更小的critic小批量来稳定训练，在多项任务上优于PPO、VAPO和HL-Gauss PPO。
AI.motivation: PPO的关键优势在于其学习到的critic，可利用历史轨迹估计期望回报并降低策略梯度方差。然而作者发现，在大语言模型强化学习中，critic也是不稳定的主要来源，存在两种导致PPO失稳的失败模式：一是过滤截断轨迹会改变策略目标，二是异构回报噪声会使高方差提示主导critic更新。
AI.method: EasyPPO包含三项设计：1）actor-only超长过滤（actor-only overlong filtering），让critic在完整与截断轨迹的回报上训练；2）噪声归一化critic回归（noise-normalized critic regression），用每个提示采样回报的标准差倒数对其critic损失加权，平衡不同提示的噪声贡献；3）适度更小的critic小批量，将离群值影响限制在更少轨迹内，配合梯度裁剪。
AI.result: 在FrontierCS连续奖励编程、AIME24二元奖励数学推理和Search-R1多轮搜索三个任务上，EasyPPO在整个训练过程中保持稳定，并持续优于vanilla PPO、VAPO和HL-Gauss PPO。其最佳验证分数相对PPO分别提升14.89%、2.28%和9.47%。
AI.conclusion: critic是LLM强化学习不稳定的关键来源，EasyPPO针对两种critic失败模式提出的改进能有效提升训练稳定性与最终性能，验证了该方法在多任务场景下的有效性和通用性。

title: RESCUE: Repairing Language Model Errors to Sparse Circuits via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong general capabilities that mechanistic interpretability has attributed to sparse computational circuits. However, existing circuit studies emphasize preserving functionality or explaining safety, leaving the mechanisms underlying failures across a broader range of tasks largely unexplored. Extending circuit analysis from abilities to errors, we explore the perspective that such failures may likewise arise from erroneous internal computations and that targeted tuning of the corresponding parameters can correct such errors while largely preserving other capabilities. Motivated by this insight, we introduce RESCUE (Reasoning-Error Sparse-Circuit Uncovering and Editing), a framework that localizes error-associated circuits and surgically repairs them for performance enhancement. General tasks typically involve multi-step reasoning and long-form generation, where early deviations can cause prefixes to drift from supervised references, leading SFT-based mask optimization to overlook circuits involved in generation-time errors. RESCUE therefore refines these masks through reinforcement learning with multiple masked-model rollouts, improving their relevance to observed task failures. Finally, RESCUE introduces a pruning technique and precisely fine-tunes error circuits to correct task failures, thereby translating error localization into a sparse and targeted model update. We validate RESCUE on heterogeneous repair sets across two domains: (1) mathematical reasoning, identifying a math error circuit of 1.40% density whose repair raises accuracy from 6.0% to 75.5%; and (2) medical QA, where a similarly compact 1.44% circuit improves repair-set accuracy from 0% to 81%. Our code is available at: https://github.com/chuanpupig/RESCUE.

AI.tldr: RESCUE框架将机械可解释性的电路分析从"能力"扩展到"错误"，通过强化学习优化掩码定位错误电路并精准微调，实现稀疏、定向的模型修复。
AI.motivation: 现有电路研究多侧重保持功能或解释安全性，对跨任务失败背后的机制探索不足。作者提出假设：任务失败同样源于错误的内部计算，针对性地调整相应参数即可纠正错误，同时基本保留其他能力。
AI.method: 提出RESCUE（Reasoning-Error Sparse-Circuit Uncovering and Editing）框架：首先定位与错误相关的电路；针对多步推理和长文本生成中早期偏差导致前缀漂移、使基于SFT的掩码优化忽略生成期错误电路的问题，采用强化学习结合多次掩码模型rollout来精炼掩码，提升其与观测失败的相关性；最后引入剪枝技术，对错误电路进行精准微调，将错误定位转化为稀疏且定向的模型更新。
AI.result: 在两个领域的异构修复集上验证：(1)数学推理，识别出密度1.40%的数学错误电路，修复后准确率从6.0%提升至75.5%；(2)医学问答，密度1.44%的紧凑电路将修复集准确率从0%提升至81%。
AI.conclusion: 错误可由稀疏的内部计算电路承载，通过定位并精准编辑这些错误电路，可在极少参数（约1.4%密度）改动下显著纠正任务失败，实现从能力分析向错误分析的范式扩展。

title: Towards Better Training Signal: Advantage Clipped Policy Optimization
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a cornerstone for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), but the need for on-policy data substantially limits training efficiency. Reusing off-policy data through importance sampling (IS) can improve efficiency but introduce considerable instability. Hence, algorithms such as PPO and GRPO widely adopt IS-ratio clipping to stabilize training. However, training stability and gradient estimate are mainly determined by the product of IS ratio and advantage. To further stabilize training, we propose ACPO, which clips the product of the IS ratio and the advantage, leading to more stable gradient estimates. We also establish a connection between ACPO and gradient clipping in policy mirror descent (PMD), which is a standard technique to stabilize optimization process, and prove the convergence of clipped-PMD under the standard RL setting. Experiments on widely used mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that ACPO consistently outperforms PPO and GRPO in both accuracy and training efficiency, delivering 4-6 percentage points gains on standard math benchmarks, with Qwen3-8B+PPO. Hence, ACPO is a practical and effective alternative to conventional IS-ratio clipping for RL post-training of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出 ACPO 算法，通过裁剪重要性采样比率与优势函数的乘积来获得更稳定的梯度估计，并建立了其与策略镜像下降中梯度裁剪的联系，证明收敛性。在数学推理基准上优于 PPO 和 GRPO，准确率提升 4-6 个百分点。
AI.motivation: 强化学习已成为提升大语言模型推理能力的关键手段，但在线（on-policy）数据的采集严重限制训练效率。复用离线（off-policy）数据虽能通过重要性采样提升效率，却会引入显著的不稳定性。PPO、GRPO 等算法广泛采用 IS 比率裁剪来稳定训练，但现有方法未针对稳定性与梯度估计的核心因素进行优化。
AI.method: 作者指出训练稳定性与梯度估计主要由 IS 比率与优势函数的乘积决定。据此提出 ACPO，直接裁剪 IS 比率与优势的乘积，从而获得更稳定的梯度估计。同时建立 ACPO 与策略镜像下降（PMD）中梯度裁剪的联系，并在标准 RL 设定下证明了裁剪版 PMD 的收敛性。
AI.result: 在常用数学推理基准上，ACPO 在准确率和训练效率上均持续优于 PPO 和 GRPO，在标准数学基准上取得 4-6 个百分点的提升（如 Qwen3-8B+PPO 配置下）。
AI.conclusion: ACPO 是面向 LLM 强化学习后训练中传统 IS 比率裁剪的一种实用且有效的替代方案。

title: RolloutFaith: Auditing Persistent Internal Interventions in Visual World Model
summary: Interpretability methods such as probes, activation patches and learned editors are designed to reveal or modify a model's current computation. World models pose a harder requirement: because their predictions become inputs to later predictions, a useful internal correction must survive after editing stops. We therefore propose RolloutFaith, a framework that measures semantic improvement both in the prediction produced at intervention time and over later autonomous predictions under fixed events, actions, noise, and information budgets. We evaluate ten fitted editors on three world models across Crafter, Cartpole, and CoinRun. We also use Reference Activation Patching, which replaces a model activation with the paired activation computed from the real observation, to measure the correction available at the chosen interface. This reference intervention improves later predictions in all nine model and task combinations and outperforms the best fitted editor in eight, yet its sustained gain decreases with horizon in five of nine combinations. Current fitted editors recover only limited and inconsistent long term effects. By restoring individual state components to their untouched values, we find that persistent effects travel through the newest generated frame in DIAMOND, recurrent memory in DreamerV3, and both in STORM. These findings suggest that training should reward future consequences. To test this hypothesis, we propose Delayed LoReFT, which optimizes the same low rank intervention through four frozen future transitions and improves sustained intervention effects to some extent.

AI.tldr: 提出RolloutFaith框架评估世界模型内部干预的持续效果，发现参考激活补丁优于拟合编辑器但持续性随视界衰减，并据此提出Delayed LoReFT以奖励未来后果。
AI.motivation: 世界模型预测会作为后续预测的输入，因此有效内部修正必须在干预停止后仍持续生效；而传统可解释性方法（probes、activation patches、learned editors）只针对干预时刻的计算，无法衡量这种持续性要求。
AI.method: 提出RolloutFaith，在干预时刻和后续自主预测（固定事件、动作、噪声与信息预算）上测量语义提升；在Crafter、Cartpole、CoinRun三个任务、三个世界模型上评估十个拟合编辑器；引入Reference Activation Patching（用真实观测的配对激活替换模型激活）测量选定接口的可用修正；通过将单个状态分量恢复为未修改值定位持续效应通道；提出Delayed LoReFT，经四个冻结未来转移优化同一低秩干预。
AI.result: 参考干预在全部9个模型-任务组合中提升后续预测，并在8个组合中优于最佳拟合编辑器，但其持续增益在9个组合中有5个随视界下降；现有拟合编辑器仅恢复有限且不一致的长期效果；持续效应在DIAMOND中经最新生成帧传递，DreamerV3中经循环记忆传递，STORM中两者兼具；Delayed LoReFT在一定程度上提升了持续干预效果。
AI.conclusion: 持续内部修正难以由现有拟合编辑器实现，其传播依赖特定状态通道；结果支持训练时应奖励未来后果，Delayed LoReFT初步验证了该假设。

title: An Effective, Reliable, and Robust Framework for Human Activity Recognition Using Wearable Sensors
summary: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) through wearable sensors greatly improves the quality of human life through its multiple applications. For HAR, multi-sensor channel information is vital for optimal performance. Current work states that applying an attention neural network to prioritize discriminatory sensor channels helps the model classify activity more precisely. However, obtaining discriminatory information from multisensory channels is not always trivial, such as when collecting data from older hospitalized patients. In this context, existing HAR methods struggle to classify activities, particularly activities with similar natures. Moreover, HAR models predominantly suffer from overfitting due to the small size of available datasets, which leads to poor performance. Data augmentation (DA) is a viable solution to this problem. However, available DA methods have various drawbacks, including the possibility of being domain-dependent, resulting in distorted models for test sequences. To address these HAR problems, we propose a novel framework, ALAE-TAE-CutMix+, which focuses on two aspects. First, it enhances the latent information across each sensor channel and learns to exploit the relation among multiple latent features and the ongoing activity. Consequently, the discriminatory feature representations of each activity is enriched. Second, a new augmentation strategy is introduced to address the shortcomings of existing multi-sensor channel data augmentation. We then extend the framework to create a further enhanced version, namely ALAE-CIE-TAE-CutMix+, which learns to capture the interactions between the features of each pair of sensor channels. We find that although the first framework performs slightly better than the latter, the latter is nonetheless more reliable and robust. Both frameworks significantly outperform SOTA approaches on the four HAR datasets from diverse domains.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对可穿戴传感器人体活动识别（HAR）中多通道判别信息难获取、小样本易过拟合及现有数据增强（DA）方法存在领域依赖等问题，提出 ALAE-TAE-CutMix+ 框架，并进一步扩展为 ALAE-CIE-TAE-CutMix+，在四个跨领域 HAR 数据集上显著优于 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 多传感器通道信息对 HAR 性能至关重要，注意力机制可优先关注判别性通道，但在老年住院患者等场景下，从多感官通道获取判别信息并非易事，且相似活动难以区分。同时，可用数据集规模小导致 HAR 模型普遍过拟合，而现有数据增强方法存在领域依赖、测试序列上模型失真等缺陷。
AI.method: 提出 ALAE-TAE-CutMix+ 框架，聚焦两方面：一是增强每个传感器通道的潜在信息，学习建模多潜在特征与当前活动之间的关系，从而丰富各活动的判别性特征表示；二是引入新的数据增强策略以克服现有多传感器通道数据增强的不足。在此基础上扩展出 ALAE-CIE-TAE-CutMix+，进一步学习捕获每对传感器通道特征之间的交互。
AI.result: 第一个框架性能略优于第二个框架，但后者更可靠、更稳健；两个框架在来自不同领域的四个 HAR 数据集上均显著优于 SOTA 方法。
AI.conclusion: ALAE-TAE-CutMix+ 与 ALAE-CIE-TAE-CutMix+ 能有效缓解多传感器 HAR 中判别信息提取困难、相似活动区分难及小样本过拟合问题，并通过通道交互建模提升鲁棒性，跨领域验证了其优越性与稳健性。

title: Markovian Nonconvex ADMM for Reinforcement Learning: Bellman-Resolvent Stability Beyond Smooth Blocks
summary: We identify and study a structural mechanism for Markovian nonconvex ADMM in reinforcement learning. Using finite discounted MDPs as a canonical proving ground, we show that the discounted Bellman resolvent $(I-γP_π)^{-1}$ can provide the multiplier stability that classical nonconvex ADMM analyses often obtain from a designated smooth block. Starting from this mechanism, we establish convergence under controlled Markov sampling and then under stochastic observations using an empirical Bellman surrogate that jointly represents the random residual and its Jacobian. Markov mixing, initialization drift, observation noise, and decaying bias enter as one operator perturbation, avoiding unbiased product and double sampling requirements. When the perturbations are square summable, the true KKT residual converges almost surely to zero. Under a finite conditional fourth moment condition, a companion iterate satisfies $ \mathbb{E}[\widetilde G_{K+1}] \le A/T+(B/T)\sum_{k<T}m_k^{-1}, $ which becomes $O(T^{-1}+T/N)$ for total Markov sample budget $N$, giving $O(ε^{-1})$ iteration complexity and $O(ε^{-2})$ sample complexity for squared KKT accuracy $ε$. Beyond stationarity, discounted occupancy coverage yields $J^\star-J(π)=O(\sqrt G)$ for direct tabular policies, so covered exact KKT points are globally optimal, while a statewise quadratic Bellman-improvement condition sharpens the relation to $O(G)$. Finally, nonlinear policy, projected Bellman, and explicit occupancy formulations exhibit the same chain of operator invertibility, dual representation, and multiplier stability. This supports discounted operator invertibility as a reusable structural principle for primal-dual reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 本文识别并研究强化学习中马尔可夫非凸ADMM的一个结构性机制：折扣Bellman预解算子 $(I-\gamma P_\pi)^{-1}$ 可提供经典非凸ADMM分析中通常依赖指定光滑块获得的多乘子稳定性。基于该机制，作者在受控马尔可夫采样与随机观测下建立了收敛性，得到 $O(\varepsilon^{-1})$ 迭代复杂度与 $O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ 样本复杂度，并进一步刻画了KKT点与全局最优性之间的关系。
AI.motivation: 经典非凸ADMM分析通常需要指定一个光滑块来获得乘子稳定性，或依赖无偏乘积、双采样等较强假设，这在强化学习的马尔可夫采样与随机观测情形下难以满足。作者希望在有限折扣MDP这一典型设定下，找到一种可复用的结构性机制，使ADMM类原对偶方法在马尔可夫噪声下仍可证明收敛，并澄清平稳性与全局最优性之间的联系。
AI.method: 以有限折扣MDP为证明平台，利用折扣Bellman预解算子 $(I-\gamma P_\pi)^{-1}$ 提供乘子稳定性。先在受控马尔可夫采样下建立收敛，再通过经验Bellman替代量（同时表示随机残差及其Jacobi矩阵）处理随机观测。将马尔可夫混合、初始化漂移、观测噪声与衰减偏差统一为单一算子扰动，从而避免无偏乘积与双采样要求。进一步分析折扣占用测度覆盖条件，并讨论非线性策略、投影Bellman与显式占用等表述。
AI.result: 当扰动平方可和时，真实KKT残差几乎必然收敛到零。在有限条件四阶矩条件下，伴随迭代满足 $\mathbb{E}[\widetilde G_{K+1}] \le A/T+(B/T)\sum_{k<T}m_k^{-1}$，对总马尔可夫样本预算 $N$ 化为 $O(T^{-1}+T/N)$，从而对平方KKT精度 $\varepsilon$ 得到 $O(\varepsilon^{-1})$ 迭代复杂度与 $O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ 样本复杂度。在最优性方面，折扣占用覆盖给出直接表格策略满足 $J^\star-J(\pi)=O(\sqrt G)$，故被覆盖的精确KKT点是全局最优；状态逐二次Bellman改进条件可将该关系加强为 $O(G)$。非线性策略、投影Bellman与显式占用表述呈现相同的算子可逆、对偶表示与乘子稳定性链条。
AI.conclusion: 折扣算子可逆性可作为原对偶强化学习中一个可复用的结构性原理，为马尔可夫非凸ADMM在强化学习中的收敛性与最优性分析提供统一框架。

title: Where the Model Changes Its Mind: Hindsight-Divergence Localization for Efficient Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
summary: Group-relative methods for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) learn from differences in rollout outcomes. Independently sampling complete trajectories is costly and does not explicitly explore the decision space at critical positions. Feedback on a completed trajectory can reveal which earlier choices the policy reconsiders, suggesting where to sample alternative continuations. We introduce Hindsight-Divergence Localization (HDL), which uses hindsight-induced changes in token log-likelihoods to select branch points. HDL generates a small number of complete root trajectories and fills each training group with continuations from the selected positions under the original task context. Each continuation reuses its root prefix and contributes policy updates only through its newly generated suffix, reducing generation cost while focusing additional exploration and learning on decisions after branching. Experiments with three models across math, code, and agent tasks show gains in both rollout efficiency and task performance. Compared with GRPO at matched group sizes and training steps, HDL yields up to a 2.5$\times$ reduction in generated tokens and a 1.8$\times$ speedup in rollout wall-clock time. Despite this reduced generation budget, HDL improves performance across all three domains, with gains of up to 12.5 points on agent tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Hindsight-Divergence Localization（HDL），利用后见诱导的 token 对数似然变化定位关键分支点，从少量根轨迹的分支位置生成续写以填充训练组，在降低生成成本的同时提升 RLVR 性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于组相对优势的 RLVR 方法依赖 rollout 结果差异学习，但独立采样完整轨迹代价高昂，且未能在关键决策位置显式探索决策空间。完整轨迹的反馈可揭示策略会重新考虑哪些早期选择，从而指示应在何处采样替代续写。
AI.method: HDL 通过后见诱导的 token 对数似然变化选择分支点。方法生成少量完整根轨迹，并在原始任务上下文下从所选位置填充每个训练组的续写。每条续写复用其根前缀，仅通过新生成的 suffix 贡献策略更新，从而降低生成成本，并将额外探索与学习集中在分支后的决策上。
AI.result: 在数学、代码和智能体任务上使用三个模型实验，rollout 效率与任务性能均有提升。与 GRPO 在相同组规模和训练步数下相比，HDL 生成 token 最多减少 2.5 倍，rollout 墙钟时间加速 1.8 倍。在降低生成预算的情况下，HDL 在三个领域均提升性能，智能体任务上最高提升 12.5 分。
AI.conclusion: HDL 通过后见散度定位关键分支点并复用前缀，实现了更高效的探索与策略更新，在显著减少生成开销的同时提升多领域任务表现，为 RLVR 的 rollout 效率问题提供了有效方案。

title: Seeing Time: Visual-Temporal Representation Learning for Interpretable Time Series Clustering
summary: Multivariate Time Series (MTS) clustering is an important tool in temporal data mining, aiming to discover latent group structures from complex observations without supervision. Although existing deep clustering methods can learn discriminative temporal representations, the resulting latent clusters are often difficult to relate back to waveform characteristics that practitioners can directly inspect and compare, limiting their ability to assess whether the discovered patterns reflect meaningful temporal behaviors. This paper, therefore, proposes WAVE (Waveform Aligned Visual-temporal Embedding), which treats time series and their deterministically rendered waveform plots as complementary views of the same observations. To produce discriminative representations whose cluster structures can be traced to observable waveform characteristics, WAVE aligns and integrates fine-grained temporal variations with holistic visual patterns, while associating each discovered cluster with its centroid-nearest authentic sample. Accordingly, interpretability in this work specifically refers to waveform-level traceability rather than a general explanation of model decisions. Extensive evaluations across 10 real-world public datasets show that WAVE achieves the highest macro-averaged clustering performance and the best average rank among the compared methods, while qualitative case studies illustrate how the discovered clusters can be inspected through authentic waveform records. The source code is available at https://github.com/Zheng-Zhu1/WAVE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多元时间序列聚类方法WAVE，将时序与其确定性渲染的波形图作为同一观测的互补视图进行对齐融合，并把每个簇关联到距离质心最近的真实样本，从而实现波形级可追溯的聚类解释。
AI.motivation: 现有深度聚类方法虽能学到有判别性的时序表示，但其潜在簇结构难以与从业者可直接查看和比较的波形特征建立联系，导致无法判断所发现模式是否反映有意义的时序行为，因此需要提升聚类的波形级可追溯性。
AI.method: WAVE（Waveform Aligned Visual-temporal Embedding）将时间序列与其确定性渲染的波形图视为同一观测的互补视图，对齐并融合细粒度时序变化与整体视觉模式，生成簇结构可追溯至可观测波形特征的判别性表示；同时将每个发现的簇与其质心最近的真实样本关联。文中可解释性特指波形级可追溯性，而非对模型决策的一般性解释。
AI.result: 在10个真实世界公开数据集上的大量评估表明，WAVE在宏平均聚类性能上最高，并在所比较方法中取得最佳平均排名；定性案例研究显示所发现的簇可通过真实波形记录进行检视。源码见 https://github.com/Zheng-Zhu1/WAVE。
AI.conclusion: 通过时序-视觉双视图对齐融合并将簇锚定到真实波形样本，WAVE在保持强聚类性能的同时实现了波形级可追溯性，为无监督时序数据挖掘提供了可检视的聚类结果。

title: What You Observe Determines How You Identify Causal Effects: Evaluating Causal Models across Observational Views
summary: Causal foundation models (CFMs) pre-trained on data generated from various structural causal models (SCMs) have been proposed for estimating causal effects from observational data. However, differences in pre-training environments and evaluation protocols make it difficult to assess how their performance depends on the information available for causal identification. To enable controlled comparisons, we introduce CausalIDView, a multi-view benchmark that holds fixed SCM realization and target estimand while varying only the observational view available to the estimator. Each observational view corresponds to a distinct identification regime under the benchmark's maintained causal assumptions. Across these matched views, no CFM consistently performs best and model rankings vary substantially. Under controlled structural changes, CFMs exhibit model-specific failures to maintain stable estimates when true effects are unchanged and to track genuine effect changes. We also examine whether combining explicit identification with strong predictive estimation is effective. A modular approach that pairs a predictive tabular foundation model with regime-specific identification procedures is competitive with CFMs and outperforms several of them. These findings motivate cross-regime comparisons to assess the empirical value of CFMs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CausalIDView多视图基准，在固定SCM实现和估计目标的前提下仅改变观测视图，对因果基础模型(CFMs)进行跨识别机制的可控比较，发现无模型全能胜出、模型排名波动大，且模块化"预测模型+识别程序"方法可与之竞争。
AI.motivation: 现有CFMs虽被用于从观测数据估计因果效应，但预训练环境与评估协议不一致，难以判断其性能如何依赖于因果识别所需的信息，缺乏可控、可比的评估手段。
AI.method: 构建CausalIDView多视图基准：固定SCM实现与目标估计量，仅变换估计器可用的观测视图，每个视图对应基准所维持因果假设下的不同识别机制；在不同匹配视图间比较多个CFMs，并进行受控结构变化实验，同时考察"显式识别+强预测估计"的模块化方法（预测型表格基础模型配合识别机制专用程序）。
AI.result: 在各匹配视图上，没有CFM始终表现最佳，模型排名差异显著；在受控结构变化下，CFMs出现模型特有失效：真实效应不变时估计不稳定，真实效应变化时又无法跟踪。模块化方法竞争力强，可超越多个CFMs。
AI.conclusion: 应通过跨识别机制的对比来评估CFMs的实际经验价值；单视图评估不足以反映其真实能力，显式识别与强预测估计的结合是有前景的方向。

title: Architecture Alignment With Sparse Priors in Tabular Foundation Models
summary: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are increasingly popular because they deliver strong predictions on new datasets through in-context learning, without task-specific training or extensive tuning. Yet released TFMs differ simultaneously in their pretraining priors, architectures, and objectives, obscuring their respective inductive biases. We therefore examine one concrete capability: irrelevant-feature suppression. Across synthetic tasks and real-world datasets, adding null features causes substantially greater predictive degradation in the row-token model TabDPT, whereas the cell-token alternating-axis model TabPFN v2 and other TFMs remain comparatively stable. This gap motivates us to ask whether architecture contributes to irrelevant-feature suppression. Because released TFMs remain confounded by other design choices, we train streamlined row-token and alternating-axis transformers under identical sparse-to-dense linear priors. Exact Bayes analysis shows that sparse prediction requires context-dependent feature gating, whereas the dense endpoint requires only uniform feature weighting. Consistent with this distinction, the alternating-axis model is substantially closer to the Bayesian optimal predictor on sparse tasks, while the architecture gap becomes negligible on dense tasks; almost all of the sparse gap arises from linear coefficient-estimation error. Finally, in both the controlled model and frozen TabPFN v2, we examine the effect of interventions on the feature-attention outputs on the linear coefficients, finding evidence of task-dependent selective routing of computation through feature-indexed pathways. Together, these results support architecture-prior alignment: preserving an addressable feature axis provides an inductive bias for task-adaptive relevance inference. Code is available at https://github.com/Tianqi-Zhao/ArchitecturePriorTFMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究表格基础模型（TFMs）中无关特征抑制能力，发现行token模型TabDPT在加入空特征时性能显著下降，而交替轴cell-token模型TabPFN v2较稳定，并通过控制实验证明架构本身贡献了这种差异，支持"架构-先验对齐"假说。
AI.motivation: 已发布的TFMs在预训练先验、架构和目标上同时存在差异，导致难以厘清各自的归纳偏置。本文聚焦一个具体能力——无关特征抑制，以解耦架构的影响。
AI.method: 在合成任务与真实数据集上比较TabDPT与TabPFN v2等模型对空特征的鲁棒性；在相同的稀疏到稠密线性先验下训练简化的行token与交替轴transformer；用精确贝叶斯分析刻画稀疏与稠密端点的最优预测器；并对特征注意力输出进行干预实验。
AI.result: 加入空特征使TabDPT预测退化明显大于TabPFN v2及其他TFMs。在稀疏任务上，交替轴模型显著更接近贝叶斯最优预测器，稀疏差距几乎全部来自线性系数估计误差；在稠密任务上架构差距可忽略。对模型和冻结TabPFN v2的干预显示存在任务依赖的、经特征索引通路的选择性计算路由。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏预测需要上下文相关的特征门控，而稠密端点只需均匀特征加权；保留可寻址的特征轴为任务自适应相关性推断提供了归纳偏置，支持架构-先验对齐的观点。

title: SINO: Scale-Invariant Neural Operator
summary: In scientific machine learning, physical fields governed by partial differential equations exhibit low-rank structure and scale invariance. When solving equations on coarse grids, missing information leads to the closure problem: modeling unresolved physics to recover lost dynamics. Although closure terms depend on grid resolution, they represent scale-invariant physical laws. A model truly learning physics should capture these mechanisms with low-rank parameterization rather than memorizing grid-specific patterns. Inspired by this, we propose the Scale-Invariant Neural Operator (SINO), which learns on normalized physical scales via a dual-branch architecture operating in spectral and spatial domains. SINO uses bottleneck MLPs to generate continuous convolution kernels, embedding an explicit low-rank inductive bias that concentrates more than 95 percent of variance in 2-3 modes, as validated by PCA across benchmarks, while drastically reducing parameters. This principled design yields 38 times steeper scaling law exponents than FNO, demonstrating superior parameter efficiency. We compare SINO with traditional models (U-Net, DeepONet), Transformer models (Transolver, Oformer, GK-Transformer), and frequency-domain models (FNO, AMFNO, UFNO) on closure problems spanning externally forced Burgers turbulence, decaying Burgers turbulence, KS turbulence, Kolmogorov-forced NS turbulence, and decaying NS turbulence. Experiments show SINO achieves 1.5-38 times error reduction and 2-23 times parameter efficiency over baselines, with superior scaling laws reflecting exceptional data efficiency from principled low-rank design. Code is available at https://github.com/AI4Science-WestlakeU/SINO.

AI.tldr: 提出尺度不变神经算子SINO，通过双分支谱-空间架构学习归一化物理尺度上的封闭项，以显式低秩归纳偏置实现高参数效率与优越缩放律。
AI.motivation: 科学机器学习中，PDE控制的物理场具有低秩结构与尺度不变性。粗网格求解时缺失信息导致封闭问题。封闭项虽依赖网格分辨率，却表征尺度不变的物理定律。真正学习物理的模型应以低秩参数化捕获机制，而非记忆特定网格模式。
AI.method: SINO在归一化物理尺度上学习，采用谱域与空间域双分支架构，使用瓶颈MLP生成连续卷积核，嵌入显式低秩归纳偏置以大幅减少参数量。
AI.result: PCA验证超95%方差集中于2-3个模态；缩放律指数比FNO陡38倍。在强迫/衰减Burgers湍流、KS湍流、Kolmogorov强迫/衰减NS湍流上，相比U-Net、DeepONet、Transolver、Oformer、GK-Transformer、FNO、AMFNO、UFNO等基线，误差降低1.5-38倍，参数效率提升2-23倍。
AI.conclusion: SINO凭借有原则的低秩设计，在封闭问题上展现卓越数据效率与缩放律，代码已开源。

title: Variational Mixtures and Multi-Marginal Flow Matching: Advancing Statistical Inference with Biological Applications
summary: In this thesis I develop methods for statistical inference when the distributions arising from complex biological systems are multi-modal, geometrically structured, and sometimes only defined up to a normalizing constant. I start from variational inference and, when analytic update equations are unavailable, move to black-box variational inference. To build intuition regarding inference challenges and the proposed methodologies, I introduce a novel unnormalized target density (the CoLN distribution) and reuse it as a controlled test case in the kappa. I then trace a trajectory of increasingly expressive approximations: ensembles evaluated with the multiple importance sampling ELBO (Paper A) and variational mixtures that automate component cooperation and exploration (Paper B). Because expressivity comes at a cost, I develop efficient mixture learning ideas, including Monte Carlo objective estimators to scale mixture learning more efficiently (Paper C). As a new result in the kappa, I overturn a three decades long misconception regarding the potential performance benefits of using mixtures in variational inference. Finally, I move from variational inference to flow matching, where I address the need for specialized treatment of interpolant learning in multi-marginal settings (Paper D). By combining insights from Papers A-D, I derive in Section 5.5 a new method: multi-marginal flow matching with mixtures of variational interpolants. I connect these methodological developments to biological applications, with special emphasis on three-dimensional spatial transcriptomics, where stacked tissue slices induce multi-modal dynamics across space.

AI.tldr: 本论文面向复杂生物系统中多模态、几何结构化且可能仅定义到归一化常数的分布，构建从变分推断、黑盒变分推断到流匹配的统计推断方法体系，并以空间转录组学为主要应用。
AI.motivation: 复杂生物系统产生的分布往往具有多模态性和几何结构，且部分目标密度仅定义到归一化常数，导致解析更新方程不可用、推断困难。作者希望建立一套可控、可扩展且表达力递增的近似推断方法，并将其应用于三维空间转录组学等生物问题。
AI.method: 提出新的未归一化目标密度（CoLN分布）作为受控测试用例；从变分推断出发，在无解析更新方程时转向黑盒变分推断。构建表达力递增的近似路径：以多重重要性采样ELBO评估的集成方法（Paper A），以及自动实现分量协作与探索的变分混合模型（Paper B）。为降低表达力带来的代价，发展高效混合学习思路，包括用于更高效扩展混合学习的蒙特卡洛目标估计器（Paper C）。进一步从变分推断转向流匹配，针对多边际场景中的插值学习提出专门处理（Paper D）。综合Paper A–D，在第5.5节提出多边际流匹配与变分插值混合的新方法。
AI.result: 作为新结果，作者推翻了关于在变分推断中使用混合模型可能带来性能收益的持续约三十年的误解；提出了高效混合学习与蒙特卡洛目标估计方法；并在多边际设置下给出了流匹配的专门处理，最终形成多边际流匹配与变分插值混合的新方法。
AI.conclusion: 论文将方法学发展连接到生物应用，特别强调三维空间转录组学中堆叠组织切片在空间上诱导的多模态动力学。

title: State Transport Routing for Short-horizon Adaptation in Multi-horizon Photovoltaic Forecasting
summary: Recent power measurements provide valuable information for photovoltaic(PV) power forecasting, but directly extrapolating short-term trends can introduce substantial errors over longer forecast horizons. To address this challenge, we propose state transport routing (STR), a lightweight adapter that refines the predictions of a frozen forecasting model. STR combines the original forecast with two complementary trajectories derived from the latest measured power level and its recent trend. A horizon-conditioned router adjusts their contributions over the first 120 min, while leaving subsequent predictions unchanged. Experiments on four public PV datasets show that STR consistently outperforms a parameter-matched residual adapter. On PVDAQ, the same approach improves five neural forecasting backbones, reducing all-horizon normalized mean absolute error by 0.0201-0.2364 percentage points, with paired 95% confidence intervals excluding zero. No reliable improvement is observed for LightGBM. These findings demonstrate the potential of structured state adaptation to improve short-term forecasting across different neural architectures without retraining the underlying models or altering their longer-horizon predictions.

AI.tldr: 提出状态传输路由（STR），一种轻量适配器，通过融合最新实测功率水平与近期趋势两条轨迹，并利用时段条件路由器在前120分钟内调节权重，来修正冻结预测模型的短期输出。
AI.motivation: 近期功率实测值对光伏功率预测有参考价值，但直接外推短期趋势在较长预测时域上会引入显著误差，且重新训练底层模型代价高。
AI.method: STR作为轻量适配器，在冻结的预测模型之上工作：将原始预测与由最新实测功率水平及其近期趋势导出的两条互补轨迹相结合，并用时段条件路由器在前120分钟动态调整三者贡献，之后预测保持不变。
AI.result: 在四个公开光伏数据集上，STR持续优于参数量匹配的残差适配器；在PVDAQ上，该方法对五种神经预测骨干模型均有效，全时域归一化平均绝对误差降低0.0201–0.2364个百分点，配对95%置信区间不含零；对LightGBM未观察到可靠提升。
AI.conclusion: 结构化状态适配可在不重新训练底层模型、不改变长时域预测的前提下，跨多种神经架构提升短期光伏预测性能。

title: Safe-by-Design Learning via Energy-based Neural Networks
summary: Learning neural-network models of dynamical systems with safety guarantees is a fundamental requirement for their deployment in safety-critical settings. Safety is commonly established by proving the invariance of a desired subset in state-space, ensuring that every trajectory initialized in this subset remains confined to it for all time under admissible inputs. Existing frameworks, however, either rely on computationally expensive post-hoc verification or employ safety-enforcing mechanisms without formal correctness guarantees. In this paper, we introduce a novel neural architecture grounded in energy-based modern Hopfield networks to guarantee safety-by-design while retaining sufficient expressiveness to model complex nonlinear dynamics. Specifically, we integrate modern Hopfield networks with a port-Hamiltonian neural ODE, enabling by design the construction of barrier functions yielding explicit admissible-input sets and quantitative robustness radii. Across several benchmarks, including an 12-dimensional nanodrone model, our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance while producing certified invariant sets that are more robust to external solicitations than comparable existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将现代Hopfield网络与端口Hamilton神经ODE结合的新型神经架构，实现"设计即安全"的动力学建模，可构造障碍函数并给出显式容许输入集与鲁棒半径。
AI.motivation: 安全关键场景部署神经动力学模型需保证安全性，通常通过证明状态空间中期望子集的不变性来实现。但现有框架要么依赖计算昂贵的后验验证，要么采用强制安全机制却缺乏形式化正确性保证，难以兼顾安全性与表达能力。
AI.method: 将基于能量的现代Hopfield网络与端口Hamilton神经ODE相融合，构建具备安全保证的神经架构。该架构在设计层面即可构造障碍函数，从而推导出显式的容许输入集与定量鲁棒半径，同时保留建模复杂非线性动力学所需的表达能力。
AI.result: 在多个基准（含12维纳米无人机模型）上，该框架达到当前最优性能，并生成经认证的不变集，其对外部扰动的鲁棒性优于同类现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过能量型Hopfield网络与端口Hamilton神经ODE的耦合，可在设计阶段内嵌安全保证，避免后验验证的高开销，同时兼顾表达力与认证不变集，为安全关键动力学建模提供可行新范式。

title: Fine-Tuning on Self-Generated and Reward-Weighted Data: Learning Dynamics, Convergence Rates, and Benefits of Off-Policyness
summary: We study the learning dynamics of fine-tuning a policy model on self-generated and reward-weighted data, with particular focus on a generalized version of REINFORCE -- referred to as RE(S) -- that updates the rollout distribution once every $S \ge 1$ gradient steps. Prior work in bandits and reinforcement learning has developed rich theory for policy gradient methods, and on-policy sampling (i.e., a small $S$, ideally $1$) is often viewed as crucial to their success; yet in prominent application like post-training large language models, reward-guided self-training has proved to be effective even when the rollout distribution is updated infrequently, but theoretical understanding remains limited for the convergence properties of these off-policy methods. To bridge these gaps, we develop a unified theory for RE(S) that covers the full spectrum of $S \ge 1$: it can be interpreted as a stage-wise optimization process, where each stage takes $S$ gradient steps for minimizing the Kullback-Leibler distance to a fixed reward-weighted rollout distribution. For multi-arm bandits with softmax policies, our in-depth analysis and numerical experiments reveal three key findings: (1) for any fixed $S$, RE(S) enjoys global convergence to the optimal policy as the number of rollout distribution updates $B = \lfloor T / S \rfloor \rightarrow \infty$, where $T$ denotes the number of gradient steps; (2) we prove tight two-sided bounds showing that the suboptimality gap of RE(S) achieves an asymptotic $Θ(1 / T)$ convergence rate, while $S$ only affects the length of a burn-in phase; (3) when initialized at a weak policy with a small optimal-action probability, RE(1) gets trapped around suboptimal policies for a long period, whereas RE(S) with a suitable $S$ avoids the detour and achieves significantly faster convergence to the global optimum, highlighting the benefits of off-policyness in this case.

AI.tldr: 本文为RE(S)（每隔S步更新一次rollout分布的策略梯度方法）建立了覆盖S≥1的统一理论，揭示其分阶段优化本质，并证明其全局收敛性与Θ(1/T)收敛速率，指出适度离策略性可显著加速收敛。
AI.motivation: 在LLM后训练等应用中，奖励引导的自训练即使不频繁更新rollout分布也有效，但离策略方法的收敛性质缺乏理论理解；同时传统bandits/RL理论强调on-policy采样（小S甚至S=1）的重要性，二者存在理论空白。
AI.method: 将RE(S)解释为分阶段优化过程：每个阶段针对固定的奖励加权rollout分布，执行S步梯度以最小化KL距离；针对softmax策略的多臂老虎机进行深入理论分析与数值实验，推导关于S和T的双侧界。
AI.result: (1) 任意固定S，当rollout更新次数B=⌊T/S⌋→∞时RE(S)全局收敛到最优策略；(2) 证明紧的双侧界，次优间隙达到渐近Θ(1/T)速率，S仅影响burn-in阶段长度；(3) 弱策略初始化（最优动作概率小）时，RE(1)长期陷入次优策略，而合适S的RE(S)避免绕行、收敛显著更快。
AI.conclusion: 离策略性（较大的S）并不损害渐近收敛速率，仅在burn-in阶段产生影响；在弱初始化条件下，适度的离策略反而带来显著收敛优势，为LLM后训练中不频繁更新rollout的实践提供了理论支撑。

title: JudgeCast: Time Series Forecasting with Experience-Informed Covariate Judgements
summary: Covariate effects vary across contexts and shift over time, requiring forecasters to assess how to use them for each forecasting context. As forecasting proceeds, observations for earlier forecasts become available, providing feedback on past covariate use for subsequent forecasts. However, when multiple covariates act together, the forecast error reveals the numerical discrepancy from the observation but not how the covariates should have been used. We introduce JudgeCast, an experience-based framework for time series forecasting with covariates. Following the judgmental adjustment practice, a frozen TSFM provides the base forecast, while a frozen LLM uses the current context and relevant experience to adjust it. Within the adjustment, assessing covariate effects and determining the numerical adjustment serve distinct roles, so JudgeCast first forms explicit covariate-wise judgments and then determines the adjustment. After observation, JudgeCast uses the observed residual of the base forecast to reconstruct alternative judgments and evaluates the original and alternatives through their resulting adjustments. The best-performing decision is selected and retained as validated experience for subsequent forecasts. Across diverse real-world datasets, JudgeCast outperforms strong baselines. Ablations show that explicit covariate-wise judgment can improve forecast-time adjustment, while residual-guided experience construction yields more reliable forecasting gains than retaining raw decisions as experience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JudgeCast，一个基于经验的带协变量时间序列预测框架：冻结TSFM生成基础预测，冻结LLM结合当前上下文与经验对预测进行调整，并通过观测残差重构和评估决策以积累经验。
AI.motivation: 协变量效应随情境变化且随时间漂移，预测者需针对每个预测情境判断如何使用协变量。随着预测推进，早期预测的观测结果可提供反馈，但当多个协变量共同作用时，预测误差只能揭示与观测的数值偏差，无法说明协变量应如何被使用，即误差信号缺乏对协变量使用方式的归因信息。
AI.method: 遵循判断性调整实践，采用双冻结模型架构：冻结的TSFM给出基础预测，冻结的LLM利用当前上下文与相关经验进行数值调整。将"评估协变量效应"与"确定数值调整"作为两个不同角色：先形成显式的逐协变量判断，再据此确定调整量。观测后，利用基础预测的观测残差重构备选判断，并将原始判断与备选判断通过各自产生的调整进行评估，选择表现最好的决策作为已验证经验保留，用于后续预测。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界数据集上，JudgeCast优于强基线。消融实验表明，显式的逐协变量判断能改善预测时的调整效果；同时，基于残差引导的经验构建比直接保留原始决策作为经验能带来更可靠的预测增益。
AI.conclusion: 将协变量效应评估与数值调整分离、并以观测残差引导经验构建，能够有效利用预测反馈提升带协变量时间序列预测的准确性，为冻结模型结合经验学习提供了可行路径。

title: TaskBridge: Bridging Unsupervised Tabular Anomaly Detection and In-Context Learning via Virtual Tasks
summary: Unsupervised tabular anomaly detection (TAD) aims to identify anomalous rows in tabular data using normal training samples. While conventional methods rely on dataset-specific training and configuration search, recent tabular foundation models (TFMs) enable zero-shot anomaly detection on unseen datasets via in-context learning. Most TFM-based approaches, however, require anomaly-specific pretraining from scratch, making detection inherently dependent on synthetic TAD-specific priors and costly to update. Some approaches instead repurpose pretrained general-purpose TFMs for TAD to avoid this burden, but rely on computationally expensive formulations with restrictive anomaly inductive biases. In this work, we introduce TaskBridge, a new framework that efficiently repurposes pretrained general-purpose TFMs for unsupervised TAD by constructing virtual supervised tasks that directly recast anomaly detection as supervised in-context inference of TFMs. The resulting virtual tasks induce predictive structures under which normal queries and their target pairs receive high support, whereas anomalies tend to violate the induced structures and receive lower support, providing direct anomaly evidence. Across 790 real-world datasets, TaskBridge consistently outperforms 30 baselines, including state-of-the-art TFM-based approaches, without anomaly-specific TFM pretraining or dataset-specific model optimization.

AI.tldr: TaskBridge 通过构建虚拟监督任务，将无监督表格异常检测重构为表格基础模型的监督式上下文推理，无需异常专用预训练或数据集级优化，在 790 个真实数据集上超越 30 个基线。
AI.motivation: 现有 TFM 类表格异常检测方法要么需从零进行异常专用预训练（依赖合成先验、更新成本高），要么复用通用 TFM 但计算昂贵且带有受限的异常归纳偏置。因此需要一个既高效复用预训练通用 TFM、又无需昂贵重训的框架。
AI.method: 提出 TaskBridge，构造虚拟监督任务，将异常检测直接重铸为 TFM 的监督式上下文推理。该虚拟任务诱导出预测结构：正常查询及其目标对获得高支持度，而异常因违反该结构而获得较低支持度，从而提供直接的异常证据。
AI.result: 在 790 个真实世界数据集上，TaskBridge 一致优于 30 个基线（含最先进的 TFM 方法），且不使用异常专用 TFM 预训练，也不做数据集特定的模型优化。
AI.conclusion: 通过虚拟监督任务桥接无监督异常检测与通用 TFM 的监督式上下文学习，可在零样本条件下实现高效、强竞争力的表格异常检测。

title: Equally Good, Yet Different: Benchmarking Rashomon sets in AutoML packages
comment: Accepted to the International Conference on Automated Machine Learning 2026, ABCD Track
summary: The Rashomon effect describes the existence of multiple near-optimal models that achieve comparable performance while offering fundamentally different explanations. This creates a critical vulnerability in AutoML: x-hacking, the selective post-hoc choice of a model based on its explanation rather than predictive merit. No existing AutoML framework exposes this risk. We introduce ARSA ML, an open-source Python framework that quantifies Rashomon set structure and predictive multiplicity within AutoML pipelines. Using ARSA ML, we benchmark AutoGluon and H2O across 28 binary classification datasets, and conduct a post-hoc x-hacking analysis revealing a consistent structural asymmetry: AutoGluon produces larger, diverse sets with stable explanations, while H2O generates compact sets with markedly higher prediction divergence and explanation instability -- making H2O users considerably more exposed to x-hacking. This gap persists across all evaluated metrics and epsilon thresholds, pointing to a fundamental difference in each framework's model-building strategy. ARSA ML is available at https://pypi.org/project/arsa-ml/ .

AI.tldr: 提出开源框架 ARSA ML，量化 AutoML 中的 Rashomon 集与预测多重性，并揭示 x-hacking 风险。
AI.motivation: Rashomon 效应使得存在多个性能相近但解释截然不同的近优模型，从而在 AutoML 中催生 x-hacking（即依据解释而非预测性能选择性挑选模型的隐患）；然而现有 AutoML 框架均未暴露该风险。
AI.method: 构建开源 Python 框架 ARSA ML，量化 AutoML 流水线中的 Rashomon 集结构与预测多重性；并据此在 28 个二分类数据集上对 AutoGluon 与 H2O 进行基准评测，开展事后 x-hacking 分析。
AI.result: 发现稳定的结构性不对称：AutoGluon 产生更大、更多样的模型集且解释稳定；H2O 产生紧凑模型集但预测分歧与解释不稳定性显著更高。该差距在所有评测指标与 epsilon 阈值下持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 该不对称性表明两框架模型构建策略存在根本差异，H2O 用户面临更高的 x-hacking 暴露风险；ARSA ML 已在 PyPI 开源发布。

title: Abductive World Modeling via Causal Representation Learning
summary: The central challenge of world modeling is to learn representations that capture how the world evolves. However, existing world models predominantly represent future states without explicitly capturing the latent causes underlying their evolution, limiting their ability to reason about why and how the world changes. To address this limitation, we propose Abductive World Modeling (AWM), a framework that learns structured causal representations by abductively inferring latent causes from predicted futures. Specifically, we realize AWM through the Hierarchical Abductive State Pyramid (HASP), which organizes the inferred world state into three complementary components - Entity, Dynamic, and Relation - capturing what exists, how it changes, and how entities interact, respectively. By jointly reasoning over the current observation and its predicted future, HASP abductively infers these latent factors and integrates them into a structured state representation for downstream reasoning. To the best of our knowledge, AWM is the first framework to introduce abductive state inference into latent-space world modeling for learning structured representations of world dynamics. Experiments across physical prediction, causal reasoning, and action understanding demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. Compared with V-JEPA, a state-of-the-art latent-space world model, AWM improves physical prediction AUROC by 10.7%, causal reasoning accuracy by 16.8%, and action Top-1 accuracy by 68.0%.

AI.tldr: 提出溯因世界建模（AWM）框架，通过从预测未来溯因推断潜在原因，学习结构化的因果表征；以分层溯因状态金字塔（HASP）实现，将世界状态分解为实体、动态与关系三部分。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型主要表征未来状态本身，未显式捕捉驱动状态演化的潜在原因，因此难以推理世界为何以及如何变化。
AI.method: AWM 从预测的未来中溯因推断潜在原因，学习结构化因果表征。具体由分层溯因状态金字塔（HASP）实现：将推断出的世界状态组织为实体（Entity，存在什么）、动态（Dynamic，如何变化）、关系（Relation，实体如何交互）三个互补分量；通过联合推理当前观测与其预测未来，溯因推断这些潜在因子并整合为结构化状态表征，供下游推理使用。
AI.result: 在物理预测、因果推理与动作理解任务上验证有效。相较最先进的潜在空间世界模型 V-JEPA，物理预测 AUROC 提升 10.7%，因果推理准确率提升 16.8%，动作 Top-1 准确率提升 68.0%。
AI.conclusion: AWM 是首个将溯因状态推断引入潜在空间世界建模的框架，用于学习世界动态的结构化表征，实验表明其能有效支撑物理预测、因果推理与动作理解等任务。

title: LongSpark: Efficient speculative decoding with a fixed-cost parallel drafter
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive inference by verifying multiple draft tokens in a single target forward pass. However, as the context grows, existing state-of-the-art drafters become increasingly expensive, eroding the very efficiency advantage they are designed to provide. We argue that this scaling is unnecessary. A standalone language model must grow with its prefix because it is solely responsible for every token it produces. A drafter, by contrast, only proposes candidates; the target catches and corrects every error before any token is committed. The drafter's decoding cost can therefore be made entirely independent of the prefix length. We introduce LongSpark, a block-diffusion drafter that achieves this by extracting fixed-size, multiscale views from the target's verification pass, thereby eliminating the need for a growing persistent state. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that LongSpark achieves state-of-the-art end-to-end efficiency across multiple model scales and realistic serving conditions. Notably, it delivers the lowest time-per-output-token on long-context tasks while reducing the drafter's context state by several orders of magnitude.

AI.tldr: LongSpark是一种块扩散（block-diffusion）草稿模型，通过从目标模型的验证前向传播中提取固定大小的多尺度视图，使草稿阶段的计算成本与上下文长度无关，从而在长上下文场景下实现更优的端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 推测解码通过单次目标前向传播验证多个草稿token来加速自回归推理。但现有最优草稿模型（drafter）随上下文增长而计算开销不断上升，反而侵蚀了其本应带来的效率优势。作者认为这种随前缀增长的开销并非必要：独立语言模型必须随前缀增长，因为它要为每个生成的token负责；而草稿模型只负责提出候选，错误由目标模型在提交前捕获并纠正，因此草稿阶段成本可与前缀长度解耦。
AI.method: 提出LongSpark，一种块扩散草稿模型。它从目标模型的验证前向传播中抽取固定大小的、多尺度（multiscale）视图，从而无需维护随上下文增长的持久状态，实现与前缀长度无关的解码开销。
AI.result: 在多种模型规模和真实服务条件下，LongSpark取得了最优的端到端效率；在长上下文任务上实现最低的每输出token时间（time-per-output-token），同时将草稿模型的上下文状态减少数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 草稿模型的解码开销无需随上下文增长，通过固定大小的多尺度视图即可兼顾效率与长上下文性能，LongSpark验证了这一思路并显著降低草稿端的状态开销。

title: High-Resolution Dynamic Functional Connectivity Generation with Graph-Variate Flow Matching
summary:
High-resolution dynamic functional connectivity (DFC) can reveal rapidly evolving brain-network interactions, but short temporal windows yield noisy, often low-rank covariance estimates. Graph-Variate Dynamic (GVD) connectivity addresses this by modulating fast instantaneous interactions with stable trial-level support. This suppresses spurious fluctuations and emphasizes persistent, informative connections. We show that the Hadamard construction lifts low-rank instantaneous connectivity from the positive-semidefinite to the positive-definite cone, keeping high-resolution trajectories on the SPD manifold without ridge regularisation or post-hoc projection.
  We introduce GVD-CFM, a class-conditional generative model for high-resolution dynamic connectivity. Each trial is represented as SPD GVD matrices on a product Riemannian manifold, then mapped through a global log-Euclidean diffeomorphism and an invertible temporal DCT basis. A Transformer-based conditional flow models all spectral modes jointly and generates the full trajectory non-autoregressively in Euclidean coordinates while preserving exact correspondence with valid SPD sequences. Retaining the full DCT basis also enables decoding on denser temporal grids without retraining.
  Across multiple EEG motor-imagery datasets, GVD-CFM delivers the strongest overall results for held-out distributional fidelity, temporal-dynamics preservation, and synthetic-to-real classification. It also remains computationally efficient relative to strong raw-signal and direct GVD-space generative baselines. GVD-CFM therefore provides a practical framework for realistic, temporally coherent, high-resolution brain-network generation with preserved manifold structure and resolution-flexible decoding from a single trained model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GVD-CFM，一种基于GVD连接与黎曼流形建模的条件生成模型，用于高分辨率动态脑网络生成，在多个EEG运动想象数据集上取得最优的分布保真度、时序动态保持与合成到真实分类性能。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率动态功能连接（DFC）能揭示快速演化的脑网络交互，但短时间窗导致协方差估计噪声大、秩低。GVD连接通过稳定试次级支撑调制瞬时交互来抑制虚假波动，然而如何在保持SPD流形结构的前提下对高分辨率动态连接进行生成建模仍具挑战。
AI.method: 利用Hadamard构造将低秩瞬时连接从半正定锥提升到正定锥，使高分辨率轨迹保持在SPD流形上，无需岭正则化或后验投影。将每个试次表示为乘积黎曼流形上的SPD GVD矩阵，经全局对数欧氏微分同胚与可逆时序DCT基映射；采用Transformer条件流模型联合建模所有谱模态，在欧氏坐标中非自回归生成完整轨迹，并保持与有效SPD序列的精确对应。
AI.result: 在多个EEG运动想象数据集上，GVD-CFM在留出数据的分布保真度、时序动态保持和合成到真实分类三项指标上总体最优，且相较强原始信号与直接GVD空间生成基线仍具计算效率。
AI.conclusion: GVD-CFM为真实、时序连贯、高分辨率脑网络生成提供了实用框架，在保持流形结构的同时支持单一模型的分辨率灵活解码（可在更密时间网格上解码而无需重训练）。

title: Beam Search as Test-Time Self-Distillation via Counterfactual Contexts
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Towards Test-Time Continual Learning Agents
summary: Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT) enables a language model to act as its own teacher: by conditioning on a demonstration, the model produces an implicit reward via pointwise mutual information, which guides on-policy learning without external supervision. However, SDFT operates at training time: it requires gradient updates and access to expert demonstrations, making it inapplicable at inference. We propose test-time self-distillation, a decoding-time method that extracts a steering signal from the self-distillation framework without any parameter updates, reward models, or training data. Our key insight is that counterfactual contexts, i.e. fixed textual templates that hypothetically prime the model for excellent versus poor reasoning, can substitute for the demonstration. The log-odds ratio of a candidate answer under these two counterfactual conditions defines a new reward signal. We derive the optimal KL-regularized policy under this reward, which takes the form of a Gibbs reweighting of the base distribution. Crucially, this reweighting is global: it cannot be decomposed into independent per-token operations without ignoring future trajectory quality. We therefore approximate the target distribution via beam search. Experiments on mathematical reasoning (MATH500), code generation (HumanEval), and graduate-level science QA (GPQA) across multiple model scales show that test-time self-distillation improves over standard sampling, low temperature, beam search and power sampling baselines on average, demonstrating that the self-distillation principle can be operationalized at inference time.

AI.tldr: 提出测试时自蒸馏（test-time self-distillation），用反事实模板构造奖励信号，通过 Gibbs 重加权与 beam search 近似，实现无需训练的自蒸馏推理。
AI.motivation: 原自蒸馏微调（SDFT）虽能利用逐点互信息构造隐式奖励指导在线策略学习，但依赖梯度更新与专家演示，无法在推理阶段使用。作者希望将自蒸馏原理迁移到解码阶段，摆脱参数更新、奖励模型和训练数据。
AI.method: 用固定文本模板构成的反事实上下文（分别诱导优秀推理与糟糕推理）替代演示；在两种反事实条件下计算候选答案的对数几率比作为新奖励信号；推导该奖励下的最优 KL 正则化策略，得到对基础分布的 Gibbs 重加权形式；因该重加权是全局的、无法分解为逐 token 独立操作，采用 beam search 近似目标分布。
AI.result: 在数学推理 MATH500、代码生成 HumanEval、研究生水平科学问答 GPQA 上，跨多个模型规模，测试时自蒸馏平均优于标准采样、低温采样、beam search 及 power sampling 基线。
AI.conclusion: 自蒸馏原理可以在推理阶段被操作化，无需任何参数更新、奖励模型或训练数据即可提升模型推理表现。

title: Message Passing Does More with Less for In-Context Learning on Graphs
summary: Achieving strong performance with graph neural networks (GNNs) typically requires training and hyperparameter tuning for each dataset, incurring repeated costs and effort. Graph in-context learning (ICL) avoids this by using a single pretrained model to predict unknown node labels directly from labeled context nodes. Existing approaches, however, rely on dense attention across nodes, making inference increasingly expensive as graphs grow. In this work, we present Ephris, a new graph in-context learner built on sparse message passing, scaling linearly with the number of node-feature entries and graph edges. Ephris is pretrained entirely on synthetic graphs generated from structural causal models with diverse graph structures and relational dynamics, exposing the model to varied dependencies among topology, features, and labels. We evaluate Ephris on 51 node-classification datasets against 15 extensively tuned GNNs and existing graph ICL methods under both high- and low-label train/validation/test splits. Across both settings, Ephris ranks first on all four aggregate measures: Elo, improvability, average rank, and accuracy. Its inference cost remains comparable to training a single GNN once, while being over 10 times faster than previous graph ICL models. Together, these results advance the performance-runtime Pareto frontier, demonstrating that strong graph ICL does not require dense attention. Code and model weights are available at https://github.com/nums-ai/ephris.

AI.tldr: Ephris：基于稀疏消息传递的图上下文学习器，线性复杂度，预训练于合成SCM图，在51个节点分类数据集上对15个调优GNN及现有图ICL方法均排名第一，推理成本低且比先前图ICL快10倍以上。
AI.motivation: GNN取得强性能通常需对每个数据集重复训练与超参调优，成本高；图ICL虽可用单一预训练模型直接预测未知节点标签，但现有方法依赖全节点稠密注意力，随图规模增大推理代价急剧上升。
AI.method: 提出Ephris，基于稀疏消息传递的图上下文学习器，计算复杂度随节点特征条目数与边数线性增长。模型完全在由结构因果模型生成、具有多样图结构与关系动态的合成图上预训练，从而暴露于拓扑、特征与标签间的多样依赖关系。
AI.result: 在51个节点分类数据集、高标签与低标签两种train/validation/test划分下，与15个充分调优的GNN及现有图ICL方法比较，Ephris在Elo、improvability、平均排名、准确率四项聚合指标上均排名第一；推理成本与训练单个GNN一次相当，且比先前图ICL模型快10倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 结果推进了性能-运行时间帕累托前沿，表明强图ICL无需稠密注意力；代码与模型权重已开源。

title: A Comprehensive View of Fairness through Distributional Stability
summary: We view fairness as a property of distributional stability. Rather than assessing a predictor under a fixed data distribution, we study how its predictions change under perturbations that modify the composition of protected groups. A predictor is fair if it remains stable under such shifts. Under this perspective, several classical notions of fairness arise as stability with respect to specific perturbations, with the associated unfairness gap given by a Lipschitz constant of a prediction-rate functional. This formulation also yields guarantees that hold uniformly over a range of demographic compositions at test time, without requiring knowledge of the deployment distribution. It leads to a learning procedure based on convex combinations of reweighted predictors, formulated as a second-order cone program, for which we establish generalization bounds. Experiments on standard benchmarks illustrate the approach.

AI.tldr: 该文将公平性重新定义为预测在受保护群体构成扰动下的分布稳定性，并给出统一的学习与泛化保证。
AI.motivation: 传统公平性评估在固定数据分布下进行，难以保证测试时人口构成变化情况下的表现。作者希望提出一种不依赖部署分布知识的公平性刻画与学习方法。
AI.method: 把公平性视为分布稳定性：研究改变受保护群体构成的扰动下预测的变化；指出若干经典公平性概念可视为特定扰动下的稳定性，其不公平性差距对应预测率泛函的Lipschitz常数；将学习问题形式化为重加权预测器凸组合的二阶锥规划，并推导泛化界。
AI.result: 该框架在测试时可在一系列人口构成范围内给出统一保证，无需知道部署分布；所提学习方法可建立泛化界；在标准基准实验上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 以分布稳定性视角统一刻画公平性，既涵盖多种经典公平性定义，又提供跨人口构成的统一保证，并通过凸优化学习程序实现，具有理论保证与实验支持。

title: RL-PaO: Prediction as Action in Decision Making under Uncertainty
summary: Decision-making under uncertainty often relies on predicted parameters, yet accurate prediction does not necessarily lead to good operational decisions.
