AI.method: 构建Synthetic Universes受控基准：将经典著名世界与匹配的"扭曲孪生"世界配对，后者由邻近的非经典机制支配。对每个报告的定律进行两类独立评估：(1) 在留出续接与迁移设置上执行该定律（预测验证）；(2) 独立检验其是否恢复真实的生成机制（机制恢复）。研究设定为预先指定的60单元（cell）实验，并包含匹配的著名对照、修正后的可识别性扫描（identifiability sweep）与Evidence Ladder等组件。
AI.result: 在预指定60单元研究的当前检查点中，22个试验完成评分，另1次运行因基础设施故障终止。20个孪生试验里，8个通过预测验证，5个通过机制恢复。解离是双向的：6个可解析输出在缺失机制的情况下预测成功，3个恢复了机制但预测推演失败。其中"Drag"呈现第一种模式（预测通过5/5，机制恢复1/5），"Gravity"呈现第二种模式（预测通过1/5，机制恢复4/5）。
AI.conclusion: 由于匹配的著名对照、修正后的可识别性扫描与Evidence Ladder尚未完成，作者不主张确证性的"因果先验冲突效应"。已完成运行仅建立一个更窄的验证性结论：预测充分性与机制恢复是两类不同的科学主张，需用不同的测试加以检验。该结果提示评测科学智能体时不能仅依赖预测成功作为机制理解的标准。

title: BiFE: Search-Efficient Discovery of CPU-Only Branching Policies via LLM-based Bi-Fidelity Evolution
summary: In branch-and-bound (B&B) for mixed-integer linear programming (MILP), branching variable selection critically impacts efficiency. Existing neural branching policies often require GPU inference, while CPU-efficient symbolic expressions lack the representational capacity for complex logic. Large Language Model (LLM)-generated code provides a flexible search space for designing lightweight branching rules with diverse algorithmic logic. To discover effective rules within LLM-based evolutionary frameworks, a core challenge arises: full B&B evaluation on real instances is prohibitively expensive, whereas offline imitation learning suffers from distribution shift. To address this, we introduce a Bi-Fidelity Evolutionary framework (BiFE). It employs low-fidelity imitation scores as a rapid pre-screener and selectively applies high-fidelity on-instance evaluation only to elite candidates, effectively balancing search efficiency with performance reliability. Experiments validate both the search efficiency of BiFE and the competitiveness of its discovered rules, which outperform the SCIP solver and other baselines on CPUs, and even surpass certain GPU-based neural policies.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出BiFE（双保真进化框架），利用低保真模仿分数快速预筛选、仅对精英候选进行高保真实例评估，从而在LLM驱动的进化搜索中发现高效的分支变量选择规则。
AI.motivation: 在MILP的分支定界（B&B）中，分支变量选择至关重要。现有神经分支策略依赖GPU推理，而CPU高效的符号表达式表达能力不足，难以刻画复杂逻辑。LLM生成的代码为设计轻量级、算法逻辑多样的分支规则提供了灵活搜索空间，但在LLM进化框架中面临核心矛盾：真实实例上的完整B&B评估代价过高，而离线模仿学习又存在分布偏移问题。
AI.method: 提出Bi-Fidelity Evolutionary框架（BiFE）：以低保真模仿分数作为快速预筛选器，仅对精英候选选择性执行高保真实例评估，从而在搜索效率与性能可靠性之间取得平衡。
AI.result: 实验验证了BiFE的搜索效率及其所发现规则的竞争力：在CPU上优于SCIP求解器和其他基线，甚至超越某些基于GPU的神经策略。
AI.conclusion: BiFE通过双保真机制有效解决了LLM进化搜索中评估代价与可靠性之间的权衡问题，能够自动发现轻量、CPU高效且性能优越的分支规则，为MILP分支策略设计提供了新范式。

title: Distinguish or Homogenize: Last-Chance Policy Identification and Risk-Budgeted Recovery under Irreversible Resource Depletion
summary: Under irreversible resource depletion, an agent can spend resources to distinguish among latent fault models, or to change the system state so that the remaining models admit a common acceptable continuation--at which point further diagnosis becomes unnecessary. This distinguish-or-homogenize principle identifies a path that existing frameworks for identification, planning, and diagnosis do not make explicit: prior formulations treat the mapping from fault models to acceptable policies as a given, whereas LCPI makes it a function of the agent's own actions. We formalize this principle through Last-Chance Policy Identification (LCPI), where correctness is evaluated at the state the agent reaches rather than at the initial state. The Last Identifiable Margin (LIM) marks the feasibility boundary between distinguishing and homogenizing. For deterministic diagnostic graphs we provide the Exact-LIM recursion; for noisy finite-horizon recovery we propose Risk-Budgeted Compatibility Planning (RBCP), which searches a compatibility-aware frontier under a hard worst-case failure constraint. Across incident recovery on abstract microservice topologies and latent-damage navigation in MiniGrid, RBCP improves risk-feasible recovery while satisfying the failure budget. A sham control--cost-matched actions that preserve model incompatibility--eliminates the gain entirely, confirming that the benefit comes from changing which policies are acceptable for which models, not from extra search or additional budget.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"区分或同质化"（distinguish-or-homogenize）原则，并将其形式化为末次机会策略识别（LCPI）：正确性在智能体所到达的状态上评估，而非初始状态。作者给出刻画可行边界的末次可识别裕度（LIM），针对确定性诊断图提出 Exact-LIM 递推，针对噪声有限时域恢复提出风险预算兼容性规划（RBCP），并在微服务故障恢复与 MiniGrid 潜在损伤导航任务上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 在不可逆资源消耗下，智能体既可花费资源区分潜在故障模型，也可改变系统状态使剩余模型共享一个可接受的后续策略，从而使进一步诊断变得不必要。既有识别、规划与诊断框架将"故障模型到可接受策略"的映射视为给定，未显式刻画智能体自身行动对该映射的影响，因此这一路径被长期忽视。
AI.method: 将上述原则形式化为 LCPI，把正确性判定从初始状态迁移到智能体实际到达的状态；用末次可识别裕度（LIM）标记"区分"与"同质化"之间的可行性边界。对确定性诊断图给出 Exact-LIM 递推精确求解；对噪声有限时域恢复提出 RBCP，在硬性最坏情况失败约束下搜索兼容性感知前沿。
AI.result: 在抽象微服务拓扑的故障恢复与 MiniGrid 潜在损伤导航两类任务上，RBCP 在满足失败预算的前提下提升了风险可行恢复率。设置 sham 对照——成本匹配但保持模型不兼容的动作——该增益完全消失，表明收益来源于改变"哪些策略对哪些模型可接受"，而非额外的搜索或预算。
AI.conclusion: LCPI 将故障模型到可接受策略的映射内化为智能体行动的函项，统一了"诊断"与"同质化"两种应对不可逆资源枯竭的路径，并提供了可计算的可行性边界与规划算法；对照实验确证其收益机制。

title: EASE: Behavior-Adaptive Skill Curation for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Agent skills provide a lightweight mechanism for self-evolving agents to accumulate reusable procedural knowledge without updating model parameters. However, existing learned skill curators typically optimize curation without explicitly modeling downstream executor behavior. We show that this can cause systematic cross-executor degradation: curators trained with different executors perform best when paired with their own training executor, indicating that effective skill curation is executor-dependent. We formulate behavior-adaptive skill curation and introduce EASE, a framework that learns a single curator that adapts its decisions to different executor behaviors. EASE maintains an online behavioral profile of recent execution patterns and conditions the curator on this profile, the current trajectory, and retrieved skills to add, modify, or remove skills from an evolving repository. We train the shared curator jointly across multiple frozen executors with reinforcement learning, using retrieval-aware and behavior-aware temporal attribution to focus optimization on curation actions with observable downstream influence. Across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and WebShop, with executors ranging from Qwen3-8B/32B and GPT-OSS-120B to unseen Kimi K2.6, DeepSeek V4 Flash, and Gemini 3.5 Flash, EASE outperforms strong skill- and memory-based baselines without per-executor finetuning. EASE also maintains 34.5--41.0% fewer skills, improves skill retrieval by 36.3--38.7% and measured edit utility by 51.8--60.0%, and reduces deployment-time inference tokens by 9.1--14.5%. These results establish behavior-adaptive skill curation as an effective principle for building self-evolving agents.

AI.tldr: 提出行为自适应技能策划问题，并给出EASE框架：学习单一策划器，根据执行器行为动态增删改技能库，跨多执行器与基准优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有学习式技能策划器在优化时未显式建模下游执行器行为，导致跨执行器系统性性能退化：策划器与训练时所用执行器配对效果最佳，说明技能策划效果依赖执行器。
AI.method: 形式化"行为自适应技能策划"任务。EASE维护近期执行模式的在线行为画像，将画像、当前轨迹与检索到的技能作为条件输入策划器，对进化技能库执行增、改、删。采用强化学习在多个冻结执行器上联合训练共享策划器，并使用检索感知与行为感知的时序归因，将优化聚焦于对下游有可观测影响的策划动作。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop上，执行器涵盖Qwen3-8B/32B、GPT-OSS-120B及未见过的Kimi K2.6、DeepSeek V4 Flash、Gemini 3.5 Flash，EASE无需按执行器微调即优于强技能/记忆基线；技能库规模减少34.5–41.0%，技能检索提升36.3–38.7%，编辑效用提升51.8–60.0%，部署推理token减少9.1–14.5%。
AI.conclusion: 行为自适应技能策划是构建自进化智能体的一条有效原则。

title: Generalizable Lifelong Model Editing via Preference Optimization
summary: Knowledge editing enables rapid updates of specific factual knowledge in large language models (LLMs) without full retraining. However, more realistic scenarios call for a lifelong framework that handles continual updates rather than one-off modifications. In such settings, existing editing methods often overfit to target prompts, significantly degrading both the generalization of the edited knowledge and the model's general capabilities. To address this issue, we propose GLIME (Generalizable Lifelong Model Editing), which combines knowledge editing with preference optimization over generation behavior. GLIME further incorporates replay-based editing and a gradient constraint to preserve previously edited knowledge. Experimental results show that GLIME significantly improves knowledge generalization in lifelong editing settings while maintaining both editing performance and general capabilities.

AI.tldr: GLIME 将知识编辑与生成行为的偏好优化结合，并引入基于回放的编辑与梯度约束，以缓解终身编辑中的过拟合，提升泛化性且保持编辑性能与通用能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 知识编辑多针对一次性修改，面向持续更新的终身编辑场景时易过拟合目标提示，导致编辑知识的泛化性与模型通用能力显著下降，因此需要更现实的终身编辑框架。
AI.method: 提出 GLIME（Generalizable Lifelong Model Editing）：将知识编辑与生成行为上的偏好优化相结合；并引入基于回放（replay-based）的编辑与梯度约束，以保持先前编辑的知识。
AI.result: 实验表明，在终身编辑设置下，GLIME 显著提升了知识泛化能力，同时保持了编辑性能与模型通用能力。
AI.conclusion: GLIME 通过偏好优化、回放编辑和梯度约束，有效应对终身模型编辑中的过拟合问题，在泛化性、编辑效果与通用能力之间取得更好平衡。

title: Code4Scene: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Constructing and Editing 3D Scenes
summary: Frontier coding agents can now write and execute code that authors 3D environments, but whether they reliably understand 3D structure and precisely control scene state remains unclear. The generated 3D scene is a persistent, executable artifact: a convincing render can hide incorrect spatial relations, intersecting objects, or unintended modifications. We introduce Code4Scene, a benchmark of 190 Unreal Engine cases built from human-assembled scenes that evaluates coding agents on two complementary settings under a shared execution interface. Construction tests scene-level spatial reasoning from open-ended language specifications, where many realizations are valid; editing tests precise control of scene state, where the agent must recover the target scene from reference images while preserving everything else. Rather than scoring code or rendered views, Code4Scene evaluates the generated engine-native scene for task fulfillment, artifact integrity, and static physical validity, with edits additionally compared against withheld ground truth. Across 14 coding-agent configurations on the 95-case public set, construction and editing performance are strongly correlated but not interchangeable (Spearman $ρ= 0.78$): Claude Fable 5.1 leads construction, Gemini 3.8 Flash leads editing, and GPT-6 Astra narrowly leads overall. Spatial Composition is the weakest construction category for every agent, while editing remains imprecise: the best Repair F1 is only 0.527, and 35.8% of edits that fully recover the target still introduce unintended changes elsewhere in the scene. These results expose a gap between plausible 3D generation and reliable spatial reasoning and state control.

AI.tldr: Code4Scene是一个包含190个虚幻引擎案例的基准，用于评估编程智能体在3D场景构建与编辑中的空间推理和状态控制能力，发现生成合理3D场景与可靠空间推理之间存在明显差距。
AI.motivation: 前沿编程智能体已能编写并执行代码生成3D环境，但其是否可靠理解3D结构、精确控制场景状态尚不明确。生成的3D场景是持久的可执行产物，有说服力的渲染可能掩盖错误的空间关系、相交物体或非预期修改，因此需要专门基准来检验。
AI.method: 提出Code4Scene基准，含190个由人工组装场景构建的虚幻引擎案例，在统一执行接口下评估两类互补任务：构建任务依据开放式语言规范测试场景级空间推理（多种实现均有效）；编辑任务依据参考图像从目标场景恢复，测试精确状态控制并需保留其他内容。评估不针对代码或渲染视图，而是检查生成的引擎原生场景的任务完成度、产物完整性和静态物理有效性，编辑任务还与保留的真值对比。在95例公开集上测试14种编程智能体配置。
AI.result: 构建与编辑表现强相关但不可互换（Spearman ρ=0.78）。Claude Fable 5.1在构建领先，Gemini 3.8 Flash在编辑领先，GPT-6 Astra总体略优。空间构成为所有智能体最弱的构建类别；编辑仍不精确，最佳Repair F1仅0.527，35.8%完全恢复目标的编辑仍在场景其他位置引入非预期改动。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示了合理3D生成与可靠空间推理、状态控制之间存在差距，表明编程智能体在3D场景理解与精确控制方面仍有显著提升空间。

title: Aperture: Merge-Consistent Rotary States for Compressed Tokens
summary: Token compression combines content from several positions, yet rotary position embeddings usually assign the merged token one coordinate. We ask what positional information must survive later merges. Aperture stores Fourier moments of the token's weighted support at the model's rotary frequencies. We prove that these moments have minimal real dimension among continuous states sufficient for the selected expected rotary interactions. Represented mass makes updates additive; attention normalisation remains a separate readout choice. Uniform intervals give a centre rotation times a sinc gain. We characterise when centres determine interval widths and construct matched examples where they do not. Numerical checks verify the weighted-support implementation. In trained temporal readers, compression transfer varies with gain calibration and feature placement. In a prespecified native video question-answering comparison, stored support reaches $65.63\%$ accuracy versus $67.12\%$ for the deployed merging rule. These results separate exact positional preservation under compression from downstream benefit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Aperture，一种在 token 压缩中保留位置信息的方法：它在模型旋转频率上存储被压缩 token 加权支撑集的傅里叶矩，并证明其维度在满足预期旋转交互的连续状态中最优。
AI.motivation: Token 压缩会把多个位置的内容合并，但旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）通常只给合并后的 token 分配一个坐标，导致位置信息丢失。作者追问：后续合并中究竟哪些位置信息必须保留。
AI.method: Aperture 存储被压缩 token 加权支撑集在模型旋转频率处的傅里叶矩；将表示的"质量"做成可加更新，把 attention 归一化作为独立读出选择；对均匀区间给出"中心旋转乘以 sinc 增益"的形式，并刻画中心何时能决定区间宽度、构造反例。通过数值实验验证加权支撑实现，并在训练好的时序读取器与预设的原生视频问答任务上评估。
AI.result: 证明了这些矩在足以支撑所选期望旋转交互的连续状态中具有最小实维度。数值检查验证了加权支撑实现；训练后的时序读取器中，压缩迁移随增益标定和特征放置而变化。在预设原生视频问答比较中，存储支撑取得 65.63% 准确率，部署的合并规则为 67.12%。
AI.conclusion: 结果区分了压缩下精确的位置保持与下游收益：最小维度的位置矩可实现精确位置保留，但未必带来下游性能提升，增益标定与特征放置等因素同样关键。

title: AI as a Compiler: Compiling Triton kernels without the Triton compiler
summary: Compiler backends are expensive to build and maintain as programming models, workloads, and accelerators evolve. We investigate whether large language models can replace the conventional optimizing and lowering pipeline, a process that we call AI lowering. We study AI lowering from Triton to NVIDIA PTX: an LLM agent translates Triton kernels directly into PTX. We build an environment that evaluates candidate PTX, and an agentic harness in which an LLM translates Triton kernels into PTX. Across twelve common kernels on Ada, Hopper, and Blackwell GPUs and ten kernels from recent ML papers, AI lowering achieves 0.83x-3.34x the performance of autotuned Triton. The largest gains come from transformations that Triton's lowering pipeline does not perform, such as decoding packed binary weights directly into Tensor Core operands (3.34x on BitDelta), assigning each thread a complete softmax row in tensor memory (1.37x on FlashAttention), and reusing overlapping convolution windows (up to 2.23x). These results rely on a robust evaluation harness with comprehensive verification support. We build on Volta, an existing PTX verifier, and substantially extend it to support modern GPU architectures by introducing support for Blackwell's tcgen05 Tensor Core interface. This requires modeling three architectural features: managed tensor memory, descriptor-based operand layouts, and asynchronous execution coordinated through commits, waits, memory barriers, and proxy fences. We discuss the challenges involved in formalizing them, as well as the current limitations. Our results suggest an emerging future in which AI compilers replace custom-written intermediate representations and checkers, reducing the time and engineering effort required to bring up software for new general-purpose and custom chips.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"AI lowering"概念：用LLM智能体直接将Triton内核翻译为NVIDIA PTX，跳过传统编译器优化与降级流水线，并在Ada、Hopper、Blackwell GPU上验证其性能与可行性。
AI.motivation: 编译器后端随编程模型、工作负载和加速器演进，构建与维护成本高昂。作者希望探究大语言模型能否替代传统的优化与降级流水线（即AI lowering），从而降低新芯片软件栈的搭建与工程开销。
AI.method: 研究Triton到NVIDIA PTX的AI lowering：构建可评测候选PTX的执行环境，并搭建由LLM将Triton内核直接翻译为PTX的智能体框架（agentic harness）。同时基于已有PTX验证器Volta进行大幅扩展，新增对Blackwell tcgen05 Tensor Core接口的支持，需建模托管张量内存、基于描述符的操作数布局，以及通过commit、wait、内存屏障和proxy fence协调的异步执行。
AI.result: 在Ada、Hopper、Blackwell三种GPU的12个常见内核及10个来自近期ML论文的内核上，AI lowering达到自动调优Triton性能的0.83x–3.34x。最大收益来自Triton降级流水线未执行的变换：将打包二进制权重直接解码为Tensor Core操作数（BitDelta上3.34x）、在tensor memory中为每线程分配完整softmax行（FlashAttention上1.37x）、复用重叠卷积窗口（最高2.23x）。结果依赖具备完整验证支持的稳健评测框架。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明存在一个新兴未来：AI编译器可取代人工编写的中间表示与检查器，减少为新通用及定制芯片搭建软件所需的时间与工程投入。作者同时讨论了形式化Blackwell相关架构特性的挑战及当前局限。

title: UpliftMem: Learning Set-Level Uplift for Agent Memory Retrieval
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents reuse external memory to guide new tasks, but effective retrieval requires learning which memory sets improve execution. Such learning relies on costly outcome feedback: ordinary retrieval observes only executed sets, while evaluating alternatives requires additional rollouts. We introduce \textsc{UpliftMem}, which learns memory retrieval from set-level execution uplift relative to the same executor without memory. A theoretical analysis of how retrieval preferences restrict feedback coverage motivates targeted probing of alternative memory sets. Probe selection follows an expected value of sample information (EVSI) criterion, derived in closed form under a correlated Gaussian model, to allocate limited training rollouts according to their expected improvement in local retrieval decisions. The shared scorer is trained with a frozen executor and selects memory sets without test-time probes. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and BigCodeBench, \textsc{UpliftMem} achieves the best success rates among evaluated baselines on the main evaluation sets. Controlled fixed-store and matched probe budget evaluations further demonstrate improved memory-use decisions and more effective use of execution feedback.

AI.tldr: 提出 UpliftMem，利用"相对无记忆执行器的集合级执行增益"来学习 LLM 智能体的记忆检索，并通过 EVSI 准则对备选记忆集合进行定向探测，在有限 rollout 预算下提升检索决策质量。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体复用外部记忆来指导新任务，但有效检索需要学习"哪些记忆集合能提升执行效果"。这类学习依赖代价高昂的结果反馈：普通检索只能观测到已执行的记忆集合，而评估备选集合需要额外 rollout。反馈覆盖不足限制了检索策略的学习。
AI.method: 1) 以"相对同一无记忆执行器的集合级执行增益（uplift）"作为监督信号，而非绝对结果；2) 对检索偏好如何限制反馈覆盖进行理论分析，据此动机化对备选记忆集合的定向探测；3) 探测选择采用期望样本信息价值（EVSI）准则，在相关高斯模型下给出闭式解，按对局部检索决策的预期改进分配有限训练 rollout；4) 共享 scorer 在冻结执行器下训练，测试时无需探测即可直接选择记忆集合。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop 与 BigCodeBench 三个基准的主评测集上，UpliftMem 在所比较的基线中取得最优成功率；在受控的固定记忆库实验与匹配探测预算实验中，进一步显示其记忆使用决策更优、对执行反馈的利用更有效。
AI.conclusion: 以 uplift 作为学习目标并结合 EVSI 引导的定向探测，可在有限执行反馈下有效学习记忆检索策略，且推理阶段无需额外探测；固定记忆库与等预算对照表明性能提升来自记忆使用决策的改善与反馈利用效率的提高，而非仅探测数量增加。

title: CAD-Native Transformer Operators for AI-Aided Engineering
summary: Modern engineering systems, from automobiles to aircraft, are designed by using precise, continuous parametric computer-aided design (CAD) models. Evaluating design changes through numerical simulation requires meshing the continuous geometry, a computationally expensive and often brittle process that can require manual intervention and replaces the continuous representation with a discrete approximation. Most neural surrogates accelerate the simulation, but inherit this representation gap by relying on meshes, point clouds, voxels, or other sampled approximations of geometry. We introduce CANTO, a transformer neural operator that maps directly from continuous CAD geometry to physical fields, without meshing the input geometry. We develop a theoretical framework for learning operators from geometric manifolds to function spaces of physical fields, representing geometry through sequences of parametric patches. CANTO instantiates this framework by directly tokenizing non-uniform rational B-spline (NURBS) patches from their control points, knot vectors, and weights, and predicts continuous surface and volume fields at arbitrary query locations. We evaluate CANTO on four automotive and aircraft aerodynamics industry benchmarks: AhmedML, WindsorML, DrivAerML, and HiLiftAeroML. CANTO achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on most evaluated surface and volume prediction tasks, including a 19.8% reduction in surface-pressure relative $L_2$ error compared with AB-UPT on HiLiftAeroML. Differentiability with respect to CAD parameters further enables gradient-based inverse design of designs. On AhmedML, CANTO identifies designs with 4.4 to 20.4% lower drag than the best dataset designs satisfying the same volume and lift constraints, with the improvements verified using the same CFD setup used to generate the original dataset.

AI.tldr: CANTO是一种直接以连续NURBS CAD几何为输入、无需网格化的Transformer神经算子，可将CAD几何映射至物理场，在多个汽车与航空气动基准上达到最优精度并支持梯度反设计。
AI.motivation: 传统数值仿真需对连续几何进行网格划分，计算昂贵且易失败，还需人工干预，并以离散近似替代连续表示；多数神经代理虽加速仿真，但依赖网格、点云、体素等采样近似，仍继承表示鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出从几何流形到物理场函数空间的算子学习理论框架，以参数化曲面片序列表示几何；CANTO据此将NURBS面片的控制点、节点向量与权重直接分词化，在任意查询位置预测连续曲面与体积场。
AI.result: 在AhmedML、WindsorML、DrivAerML、HiLiftAeroML四个气动基准上，CANTO在多数表面与体积预测任务中达到SOTA；HiLiftAeroML表面压力相对L2误差较AB-UPT降低19.8%。在AhmedML上找到满足相同体积与升力约束、阻力降低4.4%至20.4%的设计，并经原CFD设置验证。
AI.conclusion: CANTO实现了从连续CAD几何到物理场的直接映射，避免网格化表示鸿沟，兼具高精度仿真代理能力与对CAD参数的可微性，可用于梯度反设计。

title: Geometry-Conditioned Fixed-Scaffold Encoders for Time-Warp Robust Sequence Retrieval
summary: Embedding-based retrieval is attractive for long sequence collections because each item can be encoded once and searched by nearest-neighbor ranking. The difficulty is that the objects being indexed are often observed under a noncanonical clock: cardiac cycles stretch with rate, speech changes with tempo, and sensor traces reach comparable states at different speeds. This paper studies a specific source of instability in patch-based encoders for this regime. If patch boundaries are chosen from signal geometry, then the tokenization can change under the same temporal deformation that the representation is expected to tolerate. We propose GeoPatch, a fixed-scaffold patch encoder that keeps token support independent of geometry and uses slope, curvature, acceleration, affine-residual, and confidence descriptors only as continuous conditioning variables. The design turns boundary variation into feature modulation: geometry can change the embedding through a controlled pathway, but it cannot change the number, order, or support of local tokens. We formalize this distinction through a mechanism-level stability analysis that separates boundary drift, affine timing variation, confidence-weighted geometry perturbation, and retrieval-margin effects. The same local tokens support global embedding retrieval and late-interaction scoring, so the scoring rule can be matched to the evaluation protocol. Across ECG, speech, and multivariate time-series retrieval tasks, GeoPatch improves early-rank retrieval under timing variation while exposing a clear trade-off between local surface matching and strict non-overlap retrieval.

AI.tldr: GeoPatch 提出固定支架式 patch 编码器，使 token 支撑与几何无关，将几何变化转为特征调制，在 ECG、语音和多变量时间序列检索中提升时序变化下的早期排序性能。
AI.motivation: 基于嵌入的检索适合长序列，因为每个项目只需编码一次即可通过最近邻排序搜索。但在非规范时钟下（如心率随速率拉伸、语音随节奏变化、传感器轨迹以不同速度达到相似状态），patch 边界若由信号几何决定，则相同时间形变会改变 token 化，破坏表示稳定性。
AI.method: 提出 GeoPatch 固定支架 patch 编码器：保持 token 支撑独立于几何，仅将斜率、曲率、加速度、仿射残差和置信度描述符作为连续条件变量；通过机制级稳定性分析分离边界漂移、仿射时序变化、置信度加权几何扰动和检索边界效应；同一局部 token 支持全局嵌入检索和晚交互评分。
AI.result: 在 ECG、语音和多变量时间序列检索任务中，GeoPatch 在时序变化下改善了早期排序检索，同时揭示了局部表面匹配与严格非重叠检索之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 将 patch 边界与几何解耦可提升时序形变下的嵌入稳定性；几何仅通过受控路径影响嵌入，而不能改变局部 token 的数量、顺序或支撑，从而兼顾全局检索与晚交互评分。

title: Calibrate the Decisions That Change the Future: On-Policy Post-Training Quantization for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) lowers deployment cost for multimodal large language models, but calibration typically reconstructs fixed sequences with local objectives. This overlooks autoregressive feedback: a quantization-induced token change redirects the prefix and changes future states. Yet on-policy coverage alone is insufficient because many decision mismatches barely affect future generation. We propose OnPTQ, an on-policy framework that calibrates on trajectories visited by the current quantized policy. On shared prefixes, OnPTQ identifies quantization-eroded boundaries, evaluates competing tokens through short counterfactual rollouts, and combines current discrepancy with branch consequence into a Decision--Consequence risk. The risk prioritizes critical states, while context anchoring and trajectory refresh preserve multimodal behavior and keep calibration aligned with the updated policy. We further derive a Decision--Consequence bound linking behavioral deviation to current policy discrepancy and action-conditioned future-value span. Across vision--language and omni-modal Qwen models under multiple low-bit settings, OnPTQ improves downstream performance and yields fewer correctness flips against the corresponding Dense/FP16 references, without changing the deployed inference graph.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OnPTQ，一种面向多模态大语言模型的后训练量化框架，通过在当前量化策略实际访问的轨迹上进行 on-policy 校准，并引入 Decision–Consequence 风险识别关键状态，在不改变部署推理图的前提下提升低比特下游性能并减少正确性翻转。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型后训练量化（PTQ）在校准时通常重建固定序列并使用局部目标，忽视了自回归反馈：量化引起的 token 变化会改变前缀并影响未来状态。然而单纯依赖 on-policy 覆盖并不充分，因为许多决策偏差对未来生成几乎无影响，因此需要区分真正重要的状态。
AI.method: OnPTQ 在当前量化策略访问的轨迹上进行校准。在共享前缀上，它识别被量化侵蚀的决策边界，通过短程反事实 rollout 评估竞争 token，并将当前偏差与分支后果结合为 Decision–Consequence 风险；该风险用于优先处理关键状态，同时通过上下文锚定与轨迹刷新保持多模态行为并使校准与更新后的策略对齐。论文还推导了 Decision–Consequence 界，将行为偏差与当前策略偏差及动作条件未来价值跨度联系起来。
AI.result: 在视觉–语言和全模态 Qwen 模型的多种低比特设置下，OnPTQ 提升了下游性能，并相对于对应的 Dense/FP16 参考产生更少的正确性翻转，且不改变部署推理图。
AI.conclusion: OnPTQ 通过 on-policy 轨迹校准与 Decision–Consequence 风险度量的结合，有效缓解多模态大模型 PTQ 中自回归反馈带来的误差累积问题，在多种低比特设置下实现更优性能与更高保真度，同时保持部署友好性。

title: Where Does Staleness Accumulate? Pool Aware Effective Staleness Control for Asynchronous RL in LLM Post-Training
summary: Fully asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) improves resource utilization in large language model post-training by overlapping rollout generation with policy optimization, but it also introduces policy lag as trajectories are generated and queued while the trainer continues to update. We study how this lag accumulates over a trajectory's lifetime and how it can be controlled without sacrificing the wall-clock benefits of asynchronous execution. We decompose trajectory staleness into Generation Staleness, accumulated before rollout completion, and Waiting Staleness, accumulated after a completed trajectory enters the pool. Motivated by this decomposition, we introduce PACE (Pool-Aware Control of Effective Staleness). PACE converts excess pool occupancy into an adaptive rejection budget and ranks completed trajectories using an effective-staleness score that combines Waiting Staleness with prefix-aware Generation Staleness. This avoids penalizing long or interrupted rollouts solely because they span multiple policy versions. In single-turn mathematical reasoning, PACE improves the six-benchmark average validation accuracy by 18.7\% over unfiltered asynchronous RL at the same wall-clock budget and matches synchronous RL performance with 47.1\% less GPU time. PACE also improves validation performance in multi-turn tool-integrated reasoning, outperforming both synchronous and unfiltered asynchronous RL. Further experiments with the mixture-of-experts model and an alternative RL algorithm support its applicability across model architectures and training algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PACE方法，将异步强化学习中的轨迹陈旧度分解为生成陈旧度与等待陈旧度，并据此进行池感知的自适应控制，在保持异步时间优势的同时显著提升训练效果。
AI.motivation: 全异步强化学习虽能通过重叠轨迹生成与策略优化提升资源利用率，但会产生策略滞后（policy lag）：轨迹在生成和排队期间，训练器仍在更新策略，导致轨迹陈旧。如何在保留异步执行墙钟时间收益的同时控制这种滞后，是本文研究动机。
AI.method: 将轨迹陈旧度分解为生成阶段累积的Generation Staleness和完成轨迹进入池后累积的Waiting Staleness。基于此提出PACE（Pool-Aware Control of Effective Staleness）：将过量的池占用转化为自适应拒绝预算，并用有效陈旧度评分对已完成轨迹排序，该评分结合等待陈旧度与前缀感知的生成陈旧度，避免仅因轨迹跨越多个策略版本而惩罚长或被中断的轨迹。
AI.result: 在单轮数学推理中，相同墙钟预算下PACE相比未过滤异步RL的六基准平均验证准确率提升18.7%，并以减少47.1%的GPU时间达到同步RL性能。在多轮工具集成推理中，PACE的验证性能优于同步与未过滤异步RL。混合专家模型和替代RL算法的实验也支持其跨模型架构与训练算法的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 通过对轨迹陈旧度的细粒度分解与池感知的自适应控制，PACE有效缓解异步RL的策略滞后问题，在保留异步执行效率优势的同时提升验证性能，并具备良好的通用性。

title: ARC-KV: Amortizing Anchor Search for Reconstruction-Based KV Cache Compaction
summary: Long-context large language model inference is bottlenecked by KV caches that grow linearly with sequence length. This burden is especially severe for long, reusable context prefixes, whose cache must serve many downstream queries. Reconstruction-based methods such as Attention Matching achieve strong downstream task performance with compact KV caches. However, iterative anchor search dominates the compaction cost of OMP-based Attention Matching. This motivates our selective amortization principle of learning a reusable anchor-selection policy across contexts while retaining context-specific reconstruction. In this work, we propose ARC-KV, a novel reconstruction-based KV cache compaction method that follows this principle. To this end, we first train a value-aware indexer to select real-key anchors in a single scoring pass. ARC-KV then applies convex-hull-constrained key merging and fits an attention-mass bias and compact values against the full cache. At inference time, ARC-KV builds the compact cache once per context using the frozen indexer and reuses it for all subsequent queries. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ARC-KV outperforms reported compaction methods in most settings across QuALITY, RULER, and LongBench on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. In particular, at 10% KV retention on QuALITY, ARC-KV improves accuracy from 0.6409 to 0.6474 over Attention Matching while reducing compaction time by a factor of 25.73, from 959.8 s to 37.3 s.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ARC-KV，一种基于重建的KV缓存压缩方法，通过可复用的锚点选择策略替代昂贵的逐上下文迭代锚点搜索，在保持下游任务性能的同时大幅降低压缩耗时。
AI.motivation: 长上下文LLM推理受限于随序列长度线性增长的KV缓存，尤其是可复用的长前缀场景。基于重建的方法（如Attention Matching）虽性能强，但其基于OMP的迭代锚点搜索是压缩开销的主要瓶颈。作者据此提出"选择性摊销"原则：跨上下文学习可复用的锚点选择策略，同时保留上下文特定的重建过程。
AI.method: ARC-KV首先训练一个值感知（value-aware）索引器，通过单次打分即可选出真实键锚点；随后施加凸包约束的键合并（convex-hull-constrained key merging），并针对完整缓存拟合注意力质量偏置（attention-mass bias）与紧凑值。推理时，使用冻结的索引器为每个上下文构建一次紧凑缓存，并对后续所有查询复用该缓存。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上，于QuALITY、RULER、LongBench多个基准的大多数设置中，ARC-KV优于现有压缩方法。在QuALITY上10% KV保留率下，准确率从Attention Matching的0.6409提升至0.6474，同时压缩时间从959.8秒降至37.3秒，加速25.73倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过将锚点选择策略摊销化，ARC-KV在性能与效率之间取得更优平衡，证明可复用索引器加上下文特定重建是压缩可复用KV缓存的有效范式。

title: Automated Screw Planning for Reduced Pelvic Fractures Based on Statistical Shape Models and Deep Learning
summary: Percutaneous iliosacral screw fixation is an important minimally invasive treatment for unstable pelvic fractures. Because the sacroiliac region has complex anatomy and narrow screw corridors, the accuracy and safety of screw placement directly affect surgical outcomes. Accurate and reliable preoperative screw planning is therefore essential to improve surgical success and reduce intraoperative risks. Conventional preoperative planning typically requires surgeons to determine screw trajectories through manual measurements, a labor-intensive process that depends on subjective clinical experience. To address these challenges, we propose a fully automated pipeline for preoperative iliosacral screw planning in patients with pelvic fractures. Using patient-specific three-dimensional anatomy, the pipeline automatically identifies safe screw corridors and generates individualized insertion trajectories to support clinical preoperative planning. We evaluated the proposed pipeline on 200 clinical cases of pelvic fractures. Compared with conventional manual measurements, the safety margin of the safe insertion corridors increased by 2% across the four screw types, the mean planning time decreased by more than 90%, and the clinical acceptance rate reached 95%.

AI.tldr: 提出全自动经皮骶髂螺钉术前规划流程，自动识别安全通道并生成个性化置钉轨迹，在200例骨盆骨折病例上验证，安全裕度提升2%，规划时间缩短90%以上，临床接受率95%。
AI.motivation: 经皮骶髂螺钉固定是骨盆不稳定骨折的重要微创治疗方式，但骶髂区解剖复杂、螺钉通道狭窄，置钉精度与安全性直接影响手术效果，因此术前规划至关重要。传统术前规划依赖术者手工测量确定螺钉轨迹，耗时且受主观临床经验影响，亟需自动化、可靠的规划手段。
AI.method: 面向骨盆骨折患者，提出一套全自动术前骶髂螺钉规划流程。基于患者个体化三维解剖结构，流程自动识别安全螺钉通道并生成个性化进钉轨迹，用于支持临床术前规划。
AI.result: 在200例临床骨盆骨折病例上评估。与传统手工测量相比，四类螺钉的安全进钉通道安全裕度平均提升2%，平均规划时间减少90%以上，临床接受率达95%。
AI.conclusion: 该全自动流程能够生成安全且个性化的骶髂螺钉置钉轨迹，显著缩短规划时间并提升临床接受度，具备辅助骨盆骨折术前规划的临床应用潜力。

title: When Upstream Messages Override Correct Answers: A Controlled Study of Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems rely on message passing among specialized agents to accomplish complex tasks. However, an upstream agent may provide useful information or an incorrect answer that causes a downstream agent to override a correct answer supported by its own evidence. Prior work has not clearly separated the benefits of communication from the damage caused by incorrect messages. We study this problem with controlled experiments across five benchmarks and five receivers, keeping the downstream task and evidence fixed while comparing answers under three conditions: no message, the upstream agent's original message, or a message with the opposite conclusion. Our experiments reveal three key findings. First, messages often help when the downstream agent would otherwise answer incorrectly. Second, messages can also hurt: when the downstream agent would answer correctly without a message, an incorrect upstream message changes the answer in up to 32% of cases. Third, in 94% of audited harmful cases, the downstream agent copies the upstream's specific wrong answer--a pattern we term answer substitution. Removing unreliable messages recovers part of the lost accuracy, suggesting that communication should be selective based on upstream reliability and the evidence already available to the downstream agent.

AI.tldr: 本文通过控制实验研究多智能体LLM系统中上游消息对下游智能体的影响，识别出通信的收益与危害，并提出应基于上游可靠性和下游已有证据进行选择性通信。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM系统依赖消息传递，但上游智能体可能提供错误答案，导致下游智能体推翻其基于自身证据得出的正确答案。已有工作未能清晰区分通信带来的收益与错误消息造成的损害。
AI.method: 在五个基准和五个接收方上进行控制实验，固定下游任务与证据，比较三种条件下的答案：无消息、上游原始消息、结论相反的消息。
AI.result: 发现三点：一是当下游本会答错时消息常有帮助；二是消息也有害，当下游本可答对时，错误上游消息最多在32%的情况下改变答案；三是在审计的有害案例中，94%的下游智能体复制了上游的具体错误答案，称为答案替换（answer substitution）。移除不可靠消息可部分恢复损失的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 通信应具有选择性，需依据上游可靠性以及下游智能体已有的证据来决定是否采纳上游消息。

title: IronLLM: Forging Compact Edge-Native Language Models for Real-Time Embodied Intelligence
summary: We present IronLLM-0.6B, a 654M-parameter language model designed for efficient on-device inference. IronLLM-0.6B combines a hybrid attention architecture with X-MTP, a lightweight shared-KV multi-token prediction design that eliminates per-depth KV-cache replay and employs a lightweight verification head for rollback-free drafting, achieving a 1.48x decoding speedup. The model is pretrained on approximately 6.2 trillion tokens using a quality-oriented data pipeline and is further post-trained with Multi-Domain On-Policy Distillation to integrate capabilities from domain-specialized teachers. To better meet the low-latency requirements of on-device scenarios, IronLLM-0.6B adopts an Instruct-Only design. Evaluations show that IronLLM-0.6B achieves competitive performance relative to larger models such as Qwen3.5-0.8B and MiniCPM5-1B, while producing more concise responses on many tasks. We further present IronLLM-0.6B-Light, which replaces RMSNorm with Dynamic Tanh and simplifies several computationally expensive components to improve inference and quantization efficiency. Together, the IronLLM models provide an effective performance-efficiency trade-off for resource-constrained deployment.

AI.tldr: IronLLM-0.6B 是一个 654M 参数的语言模型，采用混合注意力架构与 X-MTP 多 token 预测方案，面向端侧高效推理，在约 6.2T token 上预训练，并经多域在线策略蒸馏后训练，性能可对标更大模型，同时提供进一步优化推理与量化效率的 Light 版本。
AI.motivation: 端侧场景对低延迟、资源受限部署有强烈需求，而现有较大模型难以满足该约束，因此需要在小参数规模下兼顾性能与推理效率。
AI.method: 1) 采用混合注意力架构；2) 提出 X-MTP 轻量共享 KV 多 token 预测设计，消除逐深度 KV 缓存重放，并使用轻量验证头实现无回滚草稿；3) 在约 6.2T token 上以质量导向数据流水线预训练；4) 使用 Multi-Domain On-Policy Distillation 进行后训练以融合领域专家教师能力；5) 采用 Instruct-Only 设计；6) Light 版本以 Dynamic Tanh 替代 RMSNorm 并简化高开销组件。
AI.result: X-MTP 实现 1.48 倍解码加速；模型性能相对 Qwen3.5-0.8B 和 MiniCPM5-1B 等更大模型具有竞争力，且在多项任务上输出更简洁；Light 版本提升了推理与量化效率。
AI.conclusion: IronLLM 系列为资源受限部署提供了有效的性能—效率折中方案。

title: State Trace Rationale As Auxiliary Task in Reinforcement Learning
comment: Under review as a conference paper at ICLR 2027
summary: We propose STRAT, an auxiliary task that trains deep reinforcement learning (RL) agents to predict a short textual trace of their own state. Inspired by human spatial navigation, the description combines landmark, route, and survey knowledge, tracking the agent's position, inventory, goals, and immediate progress. Environment rules generate this text online without human labelling. Our method adds a single auxiliary head to a standard policy. Across 60 sparse-reward XLand-MiniGrid tasks, STRAT solves complex environments where standard RL fails outright, while compacting state representations and preventing rank collapse. Beyond performance gains, the predicted trace provides a readable account of agent beliefs at every step for no extra cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STRAT，一种辅助任务，训练深度强化学习（RL）智能体预测自身状态的简短文本轨迹，其描述融合地标、路线与全局知识，涵盖位置、物品栏、目标与即时进度，可由环境规则在线生成而无需人工标注。方法仅在标准策略上增加一个辅助头。在60个稀疏奖励XLand-MiniGrid任务中，STRAT能解决标准RL完全失败的复杂环境，同时压缩状态表示并防止秩崩塌；预测轨迹还以零额外成本提供每步可读的智能体信念。
AI.motivation: 受人类空间导航启发，稀疏奖励环境下标准RL难以学习；现有方法缺乏可解释性，且状态表示可能存在秩崩塌问题。作者希望设计一种无需人工标注的辅助任务，既提升性能又增强可解释性、改善表示质量。
AI.method: STRAT作为辅助任务：在标准策略网络上增加一个辅助头，让智能体在线预测描述自身状态的短文本轨迹。描述融合地标（landmark）、路线（route）与全局（survey）知识，追踪位置、物品栏、目标和即时进度。文本由环境规则在线自动生成，无需人工标注。
AI.result: 在60个稀疏奖励XLand-MiniGrid任务中，STRAT能解决标准RL完全失败的复杂环境；同时压缩了状态表示并防止秩崩塌（rank collapse）；预测的文本轨迹在每一步提供可读的智能体信念说明，且不产生额外成本。
AI.conclusion: 将预测自身状态文本轨迹作为辅助任务，可同时提升稀疏奖励RL的性能与表示质量，并带来零成本的可解释性，是一种兼具效果与可读性的通用方法。

title: WEFT: Scaling Tool-Use Post-Training for General-Purpose Agents
summary: Recent efforts to scale tool-use post-training have largely centered on the synthesis of executable environments, which constitute only one component of a broader agentic interaction system comprising the environment, task, agent harness, and evaluator. Scaling environments in isolation, however, does not guarantee commensurate gains in model performance, because reliable learning signals depend on coherent interactions among all components of the agentic interaction system. To address this problem, we introduce WEFT (Whole-system Evolution For Tool-use Post-training), which couples scalable agentic interaction system construction, execution-driven self-evolution, and stable post-training. WEFT scales agentic interaction system construction across environment breadth, task complexity, and interaction diversity. Execution-driven self-evolution iteratively uses execution traces and state evidence to attribute failures and revise the responsible components, with fresh rollouts evaluating the changes and providing evidence for subsequent evolution rounds. For stable post-training at scale, WEFT addresses both optimization and execution reliability: prefix-preserving sampling retains verified progress and atomic-turn credit assignment localizes learning signals, while MegaMCP maintains isolated, recoverable state across concurrent rollouts over shared tool services. Extensive experiments across various models and benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of WEFT for tool-use post-training. WEFT-8B and WEFT-14B outperform all evaluated matched-size environment-scaling baselines on BFCL V4, $τ^2$-Bench, and Claw-Eval. In particular, WEFT-14B improves over Agent-World-14B by 6.41, 2.23, and 12.27 percentage points. WEFT-35B-A3B further extends these gains to more challenging long-horizon workflow benchmarks, including Toolathlon-Verified and AutomationBench.

AI.tldr: WEFT 提出"整体系统进化"的工具使用后训练框架，协同优化环境、任务、智能体框架与评估器四大组件，在多个基准上超越环境扩展类基线。
AI.motivation: 现有工具使用后训练工作主要聚焦于可执行环境的合成，但环境只是智能体交互系统（环境、任务、智能体框架、评估器）的一个组成部分。孤立地扩展环境并不能保证模型性能的相应提升，因为可靠的学习信号依赖于系统各组件的协同交互。
AI.method: WEFT 将可扩展的交互系统构建、执行驱动的自进化与稳定后训练三者耦合。系统构建沿环境广度、任务复杂度和交互多样性三个维度扩展；自进化利用执行轨迹与状态证据归因失败并修订相应组件，再通过新一轮 rollout 评估变更、为后续轮次提供证据。稳定后训练方面，前缀保持采样保留已验证进展，原子轮次信用分配定位学习信号，MegaMCP 在共享工具服务上维持并发 rollout 的隔离可恢复状态。
AI.result: 在多种模型与基准上验证了有效性。WEFT-8B 与 WEFT-14B 在 BFCL V4、τ²-Bench 和 Claw-Eval 上均优于所有同规模的环境扩展基线；WEFT-14B 相较 Agent-World-14B 分别提升 6.41、2.23 和 12.27 个百分点。WEFT-35B-A3B 进一步将增益扩展至 Toolathlon-Verified 和 AutomationBench 等长时程工作流基准。
AI.conclusion: 工具使用后训练不应仅扩展环境，而应对包含环境、任务、智能体框架与评估器的整个交互系统进行联合进化，并配合稳定的优化与执行机制，从而在多种规模和基准上取得稳定且可扩展的性能提升。

title: Beyond Sub-Gaussian Detector Scores: Robust Weighted Profile-Loss Change Point Detection for Human-LLM Text Segmentation
summary: Mixed human-LLM documents require locating authorship transitions from detector scores whose reliability varies across text units. Existing weighted mean contrasts are vulnerable to extreme scores, while directly replacing means with robust centers obscures how a misplaced boundary changes the population objective. We propose Robust Weighted Profile-Loss Change Point Detection (RWCP), which combines capped reliability weights, Huber profile gains, and narrowest-over-threshold search in reliability coordinates. Our key analysis expresses the population gap between a true and a displaced split as a merge cost, avoiding a closed-form solution for the nonlinear center of a mixed segment. Under explicit curvature, spacing, and dependence conditions, core RWCP recovers the number of changes and localizes their boundaries; its quadratic-loss limit recovers squared weighted CUSUM. We also study RWCP-R, a separately evaluated decoder that shares source centers across nonadjacent passages. Across five retrospective cached-score benchmark families, core RWCP reduces family-macro WindowDiff by 17.6\% relative to weighted change-point detection, and RWCP-R lowers it further. Boundary recovery improves most clearly for isolated changes, while both fixed configurations miss changes in collaborative and densely alternating text.

AI.tldr: 提出鲁棒加权剖面损失变点检测(RWCP)，在可靠性坐标下结合截断权重、Huber增益与最窄阈值搜索，实现混合人-LLM文档的作者权转移定位。
AI.motivation: 混合人-LLM文档需从检测器分数定位作者权转移，但分数可靠性随文本单元变化。现有加权均值对比对极端分数敏感，而用鲁棒中心直接替换均值又掩盖了边界错位如何改变总体目标。
AI.method: RWCP方法：截断可靠性权重 + Huber剖面增益 + 可靠性坐标下的最窄过阈值搜索；关键分析将真实与错位切分间的总体差距表达为合并代价，避免求解混合段非线性中心的闭式解；另研究RWCP-R解码器，跨非相邻段落共享源中心。
AI.result: 在曲率、间距与依赖条件明确时，核心RWCP可恢复变点数量并定位边界，其二次损失极限退化为平方加权CUSUM。五个回顾性缓存分数基准族上，家族宏平均WindowDiff相对加权变点检测降低17.6%，RWCP-R进一步降低；孤立变点边界恢复改善最明显，但两种固定配置在协作型与密集交替文本中均漏检。
AI.conclusion: RWCP通过鲁棒加权剖面损失有效提升作者权变点检测的边界恢复精度，二次损失极限与经典CUSUM关联，但仍无法处理协作及密集交替文本的变点。

title: HorizonFlow: Variable-Length Planning for Offline Goal-Conditioned RL
summary: Recent advances in generative planning have made trajectory inpainting a promising approach to offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning. However, these methods typically specify the planning horizon before generating plan content, even though the appropriate horizon depends on the route itself. A horizon that is too short can force infeasible transitions, whereas one that is too long can introduce redundant motion. We introduce HorizonFlow, a hierarchical planner that treats plan length as an output of generation rather than a prescribed input. Its subgoal route planner guides its action-prefix controller through a sequence of latent subgoals. Both components combine insertion-based generation with flow matching to jointly generate continuous plan content and length, using the partially generated plan to guide token insertion. HorizonFlow reuses the resulting length information to select candidates and steer generation toward shorter plans without a separate learned value model. Across Maze2D, Multi2D, and OGBench navigation and visual manipulation benchmarks, HorizonFlow achieves the highest average performance among the compared methods.

AI.tldr: HorizonFlow 将规划长度视为生成输出而非预设输入，通过子目标路线规划器与动作前缀控制器协同，结合插入式生成与流匹配，在多个离线目标条件强化学习基准上取得最高平均性能。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式规划方法通常在生成规划内容之前就预先指定规划时域，但合适的时域取决于路线本身：时域过短会迫使不可行转移，过长则引入冗余运动。
AI.method: 提出 HorizonFlow，一种分层规划器，将规划长度作为生成输出。其子目标路线规划器引导动作前缀控制器经过一系列潜在子目标；两个组件结合插入式生成与流匹配，联合生成连续规划内容与长度，并利用部分生成的规划引导 token 插入。此外复用长度信息进行候选选择，将生成导向更短的规划，无需单独学习价值模型。
AI.result: 在 Maze2D、Multi2D 以及 OGBench 的导航与视觉操作基准上，HorizonFlow 在对比方法中取得最高平均性能。
AI.conclusion: 将规划长度作为生成输出并借助流匹配与插入式生成进行联合建模，是一种有效提升离线目标条件强化学习中生成式规划性能的途径。

title: STAR-GRPO: Canonical Anchoring and Reliability-First Advantages against Representation-Dependent Reward Hacking
summary: Reward hacking occurs when policy optimization exploits a brittle reward interface or an overly permissive proxy objective, improving the training score without improving the underlying response quality. This phenomenon is amplified in group-relative policy optimization: an unsupported reward can shift the group baseline and alter the updates of other rollouts, while post-hoc or purely relative weighting cannot represent group-wide uncertainty. We propose \emph{Self-Tuned Anchored Reliability Group-Relative Policy Optimization} (STAR-GRPO), a reliability-first advantage estimator based on paired assessments of the same rollout. STAR separates the quality signal from its learning influence: score disagreement determines rollout reliability, relative reliability enters a self-tuned robust location--scale fit before group normalization, and absolute group reliability attenuates the resulting bounded advantage. The analysis establishes coordinate and second-moment bounds, characterizes exact centering through the weighted location equation, and gives reliability-dependent attenuation guarantees for outlying rewards. We evaluate STAR-GRPO in two complementary reward-hacking regimes. In token-interface exploitation, STAR prevents runaway optimization of the deployed-interface score while improving the canonical quality signal. In rubric-proxy overoptimization for medical reasoning, STAR improves independent semantic evaluation, narrows the proxy--judge discrepancy, and reduces overclaim while optimizing the same task proxy. Together, these results show that reliability-first normalization offers a principled way to limit unsupported reward influence on both group baselines and policy updates, while retaining the task reward as the optimization target.

AI.tldr: STAR-GRPO：一种以可靠性为先的优势估计方法，通过同一rollout的成对评估分离质量信号与学习影响，抑制奖励hacking。
AI.motivation: 奖励hacking源于策略优化利用脆弱的奖励接口或过于宽松的代理目标，在提升训练分数时并未改善底层响应质量。该现象在组相对策略优化（GRPO）中被放大：不受支持的奖励会移动组基线并改变其他rollout的更新，而事后或纯相对加权无法表示组级不确定性。
AI.method: 提出STAR-GRPO，基于同一rollout的成对评估构建可靠性优先的优势估计器：将质量信号与学习影响分离；分数分歧决定rollout可靠性；相对可靠性进入自调优的鲁棒位置-尺度拟合，再进行组归一化；绝对组可靠性对最终有界优势进行衰减。理论分析给出坐标与二阶矩界、通过加权位置方程刻画精确中心化，以及针对离群奖励的可靠性相关衰减保证。
AI.result: 在两种互补的奖励hacking场景中评估：在token接口利用场景中，STAR阻止了部署接口分数的失控优化，同时提升了规范质量信号；在医学推理的rubric代理过优化场景中，STAR改善了独立语义评估，缩小了代理与评判者之间的差距，减少了过度宣称，同时优化同一任务代理。
AI.conclusion: 可靠性优先的归一化为限制不受支持的奖励对组基线和策略更新的影响提供了原则性方法，同时保留任务奖励作为优化目标。

title: PrecogUI: Proactive GUI Agents via Pre-cognitive Simulation and Experience Retrieval
summary: Existing reactive Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents often fail in long-horizon, dynamic scenarios, where unexpected disturbances trigger attention-diverting and cascading failures. To address this, we propose PrecogUI, a pre-cognitive architecture that shifts the paradigm from reactive execution to proactive decision-making. Specifically, we design a Proactive Experience Pool (PEP), which caches recurring anomaly and success patterns as "state-action-result" tuples in a dual-memory repository. Furthermore, we introduce a Proactive Simulation Executor (PSE) that learns to forecast the next symbolic UI layout given a candidate action, enabling early anomaly avoidance and ranking candidate actions by predicted reliability. Finally, a Pre-cognitive Execution Controller (PEC) fuses these priors and predictions, prioritizes handling of foreseen anomalies, and ensures execution robustness through a closed-loop error correction mechanism. For robust evaluation, we develop AutoTraj, an automatic data-generation engine, to construct InterfereBench, a benchmark for long-horizon tasks with strong disturbances. Experiments demonstrate that PrecogUI surpasses state-of-the-art methods on InterfereBench while maintaining competitive performance on public benchmarks. The code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PrecogUI，一种从"反应式执行"转向"预认知决策"的 GUI 智能体架构，通过经验池、模拟执行器与执行控制器三模块协同，在长程动态任务中实现前瞻性异常规避，并配套构建 AutoTraj 数据引擎与 InterfereBench 基准。
AI.motivation: 现有反应式 GUI 智能体在长程、动态场景中表现不佳：意外扰动会分散注意力并引发级联失败，缺乏对未来状态的前瞻能力。
AI.method: 设计三个组件：1）Proactive Experience Pool（PEP），以"state-action-result"元组形式在双记忆库中缓存反复出现的异常与成功模式；2）Proactive Simulation Executor（PSE），学习在给定候选动作下预测下一符号化 UI 布局，从而提前规避异常并按预测可靠性对候选动作排序；3）Pre-cognitive Execution Controller（PEC），融合先验与预测，优先处理可预见的异常，并通过闭环纠错机制保障执行鲁棒性。此外开发 AutoTraj 自动数据生成引擎以构建 InterfereBench 基准。
AI.result: 在 InterfereBench 上超越现有最先进方法，同时在公开基准上保持有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 预认知/前瞻式决策范式可有效提升 GUI 智能体在长程强扰动场景下的鲁棒性，代码将公开。

title: Neuro-Symbolic Computer Use: Learning Reusable Policies for Reliable and Efficient Execution
summary: Many computer tasks recur: the same workflow runs many times, with new inputs and from different starting states. Current computer-use agents re-plan every step of every run, which makes them costly and unreliable on such tasks. We introduce neuro-symbolic computer use, in which a recurring workflow is executed by a learned policy rather than re-derived by an agent on each run. The policy fixes the decisions that are stable across runs (ordering, variables, loops, and branches) in executable code, and delegates observation-dependent decisions, such as grounding and state checks, to neural models. We learn these policies with neuro-symbolic policy iteration: starting from one agent trajectory, it executes the policy, diagnoses failures with task-completion and step-level judges, and revises the code with a coding model informed by an agent's continuation from the point of failure, without access to the benchmark evaluator. Iterating on generated parameter and initial-state variants makes the policy reusable, and a pre-action verifier guards each state-mutating step at deployment. On OSWorld-Verified and ScienceBoard, the learned policies achieve the highest Pass^3 of all methods in all four settings, 3.6-15.8 points above the base agent, while cutting per-run cost by 15-217$\times$ and latency by 3.4-5.1$\times$. On OSWorld-Verified, policies built only on variants transfer to the held-out original tasks, exceeding AutoRPA by 8.6-17.5 points in Pass^3.

AI.tldr: 提出神经符号计算机使用（neuro-symbolic computer use）：用可学习策略以可执行代码固化重复工作流中的稳定决策，将依赖观测的决策交给神经模型，通过神经符号策略迭代从单条轨迹学习策略，在OSWorld-Verified与ScienceBoard上取得最高Pass^3，并大幅降低单次运行成本与延迟。
AI.motivation: 许多计算机任务具有重复性：同一工作流在不同输入和不同初始状态下反复运行。当前计算机使用智能体每次运行都逐步重新规划，导致成本高、可靠性差，因此需要一种能复用稳定流程、仅在必要时进行神经推理的执行方式。
AI.method: 提出神经符号策略迭代：从一条智能体轨迹出发，执行策略，用任务完成与步骤级评判器诊断失败，并由编码模型在失败点智能体续接的提示下修改代码；迭代生成参数与初始状态变体以提升策略可复用性；部署时用动作前置验证器守护每个改变状态的步骤。策略用可执行代码固定跨运行稳定的决策（顺序、变量、循环、分支），把grounding、状态检查等观测依赖决策委托给神经模型，且不访问基准评测器。
AI.result: 在OSWorld-Verified和ScienceBoard上，所学策略在全部四种设置中取得所有方法中最高的Pass^3，比基础智能体高3.6–15.8分，同时将单次运行成本降低15–217倍、延迟降低3.4–5.1倍。在OSWorld-Verified上，仅基于变体构建的策略可迁移到留出的原始任务，Pass^3超过AutoRPA 8.6–17.5分。
AI.conclusion: 将重复工作流的稳定决策固化为可执行代码、仅把观测依赖决策交给神经模型，并配合策略迭代与前置验证，可显著提升计算机使用智能体的可靠性、可复用性与效率，且具备向原始任务迁移的能力。

title: Learn from the Gap: Differential-Aware Advantage Pruning with Adaptive Rollout Sampling for GRPO
summary: Recently, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and its variants have been developed for policy optimization and demonstrated notable performance gains. However, these methods usually incur substantial computational overhead due to per-question multi-rollout sampling and repeated per-token probability evaluation across rollouts. Furthermore, low-information or highly homogeneous trajectories can degrade downstream learning signal efficiency, hindering model optimization and limiting final performance. To address these issues, we propose FastRL, a novel plug-and-play reinforcement learning framework that simultaneously improves training efficiency and the effectiveness of policy learning. Specifically, 1) We introduce an advantage-aware pruning strategy to selectively preserve high-advantage trajectories while maximizing inter-trajectory gradient diversity. 2) Then, we design an adaptive rollout sampling mechanism to dynamically adjust the sampling scale across different training stages based on historical pruning distributions, balancing exploration adequacy and computational efficiency. Experiments demonstrate that FastRL can be seamlessly integrated into GRPO, DAPO, and GSPO variants, achieving an average 2.07$\times$ training speedup on Geometry3K and GeoQA8K-R1V, along with an approximately 1.64\% improvement in average accuracy on visual reasoning benchmarks. Source codes will be available at https://github.com/Nicozwy/FastRL.

AI.tldr: FastRL是一种即插即用的强化学习框架，通过优势感知剪枝和自适应采样机制，在提升训练效率的同时改善策略学习效果，可无缝集成到GRPO、DAPO、GSPO中，实现平均2.07倍训练加速与约1.64%精度提升。
AI.motivation: GRPO及其变体虽在策略优化上取得显著性能增益，但存在两个问题：一是每问题多轨迹采样与跨轨迹重复的逐token概率评估带来大量计算开销；二是低信息量或高度同质的轨迹会降低下游学习信号效率，阻碍模型优化并限制最终性能。
AI.method: 提出FastRL框架，包含两个核心组件：1）优势感知剪枝策略，选择性保留高优势轨迹，同时最大化轨迹间梯度多样性；2）自适应轨迹采样机制，基于历史剪枝分布在不同训练阶段动态调整采样规模，以平衡探索充分性与计算效率。
AI.result: FastRL可无缝集成到GRPO、DAPO和GSPO变体中，在Geometry3K和GeoQA8K-R1V上实现平均2.07倍训练加速，并在视觉推理基准上取得约1.64%的平均精度提升。
AI.conclusion: FastRL通过剪枝与自适应采样协同设计，同时提升强化学习训练效率与策略学习有效性，是一种通用、易集成的策略优化增强方案，源代码将在GitHub公开。

title: VLALight: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Traffic Signal Control
summary: Traffic signal control (TSC) is essential for improving urban mobility and reducing congestion. Although roadside cameras are widely deployed at signalized intersections and provide rich visual observations of evolving traffic, existing TSC methods typically rely on manually engineered traffic states or separate perception modules, creating a gap between physical observations and control decisions. We present VLALight, the first vision-language-action (VLA) model for end-to-end traffic signal control from multi-view roadside videos. VLALight directly maps visual observations to coordinated signal actions through multi-target spatiotemporal traffic reasoning and topology-aware cooperative perception across intersections. To establish this capability, we develop a two-stage supervised cold-start training strategy for visual traffic understanding and signal decision-making, followed by cooperative agentic reinforcement learning that jointly optimizes local control and network-wide traffic efficiency. Furthermore, VLALight introduces adaptive fast and slow reasoning modes, enabling the policy to allocate deeper reasoning only when additional deliberation provides sufficient control benefits. Through balanced mode-aware rollouts and relative advantage optimization, VLALight learns to trade off decision quality and inference cost. Extensive experiments on seven real-world traffic-flow datasets across three urban networks demonstrate that VLALight consistently outperforms transportation-based, RL-based, and LLM/VLM-based baselines. Ablation studies validate the effectiveness of cooperative perception, network-level optimization, and adaptive reasoning. These results demonstrate the potential of VLA models for real-world physical traffic control. Our project is available at https://github.com/usail-hkust/VLALight.git.

AI.tldr: VLALight：首个面向多视角路侧视频端到端交通信号控制的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，通过协同感知与自适应快慢推理实现网络级优化，在真实数据集上超越多类基线。
AI.motivation: 现有交通信号控制方法依赖人工设计的交通状态或独立感知模块，导致物理观测与控制决策之间存在脱节；同时路侧摄像头虽已广泛部署并提供丰富视觉观测，却未被端到端利用。
AI.method: 直接由多视角路侧视频映射到协同信号动作；采用多目标时空交通推理与跨路口拓扑感知的协同感知；两阶段监督冷启动（视觉交通理解、信号决策）后接协同智能体强化学习，联合优化局部控制与全网效率；引入自适应快/慢推理模式，通过均衡模式感知的 rollout 与相对优势优化权衡决策质量与推理成本。
AI.result: 在三个城市网络、七个真实交通流数据集上，VLALight 一致优于基于交通工程、强化学习及 LLM/VLM 的基线；消融实验验证了协同感知、网络级优化与自适应推理的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明 VLA 模型在真实物理交通控制中具有应用潜力，为端到端视觉驱动信号控制提供了新范式。

title: SCA: Spatial Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning of GUI Agents
summary: GUI agents automate tasks on digital devices by grounding language instructions in visual interfaces. Existing group-relative reinforcement learning improves GUI action prediction by comparing the rewards of multiple responses sampled from the same GUI state. However, binary evaluation treats spatially different failed clicks as identical and provides no relative signal when all sampled clicks fail. To address these limitations, we propose Spatial Credit Assignment (SCA), which uses the screen coordinates of sampled clicks to refine group-relative credit. Specifically, SCA predicts each held-out response's reward from the other responses in groups containing both successes and failures, then uses the prediction residual to adjust credit. When all sampled clicks fail, SCA instead orders them by distance to the annotated target. These spatial references are used only to construct the training update; the deployed policy remains unchanged. We evaluate whether this correction improves the policy update itself by comparing its error and directional alignment with the exact return gradient in a controlled synthetic study. Across GUI grounding and offline action-prediction benchmarks, SCA improves grounding across professional domains and achieves the strongest results among reinforcement-fine-tuned models on most action-prediction metrics, with consistent gains across the reported GUI suites.

AI.tldr: 本文提出空间信用分配（SCA），利用采样点击的屏幕坐标细化GUI智能体强化学习中的组相对信用分配，在全部失败组中按距标注目标的距离排序奖励，提升GUI定位与动作预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于组相对强化学习的GUI动作预测存在两个缺陷：一是二值奖励评价将位置不同的失败点击视为相同；二是当所有采样点击均失败时，组内不存在任何相对信号，无法有效更新策略。
AI.method: 提出SCA：在同时包含成功与失败的组中，用组内其他响应预测某被留出响应的奖励，并以预测残差调整信用；当所有采样点击均失败时，改用各点击到标注目标的距离进行排序。空间参考仅用于构造训练更新，部署策略不变。并通过受控合成实验，将其误差与方向对齐性与精确回报梯度比较。
AI.result: 合成研究显示该修正改进了策略更新本身；在GUI grounding与离线动作预测基准上，SCA在多个专业领域提升定位效果，在多数动作预测指标上取得强化微调模型中的最佳结果，并在各报告的GUI套件上取得一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 利用屏幕坐标的空间信息可有效弥补二值奖励与全失败组无相对信号的不足，从而在不改变部署策略的前提下提升GUI智能体策略更新的质量。

title: Dual-Channel Robust Group-Relative Policy Optimization via Advantage and Sequence-Weight Estimation
summary: Group-relative policy optimization relies on reward-derived advantages and sequence-level likelihood weights, both of which can be sensitive to localized outliers. Extreme rewards can collapse the contrast among clean responses after group normalization, while token-level log-ratio perturbations can alter sequence weights and clipping decisions. We introduce RoVR-GSPO, a dual-channel robust optimizer that addresses these failure modes separately. Its reward channel combines robust reference estimation with bounded residual credit, while its ratio channel uses differentiable SoftRoVR aggregation to construct robust sequence weights. We provide stability and efficiency analyses for both channels. Experiments on mathematical reasoning, long-context summarization, and tool-call annotation show consistent improvements over GSPO, while controlled perturbation studies demonstrate stronger robustness to reward contamination and token-ratio anomalies.

AI.tldr: 提出 RoVR-GSPO，一种双通道鲁棒优化器，分别处理奖励离群与序列级似然权重扰动问题，在多个任务上优于 GSPO 并展现更强鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 组相对策略优化依赖由奖励派生的优势值和序列级似然权重，二者都对局部离群值敏感：极端奖励在组归一化后会压缩干净响应之间的对比度，而 token 级对数比扰动会改变序列权重与裁剪决策，导致训练不稳定。
AI.method: 提出 RoVR-GSPO 双通道鲁棒优化器，分通道处理两类失效模式：奖励通道结合鲁棒参考估计与有界残差信用；比率通道使用可微的 SoftRoVR 聚合构造鲁棒序列权重；并给出两个通道的稳定性与效率分析。
AI.result: 在数学推理、长上下文摘要和工具调用标注任务上，相较 GSPO 取得一致提升；受控扰动实验显示对奖励污染和 token 比率异常具有更强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将奖励与比率两条通道解耦并分别施加鲁棒化设计，可在保持效率的同时缓解离群值引起的优化失效，验证了双通道鲁棒优化的有效性。

title: REALHOP: Rethinking Multi-Hop Reasoning Evaluation via Behavioral Auditing
summary: Complex questions often require multi-hop reasoning that connects facts distributed across sources or distant regions of a long context through intermediate steps. Benchmarks commonly evaluate this ability with questions built around predefined reasoning chains, treating a correct answer as evidence that the intended composition was used. Yet answer correctness alone leaves open whether success depends on the evidence associated with each intended step: models may instead rely on memorized associations, shorter paths, or partial evidence. We examine this dependence using the Behavioral Necessity Rate (BNR), which measures how often targeted evidence removal prevents answer recovery on initially correct instances. Across five existing benchmarks, panel-mean BNR ranges from 16.6% to 48.9%, exposing a substantial gap between annotated structure and observed dependence. Guided by this diagnosis, we introduce REALHOP, a diagnose-construct-verify framework that rebinds entities, factorizes selected relations, adds complete competing paths, and places evidence at traceable locations. Structural and semantic checks precede freezing; behavioral interventions follow. On 790 paired MuSiQue questions, REALHOP raises panel-mean BNR from 27.4% to 94.4% while retaining high Full accuracy. It also yields high BNR on REALHOP-FRAMES and REALHOP-LONGBENCH. On 216 long-context questions, the matched multiple-choice spread across 16 models grows from 13.9 to 59.2 points and persists under repeated open-ended evaluation. Together, these results show that a conceptually coherent chain and a correct final answer do not by themselves establish multi-hop reasoning. Verifying that success depends on every intended hop is therefore as fundamental to multi-hop evaluation as measuring answer accuracy itself.

AI.tldr: 该文提出行为必要性率（BNR）来检验多跳推理是否真正依赖各步证据，发现现有基准BNR仅16.6%–48.9%，并据此构建REALHOP框架，将BNR提升至94.4%同时保持高准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有多跳推理基准以预定义推理链构造问题，并以答案正确作为推理链被使用的证据。然而答案正确并不能保证模型依赖了每一步的预期证据，模型可能依赖记忆关联、更短路径或部分证据。因此需要新的度量与构造方法来验证多跳推理的行为必要性。
AI.method: 提出Behavioral Necessity Rate（BNR），衡量在初始答对的样本上，移除目标证据后导致无法恢复答案的比例。据此开发REALHOP诊断—构造—验证框架：重绑定实体、分解选定关系、加入完整竞争路径、将证据置于可追踪位置；先做结构与语义检查再冻结，随后进行行为干预验证。
AI.result: 在五个现有基准上，面板均值BNR仅为16.6%–48.9%，说明标注结构与实际依赖之间存在显著差距。在790道配对的MuSiQue问题上，REALHOP将面板均值BNR从27.4%提升至94.4%，同时保持较高的Full准确率；在REALHOP-FRAMES与REALHOP-LONGBENCH上也获得高BNR。在216道长上下文问题上，16个模型的匹配多项选择分差从13.9分扩大到59.2分，并在重复开放式评估下保持。
AI.conclusion: 概念上连贯的推理链与正确的最终答案本身并不能确立多跳推理。验证成功是否依赖每一个预期跳步，与测量答案准确率同样重要，应成为多跳评估的基础要求。

title: CF-LoRA: Decoupled Factor Aggregation and Adaptation-Aware Client Clustering for Federated LoRA Fine-Tuning
summary: Federated LoRA fine-tuning enables parameter-efficient adaptation of pre-trained models without sharing private data, but suffers from two fundamental mismatches under heterogeneous client data: a structural aggregation mismatch caused by independently averaging LoRA factors, and a statistical collaboration mismatch caused by enforcing a single global adapter across divergent clients. To address these issues, we propose CF-LoRA, a clustered federated LoRA fine-tuning framework that combines decoupled factor aggregation with adaptation-aware client clustering. CF-LoRA first learns a globally shared $A$ factor while retaining personalized $B_i$ factors, then identifies clients with similar adaptation patterns based on the cosine similarity of their learned $B_i$ factors, and finally performs intra-cluster $B$-factor aggregation with a frozen $A$ factor. By decoupling LoRA factor aggregation, CF-LoRA preserves the low-rank structure and mitigates the structural aggregation mismatch, while adaptation-aware clustering promotes collaboration among clients with similar adaptation patterns and reduces negative transfer caused by statistical heterogeneity. Experiments on four language tasks and four vision datasets with RoBERTa and ViT show that CF-LoRA achieves the highest average accuracy in both modalities while communicating only one LoRA factor per optimization round.

AI.tldr: 提出CF-LoRA聚类联邦LoRA微调框架，通过解耦因子聚合与自适应聚类解决异构数据下的结构与统计失配，在语言和视觉任务上取得最优平均精度且每轮仅通信一个LoRA因子。
AI.motivation: 联邦LoRA微调虽能实现参数高效适配且不共享隐私数据，但在客户端数据异构下存在两个根本失配：独立平均LoRA因子导致的结构性聚合失配，以及强制单一全局适配器导致的统计性协作失配。
AI.method: CF-LoRA结合解耦因子聚合与自适应客户端聚类：先学习全局共享的A因子并保留个性化B_i因子；再基于学习到的B_i因子的余弦相似度识别适配模式相似的客户端；最后在冻结A因子的条件下进行簇内B因子聚合。
AI.result: 在RoBERTa与ViT上的四个语言任务和四个视觉数据集实验中，CF-LoRA在两种模态下均取得最高平均精度，且每轮优化仅通信一个LoRA因子。
AI.conclusion: 解耦LoRA因子聚合可保持低秩结构并缓解结构性聚合失配，自适应聚类促进相似适配模式客户端的协作并减少统计异构带来的负迁移，验证了CF-LoRA的有效性与通信高效性。

title: CADOC: Cache-Aware Dynamic Object Context for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: For a long-horizon agent, context is the bottleneck: the history is resent with every request, the window caps task length, and reasoning degrades as the history grows. Replacing structured objects with compact retrieval Cards shortens the prompt and keeps the exact originals retrievable, but editing the history can break prefix-cache reuse, and prior recoverable methods time their edits by forecasts of future reuse or by preset intervals. We propose CADOC (Cache-Aware Dynamic Object Context), an online algorithm that replaces structured objects with compact Cards while preserving exact, on-demand retrieval of their original contents. CADOC schedules replacements in batches by balancing accumulated waiting cost against shared cache-reconstruction cost. Its scheduling rule follows from an economic order quantity trade-off, recovers the optimal integer batch under stationary assumptions. Across evaluation, CADOC consistently achieves the lowest aggregate input cost among the compared configurations, which reduces input cost by approximately 40\% on average while maintaining task performance close to full context. CADOC thus provides a cost-derived approach to compressible context management, demonstrating that efficient compression depends not only on shortening prompts but also on scheduling edits to preserve cache reuse.

AI.tldr: 提出 CADOC，一种缓存感知的动态对象上下文压缩算法，用紧凑 Card 替换结构化对象并按批次调度替换时机，在保留原文按需检索的同时降低约 40% 输入成本。
AI.motivation: 长程智能体的上下文成为瓶颈：历史随每次请求重复发送，窗口限制任务长度，且推理随历史增长而退化。用紧凑检索 Card 替换结构化对象可缩短提示并保留原文可检索性，但编辑历史会破坏前缀缓存复用；现有可恢复方法依赖未来复用预测或预设间隔来决定编辑时机，不够灵活。
AI.method: CADOC 是一个在线算法：以紧凑 Card 替换结构化对象，并保证原始内容可精确按需检索；按批次调度替换，权衡累积等待成本与共享的缓存重建成本；其调度规则源自经济订货量（EOQ）式的权衡，在平稳假设下可求得最优整数批量。
AI.result: 在评测中，CADOC 在所比较配置中一致取得最低的总体输入成本，平均降低约 40% 输入成本，同时任务性能接近全上下文基线。
AI.conclusion: CADOC 提供了一种基于成本推导的可压缩上下文管理方法，表明高效压缩不仅依赖缩短提示，还依赖调度编辑以保持缓存复用。

title: Physics-Informed Multi-Agent Coordination for Hospital Patient Flow Optimization
comment: Accepted to PRIMA 2026 (Full paper). 16 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
summary: Efficient patient flow coordination across autonomous hospital departments is critical for mitigating overcrowding and balancing resource utilization. While classical queueing theory, specifically open Baskett--Chandy--Muntz--Palacios (BCMP) networks, provides an interpretable mathematical topology for healthcare operations, analytical models rely on stationary assumptions and fixed routing matrices that degrade under state-dependent real-world dynamics. Conversely, centralized reinforcement learning approaches struggle to accommodate the decentralized structure of hospital governance, where individual clinical departments function with localized observations, heterogeneous resources, and divergent operational objectives. In this paper, we present a Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) framework titled \emph{Physics-Informed Multi-Agent Coordination}, which embeds empirically calibrated BCMP queueing topologies as physical priors within a decentralized multi-agent reinforcement learning architecture. Formulated as a Decentralized Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (Dec-POMDP) under coupled resource constraints, our method enables autonomous departmental agents to cooperatively negotiate patient routing and dynamic service scaling. To mitigate environmental non-stationarity without inducing excessive communication overhead, agents exchange localized action fingerprints along network edges and optimize a spatially decomposed reward structure. Empirical evaluations driven by real-world MIMIC-IV patient trajectories indicate that this cooperative multi-agent approach substantially reduces cumulative system delay compared to static Markovian approximations, heuristic dispatching, and independent multi-agent baselines, while maintaining clinical safety constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文将经验校准的BCMP排队拓扑作为物理先验嵌入去中心化多智能体强化学习框架，提出Physics-Informed Multi-Agent Coordination方法，在Dec-POMDP与耦合资源约束下实现跨自主科室的患者路由协商与动态服务扩容，并显著降低系统累积延迟。
AI.motivation: 跨自治医院科室的高效患者流转协调对缓解拥挤、平衡资源利用至关重要。经典排队论（BCMP网络）虽提供可解释的数学拓扑，但依赖平稳性假设与固定路由矩阵，难以适应状态相关的真实动态；而集中式强化学习又难以适配医院治理的去中心化结构，各临床科室仅具局部观测、异构资源与不同运行目标。
AI.method: 提出Multi-Agent Systems框架Physics-Informed Multi-Agent Coordination：将经验校准的BCMP排队拓扑作为物理先验嵌入去中心化多智能体强化学习架构；形式化为带耦合资源约束的Dec-POMDP，使自治科室智能体协同协商患者路由与动态服务扩容；为缓解环境非平稳性并避免过高通信开销，智能体沿网络边交换局部动作指纹，并优化空间分解的奖励结构。
AI.result: 基于真实MIMIC-IV患者轨迹的实证评估表明，该协作多智能体方法相比静态马尔可夫近似、启发式调度以及独立多智能体基线，显著降低累积系统延迟，同时保持临床安全约束。
AI.conclusion: 将排队论的物理先验与去中心化MARL相结合，可在分散治理、局部观测与异质目标条件下有效协调患者流转，兼顾延迟优化与临床安全性。

title: Language as the Interface: Foundation-Model Contrastive Learning Links Transcriptomes and Electrophysiology
summary: Integrating transcriptomic and electrophysiological data is essential for building multimodal foundation models for neuroscience. Patch-seq provides paired measurements of gene expression and intrinsic electrophysiology from the same neuron, establishing a basis for training cross-modal models. Here we introduce LangPatch, a foundation-model-based contrastive learning framework that uses paired Patch-seq data to align pretrained GenePT representations with electrophysiological phenotypes through a language-based interface. Gene descriptions and verbalized electrophysiological profiles are embedded by the same frozen text encoder. A context adapter and projection modules connect the modalities through paired contrastive learning. Across mouse visual, mouse motor, and human cortical cohorts, LangPatch achieves the highest mean transcriptome-to-electrophysiology prediction correlation among the evaluated foundation-model and representation-learning methods. It also improves held-out cross-modal alignment in the two mouse cohorts (FOSCTTM 0.107/0.135 vs. 0.208/0.222 for JAMIE, an existing cross-modal Patch-seq imputation method). It predicts transcriptomic family, type, cortical layer, and marker-gene expression from electrophysiology, exceeding other baselines on most endpoints. More importantly, the method transfers across brain areas and species: a model trained on mouse visual cortex predicts electrophysiology in motor cortex with approximately 70% correlation retention and in human cortex with 47% (58% on acute-slice recordings). Together, these results demonstrate alignment between molecular and functional representations of neurons, providing a building block for multimodal foundation models in neuroscience.

AI.tldr: LangPatch 是一个基于基础模型的对比学习框架，利用 Patch-seq 配对数据，通过语言接口对齐 GenePT 基因表示与电生理表型，实现跨模态预测并具备跨脑区、跨物种迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 构建神经科学多模态基础模型需要整合转录组与电生理数据。Patch-seq 能在同一神经元上同时获取基因表达与内在电生理测量，为训练跨模态模型提供了配对基础，但如何有效对齐这两种异质模态仍是挑战。
AI.method: LangPatch 采用基于基础模型的对比学习框架，将预训练的 GenePT 表示与电生理表型通过语言接口对齐：基因描述与"言语化"的电生理谱由同一个冻结文本编码器嵌入；通过上下文适配器（context adapter）与投影模块连接两种模态，并用配对对比学习进行训练。
AI.result: 在小鼠视觉、小鼠运动及人类皮层队列上，LangPatch 在评估的基础模型与表示学习方法中取得最高的转录组到电生理预测平均相关性。跨模态对齐效果提升，两个小鼠队列的 FOSCTTM 为 0.107/0.135，优于 JAMIE 的 0.208/0.222。可从电生理预测转录组家族、类型、皮层层次及标志基因表达，在多数指标上超过基线。方法可跨脑区与物种迁移：小鼠视觉皮层训练的模型预测运动皮层保持约 70% 相关性，预测人类皮层保持 47%（急性切片记录上为 58%）。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明神经元的分子表示与功能表示之间存在可对齐性，为神经科学多模态基础模型提供了构建模块。

title: AnyAct: Universal Action for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: As large language models (LLMs) advance, AI agents are increasingly deployed in open-world environments to tackle complex sequential tasks (e.g., document processing, cross-application collaboration), relying heavily on actions ranging from GUI operations to semantic APIs. However, three core challenges persist: the "scale dilemma" of massive tool ecosystems exceeding LLM context windows, the "non-stationarity" of tool quality due to updates or outages, and the "heterogeneity" of feedback formats (pixels, text, structured data) creating information silos. To address these, we propose AnyAct, a universal action layer that unifies available capabilities into a self-evolving action space, enabling agents to operate efficiently and reliably in large-scale, dynamic tool ecosystems. AnyAct's core design focuses on two objectives: constructing this action space via hierarchical progressive retrieval (filtering task-relevant actions) and test-time reliability evolution (pruning unreliable actions), and enabling reliability-aware action orchestration through a heterogeneous observation grounding module that unifies multi-modal feedback. Additionally, it defines a hybrid action space (primitive + semantic actions) and optimizes for a balance between task success rate and execution cost. Evaluations on LiveMCPBench and OSMCP (a new benchmark we developed for multi-granularity action collaboration) demonstrate state-of-the-art performance. AnyAct delivers substantial performance gains over baseline methods across various LLM base models on LiveMCPBench and improvements are particularly notable for models with constrained native capabilities. On OSMCP, it achieves 77.27% overall success with only 50 steps, which is half the steps required by most competitors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AnyAct通用动作层，通过分层渐进检索构建自演化动作空间、测试时可靠性演化剪枝不可靠动作，并用异构观测接地模块统一多模态反馈，实现大规模动态工具生态下的可靠动作编排，在LiveMCPBench与OSMCP上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 1. 工具生态规模巨大，超出LLM上下文窗口（"规模困境"）；2. 工具因更新或故障导致质量非平稳（"非平稳性"）；3. 反馈格式异构（像素、文本、结构化数据）造成信息孤岛（"异构性"）。
AI.method: AnyAct以两个目标为核心：通过分层渐进检索（过滤任务相关动作）构建动作空间，并通过测试时可靠性演化（剪枝不可靠动作）维护动作空间；同时设计异构观测接地模块统一多模态反馈，实现可靠性感知的动作编排；并定义混合动作空间（原始动作+语义动作），在任务成功率与执行成本间做平衡优化。
AI.result: 在LiveMCPBench上，AnyAct相对基线在多种LLM基座模型上均有显著提升，对原生能力受限的模型提升尤为明显；在自建基准OSMCP上，以仅50步达到77.27%的整体成功率，约为多数竞争者所需步数的一半。
AI.conclusion: AnyAct作为通用动作层，可统一可用能力为自演化动作空间，使智能体在大规模动态工具生态中高效可靠运行，并在多个基准上达到SOTA。

title: Beyond Low-Rank Parameterization: Narrowing the Gap Between LoRA and Full Fine-Tuning via Gradient Decomposition
summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is a widely used approach to parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), yet a performance gap can remain relative to full fine-tuning (FFT). Many LoRA variants improve the initialization or optimization of low-rank factors. At each training step, however, their first-order weight-space directions are constrained by the current parameterization. We characterize the corresponding LoRA-accessible gradient space and show that it coincides with the tangent space induced by the current LoRA parameterization. This characterization yields an orthogonal decomposition of the full weight gradient at the current model parameters. We term the component orthogonal to this space the normal gradient. Based on this decomposition, we propose GDLoRA (Gradient-Decomposed Low-Rank Adaptation). GDLoRA reconstructs the full weight gradient from forward activations and backward signals, extracts its normal component, and directly updates the base weights with this component, while retaining standard AdamW optimization for the LoRA factors. GDLoRA incorporates complementary normal gradients without increasing standard LoRA's optimizer-state memory budget under matched adapter and optimizer configurations. Experiments on natural language understanding, mathematical reasoning, commonsense reasoning, and image classification show that GDLoRA consistently improves over LoRA and narrows the performance gap to FFT. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/GDLoRA.

AI.tldr: GDLoRA通过分解全权重梯度，提取LoRA参数化正交的"法向梯度"直接更新基础权重，在不增加优化器状态内存的情况下缩小LoRA与全量微调的性能差距。
AI.motivation: LoRA等PEFT方法相对全量微调（FFT）仍存在性能差距。现有LoRA变体多改进低秩因子的初始化或优化，但每步训练中一阶权重空间方向受当前参数化约束，导致可更新的梯度子空间受限，无法覆盖全权重梯度中的某些方向。
AI.method: 作者刻画了LoRA可访问梯度空间，证明其等同于当前LoRA参数化诱导的切空间，由此对全权重梯度做正交分解，将与切空间正交的分量称为"法向梯度"。据此提出GDLoRA：从前向激活与反向信号重构全权重梯度，提取其法向分量直接更新基础权重，LoRA因子仍用标准AdamW优化。在适配器与优化器配置匹配时，不增加标准LoRA的优化器状态内存开销。
AI.result: 在自然语言理解、数学推理、常识推理及图像分类任务上，GDLoRA一致优于LoRA，并缩小了与全量微调的性能差距。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式补充LoRA切空间之外的法向梯度信息，GDLoRA突破了低秩参数化的梯度方向约束，实现了对LoRA的稳定提升，且保持内存效率，为缩小PEFT与FFT差距提供了新的梯度分解视角。

title: FedLAFP: Low-Rank Aggregation Meets Full-Rank Personalization in Federated Fine-Tuning
summary: Federated parameter-efficient fine-tuning enables clients to adapt pre-trained models without sharing raw data or communicating the full model, but statistical heterogeneity makes a single global adapter insufficient for personalized prediction. Existing personalized methods typically use the same low-rank structure for both shared and private adaptation, overlooking their distinct requirements for aggregation and personalization. We propose FedLAFP, a role-aware framework that couples a compact, globally aggregated LoRA branch with a client-private, full-rank-capable RandLoRA branch. The shared branch provides an efficient interface for transferring common knowledge, whereas the private branch combines fixed random low-rank bases with learned scaling coefficients to provide expressive client-specific adaptation without additional communication. Client- and layer-specific mixing coefficients jointly fuse the two branches, and only the shared LoRA parameters are exchanged. A controlled linear study supports this role assignment: LoRA yields more aligned client updates and lower aggregation error, while RandLoRA more accurately recovers client-specific residuals. Experiments across four visual recognition benchmarks show that FedLAFP consistently outperforms local-only and federated LoRA baselines, achieving an average personalized accuracy of $86.93\%$ and exceeding the best baseline average by $1.30$ percentage points.

AI.tldr: 提出FedLAFP：共享LoRA分支与客户端私有RandLoRA分支角色分离的联邦个性化微调框架，平均个性化准确率86.93%，超最优基线1.30个百分点。
AI.motivation: 联邦参数高效微调虽能避免共享原始数据与完整模型，但统计异质性使单一全局适配器难以满足个性化预测；现有方法对共享与私有适配采用相同低秩结构，忽视了二者在聚合性与个性化上的不同需求。
AI.method: 角色感知框架：共享分支为紧凑、全局聚合的LoRA；私有分支为客户端独享、具备满秩能力的RandLoRA，即固定随机低秩基加可学习缩放系数，且不增加通信。引入客户端级与层级的混合系数融合两分支，仅交换共享LoRA参数。另用受控线性研究验证角色分配合理性。
AI.result: 线性研究显示LoRA的客户端更新更对齐、聚合误差更低，RandLoRA更能准确恢复客户端特有的残差。在四个视觉识别基准上，FedLAFP持续优于仅本地与联邦LoRA基线，平均个性化准确率86.93%，超最优基线平均1.30个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 共享与私有适配应解耦设计：共享用可聚合低秩结构、私有用高表达力随机基结构，可在不增加通信的前提下有效兼顾知识迁移与个性化。

title: Watch-Think-Interact: Bootstrapping Long-Horizon Multi-Turn Streaming Video Reasoning with Reinforcement Learning
summary: Streaming video assistance requires models to answer asynchronous questions from an observed prefix under a fixed context budget. Existing approaches model response timing or compress history, but an online state formed before future questions are known can omit visual details before later questions reveal their relevance; the retained state alone cannot recover them. We introduce Watch-Think-Interact (WTI), a closed-loop framework for multi-question streaming video reasoning. WTI maintains compact natural-language memory entries tagged with source-video time ranges; these entries support direct reasoning when sufficient and otherwise anchor selective recall of finer visual evidence. For each question, WTI answers when current context and memory suffice, continues watching when required evidence has not appeared, or recalls a relevant past interval and decides again after incorporating the returned chunks, without replaying the full observed history. To train this behavior, we construct WTI-82K, comprising 82,335 timed questions across 4,812 causally aligned trajectories, and develop Stream-GDPO to optimize complete multi-question streaming rollouts using trajectory-level feedback for response timing, source-video recall, and memory updates. WTI achieves state-of-the-art aggregate performance among the compared open-source streaming baselines, reaching 83.3% on StreamingBench and 73.6% weighted overall accuracy on OVO-Bench.

AI.tldr: 提出 Watch-Think-Interact (WTI) 闭环框架，用于多问题流式视频推理，通过带时间范围标签的自然语言记忆与选择性视觉回溯，在固定上下文预算下决策“回答/继续观看/回溯”。
AI.motivation: 流式视频助手中，问题异步到达且上下文预算固定。已有方法建模响应时机或压缩历史，但问题提出前形成的在线状态可能已丢弃后续问题才显示重要性的视觉细节，仅靠保留状态无法恢复。
AI.method: WTI 维护紧凑的自然语言记忆条目，并标注其来源视频时间区间：信息充分时直接推理，否则以记忆为锚点选择性召回更细粒度视觉证据。对每个问题，模型在当前上下文与记忆足够时作答、必要证据尚未出现时继续观看、或召回相关历史区间并在纳入返回片段后重新决策，且不重放完整历史。训练上构建 WTI-82K（4,812 条因果对齐轨迹、82,335 个带时间问题），并提出 Stream-GDPO，以轨迹级反馈优化完整的多问题流式 rollout，涵盖响应时机、源视频召回与记忆更新。
AI.result: 在比较的开源流式基线中取得最佳总体性能，StreamingBench 达 83.3%，OVO-Bench 加权总体准确率 73.6%。
AI.conclusion: 通过记忆锚定回溯与轨迹级强化学习训练，WTI 缓解了固定预算下前瞻性信息缺失问题，验证了闭环“观察-思考-交互”范式在多问题流式视频推理中的有效性。

title: MatToolBench: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents in Real-World Materials Science Workflows
comment: 25 pages, 15 figures. Mei Wu and Rui Xie contributed equally. Bo Chen and Lu Chen are corresponding authors. Project page: https://mattoolbench.github.io/ ; code: https://github.com/meiwu5/MatToolBench
summary: Multimodal GUI agents have achieved impressive results on general software benchmarks, yet their ability to operate professional scientific software remains largely unexplored. In materials science, sparse domain-specific web data, specialized interfaces, and tacit workflow conventions create blind spots that general-purpose pretraining cannot readily bridge. We present MatToolBench, the first real-environment benchmark for evaluating multimodal GUI agents on professional materials science software, comprising 204 tasks across 10 tools in three modalities: GUI operation, OriginPro scripting, and code-based database queries, all executed inside a Windows 11 VM. Each task is decomposed into fine-grained sub-criteria by domain experts, enabling interpretable partial-credit scoring; the GUI component of our multi-level evaluation pipeline achieves an average F1 of 0.98.
