AI.conclusion: TIDE能够有效利用延迟推荐反馈驱动外置记忆进化，将结果信号转化为记忆适应度，在离线与在线场景及延迟标签任务中均优于对比方法，验证了其有效性。

title: Beyond a single latent space: a dual-latent world model for long-horizon planning
comment: 31 pages, 22 figures, 9 tables. Main text: 9 pages
summary: Latent world models often struggle with long-horizon planning despite accurate short-term predictions. Recursive rollouts accumulate errors, while distance concentration in high-dimensional latent spaces can weaken goal discrimination. We introduce the Dual-Latent World Model (Dual-WM), which separates local execution and long-range planning through distinct state representations and dynamics models. The low-level model predicts action-conditioned transitions, while the high-level model uses learned macro-actions to plan over longer temporal spans. We also propose Long-Horizon Representation Learning with Weighted Rollout (LoRe), which supervises self-generated predictions at both levels. An analysis of recursive error propagation motivates exponential horizon weights with separate decay rates for the two temporal scales. During planning, the high-level model generates latent subgoals that the low-level model refines into actions for precise execution. We evaluate from-scratch Dual-WM on five goal-conditioned visual control tasks against the task-wise strongest baselines without actor-guided proposals. At goal offsets of 50 and 100 environment steps, mean success increases from 75.9% to 84.4% and from 61.4% to 69.5%, respectively. At offset 100, Dual-WM outperforms these baselines on all five tasks and improves mean success over LeWM by 30.8 percentage points. Ablations and supporting analyses provide evidence of more informative representations for goal evaluation and greater consistency under recursive prediction. These results highlight the value of separating temporal roles and training across multiple horizons for reliable latent planning. Our core implementation is available at https://github.com/DeLin1001/Dual-WM-Official.

AI.tldr: 提出双潜变量世界模型Dual-WM与LoRe训练方法，通过分离局部执行与长程规划缓解递归误差与目标判别弱化问题，在视觉控制任务上显著提升长时域规划成功率。
AI.motivation: 潜变量世界模型虽短期预测准确，但长时域规划表现差：递归展开导致误差累积，高维潜空间中的距离集中现象削弱目标判别能力。
AI.method: Dual-WM将局部执行与长程规划解耦为两套状态表示与动力学模型：底层模型预测动作条件转移，高层模型用学习到的宏动作进行更长时间跨度的规划；配合LoRe（带加权展开的长时域表示学习），对两级自生成预测进行监督，基于递归误差传播分析设计两级独立衰减率的指数时域权重；规划时高层生成潜子目标，底层细化并生成精确动作。
AI.result: 在五个目标条件视觉控制任务上从零训练，与各任务最强基线（无actor引导候选）对比：目标偏移50步时平均成功率由75.9%升至84.4%，偏移100步时由61.4%升至69.5%；偏移100时在全部五个任务上优于基线，平均成功率较LeWM提升30.8个百分点；消融与分析表明表示更具目标评估信息量，递归预测一致性更强。
AI.conclusion: 分离时间角色并跨多时域训练，对可靠的潜变量规划具有重要价值。

title: EnterpriseBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Enterprise-Level Strategic Reasoning and Decision-Making
summary: LLM agents are increasingly expected to support enterprise workflows, where tasks often involve missing information, uncertainty, feedback, and long-term trade-offs. However, existing enterprise and financial benchmarks mainly test static capabilities such as information extraction, numerical calculation, domain knowledge, and financial QA, leaving interactive and long-horizon decision-making underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce EnterpriseBench, a benchmark that evaluates LLM agents across this spectrum, from static question answering to dynamic decision-making. Specifically, EnterpriseBench reorganizes existing enterprise and financial QA datasets into a unified foundational suite annotated by capability and difficulty, and introduces three professional interactive settings: Consulting, based on management-consulting-style business cases for client problem diagnosis through multi-turn information seeking; the Beer Game, adapted from a classic supply-chain management simulation for inventory control under delayed feedback; and Enterprise Digital Twin, a project-based business simulator for workforce, risk, and project planning. Experiments with nine agent methods under four backbone models show that current agents have not yet achieved stable, comprehensive, and cross-task reliability in enterprise scenarios. These results show that EnterpriseBench provides a practical benchmark for evaluating LLM agents in realistic enterprise strategic reasoning and decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EnterpriseBench，一个覆盖从静态问答到动态决策的企业级 LLM 智能体评测基准，包含能力/难度标注的基础套件与三个专业交互场景（Consulting、Beer Game、Enterprise Digital Twin），实验表明现有智能体在企业场景中尚不具备稳定、全面、跨任务的可靠性。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体日益被期望支持企业工作流，此类任务常涉及信息缺失、不确定性、反馈与长期权衡；然而现有企业与金融基准主要考察静态能力（信息抽取、数值计算、领域知识、金融问答），对交互式与长时程决策评测不足。
AI.method: 将既有企业与金融问答数据集重组为统一的基础套件，并按能力与难度进行标注；同时引入三个专业交互设定：Consulting（基于管理咨询式商业案例，通过多轮信息搜索进行客户问题诊断）、Beer Game（改编自经典供应链管理模拟，考察延迟反馈下的库存控制）、Enterprise Digital Twin（项目制商业模拟器，用于劳动力、风险与项目规划）。在四种骨干模型上评测九种智能体方法。
AI.result: 实验显示，当前智能体在企业场景中尚未达到稳定、全面且跨任务的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: EnterpriseBench 为评估 LLM 智能体在真实企业战略推理与决策中的表现提供了实用基准。

title: WISE-ATTA: When to Ask for Labels in Budgeted Active Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Active test-time adaptation (ATTA) improves robustness under distribution shift by updating a deployed model during inference while selectively querying supervision. However, most existing ATTA methods implicitly assume that supervision can be requested for every incoming test batch, which can incur substantial annotation cost over long test streams. In this work, we introduce \emph{budgeted ATTA} in which labels are available for only a fraction of test batches. This formulation shifts the central challenge from deciding \emph{what} to label within a batch to deciding \emph{when} supervision should be applied over time. To address this challenge, we propose a budget-aware approach \emph{WISE-ATTA} that allocates supervision over the test stream based on lightweight signals computed online, prioritizing periods where supervision is likely to be most useful. When a batch is selected for supervision, we further employ a drift-based sample selection criterion that targets samples exhibiting ongoing, unconverged adaptation dynamics, enabling effective updates from a single labeled example. We evaluate this approach on synthetic corruptions (ImageNet-C) and natural distribution shifts (ImageNet-R/K/A). Across settings, WISE-ATTA achieves competitive or improved performance compared to recent ATTA methods while requiring substantially fewer labels. Overall, we find that the timing of supervision is a key, yet underexplored, aspect of active test-time adaptation. Code: https://github.com/Muhammad-Huzaifaa/WISE-ATTA

AI.tldr: 本文提出预算化主动测试时自适应（budgeted ATTA）设定，即仅有部分测试批次可获得标签，并据此设计WISE-ATTA方法，通过在线轻量信号决定何时施加监督、结合漂移样本选择，实现少标签下的高效自适应。
AI.motivation: 现有主动测试时自适应（ATTA）方法大多隐含假设可为每个测试批次请求监督，在长测试流中会造成巨大的标注成本。本文关注监督请求受预算限制的场景，将核心挑战从"批次内标注什么"转向"何时施加监督"。
AI.method: 提出预算感知的WISE-ATTA：利用在线计算的轻量信号在测试流上分配监督预算，优先选择监督最有用的时期；对选中的批次，进一步采用基于漂移的样本选择准则，聚焦于处于持续、未收敛自适应动态的样本，从而用单个标注样本实现有效更新。
AI.result: 在合成腐蚀（ImageNet-C）与自然分布偏移（ImageNet-R/K/A）上评估，WISE-ATTA在显著减少标签需求的同时，取得与近期ATTA方法相当或更优的性能。
AI.conclusion: 监督的"时机"是主动测试时自适应中一个关键但尚被忽视的方面。

title: Locating Answer-Correctness Signals in Frozen Large Language Models
summary: Language models expose internal signals that predict whether an answer is correct, readable from a single forward pass of a frozen model without additional generations. Yet existing probes often commit to one signal family or layer and can be brittle under distribution shift; in retrieval-augmented settings, many specialized detectors instead target passage faithfulness, which can diverge from correctness when retrieved evidence is unhelpful or conflicting. We therefore ask where answer correctness is readable, which internal signal families carry it, and how they should be combined. We search over hidden states, token probabilities, residual-stream features, attention, and their fusion, treating the selected readouts as a predictive measurement rather than a mechanistic localization. We run this analysis separately in closed-book and with-context settings, since context can change which readouts are informative. A consistent anatomy emerges: correctness concentrates in the answer span, recovered from the answer tokens even under retrieval, and the families carry it complementarily, so fusing them helps most out of distribution, where a single signal is weakest. The protocol is effective across two backbones and gates a retrieval controller as one downstream use.

AI.tldr: 本文研究语言模型内部"答案正确性"信号的可读位置、信号家族及其融合方式，在闭卷与检索增强两种设定下系统搜索隐状态、token概率、残差流特征、注意力及其融合读法。结果显示：正确性信号集中于答案span，各信号家族互补，融合在分布外场景收益最大，并可跨主干模型泛化、用于门控检索控制器。
AI.motivation: 现有探针往往只依赖单一信号家族或单一层，在分布偏移下表现脆弱；检索增强场景中许多检测器聚焦于"段落忠实性"，当检索证据无用或冲突时会与"正确答案正确性"发生偏离。因此需要系统厘清：答案正确性在何处可读、由哪些内部信号家族承载、以及应如何组合它们。
AI.method: 将选定的readout视为"预测性测量"而非机制定位，在冻结模型单次前向传播下，搜索隐状态、token概率、残差流特征、注意力及其融合；分别在闭卷与带上下文两种设定下独立分析，因为上下文会改变哪些readout具有信息量。
AI.result: 呈现出一致的"解剖结构"：正确性信号集中于答案span，即使在检索设定下也能从答案token恢复；各信号家族以互补方式承载信息，因此融合在分布外（单一信号最弱时）收益最大。协议在两个主干模型上均有效，并可用于门控检索控制器。
AI.conclusion: 答案正确性可从冻结模型单次前向的答案span读出，且由多个互补信号家族共同承载，融合策略在分布外泛化上尤为关键；该协议跨主干有效，并可作为下游检索控制的门控信号。

title: Spatiotemporal Hyperedges for EEG Seizure Detection and Prediction
summary: Seizure detection and prediction from EEG are clinically important but challenging because seizures are rare, temporally localized, and propagate as coordinated events across multiple channels. Recent dynamic graph neural networks model this by running a temporal model over a sequence of per-time-step pairwise channel edges. However, this pairwise construction misses the spatiotemporal coupling that constitutes a seizure, at substantial training cost. We propose HyBrain, which summarizes spatiotemporal EEG evidence through a small set of soft hyperedges rather than pairwise edges. A per-channel Mamba backbone produces one token per (channel, second), and a spatiotemporal hyperedge block pools these tokens into E_h shared group embeddings through soft memberships and broadcasts them back. The same encoder serves three downstream tasks: window-based detection, one-second point-wise detection, and preictal seizure prediction. On TUSZ and CHB-MIT, HyBrain achieves the best AUROC on every reported setting against ten baselines, with the largest gap on long-clip preictal prediction. It also matches the most efficient baselines in training time and peak GPU memory. A qualitative analysis shows that even a single learned hyperedge cleanly captures the preictal -> ictal -> postictal trajectory on a real seizure clip.

AI.tldr: HyBrain 用少量软超边聚合时空 EEG 证据，替代逐时刻成对通道边，在 TUSZ 和 CHB-MIT 上多项任务取得最佳 AUROC，且训练时间与显存占用与最高效基线相当。
AI.motivation: 癫痫检测与预测因发作稀少、时间局部化、跨通道协同传播而困难。现有动态图神经网络以逐时刻成对通道边建模，存在两大问题：成对构造无法捕捉构成癫痫发作的时空耦合；训练成本高。
AI.method: 提出 HyBrain：以少量软超边而非成对边汇总时空 EEG 证据。骨干为逐通道 Mamba，输出每个（通道, 秒）一个 token；时空超边块通过软隶属度将这些 token 池化为 E_h 个共享组嵌入，再广播回各 token。同一编码器服务三类下游任务：窗口级检测、逐秒点式检测、发作前预测。
AI.result: 在 TUSZ 与 CHB-MIT 上，HyBrain 在所有报告设置中对十个基线均取得最佳 AUROC，长片段发作前预测上差距最大；训练时间与峰值 GPU 显存与最高效基线相当。定性分析显示，单个学习到的超边即可在真实发作片段上清晰刻画 preictal→ictal→postictal 轨迹。
AI.conclusion: HyBrain 以超边式时空聚合替代成对图建模，在检测与预测任务上兼顾精度与效率，证明少量软超边足以刻画癫痫的时空耦合结构。

title: ContextRender: From Execution Dependencies to Agent Context
summary: LLM agents performing long-horizon tasks accumulate tool results that later steps may need. Passing the full history to every invocation is costly even when it fits within the context window, while reducing it risks omitting needed information. Existing context management methods can overlook how earlier tool results are used in subsequent execution, leaving needed information out of context. We introduce ContextRender, which manages context through a persistent graph of execution dependencies. We develop Tool-Flow Analysis to track how later operations reuse information from earlier tool results, providing a signal called observed reuse. A renderer combines this signal with recency and semantic relevance to select results within a fixed history budget, retaining omitted results for later use. Across AppWorld and 8-objective QA with three execution models, ContextRender outperforms the evaluated context management baselines using a 6K history budget, well below the models' maximum context windows. Within this budget, it achieves task performance close to or above that of passing the full history while reducing mean inference cost by 10.2%-32.2% relative to Full history. Ablations show that observed reuse improves task performance and retention of results reused later.

AI.tldr: 提出 ContextRender，用执行依赖图和"观察到的复用"信号做上下文管理，在 6K 预算下性能接近或超过全历史输入，并降低 10.2%–32.2% 平均推理成本。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体执行长时程任务时会累积大量工具调用结果，后续步骤可能仍需用到。将完整历史传入每次调用成本高昂（即使未超出上下文窗口），而压缩上下文又有遗漏关键信息的风险。现有上下文管理方法往往忽略了早期工具结果在后续执行中如何被使用，导致必要信息被排除在上下文之外。
AI.method: ContextRender 通过一个持久的执行依赖图来管理上下文。其核心是 Tool-Flow Analysis，用于追踪后续操作如何复用早期工具结果的信息，并产生名为 "observed reuse"（观察到的复用）的信号。渲染器将该信号与近因性（recency）和语义相关性结合，在固定历史预算内选择结果，同时保留被省略的结果以备后续使用。
AI.result: 在 AppWorld 与 8-objective QA 两个基准上，使用三种执行模型，ContextRender 在 6K 历史预算（远低于模型最大上下文窗口）下优于所评估的上下文管理基线。在该预算内，任务性能接近或超过传入完整历史的方式，同时相对 Full history 将平均推理成本降低 10.2%–32.2%。消融实验表明，observed reuse 能提升任务性能以及后续被复用结果的保留率。
AI.conclusion: 利用执行依赖关系与工具结果复用信号进行上下文管理，可在显著压缩历史预算的同时保持甚至提升长时程任务性能，并有效降低推理成本。

title: Cross-Entropy Guided Routing in Mixture-of-Experts Large Language Models
summary: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) large language models scale model capacity by routing each token to a small subset of experts. Their routers are regularized with load balancing terms and learn affinity scores through the language-model objective. However, these objectives do not provide direct alignment between routing affinities and token-level error. We introduce token-error supervision for sparse routing in two forms. The first form predicts an error score per expert. The affinity-weighted aggregate of these scores is aligned to the next-token cross-entropy loss, while the individual scores attenuate affinity before top-$K$ selection. The second directly aligns the router's affinities to the model's objective without requiring an additional head or inference-time modification. Both formulations use the Itakura--Saito divergence or an exponential negative log-likelihood for aligning affinities and token errors. Across two sparse MoE backbones and four multiple-choice question-answering benchmarks, we evaluate both supervision mechanisms. On Granite, our method improves accuracy by approximately 2.3 percentage points on average over a parameter-matched routing baseline. With stronger supervision, the gain on ARC-Challenge reaches 2.94 points. Both mechanisms preserve the native sparse execution budget and aggregation policy. Our code is available in the supplementary materials.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出对稀疏MoE路由进行“token误差监督”，使路由亲和度与token级误差对齐，从而提升下游准确率且不改变原有稀疏执行预算与聚合策略。
AI.motivation: 现有稀疏MoE的router仅依赖负载均衡项与语言建模目标学习亲和度，这些目标未在路由亲和度与token级误差之间建立直接对齐，导致路由选择与模型实际错误信号脱节。
AI.method: 提出两种token误差监督形式：1）为每个专家预测误差分数，其亲和度加权聚合与下一token交叉熵损失对齐，个体分数在top-K选择前衰减亲和度；2）直接将router亲和度与模型目标对齐，无需额外预测头或推理期修改。两种形式均采用Itakura–Saito散度或指数负对数似然来对齐亲和度与token误差。
AI.result: 在两个稀疏MoE骨干与四个多项选择问答基准上评估：在Granite上，相比参数量匹配的路由基线平均提升约2.3个百分点；在更强监督下，ARC-Challenge提升达2.94个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 两种监督机制均保持原生稀疏执行预算与聚合策略，证明token误差监督可有效改进稀疏MoE路由。

title: OmniVCBench: Benchmarking Evidence-Grounded Multimodal Reasoning Towards AI Virtual Cells
summary: Artificial Intelligence Virtual Cells (AIVCs) are envisioned as scientific agents that simulate cellular responses, explain underlying mechanisms, and support hypothesis-driven discovery. Existing AIVC benchmarks, however, operate primarily at the simulation layer, motivating complementary evaluation of how models interpret experimental evidence and formulate biological hypotheses. We introduce OmniVCBench, a figure-centric, source-traceable benchmark for the interpretation component of an AIVC. It contains 6,077 curated single- and multi-subfigure question--answer pairs derived from figures and experimental contexts in the scientific literature. Guided by Bloom's taxonomy, we instantiate interpretation-layer counterparts of the AIVC Predict--Explain--Discover agenda through three scientific reasoning tasks. We further introduce AIVC-Judge, a task-conditioned MLLM-as-a-judge framework with category-specific, reference-aware rubrics for evaluating open-ended responses. A complementary Model-Derived Hard-Negative Mining (MDHNM) strategy converts plausible errors observed during model inference into MCQ distractors for lower-cost evaluation. Within the evaluated heterogeneous model pool, MCQ accuracy correlates positively with AIVC-Judge scores, providing a complementary view of performance alongside open-response evaluation. Code and data demo are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/OmniVCBench.

AI.tldr: 提出OmniVCBench，一个以图为中心、可溯源的科学文献图表基准，用于评估AI虚拟细胞（AIVC）的解释层能力，并提供AIVC-Judge与MDHNM两项配套评估方法。
AI.motivation: 现有AIVC基准主要集中在仿真（simulation）层，缺乏对模型如何解读实验证据、提出生物学假设等解释层能力的评估，因此需要构造面向解释层的互补基准。
AI.method: 构建包含6,077个单图与多子图问答对的数据集，源自科学文献中的图表与实验背景；以Bloom分类法为指导，将AIVC Predict–Explain–Discover议程映射为三项科学推理任务；提出任务条件化的MLLM-as-a-judge框架AIVC-Judge，配合类别特定、参考感知的评分标准评估开放式回答；并提出MDHNM策略，将模型推理中出现的合理错误转化为MCQ干扰项以实现低成本评估。
AI.result: 在异构模型池上的评估显示，MCQ准确率与AIVC-Judge评分呈正相关，为开放回答评估提供了互补的性能视角。
AI.conclusion: OmniVCBench通过解释层基准、任务条件化评判框架与错误挖掘策略，补充了现有AIVC仿真层基准，为科学推理与假设生成能力提供了可溯源、可扩展的评估方案。

title: Adam under Generalized Smoothness with Second-Moment-Type Stochastic Gradients
summary: Adam is widely observed to remain stable even when the objective deviates significantly from global smoothness. Under the generalized smoothness framework, however, existing analyses rely on strong tail assumptions on the stochastic gradients, such as almost-sure boundedness or sub-Gaussianity. Whether Adam converges on generalized smooth objectives under only second moment information on the stochastic gradients, without such concentration assumptions, was identified as an important open direction by Li et al. (2023). This paper gives an affirmative answer under fairly general conditions: such tail assumptions are not necessary. Building on the Adam self-normalization framework of Jin et al. (2026), developed for classical smoothness and bounded variance, we extend the stopping-time and de-preconditioning strategy to the $L_0$-$L_p$ generalized smoothness condition and a generalized second moment ABC condition. Even when the stochastic-gradient condition provides only second moment information that may grow along the trajectory, the stochastic trajectory of Adam remains in a locally well-behaved smoothness region, with stretched-exponential tail decay under bounded variance and global smoothness. Consequently, we establish high-probability convergence rate guarantees over the full range $p<2$, with confidence dependence of order $δ^{-1/2}$, while the stepsize prefactor depends on $δ$ only through a single logarithmic factor. We further construct a hard instance showing that, under only second-moment information, this $δ^{-1/2}$-type confidence dependence is sharp. Finally, in the regime $p<1$, we combine the trajectory control with polynomial-growth estimates on rare events to obtain convergence rate guarantees in expectation.

AI.tldr: 本文在广义光滑框架下证明：仅依赖随机梯度的二阶矩信息（无需几乎必然有界或次高斯等尾部假设），Adam 仍能收敛；给出 $p<2$ 全范围内高概率收敛率（置信度依赖 $\\delta^{-1/2}$），并证明该依赖阶是紧的，$p<1$ 时进一步得到期望收敛率。
AI.motivation: Adam 在实践中即使目标函数远离全局光滑性也表现稳定，但在广义光滑框架下的现有分析都依赖随机梯度上的强尾部假设（如几乎必然有界或次高斯性）。Li et al. (2023) 提出重要开放问题：在仅有二阶矩信息、无集中假设时 Adam 是否仍收敛。本文对此给出肯定回答。
AI.method: 基于 Jin et al. (2026) 为经典光滑性与有界方差设计的 Adam 自归一化框架，将停时（stopping-time）与去预条件（de-preconditioning）策略推广到 $L_0$-$L_p$ 广义光滑条件与广义二阶矩 ABC 条件；利用停时分析控制轨迹，证明即使梯度条件仅提供可能沿轨迹增长的二阶矩信息，Adam 轨迹仍停留在局部良态光滑区域，并在有界方差与全局光滑下具有拉伸指数尾衰减；对 $p<1$ 结合稀有事件上的多项式增长估计得到期望收敛率。
AI.result: 在 $p<2$ 全范围建立高概率收敛率保证，置信度依赖为 $\\delta^{-1/2}$ 阶，步长前置因子仅通过单个对数因子依赖 $\\delta$；构造困难实例证明仅凭二阶矩信息时该 $\\delta^{-1/2}$ 型置信度依赖是紧的；在 $p<1$ 情形下给出期望收敛率保证。
AI.conclusion: 本文肯定地回答了 Li et al. (2023) 的开放问题：在广义光滑目标上，随机梯度仅有二阶矩信息时，尾部分布假设并非必需，Adam 仍收敛，且收敛率在置信度依赖上达到最优。

title: DIET: Deletion-response Expert Trimming for Video Diffusion Transformers
summary: Video diffusion transformers (DiTs) increasingly adopt mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures to reduce active computation, but their full expert storage remains costly. Existing one-shot pruning criteria mainly rely on static activation or routing statistics and cannot capture layer-level re-routing after expert deletion. We introduce DIET, a training-free expert pruning framework based on deletion responses. A single all-expert calibration pass records expert outputs and router states for matched conditional and unconditional tokens. Candidate deletions are then replayed from cached tensors, requiring no additional model forward passes. The resulting deletion-response signatures characterize each expert by the changes induced when it is removed. DIET selects retained experts by minimizing Overall Diversity Loss (ODL), which preserves directional coverage in signature space, and combines intra-layer local search with an inter-layer regression-guided budget search to allocate experts across layers. On LingBot-Video 30B-A3B, pruning 50% of experts (6,144 to 3,072) reduces the checkpoint from 57 GB to 30 GB and enables single-card deployment on a 48 GB GPU without fine-tuning. Under a fixed 284-case VBench protocol, the VBench Total increases from 0.7941 to 0.8115. Across tested retention budgets, DIET consistently outperforms competitive pruning baselines adapted from large language models.

AI.tldr: DIET：一种免训练的专家剪枝框架，基于删除响应签名与ODL准则为视频DiT的MoE减容，在LingBot-Video 30B-A3B上剪除50%专家后显存从57GB降至30GB且VBench提升。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散Transformer（DiT）采用MoE架构以降低激活计算量，但全部专家的存储开销仍然很高。现有的一次性剪枝准则主要依赖静态激活或路由统计，无法刻画专家删除后层级的重路由行为。
AI.method: 提出DIET免训练专家剪枝框架：单次全专家校准前向记录条件与无条件token的专家输出和路由器状态；候选删除通过缓存张量重放完成，无需额外前向。由此得到的删除响应签名以移除某专家时引发的输出变化刻画该专家。保留专家选择通过最小化整体多样性损失（ODL）以保持签名空间的方向覆盖；并采用层内局部搜索与层间回归引导的预算搜索进行跨层专家分配。
AI.result: 在LingBot-Video 30B-A3B上，剪除50%专家（6,144→3,072）使检查点由57GB减至30GB，可在48GB单卡部署且无需微调。在固定284用例VBench协议下，VBench Total由0.7941提升至0.8115。在各测试保留预算下，DIET持续优于由大语言模型适配的竞争剪枝基线。
AI.conclusion: 基于删除响应的剪枝准则能捕获静态统计所忽略的层间重路由信息，在免训练条件下实现显著压缩并保持甚至提升生成质量，为大规模视频DiT MoE的高效部署提供可行路径。

title: Mixture of Self-Improving Branches For Agent Harness Optimization
summary: Harness optimization provides a practical setting for recursive self-improvement (RSI), where agent-generated modifications inform subsequent changes through execution feedback. Recent work such as Meta-Harness implements this process through iterative code generation and evaluation, but retains a fixed development set and proposal policy. These constraints channel evolution along a single search trajectory, increasing the risk of converging to a local optimum. We make the improvement process itself adaptive by organizing search into branches with evolving development subsets and proposal policies. Each branch retains development cases solved by more of its leading harnesses than by those of other branches, drops cases solved by every leading harness across all branches, and revises its proposal policy using its own search history. To deploy the resulting complementary harnesses, we propose a router to select one development-selected branch head for each new input before execution. Across mathematical reasoning and agentic coding benchmarks, our system achieves relative improvements over Meta-Harness of 34.8% on Olympiad-level mathematical reasoning, 11.6% on Terminal-Bench 2.0, and 3.8% on SWE-bench Lite, with harness selection and router configuration based solely on development data. These results show that evolving branch objectives and proposal policies can yield complementary harnesses whose strengths a router combines without access to test outcomes.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将harness优化的搜索过程本身自适应化：把搜索组织成多个分支，每个分支拥有演化的开发子集与提议策略，并用路由器在部署时选择合适的分支头部，从而避免单轨迹搜索陷入局部最优。
AI.motivation: 现有工作（如Meta-Harness）通过迭代代码生成与评估实现递归自我改进，但固定了开发集与提议策略，使演化被限制在单一搜索轨迹上，容易收敛到局部最优。作者希望打破这一约束，让改进过程自身具备自适应性，从而产生互补的harness。
AI.method: 方法将搜索组织为若干分支，每个分支维护演化的开发子集与提议策略：保留那些被本分支更多领先harness解决、而其他分支较少解决的开发用例；丢弃被所有分支的每个领先harness都解决的用例；并基于本分支自身搜索历史修订其提议策略。部署时提出一个路由器，对每个新输入在执行前选择一个由开发集选定的分支头部。
AI.result: 在数学推理与智能体编程基准上，相对Meta-Harness取得：奥林匹克级数学推理相对提升34.8%，Terminal-Bench 2.0提升11.6%，SWE-bench Lite提升3.8%；harness选择与路由器配置均仅基于开发数据。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，令分支目标与提议策略共同演化，可以产生互补的harness，其各自优势可由路由器在不接触测试结果的情况下组合，验证了自适应化搜索过程对缓解局部最优的有效性。

title: Active Budget Can Kill Sensitivity: Diagnosing and Repairing TopK Sparse Autoencoder Reliability
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are increasingly scaled to wider dictionaries to recover fine-grained structure from large language model activations. However, a feature is useful for interpretation only if it remains a stable unit of analysis when the same meaning is expressed in different surface forms. We study this reliability question for TopK SAEs via feature sensitivity. Experiments demonstrate that scaling selectively reduces the sensitivity of rare features, while common features remain comparatively stable. A controlled width\(\times k\) factorial experiment identifies the active budget k as the root cause: the degradation arises from the selection boundary rather than dictionary width alone. We attribute this failure to the geometry of TopK selection. The active margin, the distance to the cutoff, predicts feature loss without thresholds. Guided by this margin diagnosis, we introduce pairwise rank stabilization. Our method targets ordering failures at the cutoff and improves rare-feature sensitivity by \(8.83\) percentage points, while keeping reconstruction and alive-feature coverage near the baseline. Overall, our results suggest that wide TopK SAEs should be evaluated not only by reconstruction, sparsity, and feature count, but also by feature reliability under semantic variation and boundary geometry for stable interpretability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究 TopK 稀疏自编码器（SAE）中特征在语义变化下的稳定性问题，发现其失败根源在于 TopK 选择的边界几何，并提出 pairwise rank stabilization 方法改善稀有特征敏感性。
AI.motivation: SAE 被不断扩展为更宽的字典以恢复大语言模型激活中的细粒度结构，但一个特征只有在相同语义以不同表层形式表达时仍保持为稳定的分析单元，才真正具有可解释性。因此需要研究 SAE 特征在语义变化下的可靠性。
AI.method: 作者通过特征敏感性（feature sensitivity）研究 TopK SAE 的可靠性；设计宽度×k 的因子实验区分字典宽度与活跃预算 k 的作用；用几何分析定位 TopK 选择边界，提出 active margin（到截断阈值的距离）作为无阈值预测特征丢失的指标；并据此提出 pairwise rank stabilization，针对截断处的排序失败进行修正。
AI.result: 实验表明，扩展宽度会选择性降低稀有特征的敏感性，而常见特征相对稳定。宽度×k 因子实验确认活跃预算 k 是根本原因，退化来自选择边界而非仅由字典宽度造成。active margin 可在无阈值条件下预测特征丢失。pairwise rank stabilization 将稀有特征敏感性提升 8.83 个百分点，同时重建质量和 alive-feature 覆盖率接近基线。
AI.conclusion: 宽 TopK SAE 的评估不应仅依赖重建、稀疏度和特征数量，还应纳入语义变化下的特征可靠性以及边界几何，以实现稳定的可解释性。

title: Co-PiLOT: Constrained Physics-Informed Latent Optimization for Target-Driven Inverse Design
summary: Inverse design of physical systems (molecules, devices, microstructures) often reduces to optimizing a high-dimensional structure against an expensive black-box simulator. Direct search is difficult because the space is non-Euclidean, feasibility is hard to encode, and each evaluation is expensive. We present Co-PiLOT, a latent optimization approach that maps candidates through a generative encoder-decoder, uses the decoder as a learned validity prior, and searches the latent space with physics-informed black-box optimization. The framework is applied on the inverse design of magnesium alloy microstructure/texture. We develop a vision transformer based-encoder; paired with latent diffusion, diffusion transformer and rectified-flow transformer-based decoders on $\sim80{,}000$ EBSD-derived microstructure dataset to learn a minimal bottleneck, $z$. The ViT-FMDiT model ($z$=$768$) reconstructs high-fidelity microstructure images (FID $27.86$, MS-SSIM $0.178$), which our self-segmenting orientation codec converts into input grids for crystal plasticity solver. Finally, we introduce MERIDIAN, an active latent optimizer driven by deep-kernel Gaussian-process uncertainty, failure-aware feasibility prediction, manifold-aware trust regions, and target-aware acquisition. Within a budget of $160$ simulations, the ViT-FMDiT and MERIDIAN combination yields the best target-driven objective score, reducing the relative target error by $3$--$22\%$ against seven baselines (DANTE, TuRBO, BAxUS, CMA-ES, DDOM, SEIKO, DDPO) on the same decoder.

AI.tldr: 提出Co-PiLOT潜空间逆向设计框架，用ViT编码器+扩散类解码器学习镁合金微结构低维表示，并开发MERIDIAN主动潜优化器，在160次仿真预算下相对目标误差较7个基线降低3–22%。
AI.motivation: 物理系统（分子、器件、微结构）逆向设计需在昂贵的黑箱仿真器上优化高维结构，面临空间非欧氏、可行性难编码、单次评估成本高等困难，直接搜索不可行。
AI.method: Co-PiLOT将候选结构经生成式编码器-解码器映射，以解码器作为学得的有效性先验，在潜空间做物理信息黑箱优化。构建ViT编码器，搭配潜扩散、扩散Transformer与整流流Transformer解码器，在约8万条EBSD微结构数据上学习最小瓶颈z；ViT-FMDiT（z=768）重建高保真微结构并经自分割取向编解码器转为晶体塑性求解器输入网格。提出MERIDIAN主动潜优化器，融合深度核高斯过程不确定性、失效感知可行性预测、流形感知信赖域与目标感知采集。
AI.result: ViT-FMDiT（z=768）重建FID为27.86、MS-SSIM为0.178；在160次仿真预算内，ViT-FMDiT+MERIDIAN组合取得最佳目标驱动得分，相对目标误差较DANTE、TuRBO、BAxUS、CMA-ES、DDOM、SEIKO、DDPO七个基线（同一解码器）降低3–22%。
AI.conclusion: 将生成式潜表示与物理信息主动优化结合，可有效缓解高维非欧氏、昂贵黑箱的逆向设计难题，在镁合金微结构/织构设计上验证了框架的有效性与优越性。

title: Guide, Then Let Go: Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling for Sparse-Reward Agentic RL
summary: Reinforcement learning for long-horizon agents typically relies on sparse outcome-based rewards. This leads to a severe cold-start problem, as early-stage policies often fail to solve sampled tasks, leaving little useful reward signal for learning. To mitigate this problem, we use on-policy distillation (OPD) to provide token-level guidance on the student's own rollouts. We find that the benefit of this guidance depends on the performance gap between the teacher and the student. When the teacher substantially outperforms the student, distillation helps guide the student through the early training stage where outcome rewards provide little learning signal. As the gap narrows and eventually reverses, however, continued distillation becomes less beneficial and may hinder further improvement. Motivated by this observation, we propose Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling (GATS), which augments the student's RL objective with an OPD term whose weight adapts to the teacher-student performance gap. Specifically, GATS gradually reduces teacher guidance as the student approaches the teacher's reference performance and withdraws it once that reference is reached. This enables GATS to leverage task-trained teachers smaller than the student, since teacher guidance is primarily needed during early training. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld with three Qwen2.5 teacher-student configurations, GATS achieves the highest average success rate among the compared methods in all three configurations, improving over reward-only GRPO by 4.37%-11.87% under matched student rollout budgets. Code is available at https://github.com/Ricardo-H/guide-then-let-go.

AI.tldr: 提出Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling (GATS)，通过在策略蒸馏项中加入随师生性能差距自适应调整的权重，缓解长时序智能体强化学习的冷启动问题。
AI.motivation: 长时序智能体的强化学习通常依赖稀疏的结果奖励，早期策略难以解决采样任务，导致有用奖励信号稀少，产生严重的冷启动问题。作者观察到在策略蒸馏的收益取决于师生性能差距：差距大时蒸馏能引导早期训练，差距缩小甚至反转后继续蒸馏反而有害。
AI.method: 用 on-policy distillation (OPD) 在学生自身 rollout 上提供 token 级指导；在此基础上提出 GATS，在学生 RL 目标中加入 OPD 项，其权重随师生性能差距自适应调整——随学生接近教师参考性能而逐渐降低指导，达到参考性能后撤销指导。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 ScienceWorld 三个环境、三种 Qwen2.5 师生配置下，GATS 在全部三种配置中取得最高的平均成功率；在同等学生 rollout 预算下，相较仅用奖励的 GRPO 提升 4.37%–11.87%。
AI.conclusion: GATS 通过自适应调度教师指导，有效利用任务训练的较小教师（小于学生），在早期训练提供引导、后期及时退出，从而稳定提升性能。

title: You Cannot Pick a Provider From the Price List: Market-Aware Routing for Open-Weight LLM Inference
summary: Existing LLM routers choose among models using static per-model costs. We show that open-weight inference markets introduce a second, largely ignored decision axis: after choosing a model, a client must still choose which provider serves it. Measuring live endpoints across [nummodels] open models, competing providers, multiple task types, and three measurement waves, we find that provider choice cannot be inferred from the price list. The same model can vary sharply in quality, latency, availability, and price across providers; higher-priced providers are consistently faster, but price does not reliably predict quality or availability; and provider feasibility is task-selective, with one deployment nearly normal on knowledge tasks but catastrophically degraded on multi-step reasoning. We formulate same-model provider selection as a price-taker market-aware routing problem. A simple measured-map policy routes to the cheapest provider that is both quality-equivalent and healthy, yielding matched-quality savings while avoiding degraded endpoints. Because the map drifts, we introduce FACET, an online provider router that certifies per-(provider x task) feasibility facets and fails safe to an anchor before serving uncertified arms. Across relaxed deployment assumptions, FACET tolerates imperfect task assignment and sparse feedback, while systematic evaluator bias exposes a quality-signal trust boundary that can be mitigated with ground-truth probes or audits. Live provider runs further confirm that certification can move real traffic from a premium anchor to a substantially cheaper certified endpoint. Our results suggest that market-aware LLM routing must measure not only which model to use, but also who serves it.

AI.tldr: 开放权重推理市场引入了被忽视的"同模型、不同供应商"选择维度；作者实证发现供应商选择无法从价格表推断，并将同模型供应商选择形式化为"价格接受者"的市场感知路由问题，提出在线路由器FACET，在保证质量等价的前提下安全地切换到更便宜的认证端点。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM路由器仅在静态的"每模型成本"之间做选择，隐含假设同一模型服务同质。而在开放权重推理市场中，客户端选定模型后仍需决定由哪家供应商提供推理服务。作者希望回答：供应商选择能否由价目表推断？价格、质量、延迟、可用性、任务适配性在供应商之间如何变化？能否在保证质量的前提下利用这一维度降本？
AI.method: 1) 测量：在多波次、多任务类型下对[nummodels]个开放模型的多个竞争供应商端点进行实测，覆盖质量、延迟、可用性、价格。2) 形式化：将同模型供应商选择建模为"价格接受者"（price-taker）的市场感知路由问题。3) 策略：设计基于实测地图的简单策略——路由到既满足质量等价又健康的供应商中最便宜的一个。4) 在线算法FACET：针对地图漂移问题，在线认证每个（供应商×任务）的可行性"facet"，在服务未认证臂之前先失败安全地回退到锚点（anchor），并针对不完美任务分配、稀疏反馈、评估器系统性偏差等松弛假设进行鲁棒性分析，用真值探针或审计缓解质量信号信任边界问题。
AI.result: 同一模型在不同供应商间质量、延迟、可用性、价格差异显著；高价供应商一致地更快，但价格不能可靠预测质量或可用性；供应商可行性具有任务选择性——某部署在知识任务上接近正常，而在多步推理上严重退化。简单实测地图策略可实现质量匹配下的降本并避开退化端点。FACET在松弛部署假设下可容忍不完美任务分配与稀疏反馈；系统性评估器偏差暴露了质量信号信任边界，可通过真值探针或审计缓解。真实在线运行确认认证可将真实流量从高价的premium锚点迁移至显著更便宜的认证端点。
AI.conclusion: 市场感知的LLM路由不仅要衡量"用哪个模型"，还必须衡量"由谁提供服务"。供应商维度的实测认证能在质量等价约束下带来真实成本节约，同时需对地图漂移、任务选择性与评估器偏差保持失败安全的工程设计。

title: GRFBrain: Graph-Structured Rectified Flows for EEG Dynamic Modeling
summary: Forecasting time-varying functional connectivity from electroencephalography (EEG) requires modeling both history-dependent trends and structured variability across channels. Conditional flow matching provides a framework for distributional forecasting, yet it remains unclear whether graph-informed source distributions offer practical advantages over isotropic noise and strong deterministic predictors. We introduce a graph-structured residual flow framework that separates conditional mean prediction from stochastic residual transport. A history-only predictor estimates the future connectivity graph, while a graph Gaussian source encodes dependencies derived from past connectivity through a Laplacian-based covariance. A conditional velocity field transports source samples to future graph residuals, with transport time explicitly distinguished from physical EEG time. Our study identifies the conditions and controls needed to distinguish useful residual transport from improvements attributable to deterministic prediction, learned representations, and sampling effects.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出图结构化残差流框架，将条件均值预测与随机残差传输分离，用以预测EEG时变功能连接，并厘清图信息源分布相对各向同性噪声与确定性预测器的实际优势及所需控制条件。
AI.motivation: EEG时变功能连接预测需同时建模历史依赖趋势与跨通道结构化变异。条件流匹配虽可用于分布预测，但图信息源分布是否优于各向同性噪声和强确定性预测器尚不明确。
AI.method: 框架将条件均值预测与随机残差传输分离：仅用历史预测器估计未来连接图；基于拉普拉斯协方差构建图高斯源，从过去连接编码依赖；条件速度场将源样本传输至未来图残差，并显式区分传输时间与物理EEG时间。
AI.result: 研究识别出区分有效残差传输与源自确定性预测、学习表征及采样效应的改进所需的条件与控制措施。
AI.conclusion: 需通过严格条件与控制才能判定图结构化残差传输是否带来实质增益，避免将确定性预测、表征学习或采样效应误认为流匹配的贡献。

title: Topological Coherence for Self-evolving Multi-agent Systems
summary: Complex tasks inherently couple workflow structure, agent responsibility, collaboration, and memory access: task regions delimit responsibility and tool scope, cross-region dependencies give rise to handoffs, and ownership boundaries delimit private and selectively shared memory. Existing methods can jointly optimize agent and communication structures, yet such optimization does not by itself require responsibility, handoff, and memory boundaries to remain consistent with task dependencies. We term this requirement topological coherence. We introduce TOCOMAS, a Topology-Coherent Multi-Agent System. TOCOMAS grounds a task graph in tool interfaces, organizes compatible task nodes into reusable responsibility domains, and derives dependency-induced and profile-conditioned collaboration together with boundary-regulated memory visibility. During online self-evolution, TOCOMAS proposes coupled changes to agent, collaboration, and memory policies, retaining for subsequent tasks only candidates that satisfy structural constraints and improve evaluated reward. Across BBEH, WorkBench, SWE-Bench-Verified, and CoMemBench, TOCOMAS improves task success over baselines across backbones. CoMemBench also shows gains over the self-evolving baseline in verified progress, handoffs, and memory isolation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出TOCOMAS，一种"拓扑一致"的多智能体系统，将任务图锚定于工具接口，构建可复用责任域并推导依赖驱动、画像约束的协作与边界受控的记忆可见性，在线自演化时仅保留满足结构约束且提升奖励的候选。
AI.motivation: 复杂任务中工作流结构、智能体责任、协作与记忆访问相互耦合：任务区域界定责任与工具范围，跨区域依赖产生交接，所有权边界决定私有与选择性共享记忆。现有方法虽可联合优化智能体与通信结构，但这种优化本身并不要求责任、交接与记忆边界与任务依赖保持一致，作者将这一要求称为"拓扑一致性"，并以此为核心动机。
AI.method: TOCOMAS将任务图奠基在工具接口之上，把兼容的任务节点组织为可复用的责任域，并由此推导出依赖驱动且受画像条件约束的协作关系，以及由边界调控的记忆可见性。在线自演化阶段，系统对智能体、协作与记忆策略提出耦合的修改提案，仅保留满足结构约束且评估奖励提升的候选方案用于后续任务。
AI.result: 在BBEH、WorkBench、SWE-Bench-Verified与CoMemBench四个基准上，TOCOMAS在多种骨干模型上相较基线均提升任务成功率。CoMemBench还显示其在已验证进展、交接次数与记忆隔离方面优于自演化基线。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，以拓扑一致性为约束统一设计责任、协作与记忆边界，能有效提升多智能体系统在复杂任务上的表现与自演化质量，验证了结构约束与奖励筛选相结合的自演化机制的有效性。

title: BrainNet Studio: A Unified Toolkit for Brain Network Construction, Intelligent Analysis, and Visualization
summary: Brain networks characterize structural and functional relationships among brain regions and support research on cognition, brain disorders, and brain-computer interfaces. Their time-varying topology and higher-order spatiotemporal dependencies are not adequately represented by conventional static networks. Existing tools primarily focus on static connectomes and provide limited integration of dynamic network modeling with modern graph and sequence learning methods. We present BrainNet Studio, an integrated toolkit for static and dynamic brain network analysis. It provides a unified workflow encompassing network construction, feature extraction, predictive modeling, candidate biomarker identification, visualization, and assisted interpretation. The toolkit integrates 27 algorithms, including deep learning, graph neural networks, and spatiotemporal sequence models, to support classification and the identification of discriminative brain regions and connections. A large language model generates researcher-verifiable summaries of functional connectivity, structural connectivity, and structure-function coupling at individual and group levels. Within a consistent computational framework, users can configure analytical tasks, compare methods, inspect outputs, and extend functionality without repeatedly assembling application-specific pipelines. BrainNet Studio provides a practical and extensible platform for connectome analysis in cognitive neuroscience, exploratory studies of brain disorders, and brain-computer interfaces. The toolkit is publicly available at https://github.com/xbrainnet/Brainnet-Studio.

AI.tldr: BrainNet Studio：面向静态与动态脑网络分析的集成工具包，含27种算法与大模型辅助解读。
AI.motivation: 脑网络刻画脑区间结构与功能关系，但传统静态网络难以刻画时变拓扑与高阶时空依赖；现有工具多聚焦静态连接组，缺乏动态建模与图/序列学习的整合。
AI.method: 提出统一工作流工具包BrainNet Studio，涵盖网络构建、特征提取、预测建模、候选生物标志物识别、可视化与辅助解读；集成27种算法，包括深度学习、图神经网络与时序/时空序列模型，并用大语言模型生成可核验的总结。
AI.result: 支持分类任务及判别性脑区与连接的识别；可在个体与群体层面生成功能连接、结构连接及结构-功能耦合的可核验摘要；用户可在统一框架内配置任务、比较方法、检查输出并扩展功能。
AI.conclusion: BrainNet Studio为认知神经科学、脑疾病探索性研究与脑机接口提供实用且可扩展的连接组分析平台，已开源。

title: KV-Kaizen: Learning Context-Adaptive Cache Compression Choices
summary: As the context size of text processed with an LLM grows, the size of KV caches can outstrip the memory allocated for the original model weights. This impacts LLM throughput negatively, since decoding is memory-bound and decode cost grows with cache size. Recent work alleviates this bottleneck by discarding the least relevant tokens. Eviction introduces a tension, since a one-off decision to discard content may prove detrimental later. Instead, we focus on alternative choices that can lead to cache compression without evicting tokens. We achieve this by learning a selector that is able to produce, based on context, a per-layer cache configuration towards an overall compression budget. The selector operates along three axes: sharing one cache across layers (depth), caching at fewer bits (precision), or truncating the low-rank latent cache representations (rank). We call the resulting method KV-Kaizen, for the many small per-layer choices it compounds. We observe that these interventions taken independently and uniformly over all layers limit achievable compression because they degrade accuracy. Crucially, composing them locally and adaptively to the context can instead preserve accuracy while achieving large memory savings. At inference, the selector runs once, before pre-fill. In evaluations on instruction following and reasoning tasks, our selectors reach the Pareto frontier of accuracy against cache size, against learning-free and post-hoc baselines. On long-context tasks, KV-Kaizen improves on eviction and can be composed with it, reaching a 32x smaller decode-time cache on a 14B model while preserving accuracy. A 4x cache size reduction incurs no accuracy degradation from 7B parameters up, and a compressed model is more accurate than a smaller uncompressed one with the same cache size. Together, these findings support pre-training large models and compressing them only afterwards.

AI.tldr: 提出 KV-Kaizen，一种不丢弃 token 的 KV 缓存压缩方法：通过学习一个基于上下文的逐层选择器，在深度共享、低比特精度、低秩截断三个轴上组合压缩配置，在保持精度的同时大幅降低显存占用。
AI.motivation: 随着 LLM 处理上下文增大，KV 缓存可能超过原模型权重占用；解码是访存受限的，缓存越大解码开销越高。已有方案丢弃最不相关的 token（eviction），但一次性丢弃可能在后续造成不可逆的信息损失，因此需要一种不依赖逐出、能压缩缓存的替代方案。
AI.method: 学习一个选择器（selector），根据上下文在预填充前运行一次，输出每层缓存配置，在总压缩预算约束下沿三个轴做选择：跨层共享同一缓存（深度）、以更少比特缓存（精度）、截断低秩潜在缓存表示（秩）。核心思想是局部、自适应地组合这些干预，而非在所有层上统一施加；方法命名为 KV-Kaizen。
AI.result: 在指令跟随与推理任务上，选择器在精度—缓存大小上达到 Pareto 前沿，优于无需学习和事后（post-hoc）基线。长上下文任务中优于逐出方法并可与之组合：14B 模型上解码时缓存缩小 32 倍且保持精度；7B 以上参数下 4 倍缓存缩减无精度损失；相同缓存大小下，压缩模型比更小的未压缩模型更准。
AI.conclusion: 统一、均匀的压缩干预会因精度退化而限制可达压缩率，而按上下文局部自适应组合深度、精度、秩三个维度可在显著节省显存的同时保持精度，支持“先训练大模型、之后再压缩”的思路。

title: Which Attention Heads are like the Human Head? Not the Ones that Compute
summary: Brain-AI alignment is often interpreted as a sign that model and brain perform similar computations. Whether the aligned units are causally involved in model computation is rarely checked. On an abstract pattern-completion task (AAABAAA $\rightarrow$ B), we compare LLM attention-head representations with human EEG and test how ablating those heads affects task performance. Alignment and causation dissociate: brain-aligned heads contribute to performance, but their removal is substantially less disruptive than removal of heads selected via attribution patching. We compare two head sets that prior interpretability work defines without reference to the brain: concept vectors (CVs), which represent abstract patterns across formats, and function vectors (FVs), selected for their contribution to correct-answer prediction. Brain alignment shows little association with FV scores, while its association with CV scores varies across models. Among brain-aligned heads, we find recurring attention profiles: one emphasizes distinctive elements (novelty heads), the other repeating elements (repetition heads). The novelty family tracks salience and attends to the same elements that humans look at, yet its removal is less damaging than random ablation on average. Repetition heads contribute modestly to performance and are associated with abstract-pattern representation (CVs). Across 17 models spanning 3B-72B parameters, FV-ranked removal is substantially more disruptive than brain-ranked removal. Brain alignment thus captures how the model reads the stimulus, and only faintly captures how it represents the pattern and solves the task.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过抽象模式补全任务，对比LLM注意力头表征与人类EEG，并做消融实验，发现"大脑对齐"与"因果贡献"可分离：脑对齐的头对性能有贡献，但移除后的破坏远小于基于归因（FV）选出的头。
AI.motivation: 学界常将Brain-AI对齐解读为模型与大脑执行相似计算，但很少检验这些对齐单元是否对模型计算有因果作用。作者希望厘清"对齐"究竟反映模型如何读取刺激，还是反映其如何表征模式并解决问题。
AI.method: 在抽象模式补全任务（AAABAAA→B）上，将LLM注意力头表征与人类EEG对齐比较，并对这些头进行消融以检验对任务性能的因果影响。同时比较两类不依赖脑数据的头集合：概念向量（CV，跨格式表征抽象模式）与功能向量（FV，按对正确答案预测的贡献选出）。并在17个3B–72B参数模型上重复验证。
AI.result: 对齐与因果分离：脑对齐头虽有贡献，但移除后的破坏显著小于FV归因选出的头。脑对齐与FV分数几乎无关，与CV分数的关联因模型而异。脑对齐头中存在两类重复出现的注意力模式：新颖性头（关注显著/独特元素）与重复性头（关注重复元素）。新颖性头追踪显著性、注视与人类相同的元素，但其移除平均而言比随机消融破坏更小；重复性头对性能贡献不大，且与抽象模式表征（CV）相关。跨17个模型，FV排序消融的破坏性远大于脑排序消融。
AI.conclusion: Brain-AI对齐主要捕捉模型"如何读取刺激"，仅微弱反映模型"如何表征模式并解决任务"，因此不能简单将脑对齐等同于相似计算或因果机制。

title: Diagnosing and Improving Probabilistic Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed as decision assistants who must reason probabilistically from available evidence under explicit decision costs. We propose a decision-theoretic framework that decomposes LLMs' decision loss into two components: forming accurate beliefs from provided evidence and translating those beliefs into actions that optimize a provided utility function. Using a synthetic benchmark with known ground truth, we apply the decomposition to characterize probabilistic reasoning in frontier and open-sourced models. We further evaluate whether RL interventions targeting beliefs, decisions, or both improve these components across three domains, whether improvements transfer across components and elicitation formats, and whether decision performance can improve without improvement in belief formation. We find that targeting one component of probabilistic reasoning redistributes decision loss, improving the target without necessarily transferring to others, and that jointly targeting belief formation and decision-making improves both but hinges on matched formats between training and evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出决策论框架，将LLM的决策损失分解为信念形成与信念到行动转化两部分，并通过合成基准和RL干预实验刻画前沿与开源模型的概率推理能力。
AI.motivation: LLM被日益用作决策助手，需在明确的决策成本下依据证据进行概率推理，但其决策损失的来源尚不清晰，需区分信念形成与决策转化两个环节以针对性改进。
AI.method: 提出决策论框架，将决策损失分解为"从证据形成准确信念"和"将信念转化为优化给定效用函数的行动"两部分；使用具有已知真值的合成基准，对前沿与开源模型进行概率推理刻画；并设计针对信念、决策或二者的RL干预，在三个领域评估各组件改进、跨组件与跨引导格式的迁移性，以及决策性能能否在信念不改善时提升。
AI.result: 针对概率推理单一组件的干预会重新分配决策损失，能改善目标组件但未必迁移至其他组件；联合针对信念形成与决策制定可同时改善二者，但依赖于训练与评估格式的匹配。
AI.conclusion: LLM概率推理的两个组件可分离且相互影响，单一组件优化存在损失再分配与迁移受限问题，联合优化需格式匹配，为决策助手的针对性训练与评估提供依据。

title: HARISSA: Inference-Time Self-Checks for Efficient and Safe Local Language Model Deployment
summary: Running a language model locally offers advantages in privacy, latency, and cost, but local hardware fits only small models, which are less capable than frontier models. The usual remedy for a hard query, escalating it to a cloud model, gives up the privacy and cost advantages of running locally. A deployment that stays local faces two decisions for hard queries instead. First, it can spend more computation on a query, e.g., reasoning before answering, which raises accuracy at a cost in latency, so it must decide which queries are worth the extra computation (efficiency). Second, some queries are beyond the local model, and delivering a wrong answer is worse than deferring the query to a human in the loop, so it must decide which answers are safe to deliver (safety). We show that both decisions can be made from the model's own hidden states. The prefill state, computed before any token is generated, predicts whether the model will answer correctly, and the answer state, at the end of the generated answer, predicts whether that answer is correct. HARISSA fine-tunes the model so that both states predict correctness, then makes both decisions with one policy that cascades through the ways of answering from cheapest to most expensive, skipping a way the prefill state predicts will fail and deferring the query when the answer it stops with is predicted wrong. On a device running a single model, HARISSA is within one accuracy point of chain-of-thought at 2.7 times lower latency. On a server holding four sizes of one model, HARISSA is more accurate than the FrugalGPT and Self-REF cascades at the same latency, and at the same deferral rate the answer state leaves fewer wrong answers than the standard confidence signals in five of six task and setting pairs.

AI.tldr: HARISSA利用模型自身隐藏状态（prefill状态与answer状态）同时预测答案正确性，通过级联策略在本地部署中兼顾效率与安全。
AI.motivation: 本地部署语言模型在隐私、延迟和成本上有优势，但本地硬件只能运行小模型，能力弱于前沿大模型。常规做法是将困难查询升级到云端，但这牺牲了本地的隐私与成本优势。因此本地部署对困难查询面临两个决策：一是效率问题，即哪些查询值得消耗额外计算（如推理链）；二是安全问题，即哪些答案可安全交付，而非交给人工处理。
AI.method: 作者提出HARISSA，利用模型自身隐藏状态做出上述两个决策。prefill状态（生成任何token前计算）预测模型是否能答对；answer状态（生成答案结束时）预测该答案是否正确。HARISSA对模型进行微调，使这两种状态都能预测正确性，再用单一策略做两个决策：按从最便宜到最昂贵的解答方式级联，跳过prefill状态预测会失败的方式，当最终停止的答案被预测为错误时则延迟该查询。
AI.result: 在单模型设备上，HARISSA与思维链准确率相差不到一个百分点，但延迟降低2.7倍。在持有同一模型四种尺寸的服务器上，相同时延时HARISSA比FrugalGPT和Self-REF级联更准确；在相同延迟率下，answer状态在六组任务与设置对中的五组里，比标准置信信号留下更少错误答案。
AI.conclusion: 模型隐藏状态可用于同时对本地部署中的困难查询做出效率与安全的双重决策，HARISSA在准确率、延迟与错误率上均优于现有级联方法，验证了该方法的有效性。

title: PE-EK-PINN: Physics Embedding with Evolving Kernel for Scalable Physics-Informed Neural Networks
summary: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) embed governing equations into deep learning, but enforce them only through loss residuals, leaving highly oscillatory wave behavior to be discovered by optimization. As a result, methods that achieve relative $L_2$ errors below $10^{-3}$ on standard manufactured Helmholtz benchmarks can fail on practical radiation problems involving singular excitations, absorbing boundaries, and wave fields spanning tens of wavelengths. Architectural physics embedding addresses this limitation by factorizing the field into analytically derived oscillatory kernels and learnable envelopes. However, the kernel dictionary must be manually constructed and scales with the number of elementary units, growing exponentially with the depth of hierarchically structured systems such as antenna arrays and metasurfaces. We propose PE-EK-PINN (Physics Embedded with Evolving Kernels), which treats physics kernels as reusable learned representations rather than fixed analytical inputs. A converged subsystem field is frozen and promoted to an evolved kernel, whose transformed copies are reused to represent higher-level configurations without deriving new governing equations. The resulting hierarchy makes the peak number of active kernels independent of system size and reduces cumulative training cost from $O(N)$ to $O(\log N)$. Experiments on dipole arrays, composite line-source geometries, and cross arrays demonstrate the dramatic training cost reduction, while achieving a reduced or comparable relative $L_2$ error. One notable example is PE-EK-PINN solves a $256$-dipole array more than 30 times faster than direct PE-PINN.

AI.tldr: 提出PE-EK-PINN，将物理核作为可复用的学习表示，通过冻结已收敛子系统场并升格为进化核，实现层次化复用，使峰值活跃核数与系统规模无关，并将累计训练成本从O(N)降至O(log N)。
AI.motivation: 传统PINN仅通过损失残差施加控制方程，高度振荡波行为依赖优化发现，在辐射问题（奇异激励、吸收边界、跨数十波长波场）上即使标准Helmholtz基准L2误差低于10^-3也易失效。架构式物理嵌入通过解析振荡核与可学习包络分解场来缓解，但核字典需手工构造，且随基本单元数增长，对天线阵列、超表面等层次结构系统呈指数增长。
AI.method: PE-EK-PINN将物理核视为可复用的学习表示而非固定解析输入：将已收敛的子系统场冻结并升格为进化核，其变换副本被复用以表示更高层配置，无需重新推导控制方程，从而形成层次化核复用结构。
AI.result: 在偶极子阵列、复合线源几何与十字阵列上实验显示训练成本显著降低，相对L2误差降低或相当；例如求解256偶极子阵列比直接PE-PINN快30倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 通过进化核的层次化复用，PE-EK-PINN使峰值活跃核数独立于系统规模，累计训练成本由O(N)降至O(log N)，在大规模辐射与阵列问题中实现显著加速并保持或改善精度。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Skill Optimization via Cross-Harness Adaptation
summary: An agent skill is a reusable, actionable natural-language artifact that guides an agent to perform a task effectively under a given harness. Recent studies have explored the optimization of agent skills, contributing to a growing collection of publicly available skills spanning diverse tasks, domains, and harnesses. Despite millions of publicly shared skills, existing skill optimization methods largely overlook this accumulated knowledge, instead relying solely on expensive agent rollouts to iteratively refine skills for a target task. To address this, we propose \textbf{Retrieval-Augmented Skill Optimization (RASO)}, a framework that leverages an external skill corpus as prior knowledge throughout skill optimization. RASO retrieves relevant knowledge from existing skills and adapts it to the target task and harness via Cross-Harness Adaptation, accounting for mismatches in both domain and harness. RASO comprises two complementary stages: \textbf{Retrieval-Augmented Skill Initialization (RASI)} constructs a knowledge-grounded initial skill without requiring agent rollouts, while \textbf{Retrieval-Augmented Skill Update (RASU)} iteratively refines the skill by retrieving external knowledge guided by execution feedback. Across four agent benchmarks and two models, extensive experiments show that RASO consistently outperforms baselines without retrieval-augmented skill initialization and updating.

AI.tldr: 提出RASO框架，利用外部技能语料库作为先验知识，通过跨载体适配进行检索增强的技能初始化与迭代更新，在四个基准和两个模型上稳定优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有技能优化方法忽视了海量公开技能中积累的知识，只依赖昂贵的智能体rollout迭代精炼，成本高且未利用先验。
AI.method: RASO包含两阶段：RASI在无rollout条件下检索相关技能知识构建知识支撑的初始技能；RASU在执行反馈引导下迭代检索外部知识精炼技能。二者均通过Cross-Harness Adaptation适配目标任务的域与harness不匹配。
AI.result: 在四个智能体基准和两个模型上，RASO持续优于无检索增强初始化与更新的基线。
AI.conclusion: 将外部技能语料库作为先验知识贯穿优化过程可有效提升技能优化效果，为智能体技能优化提供新范式。

title: UserProxyBench: Evaluating LLM User Simulators for Agent Benchmarks and Training
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to the Agentic AI Benchmarks and Applications for Enterprise Tasks Workshop (AABA4ET) at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Interactive agent benchmarks and multi-turn reinforcement learning increasingly place a second language model in the role of the user. This simulated user controls what information the agent receives and when, yet current benchmarks score only the agent and do not directly measure whether the user correctly executed its assigned role. We introduce UserProxyBench, an evaluation layer over the tau-bench family, and the User Fidelity Score (UFS), which measures adherence to the benchmark's private user instructions using task-grounded rubric criteria scored independently of agent success. Holding the agent fixed at GPT-5.5 and varying only the user proxy across 375 enterprise tasks changes mean task reward by 15.2 points, while 24.4% of successful episodes contain a user-specification violation. The dominant failure is premature disclosure: users provide information before it is requested. This behavior has little effect on task reward, yet among successful episodes it causes the agent to make 1.06 fewer tool calls on average, changing the interaction being evaluated while preserving the reward. Finally, across seven proxies we identify an empirical cost-fidelity frontier, enabling practitioners to select the least expensive simulator that satisfies a required fidelity level.

AI.tldr: 提出 UserProxyBench 评测层与 User Fidelity Score (UFS)，用于衡量 tau-bench 类基准中"模拟用户"是否忠实执行其私有指令；发现仅更换用户代理即可使平均任务奖励变化 15.2 分，且 24.4% 的成功回合存在用户规格违背，主要失败模式为过早披露信息。
AI.motivation: 交互式智能体基准与多轮强化学习日益将第二个语言模型置于"用户"角色，该模拟用户决定智能体何时获得何种信息。然而现有基准只对智能体打分，不直接衡量用户是否正确地执行了其被赋予的角色，导致用户侧的不忠实行为成为未被测量的混淆因素。
AI.method: 构建 UserProxyBench：一个叠加在 tau-bench 系列之上的评测层；并提出 User Fidelity Score (UFS)，依据基准的私有用户指令，用任务锚定的评分标准（rubric）独立于智能体成功与否来衡量用户忠实度。实验中将智能体固定为 GPT-5.5，仅变化用户代理，覆盖 375 个企业任务，并对比七个不同的用户代理。
AI.result: 仅更换用户代理即可使平均任务奖励变动 15.2 分；24.4% 的成功回合包含用户规格违背；主导失败模式是过早披露（在信息被请求前即给出）；该行为对任务奖励影响很小，但在成功回合中平均使智能体少调用 1.06 次工具，改变了被评测的交互过程却保持了奖励不变；在七个用户代理上识别出一条经验性的"成本—忠实度前沿"。
AI.conclusion: 用户代理的忠实度是当前交互式智能体评测中一个被系统性忽视的变量，会显著影响测量结果与交互轨迹；UFS 提供了独立于智能体成败的用户侧度量。所识别的成本—忠实度前沿可帮助实践者在满足所需忠实度水平的前提下选择最经济的模拟用户。

title: Probability is Not Enough: Exploring and Counting Divergent Tokens for Reasoning Uncertainty Quantification in LLMs
comment: 25 pages, 16 figures, 8 tables. Under peer review
summary: As the chain-of-thought reasoning capabilities of large language models improve, evaluating and calibrating their reasoning confidence is becoming increasingly important for quantifying the uncertainty of their answers. Current methods for estimating the confidence of large language models are generally based on probabilities of selected key tokens, but the underlying mechanism remains unclear. Our pilot study finds that replacing selected token probabilities with coarse substitutes can also improve calibration, motivating us to further explore effective signals of model confidence. We introduce Divergent Token Confidence (DTC), a framework that estimates confidence by counting tokens at which two models strongly disagree during decoding. DTC identifies these divergent tokens using the Jensen-Shannon divergence between next-token distributions evaluated along the same reasoning trajectory. We find that their count is almost negatively associated with answer accuracy, thereby serving as a simple yet effective signal for uncertainty quantification. DTC supports both white-box and black-box evaluation using auxiliary models, without explicit training and affecting the generation process. Experiments across multiple model families and six mathematical benchmarks demonstrate improved calibration over probability-based and verbalized baselines. Under white-box evaluation, the count-only estimator achieves an average expected calibration error of 13.0%, compared with 32.7%-42.4% for standard full-sequence confidence methods. In black-box settings, it also improves calibration over the original verbalized scores. For example, mean expected calibration error falls from 32.1%-40.2% to 13.7%-16.3% on DeepSeek-V3.2. These findings provide new insights for improving reasoning uncertainty quantification in large language models. The code is released at https://github.com/szu-tera/DTC.git.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分歧Token置信度（DTC）框架，通过统计两个模型在同一推理轨迹上下一词分布差异较大（Jensen-Shannon散度）的Token数量来估计大模型推理置信度，无需训练且不干扰生成，在6个数学基准上显著优于基于概率与语言化置信度的基线。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型思维链推理能力提升，量化其答案不确定性变得愈发重要。现有置信度估计方法多基于所选关键Token的概率，但其内在机制尚不清晰；作者预实验发现用粗糙的替代量替换所选Token概率也能改善校准，说明存在更有效的置信度信号值得探索。
AI.method: 提出DTC框架：沿同一条推理轨迹，对两个模型（或模型与辅助模型）的下一词分布计算Jensen-Shannon散度，识别二者强烈分歧的Token并计数，以该计数作为不确定性量化信号。方法支持白盒与黑盒评估，使用辅助模型即可，无需显式训练，且不影响生成过程。
AI.result: 分歧Token数量与答案准确率几乎呈负相关。跨多个模型家族和6个数学基准的实验显示：白盒评估下，仅用计数的估计器平均期望校准误差为13.0%，而标准全序列置信度方法为32.7%–42.4%；黑盒设置下相对原始语言化分数也有改善，例如DeepSeek-V3.2上的平均期望校准误差从32.1%–40.2%降至13.7%–16.3%。
AI.conclusion: DTC以模型间分歧Token计数作为简单而有效的置信度信号，在无需训练、不干扰生成的前提下实现了较优校准，为改进大语言模型推理不确定性量化提供了新思路，代码已开源。

title: Character Training for Risk-Averse Agents
summary: Risk aversion in resources could prevent misaligned AI agents from causing catastrophic harm. Misaligned but risk-averse agents would tend to favor safer strategies like making deals with humans over riskier strategies like rebelling. We train agents to be risk averse through character training, finding that persona traits provide a robust mechanism for instilling risk preferences. To do this, we construct a model constitution describing constant absolute risk aversion (CARA) over an agent's resources and instill it through on-policy distillation. Despite never seeing the benchmark's decision format during training, character-trained models are competitive with baselines trained directly on it, and generalise better than them out of distribution on two of our four models. We also modulate different aspects of the constitution, finding that token budget and model choice are the most influential aspect of character training to instill risk aversion. We conclude from these results that character training is a promising and scalable way to instil broad dispositions, which we can use to our advantage in mitigating risk from misaligned AI agents.

AI.tldr: 通过"角色训练"（character training）在策略蒸馏中灌输风险规避偏好，可作为一种可扩展的方法降低失准AI代理的灾难性风险。
AI.motivation: 失准的AI代理可能造成灾难性危害，而风险规避倾向可使其偏好与人类达成交易等更安全策略，而非反叛等高风险策略。因此，如何稳健地为代理灌输风险偏好成为关键问题。
AI.method: 构建一份描述代理资源上的恒定绝对风险规避（CARA）的模型"宪法"（model constitution），并通过在策略蒸馏（on-policy distillation）进行角色训练以灌输风险规避。随后调制宪法的不同方面，分析哪些因素对风险规避的灌输影响最大。
AI.result: 角色训练模型在训练中从未见过基准的决策格式，却在表现上与直接在基准上训练的基线模型相当；在四个模型中的两个上，其分布外泛化能力优于基线。调制实验表明，token预算与模型选择是角色训练灌输风险规避影响最大的因素。
AI.conclusion: 角色训练是一种有前景且可扩展的灌输广泛性情倾向的方式，可用于缓解失准AI代理带来的风险。

title: NeuronEye: Query-Guided Visual Concept Activation for Vision-Language Reasoning
summary: Current vision-language models (VLMs) encode visual information in dense hidden states where object identity, spatial layout, and local attributes are implicitly entangled rather than explicitly disentangled, limiting their ability to isolate and modulate the specific visual evidence required by a given language query. Inspired by sparse population coding and top-down modulation in biological vision, we introduce NeuronEye, a plug-in framework that constructs a sparse, concept-level neuron vocabulary from intermediate VLM representations and selectively activates query-relevant visual concepts during inference. NeuronEye decomposes vision-token states into an overcomplete sparse basis organized by concept-level clusters, uses the language query to activate relevant clusters and localize the patches where selected concepts are expressed, and injects the focused evidence back into vision tokens. A complementary suppression mechanism attenuates dominant perceptual directions to preserve weaker but relevant cues. All operations run in a single forward pass over a frozen VLM backbone. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B, NeuronEye raises CV-Bench overall accuracy by +3.1 with gains of +9.5 on Distance, and improves BLINK Multi-view by +8.3, with similar trends on LLaVA-1.6-7B. These results suggest that sparse neuron vocabularies can serve not only as post-hoc interpretability tools but also as active interfaces for concept-level visual reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出 NeuronEye 插件框架，从 VLM 中间表示构建稀疏概念级神经元词表，通过语言查询选择性激活相关视觉概念，在单次前向传播中增强视觉证据，显著提升视觉推理基准性能。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉语言模型(VLM)将视觉信息编码于稠密隐藏状态中，物体身份、空间布局与局部属性相互纠缠而非显式解耦，导致模型难以隔离和调制特定语言查询所需的视觉证据。
AI.method: 受生物视觉中稀疏群体编码与自上而下调制的启发，NeuronEye 从 VLM 中间表示构建概念级稀疏神经元词表；将视觉 token 状态分解为按概念簇组织的过完备稀疏基；用语言查询激活相关簇并定位所选概念表达的图像块；将聚焦证据注入回视觉 token；辅以抑制机制削弱主导感知方向以保留较弱但相关的线索；全部操作在冻结 VLM 主干上单次前向完成。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上，CV-Bench 总体准确率提升 +3.1（Distance 子项 +9.5），BLINK Multi-view 提升 +8.3；LLaVA-1.6-7B 上呈相似趋势。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏神经元词表不仅可作为事后可解释性工具，还能作为概念级视觉推理的主动接口。

title: Stochastic World Models for Verifying Vision-Based Neural Feedback Systems
summary: Verifying a vision-based neural feedback system requires a model of the observations its controller acts upon. Such a model must capture the variation the sensor produces, while remaining tractable for closed-loop analysis. Generative adversarial networks (GANs) have served as perception surrogates, but they are large, reproduce complex scenes poorly, and are hard to verify. We explore stochastic world models as a richer class of perception surrogates. We train a world model with physically grounded latents, built from operations that standard verifiers bound. It reproduces held-out frames more faithfully than GAN surrogates with up to 130 times as many parameters. To verify these surrogates, we develop a procedure that combines falsification, adaptive refinement, symbolic, and backward analyses. On an emergency braking benchmark with a GAN surrogate, our procedure resolves the entire state space, 38% of which the state-of-the-art verifier left unresolved. On the RGB version of the benchmark, where no verification results have previously been reported, our procedure resolves over 80% of the state space with a world model surrogate.

AI.tldr: 本文探索以随机世界模型替代GAN作为感知代理，并提出了结合证伪、自适应精化、符号与反向分析的验证流程，在紧急制动基准上大幅提升了状态空间的可解比例。
AI.motivation: 基于视觉的神经反馈系统验证需要对其控制器所依赖的观测建模。该模型须刻画传感器变化，同时保持闭环分析的可处理性。GAN作为感知代理存在参数规模大、复杂场景重建质量差、难以验证等问题，因此需要更丰富且可验证的感知代理类别。
AI.method: 采用具有物理依据隐变量的随机世界模型作为感知代理，其运算由标准验证器可界定；并设计了一套验证流程，将证伪、自适应精化、符号分析与反向分析相结合。
AI.result: 世界模型对留出帧的重建比参数量多达130倍的GAN代理更忠实。在GAN代理的紧急制动基准上，该流程解决了全部状态空间，其中38%是当前最先进验证器未能解决的；在尚无验证结果的RGB版本基准上，使用世界模型代理解决了超过80%的状态空间。
AI.conclusion: 随机世界模型可作为比GAN更忠实、更可验证的感知代理，配合所提验证流程能显著扩展神经反馈系统可验证的状态空间范围，并在RGB基准上首次给出验证结果。

title: Thinking Before Thinking: Scaling Agentic Inference Through Meta-Reasoning
summary: As agents take on longer and more complex problems, controlling the execution becomes a task in its own right. Each step in the run brings new control choices, like which partial work to build on, whether to start fresh, or when to stop. We introduce agentic meta-reasoning, an inference-time harness that makes these choices an explicit and structured reasoning process. Workers carry out the task-level computation, while a controller consolidates what the run has established, explores next options, assesses what each option is worth under the remaining budget, and dispatches the chosen work with context drawn from persistent memory. Between decisions the controller carries only a compact account of the run rather than replaying its full history. Our baselines span production coding agents and research harnesses, together with a Direct Control Agent using the same workers and compute budget allowance. On ProgramBench, which tests long-horizon agentic capability through program reconstruction, meta-reasoning achieves 71.5% with GPT-5.5 against 58.0% for Codex; with Opus 4.8 it achieves 67.2% against 65.5% for Claude Code. On the other benchmarks, spanning abstract reasoning, multi-domain long-horizon reasoning, and proof generation, it gains between 3.6 and 4.2 points over direct control, averaged across three frontier models. It keeps improving over the tested budget ranges where direct control plateaus, though its overhead can hurt at small budgets. Artifact-graph analysis reveals more reuse of earlier work, higher coverage of correct solutions in most settings, and nonuniform gains in final selection. These results indicate that spending computation on structured control becomes more important as agents scale to longer runs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“代理式元推理”（agentic meta-reasoning），一种推理期控制框架：由worker执行任务级计算，controller显式进行结构化控制决策（整合已有进展、探索选项、评估预算价值、调度工作），并以持久记忆中的紧凑状态而非完整历史作为决策依据。
AI.motivation: 随着代理处理更长、更复杂的问题，控制执行本身成为一项独立任务。每一步都会产生新的控制选择（如基于哪些中间成果继续、是否重新开始、何时停止），现有方法缺乏对这些选择进行显式、结构化推理的机制。
AI.method: 构建推理期harness，将控制决策显式化为结构化推理过程。Worker负责任务级计算；Controller维护持久记忆，整合运行已确立的结论、探索后续选项、在剩余预算下评估各选项价值，并带上下文调度选定工作。决策之间controller仅保留运行的紧凑描述，而非回放完整历史。基线包括生产级编码代理、研究型harness，以及使用相同worker与计算预算的直接控制代理（Direct Control）。
AI.result: ProgramBench上，配GPT-5.5达71.5%（Codex为58.0%）；配Opus 4.8达67.2%（Claude Code为65.5%）。在抽象推理、多领域长时程推理与证明生成等基准上，跨三个前沿模型平均比直接控制提升3.6–4.2分。在直接控制趋于平台期的预算区间内仍持续改善，但小预算下开销可能带来负面影响。产物图分析显示更多复用早期工作、多数设置下正确解覆盖率更高，最终选择环节收益不均衡。
AI.conclusion: 将计算用于结构化控制，会随着代理扩展到更长运行而变得愈发重要；元推理为长时程代理提供了一种可扩展的控制范式，但需权衡小预算下的开销问题。
